The decline covers social inventories across eight consumption areas, including SHFE warrants, indicating improving near-term supply tightness for aluminium.

title: Murchison Minerals Ltd.: Murchison Prospecting Confirms Strong Nickel, Copper, Cobalt Potential Across the HPM Project in Quebec
summary: Murchison Minerals reported reconnaissance prospecting results at its HPM Quebec Ni-Cu-Co project, confirming widespread nickel and copper mineralization across airborne EM anomalies, with reported assay values including up to ~0.53% Ni and ~0.50% Cu. The update supports further drilling but does not indicate near-term production impacts.

title: Murchison Minerals Ltd.: Murchison Prospecting Confirms Strong Nickel, Copper, Cobalt Potential Across the HPM Project in Quebec
summary: Murchison Minerals reported reconnaissance sampling at its HPM Ni-Cu-Co project in Quebec showing widespread nickel and copper mineralization, with grab samples up to ~0.53% Ni and ~0.50% Cu and conductivity anomalies for follow-up. It is early exploration with no production impact, so price effects are likely limited.

title: UAE-based EGA signs licence deal with Colombian aluminium group
summary: EGA, the UAE aluminium smelter technology provider, signed a license deal with Colombia’s NEO Aluminio to export UAE-developed aluminium smelting technology for a planned Colombian aluminium production facility. The project targets 540,000 tonnes per year, powered by hydroelectricity, and is framed as part of a broader industrial cluster.

title: Atalaya reports Q3 profit jump as copper production breaks record | 19 November 2020
summary: The news references Atalaya results showing copper production breaking records and profit strength, alongside a related update that Atalaya bought a stake in Lara Exploration as a gold-copper mine advances. Improved production/progress at a copper project can raise short-term supply expectations, typically supportive for copper.

title: Shanghai exchange unveils copper futures product
summary: Shanghai International Energy Exchange began trading yuan-denominated bonded copper futures accessible to overseas investors. The product is designed to reflect international copper supply-demand and strengthen China’s role in commodity pricing. Authorities say it will enhance pricing benchmarks in Asia-Pacific and support dual-circulation, potentially improving copper market liquidity and sentiment.

title: Shanghai copper near highest in 2-1/2 yrs on Chinese demand
summary: Shanghai copper is trading near 2-1/2-year highs, supported by strong physical demand in China for production and fabrication. Prices also rise on hopes for U.S. green-energy support under a Biden presidency, a weaker dollar, and stimulus in China. Supply risks include COVID-19 effects and continuing labor strikes in Chile.

title: Doosan Solus starts mass-producing battery copper foil in Hungary
summary: Doosan Solus began commercial mass production of battery copper foil at its Hungary plant and completed the facility last year with 10,000 tons capacity. The firm plans to raise output to 75,000 tons by 2025 to meet growing European demand, citing a supply gap for battery copper foil globally.

title: Copper set for third weekly rise on China demand, supply worries
summary: Reuters reports copper rising for a third straight week, nearing a 2.5-year high, driven by strong physical demand in China and supply worries linked to COVID-19 and Chile labour disputes, plus expectations for U.S. stimulus under Biden. Aluminium also edges higher on tight stocks and a push to key price levels.

title: Shanghai bonded copper stocks added 2,800 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Nonferrous Metals
summary: SMM reported Shanghai bonded copper stocks rose for the 16th straight week, adding 2,800 mt to 369,700 mt as of Nov 20. Buyers stayed reluctant to import because an import-loss issue was still closed, limiting arrivals. Next week, inflows from bonded warehouses may rise as import loss improves and the domestic premium remains high.

title: Shanghai bonded refined nickel stocks fell 500 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Nonferrous Metals
summary: SMM data shows Shanghai bonded refined nickel stocks declined by 500 mt to 23,800 mt as of Nov 20. Some nickel briquettes arrived and were partly shipped to domestic social warehouses, while nearly 500 mt of nickel plates left bonded areas. Further overseas nickel plating shipments are expected late month/early next month, likely boosting inventories again.

title: A number of nickel related enterprises disclosed their performance in the first three quarters, Huayou Cobalt's net profit surged 640% YoY_SMM
summary: Several nickel-related firms disclosed Q1–Q3 2020 performance, led by Huayou Cobalt. Its net profit rose sharply year on year and it is building/expanding ternary precursor, nickel matte and Indonesian wet laterite nickel projects, plus nickel sulphate for battery supply chains. Overall signals supportive for nickel demand outlook.

title: Zambia's copper output increases as country defaults on foreign debt
summary: Zambia, Africa’s second-largest copper miner, produced 646,111 tonnes of copper in the first nine months of 2020, up from 590,321 tonnes a year earlier. The mines ministry attributed the 9.45% increase to factors discussed in the article, even as Zambia is described as defaulting on foreign debt.

title: Brazil audit court greenlights copper deposit auction
summary: Brazil’s audit court has approved a copper-deposit auction, potentially enabling future development of new copper supply. While this is supply-side news, the short-term effect depends on deposit scale and how quickly production could start; without such details, any immediate price pressure is likely limited.

title: UAE Business: EGA signs licence deal with Colombian aluminium group
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) signed a licence deal with Neo Aluminio Colombia to supply smelting technology and technical services for the proposed Galtco low-carbon aluminium facility in Colombia. The project is planned to use hydro power and reach 540,000 tonnes/year, potentially supporting future aluminium output and sentiment.

title: COVID-19 case reported at Highland Valley Copper | iNFOnews | Thompson-Okanagan's News Source
summary: Teck notified employees that a mill maintenance worker at Highland Valley Copper tested positive for COVID-19. The person was last on site Nov. 16 and likely contracted the virus off-site; initial tracing found no close contacts. The company continues disinfection and monitoring, potentially affecting near-term operations.

title: Chile copper miners likely to nix Lundin offer, union says
summary: A report says Chilean copper miners are likely to reject or withdraw a proposed Lundin offer, according to a union statement. The move raises uncertainty around future ownership or investment timelines for copper operations, potentially increasing perceived risk to near-term supply and pressuring copper prices.

title: New tariff codes of aluminium scrap not yet fully implemented _SMM
summary: China introduced new customs tariff code 7602000020 for imported recycled cast aluminium alloy raw materials/scrap, allowing MFN imports at 1.5% (down from 4.6%). However, many ports have yet to recognize the new code and still apply older rates, creating uneven import demand and some market uncertainty.

title: INE launched copper futures contract_SMM | Shanghai Nonferrous Metals
summary: INE launched an international copper futures contract on Nov 19, with initial call-auction participation and early trading volumes. BC 2103 opened near 47,500 yuan/mt, briefly hit 47,550, then fell toward 47,100 after bearish positioning. Theoretical pricing and spreads versus LME and SHFE supported cross-market trading.

title: Annual global output of iron-nickel to rise by 3.4% in 2020 _SMM | Shanghai Nonferrous Metals
summary: SMM forecasts global FeNi output in 2020 will rise to 429,000 mt (Ni content) from 415,000 mt, driven by recovery at Onça Puma and steady NPI plant rates. Improved stainless steel demand supported pricing, while high costs and delays to ANTAM’s East Halmahera (COVID-19) limit supply growth.

title: Copper holds near 29-month high as vaccine good news keeps coming
summary: Copper stayed near a 29-month high after AstraZeneca reported a highly effective COVID-19 vaccine, boosting hopes for global economic recovery and lifting stocks and oil. While the LME copper contract slipped 0.6% on the day, speculative net longs increased. Aluminium and nickel were also slightly lower.

title: Aluminum Can Shortage Affects Northern Michigan Breweries
summary: Northern Michigan breweries report a growing aluminum can shortage. Suppliers warned of tight can availability earlier, with demand rising as consumption shifted to canned drinks. Tariffs and COVID-era consumption pressures are cited as worsening supply constraints, leading some breweries to consider switching back to bottles.

title: Chile's Cochilco sees 2020 copper production and price rising
summary: Chile’s Cochilco expects copper output to rise to about 5.82 million tonnes in 2020 from the prior year and to increase further in 2021. It also projects the annual average copper price to climb to $2.75/lb in 2020 and $2.90/lb in 2021, signaling supportive sentiment for copper.

title: CopperBank Resources Corp: CopperBank Reviews Copper Ridge Exploration Targets
summary: CopperBank reports progress reviewing exploration targets at its Copper Ridge Prospect near the Contact Copper Project in Nevada. It cites historical surface sampling with copper oxide showings and assays up to 12.4% from 2012, and suggests potential drilling to add feedstock to the Contact project’s contemplated cathode output.

title: Copper falls from 29-month high but vaccine good news keeps coming
summary: Copper eased 1.3% from a 29-month peak as the dollar strengthened, though vaccine trial progress and strong U.S. manufacturing supported demand expectations. Despite weaker Chinese momentum noted by analysts, LME copper stayed near Friday highs. The piece also shows aluminium and nickel down modestly amid broadly mixed metal sentiment.

title: Copper surges to fresh two-year high on virus vaccine hopes
summary: The piece is centered on the claim that copper prices surged to a fresh two-year high driven by vaccine hopes. That headline suggests improved near-term growth sentiment and expectations for industrial demand, supporting upside momentum in copper within the next days to weeks.

title: Deep-South to Drill the Haib Copper Project in the South of Namibia
summary: Deep-South Resources says it has contracted Ferrodrill to begin a drilling program at Namibia’s Haib copper project. The company plans 5,000 meters initially to infill high-grade zones and improve grade and tonnage for future resource estimation. Prior intersections and a 2020 PEA support potential project value.

title: London copper gains ground on virus vaccine, demand hopes
summary: Three-month LME copper rose 0.6% as reports of COVID-19 vaccine trial progress improved global sentiment and hopes for industrial demand. Strong U.S. factory data and upbeat Markit PMI readings supported expectations of higher base metals demand. The piece notes mixed moves in Shanghai copper but a generally constructive tone for metals.

title: Caledonian Union insists Paris was in loop over nickel plant bids
summary: Pro-independence groups in New Caledonia dispute claims from France’s overseas minister that Paris was not informed about bids for Vale’s nickel plant. Vale is negotiating with Prony Resources, after rejecting Sofinor’s bid amid protests and planned video talks with Lecornu. No direct production change is stated.

title: Technavio Research: Aluminum Market: Global Demand, Growth Analysis & Opportunity Outlook 2020-2024
summary: Technavio’s press release forecasts growth for the global aluminum market from 2020–2024, citing demand drivers like beverage cans and transportation uses. It also notes that aluminum LME price volatility could hinder growth. The article is primarily an industry outlook with no new near-term catalyst for aluminum prices.

title: Chile expects a bull market for copper next year
summary: Chile’s copper commission Cochilco expects production to edge higher and, importantly, raised its forecast for the copper price to $2.75/lb in 2020 and $2.90/lb in 2021. Officials cite improved demand expectations from China, economic recovery, lower copper inventories, and vaccine rollout prospects, tempered by risks of renewed COVID waves.

title: BIS quality standards needed for aluminium scrap imports into India
summary: Experts urge India to introduce BIS quality standards for aluminium scrap imports to curb sub-standard, dumped scrap that has surged following China’s National Sword policy. India’s scrap import dependency threatens domestic primary smelters. Tighter standards and monitoring, plus duty or quantitative restrictions, could support aluminium prices.

title: Nickel Mines taps into 70% of Angel Nickel | News
summary: Nickel Mines says it has completed the acquisition of a 70% stake in an Indonesian project involving smelters and coal-fired power in North Maluku for $490 million. The move can be read as improving nickel processing capacity and supply expectations, offering short-term support for nickel prices.

title: These Miners Are a Buy Because the Copper Market Can't Keep Up With Demand,
summary: The piece argues the renewable energy buildout is accelerating but the copper market cannot meet demand, creating a shortage. It frames investors’ interest in copper-dependent miners as a response to tight supply expectations, suggesting near-term upward pressure on copper prices.

title: Vaccines, China demand and dollar drive copper to 30-month peak
summary: Copper rallied to a 30-month peak on Tuesday, driven by optimism from COVID-19 vaccine effectiveness, expectations of robust China demand, and a weaker US dollar. China’s copper imports hit an annual peak and LME warehouse stocks fell, reinforcing bullish near-term sentiment.

title: These Miners Are a Buy Because the Copper Market Can't Keep Up With Demand
summary: The piece argues that the renewable-energy buildout is accelerating while copper supply cannot meet demand. It highlights heavy reliance on copper for green infrastructure and notes a shortage. This implies tighter near-term copper availability and supportive expectations for copper prices, benefiting copper-focused miners.

title: Nevada Copper Provides Financing Update
summary: Nevada Copper announced non-binding terms and discussions for a combined US$30 million senior/related financing package, including deferrals on existing KfW repayments and additional liquidity via a promissory note. The company says the funds will support ramp-up of its Pumpkin Hollow copper operations into 2021, though completion is not assured.

title: Is Peak Copper Coming? | Is There Enough Copper?
summary: The article revisits “peak copper” concerns and concludes the market may stay supply-tight rather than face immediate exhaustion. It cites years of underinvestment, longer lead times for new mines, COVID-19 disruptions, low inventories, and rising electrification-driven demand, implying higher copper prices and bullish near-term sentiment.

title: A large domestic ferronickel factory recently reduced production by 50% due to sluggish ferronickel market_SMM
summary: An East China ferronickel plant has reduced production by 50% after two months of few transactions and an oversupplied market. The producer says supply cuts will continue, with more concentrated reductions at year-end, which should support ferronickel pricing. Downstream stainless demand is being monitored.

title: Southern Peru Copper to invest US$650mn in Cuajone mine expansion
summary: Southern Peru Copper said it will invest US$650mn to expand the Cuajone mine. The move is a direct copper supply-related development, signaling higher future production capacity. However, because the expansion’s output increase would occur later, near-term impacts on copper prices are likely limited.

title: Lindian to screen test Guinea bauxite resource
summary: Lindian Resources has begun dry and wet screening tests at its Gaoual bauxite project in Guinea to reduce high silica impurities and improve aluminium oxide grades with minimal tonnage loss. It also holds Lelouma and is evaluating near-term Woula production, but no output changes are announced.

title: Marimaca Copper Receives Final Documentation for Upcoming Drilling Program
summary: Marimaca Copper Corp. reports it has received final environmental permitting (RCA) to conduct exploration drilling at the Marimaca copper project and nearby targets, following environmental approvals and a C$25.2m financing. The company plans surveys and mobilization for drilling in early Q1 2021, but no production changes are mentioned.

title: SSR Mining Announces Exploration Results on the In-Pit Copper-Gold Porphyry C2 Target at Çöpler
summary: SSR Mining announced diamond-drilling results from the in-pit C2 target below the Çöpler Main pit in Turkey, reporting long intersections of copper-gold porphyry mineralization with chalcopyrite (e.g., up to 1.92% CuEq over 17.4 meters). Drilling and metallurgical testing are ongoing, with no immediate production change described.

title: Import breakdown data of 21% month-on-month decline in imports of copper ore and its concentrates in China in October_SMM
summary: China imported about 1.69 million tons of copper ore and concentrates in October, down 21% month-on-month and 12% year-on-year, according to customs inquiry data cited by SMM. Chile’s shipments to China also fell. Reduced concentrate inflows can weaken near-term copper demand expectations and weigh on prices.

title: Trump administration denies permit for controversial gold and copper mine in southwest Alaska
summary: The Trump administration reportedly denied a permit for a controversial gold and copper mine in southwest Alaska. While gold is not tracked here, the copper component implies potential delays or cancellation of a future supply source. Such permitting setbacks can tighten expected copper availability and add upward pressure to prices.

title: Nickel, metals lead bullish rally in Indonesian mining stocks
summary: Indonesian mining shares rebounded as investors turned bullish on nickel, citing improving nickel prices and sentiment tied to the global EV battery buildout. The government’s planned nickel-rich EVB battery holding-company deal with LG Chem is highlighted as driving expectations for stronger future nickel demand, supporting near-term price pressure.

title: US Denies Permit for Gold, Copper Mine in Southwest Alaska
summary: The US Army Corps of Engineers Alaska District denied Pebble Limited Partnership’s permit to develop the Pebble copper-molybdenum-gold mine in southwest Alaska. The decision cites non-compliance with Clean Water Act guidelines and public-interest concerns, ending a long permitting dispute and removing a potential future copper supply source.

title: Chile's peso outpaces Latam FX as copper prices spike
summary: Chile’s peso rose as copper prices spiked to a seven-year peak, driven by expectations of strong demand from China. The article cites improved Chinese industrial activity and broader risk-on sentiment after positive COVID-19 vaccine news, which lifted oil and metal prices.

title: Plans for gold and copper mine in Alaska's Bristol Bay are blocked by the Army Corps of Engineers
summary: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers denied a key water permit for the Pebble Mine in Alaska, citing that the proposed project would not comply with Clean Water Act guidelines and could harm salmon-stream ecosystems. Pebble is described as a major copper resource; the denial threatens its future and adds bearish copper supply expectations.

title: Proactive Investors China - The web's leading portal for China stocks - Pure Minerals higher on signing nickel offtake MOU with lithium-ion battery manufacturer Samsung SDI
summary: Pure Minerals reportedly rose after signing a nickel offtake memorandum of understanding with Samsung SDI, a lithium-ion battery manufacturer. The agreement suggests potential incremental demand for battery-grade nickel, which can improve near-term market sentiment for nickel prices, though the impact depends on whether the MOU is binding and the volume is material.

title: Copper rush: Opponents worry feds have fast-tracked Resolution mine OK | Cronkite News
summary: Opponents say the Trump administration may have sped up the final environmental impact statement for the Resolution Copper mine near Superior, linked to a land swap that would transfer copper-rich federal land to the company. Resolution and Forest Service officials deny acceleration. The project is projected to produce large volumes of copper over decades.

title: Surge Copper Drills 0.72% Copper Equivalent Over 176.1 Metres At Ootsa Including 0.89% Copper Equivalent Over 126 Metres
summary: Surge Copper reported assay results from the upper portion of drill hole S20-218 at its Ootsa property in British Columbia, including 176.1 metres grading 0.72% copper equivalent and higher-grade intervals. The company is continuing a 10,000-metre drilling program but no near-term production or supply changes are stated.

title: Primary aluminium inventories shrank 19,000 mt on week to 596,000 mt_SMM
summary: SMM reports that China’s social inventories of primary aluminium across eight consumption areas, including SHFE warrants, fell by 19,000 mt week-on-week to 596,000 mt as of Nov 26. The drawdown signals tighter readily available supply and tends to be supportive for near-term aluminium prices.

title: Blackstone Generates New Nickel-Copper-PGE Target at King Snake
summary: Blackstone announced a new high-priority Ni-Cu-PGE target at its King Snake prospect near its Ban Phuc nickel sulfide operation. It will use electromagnetic methods to refine drill targets, referencing historic Ni-Cu intercepts and plans to drill over coming weeks. A scoping study targets ~12.7ktpa nickel output.

title: Blackstone Generates New Nickel-Copper-PGE Target at King Snake
summary: Blackstone Minerals reports an in-house geophysics team generated a high-priority Ni-Cu-PGE target at its King Snake prospect near the Ban Phuc processing facility. It plans EM-assisted drilling over coming weeks, citing historical nickel and copper intercepts and highlighting the broader nickel sulfide project economics for NCM precursors.

title: Copper Pauses at Six-Year High as Investors Eye Path to Recovery
summary: Copper prices paused near a six-year high on the London Metal Exchange as global stocks steadied, but sentiment remains supported by vaccine-driven growth hopes and Biden pledges to fund copper-heavy renewable and EV infrastructure. Strategists cite improving demand and a potential 2021 deficit, pointing to continued upside bias for copper.

title: Teck Partners to Launch Copper & Health Hospital Study in Chile
summary: Teck announced it will expand its Copper & Health program to Chile with a pilot study at Iquique Hospital using copper and antimicrobial textiles to reduce in-hospital infections. Teck is funding academic research with results expected in 2021’s second half. The initiative targets copper usage but metal demand is likely limited.

title: Northern Dynasty's copper-gold mine plan in Alaska rejected amid tougher environment for U.S. resource development
summary: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers rejected Northern Dynasty’s Pebble mine permit in Alaska, citing non-compliant mitigation and significant wetland and aquatic ecosystem degradation. The decision effectively halts a large prospective copper-gold project, lowering expected future copper supply and adding bearish pressure to copper sentiment.

title: Lindian locks in monster Guinea bauxite project
summary: Lindian Resources completed its acquisition of a 75% interest in Guinea’s Lelouma bauxite project after shareholder approval. Resources were increased to about 900 million tonnes grading 45% aluminium oxide, with a higher-grade portion totaling 398 million tonnes at 48.1% aluminium oxide. The update supports future aluminium supply but is not an immediate production change.

title: Copper set for 4th weekly gain on demand hopes, falling stocks
summary: London copper surged to a near 7-1/2-year high and was set for a fourth straight weekly gain as total tracked inventories fell to the lowest since mid-October. Support came from vaccine prospects, stimulus hopes, and a weaker dollar; nickel and aluminium also rose.

title: London copper set for fourth weekly gain on recovery hopes, falling stockpiles
summary: London copper is set for a fourth straight weekly gain as COVID-19 vaccine hopes lift recovery expectations and combined inventories across major warehouses fall to the lowest since mid-October. LME three-month copper and Shanghai January copper are up on the week. Nickel and aluminium are also higher, reflecting supportive industrial-metals sentiment.

title: Shanghai bonded copper stocks fell 2,700 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Nonferrous Metals
summary: Shanghai bonded copper stocks fell 2,700 mt to 367,000 mt after 16 straight weeks of gains. Improved import profit and rebound in the Yangshan copper premium encouraged more customs declarations. Foreign-trade buyers sought warehouse receipts and recent arrival bills of lading, coinciding with the stock decline.

title: No-deal Brexit would cripple domestic UK aluminium scrap market, participants say
summary: Market participants say a no-deal Brexit would damage the UK domestic aluminium scrap market. They warn that the disruption would impair supply of scrap feedstock for recyclers, tightening availability in the near term and likely supporting higher aluminium pricing expectations over the coming days to weeks.

title: ALRO subsidiary supplies aluminium profiles for heliports built on the roof of several Romanian emergency hospitals
summary: ALRO’s Vimetco Extrusion supplies aluminium profiles used to build helicopter landing decks (helidecks) for Romanian emergency hospitals. The first installation is at Bistrița and a second is under construction in Bacău, with further projects discussed. The news points to incremental aluminium demand but provides no volume scale.

title: Granite Creek Copper Ltd.: Granite Creek Copper Completes Acquisition of Copper North Mining and Consolidates Southern Portion of Minto Copper Belt in Yukon, Canada
summary: Granite Creek Copper completed its acquisition of Copper North, consolidating projects on Yukon’s Minto Copper Belt. The combined portfolio includes the Carmacks copper-gold PEA-stage project and the Carmacks North (formerly Stu) exploration targets, aiming to expand resources through drilling. The deal affects copper-focused expectations, but not near-term supply.

title: Guinea topples China to become world's second-biggest producer of bauxite
summary: Guinea has boosted bauxite production and displaced Australia as the top supplier of bauxite to China. The government is pushing mining firms to build bauxite refineries and is expanding power via a planned hydro dam, aiming to improve alumina output and supply timelines through 2025.

title: BHP to ramp up Spence copper mine expansion - The Northern Miner
summary: BHP plans to accelerate work on its Spence copper mine expansion in Chile, a US$2.5 billion project delayed by Covid-19 measures earlier this year. The ramp-up is intended to catch up on completion timing, which may modestly improve expectations for future copper output and support copper prices.

title: The Copper Price Today: A Brief Overview | Key Drivers
summary: The piece outlines key drivers for copper prices: China’s outsized demand role, refinery/output cuts, mine disruptions (e.g., Escondida labor risk, Panama Cobre Panama closure risk), and inventory levels. It highlights record highs earlier in May but notes June ShFE stocks surged to a 51-month high, weighing on prices.

title: Hong Kong is the real loser from new China copper contract: Andy Home
summary: Reuters reports China’s new international yuan-denominated copper contract began trading on ShFE’s IEE with initial bonded warehouse capacity and rising volumes. The piece argues Shanghai may gradually become an Asia-Pacific copper pricing reference, diminishing Hong Kong’s role. It notes supply-chain regionalisation and changing scrap flows, but no immediate physical market shock.

title: Hong Kong is the real loser from new China copper contract
summary: The piece says China’s long-awaited international copper contract debuted last week, marking a change in how copper may be priced and traded internationally. It notes the timing is unfavorable for HKEx’s outgoing chief executive, but the excerpt does not specify direct copper price-moving fundamentals or clear direction.

title: Miners, smelters still divided on copper processing charges
summary: Miners and Chinese smelters are negotiating copper treatment and refining charges (TC/RCs) for the annual benchmark settlement. Spot charges are at an eight-year low ($50.50/t) versus smelters seeking low-$60s and miners proposing mid-$50s, with added complexity from Grasberg’s high-fluorine concentrate limiting buyers.

title: Gold, copper diverge as investors bet on recovery
summary: Copper jumped to a seven-year high as investors grew optimistic that a COVID vaccine would spur global recovery. Coverage cites stronger China demand and record imports, producers’ sentiment, expectations for continued factory expansion, and Shanghai warehouse stockpiles falling to the lowest since late 2014. Gold fell as investors rotated into riskier assets.

title: Inflation Fear and Green Hope Drive Investors Into Copper
summary: Copper is drawing heavy investor inflows, pushing it to a seven-year high near $7,520/ton. The piece cites weaker dollar and rising inflation expectations, plus government “green” stimulus boosting demand prospects. It also notes tight supply and surging Chinese refined copper imports, reinforcing bullish momentum.

title: French overseas minister to organise political round table on sale of Vale nickel plant
summary: France’s overseas minister plans a political round table over the sale of Vale’s nickel plant in New Caledonia. Negotiations between Vale and Prony Resources face pro- and anti-independence opposition, with a rival Sofinor-Korea Zinc bid also rejected over missing guarantees and due-diligence access.

title: Shanghai copper hits 8-year high on China data
summary: Copper surged to an eight-year high in Shanghai and London prices were on track for their strongest monthly gain in four years. The move was attributed to solid China manufacturing data and risk-on sentiment linked to COVID-19 vaccine developments. Aluminium also rose, indicating supportive broader metal sentiment.

title: Tight domestic and imported copper scrap supply will prevent price spread from expanding_SMM
summary: SMM reports tight availability of domestic and imported copper scrap has kept cathode–scrap price spreads from widening through early December. Scrap inventories are low and import quotas are mostly used, with small shipments arriving in early December and larger volumes later. Processing fees for scrap-based rod production remain constrained.

title: US Treasury violates Russian law, takes control of Siberia and aluminium industry
summary: The US Treasury agreed to lift sanctions against Oleg Deripaska’s En+ and related entities, including RusAl, while some sanctions remain. The deal is framed as controversial, involving transparency and board changes. It highlights RusAl as a major aluminium supplier, noting sanctions had previously pushed aluminium prices higher.

title: Copper sweeps to highest since March 2013, investors eye pause
summary: Copper on the LME jumped to the highest level since March 2013, rising on buoyant China manufacturing data and risk-on sentiment. Traders warn the rally may be overbought and could pause as CTAs and hedge funds with year-end exposure take profits. Aluminium and nickel also moved alongside broader metal strength.

title: Copper Mountain Announces New Life of Mine Plan, Including Proposed 65,000 tpd Mill Expansion
summary: Copper Mountain Mining announced a new life-of-mine plan with a proposed 65,000 tpd mill expansion (building on a 45,000 tpd expansion underway). The project includes HPGR, additional milling and flotation capacity, and lower estimated unit costs. Total expected production is about 2.0 billion pounds of copper over 21 years.

title: First Quantum Files NI 43-101 for Taca Taca and Declares Maiden Mineral Reserve of Over 7.7 Million Tonnes of Contained Copper  - Press Release
summary: First Quantum reports an NI 43-101 filing for its Taca Taca project and announces a maiden mineral reserve of over 7.7 million tonnes of contained copper. The update strengthens expectations for future copper output and supports bullish sentiment for copper, with limited immediate implications for nickel or aluminium.

title: Chile says manufacturing up 6.2% in October, copper production dips
summary: Chile’s INE reported manufacturing rose 6.2% in October, but Chilean copper production slipped 0.2% to 492,761 tonnes. While total copper output for 2020 remains slightly higher, the monthly decline from the world’s top producer signals marginally weaker near-term supply conditions for copper.

title: Latin Metals Acquires the Jacha Copper Property in Peru
summary: Latin Metals acquired the 2,200-hectare Jacha copper exploration property in Peru’s Southern Peru Copper Belt. The release outlines historical soil anomalies and planned exploration work, but provides no production or supply impact. It frames activity amid higher copper prices, yet market-price effects are likely limited in the near term.

title: Coors Light and Ball Team Up to Bring Infinitely Recyclable Aluminum Cups to Allegiant Stadium Fans
summary: Ball and Molson Coors will supply Allegiant Stadium with Ball Aluminum Cup™ for stadium guests, highlighting that the lightweight aluminum packaging is infinitely recyclable. The release states 100,000 cups will be available at events, but provides no data on aluminum demand impacts beyond this limited rollout.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Announces Powerful Results of the Updated Feasibility Study for the World-Scale Platreef Palladium, Platinum, Rhodium, Nickel, Copper and Gold Project in South Africa
summary: Ivanhoe Mines announced positive updated feasibility study and a phased development PEA for the Platreef project in South Africa. The studies forecast large future production of nickel and copper (as by-products) alongside PGMs, with potential earlier ramp-up using Shaft 1. No immediate supply disruption is indicated.

title: First Quantum Files NI 43-101 for Taca Taca and Declares Maiden Mineral Reserve of Over 7.7 Million Tonnes of Contained Copper
summary: First Quantum filed an NI 43-101 technical report for its Taca Taca copper project in Argentina and declared a maiden reserve of 7.73 million tonnes of contained copper. The open-pit plan contemplates long mine life, but a final construction decision is expected in 2023/24. Sentiment for copper supply improves.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Announces Powerful Results of the Updated Feasibility Study for the World-Scale Platreef Palladium, Platinum, Rhodium, Nickel, Copper and Gold Project in South Africa
summary: Ivanhoe Mines reported positive findings from an updated feasibility study and a phased development plan for its Platreef project in South Africa. The studies outline production scaling and economics for palladium/platinum/rhodium/gold and also sizeable nickel and copper outputs, potentially supporting broader market sentiment but not near-term supply.

title: Ero Copper significantly increases copper reserves with the integration of Deepening Extension Project into updated life-of-mine plan for the Vale do Curaçá Property
summary: Ero Copper says it has materially increased copper reserves by adding the Deepening Extension Project to the updated life-of-mine plan for the Vale do Curaçã property. The change strengthens the mine’s resource outlook, potentially improving short-term perceived copper supply and supporting prices.

title: Copper Mountain updates mine plan with mill expansion
summary: Copper Mountain Mining updated the pre-feasibility life-of-mine plan for its 75%-owned Copper Mountain operation in southern B.C., incorporating a mill expansion to 65,000 tonnes per day from a prior level. Higher milling capacity implies improved copper production prospects, which is typically supportive for short-term copper market sentiment.

title: Materials Down As Copper Gains Offset By Gold Losses -- Materials Roundup
summary: A “materials” roundup reports copper up about 0.6% on Monday to its highest close since 2014, extending November gains to roughly 12%. The article attributes broader moves to a weaker dollar and improved Covid-19 vaccine prospects that reduced safe-haven demand, while gold falls.

title: Alcoa To Sell Rolling Mill Business To Kaiser Aluminum For About $670 Mln
summary: Alcoa agreed to sell its Warrick rolling mill business to Kaiser Aluminum for about $670m, including cash and postretirement benefit liabilities. The rolling operations supply ~310,000 tpy of flat-rolled aluminum for packaging, while Alcoa retains the site’s smelter and power assets. Closure is expected by end of Q1 2021.

title: Shanghai copper hits over 8-year high on China data, vaccine
summary: Shanghai copper surged to an 8-year high on strong Chinese factory data and COVID-19 vaccine hopes, lifting the January contract and pushing London prices near multi-year peaks. The market’s demand outlook improved alongside broader risk sentiment; meanwhile, aluminum rose, while nickel declined.

title: Shanghai copper tops eight-year high on vaccine hopes, China data
summary: Shanghai copper hit an eight-year high as vaccine hopes and stronger China data lifted expectations for a fast economic recovery. The LME and SHFE copper contracts rose, with LME copper nearing a multi-year peak. Aluminum also gained to a multi-year high, while nickel declined on Tuesday.

title: Import volume of nickel ore in October stood at 5.1 million mt_SMM
summary: Customs data show China’s nickel ore imports in October rose 17.9% m/m but fell y/y, with weather and holiday disruptions weakening arrivals. Port nickel ore inventories increased to 9.238 million wet tons. SMM indicates Ni ore and NPI-related demand weaken, and nickel ore prices are expected to fall further.

title: Vaccine hopes, China data push Shanghai copper to highest in more than 8 yrs
summary: Copper prices rose sharply as Shanghai futures hit an eight-year high, supported by strong Chinese factory activity data and positive COVID-19 vaccine trial progress that boosted recovery expectations. LME copper also advanced, though near-term profit-taking risk was flagged. Aluminium was at multi-year highs while nickel fell.

title: Doubleview Provides Drilling Update at its Hat Gold Rich Copper Porphyry
summary: Doubleview Gold Corp. reported initial drilling at its Hat gold-rich copper porphyry in British Columbia, describing a new drill hole targeting a chargeability anomaly. Management also cited recent copper price strength and expects continued industry demand. The update is exploratory and lacks concrete supply-impact drivers, so near-term price effect appears limited.

title: PRICING NOTICE: Proposal to launch European low-carbon aluminium differentials
summary: Fastmarkets/Metal Bulletin issued a pricing notice saying its European low-carbon aluminium differential assessments were delayed and then corrected due to procedural errors. It updated European low-carbon aluminium 6063 extrusion billet premium midpoint assessments (Italy and North Germany) published incorrectly on April 2.

title: China nickel manufacturing continued contraction in November_SMM | Shanghai Nonferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show China’s downstream nickel PMI at 49.55 in November, signaling contraction, driven mainly by stainless steel where the production sub-index fell to 45.71. Raw materials inventories also stayed in contraction, reflecting sluggish stainless steel procurement and price competition, while electroplating/new orders were comparatively stronger.

title: Refined nickel imports fell to 6 months low in October,  nickel briquettes and electroplate nickel imports to increase in proportion by end 2020_SMM
summary: China’s refined nickel imports fell to 8,414 mt in October, down sharply versus September and a year earlier. Russian nickel imports dropped after long-term contract closures and channel shutdowns, while SHFE inventories hit a yearly bottom on low receipts and high deliveries. Some briquettes and Norwegian/Sumitomo volumes are expected later.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Ltd.: Kamoa-Kakula Copper Project Secures US$420 Million in Project-Level Credit Facilities, Including a EUR 176 million (US$211 million) Covered Equipment Financing Facility with a US$9 million Down-Payment Facility, and a US$200 million Li
summary: Ivanhoe Mines’ Kamoa-Kakula Copper Project secured about US$420 million in credit facilities, including EUR 176 million equipment financing and a US$200 million ore-stockpile-backed line of credit. Funds will fast-track Phase 2 concentrator expansion to 7.6 Mtpa, aiming to increase near-term copper production capacity ahead of schedule.

title: Kamoa-Kakula Copper Project Secures US$420 Million in Project-Level Credit Facilities, Including a EUR 176 million (US$211 million) Covered Equipment Financing Facility with a US$9 million Down-Payment Facility, and a US$200 million Line of Credit from Zi
summary: Ivanhoe Mines and Zijin-backed Kamoa-Kakula secured about US$420 million in project-level credit facilities to finance underground equipment and the Phase 2 concentrator expansion. The funding is intended to accelerate commissioning and double processing capacity to 7.6 Mtpa, supporting higher near-term copper production outlook.

title: Sanatana Resources Inc.: Sanatana Acquires Letter of Intent over 188 Km Sq Sutakiki Copper and Gold Project, Solomon Islands
summary: Sanatana Resources received a letter of intent for the Sutakiki tenure in Solomon Islands, enabling negotiations for land access and a future prospecting license. Historical drilling reported porphyry-style mineralization including copper (0.13% Cu over 354m). The update is an exploration/planning step, not production-related.

title: EnGold Mines Ltd.: EnGold Drills 215 Metres of 0.3% Copper Eq True Width at Lac La Hache
summary: EnGold Mines reported assays from hole G20-49 at its Lac La Hache property in British Columbia, finding 215 metres of mineralization grading about 0.3% copper-equivalent (up to 0.36% including magnetite). Additional nearby holes are pending, supporting further copper exploration but not near-term output changes.

title: Firefighters urge drivers to avoid area of Goose Creek aluminum plant fire
summary: Firefighters responded to an early-morning smoke incident at the JW Aluminum plant in Goose Creek, South Carolina. The spokesperson said the issue was detected around 5:45 a.m., firefighters arrived within minutes, and the incident was under control by 7:52 a.m. The cause is still unknown and no injuries were reported.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Ltd.: Ivanhoe to Host an Investor Day on December 3, 2020, to Discuss New Feasibility Study and Phased-Development Plan for the World-Scale Platreef Palladium, Platinum, Rhodium, Nickel, Copper and Gold Project
summary: Ivanhoe Mines will host an investor day on Dec. 3 to review independent engineering studies and an accelerated phased-development plan for the Platreef project in South Africa. Platreef is described as producing palladium, platinum, rhodium, nickel, copper and gold, which could shift market expectations for nickel and copper supply.

title: Ivanhoe Mines to Host an Investor Day on December 3, 2020, to Discuss New Feasibility Study and Phased-Development Plan for the World-Scale Platreef Palladium, Platinum, Rhodium, Nickel, Copper and Gold Project
summary: Ivanhoe Mines’ Platreef integrated development plan announces updated feasibility study and a phased development PEA for producing platinum-group metals plus substantial nickel and copper. It outlines higher throughput and potential earlier first concentrate via Shaft 1, with lower initial capital in the PEA, improving project economics and supply expectations.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Ltd.: Ivanhoe to Host an Investor Day on December 3, 2020, to Discuss New Feasibility Study and Phased-Development Plan for the World-Scale Platreef Palladium, Platinum, Rhodium, Nickel, Copper and Gold Project
summary: Ivanhoe Mines said it will hold an investor day to discuss independent engineering studies and an accelerated phased-development plan for its Platreef project in South Africa. The project includes nickel and copper (along with PGM and other metals). The update is exploratory/feasibility-focused, with no stated immediate production change.

title: Copper futures climb to levels not seen since 2013
summary: Copper futures surged to the highest level since 2013, reflecting buoyant expectations for industrial demand. The report notes a pandemic-linked dip in consumption but says overall global copper supply is expected to fall short of demand this year, reinforcing bullish market sentiment.

title: Sanatana Acquires Letter of Intent over 188 Km Sq Sutakiki Copper and Gold Project, Solomon Islands
summary: Sanatana Resources received a letter of intent for the Sutakiki project in the Solomon Islands, granting exclusive access negotiations for due diligence and surface access before a prospecting license is issued. The tenure is prospective for porphyry copper-gold mineralization, including past drill results with broad copper intercepts, but no production impact is indicated.

title: Kamoa-Kakula Copper Project Secures US$420 Million in Project-Level Credit Facilities, Including a EUR 176 million Covered Equipment Financing Facility with a US$9 million Down-Payment Facility, and a US$200 million Line of Credit from Zijin Mining
summary: Ivanhoe Mines and partners secured EUR 176 million plus a US$9 million down-payment and a US$200 million line of credit for Kamoa-Kakula’s Phase 2 expansion in the DRC. The funding aims to fast-track a second concentrator module to reach 7.6 Mtpa capacity ahead of schedule, supporting higher copper output expectations.

title: Cerro Grande Mining Corporation Announces Completion of the Acquisition of the Assets relating to the Pimentón Copper Gold Mining Project
summary: Cerro Grande Mining completed the acquisition of assets for the Pimentón copper-gold project in Chile, paying an initial installment and agreeing to further payments over up to 18 and 36 months. The deal is conditional on installment payments and involves equity-based pricing for later payments. No immediate production changes are described.

title: LIVE FUTURES REPORT 01/12: LME copper, aluminium and nickel prices continue to hold gains
summary: Fastmarkets’/Metal Bulletin’s live futures update says LME copper, aluminium and nickel prices “continue to hold gains.” The article attributes aluminium price support to supply disruptions, including curtailed Gulf output, inventory buffer draws, and severely disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Ivanhoe to Host an Investor Day on December 3, 2020, to Discuss New Feasibility Study and Phased-Development Plan for the World-Scale Platreef Palladium, Platinum, Rhodium, Nickel, Copper and Gold Project
summary: Ivanhoe Mines will host an investor day to review independent engineering studies and an accelerated phased development plan for its Platreef project in South Africa, a deposit producing nickel and copper along with platinum-group metals. The announcement is informational with no quantified near-term output changes. Aluminium is not addressed.

title: Canada Nickel Provides Update on the Crawford Nickel-Cobalt Sulphide Project
summary: Canada Nickel reports progress on its Crawford nickel-cobalt sulphide project, including PEA advancement and ongoing drilling with three rigs. Some locked-cycle test results will be re-run due to lab changes, with updates expected by end-December. Assay releases are delayed as exploration activity slows in the region.

title: Ivanhoe to Host an Investor Day on December 3, 2020, to Discuss New Feasibility Study and Phased-Development Plan for the World-Scale Platreef Palladium, Platinum, Rhodium, Nickel, Copper and Gold Project
summary: Ivanhoe Mines will host an Investor Day to discuss independent engineering studies and an accelerated phased-development plan for its Platreef project in South Africa. The project targets palladium, platinum, rhodium, nickel, copper and gold. Updated feasibility outlooks can lift market expectations for future nickel and copper supply.

title: Zambia Sees Deal With Glencore Over Mopani Copper Within a Month
summary: Zambia has reportedly struck a deal with Glencore concerning Mopani copper within a month. Because Mopani is an important near-term copper supply source, a resolution that helps production or shipments progress would likely ease supply concerns and offer modest upside support for copper prices.

title: Kamoa-Kakula Copper Project Mines a Record 250,000 Tonnes of Development Ore Grading 4.85% Copper in November, Accelerating Both Grade and Tonnage of Copper Ore Added to the Project's Surface Stockpiles
summary: Ivanhoe Mines says underground development and ore production at the Kamoa-Kakula copper project accelerated in November, with 250,000 tonnes of ore mined at 4.85% copper and a rise in contained copper within surface stockpiles. Tunnels were joined to enable mining of high-grade central ore, with first concentrate production planned for July 2021.

title: Nova Royalty Provides Update on Its Taca Taca Royalty, Reports Maiden Mineral Reserve of 7.7 Million Tonnes of Copper, 32-Year Initial Mine Life, and Timetable for Production Decision
summary: Nova Royalty reports First Quantum’s maiden copper mineral reserve (7.7 Mt) and updated copper resources for the Taca Taca project in Argentina, with an expected construction decision in 2023–2024. While it supports longer-term copper supply outlook via a royalty stake, it implies no immediate near-term production change.

title: Copper down as firm dollar prompts profit taking
summary: Copper prices eased about 0.9% on a firm U.S. dollar prompting profit-taking, though losses were limited by hopes for strong China demand and vaccine optimism. Chinese import/demand strength and potential U.S. stimulus supported prices. Aluminium slipped slightly and nickel fell more modestly.

title: Fjordland Exploration Inc.: Fjordland Identifies Drill Targets at North Thompson Nickel Project
summary: Fjordland Exploration reports completion of geophysical evaluation yielding 18 drill targets at its North Thompson Nickel Belt Strong property. Planning is underway for a 2,000–4,000 m drill program in early 2021, aiming to delineate nickel sulphide bodies analogous to nearby Thompson mines.

title: Norilsk Nickel Announces Output Increase Plans while Committing to Ease Environmental Impact
summary: Norilsk Nickel said at its Capital Markets Day it plans to double output and increase 2021 capex, alongside its “Green Nickel” program and smelter closures to cut emissions. As a major nickel producer, higher expected supply growth is likely to pressure nickel prices near term, while copper impact is more indirect.

title: Chilean copper output down 0.7% in October on lower volumes from Escondida, Collahuasi
summary: Chilean copper output declined 0.7% in October due to lower production volumes at Escondida and Collahuasi, two of the country’s largest copper operations. The supply reduction from major mines is likely to tighten near-term market availability, supporting expectations for higher copper prices.

title: Man Xu: Automotive and construction market-driven comparison of aluminum strip consumption_SMM
summary: SMM analyst Man Xu compares aluminium strip demand drivers, noting strong automotive optimism and softer architectural-decor growth. Aluminium plate/sheet and strip output is expected to rise in 2020 with mature industry characteristics. Export declines from EU/India anti-dumping measures reduce outward pressure, supporting domestic aluminium expectations.

title: Long-term demand for copper, steel and zinc may be underestimated by the market_SMM
summary: Freeport-Apollo/Atlantic Copper executives argue copper demand growth may be underestimated, tied to electrification and the energy transition. They also flag copper supply risks, saying production is expected to decline about 2.1% this year and projects delayed by COVID-19 have resumed amid depleted reserves and lower grades.

title: RCs for blister copper CIF rose further amid value-added tax on gold_SMM
summary: SMM reports that refining charges (RCs) for domestic blister copper rose in November and imported blister copper CIF RCs increased. The move is linked to China Customs levying VAT on gold in imported plate-shaped copper anode products since October, dampening demand amid abundant domestic smelter inventories.

title: ShFE aluminum slips from 9-year high on profit-taking
summary: Aluminum prices fell after rising to nine-year highs in Shanghai, driven by profit-taking amid strong demand and hopes for U.S. stimulus and early COVID-19 vaccine rollout. The January ShFE aluminum contract dropped 3.9%, while LME three-month aluminum fell 1%, with traders also citing potential inventory builds around Lunar New Year.

title: Primary aluminium inventories built up 4,000 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Nonferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show China’s primary aluminium ingot inventories increased by 4,000 mt over the week, reaching 600,000 mt as of December 3. Social inventories across eight consumption areas, including SHFE warrants, rose from last Thursday, suggesting a near-term build in supply that may pressure aluminium prices.

title: Aluminium Fluoride Market to Face a Significant Slowdown in 2020, as COVID 19 Sets a Negative Tone for Investors
summary: The article forecasts a significant slowdown in the aluminium fluoride market, attributing the negative investor tone to COVID-19. Since aluminium fluoride is used in aluminium smelting as a flux/processing input, weaker activity expectations imply less near-term aluminium production demand, likely weighing on aluminium prices.

title: Brazil's Vale to expand copper, nickel production
summary: Vale plans to expand its copper and nickel production in Brazil, per the article headline. More expected supply can reduce near-term price pressure for both metals. However, the provided excerpt lacks specific capacity, investment size, or start date, limiting confidence on how quickly output would affect markets.

title: Bauxite mining to begin in Nyinahin — President
summary: President Nana Akufo-Addo says a bauxite company will soon start mining at Nyinahin in Ghana’s Ashanti Region. He notes preparatory works are completed and workers will begin, aiming to create jobs and development. The announcement suggests potential future improvement in aluminium feedstock availability.

title: Here To Serve Further Expands its Nickel Footprint
summary: Here To Serve Holding’s subsidiary Fortune Nickel and Gold purchased additional mining claims in the Timmins Camp, expanding its mineral rights to about 5,100 acres. Management says the area is prospective for nickel and other base-metal systems, potentially including copper, but provides no production or supply disruption details.

title: Aluminum can production and distribution center set to open in Waco
summary: Envases Group plans to open an aluminum can production and distribution center in Waco, Texas, producing beverage containers for soft drinks, beer, and energy drinks. The investment and planned output should raise near-term demand for aluminum can materials, supporting aluminum prices despite the facility size not being benchmarked to the global market.

title: 2021 to be a peak year for commissioning of alumina capacity in China, while overseas oversupply to intensify_SMM
summary: SMM forecasts China’s 2020 alumina supply deficit and low operating rates, while 2021 is expected to be a peak year for Chinese alumina capacity commissioning. Overseas oversupply is forecast to intensify, increasing pressure. Meanwhile, costs may rise in Q4 and losses deepen for several provinces, likely weighing on aluminium margins and prices.

title: London copper climbs to near 8-year high on U.S. stimulus hopes
summary: London copper jumped to a near eight-year high, extending gains for a fifth straight week, as U.S. stimulus aid momentum in Congress boosted hopes for an economic rebound. Three-month LME copper rose up to 0.9%, with Shanghai copper also higher. Fitch noted upside may cool as markets look highly optimistic.

title: Govt maintains export ban on nickel, relaxes rules for other metals until 2023
summary: Indonesia’s ministry maintains an export ban on nickel ore while allowing exports of washed bauxite and copper anode slime (used for aluminum and certain precious metals) until June 2023, provided smelter activity requirements are met. The policy reinforces tighter nickel ore supply from a major producer, likely supporting nickel prices near term.

title: UK Regulatory Announcement: Investment in Marimaca Copper Corp (TSXV:MARI)
summary: Metal Tiger plc announced it subscribed for units in Marimaca Copper Corp as part of Marimaca’s completed C$28.98 million equity financing. Marimaca’s flagship Chile copper project received approval for additional drilling. The news is primarily an investor/financing update with no stated immediate impact on copper supply or trade flows.

title: 2021 to be a peak year for commissioning of alumina capacity in China, overseas oversupply to intensify_SMM
summary: SMM’s Joyce Li forecasts China’s alumina supply deficit in 2020 but expects 2021 to be a peak commissioning year, boosting domestic alumina supply. Overseas oversupply is also expected to intensify, increasing 2021 pressure. Rising bauxite, caustic soda and coal costs may widen alumina losses, weighing on aluminium sentiment.

title: Impact on China domestic supply/demand of the new scrap law and the operational challenges of the law to primary and secondary aluminium industries_SMM
summary: SMM reports that China’s new solid waste law increases aluminium ash processing costs and limits secondary producers’ operations due to insufficient qualified processing capacity and harder hazardous waste transport. It also discusses tariff policy shifts that could expand/reshape imports of secondary aluminium ingots and affect scrap-derived feedstock availability, supporting tighter near-term supply.

title: Global copper ore resources structure and overseas investment by Chinese companies_SMM
summary: SMM reports a consultant’s view that global copper ore and concentrate production costs are expected to rise, driven by inflation, worsening ore grades, and tighter environmental and mining safety considerations. It also notes expanding Chinese overseas copper mining investments, though slow project construction and limited operating mines are key constraints.

title: Varied Properties of Copper to Bring Immense Growth Prospects for Copper Pipes and Tubes Market during Tenure of 2019-2027: TMR
summary: Transparency Market Research forecasts growth in the copper pipes and tubes market through 2027, driven by construction, urbanization, HVAC/refrigeration, and oil & gas. It notes copper supply concentration in Chile and Peru and price volatility as risks, but overall demand momentum implies supportive conditions for copper.

title: Copper ETFs rally as global industry cranks back into gear
summary: Copper ETFs rose on Friday, extending multi-month gains, with copper futures at a seven-year high. The article links the rally to global reopening and stronger manufacturing demand, especially from China. It also flags tighter supply prospects, referencing a forecast refined copper deficit, supporting bullish sentiment.

title: Tech Resources rebounds 175% from March lows, betting on copper's blistering rally
summary: Teck Resources’ shares rebound as the company pours cash flows into its Chilean QB2 copper expansion, arguing vaccines and stimulus will lift global industrial demand. Copper is cited near a seven-year high, with analysts expecting elevated prices as inventories tighten and China consumption remains strong.

title: Copper strides to highest peaks since 2013 on U.S. stimulus plans
summary: Copper prices surged to the highest levels since 2013 as U.S. politicians neared agreement on coronavirus stimulus spending, boosting economic expectations. The rally was reinforced by vaccine rollout optimism, strong China data, and a weaker U.S. dollar. Aluminium and nickel also rose on the same macro-driven risk-on backdrop.

title: Teck Resources rebounds 175% from March lows, betting on copper's blistering rally
summary: Teck Resources’ rebound is framed around a sharp copper rally, with copper near a seven-year high. Management cites U.S. vaccination rollout as a tailwind for recovery and infrastructure-led demand. Teck is also shifting capital from coal and zinc into copper via its Quebrada Blanca 2 project.

title: GLOBAL NICKEL WRAP: Asia, Europe refined nickel premiums flat
summary: The Global Nickel Wrap reports that Asia and Europe refined nickel premiums were flat. It also notes Fastmarkets delayed and corrected certain European low-carbon aluminium differential and Aluminium 6063 extrusion billet premium assessments due to procedural errors, suggesting data corrections rather than a new immediate market driver for aluminium prices.

title: Canada Nickel Company Announces Filing of NI 43-101 Technical Report for Previously Announced Crawford Project Updated Resource
summary: Canada Nickel filed an NI 43-101 technical report for its Crawford nickel-cobalt sulphide project with an updated mineral resource estimate effective October 18, 2020. The release describes QA/QC and independent qualified-person review, plus corporate updates. It does not announce production changes or new supply disruption.

title: Copper surges as macro investors drive metals
summary: Copper surged to a fresh seven-year high as investors bet on further US COVID-19 stimulus and broader global recovery boosting demand. A weaker dollar and rising inflation expectations also helped. The rally is supported by supply disruptions and worries miners may not meet demand, despite signs commodity demand could stall.

title: Behind the feud between Turquoise Hill and Rio Tinto over the copper mine in Mongolia
summary: Turquoise Hill and Rio Tinto are in arbitration over financing and cost overruns for the Oyu Tolgoi underground expansion in Mongolia. Rio plans $500m borrowing plus a potential Turquoise Hill stock offering, while Turquoise Hill seeks timeline extensions and alternative funding. Costs and delays feed uncertainty, but no immediate output cut is stated.

title: Copper supply to shrink further, while the surge in demand for electric vehicles will boost copper demand _SMM
summary: Anglo American’s Paul Ward says copper demand is accelerating, supported by electric-vehicle uptake and broader Asia-led consumption. He also projects shrinking supply, citing a 5% drop in 2020 ore supply and ongoing mine interruptions related to COVID-19 and structural constraints like water and power shortages, keeping a supply gap ahead of demand.

title: Copper slips from near 8-year high on falling Chinese imports
summary: London copper prices eased from an eight-year high after data showed China’s copper imports fell for a second straight month to a six-month low. The drop closed a favorable price-arbitrage window and triggered automatic selling. Some support could return if a U.S. stimulus package passes, but near-term pressure remains.

title: TCs of copper concentrate likely to rise in 2021 amid concentrated supply_SMM
summary: SMM reports that long-term contract copper concentrate treatment charges for 2021 are expected to settle around $57–62/mt, trending higher due to increased concentrate capacity in late 2020. Concentrate supply is expected tight early 2021, but Peru political turmoil may disrupt supply. Smelter losses from low 2020 spot TCs underpin sentiment.

title: A large trader has taken over Vale's stake in the Goro nickel-cobalt mine, MHP production to continue in 2021_SMM
summary: Vale previously warned the Goro nickel-cobalt mine in New Caledonia could suspend in 2021 after failing to sell its stake to NCZ. SMM reports a large trader took over Vale’s stake, allowing MHP production to continue. This mitigates supply risk for battery-grade nickel sulphate.

title: One Japanese buyer agrees to pay Q1 aluminium premium of $130/T, up 48% from Q4-source
summary: A Japanese buyer agreed to pay a Q1 aluminium premium of $130 per tonne, up 48% versus the Q4 source. Rising premiums typically reflect tighter availability and stronger physical demand conditions, which can support aluminium prices in the coming weeks.

title: Bidder for New Caledonia's Vale nickel plant pulls out
summary: Korea Zinc withdrew from bidding for Vale’s nickel plant in New Caledonia after protests, blockades, and unrest disrupted sale discussions and due diligence access. Vale warned it would shut the plant in a few weeks if a sale fails, raising near-term supply concerns for nickel and likely pushing prices lower.

title: Century Aluminum and Santee Cooper reach a temporary power deal to keep SC smelter open
summary: Santee Cooper and Century Aluminum agreed to temporarily extend electricity supply to Century’s Mount Holly smelter in South Carolina, avoiding a year-end closure. The deal keeps power flowing and employment stable for three months while both sides negotiate a longer-term contract likely to supply most needed electricity.

title: China imports ever more aluminium as alloy demand booms
summary: China increased aluminium imports further in October, bringing unwrought aluminium imports to about 220,000 tonnes and lifting net primary aluminium and alloy imports to 1.74 million tonnes in the first 10 months. This surpasses 2009 full-year levels, signaling a demand-driven draw on global supply.

title: Century Aluminum reaches preliminary agreement with Santee Cooper over power contract
summary: Century Aluminum reached a preliminary three-year power contract with Santee Cooper for its Mount Holly aluminium plant, averting a threatened shutdown over high electricity prices. The deal is expected to deliver at least 290MW, allowing a 50% production increase after rebuilding cells and adding capacity, subject to approvals.

title: Ferronickel prices likely to rebound slightly amid lower prices of substitutional raw materials _SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s high-grade NPI average price edged down week-on-week but remained supported by high production costs. Weak stainless steel demand reduced restocking, yet alternative raw materials’ cost efficiency is improving, likely boosting NPI prices slightly. High-grade NPI is expected to trade around 1,030–1,050 yuan/mtu.

title: Exclusive: China's refined nickel output rose 11.56% MoM to 13,700 mt in November_SMM
summary: SMM says China’s refined nickel output rose 11.56% month-on-month to 13,700 mt in November, driven by a Gansu smelter returning from maintenance. Xinjiang was steady and Shandong ran low due to raw-material shortages. SMM expects output to drop to 13,200 mt in December.

title: Copper-Gold Mineralisation Expands at Kharmagtai
summary: Xanadu Mines reported expanded mineralisation drilling at its Kharmagtai copper-gold project in Mongolia, including larger Zaraa and ongoing results awaiting assays. Phase 1 drilling progress and upcoming Q1 CY21 results and H1 CY21 resource update are expected, but no immediate production or supply changes are announced.

title: Chief Medco: Indonesian copper miner Amman Mineral preparing for IPO
summary: Indonesia’s copper and gold miner Amman Mineral, controlled by Medco Energi, is preparing for a potential IPO but has not set timing. The firm runs the Batu Hijau copper and gold mine. Investment banks have reportedly not been hired yet, with no guidance on production or shipments.

title: Tartisan Nickel Corp. Expands Kenbridge Nickel Project Property Position, Kenora Mining Division, Ontario
summary: Tartisan Nickel Corp. announced it staked additional mining claims contiguous to its Kenbridge Nickel Project in Ontario, bringing the total to 114 single-cell claims. The company says reinterpretation of geophysical data supports follow-up exploration to potentially expand resources, with surveys planned for winter.

title: Taseko Mines: Florence Copper Receives Aquifer Protection Permit
summary: Taseko Mines said Arizona regulators granted an Aquifer Protection Permit for its Florence Copper project, a key step in the permitting process. The company expects further approvals, with construction anticipated in 2021. The news reduces regulatory uncertainty and supports sentiment for future copper supply, potentially pushing copper higher.

title: Copper rises on UK vaccine rollout, hopes for U.S. stimulus
summary: Copper prices climbed on upbeat sentiment tied to the UK’s first mass COVID-19 vaccine rollout and hopes for a large U.S. pandemic relief package. The LME three-month copper contract gained 0.6% and Shanghai January copper rose 0.4%. LME aluminum also increased, reflecting broader metal risk-on sentiment.

title: Peru's copper production rose 1.4% in October compared with the same period last year. Zinc production increased by 8%._SMM
summary: Peru’s Ministry of Energy and Mines said October copper production rose 1.4% year-on-year to 207,034 tonnes, helped by miners restoring staffing and operations after an outbreak. Output gains at Antamina, Toromocho and Los Quenuales supported the rebound, while other metals moved differently.

title: MAX Resource Corp.: Max Resource Commences Analysis of Historic Drill Cores and Seismic Data for its CESAR Copper-Silver Project, NE Colombia
summary: MAX Resource Corp. begins analysis of historic drill cores and seismic data for its CESAR copper-silver project in northeast Colombia. The release is primarily technical and exploration-focused, with investor commentary linking copper fundamentals to higher prices and future deficits, but it offers no immediate supply shock. Aluminium is not addressed.

title: Analysis of production restrictions impact on aluminium processors in Henan _SMM
summary: Henan re-launched red heavy-air-pollution alerts requiring aluminium processors in Anyang, Xinxiang, Hebi and Jiaozuo to shut or significantly cut output, with some restrictions likely extending. SHFE 2101 aluminium fell 1.02% quickly. SMM estimates restrictions hit 37.5% of plate/strip/foil capacity and reduce primary aluminium demand by ~4,000 mt/day.

title: Copper rises on Britain's vaccine rollout, U.S. stimulus hopes
summary: Copper prices rose 0.7% on the LME and 0.4% on the Shanghai market, driven by upbeat sentiment from Britain’s first COVID-19 vaccine rollouts and expectations of a U.S. pandemic relief package. It cites improving China factory activity, though CRU warns demand could weaken early 2021.

title: Taseko's Florence Copper granted aquifer protection permit
summary: Taseko’s Florence Copper project in Arizona received an Aquifer Protection Permit from the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality. The approval is an important environmental milestone that can support permitting progress for the copper project, modestly improving sentiment around future copper supply prospects.

title: LIVE FUTURES REPORT 09/12: Tin, zinc, nickel set new 2020 highs; Al up 2.3%
summary: Metal futures commentary reports aluminium futures rising around 2.3% and states that nickel (along with tin and zinc) set new 2020 highs. This signals improving market pricing expectations for aluminium and nickel in the very near term.

title: Commission Finalises Consumer Protections For Withdrawal Of Copper Phone And Broadband Services By Chorus
summary: New Zealand’s Commerce Commission finalised a Copper Withdrawal Code requiring Chorus to provide protections before stopping wholesale copper phone and broadband services, where fibre is available. The code sets notice periods and service continuity obligations, aiming to manage consumers’ transition from copper infrastructure to fibre.

title: At 8.81% CAGR Nickel-Plating Market to reach USD 1,263.3 million in 2027- Credence Research – Business
summary: The article forecasts growth in the nickel-plating market, noting nickel electroplating demand was expected to drop about 20% in 2020 due to COVID-19, with recovery anticipated as economies reopened and a vaccine rollout was expected. It cites steady demand from automotive and decorative uses but no direct nickel supply shock.

title: Si6 Metals to hit Botswanan nickel targets
summary: Si6 Metals plans to begin drilling at the Maibele North nickel-copper project in Botswana after identifying a deep electromagnetic target, with additional drilling at Airstrip and Dibete where prior results included high-grade copper. The company is also funding exploration via a placement, but the news is mainly project-level.

title: Aluminium billet inventories shrank 2,400 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Nonferrous Metals
summary: SMM data for China’s five major consumption areas show 6063 aluminium billet inventories fell 2,400 mt week-on-week to 70,300 mt as of Dec 10. Foshan saw a build, but Wuxi, Huzhou, Changzhou, and Nanchang declined, with Wuxi dropping 5,800 mt.

title: Primary aluminium inventories shrank 4,000 mt on week to 596,000 mt_SMM
summary: SMM reported that China’s social inventories of primary aluminium across eight consumption areas, including SHFE warrants, fell 4,000 mt week-on-week to 596,000 mt as of Dec 10. The inventory draw suggests tighter nearby supply conditions that can support aluminium prices.

title: Aluminium rises on supply concerns, copper recoups losses
summary: Aluminium prices rose as China’s winter air-pollution restrictions began disrupting top-consumer refinery operations, raising near-term supply concerns. Copper slightly recovered from early losses, with gains limited as investors awaited progress on stalled US stimulus talks. China demand and smelter maintenance were also cited.

title: Aluminium rises on supply concerns, copper recoups losses
summary: Aluminium prices rose as China’s winter air-pollution restrictions began affecting refining operations, tightening near-term supply in the top consumer market. Three-month LME aluminium and Shanghai prices climbed. Copper also recovered early losses with modest gains, while trading sentiment was tempered by uncertainty over stalled U.S. stimulus talks.

title: Copper eases on U.S. stimulus doubts, firm dollar; aluminium shimmers
summary: Copper fell as investors scaled back expectations for another U.S. coronavirus stimulus deal and as a stronger dollar reduced appeal for dollar-priced metals. LME three-month copper slipped while Shanghai copper also eased. Aluminium rose, supported by winter restrictions disrupting Chinese alumina operations and robust smelting margins/demand.

title: Copper eases on U.S. stimulus doubts, firm dollar; aluminium shimmers
summary: Copper prices fell as investors cooled expectations for another U.S. stimulus package and a stronger dollar reduced demand for dollar-priced metals. Three-month LME copper and Shanghai contracts both declined. Aluminium was the lone gainer, rising on winter restrictions hitting Chinese alumina output and supporting supply.

title: Thursday's Insider Report: Director adds to his position in this emerging copper producer
summary: The piece summarizes recent insider trades, focusing on purchases in emerging copper producer Ivanhoe Mines and mentions its Kamoa-Kakula project, with copper production expected to begin in mid-2021. The news is limited to trading activity and project commentary, without new near-term supply, demand, or policy catalysts for copper.

title: Here To Serve Hires Geophysicist for Nickel Exploration
summary: Here To Serve Holding’s subsidiary is hiring a geophysicist to process geophysical data for its nickel exploration claims in Gowan Township, Timmins, Ontario. The piece cites historical drilling with 3.5% Ni and 1.25% Cu but provides no production changes or immediate supply effects, limiting near-term price impact.

title: Altus Strategies Plc: Further Copper and Silver Discoveries at Agdz Project, Morocco
summary: Altus Strategies announced further copper (up to ~4.67% Cu) and silver findings at its Agdz project in Morocco, including a new Makarn North zone and follow-up exploration plans such as IP surveys. The update is early-stage and relates to potential future copper supply, with limited immediate effects on copper prices.

title: Nickel rises to highest since October 2019 on steel boom
summary: Nickel prices jumped to the highest level since October 2019, supported by expectations of strong demand from Chinese steel mills and declining nickel stocks in Chinese exchange warehouses. The rally is linked to improving Chinese industrial activity and reduced inventories, pushing LME nickel up and lifting gains since March.

title: Copper Fox Metals Inc.: Copper Fox Provides Corporate Update
summary: Copper Fox Metals provided a corporate update, including progress on preliminary economic assessments for the Schaft Creek and Van Dyke copper projects, receipt/approval of exploration permits for Eaglehead, and planning drilling for Sombrero Butte. The news is development-stage and does not reflect near-term production changes.

title: Copper Fox Provides Corporate Update
summary: Copper Fox issued a corporate update on ongoing studies and permits for its copper projects, including commencement and progress on PEAs (Schaft Creek and Van Dyke), receipt of exploration permits for Eaglehead, and planning drill testing at Sombrero Butte. It outlines near-term administrative and technical milestones without production or market-impact events.

title: Tensions Flare On Restive French Pacific Island Over Nickel Plant Sale
summary: French police evacuated workers and repelled pro-independence activists attempting to storm Vale’s nickel-and-cobalt plant in New Caledonia as tensions flare over a planned sale. The island holds large known nickel reserves; the unrest and property damage raise near-term risk of supply disruption. This likely weighs on nickel prices.

title: Quebec Precious Metals Corporation: Fjordland To Acquire Historic Renzy Nickel Copper Project, Quebec; Quebec Precious Metals Monetizes Non-Core Asset
summary: Fjordland agrees to acquire 100% of the Renzy nickel-copper project (Vulcain) in Quebec from QPM. The release cites historical high-grade nickel and copper intercepts, prior mining/concentrate shipments, and plans for renewed geophysical targeting and drilling. No aluminium-related information is provided.

title: Protests erupt in New Caledonia over proposed sale of major nickel mine
