summary: Protests in New Caledonia erupted over Vale’s planned sale of its major Goro nickel plant, with clashes, arson and arrests reported in Noumea. The unrest follows political disputes and a partner exit that delayed due diligence, raising near-term supply and transaction uncertainty for a key nickel producer.

title: Salazar Resources Limited: Salazar Resources Enters Letter of Intent to Acquire the Los Santos 2.1 Copper / Gold Project, El Oro, Ecuador
summary: Salazar Resources entered a letter of intent to acquire the Los Santos 2.1 gold/copper project in Ecuador and expand its Cerro Pelado land holdings. The release highlights copper-gold porphyry-style geology and anomalous copper results from historic sampling, but it remains exploration-focused with no production impact.

title: Nickel Creek Platinum Identifies Eleven New Geophysical Anomalies From Extensive Geophysics Program And Announces Results From Limited 2020 Drill Program
summary: Nickel Creek Platinum reported results from its 2020 EM geophysical survey and limited drilling at the Nickel Shäw Project in Yukon, Canada. The TEM work found 42 conductive anomalies, with 11 considered potentially massive nickel sulphide. The company is advancing exploration targets along trend of the Wellgreen deposit.

title: Copper-to-gold ratio points to higher bond yields in positive news for bank stocks
summary: The article argues that a rising copper-to-gold ratio signals improving global growth and higher inflation expectations, which would push Canadian bond yields higher. It links copper’s performance to economic outlook and suggests that a continued recovery scenario would lift copper sentiment, while softer data would pressure it.

title: Peru's copper production up 20% in October
summary: Peru’s copper production reportedly increased 20% in October, signaling higher mine output from a key global supplier. The rise suggests greater near-term availability, which can pressure copper prices by easing supply concerns and shifting short-term market expectations toward more supply.

title: Chilean state-owned copper company reaches salary agreement with Radomiro Tomic copper mining union_SMM
summary: Codelco said it reached a preliminary 36-month salary agreement with the Radomiro Tomic copper mining union. Wages are not affected, but workers receive a final bonus (~$4,800) and a variable incentive tied to output and cost targets. The firm previously maintained production during the COVID outbreak.

title: Shanghai nickel jumps on demand outlook, LME benchmark slips
summary: Shanghai nickel jumped, with the main January contract hitting its upper limit and closing up 3.8% after strong demand outlooks and speculative buying. LME nickel was mixed but remained near a more-than-one-year peak, supported by Chinese stainless demand and a supply crunch from an Indonesian export ban. Battery-grade demand is also rising.

title: Hot Chili ramps up Chilean copper production
summary: Hot Chili agreed with Chilean state miner ENAMI to process more copper ore from its Productora deposit at the Vallenar mill, lifting mining to 180,000 tpa. The deal increases royalties tied to copper sales, while rising copper prices boost value, but the incremental supply impact is likely limited globally.

title: Nickel price climbs
summary: Nickel surged more than 4% on Thursday to above $17,500/tonne for the first time since 2019, boosted by renewed Chinese steel mill demand, speculative buying at Shanghai Futures Exchange open, and strong iron ore futures. LME nickel leapt and copper also rose to a multi-year high before easing.

title: Shanghai bonded copper stocks fell 8,500 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Nonferrous Metals
summary: SMM said Shanghai bonded copper stocks declined for three straight weeks, dropping 8,500 mt from the prior week to 351,400 mt as of Dec 11. Traders cited delayed shipping and fewer arrivals, while warehouse receipts tied to prior import-profit opportunities were taken for import this week, further reducing inventories.

title: Indigenous communities stall Ecuador's most ambitious copper mining project
summary: Ecuador’s San Carlos Panantza, a major $3bn copper project, has been stalled nearly two years after disputes with the Shuar community and further attacks that burned installations and stole equipment. Planned copper exports this year have slipped, undermining Ecuador’s broader mining expansion and potentially weighing on near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Shanghai bonded refined nickel stocks fell 1,000 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Nonferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show refined nickel inventories in Shanghai bonded areas fell 1,000 mt to 22,800 mt. Nearly 1,000 mt of nickel plates were packed and shipped to an LME Asia delivery warehouse, easing stocks. The duty-free import window for briquettes opened, though Russian nickel import losses remain, keeping inventory pressure.

title: Nickel ore inventories at Chinese ports rose 101,000 wmt to 9.41 million wmt_SMM
summary: SMM data show nickel ore inventories across all Chinese ports rose 101,000 wmt from Dec 4 to 9.41 million wmt as of Dec 11. In nickel content, stocks increased 1,000 mt to 74,600 mt. Seven major ports saw an additional 141,000 wmt increase to 7.13 million wmt.

title: Rockcliff Metals Corp.: Positive PEA Results Demonstrates Path to Copper Production After Tax NPV8 of $71M and IRR of 30%
summary: Rockcliff Metals reported positive PEA economics for its Tower and Rail copper-focused project in Manitoba, including post-tax NPV8 and IRR based on copper (and other metal) price assumptions. The study projects steady-state CuEq production and unit costs, but the results are preliminary and do not guarantee near-term supply.

title: Dr. Ioannou is a Bull on Nickel for the New Green Economy - The Wall Street Transcript
summary: The interview is bullish on nickel and copper, citing China’s large share of base-metal consumption and ongoing demand support from stimulus and stockpile replenishment. It also warns of constrained copper supply from EV-related incremental demand and notes nickel cathodes’ reliance on nickel in EV batteries, supporting higher nickel demand.

title: Resolution Copper may be on the fast track in Trump's final days
summary: The U.S. Forest Service moved the deadline for the final environmental review of the Resolution Copper mine to Dec. 31, enabling a 60-day clock for a required land exchange. Opponents allege political pressure to “fast-track” approvals. The project remains dependent on several other regulatory sign-offs.

title: Moscow Exchange: Reduction Of Lot Size For Norilsk Nickel Futures Contract
summary: Moscow Exchange is reducing the lot size for Norilsk Nickel nickel futures contracts. The adjustment is aimed at changing contract specifications for trading. It may influence liquidity and short-term price discovery in nickel futures, though the article does not indicate any immediate change to underlying supply, demand, or inventories.

title: Chile's mining industry mulls increase of copper smelting capacity
summary: The piece says Chile’s mining industry is considering expanding copper smelting capacity. If capacity additions proceed, market participants may expect more refined copper supply from Chile, which can weigh on copper prices in the short term. Timing and size of the increase are not specified in the excerpt.

title: The Tesla team will visit the world's largest nickel reserve country next month to discuss investment opportunities in the lithium battery industry._SMM
summary: Indonesia confirmed Tesla will visit next month to discuss EV supply-chain investment. The dialogue focused on battery components, with Indonesian leaders highlighting the country’s vast nickel reserves and prospects to build nickel supply chains to cut costs. Musk indicated plans for large long-term contracts tied to nickel mining efficiency.

title: Trump's push to turn sacred Arizona oasis into a copper pit
summary: The article says the Trump administration is rushing the Forest Service process to transfer Oak Flat in Arizona to Resolution Copper (Rio Tinto/BHP), enabling a large open-pit copper mine. It describes earlier legal protections and acceleration of the environmental review and land transfer timeline.

title: Federal Government guarantees Alcoa's Portland aluminium smelter income during peak power-usage periods
summary: Australia’s federal government will provide $76.8 million to underwrite Alcoa’s Portland aluminium smelter income when it must reduce load during peak electricity demand. The funding is expected to prevent summer power curtailments through 2025 and keep the ~600 jobs and smelter operating, supporting aluminium supply expectations.

title: China Moly buys 95% of DRC copper-cobalt mine from U.S.-based Freeport for $550 million
summary: China Molybdenum said it bought a 95% stake in the Kisanfu copper-cobalt mine in the DRC from Freeport for $550 million. The acquisition adds sizable copper reserves near China Moly’s Tenke Fungurume operations. It is a supply-related copper development but not a short-term production change.

title: Alcoa's Portland aluminium smelter subsidy secures jobs, fails green energy test
summary: Australia’s federal government will underwrite Alcoa’s Portland aluminium smelter with $76.8m, expected to keep the plant operating until 2025 and compensate for curtailments during peak power demand. The policy supports grid reliability while reducing the risk of closures, which may support near-term aluminium supply expectations.

title: London nickel scales 14-month peak on supply crunch fears
summary: Nickel surged to a 14-month peak in London and topped contract levels in Shanghai, gaining on supply crunch fears. Support comes from higher China stainless steel prices and concerns about nickel availability. The Eramet New Caledonia smelter is running low on ore due to protests, while Philippines output fell 12% year-to-date.

title: SLN mine still shut amid New Caledonia nickel debate
summary: New Caledonia reports SLN’s Thio nickel mine is still closed as pro-independence FLNKS-related protests continue. Roadblocks were lifted, but unrest persists after Vale’s planned sale to a new consortium, amid opposition to Trafigura involvement. Talks are expected, leaving nickel output supply risks elevated.

title: Price of secondary aluminium relatively stable amid slower increase in aluminium prices _SMM
summary: SMM reports secondary aluminium prices in East China and in the domestic spot market have been relatively stable despite recent highs. Die-casting buyers resist higher prices due to losses, while scrap supply is harder to secure amid cautious demand and limited scrap imports under new tariff coding.

title: Wasesa acquires Indonesia copper mine | News
summary: Wasesa Indo Nusa is closing a $163 million deal to acquire a 100% stake in Asiamet Resources’ Beruang Kanan Main copper project in Central Kalimantan. The transaction can influence market expectations for future copper supply and project development, offering a mild bullish tone for copper.

title: Fire at New Caledonia's Vale nickel mine site
summary: A fire broke out at Vale’s nickel mine site in New Caledonia, following last week’s riots that already led to the site being closed. Firefighters worked overnight to contain the blaze and protect fuel and equipment. The incident comes amid ongoing protests over Vale’s planned sale, now potentially worsening nickel supply disruption.

title: China Molybdenum buys 95 pct stake in DRC copper-cobalt mine--China Economic Net
summary: China Molybdenum agreed to buy a 95% stake in the Kisanfu copper-cobalt mine in the DRC from Freeport-McMoRan for $550 million. The project is estimated to contain 6.28 million tonnes of copper. The deal may improve sentiment on future copper supply, supporting prices short term.

title: Shipments of copper cathode from Guangdong increased over 30% in November_SMM
summary: SMM says copper cathode shipments from Guangdong warehouses rose to 97,000 mt (+30.2% y/y, +42.2% m/m) as rod, tube, and bar/plate/strip producers’ operating rates recovered and customers stockpiled ahead of year-end. Secondary copper arrivals under an import policy may later add supply, so the net near-term effect on cathode demand seems modest.

title: Los Andes Copper Ltd. Announces Successful Completion of Public Participation Process for the Drilling Permitting Process
summary: Los Andes Copper Ltd. said Chile’s public participation process for the drilling campaign permitting was finalized, following a court-ordered SEA process. Comments will be compiled and the company is expected to formally respond by March 13, 2021, before resubmission for environmental voting. Drilling is delayed by months, but overall timing is expected unchanged.

title: Golden Dawn Minerals Inc.: Golden Dawn to Fly Airborne Survey to Test New Theory on Location of the Source to the World-Class Phoenix Copper-Gold Mine
summary: Golden Dawn Minerals plans an airborne geophysical survey in early January over its Phoenix copper-gold property in southeastern British Columbia to test where the hydrothermal system roots are located. The update is exploratory and does not change production or supply expectations immediately. Historical copper-gold grades are cited but unverified.

title: Copper subdued as virus resurgence dents sentiment
summary: Copper was little changed as renewed COVID-19 lockdown fears dented investor sentiment, offsetting strong China industrial output data. While most-tracked prices stayed in narrow ranges, LME aluminium and nickel also moved modestly with the broader risk-off tone. Analysts highlighted heightened downside risk during winter.

title: Operating rates at aluminium extrusion producers rose slightly in November_SMM
summary: SMM says operating rates at China’s aluminium extrusion producers rose in November, helped by moderate orders and stronger industrial extrusion demand (autos, PV, electronics, rail). Environmental restrictions reduced output in Henan and Shandong. Aluminium spot prices also jumped, and December operating rates are expected to rise.

title: Copper concentrate output to increase in 2021 despite low benchmark TCs_SMM
summary: SMM reports Chinese smelters’ 2021 copper concentrate treatment charges at $59.5/mt and refining charges at 5.95 cents/lb, slightly below 2020. Despite benchmark TCs hitting multi-year lows, SMM expects smelter output to remain stable and copper cathode output to rise, with spot TCs likely rebounding later in 2021.

title: 1.5% of medium-grade nickel ore prices to decline in December _SMM
summary: SMM says medium-grade nickel ore prices held near $75/wmt in November, but spot shipments thinned as rain affected Philippine supply. Negotiations for January FOB/CIF levels with Qingshan are at a deadlock, with a 1.5% bidding CIF price quoted at $52/wmt. Prices are expected to fall in December or January.

title: Economic Data - Copper Stays Supported After Strong Chinese Economic Data
summary: COMEX copper futures found bargain buying after strong Chinese economic data. Despite weak equities and concerns around Covid-19 and lockdowns, the article says the upbeat economic backdrop kept copper supported. Base metals were mixed overall, but copper remained resilient on the data-driven demand outlook.

title: China data and vaccine optimism lifts copper price
summary: Copper prices rose as China’s factory data pointed to faster economic growth in the top consumer, and vaccine rollout boosted risk sentiment. Funds’ bullish copper positioning also remained elevated. The piece adds that China’s primary aluminium output hit a record, while nickel edged higher alongside the broader base-metals tone.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: Talon Metals Intersects 2.71 Meters (8.9 Feet) of Shallow Mineralization Grading 5.13% Nickel Outside of the Company's Current Resource Area
summary: Talon Metals reported BHEM-guided drilling at its Tamarack nickel-copper-cobalt project, intersecting shallow massive sulphide mineralization grading 5.13% Ni over 2.71m within a wider 9.55m zone at 2.12% Ni, with accompanying copper grades. The release is exploration-focused and does not alter near-term supply materially.

title: Nickel reserves, Job Creation Law may help Indonesia attract Tesla: Expert
summary: Indonesia’s nickel reserves and its recently passed Jobs Creation Law are highlighted as factors to attract Tesla investment, with government officials discussing cooperation to develop EV battery supply chains. The piece also reiterates Indonesia’s nickel ore export ban aimed at expanding smelting, supporting near-term expectations for nickel demand.

title: Ero Copper intersects 46.5 meters grading 4.96% copper including 36.5 meters grading 6.08% copper extending high-grade mineralization within the Deepening Extension Zone -- identifies three different styles of PGM mineralization throughout the Curaçá Valley
summary: Ero Copper reported drill results from its Vale do Curaçá Pilar mine, highlighting new “Superpod” high-grade intercepts including 46.5m at 4.96% copper and 20.3m at 4.76% copper, plus a potential new parallel lens at depth. The update is supportive for near-term copper production outlook and sentiment.

title: Talon Metals Intersects 2.71 Meters of Shallow Mineralization Grading 5.13% Nickel Outside of the Company's Current Resource Area
summary: Talon Metals reported BHEM-guided drilling outside its current resource area at the Tamarack project, intersecting 2.71m of massive sulphide grading 5.13% Ni (plus associated copper) in shallow mineralization. The company plans further drilling to delineate resources, but no production or supply change is indicated.

title: SKC to build first overseas copper foil plant in Malaysia
summary: SKC plans to more than quadruple copper foil production by building its first overseas plant in Malaysia, alongside expansions in Korea, targeting EV battery demand. Copper foil will be shipped to EV battery makers including CATL and Panasonic. Operations are expected from 2023, with further domestic capacity ramping next year.

title: Eramet SA: BASF and Eramet partner to assess the development of a nickel-cobalt refining complex to supply growing electric vehicle market
summary: BASF and Eramet signed an agreement to jointly assess a nickel and cobalt hydrometallurgical refining complex (HPAL in Weda Bay, Indonesia, plus a base metal refinery). If developed, it would process local ore and supply additional nickel (~42,000 t/year) for EV battery materials, supporting demand expectations for nickel.

title: U.S. Department of Commerce Makes Substantive Changes to Section 232 Steel and Aluminum Tariff Exclusions Process | Faegre Drinker Biddle & Reath LLP
summary: U.S. Commerce announced interim changes to the Section 232 exclusion process, including General Approved Exclusions (GAEs) for selected steel and aluminum items. For aluminum, GAEs allow duty-free entry of enumerated products without objections and without quantity limits, likely easing import costs and weighing on domestic aluminum prices.

title: FPX Nickel Provides Outlook for 2021
summary: FPX Nickel reported year-end progress on its Baptiste nickel-cobalt project, including a preliminary economic assessment projecting long mine life and costs, plus plans for maiden drilling at the Van target and further metallurgical testing for EV battery-grade nickel/cobalt products. It also expands carbon sequestration studies for the tailings.

title: Eramet : BASF and Eramet study the feasibility of nickel-cobalt production for electric batteries
summary: Eramet and BASF signed an agreement to study feasibility of a nickel-cobalt hydrometallurgical refining complex in Weda Bay, Indonesia. The project would include an HPAL plant and base metal refinery, targeting mid-2020s startup, and could provide BASF access to an additional 42,000 tonnes of nickel annually.

title: Copper: The Most Critical Metal
summary: The piece contends copper faces tightening supply as mines age, expansions are delayed, and production is cut or disrupted, while electrification, renewables and EV charging drive growing demand. It references BHP’s ramp-up and expansion plans at Spence amid broader investment needs and notes copper’s recent price strength.

title: Surge Copper Signs Option Agreement to Acquire a 70% Interest in The Berg Copper Project from Centerra Gold Inc.
summary: Surge Copper signed an option agreement to acquire a 70% interest in the Berg Copper Project from Centerra Gold. The news is a copper-focused asset deal that may slightly improve sentiment around future copper development and output prospects, offering mild near-term support for copper prices.

title: Equipment torched as worker protest paralyzes Indonesia nickel plant
summary: Hundreds of workers protested at Indonesia’s PT Virtue Dragon Nickel Industry smelter in Konawe, turning violent and damaging equipment, with operations “paralyzed.” The disruption threatens nickel supply from the billion-dollar refining facility, where exports and nickel processing are strategically important, adding upside pressure to nickel prices.

title: Equipment torched as worker protest paralyses Indonesian nickel plant
summary: Hundreds of workers at PT Virtue Dragon Nickel Industry’s Indonesian nickel smelter in Sulawesi protested for higher pay and permanent jobs for contractors. The protest turned violent, with workers torching vehicles and buildings, and the company said smelter activities were paralysed, disrupting nickel supply.

title: Canada Nickel Signs Groundbreaking Memorandum of Understanding with Taykwa Tagamou Nation on The Crawford Nickel-Cobalt Sulphide Project
summary: Canada Nickel signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding with Taykwa Tagamou Nation for the Crawford nickel-cobalt sulfide project, including plans for TTN-managed electrical transmission assets to supply power and potential future minority interest options. Ontario also publicly supports the partnership, framing it as enabling sustainable development.

title: Kodiak Copper Corp.: Kodiak Provides Update and 2021 Exploration Plans for its MPD Copper-Gold Porphyry Project
summary: Kodiak Copper Corp. reports successful 2020 drilling at its MPD copper-gold porphyry project and outlines a fully funded 2021 exploration program of up to 30,000 metres. Results show high-grade copper-gold intervals at the Gate Zone, with further step-out drilling planned, but no near-term production impact.

title: Huntsman Exploration Inc.: Huntsman Completes Financings, Key Acquisitions; Moves Forward with Large Scale Gold and Nickel Projects
summary: Huntsman Exploration reports successful financings and acquisitions, and it says the permitting process has begun for an upcoming 18-hole drill program at its Canegrass high-grade nickel project in Western Australia, which also hosts copper. Work is expected after permits are received, but no production changes are announced.

title: Surge Copper to acquire 70% stake in Berg copper project in Canada
summary: Surge Copper agreed to buy a 70% stake in Centerra Gold’s Berg copper-molybdenum-silver project in British Columbia for C$5m in shares and C$8m in spending commitments. The deal supports copper resource expansion but offers no near-term production impact, so it is unlikely to move copper prices quickly.

title: Canada Nickel Makes Fourth New Discovery - North Zone at Crawford Nickel-Cobalt Sulphide Project
summary: Canada Nickel announced a fourth discovery—North Zone—at its Crawford nickel-cobalt sulphide project in Ontario. Two drill holes intersected mineralized dunite over long intervals, expanding a large geophysical anomaly, but assay results are pending. The update may modestly support nickel supply expectations despite no near-term production impact.

title: Canada Nickel signs unique agreement with First Nation at Crawford project
summary: Canada Nickel signed a memorandum of understanding with the Taykwa Tagamou First Nation for electric power development tied to its Crawford nickel-cobalt sulphide project in Ontario. The partnership is intended to enable project progress by securing power, which could modestly support near-term nickel supply expectations.

title: Golden Deeps builds copper potential in Namibia with discovery of three surface anomalies
summary: Golden Deeps reports three newly detected surface copper anomalies on Namibia prospecting tenements near Trigon Metals’ Kombat mine and close to Votorantim Metals’ Deblin deposit. Soil sampling found peak copper readings (279 ppm and 365 ppm) and defined targets for shallow reconnaissance drilling. No production or supply change is stated.

title: Copper advances as investors eye further U.S. stimulus
summary: Copper prices rose for a third straight session as investors looked for additional U.S. COVID-19 aid and the Fed pledged continued support until recovery is secure. The article also notes aluminium up on the day, while nickel fell on China’s SHFE, reflecting broadly risk-on sentiment.

title: BASF and Eramet partner to assess the development of a nickel-cobalt refining complex to supply growing electric vehicle market
summary: BASF and Eramet will assess a nickel-cobalt HPAL refining complex fed by Eramet’s Weda Bay mining ore. The project is intended to supply intermediate and cathode active materials for EV batteries, targeting ~42,000 metric tons of nickel and 5,000 tons of cobalt annually from the mid-2020s.

title: Aluminium billet inventories rose 2,700 mt on week on larger arrivals_SMM
summary: SMM reported that China’s aluminium billet inventories rose 2,700 mt week on week to 73,000 mt as of Dec 17, mainly due to increased arrivals. Foshan stocks jumped, while some regions declined (notably Changzhou). Overall buildup suggests improved supply and potentially weaker short-term market tightness for aluminium.

title: From January to October of WBMS:2020, there is a supply shortage of 1.143 million tons in the global copper market._SMM
summary: WBMS data show a global copper supply deficit of 1.143 million tonnes from January to October 2020, larger than the 383,000 tonnes shortage for all of 2019. Demand rose to 20.8 million tonnes, while production gains were insufficient. Inventories increased but net balance remained tight.

title: Roskiel: copper demand will grow by 28% over the next 10 years_SMM
summary: Roskiel forecasts global copper consumption to rise 28% from about 30Mt in 2020 to 38Mt by 2030, led by China. It expects copper demand to fall slightly this year, but notes scrap import restrictions force more refined purchases, supporting copper prices. LME copper has recently hit highs since March.

title: The U.S. Department of Commerce modifies Article 232 Steel and Aluminum tariff exclusion procedures_SMM
summary: The U.S. Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security issued new rules changing Section 232 tariff exclusion procedures for aluminum and steel. The stated goal is faster, more effective approval, with an estimated 5,000 fewer exclusion requests annually. The impact could shift near-term aluminum import costs and availability.

title: Putin: Nornickel should bear responsibility for Arctic fuel spill
summary: Putin said Norilsk Nickel should be responsible for a major diesel spill in Russia’s Arctic, where 21,000 tonnes leaked into rivers and subsoil near Norilsk. A lawsuit by the environmental watchdog seeks $2 billion and has a Dec. 24 hearing. The case and environmental obligations add operational risk.

title: LG And Tesla Reportedly Ink Deal For Nickel-Based Batteries
summary: LG Chem and Tesla reportedly signed a deal for nickel-based batteries. LG will produce NCMA batteries (nickel, cobalt, manganese and aluminium anode materials) and provide them to Tesla next year. The arrangement links Tesla’s battery sourcing to higher demand expectations for nickel and some aluminium content.

title: Metso Outotec to modernize Norilsk Nickel smelting line in Russia - Chemical Engineering
summary: Metso Outotec won a ~EUR 90 million contract to modernize PJSC MMC Norilsk Nickel’s Nadezhda smelting line in Norilsk. The scope includes a nickel flash smelting furnace and heat recovery boiler to boost capacity and availability, cut metal losses, and improve maintenance, supporting stronger near-term nickel production outlooks.

title: Mason Valley Copper Has Sold Nevada Mining Claims to Hudbay Minerals
summary: The piece reports that Mason Valley Copper sold its Nevada mining claims to Hudbay Minerals. While claim ownership can influence future copper supply plans, the available information lacks project scale, permitting, and production timelines, making any near-term effect on copper prices likely minimal.

title: Protests erupt in New Caledonia over sale of nickel mine
summary: Protests in New Caledonia over Vale’s planned sale of its nickel assets escalated into riots, with road blockades, violence, and police action. The Vale plant was damaged and forced to shut, and the Thio mine was closed, cutting local nickel output and raising short-term supply concerns.

title: Copper set for seventh straight weekly gain on U.S. stimulus hopes
summary: Copper prices rose on Friday and were set for a seventh straight weekly gain as expectations for a new U.S. COVID-19 aid package increased. Three-month copper on the LME climbed 0.9% and remained up for the week, reflecting improved demand sentiment tied to stimulus hopes.

title: Wood is on fire and nickel shines | MarketScreener
summary: The piece says nickel is a top performer as Indonesia faces labor unrest that paralyzed sections of national production. With global supply concerns rising, nickel prices surged to about $17,650/mt. The article contrasts this with earlier disruption from Indonesia’s nickel-ore export ban.

title: Hussey Copper to pay fine, serve probation
summary: Hussey Copper, a flat-rolled copper products manufacturer, pleaded guilty to Clean Water Act violations for discharging pollutants, including oil and copper, into the Ohio River and falsifying discharge monitoring reports. The company will pay a $550,000 fine and face three years probation, with added compliance requirements under a civil consent decree.

title: Shanghai bonded copper stocks fell 4,400 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Nonferrous Metals
summary: Shanghai bonded copper inventories declined for four consecutive weeks, falling 4,400 mt to 347,000 mt by Dec 18. The drop was linked to smaller inbound arrivals and lower port efficiency as customs strengthened quarantine checks, making some ships harder to dock.

title: Shanghai bonded refined nickel stocks fell 800 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Nonferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show Shanghai bonded refined nickel inventories fell 800 mt from the prior week to 22,000 mt by Dec 18. Nickel briquette arrivals continued via direct customs clearance while import losses on nickel plates persisted. About 800 mt of nickel plates were packed and shipped overseas to LME Asia warehouses, reducing bonded stocks for two straight weeks.

title: Copper reaches 7-year highs as commodities enter 'super-cycle'
summary: Copper hit seven-year highs above $8,000/t on the London Metal Exchange as markets anticipate a supply shortfall against strong demand, led by China’s recovery and tight LME stockpiles at a six-year low. Analysts cite the start of a commodities “super-cycle,” boosted by a weaker dollar and green-tech demand. Aluminium also rose.

title: Pacific Empire Minerals Corp.: Pacific Empire Signs Definitive Agreement to Option Kitimat Copper-Gold Project
summary: Pacific Empire Minerals signed an agreement granting CAVU an exclusive option to earn up to a 100% interest in its Kitimat copper-gold project. The deal involves cash, share payments, and minimum funded exploration expenditures. The company describes copper-gold mineralization but provides no production timeline.

title: COVID-19: Dr Copper offers encouraging prognosis for world economy
summary: Copper prices have surged to multi-year highs on the LME and nine-year highs on SHFE, with gains across seven weeks. The article links the rally to improving growth sentiment, a weaker US dollar, tight warehouse stocks, container shipping disruptions into China, and possible supply strain amid Chile miner demands/strikes.

title: Nickel ore inventories at Chinese ports fell 557,000 wmt to 8.85 million wmt_SMM
summary: SMM data shows nickel ore inventories at Chinese ports fell 557,000 wmt from Dec 11 to 8.85 million wmt by Dec 18. Ni content stocks dropped 4,500 mt to 70,100 mt, while inventories at seven major ports fell 577,000 wmt to 6.55 million wmt.

title: Pacific Empire Signs Definitive Agreement to Option Kitimat Copper-Gold Project
summary: Pacific Empire Minerals signed an agreement giving CAVU an exclusive option to earn up to a 100% interest in the Kitimat copper-gold project in British Columbia. The deal includes cash and share payments and CAVU-funded exploration expenditures. It signals advancing exploration but no near-term copper production impact.

title: mediacongo.net - Appel d'offres - Supply of clearing agent services for the out-bond logistics of sulphide copper concentrate
summary: The document is a request for quotation for clearing agent services supporting out-bound logistics of sulphide copper concentrate from Kamoa to various destinations. It is an operational procurement notice without any stated change in mine output, exports, inventories, or broader supply constraints that would likely move copper prices within weeks.

title: The Importance of Copper in China's Economy
summary: CME’s analysis argues copper prices are supported by surging Chinese demand—June unwrought imports jumped 50% month-on-month to a record 656,483 tonnes—while supply is constrained by COVID-19 outbreaks in Peru and temporary closures/suspensions at Chile’s Codelco. Stimulus, infrastructure plans, and renewable/EV demand are cited as further near-term supports.

title: Over 400 metalworkers on strike at Constellium aluminum plant in Alabama
summary: Over 400 metalworkers struck indefinitely at Constellium’s aluminum plant in Muscle Shoals, Alabama after contract negotiations failed. The stoppage targets proposed health-care cuts and other labor practices. The plant supplies aluminum sheet for beverage can production, so the dispute could reduce near-term aluminum supply and support prices.

title: Long-term contracts for copper imports in 2021 trended lower_SMM | Shanghai Nonferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that long-term copper import contract levels for 2021 trended lower, with more deals using floating pricing and many offers below $70/mt versus Codelco’s $88/mt. Weaker China-driven demand expectations, COVID-related overseas uncertainty, and new secondary copper import rules are cited as bearish for imports.

title: Tartisan Nickel Corp. Closes $1 Million Flow-Through Financing With Probity Mining at $0.43 per Unit
summary: Tartisan Nickel Corp. closed a $1 million flow-through financing at $0.43 per unit with proceeds intended to fund exploration and development of its Kenbridge Nickel Project in northwestern Ontario. The company plans to start work in winter 2021, which may support long-term nickel prospects but is unlikely to move near-term nickel prices materially.

title: Talon Metals Discusses a Transformational Year Ahead for the Tamarack Nickel Project
summary: Talon Metals provided an update on the Tamarack nickel-copper-cobalt project in Minnesota, highlighting drilling progress, metallurgical test work, and plans to issue an updated PEA and move toward pre-feasibility in 2021. The company aims to develop battery-grade nickel and potentially refined products, supporting long-dated nickel supply expectations.

title: Apache Nation Organizes Day of Action Against Proposed Copper Mine
summary: A day of action in Arizona was organized against a proposed copper mine at Oak Flat, with opponents citing destruction of an ancient forest and potential contamination across southern Arizona. The Trump administration was described as rushing to approve multiple energy and mining projects, raising uncertainty and possible delays for copper supply plans.

title: Pacific Empire Signs Definitive Agreement to Option Pinnacle Copper-Gold Project
summary: Pacific Empire Minerals signed a definitive option agreement for the Pinnacle copper-gold project in British Columbia. 1111 Acquisition can earn 70% by funding CDN$5.7m of exploration and paying cash and share consideration over four years. The company retains a 30% free-carried interest until a pre-feasibility study.

title: Chile set to vote on approval for copper mine expansion
summary: Chile is expected to vote on whether to approve expansion of a copper mine. Approval would likely increase future copper production capacity, shifting near-term market expectations toward higher supply. That usually exerts downward pressure on copper prices in the following days as traders price in the potential expansion outcome.

title: Excelsior produces first copper cathode at Gunnison in Arizona
summary: Excelsior Mining says its Gunnison copper project in Arizona has produced its first copper cathode. The company expects to sell early cathode shipments in January, signaling commissioning progress for its ISR operation. The update modestly supports copper supply outlook while remaining limited by the sales timing.

title: The first batch of copper concentrate of Xifuma Copper Mine is produced and sold._SMM
summary: Casampa Mining Co. (China Mineral Resources) produced and sold the first batch of about 600 tons of copper concentrate from the Xifuma Copper Mine in Zambia. The project is moving into substantive operations, with long-run output estimated at 10,000–20,000 tons of copper concentrate annually. This adds near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Hannan Metals Ltd.: Hannan Expands San Martin Copper-Silver Project Portfolio To 937 sq km
summary: Hannan Metals announced it expanded mineral tenure in Peru’s San Martin district by staking an additional 278 sq km of concessions prospective for sediment-hosted copper-silver, bringing total holdings to 937 sq km. The new areas extend an existing JV with JOGMEC, which aims to advance toward a feasibility study.

title: City lauds Canada Nickel agreement with First Nations
summary: Timmins praised Canada Nickel’s new MOU with Wabun Tribal Council and Taykwa Tagamou Nation, saying it advances the Crawford nickel-cobalt project toward permitting. The mayor links the agreement to job creation and progress on NetZero Metals’ planned processing facility for zero-carbon nickel, aligning with electric-vehicle demand.

title: Nickel Forecast 2021: Juniors Optimistic, Challenges Remain
summary: The article expects nickel to stay oversupplied in 2026, citing strong Indonesian production and softer demand from stainless steel and EV/battery markets. Prices were volatile in Q1 2026 but have struggled below key highs. Even with Indonesian quota adjustments and mixed exchange inventories, oversupply risks further downside.

title: City of Timmins lauds Canada Nickel agreement with First Nations
summary: Timmins praised Canada Nickel’s newly announced MOU with local First Nations, saying it helps move the Crawford nickel-cobalt sulphide project toward permitting. The company also plans a nearby research and processing facility via NetZero Metals to produce low/zero-carbon nickel for EV demand, supporting regional mining jobs.

title: UAE's EGA signs deal with Indonesia to provide tech know-how for aluminium smelter
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) signed an agreement with Indonesia’s state-owned INALUM to retrofit technology at the North Sumatran smelter, targeting higher performance and production. The upgrade is expected to add around 20,000 tonnes/year, with possible future cooperation on building a new smelter using EGA technology.

title: LIVE FUTURES REPORT 22/12: Nickel down 1.6%; LME complex falls on Covid-19 variant fears
summary: Nickel futures were down 1.6% in the LME complex, with the report attributing the decline to fears around a new Covid-19 variant. Such risk-off sentiment typically pressures near-term demand expectations for industrial metals. The piece references broader LME weakness but gives nickel the clearest impact detail.

title: MMG says production at Las Bambas copper mine in Peru hit by road blockades
summary: MMG says Peru’s Las Bambas copper mine is progressively cutting production after local residents blocked a key road, stopping mining trucks from using routes in Cusco’s Velille district. The disruption follows protests over perceived lack of local benefits and affects a mine supplying roughly 2% of global copper.

title: China aluminium scrap imports fell 40.4% in October_SMM | Shanghai Nonferrous Metals
summary: China’s aluminium scrap imports fell to 47,000 mt in October, down 40.4% month-on-month and 21.5% year-on-year, with total imports in the first ten months down 48%. Customs data also show new tariff effects in early November, implying only modest remaining imports in November-December.

title: Operating rates at secondary aluminium producers rose to 62.4% in November _SMM
summary: SMM data shows secondary aluminium producer operating rates rose to 62.4% in November (+4.9 pp m/m) on stronger auto-driven orders, but scrap and secondary trading were muted while aluminium prices jumped. Large producers stayed cautious in mid-December, and operating rates are expected to fall sharply in December.

title: China's aluminium imports surpass 2009 record high
summary: China’s aluminium imports surged to a record annual high, with November inflows bringing January-November totals to 2.44 million tonnes, far above 2009 levels. The flows were encouraged by earlier Shanghai-London price arbitrage and continue via unwrought aluminium and alloyed products as scrap import restrictions tighten.

title: NORNICKEL SHUTS DOWN SMELTER IN NIKEL TOWN
summary: Norilsk Nickel said it is shutting down its oldest smelting shop in Nikel, Russia (Murmansk region) as part of an environmental program to eliminate cross-border sulphur dioxide emissions. The closure reduces the local nickel smelting operation and implies tighter nickel supply, while copper and aluminium are not addressed.

title: Canada Nickel Announces Positive Initial Metallurgy Results at Crawford Nickel-Cobalt Sulphide Project
summary: Canada Nickel said lab locked-cycle metallurgy for its Crawford nickel-cobalt sulphide project achieved nickel recoveries of 46% and 51% with concentrate grades above 30% for some tests. The company will continue flowsheet optimization in 2021, which can improve expected production economics and support nickel sentiment.

title: Meridian Mining S.E.: Meridian Provides Update on Espigao Copper-Gold Exploration Program
summary: Meridian Mining reported expanded open geochemical anomalies and newly modelled EM bedrock conductors at its Espigão copper-gold polymetallic project in Brazil. Copper-bearing DDH intersections and soil anomalies co-occur with EM conductors, strengthening IOCG prospectivity and potential future copper resources. No production or supply changes were indicated.

title: German Antitrust Watchdog Fines Aluminum Cartel €175M
summary: German antitrust authorities reportedly fined an aluminium cartel €175M. The action highlights regulatory enforcement against coordinated behavior in the aluminium market, which can reduce the likelihood of price support from collusion. That prospect typically pressures near-term aluminium prices lower, though the immediate magnitude is uncertain.

title: KPS Capital Partners Completes Acquisition Of Hussey Copper
summary: KPS Capital Partners completed its acquisition of Hussey Copper, a leading North American processor and fabricator of copper products and the largest copper bus bar manufacturer. The deal was approved by a bankruptcy court, with financial terms undisclosed. No specific change in production volumes, supply disruptions, or demand is described.

title: Ball Corporation Builds Aluminum Can Manufacturing Plant in Pittston, Pennsylvania
summary: Ball Corporation will retrofit a large facility in Pittston, Pennsylvania to produce multi-line aluminum beverage cans starting mid-2021. The company cites accelerating demand for infinitely recyclable aluminum packaging and existing long-term customer contracts, supported by state incentives and tax credits. The added capacity suggests incremental near-term aluminum demand support.

title: Copper dips, hovers near 8-year high on demand recovery hopes
summary: London copper edged lower but remained near an eight-year high as traders paused after a rally, supported by expectations of global/economic recovery and strong Chinese demand. Shanghai copper rose on the same optimism, alongside a note that China’s aluminium imports hit record levels, affecting nearby sentiment.

title: Primary aluminium inventories shrank 3,000 mt on week to 586,000 mt_SMM
summary: Primary aluminium social inventories across eight Chinese consumption areas fell by 3,000 mt week-on-week to 586,000 mt as of Dec 24. The decline was mainly driven by Gongyi and Nanhai, suggesting reduced near-term stock levels and tighter local availability for aluminium.

title: Aluminium billet inventories dipped 600 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Nonferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show China’s 6063 aluminium billet stocks across five major consumption areas fell 600 mt WoW to 72,400 mt by Dec 24. Declines in Wuxi and Nanchang (largest -3,200 mt) reflected stronger downstream purchases as prices moved lower, partially offset by builds in Foshan and Changzhou.

title: Copper dips, but hovers near multi-year high on demand recovery hopes
summary: London copper edged lower but remained near the highest level since 2013 on expectations of global/economic recovery and strong Chinese demand. The dollar’s softness outlook also supports dollar-priced metals. Separately, China’s aluminium imports hit a record annual high, indicating continued strong buying and arbitrage-fuelled flows.

title: Spruce Ridge Resources Limited: Spruce Ridge Intersects 22.75 Metres of 6.89% Copper at Great Burnt
summary: Spruce Ridge reported assay results from infill drilling at the Great Burnt copper-gold VMS deposit in Newfoundland, including 22.75 m at 6.89% Cu and a higher-grade interval of 12.55 m at 10.59% Cu. Management says historic drilling may have understated copper grades, boosting exploration outlook.

title: Will EcoProBM challenge Japan's Sumitomo in high nickel tech?
summary: EcoProBM is ramping cathode-material capacity via a joint venture with Samsung SDI, targeting large increases in NCA (high-nickel) supply. The expansion is expected to capture more EV battery material demand, supporting higher nickel-linked cathode utilization. Aluminium is mentioned as part of NCA supply, but impact is secondary.

title: Shanghai bonded copper stocks added 1,500 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Nonferrous Metals
summary: SMM said Shanghai bonded copper stocks rose 1,500 mt to 350,500 mt as of Dec 25, ending a four-week decline. The increase followed larger arrivals, weaker year-end trading, and reduced shipments due to invoicing suspension and delayed customs declarations. Bonded import economics were also less supportive.

title: Nickel ore inventories at Chinese ports rose 403,000 wmt to 9.25 million wmt_SMM
summary: SMM data shows Chinese nickel ore inventories at all ports rose 403,000 wmt to 9.25 million wmt between Dec 18 and Dec 25. In nickel content terms, stocks increased 3,100 mt to 73,200 mt. Inventories at seven major ports also climbed by 703,000 wmt to 7.25 million wmt.

title: Congo January-November copper output rises 12.4%, cobalt up 8.9%
summary: Congo’s copper output in January-November rose 12.4%, helped by mine-site confinement and government support. The government is also considering restarting defunct state mining companies and conducting aerial surveys for new deposits. The report is focused on production performance rather than near-term trade constraints or inventory changes.

title: Copper falls on weak China data
summary: Copper fell on the LME as weak China inflation and producer price figures weighed on sentiment. LME three-month copper closed down 1.3% to $5,595/ton, after hitting a one-week low during the session, reflecting concerns about China’s near-term demand.

title: Coal India prepares Rs 1L cr plan to diversify into aluminium, solar sectors
summary: Coal India’s ₹1 lakh crore plan will create SPVs for a greenfield aluminium project and an aluminium smelting unit with NALCO, alongside major solar manufacturing investments. The aluminium projects are planned in eastern India using captive thermal power, with locations under consideration but approvals already in place.

title: CSPT sets 2021 Q1 floor price of copper concentrate TC at $53/mt_SMM
summary: CSPT set Q1 2021 floor prices for imported copper concentrate TC/RC at $53/mt and 5.3 cent/lb, down from Q4 2020. Spot concentrate remained tight in Q4, with spot TCs often below $50/mt, but trading became active after contracts were agreed and spot TCs rose on optimism about future supply.

title: Long-term contract benchmark RCs of blister copper to rise on ample supply_SMM
summary: SMM reports benchmark long-term refining charges for blister copper in 2021 are expected at $140–145/mt, higher than prior expectations due to ample blister supply. Scrap inflows since a secondary copper policy took effect boosted domestic blister availability, weakening reliance on imports. It also notes delays tied to COVID-19 and VAT disputes.

title: Shanghai copper gains for third session as Trump approves U.S. stimulus
summary: Shanghai copper rose for a third session after Trump signed a $2.3 trillion coronavirus aid package, boosting near-term demand expectations. ShFE nickel also gained, while aluminum fell. The piece adds supportive fundamentals like tight supply and better China industrial activity, plus specific disruptions and trade-related supply issues.

title: Global Wet Alumina Trihydrate Market 2020 Key Players, Regions, Company Profile, Growth Opportunity and Challenges by 2025 – Business
summary: The article summarizes a 2020 market report on Wet Alumina Trihydrate (ATH), listing companies, regional segments, and applications such as aluminium sulfate and polyaluminium chloride. Since ATH is used in aluminium-related processes, it is connected to aluminium supply chains, but the release contains no actionable near-term price catalysts.

title: London copper edges up on U.S. stimulus paychecks optimism
summary: London copper rose 1.4% as investors anticipated U.S. $2,000 COVID relief checks could accelerate economic recovery and boost metal consumption, with a weaker dollar supporting dollar-priced commodities. The report also shows nickel up and aluminium down, indicating mixed short-term responses across base metals.

title: Inner Mongolia intends to control total capacity of steel and refined aluminium industries_SMM
summary: Inner Mongolia’s DRC drafted energy-consumption control measures requiring accelerated efficiency upgrades in high-energy sectors, and it will limit approvals for new ferroalloys and suspend/adjust projects. It specifically caps total capacity of refined aluminium and controls steel capacity, while cancelling preferential electricity prices.

title: Aluminium hits lowest level in a month, copper climbs
summary: Aluminium prices hit their lowest level in a month as investors worried that higher primary output and new capacity would add to surpluses, with Shanghai and LME contracts falling. Copper rose after the U.S. House approved larger coronavirus aid payments, supporting activity hopes. Nickel edged up, though drivers were not specified.

title: Aluminium hits lowest level in a month, copper climbs
summary: Aluminium prices dropped to a one-month low as investors worried that rising global primary output and new capacity would increase surpluses, with LME and Shanghai declines. Copper rose after the U.S. House approved higher coronavirus aid payments, boosting hopes for stronger near-term economic activity. Portfolio shifts also mentioned.

title: Metso Outotec divests its aluminum business - Chemical Engineering
summary: Metso Outotec has agreed to sell its aluminum business to REEL International, including green anode plants, anode rodshops, and casthouses used in aluminum smelters. Closing is expected in Q1 2021, with undisclosed value and no material impact on Metso Outotec’s financial results.

title: Altiplano Metals Inc.: Altiplano Advances to New Development Level at Farellon and Observes 2.15% Copper Grade
summary: Altiplano Metals reports expanded underground development at its Farellon copper-gold mine in Chile, reaching a new 376 m access level and advancing additional headings. Initial sampling at the 376 m level shows copper grades averaging 2.15%. The company also begins engineering studies for a ventilation upgrade to support further development.

title: Rising nickel prices to support project development, Fitch says
summary: Fitch Solutions forecasts nickel mine production growth of 8.3% year-on-year in 2021, above the 2010–2019 average of 5.9%, though it does not fully offset a projected 23.3% contraction in 2020 output. The report’s backdrop of rising nickel prices is expected to support project development.

title: Metso Outotec signs contracts in Russia for zinc, copper projects - Chemical Engineering
summary: Metso Outotec signed contracts in Russia for process equipment, including main equipment for a new high-capacity copper concentrator (four lines, 80m tonnes/year ore capacity). The order is booked in Q4 2020, with deliveries during 2022–2023. No copper price or near-term production effects are specified.

title: Chilean copper output expected to rise 22.6 pct in coming decade
summary: Chile’s Cochilco expects copper production to rise 22.6% by 2031, peaking at 7.35 million tons in 2028, but notes existing operations’ fine output could fall 31% versus 2019 due to COVID and delayed development. The update implies a need for new projects, mainly a longer-term signal.

title: Las Bambas blockades affect Peru copper shipments
summary: Peru’s Ministry of Energy and Mines opposed blockades on the Southern Runway that are disrupting transport. The disruption is linked to Las Bambas copper shipment logistics, raising short-term supply concerns. Such delays can reduce near-term copper availability and support expectations for higher prices over days to weeks.

title: Shanghai bonded copper stocks added 13,500 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data shows Shanghai bonded copper stocks rose 13,500 mt from the prior week to 364,000 mt as of Dec 31, supported by larger arrivals. The trade market turned active but imports remained unprofitable; domestic discounts and weak US dollar demand reduced exports, leading to a rebound in inventories for two consecutive weeks.

title: Nickel ore inventories at Chinese ports rose 40,000 wmt to 9.29 million wmt_SMM
summary: SMM data shows nickel ore inventories at Chinese ports rose by 40,000 wmt to 9.29 million wmt from Dec 25 to Dec 31. In nickel content, stocks increased to 73,500 mt. Stocks at seven major ports also climbed to 7.3 million wmt.

title: Argentina's Aluar aluminium smelter hits 70% capacity
summary: Argentina’s Aluar aluminium smelter reportedly is running at about 70% of capacity. The reduced operating rate suggests lower aluminium supply into the near term, which can shift short-run balance dynamics. The update is directly linked to aluminium production rather than other tracked metals.

title: Top LME performer copper dips on hazy new year outlook
summary: Copper prices fell on the LME as investors grew wary after copper’s strong 2020 outperformance. Analysts cited overheating/overextended speculative positioning, and expectations that China’s stimulus and metals-intensive investment cycle may peak in 2021, raising odds of a short-term correction. Other base metals were also weaker.

title: China's GEM seeks to take control of Indonesia nickel project
summary: GEM, a Chinese EV battery firm, plans to double its stake in an Indonesian nickel project at Morowali Industrial Park, rising to 72% from 36%. The company says the move is meant to strengthen strategic control amid a nickel shortage, implying firmer access to future nickel supply.

title: London copper jumps 1.5% as China's factory sector expands
summary: Reuters reports London/SHFE copper prices rose after Caixin/Markit PMI showed China’s factory activity expanded, boosting confidence in near-term demand as the economy recovers from COVID-19. Three-month LME copper gained about 1.4% and China’s February contract also increased, reflecting stronger macro demand sentiment.

title: GEM : Copper rises on weak U.S. dollar, upbeat broader markets
summary: Copper and most industrial metals rose Monday as the weaker U.S. dollar boosted demand for greenback-priced commodities and sentiment improved on hopes for global recovery. LME three-month copper gained to $7,910/tonne. Nickel rose sharply, topping a two-week high, alongside gains across broader commodity markets.

title: Copper rises on weak U.S. dollar, upbeat broader markets
summary: Copper rose 1.9% on the LME and nickel gained as much as 5% amid a weaker U.S. dollar and upbeat commodity/market sentiment. Broader gains were also linked to optimism over global economic recovery. The only offset noted is forthcoming GSCI/BCOM rebalancing that may sell copper within days.

title: Metso Outotec Wins Major Order To Deliver Key Process Technology For A New Copper Concentrator In Russia
summary: Metso Outotec won a major contract to deliver key processing technology for a new high-capacity copper concentrator in Russia. The plant will have four lines and process at least 80 million tonnes of ore per year, with grinding, flotation, dewatering equipment and automation delivered in 2022–2023. Order booked in Q4 2020.

title: Restoration of MFN tariff on solid waste imports to have little impact on aluminium industry_SMM
summary: China will cancel provisional import taxes on solid waste such as shredded metal scrap from Jan. 1, 2021 and restore MFN rates. For traditional shredded aluminium scrap, provisional tariffs are removed and MFN returns to 1.5%, but a 7602.0000 ban limits actual effect. Overall impact on aluminium is expected minimal.

title: China copper concentrate imports increased slightly in November_SMM
summary: China imported 1.83 million mt of copper ore and concentrate in November, up 8.3% month-on-month. Imports were down year-on-year, with Peru rising on mine recovery and Australia and the US falling amid political/tariff and operational risks. US inventory destocking may also reduce near-term supply.

title: Refined nickel update: Limited available cargoes after operations halts among traders, spot nickel quotes rose_SMM
summary: SMM says refined nickel spot strengthened as traders faced limited available cargoes and halted operations, leaving tighter supply. title: Chinese Metals Supplier GEM Soars on Deal to Hike Stake in Indonesia Nickel Salt Project
summary: GEM plans to raise its stake in an Indonesia lithium-battery nickel salt project to 72% from 36%, with its unit able to acquire partners’ shares and buy additional holdings. The JV targets production of battery-grade nickel sulfate, potentially improving supply expectations for nickel feedstock.

title: Worry about Indonesian supplies fuel nickel's surge
summary: Nickel prices jumped to two-week highs as traders worried about Indonesian nickel supplies following an earthquake in Sulawesi. Despite reports of limited damage at Morowali Industrial Park where Tsingshan produces nickel pig iron, buying surged. A weaker U.S. dollar and stronger manufacturing activity also supported broader base metals.

title: Worry about Indonesian supplies fuels nickel's surge
summary: Nickel prices surged to two-week highs as an earthquake in Indonesia sparked worries about nickel supply. LME nickel rose about 4.9% to around $17,420/t, with traders calling it a knee-jerk reaction because production at a major Indonesian facility appeared largely unaffected. Base metals also firmed on a weaker dollar and strong manufacturing.

summary: Reuters reports the U.S. Forest Service plans to publish a final environmental impact statement on Jan. 15 for Rio Tinto’s Resolution Copper project, a necessary step for a land swap. title: London copper eyes $8,000 as dollar slips
summary: London three-month copper rose 0.9% toward $8,000/t as a weaker U.S. dollar made dollar-priced metals cheaper for non-USD holders. title: China nickel downstream activity returned to expansion in December_SMM
summary: SMM’s December survey showed China’s nickel downstream sectors returned to expansion, with a downstream PMI rising to 51.11. title: EGA's new Al Taweelah alumina refinery completes ramp-up
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium said its Al Taweelah alumina refinery has maintained monthly output at or above nameplate capacity for three months and is replacing some alumina imports. summary: GEM signed a memorandum of understanding to increase its stake in an Indonesian nickel project. title: EGA's new Al Taweelah alumina refinery delivers production at or above nameplate capacity for three consecutive months, completing world-class ramp-up
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium says its Al Taweelah alumina refinery has sustained monthly output at or above nameplate capacity for three straight months, replacing some alumina imports. summary: Element 29 Resources updated results from its Elida porphyry Cu-Mo-Ag project in Peru, highlighting historic drill intercepts and renewed community agreement through 2025. summary: Transition Metals Corp. granted an option to Rich Copper Exploration Corp. on its Island Copper project in Ontario. title: Increased Use of Electric Vehicles Generates Prominent Demand Opportunities in Carbonyl Nickel Powder Market: TMR
summary: A Transparency Market Research note says EV adoption and government EV/battery regulations are boosting demand for nickel-based batteries, supporting growth in the carbonyl nickel powder market. title: Lower dollar, inventories propel copper towards 8-year peak
summary: Copper futures rose toward an eight-year peak as a weaker US dollar, expectations of robust Chinese demand, and falling LME inventories with high cancelled warrants spurred buying. title: Chile's copper output down 3% in November on falls at Escondida, Collahuasi
summary: Chile’s copper output fell 3% in November, attributed to declines at Escondida and Collahuasi. title: Protest blocks $530 mln worth of copper from MMG's Las Bambas mine in Peru -association

title: Taseko Mines: Florence Copper Aquifer Protection Permit not Appealed by Town Council
summary: Taseko said Florence Town Council will not appeal the Aquifer Protection Permit granted by Arizona’s ADEQ for its Florence Copper project. title: Explainer-What's next for Rio Tinto's Arizona copper project after U.S. land swap | 104.1 WIKY

summary: Trump’s outgoing administration plans to approve a Jan. 15 land swap needed for Rio Tinto and partners to build the Resolution underground copper mine in Arizona. title: Aluminum Outlook 2020: Experts Call for Surplus in Years to Come
summary: The piece projects aluminum’s outlook into 2020 amid competing factors: supply increases from restarts and new projects (Canada/Brazil, Bahrain expansion, SALCO, Alunorte removal, Xinfa restart) versus demand drag from trade-war uncertainty and slower global growth. title: Las Bambas copper shipment delay extends into Jan; 189kt of concentrate stranded

summary: ALX Resources agreed to acquire a 100% interest in Ontario’s Electra nickel project near Thunder Bay, covering 148 units over 3,000+ hectares. title: Shanghai stainless steel extends rally on firm demand, nickel's surge
summary: Shanghai stainless steel futures rose to a three-week high as brisk demand and low inventories coincided with a surge in nickel-linked feedstock prices. title: Copper hits near 8-year high on more U.S. stimulus hopes
summary: Copper rallied to an eight-year high as hopes for additional U.S. stimulus grew after Democrats edged closer to taking the Senate. summary: S&P Global Caizhi projects Africa’s copper production to rise slightly in 2020 despite COVID-19, with capacity gains at Glencore and Zijin offsetting the Mutanda shutdown. summary: Copper futures reportedly breached $8,100/t as Las Bambas export disruption tightened near-term supply expectations, with support from a low US dollar index. summary: Nevada Copper reported strong ramp-up progress at its Pumpkin Hollow underground project, including higher ore hoisting, completion of commissioning for the main hoist to run at full production speed, improved concentrate recovery, and expected increases toward ~5,000 tpd steady-state.
