The ore loading section collapsed while repairs were underway to reinforce the structure, indicating potential disruption to nickel processing operations in the near term.

title: Norilsk Nickel shares sink almost 4% following statement by CEO
summary: Norilsk Nickel shares fell about 4% after CEO Vladimir Potanin blamed a plant “crushing shop gallery” collapse on gross safety violations. The plant manager was suspended. The company said it plans to invest around 100 bln rubles in industrial safety over five years, raising near-term production risk.

title: Nornickel Takes Full Responsibility for Concentrator Collapse
summary: The article’s headline says Nornickel has taken full responsibility for the collapse of a concentrator. Such incidents can disrupt nickel ore processing and concentrate production, reducing short-term supply availability and increasing the likelihood of tighter supply expectations, which is generally bearish for nearby nickel pricing.

title: Goldman Sachs: Historic Copper Shortage Loom As Prices Rocket
summary: Goldman argues copper faces a historic, growing shortage, pointing to a tight supply phase, low starting inventories, and a burst of Chinese onshore investor buying after the LNY holiday. Limited inventory builds and rising SHFE interest support bullish fundamentals. The broader base-metals rally also lifts nickel, near multi-year highs.

title: Copper Surges Above $9,000 as Major Deficit Drives Record Rally
summary: Copper is reported to surge above $9,000, with the rally linked to a major market deficit. The headline suggests strengthening expectations of near-term tight supply conditions, which typically supports higher prices in the coming days and can reinforce momentum if inventories remain constrained.

title: London copper surpasses $9,000/T for first time since Sept 2011
summary: London copper extended gains Monday, crossing $9,000/t for the first time since Sept 2011, with LME three-month up as much as 3.3% to $9,199/t. Moves were driven by a weaker dollar and hopes for stronger China demand after Lunar New Year, alongside limited supplies, supportive liquidity, and disruptions.

title: Proactive Investors China - The web's leading portal for China stocks - Galena Mining unveils up to 26.9 metres at 1.4% copper in first targeted copper-gold hole at Abra Base Metals Project
summary: Galena Mining announced results from its first targeted drilling at the Abra Base Metals Project, reporting up to 26.9 metres of mineralization at 1.4% copper. The discovery is presented as evidence of copper-gold potential, which can bolster market sentiment toward future copper supply.

title: Copper Surges Above $9,000 as Shortfall Concern Spurs Rally
summary: Copper rose above $9,000 as market sentiment shifted toward supply shortfall concerns. The rally suggests traders are expecting tighter near-term availability and reduced inventories, supporting higher prices. This is a direct, price-driving development for copper within days to weeks.

title: Three arrested on copper wire thefts
summary: RCMP arrested three people tied to multiple copper wire thefts at oilfield sites in eastern Alberta. Police seized about 900 pounds of copper wire and related tools during stops and a search warrant in February 2021. The suspects face charges including possession of stolen property.

title: Base metals surge, LME Copper at 9-year high on supply concerns
summary: Copper surged to a nine-year high on LME above $9,000/t, up about 3% for the three-month contract, citing supply concerns and China demand hopes. Domestic copper futures rose similarly. Nickel also topped $20,000/t, while aluminium (and zinc) were higher, reflecting broad base-metal momentum.

title: A steel rally: Copper at 10-year high, Nickel above $20,000; Hindalco's investor meet in focus
summary: LME copper surged above $9,000/ton and three-month nickel rose above $20,000/ton, both near multi-year highs, extending a coordinated commodity rally. The piece attributes gains to weak USD, recovery optimism, China demand, copper concentrate supply issues, and very low LME stocks. Hindalco’s investor day coincides with shares rising.

title: A steel rally: Copper at 10-year high, Nickel above $20,000; Hindalco's investor meet in focus
summary: LME copper jumped above $9,000/ton and three-month nickel rose above $20,000, extending a coordinated commodity rally. The article cites a decade-largest deficit, high risk of scarcity, copper concentrate supply issues, strong Chinese demand, and very low LME stocks, supporting higher near-term prices. Hindalco’s investor day and stock strength add bullish sentiment.

title: Xu Maili: Copper prices to rise further in the near term_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports SHFE 2104 copper hitting the daily limit and an eight-day winning streak, up 18.5% from early February lows. Everbright Futures’ Xu Maili says supply is stable but demand hasn’t matched expectations, while easing COVID-19, improved global liquidity, and stimulus boost risk appetite. Copper likely rises further near term.

title: Copper Hits Highest Price Since 2011, and Two More Numbers to Know
summary: The piece highlights copper crossing $4 per pound and reaching its highest level since 2011, up more than 15% year-to-date. It links the rally to vaccine distribution, expected stimulus, and improving economic growth sentiment, with “Doctor Copper” used as an indicator of global recovery.

title: Growth pulse sends copper price to nine-year high
summary: Copper jumped to a nine-year high as global growth expectations firmed and market supply tightened. The “Dr Copper” rally also strengthened the Australian dollar versus the US. A concurrent bond-market sell-off pushed Australian yields higher, but copper’s move reflects immediate demand optimism and supply constraints.

title: Singapore freezes two firms' bank accounts after alleged nickel fraud
summary: Singapore froze bank accounts of Envy Global Trading and Envy Asset Management after an investigation into alleged fraud involving funds meant for nickel trading. The trader says accounts are frozen but customer funds are protected. The case follows prior scandals and comes as nickel has rallied sharply this year.

title: Copper surges above US$9,000 as shortfall concern spurs rally
summary: Copper prices are reported to have broken higher, moving above US$9,000. The rally is attributed to growing concerns about a supply shortfall, which signals tightening availability in the near term and supports expectations of higher copper prices over coming days.

title: Copper price soars to 10-year high on rising demand
summary: Global copper prices are rising to multi-year highs, supported by a faster-than-expected recovery in China’s demand. The article also highlights China’s plan to expand overseas participation in commodities markets, including trading copper futures, which may support bullish sentiment and near-term pricing.

title: Base metals surge, LME Copper at 9-year high
summary: Base metals rallied as copper surged above $9,000/t at the LME, its highest since 2011, driven by supply concerns and post–Chinese New Year demand hopes from China. Nickel also rose above $20,000/t, while aluminium increased on broader growth and stimulus expectations alongside a weaker dollar.

title: Exclusive: Chilean miner Codelco says copper price spike will bolster war chest, raise costs
summary: Codelco, Chile’s top copper producer, says the recent copper price spike is a “good opportunity” to raise cash and manage debt, but could increase its costs as suppliers lift prices. Copper has risen above $9,000/tonne on improved demand expectations; Codelco is unsure if this marks a super-cycle.

title: Copper rises over $9,000 as supply tightens in pandemic recovery
summary: Copper breaks $9,000/t as investors bet tightening supply will worsen during pandemic recovery. Physical markets show the tightest conditions in years, refining margins (treatment charges) hit multi-year lows, and LME backwardation plus low inventories point to spot demand outpacing supply. Smelters may cut output, reinforcing bullish pressure.

title: With new power deal in hand, Century Aluminum invests in expansion at Mount Holly plant
summary: Century Aluminum will invest about $50 million in 2021 to restart part of a second pot line and rebuild electrolytic cells at its Mount Holly aluminum smelter. A new fixed-price electricity deal with Santee Cooper (about 300 MW) starting April enables capacity to rise to 140,000 tons this year and 170,000 tons after expansion completion.

title: First Targetted Copper-Gold Hole at Abra Hits 26.9M at 1.4% Copper
summary: Galena Mining reports strong drill-hole AB195 results at its Abra copper-gold project, including 26.9m at 1.4% copper and additional high-grade copper intercepts. The company plans an EM survey and follow-up drilling. The news is positive for project potential but unlikely to affect near-term global copper supply.

title: Copper mining company to get access to Oak Flat unless federal judges step in
summary: A federal court injunction could stop or delay Resolution Copper from gaining access to Oak Flat for the planned underground mine. Tribes and environmental groups argue the Forest Service environmental review is invalid and rushed. A judge must decide before March 16, potentially affecting near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Chilean miner Codelco says copper price spike will bolster war chest, raise costs
summary: Codelco, Chile’s state-owned copper miner, says the recent copper price spike above $9,000/tonne will bolster cash flow for investment and reduce reliance on debt. It also warns higher expected production input prices could raise its operating costs. The firm views current levels as helpful but not altering long-term plans.

title: Primary aluminium inventories built up 121,000 mt to 1.02 million mt_SMM
summary: SMM said China’s social inventories of primary aluminium across eight consumption areas rose 121,000 mt to 1.02 million mt as of Feb 22, with Wuxi, Nanhai and Gongyi contributing most. The build suggests easing supply tightness and tends to weigh on short-term aluminium prices.

title: Copper continued to soar, suppressing the production of copper processing enterprises_SMM
summary: SMM reports SHFE copper surged sharply over several sessions to fresh highs, with downstream copper rod/wire/cable processors running lower-than-expected operating rates. Firms cite limited raw-material and finished-goods stocks and reduced new orders, adopting a wait-and-see approach amid concerns of fund-driven overextension and potential correction.

title: Zambia's copper production hit record high in 2020, mines minister says
summary: Zambia produced 882,061 tonnes of copper in 2020, a record and up 13.6% from 2019. The mines minister said Zambia expects to exceed 900,000 tonnes in 2021. This points to improving output levels from one of the world’s major copper producers.

title: Low demand causes MJP aluminium stocks to drop 9.7% y-o-y in Jan
summary: MJP aluminium stocks dropped 9.7% year-on-year in January, with the article attributing the decline to low demand. Lower demand signals weaker end-market buying and can weigh on aluminium price expectations over the coming days and weeks, despite any ongoing supply and logistics developments mentioned.

title: Aluminium output in Baise City stood at 1.7 million mt in 2020_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that Baise City in Guangxi produced 1.7 million mt of aluminium in 2020 and 9 million mt of alumina, with aluminium producers operating at full capacity after a local power grid came online. Aluminium products output rose to 1.5 million mt, increasing industry activity and supply conditions.

title: ZAMBIA 2020 COPPER PRODUCTION ROSE TO 882,061 TONNES, UP 13.6% FROM 776,430 TONNES IN 2019 - MINES MINISTER
summary: Zambia’s mines minister said 2020 copper production rose to 882,061 tonnes, up 13.6% from 776,430 tonnes in 2019. The higher output suggests increased supply expectations for copper, which typically supports bearish pressure on copper prices in the near term as markets adjust for greater availability.

title: Pan Global Resources Inc.: Pan Global Reports New Drill Results and Extends High Grade Copper at La Romana, Southern Spain
summary: Pan Global Resources reported additional drill results from La Romana in southern Spain, extending near-surface and deeper massive chalcopyrite copper mineralization. Intercepts include thick near-surface copper and a high-grade massive sulfide up to 17.05% Cu. The company says mineralization is wide open and Phase 4 drilling is underway.

title: Conquest Resources Limited: Conquest Completes Expanded Airborne Survey and Readies Belfast Copper Project for Exploration Drilling
summary: Conquest Resources completed a VTEMmax airborne survey over its Belfast Copper Project and is advancing gravity surveys and preparing to drill six EM targets starting in early March. The company reports numerous conductors and deep sulphide potential, while Golden Rose results await assay lab returns. No copper assay or production impact is reported.

title: JV Article: Solaris doubles drill program on major discovery at Warintza copper project in Ecuador
summary: Solaris Resources doubled the drill campaign at its Warintza copper project in Ecuador after geophysics showed a much larger, laterally extensive porphyry system than previously expected. Results highlight potentially continuous mineralization across multiple targets, strengthening long-run copper outlook and boosting market sentiment.

title: Bitterroot Resources Ltd.: Bitterroot Resources Options Additional 80 Acres at the LM Nickel-Copper-PGM Project in Michigan
summary: Bitterroot Resources’ subsidiary signed a minerals lease and purchase option for additional 80 acres adjacent to its LM Project in Michigan, where drilling targets magmatic nickel-copper sulphides. The deal expands exploration acreage for mid-2021 drilling but does not change current production or confirmed supply, limiting short-term price impact.

title: Bitterroot Resources Ltd.: Bitterroot Resources Options Additional 80 Acres at the LM Nickel-Copper-PGM Project in Michigan
summary: Bitterroot Resources’ Michigan subsidiary secured an additional 80 acres of mineral rights at the LM Project in Michigan, adjoining areas drilled for magmatic nickel-copper sulphides. The company plans to drill-test the added lands mid-2021, but no production or major supply change is announced.

title: Copper supply expected to move into deficit in 2021, says StoneX.
summary: Copper prices surged again in mid-February, with March contracts nearing historical highs. The piece cites StoneX expectations that copper supply will shift into a deficit in 2021, reinforcing the market’s view of tightening availability and supporting bullish price momentum.

title: ZAMBIA 2020 COPPER PRODUCTION ROSE TO 882,061 TONNES, UP 10.8% (NOT 13.6%) FROM 796,430 (NOT 776,430) TONNES IN 2019 - MINES MINISTER
summary: Reuters reports Zambia’s 2020 copper production increased to 882,061 tonnes, up 10.8% from 796,430 tonnes in 2019, citing the mines minister. The stronger year-on-year output from a key global supplier may boost market supply expectations and potentially pressure copper prices in the near term.

title: Zambia's copper production hits record high in 2020, mines minister says
summary: Zambia produced a record 882,061 tonnes of copper in 2020, up 10.8% from 2019, according to the mines minister. The government targets over 900,000 tonnes in 2021, aiming to eventually exceed 1 million tonnes annually. The higher output suggests increased supply expectations.

title: Zambia achieves record high copper production in 2020, minister says
summary: Zambia produced 882,061 tonnes of copper in 2020, a record and 10.8% higher than 2019, and plans to exceed 900,000 tonnes in 2021. The minister links the outlook to rising electric-vehicle demand. Overall, the report may slightly shift supply expectations for copper.

title: Ferndale rethinks its future after hundreds lose jobs at aluminum plant
summary: Ferndale is reportedly reconsidering its future after hundreds of workers lost jobs at an aluminium plant. The restructuring and job cuts point to production disruption or reduced output, which can quickly change expectations for aluminium supply in the near term, weighing on aluminium prices.

title: Zambian Minister of Mining: Zambian Copper production hit a record High in 2020_SMM
summary: Zambia’s mining minister says the country produced 882,061 tons of copper in 2020, up 10.8% from 2019 and an all-time high. Zambia aims for over 900,000 tons in 2021, supported by an optimistic outlook despite COVID-19. The electric-vehicle shift is cited as long-term demand support.

title: Copper retreats from 9-1/2-year high as rally loses steam
summary: Copper prices in London retreated from a 9-1/2-year high after a sharp four-day rally (+9.2%). LME three-month copper slipped 0.3% and Shanghai copper rose modestly. Analysts cited tight supplies, reduced Chinese smelter output, and a recovering demand outlook. Aluminium and nickel moved slightly too.

title: Chile's big copper producers cheer price spike; wary of costs
summary: Chile’s major copper producers welcome copper’s surge to a 10-year high above $9,000/tonne, citing expected demand growth from power and construction overwhelming supply. They warn that higher prices may raise input/service costs and labor leverage, while complex negotiations could risk stoppages. Policymakers note rising tax revenue.

title: Analysis: Chile's big copper producers cheer price spike; wary of costs
summary: The analysis highlights that Chile’s large copper producers are reacting positively to a recent copper price spike, suggesting near-term strength in market expectations. At the same time, producers express caution about costs, which could weigh on margins but does not negate the short-term bullish price impulse.

title: GLOBAL ALUMINIUM WRAP: Duty-unpaid tightness boosts Rotterdam, Turkey, Brazil premiums
summary: A global aluminium wrap reports that duty-unpaid tightness has boosted premiums across Rotterdam, Turkey and Brazil. It also notes Fastmarkets corrections and delays to low-carbon aluminium differential assessments and related aluminium 6063 extrusion billet premium publication errors. Overall, the physical market tone is tighter and supportive.

title: SMM survey: Resumption of work after CNY at aluminium processors_SMM
summary: SMM reports aluminium processors restarted production between Feb 18-21 after CNY, though southern plants lag until March. Demand for extrusion, plate, strip and foil is strong, while wire/cable and some construction extrusion are tepid. Aluminium prices rose faster than expected. Scrap shortages should boost secondary aluminium prices near term.

title: Domestic raw material market generally rose, while the aluminium fluoride market remained stable_SMM
summary: After CNY, domestic nonferrous markets rose and aluminium prices jumped. Aluminium fluoride output stayed at low load (~45%), with reduced production and inventory consumption. Aluminium plants are profitable and running at high load, improving aluminium-fluoride demand, while costs were stable, keeping near-term fluoride prices steady and supporting aluminium demand sentiment.

title: SMM survey: Resumption of work after CNY at copper industries_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports a roundup of post-CNY developments for copper, highlighting Shanghai 1# copper physical premiums before and after the Spring Festival. The piece indicates how physical premium levels changed after the holiday, a key indicator of short-term balance between prompt copper supply and resumed downstream demand.

title: SMM Evening Comments (Feb 24): Shanghai nonferrous metals declined for the most part, copper advanced 0.53%_SMM
summary: SMM reports Shanghai nonferrous prices mostly fell as investors turned cautious, after Jerome Powell’s testimony suggested policy would remain supportive and inflation concerns were softer. Copper was the exception, rising 0.53%, while aluminium slipped 0.48% and nickel dropped 2%. Markets also watched inventories and LME SHFE copper signals.

title: Analysis: Chile's big copper producers cheer price spike; wary of costs | The Mighty 790 KFGO
summary: Chile’s major copper miners welcomed a rapid copper price spike to a 10-year high, with analysts citing demand strength from power and construction outpacing supply. Producers expect potential higher costs and possible labor negotiation disruptions, but financiers are broadly bullish and the government sees more tax/royalty revenue if prices hold.

title: Nickel Rock Resources Closes Fundamental Transaction to Acquire Two Nickel Exploration Properties in BC
summary: Nickel Rock Resources closed the acquisition of two 100%-owned nickel exploration properties in British Columbia, subject to a 2% NSR, issuing shares and paying consideration to the vendor. The company filed an NI 43-101 technical report and plans detailed exploration, but no immediate production or supply disruption is indicated.

title: Rendi-Guinean Jinbo project honed for five years to build the whole logistics chain of Guinean bauxite-Chinese alumina plant._SMM
summary: Guinea’s Jinbo bauxite project under Rendi Aluminium has started mining and built port/road infrastructure, with the first shipment of about 200,000 tons of bauxite expected to arrive in Hong Kong in June. The port’s 10 million tons annual capacity and planned alumina plant enhance near-term supply outlook for aluminium.

title: Mantos Copper selects Ausenco for Mantoverde EPC
summary: Ausenco was selected to provide EPC for Mantos Copper’s Mantoverde Development Project in Chile, including engineering, procurement, construction, and production ramp-up to nameplate for a 30,000 tpd copper concentrator. The work targets cost and efficiency improvements, potentially supporting future copper output and market sentiment.

title: Indonesia's nickel mine market continues to recover and production and sales are expected to increase this year._SMM
summary: Indonesia’s nickel miners’ association says mining activity is normalizing and nickel production and sales are expected to rise in 2021 as vaccination recovery boosts operations. APNI members sold 40 million tonnes of nickel ore to smelters in 2020. With ore exports closed and output sold domestically, supplies are expected to increase.

title: NORNICKEL PARTIALLY SUSPENDS OPERATIONS AT OKTYABRSKY AND TAIMYRSKY MINES
summary: Nornickel partially suspended operations at its Oktyabrsky and Taimyrsky mines after detecting increased groundwater inflow and water entering connected underground workings. The company is installing a cofferdam and draining to eliminate flooding, and will reassess production impacts after relief operations conclude. The disruption can reduce near-term nickel and copper supply.

title: MMC Norilsk Nickel: Nornickel partially suspends operations at Oktyabrsky and Taimyrsky mines
summary: Norilsk Nickel partially suspended operations at the Oktyabrsky and Taimyrsky mines after increased groundwater inflow caused flooding risk. The firm is eliminating water and installing a cofferdam at Taimyrsky to stop further inflow. It will reassess production guidance after relief operations conclude, implying near-term supply loss for nickel and copper.

title: Minnesota Supreme Court rules in favor of PolyMet copper mine
summary: Minnesota’s Supreme Court ruled in favor of PolyMet regarding its copper mine. The decision potentially lowers permitting/legal uncertainty for the project, which can improve market expectations for copper supply over the coming weeks and support copper prices, assuming no further delays or appeals.

title: Indonesia nickel ore market continued to recover, output and sales are expected to increase this year_SMM
summary: Indonesia’s nickel ore market is recovering as COVID-19 vaccination and production normalization are expected to boost nickel mining output and domestic sales. APNI reports substantial ore sales to smelters and notes nickel ore export bans that keep supply within Indonesia. Authorities expect output and sales to rise in 2021 amid higher ore prices.

title: China's Appetite For Copper Provides Chile With Opportunity
summary: Copper has jumped to a 10-year high near $4.21/lb, driven largely by China buying almost half of global supply and using more copper for renewables and electric mobility. It also cites weaker USD, pandemic stimulus liquidity, and lower mining investment reducing supply growth, lifting prices for Chile’s exports.

title: Sandfire boss says copper market best in more than a decade
summary: Sandfire Resources says the copper market has been its best in more than a decade, citing sharply higher first-half net profit. The company attributes gains to surging copper prices and plans to pursue new mines in Africa to sustain its ageing DeGrussa operations in Western Australia, reinforcing bullish copper sentiment.

title: Copper eyes 10-year high as U.S. Fed reaffirms policy support
summary: Shanghai copper surged toward a near 10-year high after the U.S. Fed signaled it would keep policy loose longer. The most-traded copper contract rose sharply, while LME copper hit multi-year highs. Aluminum also jumped, and the piece notes nickel gains alongside the broad base-metals rally.

title: Copper nears 10-year high as Fed suggests continuing supportive steps
summary: Copper on Shanghai and LME jumped toward decade highs after Fed Chair Jerome Powell said it may take more than three years to meet inflation goals, implying rates will stay low longer. Aluminum and nickel also rose. The supportive monetary outlook calmed fears of earlier tightening, lifting base metals.

title: MN Supreme Court hands victory to PolyMet copper mine | News, Sports, Jobs
summary: Minnesota’s Supreme Court reversed an appeals court decision involving PolyMet’s air emissions permit for the planned copper-nickel mine near Babbitt and Hoyt Lakes, sending the case back for further review. The ruling is a partial win for PolyMet but other legal hurdles remain, keeping supply prospects slightly less risky.

title: Pampa Metals Corp.: Pampa Metals Accelerates Exploration Program at it's Redondo Veronica Copper Project
summary: Pampa Metals started geophysical surveying and expanded geological mapping at its Redondo-Veronica copper project in northern Chile, including 3D IP and MT work and an expanded property footprint. It also mentions surveying progress at another project. No drilling results or production changes are reported.

title: Aluminium billet inventories rose 25,100 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reported that China aluminium billet shipments were limited and downstream demand had not fully returned. Aluminium billet stocks across five major consumption areas rose 25,100 mt week-on-week to 239,300 mt as of Feb 25. Foshan and Wuxi saw the largest inventory gains.

title: Primary aluminium inventories built up 181,000 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data shows China’s social inventories of primary aluminium ingots across eight consumption areas rose 181,000 mt from last Thursday to 1.08 million mt as of Feb 25. Increases were mainly in Wuxi, Nanhai and Gongyi. The report notes shipment willingness and downstream recovery should be monitored.

title: LIVE FUTURES REPORT 25/02: Aluminium, copper rise 2% to new highs
summary: Fastmarkets’ live futures report (25/02) notes that aluminium and copper futures climbed roughly 2% and reached new highs. The excerpt also discusses procedural corrections to some aluminium assessments and steel indices, but the primary market message is the upward move in aluminium and copper prices.

title: LIVE FUTURES REPORT 25/02: Aluminium, copper rise 2% to new highs
summary: Fastmarkets/Metal Bulletin’s live futures report says aluminium and copper rose around 2% to new highs, signaling near-term bullish momentum. The text also notes aluminium has been hard to move amid supply disruption and drawdowns/repositioning of inventories, supportive for prices over the next days.

title: Chilean Metals, Inc.: Chilean Metals Closes NISK Acquisition Providing the Company a High-Grade Historical Nickel Copper Cobalt PGE Resource
summary: Chilean Metals closed its acquisition of 80% of the NISK property, which hosts a historical resource containing meaningful nickel and copper grades (plus cobalt and PGEs). The company plans confirmation and infill drilling to update the resource estimate and assess mine potential. This can modestly support nickel and copper sentiment.

title: Avidian Gold Corp.: High Tide Advances Its Lac Pegma Copper-Nickel-Cobalt Deposit
summary: Avidian Gold’s subsidiary High Tide Resources acquired 35 additional exploration claims adjacent to the Lac Pegma copper-nickel-cobalt sulphide deposit in Quebec and plans desktop studies and geophysical work for resource expansion. The article cites historical copper and nickel drill results but no new assays or production.

title: Avidian Gold Corp.: High Tide Advances Its Lac Pegma Copper-Nickel-Cobalt Deposit
summary: Avidian Gold’s subsidiary High Tide adds exploration claims adjacent to its Lac Pegma copper-nickel-cobalt deposit in Quebec and plans desktop studies and geophysical work for potential resource expansion. The release cites historical drill results but includes no reserve, production, or near-term development updates likely to move metal prices soon.

title: Element 29 Resources Inc.: Element 29 Provides Update for Flor De Cobre Copper Project, Peru
summary: Element 29 provided an update on its Flor de Cobre copper project in southern Peru, including historical drilling results, plans to verify data, and progress on EIA approvals to begin a 3,700m 2021 drilling program. It focuses on resource estimation work and exploration, with no immediate supply effects stated.

title: SMM Evening Comments (Feb 25): Shanghai nonferrous metals rose across the board, aluminium surged 5.05%_SMM
summary: SHFE nonferrous metals closed higher after Powell downplayed inflation persistence and the US stimulus bill advanced. Aluminium led with a 5.05% rise, while copper gained 3.63% and nickel rose 1.65%. Open interest changes and billet stock buildup are also noted, but the headline is broad bullish price momentum.

title: Head of Nornickel's Arctic processing plant placed under house arrest -IFX
summary: A Russian court placed the head of Norilsk Nickel’s Arctic processing plant under house arrest while investigating a Feb. 20 plant collapse that killed workers. Nornickel said it would tighten safety. The accident followed partial suspension of two major Siberian mines due to water inflow.

title: China's appetite for copper boosts Chilean economy
summary: Copper prices are hitting a 10-year high, doubling since last year, with experts citing China’s strong demand and use in renewables and electric mobility. Reduced mining supply-side investment since 2003–2013 is also tightening availability, supporting expectations of further record highs in the coming weeks.

title: Copper Prices Soar To 10-Year Highs
summary: Copper prices rose to nearly 10-year highs, with March delivery up 1.53% to about $9,306/t. Analysts expect surging demand from power and construction to outpace supply. Chile miners warned rising costs and possible labor or vendor-driven stoppages could further tighten copper supply.

title: Peru's Southern Copper to push forward on new projects as copper price spikes
summary: Peru’s Southern Copper said it plans to advance pending copper projects, including the Chancas and Michiquillay developments and a proposed southern Peru smelter, as copper prices rise and supply is described as tight. The timing depends on the new administration later this year and board approval for the smelter.

title: Government of Canada now closer than ever to Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean aluminum industry
summary: Canada is granting $1.5M to A3 Surfaces in Quebec to acquire equipment including an automated anodizing line, plus labs and marketing support, as part of a regional innovation program. The project is tied to the aluminum sector and aims to create/maintain jobs, but its size suggests limited impact on aluminium prices.

title: TCs for copper concentrate continued to fall, the rising prices of sulphuric acid alleviated pressure on refinery profits_SMM
summary: SMM reports copper concentrate TCs have fallen for two months, squeezing smelter margins, though rising sulphuric acid prices partially offset losses. Blister copper TCs increased on scrap availability, improving refinery economics. With mineral TCs still very low, SMM expects more smelter maintenance and possible production cuts in April-May.

title: Copper Mines in Australia | Olympic Dam is the Biggest
summary: The piece outlines Australia’s major copper mines—such as Olympic Dam, Carrapateena, Mount Isa, Prominent Hill and Cadia—along with production volumes and ongoing expansions/ramp-ups. It also surveys advanced development projects across several states and notes industry supply concerns, but lacks any near-term supply disruption or trading catalyst.

title: Copper slips; set for best monthly gain since 2016 on tight supply, demand hopes
summary: Copper prices eased on Friday, but the article highlights tight supply and low inventories supporting an exceptional monthly gain outlook. It notes broadly positive sentiment for green transition metals, including nickel, while reporting LME aluminium and nickel were also down on the day, implying mixed short-term direction.

title: Why was the price spread between copper scrap and copper cathode still high even as domestic copper scrap was in short supply?_SMM
summary: After CNY, copper prices hit record highs and the cathode–scrap spread widened sharply. Traders restocked scrap only for a few days amid COVID concerns and high prices, while small recyclers held prices firm. Tight scrap supply persists until mid-March; large scrap inflows from Hong Kong may return next week.

title: Nickel ore inventories at Chinese ports fell 614,000 wmt to 7.26 million wmt_SMM
summary: SMM data shows nickel ore inventories at Chinese ports fell 614,000 wmt to 7.26 million wmt from Feb 18 to Feb 26, reaching a three-year low. Nickel ore stocks in Ni content also declined. FOB and freight costs rose, making downstream restocking cautious and keeping the market tense.

title: Copper set for best month since late 2016 on tight supply, demand hopes
summary: Copper is on track for its best month since late 2016 as prices remain supported by tight supply and low inventories, alongside brighter demand expectations. Although copper dipped on Friday, the article also cites positive sentiment for green-transition metals including nickel, while aluminium rose on strong demand and Inner Mongolia supply-disruption fears.

title: Bauxite ASP needs correction for Indian Al to be competitive
summary: The article says India’s bauxite ASP calculation for metallurgical-grade bauxite is artificially inflated by linking it to aluminium end-product prices, harming mine lease auctions and driving higher bauxite imports. It argues ASP methodology should be corrected to improve aluminium industry competitiveness and viability amid rising demand.

title: Freeport eyes U.S. expansions as Biden's EV plan boosts copper demand
summary: Freeport CEO Richard Adkerson said the company may greenlight expansions at several U.S. copper mines, adding over 250 million pounds of annual output, to capitalize on demand for copper from Biden’s EV and climate initiatives. The article ties EV electrification to higher copper intensity and highlights Freeport’s production scale.

title: SMM Evening Comments (Feb 26): Shanghai nonferrous metals declined for the most part, aluminium advanced 1.36%_SMM
summary: SMM reports SHFE nonferrous metals mostly fell on Feb 26 after a sudden spike in US bond yields triggered risk-off sentiment and a firmer US dollar, pressuring copper and nickel. Copper ended down 2.06% and nickel down 1.79%. Aluminium rose 1.36% despite broader weakness.

title: Shanghai bonded refined nickel stocks rose 800 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show Shanghai bonded refined nickel stocks rose 800 mt to 18,400 mt by Feb 26. Nickel prices continued rising after the holiday, suppressing domestic demand, and thousands of tonnes of nickel plates were shifted into bonded warehouses to wait for import opportunities this week, slightly lifting bonded inventories.

title: Great Atlantic Resources Corp.: Great Atlantic Commences Diamond Drilling at Its Copper, Cobalt, Nickel, Zinc, Gold Mascarene Property Southern New Brunswick
summary: Great Atlantic Resources began a maiden diamond drilling program at its Mascarene Property in New Brunswick. Prior rock and soil samples show anomalous copper and nickel-related mineralization within a magnetic high trend that could host mafic intrusive copper–nickel–cobalt deposits, but no assay results or production changes are reported.

title: UPDATE 2-Brazil's Vale bullish on metal prices, seeks to accelerate copper projects
summary: Vale is described as bullish on metals prices and aiming to accelerate copper projects. While the step points to future supply development, it also signals corporate confidence and can affect near-term market expectations around copper project timelines, influencing short-term copper price sentiment.

title: Why copper just scored its biggest monthly gain since 2016
summary: Copper posted its biggest monthly gain since 2016 as traders anticipate stronger post-coronavirus demand for the industrial metal. The rise is also linked to concerns about potential supply shortages and a weakening U.S. dollar, both of which can tighten market availability and support price momentum.

title: Chile's State Copper Company Reports Higher 2020 Profit
summary: Chile’s state-owned Codelco reported 2020 profit up more than 55% versus the prior year, helped by higher production and better copper prices. The company says output rose to 1.6 billion tons and cites a pickup in the red metal’s second-half 2020 price. It notes Chile’s large copper role.

title: Copper crunch set to ease with more supply heading to China
summary: Chinese copper smelters facing semi-processed material shortages are set to receive more shipments from Chile and Peru as shipping bottlenecks ease. From next month, ports should see a major rise in concentrate inflows—nearly 60% versus February—signaling that the supply tightness underpinning copper’s rally may be fading.

title: Copper's Yearlong Rally Feeds Through to Homes, Phones and Cars
summary: Copper is at a nine-year high above $9,000, feeding through into consumer appliance pricing plans and stimulus-linked electrification demand. However, on Friday copper saw its biggest one-day drop in over four months as global equities and bonds sold off, raising concerns about earlier policy tightening.

title: Indonesia says "ready to fight" EU at WTO over nickel export curbs
summary: Indonesia’s trade minister says it is ready to fight the EU’s WTO challenge to Indonesia’s ban on nickel ore exports. Indonesia imposed the curb to attract investment for an integrated nickel supply chain, including processing for battery materials and EVs. The dispute may affect expectations for nickel supply flows.

title: Police arrest 5 men in Homestead for elaborate scheme to steal expensive copper wiring
summary: Homestead, Florida police arrested five men for stealing about $30,000 worth of AT&T copper wiring, worth roughly $100,000 to repair, using a scheme to cut and cap underground lines before pulling them out. The incident is local and largely affects wiring and scrap recovery rather than broader copper supply.

title: Shanghai copper slips from multi-year highs as bleak China data weighs
summary: Shanghai copper fell from multi-year highs after China reported weaker-than-expected February factory growth, missing market expectations following earlier COVID-related disruptions. The April copper contract dropped 2.7%. Shanghai aluminium and nickel also declined around 2% as the disappointing data weighed on industrial metal demand expectations.

title: Euro Sun Announces Robust Definitive Feasibility Study for the Rovina Valley Gold-Copper Project in Romania
summary: Euro Sun Mining reported positive definitive feasibility study results for its Rovina Valley gold-copper project in Romania, including expected copper output (~19 million lb/year in years 1–10) and copper-linked project economics using a $3.30/lb copper price assumption. The update is development-focused with no immediate supply/tariff shock.

title: How will alumina prices perform after hitting 4-year high?_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports alumina demand stayed soft after CNY, with alumina plants cutting offers as inventories rose. Prices are expected to tick up as smelters gradually restock and aluminium rallies support alumina floors. A Texas alumina plant reduced output due to energy and higher caustic soda costs, while higher freight adds transport pressure for overseas buyers.

title: Early offers for Q2 aluminium cif MJP at $150/t and higher - sources
summary: The article cites sources saying early offers for Q2 aluminium CIF MJP are around $150/t and higher, pointing to firmer forward aluminium pricing. It also notes Fastmarkets corrected several aluminium and steel assessment entries due to procedural errors, plus scheduling changes for Asian base metal differentials.

title: In Russian Arctic, Miner Nornickel Exhibits Green Goal
summary: Nornickel is closing its aging Nikel nickel smelter in Russia’s Arctic and transferring some metallurgical output to the Monchegorsk facility. The move follows environmental incidents and aims to cut sulphur emissions by 85%. The company plans a new refining unit and expects to double copper output.

title: How India turned copper importer from exporter in 3 yrs & Pakistan stepped in to fill the gap
summary: India is set to be a net importer of refined copper for a third year as Sterlite Copper’s Tamil Nadu smelter remains shut over environmental concerns, slashing domestic output. Imports rose sharply while exports fell. Pakistan is said to replace India’s export share to China, amidst global supply tightness keeping prices elevated.

title: Trigon Completes Land Acquisition of "Copper King Extension" Surrounding its Kombat Copper-Silver-Lead Mine in Namibia - Press Release
summary: Trigon announced completion of land acquisition for the “Copper King Extension” surrounding its Kombat copper-silver-lead mine in Namibia. The update signals permitting/expansion progress that could support longer-run copper supply expectations, but the release provides limited information on near-term output changes.

title: Trigon Metals, Inc.: Trigon Completes Land Acquisition of Copper King Extension Surrounding its Kombat Copper-Silver-Lead Mine in Namibia
summary: Trigon Metals says it completed the purchase of EPL 3540 (“Copper King Extension”) surrounding its Kombat copper-silver-lead mine in Namibia. The expanded licence position along the Kombat trend is expected to increase prospective strike length and exploration potential, supported by a pending renewal process.

title: Bulls run wild: Chinese funds throw more fuel on copper's flames
summary: Copper prices surged above $9,000/t as Chinese funds and broader speculative demand drove fresh longs, including a reported ~$1bn bet. LME inventories are low and the cash-to-three-months spread is tight, indicating a squeeze risk. CME longs trim and options buying hints at correction risk. Aluminium positions also grew quickly on ShFE.

title: Kamoa-Kakula Copper Mines 339,000 Tonnes of Ore Grading 5.50% Copper in February, Including 107,000 Tonnes Grading 9.01% Copper from the High-Grade Centre of the Kakula Mine, Setting a New Production Record
summary: Kamoa-Kakula in the DRC mined 339,000 tonnes of ore in February (5.50% Cu), exceeding concentrator steady-state requirements, with higher grades and contained copper growth in stockpiles. Progress toward July 2021 first production continues despite conveyor changeover, supporting expectations of increased copper supply and bullish sentiment.

title: When rising bond yields will pose a serious risk to stocks. Plus, a setback for emerging markets, and bulls run wild in copper
summary: Copper prices punched through $9,000/tonne for the first time since 2011 and have risen for 11 consecutive months. The rally is attributed to sustained Chinese physical buying and a “green recovery” narrative, reinforced by Chinese funds adding risk, including a reported $1 billion bet on higher copper prices.

title: Phoenix Gold Resources Corp.: Phoenix Gold Signs Option to Acquire Past-Producing Copper-Zinc Mine in Newfoundland
summary: Phoenix Gold signed an option to acquire 100% of the York Harbour Cu-Zn massive sulphide property in Newfoundland, referencing historical production and copper grades. The transaction requires exploration spend and includes a 2% NSR, but the release does not indicate near-term production or shipments that would move copper prices immediately.

title: USDA puts brakes on land transfer for Arizona copper mine
summary: The USDA delayed further environmental review steps for the transfer of federal land at Oak Flat needed for Resolution Copper’s large Arizona project. The administration said it will consult more with tribes. While mining is years away, the delay and legal uncertainty around the project add potential supply risk for copper.

title: Setback for BHP and Rio Tinto at US copper project
summary: Rio Tinto and BHP’s Resolution Copper project faced a setback as the US Department of Agriculture ordered the rescindment of a previously granted environmental impact study milestone. The January study had signaled regulator willingness to approve, so removal increases delay risk and near-term supply uncertainty for copper.

title: Crown Mining Corp.: Crown Mining Advances U.S.-Based Copper Project amid Biden's Executive Order on Critical Minerals Supply Chain
summary: Biden’s executive order launches a 100-day review to strengthen U.S. supply chains for critical minerals. Crown Mining highlights its Moonlight-Superior copper project in California and aims to advance it toward production, framing copper as essential for EVs and renewable power. The news is supportive for copper sentiment, but not a near-term supply shock.

title: Rio Tinto, BHP's copper mine project on Apache land faces fresh blow
summary: The US Forest Service reversed a decision that cleared a land swap needed for Resolution Copper’s planned Arizona copper mine, owned jointly by Rio Tinto and BHP. The project faces tribal opposition. The withdrawal implies delays and supply uncertainty, likely weighing on near-term copper price expectations.

title: Aluminium processors resumed production rapidly after CNY, production likely to return to pre-holiday level this week _SMM
summary: SMM surveyed 41 aluminium processors and found operating rates rising after CNY (to 60.1% overall). Large producers resumed normal output and logistics improved, while some small/medium firms stayed cautious due to raw-material stockpiling and higher prices. End-users reportedly picked up orders amid strong downstream demand.

title: Yangshan copper premiums rose before falling _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports Yangshan copper import premiums rose early then eased as higher SHFE/LME-linked copper prices and weaker domestic spot quotes pressured downstream buying. Import losses narrowed and inventories at INE and Shanghai bonded zone increased, reflecting softer import demand and more cargoes entering warehouses, yielding mixed short-term price signals.

title: Feds rescind OK for copper mine at Oak Flat, seek 'thorough review' | Cronkite News
summary: U.S. authorities rescinded approval for the proposed Resolution Copper mine at Oak Flat days before the land transfer, citing a need for a thorough environmental and cultural/tribal review. Supporters say the project could supply significant copper, but the reversal likely delays production rather than cancels it.

title: LIVE FUTURES REPORT 02/03: LME nickel drops 1%, tin above $23,500/t
summary: Fastmarkets’ live futures report notes LME nickel is down around 1%, pointing to immediate bearish sentiment for nickel. It also includes commentary on aluminium market liquidity and supply conditions, including output curtailments and Hormuz shipping disruption, but does not provide a specific aluminium price change in the excerpt.

title: Manufacturing activities across nickel downstream sectors retreated to contraction in February_SMM
summary: SMM data show China’s downstream nickel industries’ PMI fell to 46.93 in February, with contraction in production, new orders, and inventories. Stainless steel output and demand softened around the CNY holiday, electroplating activity remained weak, and battery buyers stayed cautious, reducing feedstock purchases. This points to weaker near-term nickel demand.

title: Tartisan Nickel Corp. Announces Geophysical Survey at the Kenbridge Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project, Kenora Mining District, Ontario to Assess Targets
summary: Tartisan Nickel Corp. announced a surface TDEM geophysical survey at its Kenbridge Ni-Cu-Co project to identify additional nickel sulphide targets north of the known deposit. The company also plans a late-spring/early-summer drill program on extensions to test TDEM targets and advance the project toward feasibility steps.

title: Tartisan Nickel Corp. Announces Geophysical Survey at the Kenbridge Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project, Kenora Mining District, Ontario to Assess Targets
summary: Tartisan Nickel Corp. announced a surface TDEM geophysical survey at its Kenbridge nickel-copper-cobalt project in Ontario to assess targets north of the known deposit. It also references an updated resource estimate and a planned drill program later in spring/early summer aimed at down-dip and down-plunge extensions.

title: World Copper Ltd.: World Copper Provides Exploration Update
summary: World Copper Ltd. issued an exploration update for its Chilean Escalones and Cristal projects, describing oxide-soluble copper testing (heap-leach potential) and further work planned in 2021. The company also mobilized sampling for additional porphyry targets. The release is exploratory and does not change immediate copper supply.

title: Feds rescind OK for copper mine at Oak Flat, seek 'thorough review'
summary: US federal agencies rescinded approval for a proposed large Oak Flat copper mine, citing the need for a more thorough environmental and tribal consultation review after a final EIS was issued. The land swap that would enable the mine was delayed, adding supply uncertainty and potential upside support for copper.

title: Chile copper production down 0.7% year on year in January
summary: Chile copper production reportedly declined 0.7% year on year in January. As Chile is a key global source, weaker output can affect near-term supply expectations and inventory outlooks. Other text in the excerpt mainly concerns Fastmarkets procedural/assessment corrections rather than immediate aluminium pricing moves.

title: Copper to stay tight on long path to new supply, top miner says
summary: The piece suggests copper supply will remain tight until new production arrives, implying limited near-term availability. With the market facing a prolonged wait for additional supply, expectations may shift toward firmer copper pricing in the short term as inventories tighten and buyers compete for supply.

title: Aluminum Flat-Rolled Products (FRP) Market to Accelerate at a CAGR of over 3.33% during 2021-2025|Key Vendor Insights and Forecasts
summary: Technavio forecasts the aluminum flat-rolled products market will grow during 2021-2025, discussing COVID-19 recovery phases and drivers like green initiatives and higher packaging demand. It lists major producers and notes supply-chain and demand effects from the pandemic, but provides no specific near-term shocks to aluminum prices.

title: Blue Rhino Capital Corp: Blue Rhino Signs Definitive Agreement to Acquire Zebediela Nickel Project and Closes Subscription Receipt Offering
summary: Blue Rhino Capital Corp signed an agreement to acquire URU Metals’ Zebediela Nickel Project in South Africa and completed a subscription receipt financing for exploration and development. Closing depends on TSX-V and shareholder approvals, with no near-term production updates provided. Overall, the deal is supportive for nickel interest but unlikely to move prices immediately.

title: Nickel Mines in Australia | BHP is the Top Producer
summary: The article summarizes Australia’s nickel production and reserves, noting 160,000 tonnes produced in 2022 and large operator output concentrated in Western Australia (notably BHP Nickel West, Glencore and First Quantum). It also cites rising battery-linked demand and expected export volume/capacity growth, implying supportive fundamentals for nickel prices.

title: U.S. Commerce sets anti-dumping duties on aluminum sheet from 16 countries
summary: U.S. Commerce has set anti-dumping duties on aluminum sheet imports from 16 countries. The measure is likely to curb cheaper imports and reduce import volumes into the U.S., tightening supply for aluminum sheet. This is expected to support aluminum prices in the near term.

title: U.S. Commerce sets anti-dumping duties on aluminum sheet from 18 countries
summary: The U.S. Commerce Department issued final anti-dumping duties on common alloy aluminum sheet from 18 countries, with rates up to 242.8% for Germany and 4.83% for Bahrain, alongside related countervailing duties. The action comes on top of existing 10% aluminum tariffs, likely tightening U.S. supply and lifting prices.

title: US imposes aluminum duties on Germany, Bahrain
summary: The article states that the US has imposed aluminum duties on Germany and Bahrain. Such trade barriers typically reduce aluminum import volumes into the US, tightening availability and lifting pricing expectations for aluminium in the near term as markets anticipate higher delivered costs.

title: China's Tsingshan signs pacts for 100,000 T nickel matte in EV push
summary: Tsingshan Holding signed pacts to supply a total of 100,000 tonnes of nickel matte—60,000 tonnes to Huayou and 40,000 tonnes to CNGR—within a year starting October 2021. Nickel matte is used for EV batteries, reinforcing demand expectations and supporting nickel pricing.

title: Tsingshan signs pacts for 100,000 T nickel matte in EV push
summary: Tsingshan Holding signed pacts to deliver 100,000 tonnes of nickel matte within a year for EV battery supply chains, with 60,000 tonnes to Huayou and 40,000 tonnes to CNGR. The deals start October 2021 and build on trial nickel-matte production, supporting nickel demand expectations.

title: Shanghai aluminum lingers near 9-1/2-year high on supply worries
summary: Shanghai aluminum held near a 9-1/2-year peak as traders cited China supply risks, including possible smelter closures for environmental non-compliance and Inner Mongolia pausing approvals for high-energy-consuming projects. April SHFE and nearby LME aluminum rose, reflecting tighter physical availability and warrant demand.

title: Ferronickel prices rose while profit margins of spot ore were still shrinking_SMM
summary: SMM reports that after the holiday, nickel ore and ferronickel prices rose sharply. Tight nickel ore supply, falling domestic port inventories, and higher ocean freight lifted CIF Philippine laterite prices. Elevated ore costs support ferronickel prices, though plant margins remain squeezed, keeping prices high and volatile near term.

title: GLOBAL ALUMINIUM WRAP: Premiums soar in US, Rotterdam, Japan
summary: The article reports that global aluminium wrap premiums have surged across major regions, including the US, Rotterdam and Japan. It also notes Fastmarkets corrections to certain aluminium-related premium assessments following procedural errors. Overall, the headline premium increase signals near-term upward pressure for aluminium benchmarks.

title: Washington slaps tariffs on aluminum imports from 18 countries
summary: The US Commerce Department announced anti-dumping and countervailing tariffs on common alloy aluminum sheet imports from 18 countries following an investigation. Rates vary by country, including higher duties on major exporters like Germany. The duties stack on prior 10% national-security aluminum tariffs, likely tightening supply and supporting higher aluminium prices.

title: Copper Fox Metals Inc.: Copper Fox Announces 2021 Schaft Creek Program
summary: Copper Fox outlined its 2021 program for the Schaft Creek copper-gold-molybdenum-silver project, including drilling, metallurgical/geotechnical testwork, environmental baseline monitoring, and permitting updates, with a C$3.4 million budget. The work aims to refine throughput, recoveries, strip ratio, and costs, but no immediate production is stated.

title: Aluminium gains on concern about Chinese supply
summary: Aluminium prices climbed toward recent highs as investors worried China could curb aluminium output to meet greenhouse-gas decarbonisation goals announced around the “two sessions.” The Inner Mongolia region’s energy-efficiency actions and reports of tight physical availability/strong warrant demand supported a bullish tone. Other metals moved less.

title: Max Resource : Reports New Copper Discovery at CESAR North, NE Colombia
summary: Max Resource Corp. reports the CONEJO discovery, a new copper-silver mineralization zone within its CESAR copper-silver project in NE Colombia. The zone is open in all directions, and over 200 samples have been sent for assays expected early April. The update supports improved copper supply outlook but remains exploration-stage.

title: SMM Evening Comments (Mar 3): Shanghai nonferrous metals rose across the board, aluminium surged 4.16%_SMM
summary: SMM reports Shanghai nonferrous futures closed higher on Mar 3. Copper rose 1.68% and aluminium surged 4.16%, supported by a weaker US dollar and expectations of continued central bank stimulus. Nickel increased marginally (0.17%). Mixed oil-price pressure was noted but net moves were positive.

title: WBTL China Investing $50 MUSD in Mexico to produce Aluminum Chassis Components to Support North American Car Manufacturers
summary: WBTL (Bethel Automotive Safety Systems) plans a $50M plant in Mexico to cast and machine aluminum chassis components such as knuckles and control arms for North American automakers. The facility will be built in phases and commissioned in Q3 2022, supporting future aluminum consumption.

title: Nornickel to Stabilize Water Inflows at Mine by Next Week
summary: The article headline says Nornickel plans to stabilize water inflows at one of its mines by next week. Improving water management typically lowers the risk of production interruptions at nickel operations, supporting near-term nickel supply expectations and modestly underpinning nickel prices over coming days.

title: Group Ten Metals Inc.: Group Ten Drills High-Grade Nickel Sulphide in 455 Meters of Continuous Palladium, Platinum, Rhodium, Gold, Copper, and Cobalt Mineralization at the Stillwater West Project in Montana, USA
summary: Group Ten Metals reported 2020 drilling results at the Stillwater West project, highlighting long, continuous nickel and copper sulphide mineralization with strong grade-thickness and co-products. The company cites metallurgical potential and resource-modeling progress. As this is exploration progress without production changes, near-term market price impact is likely minimal.

title: China plans to reduce output of steel, aluminum to achieve carbon neutrality
summary: China plans to cut steel and aluminium output as part of carbon-neutrality efforts. Provinces like Tangshan will impose volume controls extending beyond steel into related industries to cut emissions. Supply constraints are expected to alter supply-demand dynamics and support metals prices; steel prices have already risen sharply.

title: Couple accused of taking copper lines, causing power outage
summary: Authorities accuse a couple of posing as electrical workers and stealing copper power lines in a South Carolina neighborhood, cutting lines and stripping copper from poles, leading to an outage. Investigators traced a truck used in the theft and found tools. Additional charges for tampering with telephone lines are possible.

title: Trades muted in copper scrap market as soaring copper prices left scrap holders reluctant to sell_SMM
summary: SMM reports muted trading in the copper scrap market after CNY as scrap holders delay selling amid bullish sentiment and holiday-related production gaps. High copper prices limit scrap consumption, while domestic–overseas price spreads and import timing reduce sustained inflows of imported scrap. Overall, availability is constrained but shortages look limited.

title: Blister copper RCs climbed amid abundant supply of blister copper produced from scrap copper and weak demand_SMM
summary: SMM reports domestic blister copper refining charges (RCs) rising to 1,700–1,900 yuan/mt in February, and imported blister copper RCs to about $155–165/mt. Copper price strength attracted more scrap, boosting supply, while weak blister demand from smelters lifted RCs further.

title: Tsingshan will supply high-grade nickel matte to Huayou Cobalt and CNGR_SMM
summary: Tsingshan Group signed agreements to supply 60,000 mt of high-grade nickel matte to Huayou Cobalt and 40,000 mt to CNGR over the following year starting October 2021. Tsingshan also expects rising Indonesia nickel-equivalent output and adjusts matte/ferronickel volumes to market demand, supporting nickel supply-demand expectations for batteries.

title: GLOBAL NICKEL WRAP: Chinese premiums rise 9.5% in bullish return from holidays
summary: The article reports a “bullish return from holidays” for China’s nickel market, with Chinese nickel premiums rising 9.5%. This suggests improved short-term demand and tighter pricing expectations for nickel in the regional physical market, likely supporting near-term nickel prices.

title: Business Scoop » Group Ten Drills High-Grade Nickel Sulphide At The Stillwater West Project In Montana, USA
summary: Group Ten Metals announced drill results from the Stillwater West Chrome Mountain target in Montana, reporting continuous nickel and copper sulphide mineralization, including high-grade nickel-tenor intervals and associated copper. Preliminary metallurgical work also supports flotation recoverability. The findings strengthen expectations for future battery-metal supply from the project.

title: Group Ten Drills High-Grade Nickel Sulphide At The Stillwater West Project In Montana, USA
summary: Group Ten Metals reported 2020 drill results from the Stillwater West project in Montana, intercepting wide nickel and copper sulphide mineralization with higher-grade zones, plus PGE co-products. While positive for nickel/copper sentiment, it is an exploration update without near-term supply changes, so near-term price impact is limited.

title: Global aluminium producers offer Q2 premiums of $149-$165/T, up 15%-27% from Q1
summary: Global aluminium producers are offering Q2 premiums of about $149-$165 per tonne, which are 15% to 27% higher than in Q1. Rising contract premiums suggest stronger pricing for aluminium availability and sales terms heading into Q2, typically supporting aluminium price expectations over the coming weeks.

title: China stainless steel slumps 6% as nickel prices drop
summary: China stainless steel futures fell 6% to their daily limit as nickel prices on the Shanghai Futures Exchange dropped 6%. Nickel slid on supply glut concerns after Tsingshan claimed stable nickel matte supply, denting sentiment. Analysts expect a possible rebound later if stainless fundamentals improve.

title: How will demand for copper from wire and cable producers recover after copper prices dropped from highs?_SMM
summary: After CNY, SHFE copper surged, lifting costs for wire and cable producers and pressuring demand. An SMM survey expects operating rates around 68% in March, with orders down year-on-year. Weaker State Grid and China Southern Power Grid orders add pressure, though improvement is expected from late March as copper stabilizes.

title: Green Revolution Gets More Expensive as Copper Price Surges
summary: The headline says the “Green Revolution” is getting more expensive as the copper price surges. This suggests near-term strength in copper markets, likely driven by improved price momentum or demand expectations for electrification and related infrastructure. The provided text contains no details on nickel or aluminium impacts.

title: Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt : London nickel tumbles to over 2-month low on oversupply concerns
summary: London and Shanghai nickel prices dropped sharply to multi-week lows as investors worried about oversupply in nickel battery materials. The selloff was linked to Tsingshan’s plan to supply 100,000 tonnes of nickel matte to Huayou Cobalt and CNGR, which could ease a perceived battery nickel shortage.

title: Champion industry, aluminium, looks for 5% RoDTEP rate to boost exports
summary: India’s finance ministry announced implementation of RoDTEP from April 1, but exporters face uncertainty over sector-wise rates and MEIS withdrawal/blocking of claims. The non-ferrous—especially aluminium—industry says unrebated taxes raise costs ~15% and seeks at least a 5% RoDTEP remission to boost competitiveness and exports.

title: Champion industry, aluminium, looks for 5% RoDTEP rate to boost exports (Ld)
summary: India’s finance ministry has extended RoDTEP from April 1 but sector-wise remission rates remain pending, creating uncertainty for exporters. The article says aluminium firms face high unreimbursed taxes (~15% of production cost) and weak competitiveness after MEIS withdrawal, urging at least a 5% RoDTEP remission rate to boost exports.

title: US Reduces Anti-Dumping Tariff on Alro's Aluminum to 37.2% from 84%
summary: The US Department of Commerce cut an anti-dumping tariff on aluminum sheets produced by Romania’s Alro SA to 37.26% from nearly 84%, per the company’s statement. Reduced duties may improve US import competitiveness and affect short-term expectations for aluminum sheet supply and pricing.

title: Nickel collapse triggers slide across industrial metals
summary: Industrial metals fell sharply after nickel prices collapsed for a second day following a spike driven by speculative inflows. Copper dropped nearly 5% and aluminum was also lower as investors turned jittery with rising U.S. yields, weaker equities, a stronger dollar, and concern over supply outlook and positioning.

title: Primary aluminium inventories expanded 91,000 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM said China’s social inventories of primary aluminium across eight consumption areas rose 91,000 mt week-on-week to 1.17 million mt as of March 4. Increases were mainly driven by stocks in Wuxi, Nanhai and Gongyi, suggesting improved near-term availability that could pressure prices.

title: Canada Nickel Announces Improved Metallurgical Testing Results at Crawford Nickel-Cobalt Sulphide Project
summary: Canada Nickel says metallurgical tests at its Crawford nickel-cobalt sulphide project show a 20% increase in primary grind size with no loss in recovery, reducing energy use per tonne and enabling higher throughput. The PEA is delayed to April 30, 2021 to incorporate improvements. It does not imply near-term production changes.

title: Nickel Rock Resources Files NI 43-101 Report for the Nickel Project Next to the Decar Nickel Project of FPX Nickel Corp.
summary: Nickel Rock Resources filed an NI 43-101 technical report for its Nickel Project targeting awaruite nickel-iron alloy, with planned 2021 exploration (trenching, sampling, diamond drilling). The property is near FPX Nickel’s Decar project. The news relates to nickel resource potential but offers no immediate production changes.

title: Energy Transition Will Drive More Copper Mining
summary: Bloomberg says the energy transition is copper-intensive, with grid buildouts, interconnectors, EVs, and renewable expansion driving demand growth and potentially longer periods of supply shortfall. Copper has recently surged near a nine-year high. Some substitution toward aluminum is discussed, but copper remains central.

title: Class 1 Nickel Announces Nickel Sulphide Projects Update, Quebec and Ontario
summary: Class 1 Nickel reports completion and planning of drilling and permitting activities at its Somanike project in Quebec and Alexo-Dundonald project near Timmins, Ontario. Results so far indicate massive sulphides likely nickeliferous, with assays pending, and a staged $8M exploration/PEA plan.

title: New Caledonia agrees to Vale nickel mine sale, Tesla to be partner
summary: The headline reports that New Caledonia has agreed to a Vale nickel mine sale, with Tesla named as a partner. Such changes can influence expectations for nickel output and investment in the near term. However, the excerpt provides no specifics on volumes or timelines, limiting certainty on price direction.

title: Turquoise Hill CEO exits amid tension with Rio Tinto over funding of Mongolian copper mine
summary: Turquoise Hill CEO Ulf Quellmann resigned after tensions with Rio Tinto over funding for Mongolia’s Oyu Tolgoi copper-gold mine. Arbitration and potential governance shifts raise expectations that a financing mix including equity may be needed, increasing near-term uncertainty around project delivery amid ongoing cost and tax disputes.

title: SMM Evening Comments (Mar 4): Nonferrous metals on the SHFE fell across the board, nickel tumbled 6%_SMM
summary: SMM reports SHFE nonferrous metals fell on Mar 4, with copper down 1.95%, aluminium down 1.64%, and nickel down 6%. Aluminium stocks rose across key consumption areas, indicating ongoing inventory pressure. The nickel drop is part of broad market weakness. Macro drivers include rising US Treasury yields.

title: Polish miner KGHM looking to sell two U.S. copper assets -sources
summary: KGHM is exploring the sale of its U.S. Robinson (Nevada) and Carlota (Arizona) copper mines, valued around $500 million, with proceeds planned for reinvestment in domestic operations. The report is about asset divestment rather than any immediate production loss, limiting direct short-term supply impact.

title: Copper Porphyries: Are They the Key to the Electric Vehicle Boom?
summary: The piece highlights that copper porphyry deposits supply most global copper and argues EV adoption will boost copper intensity in vehicles and charging infrastructure. Citing forecasts for rapid EV growth and higher copper requirements per unit, it frames strong future demand, supporting a bullish copper sentiment.

title: Nickel price collapse triggers slide across industrial metals
summary: Industrial metals fell as nickel prices collapsed for a second day, with refined nickel dropping more than 10% in two days. The sell-off followed eased shortage fears after a Chinese producer’s plan to add supply. Risk-off sentiment from higher U.S. bond yields also pressured copper, which fell up to 5% intraday.

title: Coppertunities! - FNArena
summary: The piece argues copper will remain supported by tight supply and rising electrification demand. It cites near-term bullish catalysts: US stimulus, potential supply disruptions before Chilean and Peruvian elections, and Chinese restocking around Lunar New Year. It also references a large projected supply deficit, limiting downside risk.

title: Aluminium producer Hydro agrees $1.65 bln sale of Rolling division
summary: Hydro agreed to sell its Rolling division to KPS Capital Partners for €1.38bn, including seven plants and about 5,000 employees. The sale reflects an impairment charge and supports Hydro’s strategy for low-carbon aluminium. The division produced 864,000 tonnes of aluminium for sheets used in packaging and vehicles.

title: Shanghai bonded copper stocks rose 4,900 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Shanghai bonded copper stocks rose for a third consecutive week, increasing 4,900 mt to 365,500 mt as of Feb. 26. SMM attributes the build to delayed domestic consumption after price spikes, weak import demand due to losses and sluggish premiums, and continued piling up of refined copper, keeping inventories slightly higher.

title: S&P Global Platts to Publish New Low-Carbon Aluminum Prices
summary: S&P Global Platts will start publishing daily Low-Carbon Aluminum Price (LCAP) and Zero-Carbon Aluminum Price (ZCAP) assessments for European markets from April 6, 2021. LCAP is assessed as a premium to LME cash and applies to certified low-emissions primary aluminum; ZCAP offsets emissions using carbon-credit prices.

title: S. Korean firm invests RM2.3bil to set up copper foil plant in Sabah
summary: SK Nexilis will invest RM2.3bn to build its first overseas copper foil plant in Sabah, Malaysia. The announced investment signals incremental copper usage for foil manufacturing and can lift short-term expectations for copper demand, though timing and commissioning details aren’t provided.

title: SMM Evening Comments (Mar 5): Nonferrous metals on the SHFE closed mostly lower, Nickel tumbled 6.7%_SMM
summary: SMM reports broad declines in SHFE nonferrous prices on Mar 5. Copper fell 1.76% and aluminium declined 1.68%, while nickel tumbled 6.7% on the day, with mixed open-interest changes. The piece ties sentiment to macro moves and market expectations, but overall closes bearish.

title: KPS Capital Partners to Acquire Aluminum Rolling Business from Norsk Hydro ASA
summary: KPS Capital Partners agreed to acquire Norsk Hydro’s global aluminum rolling business for €1.38 billion. The target operates major rolling and finishing facilities, producing about one million tonnes per year, serving packaging and automotive customers. The transaction is expected mid-2021, subject to approvals and customary conditions.

title: KPS Capital Partners To Buy Global Aluminum Rolling Business From Norsk Hydro For About $1.67 Bln
summary: KPS Capital Partners agreed to buy Norsk Hydro’s global aluminum rolling business for about $1.67 billion. The sold assets include major rolling and finishing facilities in Germany and Norway, with Alunorf and Grevenbroich. The transaction is expected to close mid-year 2021, creating an independent company.

title: Bell Copper Corporation: Bell Copper Completes $725,000 Non-Brokered Private Placement
summary: Bell Copper Corporation completed a CDN $725,000 non-brokered private placement to fund ongoing drilling at its Big Sandy and Perseverance porphyry copper projects and for working capital. The financing details include share/warrant terms and regulatory approvals, but it does not indicate any immediate supply disruption or copper market shock.

title: Bell Copper Completes $725,000 Non-Brokered Private Placement
summary: Bell Copper completed a CDN $725,000 non-brokered private placement to fund drilling and exploration at its Big Sandy copper project and general working capital. Shares and warrants were issued, with standard hold period and TSX-V approval required. The news is financing-focused rather than a direct supply or demand shock.

title: Nickel ore inventories at Chinese ports fell 161,000 wmt to 7.1 million wmt_SMM
summary: SMM data show Chinese nickel ore inventories fell 161,000 wmt from Feb 26 to 7.1 million wmt as of Mar 5. In nickel content terms, stocks dropped 1,300 mt to 56,000 mt, while inventories at seven major ports declined 51,000 wmt to 5.85 million wmt, implying tighter supply.

title: Shanghai bonded refined nickel stocks fell 1,700 mt on wee_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show Shanghai bonded refined nickel inventories fell 1,700 mt to 16,700 mt as of March 5. Stocks dropped after the holiday amid a sharp rise in nickel prices and an opened import window. Russian nickel and briquettes saw transactions, with further exports expected, likely keeping stocks declining near term.

title: Here To Serve Holding Corp.: Fortune Nickel and Gold Commences Airborne Geophysical Review on the Beck-Ottaway Nickel Sulphide Project
summary: Fortune Nickel and Gold begins an airborne geophysical review for drill targeting at its Beck-Ottaway nickel sulphide project near Canada Nickel’s Crawford deposit. The company expects maps and reports within four weeks and references prior drill intersections of nickel and anomalous copper associated with sulphides and veins.

title: Nickel slumps as electric dreams are rudely disturbed
summary: Nickel prices plunged about 16% in two days to a three-month low after Tsingshan announced contracts to deliver nickel matte to Chinese battery materials suppliers. Analysts say the route could loosen balances or weaken the higher-price investment case, while positioning is stretched, amplifying investor sell-offs.

title: ArrowMetals signs nickel sulfate tolling deal for Q3 2021 production
summary: ArrowMetals announces a nickel sulfate tolling deal covering Q3 2021 production. The news implies changes to nickel sulfate processing and supply volumes, which can affect expectations for near-term availability along nickel chemical/conversion supply chains and potentially support nickel prices.

title: SaskPower increasing measures to foil copper thieves
summary: SaskPower says copper thieves cost it $41,000 in 2020 and warns that stolen copper grounding materials create electrocution and outage risks. The utility is adding remote video monitoring and replacing stolen wire with copper cladding that has no scrap value to deter future thefts.

title: Tesla Secures Long-Term Nickel Supply Through New Caledonia Partnership
summary: Tesla is named as a technical partner in a deal to take over Vale’s New Caledonia nickel mine after political turmoil and protests. The agreement gives local interests a 51% stake and keeps key processing rights, while Tesla aims to secure nickel for EV battery demand, which is expected to rise.

title: Chinese Metal Giant Is Upending the Nickel Market All Over Again
summary: Bloomberg reports Tsingshan is preparing to deliver nickel matte made from nickel pig iron to battery-material producers, potentially enabling battery-grade performance with lower-cost feedstock. With battery demand fears already supporting nickel prices, the prospect of added supply drove a sharp selloff, with London futures down 14% in two days.

title: Nickel Slumps as China Metal Giant Upends Markets All Over Again
summary: Tsingshan appears poised to supply battery-grade nickel products by refining nickel pig iron into nickel matte, potentially reducing a perceived nickel supply deficit tied to EV demand. The market reaction has been sharp: London nickel futures plunged 14% in two days, reflecting expectations of increased nickel availability.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Invites You on a Virtual Site Tour of the Kamoa-Kakula Mine, Now Approximately 80% Complete and Soon to Join the Ranks of the World's Major Copper Producers
