summary: Ivanhoe Mines released a virtual tour of its Kamoa-Kakula copper project in the DRC, stating the first phases are about 80% complete and construction is progressing rapidly. It also notes upgraded hydropower and high-voltage power lines supporting operations, potentially improving near-term expectations for copper supply.

title: Tesla gets involved in New Caledonia nickel mine to secure metal supply
summary: Tesla will act as a technical adviser for New Caledonia’s nickel mine amid conflict, aiming to secure sufficient battery-metal supply. The move signals stronger involvement by an EV maker in nickel sourcing, potentially tightening perceived supply risk and supporting near-term nickel price sentiment.

title: SaskPower warns of the dangers of stealing copper
summary: SaskPower warns Saskatchewan residents against stealing copper from power infrastructure, citing safety risks from removed grounding material and potential power outages. The Crown corporation says copper theft cost it over $41,000 in 2020 and created repair risks. SaskPower will add monitoring and replace stolen wire with low-scrap cladding.

title: Bam Bam Resources Corp.: Bam Bam Drill Holes Indicate Supergene Copper Enrichment Below the Oxide Mineralization at Majuba Hill, Nevada Porphyry Project
summary: Bam Bam Resources reported drill results at its Majuba Hill porphyry copper project showing copper enrichment below oxide mineralization, including intercepts up to 1.31% Cu. The company says this could expand known mineralization, but the update is project-specific and unlikely to significantly move near-term copper prices.

title: Has China shattered battery nickel's supply chain bottleneck?
summary: China’s Tsingshan Holding agreed to supply about 100,000 tonnes of nickel matte (65–75% nickel) to Huayou Cobalt and CNGR. The deal is presented as disrupting the prior nickel supply bottleneck, potentially improving feedstock availability for battery-related production.

title: Tesla has partnered with a nickel mine after Elon Musk said the metal was the group's 'biggest concern' amid shortage fears
summary: Tesla agreed to become an industrial adviser to Vale’s Goro nickel mine in New Caledonia, aiming to help secure nickel supplies for lithium-ion battery production. The deal follows Musk’s warnings that nickel is the biggest concern amid potential shortages as EV output accelerates, with prior disruptions in the region.

title: Nickel slumps as electric dreams are disrupted
summary: Nickel fell sharply, posting its worst week in nearly a decade, after Tsingshan Holding said it signed deals to deliver nickel matte to Chinese battery suppliers. The move challenges the market’s assumption about battery-grade nickel supply tightness and raises doubts over profitable matte-to-sulfate conversion, weighing on sentiment.

title: Peak Aluminum Looms for China as Xi Pushes New Green Mission
summary: China’s green and carbon-neutrality drive is likely to curb aluminum smelting growth by tightening energy-consumption constraints, starting with stopping new projects in Inner Mongolia and potentially spreading nationwide. Analysts expect earlier “peak” output and a widening global supply deficit, supporting higher Shanghai aluminum futures.

title: Material Matters: Nickel, Bulks, Oil, Gold
summary: Tsingshan’s announcement to sell 75kt of nickel and ramp production sparks fears of nickel/NPI oversupply, weighing on LME nickel. It also points to higher China copper wire/product inventories as a demand drag. Separately, China’s aluminium capacity-curb commitment is expected to slow supply growth, lifting premiums and supporting aluminium.

title: Spot cargoes offered below SHFE copper prices_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SHFE copper prices fell, shrinking Shanghai spot discounts toward zero as dip buyers increased trading. In Shandong and north China, premiums rebounded on improving downstream interest and lower smelter inventories, with expectations for further premium increases ahead of SHFE delivery. Gujarat premiums also rose despite higher inventories and shipment shifts.

title: London copper dips as U.S. stimulus fails to lift prices
summary: London copper prices dipped 0.1% after a strong rally to multi-year highs, with traders saying the U.S. stimulus progress was largely priced in. LME aluminium (-0.3%) and nickel (-1%) also fell. China’s copper imports rose in January-February, but investors stayed cautious at current levels.

title: Chile copper export revenue surges 65% in February as prices soar
summary: Chile’s central bank said February copper export revenue surged 65% year on year to $3.879 billion as global copper prices soared above $9,000 a tonne for the first time since 2011. Shipments rose 65% and total exports increased 41%, widening the trade surplus.

title: Exclusive: China's primary aluminium output rose to 3.02 million mt in February _SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s primary aluminium output rose 5.23% YoY to 3.02 million tonnes in February, with operating rates at 91.1% and daily production increasing versus January. March output is expected to reach 3.34 million tonnes, with imports resuming. Aluminium inventories are forecast to rise to ~1.35 million tonnes.

title: Exclusive: China's copper cathode output rose 2.89% MoM to 821,800 mt in February_SMM
summary: SMM’s survey shows China’s copper cathode output in February rose 2.89% month-on-month to 821,800 mt, helped by smelters recovering from maintenance. Higher sulphuric acid prices eased concentrate TC pressure, but smelters faced finished-product inventory pressure as higher copper prices deterred downstream buying. March output is expected to rise further.

title: Exclusive: China's refined nickel output rose 5.33% MoM to 13,700 mt in February_SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s refined nickel output rose 5.33% month-on-month to 13,700 mt in February, with most production attributed to the Gansu and Xinjiang smelters while other plants stayed suspended. March output is expected to climb further as Tianjin resumes and Jilin restores late-March lines.

title: Copper rises on U.S. stimulus and higher Chinese imports
summary: Copper prices rose after the U.S. Senate approved a $1.9 trillion stimulus and China increased copper imports, even as exports hit record levels. Lower China treatment charges signaled tight concentrate feedstock, while LME copper stocks rose. Citi turned more bullish, forecasting further gains toward $10,500 within three months.

title: U.S. Gold Corp. Reports Update on CK Gold Project Metallurgical Testing, Anticipating Improved Gold and Copper Recoveries
summary: U.S. Gold Corp. updated CK Gold project metallurgical testing, saying oxide recovery improved with copper recoveries rising to 55–60% (up from earlier 10% figures) and producing concentrates with over 25% copper. Management expects improved recoveries to improve project economics and plans locked cycle tests.

title: Material Matters: Iron Ore, Nickel, Aluminium, Oil
summary: Views across commodities highlight nickel weakness after Tsingshan disclosed plans to start producing nickel-in-matte from Indonesian satellite ore for EV battery sulphate, triggering a sharp LME sell-off and making rebounds unlikely. Aluminium is described as having limited immediate physical-market impact, though China energy-control measures could raise future disruption risks.

title: Material Matters: Iron Ore, Nickel, Aluminium, Oil
summary: Expert commentary covers nickel and aluminium. Nickel is pressured after Tsingshan indicated it will produce more nickel-in-matte from satellite ore for conversion to sulphate, creating uncertainty about long-run support, though supply disruptions at Norilsk cap downside. Aluminium gains are tempered by China energy control measures in Inner Mongolia affecting smelting fees and new approvals.

title: NorthWest Copper Announces C$13.0 Million Bought Deal Private Placement
summary: NorthWest Copper announced a C$13.0 million bought-deal private placement, including flow-through shares, to fund project development, exploration expenditures, and working capital. The company is a copper-gold explorer, so the financing may slightly affect copper sentiment, but the release contains no immediate supply or demand impact.

title: Orders continued to pick up across copper processing enterprises amid lower copper prices_SMM
summary: SMM reports mixed order trends across China’s copper processing supply chain. Cable and tube makers show limited new orders amid falling copper prices and project timing effects, while copper rod firms see improved orders as prices dropped. Cathode-fed rod demand remains pressured by high prices and scrap spreads; other segments show optimism for March.

title: Copper edges down as a firm dollar weighs
summary: Copper edged down in London on Tuesday as a firm dollar, supported by higher U.S. yields and faster recovery expectations, weighed on dollar-priced metals. LME three-month copper fell 0.7% to $8,935/t. Aluminium and nickel also declined, while copper inventories rose to high levels.

title: Aluminium processors continued to resume production, but high aluminium prices affected production resumptions_SMM
summary: SMM reports that aluminium processors’ operating rates rose week-on-week, helped by backlog orders and production resumption. However, high aluminium prices limited downstream purchases for construction extrusions and reduced new orders (e.g., State Grid, wheel plants). Wire/cable rates may decline and extrusion demand is mixed, with PV affected by high silicon.

title: Tsingshan's announcement severely impacted nickel futures prices_SMM
summary: SMM reports that Tsingshan’s announcement on supplying high-grade nickel matte has disrupted the nickel market, pressuring nickel futures lower. The write-up argues that if matte supply expands, nickel-briquette premiums could ease back toward precursor pricing, weakening price support from NPI and sulphate-linked feedstocks.

title: Nickel futures fell sharply, dragging down stainless steel prices_SMM
summary: SMM reports a weekly drop in SHFE nickel futures, which spilled into spot NPI and stainless steel. High-grade NPI benchmark prices fell, spot transactions weakened, and NPI plants faced cost pressure and potential hedged-cargo selling. Stainless steel prices slid on weaker nickel sentiment, though a short-term rebound is possible if prices stabilize.

title: Pampa Metals Corp.: Pampa Metals Provides Exploration Update and Background on Its Block 3 Copper Project in Chile
summary: Pampa Metals issued an exploration progress update for its northern Chile program and provided background on its Block 3 copper project. The release details completed mapping, advancing 3D IP/MT geophysics, and planned surveys to define drill targets, but includes no changes to copper supply or demand.

title: LIVE FUTURES REPORT 09/03: LME aluminium price falls 1%; nickel below $16,000/t
summary: Fastmarkets/Fastmarkets’ live futures update reports that LME aluminium prices are down 1% on the day and that nickel is trading below $16,000/t. The report is therefore directly tied to immediate market pricing for aluminium and nickel, signaling bearish momentum over the next days.

title: LIVE FUTURES REPORT 09/03: LME aluminium price falls 1%; nickel below $16,000/t
summary: Live futures commentary reports LME aluminium falling 1% and nickel trading below $16,000/t. The remainder of the text focuses mainly on Fastmarkets methodology/publication corrections rather than new supply-demand drivers, but the headline pricing indicates immediate bearish movement in aluminium and nickel.

title: NORNICKEL CONTINUES WORKING ON BLOCKING THE GROUNDWATER INFLOW AT OKTIABRSKY AND TAYMIR MINES
summary: Norilsk Nickel said it is continuing work to stop groundwater inflow at Oktiabrsky and Taymir mines. One mine working has been filled with hardening backfill, and regulators’ inspections are underway. The Norilsk Concentrator remains fully idled while repairs proceed, with relaunch timing to be decided after inspections around March 16.

title: SMM Evening Comments (Mar 9): Shanghai nonferrous metals fell for the most part, nickel plunged 3.81%_SMM
summary: SMM reports that most SHFE nonferrous metals fell on Tuesday. Copper slid 0.68% as a firmer US dollar weighed on prices. Aluminium dropped 2.13%. Nickel plunged 3.81% amid wider risk-off/commodity weakness. Other base metals were mixed, with zinc slightly higher.

title: Metals and mining stocks battered in London trading as iron and copper prices tumble
summary: London’s metals and mining stocks fell sharply as copper and iron prices declined. Copper was down about 1.5% on Tuesday, while April iron ore futures were near 6% lower. The drops pressured major U.K.-listed copper and iron producers such as Rio Tinto, BHP and Glencore.

title: Nornickel schedule for mine restarts to be considered by March 16
summary: Norilsk Nickel said it expects another week before deciding when to restart two Siberian waterlogged mines. It is also idling the Norilsk Concentrator after an accident and plans only partial restoration by March 16. Delays could cut output; analysts cite potential 4–5% loss if suspensions last a month.

title: Copper prices slip as China cools growth and credit plans
summary: Copper slipped on Monday as China’s economic growth targets looked more modest and authorities signaled less aggressive credit expansion to contain debt risks. Fitch expected softer fiscal consolidation. LME copper was down 1.4%, with aluminium and nickel also falling amid weaker near-term demand sentiment.

title: Nornickel to take another week to halt water inflow at Siberia mines
summary: Norilsk Nickel said it needs about another week to stop groundwater inflow at two Siberia mines before assessing restart timing. The mines contribute a large share of its Russian ore, and the company is also idling its Norilsk concentrator after a collapse. Analysts warn of multi-month output loss, bearish for nickel.

title: Golden Arrow Boosts Copper Strategy, Options its Caballos Copper-Gold Project, Argentina
summary: Golden Arrow Resources entered a definitive agreement to option its Caballos copper-gold project in Argentina to Hanaq, with Hanaq earning a 70% interest by funding US$4 million of exploration over six years. The company cites recent copper market strength, but the deal does not indicate immediate supply changes.

title: Concerns over stockpile of hazardous waste at New Zealand aluminium smelter
summary: Concerns were raised about hazardous waste (spent pot lining with fluoride and cyanide) stockpiled at Rio Tinto’s Tiwai Point aluminium smelter. RNZ reported unclear end plans and potential risks, prompting New Zealand government pauses on shutdown talks. Rio Tinto says storage is monitored while exploring disposal and possible cement reuse.

title: Trader buys $US36.6m worth of copper, but gets painted rocks instead
summary: Mercuria agreed to buy about $36m of blister copper from a Turkish supplier, but the shipments arriving in China contained painted paving stones instead. Turkish police arrested 13 suspects and the company seeks redress after forged insurance contracts. The case highlights copper cargo fraud rather than system-wide market disruption.

title: Swiss commodities trader Mercuria buys $US36 million of copper from Turkish supplier Bietsan, but gets painted rocks instead
summary: Swiss trader Mercuria says it paid for $36 million of copper shipments from Turkey, but upon arrival in China it found containers of spray-painted paving stones instead of about 6,000 tons of blister copper. The fraud creates disrupted physical supply and heightened counterparty risk, likely bearish for copper near term.

title: Hannan Metals Ltd.: Hannan Discovers First High Grade Copper-Silver Outcrops Over 2.5 KM Strike at Tabalosos, Peru
summary: Hannan Metals reports first high-grade copper-silver outcrop discoveries at its Tabalosos project in Peru, with channel sample grades up to 6.3–7.2% copper and high silver values. The update follows assay and field work resumption after COVID-19 restrictions and describes further soil sampling to define mineralized widths.

title: Material Matters: Copper Bull, Gold & Nickel Bear
summary: Macquarie and Citi expect a copper deficit and calls on scrap to support higher prices, with Citi raising near-term copper targets. In contrast, Credit Suisse links Tsingshan’s nickel strategy to potential oversupply, cutting its 0–3 month nickel outlook. Gold is discussed as capped, but aluminium is not.

title: Material Matters: Copper Bull, Gold & Nickel Bear
summary: Macquarie upgraded its copper balance to a sizable refined deficit and lifted 2021-2023 price forecasts, citing strong demand rebound, thin inventories, and a large scrap “call.” For nickel, Tsingshan’s plan to expand contained output and convert to class 2-to-class 1 is described as triggering positioning exits and potential oversupply, pushing prices lower.

title: London copper rises on demand hope, China's policy risks limit gains
summary: London three-month copper rose 0.5% while Shanghai copper fell 1.5% as investors balanced improving demand hopes against concerns that China’s modest growth target may trigger tighter liquidity. Additional notes cite Peru output prospects and China base-metals commentary, with sharp fluctuations and speculation risk discussed.

title: GLOBAL COPPER WRAP: European copper premiums reach highest level in over two years
summary: The article reports that European copper premiums have risen to the highest level in more than two years, indicating tighter physical availability and improving demand conditions in Europe. It also includes administrative updates on some Fastmarkets aluminium assessment publications, but the main market signal highlighted is for copper premiums.

title: London copper rises on demand hopes; China policy worries hit Shanghai
summary: Reuters reports London copper up 0.5% on demand hopes and global recovery optimism, while Shanghai copper fell 1.9% amid fears of China tightening policy. Analysts cite macro-driven volatility and potential downstream buying only after price stabilizes. Peru output prospects are also noted.

title: Chinese aluminium producer Shenhuo doubles alumina intake from ERG
summary: Henan Shenhuo will buy 300,000 tonnes of alumina from Eurasian Resources Group this year, doubling its prior ERG intake. The kazakhstan-refined alumina will feed Shenhuo’s Xinjiang smelter, alongside domestic alumina capacity ramp-ups. More secure alumina supply supports aluminium production and sentiment.

title: Vimetco Extrusion invests 10 million Euro in an automatic extrusion line for aluminium profiles
summary: ALRO’s Vimetco Extrusion plans to spend €10m to buy and install a new automated extrusion line for aluminium profiles. The investment, supplied by Presezzi Extrusion, aims to produce higher value-added, customized products with lower environmental impact and improved cost efficiency through increased automation and reduced labor intervention.

title: Nine suspects bust with R600,000 worth of stolen copper in Cape Town
summary: Cape Town police arrested nine suspects for possession of stolen copper valued at R600,000. Officers recovered copper and a hijacked vehicle after a truck carrying copper was hijacked last weekend, with further seizures in Philippi and Parow. Suspects are set to appear in court Thursday.

title: Yangshan copper premiums continued to fall_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports Yangshan copper premiums for March continued to decline on subdued trades. Domestic consumption recovery is slower due to high prices and cathode-versus-scrap spread, while Shanghai bonded copper inventories rose for a third week. Import losses and weaker quotes keep the import window closed, pressuring sellers and lowering premiums further.

title: SMM Evening Comments (Mar 10): Shanghai nonferrous metals were mostly lower, nickel declined 2.05%_SMM
summary: SMM reports most Shanghai base metals fell on Wednesday Mar 10. SHFE copper eased 1.95% to 65,400 yuan/mt, aluminium slipped 0.06% to 17,185 yuan/mt, and nickel dropped 2.05% to 119,770 yuan/mt, signaling broad near-term bearish price pressure in these contracts.

title: X2 PERFORMANCE® Partners With Hudson Worldwide To Source Aluminum Can Needs For Natural Energy Drinks
summary: X2 PERFORMANCE partnered with Hudson Worldwide to secure aluminum can supplies for its expanding natural energy drink line. The company cites worldwide aluminum can shortages and retailer demand, noting that competition and major beverage firms control much of global aluminum supply. The partnership aims to resolve X2’s inventory constraints via additional aluminum can sourcing.

title: No aluminium queue at LME Istim warehouses in Port Klang for first time since 2018
summary: Metal Bulletin reports that for the first time since 2018 there is no aluminium queue at LME Istim warehouses in Port Klang. The update suggests improved availability versus prior congestion, which can ease near-term supply tightness expectations for aluminium prices.

title: Norilsk Nickel pays $2.5 billion to Russia over massive Arctic oil spill
summary: Norilsk Nickel confirmed it paid about $2.5 billion to Russia after a massive Arctic fuel spill in 2020, which triggered Russia’s largest environmental fine. The company did not appeal and said the incident hurt 2020 profit. Ongoing fixes and mine/plant issues could imply near-term nickel supply and cost pressure.

title: Copper prices to hit record high in next 12 months, China's Maike says
summary: Maike Group’s chairman said copper prices are likely to reach record levels over the next 12 months, citing China’s clean energy and electric vehicle infrastructure demand and years of insufficient investment in mine supply. Copper recently hit a 9½-year high on the LME but has since eased, with expectations of future shortages.

title: Norilsk Nickel: Mining firm pays record $2bn fine over Arctic oil spill
summary: Norilsk Nickel has paid a record $2bn fine after a May Arctic diesel spill from its facilities in Siberia. The incident, linked to melting permafrost and safety failures, cut 2020 profits and implies significant ongoing cleanup and environmental spending. Nickel supply-cost concerns could weigh on prices in coming days.

title: Copper rally closes Rio's Mongolian funding gap
summary: Turquoise Hill Resources says higher copper prices are shrinking its funding shortfall for Mongolia’s Oyu Tolgoi project, improving its chances of avoiding an equity raise requested by Rio. Rio and Turquoise Hill remain divided on how to address the multi‑billion funding gap, but the update is driven by the copper rally.

title: Fire affects Chile's Andina copper mine
summary: A fire has affected Chile’s Andina copper mine, raising concerns about short-term output disruptions. Any interruption to processing or production can tighten near-term copper supply expectations, typically leading traders to price in a potential temporary shortfall and support copper prices over the next days.

title: Oil Trader Mercuria Gets Painted Bricks, Not Copper In $36 Million Scam
summary: Mercuria allegedly received painted rocks instead of 6,000 tons of copper in a $36 million fraud involving container tampering in Turkey and diversion of the cargo to China. While it underscores supply-chain vulnerability amid tightening base-metal supply expectations, the event appears isolated and not clearly market-wide.

title: Copper Wobbles Mask Ongoing Demand Strength, Top Supplier Says
summary: Chile’s Energy and Mining Minister says the recent copper dip is not a sign of cooling demand. He cites strong Chinese buying, expectations of economic stimulus-led recovery, and medium-term demand growth from renewables and electro-mobility. He also notes continued investment discipline and Chile’s large project pipeline.

title: Rio Tinto makes first sale of aluminium-scandium alloy for 3D printing
summary: Rio Tinto says it has made its first commercial sale of high-performance aluminium-scandium alloy to Amaero, delivered from its Canadian hydro-powered smelters and scandium oxide supply from a Quebec metallurgical complex. The company is also building a new Quebec plant to expand scandium oxide output using titanium-dioxide waste streams.

title: Rio Tinto : makes first sale of aluminium-scandium alloy for 3D printing
summary: Rio Tinto said it has signed an agreement to deliver the first commercial batch of aluminium-scandium alloy for 3D printing to Amaero, using low-carbon aluminium from Canadian hydro-powered smelters and high-purity scandium oxide from a Quebec complex. The supply helps commercialize aerospace/defence high-temperature aluminium alloy demand.

title: Rio Tinto Provides Aluminium-scandium Alloy For 3D Printing
summary: Rio Tinto signed an agreement to supply Amaero with a first commercial batch of high-performance aluminium-scandium alloy for 3D printing. The billets will come from Rio’s hydro-powered Canadian smelters, while scandium oxide is sourced from its Quebec complex. The deal targets aerospace and defence high-temperature uses.

title: Copper rises on U.S. stimulus cheer, Chile supply threat
summary: Copper rose 0.6% on the LME and 0.5% on the Shanghai market as U.S. lawmakers moved toward passing a $1.9 trillion stimulus bill. Separately, Chilean mine workers at Antofagasta’s Los Pelambres voted to reject a contract, raising strike supply risk.

title: PRICING NOTICE: Amendment to frequency of cif South Korea registered copper premium assessment
summary: Fastmarkets issued a pricing notice amending the publication timing/holiday schedule for CIF South Korea registered copper premium assessments starting May 18. It also corrected procedural errors affecting certain European low-carbon aluminium differential and Aluminium 6063 extrusion billet premium midpoint assessments. Changes relate to assessment publication, not underlying market supply/demand.

title: Workers at Antofagasta's Los Pelambres copper mine in Chile reject contract offer
summary: Workers at Antofagasta’s Los Pelambres copper mine in Chile rejected a contract offer. Such labor actions can threaten mine operations or schedules, tightening near-term copper supply expectations. This typically supports downside pressure on copper prices over the following days as markets assess disruption risk.

title: Operating rates of aluminium wire and cable continued to fall in February_SMM
summary: SMM says operating rates for aluminium wire and cable producers fell to 26.63% in February due to shorter production time, weak order intake, and downstream inability to absorb high raw material prices. Some companies face losses from pricing tied to average prior-month aluminium. March is expected to rebound.

title: Operating rates at copper tube producers missed expectations in February_SMM
summary: SMM says copper tube producers’ operating rates fell to 62.67% in February, missing expectations, after copper prices surged post–Chinese New Year and weakened downstream consumption. Raw material inventory/production rose to 15.91%, indicating slower use of feedstock. March operating rates are expected to rebound to 81.73% with higher air-conditioning production.

title: Copper plate, strip and foil operating rates in February fell short of expectations_SMM
summary: SMM says Chinese copper plate/strip/foil producer operating rates fell to 63.79% in February, down on the month, as CNY holidays and post-holiday copper-price hikes curtailed downstream consumption. Feedstock inventory/output rose. SMM expects operating rates to rebound to 80.36% in March on stronger NEV, 5G and appliance demand.

title: Copper rises towards 10-year highs as bullish mood grips markets
summary: Copper prices rose sharply on Thursday toward 10-year highs on supportive macro sentiment, including U.S. stimulus approval, benign U.S. inflation, and stronger-than-expected Chinese lending and lending-linked demand indicators. The article also mentions aluminium and nickel rising alongside copper, though some analysts warn China demand may be overstated.

title: Peru's copper, zinc output down in January amid Antamina drop
summary: The article reports that Peru’s copper (and zinc) output declined in January, citing a drop in production at Antamina. As Antamina is a significant copper mine, the reduced supply outlook for the near term is expected to support copper prices within the following days to several weeks.

title: Westminster Resources Ltd.: Westminster Reaches Terms on Mostazal Copper Project in Chile's Atacama
summary: Westminster Resources agreed indicative terms to acquire full interest in Chile’s Mostazal copper property in the Atacama. The company highlights historical processing of 120,000 tons at 1.8% Cu and plans first scheduled drill testing of copper porphyry targets. It also notes a nearby Codelco expansion at El Salvador mine.

title: Playfair Mining Ltd.: Playfair Discovers New Copper Target Near Former Rodalen Mine, Norway
summary: Playfair Mining reports a new copper target near the former Rødalen mine in Norway, with a strong copper soil anomaly (MMI) and historical dump samples containing up to 1.81% copper. The program also notes that some targets showed elevated nickel values, but no production is confirmed.

title: Class 1 Nickel Signs Memorandum of Understanding With Matachewan First Nation for Alexo-Dundonald Nickel Sulphide Project
summary: Class 1 Nickel signed an MoU with the Matachewan First Nation to support exploration and development of the Alexo-Dundonald nickel sulphide project near Timmins, Ontario. The company plans to start a Phase 1 drill program, which can improve near-term expectations for nickel supply, with some potential spillover to copper.

title: They Paid $36M for Copper. Instead, They Got Rocks
summary: Mercuria Energy says a fraud scheme swapped 6,000 tons of copper shipments with painted paving stones after loading, using real and fake container seals. Police arrested 13 suspects, and forged insurance contracts were found. The event affects specific physical copper quality and a trader’s losses rather than clear market-wide supply.

title: Tesla secures deal to buy nickel from New Caledonia mine
summary: Tesla agreed to buy nickel from New Caledonia’s mine following political leaders’ approval of a new ownership deal after violent unrest and Vale’s shutdown. The contract aims to secure battery-grade, more ESG-compliant supply amid broader nickel supply fears and competing Chinese procurement deals, supportive of nickel prices.

title: Argonaut to drill for copper against Aboriginal wishes in ...
summary: Argonaut Resources plans to start 24/7 drilling next week for its Murdie copper project at South Australia’s Lake Torrens after government approval. Local Aboriginal groups strongly oppose the drilling, citing ancestral ties and risks to fresh-water aquifers, but the company has moved forward with logistics delivery and preparations.

title: Glencore : Copper dips in London as signs of weakening demand weigh
summary: Copper prices in London fell as demand concerns and higher supply pressured a recent rally to a near-10-year peak. The Yangshan premium declined, LME/SHFE inventories rose, and nearby supply tightness eased. China smelters increased cathode output. Aluminium and nickel also edged lower.

title: Shanghai bonded copper stocks rose 6,400 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show Shanghai bonded copper stocks rose 6,400 mt to 371,900 mt for a fourth consecutive week, driven by larger arrivals. Domestic consumption is still recovering and the refined copper–scrap price spread weighs on consumption. With the import window closed and declared imports down, inventories continue to climb.

title: China should focus on the development and utilisation of nickel and cobalt resources_SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s officials emphasizing increased development and utilization of nickel (and cobalt) resources, citing past supply shortages and current high foreign dependency for nickel raw materials. The stated goal is to strengthen strategic manufacturing and battery/alloy inputs, which could marginally support near-term nickel price sentiment via supply-risk expectations.

title: Peru's copper, zinc output down in January | American Metal Market
summary: The report states that Peru’s copper output declined in January, pointing to lower supply from a key producer. With reduced near-term mine production, market participants may expect tighter availability and reassess balance conditions, creating downward pressure on copper prices over the subsequent days to weeks.

title: LIVE FUTURES REPORT 12/03: Further 320kt of aluminium delivered into LME; tin, lead prices rise
summary: The live futures report notes an additional 320kt of aluminium delivered into LME, alongside price moves in tin and lead. For tracked markets, the aluminium delivery/inventory addition points to improving near-term supply availability and inventory pressure, which is generally bearish for aluminium prices.

title: Nationalizing Zambia′s copper mines | Africa | DW
summary: Zambia plans to acquire Mopani Copper Mines, citing the need for domestic control over assets, but details are unclear. Economists warn the deal could worsen liquidity and debt sustainability amid IMF talks, discourage investment, and disrupt mining operations on the Copperbelt. Investors may price higher copper supply risk.

title: RIO Share Price - Antipa Minerals advances two-pronged approach to gold-copper development in Paterson Province
summary: The article reports Antipa Minerals advancing a two-pronged strategy for gold-copper development in Paterson Province, targeting new discoveries and increased brownfield gold and copper resources. The broader market commentary notes miners under pressure from lower commodity prices, but the project progress is supportive for copper sentiment.

title: ALUMINIUM FOUNDRY WRAP: European premiums surge to more than 2-year highs
summary: European low-carbon aluminium differential/premium assessments are discussed, including corrections to specific billet premium indices after procedural errors. The key market takeaway is that European aluminium premiums have surged to more than two-year highs, pointing to firmer physical demand/supply conditions for aluminium in the near term.

title: Butte mining industry getting boost from high copper price and demand
summary: The article says Butte’s mining industry is benefiting from copper’s rebound to about $4.10/lb. It links rising demand to proposed “green” policies driving electric vehicles and wind power, and notes Montana Resources is hiring and ramping output expectations, suggesting supportive near-term copper sentiment.

title: Rash of copper wire thefts, cell phone tower tampering continues
summary: Monroe County authorities reported multiple incidents of cell phone tower tampering and copper wire thefts, including about $2,000 worth of copper wire and associated ground wiring stolen from an AT&T tower in Berlin Township. Similar thefts were reported across nearby townships, with estimated repair damage included.

title: The King of Nickel Is Betting Big on a Green Future in Batteries
summary: Tsingshan Holding says it will supply carmakers “green, clean” battery-grade nickel, aiming to resolve nickel availability concerns for EV batteries. Its alternative refining plans added supply expectations but raised environmental worries amid coal-based power use. The firm vows renewable energy and Indonesia support to win broader automaker purchases.

title: Chile's Codelco sees copper demand rising for 3-4 years, price at $3 per pound or more - chairman
summary: Codelco chairman Juan Benavides says copper demand should keep rising for the next 3–4 years and expects copper prices to hover around $3 per pound or higher. As Chile’s state producer, Codelco’s view supports bullish sentiment, but it is a longer-horizon outlook and may be largely already priced in.

title: China data, supply concerns push copper prices to near two-week high
summary: Copper prices rose to nearly a two-week high as upbeat China industrial output data supported demand expectations and renewed concerns about global supply resurfaced. Reuters cited gains across LME and Shanghai contracts, with market chatter including a potential copper supply deficit and a prolonged high-price cycle.

title: China data, supply concerns lift copper prices to near two-week high
summary: Copper prices rose to a near two-week high as China’s industrial output growth beat expectations and global supply concerns resurfaced. Trafigura flagged a copper supply deficit and a prolonged high-price cycle. Aluminium also advanced, but nickel fell during the same session, showing mixed cross-metal moves.

title: Robust demand continued to improve orders at copper processing enterprises_SMM
summary: SMM reports stronger near-term demand for copper rods made from cathode, with improving orders in wire/cable and enamelled wire, supporting production and higher utilization. However, high copper prices keep downstream buyers cautious, and orders for some plates/strips weaken. Copper tube demand benefits from peak season activity.

title: Copper prices to fluctuate rangebound at highs_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM expects SHFE copper to trade rangebound at 65,800–67,800 yuan/mt and LME copper at $8,850–9,150/mt this week. Softer risk appetite and rising yields cap gains, while US data and Fed expectations support sentiment. At the same time, high prices have weakened demand and lifted smelter inventories, weighing on the market.

title: LIVE FUTURES REPORT 15/03: LME aluminium price hits $2,200/t, cancellations follow 600kt inflow
summary: Live futures commentary says LME aluminium has risen to about $2,200/t, but “cancellations follow” a reported 600kt inflow. The combination of large warrant/inventory inflow followed by cancellations points to increased near-term supply availability, likely weighing on aluminium price expectations over coming days.

title: Copper gains in thin volumes on buoyant Chinese data
summary: Copper rose on Monday on stronger-than-expected Chinese industrial growth, though trading volumes were thin and investors were cautious ahead of central bank meetings. The story also cites rising Chinese aluminum output and ongoing copper mine labor/supply disruptions in Chile and Peru, supporting bullish sentiment across copper and some spillover to aluminum and nickel.

title: GlobalData: Copper production in Peru forecast to rise by 10.4% in 2021
summary: GlobalData expects Peru’s copper production to rebound by 10.4% in 2021 to about 2.4 million tonnes after a 13% 2020 decline from COVID-19 shutdowns and restrictions. It cites mine resumptions and expansions, supporting a gradual return toward pre-COVID output levels and encouraging supply outlook.

title: Copper gains in thin volume, aluminum jumps on China power cuts
summary: Copper rose modestly on stronger-than-expected Chinese industrial growth, suggesting improved near-term demand, though trading volumes were thin. Aluminium jumped about 2% after Chinese city Baotou ordered industrial and power plant shutdowns to meet energy targets, tightening supply for energy-intensive production.

title: Copper gains in thin volume, aluminum jumps on China power cuts
summary: Copper rose modestly on stronger-than-expected Chinese industrial growth, indicating improving near-term demand expectations, though trading volumes were thin. Aluminum surged after Baotou ordered shutdowns/production curbs to meet energy targets, tightening power-intensive supply. The piece also notes broad base-metals gains, including nickel.

title: LIVE FUTURES REPORT 15/02: LME aluminium edges close to 2021 high on supply concerns, zinc up 2%
summary: The live futures report says LME aluminium is edging close to its 2021 high on supply concerns. It also references zinc gains, but the tracked linkage here is aluminium. Overall, the stated market driver points to tightening supply conditions supporting higher aluminium prices near term.

title: Grijalva announces bill to reverse land swap for copper mine
summary: U.S. Rep. Raul Grijalva introduced a bill to repeal a 2014 provision allowing the Forest Service to transfer national forest land to Resolution Copper. The land exchange supports development of a major copper project, but the bill would keep the land from being turned over, raising delay risk.

title: Serbia rejects Zijin's request to separate environmental assessments in copper smelter project
summary: Serbia’s Ministry of Environmental Protection rejected Zijin’s request to separate environmental assessments for preparatory works at its Bor copper smelter expansion, ordering a study for the entire project. Environmental groups argue “salami slicing” would hide cumulative damage; the ruling could delay permits, construction and future smelter capacity.

title: AZ Lawmaker Introduces Bill To Protect Oak Flat From Copper Mine
summary: Arizona Rep. Raul Grijalva introduced the “Save Oak Flat Act” to protect the sacred Oak Flat site from being used for Rio Tinto’s proposed project, described as the largest copper mine in the U.S. The measure would overturn prior land-trade authorization under 2014 legislation.

title: Shanghai aluminum hits 9-1/2-yr high on Chinese supply worries
summary: Shanghai aluminium surged to a 9-1/2-year high as Baotou, a key Inner Mongolia producer, ordered power cuts and industrial shutdowns to cut carbon emissions. Analysts expect sizable output curbs, tightening supply. LME and ShFE aluminium contracts rose, with April aluminium up as much as 2.6% and LME three-month also gaining.

title: Operating rates at secondary aluminium makers lost 20.8 percentage points in February_SMM
summary: SMM says operating rates at secondary aluminium producers fell to 41.35% in February, down 20.8 points m/m, due to CNY shutdowns and maintenance. Aluminium prices rose after the holiday, discouraging downstream purchases and leaving scrap recyclers holding cargoes, tightening feedstock supply. Rates should rebound in March as scrap recycling and demand recover.

title: Shanghai aluminium touches over 9-yr high on Chinese supply concerns
summary: Shanghai aluminium jumped to a 9-1/2-year high after Inner Mongolia’s Baotou ordered power cuts and shutdowns to meet energy targets, potentially reducing aluminium output. The April SHFE contract rose up to 2.6%. LME cash and three-month contracts also edged higher despite mixed inventory signals.

title: Shanghai aluminum touches over 9-year high on Chinese supply concerns
summary: Shanghai aluminium jumped to a multi-year high as Baotou in China ordered power cuts and shutdowns to meet early-quarter energy targets. CRU estimates the curtailments could cut annual output by about 100,000 tonnes. Prices rose sharply on the ShFE and modestly on the LME, reflecting tighter supply expectations.

title: Emirates Global Aluminium delivers strong 2020 performance despite pandemic challenges
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium reported strong 2020 results despite Covid disruption, citing ramp-up of its alumina and bauxite assets and improved smelting margins. Management said the aluminium market recovery continued into 2021 and expects benchmark prices near $2,000. It also flagged uncertainty over a potential US tariff reinstatement.

title: Operating rates across major aluminum processors increased gained 0.2 percentage point on week_SMM
summary: SMM reports weekly operating-rate changes across aluminium processors: primary alloy and foil/wire-cable output rose slightly, while extrusion rates dipped on weaker orders from construction and PV amid high aluminium prices. Secondary alloy rates also edged up. Overall, firms expect operating rates to remain broadly stable this week.

title: Increased high-nickel precursor output limited decline in precursor production_SMM
summary: SMM says February production of high-nickel precursor fell 10.8% month on month to 35,000 mt, despite some producers maintaining output and one Zhejiang producer raising high-nickel precursor output after a January supply shortage. Ternary production fell 13.1%. Demand was mixed: motive power demand was positive, but battery-company operating rates were bearish with pre-CNY restocking supporting only some uplift.

title: LIVE FUTURES REPORT 16/03: 85k-tonne cancellation of aluminium in LME warehouses; tin price down 2.7%
summary: Fastmarkets’/live futures report highlights an 85k-tonne cancellation of aluminium from LME warehouses. Removing volume from exchange stock tends to signal tighter immediate availability and improved demand/supply balance. The piece also mentions tin weakness, but the actionable warehouse-flow detail is specific to aluminium.

title: Three ETFs to play the resurgence in copper prices
summary: The article highlights copper’s strong rebound, saying prices have doubled over the past year due to tight supply and strong demand, supported by economic reopening and a “green” shift for EVs and renewables. It notes a recent pullback after China’s softer growth target, but remains broadly bullish on copper exposure via ETFs.

title: Europe to Remain at the Forefront of Global Aluminum Bags and Pouches Market : Fact.MR
summary: Fact.MR reports steady growth and strong demand for aluminium bags and pouches, driven by longer shelf-life needs, convenience packaging, and lightweight durable materials. Europe is expected to spearhead the market, with food packaging a major end use. It’s a demand outlook without explicit short-term supply constraints or price signals.

title: Adventus and Salazar Announce Drilling Results at The El Domo Deposit Highlighted by 5.06% Copper Equivalent Over 44.19 Metres
summary: Adventus and Salazar report infill drill results at the El Domo volcanogenic massive sulphide project in Ecuador, highlighting multiple intersections with high copper grades (e.g., up to ~5–6% Cu) and copper-equivalent values. Results will feed a 2021 resource update for the feasibility study, supporting copper project sentiment.

title: Fastest Developing Aluminum Business in Russia
summary: A Russian press release says BK-ALPROF LLC expanded rapidly since 2003 and now produces about 20,000 tons of aluminum profiles annually, using its own foundry and extrusion lines. It claims reliable ingot supply (including from RUSAL) and lists downstream uses across construction and manufacturing.

title: Nickel prices to come off highs in 2021, Fitch Solutions says
summary: Fitch Solutions expects nickel prices to fall from multi-year highs in 2021 as supply increases, helped by the end of the rainy season in the Philippines and resumed mining that feeds China’s NPI facilities. Despite a gradual long-term uptrend, Fitch keeps a bearish near-term view.

title: Visionary Gold Corp Submits Permits for Drilling at Wolf Gold Project, Samples 2.19% Cu and 1.25 grams per tonne Gold on New Surface Copper-Gold Anomaly Parallel to Wolf
summary: Visionary Gold Corp submitted permits for drilling at the Wolf Gold Project and discovered a parallel copper-gold mineralized structure on adjacent Miz claims. Surface geochemistry includes copper values up to about 2.1% and gold up to 3.1 g/t. The report is exploratory and doesn’t indicate production or resource confirmation.

title: Russia's Nornickel downgrades 2021 output forecast as two mines partially suspended
summary: Nornickel said water inflow forced partial suspension at the Oktyabrsky and Taimyrsky mines, downgrading 2021 output: nickel -35,000 tonnes, copper -65,000 tonnes, and PGM -710,000 ounces, with restart unlikely for 3-4 months. Markets initially lifted nickel, but nickel gains faded quickly.

title: Copper slips on profit taking, firmer dollar ahead of Fed
summary: Copper fell 1.8% on profit taking and a firmer dollar ahead of the Fed, with investors cautious on inflation. Aluminum weakened after China ordered power cuts and output curbs in an Inner Mongolia hub. Nickel also declined around 1%, reflecting broader downside pressure in industrial metals.

title: Copper slips on profit taking ahead of Fed meeting
summary: Copper prices fell sharply on the LME as investors took profits ahead of the Fed meeting amid inflation worries and higher U.S. yields. The piece also flags rising aluminum supply risks from China power cuts and output curbs, while nickel edged lower, pointing to softer near-term sentiment.

title: Yangshan copper premiums continued downward trend amid subdued trades_SMM
summary: Yangshan copper premiums fell across both warrants and bill of lading, with import losses narrowing demand. Ample supply arriving late March and persistently rising Shanghai bonded inventories (to 371,900 mt) kept trading subdued. The SHFE/LME ratio and yuan moves boosted LME relative to SHFE, weighing on premiums and outlook.

title: Norilsk Nickel to restore production in flooded mines within 3-4 months
summary: Norilsk Nickel says it will restore production at its Oktyabrsky and Taimyrsky flooded mines within 3-4 months, with recovery starting in April–May and early June. It also intends to restart processing at Norilsk Concentration Plant by April 15 and revised down nickel (35,000 tonnes) and copper (65,000 tonnes) forecasts.

title: Canyon Resources to meet potential partners for the development of the Minim Martap bauxite project
summary: CAMALCO, a subsidiary of Canyon Resources, plans to meet local Cameroonian partners to develop its Minim-Martap, Makan, and Ngaoundal bauxite deposits in Cameroon. The company cites large potential bauxite resources, including very high-grade material suitable for aluminium production, and expects mining to start in 2022.

title: Butte mining industry gets a boost from high copper price and demand
summary: Butte’s mining industry is upbeat after copper prices surged to about $4.10 a pound. Officials attribute part of the rebound to anticipated demand from a “green new deal,” including electric cars and wind power. Montana Resources plans expansion and higher employment, expecting strong copper production in 2021.

title: Copper slips ahead of Fed meeting
summary: Copper prices fell 1.6%-1.9% ahead of the Fed meeting as investors reduced bullish exposure amid inflation worries and rising U.S. borrowing costs. Aluminum hit a 9-1/2-year high on supply concerns from China power cuts. Nickel also dipped, indicating broad downside pressure across industrial metals.

title: BK-ALPROF now the Fastest Developing Aluminum Business in Russia
summary: BK-ALPROF LLC says it has become Russia’s fastest-growing aluminum producer, expanding extrusion and downstream processing (casting ingots, anodizing, and profile sales) and reporting about 20,000 tons per year of aluminum profiles capacity. It claims supply security via its own foundry and uses RUSAL and other inputs.

title: FOCUS: Copper TC/RCs hit decade-lows, market questions where bottom is
summary: Fastmarkets notes copper treatment and refining charges (TC/RCs) have fallen to decade-lows, prompting questions about where the market bottom lies, implying tightening in refining economics. It also discusses aluminium’s supply/inventory situation and Gulf/Hormuz shipping disruption context, though without clear near-term aluminium price direction.

title: Nickel sulphate inventories kept falling, supporting battery-grade nickel sulphate prices _SMM
summary: SMM reports nickel sulphate inventories have been falling, with tight supply of battery-grade material despite adequate nickel briquette feedstock. Downward spot moves were slowed as transaction activity was thin and premiums widened. Production declines and a plant accident reduced output, while downstream/new energy demand stayed strong.

title: Automotive Aluminum Market to Witness Growth Acceleration During 2019 to 2025
summary: The article states that the automotive sector’s aluminium market is expected to see growth acceleration from 2019 to 2025. This implies rising consumption tied to auto manufacturing and applications that use aluminium, which can support aluminium price expectations despite the forecast extending beyond the immediate weeks.

title: Millard Co. Sheriff calls on public to help surveil copper and catalytic converter thefts
summary: Millard County Sheriff’s Office urges residents to help deter theft of copper wire and catalytic converters, citing higher current metal prices that increase scrap and recycling incentives. The post suggests using trail and doorbell cameras and better lighting, but does not quantify any supply impact or disruptions to copper markets.

title: Stratabound Minerals Corp.: Stratabound Reports 3.34% Copper Equivalent over 11.5m Including 5.39% Copper Equivalent over 2.5m with High Cobalt Values at Captain Cu-Co-Au-Ag Deposit
summary: Stratabound reported final drill-hole assays at its Captain Cu–Co–Au–Ag deposit, highlighting intercepts such as 5.39% CuEq over 2.5m and higher cobalt grades, and notes drilling is complete with a study for a small-scale direct-shipping mining concept. The update is mainly copper-sentiment positive but not a near-term physical supply change.

title: 'At the limit': Chile's world-leading copper industry rejects lawmaker bid to hike taxes
summary: Chile’s copper industry argues it has reached a tax burden limit and warns lawmakers against raising royalties or levying a tax on copper sales. Opposition seeks higher mining taxes amid the coronavirus crisis as copper prices hit a decade high, citing social spending needs. Industry officials warn some mines could struggle with higher taxes.

title: FPX Nickel Announces $10 Million Bought Deal Public Offering of Common Shares
summary: FPX Nickel Corp. announced a $10 million bought-deal public offering, with proceeds mainly earmarked for exploration and development at its Baptiste Nickel Project. The release provides share and over-allotment details and notes exchange/regulatory approval requirements. The funding could marginally support future nickel supply expectations in the near term.

title: Rio Tinto cuts 41 jobs at Weipa bauxite mine operations
summary: Rio Tinto is cutting 41 jobs at its Weipa bauxite operations as part of cost reductions. Management links the restructure to “falling aluminium prices” and lower alumina prices amid competition. The job cuts are said not to affect the Amrun expansion, which is still under construction.

title: Material Matters: Aluminium, Iron Ore & Nickel
summary: Morgan Stanley says aluminium supply remains tight, supported by restocking and constrained LME scrap/tonnage despite higher production and falling alumina; shortages and elevated freight keep spot near $2150/t. It also notes the squeeze may ease in Q2. Credit Suisse expects Tsingshan expansion to create a nickel surplus and weigh on prices.

title: Material Matters: Aluminium, Iron Ore & Nickel
summary: Morgan Stanley expects aluminium tightness to support prices near $2150/t, citing restocking, scarce spot availability, and elevated freight disrupting scrap supply, though it doubts the squeeze persists into Q2. For nickel, Credit Suisse says Tsingshan’s planned ramp could create a surplus (even if constraints exist), pressuring prices later.

title: Copper advances as Fed projects rapid economic growth
summary: Copper rose on Thursday after the Fed projected rapid U.S. growth while keeping stimulus, a dovish tone that weakened the dollar and made dollar-priced metals cheaper for other-currency holders. Nickel also increased, while aluminium was slightly lower. LME copper inventories hit a local high, but prices still firmed.

title: Papua New Guinea's Ok Tedi copper mine suspends operations over COVID-19
summary: Papua New Guinea’s Ok Tedi Mining will suspend copper operations for 14 days as COVID-19 infections surge at the mine and in the region. The shutdown, driven by travel restrictions and rising cases, is expected to cut revenue and temporarily reduce copper supply, likely weighing on short-term copper prices.

title: Clean Air Metals hits Norilsk-style Nickel-Copper Massive Sulfides, 350m North of Escape South High Grade Zone
summary: Clean Air Metals announced new drill assay results from the Escape Lake Deposit, intersecting Norilsk-style nickel-copper massive sulfides with grades including 4.76% copper and 2.5% nickel over 0.5m, plus meaningful platinum/palladium. The company plans further delineation drilling to expand targets, but no production changes were reported.

title: Mitsubishi Corporation Enters Agreement to Acquire Interest in Aurukun Bauxite Project
summary: Mitsubishi agreed with Glencore to acquire a 30% interest in Australia’s Aurukun bauxite project. The undeveloped mine’s feasibility work is ongoing, with a potential final investment decision in 2022 pending regulatory approvals. As bauxite is aluminium feedstock, the deal is broadly supportive for future aluminium supply expectations.

title: Aluminium billet inventories shrank 3,900 mt to 232,900 mt_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data on March 18 showed Chinese 6063 aluminium billet stocks across Foshan, Wuxi, Huzhou, Changzhou and Nanchang fell 3,900 mt to 232,900 mt versus the previous week. Declines in Changzhou and Huzhou outweighed increases in Wuxi, indicating tighter local billet supply.

title: Rockridge Resources Ltd.: Rockridge Commences Drilling Program at Knife Lake Copper Project, Saskatchewan
summary: Rockridge Resources began a funded diamond drilling program at its Knife Lake copper project in Saskatchewan, targeting VMS-style copper (plus associated silver, zinc and cobalt) along newly defined conductors and at depth. The release is exploration-focused with no production volumes or timing impacts for near-term copper supply.

title: China Jan-Feb aluminium imports rise 150.7% year on year
summary: China’s aluminium imports in January-February surged 150.7% year on year to 455,128 tonnes, following an arbitrage window that reopened as overseas metal became cheaper. Customs data also shows record 2020 imports. Bauxite imports fell slightly. The increased inflow could add near-term supply pressure on aluminium prices.

title: Spruce Ridge Resources Limited: Spruce Ridge Reports Final Assay Results at Great Burnt Copper Deposit
summary: Spruce Ridge reported final assay results from the 2020 drill program at the Great Burnt copper deposit in Newfoundland, highlighting high-grade copper intersections (e.g., up to 8.06% Cu over 27.2 m, and a 22.4% Cu one-metre assay). The company expects an updated resource/PEA, but no production timeline is provided.

title: EnGold Mines Ltd.: EnGold Reports Maiden Inferred Resource of 1.71 Million Tonnes Grading 1.65% Copper Equivalent at G1 Copper Deposit at the Lac La Hache Property
summary: EnGold reports maiden inferred and open-pitable indicated mineral resource estimates at the G1 and Spout copper deposits within the Lac La Hache project in British Columbia. Resources are reported as copper contained and CuEq grades, with cut-off grades based on assumed copper prices, but no near-term production changes are announced.

title: Heatherdale Resources Ltd.: Heatherdale Announces $2.5 Million Non-Brokered Private Placement and Proposed Name Change to Blackwolf Copper and Gold
summary: Heatherdale Resources announced a $2.5 million non-brokered private placement to fund drilling and awaiting assays at its Niblack copper-gold project in Alaska, along with related investigations and working capital. The company also plans a name change to Blackwolf Copper and Gold, subject to regulatory approval.

title: Rockridge Commences Drilling Program at Knife Lake Copper Project, Saskatchewan
summary: Rockridge Resources started a fully funded diamond drilling program (1,600 m in 6–8 holes) at its Knife Lake copper VMS project in Saskatchewan. The company targets newly defined conductors and deeper extensions under the existing deposit. Management links the timing to a strengthening copper market, but no immediate production change is stated.

title: BK-ALPROF LLC has become the fastest-growing aluminum company in Russia
summary: BK-ALPROF LLC in Russia is described as rapidly expanding aluminum production, including a casting foundry and extrusion capability, with stated capacity of about 20,000 tons of aluminum profiles per year. The firm says it uses aluminum alloy input from RUSAL and produces profiles for construction and industrial uses.

title: Arizona Democrat reintroduces bill to protect sacred Apache site from planned copper mine
summary: Arizona’s Democrat reintroduced the Save Oak Flat Act to permanently protect a sacred Apache site from Resolution Copper’s planned underground mine. The act would repeal the earlier land-transfer authorization and bar mining or mineral-related actions on the site. Resolution Copper says it will meet water standards and continues consultation.

title: Portland smelter: Alcoa's struggling aluminum plant secures $160m subsidy deal with Morrison government
summary: Alcoa’s Portland aluminium smelter in Victoria secured about $160m in state and federal support plus five-year power supply agreements to 2026. Energy costs are a major part of smelting economics, and the deal reduces the risk of closure, supporting aluminium output expectations and sentiment.

title: Red Rocks Amphitheater gets an Aurubis Copper Roof from Hamburg, Germany
summary: Superior Roofing is completing a Red Rocks Amphitheater stage roof replacement, installing an 8,500 sq. ft. Nordic Brown copper standing-seam roof. The copper was supplied by Aurubis and shipped from Hamburg, Germany. The piece is promotional and indicates end-use copper demand but not a market-moving supply or policy change.

title: How The New Lead And Copper Rule Could Impact You
summary: EPA released revisions to the U.S. Lead and Copper Rule, tightening service-line inventories, sampling (including fifth-liter draws), public notification, corrosion control, and accelerated replacement triggers for exceedances. Utilities must build and update inventories and begin replacement planning, increasing compliance and potential pipe-material demand.

title: Portland Aluminium smelter thrown $150m government lifeline to secure its future
summary: A Victoria energy-retailers deal backed by more than $150m in federal and state support will keep the Portland Aluminium smelter operating until at least 2026. The funding enables a new electricity supply arrangement, crucial because the plant uses about 10% of Victoria’s power. Output remains ~20% of Australia’s aluminium production.

title: 8OOm copper drill hit for Hot Chili
summary: Hot Chili reported further very long copper drill intercepts at its Cortadera copper-gold porphyry project in Chile, highlighting an 813m zone averaging 0.4% copper from 54m depth and a wider high-grade core. Results support a planned resource upgrade later this year, but do not signal near-term production changes.

title: Grijalva reintroduces bill to protect sacred Apache site from planned copper mine
summary: Arizona Rep. Raúl Grijalva reintroduced the Save Oak Flat Act to permanently protect Oak Flat from the Resolution Copper project. The land exchange for the site was recently paused for additional review. The proposed legislation would repeal the mining-related authorization, potentially delaying copper supply growth.

title: Russian Company Bankrolling Troubled Kentucky Aluminum Plant Suspends Investments
summary: Rusal has suspended investments in a troubled aluminum plant near Ashland, Kentucky, having already spent at least $65 million and waiting for U.S. partners to raise needed funds. The project has faced fundraising issues and prior sanctions controversy, and Kentucky funding is contingent on the mill materializing.

title: Alcoa : Announces Multi-Year Repowering for Australia's Portland Aluminium Smelter in State of Victoria
summary: Alcoa announced new five-year power supply agreements for its Portland Aluminium smelter in Victoria and government underwriting via Australia’s RERT scheme, with matching state funding in principle. The measures improve electricity-price certainty and grid reliability for smelter operations, supporting primary aluminium output stability.

title: Alcoa Announces Multi-Year Repowering for Australia's Portland Aluminium Smelter in State of Victoria
summary: Alcoa said it has signed five-year electricity supply agreements for its Portland Aluminium smelter in Victoria, starting Aug. 1, to replace expiring power arrangements. The federal government will underwrite participation in a grid reliability scheme, with Victoria matching support. Terms are confidential but improve power-cost certainty.

title: Nevada Copper Provides Underground Project Update; Releases 2020 Financials and MD&A
summary: Nevada Copper reports completion of Main Shaft commissioning and significant underground electrical upgrades, with ventilation upgrades progressing on schedule. The company expects first stopes in coming weeks and targets steady-state underground production of 5,000 tons per day in Q3 2021, supporting near-term copper output expectations.

title: Portland aluminium smelter saved again, but wind tower workers cut loose
summary: Australia’s Prime Minister announces a deal to extend Alcoa’s Portland aluminium smelter life by five years, backed by discounted power supply to 2026 and about $80m each from federal and Victorian governments. The smelter is framed as a grid “battery,” implying steadier aluminium output and supportive sentiment for aluminium markets.

title: PNG's Ok Tedi copper mine starts 2-week suspension on Covid-19 concerns
summary: PNG’s Ok Tedi copper mine has begun a two-week suspension because of Covid-19 concerns. The stoppage reduces near-term copper production/supply flow into the market, increasing short-term availability risk for miners while potentially weighing on copper prices in the coming days.

title: Si6 locks onto Maibele North nickel extensions
summary: Si6 Metals says drilling at its Maibele North nickel deposit in Botswana intersected sulphide mineralisation with anomalous nickel and copper assays, extending the strike length of the system. The company also points to the nearby Selebi Phikwe mine nearing restart, potentially boosting near-term nickel-copper supply expectations.

title: Shanghai bonded refined nickel stocks fell 2,100 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show Shanghai bonded refined nickel stocks fell 2,100 mt to 12,800 mt as of March 19, marking the third consecutive weekly decline. The import window reopened in stages after a rebound in bonded-area transactions, with nickel plates and briquettes entering the domestic market post-customs clearance.

title: Minim-Martap Bauxite Project: Business Opportunities Presented
summary: Camalco presented business opportunities for Cameroonian firms tied to the Minim-Martap bauxite project in Cameroon, citing large, high-alumina bauxite reserves and planned substantial investment in transport and port logistics. Because bauxite is the key feedstock for aluminium, the project may support expectations for future supply.

title: SMM Evening Comments (Mar 19): Nonferrous metals on the SHFE closed mostly lower, copper weakened 1.64%_SMM
summary: SMM reports broadly lower SHFE nonferrous prices: copper fell 1.64% and aluminium 1.55%, while nickel slipped 0.12%. The move is attributed to risk-off sentiment as US-China talks start badly and global stock markets decline. Additional context for aluminium includes regional supply constraints and shifting demand.

title: Man charged in string of copper thefts | Regina Leader Post
summary: A Regina man was charged after copper piping was stolen from ten vacant properties between Jan. 14 and March 18. Police say the thefts caused more than $50,000 in damage, and the suspect had copper pipe and break-in tools when arrested on March 18.

title: Peru's Las Bambas copper mine stepping up use of technology
summary: Peru’s Las Bambas copper mine is reportedly stepping up its use of technology. The change is framed as an operational upgrade that could improve mine performance and reduce disruption risk, which would affect near-term copper supply expectations. The full article text is not provided here, limiting assessment of magnitude.

title: Nationwide freight strike in Peru puts copper, zinc and lead exporters on alert
summary: The article says a nationwide freight strike in Peru has put copper exporters on alert. Disrupted transport can delay exports and reduce near-term market availability, tightening supply expectations. That logistics risk typically supports copper prices over the following days to weeks. No comparable, direct effects on nickel or aluminium are described.

title: Local Opinion: America's energy future is green with Arizona's copper | Local Editorials and Opinion
summary: The editorial says the U.S. cannot meet rising copper demand driven by renewables and electric vehicles and currently uses far more copper than it produces. It argues higher domestic mining in Arizona is needed to avoid future supply shortfalls, price hikes, and geopolitical risk, supporting a bullish copper narrative.

title: Apaches Push 9th Circ. To Halt Copper Mine Land Exchange
summary: The article headline says Apache groups are pushing the Ninth Circuit to halt a land exchange related to a copper mine. If the legal action delays permits or land transfer needed for mining activities, it may raise fears of reduced near-term copper supply, supporting copper prices over coming days to weeks.

title: Aluminium rattled by signs of 'green' disruption in China: Andy Home
summary: Shanghai aluminium prices have risen to their highest since Aug 2011 amid speculative inflows and record open interest. The move is linked to Inner Mongolia’s mandated curtailment of aluminium smelting to meet energy targets, with similar “green” power constraints likely recurring and tightening future supply expectations.

title: China's Jan-Feb copper, tin ore imports from Myanmar fall amid unrest
summary: China’s copper cathode imports from Myanmar fell more than 25% year-on-year in January-February, with February down over 55%, amid Myanmar’s coup and ensuing unrest. While tin supply is partly isolated, the import drop indicates near-term supply disruption risk for copper flows into China.

title: Peru: Antapaccay Copper Mine Suspends Activities Due to Protest Blockade
summary: Peru’s Antapaccay copper mine, operated by Glencore, suspended activities after a protest blockade shut the road access to the mine. The disruption reduces near-term copper output and raises expectations of tighter supply, which is typically supportive for copper prices over the coming days.

title: [INTERVIEW] 'Aluminum ideal material for EV era'
summary: The article interviews Novelis Asia on how EV electrification is increasing demand for aluminum “green metal,” including automotive sheets, recycling and battery-related uses. Novelis forecasts higher automotive aluminum demand, describes expanding recycling capacity and shifting rolling capacity toward China, supporting near-term aluminum consumption expectations.

title: First Quantum: A Big Jump in Copper Production
summary: First Quantum says its Cobre Panama ramp increased production by about 50% and reiterates copper output guidance for 2021-23. The company’s Q4 results benefited from higher realized copper prices and hedges much of 2021 production. Nickel is mentioned via Ravensthorpe, but copper is the focus.

title: LIVE FUTURES REPORT 22/03: LME zinc up 1.3%; aluminium price still rising, cancellations continue
summary: Fastmarkets’/live futures update notes LME zinc up 1.3% but highlights that aluminium prices are still rising, with cancellations continuing. It also reiterates that aluminium supply has remained technically intact despite curtailed output in parts of the Gulf and severe shipping disruption through the Strait of Hormuz, supporting tightness.

title: Copper Fox Announces Updated Mineral Resource Estimate for the Schaft Creek Project
summary: Copper Fox announced an updated NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate for the Schaft Creek porphyry project in British Columbia, focused on copper-gold-molybdenum-silver mineralization. The estimate uses specified copper assumptions and recoveries and will feed a forthcoming PEA. As a resource-stage update, near-term effects on copper prices appear limited.

title: SKC to Spend 700 bln Won for 1st Overseas Copper Foil Factory in Malaysia
summary: SKC says it will invest 700 billion won to build its first overseas copper foil factory in Malaysia. The move signals expansion of copper-foil production outside Korea, which could influence near-term expectations for copper processing demand and supply balance, though the article provides limited detail on ramp-up timing.

title: NORNICKEL CUTS EMISSIONS AT KOLA PENINSULA BY 85% IN 2021
summary: Norilsk Nickel shut down the metallurgical shop at its Kola MMC site on March 20, stopping pyrometallurgical operations and sulfur-dioxide emissions. Copper-containing materials will be cleaned up in 2021, while concentrate will be processed in the Norilsk division. A new Monchegorsk copper refinery is planned for higher capacity later.

title: Funds take the money and run as copper rally stalls
summary: Funds have cut bullish exposure to copper as the rally stalls: CME copper longs fall sharply and LME speculative length shrinks. Meanwhile LME inventories rise from very low levels and backwardation narrows, with additional “shadow” copper moving into registered/visible stocks, weakening short-term tightness and sentiment.

title: Santee Cooper approves new contract with Century Aluminum plant
summary: Santee Cooper approved a new multi-year electricity contract for Century Aluminum’s Mount Holly plant, using an experimental rate tied to excess power capacity and enabling the plant to continue operations. The deal is expected to avoid shutdown risk and supports potential expansion, helping stabilize near-term aluminium supply expectations.

title: Public Joint Stock Mining and Metallurgical Norilsk Nickel : NORNICKEL CUTS EMISSIONS AT KOLA PENINSULA BY 85% IN 2021
summary: Norilsk Nickel (Nornickel) cut emissions by shutting down its Kola Peninsula metallurgical shop at the Monchegorsk site, stopping furnaces/converters and ceasing sulphur dioxide emissions. The company will reroute concentrate for processing elsewhere and plans a new Monchegorsk copper refining facility with higher capacity in the future.

title: Aluminum producer setting up facility in Kentucky
summary: An AP report says Matalco will invest $53 million to convert a vacant Kentucky facility into an aluminum ingot plant using recycled aluminum. The project, planned for Simpson County, is expected to start operating by 2022 and produce up to 270 million pounds annually, creating 60 jobs.

title: Impact from high copper prices and secondary copper slowed recovery in copper rods produced with copper cathode_SMM
summary: SMM reports that high copper prices and weak wire/cable demand have slowed recovery for copper rod producers using copper cathode. Cash pressure leads secondary-copper suppliers to sell aggressively, while March may see higher secondary-copper demand. Discounts and spreads favor secondary rods, depressing cathode-rod consumption into April.

title: Shanghai aluminium hits over 1-month low on rising supply concerns
summary: Shanghai aluminium fell to a one-month low as traders feared Chinese authorities may release ingots into the market, adding to supply concerns. Reuters notes rising LME and ShFE aluminium inventories and a sharp jump in China’s imports. Primary margins and robust production further suggest ample near-term supply, pressuring prices downward.

title: Indonesia eases requirements for mining export permits, nickel excluded
summary: Indonesia will grant export permits for unrefined mineral ores even if refining construction is delayed, aiming to cushion COVID impacts. However, nickel ore is explicitly excluded from the relaxation, keeping the prior export ban in place to support Indonesia’s nickel supply-chain development. This may sustain tighter nickel supply expectations.

title: Operating rates at aluminium processors rose slightly on recovering rigid demand, it takes time for downstream producers to accept high aluminium prices_SMM
summary: SMM reports slightly higher operating rates at multiple aluminium processing segments as rigid demand and order backlogs keep producers running despite high, volatile aluminium prices. Some demand is constrained by customers’ delayed acceptance of prices and weaker overseas orders, but overall operations remain supported, especially for plate/strip and wire/cable.

title: SHFE aluminium to continue to fluctuate at highs this week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports SHFE 2105 aluminium rose about 1% last week, while LME aluminium gained about 2%. Sentiment was supported early by Inner Mongolia smelter output-cut news and slowing domestic inventory growth, alongside seasonal demand recovery. Macro risks (lower oil, higher yields) may limit upside; price is expected to stay firm this week.

title: Russian nickel premiums fell amid goods arrival, Jinchuan nickel premiums rose_SMM
summary: SMM reports bearish pressure on nickel, with Russian nickel premiums falling as more material arrived and importers cut prices. Downstream purchases stayed cautious amid weakening end-demand. Jinchuan premiums rose slightly due to tighter Shanghai supply, but overall Russian premium declines and inventory movements suggest near-term downside risk for nickel prices.

title: China Mulls Selling Aluminum From State Reserves to Cool Prices
summary: China is considering selling roughly 500,000 metric tons of aluminum from state reserves to cool prices and support emissions/energy objectives. Aluminum futures in Shanghai fell to a daily limit on the speculation. The proposed stock release would likely add near-term supply and pressure aluminum prices.

title: BeMetals Corp.: BeMetals to Accelerate Copper Exploration at Pangeni Project in Zambia with JOGMEC Exploration Investment
summary: BeMetals announced a Joint Exploration and Option Agreement with JOGMEC to fund $1.5 million for accelerated exploration at the Pangeni copper project in Zambia, plus pro-rata funding to maintain interest and potential off-take rights later. The news supports future copper development but offers no near-term output changes.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: Talon Metals Reports Assays for Record Massive Sulphide Interval at the Tamarack Nickel Project: 21.73 Meters (71.2 Feet) Grading 8.35% NiEq
summary: Talon Metals reported record-length drill results at the Tamarack nickel-copper-cobalt project, intersecting 21.73 meters of mixed massive sulphides grading 6.72% Ni and 2.95% Cu (plus Co and precious metals). The company plans further drilling to extend the high-grade zone, but no production or supply changes were announced.

title: SMM Evening Comments (Mar 23): Shanghai nonferrous metals closed mixed, aluminium plunged 2.57%_SMM
summary: SMM says SHFE nonferrous metals closed mixed: copper +0.33% and nickel +2.12% rose, while aluminium fell 2.57% to a one-month low before partial recovery.
