summary: Copperstone opened the previously closed Viscaria mine entrance to conduct further technical and environmental studies, including groundwater quality/levels and rock mechanics, supporting an environmental permit application expected around year-end. The Viscaria deposit is high in copper, so progress may modestly boost near-term expectations for future copper supply.

title: Copperstone opens the gates to the Viscaria mine in Kiruna after 25 years, for further environmental studies
summary: Copperstone Resources has reopened the Viscaria copper mine entrance in Kiruna after 25 years to conduct additional environmental and technical investigations (groundwater quality/levels, rock mechanics, geology). The results are intended to support the environmental permit application expected around year-end, improving confidence in potential future copper production.

title: Canada Invests in Improving Energy Efficiency in Canadian Aluminum Sector
summary: Canada announced a $40,000 investment (with Alcoa and Énergir bringing total funding to $350,000) to add an energy information system for Alcoa Canada’s Deschambault aluminum smelter. The project supports ISO 50001:2018 energy management certification to reduce energy costs and greenhouse gas emissions.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Ltd.: Ivanhoe Mines Reports Fatality at the Kamoa-Kakula Copper Project
summary: Ivanhoe Mines reported a fatal accident at its Kamoa-Kakula Copper Project in the DRC, where a contractor worker was struck by a loose rock underground. The company and contractor management are investigating with DRC authorities. No production disruption or output guidance changes were stated in the release.

title: Pacific Ridge Closes $1.5 Million Financing for Summer Drill Program at Kliyul Copper Gold Project; Crescat Lead Order
summary: Pacific Ridge closed a $1.5 million financing to fund a 2,500-metre summer drill program at its Kliyul copper-gold project, with Crescat taking most of the units. The company says initial geology suggests a high-grade Cu-Au porphyry at depth. The news is exploratory and does not affect near-term supply.

title: Just Nickel and Dime Stuff, Really – ShareCafe
summary: A Fitch study expects ongoing nickel price strength over time, citing a persistent global supply deficit and gradual price recovery. It notes easing spot levels ahead as demand stabilises and new production ramps up, though a possible stoppage at Vale’s Sudbury mine could alter the outlook. LME nickel remains elevated.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Reports Fatality at the Kamoa-Kakula Copper | The Kingston Whig Standard
summary: Ivanhoe Mines said a fatal accident occurred underground at the Kakula Mine at its Kamoa-Kakula copper project in the DRC. The contractor employee was struck by loose rock and died despite first aid. Management and authorities are investigating. The release does not specify production curtailments or output effects.

title: Mining and Metallurgical Norilsk Nickel : Nornickel resumed mining at Taimyrsky
summary: Norilsk Nickel said it began gradually restarting ore mining at the Taimyrsky underground mine in Russia on June 1, after pumping out water and reinforcing underground workings. The mine reached 5 kt/day (40% of design) and is expected to reach full capacity by end-June, boosting near-term nickel supply confidence.

title: Century Aluminum Expands Moncks Corner, South Carolina, Operations
summary: Century Aluminum is expanding its Mt. Holly, South Carolina operations with a $60+ million investment, adding production capacity to cast molten aluminum into ingot and other primary products. The project is expected to be completed by end-2021 and includes job development credits, signaling higher aluminium supply expectations.

title: Benton Reports Results of Phase II Drilling at Far Lake Copper-Silver Project, Ontario
summary: Benton Resources reported Phase II drilling results at its Far Lake copper-silver project in Ontario, including copper mineralization in new zones and expanded intervals such as 0.15% Cu over 64.2 m. Additional step-outs found chalcopyrite-bearing altered granodiorite. Overall results are encouraging but remain exploration-stage.

title: Commentary: Section 232 program is vital for high-paying jobs like those at Century Aluminum
summary: Century Aluminum says the Section 232 program is vital to sustaining and expanding U.S. primary aluminum production. It cites a 50% production increase at its Goose Creek smelter, a $60 million investment, and job creation, attributing gains to tariff protection amid global overcapacity.

title: High copper prices revive old deposits - The Northern Miner
summary: Record copper prices have revived exploration at several projects that were previously marginal at long-term average prices. The Northern Miner cites examples such as US Copper, noting renewed mobilization this week, suggesting stronger copper-focused activity as current prices remain elevated.

title: ALUMINIUM BILLET WRAP: Premiums in Germany, Thailand at fresh highs; US premium slips
summary: Fastmarkets/Metal Bulletin report corrected and updated aluminium billet premium assessments, including fresh highs for wrap premiums in Germany and Thailand, while the US premium slips. The note focuses on aluminium 6063 extrusion billet premiums (low-carbon inferred) and related assessment revisions, pointing to regional physical-market price pressure.

title: Reynaers Aluminium launches MasterWall
summary: Reynaers Aluminium launched MasterWall, a fast-installation, high-performance façade system using its MasterLine 8 aluminium window platform. The release emphasizes handling building tolerances, insulation, and air/water tightness, aiming to speed production and installation for high-rise projects. It signals potential incremental aluminium demand but lacks contract or volume data.

title: Gold Back Below US$1,900, How to Make Money in Copper
summary: The piece notes gold weakening then stabilizing, but shifts to copper, saying it continues to experience “price momentum.” It recommends investing in large copper producers like Freeport-McMoRan, BHP, Glencore and Rio Tinto, arguing juniors may not produce within the current cycle. Overall tone is supportive of copper prices.

title: As Vale Inco nickel miners' walkout in Ontario prepares to enter second week, critical lessons posed by 2009-10 strike
summary: Vale Inco nickel miners in Sudbury are entering a second week of strike after voting down a concessions contract. The walkout and reported management actions could affect mine and processing output timing, tightening near-term nickel supply expectations. The article also cites rising living costs and benefits cuts influencing wage demands.

title: ESG Focus: Green Copper Demand Ready To Roar
summary: The article says the copper market is near peak supply but unprepared for demand tied to renewables, with Goldman predicting deficits over 2021-2022 and inventory depletion if prices stay low. It argues prices may need to rise toward mid-teens levels to stimulate long-cycle investment, supporting a bullish copper outlook.

title: China's May unwrought copper imports at 445,725 tonnes - customs
summary: China’s May unwrought copper imports fell to 445,725 tonnes, down from 484,890 tonnes in April, according to customs data. The decline follows record-high copper prices that eroded buying interest in the world’s top consumer. Imports were also slightly above May 2020 levels.

title: Copper climbs as U.S. jobs data calms fears of policy tightening
summary: Copper rose on Monday after the U.S. jobs report suggested economic recovery without forcing an earlier Fed policy tightening, helping sentiment. LME three-month copper edged toward $10,000. ShFE contracts for aluminium and nickel also increased, reflecting supportive broader industrial-metals market tone.

title: China copper, iron ore, soybeans imports rise in May on year
summary: China customs data show copper imports rose 2.2% year-on-year in May to 445,725 tonnes, remaining relatively high due to delayed logistics from January-April and overseas orders shifting to China. Such demand support for refined copper in the near term could underpin prices.

title: Secondary aluminium market saw muted trades amid sell-off by traders_SMM
summary: SMM reports aluminium ingot prices fell sharply, dragging down aluminium scrap by 200–300 yuan/mt and ADC12 secondary aluminium by about 550 yuan/mt. Weak downstream demand, off-season expectations, die-casting wait-and-see behavior, chip shortages, pandemic disruption, and power curtailment are reducing orders, keeping secondary prices weak.

title: SHFE aluminium to drop slightly on concerns of tightening liquidity and talk of SRB sell-off _SMM
summary: SHFE aluminium ended the week lower as liquidity-tightening fears grew after unusually positive US economic data and renewed rumours of a possible SRB sell-off. The pullback pressured LME aluminium, which saw a three-day losing streak. Analysts expect SHFE aluminium to fall slightly amid limited immediate SRB release risk.

title: Nickel prices still supported by fundamentals, SS contract prices clawed back losses_SMM
summary: SMM reports nickel prices surged to 135,000 yuan/mt before pulling back, but says fundamentals remain supported. High production in new energy and stainless steel and firmer nickel sulphate and NPI help underpin demand/supply balance. Dollar and US data added volatility, but SMM expects a nickel rally this week.

title: London copper eases as China exports data fans demand concerns
summary: London copper eased 0.5% as China’s May exports grew less than expected, with traders citing concerns over weakening industrial demand. The Reuters report attributes the move primarily to the export data that followed a prior rebound, while noting other metals had mixed price action.

title: This Pivot to Copper Is Unlikely to Revive the Prospects for NAK Stock
summary: The piece discusses Northern Dynasty’s Pebble project, long stalled by environmental opposition, and the company’s pivot to highlight the copper content. It argues copper demand could rise for renewables, while supply risk exists due to politics in Peru and Chile. It also notes U.S. permits remain unlikely under Biden.

title: SMM Evening Comments (Jun 7): Shanghai nonferrous metals ended mixed, nickel weakened 1.12%_SMM
summary: SMM reported SHFE nonferrous metals finished mixed after investors reacted to China trade data and US macro signals. Copper rose 0.38% supported by a weaker USD and falling yields. Aluminium gained 0.74%. Nickel fell 1.12% on softer sentiment despite improving smelting supply and ongoing zinc imports context.

title: Braveheart Resources Inc.: Braveheart Intersects 19.8% Copper over 0.6 Metres at Bull River Mine Project
summary: Braveheart Resources reported drilling results from its Bull River Mine project, intersecting high-grade copper mineralization, including 19.79% Cu over 0.6 metres within a broader 5.12% Cu interval. All drilled holes intersected mineralized structures below current workings, supporting potential mine-life expansion.

title: Rusal promises equal quality of aluminium for domestic and foreign markets after spin-off
summary: Rusal says that after its planned demerger of higher-carbon assets into a separate Al+ entity, customers in Russia and abroad will receive the aluminium they order with equal quality. The new company will focus on domestic contracts, while Rusal keeps most production assets and pursues lower/“carbon-free” anode technology.

title: Jetti raises $50m funding to advance copper extraction technology
summary: Jetti Resources raised $50m to scale its catalytic technology for heap/stockpile leach extraction of copper from low-grade sulfide ores such as chalcopyrite. Investors include Mitsubishi, Freeport-McMoRan, and BHP Ventures. The funding aims to deploy at large-scale mines, building on prior results at Pinto Valley, Arizona.

title: Pacific Ridge Exploration Ltd.: Drilling Commences at Pacific Ridge's Spius Porphyry Copper Project
summary: Pacific Ridge Exploration announced a 550-metre drill program at its Spius copper porphyry project in British Columbia. The drilling targets higher-grade surface mineralization and porphyry-style copper at depth, while the company also references an upcoming Kliyul copper-gold drill program funded through options.

title: Aluminum shortage temporarily stops Arizona license plate production
summary: An aluminum shortage has temporarily halted Arizona license plate production in the state, according to the headline. The disruption indicates a near-term supply constraint affecting downstream usage, likely reducing aluminium consumption expectations over coming days and weighing on short-term market sentiment for prices.

title: Malaysian secondary copper dismantling and processing plants to shut for 14 days amid full lockdown_SMM
summary: Malaysia imposed a full lockdown from June 1–14, forcing secondary copper dismantling/processing plants to shut and suspending secondary copper exports. China’s imports from Malaysia drop by about 15,000 mt (under 10% of total), and wider regional halts tighten supply. CIF secondary scrap quotes firmed, supporting copper prices.

title: London copper rises on weak dollar, tepid China demand weighs
summary: London copper rose slightly as a weaker dollar provided support, but it failed to break $10,000/t amid tepid demand from China. China copper imports fell 8% in May on high prices. The piece also notes LME nickel down and ShFE aluminum lower, reflecting broader market softness.

title: Tartisan Nickel Corp. Arranges $4,482,000 Flow-Through Financing at $0.57 per Unit and Has Closed First Tranche
summary: Tartisan Nickel Corp. closed the first tranche of a $4.48M flow-through financing priced at $0.57 per unit and plans to use proceeds to fund exploration and development work at its Kenbridge Nickel Project in Ontario. The company has commenced work and intends a summer 2021 drill program.

title: Callinex Intersects 4.87m of 14.94% Copper in 90m Step-out from the Rainbow Deposit in the Flin Flon Mining District, MB
summary: Callinex reported intersecting 4.87m grading 14.94% copper in a 90m step-out from the Rainbow Deposit in Manitoba’s Flin Flon district. The result is a positive exploration signal for future copper supply potential, but it is not large enough from a near-term pricing perspective to clearly shift prices.

title: DRC copper holds key to greening global economy, says mining magnate
summary: Ivanhoe Mines’ Kamoa-Kakula project in the DRC has begun producing copper concentrates, with an initial phase targeting 200,000 tonnes/year and potential higher output depending on hydro power availability. The piece contrasts easing DRC development prospects with risks like power limits and copper export/ mining-code issues.

title: World needs Congo copper to kick fossil fuels, B.C. billionaire says
summary: Vancouver mining magnate Robert Friedland says the DRC’s Kamoa-Kakula project has begun producing copper concentrates, positioning Congo as a crucial supplier for electrification. The piece notes supply bottlenecks as Chile faces slower growth from ore-quality issues and emphasizes the need to ramp DRC output amid rising demand.

title: World Needs Congo Copper to Kick Fossil Fuels, Billionaire Says
summary: Bloomberg reports that Ivanhoe’s Kamoa-Kakula venture in the Democratic Republic of Congo has started producing copper concentrates, with initial output of about 200,000 tons/year and potential to scale up. It argues electrification needs more copper as Chile slows, implying tighter supply conditions that support prices.

title: Clean energy is driving a copper supercycle
summary: Kamoa-Kakula in the DRC is described as a high-grade copper mine with potential output exceeding 5% of China’s annual demand. The operator employs ~7,000 workers, uses its own trucking route to a nearby smelter, and is upgrading a Congo River hydropower station to supply electricity for mine operations.

title: Pampa Metals Corp.: Pampa Metals Initiates Drone-Flown Aeromagnetic Survey at its Block 3 Copper Project in Chile And Provides Update from Geological Mapping
summary: Pampa Metals announced it has started a drone-flown aeromagnetic survey and continued geological mapping at its wholly owned Block 3 copper project in northern Chile. The company is using geophysics to identify concealed porphyry copper systems and may pursue additional electrical surveys and drill testing if results warrant it.

title: Pampa Metals Initiates Drone-Flown Aeromagnetic Survey at its Block 3 Copper Project in Chile And Provides Update from Geological Mapping
summary: Pampa Metals says it has started a drone-flown aeromagnetic survey at its Block 3 copper project in Chile and is providing updates from geological mapping. The announcement relates to exploration work rather than production or disruptions, implying no immediate supply-demand shock for copper.

title: Exclusive: China's nickel otuput fell to 12,400 mt in May_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports China’s refined nickel output fell 590 mt (down 4.53%) month on month to 12,400 mt in May, with operating rates at 57%. Some smelters remained suspended (Shandong, Tianjin, Guangxi), while Gansu overhaul limited impact. June output is forecast to rise to 13,600 mt.

title: Exclusive: China's nickel sulphate output decreased to 97,700 mt in May_SMM
summary: China’s nickel sulphate output fell in May to 97,700 mt (-5.82% m/m) but rose y/y, with limited intermediate raw-material stocks and some production halts in southwest salt plants. Overseas MHP smelter maintenance tightened supply. However, output is expected to rise in June as briquette dissolution lines expand.

title: Vedanta's Sterlite Copper CEO Pankaj Kumar quits
summary: Sterlite Copper CEO Pankaj Kumar quit Vedanta. The Thoothukudi copper smelter has been shut since 2018 by Tamil Nadu, except for producing oxygen during COVID. The piece also notes Vedanta’s proposed new 500 ktpa smelter and ongoing local/provincial political opposition. No clear immediate operational change is stated.

title: Forum Energy Metals Corp.: Rio Tinto Intersects 14 Metres of 0.89% Copper and 8 G/t Silver Including 6 Metres of 1.67% Copper and 13 G/t Silver at Forum's Janice Lake Copper/Silver Project, Saskatchewan
summary: Forum Energy Metals reported additional drill results from Rio Tinto Exploration’s drilling at the Rafuse target on the Janice Lake copper/silver project in Saskatchewan, including an intercept of 0.89% copper over 14 metres (with higher-grade intervals). Crews are being mobilized for further drilling, but no market-level supply change is indicated.

title: World Copper Ltd.: World Copper Announces Amendment to Letter Agreement for the Acquisition of the Zonia Copper Oxide Project
summary: World Copper announced an amendment to its acquisition agreement for Cardero’s Zonia copper-oxide project in Arizona, including a 1% NSR royalty option and possible buyout in World Copper shares. The release details copper resources and potential SX-EW heap-leach processing, but provides no immediate supply disruption or output change.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: Talon Metals Announces Multiple Thick Intersections of Massive Nickel-Copper Mineralization Including 9.81 Meters Outside of Tamarack Nickel Project's Resource Area
summary: Talon Metals announced seven new drill holes in the Tamarack Nickel-Copper-Cobalt project’s CGO West area, all intersecting nickel-copper mineralization, including intervals up to 9.81 meters of mixed massive sulphides. The company says the results expand the presumed massive sulphide pool beyond the current resource area; assays remain pending.

title: Bell Copper Corporation: Bell Copper Announces $2,000,000 Non-Brokered Private Placement
summary: Bell Copper announced a CDN $2.0 million non-brokered private placement to fund drilling and exploration at its Big Sandy and Perseverance copper projects and general working capital. The first tranche is expected soon, subject to approvals. The financing is copper-related but unlikely to materially move near-term physical copper markets.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: Talon Metals Announces Multiple Thick Intersections of Massive Nickel-Copper Mineralization Including 9.81 Meters Outside of Tamarack Nickel Project's Resource Area
summary: Talon Metals reported seven new drill holes in the CGO West area of its Tamarack nickel-copper-cobalt project, intersecting multiple thick zones of nickel-copper mineralization, including up to 9.81 meters of massive sulphides. The company cites expanded potential for future resource growth, while assays remain pending.

title: Canada Nickel announce industry leading low carbon footprint
summary: Canada Nickel says its Crawford project is expected to have an “industry-leading” low carbon footprint, with CO2 intensity 93% below the industry average and potential additional offsets from spontaneous mineral carbonation. It attributes results to low strip ratio, hydroelectric power, and electrified equipment, supporting a net-zero nickel narrative.

title: Wedgemount Resources Corp.: Assembling a Prospective Portfolio of British Columbia Copper Assets Through an Experienced Team of Project Developers
summary: Wedgemount Resources updates shareholders on funding and progress building a portfolio of British Columbia copper-gold exploration assets, including optioning multiple projects and planning 2021 field work and potential follow-on drilling. The news supports ongoing copper exploration activity but does not signal near-term supply changes.

title: Angkor Resources Corp.: Angkor Resources Expands Copper Anomaly at Andong Meas
summary: Angkor Resources reports expanded copper-in-soil anomalies at its Andong Meas license in Cambodia, with up to 443 ppm copper and associated copper–molybdenum mineralization. The company plans trenching, detailed grid work, and expanded soil geochemistry to define drilling targets. It remains an exploration update, not production.

title: Copper slips as Chinese factory gate prices surge
summary: Copper prices fell as Chinese factory gate input costs rose at the fastest pace in 12 years and a Chinese agency said it would increase monitoring of commodity markets. Copper import premiums eased to the lowest in years, signaling weak demand, while speculators cut long exposure. Aluminium was slightly down.

title: Talon Metals Announces Multiple Thick Intersections of Massive Nickel-Copper Mineralization Including 9.81 Meters Outside of Tamarack Nickel Project's Resource Area
summary: Talon Metals reported seven new drill holes from the Tamarack Nickel-Copper-Cobalt project in Minnesota, intersecting multiple thick nickel-copper (massive sulphide) intervals, including up to 9.81 meters. Assays are pending and the release is exploration-focused, implying potential future resource expansion rather than immediate production changes.

title: Rio Tinto Intersects 14 Metres of 0.89% Copper and 8 G/t Silver | The Kingston Whig Standard
summary: Forum Energy Metals reported Rio Tinto Exploration Canada drill intercepts at the Janice Lake copper/silver project in Saskatchewan, including 0.89% copper over 14 metres (and higher-grade intervals). The release provides assay results and notes further drilling plans, but no near-term production or trade impact.

title: Joe Biden Plans to Surrender Protections for American Steel and Aluminum
summary: Bloomberg reports Biden plans to drop or ease U.S. tariffs protecting steel and aluminum as part of an EU-U.S. summit deal, with tariff rollback targeted by December. The EU retaliated earlier, but both sides are drafting commitments to avoid escalation, supporting a more constructive near-term outlook for aluminum prices.

title: Rio Tinto Intersects 14 Metres of 0.89% Copper and 8 G/t Silver Including 6 Metres of 1.67% Copper and 13 G/t Silver at Forum's Janice Lake Copper/Silver Project, Saskatchewan
summary: Forum Energy Metals reports Rio Tinto Exploration’s 2021 summer drill results at the Janice Lake copper/silver project in Saskatchewan, including multiple copper-bearing intercepts up to 0.89% Cu over 14 metres in a prior hole. The update may slightly influence copper supply expectations, but is not production-related and is unlikely to move prices materially.

title: Port of Spain scrap dealer: Police took my copper
summary: A scrap dealer in Port of Spain claims police seized about 3,000 lbs of copper during a raid on an illegal scrapyard suspected of weapons. Police also took state-linked drain covers and other scrap. The case centers on alleged theft and unlawful possession, with only local copper availability affected.

title: Copper Theft Rising Alongside Stronger Copper Prices
summary: Copper prices are rising to record levels, and that strength is increasing theft of copper wiring and scrap globally. The piece cites multiple theft incidents and new anti-theft legislation in places like Oklahoma and Saskatchewan. It implies the high price environment sustains black-market supply demand for copper.

title: Surge Copper : Announces Closing of C$14.0 Million Bought Deal Private Placement
summary: Surge Copper Corp. closed a C$14.0 million bought deal private placement, including flow-through units, to fund development and exploration at its Ootsa and Berg properties. The company highlights advancement of copper projects and working capital use. No immediate production changes, shutdowns, or concentrate supply impacts are stated.

title: Avrupa Minerals Drills 22.25 meters of 0.42% Copper and Additional Intercepts at Sesmarias North, Alvalade Project, Portugal
summary: Avrupa Minerals reported new drill intercepts at the Sesmarias North Alvalade Project, including 22.25m of 0.42% copper and additional down-dip massive sulfide mineralization. The release discusses geological continuity and future drilling but provides no near-term production, supply disruption, or inventory impact.

title: Aluminum shortage puts stop on production of Arizona license plates
summary: Arizona temporarily halted production of license plates because of a worldwide aluminum shortage after a missed delivery of aluminum to the state’s plate maker. The agency switched to an interim vendor and expects a backlog to clear in about two weeks. ADOT also faces impacts for highway signs.

title: Copper eases on fears of China price curbs
summary: Copper fell as markets worried China will curb commodity prices after renewed pledges to monitor spot and futures, following surging producer inflation. LME copper dropped 0.6% and ShFE copper 0.5%. The article also notes LME aluminum and nickel weakening, with attention on upcoming U.S. inflation data.

title: MAX Resource Corp.: Max Resource Assays 4.3% Copper Over Widths 10-Metres at the Newly Discovered URU Zone, CESAR North, Colombia
summary: MAX Resource Corp. reports first assay results from the URU zone at its CESAR North copper-silver project in Colombia, with multiple rock-chip channel hits grading above 1% copper and highlights including 4.3% copper over 10 metres. Exploration programs are continuing, suggesting improved copper resource potential.

title: Copper Fox Metals Inc.: Copper Fox Announces Update on Eaglehead Copper Project
summary: Copper Fox reported an updated geological model and further interpretation for its Eaglehead copper porphyry system, noting expanded open zones and favorable preliminary metallurgical results producing a clean bulk copper-molybdenite concentrate with high copper recoveries. The company plans 2021 exploration targeting broader Cu-Mo anomalies north of historic drill areas.

title: Perenti wins $496m contract for Motheo copper project in Botswana
summary: Perenti subsidiary African Mining Services was awarded a $496m contract for open-pit mining services at Sandfire’s Motheo copper project in Botswana (T3 pit). Work is scheduled to start early next year after licensing and contract finalisation. The long-term project could support future copper output, but near-term price impact appears limited.

title: CITIC Metal, Zijin sign offtake agreements for Kamoa-Kakula copper mine
summary: CITIC Metal and Zijin Mining signed offtake agreements for phase-one of the Kamoa-Kakula copper mine in the DRC, buying 50% each of copper production and related concentrates/blister via the Lualaba Copper Smelter. A total $300m advance payment supports ramp-up as exports begin.

title: Copper Fox Announces Update on Eaglehead Copper | The Kingston Whig Standard
summary: Copper Fox provided an update on its Eaglehead copper (Cu-Mo-Au-Ag) project in British Columbia, highlighting an updated geological model, open mineralized zones, and preliminary metallurgical testwork yielding a copper-molybdenite concentrate with high recoveries. The news is exploration-focused and does not imply near-term supply changes.

title: Max Resource Assays 4.3% Copper Over Widths 10-Metres at the Newly
summary: Max Resource reported first assay results from the newly discovered URU zone within its CESAR copper-silver project in Colombia, including 4.3% copper over 10-metre widths and multiple other high-grade results. Exploration on URU has commenced, improving near-term sentiment for potential copper supply.

title: Copper Prices Are Going Nowhere. What That Means for Stocks.
summary: The piece notes copper prices have soared to levels not seen in more than a decade but now appear to be “hitting a wall,” indicating the rally may be losing momentum. It connects this to expectations for value stocks, implying copper gains could be less impressive from here.

title: Copper falls on China's pledge to cool prices, low premiums
summary: Copper prices fell as China pledged to cool base-metal prices and as low Chinese copper premiums and cash-to-3-month discounts pointed to soft demand. The article also notes planned sales from China state reserves of copper and aluminum and expects easing supply, weighing on both metals in the near term.

title: World's Largest Copper Miners Leave Money On The Table During Epic Rally
summary: Mining.com says several major copper miners had lower grades, restrictions, maintenance, or suspended operations, while Freeport-McMoRan increased Q1 copper output ~25% at Grasberg. It details higher realized prices and expansion progress, but overall production among top suppliers barely changed early in the year.

title: Freeport: EVs and Solar Boost Copper Prospects
summary: The article argues that faster economic reopening and accelerated “green” spending will boost copper demand for construction, electrical networks, EVs, and renewable energy transmission/storage. It cites EVs using multiple times more copper and notes copper’s importance in renewables, projecting strong demand growth that would tend to lift copper sentiment.

title: Copper, aluminum and zinc should be thrown into chu? Five ministries and commissions investigated the situation of coal hoarding in Caofeidian Port._SMM
summary: China’s State Reserve Bureau is reported to be selling “chu” (reserve metal) directly to downstream firms, targeting copper and aluminium (and zinc). Analysts say this will ease tight spot supply, narrow spot premiums, slow destocking, and suppress short-term futures prices, with copper pressure expected to be stronger.

title: Copper, aluminum and zinc should be thrown into chu? Five ministries and commissions investigated the situation of coal hoarding in Caofeidian Port._SMM
summary: The article says China’s State Reserve Bureau has essentially confirmed it will sell stockpiled non-ferrous metals directly to downstream terminals (“throw chu”), including copper and aluminium, with monthly deliveries into late 2021. Analysts expect the move to relieve spot tightness, reduce spot premiums, and weigh on short-term copper and aluminium futures.

title: TABLE-Japan aluminium buyers to pay higher premiums for July-Sept imports
summary: Japan aluminium buyers are set to pay higher premiums for imported material in the July–September period. Higher import premiums generally reflect stronger physical demand or constrained supply in the near term, which can lift market expectations for aluminium prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Outlook on the Aluminum Extrusion Global Market to 2027 - Opportunity Analysis and Industry Forecasts
summary: The report outlines growth prospects for the global aluminum extrusion market and highlights that Hindalco plans to open a 34,000-metric-ton extrusion facility in Silvassa to supply downstream demand. It also cites rising use of aluminum extrusions in construction, automotive, and electrical sectors, implying steadier aluminium demand.

title: BHP Dodges Chile Copper Strike With Eleventh-Hour Wage Deal
summary: BHP reportedly avoided a planned copper-related strike in Chile by agreeing to an eleventh-hour wage deal. By averting labor disruption at copper operations, the news reduces near-term supply uncertainty for the metal, which can weigh on copper prices in the coming days as disruption risk fades.

title: African Mining Services awarded Motheo Copper Project contract
summary: Perenti’s African Mining Services (AMS) won an opencast mining services contract for Sandfire’s Motheo copper project in Botswana, contingent on a mining licence and contract finalisation. The deal spans about 7.3 years, with mining targeted to begin in early 2022, supporting expectations of future copper supply growth.

title: Aluminum And Steel Could Peak In China As Coal Is Fazed Out
summary: Reuters says China’s peak coal-use target and stricter environmental rules are dampening investment in new steel mills and aluminum smelters, potentially bringing production near peak. It also warns China’s export-rebate removal for steel could foreshadow reduced aluminum semi exports, tightening global supply and lifting aluminum prices.

title: Road Runner: Aluminum shortage causes Arizona license plate backlog
summary: Arizona’s transportation department said a worldwide aluminum shortage temporarily halted license plate production, creating a backlog of about 68,000 plates. With no aluminum in stock, it sourced interim plates from another vendor and resumed production using new fonts, with standard plates arriving from the fulfillment center starting June 14.

title: Copper trades flat in thin holiday trade
summary: Copper was unchanged in thin trade as China was on holiday and reduced activity in the SHFE. Supply fears eased after workers at BHP’s Spence mine in Chile agreed a contract deal, avoiding a strike. Aluminium and nickel were slightly higher, indicating limited net near-term price pressure.

title: Northwest Copper : Starts Drilling at Kwanika - Initial 7200 Metre Program
summary: NorthWest Copper says drilling has begun at its Kwanika/Stardust project in central British Columbia, with an initial 7,200-metre program targeting high-grade and regional targets. Two diamond rigs will drill 18 holes, aiming to complete by end of August and deliver new resources by year-end.

title: ALX Resources Corp. Announces Commencement of Drilling at the Firebird Nickel Project, Northern Saskatchewan
summary: ALX Resources began a fully funded ~1,500-metre diamond drilling program at its Firebird nickel project in northern Saskatchewan, operated by ALX with Rio Tinto earning up to an 80% interest. The program targets VTEM anomalies where surface assays previously showed nickel-rich mineralization.

title: Waterton plans to offload Canadian nickel mine for up to $1bn
summary: Waterton Global is reportedly seeking to sell its Dumont nickel sulphide project in Quebec for up to $1bn, appointing Goldman Sachs to run the process. The undeveloped mine is expected to produce 33,000 tpa, rising to 50,000 tpa, feeding growing EV battery nickel demand.

title: A nickel refinery tops U.S. battery metals wish list: Andy Home
summary: Reuters reports the Biden administration’s critical supply-chain review prioritizes expanding U.S. nickel refining, emphasizing Class 1 nickel shortages in 3-7 years. With limited domestic processing and rising battery demand, the push for more refining capacity and stockpiling/recycling is likely to support near-term nickel price expectations.

title: NSJ Gold Corp. (NSJ) Announces 7.93 g/t Gold and 1.61% Copper Over
summary: NSJ Gold Corp. reported partial assay results from its Golden Hills Project in Arizona, including copper grades of 1.61% over 4.57 meters and additional intercepts totaling 10.7 meters averaging about 1.5% copper. The press release frames findings as potential high-grade copper mineralization, though still early-stage exploration.

title: Copper falls as market frets about demand, China curbs
summary: Copper fell on the LME as markets fretted about China taking steps to curb further industrial metals price gains and as demand fundamentals looked less supportive. The piece cites potential Chinese reserve releases for non-ferrous metals and upcoming industrial production data, reinforcing near-term downside pressure. Aluminium and nickel were also mentioned with gains.

title: Peru's Copper Industry At Risk As New Administration Takes The Wheel
summary: Peru’s election result may put copper output at risk: socialist candidate Pedro Castillo is seen as favoring higher mining royalties and a review of tax stability agreements, potentially reducing incentives and investment. Peru is the world’s second-largest copper producer, so policy uncertainty could weigh on near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Worldwide Aluminum Extrusion Industry to 2027 - Growth in Demand for Customized Extrusion Presents Opportunities
summary: The PRNewswire item promotes a ResearchAndMarkets report on the global aluminum extrusion market. It cites projected demand growth from construction, automotive, and electrical end-uses, plus a COVID-19 temporary downturn tied to weaker automotive and construction demand and supply-chain delays. No immediate pricing or policy catalyst is provided.

title: Copper prices at 7-week low on Chinese crackdown fears
summary: Copper prices fell to a 7-week low as investors feared Chinese authorities would curb the recent commodity rally via increased monitoring and a crackdown on speculative positions. The article expects China may release copper and aluminium state reserves. It also reports declines in LME and ShFE aluminium alongside copper.

title: Copper prices hit 7-week low as traders brace for China curbs
summary: Copper prices dropped to a 7-week low as traders braced for potential Chinese measures to curb commodity price gains. China’s renewed pledge to monitor prices and expectations of copper reserve releases pressured LME three-month copper, while LME aluminum also fell, reflecting broader downside sentiment across industrial metals.

title: Operating rates at aluminium processors dropped slightly amid increased finished product inventory _SMM
summary: SMM said operating rates at major aluminium processors slipped to 75.7% last week, with further slight declines expected. Primary alloy orders fell 10–25% in May, downstream demand remained sluggish due to summer car production cuts and chip shortages, and some finished inventories rose. Guangdong power curbs partially eased.

title: Copper prices to fluctuate rangebound _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM attributes near-term copper price action to a macro Fed/CPI backdrop and domestic supply-demand conditions. US core CPI hit a 1992 high, but the Fed is unlikely to taper QE soon. Meanwhile, copper inventories declined on hampered imports, supporting spot discounts narrowing. Net outlook: rangebound copper.

title: Copper hits 7-week low as funds, traders cut long positions
summary: Copper prices slid to seven-week lows as funds and traders cut long positions, driven by concern that China may curb further price rises. Copper is down sharply versus its recent record. The article also cites aluminium easing and a related June delivery dynamic, while nickel falls alongside broader nonferrous weakness.

title: Aurania Resources Ltd.: Aurania Reports That Drilling Has Intersected Sediment-Hosted Copper Mineralization at Tsenken N1
summary: Aurania reported that drilling at the Tsenken N1 target intersected sediment-hosted copper-silver mineralization, with intensity increasing eastward, and planned additional drilling while a rig moves to nearby targets. Assay results for the easternmost hole are awaited, making the immediate market impact likely modest.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: Talon Metals Drilling Extends Thick Nickel-Copper Mineralization to the North-East of the Resource Area at the Tamarack Nickel Project
summary: Talon Metals announced new drilling at the Tamarack Nickel-Copper-Cobalt project, reporting multiple thick intersections of nickel-copper mineralization in step-outs within the Upper Semi-Massive Sulphide Unit. Assays are pending, and the release focuses on resource growth and continued drilling rather than near-term production changes.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: Talon Metals Drilling Extends Thick Nickel-Copper Mineralization to the North-East of the Resource Area at the Tamarack Nickel Project
summary: Talon Metals reported new drill intersections at its Tamarack nickel-copper-cobalt project in Minnesota, extending thick nickel-copper mineralization in step-out holes within the Upper Semi-Massive Sulphide Unit. Assays for the new holes are pending and no production change is announced, so near-term effects on nickel and copper prices are likely limited.

title: CanAlaska Uranium Ltd.: CanAlaska Stakes Fifth Thompson Nickel Belt Project
summary: CanAlaska Uranium reports staking additional claim blocks at Halfway Lake in Manitoba’s Thompson Nickel Belt, targeting folded ultramafic lenses adjacent to the Halfway Lake nickel deposit. Historic drilling reported 15.8 metres of 0.55% nickel with higher-grade segments, reinforcing exploration potential and supporting nickel sentiment.

title: PPC – Mytilineos: Agreement on electricity contract in Aluminum of Greece closed
summary: Mytilineos’ Aluminium of Greece agreed a new electricity supply contract with PPC until 2023, aiming for cheaper, greener power as the plant shifts to a nearby 826 MW gas unit and bilateral renewables. The firm also secured a 10-year Glencore deal for alumina/aluminium with guaranteed prices, plus major investments.

title: Universal Copper Announces Purchase Agreement with Poplar Copper Corp., Change of Directors and Private Placement
summary: Universal Copper announced a purchase agreement with Poplar Copper Corp., along with board changes and a private placement. The transaction is copper-related and could influence near-term expectations for copper project development or commercial arrangements, potentially supporting copper prices, while providing no direct nickel or aluminium linkage.

title: Universal Copper Ltd.: Universal Copper Announces Purchase Agreement with Poplar Copper Corp., Change of Directors and Private Placement
summary: Universal Copper announced an agreement to acquire 100% of Poplar Copper Corporation, expanding land around its Poplar copper project, and also announced a C$1.27m private placement to fund exploration and working capital. The news is specific to copper exploration, with no immediate production or trade disruption described.

title: Talon Metals Drilling Extends Thick Nickel-Copper Mineralization to the North-East of the Resource Area at the Tamarack Nickel Project
summary: Talon Metals reported drilling step-outs at the Tamarack Nickel-Copper-Cobalt project that intercepted thick nickel-copper mineralization, expanding the Upper SMSU to the northeast. The company emphasizes continued resource expansion and pending assays. No production, inventory, or near-term supply disruption is indicated for nickel or copper.

title: Talon Metals Drilling Extends Thick Nickel-Copper Mineralization to the North-East of the Resource Area at the Tamarack Nickel Project
summary: Talon Metals reported that new drill holes at the Tamarack nickel-copper-cobalt project in Minnesota extended thick nickel-copper mineralization in the north-east portion of the resource area. Intersections include multiple long intervals of Ni and Cu mineralization, though assay results are pending and no production impacts are provided.

title: Guatemala sets date for Fénix nickel mine consultation
summary: Guatemala set a date for consultation regarding the Fénix nickel mine. The headline suggests an upcoming regulatory/community process that could affect the project’s timeline and future nickel supply. However, the excerpt does not specify likely outcomes, so near-term price direction remains unclear.

title: Giga Metals Corporation: Giga Metals to Pursue MHP Production at Turnagain Nickel Project
summary: Giga Metals said it is studying expansion of processing at its Turnagain Ni/Co project to produce Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate (MHP), used in battery supply chains for NiSO4 and related nickel salts. The release cites rising MHP demand and payables, implying potential future incremental nickel feedstock, though timing is not immediate.

title: Copper Rally Stalls as Traders Unravel Bets Ahead of Fed Meeting
summary: The report headline says copper’s rally is losing momentum as traders unwind bets ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting. That suggests reduced speculative support and potentially softer near-term expectations for copper demand or pricing tied to upcoming rate and macro signals.

title: CanAlaska Stakes Fifth Thompson Nickel Belt Project
summary: CanAlaska Uranium staked new claim blocks at Halfway Lake in Manitoba’s Thompson Nickel Belt, targeting ultramafic lenses and known nickel mineralization. Historic results cited include drill intersection 15.8m at 0.55% Ni. The release is exploratory and does not indicate imminent production or supply changes for nickel.

title: White House Elevates Battery-Grade Nickel to 'Critical' Status in 100-day Supply Chain Review, Notes Huge Potential of Seafloor Resources | Business
summary: The White House reportedly designated battery-grade nickel as “critical” in a 100-day supply chain review and highlighted potential seafloor resources. Such moves can strengthen expectations for future nickel supply support and procurement focus, which can lift sentiment and price pressure in the nickel market over the coming weeks.

title: Rio Tinto and ARENA to study using hydrogen to reduce carbon emissions in alumina refining
summary: Rio Tinto and ARENA will fund a $1.2 million feasibility study to assess whether clean hydrogen can replace natural gas in the calcination step of alumina refining at the Yarwun plant. The work aims to cut refinery emissions, but it is a lab and design study rather than an operational change.

title: Copper Futures Plunge To Seven-Week Low As Base Metals Slip-On Fed, China Demand Woes
summary: Copper futures fell sharply to a seven-week low as base metals declined amid concerns tied to the Federal Reserve stance and China demand weakness. The market reaction suggests reduced near-term demand expectations and lower price support for copper, likely weighing on follow-through buying in coming sessions.

title: Material Matters: Steel, Copper And Batteries
summary: Citi says copper destocking tied to strong end-demand is unsustainable and expects a refined drawdown and higher prices over the next 3–4 months, with a possible upside from proposed Chilean taxes. Nickel sulphate is described as especially tight. The article also notes reported Chinese state reserve selling of aluminium, cautioning about speculation.

title: SHFE aluminium to extend gains on positive macro front and fundamentals_SMM
summary: SMM reports SHFE aluminium rebounded sharply and expects further gains this week. Support comes from a weekly drop in aluminium ingot social inventory, peak-season consumption, and slower restart of closed capacity in Inner Mongolia and Yunnan. Macro conditions are also viewed as supportive after US CPI eased liquidity-tightening worries; SRB sell-off rumours are unconfirmed.

title: A nickel refinery tops U.S. battery metals wish list
summary: A Biden Administration 100-day critical supply chain review prioritizes investing in nickel refining capacity, citing vulnerabilities in battery-grade “Class 1” nickel and market indications of a potential shortage. The report highlights EV cathode shifts and urges domestic processing and recycling capacity, implying supportive near-term sentiment for nickel prices.

title: China to release national reserves of copper, aluminium and zinc
summary: China announced it will release national reserves of base metals over the near term as it seeks to stabilise critical commodity prices. The move targets copper and aluminium, aiming to cool a sector where prices have surged amid recovery, liquidity and speculative buying, likely adding immediate supply pressure.

title: China to release national reserves of copper, aluminium and zinc
summary: China will release national reserves of base metals over the near term to help stabilise critical commodity prices. The move targets copper and aluminium amid strong price gains this year driven by recovery, liquidity, and speculative buying. Additional supply from reserve releases is likely to weigh on prices in coming days.

title: National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration to release copper, aluminium, and zinc stocks_SMM
summary: China’s National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration will release copper and aluminium (and zinc) stocks under State Council guidance. The release targets non-ferrous processing and manufacturing firms through public bidding, with the National Reserves Adjustment Centre handling implementation. The stated aim is to ensure supply and stabilise commodity prices.

title: National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration to release copper, aluminium, and zinc stocks_SMM
summary: China’s National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration plans to release copper and aluminium (and zinc) stocks to support supply and stabilise commodity prices, under State Council deployment. Releases will be conducted through public bidding for non-ferrous processing/manufacturing enterprises, with detailed terms to follow separately.

title: Hot Chili set to grow high-grade copper inventory ahead of PFS
summary: Hot Chili reports strong drilling results at the Cortadera deposit within its Costa Fuego copper hub in northern Chile, including a 144m intercept at 1% copper-equivalent and other high-grade intervals. The company plans a pre-feasibility study to combine Cortadera with producing Productora and expects further growth.

title: LME copper rebounds from sharp sell-off, but inflation weighs
summary: London copper edged up after a sharp sell-off to a seven-week low, but the rebound was limited by fears of U.S. policy tightening as inflation rose and retail sales weakened. Nickel and aluminium also fell across LME and Shanghai, reflecting broader macro pressure ahead of the Fed meeting.

title: China to release copper, aluminum and zinc reserves to stabilize prices
summary: China’s National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration said it will release copper and aluminium (and zinc) from national reserves in batches via public auctions to curb rising commodity prices. Analysts expect the sales to weigh on markets, though volumes are unclear. Copper and aluminium prices likely face near-term bearish pressure.

title: China to release copper, aluminum and zinc reserves to stabilize prices
summary: China announced it will release copper and aluminium (and zinc) from national strategic reserves in batches via public auctions “in the near future” to stabilize commodity prices amid a surge. Traders may already price some sales, but uncertainty over quantities still suggests downside pressure, especially for copper and aluminium.

title: Six workers injured after fire at Indonesia's Weda Bay nickel smelter
summary: Six workers were injured in a fire at Indonesia’s Weda Bay nickel smelter. The incident points to temporary disruption of nickel refining capacity, which can reduce near-term supply and worsen availability expectations. Such operational setbacks typically create downward pressure for nickel prices over the next days to weeks.

title: Six workers injured after fire at Indonesia's Weda Bay nickel smelter | Kat Country 98.9
summary: A fire broke out at Indonesia’s Weda Bay nickel smelter on Halmahera, injuring six workers. The incident is under control, and only one of 23 smelting lines was affected, with other lines operating normally. The operator said investigations and repairs will occur in coming days.

title: Blackwolf Copper and Gold Ltd: Blackwolf Intersects 27.0 Meters Averaging 1.1% Copper, 1.9 g/t Gold, 32.8 g/t Silver and 1.0% Zinc or 3.1% Copper-Equivalent from Lookout Deposit at Niblack
summary: Blackwolf Copper and Gold reports drill results from the Niblack VMS project, including wider/thicker intervals averaging about 1.0% copper over tens of meters, supporting potential expansion. It also notes planned upgrades for larger drilling programs. The update is copper-positive technically, but likely too small for near-term copper price impact.

title: Trigon Receives Definitive Approval for Mining Licence to Restart Copper Production at the Kombat Mine, Namibia
summary: Trigon reports it has received definitive approval for a mining licence to restart copper production at the Kombat mine in Namibia. The update points to improved near-term production prospects, increasing expectations for copper supply and potentially weighing on copper prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: What Inflation? Export Prices Rise 17.4%, Import Prices Rise 10.8% (Copper And Nickel Fall 4%)
summary: The post reports US export prices up 17.4% and import prices up 10.8% year-over-year, framing expectations of inflation ahead of a Fed meeting. Despite earlier commodity strength, it states copper and nickel are down 4% that day, implying a near-term bearish reaction for both metals.

title: What Inflation? Export Prices Rise 17.4%, Import Prices Rise 10.8% (Copper And Nickel Fall 4%)
summary: The post cites a strong US export price rise (+17.4% YoY) and a higher import price index (+10.8%) ahead of the Fed. Despite the inflation backdrop, it says copper and nickel are down roughly 4% that day, while gold and silver are higher, suggesting near-term bearish pressure on industrial metals.

title: Sama Resources acquires 370 exploration claims following the discovery of a mineralised gossan at the new Lac Brule Nickel-Copper project in the Province of Quebec, Canada
summary: Sama Resources acquired 370 exploration claims for the Lac Brulé Ni-Cu project in Quebec after finding a mineralised gossan exposed over 115m strike length. Surface results show up to 0.52% nickel and 0.58% copper, plus high scandium, and follow-up airborne surveys are planned. No production timelines are provided.

title: China to release national reserves of copper, aluminum, zinc
summary: China’s National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration said it will release national reserves of copper and aluminium (and zinc) in batches to nonferrous processing and manufacturing firms via public bidding. The decision follows a State Council move to ensure supply and stabilize prices of bulk commodities, implying near-term downward pressure on metal prices.

title: China aluminum exports have likely peaked, CRU says
summary: CRU says China’s aluminum exports likely peaked as anti-dumping and tariff measures in Europe and the U.S. reduce demand for Chinese unwrought aluminum, pushing exports toward higher-value products elsewhere. CRU also cut 2021 production forecasts for Yunnan and Inner Mongolia due to energy-consumption pressure, with May output falling on power curbs.

title: Rio Tinto eyes hydrogen to fuel Aussie alumina refinery
summary: Rio Tinto and ARENA will spend about A$1.2mn on a feasibility study to see if clean hydrogen can replace natural gas at Rio’s Yarwun alumina refinery. The work targets lower emissions in alumina refining and supports broader Australia–Germany hydrogen initiatives, but does not signal near-term output changes.

title: China to release national reserves of copper, aluminum, zinc
summary: China’s National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration said it will release national reserves of copper and aluminium (and zinc) in batches. The move follows a State Council decision to ensure supply and stabilize bulk commodity prices, with releases to nonferrous processors and manufacturers via public bidding.

title: World Copper Announces Effective Date of Consolidation
summary: World Copper Ltd. announced a 1-for-3 share consolidation effective June 18, 2021, and reported completion of geochemical soil sampling for three distal porphyry copper targets at its Escalones project. The company is continuing permitting and plans to file an environmental application in June to obtain a drilling permit. No immediate output change is indicated.

title: China To Sell Off Reserves of Aluminum, Copper and Zinc In Order To Tame Prices
summary: The article headline says China will sell off reserves of aluminium and copper (and zinc) to help tame prices. Reserve sales typically boost short-term supply expectations, which can pressure spot and nearby futures for aluminium and copper over the next days to several weeks.

title: China To Sell Off Reserves of Aluminum, Copper and Zinc In Order To Tame Prices
summary: The article headline says China will sell off reserves of aluminium and copper (and zinc) to tame prices. Such reserve liquidation typically boosts near-term supply expectations, pressuring benchmark prices in the coming days as traders adjust for higher availability.

title: Chile Senators Pause to Ponder Copper Tax Implications
summary: Chile’s Senate will debate a proposed copper windfall/royalty tax with brackets linked to the copper price through mid-July. The industry argues the higher total tax burden threatens future investment, while opponents cite existing profit-based sliding taxes. The process includes hearings with major miners and unions.

title: Fabled Silver Gold Announces Private Placement Financing of Up to $6 Million in Connection with the Proposed Spin-Out of Copper Assets
summary: Fabled Silver Gold announced a best-efforts private placement tied to spinning out its wholly owned Muskwa copper project into Fabled Copper. Net proceeds from conventional receipts support general purposes, while flow-through proceeds fund exploration. The press release does not cite changes to production, supply, or large near-term copper market fundamentals.

title: NORNICKEL'S PALLADIUM FUND LAUNCHES FIRST NICKEL AND COPPER ETCS ON LSE
summary: Nornickel’s palladium fund launched its first nickel and copper ETCs on the LSE, broadening listed instruments for investors seeking exposure to these metals. While it is not tied to production, inventories, or trade flows, the launch may support modest near-term demand and sentiment for nickel and copper prices.

title: NORNICKEL'S PALLADIUM FUND LAUNCHES FIRST NICKEL AND COPPER ETCS ON LSE
summary: Nornickel’s palladium fund has launched its first nickel and copper exchange-traded commodities (ETCs) on the LSE. The new listings provide investors direct exposure to nickel and copper price movements, which could support near-term sentiment and flows into these metals.

title: Why China Can't Stop the Rally in Copper
summary: Copper prices eased from a record high after China tried to curb commodity gains, but the article argues the rally is far from finished. It cites ongoing supply constraints alongside growing demand, implying continued support for copper and potential for renewed price strength over the coming weeks.

title: Rio Tinto and ARENA to explore clean hydrogen usage in alumina refining
summary: Rio Tinto and ARENA will study replacing natural gas with clean hydrogen in alumina calcination at the Yarwun refinery. The A$1.2m feasibility work includes lab-scale simulation and preliminary engineering for a possible demonstration project. The goal is to cut emissions and support “green aluminium” pathways.

title: Hot Chili fast-tracks PFS on major Chile copper-gold project
summary: Hot Chili fast-tracked a pre-feasibility study for its large Costa Fuego copper-gold project in northern Chile, appointing Wood to update and expand on a prior PFS. The resource base has grown to about 724 million tonnes at ~0.4% copper, with plans for a sizable milling facility, supporting bullish copper sentiment.

title: Rockridge Resources Ltd.: Rockridge Intersects 1.95% Cu, 0.11 g/t Au, 7.41 g/t Ag, 0.53% Zn and 0.02% Co (2.34% CuEq) over 14.02m at Knife Lake Copper Project, Saskatchewan
summary: Rockridge Resources announced drilling results from its Knife Lake Copper Project in Saskatchewan, including an infill intercept of 1.95% copper over 14.02m. The company frames findings as encouraging for expansion of the near-surface VMS deposit. The news is exploration-focused and not immediate supply, but supports copper-positive sentiment.

title: Palladium One Mining Inc.: Palladium One Intercepts More High-Grade Nickel Including, 6.0% Nickel_Eq (13.9% Cu_Eq) Over 5.0 Meters at Tyko Nickel-Copper Project, in Ontario, Canada
summary: Palladium One reported Phase II drill results from its Tyko Ni-Cu-PGE project in Ontario, including multiple high-grade nickel-copper sulphide intervals and extended strike continuity (e.g., up to 6.0% Ni_Eq over 5.0 meters). The update may mildly affect sentiment on future Ni and Cu supply, but no production changes are indicated.

title: Orestone Mining Corp.: Orestone Drilling Intersects Tabular Gold-Copper Zones at Captain Indicating a Large Gold-Copper Porphyry System
summary: Orestone Mining reported drilling results at its Captain gold-copper project, intersecting wide gold-copper mineralized zones consistent with a large porphyry system. While the findings may influence longer-term copper supply expectations, the release does not indicate near-term production changes or disruptions that would likely affect copper prices in the next few weeks.

title: Palladium One Mining Inc.: Palladium One Intercepts More High-Grade Nickel Including, 6.0% Nickel_Eq (13.9% Cu_Eq) Over 5.0 Meters at Tyko Nickel-Copper Project, in Ontario, Canada
summary: Palladium One reported results from Phase II drilling at its Tyko Ni-Cu-PGE project in Ontario, extending strike length and confirming continuity of massive/semi-massive sulphide mineralization. Intercepts include high Ni_Eq and Cu_Eq (e.g., 6.0% Ni_Eq over 5.0 m). Early-stage results imply limited immediate market price impact.

title: Nobel29 Resources Corp. Commences Induced Polarization Surveys Over Priority Target Areas, Algarrobo Copper-Gold Project, Chile
summary: Nobel29 Resources begins induced polarization (IP) surveying over priority targets at its Algarrobo copper-gold project in Chile, following a magnetometer survey. About 80 line-kilometers are planned over six weeks, with high-priority areas in 3–4 weeks, to support integration with drilling and assays.

title: Kodiak Copper Corp.: Kodiak Adds Second Drill Rig at MPD Copper-Gold Porphyry Project in Southern British Columbia
summary: Kodiak Copper announced mobilizing a second drill rig to its MPD copper-gold porphyry project in British Columbia and expanding a fully funded 2021 drill program to up to 30,000 metres. Drilling will initially focus on step-out/infill at the Gate Zone, with eventual rig movement toward the Dillard Zone.

title: Wedgemount Resources Corp.: Wedgemount Commences Exploration Program at the Eagle Copper-Gold Property
summary: Wedgemount Resources begins a 2021 exploration program at its Eagle copper-gold property in British Columbia’s Quesnel Trough copper district. The release details target areas, prior drilling copper grades, and new VTEM anomalies, plus planned mapping, sampling, and IP work to refine drill targeting. It signals future exploration, not production.

title: Pacific Ridge Exploration Ltd.: Pacific Ridge Announces 2021 Exploration Plans; Drilling to Start Next Month at the Kliyul Copper-Gold Porphyry Project
summary: Pacific Ridge Exploration plans a fully funded ~2,500-m diamond drilling program starting in July at its Kliyul copper-gold porphyry project, alongside exploration at RDP and Redton. The company aims to extend historic copper-gold mineralization. The news is exploratory and does not indicate immediate supply disruptions or new production.

title: SPC Nickel Corp.: SPC Nickel Announces 3.15 % Nickel Equivalent over 10.5 Metres at Its Janes Ni-Cu-PGM Project
summary: SPC Nickel reported partial assay results from its Trench 1 drill program at the Janes Ni-Cu-PGM project in Ontario, including nickel and copper grades, and noted remaining results are expected in 3–4 weeks. The company presents nickel-equivalent using 30-day average metal prices, but no production or supply changes were announced.

title: Primary aluminium inventories shrank 29,000 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show China’s primary aluminium ingot social inventories across eight consumption areas fell by 29,000 mt from last Thursday to 890,000 mt as of June 17. Declines were reported in key regions including Nanhai, Shanghai, Wuxi and Gongyi, suggesting tighter near-term availability for aluminium.

title: Eagle Plains Resources Ltd: Eagle Plains' Partner Rockridge Resources Intersects 1.95% Cu, 0.11 g/t Au, 7.41 g/t Ag, 0.53% Zn and 0.02% Co (2.34% CuEq) over 14.02m at Knife Lake Copper Project, Saskatchewan
summary: Eagle Plains reported early drill results from Rockridge’s Knife Lake Project in Saskatchewan. Infill drilling at the Knife Lake Deposit intersected 1.95% Cu over 14.02m (plus Ag, Zn and Co). The release is a copper-focused exploration update, with no stated impacts to aluminium or nickel supply or demand.

title: Hannan Metals : Soil Sampling Defines Copper-Silver Mineralization over 18 kilometres at Tabalosos East
summary: Hannan Metals reports soil sampling results at its Tabalosos East prospect in Peru, confirming continuity of copper-silver mineralization over 18 km and highlighting multiple copper anomaly zones. Permitting and DIA baseline studies for advanced exploration, including diamond drilling, are ongoing, but there is no production or supply change.

title: Denis Klimentov SP: Nornickel's Global Palladium Fund Lists World's Only Physically Backed Copper and Nickel ETCs on London Stock Exchange: Metals Critical to Enabling the Clean Energy Transition
summary: Global Palladium Fund (backed by MMC Norilsk Nickel) launched physically-backed copper and nickel ETCs on the London Stock Exchange, later listing on Xetra, with the funds tracking spot prices and stored in Rotterdam. The release targets clean-energy investors but does not describe any immediate supply, demand, or inventory change.

title: SPC Nickel Announces 3.15 % Nickel Equivalent over 10.5 Metres at Its Janes Ni-Cu-PGM Project
summary: SPC Nickel reported partial assay results from initial drill holes at its Janes Ni-Cu-PGM project in Sudbury, highlighting disseminated sulphides with nickel and copper grades. The company expects further assays over 3–4 weeks but provides no production or supply-impact update; the news is exploratory rather than market-moving.

title: Nornickel launches Exchange Traded Commodities for nickel, copper on LSE
summary: Nornickel’s Global Palladium Fund launched exchange-traded commodities on the London Stock Exchange for nickel and copper. The ETCs track LME cash prices and are backed by metal stored in Rotterdam. Management highlights low expense ratios for investor access to base metals, with no mention of supply or demand changes.

title: Nornickel launches Exchange Traded Commodities for nickel, copper on LSE
summary: Nornickel’s Global Palladium Fund launched exchange-traded commodities for nickel and copper on the London Stock Exchange. The ETCs have low expense ratios and are designed to track LME cash prices, with metal backing stored in Rotterdam warehouses. The article signals improved market access, not physical fundamentals.

title: Why copper's drop from all-time highs may not mark the end of its run up in prices
summary: Copper fell from a record high after China tried to cool commodity prices, but the article argues the rally may continue. It cites China’s rapid economic recovery and expectations for major global government spending, especially on clean energy and clean transportation, which are copper-intensive and supportive for demand.

title: Sudan signs nine concession agreements for gold and copper mining_SMM
summary: Sudan signed nine mining concession agreements for gold and one copper concession with foreign and local firms across several states. The government highlighted gold export sales and recent steps to open precious metals trading and curb smuggling. The only copper element is a single concession, with no output figures or timing.

title: Serbia to Become Europe's Second Largest Copper Producer...
summary: Serbia received approval for mining at Zijin Mining Group’s Cukaru Peki copper-gold mine within the Timok project. The mine is expected to begin production in Q4 2021 and raise Serbia’s share of Europe’s copper output from 5% to 18%. Zijin Bor is investing $474 million in development.

title: LME copper eyes worst week since March on China sale, Fed
summary: London copper is set for its worst week since March as China plans to sell state copper reserves, aiming to curb the rally. A firmer dollar on expectations of earlier U.S. rate hikes adds pressure to dollar-priced commodities. LME aluminium is also slightly lower; nickel is up.

title: LME copper eyes biggest weekly drop in 15 mths on China sale plan, dollar
summary: London three-month copper is on track for its steepest weekly fall in 15 months after China announced plans to sell state copper and other metal reserves and the dollar firmed on expectations of earlier U.S. rate hikes. The stronger dollar and reserve-selling expectations pressured copper and also weighed on aluminium; nickel showed a smaller move.

title: What Was the Highest Price for Copper? | How it Happened
summary: Copper is described as hitting all-time highs on COMEX and LME on Jan. 29, 2026, with LME up sharply intraday. The rally is attributed to speculative buying, growth/data-center spending expectations, and tariff-related supply strains. It also cites ongoing mine supply disruptions and tightening fundamentals, especially versus demand.

title: LME copper eyes worst week in 15 months on firm dollar, China sale plan
summary: London copper is set for its worst weekly fall since March 2020 as China plans to sell state copper reserves and the dollar firms on expectations of faster U.S. rate hikes. Copper prices decline and Shanghai contracts also weaken. Aluminium and nickel move differently, but the macro/China-reserve backdrop is bearish.

title: SMM Evening Comments (Jun 18): Shanghai nonferrous metals declined for the most part, nickel advanced 0.09%_SMM
summary: SMM reports broad falls in Shanghai nonferrous metals, with copper down 2.63% and aluminium down 1.84%, citing weaker macro sentiment, a firmer US dollar and higher LME copper inventories. Nickel edged up 0.09% despite falling Chinese port nickel ore inventories, producing mixed near-term signals.

title: Copper on track for biggest weekly tumble since March 2020
summary: Copper is set for its biggest weekly fall since March 2020 after the Fed signaled monetary tightening and China said it will sell state reserves, lifting the dollar and pressuring metals. LME copper prices drop sharply, and LME inventories rise, suggesting increased near-term supply overhang.

title: SRHI Inc. (Three Valley Copper) Confirms Commitment to MTV,
summary: SRHI (Three Valley Copper) reports an arbitration with a minority shareholder and says operations at MTV will continue. It also highlights a Chile Senate review of a proposed mining royalty applying only if output exceeds 12,000 tonnes annually; MTV is expected to stay below that threshold in 2021–2022.

title: Copper gutted as China, Fed pressure metals
summary: Copper sold off sharply, down about 8.35% this week, after China announced plans to release copper and also aluminium from strategic reserves. The move coincided with Fed guidance toward higher rates and a stronger dollar, both of which tend to curb industrial metal demand and pressure prices further.

title: Quaterra Announces AGM Results, Appointment of Travis Naugle to the Board of Directors, and Drilling Update on MacArthur Copper Project in Nevada
summary: Quaterra reported AGM results and appointed new leadership for the year. It also provided a drilling update at the MacArthur copper project in Nevada: as of June 15, 4,618 ft had been drilled and initial assay results are expected in July. No results or supply impact were disclosed.

title: EMERGING MARKETS-Chilean peso leads Latam FX losses as copper prices plunge
summary: The article says the Chilean peso led Latam FX losses as copper prices plunged. The key takeaway is that weakening copper prices are the driving factor behind broader regional risk sentiment, implying immediate downside pressure for copper as traders react to falling quotations.

title: Walt Breitinger: Copper crushed, scorching temps
summary: The piece says copper has been “crushed,” falling 10% in a week, alongside lumber down 20%. It attributes the move partly to Federal Reserve Chair Powell signaling possible rate hikes, which can curb home sales and construction activity—reducing near-term demand for copper used in building wires and pipes.

title: Sudan signs nine concession deals for gold, copper mining
summary: Sudan signed nine mining concession deals for gold and one copper concession with eight local and foreign firms. The government is expanding private participation in gold exports and cracking down on smuggling. While the copper concession could affect future supply, specifics are insufficient to expect near-term copper price moves.

title: Tariff Alchemy: Turning Aluminum Tariffs Into Gold?
summary: The article criticizes a study claiming U.S. Section 232 aluminum tariffs had no adverse effects. It argues the analysis understates costs to downstream users and cites examples of firms absorbing retaliatory tariff burdens. It also highlights the U.S. depends on imported aluminum, implying tariffs can meaningfully affect aluminum market balances and prices.

title: UPDATE 1-BHP Spence copper mine workers in Chile to extend talks for two days
summary: BHP’s Spence copper mine workers in Chile have agreed to extend talks for two more days. The labor negotiation update matters for near-term copper supply expectations, as a stoppage would tighten output, while continued talks can lower the probability of an immediate shutdown, offering modest support to prices.

title: Copper hits near 10-week low as dollar firms after Fed rate view
summary: Copper prices fell to a near 10-week low as expectations of sooner-than-expected U.S. Fed tightening strengthened the dollar. The dollar’s rise made greenback-priced metals more expensive. China’s copper exports edged up, partly offsetting demand, but near-term sentiment remained bearish; LME/Shanghai nickel rose.

title: Operating rates across major aluminium processors remained largely stable amid softening wait-and-see sentiment due to decreased aluminium price volatility_SMM
summary: SMM says operating rates across major aluminium processors were largely stable, with only a small weekly dip, but primary alloy output is pressured by weaker car consumption amid Guangdong disruptions and high-temperature/pandemic shutdowns. Several downstream areas show softer new orders and off-season effects, supporting a cautiously bearish near-term aluminium outlook.

title: Copper sell-off eased on narrower import losses_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that copper sell-off eased as China’s import losses narrowed (from ~800 yuan/mt to <400 yuan/mt) and inquiries improved while import premiums under both warrants and bill of lading showed less deterioration. It also notes improving LME 0–3 contango, a higher SHFE/LME ratio, and expected premium stability amid surplus supply.

title: Copper prices to trend lower_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM expects copper to trend lower, driven by Fed tightening expectations and a stronger US dollar that have pressured SHFE prices. LME copper inventories rose sharply and State Reserve Bureau reserve sales weighed on sentiment. Although SHFE inventories fell and dip buying supported spot earlier, the net outlook remains bearish.

title: Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold acquires Plains Exploration & Production for $16.3bn
summary: Freeport-McMoRan completed its $16.3bn acquisition of Plains Exploration & Production, assuming debt and paying cash plus new shares. The purchase mainly adds oil and gas assets (California, Eagle Ford, Haynesville), while FCX’s existing copper operations are referenced. The deal supports copper-focused sentiment but details on copper output are limited.

title: Class 1 Nickel Provides Update on Phase 1 Drill Program at
summary: Class 1 Nickel reported that Phase 1 drilling at its Alexo-Dundonald property intersected massive and net-textured sulphide mineralization at Alexo North and Alexo South, with hand-held XRF indicating nickeliferous material. Core samples were submitted for confirmation assays, and Phase 2 drilling targeting BHEM-generated conductors is planned.

title: China's refined copper imports fell 4.68% in May compared with the same period last year._SMM
summary: China’s refined copper imports fell 4.68% year-on-year to 291,378.19 tons in May and also dropped 8.70% month-on-month. Imports from Chile fell sharply, down 28.06% from the previous month and 38.13% from a year earlier, suggesting weaker demand for refined copper.

title: Nickel in Electric Vehicles: A Booming Market
summary: The article argues EV battery growth will increase demand for Class 1 nickel and emphasizes Indonesia’s export ban that shifted supply toward other producers, including Canada. It cites an expected Class 1 nickel supply gap and rising EV nickel demand, supporting a bullish outlook for nickel.

title: US Copper Corp Announces US Listing on OTCQB Under Symbol | The Kingston Whig Standard
summary: US Copper Corp announced it received approval to list its shares on the US OTCQB marketplace under ticker USCUF starting June 22, while continuing to trade on TSX Venture and in Frankfurt. Management cited strong copper market interest but provided no operational or supply changes.

title: 10 Best Copper Stocks to Buy Now - Insider Monkey
summary: The piece discusses copper’s outlook but emphasizes recent pressure on prices. It links a potential near-term decline to expected US rate hikes that strengthen the dollar and lower demand, alongside China’s announcement of releasing copper from national reserves to manage commodity prices, weighing on the copper market despite longer-term bullish forecasts.

title: Money paid in fine for fuel spill on Taimyr to be used for Arctic cleanup
