It describes project team mobilization and ongoing social/environmental workstreams.

title: Ball intends to build new aluminum beverage packaging plants in UK & Russia, supporting the long term growth of our strategic partners.
summary: Ball Corporation said it intends to build new aluminum beverage can plants in the UK (East Midlands) and Western Russia, adding billions of cans per year from 2023. The company links the expansion to rising demand for aluminum beverage packaging categories, implying stronger near-term aluminum consumption expectations.

title: Alianza Minerals and Cloudbreak Discovery Make First Acquisition Under Southwest US Copper Alliance with Klondike Project, Colorado
summary: Alianza Minerals and Cloudbreak Discovery announce acquisition of the Klondike copper project in Colorado under a new Southwest US copper alliance. The property is in the Paradox Copper Belt near the Lisbon Valley mine, with historical outcrop assays up to 6.3% Cu. Work programs are planned to refine drill targets; no production is discussed.

title: London copper prices rise to US$9,383 a ton
summary: London copper prices increased to US$9,383 a ton, signaling buyers supporting higher levels in the immediate market. The surrounding listed items are broad financial headlines, but the only clear commodity-specific signal is the copper price move itself.

title: Ball Plans To Build New Aluminum Beverage Packaging Plants In UK & Russia To Meet Demand
summary: Ball Corp said it plans to expand aluminum beverage packaging capacity by building new can plants in the UK and Russia to meet growing demand. The projects would produce billions of cans annually from 2023, reflecting more brands choosing cans and sustainability goals, supporting expectations for higher aluminum consumption.

title: Ball to build new aluminum beverage packaging plants in UK & Russia
summary: Ball will build new aluminium beverage can plants in Western Russia and England’s East Midlands (UK), targeting faster growth in beer, energy drinks and newer can categories like hard seltzer. The UK project is progressing via site planning; the Russia project is also under development, expanding total capacity.

title: Primary aluminium inventories fell 26,000 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reported that China’s social aluminium inventories fell 26,000 mt on the week to 832,000 mt as of June 24. The decrease was mainly driven by lower stocks in Wuxi and Hainan. Falling inventories generally indicate tighter availability and can be price-supportive for aluminium.

title: Aluminium billet inventories fell to 120,800 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says aluminium billet inventories in major consumption areas fell to 120,800 mt, while outbound volumes rose. Despite supportive factors for prices (PBOC rate cut and Yunnan power rationing), downstream users are cautious and orders may decline, with expectations of higher inventories next week as outbound shipments drop.

title: C3 Metals Inc.: C3 Metals Acquires 100% of Flagship Jasperoide Copper-Gold Project, Peru
summary: C3 Metals agreed to acquire full ownership of Hochschild Mining’s interest in the Jasperoide copper-gold project in Peru by issuing 25.0 million shares. The deal consolidates control, aims to accelerate exploration, and adjusts a net smelter returns royalty. It signals positive copper project prospects but no immediate production impact.

title: UPDATE 1-Freeport Indonesia cancels Tsingshan copper smelter plans
summary: Freeport Indonesia plans have led to cancellation of Tsingshan’s copper smelter project. With the project not proceeding, market expectations for incremental refined-copper supply weaken, potentially tightening nearby refined-copper availability. This typically creates upward pressure on copper prices over the following days to weeks.

title: Aguila American Gold Limited: Aguila American Gold Secures Cora Copper Project in Southern Arizona
summary: Aguila American Gold announced it acquired 100% of the Cora copper project in Arizona via staking, describing historical oxide copper intercepts and geological indications of a potential porphyry setting. The release focuses on exploration preparation and demand narratives, without any near-term supply impact to copper markets.

title: Atico Mining Corporation: Atico Drills Additional High-Grade Copper-Gold Massive Sulphide Mineralization, Intercepting 3.32% Cu, 5.91 g/t Au, 74.51 g/t Ag and 4.70% Zn over 9.60 meters at La Plata Project in Ecuador
summary: Atico Mining reported additional high-grade copper-gold massive sulphide intercepts from drilling at its La Plata VMS project in Ecuador, extending mineralization along strike and at depth (including chalcopyrite-dominated intervals). While copper grades are highlighted, the release is exploration-focused and does not indicate immediate production, inventory, or trade changes.

title: C3 Metals Acquires 100% of Flagship Jasperoide Copper-Gold Project, Peru
summary: C3 Metals agreed to acquire Hochschild’s remaining interest to bring 100% ownership of the Jasperoide copper-gold project in Peru, issuing shares to Hochschild and adjusting NSR royalty terms. The update supports exploration acceleration but provides no near-term production or supply impacts for copper markets.

title: Updated PEA Planned for Cañariaco Norte Copper Project
summary: Candente Copper Corp. plans an updated Preliminary Economic Assessment for its Cañariaco Norte copper project, requesting engineering firms to study development options. The PEA will consider different initial concentrator throughputs, updated smelting costs, and ESG-focused tailings approaches. The update is project-level and not an immediate supply change.

title: Alcoa reports record profit in Q2 as aluminum prices soar
summary: Alcoa reported record Q2 profit as aluminum prices rose more than 60% year-on-year. The company earned $309 million and beat analyst estimates, with management pointing to continued economic recovery and rising end-market aluminum demand. It also cited ongoing inflationary pressure on raw materials and energy.

title: Nickel Stocks in Western Australia
summary: The piece outlines Western Australia’s role in global nickel, citing reserves and production figures and profiling key nickel assets including BHP’s Nickel West and IGO’s Nova operation. It highlights investment appeal and production volumes but provides no fresh supply disruption or policy change likely to move nickel prices immediately.

title: Shanghai bonded copper stocks fell 4,300 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Shanghai bonded copper stocks fell 4,300 mt to 435,500 mt as arrivals stayed smaller than the prior week’s build. The decline reflects domestic smelter maintenance, low import inflow, refined copper replacing scrap, and a newly opened import profit window that lifted foreign demand and reduced outbound inventories.

title: Exclusive: SMM's nickel team field trip - Yangzhou Yichuan Nickel Industry Co., Ltd._SMM
summary: SMM reports a field trip to Yangzhou Yichuan Nickel Industry, detailing its RKEF-based NPI/10–15% nickel-iron alloy production lines, laterite ore sourcing (notably from New Caledonia via SMSP), estimated consumption and electricity use, and planned clean-energy projects. The visit is more informational than a new supply or demand shock.

title: Nickel hits near 5-month high on strong demand, low supply
summary: Nickel prices surged to near five-month highs, supported by strong stainless-steel-linked demand and tight supply. LME three-month nickel rose up to 2.3% and SHFE August nickel up to 3.6%. Chinese nickel cathode output fell year-on-year, reinforcing the supply crunch.

title: Tin hits record on supply concerns, nickel jumps to 5-month high
summary: Nickel rose to a five-month high as Chinese stainless steel futures surged more than 6% amid strong consumption and a raw-material supply crunch, plus concerns about output cuts. The nickel move is linked to higher demand for corrosion-resistant stainless steel, supporting near-term price expectations.

title: Copper falls as dollar firms amid virus worries
summary: Copper prices declined as the dollar strengthened to near multi-month highs and investors grew nervous about the Delta-driven rise in coronavirus cases. This hurt demand expectations for industrial commodities. LME nickel edged higher, but LME aluminium and other metals weakened, reflecting broader risk-off sentiment.

title: Operating rate at major aluminium processors continued to drop, affected by power curtailment in Henan _SMM
summary: SMM reports operating rates at major aluminium processors fell to 70.7% from the prior week, mainly due to power curtailment in Henan forcing staggered use and output reductions at plate/strip and wire/cable producers. Aluminium prices are at a recent high, while off-season demand softening keeps output plans cautious, weighing on near-term sentiment.

title: Spot copper concentrate TCs broke through $50/mt mark_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports imported copper concentrate treatment charges (TCs) rising to about $50.82/mt, with spot trades at $51–52/mt and offers for September generally above $48/mt. A Shandong smelter equipment failure reshuffled flows, while rising overseas mine output and weak demand risk further TC increases.

title: Nornickel to invest $1.43 billion in new copper plant in Murmansk Region
summary: Nornickel will invest about $1.43 billion to build a new cathode copper facility in Monchegorsk, Murmansk Region, to replace a closed shop and reportedly double copper output. It will also add a Feinstein separation facility, citing favorable subsidies and energy-cost support. Construction is due to start in 2022.

title: Nornickel to invest $1.43 billion in new copper plant in Murmansk Region
summary: Nornickel will invest about $1.43 billion in its Murmansk Region to build a new cathode copper plant (“Big Copper”) in Monchegorsk, replacing an older shop closed in 2021. The project also includes a Feinstein separation facility and cites favorable subsidies and energy cost arrangements.

title: Kamoa-Kakula Begins Exporting Copper Concentrate Internationally as Production Ramps Up
summary: Kamoa-Kakula has begun exporting copper concentrate internationally as its production ramps up. The move indicates growing supply flowing into global concentrate markets, which can affect short-term concentrate availability and copper market expectations, potentially supporting copper prices if local tightness eases more slowly than demand.

title: Russian tax brews up perfect aluminium premium storm: Andy Home
summary: Russia plans an export tax on aluminium (15% or a minimum per tonne) from August to December, expected to lift up to $2.3bn. Following the June 28 announcement, U.S. and European aluminium physical premiums surged sharply, reflecting tighter availability and pass-through expectations from Rusal into local prices.

title: Russian tax brews up perfect aluminum premium storm: Andy Home
summary: Russia plans an export tax on aluminium (15% or a minimum per tonne) for Aug–Dec, applied to Rusal supply that is significant for Europe and the US. After the June 28 announcement, US and European duty-paid aluminium premiums jumped sharply, reflecting tighter expected imports and higher all-in prices.

title: NORNICKEL PRODUCES FIRST BATCH OF CERTIFIED CARBON-NEUTRAL NICKEL
summary: Nornickel says it has produced the first batch of certified carbon-neutral nickel. The certification may support demand from buyers seeking lower-emissions supply and could improve sentiment toward nickel supply quality. As an initial batch, the market impact is likely modest and primarily sentiment-driven.

title: Demand doubts and dollar dent copper sentiment
summary: Copper fell to four-week lows as a stronger U.S. dollar and worries about slowing China demand weighed on sentiment. Market attention included China’s continued releases from state reserves (including copper and aluminum) and rising LME and China warehouse inventories. Aluminium and nickel also declined, reflecting broad industrial metals pressure.

title: Attorneys argue suit over permit for a copper mine along a Smith River tributary
summary: Attorneys are arguing a lawsuit over a permit required for a planned copper mine near a Smith River tributary. The legal challenge could delay or obstruct project approvals, affecting near-term expectations for copper supply and potentially tightening availability, which may support copper prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Silver Elephant Appoints Peter Lightfoot as Technical Advisor for its Minago Nickel Project in the Thompson Nickel Belt
summary: Silver Elephant announced the appointment of Peter Lightfoot as a technical advisor for its Minago nickel project in Canada’s Thompson Nickel Belt. The update is related to project technical management rather than production, permitting, or financing changes, so it is unlikely to drive immediate nickel price moves.

title: Comex Copper Settles 2.82% Lower at $4.2105 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for July delivery settled 2.82% lower at $4.2105, down 12.20 cents per pound. It was the largest one-day decline in both dollar and percentage terms since June 17, and the contract fell for two consecutive sessions, dropping 2.83% over the two-day period.

title: Norilsk Nickel produced first batch of carbon neutral nickel — company
summary: Norilsk Nickel said it has produced its first certified batch of carbon-neutral nickel and will begin shipping nickel cathode volumes. The initial lot totals 5,000 tons, with up to 10,000 tons planned by year-end. The product will be tokenized on Atomyze and listed via a Vienna Stock Exchange mechanism.

title: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing : LME launches six new contracts, including lithium and scrap aluminium
summary: The LME, owned by HKEX, launches six new contracts including lithium hydroxide and scrap aluminium. The aluminium scrap contract targets North American used beverage can markets, with an additional aluminium premium duty contract for Europe. The contracts are based on industry pricing from Fastmarkets, Argus, and S&P Global Platts. No broader aluminium supply disruption is mentioned.

title: Aranjin Resources Ltd: Aranjin Resources Provides Update on Acquisition of Sharga Copper Project
summary: Aranjin Resources updated shareholders on its proposed acquisition of the Sharga Copper Project in Mongolia. The company is awaiting final TSXV approval and is arranging a US$1.5m convertible debenture financing, including a 1% net smelter returns royalty. The transaction remains on track but is not tied to immediate output changes.

title: CAVU Mining Corp.: CAVU Intersects Copper-Bearing Skarn at Hopper Copper-Gold Project and Updates on Current Drilling Program
summary: CAVU Mining reported 250 meters of drilling in three holes at its Hopper Copper-Gold project in Yukon, intersecting a skarn horizon with localized copper sulphides (including up to ~8% copper sulphides over ~2 meters) linked to an EM anomaly. Drilling paused due to nearby forest-fire safety clearance from authorities.

title: Guidance on the reassessment of copper and nickel production by Brazil's Vale_SMM
summary: Vale said it is re-evaluating 2021 copper and nickel production guidance after strikes at its Sudbury, Canada mine and flooding at Voisey’s Bay, Labrador, alongside refinery maintenance in Wales. Q2 nickel output fell 14.3% and copper 4%, prompting lower near-term supply expectations.

title: Guidance on the reassessment of copper and nickel production by Brazil's Vale_SMM
summary: Vale said it is reassessing its 2021 copper and nickel production guidance after a union strike at its Sudbury, Canada mine and flooding at Voisey’s Bay, plus maintenance at a Wales refinery that limits nickel. Q2 nickel and copper output fell quarter-on-quarter, signaling near-term supply pressure.

title: Material Matters: Coal, Iron Ore And Copper
summary: The piece expects a more volatile second half for commodities and highlights short-term bearish signals for copper. It points to peaking growth/inflation expectations, a potential Fed taper reducing liquidity, and changing market views on break-even inflation. It also mentions improving long-term demand but stresses near-term downside risk.

title: Shanghai copper near one -month low

title: South Australia rules out copper tax increase in boost for OZ, BHP
summary: South Australia said it will not raise taxes on copper production, a decision framed as supportive for local producers including OZ Minerals and BHP. The move comes as Chile, Peru and possibly Russia consider higher miner taxes to fund recovery plans, highlighting mixed regional policy risk for copper supply.

title: C3 Metals Inc.: C3 Metals Continues to Intersect High Grade Copper at Jasperoide Project, Peru Including 119 metres of 1.15% Cu and 0.37 g/t Au
summary: C3 Metals announced additional drill-hole assays from its Jasperoide copper-gold project in Peru, including long intervals with grades such as 118.71m at 1.15% Cu. Results support a skarn/porphyry system interpretation and are part of ongoing exploration; no production or supply effects are stated.

title: C3 Metals Continues to Intersect High Grade Copper at Jasperoide Project, Peru Including 119 metres of 1.15% Cu and 0.37 g/t Au
summary: C3 Metals says it continues to intersect high-grade copper at its Jasperoide project in Peru, including 119 metres of 1.15% Cu. The update is supportive for potential future copper supply, but it does not change near-term production or inventories, so any immediate copper price effect is likely minimal.

title: Palladium One Mining Inc.: Palladium One Expands the Tyko Sulphide Nickel-Copper Project to 24,500 hectares and Completes VTEM Survey
summary: Palladium One expanded its Tyko nickel-copper project footprint via earn-in agreements and claim purchases and completed a 3,100-kilometer VTEMmax geophysical survey. The company is conducting soil sampling and awaiting assays, citing drill intercepts with nickel and copper equivalent grades.

title: Palladium One Mining Inc.: Palladium One Expands the Tyko Sulphide Nickel-Copper Project to 24,500 hectares and Completes VTEM Survey
summary: Palladium One expanded its Tyko nickel-copper project footprint and completed a 3,100-kilometer VTEMmax geophysical survey, with ongoing soil sampling and pending assays. The company cites prior drill intercepts with high nickel and copper equivalents and adds new option/claim acreage, but no near-term production or supply changes.

title: Copper knocked by dollar's gains as Fed meeting in focus
summary: Copper prices fell 0.8% after a five-session run as a rebounding U.S. dollar and caution ahead of the Fed meeting pressured sentiment. Separate factors cited include Peru’s blockade disrupting Las Bambas mine operations, while heavy rains in China and aluminium production halts from floods offered some support.

title: Exclusive: Bandits steal truckloads of copper worth millions in southern Africa
summary: An exclusive report says bandits stole several truckloads of copper worth millions in southern Africa. The theft likely disrupts local copper deliveries and reduces near-term available supply for buyers, which can support short-term copper price expectations, particularly through local tightness and logistics uncertainty.

title: Marvel Completes Heliborne Survey on Duhamel Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Property, QC / Musil Steps Down
summary: Marvel Discovery reported completion of a heliborne magnetic and TDEM survey over its Duhamel Ni-Cu-Co (plus Ti-V-Cr) property in Quebec. The company plans interpretation and follow-up prospecting and diamond drilling, citing historic Ni and Cu intercepts, but provides no new production or confirmed discoveries.

title: LIVE FUTURES 27/07: Nickel reverses earlier gains, most LME metals down 1%-plus
summary: Nickel reversed earlier gains and most LME-listed metals were down at least 1% in the live futures update. The excerpt also includes Fastmarkets/Metal Bulletin procedural and methodology correction notes for certain aluminium and steel assessments, but the market update points to near-term bearish price pressure.

title: U.S. Copper Buyers Face World's Highest Prices as Demand Booms
summary: The article headline says U.S. copper buyers face the world’s highest prices as demand booms. This suggests strong near-term copper demand and tighter supply/availability conditions for physical copper, which would typically support higher copper prices over the coming days.

title: Going green: BHP trumps Twiggy in nickel deal, Rio to build $3.3b lithium mine
summary: BHP outbid Wyloo/Andrew Forrest to buy Canada’s Noront Resources, backing the Eagle’s Nest deposit in Ontario’s Ring of Fire, which is a major nickel and copper resource. Rio also announced a lithium project in Serbia. The focus on nickel for EV batteries is supportive for near-term nickel sentiment.

title: New Nickel Sulphide Mineralization discovered 1 km South of the Marbridge Nickel Mine at the Somanike Project in Quebec
summary: Class 1 Nickel announced new high-grade nickel sulphide intersections at its Somanike project in Quebec, including massive sulphides with reported Ni grades in a conductor trend near the historic Marbridge Mine. Follow-up geophysics and further drilling are planned, which may support nickel sentiment despite no near-term output.

title: US metals buyers paying highest ever premium for Aluminium
summary: U.S. buyers of physical aluminium ingot are paying a record premium of about 30 cents per lb ($670/tonne) over the LME cash price to source metal for processing plants. The article links this premium to aluminium prices near recent highs, suggesting tight near-term supply.

title: Copper advances on strong second-half outlook
summary: Copper rose on Wednesday as investors priced in a strong second-half outlook, citing falling inventories and rising premiums in top consumer China. Three-month LME copper gained 0.4% and September SHFE copper rose 0.3%. The move is linked to tighter market supply signals in ShFE inventories.

title: Copper prices rise on strong second-half outlook
summary: The piece reports that copper prices are moving higher, attributing the rise to a strong outlook for the second half of the year. Although broader market headlines are mixed, the core message is improving expectations for copper demand, which typically supports near-term price momentum.

title: Copper prices hover near multi-week highs on solid H2 outlook
summary: Copper prices hovered near multi-week highs as investors priced in a strong second-half outlook, supported by falling ShFE inventories and rising physical premiums pointing to solid demand. The article also flags expectations of a looser monetary policy and shows LME nickel and aluminium moving modestly, reinforcing bullish sentiment across industrial metals.

title: POSCO to build $200 mn nickel refining plant to ramp up battery materials
summary: POSCO Chemical plans to invest about $523m (600 billion won) to build a 60,000-ton cathode materials plant and is also described as building a $200m nickel refining plant. The expansion supports battery-material output and affects near-term expectations for refined nickel supply and nickel demand for cathodes.

title: POSCO to Build Nickel Sulfate Refinery
summary: POSCO plans to build a nickel sulfate refinery, expanding its ability to refine nickel into nickel sulfate. The project suggests improved supply of refined nickel products used in industrial and battery-related supply chains, which can support expectations for tighter refined nickel availability and a favorable near-term nickel price bias.

title: Lundin faces charges from Chile regulator over copper mine lapses
summary: Chile’s SMA has initiated legal proceedings against Lundin Mining over irregularities at its Candelaria copper mine. The regulator filed six charges, three grave, including excess explosives increasing emissions and non-compliance on freshwater consumption. Penalties could reach ~$23m and include revoking environmental credentials or closing the project.

title: Rising supply to push copper further below record peak: poll
summary: A Reuters poll expects copper to keep falling from record highs as abundant mine supply ramps up and China seeks to cap commodity prices. Aluminium Q4 forecasts also point lower prices amid potential demand moderation. Nickel faces downside risks from higher Indonesia supply and an increased 2021 surplus.

title: Experts Say Copper Shaping Up to be the New Oil as Demand Soars
summary: Commentary highlights Goldman Sachs’ view that copper is critical to the zero-emissions transition and may set all-time highs, forecasting very large demand growth through 2030. It frames electrification and renewables as needing copper and notes improving progress on Teck’s QB2 copper project and Neptune port upgrades.

title: Namibia Critical Metals Inc.: Namibia Critical Metals Announces Drilling Started at Grootfontein Gold and Nickel-Copper Project
summary: Namibia Critical Metals began RC drilling at its Grootfontein project in Namibia, targeting geophysical and geochemical anomalies related to magmatic copper-nickel-PGE mineralisation. The program is planned for several weeks and remains exploration-focused, with no reported production, reserves, or price-relevant supply changes.

title: Namibia Critical Metals Announces Drilling Started at Grootfontein Gold and Nickel-Copper Project Seite 4
summary: Namibia Critical Metals says drilling has started at its Grootfontein gold and nickel-copper project in Seite 4. The announcement points to ongoing work at a nickel-copper asset, which can modestly lift near-term sentiment for nickel and copper supply prospects versus no new development progress.

title: Union at BHP's Escondida copper mine urges members to strike
summary: A union at BHP’s Escondida copper mine in Chile urged members to vote to reject BHP’s contract offer and enable a legal strike. The union warns the offer is insufficient and that a prolonged stoppage would constrict tight global copper supplies, likely lifting already high copper prices. Workers vote this week.

title: Four arrested for copper thefts
summary: Calcasieu Parish deputies arrested four men accused of stealing copper wire and piping from a hurricane-damaged hotel and dismantling air conditioners to remove copper. Investigators allegedly found stolen copper at a suspect’s home and claim one man scrapped nearly 17,000 pounds of copper in seven months.

title: The Escondida copper union of BHP Billiton summoned its members to vote on the strike._SMM
summary: BHP’s Escondida copper union in Chile called members to vote on a potential strike, saying management’s contract offer is insufficient and workers fear an imposed deal. The union will also vote on BHP’s proposed contract treatment over the next days, raising short-term supply risk for copper.

title: Showa Denko Installs Additional Lines to Produce Aluminum Heat Radiators for xEVs
summary: Showa Denko said it is installing additional production lines at its Oyama plant to double capacity for aluminum heat radiators used in power modules for electrified vehicles. The extra line is slated to start in early 2022, aiming to meet rising demand for these aluminum components tied to xEV growth.

title: London copper rises as weaker dollar lifts metal's appeal
summary: London copper rose 0.6% as a weaker dollar improved non-USD buying appetite and Fed remarks reduced rate-hike expectations. LME nickel gained 0.8% while LME aluminium slipped 0.4%. ShFE copper and some other contracts fell, indicating mixed regional demand/FX-driven effects across metals.

title: Business Scoop » Showa Denko Installs Additional Lines To Produce Aluminum Heat Radiators For XEVs
summary: Showa Denko will double capacity at its Oyama plant to produce aluminium heat radiators for power modules used in battery and hybrid electric vehicles. The firm is installing additional lines with startup planned for early 2022, citing rising demand. The radiators use aluminium fins and vacuum brazing.

title: Man arrested after copper wiring stolen from electricity substation
summary: A man was arrested after an electricity substation in Farrington lost power following damaged fencing and stolen copper wiring. Police cite similar incidents across Leyland, where substations were targeted and power was cut to about 2,000 homes and businesses. Investigations continue, but the impact seems localized.

title: NORNICKEL REPORTS IFRS FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR 1H 2021 AND HOSTS CONFERENCE CALL ON AUGUST 5
summary: The article states that Nornickel reports its IFRS financial results for 1H 2021 and will host a conference call on August 5. As a key nickel producer, the update could affect market expectations for near-term nickel supply and pricing, though the excerpt provides no concrete operational details.

title: Copper rises as Fed spreads bullish mood through markets
summary: Copper rose after the Fed signaled it was “some ways away” from tapering and as China tried to calm regulatory fears, boosting risk sentiment and weakening the dollar. Additional support came from a potential strike at BHP’s Escondida mine and progress on a U.S. infrastructure bill.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: Talon Metals and Steelworkers Union Partner to Advance the Tamarack Nickel Project for US EV Battery Supply Chain
summary: Talon Metals and the United Steelworkers announced a workforce development partnership to advance the Tamarack Nickel Project in Minnesota for US EV battery supply. The project aims to build an integrated domestic nickel supply chain, including potential nickel sulphate processing, with planned mine and maintenance staffing.

title: Primary Aluminium Inventories Fell 51,000 mt on Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data showed China’s social aluminium inventories fell 51,000 mt week-on-week to 758,000 mt as of July 29 across eight consumption areas. Limited shipment efficiency and constrained south-China arrivals reduced inflows, while outbound volumes stayed relatively high. The article flags logistics as key to near-term inventory dynamics.

title: Aluminium Billet Inventories Fell to 99,000 mt on week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show aluminium billet inventories in five major consumption areas fell 20,600 mt to 99,000 mt week-on-week, a 17.2% drop, with declines in all regions due to Henan flood-related rail blockages. Outbound shipments rose on improved downstream buying, and arrivals should normalize next week.

title: Grizzly Discoveries Inc.: Grizzly Completes Phase 1 Exploration at the Robocop Copper-Cobalt Project, Southeastern British Columbia, Canada
summary: Grizzly Discoveries reports completion of Phase 1 sampling at its Robocop copper-cobalt project in southeast British Columbia, following VTEM/magnetic survey anomalies. Results are pending for multielement assays, with drill testing planned for fall 2021. The release cites historical high-grade Cu/Co/Ag intersections and new copper showings in float.

title: Russian fishing agency seeks $800mln in damages from Nornickel over fuel spill
summary: Russia’s state fishing agency Rosrybolovstvo filed a damages claim seeking 58.7 billion roubles (~$801 million) from Nornickel over an Arctic fuel spill in May 2020. The spill involved about 20,000 tonnes of oil products. The legal action may heighten costs and operational risk for nickel production.

title: Uzbek President Launches Construction of Copper Plant, Part of Almalyk Mining
summary: Uzbek President Mirziyoyev laid the foundation for Copper Processing Plant No 3 at the JSC Almalyk Mining and Metallurgical Complex. The project will process large volumes of ore and is targeted to reach 290,000 tonnes of copper cathode in the first phase, rising further by 2024-2028.

title: Comex Copper Settles the Month 0.87% Higher at $4.5200 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper futures (front month for August delivery) settled 0.87% higher at $4.5200 per pound, gaining 3.90 cents. The contract snapped a two-session losing streak and rose on most of the past sessions. The piece frames the move as improving near-term momentum despite being below recent highs.

title: Russian Fisheries Agency Seeks Damages From Nornickel For Arctic Fuel Spill
summary: Russia’s fisheries agency seeks about $800 million in damages from Nornickel over a 2020 Arctic diesel spill that affected rivers and fish. Nornickel already paid $2 billion, disputes the latest estimates, and says it will challenge methodology in court. Managers were arrested after the incident.

title: Sherritt Reports Strong Nickel and Cobalt Production in Q2 and Upgrades ESG Targets
summary: Sherritt’s Q2 update highlights higher finished nickel output at its Moa JV and improved financial performance, attributing gains partly to stronger realized nickel prices. It also discusses nickel market conditions—tight inventories on the LME and supply-side constraints—supporting expectations for firmer nickel pricing in the near term.

title: Shanghai Bonded Copper Stocks Fell 19,000 mt on Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Shanghai bonded copper stocks fell by 19,000 mt to 409,600 mt as de-stocking intensified for a third consecutive week. SMM attributes the drawdown to relatively strong domestic consumption and high domestic premiums that support imports. Import profits helped some cargoes clear customs, further reducing bonded inventories this week.

title: Glencore H1 Own Sourced Copper Production Up 2%
summary: Glencore said its own-sourced copper production rose 2% to 598,000 tonnes in H1, while cobalt increased 3%. Nickel production fell 14% to 47,700 tonnes due to planned maintenance at Murrin and issues at Koniambo. Zinc, gold, and silver also moved higher.

title: SHEF to LME Nickel Ratio Reached High Early This Week, Encouraging Inflow of Spot in Bonded Areas_SMM
summary: SMM reports the SHEF to LME nickel ratio climbed to around 7.55 early this week, indicating improved arbitrage. Small opportunities for importing spot nickel plate into bonded areas emerged, encouraging spot inflows domestically. Market activity remains mostly deal-driven, with Russian warehouse and other quotes cited.

title: Pacific Ridge Exploration Ltd.: Pacific Ridge's Common Shares Trading on The OTCQB; Kliyul Copper-Gold Project Update
summary: Pacific Ridge announced its Kliyul copper-gold project drill program was temporarily delayed by a wildfire closing the access road, now brought under control. Camp construction is nearly complete and the drill rig is expected to arrive soon, with drilling to commence shortly. The release provides copper-gold project context and prior intercepts.

title: Glencore upgrades outlook on earnings, but cuts output forecast on coal, zinc, nickel  | 30 July 2021
summary: The article headline says Glencore upgraded its earnings outlook but cut its output forecast for coal, zinc, and nickel. A reduction in expected nickel production can shift short-term supply expectations and affect nickel pricing. The magnitude and timing are not provided in the excerpt.

title: Botswana's copper industry expected to bounce back as mine opens
summary: Botswana’s Khoemacau Copper Mine is set to open near Maun after a five-year pause, following first batches of copper-silver concentrate at the Boseto plant. The mine is projected to produce about 165,000 tonnes of high-grade concentrate annually, boosting expected copper output and increasing supply expectations.

title: TCs for Copper Concentrate Reached $60/mt amid Rebounding Market Trade_SMM
summary: SMM reports copper concentrate treatment charges rising to around $60/mt, with weekly and monthly indices climbing significantly. Trade rebounded but negotiations were mixed as sellers resisted higher TCs amid strike risks in Andina/Escondida and shipment blockades affecting Las Bambas. Higher TCs support smelters and encourage shipment decisions.

title: Copper's run to record highs may not be over yet
summary: Copper futures remain close to record levels, trading about 5% below the peak. Despite a recent pullback, the piece cites tight supplies and improving industrial demand as reasons prices could climb further. It also notes copper’s positive monthly momentum, with futures projected to gain roughly 3%.

title: Mich Resources to Acquire Advanced Copper Exploration Project in Peru via Reverse Takeover
summary: Mich Resources announced an RTO to acquire the Pecoy advanced-stage copper exploration project in Peru for cash and share consideration. The company plans to verify historical drilling and prepare an updated technical report, with closing targeted for Q4 2021. No near-term production or supply disruption details are provided.

title: Workers at world's biggest copper mine in Chile agree to strike: union
summary: Workers at BHP’s Escondida copper mine in Chile approved a strike after rejecting the latest employer offer. A vote ended Saturday night with 2,164 votes for striking versus 11 for accepting. As Chile is the top global copper producer, the action raises near-term supply risk and price support.

title: Workers at world's biggest copper mine in Chile agree to strike
summary: Workers at the world’s biggest copper mine in Chile have agreed to strike. The planned labor action raises the risk of reduced copper output in the near term, likely tightening supply and supporting market expectations for firmer copper prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Workers At World's Biggest Copper Mine In Chile Agree To Strike
summary: Workers at BHP’s Escondida copper mine in Chile voted overwhelmingly to strike after rejecting a compensation offer. The dispute centers on a one-off bonus, career development, and education benefits. As the mine is a major global copper source, the risk of output disruption supports bullish copper price expectations in coming days.

title: Union declares strike in world's LARGEST copper mine in Chile after labor negotiations fail — RT World News
summary: A union voted to approve a strike at Escondida, the world’s largest copper mine in Chile, after labor negotiations failed. Workers are demanding better work conditions, benefits, and an additional bonus. BHP says it has offered improvements and will attend government-mediated talks, but strike risk is rising.

title: Emirates Global Aluminium, Gulf Extrusions sign agreement on industrial by-products
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium signed an agreement with Gulf Extrusions to reuse industrial by-products. Gulf Extrusions will supply about 450 tonnes of consumed caustic soda monthly for use in Emirates Global’s alumina refinery. The circular-use plan reduces demand for raw bauxite and caustic soda and supports sustainable, potentially lower-cost aluminium production.

title: Aluminium Bahrain B S C : Alba Discloses its Financial Results for the Second Quarter and H1 of 2021
summary: Aluminium Bahrain reported sharply higher Q2 and H1 2021 profits, attributing revenue growth mainly to higher LME prices, partially offset by slightly lower sales volumes. It cites improved demand trends, higher smelting margins, and LME inventories down year-on-year with lower cash averaging, overall supportive of aluminium price sentiment.

title: Copper Inventories in Major Trading Markets up 5,700 mt over Weekend_SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s copper social inventories in major trading markets rose 5,700 mt to 155,900 mt over the weekend, the first increase since May 21. Shanghai (+400 mt) and Guangdong (+5,600 mt) drove most of the gain, attributed largely to higher copper imports. Further import inflows may trigger re-stocking.

title: Glencore to purchase $10.5m worth stake in copper miner Hot Chili
summary: Glencore will buy a 9.99% stake in Chile-based Hot Chili for $10.5m and related agreements will back completion of the feasibility study for the Costa Fuego copper-gold project. Hot Chili will grant Glencore offtake for over 60% of concentrate production for eight years.

title: Aluminium Prices Broke Through 20,000 yuan/mt on Supply Disruptions_SMM
summary: SMM reports SHFE and LME aluminium rising sharply above 20,000 yuan/mt amid supply disruptions. Truck transport in Henan remains impaired after flooding, while power curtailment in south-west China tightens local aluminium production. A weaker US dollar and rising SHFE lift LME. Inventory decline, COVID impacts, and possible reserve releases are key.

title: Vedanta Aluminium becomes India's largest green power purchaser
summary: Vedanta Aluminium says it became India’s largest green power purchaser on IEX’s Green Term-Ahead Market, sourcing 354 million units of solar and non-solar renewables for its Jharsuguda integrated aluminium facility in Q1 FY22. The company links this to lower emissions and plans a shift toward low-carbon energy.

title: Caserones, Andina copper mines in Chile undergoing govt mediation following strike vote
summary: Caserones and Andina copper mines in Chile are reportedly undergoing government mediation following a strike vote. The development introduces near-term uncertainty about mine operations and potential supply disruption. That supply-risk backdrop is generally supportive for copper prices over the next several days to a few weeks.

title: Copper claws higher on softer dollar, hopes for China stimulus
summary: Copper rebounded as the dollar weakened and traders increased hopes for China stimulus after soft factory data. Supply tightness was also cited following recent floods in China, alongside potential labor disruption in Chile. The report notes gains in LME copper, aluminium, and nickel alongside expectations of bullish base-metal momentum in August.

title: Hellenic Minerals completes nickel sulfate hexahydrate facility in Cyprus
summary: Hellenic Minerals says it has completed a nickel sulfate hexahydrate facility in Cyprus. Nickel sulfate is an important input for nickel downstream processing, so the new capacity can modestly improve near-term expectations for nickel-related supply tightness, supporting nickel prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Optimistic about the long-term prospect of copper market zinc giant Nexa Resources plans to develop copper projects_SMM
summary: Nexa Resources said it plans to increase investment in copper, reviewing expansions and potential new projects and acquisitions across the Americas and Africa. After COVID-related interruptions in Peru and a Brazil smelter shutdown, production has rebounded. While focused on long-term bullish copper prospects, forecasts suggest supportive sentiment for copper prices.

title: The new hydrometallurgical unit of Hellenic Minerals Nickel Sulfate Project has been completed._SMM
summary: Hellenic Minerals says its new hydrometallurgical plant for producing nickel sulfate hexahydrate (NiSO4•6H2O) has been completed and commissioned, enabling commercialization. The facility targets annual output of 44,000 tons of nickel sulfate (~10,000 tons metallic nickel) and plans early export via a Swiss trader.

title: Taber Extrusions Announces Larger Machining Center To Compliment Their Larger Aluminum Extrusion Capabilities
summary: Taber Extrusions announced it added a new Haas VF-12 CNC machining center to support its larger aluminum extrusion capabilities. The company says the added in-house machining capacity reduces processing time and costs for long aluminum profiles and can work across various aluminum alloys for sectors like automotive, defense, transportation, and marine.

title: Copper Import Profits Incentivised Inquiries_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says Yangshan copper import premiums increased (warrants up, B/L up) as the SHFE/LME copper price ratio improved, narrowing losses for the August contract. Customs clearance accelerated and Shanghai bonded-zone inventories fell for the third week. Firm domestic spot quotes and improved import profits boosted demand and trading volumes.

title: Nickel Ore Prices Continued to Rise, Shipping Rates Unlikely to Fall from Highs_SMM
summary: SMM says CIF prices for Ni1.5% ore averaged $81.5/wmt on July 30, up $2.5/wmt from the prior week, with some NPI buyers paying more to restock. Shipping rates from the Philippines to China stayed high/flat and are unlikely to fall due to COVID customs measures and typhoon impacts.

title: Global Battery Metals Ltd: Global Battery Metals Receives Option Payment from Minsur for Lara Copper Project
summary: Global Battery Metals said it received a second US$200,000 option payment from Minsur for the Lara Copper Project and expects fieldwork to start next month, including relogging, geological mapping and geophysics, with drilling planned after permitting. GBML retains a 0.75% net smelter royalty.

title: Grid Metals Corp. Provides Update on Exploration Activities at Bannockburn Nickel and East Bull Lake Palldium Properties
summary: Grid Metals reports completion of an eight-hole drill program at its Bannockburn nickel project with seven remaining holes awaiting assays, while East Bull Lake sampling and metallurgical tests are progressing for PGM-focused targets that may include copper/nickel recovery. No new price-relevant assay or production outcomes are provided.

title: Highland Copper announces the sale of non-core assets to Sweetwater Royalties and a C$26 Million Private Placement
summary: Highland Copper announced the sale of its non-core UPX properties in Michigan for US$3 million plus assumption of a US$15 million note, and plans a C$26 million private placement to eliminate cash indebtedness. The changes relate to copper projects, but they do not imply immediate market-wide supply shifts.

title: Western Copper and Gold Files Preliminary Economic Assessment on Casino Project
summary: Western Copper and Gold filed a NI 43-101 technical report containing a preliminary economic assessment for its Casino copper-gold project in Yukon, Canada. The results were previously released, and the update mainly reflects project development rather than immediate production, supply disruptions, or demand changes affecting copper prices in the near term.

title: Lara Exploration Ltd.: Option Payment Received from Minsur for the Lara Copper Project in Peru
summary: Lara Exploration reports receipt of a US$200,000 second option payment from Minsur for the Lara Copper Project in Peru and outlines near-term fieldwork plans, mapping, and permitting for a later drilling campaign. The update is development-stage and does not indicate immediate supply or demand changes for copper.

title: Tertiary looks to acquire majority stakes in Zambian copper licenses
summary: Tertiary Minerals’ subsidiary Luangwa Minerals agreed to option up to a 90% interest in five Zambian copper exploration licences, including Jack’s Licence, through staged investments and environmental permitting approvals. The deal targets further exploration of a copper mineralised trend but does not signal production changes imminently.

title: Vale reaches tentative agreement with Sudbury nickel miners' union
summary: Vale reached a tentative five-year agreement with Sudbury nickel miners’ union members. The pact includes higher monetary terms, preserves retiree health benefits, and includes a $2,500 August payment for pandemic efforts. The deal will be voted on Tuesday after members rejected earlier offers over benefits and wage issues.

title: Arizona's Second-Largest Labor Union Urges Congress To Block Copper Mine
summary: Arizona’s Teamsters union and tribal groups are urging Congress to block Rio Tinto’s proposed Resolution Copper mine at Oak Flat, a culturally sacred site. The Save Oak Flat Act would reverse a 2014 land swap, and the Forest Service has put the final environmental review on hold, delaying the project indefinitely.

title: EPA Settles with Libertas Copper Over Wastewater Discharges
summary: The EPA settled with Libertas Copper over alleged unpermitted discharges from its smelting facility in Leetsdale, Pennsylvania, including wastewater containing copper and nickel among other pollutants. The settlement requires environmental audits, updated management systems, and an $861,500 penalty. It signals compliance enforcement but no clear near-term capacity loss.

title: Material Matters: Iron Ore, Copper & Nickel
summary: Broker commentary points to bullish near-term moves in copper and nickel. Citi expects copper prices to rally further as the balance tightens and demand/structural de-stocking improves. Morgan Stanley highlights exceptionally strong nickel demand and several mine/shipping disruptions that keep the market tight into the second half.

title: Material Matters: Iron Ore, Copper & Nickel
summary: The article is highly bullish on copper and nickel. Citi expects copper to rally 10–12% to about $5/lb over the next three months on tightening balances and improved refined demand. Morgan Stanley flags exceptionally strong nickel demand amid mine disruptions, with prices lifted by higher stainless and EV-linked battery demand.

title: London copper rises on weak dollar, virus concerns dent demand outlook
summary: London copper rose 0.5% on a weak dollar, but prices were tempered by fears that Delta-variant COVID outbreaks in major Chinese cities will weaken industrial activity and copper demand. Traders also watched U.S. jobs data for rate cues. LME aluminum edged up and nickel was slightly lower.

title: Nickel 28: nickel production increased by 2% in the second quarter compared with the same period last year. Sales increased by 45%._SMM
summary: Nickel 28 Capital reported improved Q2 results for its Ramu nickel-cobalt mine in Papua New Guinea. Nickel production rose 2% year-on-year to 7,773 tons, while nickel sales increased 45% to 10,975 tons. The company said the quarter met guidance amid rising nickel and cobalt market prices.

title: Gabbs Metallurgical Test Work Achieves Average Recoveries of 97.2% for Gold and 95.2% for Copper in Sullivan Oxide Zone
summary: Test work at the Gabbs Sullivan oxide zone reportedly achieved average recoveries of 95.2% for copper (and 97.2% for gold). Higher recoveries can improve anticipated copper production and concentrate performance, which may modestly support copper market expectations in the near term.

title: Nickel Prices to Stand High amid Supply Shortage in August_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports nickel prices rising in July to a February high, with LME warehouse stocks continuing to fall. It expects August prices to remain supported by tight supply, stable stainless steel raw-material conditions, and strong new-energy nickel briquette demand. Indonesia pandemic risks could delay upstream capacity, reinforcing bullish sentiment.

title: Golden Arrow Identifies Multiple Target Horizons and Announces First Drill Program at Rosales Copper Project, Chile
summary: Golden Arrow Resources announced additional TEM geophysical surveying at its Rosales copper project in Chile, identifying deeper conductive targets and planning an initial 3,000 m reverse-circulation drilling program. The company believes the data supports a manto-style copper model. The news is exploration-stage and does not change production or inventories.

title: Amarc Resources Ltd.: Amarc Receives Additional Funding From Freeport-McMoran Mineral Properties Canada Inc. To Advance Exploration Activities at Its Joy Copper-Gold Porphyry District, BC
summary: Amarc Resources said Freeport-McMoRan increased its first-year contribution to Amarc’s Joy Cu-Au exploration program by 37.5% to CDN$5.5 million, mainly to expand diamond drilling. The company plans to announce initial exploration results later in the summer, with no near-term production impact disclosed.

title: Element 29 Resources Inc.: Element 29 Commences Drilling at Its Elida Copper Project
summary: Element 29 Resources began a 4,000 m drill program at its Elida porphyry copper-molybdenum project in Peru to expand and upgrade known copper mineralization and potentially estimate a resource. The article does not indicate any near-term production, export, or demand changes that would move metal prices immediately.

title: Copper drifts as focus turns to U.S. jobs data
summary: Copper prices drifted sideways ahead of U.S. non-farm payrolls, which are expected to clarify the timing of Federal Reserve stimulus tapering and affect market liquidity. The dollar stayed near lows, while Delta COVID-19 concerns weighed on China’s demand; Yangshan premium improved. Aluminium slipped modestly, suggesting limited incremental impact.

title: Vale Nickel Strike Ends as Canadian Miners Accept Wage Offer
summary: BNN Bloomberg reports that a Vale nickel strike has ended as Canadian miners accept a wage offer. The resolution should restore nickel supply flows that were previously disrupted by labor action, reducing short-term tightness expectations and likely putting downward pressure on nickel prices over the next days.

title: Chile's copper output up 2.3% in June on Codelco boost; Escondida down
summary: Chile’s copper output is reported to have increased 2.3% in June driven by higher production at Codelco, though Escondida is down. The net effect implies mixed but slightly improved Chilean supply conditions, which can pressure near-term copper price expectations.

title: Brigadier Makes New Precious Metal Rich, Copper Discovery in Previously Unexplored Area at Picachos
summary: Brigadier Gold reports analytical trench results at its Picachos gold-silver-copper project in Mexico, including copper grades up to 1.2% Cu in selected intervals and copper-dominant geochemistry over parts of the trench. The update suggests potential expansion at depth but does not confirm mineable reserves, limiting near-term price impact.

title: Vale Warns Canada Nickel Ramp-up Will Stretch Into Next Quarter
summary: Vale warns that its nickel ramp-up in Canada will extend into the next quarter. The delayed production trajectory suggests less nickel supply than previously expected over the near term, which can tighten market balances and support nickel prices in the coming days to weeks.

title: Vale warns Canada nickel ramp-up will stretch into next quarter
summary: Vale warns that its Canada nickel ramp-up will extend into the next quarter rather than reaching the planned schedule. The delay suggests a slower increase in near-term nickel supply, supporting expectations for tighter market availability and potentially higher nickel prices over the coming weeks.

title: Hussey Copper paying $861K in a proposed settlement
summary: Hussey Copper, a Leetsdale copper manufacturer, agreed to a proposed DOJ/DEP civil settlement requiring a $861,500 payment, wastewater and compliance audits, corrective measures, training, and future-violation penalties. The case follows criminal charges for knowingly discharging excess pollutants, including copper, into the Ohio River.

title: China's imports are reshaping the global aluminium market
summary: China imported an additional 158,000 tonnes of primary aluminium in June, taking its half-year total to 744,000 tonnes. The report suggests China has continued accessing global supplies since early last year, implying reduced availability elsewhere and potential near-term support for aluminium prices as imports rise.

title: Ero Copper reports record cash flow from operations of $85.1 million in the second quarter
summary: Ero Copper reported record quarterly cash flow from operations of $85.1 million, driven by strong performance at its operations and elevated copper prices. At the MCSA complex, it produced 10,898 tonnes of copper in concentrate and maintained output despite scheduled mill maintenance, reiterating 2021 guidance.

title: Chile increases copper production 2.3% in June | Business
summary: Chile’s state copper commission Cochilco said June 2021 copper production rose 2.3% year on year to 477,300 tonnes. Codelco output increased 14.9%, while Collahuasi fell 6.7%. Higher Chilean supply from the major producing hub can weigh on short-term copper prices.

title: Copper falls on firm dollar, virus surge sparks demand fears
summary: Copper prices fell as COVID-19 outbreaks spread, raising fears of weaker base-metals demand, while a firmer dollar pressured greenback-priced commodities. Reuters cites lower Shanghai copper and mixed but weaker nearby base-metal performance, including comments about premiums and weaker volumes in China.

title: Primary Aluminium Inventories Fell 26,000 mt on Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data showed China’s social aluminium inventories across eight consumption areas fell 26,000 mt on the week to 732,000 mt as of Aug 5. The drop was mainly attributed to low arrivals in Gongyi and Hainan, with Henan also affected by inefficient truck transport amid pandemic conditions.

title: Aluminium Billet Inventories Up to 103,200 mt on Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reported aluminium billet outbound shipments fell to 46,100 mt as downstream buying turned quiet amid surging aluminium prices. Social inventories in major consumption areas rose to 103,200 mt, with gains across most regions. Pandemic-driven production cuts and power-related plant reductions weakened demand, suggesting inventories may climb further next week.

title: Tertiary Minerals acquires Zambian copper prospects
summary: Tertiary Minerals, via its Zambian subsidiary, entered an option agreement to acquire up to 90% interest in exploration licences in Zambia prospective for copper. The focus is Jack’s Licence, where historic drilling reported intercepts around 1–1.6% copper, suggesting a trend needing further exploration.

title: Copper slips for fifth day on China demand concerns
summary: Copper prices fell for the fifth straight day on the LME as investors worried about top consumer China’s demand outlook. The decline pulled prices away from an earlier all-time peak, with broader macro signals (weaker equities, firmer dollar) reinforcing a bearish sentiment near term.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: Talon Metals Grows the New 'Pool' of Massive Nickel-Copper Mineralization at the Tamarack Nickel Project
summary: Talon Metals reports additional drilling results in the CGO West area at its Tamarack nickel-copper project, intersecting thick mixed and massive sulphide mineralization (assays pending). The update is positive for potential resource expansion but does not indicate production or inventory changes, so short-term nickel and copper price impact is likely limited.

title: Pacific Ridge Exploration Ltd.: Drilling Underway at Pacific Ridge's Kliyul Copper Gold Porphyry Project
summary: Pacific Ridge announced diamond drilling is underway at its Kliyul copper-gold porphyry project in British Columbia, targeting expansion of known mineralization with at least 2,500 metres planned. Historical holes reported meaningful copper-gold intercepts, but no new production or resource changes were provided, limiting short-term price impact.

title: Talon Metals Grows the New 'Pool' of Massive Nickel-Copper Mineralization at the Tamarack Nickel Project
summary: Talon Metals reported further thick intersections of nickel-copper massive sulphide mineralization in the CGO West area near its Tamarack project in Minnesota. Several new drill holes hit multiple meters of Ni-Cu mineralization, but assays remain pending for these new results, limiting immediate confirmation of grades and tonnage.

title: Diatreme signs MOU with Metallica for Australian copper/gold project
summary: Diatreme Resources signed a binding MoU with Metallica Minerals to earn into the Clermont copper/gold project in Queensland, via staged exploration expenditures tied to earning up to a 75% stake. The deal covers drilling and JV planning, but does not indicate near-term copper production changes.

title: Ubique Minerals Limited: Ubique Minerals to Acquire up to 80% of the Port Loko Bauxite Deposit and Partially Developed Mine in Sierra Leone
summary: Ubique Minerals entered a non-binding MoU to earn up to 80% of the Port Loko bauxite deposit in Sierra Leone via funding infrastructure, infrastructure spend, and a production shipment trigger. The project was previously halted due to COVID and is described as partially developed, with potential restart in a short timeframe.

title: Is the Economy in Trouble? Copper Prices Are a Worrying Sign.
summary: The article notes that copper prices are continuing to fall and warns that a further break below a key level could signal a worsening economic outlook. It frames the copper sell-off as an indicator of weakening demand expectations, implying continued downward pressure on copper in the near term.

title: Copper edges down as dollar firms
summary: Copper prices fell in London and were set for a weekly decline as a stronger U.S. dollar increased the cost of dollar-priced metals. LME aluminium and nickel also dipped slightly. The dollar firmed ahead of U.S. employment data that could support faster policy tightening.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports Shrank 63,000 wmt to 5.767 Million wmt_SMM
summary: SMM data show Chinese nickel ore inventories fell by 63,000 wmt to 5.767 million wmt by Aug 6, with Ni content at 45,400 mt. Stocks at major ports also dropped. Frequent pickups and slowed restocking amid tight supply/demand are attributed to higher nickel ore prices.

title: Copper rises as Chile strike threat sparks supply worries
summary: Copper prices rose as unions at Chile’s Escondida mine urged workers to prepare for a strike over contract disputes. Analysts cited broader strike risk across Chilean operations unless mediation ends. The move was tempered by a firm U.S. dollar ahead of U.S. jobs data, but supply worries still lifted copper futures.

title: Copper gains as world's biggest mine preps for strike
summary: Copper rose 0.8% as Chile’s Escondida mine, the world’s largest, told workers to prepare for a union strike after rejecting a contract offer. This raised expectations of reduced near-term copper supply. Gains were tempered by concerns about weaker Chinese demand amid the coronavirus outbreak, stocks and the dollar.

title: Shanghai Bonded Refined Nickel Stocks Shrank 600 mt on Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Shanghai bonded refined nickel stocks fell by 600 mt for the week. SMM notes limited opportunities for new spot imports into bonded areas, with inflows mainly prior fixed-ratio resources. Domestic and overseas inventories remain low, while nickel under warrant is quoted high, supporting firmer market sentiment.

title: Peru copper production rises in H1
summary: Peru’s copper production reportedly rose in the first half. Higher output from a major producing country can increase expectations for copper supply availability, potentially affecting near-term supply-demand balance and pricing. The magnitude of the price impact would depend on whether the increase translates into meaningful spot or inventory changes.

title: Vedanta Aluminium scores a hat-trick at SEEM Awards
summary: Vedanta Aluminium Business, India’s largest aluminium producer, won multiple energy-management awards for its Jharsuguda smelters and captive power assets. It highlights reduced energy use, renewable power procurement, and lower GHG intensity targets, including digital smelter and ISO 50001 initiatives, without stating near-term changes to output or trading flows.

title: Five arrested in NC for copper cable theft, vandalism
summary: South Africa’s Hawks arrested five suspects for stealing copper cables and damaging mine water-supply infrastructure at Ekapa Minerals’ properties in Kimberley. Authorities recovered 52kg of copper cables. The vandalism caused infrastructure damage valued at R3.6 million, with arrests made in August 2021 after theft in April.

title: Something Interesting Is Happening In Copper Markets
summary: The piece says an unusual COMEX-LME copper arbitrage reflects imbalanced inventories, with the U.S. short physical copper versus LME supplies, skewed toward Asia. COMEX money-manager shorts have fallen, and Citi estimates U.S. copper consumption jumped 22% y/y, implying tightness and possible delivery premium as imports tighten.

title: Copper Prices to Move Rangebound in Wide Range_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: US non-farm payrolls beat expectations, lifting the US dollar and pressuring copper. Fed/BoE signals support earlier monetary tightening. On the supply side, China’s cathode output is higher, concentrate TCs rose, and smelters stay profitable, while imported inflows and off-season inventory weigh on prices. Net: rangebound SHFE/LME copper.

title: Copper Inventories in Major Trading Markets Down 1000 mt over Weekend_SMM
summary: SMM says copper social inventories in China’s major trading markets fell 1,000 mt over the weekend to 170,000 mt. Shanghai rose slightly, while Guangdong dropped sharply. The decline was linked to reduced arrivals from Guangxi and overseas. Traders will watch this week’s lower import arrivals, which may push inventories down if consumption holds.

title: Amex Makes Copper Rich VMS Discovery at Perron, Intersects 2.40% Copper, 0.72% Zinc, 0.27 g/t Gold and 22.15 g/t Silver over 7.80 m
summary: Amex Exploration announced discovery of a copper-rich VMS zone at its Perron property, reporting 2.40% Cu over 7.8 m (including 3.92% Cu over 4.4 m) and accompanying Zn/Au/Ag grades. It also mentions a follow-up hole at depth, awaiting assays. The article is copper-focused and exploration-stage.

title: Hannan Metals Ltd.: Hannan Soil Sampling Continues to Extend Scale and Define Continuity of Copper-Silver Mineralization at Tabalosos East, Peru
summary: Hannan reports soil geochemical sampling at the Tabalosos East target in Peru, extending sub-cropping copper-silver mineralized horizons over 24 km and confirming continuity of previously reported high-grade copper-silver zones. Additional sampling and trenching are planned, with permitting for potential drilling underway.

title: Hannan Soil Sampling Continues to Extend Scale and Define Continuity of Copper-Silver Mineralization at Tabalosos East, Peru
summary: Hannan soil sampling continues at Tabalosos East in Peru, extending the scale and confirming continuity of copper-silver mineralization. The update supports the potential quality and extent of the mineralization at the project, which can modestly boost sentiment around future copper supply prospects, though it is not immediate production impact.

title: China's July copper production flat m/m; tin output falls - Antaike
summary: Antaike said China’s 22 surveyed smelters produced 747,200 tonnes of refined copper cathodes in July, roughly flat versus June, with output expected to rise in August. Copper concentrate treatment charges rose to $57.50/t. The report covers tin separately and includes no aluminium or nickel impact.

title: Latin Metals Expands Land Position at Auquis Copper Project, Peru
summary: Latin Metals acquired an additional 700 hectares at its Auquis copper project in Peru, expanding total property size to 3,600 hectares. The company plans Phase I follow-up stream sediment and surface sampling and is negotiating local community agreements. The news is exploratory and does not affect immediate copper supply or trade flows.

title: Phytomining: Hyperaccumulator plants can be mined for gold, zinc, nickel.
summary: The article describes Malaysia’s ongoing phytomining pilot for nickel using hyperaccumulator plants, reporting annual yields of roughly 150–250 kg nickel per hectare and potential scalability. It notes industry interest and planned Indonesia trials, but adoption is still delayed and likely gradual, limiting immediate price impact for nickel.

title: Trouble Is Brewing At The World's Largest Copper Mine
summary: The piece highlights rising copper prices alongside risks around BHP Escondida in Chile, where workers voted to reject a final labor contract and may strike unless mediation ends Aug. 13. It also cites production declines, tight supply, and generally supportive demand signals, pointing to strong bullish near-term pressure.

title: Riding the Wave of Copper Inflation Pricing
summary: An interview argues the electronics industry is facing inflation alongside copper raw-material shortages. It cites growing PCB layer counts, 5G infrastructure demand, and electric-vehicle/battery needs, stressing copper-foil capacity constraints and long lead times for key equipment. Shipping costs are also elevated.

title: JX Nippon Copper Workers to Strike as Chile Wage Talks Fail
summary: Workers at JX Nippon’s Chile operation are set to strike after wage negotiations fail. The labor action raises the risk of short-term production disruption and tighter copper supply availability. That can lift market expectations for near-term copper fundamentals and add upward pressure to copper prices.

title: Aluminum cans slowly replace plastics to tackle marine pollution
summary: Japanese beverage vendors are gradually shifting from plastic bottles to aluminum cans to reduce marine plastic pollution. The move suggests incremental demand for aluminium packaging materials and recycling streams as brands replace one-way plastic with can formats, potentially supporting short-term sentiment for aluminium prices.

title: Copper advances on supply worries in Chile
summary: Copper prices rose as supply worries grew in Chile, with mine workers at Caserones walking off and mediation talks extending at BHP’s Escondida to avoid strikes. Separately, power consumption restrictions in China’s Guangxi region could temporarily shut a large share of aluminum smelting capacity, supporting aluminium.

title: MAX Resource Corp.: Max Resource Reports 3.9% Copper over 10-metre Widths and Visible Copper Mineralization Over 12-km(2) at the URU Zone, CESAR North, NE Colombia
summary: MAX Resource Corp. reports assay results from its CESAR North URU zone in northeastern Colombia, highlighting widespread visible copper mineralization over 12 sq km and channel/grab results with copper grades up to 3.9% (plus silver). The release focuses on ongoing exploration and pending additional assays.

title: Where Will the Aluminium Market be Heading in 2H amid Surging Prices and Outperforming Shares?_SMM
summary: SMM reports aluminium futures at SHFE have risen and are near a 13-year high, with international prices up ~29% YTD. It cites strong earnings and demand outlooks from Alcoa and higher sales at Rusal, robust profit expectations at Chalco, and limited supply recovery plus low inventories, while noting possible Fed hikes and reserve releases.

title: Chile supply concerns help copper bounce
summary: Copper prices rebounded as concerns about Chile supply disruptions intensified. BHP’s Escondida labor talks were extended to avoid a strike, while Caserones workers planned a walkout after contract talks failed. Traders also weighed China demand worries and a firmer U.S. dollar, but Chile risk supported copper.

title: SunSirs: China's Nickel Prices Fell Slightly on August 9 - Top Chemical News from ChemNet.
summary: SunSirs reported that China’s spot nickel fell on Aug 9 to 141,766.67 yuan/ton, down 2.76% from the prior day. The move was linked to a stronger US dollar from robust US data and weaker metal sentiment. Philippine nickel-ore supply recovery eased tightness, while stainless demand stayed light.

title: Awalé Resources Delineates Significant Surface Copper/Gold Anomalies at the Odienné Project, Côte d'Ivoire
summary: Awalé Resources reports >5 km of copper–gold (up to 0.18% Cu in soil) anomalism at its Odienné project in Côte d'Ivoire after reinterpreting geochemistry following an IOCG discovery at Charger. It also describes associated gold and coincident nickel/arsenic/lead anomalies, plus planned geophysics and drilling.

title: Tartisan Nickel Corp. Provides Update on the 10,000 Meter Drill Program at the Kenbridge Nickel Deposit and Grants Stock Options
summary: Tartisan Nickel Corp. reports progress on a 10,000m diamond drilling program at its Kenbridge nickel deposit in Ontario, with two rigs operating and 3,200m completed. It notes sampling for analysis and potential additional nickel sulphide and a 400m conductor. No assay results are provided; options are granted.

title: Forum Energy Metals Corp.: Forum Commences Drilling at Love Lake Nickel/Copper/Palladium Project, Saskatchewan
summary: Forum Energy Metals began drilling at its 100% owned Love Lake nickel-copper (and PGM) project in Saskatchewan after EM survey targets. The release outlines planned holes and cites historical copper and nickel grades from prior drilling/trenching. As exploration, it’s more sentiment than immediate supply, likely limiting near-term price effects.

title: Forum Energy Metals Corp.: Forum Commences Drilling at Love Lake Nickel/Copper/Palladium Project, Saskatchewan
summary: Forum Energy Metals began drilling at its 100%-owned Love Lake nickel-copper-PGM project in Saskatchewan after EM survey targeting. The release discusses planned follow-up drilling and prior intersections/grades for copper and nickel. However, it does not announce new assays or production, limiting near-term price impact.

title: Eagle Plains Resources Ltd: Eagle Plains' Partner Rockridge Resources Plans Upcoming Summer Exploration Program at the Knife Lake Copper Project, Saskatchewan
summary: Eagle Plains reports Rockridge will mobilize a summer/fall exploration program at the Knife Lake copper VMS project in Saskatchewan, using VTEM plus geophysics and follow-up drilling. The update references prior copper results and plans funded by Rockridge, but provides no near-term production or supply change. Impact on metals prices is likely limited.

title: BHP Gets Closer to Wage Deal at World's Largest Copper Mine
summary: The article headline says BHP is getting closer to a wage agreement at the world’s largest copper mine. A finalized wage deal typically lowers the likelihood of strikes or work stoppages, improving near-term copper production certainty and supporting copper price sentiment.

title: Golden Birch Resources Inc. Commences Drilling at Waki Copper-Gold Prospect on the Keveri Project and Changes Name to PNG Copper Inc.
summary: Golden Birch Resources begins a ~3,000 m drilling program at PNG’s Keveri project targeting copper-gold porphyry prospects (Waki, Urua, Omu) and a separate nickel target (Doriri). It is an exploration drill test with no reported production changes or firm resource results. The firm also changes its corporate name to PNG Copper Inc.

title: Camino to Commence Drilling at its New Lidia Copper & Gold Zone at Los Chapitos Project
summary: Camino Corp. says it has received drilling permits and will start core drilling at the Lidia copper-gold zone of its Los Chapitos project in Peru. The program targets new copper-bearing structures with reported assay highlights, but provides no production or supply changes, making near-term copper-price impact likely small.

title: Forum Commences Drilling at Love Lake Nickel/Copper/Palladium Project, Saskatchewan
summary: Forum Energy Metals commenced drilling at its Love Lake nickel-copper-PGM project in Saskatchewan. The program targets electromagnetic anomalies for magmatic nickel-copper-PGM mineralization, with follow-up planned on copper and nickel occurrences reported in prior work. The release is exploration-focused and does not indicate production or trade changes.

title: MMC Norilsk Nickel: Nornickel Awards Major Contract for Processing Equipment Supply to Metso Outotec
summary: Nornickel awarded Metso Outotec a contract to supply dewatering, flotation and automation equipment for the Talnakh concentrator expansion (Line 3). The modernization and new flotation equipment aim to increase ore processed, supporting production ramp expectations for Nornickel’s nickel and, indirectly, copper outputs.

title: Industry group: Peruvian miners will pay a record $3 billion in taxes this year_SMM
summary: Peruvian miners are expected to pay a record 12 billion soles ($3 billion) in taxes in 2021, more than double 2019. The industry group attributes higher taxes to rising copper prices and currency weakness boosting miners’ dollar-denominated export revenue. Peru and Chile are also discussing higher mining taxes.

title: Sandfire Resources America Acquires Key Mine Property at the Black Butte Copper Project Provides update on development activities, legal challenge, and financing
summary: Sandfire Resources America acquired key surface property for the Black Butte copper project in Montana and outlined ongoing permitting, a pending environmental legal challenge, and continued construction. The company also seeks about US$12 million in 2021 funding through mid-2022, which could affect development timing but not current copper supply immediately.

title: Operating Rates of Copper Rod Produced from Secondary Copper Down 7.59% on Month_SMM
summary: SMM reports secondary copper-based rod producer operating rates fell to 59.53% in July, down 7.59 points month-on-month, amid power curtailment, late-July floods, and furnace repairs in Henan. Tight secondary copper supply forced plants to reduce or suspend output, with August rates expected to decline further.

title: Operating Rates of Copper Billet Down 1.28% on Month_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says operating rates of copper billet producers fell to 57.64% in July, down month on month, with backlog from June only partially supporting output. Demand for copper-zinc alloy billets was weak due to off-season conditions and reduced refrigeration orders, while August rates are expected to decline further.

title: Sandfire Resources America : Acquires Key Mine Property at the Black Butte Copper Project
summary: Sandfire Resources America acquired key surface property needed for infrastructure at its fully permitted Black Butte copper project in Montana. The release notes construction continues despite an ongoing environmental legal challenge that could delay timelines, and the company seeks additional US$12m funding to progress toward mid-2022.

title: Surge Copper Provides Update on Summer Field Programs at Ootsa and Berg Projects
summary: Surge Copper provided an update on summer work at its Ootsa and Berg projects in British Columbia. The company completed access trail upgrades for Berg, finished airborne geophysical data acquisition, and is continuing drilling at Ootsa. Assay results and a later resource update are expected, with no production or supply change announced.

title: Seabridge Gold Inc.: Seabridge to Begin Drilling Iskut Gold-Copper Porphyry Target
summary: Seabridge Gold said it will begin core drilling at its Iskut project in British Columbia to test targets for a possible gold-copper porphyry system. The program follows successful geophysical work and prior 2020 drill intercepts with gold and copper. Results could expand long-term copper prospects, but no production is affected now.

title: BHP Strikes Deal With Chilean Union Over Copper Mine Strike
summary: BHP reached an agreement with the union at Chile’s Escondida copper mine, following calls for a strike over a one-off COVID bonus. The deal finalizes the collective contract ahead of a worker vote. Avoiding a disruption at the largest producer should help support short-term copper prices.

title: Udokan Copper Completes Installation of Coarse Ore Crusher
