Reported copper-equivalent grades exceed 11.7%, reinforcing the company’s high-grade claims, but it does not indicate near-term production.

title: Peru: Copper production up 10% in Jan-Oct 2021 | News | ANDINA
summary: Peru’s Ministry of Energy and Mines said copper production increased 10% in Jan–Oct 2021 versus the same period in 2020, reaching 1.89 million fine metric tons. Growth was attributed to higher output at Antamina and Cerro Verde, with Antamina hitting its highest 2021 level in October.

title: MMG will shut down the operation of the Las Bambas copper mine in mid-December_SMM
summary: MMG will shut down copper production at the Las Bambas mine in Peru by mid-December because road closures prevent supplies reaching the site. Communities along the transport route demand more logistics contracts and compensation, while the company cannot reach agreement. Las Bambas is a major global copper source, implying near-term supply loss.

title: Valley breweries could be hit by aluminum can price hike
summary: Supply chain problems have caused an aluminum can shortage, and Ball Corp plans to raise minimum order sizes, forcing distributors to revise order quantities. Arizona craft breweries report difficulty obtaining normal can volumes, predicting higher costs, price increases, and scaled-back releases into spring, supporting higher aluminum-related prices.

title: Aluminum can shortage impacts Central Alabama breweries
summary: A report says aluminum can demand is high, but shortages of cans available for shipment are affecting Central Alabama breweries. Ball Corporation links the issue to recycling input quality and supply chain constraints, forcing larger orders and higher costs that may be passed to consumers, potentially supporting near-term aluminum sentiment.

title: Copper Prices are Under Pressure_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports SHFE copper trended lower as markets priced the South Africa COVID variant and digested Powell’s hawkish taper remarks, strengthening the U.S. dollar. November cathode output beat expectations with power rationing easing, but imports stayed weak. Inventories may pivot higher, and demand shows little support.

title: Copper Anode Output at Southeast Copper Co. Hit All-Time High of 46,000 mt in November _SMM
summary: Southeast Copper in China produced over 46,000 mt of copper anode in November, an all-time high since commissioning. Cathode output from January–November reached 383,000 mt, ahead of plan, and the 400,000 mt target is expected to be met by mid-December. The faster supply build may pressure copper prices.

title: Copper Inventory in Major Chinese Markets Added 8,500 mt over Weekend_SMM
summary: SMM says copper inventories across major Chinese markets rose 8,500 mt to 91,200 mt over the weekend, mainly in Shanghai and Guangdong. Growth was linked to concentrated imported-copper arrivals and reduced downstream activity amid high premiums. The report expects limited additional imports this week, but continued slight inventory increases as consumption stabilizes.

title: There is a lot of pressure on the price of mismatched copper between supply and demand [institutional review]_SMM
summary: The piece forecasts near-term copper weakness: traditional demand is soft, real estate performance is poor, and smelting/refining capacity and mine supply expectations are rising. Although low inventories could make the downside “more tortuous,” the net setup is described as pullback pressure on copper prices, with strength expected later after 2023.

title: Initial producer offers for Q1 MJP aluminium at $195/t
summary: The article cites initial producer offers for Q1 MJP aluminium at $195/t and discusses Fastmarkets’ corrections/delays to European low-carbon aluminium differential and 6063 extrusion billet premium assessments. While it is directly linked to aluminium price benchmarks, it does not state a clear increase or decrease versus earlier offers.

title: Nornickel tests online system to monitor air conditions in Norilsk
summary: Nornickel is testing an online, real-time air quality monitoring system for Norilsk, aiming for transparency via a mobile app. The firm cites past SO2 emission reductions after a nickel plant closure and continues investment in its Northern Project to further cut emissions, but no immediate production or trade impact is specified.

title: Three Valley Copper Increases its Ownership in MTV to
summary: Three Valley Copper increased its ownership in Minera Tres Valles SpA to 95.1% by taking up shares after a bought-deal financing. The funding, about $9 million, supports operations of the Salamanca, Chile copper mining complex. Further dilution is expected if the minority shareholder doesn’t participate in future issuances.

title: Copper Mountain Mining Reports No Material Impact due to the Heavy Rains in B.C.
summary: Copper Mountain Mining said heavy rains, flooding, and mudslides in British Columbia have caused no material impact to its mine operations, production, or concentrate shipments. Temporary road closures did not significantly affect trucking concentrate to Vancouver port. The company will continue monitoring the situation.

title: Peru's copper production hits almost 1.9Mt in Jan-Oct
summary: Peru’s copper output reached nearly 1.9Mt over January–October, highlighting ongoing supply from a major producing country. As a direct production statistic, it can influence short-term expectations for copper availability. The provided excerpt lacks context on whether production rose or fell versus earlier periods.

title: Proposed gold, copper mine project advances
summary: U.S. Gold Corp says its $4 million pre-feasibility study for the former Copper King open-pit project in Wyoming is encouraging enough to proceed to full feasibility. The company cites higher copper demand from wind, EVs and grid modernization and expects concentrate shipping after permitting.

title: Nickel market tightens as China lifts imports
summary: LME nickel stocks have fallen sharply since April and premiums remain wide, indicating tight prompt availability. China’s refined nickel imports accelerated since April, reaching record monthly highs and strengthening demand amid constraints from maintenance, product shifts, and energy-related disruption. The market supply gap is widening, keeping nickel tight.

title: Will the Nickel Market to See Oversupply in 2022?_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports Nornickel’s nickel balance update: 2021 tightened sharply due to supply cuts and strong demand recovery, but expectations shift to a nickel surplus of about 59,000 mt in 2022 (mainly low-grade). High-grade may be balanced with possible shortages, while EV battery demand supports longer-term growth.

title: Long-term optimism about the price of nickel (agency review)_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Since Q4, primary nickel supply has been tight and prices strong, but the article anticipates an off-season slowdown. Refined nickel supply eases gradually, nickel sulfate demand faces weaker momentum, and stainless steel production trends remain under pressure, limiting upside drivers into December/1Q.

title: The Exports of Unwrought Aluminium and Aluminium Semis Hit a Record High in November _SMM
summary: China’s aluminium exports reached record levels in November, totaling 509,300 mt of unwrought aluminium and aluminium semis (+6.2% month-on-month, +20.1% year-on-year). Total exports in January–November rose 14.9% to 5.06 million mt, per customs data, suggesting increased outward supply.

title: UK pushes US to remove Trump-era steel, aluminum tariffs
summary: The UK Trade Secretary says she will urge the U.S. to remove Trump-era tariffs on British steel and aluminum. The move follows an October U.S.-EU deal to drop their levies, which would likely lower aluminum trade barriers and improve supply conditions, supporting near-term aluminum sentiment.

title: China Imports of Unwrought Copper and Copper Semis Rose 24.34% in Nov_SMM
summary: China’s imports of unwrought copper and copper semis rose 24.34% to 510,402.3 mt in November versus the prior month, according to customs data cited by SMM. While November imports were down 9.07% year on year, the month-on-month increase suggests improved demand/support for copper prices.

title: Zambia's Project Roan Sets to Deliver Copper Concentrate to Sable Refinery
summary: Zambia’s Project Roan is virtually complete, with commissioning starting in December and first commercial production expected in March 2022. Jubilee Metals says the project will deliver copper concentrate to the upgraded Sable Refinery from Q1 2022, adding 10,000 t/y of copper units and planning more concentrating capacity in Northern Zambia.

title: Cornish Metals Reports High-Grade Copper at the United Downs Copper – Tin Project
summary: Cornish Metals announced new drilling at the United Downs copper–tin project, intersecting multiple zones of high-grade copper mineralisation beneath the historic United Mines. The company says high-grade copper has now been confirmed over a 500m strike length and remains open along strike and at depth, with additional drilling planned.

title: Trades in Copper Import Market were Quiet, Shipments Delays Plagued the Market_SMM
summary: SMM reports quiet trading in China’s copper import market as premiums ease and buyers stay cautious. The market is described as oversupplied, with spot activity low despite high LME backwardation. Bonded zone inventories kept falling, but arriving shipments declined amid delays from customs quarantine and low port efficiency.

title: China's Copper Import Demand Shrank, Watch the Change of Global Copper Trade_SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s copper cathode imports fell to 2.71 million mt in the first ten months of 2021 (down 30.03% YoY) with sluggish import premiums. SHFE/LME ratio issues limited inflows, while global shipping shortages stranded cargoes overseas, reducing expected total imports to 4.52 million mt (down 28.10%).

title: Why the Exports of Unwrought Aluminium and Aluminium Semis Hit a Record High in November? _SMM
summary: China exported 509,300 mt of unwrought aluminium and aluminium semis in November, a record high since March 2020, with exports up 6.2% month-on-month and 20.1% year-on-year. Rumours of reduced export rebates and strong overseas demand boosted shipments as export profits rose and SHFE/LME ratios stayed low.

title: Azimut and Mont Royal Discover a Highly Prospective Nickel-Copper Ultramafic Intrusion at Wapatik
summary: Azimut and Mont Royal report discovering a highly prospective nickel-copper ultramafic intrusion at Wapatik. The headline suggests potential future mineralization, but the report is exploratory and does not indicate immediate changes to mine output, inventories, or refining capacity. Near-term price impact on nickel and copper is therefore limited.

title: Battery Mineral Resources Corp.: Dalmacia Drilling Delivers Step-Out Hole of 14 Meters at 2.44% Copper at Battery Mineral Resources Punitaqui Mine
summary: Battery Mineral Resources reported assay results from step-out and infill drilling at the Dalmacia target within the Punitaqui copper complex in Chile, including multiple intercepts above 2% copper. The company states Punitaqui is expected to resume copper concentrate production in mid-to-late 2022, supported by ongoing drilling and permitting progress.

title: Chile copper exports soar to $4.9bln in November on high global prices
summary: Chile’s copper exports rose more than 35% in November to $4.92 billion, supported by all-time-high global copper prices. The strong results contributed to a trade surplus, amid expectations of post-pandemic demand recovery and comments from Codelco that prices may dip next year due to increased supply.

title: Dalmacia Drilling Delivers Step-Out Hole of 14 Meters at 2.44% Copper at Battery Mineral Resources Punitaqui Mine
summary: Dalmacia Drilling reports a step-out hole delivering 14 meters of mineralization grading 2.44% copper at Battery Mineral Resources’ Punitaqui mine. Such exploration results can support expectations for higher future copper resources and production potential, which may provide modest short-term bullish sentiment for copper.

title: Aluminium prices may gain next year on demand, supply concerns
summary: Trade experts and the World Bank forecast higher aluminium prices, citing strong demand and ongoing supply concerns. Aluminium output was affected this year by power crises in China, India and other locations, while alumina (needed for refining) output dynamics are highlighted. Prices are expected to rise before easing as energy constraints fade.

title: Sanatana Resources Inc.: Sanatana Reports Strong Results on Its Oweegee Copper-Gold Project, Golden Triangle, BC and Provides Exploration Update
summary: Sanatana Resources reports strong grab-sample results from the Molloy Zone at its Oweegee copper-gold project in British Columbia, including up to ~1.09% copper and elevated gold and silver. Management says the zone may be a copper-gold porphyry window that will be drill-tested in 2022, supported by alteration mapping and soil anomalies.

title: U.S. trade chief, UK trade minister discuss steel and aluminum sectors -USTR
summary: U.S. Trade Representative Katherine Tai met the UK trade minister and reiterated U.S. focus on tackling non-market excess capacity in steel and aluminum, including cooperation with partners on trade and carbon intensity. The U.S. also maintains Section 232 tariffs—25% on steel and 10% on aluminum—supportive for near-term aluminum market sentiment.

title: Emmerson Resources : Stunning 117m at 3.38% copper drill hit at Hermitage project
summary: Emmerson Resources reported strong RC drill results at its Hermitage Project in Australia, including 117m at 3.38% copper and additional copper-rich intervals. The company plans further drilling and notes assay results are still pending for some sections. The update supports positive near-term sentiment for copper exploration prospects.

title: Exploration results enhances Canada Nickel's case for new mine
summary: Canada Nickel released improved metallurgical testing for its 100%-owned Crawford Project in Ontario, reporting 61% nickel recovery and 37% nickel concentrate from lower-grade samples. The company is starting further variability testing for its feasibility study, citing recovery gains versus the earlier PEA and potential for enhanced flowsheet performance and future supply.

title: Domestic Output of Aluminium Down 3% MoM _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show China’s aluminium output fell 3% month-on-month to 3.07 Mt in November, with declines linked to power rationing in Guangxi/Chongqing and an accident at a plant in Yunnan. Some plants resumed, but December output is projected steady. Downstream restocking and lower social inventories may support prices into late December.

title: Inner Mongolia promotes the development of high-quality industries such as high-performance aluminum, copper materials and new rare earth materials_SMM
summary: Inner Mongolia’s new materials development plan (2021-2025) calls for expanding downstream capacity for high-performance aluminium (over 2 million tons by 2025) and high-performance copper products (e.g., copper poles, conductors, foil). The policy supports industry chain buildout that may boost supply expectations for both metals.

title: Inner Mongolia promotes the development of high-quality industries such as high-performance aluminum, copper materials and new rare earth materials_SMM
summary: Inner Mongolia’s new materials development plan (2021-2025) calls for expanding downstream non-ferrous metal industries, targeting high-performance aluminum (including alloys, foil, rods, cables) and high-performance copper (copper poles, conductors, foil). Planned capacity additions and industrial-chain extension can lift near-term demand expectations for aluminium and copper prices.

title: Domestic Output of Aluminium Down 3% MoM in November _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show China’s aluminium output fell to 3.07mn mt in November (-3% YoY), with monthly production affected by power rationing in Guangxi/Chongqing and an accident at a plant in Yunnan. Some plants resumed, but operating rates remain ~85.6%. Downstream restocking and expected lower end-December inventories are supportive.

title: 8 aluminum alloy makers fined W21b for price fixing
summary: South Korea’s antitrust regulator fined eight aluminum alloy makers a combined 20.7 billion won for colluding to fix bidding prices and split Hyundai Motor and Kia orders between 2011 and 2021. The FTC also ordered corrective steps and Hyundai/Kia will tighten bidding to prevent price collusion next year.

title: Planned $4bn offshore windfarm could fully power Alcoa Portland aluminium smelter
summary: Alinta plans a $4bn offshore windfarm near Victoria to connect through Alcoa’s Portland smelter, enabling the large energy user to run on 100% renewable power. The move supports the smelter’s long-term viability and green aluminium demand, though the project is only at early planning stages and would take years to build.

title: Britain presses U.S. for quick move on steel, aluminum tariffs
summary: Britain’s trade minister will press the U.S. Commerce Secretary to start talks on cutting U.S. tariffs on steel and aluminum. The UK is concerned about rising pressure from retaliatory tariffs and faces changing trade flows after the U.S.-EU metals deal, which keeps broader U.S. aluminum tariffs in place.

title: GM to invest more than $51 million in aluminum casting facility for Silverado | Companies
summary: General Motors says it will invest more than $51 million to add equipment at its Bedford, Indiana aluminum die casting foundry to produce drive unit castings for the Chevrolet Silverado EV and other applications. The expansion signals incremental demand for aluminum cast products, likely offering mild upward pressure on aluminum.

title: Gigawatt-scale offshore wind plan to help giant aluminium smelter make green switch
summary: Australian energy group Alinta is evaluating a gigawatt-scale offshore wind project to decarbonise electricity for a large aluminium smelter in Victoria, which is described as the state’s biggest power user. The proposal targets green power procurement to support ongoing aluminium output and reduce power-related transition risk.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel Announces High-Grade Nickel Intersections From Langmuir Project
summary: EV Nickel reported high-grade nickel intersections at its Langmuir Project, including 8.66% Ni over 1.11m and other significant intervals, plus calculated nickel tenors of 18% to >40% in sulphide. Metallurgical testing is pending, but the results bolster expectations for future nickel production.

title: Copper edges lower as Omicron caution outweighs China stimulus
summary: Copper fell for a third day as Omicron concerns offset China’s stimulus effects. A stronger yuan reduced costs for buyers, but investors cut Comex longs and remained cautious. Tight Chinese stockpiles and strong imports were supportive, while rising LME availability and weak deliveries tempered gains.

title: Copper Prices to Remain Rangebound amid Muted Fundamentals_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM expects LME copper to trade rangebound at $9,350–9,680/mt and SHFE at 68,500–70,500 yuan/mt. Support comes from relatively low inventories and stable smelter/downstream operating rates, but downside risk from Omicron-driven caution, a firmer dollar, mixed US data, and year-end demand/fund outflows keeps prices from trending higher.

title: CBAM remains afterthought for European aluminium premiums
summary: The EU’s CBAM remains largely unpriced in European spot aluminium premiums due to a long implementation timeline and an emissions scope not yet fully reflected. Still, decarbonisation policy raises production costs and keeps widening low-carbon aluminium differentials, supporting a modest bullish tone for aluminium prices and low-carbon product premiums.

title: China increases nickel imports and tightens market_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: LME nickel inventories are falling and cash premiums have risen, while Shanghai refined nickel stocks remain extremely low. China has accelerated imports of refined nickel and nickel intermediates since April, driven by tight domestic supply and booming demand (stainless and battery-grade). Analysts expect nickel to stay tight until new supply arrives, supporting higher prices.

title: Nickel Mines signs $525m deal to buy 70% stake in Indonesian project
summary: Australia’s Nickel Mines agreed to buy a 70% stake in Indonesia’s Oracle Nickel Project for $525m, including $371m equity purchase and $154m shareholder-loan funding. The RKEF-based project targets 36,000 tpa nickel-in-NPI capacity plus a 380MW captive power plant, with operations starting in 2023.

title: Zinc and Aluminum Daily: lower reserve requirements to boost limited aluminum prices continue to fluctuate [institutional review]_SMM
summary: The piece reports weak/volatile Shanghai aluminium trading despite a modest night-market rebound and a reserve-rate cut that has not lifted sentiment meaningfully. It cites solid November export data and limited short-term supply additions, but also notes mild long-short tension, improving yet soft terminal demand, and ongoing sensitivity to energy and Winter Olympic-related policy.

title: GM Invests $51 Million In Indiana Aluminum Casting Plant To Support Silverado EV Production
summary: GM plans to invest $51 million in its Bedford, Indiana aluminum die-casting plant to install new equipment supporting EV drive unit castings for the upcoming Chevrolet Silverado EV and other applications. The expansion begins immediately, adding incremental aluminum-based demand tied to GM’s all-electric production ramp.

title: Copper in LME futures rose for the third day in a row as China cut reserve requirements to stimulate the economy._SMM
summary: LME copper futures rose for a third day as China cut reserve requirements to boost liquidity, strengthening the renminbi and making dollar-denominated copper cheaper. The piece also cites stronger Chinese imports, rapidly falling inventories in China and a shift toward lower speculative longs, with supply still described as relatively tight.

title: Determination of Western Australian Nickel conductor Target by Great Southern_SMM
summary: Great Southern Mining reports newly identified bedrock electromagnetic anomalies at its East Laverton Nickel project in Western Australia, suggesting potential blind nickel sulphide mineralization. The company plans tighter-grid electromagnetic follow-ups and borehole testing to refine conductors. Coverage highlights the region’s magmatic nickel prospects, supporting nickel sentiment.

title: Tsingshan's First Production Line of High-Grade Nickel Matte Yielded Output in Indonesia_SMM
summary: Tsingshan began adding molten low-grade nickel matte to the #1 converter in Indonesia, completing over seven hours of blowing to produce qualified high-grade nickel matte. The start of high production at Tsingshan’s industrial park increases output of a key nickel input, likely raising short-term supply expectations for nickel.

title: Blackstone restarts Ban Phuc nickel mine and concentrator
summary: Blackstone Minerals has restarted mining at its Ta Khoa nickel project in Vietnam and is progressing ~1,000m of development at the Ban Phuc orebody. The company plans to recommission the Ban Phuc concentrator to produce nickel concentrate batches for refinery pilot programs, using the existing plant capacity.

title: Horizonte Minerals PLC Announces Acquisition of Ferronickel Processing Equipment
summary: Horizonte Minerals said its subsidiary will acquire ferronickel processing equipment to fast-track development of a second RKEF line at its Araguaia project in Brazil. The equipment is expected to lower development cost and supports a target of higher nickel output, improving sentiment toward future nickel supply.

title: Aluminium Billet Inventories Up 13,800 mt on Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports aluminium billet inventories in five major consumption areas rose 13,800 mt to 85,500 mt versus the prior week, reversing a seven-week decline. The build was driven by higher billet arrivals and relatively weak downstream demand, and inventories are expected to stay on an upward trajectory.

title: The agency predicts that copper will be in excess supply in 2022._SMM
summary: Copper prices rose Wednesday on strong Chinese import demand, but the article highlights ICSG expectations of a large refined copper surplus in 2022. It attributes the surplus to higher refining production and increased secondary scrap output, arguing demand growth won’t absorb supply, which could weigh on copper sentiment going forward.

title: South Korean aluminium parts makers fined for price fixing
summary: South Korea’s Fair Trade Commission fined eight aluminium alloy product makers a combined KRW20.7bn for colluding to fix quotation and bidding prices and divide order volumes for carmakers including Hyundai and Kia from 2011-2021. The FTC expects a revised bidding system from next year to prevent future price fixing.

title: Rockridge Resources Ltd.: Rockridge Completes its VTEM Geophysical Program and Awaits Analytical Results from Field Program at the Knife Lake Copper Project
summary: Rockridge completed a helicopter-borne VTEM EM and magnetic survey at its Knife Lake copper project in Saskatchewan and reports encouraging identification of conductors, while field analytical results are still pending. The update supports future drilling targeting for a Cu-Zn-Co VMS deposit, with no immediate production or supply change indicated.

title: Copper slips as receding Omicron fears support dollar
summary: Copper prices fell as Omicron-related concerns eased and the dollar firmed, adding pressure despite still-low LME inventories. LME on-warrant stocks rose to a one-month high, signaling easing nearby tightness. Nickel declined as well, while aluminium rose slightly, showing mixed pressure across industrial metals.

title: Fathom Nickel Inc.: Fathom Announces Final Results and Initial Interpretation of the 2021 Soil Geochemistry Program at the Albert Lake Property
summary: Fathom Nickel announced updated 2021 soil geochemistry at its Albert Lake property near the historic Rottenstone mine, identifying extensive Ni-Cu-Co anomalies consistent with magmatic nickel signatures and planning winter drilling. Nickel and copper exploration potential is increased, but no immediate production changes are stated, limiting near-term price impact.

title: Nevada Copper Provides Operational Activity Update
summary: Nevada Copper reported significant operational improvements at its Pumpkin Hollow underground copper mine, including higher equipment availability, improved contractor productivity, development rates up 50% vs August, and consistent milling with >90% recoveries and ~4,700 tpd processing. Commissioning and ventilation upgrades support ramp-up into H1 2022.

title: Nickel 28 Annual Shareholder Letter
summary: Nickel 28’s annual shareholder letter highlights strong performance from the Ramu nickel-cobalt operation, including production on target (~31,000 tonnes nickel), low costs, and the first cash distribution after debt repayment. The letter attributes nickel strength in 2021 to electrification demand and declining LME inventories, implying supportive near-term nickel pricing.

title: Nickel Mines to gain more exposure to Indonesia | News
summary: ASX-listed Nickel Mines agreed with a Tsingshan subsidiary to acquire a controlling interest in an Indonesia project covering nickel production and a power plant for $525 million. The transaction increases Nickel Mines’ exposure to Indonesian nickel output, which may support near-term nickel market sentiment.

title: The present situation and Price influencing factors of SMM: waste Aluminum Industry and the Prospect of 2022 trend [SMM Analysis]_SMM
summary: SMM expects China’s waste aluminium supply to become relatively surplus as recycled-aluminium consumption slows with weak real estate and auto end-demand. Import volumes of unwrought aluminium alloys are forecast to fall further as overseas supply/imports tighten. Higher waste treatment costs may support some grades, but overall pressure remains negative.

title: The elasticity of stock supply weakens, can the shortage of recycled copper supply break the situation? [2021 South China Annual meeting]_SMM
summary: SMM discusses tight short-term recycled copper supply and worsening availability of copper scrap due to stricter customs/import controls, COVID disruptions, and energy ‘double control’ costs. It argues that recycled copper helps offset mineral supply gaps, but constrained supply and long clearance times keep scrap-driven copper pricing under upward pressure.

title: UAE's EGA inks 3-year Guinea bauxite supply deal with China's Bosai
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) signed a three-year bauxite supply deal with China’s Bosai Group, providing several million tonnes annually from Guinea, with the first shipment expected in January 2022. It also cites rising Chinese bauxite imports and alumina capacity additions, supporting feedstock availability for aluminium production.

title: SMM: Scramble for Raw Materials for Secondary Copper to Become Fiercer_SMM
summary: SMM reports that China’s secondary copper raw-material policy (zero solid-waste imports from 2021 and stricter standards) is tightening supply of copper scrap/feedstock. With saturated copper-rod capacity but insufficient scrap availability, competition for raw materials is expected to intensify, keeping copper-related spreads tight and supporting bullish near-term pricing.

title: How much is the demand for copper in emerging fields? [SMM South China Annual meeting]_SMM
summary: SMM summarizes analysis that copper demand in emerging applications—EVs, charging piles, wind and solar—will rise quickly, lifting copper’s share of total demand. It cites supply tightness, including refined copper and concentrate shortages in 2021-2022, implying tighter near-term balances and supportive price conditions for copper.

title: SMM: EV, PV and Wind Power to Boost Copper Demand_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that booming EVs, charging piles, and renewable power (PV and wind) are set to lift copper demand in 2021-2023, with emerging uses breaking the prior supply-demand balance. Industrial Securities estimates show a sizable copper supply gap and cathode/concentrate shortages in 2021-2022.

title: SMM: Supply & Demand Analysis and Forecast of Aluminium Billet _SMM
summary: SMM reports aluminium billet conversion margins have stayed high but inventories across China have been declining for seven weeks amid sluggish downstream purchases and falling shipments. The inventory is expected to drop more slowly and possibly turn to accumulation in 1–2 weeks, with conversion margins peaking. Downstream extrusion operating rates may also fall.

title: Conclusion of consultation on Fastmarkets alumina indices
summary: Fastmarkets announced a consultation outcome affecting the publication times/holiday schedule of some base metal assessments in Asia, plus delays and corrections to European low-carbon aluminium differential assessments and aluminium 6063 extrusion billet premium midpoints. It also discusses methodology compliance for steelmaking raw-material indices, without citing new aluminium fundamentals.

title: SMM: Aluminium Scrap Supply to Exceed Demand amid Weak Downstream Consumption_SMM
summary: SMM expects aluminium scrap supply to turn surplus as recycling output rises while downstream consumption in real estate and automobiles stays weak. China’s scrap import limits and logistics frictions reduce unwrought alloy imports. Cost and silicon-price effects may tighten some scrap spreads, but overall scrap surplus implies downward pressure on aluminium-linked pricing.

title: SMM: Copper Prices to Fall 5,000 yuan/mt in 2022 from Current Level amid Muted Traditional Consumption _SMM
summary: SMM forecasts copper prices to decline, citing stronger US dollar/lower liquidity amid tightening expectations and weakening demand from construction, housing, and power grid cable volumes. It also notes export order declines and squeezed downstream margins. Despite a LME stock drawdown and contango/backwardation, the overall outlook remains bearish for copper.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports fell 164,000 wmt_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Nickel ore inventories at Chinese ports fell 164,000 wmt to 9.01 million wmt as of Dec 10, with Indonesian ore nearly fully utilised. However, wet-season Philippine supply shrank while weak NPI demand and falling NPI prices kept buying cautious, muting the effect of tighter ore supply expectations.

title: UAE's EGA to supply bauxite ore from Guinea to Chinese group
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) will supply several million tonnes of Guinean bauxite ore per year to China’s Bosai Minerals Group under a three-year agreement. EGA already delivered over a million tonnes this year. Bauxite is the key input to alumina and aluminium, supporting feedstock reliability for Chinese output.

title: KALU Stock Price | Kaiser Aluminum Corp. Stock Quote (U.S.: Nasdaq)
summary: The article includes a Dow Jones news item noting that a military coup in Guinea has sent aluminum futures to a 10-year high, with Alcoa shares up about 2.3% in premarket. Because Guinea is central to bauxite supply, expectations for aluminum supply tightness should be bullish.

title: A delicate balance for copper
summary: The piece forecasts copper prices slipping moderately in 2022 after record highs, driven by macro headwinds like a stronger dollar and US rate tightening. It also cites supportive factors such as mine and refined supply growth, low visible inventories, and ongoing “green” demand, but expects overall moderation from 2021 levels.

title: A matter of class in the nickel market
summary: ING says nickel rebounded as supply growth lagged expectations and inventories fell, with a structural deficit concentrated in Class 1 and tighter battery-grade feedstocks. Supply was hit by disruptions and high power costs, while battery and stainless demand surprised higher. Nickel sulphate deficits keep pressure supportive.

title: Pacific Ridge Hits Major Copper in British Columbia
summary: Pacific Ridge Exploration highlights major drill intersections at its Kliyul copper project in British Columbia, reporting long intervals of copper and copper-equivalent grades. The news may boost market sentiment for copper mining prospects and explorer equities, but it provides no near-term production outlook strong enough to drive physical copper prices immediately.

title: Castle Peak Indonesia High Ice Nickel production hit an one-week low in Shanghai Nickel_SMM
summary: Shanghai nickel’s night market in China weakened to a one-week low around 144,630 yuan/ton. Castle Peak Indonesia high-ice nickel has started production, while support factors like low inventories are offset by weak demand from stainless steel and nickel sulfate producers, some of which have paused output, limiting price upside.

title: Statistical Analysis of Import data of unwrought Aluminum and Aluminum products in China from January to October 2021_SMM
summary: SMM cites China Business Industrial Research Institute data showing China imported 2.572 million tons of unwrought aluminium and aluminium products from January to October 2021, up 14.4% year-on-year. Import value rose to $7.518 billion, up 46%, indicating stronger supply inflows that may weigh on aluminium prices.

title: Copper miners and smelters are getting closer and closer to reaching TC/RC._SMM
summary: Major copper miners and Chinese smelters are nearing agreement on 2022 treatment and refining charges (TC/RC). The stated gap is about $8/t, with smelters near $69/t and miners near $61/t. Analysts expect supply tightness to ease, potentially affecting copper market balance and profitability.

title: Nickel supply stable demand month-on-month weakening Shanghai Nickel three consecutive falls how to go this week? [SMM Express]_SMM
summary: Shanghai nickel prices fell for three consecutive sessions, with intraday weakness before narrowing by midday. The piece attributes the move to weakening demand (stainless steel and ferro-nickel), lack of import-support for domestic pricing, and expectations that nickel plate arrivals may weigh on inventory digestion. Overall, nickel downside risk persists.

title: Copper Inventory in Major Chinese Markets Added 4,700 mt over Weekend_SMM
summary: SMM says copper inventories across major Chinese markets rose 4,700 mt over the weekend to 94,800 mt, marking consecutive weeks of increases. Gains were concentrated in Shanghai and Guangdong due to more imported copper arrivals and shrinking demand, worsened by COVID-related logistics disruptions and higher premiums. Inventory is likely to keep building this week.

title: Copper Prices Are Likely to Meet Resistance at 70,000 yuan/mt_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says PBOC easing and US debt-ceiling progress may support copper, but market signals point to weaker end-year demand: SHFE backwardation shows pessimism, imports remain strong, and logistics risks persist. With spot premiums expected to weaken and sellers likely liquidate after deliveries, copper faces resistance near 70,000 yuan/mt.

title: China Color Corporation signs "Indonesia Oman Copper smelter Project Purchasing contract" with PT AMMANMINERAL INDUSTRI_SMM
summary: China Color Corp. signed a $550 million purchasing contract for a copper smelter project in Oman/Indonesia with PT AMMANMINERAL INDUSTRI. The plan includes ~900,000 t/y copper-concentrate smelting and related port/water facilities, with China Color supplying equipment for Bennett South/Bennett Bay smelters. The project supports future copper supply processing.

title: When will Aluminium Prices Break the Current Congestion When Falling Inventory cancelled out the Effects of Collapsed Costs_SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s domestic aluminium social inventory fell to 91,500 mt, supporting a brief upside in SHFE trading. However, costs are shrinking as alumina and electricity prices fall. With heating-season production restrictions and colder weather likely weakening demand, SMM expects SHFE aluminium to remain rangebound with slight declines into month-end.

title: Drug addiction fuelling copper cable theft spike
summary: South African rail operators report recurrent theft of copper cables, sometimes causing power failures and train delays or cancellations. Police and rail agencies say thieves steal and sell copper for drugs, while replacement and lost-revenue costs run into the hundreds of millions. This implies additional near-term copper demand for repairs.

title: Castillo Copper provides operational update
summary: Castillo Copper reported progress on exploration and drilling at its Arya copper prospect in Queensland and continued work on Zambia assets, including IP surveys targeting areas with copper anomalies. Laboratory assay delays extend some lithium option timelines, but the article contains no immediate changes to copper production or supply.

title: Aston Bay Holdings Ltd: Aston Bay Reports New High Priority EM Targets at the High-Grade Storm Copper Project, Nunavut
summary: Aston Bay reports that ground EM surveys at its Storm Copper Project in Nunavut identified multiple new conductive anomalies and drill-ready shallow and deep copper targets ahead of a planned 2022 campaign. Results show conductors correlate with previously drilled high-grade copper, supporting exploration growth potential rather than near-term supply changes.

title: Copper Mountain Mining Announces Updated Economics and Development Plan for Eva Copper Project
summary: Copper Mountain Mining announced updated economics and formally approved advancing the Eva Copper Project in Queensland, citing improved NPV mainly from higher metal prices despite higher capex from inflation and COVID-related material/labour constraints. The company plans to advance detailed engineering, secure financing, and target commissioning in late 2024, supporting copper sentiment.

title: U.S. Pitches Truce to Japan Over Trump-Era Steel, Aluminum Tariffs
summary: The headline indicates the U.S. is pitching a truce to Japan regarding Trump-era steel and aluminum tariffs. If negotiations lead to reduced or avoided tariff pressure, it would improve expectations for aluminum trade flows and pricing near term, likely providing support to aluminum markets over the coming days.

title: Copper futures closed lower in LME due to higher inventories and higher dollar_SMM
summary: LME three-month copper fell 0.62% to $9,447.5/t after higher warehouse inventories and a stronger dollar prompted selling. LME registered and total stocks rose markedly in recent weeks, easing supply concerns. China’s call for earlier policy efforts helped limit the drop, but USD strength pressured demand.

title: Material Matters: Iron ore, Lithium, Nickel, Coal, Gold & Rare Earths
summary: The piece provides commodity outlooks and highlights nickel. It notes Indonesia’s strategy to ban nickel ore exports, boosting value-add flows to China (nickel pig iron, stainless steel, mixed hydroxide) and expects nickel production to double, supporting strong export revenue upside and thus a bullish nickel price bias.

title: Aluminium Scrap Supply Tightened Further in China_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says China’s aluminium scrap supply tightened further, pushing scrap prices up ~200 yuan/mt as recycling fell and processors reduced output after annual targets. Die-casting plants resumed buying and may stockpile ahead of end-month. Secondary aluminium alloy prices stabilised but edged higher despite weak demand and closed import windows.

title: ITC Futures: accelerated removal of domestic inventory, strong operation of aluminum price_SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s electrolytic aluminium inventory fell to 915,000 tons (-75,000). Spot prices in Guangdong slipped slightly but aluminum discounts narrowed. The piece argues macro support for stable growth and faster inventory movement “into the warehouse” boosts sentiment, while falling alumina prices temper gains.

title: Shanghai aluminium scales over 2-week peak on tight supply
summary: Shanghai aluminium futures rose to a more-than-two-week peak, up 1.7%, driven by low inventories and improving demand as China eases energy consumption curbs. Reported lack of imminent large-scale output restarts and potential production cuts in northern China add support, lifting both ShFE and LME earlier.

title: LME prices mostly down; near 75,000-tonne inflow of aluminium into Asian warehouses
summary: LME prices are described as mostly lower while the report highlights a near 75,000-tonne inflow of aluminium into Asian warehouses. Such warehouse additions increase readily available supply in the region, which can weaken nearby pricing and contribute to the overall downside move in aluminium.

title: Kodiak Copper Corp.: Kodiak Drills 126 m of 0.87% CuEq within 537 m of 0.45% CuEq at Gate Zone
summary: Kodiak Copper reported assay results from three new drill holes at its MPD copper-gold porphyry project, including multiple long intervals with elevated copper grades and the Gate Zone target remaining open. The company also plans ~25,000 m of additional drilling in 2022 to expand appraisal and test new targets.

title: Rising inventories undermine aluminium prices
summary: LME aluminium prices fell after LME-registered warehouse inventories jumped by 67,750 tonnes to 977,400 tonnes. Expectations of solid demand and still-tight Chinese supply limited losses, but cash/3-month premiums narrowed and the market reversed earlier gains. Aluminium has dropped 18% since October highs.

title: Royal Road Minerals Limited: Royal Road Intersects 303.7 Meters at 1.1 Grams per Tonne Gold Equivalent in Newly Discovered Porphyry Copper and Gold System at Its Guintär Project; Colombia
summary: Royal Road Minerals reported initial drill results from its Guintár copper-gold project in Colombia, including porphyry-style altered intrusive rocks with mineralized stockwork and sheeted veinlets. The release cites intersections featuring copper (e.g., 0.62% Cu) alongside gold and silver, supporting bullish sentiment for copper.

title: Aztec Minerals Corp.: Aztec - Kootenay Joint Venture Commences 22 hole, 5000 meter RC Drill Program at Cervantes Gold-Copper Project, Sonora, Mexico
summary: Aztec Minerals and Kootenay Silver start a 22-hole, 5,000 m RC drilling program at the Cervantes gold-copper porphyry project in Sonora, targeting oxide and deeper sulfide mineralization. The work aims to expand and define gold-copper zones at multiple prospects, but no production or supply data are provided.

title: Camino Minerals Corp.: District-Scale Manto-Style Copper Oxides with Primary Sulphide Mineralization Potential at the Los Chapitos Project in Peru
summary: Camino Minerals announced discovery drilling at its Los Chapitos copper project in Peru, reporting anomalous copper up to 1.05% Cu and associated cobalt, plus oxidized and sulphide mineralization. The company expects drilling permits soon, but the news is exploratory and does not signal near-term production impacts for copper markets.

title: Aranjin Resources Ltd: Aranjin Resources Announces Promising Drilling Results at the Sharga Copper Project
summary: Aranjin Resources reported promising maiden drilling results from the Sharga Copper Project in Mongolia, confirming a substantial VMS mineralized system. Intercepts included up to 15.4m at 1.33% copper (and 0.94 g/t gold), with wider mineralization zones. Phase 2 drilling is planned.

title: Norsk Hydro to invest US$230mn to switch to natgas at Brazil alumina plant
summary: Norsk Hydro will invest about US$230mn to convert a Brazil alumina plant to natural gas. The change is intended to alter the plant’s energy inputs, potentially lowering operating costs and improving production economics. Better near-term alumina affordability can support expectations for aluminium output.

title: US offers Japan deal on steel, aluminum tariffs
summary: The US is offering Japan a deal to resolve disputes over 2018-era tariffs on steel and aluminum. The proposed arrangement would allow a quota of imports to enter the US free of duties, similar to the US-EU suspension. Japan seeks full abolition, but talks are ongoing.

title: The Power Play by The Market Herald Releases Interviews With QuestEx Gold & Copper and Sprout AI
summary: The Market Herald publishes an interview highlighting QuestEx Gold & Copper’s induced polarization survey results at its KSP property in British Columbia. The IP survey reportedly identified a new top-tier porphyry copper-gold exploration target. The news is exploratory and does not indicate immediate production, but it may slightly support copper sentiment.

title: Insight - Funds call it quits on copper stocks poker game
summary: Funds have reportedly closed their copper trading books earlier this year. Speculative positioning on LME and CME copper futures has dropped sharply since October’s high-volatility spike, when LME three-month copper briefly surged to about $10,452.50/tonne amid unusual time-spread turbulence. Reduced speculative exposure can pressure prices downward.

title: Aluminum closed lower in LME due to sharp rise in inventory_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: LME three-month aluminium fell 0.96% after LME warehouse inventories jumped by 67,750 tonnes, though declines were capped as demand stayed strong and China supply was expected to remain tight. The article also says copper dropped 0.38% with LME registered stocks rising for a fourth day.

title: INSG: October 2021 global nickel market supply turns to a small surplus_SMM
summary: INSG reported that the global nickel market moved from a September shortage of 3,100 tons to a small October surplus of 5,000 tons. For the first ten months of 2021, however, the market still ran a large supply shortfall versus the same period last year.

title: The continued downward pressure on nickel prices has not eased. [agency Review]_SMM
summary: Shanghai nickel and spot nickel in major regions fell and market sentiment remains weak. The article links the decline to soft stainless steel demand, ferro-nickel inventory and cautious shipment expectations, and pessimism from Indonesia’s Aoyama high-nickel matte commissioning. It notes possible further downside and recommends short positions.

title: Global Ferro-Nickel supply short-term tight short-term Nickel Mine prices in advance to maintain stable Operation [Agency Review]_SMM
summary: SMM reports tight global ferronickel supply in the short term, driven by China’s ongoing power/energy consumption restrictions and declining ferronickel output. Nickel ore imports and port inventories are limited as the Philippines rainy season reduces output. With cautious trading and firmer demand from stainless steel and batteries, nickel prices are supported.

title: Copper Prices to Remain Rangebound amid Improving Liquidity in Global Market in Dec._SMM
summary: SMM expects copper prices to remain rangebound in December due to improving global liquidity from China’s RRR cut, while Fed expectations remain a key focus. Offsetting factors include weaker fundamentals, lower concentrate TC sentiment over Peru’s Las Bambas risk, disruptions to smelter imports, and inventories likely turning up.

title: Supply is still limited. China's aluminum production fell slightly in November._SMM
summary: China’s aluminium production in November fell 1.8% year-on-year to 3.1 million tons, with electrolytic operating capacity still constrained in some regions due to power reasons. Several areas reduced energy-intensive output amid electricity pressure, and a tank leakage accident occurred at a plant in Yunnan, keeping supply tight.

title: Domestic Bauxite Prices under Pressure as Alumina Prices Plummeted_SMM
summary: SMM says alumina prices have plunged, reversing prior gains, and bauxite prices in Shanxi, Henan, and south-west regions are under pressure or expected to fall further. Weaker alumina profitability, low acceptance of high-priced bauxite, increased north China mining and discounts, and planned procurement cuts support bearish near-term aluminium sentiment.

title: Aluminium Fluoride Prices Continued to Rise in November amid Low Operating Rates_SMM
summary: SMM says aluminium fluoride prices rose in November, driven by largely unchanged supply and restocking by some aluminium smelters for winter. Major firms lifted purchasing quotations, with Chinalco’s price up to 12,500 yuan/mt, improving producer profits and operating rates. Fluorite powder gains and expectations point to further December increases.

title: London copper flat as investors eye crucial Fed decision
summary: London copper was flat as investors awaited a key U.S. Fed decision on timing of tapering and potential earlier rate hikes. The dollar’s strength and possible liquidity tightening were a focus. LME aluminium eased, nickel was steady, and Shanghai contracts were slightly lower, indicating limited net near-term momentum.

title: Amarc Resources Ltd.: Amarc, Freeport-McMoRan Mineral Properties Canada Inc. Continue Earn-in at JOY Copper-Gold District into 2022
summary: Amarc Resources said Freeport-McMoRan will continue its earn-in into a second drilling season at the JOY copper-gold district in British Columbia, following $5.94 million invested in 2021. The update focuses on exploration, data integration, and next-season planning, with results to be released later.

title: Critical minerals: Australian lithium, nickel, cobalt can charge batteries in India, South Korea and Japan
summary: The piece argues Australia has exported raw battery minerals rather than processing them, while China dominates processing of critical battery minerals. It warns that any restrictions on China’s refined battery-material exports could disrupt battery manufacturers in India, South Korea and Japan, potentially tightening supply expectations for nickel used in batteries.

title: Road blockade at Las Bambas Copper Mine is difficult to mediate or production will stop this week._SMM
summary: Peru’s PM warned that a 26-day road blockade blocking MMG’s Las Bambas copper mine may lead to a full production suspension later this week. Negotiations with local residents in Chumbivilcas have stalled, with residents refusing to lift the blockade, raising near-term copper supply disruption concerns.

title: MMG shuts copper production at Las Bambas in Peru as talks to end blockade fail
summary: MMG said it will be unable to continue production at the Las Bambas copper mine in Peru after failing to agree with a community blocking the transport road used to move ore. The shutdown represents an immediate copper supply disruption, likely tightening near-term market availability and supporting prices.

title: Aluminium Billet Inventories Down 10,000 mt on Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM said aluminium billet inventories in five major consumption areas fell 10,000 mt WoW to 75,500 mt on Dec 16, led by sharp declines in Wuxi and Nanchang. Warehouses reported low arrivals because billet makers were less willing to ship amid low conversion margins. Next week inventory is expected to be largely unchanged.

title: Barksdale Resources Corp.: Barksdale Intercepts 15m of 1.74% Copper, 15m of 1.46% Copper, and 67m of 0.59% Copper at San Javier in Sonora, Mexico
summary: Barksdale Resources announced completion of a 5,000m drilling program at the Cerro Verde zone in Sonora, Mexico, with all holes intersecting assay-confirmed copper mineralization above a 0.20% cut-off and reporting several high-grade near-surface intercepts. Metallurgical column tests suggest heap-leach recovery is promising.

title: Global Energy Metals Signs Binding Agreement for Royalty Sale on Norway Based Rana Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project; Increases Equity Holdings in Electric Royalties
summary: Global Energy Metals signed an agreement to sell a 1% NSR on Norway’s Rana nickel-copper-cobalt project to Electric Royalties, while Metals One plans to acquire 90% and fund exploration. The deal is aimed at unlocking remaining Ni-Cu potential, but implies no immediate supply change.

title: Global Energy Metals Signs Binding Agreement for Royalty Sale on Norway Based Rana Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project; Increases Equity Holdings in Electric Royalties
summary: Global Energy Metals signed a definitive agreement to sell a 1% net smelter royalty on Norway’s Rana Ni-Cu-Co project to Electric Royalties, with Metals One planning a funded exploration program and resource update timeline. The transaction is supportive for nickel supply expectations and, secondarily, copper via the mixed deposit grades.

title: MMG halts copper operations at Las Bambas as talks to end blockade fail
summary: Peru’s Las Bambas suspended copper operations after talks to end a month-long road blockade failed. The government considered a state of emergency “as a last resort.” Las Bambas—about 2% of global supply—will end processing, likely reducing near-term copper output and supporting copper prices.

title: TNR Gold Corp.: TNR Gold Arranges Investment Loan, Provides Updates on Royalty Holdings on Ganfeng's Mariana Lithium and McEwen's Los Azules Copper, Gold and Silver Projects
summary: TNR Gold announced a new investment loan and updated its royalty holdings. For Los Azules in Argentina, McEwen Copper is reopening access roads and preparing a large drilling program and pre-feasibility study work. The release is broadly positive for the copper project but does not imply immediate production.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: US EV Battery Supply Chain: Talon Sets Ambitious 2022 Exploration Goals for the Tamarack Nickel Project in Minnesota and Provides Corporate Update
summary: Talon Metals updates its Tamarack nickel-copper project, reporting new high-grade drill intersections and outlining an aggressive 2022 exploration program to progress toward pre-feasibility and expand resource potential. It also establishes an ATM program to fund operations, citing strong US interest in domestic battery nickel supply.

title: Metals generally pull up Shanghai Zinc up more than 3.6% Shanghai Aluminum, Shanghai Nickel up more than 2.7% [SMM afternoon Review]_SMM
summary: SMM reports the inner metal market trading higher. Shanghai nickel rises over 2.7% and Shanghai aluminium over 2.7% (around 2%+). Copper also stays high and volatile, with spot prices up for two days, though downstream buying weakens after replenishment. Overall sentiment remains supported by a weaker USD.

title: Metals generally pull up Shanghai Zinc up more than 3.6% Shanghai Aluminum, Shanghai Nickel up more than 2.7% [SMM afternoon Review]_SMM
summary: SMM reports a broad metal rally in China as the dollar moved higher then the market stayed bid. Shanghai nickel rose about 2.75% and Shanghai aluminium about 2.7% on supportive spot dynamics. Copper remained high and volatile for two straight days, despite weaker downstream replenishment.

title: Las Bambas Copper Mine to Suspend Production as Talks Fail_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: MMG’s Las Bambas copper mine in Peru will shut down after talks with the Chumbivilcas community failed. The decision follows negotiations breaking down, prompting a Credit Suisse downgrade. MMG shares fell sharply, reflecting heightened risk of copper supply loss, which can tighten near-term availability and lift prices.

title: China Cancelled Provisional Export Tariffs of Copper Anode in 2022_SMM
summary: China will adjust tariffs effective Jan 1, 2022. Per SMM, the provisional export tariff for unrefined copper and copper anodes (electrolytic refining, HS 74020000) is being cancelled for 2022, but the cited tariff level changes from 15% in 2021 to 30% in 2022. Exports totalled 66 mt in 2020 and 122 mt Jan–Oct 2021.

title: Peak Season for Copper Tube/Pipe, Strong Support from Air-Conditioner Orders_SMM
summary: SMM reports copper tube/pipe producers’ operating rates rose to 85.18% in November, signaling peak-season demand. Air-conditioner exports lifted planned output by 10% and orders by 29.3% year-on-year, helping clear previously delayed orders. December operating rates are forecast higher, supporting copper tube/pipe demand.

title: Higher SHFE/LME Nickel Price Ratio Drove Rapid Declines in China Bonded Zone Inventories_SMM
summary: SMM reports the SHFE/LME nickel price ratio rose amid shortages of domestic cargoes. When the spot nickel import window reopened, traders moved nickel plate from bonded zones into China’s domestic market. Limited briquette imports and lower prices revived downstream buying, sharply reducing plate inventories, with premiums at a yearly high and less expected inflow next week.

title: Rusal builds new aluminum smelter in Siberia_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Rusal said its previously long-delayed Taishet aluminum smelter in Siberia has begun production, with the first phase completed and testing starting. The plant’s planned first phase capacity is 428,500 tons annually. Restarting output increases Russian aluminum supply expectations, potentially weighing on prices.

title: Electric Royalties to buy 1% NSR in Norwegian nickel project
summary: Electric Royalties agreed to buy a 1% NSR for Norway’s Rana nickel project on the Ofoten Fjord, paying shares and $100,000 cash to the current owners. The project’s past production and planned exploration under Metals One are positioned as potential future nickel supply, supportive for nickel sentiment.

title: Peru reportedly loses 150,000t of copper production due to social conflicts
summary: Peru reportedly faces social conflicts that disrupt operations and result in the loss of around 150,000 tonnes of copper production. The disruption would tighten near-term copper supply expectations from an important producing country, likely putting upward pressure on copper prices over coming weeks.

title: Long order negotiation results "settled" spot copper concentrate to maintain 60 low operation [SMM Copper Weekly report selection]_SMM
summary: SMM reports the imported copper concentrate index edged down to about $60.75/ton as spot transactions were limited and smelters held ample inventories. Long-order negotiations remained the key driver. Smelters and major processors finalized 2022 processing fees at $65/ton, higher than 2021.

title: Peru Sends Team to Negotiate Pass at Halted Key Copper Mine
summary: Peru’s government is sending a team to negotiate a “pass” connected to a key copper mine that has been halted. The talks could enable the mine to resume operations or ease the disruption, improving expected near-term copper supply and providing upward support to prices over coming days.

title: Metal trading early mixed strong shock of Shanghai aluminum rose more than 1.5% coking coal rose 4.26% [SMM comment]_SMM
summary: SMM notes early mixed trading: Shanghai aluminium rose ~1.6% on low inventories and tight supply, while nickel rose slightly as tight absolute inventories eased via limited imports, though fundamentals remain weak. Copper was pressured by a stronger dollar amid BoE/ECB tightening and Covid cases, keeping moves mixed overall.

title: EGA signs three-year agreement to supply bauxite from Guinea to China's Bosai Minerals Group
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) signed a three-year deal to supply China’s Bosai Minerals with several million tonnes of Guinea bauxite annually, starting with shipments in January 2022. EGA highlights its growing role as a bauxite supplier, with mining, rail transport to Kamsar port, and transshipment capacity.

title: RUSAL Opens New Low-carbon Aluminium Smelter in Taishet
summary: RUSAL announced the opening of a new low-carbon aluminium smelter in Taishet. The start of production and potential lower emissions/cost competitiveness can influence market expectations for aluminium supply and operating costs, which may provide near-term support to aluminium prices, subject to ramp-up timing.

title: Copper Inventory in Major Chinese Markets Added 900 mt over Weekend_SMM
summary: SMM says copper inventories in major Chinese markets rose 900 mt to 86,700 mt over the weekend, with most gains in Shanghai. COVID-19 keeps East China consumption weak, while lifting a Ningbo lockdown released stranded scrap into the cathode market. Guangdong arrivals were limited, and SMM expects inventories to rise further this week.

title: The short-term operation of aluminum price is too strong._SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: The article argues aluminium should stay supported near term: electrolytic aluminium demand is improving, social inventories have fallen for eight consecutive weeks, and supply remains tighter due to limited electricity production. It also points to stronger auto/NEV output and aluminium-profile exports. Despite Fed debt reduction/interest-rate expectations, prices are expected to oscillate on the upside.

title: Copper Prices to Move Rangebound_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says copper prices edged up after the Fed signaled faster tapering but a less-hawkish tone, weakening the US dollar. China liquidity improved following an RRR cut. Copper also got support from falling China inventories and a Las Bambas disruption reducing concentrate supply.

title: China's aluminum imports have broken the annual record in only 11 months._SMM
summary: China’s aluminium imports hit an annual record within 11 months, with November unwrought and product imports jumping to 397,915 tons (+34% vs October; +109% y/y). Electricity restrictions at domestic smelters reduced supply, enabling arbitrage into cheaper overseas metal inflows.

title: IGO buys Western Areas for A $1.1 billion at a time of soaring demand for nickel_SMM
summary: Australian miner IGO will acquire Western Areas for A$1.1 billion, taking on debt and funding the deal partly from cash. The transaction is set to expand IGO’s nickel production capacity via Forrestania and the Odysseus mine, amid expectations of sharply rising EV battery demand for nickel.

title: Vedanta acquires Goa-based nickel, cobalt producer Nicomet
summary: Vedanta acquired Goa-based nickel and cobalt producer Nicomet, aiming to boost India’s domestic nickel supply. The firm says it will become India’s sole nickel producer and that Nicomet’s 7.5 KTPA capacity can meet about 50% of total demand. The move comes as nickel markets tighten on EV battery and stainless demand.

title: Singaporean nickel trader faces more charges in alleged US$1.1 billion scam
summary: A Singaporean businessman accused of masterminding a large nickel trading scam received six additional criminal charges, bringing the total to 75. Prosecutors allege about US$124 million in cash and assets were involved. The report details courtroom filings but does not indicate changes to physical nickel supply or trade flows.

title: Pacific Nickel Mines gets development nod for Kolosori project
summary: Pacific Nickel Mines received development consent from Solomon Islands authorities for its Kolosori Nickel Project, advancing the path to a mining lease and eventual production. The project targets output of 6.23m tonnes at 1.5% nickel, with early works and feasibility steps underway. Such progress is mildly supportive for nickel supply expectations.

title: Trigon Metals, Inc.: Trigon Announces First Copper Flotation Successful at Kombat Processing Plant, Namibia
summary: Trigon Metals announced the first successful flotation of copper concentrate at the newly refurbished Kombat Mill in Namibia, with most refurbishment complete and commissioning underway. Long-lead processing equipment has arrived and installation is progressing, targeting first concentrate production ahead of year-end and restart of the Kombat Mine.

title: Lundin to Buy Copper-Gold Project in Argentina for $483 Million
summary: Lundin agreed to buy a copper-gold project in Argentina for $483 million. The deal is more about future development and supply prospects than immediate output changes, but it can still support copper sentiment by reinforcing investment interest in new sources of supply.

title: China's Imports of Nickel Ore and NPI Dropped MoM in November_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports China imported 4.01 million mt of nickel ore and concentrate in November, down 10% month on month. Imports from the Philippines and Indonesia also fell. Copper NPI imports were slightly lower and much weaker year on year, suggesting reduced nickel feedstock inflow that may support nickel prices near term.

title: China's Copper Ore and Concentrate Imports Surged 22% in Nov_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s copper ore and concentrate imports rose 22.3% month-on-month in November to 2.19 million tonnes, with year-on-year growth of 18.8%. Chile remained the largest source at 861,031 tonnes (+26.5% MoM), while Peru totaled 458,145 tonnes (-12.2% MoM).

title: Philippines' Philex plans to launch Silangan copper-gold mine in 2025
summary: Philex says it will launch the Silangan copper-gold mine in 2025 after shifting from open-pit to underground mining due to the 2017 ban. The project, a major revenue source after Padcal’s closure in 2024, aims for gradual ramp-up, targeting copper production from the first years.

title: A list of itemized import data of bauxite imports in China, which decreased by 19% month-on-month in November._SMM
summary: China’s bauxite (and concentrates) imports fell 19% month-on-month to 7.7 million tons in November, and were also down year-on-year. Guinea remained the largest supplier but exports to China declined as well. Reduced bauxite inflows can pressure alumina supply expectations and bearishly affect aluminium.

title: China's import volume of raw aluminum tripled in November compared with the same period last year_SMM
summary: China’s imports of raw (primary) aluminium rose to 229,400 tons in November, up 64% from October and 309% from the same month last year, per China customs data cited by SMM. Imports from India also surged, suggesting stronger near-term physical demand that could support aluminium prices.

title: Nornickel plans to invest $8 billion in energy infrastructure development to 2030
summary: Norilsk Nickel plans about $8.1B (600B rubles) to 2030 to upgrade energy infrastructure in Russia’s Krasnoyarsk north, including new power units, heat and hydro plant replacements, 1,000+ km of transmission lines, and gas pipeline works. As a top nickel producer, this could support supply continuity.

title: Kintavar Completes Drilling on Wabash Copper Project; Mineralization Confirmed at Depth Over 2.5 Kilometers Combined
summary: Kintavar announced it has completed drilling on its Wabash copper project, reporting confirmed mineralization at depth over more than 2.5 kilometers combined. The update improves the project’s potential for resource growth, which can provide mild bullish sentiment for copper expectations.

title: Canada Nickel Announces US$10 Million Loan Facility and Provides Corporate Update
summary: Canada Nickel announced a US$10 million secured loan facility to fund progress on its Crawford nickel-cobalt sulphide project through early 2022, alongside an investor update. The release is tied to nickel project financing and development, but it does not indicate imminent production or supply disruption.

title: Deep-South Requests the Judge to Render a Decision in the Review Case with the High Court of Namibia Concerning Haib Copper Licence Refusal
summary: Deep-South Resources said Namibian counsel amended a case seeking a court order requiring the Minister of Mines and Energy to grant renewal of its Haib Copper EPL 3140 licence within 30 days. The company claims refusal lacked documented administrative evaluation. Management is also seeking other copper projects.

title: BHP bows out of tussle with 'Twiggy' Forrest for Canadian nickel miner
summary: BHP withdrew from a bidding war for Canadian nickel miner Noront, allowing Andrew “Twiggy” Forrest’s Wyloo Metals to proceed with a higher offer. Noront holds significant high-grade nickel deposits in Ontario’s Ring of Fire. The deal contest highlights accelerating corporate efforts to secure battery-metals supply, supporting nickel sentiment.

title: Higher copper closing in LME helped improve risk appetite_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: LME copper for three months rose about 0.9% to $9,534/t as oil and equities climbed, the dollar weakened, and investors turned slightly more optimistic amid Omicron concerns. Coverage highlights low copper warehouse receipts and a reported refined copper market shortage, suggesting limited near-term buffering against supply risks.

title: Nevada Copper Operational Performance Continues to
summary: Nevada Copper reported continued positive operational performance at its Pumpkin Hollow underground mine. Development is running at the highest rate of 2021, nearly 50% higher than November, with additional bolters and ventilation fan infrastructure being delivered and commissioned. The company remains on track to mine the first high-grade stope in Q1 2022.

title: The global nickel surplus in Global Palladium Fund:2022 is 59000 tons._SMM
summary: SMM cites Global Palladium Fund forecasts a 2022 global nickel surplus of about 59,000 tons, concentrated in low-grade NPI depending on Indonesian capacity ramp-ups. It notes COVID-delayed NPI expansion earlier and highlights uncertain higher-grade supply versus rising EV battery demand, suggesting softer nickel fundamentals.

title: Crunch Time for Alro: The Aluminum Producer Kicks off Activity Shutdown Process amid Soaring Energy Prices
summary: Alro Slatina, Romania’s major vertically integrated aluminum producer, is launching a total activity shutdown process due to soaring energy prices. As Romania’s largest energy consumer, the firm faces cost pressure that may curb smelting output in the near term, influencing European aluminum supply expectations.

title: SHFE Aluminium Rose Sharply on Concerns of Production Restrictions of Aluminium Producers in Europe Born from Energy Crisis _SMM
summary: LME and SHFE aluminium prices rose sharply as traders worried European producers in countries such as Montenegro and Germany could restrict output at year-end. The concern stems from energy shortages and surging electricity prices. With Western Europe’s aluminium capacity and operating rates already relatively low, bearish supply risk supports long positions.

title: The Exports of Aluminium Extrusion Rose Sharply MoM in November, and to Decline Slightly in December _SMM
summary: China’s aluminium extrusion exports rose to 88,100 mt in November (+18% MoM, +5% YoY), with EU shipments up. The SHFE/LME ratio fell to 7.07, improving export margins and encouraging traders. Exports are expected to correct slightly in December around Christmas/New Year despite lower LME ratio.

title: China's imports of raw aluminum surged 64% month-on-month in November and may decrease in December._SMM
summary: China’s raw aluminium imports rose 64% month-on-month in November to 229,000 tonnes, amid production constraints and tighter energy controls affecting smelters. Market participants expect imports to fall in December because domestic aluminium prices have been declining and import buyers face losses. Alumina imports also dropped on oversupply.

title: The DISER:2021 annual nickel price rise is driven by demand in the early stage and supply in the later period._SMM
summary: An SMM DISER-linked review attributes nickel’s 2021 price rise to early demand (stainless steel rebound, EV battery demand) and later supply-side shocks. It also flags China power cuts that can reduce stainless output and nickel demand in late 2021/early 2022, alongside rising refining costs and expected supply growth.

title: EU to impose extra tariffs on China aluminum foil over subsidies
summary: The EU plans to impose additional tariffs on imports of Chinese aluminum foil, citing subsidy concerns. The measure is expected to alter trade flows and effective supply into the European market, potentially tightening availability for aluminum foil and supporting near-term aluminum pricing versus a tariff-free outlook.

title: Wyloo to buy nickel miner Noront after BHP drops off from race
summary: Wyloo Metals agreed to buy Canada’s Noront Resources after BHP exited its bid to acquire Noront. The deal targets Noront’s Eagle Nest nickel asset in the Ring of Fire. Both companies pursued the nickel supply for EV batteries, with the transaction likely supporting tighter near-term nickel supply expectations.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Ltd.: Kamoa-Kakula Surpasses Annual Copper Guidance, with More than 100,000 Tonnes Produced
summary: Ivanhoe Mines says its Kamoa-Kakula Phase 1 concentrator in the DRC has produced over 100,000 tonnes of copper in concentrate year-to-date, surpassing the top end of 2021 guidance. Phase 2 remains on track for a Q2 2022 start, targeting roughly doubling annual output.

title: Shanghai Nickel stopped falling and rebounded, but the demand for Nickel in the two major consumer chains is still weak [SMM Analysis]_SMM
summary: SMM reports Shanghai nickel rebounded after five consecutive down days, rising about 1.87% to 145,820 yuan/ton. Prices received some support from low pure nickel inventories and a broader non-ferrous move tied to crude oil. Yet spot transactions and stainless/new-energy nickel demand remain weak, so SMM expects range volatility.

title: Europe's Biggest Aluminum Smelter Cuts Output on Power Price Surge
summary: The article reports that Europe’s largest aluminum smelter has reduced output following a sharp surge in electricity power prices. Higher energy costs can force curtailments in aluminum production, tightening short-term supply and likely providing upward support to aluminum prices in the near term.

title: Young Environmentalists Plan a Rewrite of Chile's Copper Mining Rules
summary: Young environmentalists plan to push changes to Chile’s copper mining rules. If the proposed rewrite leads to tighter permitting, higher compliance requirements, or delays/constraints on production, near-term expectations for copper supply could weaken. That would likely be supportive for copper prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Peru Villagers Agree to Lift Copper Mine Blockade in Short Truce
summary: Peru villagers have agreed to lift a copper mine blockade for a short truce, easing disruption risk at the operation. By improving prospects for near-term production and reducing supply loss expectations, the development is likely to support copper prices over the next several trading sessions.

title: Copper Consumption to be Boosted Significantly by New PV Capacity in Major Areas Worldwide Next Few Years_SMM
summary: SMM reports that under China’s carbon peak/neutrality push, photovoltaic (PV) installed capacity is expected to rebound in 2022, with global PV copper demand rising. It estimates copper consumption from PV at 564,000 mt in 2021 (189,000 mt China) and 1.23 million mt by 2026 (538,000 mt China).

title: Antofagasta to Follow the Recently Finalised Copper Concentrate Benchmark TC/RC in 2022_SMM
summary: Chinese smelters including major players settled the 2022 copper concentrate benchmark TC/RC with Freeport. Benchmark charges are set at $65/mt and 6.5¢/lb, up from 2021’s $59.5/mt and 5.95¢/lb. Antofagasta confirmed it will follow the benchmark from Dec 22.

title: Copper Consumption to be Boosted Significantly by New PV Capacity in Major Areas Worldwide in the Next Few Years_SMM
summary: SMM reports that China’s PV installed capacity outlook may decline for 2021 but is expected to rise sharply in 2022, with significant global PV growth thereafter. It estimates copper consumption for new PV projects at 564,000 mt in 2021 and 1.23 million mt by 2026, boosting copper cathode demand.

title: Blackstone Vietnam nickel resource jumps 73 per cent
summary: Blackstone Minerals announced a 73% jump in Ta Khoa’s nickel resource base in Vietnam, now totaling about 485,000 tonnes of contained nickel (0.37% Ni on average) across multiple deposits. The update is resource-focused, with further drilling and study work planned, not new near-term nickel output.

title: Newcrest increases its stake in Havieron Gold and Copper Project_SMM
summary: Newcrest agreed to increase its stake to 70% (with options to 75%) in the Havieron gold and copper project with Greatland Gold in Western Australia. The pre-feasibility work points to output including 6,900 tonnes of copper over nine years, but the news is mainly ownership restructuring.

title: Romanian aluminum smelter Alro plans to suspend operation and is gradually reducing production._SMM
summary: Romanian aluminum producer Alro Slatina plans to shut down and has started reducing output by 60%, citing high energy prices and energy scarcity.
