The union chairman said the company cannot profitably produce aluminum at current price levels of $2,300–$2,600/ton, prompting closure of production lines.

title: In the inflection point, it is difficult to stop the pressure and the copper price is on the "downhill road"?_SMM
summary: SMM survey commentary argues copper prices face downside pressure as liquidity tightens with Fed tapering, while mine output is expected to rise and traditional demand (e.g., real estate, power investment) may decline. Scrap copper supply remains supported by import-policy frictions and low inventories, but net outlook stays weak.

title: Norsk Hydro to upgrade the electrolysis cells at its aluminum plant in Årdal, Norway
summary: Norsk Hydro will invest NOK 60 million to upgrade electrolysis cells at its Årdal, Norway aluminum plant starting spring 2022. The project targets improved worker safety and reduced energy use (about 860 MWh) and lower CO2 emissions via next-generation cell control systems, with rollout expected late 2022.

title: Aluminium Billet Inventories Down 900 mt on Week _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says aluminium billet stocks across five major consumption areas fell 900 mt to 74,600 mt week-on-week. Weekly arrivals remained low as manufacturers were less willing to ship amid falling RCs, with some planning production cuts. Demand is muted into year-end, so inventories may rise next week.

title: Copper, alumina operations in northern China ordered to reduce output to curb emissions
summary: Copper and alumina operations in northern China have been ordered to reduce output to curb emissions. Such curtailments are typically seen as near-term supply tightening for copper and for alumina feedstock into aluminium refining, supporting price expectations over the coming days and weeks.

title: Copper, alumina operations in northern China ordered to reduce output to curb emissions
summary: The news says copper and alumina operations in northern China were ordered to reduce output to curb emissions. Such production curtailments can constrain near-term supply expectations. That typically adds upward risk to prices, but in the short run may also pressure metals if demand expectations weaken alongside compliance-related disruptions.

title: Power price surge keeps aluminium near 2-month highs
summary: Aluminium stays near two-month highs after rising over 5% in two days. Record European power prices raise fears of higher smelting costs and potential shutdowns, including a reported halt of 3% capacity at Dunkerque. LME aluminium stocks on-warrant fell sharply, signaling tighter supply.

title: Mundoro Capital Inc.: Mundoro Announces Strategic Alliance with Vale for Copper in Southwest USA
summary: Mundoro Capital announced a two-year strategic alliance with Vale to generate copper (porphyry) exploration projects in Arizona and New Mexico, with Vale sole-funding generative work and earn-in options for designated projects. The deal centers on potential future resources, not current production changes.

title: Brazil sets aluminium import quota of 350,000 tonnes for 2022
summary: Brazil has set an aluminium import quota of 350,000 tonnes for 2022. By limiting allowable imports, the policy can reduce near-term supply into Brazil, tightening availability for local buyers and supporting expectations for higher aluminium prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Indonesia's Adaro plans $728 million aluminium smelter in Borneo
summary: Adaro Aluminium Indonesia signed an LOI to invest $728 million in a new aluminium smelter in North Kalimantan’s Green Industrial Park. The project would use hydropower from an 11,000 MW Kayan river plant and is positioned as a ‘green’ supply push targeting growing demand for aluminium products.

title: Sandvik wins Newcrest1850 US $10,000 maintenance Station equipment order to further develop Red Chris Copper and Gold Mine_SMM
summary: Sandvik received an $18.5m order from Newcrest to supply drilling equipment and aftermarket tools for the Red Chris open-pit copper and gold mine in British Columbia. The rigs and service support aim to improve reliability and productivity, with delivery slated for Q4 2021.

title: General Administration of Customs: China's nickel ore imports continued to decline in November, but higher than the same period last year._SMM
summary: China’s customs data show nickel ore and concentrate imports in November at 4.0076 Mt, down 10.47% from October but up 12.08% versus a year earlier. Shipments from the Philippines were the majority, also lower m/m, with rainy-season conditions reducing transport volume, affecting near-term supply expectations for nickel.

title: Risk appetite warms up and copper prices continue to rebound [institutional review]_SMM
summary: SMM survey notes risk appetite improving and copper prices continuing to rebound. It describes weakening spot discounts as holders show higher willingness to exchange for cash, while Guangdong electrolytic copper inventory falls for four straight days. Scrap and import windows remain unfavorable, and LME/SHFE warehouse levels are discussed.

title: China's Exports of Aluminium Wheel Remained Low in Nov, Likely to Rebound in Dec_SMM
summary: China’s aluminium wheel exports were 67,300 mt in November, down 25% m/m, with the weakness blamed on suppressed September production caused by volatile silicon and magnesium prices. As silicon and magnesium stabilized in Oct–Nov, aluminium alloy and wheel output recovered and overseas buyers accepted higher margins, suggesting exports may rebound in December.

title: The Production Capacity of Lithium Battery Copper Foil to Boom in 2023_SMM
summary: SMM reports a CITIC Securities note saying lithium battery copper foil production capacity is expected to jump sharply in 2023, shifting competition toward customer channels and supply-chain management. It highlights risks of oversupply in the copper foil sector and points to growth in high-performance electronic circuit foil.

title: Pure Nickel Imports Rose over 100% YoY to 26,000 mt in November  _SMM
summary: SMM cites Chinese customs data showing refined nickel imports of 26,069 mt in November. While imports fell 24.4% month-on-month, they more than doubled versus a year earlier (+102.5% YoY). January–November imports were also up sharply year-on-year, signaling higher nickel inflows.

title: Zinc and aluminum daily: going to the warehouse to superimpose overseas supply disturbance and high aluminum price concussion [institutional review]_SMM
summary: SMM reports Shanghai aluminium rising amid European energy and electricity price pressure. Alro (Romania) plans to cut aluminium output by 60% due to high power costs, with broader risk of further smelter curtailments. LME and domestic inventories fall while spot discounts fluctuate, implying tight near-term supply.

title: Adaro plans to build $728m aluminum smelter in Indonesia
summary: Adaro Energy signed a letter of intent to invest $728m in a new aluminum smelter in North Kalimantan, Indonesia, targeting production of aluminum ingots or sheets. While it signals potential future supply growth, construction is expected to take around two years, limiting immediate price impact.

title: Imports of Spot Nickel Saw Slight Profits_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Spot nickel import profits are positive (~250 yuan/mt) as traders move cargoes from bonded inventories into China. However, Shanghai inventory growth is limited because some cargoes were presold. Domestic pure nickel inventories are expected to stay low next week, with only 1,500–2,000 mt arrivals, keeping the SHFE/LME ratio high.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports Fell 118,000 wmt_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Chinese ports’ nickel ore inventories fell 118,000 wmt to 8.66 million wmt as of Dec 24, with Ni content at 68,000 mt. Inventories have declined for five straight weeks after reduced imports, though downstream demand remains weak due to high costs and restrictions. Further declines are expected before Chinese New Year.

title: Announcement on the addition of SMM low-carbon aluminum price points [SMM announcement]_SMM
summary: SMM announced it will add and release benchmark price points for low-carbon aluminium starting Dec 27, using a methodology based on the Foshan spot A00 aluminium price plus carbon emission and CEA carbon-price components. The document focuses on pricing mechanics and coverage, not on any new physical supply or demand shock.

title: The first phase of Julong Copper Project in Tibet is expected to produce 12-130000 tons of copper in 2022._SMM
summary: Zijin Mining said the first phase of its Julong Copper Project in Tibet is completed and in production. The company expects 12–130,000 tons of copper in 2022 and about 160,000 tons per year after ramp-up. The project boosts China’s copper supply capacity and improves Zijin’s copper output.

title: Surpluses on the horizon expected to douse fire under copper prices
summary: Reuters reports that higher supplies and softer demand are expected to cool copper prices after record highs, with China’s demand growth slowing and mine output (e.g., Quellaveco) rising. Analysts forecast a modest refined surplus and surpluses from scrap, leading prices to stay subdued despite supportive energy-transition demand.

title: Vale's target nickel production increased from 170000 tons to 190000 tons in 2022_SMM
summary: Vale CEO Eduardo Bartolomeo said the company wants to expand its industrial metals focus. Vale targets next year higher copper output (300,000 to 350,000 tons) and nickel output (170,000 to 190,000 tons), including battery-grade nickel sales and possible nickel-sulfate processing.

title: Egyptian copper exports rise by 130% in 2021
summary: Egyptian copper exports rose to $296 million in 2021, up from $129 million in 2020, with shipments going to 45 countries and new destinations added. Imports from Saudi Arabia, China, Lebanon and others surged, while exports to Algeria and Jordan fell. The report is trade-focused and largely historical.

title: Nickel Prices Were Boosted by Overseas Energy Crisis_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Europe’s renewed energy shortage pushed natural gas prices higher, leading some European aluminium smelters to gradually cut production, tightening supply concerns. Nickel showed no clear production cuts, but prices rose on bullish sentiment as well as changes in Chinese inventory and refined nickel premiums. Battery-grade nickel sulphate remained weak, limiting upside.

title: Nickel production at Harjavalta stopped due to slag explosion
summary: Boliden said nickel production at its Harjavalta smelter stopped after a slag explosion caused by a malfunction in the electric furnace slag tapping system on Dec. 24. The nickel line is expected to be offline until mid-January, with repair and lost-production costs estimated at 100 MSEK, half in Q4 2021.

title: Egypt's copper exports jump by 130 percent this year
summary: Egypt’s Export Council reports copper exports rose 130% in the first ten months of the year to about USD296 million versus USD129 million a year earlier. Egypt shipped copper to 45 nations and expanded into 16 new markets, with particularly large gains in Lebanon and Greece.

title: American Eagle finalises purchase of Canada's NAK copper-gold project
summary: American Eagle Gold finalized its purchase of a 100% stake in Canada’s NAK copper-gold porphyry project in British Columbia and plans drilling to test a geophysical target. The deal includes cash and work obligations plus an NSR royalty, alongside a flow-through equity raise to fund near-term exploration.

title: China-invested ferronickel smelter put into production in Indonesia-Xinhua
summary: Indonesia’s President attended a ceremony marking the start of production at the PT Gunbuster Nickel Industry ferronickel smelter in Central Sulawesi. The plant, invested by China’s Jiangsu Delong Nickel Industry, is designed to produce 1.8 million tons of ferronickel annually, implying higher nickel supply.

title: China's Zijin starts production at giant Tibet copper mine
summary: Zijin began production at its Qulong copper mine in Tibet. The company expects 120,000-130,000 tonnes of copper output in 2022 and about 160,000 tonnes after Phase 1, with further phases pending approvals. It also cites easing concentrate tightness and rising TC/RCs, implying greater supply ahead for copper.

title: Shengtun Mining Industry: Indonesia Youshan Nickel Industry 34000 tons of nickel metal high matte project currently produces nickel-iron_SMM
summary: Shengtun Mining says its Indonesia Youshan nickel project (about 34,000 tons of high-nickel matte/related product) is operating smoothly with stable output and targets full production, with high-nickel matte production planned. The company also outlines plans to address inter-industry competition through potential asset/equity moves.

title: China's Copper Cathode Imports Soared in Nov as Overseas Shipping Issues Gradually Alleviated_SMM
summary: China’s copper cathode imports in November rose 22.83% month-on-month to 325,500 mt as shipping disruptions in Africa and follow-on shipments from Chile and Australia eased. LME warrant-canceled cargoes also arrived. Exports increased as smelters faced high LME cash backwardation.

title: China's Costs of Aluminium Pulled Back from Highs on Lower Prices of Electricity and Raw & Auxiliary Materials_SMM
summary: SMM reports aluminium smelters returned to profit in December as electricity prices and thermal coal costs fell and alumina and auxiliary material prices declined. January’s electricity cost base remains low, but weighted electricity prices dropped month-on-month. Cost easing below 18,000 yuan/mt supported improved margins, implying supportive aluminium pricing.

title: Designed to Be the World's Biggest Copper Mine, Qulong Gets Up and Running
summary: Phase 1 of China’s Qulong copper mine began production on Monday, according to the operator’s social media post. Qulong, alongside Zhihula, is expected to yield 120,000–130,000 tons of copper in 2022, with Phase 1 designed for nearly 160,000 tons annually. The start-up may affect near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Aluminium industry asks govt not to impose anti-dumping duty on import of Caustic Soda
summary: India’s Aluminium Association urged the Finance Ministry against imposing anti-dumping duties on imported caustic soda from Japan, Iran, Qatar and Oman. It argues existing tariffs and non-tariff barriers already restrict imports, and additional duties would raise aluminium producers’ raw-material costs, potentially harming viability.

title: EBRD to loan EUR 20 million to Bulgarian copper producer Sofia Med AD | Business
summary: EBRD plans to loan EUR 20 million to Bulgarian copper producer Sofia Med AD to support sustainable growth. The funding includes investments in annealing furnaces and a new cold rolling unit, plus a low-carbon pathway aligned with Paris goals. The news signals incremental capacity improvements rather than a clear near-term supply shock.

title: China copper smelters keep Q1 treatment charges flat from previous quarter
summary: China’s top copper smelters kept Q1 treatment and refining charges (TC/RCs) flat versus the previous quarter at $70/tonne and 7 cents/lb for concentrate processing. The floor is higher year-on-year, and relates to concentrate supply tightness; analysts expect easing supply in 2022.

title: CSPT Finalised TC Guidance for Spot Copper Concentrate Procurement in Q1 at $70/mt_SMM
summary: SMM reports that China Smelters Purchase Team (CSPT) finalized Q1 guidance for spot copper concentrate procurement terms (TC/RC) at $70/mt ($0.07/lb). It also notes the weekly SMM Imported Copper Concentrate Index was $62.02/mt on Dec 24. The guidance directly affects smelter concentrate costs.

title: More MJP aluminium Q1 deals emerge at $177/t amid persistent buyer pushback
summary: More MJP aluminium Q1 deals have emerged around $177/t, but buyers continue to push back. The piece also notes Fastmarkets’ administrative corrections and delayed low-carbon aluminium differential assessments, while the deal coverage implies ongoing resistance to higher aluminium prices.

title: Copper hits one-month high as LME reopens after Christmas break
summary: Copper rallied to a one-month high after the LME reopened following a two-day holiday break, rising 1.2% to about $9,679/t, with prices supported by COMEX-LME arbitrage. The piece also notes mixed price action in aluminium and nickel on LME and Shanghai, but no metal-specific drivers beyond trading conditions.

title: Zhongwei Corporation and Xiamen Xiangyu Strategic Cooperation will purchase Nickel and Cobalt from Xiamen Xiangyu_SMM
summary: Zhongwei signed a strategic cooperation framework with Xiamen Xiangyu to secure nickel (about 80,000 tons of nickel metal) and cobalt raw materials over 2022-2027. The deal emphasizes raw material supply and supply-chain security, supporting nickel availability expectations for the company’s precursor production.

title: CSPT finalizes the copper concentrate guidance processing fee in the first quarter. How does TC go in the first quarter? [SMM comment]_SMM
summary: SMM reports CSPT set the Q1 2022 copper concentrate spot procurement processing fee at $70/ton (7.0 cents/lb). It reviews Q4 2021 fee movements, notes increased 2021 concentrate imports, and cites Las Bambas disruptions plus northern China port delays that affected concentrate flows and early-December processing fees.

title: Alcoa to Curb Aluminum Output in Spain After Energy Costs Soar
summary: Alcoa plans to reduce aluminum production in Spain after energy costs surged. The move signals margin pressure for smelters and implies lower near-term primary output, which can tighten aluminum supply conditions and lend support to spot and short-dated aluminum prices in coming days.

title: Indonesia ferronickel plant highlights closer supply chain integration in Asia
summary: Indonesia’s President inaugurated a $2.7 billion ferronickel plant in southeast Sulawesi, invested by a Chinese company. The project is intended to deepen the local supply chain and improve Indonesia’s role in global value chains. Added production capacity would raise expectations for nickel supply and likely support prices.

title: Alcoa to curb aluminium output in Spain as energy costs soar
summary: Alcoa will stop primary aluminium production at its Spanish plant for two years, citing soaring European energy prices. The move adds to recent production cuts by other major smelters in the region, including Aluminium Dunkerque. With supply restrained by high power costs, expectations for aluminium prices move higher.

title: Alcoa To Curtail Aluminum Smelter In Spain For Two Years Due To High Energy Prices
summary: Alcoa said it agreed with workers to curtail its San Ciprián aluminum smelter in Spain by two years because European energy prices are high. Output reduction covers 228,000 mt/year capacity starting Jan. 1, 2022, while the casthouse and alumina refinery keep running. Alcoa expects restructuring charges.

title: Alcoa Corp to Suspend the Production of Aluminium at its Spanish Plant_SMM
summary: Alcoa will suspend aluminium production at its Spanish plant for two years, citing soaring European energy prices. The move follows an earlier production cut by Aluminium Dunkerque Industries France after energy costs hit record highs, worsening financial pressure on European smelters.

title: The United States adjusts its aluminum import regulations_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: The US White House announced adjustments to aluminum imports under Section 232, including a 10% tariff on aluminum products from most countries and a quota-based exemption framework for EU member states. Imports exceeding quotas face duties; qualifying EU products are excluded within set limits until end-2023.

title: Yunnan Aluminum non-public offering shares raised 3 billion yuan for Yunnan Aluminum Wenshan Green Aluminum Project_SMM
summary: Yunnan Aluminum announced a RMB 3 billion non-public share offering to fund and replace capital for its Wenshan green low-carbon hydropower and aluminium integration project. The project has been completed and is in production, with proceeds intended for project use, working capital and loan repayment, potentially improving future profitability and output confidence.

title: Copper range-bound ahead of New Year holiday
summary: Copper traded in a narrow range ahead of the New Year holiday, slightly lower on the LME and Shanghai. Supportive factors include falling inventories and expectations of expanding demand. Copper risk comes from uncertainty over Las Bambas’ restart. Aluminium rose on supply concerns and Alcoa’s temporary Spain shutdown; nickel also ticked up.

title: Yunchen Futures: review of Aluminum Futures Market in 2021 and Market Prospect in 2022_SMM
summary: SMM’s review argues aluminum prices face support in 2022 because energy-consumption “double control” limits new electrolytic aluminium capacity and production recovery, keeping supply tight. Demand is relatively stable, with weaker real-estate aluminum in 2022 and faster but smaller photovoltaic growth. Fed/dollar strength suppresses commodities broadly.

title: Norway's Hydro to cut Slovakia aluminium output further due to power prices
summary: Norsk Hydro said its Slovalco aluminium plant in Slovakia will cut output further because power costs remain high. Production will fall to about 60% of capacity from roughly 80% currently, removing an additional 35,000 tonnes annually. The supply reduction is supportive for aluminium pricing.

title: Aluminium Billet Inventories Up 5,700 mt on Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports aluminium billet inventories in five major consumption areas rose 5,700 mt to 80,300 mt on Dec 30, a 7.64% weekly increase. Most markets saw gains, notably Huzhou and Foshan. Year-end cash-flow management and weaker orders kept the market subdued, and sluggish demand around New Year may drive further inventory growth.

title: SMM Evening Comments (Dec 30): Shanghai Nonferrous Metals Closed Mixed with Aluminium Leading the Gains_SMM
summary: SMM reports Shanghai nonferrous metals closed mixed. Aluminium rose sharply as European aluminium output is cut due to surging electricity prices, with falling social inventories. Nickel also gained on tight supply and lower SHFE/LME inventories, despite future Philippine ore pickup. Copper edged down slightly amid a quiet spot market.

title: NorthWest to buy remaining stake in Kwanika Copper Corporation
summary: NorthWest Copper agreed to buy POSCO International’s remaining 31% stake in the Kwanika Copper Corporation JV for $8.5m in NorthWest shares, making Kwanika a wholly owned subsidiary. The deal ends existing JV/offtake rights, pending TSX Venture Exchange approval, but no immediate production changes are stated.

title: LME nickel inventory declines 636t Singapore and Rotterdam warehouses lead the decline_SMM
summary: SMM reports LME nickel inventories falling by 636 tonnes on Dec 30, led by declines at Singapore and Rotterdam warehouses. The lower visible stock levels suggest tighter near-term availability on the LME, which usually improves sentiment and can underpin nickel price performance over the following days.

title: Early gains and losses of metal trading show that Shanghai aluminum is up more than 1.5%. Black floating red coke fell slightly [SMM Review]_SMM
summary: The report describes early-session mixed moves across metals: Shanghai aluminium up ~1.56% and Shanghai nickel up ~1.27%, while copper fluctuates around 70,000 yuan/ton. It attributes aluminium strength to European energy price shocks and Alcoa planning a two-year Spanish electrolytic shutdown, but overall trading remains range-bound.

title: Alcoa to curb output at  Spain aluminium plant
summary: Alcoa says it will curb primary aluminium production at its Spain plant for two years, citing soaring European energy prices and fresh record power costs. The move follows earlier output reductions by other regional aluminium smelters, highlighting growing supply risk for aluminium in Europe.

title: President Biden Issues Proclamations Adjusting Imports Of Steel And Aluminum Into The United States - International Law
summary: Biden issued proclamations replacing some Section 232 tariffs with TRQs for EU steel and aluminum. Aluminum faces in-quota treatment only up to specified TRQ volumes (and certain exclusions may count against quota), while out-of-quota volumes remain subject to tariffs. The U.S. will monitor implementation through Dec. 2023.

title: Copper Inventory in China Bonded Zone Grew 15,600 mt on Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s bonded copper inventories rose 15,600 mt to 187,300 mt (Dec 24–Dec 31), the first uptick after 11 consecutive declines. Shanghai and Guangdong bonded zones both increased. Subdued import trading and severe import losses reduced demand and shipments, shifting arrivals into bonded warehouses and stopping the drawdown.

title: The Supply Gap of Aluminium to Record 110,000 mt in 2022, Supply-Demand to Maintain Tight Balance_SMM
summary: SMM cites Sinolink Securities forecasting a 110,000 mt aluminium shortage in 2022, with supply-demand kept in a tight balance. Production capacity in Yunnan and Guangxi may rise as energy-consumption problems ease, while demand from real estate and manufacturing rebounds, but overall the market stays constrained into 2023.

title: Indonesian Government Supports EVs Battery Plan, the Demand for Nickel to Increase_SMM
summary: Indonesia’s government signals strong support for an EV battery development plan with cooperation from investors and research institutions. The article argues that rising EV procurement and manufacturing will increase nickel demand as a battery raw material, implying favorable prospects for nickel prices, given Indonesia’s dominant position in nickel production.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports Fell 65,000 wmt_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Nickel ore inventories at Chinese ports fell 65,000 wmt week-on-week to 8.59 million wmt as of Dec 31. Total Ni content was 67,500 mt. Declines persisted but at a slower pace as arrivals and loading slowed and unloading pressure eased, while some NPI plants may maintain in January.

title: Soaring Natural Gas Prices Are Weighing On Global Aluminum Production
summary: Soaring natural gas prices have increased European power costs, driving cuts in primary aluminium production at Aluminium Dunkerque, Alcoa’s Spain plant shutdown, and Alro’s 60% reduction. Delivery premiums are rising again while LME inventories remain under 1 million tons, tightening supply and supporting aluminium prices.

title: Bullish sentiment spreads Pure Nickel supply is tight and Nickel Price volatility strengthens [SMM Nickel Weekly report]_SMM
summary: SMM’s nickel weekly report says pure nickel supply remains tight, with low stocks supporting prices above 150,000. Spot premiums stayed strong as arrivals fell after traders completed long orders and account closures. Rigid downstream demand and end-year stainless steel stockpiling underpin a bullish near-term nickel outlook.

title: At the end of the year, there was a strong atmosphere for foreign trade and few copper transactions were made [selected by SMM Copper Weekly]_SMM
summary: SMM reports a strong end-of-year foreign-trade atmosphere but very light copper market trading. Premiums keep falling due to oversupply pressure, import losses fluctuate around 700 yuan/ton, and buyers show low enthusiasm to acquire or build inventory. Traders largely wait for post-holiday liquidity and guidance.

title: CBP Issues Guidance On EU Section 232 Tariff Rate Quotas On Imports Of Aluminum And Steel Articles - International Law
summary: CBP issued guidance on EU Section 232 tariff-rate quotas starting Jan 1, 2022. EU aluminum articles entered within the quota via specified HTSUS TRQ IDs face duty-free treatment, while out-of-quota imports face a 10% ad valorem duty. In-quota processing is first-come/first-served and tracked weekly.

title: Break-ins, copper cable theft and now fire: Here's when parliament's security was breached
summary: Cape Town’s parliamentary precinct has suffered repeated security breaches, including reports in October of thieves stripping copper wire from bathrooms and stealing copper pipes and taps. The latest fire and earlier break-ins highlight ongoing theft and arson risks. The article’s copper-related theft is likely small but sentiment-negative.

title: Copper production in Chile fell 1.6 per cent to 485716 tons in November from a year earlier._SMM
summary: Chile’s National Bureau of Statistics (INE) reported that copper production fell 1.6% year-on-year to 485,716 tons in November. As Chile is the world’s largest copper producer, weaker output can influence near-term supply expectations and sentiment for copper prices.

title: Comex Copper Settles 0.91% Lower at $4.4145 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex Copper front-month futures settled 0.91% lower at $4.4145 per pound, down 4.05 cents. The drop marks the largest one-day dollar and percentage decline since Dec. 28, and copper fell in four of the past five sessions, also declining about 7.62% from its 52-week high.

title: Lunnon Metals hits high-grade nickel in shoot near old Foster mine
summary: Lunnon Metals announced drill results from the Warren shoot in Western Australia’s Kambalda nickel district, including 8.72m grading 3.54% nickel and an interval of 2.33m at 4.41% nickel. The company highlights momentum for follow-up drilling. The report also references falling LME nickel inventories, reinforcing a bullish nickel tone.

title: The profits of electrolytic aluminum enterprises are expected to continue to improve._SMM
summary: SMM reports aluminium prices in China rebounded toward 20,000 yuan/ton as inventories fell and European electrolytic capacity was reduced. Alumina costs also declined, improving per-ton margins. With demand from new energy vehicles rising and policy carbon-reduction support expected, aluminium prices are expected to stay high and profits improve.

title: Aluminum: profit per ton of aluminum rises rapidly, electrolytic aluminum plate is not very good [institutional review]_SMM
summary: SMM reports aluminum profits per ton have surged, supported by falling inventories to under 1 million tons and easing end-of-demand power cuts with order resumption. Costs for electricity, alumina, and pre-baked anodes have declined since late October. Despite energy-consumption limits keeping supply tight, improving demand points to bullish aluminum price pressure.

title: Copper prices slip as dollar strength, rising Omicron cases weigh
summary: Copper fell about 1% on the LME as the dollar strengthened and Treasury yields rose, with traders pricing an early U.S. Fed hike. Rising Omicron cases also weighed on sentiment. The same macro pressure pulled down LME aluminium and nickel, alongside other base metals.

title: Copper prices slip as firm dollar, Omicron worries weigh
summary: Copper prices fell as a firmer U.S. dollar and uncertainty about Omicron’s impact weighed on industrial-metals sentiment. Three-month copper on the LME dropped 1%. The article also notes declines in LME aluminum and nickel on the day, reflecting broader macro-driven bearish pressure.

title: Review of China Alumina Price Moves in 2021_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reviews China alumina price moves in 2021: a surplus early-year, rising prices from late July to a 10-year high in early November driven by higher costs, production cuts, and political disruption, then a Q4 decline on falling costs, surplus, and cheaper imports. Aluminium prices trended down in Q4.

title: Supply worries boost aluminium and zinc prices
summary: Aluminium prices rose as market participants worried that prolonged high European power costs could trigger further supply disruptions; LME aluminium inventories are down over 60% since mid-March. The same inventory-tightness theme and cancelled warrants point to potential further draws on nickel supply, supporting a broader bullish tone.

title: China decarbonization forces shift in western aluminium market
summary: China’s decarbonization and emissions compliance have reduced aluminium output and tightened supplies, contributing to Chinese and global deficits. Tonnage has shifted from western stockpiles toward Asia, shrinking LME warehouse levels, widening contango/backwardation dynamics, and lifting global aluminium premiums and prices to records in 2021.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel announces continued High-Grade Nickel Intersections from Langmuir, completing the Phase 1 Drilling
summary: EV Nickel reports assay results from the second half of Phase 1 drilling at its Langmuir Nickel Project, including near-surface nickel sulphide intercepts (e.g., ~15.7m at 1.14% Ni and 19.5m at 0.96% Ni). The company says Phase 2 drilling begins next.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Ltd.: Ivanhoe Mines to Issue 2021 Production Numbers and 2022 Production and Cost Guidance for Kamoa-Kakula Copper Complex on January 10
summary: Ivanhoe Mines said it will release year-end 2021 production results and 2022 production and cost guidance for the Kamoa-Kakula copper complex in the DRC on January 10. Kamoa-Kakula is positioned to expand output and uses renewable hydro power, but no specific numbers are announced yet.

title: Supply fears boost aluminum and zinc prices
summary: Aluminum prices rose about 1% on Tuesday as traders flagged supply disruptions linked to prolonged high electricity and gas costs, with low LME inventories and expectations of additional warehouse departures. Industrial metals broadly gained on a weaker dollar amid uncertainty in Europe’s energy market. Nickel also increased alongside the move.

title: Chile's copper production down by 0.68% in November: Cochilco
summary: Cochilco said Chilean copper production fell 0.68% in November. As the world’s largest copper producer, any output decline can affect near-term expectations for supply. However, the reported drop is modest, suggesting limited immediate impact on prices.

title: How a nickel mine in New Caledonia could be the key to Tesla's success
summary: The piece describes the Goro nickel mine in New Caledonia, potentially holding up to about one-quarter of global nickel reserves. It emphasizes Tesla’s push to secure responsible battery mineral supply chains. The mine is described as suspended, raising expectations of tighter nickel supply in the near term.

title: Technical Factors to Push up Nickel Prices_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports nickel prices in China exceeding 150,000 yuan/mt as pure nickel inventories remain low and spot premiums stay firm. Traders completed long-term order activity, reducing arriving shipments, while stainless demand supports NPI and brisk nickel sulphate restocking. Despite expectations of easing premiums from arrivals, technicals suggest further upside for nickel this week.

title: Nickel Sulphate Prices to Rise amid High Raw Material Prices_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says battery-grade nickel sulphate quotes rose to 34,500–35,500 yuan/mt on higher nickel prices and higher upstream quotes as low-priced cargoes were consumed. Spot inventories declined after downstream stockpiling, easing cash flow and limiting discount sales. Prices are expected to stay within 34,500–35,500 this week, with nickel poised to rise.

title: Vale reaches nickel supply agreement with US automakers_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Vale’s CEO said the company is in talks with US automakers and has agreed to sell 5% of its annual first-class nickel production to a carmaker, widely rumored to be Tesla. The deal supports nickel supply linked to North American battery-material demand, likely tightening sentiment.

title: London copper eases off 6-week high on dollar strength
summary: London copper fell 0.4% from a six-week high as the U.S. dollar held firm on expectations for early Federal Reserve rate hikes, potentially reducing market liquidity. LME aluminium dipped 0.1% and nickel slipped 0.7% in tandem, reflecting broad macro pressure. Separate data points were also cited.

title: London nickel inventory fell by more than 10% after brushing the new low of Shanghai nickel inventory for more than two years._SMM
summary: SMM cites LME data showing nickel inventories continued to fall, reaching about 101,256 tons—lowest in over two years—down roughly 61.7% from late April 2021. Shanghai inventories also declined, down 12.25% to 5,057 tons, reinforcing tighter near-term nickel supply expectations.

title: Vedanta Aluminium and GEAR India to deploy one of India's largest lithium-ion forklift fleets
summary: Vedanta Aluminium will deploy 23 lithium-ion electric forklifts at its Jharsuguda aluminium smelter, replacing diesel units. The move is aimed at reducing diesel use and emissions and improving productivity and safety through smart fleet management and IoT monitoring. It is an operational decarbonization initiative, not a supply change.

title: The rise in aluminum and zinc futures in LME is boosted by supply concerns and a weaker US dollar._SMM
summary: LME aluminum rose after traders cited supply concerns from long-term high European electricity prices and low inventories, with more metal expected to leave warehouses. Copper also increased alongside a weaker US dollar, which can spur demand for dollar-priced commodities. Energy/gas uncertainty in Europe remains a key risk factor.

title: Adventus, Salazar form JV for Ecuadorian copper-gold project
summary: Adventus Mining formed a joint venture with Salazar Resources to develop Ecuador’s Curipamba copper-gold project. Adventus will fund exploration and cover capital costs to production after the feasibility study, owns 75%, and is set to begin detailed engineering and finalize an investment agreement with the Ecuadorian government.

title: Power prices propel aluminium to 2-month peak
summary: Aluminium prices surged to a two-month peak as high European power prices reinforced expectations of large market deficits. Prompt European power forecasts (e.g., weaker German wind supply and stronger French demand) raise smelting costs, while LME aluminium stocks have fallen sharply and cancelled warrants suggest continued outflows.

title: Bell Copper Corporation: Bell Copper Drills Strong Leached Cap in Porphyry at Big Sandy
summary: Bell Copper reports drilling at its Big Sandy porphyry copper project, intersecting hematitic leached capping in quartz porphyry and referencing prior chalcocite supergene enrichment in a nearby hole. Management says results match expectations for targeting copper oxide/supergene minerals at an oxidation boundary, but no resource is defined yet.

title: BHP to adapt Chile copper mine after court ruling on water usage
summary: BHP said it will modify operations at its Cerro Colorado copper mine in Chile after a court ruling restricts water extraction. A new 90-day prohibition on drawing from the Lagunillas aquifer led BHP to halt one plant and limit production while it awaits further decisions, which could affect copper supply.

title: U.S. Customs and Border Protection Announces Details of Tariff-Rate Quotas for Steel and Aluminum Products From the European Union | Faegre Drinker Biddle & Reath LLP
summary: CBP set out how tariff-rate quotas for EU steel and aluminum—negotiated to replace Section 232 tariffs—are administered by HTS group and by EU country, split by quarter on a first-come basis. After quarterly quota closure, remaining EU aluminum shipments face Section 232 tariffs unless exclusions apply.

title: LME copper closed down, electricity price was high, aluminum hit its highest level in more than two months during the recovery period._SMM
summary: LME aluminium surged to a two-month high amid high European electricity prices and sharply lower LME inventories, with large cancellations of warehouse receipts suggesting more metal could leave. Aluminium spot prices rose sharply, reinforcing tight European supply fears. LME copper meanwhile settled lower on the day, limiting net cross-metal bullishness.

title: LME copper closed down, electricity price was high, aluminum hit its highest level in more than two months during the recovery period._SMM
summary: LME aluminium jumped to a two-month high as high European electricity prices and sharply lower LME stocks/warehouse receipt cancellations raised expectations of severe shortages. Aluminium’s supply tightness is reinforced by soaring spot prices and estimates of European capacity shutdown. LME copper settled lower during the same recovery session.

title: Culpeo Minerals raises ownership level at flagship Chile copper project
summary: Culpeo Minerals increased its stake to 66% in the Las Petacas copper project in Chile, after earlier reports of encouraging copper intercepts over 500m and a >6km mineralized trend. Drilling is continuing into 2022 and planned for additional copper-gold prospects, including Diego East and Far East.

title: Lunnon Metals builds potential at Kambalda project with more high-grade nickel
summary: Lunnon Metals says recent drilling at its Kambalda project (old Foster mine, N75C) returned high-grade nickel, including 7.7m at 2.92% Ni and adjacent intercepts around 3% Ni. Management says historic workings likely host unmined nickel and plans to finalize an updated resource estimate.

title: Nickel Downstream Composite PMI in December Stands in the Contraction Range_SMM
summary: SMM reports December 2021 PMI for China’s nickel downstream industries stayed in contraction (composite 49.59). Production fell to 49.02 with weak readings in stainless steel and electroplating, while new orders were mostly contracting and declined sharply late in 2021. Nickel sulphate purchasing prices were stable with small fluctuations.

title: Trigon Metals produces first concentrate at Namibian copper mine
summary: Trigon Metals says it has produced the first copper concentrate at the Kombat Mine in Namibia after a 14-year shutdown due to flooding. The mine is equipped with filter presses and expects full commercial production in March 2022, targeting 4,000t in concentrate capacity, rising to 14,500t by 2024.

title: The market is worried about increasing the downward trend of nickel and stainless steel [agency review]_SMM
summary: SMM says domestic nickel and stainless steel prices fell more than 2% as markets priced in the possibility of U.S. rate hikes as early as March, raising risk concerns. Despite low inventories supporting levels, the article expects greater downside pressure and near-term nickel weakness, partly offset by upstream supply mismatches.

title: Bitterroot Resources Ltd.: Bitterroot Resources To Resume Drilling at the LM Nickel-Copper Project
summary: Bitterroot Resources and its JV plan to resume drilling at the LM nickel-copper project in Michigan the week of Jan. 10, targeting the SE quadrant of the LM intrusion. The first hole will test for nickel and copper massive sulphides based on earlier high-grade intersections, with drilling serving exploration rather than production.

title: Bitterroot Resources Ltd.: Bitterroot Resources To Resume Drilling at the LM Nickel-Copper Project
summary: Bitterroot Resources and its JV partner plan to resume drilling at the LM nickel-copper project in Michigan, targeting the keel of a massive sulphide body with prior high-grade nickel and copper intercepts. The news is exploration-focused, with no near-term production or supply change implied.

title: South32, Alcoa to resume production at Brazilian aluminium smelter
summary: South32 and Alcoa plan to invest $175m to restart the Alumar aluminium smelter in Brazil, previously on care and maintenance since 2015. Using 100% renewable power, the project targets production in the June quarter of 2022 and up to 447,000 tpa capacity by March 2023.

title: Aluminium Bahrain B S C : Alba sets an all-time production record of 1,561,222 MT in 2021
summary: Aluminium Bahrain (Alba) said it produced an all-time record 1,561,222 tonnes in 2021, beating its 2020 output and marking more than 20 million safe working hours without any lost-time injuries. The release highlights stronger smelting performance at a major ex-China supplier.

title: ATEX Provides Update on Valeriano Copper Gold Project with D...
summary: ATEX announced contracts to mobilize drilling rigs and complete geophysical surveys at its Valeriano copper-gold project in Chile. A planned 6,000-metre program will follow historical copper intersections and aims to confirm the mineralized system. The release provides an inferred resource but no production or supply impact.

title: Bitterroot Resources : to Resume Drilling at the LM Nickel-Copper Project
summary: Bitterroot Resources and Below Exploration plan to resume drilling in January 2022 at the LM nickel-copper project in Michigan, targeting massive sulphide zones for new intersections. Prior holes reported high-grade nickel and copper results. The update is exploration-focused with no production or supply disruption details.

title: Bitterroot Resources : to Resume Drilling at the LM Nickel-Copper Project
summary: Bitterroot Resources and Below Exploration plan to resume drilling during the week of January 10, 2022 at the LM nickel-copper property in Michigan. Drilling targets massive sulphide zones for further testing. The release cites prior intercepts with high nickel and copper grades but no production changes.

title: BHP Cuts More Jobs at Water-Stressed Chilean Copper Mine
summary: BHP is cutting more jobs at a water-stressed copper mine in Chile. The move signals operational strain from insufficient water availability, raising expectations of reduced mine output and potentially tighter near-term copper supply conditions.

title: New Year, New Duty Savings: TRQ For EU Steel and Aluminum Takes Effect   | Arent Fox
summary: US Customs and Border Protection published guidance and Federal Register proclamations for EU steel and aluminum TRQs under Section 232. The aluminum quota begins processing Jan 3, 2022, with quota allocation rules and renewed exclusions through 2023. Reduced effective tariff burden and managed import volumes may weigh on aluminum prices near term.

title: Zenith Minerals reveals high-grade copper and new lithium alliance
summary: Zenith Minerals entered a trading halt after reporting broader, high-grade copper intercepts at its Develin Creek VMS project in Queensland, including multiple drill hits above ~1.7% to 2.5% copper. The company is also preparing details of a lithium alliance, but copper results are the immediate price-relevant takeaway for markets.

title: LME copper futures closed lower Fed hawkish signals hit risk appetite_SMM
summary: LME copper futures closed down after Federal Reserve minutes signaled interest rates could rise faster, weighing on risk appetite and liquidity. The stronger dollar reduced demand for dollar assets. Yangshan copper premium fell, suggesting softer Chinese import demand, while aluminium also eased as base metals fell despite tight warehouses.

title: Japan Buyers Agreed to $177/mt Premiums for Liquid Aluminium _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Japan buyers agreed liquid aluminium shipment premiums of $177/mt for Jan–Mar, down 20% from the prior quarter and below $220/mt in Oct–Dec. The cut reflects weaker Japanese spot premiums and overseas prices, signaling reduced demand pressure. Japan is Asia’s largest aluminium importer, with bids above LME.

title: Copper Inventory in Major Chinese Markets Dropped 11,200 mt From Monday_SMM
summary: SMM says copper inventories across major Chinese markets fell 11,200 mt to 83,700 mt from Jan 3 to Jan 7, reversing a brief rise. Smelter operating rates eased after New Year, customs-cleared imports dropped, and demand firmed after recent price falls. Inventories are expected to keep declining next week.

title: China's nickel sulfate price rebounds in first week of 2022; no major impact from Indonesia power tightness
summary: The piece reports that China’s nickel sulfate prices rebounded in the first week of 2022, implying firmer pricing for a key nickel feedstock. It also notes that Indonesia’s power tightness did not have a major market impact, suggesting limited near-term downside pressure from that factor.

title: Copper Inventory in China Bonded Zone Up 16,200 mt on Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s domestic bonded copper inventories rose 16,200 mt to 203,500 mt by Jan 7, with Shanghai up 13,000 mt and Guangdong up 3,200 mt. With the import window closed, losses were mainly 700 yuan/mt and outflows slowed, while overseas arrivals increased, lifting stocks and pressuring sentiment for copper.

title: Spot Nickel Imports Maintained Sound Profits_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that the SHFE/LME nickel price ratio has bottomed and the import window has reopened, improving traders’ profitability. Bonded-zone nickel inventory rose mainly due to nickel plant supply, which may extend into next week and flow into the domestic market given tight local supply. Spot premiums remain high, and import data will be watched.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports Rose 86,000 wmt on Week_SMM
summary: SMM said Chinese nickel ore inventories rose 86,000 wmt to 8.67 million wmt (6.81 million mt Ni content) as of Jan 7. Arrivals were limited by low Philippine exports in the rainy season. NPI output stayed stable but constrained by environmental limits and maintenance, reducing ore demand. Inventory may drop slightly soon.

title: Aluminium rises as stocks dwindle and output cuts loom
summary: Aluminium rebounded toward $3,000/t as LME-registered warehouse stocks dropped sharply, with traders fearing Europe’s and Asia’s energy crunch will force additional smelter cutbacks. Analysts cite energy as ~40% of operating costs and warn significant capacity is at risk, reinforcing a worsening supply deficit.

title: Value of Chile's copper exports jumps 21.9% in December, 40.6% in 2021
summary: Chile’s central bank reported that the value of copper exports rose 21.9% in December and 40.6% in 2021, supported by strong copper prices. Copper shipment values reached $4.91 billion in December and $53.42 billion in 2021. Economists expect weaker performance this year amid higher supply.

title: Guatemala lifts Fénix nickel mine suspension
summary: The article headline says Guatemala lifted the suspension of the Fénix nickel mine. If operations resume, the market would likely anticipate higher near-term nickel supply, which typically weighs on nickel prices within the next days to four weeks.

title: Bill orders Kentucky to recover $15 million in stalled aluminum plant deal
summary: Kentucky’s legislature introduced a bill ordering the state to recover a $15 million investment (with interest/fees) from a failed aluminum mill deal near Ashland, connected to Braidy Industries/Unity Aluminum. The project’s financing fell short amid allegations of fraud. The bill sets deadlines and limits further time for private funding.

title: European aluminium scrap and secondary prices to be supported, participants say: 2022 preview
summary: Market participants expect European aluminium scrap and secondary ingot prices to stay robust into 2022 despite a sharp recent decline in DIN226. They cite bullish sentiment from tight raw-material supply, rising automotive order inquiries for early 2022, and continued support from record scrap prices and growing demand for low-CO2 recycled aluminium.

title: Comex Copper Ends the Week 1.17% Lower at $4.4030 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex front-month copper for January delivery settled at $4.4030, down 1.17% for the week and losing 5.20 cents per pound, snapping a four-week winning streak. It rose 1.26% on the day and was up from the prior session losses. No underlying drivers beyond price data are cited.

title: Aluminum futures rise due to falling inventories and high energy costs may lead to production cuts._SMM
summary: LME aluminium rose to multi-year highs as LME inventories fell to the lowest since 2005. Traders expect additional aluminium smelter cuts because European and Asian electricity prices have surged, reinforcing supply tightness. BofA notes large output reductions already and potential further shutdowns from high energy costs.

title: LME copper inventory decreased by 1175 tons from Rotterdam and Singapore_SMM
summary: The article states that LME copper warehouse inventories fell by 1,175 tons, with the change attributed to Rotterdam and Singapore. Tracking LME stock levels suggests tighter near-term supply conditions, which usually provides upward support to copper prices over the short term.

title: Global copper smelting activity held steady in December_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Satellite monitoring reported global copper smelting activity was broadly stable in December 2021, but China’s production fell as power shortages reduced smelter operations, particularly in the southwest. SAVANT’s dispersion index dropped to 53.5, though increased output outside China largely offset the loss overall.

title: Chile's copper exports jumped 21.9% to US $4.9 billion in December_SMM
summary: Chile’s central bank data show copper export revenue rose 21.9% in December to $4.91 billion, supported by strong prices. With Chile the world’s largest copper producer, higher export receipts strengthen near-term market sentiment and expectations for copper demand and price levels. Trade surplus also improved to $520 million.

title: 'Large amount of copper' stolen from windfarm in Offaly
summary: A theft at Mountlucas Windfarm in Offaly is under investigation after copper wire and copper clips were stolen over several days. Gardai are appealing for information. The incident directly involves copper but appears localized with no indication of a market-wide supply effect.

title: Europe's power crunch sparks aluminium smelter meltdown
summary: Europe’s aluminium smelters face a winter power crunch, with operators announcing curtailments totaling over half a million tonnes of annual capacity. Others are flexing output to manage power-load price spikes. The resulting supply squeeze is likely to affect aluminium market expectations over the coming days to weeks.

title: How will the supply and demand of nickel market go in 2022? [institutional point of view]_SMM
summary: The piece weighs differing views on 2022 nickel supply-demand, citing INSG surplus/shortage estimates and Commerzbank/Nornickel/ANZ scenarios. It highlights Indonesia’s expanding projects but also uncertainty from disruptions, China power cuts, and possible export bans or taxes—factors that could offset each other and leave prices range-bound.

title: Lower-than-expected low inventory data from the United States and Africa supported strong volatility in nickel prices [institutional review]_SMM
summary: SMM reports tight nickel supply with low spot availability and mentions global nickel inventories staying at historically low levels and LME nickel transfer fees at multi-month highs. Spot prices/rising waters supported firm sentiment, while downstream stainless steel restocking/pre-holiday demand improved. The outlook remains supported but wary of stainless steel maintenance.

title: Carnaby Resources : Strong Drill Results at Nil Desperandum - 60m @ 0.9% Copper
summary: Carnaby Resources announced strong drilling at its Nil Desperandum prospect, including 60.3m @ 0.9% copper and confirmation of down-plunge continuity, with further results pending. The company plans major follow-up drilling with multiple rigs and IP surveys, plus additional tenement applications targeting an IOCG corridor.

title: Copper Prices to Remain at the Current Level with Strong Support_SMM
summary: SMM reports copper trading between 69,000-70,500 yuan/mt, with Fed minutes hawkishness causing short-term volatility. It expects improved domestic macro and notes higher December cathode output, easing copper anode shortages after better port shipping, and declining inventories with resilient consumption, supporting prices near current levels.

title: Metal price rise Shanghai aluminum four consecutive rise stainless steel up more than 3% [SMM Daily Review]_SMM
summary: SMM’s daily review says most metals rose, led by stainless steel, with Shanghai aluminium up over 1% for a fourth straight session and aluminium inventories decreasing. Shanghai nickel rose about 2.5% as spot supply remained tight and premiums increased. Copper also edged higher, supporting a bullish near-term tone.

title: Copper Inventory in Major Chinese markets Added 2,700 mt over Weekend_SMM
summary: SMM says China’s major-market copper inventories rose 2,700 mt from Friday to 86,400 mt. Shanghai and Guangdong increased due to stronger imported-copper arrivals, while Tianjin declined. With customs clearance expected to rise slightly and consumption weak, SMM expects stock accumulation this week, pressuring copper sentiment.

title: EBRD supports EV battery copper foil producer in Hungary
summary: EBRD approved a US$28 million loan to Solus Advanced Materials to build an ultra-thin copper foil plant for EV battery production in Hungary, supplying European battery makers. The project is based on scrap copper recycling, boosting circularity. The new capacity outlook supports copper demand expectations for the near term.

title: BHP to invest $50 million to advance Tanzania nickel project
summary: BHP plans to invest $40 million into Kabanga Nickel’s Tanzanian nickel project and $10 million into Lifezone’s cleaner refining technology to cut emissions and improve efficiency. The project targets first nickel production in 2025, ramping later, but the news supports positive near-term sentiment for nickel supply prospects.

title: EBRD supports EV battery copper foil producer in Hungary | Business
summary: EBRD is providing a $28 million loan to Solus Advanced Materials to build an ultra-thin copper foil plant for EV batteries in Tatabanya, Hungary. The project relies on scrap copper and supports the EU’s e-mobility transition, increasing expected copper demand from the battery supply chain.

title: EBRD to support copper foil factory for EV batteries project...
summary: EBRD will provide a $28 million loan to Solus Advanced Materials to build an ultra-thin copper foil factory in Tatabanya, Hungary, supplying European EV battery producers. The plant uses scrap copper and supports EU electro-mobility and climate targets, signaling incremental copper demand for battery materials.

title: Aluminium queue at Port Klang drops to just under 60 days
summary: The news says the aluminium queue at Port Klang has fallen to just under 60 days, suggesting congestion is easing and shipments should move more smoothly. With improved logistics and less near-term delivery tightness, market expectations for aluminium availability may turn more favourable over the coming days.

title: Indonesia plans to stop exporting bauxite, copper ores-Xinhua
summary: Indonesia’s President said the country will halt bauxite ore exports in 2022 and copper ore exports in 2023 to drive downstream investment and shift exports toward higher-value semi-finished and finished products. Indonesia is a major bauxite and copper exporter, implying reduced global ore supply.

title: Indonesia plans to stop exporting bauxite, copper ores-Xinhua
summary: Indonesia’s president said Jakarta plans to stop exporting bauxite ore in 2022 and copper ore in 2023 to accelerate downstream investment and shift toward higher-value products. Indonesia is a major exporter, and the move is expected to affect near-term supply expectations for copper concentrates and aluminium feedstock.

title: BHP branches out into Tanzania with nickel play
summary: BHP plans to invest up to $100 million in Tanzania’s Kabanga Nickel project, including an initial $40 million, as part of its expansion into “future-facing commodities.” The deposit is described as the world’s largest development-ready nickel sulphide resource, supporting bullish sentiment toward nickel supply prospects.

title: BHP to invest in Tanzanian nickel project
summary: BHP will invest $90m in Tanzania’s Kabanga Nickel project, with tranches converting into equity and expanding its stake subject to approvals and milestones. The project is expected to produce 65,000 tonnes nickel equivalent annually, supporting nickel supply development, alongside plans to advance low-carbon hydromet refining technology.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: Tesla and Talon Metals Enter into Supply Agreement for Nickel
summary: Talon Metals and Tesla signed a multi-year supply agreement for Tesla to buy 75,000 metric tonnes of nickel concentrate from the Tamarack Nickel Project in Minnesota, with Tesla holding a right to additional volumes. The price is linked to the LME official nickel cash settlement, subject to conditions for commercial production.

title: Metals rose more than 2.5% in Shanghai Nickel at midday, stainless steel rose more than 2.8% against the trend [SMM afternoon Review]_SMM
summary: SMM’s afternoon review notes Shanghai nickel rising about 2.56% and Shanghai aluminium gaining roughly 1.1% by midday, while copper also moved higher. For copper, Tianjin epidemic-related disruption left spot trading deserted, with electrolytic copper discounts narrowing. Overall moves appear intraday and mixed across the strip.

title: Tesla, Talon Enter Into Nickel Concentrate Supply Agreement
summary: Tesla and Talon have reportedly entered into a nickel concentrate supply agreement, signaling secured sourcing of nickel feedstock for battery-related production. Such deals can tighten perceived near-term nickel concentrate availability and improve demand visibility, usually supporting modest upward pressure in nickel prices over the next days to weeks.

title: BHP bets on new African nickel mine as electric car era dawns
summary: BHP agreed to invest in Tanzania’s Kabanga Nickel project, expanding development and refining efforts tied to future nickel sulphide production. The piece links nickel demand to EV battery growth and policy-driven electrification, suggesting supply support and stronger demand expectations, which are modestly positive for nickel sentiment.

title: Indonesia plans to stop exporting bauxite, copper ores
summary: Indonesia’s President said the country will stop exporting bauxite ore from 2022 and copper ore in 2023 to accelerate downstream processing and exports of higher-value products. Indonesia already banned nickel ore exports in 2020, signaling a broader shift that could tighten traded ore supplies supporting bearish price pressure.

title: Indonesia plans to stop exporting bauxite, copper ores
summary: Indonesia plans to halt bauxite ore exports in 2022 and copper ore exports in 2023 to boost downstream processing and exports of higher-value products. It already banned nickel ore exports from Jan 1, 2020. These actions tighten supply of key raw inputs for aluminum and copper markets.

title: Tesla Inks Nickel Supply Deal With Talon Metals
summary: Tesla has signed a nickel concentrate supply deal with Talon Metals from the Tamarack Nickel Project in Minnesota. Tesla plans to buy about 75,000 tons of nickel concentrate over six years at LME-listed prices, supporting battery-material sourcing and potentially tightening near-term nickel supply expectations.

title: BHP Billiton returns to Africa through Tanzanian Nickel Investment_SMM
summary: BHP will invest about $100m in Tanzania’s Kabanga nickel project, including buying an 8.9% stake with potential to raise it further. The move reflects a shift back to nickel amid green-energy demand. Kabanga also targets copper production, but output is planned from 2025 onward, limiting near-term price impact.

title: Ivanhoe Mining: Kamoa-Kakula Copper Mine will produce 290000 to 340000 tons of Copper concentrate in 2022_SMM
summary: Ivanhoe Mining raised/confirmed its 2022 output outlook for the Kamoa-Kakula copper mine, targeting 290,000–340,000 tonnes of copper concentrate, after exceeding prior production guidance. The firm expects earlier ramp-up from a second-phase concentrator expansion and discusses costs and ongoing expansion phases.

title: Tesla signs a $1.5 billion deal to buy nickel from the Minnesota project of Talon Metals_SMM
summary: Tesla signed its first US nickel supply deal to buy 75,000 tonnes of nickel over six years from Talon Metals’ Tamarack mine in Minnesota, with options to increase tonnage. The contract supports nickel demand visibility and development funding, likely boosting sentiment for nickel prices in the near term.

title: Low Inventory Supported the Nickel Prices to Stand High _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports nickel prices pulled back but remain supported by low refined nickel inventories and continued stock declines. Spot premiums over futures expanded and the import window stayed open, easing tight supply. Nickel sulfate demand and restocking activity were strong, with fewer producers cutting output, leaving few bearish factors.

title: Resources & Energy : Magmatic Nickel Sulphides Confirmed at East Menzies
summary: Resources & Energy reports petrographic confirmation of magmatic Ni-Fe sulphides at its Springfield (East Menzies) project, identifying nickel minerals such as pentlandite and related sulphides in RC drill samples. The company expects further multi-element and PGE/gold assays in coming weeks, but no production or supply change is announced.

title: Dundas Minerals to wrap up Kokoda drilling and move to Jumbuck nickel prospect
summary: Dundas Minerals says its maiden drilling at the Kokoda gold prospect will finish this week, and the rig will move to the nearby Jumbuck nickel prospect. Jumbuck has historic anomalous nickel grades (0.5% in a 2011 hole) with untested conductive anomalies, and drilling is expected to start this weekend.

title: Tesla signs deal for first U.S. nickel supply with Talon Metals
summary: Tesla signed its first U.S. nickel supply agreement with Talon Metals, tied to nickel concentrate prices on the London Metals Exchange. The deal sources from Talon’s Tamarack project in Minnesota and is aimed at more environmentally friendly battery materials. Tesla plans to buy 75,000 tonnes over six years.

title: Nickel price buoyed by strong demand, dwindling stocks
summary: Nickel prices held near two-month highs as electric-vehicle battery demand boosted offtake and reduced nickel stocks in LME-approved warehouses. LME inventory has fallen sharply since April 2021, with high cancelled warrants and a wider cash premium versus the three-month contract indicating tightening supply. Aluminium is also mentioned.

title: Annual performance pre-increase report of Huafeng Aluminum Industry: net profit of RMB 430-510 million in 2021_SMM
summary: Huafeng Aluminum reported a 2021 pre-increase, with profit for shareholders expected at RMB 430–510 million, up on year due to recovering national demand and rapid new-energy vehicle growth. The company links improved output and sales to demand for aluminum foil and heat-transfer aluminum materials.

title: ITC Futures: domestic aluminum ingots continue to go to the warehouse and aluminum prices go up further._SMM
summary: SMM reports China electrolytic aluminum inventory falling to 752,000 tons and spot prices for aluminum rising across Guangdong and the Yangtze River. It attributes strength to continued destocking of domestic aluminum ingots and expected supply tightness in Europe from energy-related production disruptions, despite some macro pressure from Fed hawkishness.

title: Tesla Signs Deal for First U.S. Supply of Nickel With Talon Metals
summary: Tesla said it signed its first U.S. nickel supply deal with Talon Metals, selecting the Tamarack mine in Minnesota for its EV battery material. Tesla plans to buy 75,000 tonnes of nickel over six years and will also purchase cobalt and iron ore from Talon.

title: LME Nickel soars about 3% to its highest level since May 2014_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: LME nickel futures gained around 3% to $21,500/tonne, the highest since May 2014. Prices rose as electric-car battery demand reduced LME nickel inventories, which fell about 62% since April 2021. Warehouse stock levels were 99,954 tonnes and nearly half were write-off receipts, signaling continued supply pressure.

title: SMM Evening Comments (Jan 11): Shanghai Nonferrous Metals Closed Mixed with Nickel Outperforming the Market_SMM
summary: SMM reports Shanghai nonferrous metals closed mixed around Jan 11. Nickel led with a 3.45% gain, supported by falling SHFE inventories, LME nickel and tight spot pure-nickel supply. Aluminium rose 1.97% with inventories down, despite weakening demand. Copper was essentially flat, though LME copper inventory fell.

title: Metals generally rebounded, Shanghai Nickel and stainless Steel rose sharply [SMM Daily Review]_SMM
summary: SMM’s daily review reports mixed metal moves in Asia: Shanghai nickel rose more than 3% and stainless steel also jumped, while Shanghai aluminium climbed nearly 2%. Copper edged down slightly (~-0.01%). The piece attributes some nickel support to low inventories and improved spot tightness.

title: France plans to spend 7.2 billion yuan to guarantee the supply of nickel, lithium and other battery raw materials._SMM
summary: France plans to raise €1bn to support industries in securing battery raw materials amid soaring prices, including nickel. The government intends to reduce dependence on nickel, cobalt and lithium outside the EU and push Renault and Stellantis toward domestic battery production. It also seeks investment in processing projects such as in Dunkirk.

title: Golden Lake Exploration Inc.: Golden Lake Expands North Copperview Property to Cover Targets Adjacent to Gold Mountain Mining Corp's Elk Property
summary: Golden Lake Exploration acquired additional claims to expand its North Copperview property, citing historic soil copper anomalies and a newly identified geophysical resistivity anomaly near other copper-linked properties. The company plans a high level of exploration in 2022 but provides no production, inventory, or trade impacts that would affect near-term copper pricing.

title: Production of the world's largest copper producer fell_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Cochilco data show Chile’s copper production fell in November versus a year earlier. Codelco output declined 7.4% to 153,800 tonnes, while Escondida dropped 11.6% to 80,300 tonnes. Overall Chilean copper production fell 0.6% to 481,800 tonnes, suggesting tighter near-term supply.

title: Fabled Copper's Lady Luck Reports High-Grade Copper Including 14.30 % Copper over 4.60 meters
summary: Fabled Copper reported high-grade assay results from its drilling, citing 14.30% copper over 4.60 meters. Such results can strengthen expectations for the project’s resource potential and support broader copper sentiment, though it is not a confirmed production or supply-change event in the immediate term.

title: Chile's copper exports increased by 40.6% last year._SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Chile’s central bank reported that copper export values rose 21.9% in December and 40.6% over the year, as copper prices hit record highs. Export proceeds reached US$4.91 billion in December and US$53.42 billion in 2021. Some analysts expect weaker prices later due to supply growth.

title: Progress of projects such as Punitakui Copper Mine in Chile_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Battery Mineral Resources reports exploration and drilling results at Chile’s Punitaqui project, including Dalmatia mineralization with 1.77% copper overall and higher-grade zones, plus copper grades at San Andres. The company aims to resume production of Punitaqui copper concentrate mid-year, implying potential near-term supply support for copper.

title: Surge Copper Intersects 52 metres of 0.7% CuEq from 8 metres downhole including 20 metres of 1.5% CuEq at the Seel Breccia Zone
summary: Surge Copper Corp. reported assay results from 15 drill holes at the Seel Breccia Zone in British Columbia, including multiple long intercepts with high copper equivalent grades (e.g., 52m at 0.71% CuEq, with higher-grade sub-intervals). The findings are exploration-focused with no immediate production impact.

title: Talon to supply 75,000MT of nickel concentrate to Tesla from Tamarack
summary: Talon Metals agreed to supply Tesla with 75,000MT of nickel concentrate from its Tamarack project, with pricing linked to the LME nickel cash settlement. The deal is conditional on reaching required stake and starting commercial production by 2026. Tesla also holds rights to negotiate additional supply, supporting nickel demand visibility.

title: Cordoba Minerals Corp.: Cordoba Announces Positive Preliminary Feasibility Study Results for the 100%-Owned Alacran Deposit within the San Matias Copper-Gold-Silver Project in Colombia
summary: Cordoba Minerals reported positive Preliminary Feasibility Study results for its Alacran copper-gold-silver deposit in Colombia. The PFS outlines an open-pit plan producing about 68.8 Mlbs copper annually and shows improved NPV/IRR at spot copper prices, supporting constructive sentiment for copper.

title: Tesla Aims To Lock Down Carbon Neutral US Nickel Source In New Deal
summary: Tesla signed a deal with Talon Metals to source carbon-neutral nickel from a Minnesota plant. Talon expects to sell at least 165 million pounds of nickel to Tesla over six years, with pricing linked to the LME nickel official price. The announcement signals firmer nickel demand expectations.

title: Tesla inks deal to source nickel from Minnesota mine
summary: Tesla has signed a deal to source nickel from a Minnesota mine. The agreement links Tesla’s battery supply chain to a specific nickel source, potentially tightening expectations around available supply for the near term and supporting nickel pricing sentiment over the coming days to weeks.

title: USW Applauds Talon Metals' Nickel Supply Agreement
summary: United Steelworkers praised Talon Metals’ six-year nickel supply agreement for the Tamarack Project in central Minnesota. The union highlighted the deal’s role in providing customer stability and supporting domestic sourcing for battery-related nickel demand, reinforcing expectations for nickel supply continuity.

title: Tesla in US nickel supply deal at Tamarack with Talon Metals
summary: Talon Metals and Tesla agreed on a supply deal for nickel from the Tamarack project in Minnesota. Tesla will buy 75,000 tonnes of nickel in concentrate over six years, with pricing linked to the LME nickel cash settlement. The contract supports demand sentiment for EV battery nickel.

title: Aluminum company to expand in Todd County, create 140 jobs
summary: Novelis will invest about $365 million to expand in Todd County, Kentucky, building a new recycling center with 240,000 tons annual capacity and 140 jobs. The project adds sheet ingot casting and shredding and increases recycled aluminium input for automotive markets, implying supportive aluminium supply/demand dynamics.

title: Tesla Inc strikes nickel deal in push to ensure supplies
summary: Tesla agreed to buy 75,000 tonnes of nickel concentrates from Talon Metals’ Tamarack project, with pricing linked to the LME cash-settlement nickel price. The supply contract strengthens near-term nickel demand sentiment as automakers secure battery-material inputs. Tamarack also involves copper, but impact is mainly nickel-focused.

title: Base metals prices up on LME; nickel shows 4.8% rise
summary: The article notes that base metal prices on the LME are rising, highlighting that nickel gained about 4.8%. While much of the text is promotional and procedural, the headline datapoint points to immediate upward momentum for nickel prices in the near term.

title: Teck Receives Highland Valley Copper Operations Strike
summary: Teck said it received strike notice for Highland Valley Copper (HVC) Operations in B.C., affecting 1,048 workers. title: Teck Receives Highland Valley Copper Operations Strike Notice
summary: Teck has received a strike notice for its Highland Valley Copper operations. A potential strike can disrupt mine output and tighten near-term copper supply expectations. title: Teck Receives Highland Valley Copper Operations Strike Notic...
summary: Teck said it received a strike notice from USW Local 7619 for 1,048 workers at its Highland Valley Copper operations in British Columbia. title: GEM: The Company Plans to Put Its Indonesia Nickel Resource Project into Production in H1 2022_SMM
summary: GEM said its Indonesian nickel resource project’s key equipment was shipped to Indonesia and installation was completed by mid-May 2021. title: Zijin Mining built the largest Copper Mine in China_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Zijin Mining and Tibet Julong Copper completed and commissioned the first phase of China’s largest world-class copper project in Tibet. After reaching production, the project targets about 160,000 tons of annual copper output, supporting China’s copper self-sufficiency and expanding expected supply capacity.

title: Nickel prices soar to highest since 2012
summary: Nickel prices jumped to the highest level in nearly 10 years, approaching $10 a pound, as on-warrant inventories fell to multi-year lows and an LME outage disrupted trading for several hours. Tight supplies were reinforced by lower stainless steel output during maintenance and seasonal/Beijing Olympics curbs, alongside EV-driven demand.

title: ITC Futures: worries about supply disruptions Aluminum prices rise sharply_SMM
summary: SMM reports sharp rises in aluminium prices, citing higher Guangdong and Yangtze River spot ingot prices. It notes China’s electrolytic aluminium inventories fell to 752,000 tons. The piece attributes support to Europe’s energy-driven production disruptions and ongoing domestic ingot stock build, reinforcing bullish near-term aluminium sentiment.

title: Copper Market Facing Shortages, Says Barrick CEO: Saudi Update
summary: The piece headline claims copper is facing shortages, quoting a Barrick CEO with a Saudi-related update. If shortages are real and near-term, they would raise expectations for tighter supply and likely support copper prices over coming days. The excerpt provides limited detail on the drivers and timing.

title: Nickel storms to 10-year peak on worries about supplies
summary: Nickel prices jumped to a 10-year peak as investors focused on dwindling LME/ShFE inventories, tight nearby supplies (cash premiums), and forecasts of a widening market deficit for EV batteries. The broader industrial metals complex also rose, with copper and aluminium moving higher as supply worries and China stimulus expectations improved sentiment.

summary: Pedro Resources announced sulphide mineral indicator results from stream sediment surveys on its Voisey’s Bay West property and staked additional adjacent licenses to cover potential upstream sources. title: BHP's nickel partner sees high demand for 'greener' EV metals
