title: BHP to invest $50 m into Kabanga Nickel project in Tanzania
summary: BHP plans to invest around $50m into the Kabanga nickel project in Tanzania, with $40m already invested into Kabanga Nickel Limited. The project is described as the largest development-ready nickel sulphide deposit in the world, which can bolster nickel market sentiment on continued supply development.

title: Teck Resources faces strike threat at largest copper mine
summary: Teck Resources faces a strike threat at its largest copper mine. Labor disruption risk can constrain copper supply and increase near-term availability worries. Such developments often lead to short-term selling pressure in copper futures as markets price a potential reduction in output and shipment schedules.

title: Teck says United Steelworkers issue strike notice at its Highland Valley copper mine | iNFOnews
summary: Teck says it has received strike notice from United Steelworkers for workers at the Highland Valley Copper mine in British Columbia. The union could begin job action after expiry of notice and mediation steps, with talks scheduled Friday and potential earliest strike Sunday. Highland Valley is Teck’s largest Canadian copper mine.

title: Teck says United Steelworkers issue strike notice at its Highland Valley copper mine
summary: Teck said the United Steelworkers issued a strike notice for its Highland Valley Copper operations in British Columbia, covering 1,048 workers. The earliest job action could start Sunday, after a 72-hour notice expiry and mediation steps. Talks are set for Friday, while workers remain without a contract at another site.

title: Teck Resources : Receives Highland Valley Copper Operations Strike Notice - Form 6-K
summary: Teck Resources says it received a strike notice from USW Local 7619 for 1,048 workers at its Highland Valley Copper operations in British Columbia. After a 72-hour notice and mediator steps, work stoppage could begin as early as Jan. 16, with further meetings scheduled Jan. 14. Negotiations are ongoing.

title: Union issues strike notice at Highland Valley copper mine near Kamloops | iNFOnews
summary: Teck Resources said a union at its Highland Valley Copper mine near Kamloops issued a strike notice. Job action could begin after a 72-hour notice window and mediation steps, with the earliest possible start Sunday. The mine is Canada’s largest open-pit copper operation, risking near-term copper output disruption.

title: Kentucky lawmakers seek to recoup $15 million from stalled aluminum mill
summary: Kentucky lawmakers are considering clawing back $15 million of taxpayer funds from a stalled aluminum rolling mill project in northeastern Kentucky. The plant, financed since 2017, still hasn’t broken ground. A bill would require repayment by year-end unless investors are lined up, adding pressure and uncertainty for aluminum capacity timelines.

title: Ky. lawmakers seek to recoup $15 million from stalled aluminum mill
summary: Kentucky lawmakers are advancing Senate Bill 48 to recoup $15 million of taxpayer funds from a stalled aluminum mill project by Unity Aluminum (formerly Braidy Industries) unless the company repays voluntarily or secures financing. The project has not broken ground after five years, raising production/capacity uncertainty for aluminum.

title: Comprehensive distribution of nickel, cobalt and lithium resources Huayou cobalt is expected to make a net profit of 3.7 billion-4.2 billion in 2021_SMM
summary: Huayou Cobalt forecast a 2021 net profit jump, citing strong demand and higher prices for new-energy battery materials. It also announced an acquisition related to a lithium mine in Zimbabwe and highlights integrated nickel/cobalt-to-lithium production capacity growth. The news is company-specific and offers no clear near-term market dislocation for traded metals.

title: Culpeo Minerals extends copper system in Chile with near surface hits
summary: Culpeo Minerals reported additional near-surface drilling assays at its Las Petacas copper-gold target in Chile, including multiple high-grade copper intercepts close to surface. The company says results expand confidence in a large copper-gold system and plans further drilling over a 1,000m strike length. No production impact is cited.

title: China Stock Market Has A Green Light For Thursday's Trade
summary: China’s stocks turned positive after a four-day losing streak, helped by upbeat global sentiment and a jump in crude oil prices. Resource and energy shares supported the index, including gains in Jiangxi Copper and Aluminum Corporation of China (Chalco), implying mild near-term support for copper and aluminium.

title: Nickel continues surge; now over $10 a pound
summary: Nickel prices surged to their highest in a decade, driven by continued LME and Shanghai inventory declines, strong backwardation, and tightening warehouse stocks that signal a potential squeeze. Copper also rose to fresh peaks on renewed supply fears. Aluminium edged higher amid broader industrial metals strength and improving China sentiment.

title: Aluminium Prices Are Likely to Rise and Then Fall throughout 2022_SMM
summary: SMM expects 2022 LME and SHFE aluminium to trade within broad ranges and form an inverted-V pattern, citing expanding alumina capacity, recovering aluminium output, earlier gains tied to cost/energy dynamics, and a later drop after coal-price regulation. Demand is seen improving via autos, new energy vehicles and PV, though Fed hikes pressure metals overall.

title: Rio Tinto's Tomago aluminium smelter battles shipping delays
summary: Rio Tinto’s Tomago Aluminium faces shipping delays and chronic shortages, forcing the plant to create back-up plans to keep operating. CEO Matt Howell says container deliveries are being delayed, slowing inbound specialist materials and components needed for the NSW smelter. The disruption increases near-term aluminium supply risk.

title: Copper Prices to Gain Strong Support from Macro Economy and Low Inventory_SMM
summary: SMM says copper prices should receive strong support from China’s expected monetary easing, improving overseas macro conditions, and unusually low domestic social inventories entering 2022. Smelter output is expected to stay near full capacity with easing anode supply, while bonded inventory build risks are mainly in the off-season.

title: Vedanta Aluminium becomes India's largest industrial consumer of renewable energy
summary: Vedanta Aluminium says its Jharsuguda smelter became India’s biggest industrial consumer of renewable energy in 2021, procuring about 2 billion units of RE power and large volumes of renewable energy certificates. The move is aimed at lowering emissions intensity, not reported as changing output or shipments.

title: China Hurt Most by Indonesia's Move to Keep Nickel at Home
summary: The piece centers on Indonesia’s policy shift to keep nickel “at home,” implying less material nickel supply for overseas buyers, particularly China. By limiting export availability and potentially tightening near-term supply, the change is expected to support nickel prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: China hurt most by Indonesia's move to keep nickel at home
summary: Indonesia is considering a progressive export levy on nickel pig iron and ferronickel that could be imposed as soon as this year. The move is expected to reduce nickel feedstock flows to China’s steel and EV supply chains, increasing cost and supply pressure that can lift nickel prices.

title: Tinka Resources Ltd.: Tinka Increases Scale of The High-Grade Copper-Gold Discovery at Silvia NW
summary: Tinka Resources announced expanded high-grade copper-gold mineralization at its Silvia NW project in Peru, including new “Skarn Veins” with samples up to ~1.1% copper and 7.9 g/t gold and plans to prepare an Environmental Impact Declaration for drilling. It advances zinc-silver work at Ayawilca but provides no production.

title: Metal & New Materials Industry Database: copper and Aluminum rebounded and prices of rare Earth oxides rose as a whole [Agency Review]_SMM
summary: SMM says copper prices rose slightly, with improving demand expectations and sharply lower inventories. Aluminium also rebounded, aided by falling inventories, downward domestic operating capacity, and reduced imports. It attributes supply disruption to European smelters cutting output from power shortages and notes profit recovery in electrolytic aluminium.

title: Metal & New Materials Industry Database: copper and Aluminum rebounded and prices of rare Earth oxides rose as a whole [Agency Review]_SMM
summary: The SMM review says copper prices rose slightly as demand expectations improved and inventories fell, citing Zijin Mining. Aluminium rebounded with lower inventories and weaker domestic output, plus supply disruption from European smelter power shortages. Overall, price action is supported by both demand and supply-side factors.

title: Electric cars drive nickel prices to ten-year high
summary: Nickel prices are surging to a ten-year high as EV makers rush to secure battery supplies. The London Metal Exchange reports warehouse nickel stocks have fallen for 51 straight days and China reserves are near record lows. Nickel jumped up to 4.4% on Wednesday amid strong demand expectations.

title: European aluminium premiums bullish on further energy concerns
summary: French aluminium smelter Dunkerque will curtail an additional 5% of output, bringing total cuts to 15%, citing high energy costs. Similar curtailments by Alcoa, Norsk Hydro and Alro tightened European supply, pushing aluminium premiums higher (Rotterdam P1020A up) and keeping forward spreads in contango.

title: Awalé Resources - Advancing Large-Scale IOCG Copper-Gold Targets at the Sceptre Prospect, Odienné, Côte d'Ivoire
summary: Awalé Resources announced follow-up soil and termitaria sampling at its Sceptre IOCG copper-gold target in Odienné, Côte d’Ivoire, defining new copper–gold anomalies and planning geophysics and drilling in 2022. The release highlights elevated Cu/Au footprints and compares the geology to major IOCG provinces, but provides no production or supply changes.

title: Price of nickel reaches 10-year high
summary: Nickel prices surged 4% to a decade high, supported by continued declines in global stockpiles (including record low China warehouse stocks) and strong EV-related demand growth. The piece also highlights new nickel supply arrangements and investment in nickel projects, reinforcing bullish sentiment for near-term nickel fundamentals.

title: Wide & Shallow Copper-Gold Results Lift Cortadera's Open Pit Potential
summary: The piece highlights drilling results at Cortadera, describing “wide & shallow” copper-gold findings that lift the project’s open-pit potential. By improving confidence in copper resource economics and development prospects, the update is likely to influence short-term market sentiment toward higher expected copper supply.

title: Golden Dawn Minerals Inc.: Golden Dawn Minerals Drilling Permit for Tam O'Shanter Copper Gold Property, Greenwood BC in Final Stage
summary: Golden Dawn Minerals says its subsidiary is in the final stages of obtaining a $20,000 security bond for a drill permit at the Tam O’Shanter copper-gold property in Greenwood, BC. The permit would allow up to 10,350 metres of drilling in 2022, targeting Au-Cu anomalies and expanding resources.

title: Nickel Prices Remain Bullish in January amid Tight Spot Supply_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM expects nickel prices to rise in January, citing tight spot supply and strong fundamentals. Global inventories are low, LME nickel remains in backwardation, and domestic spot premiums stay elevated. Pre-CNY importing is limited, while nickel sulphate trading is active due to stockpiling and smelter output cuts, supporting demand.

title: An impressive start to the year for nickel as it hits 10-yea...
summary: Nickel starts the year at a 10-year high, up nearly 6% YTD, driven by falling LME exchange stocks and tight Class 1 availability. Demand support comes from rapid EV and battery growth (boosting nickel sulfate needs), while supply risk persists after smelter disruption and constrained feedstocks.

title: Saudi Arabia plans 2 more auctions for copper mines after Al-Khunayqiyah tender
summary: Saudi Arabia plans two more copper mine license auctions after the Al-Khunayqiyah tender, aiming to broaden exploration and meet domestic needs. It also promotes bauxite-to-aluminum value-chain development for EV-related aluminum sheets. However, no production volumes or near-term output changes are specified.

title: Copper Inventory in Major Chinese Markets Added 200 mt From Monday_SMM
summary: SMM said copper inventories across major Chinese markets rose 200 mt from Jan 10 to 86,600 mt, a relatively rare increase. Shanghai climbed sharply, helped by smelter shipments from Tianjin and slightly higher imports. Guangdong and Jiangsu fell, but demand is expected to weaken after the holiday as downstream activity pauses, pushing inventories higher.

title: Shanghai aluminum fell more than 2% at midday, and Shuangjiao fell more than 3% [SMM midday review]_SMM
summary: SMM’s midday review shows downside pressure across most non-ferrous markets. Shanghai aluminium fell about 2.18% at midday, while Shanghai copper dropped around 0.78%. Shanghai nickel ultimately recovered and closed up about 0.97%. The US dollar eased slightly, but demand/spot activity remained soft, weighing on prices.

title: Indonesia may start taxing exports of ferronickel and nickel pig iron this year._SMM
summary: Indonesia’s deputy minister said the government may start taxing exports of ferronickel and nickel pig iron in 2022. A 2% tax is likely if nickel prices are above $15,000/tonne and increases with higher nickel prices, aiming to drive downstream investment. The measure could curb export supply.

title: Copper Inventory in China Bonded Zone Up 13,300 mt on Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s domestic bonded copper inventories rose 13,300 mt from Jan 7 to 216,900 mt as of Jan 14, extending gains for a third straight week. Shanghai and Guangdong zones increased, while closed import/export windows kept customs activity quiet. Falling Yangshan premiums and warehousing of newly arrived goods into bonded zones boosted totals.

title: Alleged nickel trading fraudster Ng Yu Zhi fails in bid to stay $23m civil suit against him
summary: Singapore’s High Court dismissed businessman Ng Yu Zhi’s bid to stay a $23m civil suit tied to an alleged $1 billion nickel trading scam. The case stems from a purported investment scheme run by his firms, while he faces 75 criminal charges. The report does not mention physical nickel supply or trading disruptions.

title: Teck Resources report strike notice at Highland Valley Copper
summary: Teck Resources said United Steelworkers Local 7619 issued a strike notice for workers at its Highland Valley Copper Operations in British Columbia. Negotiations for a new collective bargaining agreement are ongoing, with the earliest potential strike date 16 January. Highland Valley is Canada’s largest open-pit copper mine, so any stoppage could disrupt supply.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports Dropped 78,000 wmt on Week_SMM
summary: SMM said nickel ore inventories at Chinese ports fell 78,000 wmt week-on-week to 8.59 million wmt as of Jan 14 (67,500 mt Ni content). Arrivals of laterite ore were low, and downstream purchasing before Chinese New Year was weak, leaving port stock levels tight.

title: Will the inventory of nickel at home and abroad continue to go to the warehouse in 2021 or will it slow down in 2022? [SMM Review]_SMM
summary: SMM reviews 2021 nickel inventory trends: domestic stocks fell after mid-May, bonded-area nickel inflows slowed near year-end, and LME inventories slid down as nickel beans and plates flowed into China. It describes tight spot pure nickel and expects 2022 de-stocking, though at a slower pace later.

title: Nickel hits its highest since 2011 as stockpiles dwindle
summary: Nickel surged to the highest level since 2011 as supply deficits reduced LME and ShFE inventories. On-warrant stocks fell to the lowest since 2019 and the cash premium over three-months jumped sharply, signaling tightening physical markets. EV battery demand expectations further supported bullish sentiment.

title: Us inflation rises again, the center of gravity of copper prices rises rapidly [selected SMM Copper Weekly]_SMM
summary: The excerpt notes U.S. December CPI rose faster than expected, boosting expectations of Fed rate hikes and initially lifting commodities as the dollar fell after Powell’s dovish comments. However, it also highlights China’s inventory buildup, weak import-price performance, cautious downstream buying, and spring-festival off-season effects that keep copper under pressure.

title: Metal multi-downside Renni brushes have fallen more than 2% since August 2011, a new high for Shanghai copper._SMM
summary: SMM reports macro-driven risk sentiment shifts with a stronger dollar and higher Treasury yields, pressuring industrial metals. Shanghai copper fell more than 2%, Shanghai aluminium dropped about 1.06%, and Shanghai nickel ended down after a volatile open. Inventories are said to have fallen amid supply shortages, but immediate pricing remains bearish.

title: From January to November 2021, Russia's aluminum exports increased and nickel and copper exports declined._SMM
summary: Russian customs data show aluminum exports increased from January to November 2021, while nickel and copper exports declined versus the same period in 2020. Copper exports fell in both tonnage and value; nickel exports also decreased. Aluminum exports rose sharply in tonnage and total export value.

title: From January to November 2021, Russia's aluminum exports increased and nickel and copper exports declined._SMM
summary: Russian customs data show exports from January–November 2021: aluminum shipments rose to 3.19 million tonnes (from 2.43 million), while nickel exports fell to 45,100 tonnes (from 105,900) and copper exports dropped to 440,500 tonnes (from 656,900). Net supply effects could differ by metal.

title: From January to November 2021, Russia's aluminum exports increased and nickel and copper exports declined._SMM
summary: Russia’s customs data for Jan–Nov 2021 show aluminum exports rising to 3.19m tons (+31%), while nickel and copper exports fell to 45.1k tons (-57%) and 440.5k tons (-33%). The supply shifts imply tighter nickel/copper availability and more aluminum supply.

title: Personal View: It's time to focus on repealing aluminum tariffs
summary: The piece is a personal view calling for the repeal of aluminium tariffs. By suggesting tariff removal, it implies lower costs for imported aluminium and improved market access, which could support aluminium demand and sentiment in the near term. No specific tariff rates or timing are provided.

title: A Copper Crisis Threatens The Energy Transition
summary: Rystad Energy projects global copper demand to outstrip supply by millions of tonnes by 2030, with near-term supply strain already emerging. Mine closures in Peru, a reported shutdown at Las Bambas, and regional instability add tightness, while EV/renewables-driven demand keeps rising.

title: Comex Copper Ends the Week 0.19% Higher at $4.4115 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex front-month copper ended the week 0.19% higher at $4.4115 per pound, gaining 0.85 cent. Despite a strong weekly advance, the contract fell sharply on the day (down 2.70%) and has declined over the last two sessions, indicating choppy near-term momentum without a cited catalyst.

title: Omani copper mining project to generate RO 200m in cash flow over 10 years
summary: Sohar International agreed to finance RO 19 million for the Wash-hi Majazah copper mining project in Oman, a JV holding a copper mining license. The deposit is estimated at 16 million tons of copper resources and 10 million tons of mineable reserves. The plant is planned to start in November and generate RO 200 million cash flows over 10 years.

title: Rio, BHP's seek resolution of US copper mine stand-off
summary: Rio Tinto and BHP are seeking resolution of a stand-off at a US copper mine in Arizona. The report frames the dispute within an active underground operation, implying potential production disruption or delays until resolved, which could tighten near-term copper supply expectations and support copper prices.

title: ITC Futures: aluminum prices fall further and continue to pay attention to inventory changes_SMM
summary: SMM notes that aluminium prices in China have fallen further, with Guangdong Nanzhu and Yangtze River spot ingot prices down and discounts easing. It attributes near-term pressure to risk-off macro factors and concerns about slowing demand into Spring Festival, while inventory conditions keep some downside limited.

title: Southern Peruvian Community signs Memorandum of understanding to avoid blockade of Las Bambas Copper Mining Corridor_SMM
summary: A Peruvian community near MMG’s Las Bambas signed a memorandum to avoid blockading the southern mining corridor used to haul copper concentrate. Past protests caused cargo suspensions and forced shutdowns. The deal commits to no planned protests and further local hiring/training discussions, lowering near-term copper supply disruption risk.

title: Low inventories support high nickel prices but increased volatility [agency review]_SMM
summary: SMM reports low global nickel inventories and high LME nickel 3-month transfer fees supporting tightness and elevated nickel prices. It also highlights Indonesia’s possible export tax on nickel ore/pig iron if prices stay above $15,000, plus ongoing supply-side disturbances. Overall, near-term nickel remains firm despite volatility.

title: Metal recovery from aluminium dross
summary: A Middle East aluminium dross processing plant bought magnetic and electrostatic separation equipment (drum magnet, eddy current separator, electrostatic separator) to recover residual aluminium. Controlled tests showed about 15% recovery from dross. The production system targets ~3 tonnes/hour throughput, increasing secondary supply marginally.

title: Explosions at Hussey Copper caused by molten copper, firefighters stop with no injuries
summary: Firefighters responded to explosions at the Hussey Copper headquarters after a malfunctioning valve released about 4,000 pounds of molten copper. The incident caused roof and wall damage and fires inside the plant, with a melted waterline worsening explosions. Crews contained the emergency, with no injuries reported.

title: Cinda Securities Nonferrous Metals Weekly report: lithium Aluminium profitability boosts stable economy and boosts Metal demand_SMM
summary: Cinda’s nonferrous weekly links improving China and trade data with supportive demand for industrial metals. It highlights bullish factors for aluminium—declining ingot inventories, ongoing French energy-driven production cuts, and rising industry profits. For copper, it notes inflation and financial indicators lifting prices, with low inventories and tight short-term supply/demand keeping prices firm.

title: Copper Inventory in Major Chinese markets Added 5,900 mt over Weekend_SMM
summary: SMM says China’s major copper inventories rose 5,900 mt over the weekend to 92,500 mt, after seven straight weeks of gains and with the pace accelerating. Shanghai and Tianjin fell slightly, but Guangdong and Jiangsu increased on arrivals from smelters and north China. This week, inventories may keep rising amid weakening demand.

title: China 2021 aluminum output rises to annual record high
summary: China’s 2021 aluminium production rose 4.8% to a record 38.5 million tonnes, even with energy-consumption curbs at smelters. December output was slightly up month-on-month but down year-on-year. China also produced more of a non-ferrous basket including copper and nickel, but overall the aluminium supply outlook is bearish.

title: Guoyuan Futures: copper and Aluminum trend differentiation supply support is still there_SMM
summary: The piece describes a split: copper fell sharply as USD disturbances pressured prices, though Europe’s energy problems/outbreaks and low inventories keep fundamentals supported. Aluminum closed slightly higher on supply concerns from potential European smelter suspensions, but China UHV line proposals failed to boost prices meaningfully, suggesting limited directional follow-through.

title: Guoyuan Futures: copper and Aluminum trend differentiation supply support is still there_SMM
summary: The article reports copper fell sharply, attributing the move to USD fluctuations, though it notes low global inventories and ongoing supply disruption from European outbreaks and energy problems. Aluminium closed slightly higher on concerns about possible European smelter pauses, while China UHV-line plans reportedly failed to meaningfully boost prices.

title: Analysis of Copper demand Market in 2022_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: The piece forecasts 2022 copper demand by sector: China power/electroweb investment supports demand near historical averages, while real estate and air-conditioner/channel inventory pressures reduce copper use. Overseas demand (US/Europe/Japan) may add support. New-energy vehicles and renewables are expected to add additional copper demand, netting mixed signals for near-term copper prices.

title: China's raw aluminum output reached a record high of 38.5 million tons in 2021_SMM
summary: China’s raw aluminum output rose 4.8% in 2021 to a record 38.5 million tons, despite energy-consumption limits. December primary aluminum production was near November but still high versus the prior year. The article also notes overall non-ferrous output, including copper and nickel, strengthening near-term supply expectations.

title: China 2021 aluminum output climbs to record despite power curbs
summary: China’s official data shows 2021 primary aluminium output rose 4.8% to a record 38.5 million tonnes, even with factory power consumption curbs. December output edged down versus November, but remains high. The report also tracks other non-ferrous output (including copper and nickel) lower year-on-year, suggesting pressure from ample supply.

title: LME base metal futures mixed at 9am open, nickel down 1.2%
summary: LME base metal futures were mixed at the 9am open, with nickel down 1.2%. The rest of the piece discusses Fastmarkets/Metal Bulletin changes, including delayed or corrected aluminium and steel-related assessments and methodology/publication timing updates. No comparable immediate copper or aluminium price move is specified.

title: Araguiaia closes ECA-backed facilities for Brazil nickel project
summary: Araguiaia Niquel Metias finalized a $346.2 million ECA-backed loan to fund its Horizonte Minerals Araguaia ferronickel project in Brazil. The financing was closed on 23 December 2021 and split into multiple facilities, supporting development of the nickel project by lowering funding risk.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: Phase 2 Drilling is Underway, Targeting the Next Identified High Priority Targets
summary: EV Nickel reports Phase 2 drilling is underway at its Langmuir nickel project in Ontario, targeting additional high-priority EM conductor zones beyond the W4 area. The program involves at least 10,000 metres of diamond drilling and is designed to test new targets and improve confidence in the nickel mineralization potential.

title: SHFE Aluminium Is Expected to Retreat amid Pre-holiday Risk Aversion Sentiment _SMM
summary: SMM reports SHFE aluminium may retreat as pre–Chinese New Year risk aversion prompts long exits. While USD weakness supported LME, expected slightly higher January supply in key regions and ending downstream stocking could weaken demand further. Technical indicators warn of short-term correction, with expected weekly trading ranges.

title: Low Pure Nickel Stocks and Continuously High Premiums Opened the Door to Carnivals for Bulls_SMM
summary: SMM reports nickel prices maintained strong momentum as pure nickel inventory fell in both social and bonded areas and shipment arrivals failed to meet expectations. With limited near-term arrivals and high premiums likely to persist, downstream stainless and nickel sulphate buyers stocked before CNY. Risks include earlier Fed hikes or higher-than-expected arrivals.

title: Teck Provides Update on Highland Valley Copper Operations
summary: Teck said the United Steelworkers Local 7619 at its Highland Valley Copper (HVC) operations agreed to put the mediators’ recommendation to a ratification vote by no later than Jan. 24. The update suggests progress toward an agreement, lowering immediate risk of labor disruption and supporting copper supply expectations.

title: Teck, union at B.C.'s Highland Valley Copper mull mediator's contract proposal
summary: The piece references talks between Teck and a union at B.C.’s Highland Valley Copper over a mediator’s contract proposal. Labor negotiations at major producing sites can quickly affect expectations for mine continuity and output. Any increased disruption risk would likely be bearish for short-term copper prices.

title: Teck, Steelworkers at B.C.'s Highland Valley Copper mull mediator's contract proposal | iNFOnews
summary: Talks between Teck Resources and the United Steelworkers at Highland Valley Copper in B.C. ended, with mediators issuing settlement recommendations. The union’s ratification vote for about 1,000 workers must be completed by Jan. 24, and members are told to keep reporting while contract details await voting.

title: ADVENTUS MINING AND SALAZAR RESOURCES SECURE US$235.5 MILLION WITH WHEATON PRECIOUS METALS AND TRAFIGURA TO CONSTRUCT THE CURIPAMBA COPPER PROJECT
summary: Adventus Mining and Salazar secured US$235.5 million (including Wheaton streaming funding and Trafigura offtake financing) to construct the Curipamba copper project in Ecuador. The financing supports pre-construction and staged construction funding tied to feasibility-based concentrate offtake, strengthening expectations for future copper supply.

title: There is a strong pattern of continuous oscillation in the fundamentals of Shanghai Nickel._SMM
summary: SMM reports Shanghai nickel rising and breaking above 160,000 yuan/ton to a record level. It attributes strength to tight global/refined nickel inventories, rising nickel sulfate costs, stable downstream replenishment before the Spring Festival, and expectations of Indonesia introducing export duties on ferronickel, raising import costs.

title: The decline of the high level of copper in Shanghai is the general direction [institutional review]_SMM
summary: SMM attributes copper’s recent oscillation to macro policy expectations and weak fundamentals. It cites inventory build signals across LME/Shanghai/COMEX and bonded areas, rising domestic refined output, and subdued consumption. With Fed tightening risk and accumulation pressures, it expects the high-price copper decline to continue.

title: Copper Prices to Face Great Pressures amid Inventory Accumulation_SMM
summary: SMM reports that Chinese bonded and social copper inventories rose alongside accumulating imported cargoes, while downstream buying was sidelined by higher SHFE prices. Consumption weakened during the recent restocking pause. With the traditional low season approaching, copper is expected to face pressure, and spot premiums should have downside room this week.

title: Platinex buys W2 Copper-Nickel-PGE Project from Springer Mineral
summary: Platinex completed the purchase of the W2 copper-nickel-PGE project from Springer Mineral Resources in Ontario’s Ring of Fire area, including potential smelter returns royalties. The deal targets known Cu-Ni-PGE mineralisation but does not indicate near-term output, so any impact on copper and nickel prices is likely limited.

title: Zijin Mining Copper and Gold output improvement performance greatly increased compared with the same period last year [Agency Review]_SMM
summary: Zijin Mining reported a major 2021 profit jump and said it expects 2022 copper output to rise sharply, supported by higher copper prices and contributions from several copper mines. The update reinforces near-term copper production and price optimism, though gold underperformance in 2021 is noted as a partial offset.

title: Copper supply deficit of 6 million tons by 2030 threatens renewables, EVs | Business
summary: Rystad Energy projects a large copper supply deficit by 2030 as demand rises strongly from EVs and renewables. It cites Peru mine closures amid environmental protests and reported production stoppage at Las Bambas due to transport issues, plus pandemic-related bottlenecks, pointing to continued upward pressure on copper prices.

title: Financing takes shape for Ecuadorean copper | News
summary: Developers of Ecuador’s Curipamba copper project secured an offtake financing agreement and a precious metals purchase agreement to fund progress toward building the mine. This is supportive for future production, but the article provides no near-term operational or trade changes, so immediate copper price effects appear limited.

title: Fathom Nickel Inc.: Fathom Announces the Buyback of Uravan Minerals Inc.'s 2% Net Smelter Return Royalty on the Albert Lake Property
summary: Fathom Nickel announced it bought back a 2% net smelter return royalty tied to its Albert Lake nickel-copper property in Saskatchewan for $175,000 and started a 5,000m Q1-2022 drill program. The release highlights improved project economics and future assays, without any stated production or supply impact.

title: Southern Silver Exploration : Reports Oro Copper Porphyry Property is Fully Permitted with Drilling Commencing within Two Weeks
summary: Southern Silver Exploration reports it has obtained all required approvals to begin an approximately 4,000-metre diamond drilling program at its Oro copper porphyry/skarn property in New Mexico, expected to start in early February. The update relates to potential future copper resource development rather than current production.

title: Nickel cash premium surges amid supply squeeze
summary: Nickel cash contracts on the LME reportedly hit a $90/tonne premium versus the next day, the highest since 2010, driven by the biggest supply squeeze in over a decade. Plunging inventories are forcing buyers to pay for immediate metal, prompting heightened LME monitoring and possible further measures.

title: Nickel Slides Into Deficit As Stockpiles Tumble
summary: Nickel prices are supported by falling exchange and warehouse inventories, with LME stockpiles dropping for a record stretch and China’s official stocks near a low. The market runs a sizable deficit, while EV and stainless demand growth expectations keep buyers engaged. Aluminum inventories are also described as in deficit.

title: The Power Play by The Market Herald Releases Interviews With Angold, Datametrex, Fabled Copper, Nextech AR, Tocvan Ventures, and Silver Bullet Mines
summary: The Market Herald released interviews including Fabled Copper, which reported results from surface field work at its Muskwa Copper Project in Canada’s Muskwa area. Among five surface samples, all exceeded 1% copper and multiple samples exceeded 5%, 10%, and 15% copper, supporting positive sentiment for copper development prospects.

title: Aston Minerals discovers broad nickel zones at Edleston gold project
summary: Aston Minerals reported thick nickel sulphide mineralisation at its Edleston gold project in Canada, including 282m at 0.43% nickel and higher-grade intervals up to 0.52% nickel, plus an 18m final interval at 0.66% nickel. The company plans further resource definition drilling and studies.

title: Aluminium Prices Will Stand Firm amid Intensifying Energy Shortage in Europe_SMM
summary: Europe’s energy shortage worsened after Russia cut natural-gas flows to zero via the Yamal-Europe pipeline, raising electricity costs for Western European aluminium smelters. Production has been reduced and global primary supply faces further contraction risk. Meanwhile, China’s off-season social aluminium inventory keeps falling, supporting prices despite softer near-term demand.

title: Over 1,000 Teck Resources copper miners in British Columbia voting on wage-cutting contract proposal
summary: More than 1,000 Teck Resources Highland Valley Copper miners in British Columbia are voting on mediator recommendations for a contract with low wage increases, with threats of strike or lockout if management rejects terms. title: Antofagasta Reports FY Group Copper Production Of 721,500 Tonnes
summary: Antofagasta reported full-year group copper production of 721,500 tonnes, within guidance but 1.7% below last year. summary: Eskom says a contracted security officer was killed while security staff foiled an attempted theft of City Power copper cable at an Eskom Customer Network Centre in Soweto. Eskom reports high ongoing infrastructure theft volumes and runs an awareness campaign, but the article provides no scale shift affecting copper supply or pricing beyond the incident.

title: Ero Copper Reports Two Separate Fatal Incidents at its
summary: Ero Copper reported two fatal incidents at its operations: one at the MCSA Mining Complex (copper) and another at the NX Gold Mine (gold/silver). title: Northern Dynasty Minerals Ltd.: Northern Dynasty Comments on One Year Anniversary of Appeal Submission and Recent Predictions of Significant Increases in the Price Of Copper Coming in Light of Supply/Demand Imbalances
summary: Northern Dynasty comments on the one-year anniversary of its USACE appeal submission for the Pebble Project and notes no decision yet. title: Mine costing $200mln to be built in Saudi Arabia after gold and copper discovery: mining chief
summary: Gold and Mineral Co. says a $200 million mine in Saudi Arabia will be built after gold and copper were discovered. The firm targets production in 2025, pending mine design and environmental/community approvals. The CEO expects growing copper demand, but the timeline suggests limited short-term price impact.

title: Northern Dynasty Minerals : comments on one year anniversary of appeal submission and recent predictions of significant increases in the price of copper coming in light of supply/demand imbalances - Form 6-K
summary: Northern Dynasty’s 6-K discusses a year without progress in USACE appeal processing for the Pebble Project and highlights recent bank forecasts for significantly higher copper prices. summary: A commentary on fluorspar demand highlights uses in steelmaking and aluminum refining, but the most price-relevant section concerns Alcoa’s San Ciprián aluminum smelter. title: Barrick produced 1.2 million ounces of gold and 126 million pounds of copper in Q4
summary: Barrick reported Q4 production results, including 126 million pounds of copper. Quarterly output figures can shift near-term expectations for copper supply and inventories, potentially affecting prices. title: Boliden: Nickel production in Harjavalta resumed
summary: Boliden says nickel production at its Harjavalta smelter has resumed after a December 24 stoppage from a slag explosion. title: Zambia has more than copper, and offers unexplored potential
summary: The piece spotlights Zambia’s mining reform prospects under President Hakainde Hichilema, with copper production having fallen in Q2 2021 due to Covid-19 and rainy-season impacts. summary: The article reports nickel breaking above $23,000/t on the LME, signaling near-term bullish momentum. summary: The U.S. and UK will begin talks aimed at resolving their steel and aluminum tariff dispute, including U.S. tariffs on British metals and UK retaliatory tariffs. title: Imperial to Surrender Giant Copper Property to the Province
summary: Imperial Metals agreed with the Province of British Columbia to surrender its Giant Copper mineral claims near Hope, BC, citing challenges in obtaining permits. title: Comex Copper Settles 1.98% Higher at $4.4625 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex Copper front-month for January delivery settled up 8.65 cents per pound, or 1.98%, at $4.4625, reversing a three-session losing streak. The piece frames it as the largest one-day dollar and percentage gain since Jan. 12, reflecting immediate bullish momentum in copper futures.

title: Alcoa Warns Russia-Ukraine Conflict Could Hit Aluminum Supply
summary: Alcoa warned that the Russia-Ukraine conflict could disrupt aluminum supply. title: Nickel continues good run as supply squeeze pushes price up

title: SMM Morning Comments (Jan 20): Base Metals Rose across the Board, Nickel Surged over 5%_SMM
summary: SMM says base metals rose overnight, with copper up ~1.5%, aluminium up ~1.1%, and nickel surging over 5% on tighter overseas inventories and supportive demand/infrastructure expectations. title: US and UK start formal talks over Trump's steel, aluminum tariffs
summary: The US and UK have started formal talks regarding Trump’s proposed steel and aluminum tariffs. title: U.S., UK launch talks to resolve steel, aluminum dispute; U.S. producers wary
summary: The U.S. and UK agreed to begin talks to resolve their tariff dispute on steel and aluminum, covering global excess capacity and the U.S. tariffs on imports from Britain. summary: The U.S. and UK agreed to launch talks to resolve their trade dispute over U.S. steel and aluminum tariffs. title: SunSirs: Chinese Nickel Prices Fell Slightly on January 19 - Top Chemical News from ChemNet.
