No explicit short-term supply or price catalysts are given.

title: LIBERO COPPER SIGNS EXPLORATION DRILLING CONTRACT FOR THE MOCOA PORPHYRY COPPER-MOLYBDENUM PROJECT IN COLOMBIA
summary: Libero Copper announced it has signed an exploration drilling contract for the Mocoa porphyry copper-molybdenum project in Colombia. The decision relates to progressing exploration toward potential future copper production. It is unlikely to change current output quickly, but it can provide modest bullish sentiment for copper.

title: Hannan Metals Ltd.: Hannan Extends Mineralization by 3 Kilometres Strike at San Martin, Peru Channel Samples 0.4 Metres @ 10.8% Copper and 124 g/t Silver
summary: Hannan Metals reports it extended mineralization at its San Martin, Peru sediment-hosted copper-silver project by 3 km, with channel results including 0.4 m @ 10.8% copper. The company plans social and geophysical programs before a maiden drill program, boosting exploration sentiment for potential future copper supply.

title: BeMetals Corp.: BeMetals Intersects Further Encouraging Copper Results from the Pangeni Exploration Project in Zambia
summary: BeMetals reported new 2021 core drilling results at its Pangeni copper exploration project in Zambia, including intersections up to 0.62% Cu over 4.14 metres and multiple meaningful copper zones at the D-Prospect. The company plans follow-up work, but the announcement is exploration-focused.

title: Nickel leads down base metals Fed meeting and tensions in Ukraine pose pressure_SMM
summary: Nickel led a broad base-metals decline as investors turned cautious ahead of a key Fed meeting and amid rising Ukraine tensions. Nickel futures and spot fell after prior rallies, driven partly by exchange fee/margin adjustments and profit-taking. Copper and aluminium also declined in Shanghai, reflecting risk-off sentiment despite low nickel inventories.

title: Newcrest withdraws from Option and Farm-in Agreement for the Caña Brava/Tioloma gold-copper Project in Ecuador
summary: Newcrest has withdrawn from an option and farm-in agreement tied to the Caña Brava/Tioloma gold-copper project in Ecuador. The change introduces uncertainty around project progression and future copper development, which can modestly support copper sentiment, though any immediate impact on prices is likely small.

title: Continued Drilling Planned for Playfair's RKV Copper Project...
summary: Playfair plans additional 1,300 metres of shallow drilling in 26 holes to trace MMI copper anomalies at its RKV copper project in Norway. 2021 results highlighted strong copper anomalies and a sulphide-rich block with notable copper and nickel grades. Drilling is delayed to spring for logistics and terrain.

title: Teck Joins Rivals With Stake in Startup Tapping Copper From Waste Rock
summary: Teck is reported to be joining peers with a stake in a startup focused on extracting copper from waste rock. The initiative could increase future copper recovery, implying incremental supply potential. With no near-term production scale provided, the immediate market impact is likely modest but mildly bearish for copper prices.

title: 'Green' copper company wants stock exchange listing, with plans to raise R100m in capital
summary: Big Tree Copper seeks a JSE/Cape Town listing and plans to raise over R100m. It processes copper oxide ore from old tailings and waste rock at Nababeep. Management highlights a “copper supply crunch” and EV demand growth as support for high copper prices in the near term.

title: Will the tight supply of nickel push up prices further?_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says nickel faces its worst supply shortages since 2007, with LME inventories falling daily since October and spot prices running with a premium indicating tight availability. Demand support comes from stainless steel and accelerating EV battery demand, while supply additions are uncertain.

title: Mongolia, mining giant Rio Tinto end long-running dispute over Oyu Tolgoi copper mine-Xinhua
summary: Mongolia and Rio Tinto have settled their dispute over underground expansion at the Oyu Tolgoi copper-gold project, allowing underground mining construction to start. The government expects the mine to produce about 430,000 tons of copper annually once fully operational, improving forward supply visibility for copper markets.

title: Comex Copper Settles 0.91% Higher at $4.4430 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for January delivery settled 0.91% higher at $4.4430, gaining 4.00 cents per pound and snapping a two-session losing streak. The settlement is noted as the seventh highest this year and remains down versus recent highs, with month-to-date and year-to-date declines cited.

title: Mongolia, mining giant Rio Tinto end long-running dispute over Oyu Tolgoi copper mine
summary: Mongolia and Rio Tinto settled a dispute over the underground expansion of the Oyu Tolgoi copper-gold project, enabling underground construction to start. The government says the mine is expected to produce about 430,000 tons of copper annually once fully operational, supporting copper supply expectations.

title: Teck Resources announces new deal for Highland Valley Copper employees
summary: Teck Resources reached a new five-year collective agreement with United Steelworkers at Highland Valley Copper after a brief contract impasse and a 72-hour strike notice. A vote of over 1,000 members approved the deal, avoiding a likely near-term work stoppage at Canada’s largest open-pit copper mine.

title: LME aluminum rose against the market because of concerns about Russian supply._SMM
summary: LME three-month aluminum jumped 2.1% as markets focused on potential supply disruptions from Russia/major producer Rusal amid Ukraine-related escalation and possible sanctions. The piece links the move to past sanctions impacts on Rusal and also reports broader base-metal weakness, while nickel remained highly volatile.

title: Environmental groups sue for cancellation of PolyMet opencast copper and gold mine deal in Minnesota_SMM
summary: Environmental groups sued the U.S. Forest Service to overturn a 2017 land transfer enabling PolyMet to develop an open-pit copper (and gold) mine in Minnesota. They argue endangered species habitat would be destroyed and seek court review/resumption of land. Regulators are also being asked to reconsider PolyMet wastewater permits.

title: The first shipment of high matte in Aoyama, Indonesia, the price of nickel in China fell by the limit [institutional review]_SMM
summary: SMM reports the first batch of high matte shipped from Morowali Park in Indonesia to China, easing tight domestic supply and improving expectations for increased Qingshan production. It states Shanghai nickel fundamentals have weakened and shifted toward surplus, with weak downstream demand and low yet only marginal inventory changes, supporting bearish price pressure.

title: Qingshan High matte Nickel supply Market Shanghai Nickel fell by the limit in intraday trading [Agency Review]_SMM
summary: Qingshan’s Indonesia Morowali Park shipped the first batch of high matte back to China, adding supply capacity (~3,000 t/month). Market participants expect higher nickel supply, prompting short-covering/bullish funds to unwind. Shanghai nickel futures hit the intraday limit lower; electric nickel fell sharply, pressuring downstream sentiment around the holiday.

title: Aluminium Futures Closed with Gains Overnight on Intensifying Tension between Ukraine and Russia, Spot Trading Muted_SMM
summary: Aluminium prices rose overnight on SHFE and LME, with the market increasingly concerned about potential reductions in overseas aluminium supply due to intensifying Ukraine-Russia tensions and evolving US sanctions. LME-listed warehouse stocks fell sharply, while spot activity softened ahead of the CNY holiday. Overall outlook points to high-level fluctuations.

title: Rio Tinto begins underground work at vast Mongolia copper mine: state media
summary: State media reports that Rio Tinto has begun underground work at a vast copper mine in Mongolia. The start of mine development can be read as progress toward future copper supply, potentially supporting sentiment around copper in the coming weeks, though detailed production timelines are not provided.

title: Increase in custom duty on Aluminium scrap from 2.5 to 10% is key expectation
summary: SME Times reports that India’s aluminium industry is pushing for higher customs duty on aluminium scrap, from 2.5% to 10%, to counter rising scrap imports driven by China’s restrictions. The tariff change is expected to reduce scrap inflows, support domestic producers’ margins, and lift aluminium price expectations.

title: The price of copper rebounded strongly and the decline of Shanghai, tin and nickel narrowed [SMM Daily Review]_SMM
summary: SMM’s daily review says metals rose overall, with Shanghai copper rebounding strongly after two losses (+1.30%) and Shanghai aluminium ending a losing streak (+1.87%). Shanghai nickel remained slightly down (-0.57%), though the decline narrowed. LME copper futures also rose in the afternoon.

title: The price of copper rebounded strongly and the decline of Shanghai, tin and nickel narrowed [SMM Daily Review]_SMM
summary: SMM’s daily review says metals rose generally, with Shanghai copper rebounding strongly (+1.30%) after two losses and LME copper also firmer. Shanghai aluminium ended a losing streak (+1.87%) on supply and Europe-energy worries, while Shanghai nickel fell slightly (−0.57%) but the drop narrowed.

title: Three Valley Copper suspends operations at its Minera Tres Valles mine
summary: Three Valley Copper suspended operations at its Minera Tres Valles (MTV) copper mine near Salamanca, Chile, after sustained underperformance and lower-grade ore deliveries undermined mine economics. The company also paused exploration and some capex, demobilizing contractors and placing the Don Gabriel pit into care and maintenance.

title: Downstream purchasing willingness to prepare is weakening and short-term nickel prices are expected to face adjustment [agency review]_SMM
summary: The piece expects near-term nickel price adjustment as risk aversion rises with hawkish Fed expectations and the stronger dollar. It notes Indonesian tariff considerations and reduced refinery/refined-nickel supply schedules ahead of Spring Festival. Rising nickel prices weaken downstream stainless steel buying, likely pressuring nickel in coming days.

title: BHP starts autonomous drilling at Chilean copper mine
summary: BHP has started autonomous drilling at its Spence copper mine in northern Chile, using remote-operated Pit Viper 351 drills and planning to deploy five autonomous units. BHP says the program improves worker safety and is part of broader autonomy plans at Spence and nearby operations like Escondida.

title: Los Andes Copper Announces Financial Results for the Year Ended September 30, 2021
summary: Los Andes Copper reports financial results and a corporate update for its Vizcachitas copper project in Chile. The company emphasizes ongoing and planned drilling to support a pre-feasibility study, including expansion from three to five rigs and receipt of a drill permit. No production or market-moving copper supply changes are announced.

title: Aurania halts most work at Ecuador's Lost Cities copper project on Covid-19 concerns
summary: Aurania halted most work at Ecuador’s Lost Cities copper project because of Covid-19 concerns. The stoppage can delay project development and potentially reduce future copper supply expectations, which typically supports higher prices in the near term as markets weigh supply disruption risk.

title: Copper in LME continues to rise as the Fed is not expected to raise interest rates too soon_SMM
summary: LME three-month copper rose about 1.2% as investors expected the Fed to take a moderate approach to March rate hikes, supporting economic recovery and near-term metal demand. SHFE copper also gained. LME aluminum was slightly higher, lifted by Russia-Ukraine supply-risk concerns.

title: Nickel price trend is weak and short-term high volatility [institutional review]_SMM
summary: SMM reports Shanghai and spot nickel prices rebounded from Jan 26 lows but remain weak and volatile, citing shifting market sentiment. It notes low global inventory and strong near-term demand support, with import supplies still weak, suggesting limited downside near 160,000 yuan and a wait-and-see stance.

title: Absolutely Low Inventory Supports Nickel Prices_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports tight nickel sulphate spot supplies after producers cut output on operating losses. PCAM makers plan to keep running and maintain raw material demand post-holiday, while nickel intermediates/matte remain limited. Nickel briquette demand stays resilient, inventories fall, and SHFE/LME briquettes decline, supporting backwardation and bullish nickel futures.

title: The Biden administration killed the Antofagasta Minnesota copper project._SMM
summary: The Biden administration cancelled two mineral leases for Antofagasta’s Twin Metals proposed copper-nickel mine in Minnesota, halting the project. The Interior Department said renewals were improper under regulations. Twin Metals plans to challenge the decision. The move complements a longer Minnesota mining ban proposal, affecting expected North American supply.

title: Aluminium Billet Inventories Up 34,700 mt on Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says aluminium billet inventories in five major consumption areas rose 34,700 mt to 211,600 mt on Jan 27, the fifth straight weekly increase. Foshan and Wuxi drove most of the gains. Demand was sluggish ahead of Chinese New Year, and inventories are expected to rise further during the holiday.

title: Aluminium industry seeks reduction in basic custom duty, correction of inverted duty structure on critical raw materials
summary: India’s Aluminium Association of India asks the finance minister to cut basic customs duties, fix inverted duty structures on aluminium value-chain raw materials, align scrap and primary duty rates, and eliminate coal cess for power-intensive aluminium producers. The stated goal is lowering production costs and improving competitiveness versus cheaper imports, which could support aluminium prices.

title: Grid Metals Corp.: Grid Metals Reports Wide Zones of Nickel Mineralization and Higher Grade Core at Bannockburn Nickel Property
summary: Grid Metals reports further 2021 drilling results from its Bannockburn nickel sulfide property, including wide nickel-enriched ultramafic intervals (e.g., 193.5m at 0.31% Ni) and higher-grade sections near 0.40–0.41% Ni. The B Zone target is widened and remains open for further drilling; assay results for remaining holes are pending.

title: Shanghai Nickel shock weak stainless Steel warming up at the end of the year [Agency Review]_SMM
summary: SMM commentary links hawkish Fed rhetoric to a stronger dollar but says nickel is starting to rise as the Philippines enters the rainy season. It highlights Indonesia considering export tariffs on nickel goods (policy still uncertain). Reduced refinery schedules and weaker stainless procurement are noted, yet expectations point to short-term higher nickel prices.

title: Electric Royalties Ltd.: Electric Royalties Closes Rana Nickel Royalty Acquisition
summary: Electric Royalties Ltd. announced the closing of its Rana nickel project royalty acquisition, securing a 1% net smelter revenue royalty tied to exploration licenses in Northern Norway, including the former producing Bruvann Nickel mine. The transaction is funded with shares and cash and remains subject to customary closing conditions.

title: Wolfden Resources Corporation: Wolfden Files NI-43-101 Technical Report for the Rice Island Nickel Project
summary: Wolfden filed an NI-43-101 technical report for its Rice Island nickel project and reiterated a mineral resource estimate using a 0.5% NiEq cut-off. The release includes upcoming expansion drilling to test extensions of nickel mineralization and references copper grades within the NiEq calculation.

title: Looming Super Cycle Sparks Copper Miners Seeking Future Supplies in Stable Jurisdictions
summary: The piece argues copper inventories could be critically low, citing a projected multi-million-ton deficit by 2030 tied to EV-driven demand and growth. It also references supply constraints and disruptions: BHP production near lower guidance, potential concentrate sale delays at Teck, and logistics/export uncertainty for Rio Tinto.

title: Weekly data: Copper, cobalt, and silver production set to increase in the Philippines after open-pit ban lifted
summary: The Philippines ended its 2017 open-pit mining ban, aiming to revive a mining sector hurt by the pandemic. GlobalData says the ban delayed projects, including the King-King mine. Now-allowed open-pit projects are forecast to add copper and nickel production, potentially improving near-to-medium-term supply expectations.

title: KOOTENAY REPORTS AZTEC JOINT VENTURE COMPLETES FIRST 14 HOLES OF PHASE 2 DRILL PROGRAM AT THE CERVANTES GOLD-COPPER PROPERTY, MEXICO
summary: Kootenay Silver reports that its Aztec joint venture completed the first 14 RC drill holes of a planned 5,000 m Phase 2 program at the Cervantes gold-copper property in Sonora, Mexico. Drilling targets oxide gold and deeper copper-gold porphyry sulfides; assay results are pending.

title: Chile's Cochilco forecasts start of copper price downward cycle
summary: Chile’s state mining agency Cochilco forecasts the start of a copper price downward cycle. The guidance implies weakening price momentum ahead, influencing market expectations for copper demand and pricing over the coming weeks. This creates near-term bearish sentiment for copper, even though details are not provided in the excerpt.

title: World Copper and Cardero Provide Update on Plan of Arrangement
summary: World Copper and Cardero updated their plan of arrangement, with Cardero’s shares halted and expected delisting as the companies combine. The exchange ratio would give Cardero holders 40% of World Copper post-closing. The update concerns transaction timing and approvals, not changes to copper supply or demand.

title: The trend of nickel price fluctuates and the rising pattern remains unchanged [institutional review]_SMM
summary: SMM reports Shanghai nickel futures and spot prices fluctuated, with Shanghai contract 2202 closing at 163,880 yuan/ton. Spot in Huatong rose slightly, Guangdong was flat. The piece attributes near-term volatility to fast prior gains and sustained funding/sentiment pressure, while fundamentals remain supported by weak imports and low global inventories.

title: China's Aluminium Output Likely to Fall 2.6% YoY in January, 530,000 mt of Aluminum Capacity was Resumed _SMM
summary: SMM estimates China’s January aluminium output at 3.19 million mt (-2.6% YoY). However, 530,000 mt of capacity was resumed and more is expected to ramp in February, while downstream consumption drops sharply after CNY due to delayed re-openings from environmental rules. Inventories may accumulate to 1.1 million mt by end-Feb.

title: Anglo American posts flat Q4 overall output, sees higher copper in 2022
summary: Anglo American said Q4 overall output was flat, with a 4% decline in copper production offset by stronger diamonds. It expects higher copper output in 2022, citing progress at its Quellaveco Peru mine, targeting 680,000–760,000 tonnes for the year and noting risks from COVID disruptions and Chile water shortages.

title: U.S.-U.K. Steel and Aluminum Talks Will End with Managed Trade
summary: The commentary argues that U.S.-U.K. talks will likely result in managed-trade tariff-rate quotas that limit steel (and in the broader system, aluminium) import volumes to pre-2018 levels. By constraining imports and keeping volumes fixed, the author expects continued price pressure rather than relief for downstream users.

title: Anglo American Group raises Copper production guidance to produce 680000 to 760000 tons of Copper in 2022_SMM
summary: Anglo American lifted its 2022 copper production outlook to 680,000–760,000 tonnes as Peru’s Quellaveco moves toward concentrate production mid-year, while Chile’s Collahuasi benefits from strong plant performance. The firm still faces drought-related water constraints in Chile, but guidance implies additional supply without clearly shifting the near-term balance.

title: Copper Inventory in Domestic Bonded Zone Grew 18,600 mt on Week_SMM
summary: SMM data shows China’s domestic bonded-zone copper inventories rose 18,600 mt to 243,100 mt over Jan 21–Jan 28, with gains in Shanghai and Guangdong. Imports slowed ahead of CNY holidays due to high losses and slower warehouse transport, while shipment arrivals and domestic smelter exports boosted inflows.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports Fell 175,000 wmt_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Chinese ports’ nickel ore inventories fell 175,000 wmt to 8.28 million wmt as of Jan 28, with total Ni content at 65,000 mt. Inventories at seven major ports also declined. Slower arrivals ahead of CNY holidays and Philippines wet-season conditions likely sustain a near-term downward inventory trend.

title: Nickel Import Premiums to Remain High on Low Shipments Arrivals in China Boned Zone_SMM
summary: Nickel imports into China remain loss-making as shipments are insufficient versus domestic demand and spot supply of nickel plates and briquettes stays tight. Import premiums continue rising, likely supported by limited bonded-zone arrivals after CNY holidays and slower customs clearance. The SHFE/LME nickel price ratio is expected to improve.

title: Quick Review of the non-ferrous Metal Electrolytic Aluminum Industry: the supply side is increasingly vulnerable to two main lines [Agency Review]_SMM
summary: Report notes no typical pre–Spring Festival buildup in aluminium ingot stocks; inventories have fallen since January. It highlights supply vulnerability from hydropower seasonality and power curtailments in Yunnan, and potential sanctions/energy-cost impacts from Russia-Ukraine conflict. With low inventories and strong spot demand, aluminium prices face bullish pressure.

title: Conservation groups challenge Minnesota copper mine permit
summary: Conservation groups filed suit to overturn U.S. agencies’ approvals for the PolyMet open-pit copper mine in Minnesota, arguing violations of the Endangered Species Act tied to habitat destruction. Challenges to related permits could delay the mine’s progress, potentially tightening near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Copper to soften in 2022 on growing supply and rate hikes: poll
summary: A Reuters poll expects copper to soften in 2022 as rising interest rates weaken demand and more mine output—mainly from South America—adds supply. Aluminium remains supported by past power curtailments, but tighter conditions are seen as already priced in. Nickel is forecast lower as inventories rise and Indonesia supply increases.

title: Biden administration cancels dangerous copper mining leases near Minnesota's Boundary Waters
summary: The Biden administration canceled two Twin Metals Minnesota leases near the Boundary Waters, where the project sought to mine sulfide ore for copper and nickel. The rollback follows earlier political blocks and years of contention over environmental harm. Twin Metals vowed to challenge the decision, but cancellation reduces near-term mine prospects.

title: Copper conc TC/RCs rebound in holiday lull; eyes on Chile tax development
summary: The article discusses a rebound in copper concentrate treatment and refining charges (TC/RCs) during a holiday lull, suggesting easing concentrate tightness. It also references Fastmarkets publication and correction updates for several metals assessments, but the only direct price-relationship highlighted is for copper smelting terms via TC/RC movements.

title: January 28th LME Market: copper prices hit the biggest weekly decline since October_SMM
summary: LME copper for three-month delivery fell 2.81% to $9,507.5/t and is down 4.4% for the week, the biggest weekly drop since October, as central-bank tightening expectations strengthened the dollar and dampened risk appetite. Aluminium slipped 0.5% while nickel was discussed amid supply-tightness and power-led smelter cuts.

title: China's aluminum industry has won a full victory in Brazil's anti-dumping defense against aluminum sheet, strip and foil._SMM
summary: Brazil issued a final notice ending its anti-dumping investigation into Chinese aluminum sheet, strip and foil without imposing measures. The Chinese side reportedly won a comprehensive defense after a year and a half, narrowing scope during the probe. The outcome should ease tariff risk and support aluminum export expectations.

title: Lun Copper recorded its biggest weekly decline since October last year._SMM
summary: LME copper futures fell Friday and are set for the biggest weekly drop since October, driven by Fed tightening expectations that strengthened the dollar and hurt risk appetite. Copper demand worries around Chinese New Year are cited. Nickel and aluminium show mixed moves, with smelter cutbacks and export concerns cited.

title: Sudburians expected to benefit from strong nickel price
summary: The article says Sudbury miners could benefit from recent strength in nickel, which rose to a decade high due to supply shortages and surging electric-vehicle demand. Although prices have eased slightly, nickel remains above $10/lb, and unions/locals expect continued support for local spending and bonuses.

title: The Biden administration talks with Wall Street about Russian sanctions and worries about a repeat of 2018, when aluminum prices soared by 30%._SMM
summary: Biden officials discussed potential sanctions on Russia if the Ukraine conflict escalates. The article warns sanctions could disrupt global non-ferrous supply, citing the 2018 Rusal case when aluminum jumped over 30% in 11 sessions and nickel also rose. It suggests sanctions risk renewed immediate upward price pressure.

title: Friedland: copper supply is facing a huge gap_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Ivanhoe Mining founder Robert Friedland said global copper supply faces a “huge gap,” even before accounting for additional electrification demand, stressing limited mine capacity and large required investment. He expects sharply rising copper use tied to EV infrastructure and also said nickel production must expand to meet battery-metal demand.

title: Is the sharp drop in nickel prices caused by high matte? [agency Review]_SMM
summary: SMM discusses Indonesia’s first batch of high-nickel matte shipped to China (~500 tons) and relates it to a sharp move in nickel futures. It argues the shipment is a fuse, not the fundamental driver, with risk aversion and profit-taking after margin increases playing the main role; high-matte impact on prices is limited.

title: Review and short-term Forecast of Copper Price trend in January 2022_SMM
summary: SMM reviews January 2022 copper, noting a brief surge followed by consolidation. It argues price support from loose domestic monetary policy, rising inflation/energy-driven costs, and Europe’s gas/electricity crisis constraining smelting. It also highlights historically low inventories and only moderate off-season demand weakness, implying limited downside and volatile-to-firm prices.

title: Global Aluminum Market - 74% of Growth to Originate from APAC|Rising demand of aluminum in electric vehicles to Boost Market
summary: The report projects that 74% of global aluminum market growth will come from APAC, led by China, Japan and India, and expects overall aluminum demand to expand at about 3% CAGR through 2024. It also points to rising aluminum demand in electric vehicles as a growth driver.

title: Aluminum prices can't keep up with energy costs, driving wave of closures
summary: Europe’s natural-gas and power costs have surged, forcing aluminum smelters to cut output or close (including Alcoa in Spain and Norsk Hydro in Slovakia). War-related fears around Russian supply and shrinking LME stocks to the lowest level since 2007 point to short-term aluminum tightness and higher prices.

title: Wolfden Commences Expansion Drill Program at Rice Island Nickel Project
summary: Wolfden Commences an expansion drilling program at its Rice Island Nickel Project. The move is intended to extend or grow the project’s resource base, which can improve expectations for future nickel supply. Although it does not change current production immediately, it is sentiment-supportive for nickel in the near term.

title: Callinex Announces Expansion of Rainbow Deposit to Surface and at Depth with Multiple Copper-Gold-Zinc Assays
summary: Callinex reported additional drilling results expanding the Rainbow VMS copper-gold-zinc deposit at its Pine Bay Project, including deeper intersections and a newly defined Red Zone with high copper-equivalent grades. Assays support potential continuation at depth, but there is no near-term production or supply change, limiting immediate price impact.

title: Tucson digs in against Rosemont copper mine in a dispute over a water storage project
summary: Tucson is challenging the Rosemont copper mine amid a dispute over a water storage project. Such local opposition can delay approvals, permitting, or related site works, raising expectations of reduced or postponed copper supply, which can support near-term copper prices.

title: Bright prospects for stainless steel, copper projects
summary: Sohar Port invites investors to develop downstream metals processing, highlighting copper concentration from Oman’s mined ore (with copper ore exports curtailed to support in-country value) and aluminium downstream uses from Sohar Aluminium’s smelter feedstock. The piece is promotional and doesn’t specify near-term output increases affecting prices.

title: Alro Slatina Eyes Resuming Electrolytic Aluminium Production In 2023 Subject To Energy Market Stabilization
summary: ALRO S.A. said management is working on solutions to bring electrolytic aluminium production back to the 2021 level starting in 2023, contingent on stabilization of energy prices. The announcement links production volumes to power-market conditions, influencing market expectations for aluminium supply.

title: Sego Resources Inc.: Sego Resources Intersects 74.5 m of 0.79 g/t Gold and 80.5 m of 0.69 g/t Gold Including 17.9 m of 1.27 g/t and 0.11% Copper to Expand the Southern Gold Zone at Miner Mountain Project
summary: Sego Resources reports additional drill results expanding the Southern Gold Zone at the Miner Mountain Cu-Au project near Princeton, BC. Intervals include disseminated chalcopyrite and one reported copper grade of about 0.11%, with proposed 2022 holes to extend the mineralized zone and test deeper porphyry potential.

title: Copperstone explores the conditions for carrying out a directed issue of shares
summary: Copperstone Resources announces a directed share issue of about SEK 130 million and intends to use the net proceeds to accelerate investment for the re-opening process of the Viscaria mine in Kiruna. The release emphasizes Viscaria’s high copper grade, implying improved near-term copper supply outlook.

title: Low inventory "turn stone into gold" new supply "cold" Nickel in the year of the Tiger can "Tiger whistle Fengsheng"? [agency Review]_SMM
summary: The piece analyzes a surge then sharp reversal in Chinese nickel prices around the Spring Festival. It cites extremely low global and domestic nickel inventories, strong stainless-steel and new-energy demand, and supply/cost shocks (e.g., Indonesia export tariffs, incidents in Myanmar). Analysts debate whether new Indonesian supply (high matte) will loosen balances.

title: Chile's copper production fell 1.9% to 5.68 million tons in 2021_SMM
summary: Chile’s national statistics agency reported copper production fell 1.9% in 2021 to 5.68 million tonnes, with December output down 0.6% to 503,605 tonnes. Chile is the world’s largest copper producer. The data points to weaker supply conditions versus the prior year.

title: Comex Copper Ends the Month 3.08% Lower at $4.3180 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper futures for February delivery ended the month at $4.3180, down 3.08% (13.70 cents/pound), the largest one-month decline since Sept. 2021. Copper has been down in four of the past six months and remains below key highs despite a small uptick on the day.

title: NORNICKEL'S GLOBAL PALLADIUM FUND LAUNCHES WORLD'S FIRST PHYSICALLY-BACKED ELECTRIC VEHICLE METALS ETC
summary: Norilsk Nickel’s Global Palladium Fund launched a physically-backed EV metals ETC. The tracked index weights include Copper (40%) and Nickel (18.65%) and stores metal in LME/LPPM warehouses. The news is primarily an investment product launch, without clear immediate supply-demand impact, and Aluminium is not referenced.

title: Nickel 28 Capital Corp.: Nickel 28 Releases Ramu Q4 and Full Year 2020 Operating Performance
summary: Nickel 28 reported Q4 2021 and full-year 2021 operating results from its Ramu nickel-cobalt joint venture in Papua New Guinea, including contained nickel production and nickel sales, plus cost guidance. It also cites LME nickel average pricing but does not announce new near-term supply disruptions or changes.

title: Aguila Copper completes stake acquisition in Halo properties
summary: Aguila Copper completed a deal to acquire a 90% interest in Manitoba copper-zinc-gold mining properties, including 28 claims covering the Sherridon Mining District. The transaction requires cash payment and staged exploration spend, with a joint venture formed post-closing, potentially supporting expectations for future copper supply development.

title: Inomin Mines Inc.: Inomin to Start Ground Survey at Lynx to Identify Nickel Drill Targets
summary: Inomin Mines will start a 118 km ground magnetic survey at its Lynx sulphide nickel property to delineate drill targets, with similar geologic success referenced from its Beaver nickel-cobalt project. The release also notes strong current nickel sentiment tied to EV-battery demand, implying supportive near-term nickel outlook.

title: Green aluminum? Complex deal seeks to restart the last aluminum smelter in the NW and cut pollution
summary: A deal is being discussed to restart Alcoa’s idled Intalco aluminum smelter in Washington, using $10 million in state funds to improve efficiency and cut pollution, plus a still-uncertain low-cost electricity contract. Power negotiations with Bonneville Power Administration are ongoing, making timing and market impact uncertain.

title: Proactive news headlines including Tesla, FPX Nickel, Skye
summary: This Proactive roundup contains several nickel and copper headlines tied to company developments: FPX Nickel begins a scoping study for low-cost, low-carbon nickel from its Baptiste project, while Talon Metals reports nickel-copper mineralization drill results and Lion Copper and Gold discusses a Nevada property option spin-out. Impacts are supportive but not immediate price-altering.

title: KUOW - Green aluminum? Complex deal seeks to restart the last aluminum smelter in the NW and cut pollution
summary: Washington state and stakeholders are seeking to restart Alcoa’s idled Intalco Works aluminium smelter near Ferndale using about $10 million in upgrades to cut pollution and improve efficiency. A buyer sale is being negotiated alongside early-stage talks for affordable wholesale power, crucial for the power-hungry restart.

title: February 1st LME market: copper price rises, low inventory pushes nickel price up_SMM
summary: LME copper rose about 2% as euro zone, Japan, and US manufacturing expanded and the dollar weakened, improving affordability. Nickel climbed to multi-year highs because LME and Shanghai inventories fell close to record lows, tightening supply; the spot premium over three-month rose above $500/t for the first time since 2009.

title: Acadia Crime Stoppers: Help needed solving copper theft
summary: Acadia Parish authorities are investigating thefts where thieves cut copper wiring for water well pump sites, damaging conduit and delaying field flooding. Farmers face about $3,000 per repaired site. The story seeks tips for the arrest, but it indicates only local copper scrap/replacement demand.

title: February 1st LME market: copper price rises, low inventory pushes nickel price up_SMM
summary: LME three-month copper rose about 2% after improving manufacturing surveys in the euro zone, Japan and the US and a weaker dollar. Nickel also jumped, with exchange warehouse stocks falling markedly and spot premiums rising above $500/t, indicating tight near-term supply conditions.

title: Nickel prices up, but so are gas prices
summary: Nickel prices continued their strong January rise, topping $US10.50 a pound. The report attributes gains to falling LME-registered inventories and higher premiums for prompt delivery, with cash nickel premiums above $500 a tonne for the first time since 2009. Gas prices are also rising but don’t drive nickel.

title: Coal shortage now at alarming levels, say aluminium producers
summary: Aluminium producers in India say coal rakes for captive power plants remain critically low, with stocks around 3–4 days versus a 15-day target. They warn production disruptions are looming because smelting requires continuous power. The group asks for 25–30 coal rakes per day and cites cancellations of coal auctions for non-regulated sectors.

title: Glencore's FY 21 Cobalt Production Up; Copper, Zinc Drop; Retains FY 22 Guidance
summary: Glencore reported FY21 production with own-sourced copper down 5% to 1.2 million tonnes, attributing declines to Mopani disposal, weaker grades at Antapaccay and lower copper by-products from mature zinc/nickel mines. Cobalt rose on limited Mutanda restart. FY22 guidance was unchanged, with copper around 1.15 mt.

title: Copper wire thefts leave people without phone and internet connection for days
summary: Authorities report numerous theft incidents targeting telephone cable, believed to be for the copper in the wire, causing widespread phone and internet outages across Irish counties. Gardaí are urging public vigilance and working with metal dealers, but the episode appears localized and unlikely to materially move copper prices.

title: Copper climbs on low inventories, soft dollar
summary: Copper prices rose 1.5% on a softer U.S. dollar and buying driven by concerns over low LME inventories, though gains were tempered by slowing China activity around the new year holiday. China’s smelter shutdowns for pollution controls supported supply tightness, aiding the broader base-metals tone. Aluminium shortages also remain stressed.

title: Small Craft Breweries Scramble to Adapt to Aluminum Can Shortages
summary: A growing “candemic” is causing aluminum beverage container shortages. Small craft breweries are struggling to keep selling because can supply is tight, leading them to stock up on unbranded cans or shift to bottled beer. The aluminum can bottleneck can tighten short-term demand/supply dynamics for aluminium packaging.

title: Copper wire thefts in Louth and surrounding counties cut off  phone and internet connection for days
summary: Irish police report 66 phone-cable theft incidents over six months, disrupting phone and internet services for over 1,500 households. Investigators say cables are targeted for copper contained in the wiring. Garda appeals include reporting unusual purchases of copper cable or copper in large amounts to police.

title: Material Matters: Potential WA Supply Shock, Oil, Natural Gas, Copper & Nickel
summary: The piece weighs a potential Western Australia supply shock (prompted by an omicron spread) and its possible impact on WA-linked commodities, including nickel and alumina. It also notes Oxford Economics expects improved metal supply and new copper projects coming online, while nickel production rises in Indonesia/Philippines, offsetting disruption risk.

title: Tesla nickel supplier BHP building off-grid solar & battery storage systems for mining
summary: BHP, Tesla’s nickel supplier, has begun construction of the Northern Goldfields Solar Project to supply off-grid renewable power to its Nickel West operations (Mt. Keith and Leinster). Solar and battery storage will replace diesel and gas, cutting scope 2 emissions and supporting BHP’s low-carbon nickel strategy amid strong EV nickel demand.

title: Atalaya Mining PLC Announces Best Copper Intercept to Date at Masa Valverde
summary: Atalaya Mining announced drill results from Proyecto Masa Valverde in Spain, highlighting the best continuous copper intercept to date: 125 metres at 1.19% Cu (including 19m at 2.56% Cu). The firm expects higher grades to lift the upcoming NI 43-101 resource estimate and potentially support increased copper production.

title: Atalaya Mining announces best copper intercept to date at Masa Valverde | Companies
summary: Atalaya Mining announced new infill drill results from its Masa Valverde (PMV) copper project in Spain, including a best continuous copper intercept of 125m at 1.19% Cu and other high-grade intervals. Management expects these results to lift the planned NI 43-101 resource estimate and support future copper production growth without rate changes.

title: Aluminium futures up as LME stocks drop to 15-year low
summary: Aluminium futures rose as LME warehouses drew down quickly, with stocks hitting a 15-year low. The move is supported by geopolitical uncertainty from Russia-Ukraine and elevated power costs in Europe, both of which can pressure supply availability and increase production economics for aluminium producers.

title: Enduro Metals concludes option to buy Romios copper-gold project
summary: Enduro Metals has completed the option to acquire full interest (100%) in the Newmont Lake copper-gold project in British Columbia from Romios, meeting exploration, payment, and royalty milestones. The company can focus on its next exploration program, supported by multiple identified copper-gold and related mineralization targets.

title: Tesla Chooses Talon Metals In Minnesota For Nickel Supply
summary: Tesla agreed with Talon Nickel to buy 75,000 metric tons of nickel concentrate over six years for battery supply, with options to negotiate more. The deal targets a Tamarack Nickel Project in Minnesota amid US nickel supply constraints. Production is planned for 2026, but the contract supports nickel demand expectations.

title: Peruvian copper output falls 5.5% in Dec; zinc down 19%, Minem says
summary: Peru’s mining ministry (Minem) reported that Peruvian copper output declined 5.5% in December. The headline also notes zinc production down 19%, but the tracked focus is copper. Weaker copper output can influence near-term supply expectations and affect copper price sentiment over coming sessions.

title: Peru copper production grows in 2021 despite social conflicts
summary: The article reports that Peru’s copper production rose in 2021 even with ongoing social conflicts. The implication is that output disruption was less severe than feared, supporting improved copper supply expectations, which can pressure prices downward over the near-term trading horizon.

title: Electric vehicles drive up nickel, cobalt and lithium prices
summary: EV sales growth is driving higher battery demand. The article notes nickel shortages and large draws in LME-approved warehouse stocks and briquette used to produce nickel sulphate for batteries. Analysts expect higher average nickel prices, with nickel recently at multi-year highs, though supplies may ease later in the year.

title: Orogen to divest Canada copper-gold porphyry project to Pacific Ridge
summary: Orogen Royalties agreed to sell its Onjo copper-gold porphyry project in British Columbia to Pacific Ridge Exploration for cash and equity, plus a 2% NSR royalty. The property lies near the Mount Milligan mine and contains alkalic porphyry/copper-gold skarn targets. The transaction is exploratory, with no immediate output changes.

title: Allied Copper acquires option to buy Klondike Property in US
summary: Allied Copper has secured an option to buy a 100% stake in the Klondike copper property in Colorado’s Paradox Copper Belt. The deal requires about $4.75m of exploration spending over four years plus cash and share issuances. The project remains at exploration stage with no near-term output.

title: Brazil's alumina exports down 14% in January, ministry says
summary: Brazil’s ministry says alumina exports declined 14% in January. Because alumina is the key feedstock for primary aluminium production, weaker export flows from a major supplier can tighten supply expectations and increase near-term cost concerns, weighing on aluminium price sentiment over coming days.

title: Comex Copper Ends the Week 4.19% Higher at $4.4835 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex Copper futures ended the week up 4.19% to $4.4835/lb, gaining 18.05 cents. The contract rose seven of the past nine weeks and was higher on most recent sessions, with today’s settlement also up. The note is a data summary with no additional drivers.

title: Geopolitical Tensions Could Send Aluminum Prices Even Higher
summary: Russia-Ukraine tensions raise the prospect of sanctions and energy disruption in Europe. Natural gas prices are already far higher and Nord Stream flows are uncertain, leading multiple aluminum smelters to curtail output. With global cutbacks and potential trade stymies from sanctions, aluminum prices are pressured higher, evidenced by recent LME and cash gains.

title: DGTR for imposing countervailing duty on copper tubes, pipes from Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam
summary: India’s DGTR recommends countervailing duties for five years on subsidized imports of copper tubes and pipes from Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam, with duty rates up to 14.76% of CIF value. The probe found rising import volumes and injury to domestic producers, pending final approval by India’s finance ministry.

title: Peru's copper production increased by nearly 7% in 2021_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Peru’s copper production rose nearly 7% to 2.3mn tons in 2021, helped by the Mina Justa start-up. However, growing protests since President Castillo took office have disrupted operations and heightened fears of future copper shortages, as Peru supplies a large share of global copper exports.

title: Shanghai aluminum scales 3-1/2-month peak on supply woes, demand hopes
summary: Shanghai and LME aluminium prices rose sharply, reaching multi-month highs after the Lunar New Year holiday. Traders cited supply risks from production cuts, high electricity prices and possible sanctions on Russia, plus hopes for demand pickup in China. The move reflects immediate bullish pressure on aluminium fundamentals.

title: Kingston Resources begins exploration at historic Mineral Hill copper-gold mine
summary: Kingston Resources began exploration drilling at its Mineral Hill copper-gold project in New South Wales, targeting near-mine and brownfields deposits to support future ore feed beyond tailings reprocessing. While the Southern Ore Zone resource includes about 1.2% copper, the article lacks near-term copper output changes, limiting immediate price impact.

title: Metal general rise Shanghai nickel rose 3.25% black is strong [SMM Daily Review]_SMM
summary: SMM’s daily review notes a general metal rise: Shanghai nickel jumped 3.25% with a “black series” strength and tight post-festival spot supply, while aluminium (Shanghai) rose about 3.03% on rapid opening gains. Shanghai copper closed nearly flat (-0.04%). Nickel’s supply/destocking outlook remains key.

title: Shanghai Aluminum climbed to a three-and-a-half-month high, boosted by supply concerns and demand prospects._SMM
summary: Aluminium futures in Shanghai and the LME jumped after the Spring Festival, supported by supply concerns and expectations of higher demand. The move was reinforced by very low LME aluminium inventories and commentary on European production cuts, high electricity costs, and Russia-related sanctions risk. Nickel also firmed on tight inventories.

title: Worldwide Copper Pipes and Tubes Industry to 2027 - Featuring KME, Kobe Steel and MetTube Among Others
summary: ResearchAndMarkets previews a 2022–2027 forecast for the global copper pipes and tubes market, citing demand growth from construction, HVAC, industrial heat exchangers, medical and water systems, and oil & gas. While it implies steady copper end-use consumption, it offers no immediate supply, trade, or pricing shock for near-term copper moves.

title: ORCA maps St. Lucie River pollution: muck, copper, glyphosate, nutrients
summary: ORCA mapped pollution hotspots in Florida’s St. Lucie River, finding high copper levels (river peak ~170 ppm; canal near Palm City Bridge) alongside glyphosate and nutrient pollution. The report suggests legacy boat-bottom paint and vegetation-control chemicals could contribute, calling for source identification and mitigation studies.

title: PRICING NOTICE: Discontinuation of Turkey aluminium primary foundry alloy silicon 7 ingot premium
summary: Fastmarkets says the Turkey aluminium primary foundry alloy silicon 7 ingot premium (cif dup over P1020A Turkey) will be discontinued after a four-week consultation. The market largely agreed because of persistent lack of spot liquidity. Germany and Eastern Europe premiums remain unchanged; Turkey may be reintroduced if liquidity returns.

title: Ghana's Integrated Aluminium Industry: Work starts at Project 2
summary: Ghana’s GIADEC started Project 2 activities for its integrated aluminium industry, with Rocksure International conducting mineral resource estimate work to validate Nyinahin bauxite reserves. The work involves drilling and laboratory sampling to determine alumina quality and guide a planned mine and refinery, supporting future aluminium supply development.

title: Protesters object to expansion of Aughinish Alumina refinery in Co Limerick
summary: Local groups oppose Aughinish Alumina’s planned expansion of its bauxite refinery near the Shannon estuary, citing risks from higher “red mud” and salt-cake storage and more rock blasting. Russian owner Rusal seeks planning approval to secure production to 2039; any delays could constrain alumina inputs to aluminium.

title: B.C. government rejects proposal for gold and copper mine for third time
summary: The B.C. government has rejected a proposal for a gold and copper mine for the third time. By blocking the planned copper development, the decision lowers the probability of future copper supply coming online, which can provide some short-term support to copper prices despite uncertainty around timing and size.

title: The metal market is mixed and Shanghai aluminum turns red and black to maintain a strong rise of coking coal by more than 5% [SMM Review]_SMM
summary: SMM reports a mixed metal tape on March 8: Shanghai copper is slightly lower while Shanghai aluminium turns up marginally after improving demand and expectations of tight spot ingot supply post-holiday. Nickel rises as pure-nickel supply remains tight and LME/d omestic inventories decline. Overall direction is mixed across tracked metals.

title: B.C. government rejects proposal for gold and copper mine for third time | iNFOnews
summary: British Columbia rejected an environmental assessment certificate for the proposed open-pit Morrison mine on Lake Babine Nation territory, citing risks to water quality and fish, including sockeye salmon habitat. The project would have produced substantial ore containing copper (plus gold and molybdenum), lowering future copper supply prospects.

title: Lion Copper and Gold Corp. Releases Updated Geology & Resour...
summary: Lion Copper and Gold Corp. said it released an updated geology and resource presentation for its MacArthur copper project in Nevada, referencing a prior 55% increase in measured and indicated copper resources and planning an updated PEA. The news is specific to one company’s project advancement, not broader market supply shocks.

title: Material Matters: Oil, Aluminium, Zinc & Rare Earths
summary: The article says aluminium prices stay elevated due to fears of further supply disruptions. It attributes weakness in supply to surging energy costs and energy shortages forcing smelters to cut output, with China prioritizing residential power. ANZ expects below-trend aluminium supply growth and a return to deficit in 2022.

title: Aluminium hits near 4-month high on supply worries
summary: Aluminium prices rose to near four-month highs as supply worries intensified. COVID-19 curbs in Baise disrupted transport of alumina, threatening local aluminum output and production cuts. Russia-Ukraine sanction risks also lifted fears of tighter supply, with LME and Shanghai contracts both up sharply.

title: Alumina Capacity Cuts Have Totalled 15.02 Million mt in Shanxi, Shandong and Henan_SMM
summary: SMM says alumina refineries in Shanxi, Shandong and Henan have implemented environmental-protection production cuts totaling about 15.02 million mt/year. Operating capacity reductions cut daily alumina supply, constraining smelters’ feedstock and prompting inventory building, raising concerns of a near-term supply shortage for aluminium.

title: Outbreak of COVID-19 Pandemic in Baise, Guangxi Impacted Regional Aluminium Supplies_SMM
summary: An outbreak of COVID-19 in Baise, Guangxi led to city-wide traffic controls and constrained operations around major aluminium capacity (most of Guangxi’s smelting). The disruption threatens alumina/refining output and replenishment of key inputs, lowers shipment of ingot/billet, and is expected to raise local aluminium inventories.

title: Tight supply drives aluminium towards 13-year high
summary: Aluminium prices surged toward a 13-year high as investors worried about tight supply. LME and Shanghai inventories fell sharply, China maintained output restrictions for pollution control and faced COVID-related disruptions, and power/emissions costs cut European output. Sanctions risks for Russian supply further supported gains.

title: Aluminum Hits Highest Since 2008 on LME, Closes In on a Record
summary: Aluminum prices on the LME surged to their highest level since 2008 and finished higher on a record close, signaling strong near-term bullish momentum. The report highlights the latest market move, which would likely reinforce expectations for tighter pricing/availability in the coming days.

title: Aluminum Hits Highest Since 2008 on LME, Closes In on a Record
summary: Aluminium prices on the LME reportedly hit the highest level since 2008 and closed close to an all-time record. The move suggests strong upward price momentum and improving near-term market expectations for aluminium supply and/or demand.

title: Tight supply drives aluminum towards 13-year high
summary: Aluminum prices nearly hit a 13-year high as investors worry about tight supply and inventories dropping to multi-year lows on both the LME and Shanghai exchanges. China’s output curbs for pollution control and a Baise COVID lockdown add disruption risk, while power/emissions costs and potential Russia sanctions further tighten supply expectations.

title: Solis Announces Widespread Copper Sulphides Logged in First ...
summary: Solis Minerals said diamond drilling at its Mostazal copper project in Chile has intersected widespread copper sulphides (including chalcocite/bornite with chalcopyrite) from surface through the first two holes. Assays are underway with expected lab turnaround of at least four weeks, and the rig has moved to a third hole.

title: Aluminium price spikes to 2008 peak
summary: Aluminium prices surged to a 14-year high on the London Metal Exchange, reaching levels last seen in 2008. The rise is attributed to tighter supply after China put Baise, a key aluminium-producing city, into Covid lockdown, raising expectations of immediate shipment delays and reduced output.

title: COVID-19 outbreak in S.China's Guangxi, major aluminum production hub, boosts price
summary: COVID-19 outbreak-related measures in China’s Guangxi region—highlighted as a major aluminum production hub—are reported to be pushing prices higher. The piece describes testing and renewed border-related controls, implying potential disruptions to worker movement and logistics that can tighten short-term aluminum supply expectations.

title: Correction to aluminium arbitrage calculations – February 7
summary: Fastmarkets corrected its aluminium import arbitrage calculations for Feb. 7. The dollar per tonne arbitrage figure should be -120.63 versus 48.87, and the yuan per tonne figure should be -768.77 versus 311.43. The MInD pricing database was updated accordingly.

title: Sierra Aluminum Announces Expansion Plans
summary: Sierra Aluminum (Samuel) plans to expand extrusion, anodizing and painting capacity with a new 300,000 sq ft greenfield facility in Mexicali, Mexico, and an additional extrusion line in California. Groundbreaking is later in 2022, with completion expected in 2023, aimed at meeting customer demand in the U.S. and Mexico.

title: Aluminium prices hit highest in 14 years
summary: Aluminium prices surged to the highest level in 14 years, with LME benchmark up about 1.6% at $3,183.50/t. Reuters attributes the rally to investor concerns about tight supply and declining inventories, pointing to strong near-term bullish momentum for aluminium.

title: The transnational plunder of Chilean copper
summary: The piece focuses on Chilean copper mining and claims transnational firms exported large volumes of copper concentrate while paying low taxes under Chile’s post-1990 tax laws. It argues this has harmed Chile and discusses nationalisation as a possible remedy. The thrust is heightened political/regulatory risk for Chilean copper in the near term.

title: Rusal: aluminum sales rose 8.1 per cent quarter-on-quarter to 989000 tons in the fourth quarter of 2021_SMM
summary: Rusal said Q4 2021 aluminium sales rose 8.1% QoQ to 989,000 tons, with the average realised aluminium price up 7.3% to $2,927/ton. The gain was linked to higher LME quotation-period pricing (up 7.7% QoQ) and higher quarterly premiums (up 3.8%).

title: Metal up and down mutual current aluminum strength period nickel fell sharply iron ore fell more than 3% [overnight market]_SMM
summary: Overnight, macro signals were mixed (stronger dollar, CPI awaited). Shanghai aluminum rose 1.9% (and LME aluminum also up), while Shanghai nickel dropped 2.53% (LME/Shanghai nickel down sharply). Overall industrial metals were mixed, implying offsetting short-term pressure across aluminium and nickel.

title: LME aluminum hit its highest level since 2008 due to tight supply and falling inventory_SMM
summary: LME aluminium surged to the highest since 2008 on investor worries over tight supply and declining inventories. China’s pollution-related production restrictions and disruption concerns in Guangxi support the move, while LME warehouse stocks are at multi-year lows. The piece also flags a sharp decline in Peru’s Las Bambas copper output after protests blocked transport.

title: Sensex Today: Stock Market Live Updates: Sensex jumps 400 points, Nifty nears 17,400; Airtel in red post Q3 show; NALCO, Hindalco surge up to 5% on rise in aluminium prices
summary: Market live updates note that NALCO and Hindalco shares rose as aluminium prices increased. While most items are equity/corporate news, the aluminium price mention implies immediate support for aluminium pricing, which can influence near-term market expectations over the next days to weeks.

title: Why has a Chinese city's lockdown sent aluminium prices surging?
summary: The article attributes a surge in aluminium prices to a lockdown in a Chinese city. The lockdown is likely disrupting local production, refining, or transport flows, tightening available supply and raising expectations of short-term shortages, which lifts aluminium prices in the immediate trading horizon.

title: Explanation on Newly Added SMM Low Carbon Aluminium Prices _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM describes its newly released Low-Carbon Aluminium benchmark price methodology starting December 27, 2021, including how it is formed from Foshan spot aluminium plus an enterprise carbon-emission difference and the prior day CEA carbon allowance closing price. It covers data sources, contributor validation, specs, and publication process.

title: LME Aluminium Recorded A New High since 2008_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: LME aluminium futures surged to a new 2008 high as inventories in LME warehouses hit the lowest since 2007, with spot premiums widening amid tight supply fears. China’s production limits and COVID-related disruptions are cited, alongside smelter cuts and sanctions risk. Separately, Las Bambas copper mine output is declining after road blockades, tightening copper supply expectations.

title: London aluminium holds near 13-1/2-year high on supply fears
summary: London aluminium prices held near a 13-1/2-year high as supply fears supported sentiment. Three-month LME aluminium was flat near $3,183/tonne. Output was cut at Slovakia’s Slovalco over high power/emissions costs and lack of compensation, while COVID curbs in China’s Baise raised disruption concerns.

title: Covid outbreak in China province hits aluminium production
summary: A new COVID outbreak in Baise, Guangxi—a key Chinese aluminium production hub—has led to a citywide lockdown and suspended aluminium output. With booming demand and low inventories, the supply disruption is expected to tighten aluminium availability and lift both downstream and upstream prices, with reported gains of hundreds of yuan per tonne.

title: Antofagasta to earn stake in Pacific Ridge's Canada copper-gold project
summary: Antofagasta has agreed to option Pacific Ridge’s RDP copper-gold project in Canada, with a move to acquire 75% via cash plus a success payment and exploration spending. The deal is focused on funding drilling and assessments rather than immediate output, implying limited near-term impact on copper prices.

title: Explanation on SMM Low Carbon Aluminium Prices _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM explains its low-carbon aluminium benchmark pricing methodology, covering how the benchmark is calculated from Foshan spot aluminium plus a carbon-emission differential times the previous day’s CEA carbon allowance closing price. It outlines data sources, contributor verification, and publication rules, aiming to reflect China’s low-carbon aluminium supply-demand dynamics.

title: Commodities Prices - Aluminium stocks surge as metal's price climbs to 13-year high
summary: Aluminium prices have climbed more than 14% this year and reached a 13-year high, with market participants citing concerns that supply may fall short of demand. The report notes aluminium stock gains alongside the metal’s rally, reinforcing expectations of a potentially tight market.

title: Supply fears push aluminium to 13-1/2-year highs
summary: Aluminium surged to 13½-year highs as smelter closures in Europe and China reduced output amid high energy prices and pollution crackdowns. A Baise COVID lockdown disrupted alumina and aluminium logistics, while LME and ShFE warehouses fell to multi-year lows, reinforcing expectations of a large market deficit.

title: Gungnir Resources Inc.: Gungnir Identifies Twin Conductor at Lappvattnet Nickel Project
summary: Gungnir Resources says it has identified a “twin conductor” at its Lappvattnet nickel project. Such exploration results can raise expectations about the prospectivity of the deposit and support sentiment toward future nickel supply, typically providing mild near-term support to nickel prices rather than a direct supply change.

title: US, Brazil, set records amid generally rising aluminium premiums
summary: The article reports record conditions and generally rising aluminium premiums in the market. It also notes Fastmarkets/Metal Bulletin database corrections to certain aluminium premium assessments (low-carbon Aluminium 6063 extrusion billet differentials). Overall, the tone suggests firmer pricing for aluminium premiums in the near term.

title: Copper theft gets Onawa man 15 years in prison
summary: An Onawa, Iowa man was sentenced to 15 years for stealing copper wiring from rural Monona County electrical substations, causing thousands of dollars in damage. Authorities also arrested others for similar thefts, including missing copper cable powering streetlights along I-80 interchanges.

title: SE Asia copper premiums at highest for 5 years; EU, US mostly steady
summary: SE Asia copper premiums have risen to their highest level in five years, while EU and US premiums are mostly steady. This implies stronger regional demand or supply tightness in Asia relative to other markets, supporting expectations of upward near-term copper pricing through premium-driven settlement.

title: Sherritt Ends 2021 With Strong Production Results and a Favourable Outlook for Nickel and Cobalt Markets
summary: Sherritt reported strong Q4 and full-year 2021 results, including finished nickel output at the Moa JV and improved unit economics. The company attributes performance to better nickel market fundamentals and expects bullish near-term conditions linked to EV demand, positioning it as a “pure play” for rising nickel prices.

title: Metals rose at midday and Shanghai copper and aluminum hit new intraday highs in more than three months [SMM midday review]_SMM
summary: SMM reports a midday rally in China’s base metals as the US dollar weakened. Shanghai copper rose over 3% to a three-month intraday high, while Shanghai aluminium gained over 2% for the eighth day on tight domestic supply, low inventories and improving downstream spot demand. Shanghai nickel also rose.

title: Metals rose at midday and Shanghai copper and aluminum hit new intraday highs in more than three months [SMM midday review]_SMM
summary: SMM’s midday review notes a weaker US dollar and rising industrial metals. Shanghai copper climbed over 3% to a new intraday high for more than three months. Shanghai aluminum rose over 2% for eight straight sessions, supported by tight inventories and expected supply shortages versus imports in the near term.

title: CATL, Jiayuan Technology to build joint venture for copper foil production
summary: CATL will form a joint venture with copper-foil supplier Jiayuan Technology to build electrolytic copper foil manufacturing with 100,000 tonnes/year capacity in Guangdong, in two phases. The project targets high-performance lithium-ion battery current-collector foils, implying higher expected copper demand.

title: Warburg Securities: supply risk increases aluminum price to maintain strength_SMM
summary: Shanghai aluminium prices have risen for seven straight sessions as Spring Festival ingot inventory accumulation runs below historical norms. Geopolitical risks from Ukraine/Russia are increasing fears of sanctions and reduced Russian electrolytic-aluminium circulation, while domestic electrolytic output is down and operating rates remain constrained. Demand is mixed but new-energy and foil/strip stay firm.

title: Comex Copper Settles 3.16% Higher at $4.6005 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for February delivery settled up 14.10 cents per pound, or 3.16%, at $4.6005, snapping a two-session losing streak. The move was the largest one-day dollar and percentage gain since Jan. 12, with the settlement at the highest level since Oct. 20, 2021.

title: 'It's a pretty significant problem': NSP says copper thieves are targeting interstate light posts
summary: Nebraska State Patrol says copper thieves are cutting the copper wire from street lights along Interstate 80 and Highway 75, leaving many lamp posts unlit and costing taxpayers over $100,000 in repairs and rewiring. The theft is linked to scrap-metal sales, but the impact appears highly localized.

title: Aluminium Ingot Social Inventory in China Increased by 84,000 mt after the Chinese New Year_SMM
summary: SMM data shows China’s aluminium ingot social inventory rose to 950,000 mt on Feb 10, increasing by 84,000 mt from Monday. The increase was mainly driven by stocks in Wuxi, Gongyi, Nanhai and Chongqing following Chinese New Year, suggesting more available supply and potentially softer demand.

title: SMM Analysis: Three Factors That Slowed Production Recovery at Chinese Secondary Copper Rod Makers after Chinese New Year _SMM
summary: SMM reports Chinese secondary copper rod production will not resume until around the Lantern Festival and recovery will be gradual. Output is delayed by Winter Olympics environmental restrictions until Feb. 20 in northern provinces. Additionally, weaker orders after Chinese New Year suppress production. The market also awaits March 1 VAT refund policy effects.

title: Tsingshan Began to Deliver High-Grade Nickel Matte to Huayou Cobalt _SMM
summary: Huayou Cobalt said on Feb 10 that Tsingshan has begun executing a 60,000 mt high-grade nickel matte supply agreement, with deliveries starting from October 2021. It also reported steady progress on Huayou’s Huake (Indonesia) nickel matte pyrometallurgy project, suggesting improving nickel supply conditions.

title: EMX Royalty Corp.: EMX Assigns Arizona Exploration Permit to Arizona Sonoran Copper Company in Return for Cash and Royalty Payments
summary: EMX assigned its Arizona state exploration permit covering part of the Parks Salyer copper target to Cactus 110 LLC, with cash and a 1.5% NSR royalty. The deal funds exploration and adds milestones tied to copper resource size, but provides no near-term production or output changes.

title: Aston Bay Holdings Ltd: Aston Bay Further Expands Land Package and Extends Drill Program at its Mountain Copper-Zinc Project in Virginia, USA
summary: Aston Bay Holdings announced expanded leased land for its Mountain copper-zinc project in Virginia and extended its diamond drilling program to 3,500 metres. Copper and zinc mineralization have been observed in multiple holes, but assay results are pending, limiting any immediate impact on copper market expectations.

title: Los Andes Copper Ltd.: Los Andes Copper Announces 732m at 0.51% Copper Equivalent Mineralization in Initial Drilling Results at Vizcachitas Copper Project, Chile Detailed Table Update
summary: Los Andes Copper reported initial drill results at its Vizcachitas Chile project: 732m at 0.51% copper equivalent (with copper and molybdenum grades) and continued drilling to expand resources. The update can bolster bullish sentiment for copper given improved resource expectations, though nickel is not meaningfully addressed.

title: KGHM has registered its copper cathodes on the INE stock exchange in China
summary: KGHM has registered its copper cathodes on China’s INE stock exchange, enabling the metal to be traded through that platform. The update may affect near-term expectations for physical copper supply and liquidity in China, potentially supporting prices, while it is not directly related to nickel or aluminium fundamentals.

title: Aluminium price hits $3,300/t despite 120kt delivery into LME warehouses
summary: The piece notes aluminium prices have risen to around $3,300/t even with about 120kt delivered into LME warehouses. It also includes Fastmarkets/Metal Bulletin procedural updates and methodology/publishing corrections, but the headline focus remains the firm aluminium price in the face of warehouse inflows.
