title: Volkswagen plans JVs in Asia to secure nickel, cobalt supply
summary: Volkswagen plans two joint ventures with Huayou Cobalt and Tsingshan to secure nickel and cobalt for EV batteries. One JV in Indonesia targets nickel raw materials; the other in China refines nickel sulfates and battery precursors. The announced supply arrangements are expected to bolster nickel demand outlook.

title: Bell Copper Corporation: Bell Copper Starts Met Testing at Big Sandy
summary: Bell Copper started metallurgical testing of chalcocite-bearing samples from its Big Sandy porphyry project, evaluating copper recovery via froth flotation and acid leaching and studying molybdenite concentration and rhenium content. It is early scoping work without production or inventory changes, implying minimal near-term copper price impact.

title: LME in Talks with Governments on Whether to Block Russian Metal
summary: The LME is reported to be in talks with governments about whether to block Russian metal. If such restrictions or trading blocks are implemented, they could reduce near-term supply and tighten availability, typically a supportive setup for copper, nickel and aluminium prices over the following days to weeks.

title: Bell Copper Starts Met Testing at Big Sandy
summary: Bell Copper says it has begun metallurgical testing on chalcocite-bearing samples from its Big Sandy Arizona copper-molybdenum project. Work includes froth flotation and acid-leach tests to estimate recoverable copper and concentrate quality for potential smelter discussions, plus flotation studies for molybdenite.

title: London nickel trading shows signs of recovery
summary: London Metal Exchange nickel trading resumed after a March 8 suspension tied to a sharp price spike. On the day of reporting, the LME three-month nickel contract fell sharply at the open, then eased, with daily down limits preventing full downside moves. Volumes are picking up, suggesting gradual market normalization.

title: Fallout From London Nickel Trading Fiasco Will Be Extensive, Expert Says
summary: The LME halted nickel trading after a March 8 short squeeze linked to a large Chinese short position, causing nickel to surge to above $100,000/ton. The piece says the fallout will extend to Chinese firms globally and notes nickel strength amid Russia supply disruptions following sanctions since Ukraine.

title: The LME 'Demon Nickel' Incident That Shocked the World Confirmed the Existence of 'Hong Kong Backdoor'
summary: The piece recounts the “demon nickel” episode tied to Tsingshan Group and the LME. It notes LME resumed nickel trading on March 16 after a March 8 suspension, but imposed a limit on daily price swings, preventing nickel from repeating the earlier $40,000-to-$100,000 one-day surge.

title: Lion Copper and Gold finalises earn-in agreement with Rio Tinto
summary: Lion Copper and Gold signed an earn-in agreement with Rio Tinto America for copper assets in Mason Valley, Nevada. Rio Tinto can earn up to a 65% stake via a $4m payment and studies, with further funding options tied to additional ownership. Rio will also assess Nuton tech to improve copper recovery.

title: Biden wants Americans to buy electric cars made with Russian aluminum
summary: The article argues U.S. EV plans rely on Russian materials, citing Tesla purchases tied to Rusal and discussing how rising battery raw-material prices—especially nickel—could slow EV adoption. It notes nickel has reached an 11-year high amid fears Russia’s metal exports could be interrupted, implying near-term nickel strength.

title: World Copper Ltd.: World Copper Files Preliminary Economic Assessment Technical Report for Escalones Project on SEDAR
summary: World Copper filed a NI 43-101 preliminary economic assessment technical report for its Escalones copper project in Chile, highlighting modeled NPV and cost metrics and expected heap-leach production over a 20-year life at certain copper price assumptions. Results are preliminary and based on inferred resources, with no certainty of development or output.

title: Peru: Gold, copper projects lead this year's mining exploration portfolio | Noticias | Agencia Peruana de Noticias Andina
summary: Peru’s Ministry of Energy and Mines said the 2022 mining exploration portfolio includes 20 copper projects totaling US$211 million, making up 36.1% of nationwide exploration investment. The report lists several leading copper targets and notes copper’s importance for Peru’s exports and revenues.

title: U.S., U.K. Reach Deal to Ease Tariffs on British Steel, Aluminum
summary: A U.S.-U.K. deal will ease tariffs on British steel and aluminum. By lowering trade barriers, the agreement is likely to reduce aluminum import costs and improve availability in the near term. That increased supply outlook can pressure aluminium prices over coming days and weeks.

title: US & UK Announce Trade Deal to End Tariffs on Steel, Aluminum Products
summary: The US and UK agreed to expand the lifting of Section 232 tariffs, restoring tariff-free access for UK steel and aluminium exports to the US effective June 1, 2022. The US also eased UK retaliatory tariffs. The article cites improved supply-demand balance for aluminium, but no direct copper linkage.

title: U.S., U.K. Reach Deal to Ease Tariffs on Steel and Aluminum
summary: The U.S. and U.K. reportedly reached a deal to ease tariffs on steel and aluminum. Easing aluminum tariffs can reduce import costs and uncertainty for buyers, supporting near-term aluminum market sentiment as supply expectations improve and immediate demand for metal inflows strengthens.

title: UK and US agree deal to partially end tariffs on British steel and aluminium
summary: The UK and US agreed to partially lift US Section 232 tariffs impacting British exporters, with changes effective June 1, 2022. The deal replaces tariffs with tariff-rate quotas, aiming to restore tariff-free access for UK aluminium (and steel) to the US market, reducing export barriers.

title: US to drop UK steel and aluminum tariffs | News | DW
summary: The US will lift Trump-era steel and aluminum tariffs on UK imports, removing Section 232 duties on UK aluminium and allowing sustainably based volumes into the US. The UK will also drop retaliatory tariffs. This should add near-term aluminium supply and weigh on prices; copper effects are indirect.

title: Global Aluminium Demand to Reach New Highs After Covid
summary: A report by the International Aluminium Institute (IAI) says global aluminium demand could rise nearly 40% by 2030, requiring 33.3 Mt more production. Growth drivers include EVs, solar power, construction and sustainable packaging, with most incremental demand expected from China and Asia.

title: US announces deal with UK to end steel, aluminum tariffs
summary: The US and UK agreed to end Trump-era tariffs on steel and aluminum imports, removing the UK’s retaliatory tariffs and allowing duty-free flows into the US. Officials framed the deal as easing supply-demand gaps and aiding domestic producers, though it may also increase import supply pressures for aluminium prices.

title: From January to February this year, the export volume of China's aluminum products increased significantly!_SMM
summary: China’s aluminum product exports rose sharply from January to February, with higher shipments of unwrought aluminum and key downstream items like strips/foil, despite some declines in profiles and certain categories. It cites epidemic and energy shortages boosting reliance on Chinese supplies and notes a strong rise in export values, supporting aluminium price sentiment.

title: US agrees to lift taxes on British steel, aluminum imposed during Trump administration
summary: The US and UK agreed to end tariffs on imported British steel and aluminum that were imposed during the Trump era. The move is intended to resolve a bilateral trade dispute, with the UK also lifting retaliatory tariffs on US exports. Annual audits are required for certain Chinese-owned UK steel.

title: U.S., Britain strike trade deal on steel, aluminum-Xinhua
summary: The U.S. and Britain agreed to end a long-running dispute by allowing specified volumes of British aluminium (and steel) to enter the U.S. without Section 232 tariffs. The deal also removes related retaliatory tariffs, easing trade frictions and likely improving near-term aluminium supply expectations and price support.

title: U.S., Britain strike trade deal on steel, aluminum
summary: The U.S. and Britain reached a trade deal to end a long-running dispute over Section 232 tariffs on steel and aluminum. The deal allows tariff-free, historically based volumes of British steel and aluminium to enter the U.S., lifting retaliatory tariffs and easing inflation concerns, benefiting U.S. consumers and producers.

title: London aluminium prices inch higher on Russian supply concerns
summary: London aluminium prices edged higher as Russia-Ukraine-related supply concerns increased, supported by Australia’s ban on exports of aluminium-making materials to Russia and output cuts by European smelters facing higher energy costs. It notes LME has no plans to ban Russian metals, while copper and nickel were weaker overall.

title: US, Britain strike trade deal on steel, aluminum
summary: The US and Britain reached a trade deal ending a Section 232 tariff dispute on steel and aluminum. British aluminium products will enter the US without the 10% tariff, and retaliatory tariffs on over $500 million of US exports to Britain are lifted. The change should support near-term aluminium market sentiment.

title: INSG Predicts Global Nickel Supply Deficit, SMM Thinks Differently!_SMM
summary: INSG expects the global nickel market to swing to a 157,100 mt supply deficit in 2022 versus a 103,700 mt surplus in 2021, with January still oversupplied. SMM, however, says primary nickel shifts toward tight-to-surplus dynamics in 2022 due to structural issues, with inventories declining but slower.

title: London Metal Exchange facing lawsuit threat after  nickel debacle
summary: The LME faces potential lawsuits after canceling nickel trades during a “debacle” when nickel spiked above $100,000. The move followed supply fears after Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and an LME suspension, eliminating gains for shorting and hedging funds including AQR. Nickel is now cited near $28,290/ton.

title: The price of Lunni is nearly halved after the "demon" nickel can no longer cause unrest?_SMM
summary: LME nickel futures opened lower and fell for five straight sessions, down about 10% on March 22 and nearly halving from roughly $55,000/t before the suspension. LME leadership said the market is returning to normal after shorting and will tighten rules, with extended daily limits.

title: Britain and US resolve trade row over steel and aluminium tariffs
summary: Britain said it resolved a US trade dispute that had left UK exporters facing steel and aluminium tariffs. Under the deal, UK aluminium and steel exporters get high-level tariff-free access to the US, taking effect June 1, after the US lifted Trump-era measures for the UK.

title: LME benchmark nickel rises at open for first time since restart
summary: LME benchmark nickel jumped sharply at the open, rising 5.5% and then spiking close to $3,000 in about 20 minutes to hit the upper limit near $32,380/t. Traders cited an unclear catalyst, possibly automated trading, alongside a tight market and lingering Russian uncertainty after restart glitches.

title: Nickel Rises on the LME as Market Continues Reset After Squeeze
summary: Nickel is reported to be rising on the LME as trading markets continue to reset following a squeeze. This suggests short-term correction after stressed positioning, with the immediate price reaction favoring nickel bulls. No clear details on supply, demand, or broader metal fundamentals are provided in the text shown.

title: SMM Analysis: Aluminium Scrap Trading Review of The First Three Days of This Week_SMM
summary: SMM reports aluminium prices rose early week, but aluminium scrap prices (taint and tense) showed mixed, mostly smaller changes. Supply in scrap was tight and transactions remained weak due to pandemic-related transport restrictions and required nucleic acid testing. Trading may improve after restrictions ease, but near-term activity is muted.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: US EV Battery Supply Chain: Talon Metals Announces Numerous High-Grade Nickel-Copper Intercepts Outside Main Resource Area at Tamarack Nickel Project
summary: Talon Metals reported new high-grade nickel-copper (plus cobalt) drill intercepts at the Tamarack Nickel Project, including thick shallow sulphide intersections outside the current resource area. The company frames results as deposit expansion progress toward feasibility and a Tesla nickel-concentrate offtake after commercial production.

title: Class 1 Nickel Announces Key Appointments to Accelerate
summary: Class 1 Nickel announced appointments and mobilization of a 35 km ground EM geophysics survey at its Somanike nickel project in Quebec, including the historical Marbridge Mine. The program aims to confirm extensions to known nickel sulphide trends and generate drill targets ahead of an extensive drilling campaign.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: US EV Battery Supply Chain: Talon Metals Announces Numerous High-Grade Nickel-Copper Intercepts Outside Main Resource Area at Tamarack Nickel Project
summary: Talon Metals reported additional shallow, high-grade nickel and copper intercepts from drilling in the Tamarack Nickel-Copper-Cobalt project’s CGO West area. Results include thick nickel-copper sulphide intervals and expanded mineralization outside the current resource area, supporting future feasibility and an existing Tesla nickel concentrate offtake.

title: Indian Aluminum Mills Get Fewest Coal Rail Rakes in Six Months
summary: BNN Bloomberg reports that Indian aluminum mills are getting the fewest coal rail rakes in six months. The shortage of coal transport likely limits fuel availability for smelters, potentially constraining aluminum output in the near term and weighing on aluminium price expectations over the coming days.

title: US lifts tariffs on imported UK steel and aluminium products, including boats
summary: The article headline says the US has lifted tariffs on imported UK steel and aluminium products, including boats. While steel is not tracked here, removing aluminium-related tariffs should lower import costs and support near-term aluminium supply and demand expectations, providing a mild bullish impetus for aluminium prices.

title: Aluminum prices soar as Australia bans alumina exports to Russia
summary: Australia immediately banned alumina exports to Russia, cutting off a major share of Russia-bound alumina feedstock used to produce aluminum. Rusal faces supply-chain disruptions and possible production impacts, while the article reports LME aluminum prices rising about 5.7% to over $3,500/ton, with further inflation fears.

title: Fastmarkets LME Nickel March Average skewed by suspension of market: subscriber notice
summary: Fastmarkets says its LME Nickel March Average was skewed because the LME suspended trading and published disrupted Officials for specific dates in March (8-21 and 23 March). It points subscribers to LME Notice 22/064 on Averages methodology during disrupted Officials and will review and update further.

title: Raising aluminium duties would cost European consumers Billions
summary: EU regulators are considering a sharp rise in duties on Russian aluminium imports. With Russian metal a significant share of Europe’s primary supply and limited substitution, buyers would likely absorb higher costs. Other producers could lift prices, using the apparent supply deficit, pushing aluminium prices up for European consumers and industry.

title: Barrick Gold Sees Scope to Grow Zambia Copper Output
summary: The piece’s headline says Barrick expects room to increase copper output in Zambia. That points to improved production outlook at a key African copper supply source, which can influence near-term expectations for mine supply and therefore copper prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: EPA Proposes Updates to the Hazardous Air Pollutant Copper Smelting Rules | Clark Hill PLC
summary: EPA proposed more stringent NESHAPs for hazardous air pollutants from primary copper smelters, including lower PM limits, standards for fugitive furnace/converter emissions, and removal of startup/shutdown/malfunction exemptions with added opacity limits. The changes could raise control and compliance costs for smelters, affecting short-term copper supply expectations.

title: MDO bets on copper and limestone projects
summary: Minerals Development Oman (MDO) outlined multiple projects, highlighting Mazoon Mining in Yanqul, which it says contains up to 16 million tonnes of copper reserves and 1.56 million tonnes annual production capacity. MDO is also exploring additional copper ore in nearby areas, alongside industrial minerals like limestone and gypsum.

title: Russian invasion of Ukraine breaks supply chains for everything from neon to nickel, a panel of Moody's economists says
summary: Moody’s Analytics economists say Russia’s invasion of Ukraine is disrupting global commodity supply chains, including nickel produced largely in Russia and Ukraine. With output and logistics constrained, market participants face tighter availability and greater uncertainty for nickel used in batteries, supporting expectations for higher near-term prices.

title: Peruvian transport carriers end road blockages as giant copper mines remain shut down
summary: Peru transporters protest higher fuel prices, threatening road and logistics disruption. More importantly for metals, Las Bambas halted operations mid-January and Southern Copper’s Cuajone was suspended for 15 days after protests blocked access to water and supplies. Output from both mines is down about 27% year-to-date.

title: Yukon Junior Boosts Copper Resource by 43%, PEA On the Way
summary: Granite Creek Copper reported a 43% increase in its Carmacks copper-gold-silver resource to 651 Mlb Cu and expects a PEA in Q3, with better sulphide recoveries. The news is project-focused and does not imply near-term production or supply disruptions, limiting impact on short-term copper prices.

title: Varadkar and Donohoe in talks with Aughinish Alumina
summary: Irish officials met Aughinish Alumina amid concern that further EU sanctions on Rusal/EN+ owners could jeopardize the Limerick alumina plant. The plant refines imported bauxite into alumina shipped to European smelters. A strategic review and potential divestment are being considered ahead of an EU summit.

title: Copper prices continue to rise as macro expectations improve [institutional review]_SMM
summary: Copper prices rebounded after a volatile session, with night trading lifting both Shanghai and international 2205 contracts. Spot electrolytic copper in Shanghai saw an average rise but weakened as the “downstream epidemic” weighed on demand and water fell. Macro sentiment improved on falling yields and risk appetite, with Lunni gains supporting prices.

title: Shanghai nickel jumps 17%, gains by daily limit on supply worries
summary: Shanghai nickel jumped 17% on the daily limit as supply worries intensified after Russia’s threat to demand rouble payments for natural gas raised concerns about metals supply disruptions. Higher energy costs and LME discussions around Russian metal deliveries also supported aluminium. The piece cites a Zambia copper mine disruption.

title: China Refined Nickel Imports Surged 90.53% YoY in Jan-Feb_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s refined nickel imports rose 90.53% YoY in Jan–Feb 2022 to 37,573 mt, with downstream pre–CNY stockpiling and an open import window supporting volumes. February demand softened post-holiday, but overall flows stayed high. Nickel briquette prices are pushing some production cuts, potentially affecting supply.

title: Chinese Aluminium Market Still in Destocking Cycle_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show Chinese social inventories of aluminium ingots across eight major markets fell to 1.04 million mt as of Mar 24, down 50,000 mt on the week. Drops in several regions were attributed to pandemic disruptions that hindered cargo arrivals. Inventories are expected to keep declining next week as arrivals may increase slightly.

title: Alumina Prices in China to Rise Slightly on Pandemic-Induced Supply and Demand Imbalance_SMM
summary: SMM reports COVID containment slowing transport in northern China, tightening spot alumina raw-material availability and creating local supply-demand imbalances, with exports supported by a wider China-vs-overseas price gap. However, large new alumina capacity in southwest China will come online in early April, likely limiting overall upside.

title: SMM Minutes: LME Price Spread Widened Again, Driving SHFE Nickel up Overnight_SMM
summary: SMM reports LME nickel rose sharply, pulling SHFE nickel to limit up (up to ~17%). Supply tightness in Shanghai amid transport restrictions and light spot trades, plus firmer ferronickel/NPI support from smelting costs and market spreads, is lifting nickel-related prices. Nickel sulphate remains cautious, with near-term flat trading until settlement.

title: Stainless Steel Cost Inflated amid Still Rising LME Nickel_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says nickel-based raw materials drive roughly two-thirds of stainless steel production costs. Since March’s sharp LME nickel rise, prices for NPI, stainless scrap and ferronickel have also climbed, lifting 304 cold-rolled coil costs to about 19,200 yuan/mt and pressuring profits. A later nickel cooling may reduce costs.

title: Ximen Mining Corp.: Ximen Mining's April Drill Program Targeting Bud Elk Copper Gold Porphyry Targets
summary: Ximen Mining announced drilling plans for its Bud-Elk copper-gold property in British Columbia, targeting disseminated copper-gold porphyry and copper-gold skarn mineralization. The company describes historical grades and confirms 10 drill sites approved for 2022, with drilling expected to start after April surveys.

title: China faces challenges supplying Russia with alumina - analysts
summary: Australia banned exports of alumina and aluminium ores to Russia, cutting Rusal’s estimated Australian alumina feedstock share. Analysts expect China to absorb some redirected alumina, but note limited Chinese export surplus, rising domestic alumina demand, and sanctions concerns. Additional refinery disruptions elsewhere further tighten supply.

title: China faces challenges supplying Russia with alumina – analysts
summary: Australia banned exports of alumina and bauxite-related ores to Russia, cutting Rusal’s alumina supply from Queensland Aluminium. Analysts expect China may divert some alumina but face domestic feedstock constraints and secondary-sanctions risk. Additional refinery disruptions in Ukraine and Ireland add supply tightness, likely supporting higher aluminium prices.

title: Power Nickel Inc.: Power Nickel Follows Up High Grade Results at Nisk with New Fully Funded 5000 M Drill Program
summary: Power Nickel announced a fully funded 5,000-meter follow-up diamond drilling program at its Nisk nickel sulphate project after promising high-grade findings. The company plans to start later in Q2, using existing capital and accelerating warrant expiry, and frames the project as a potential source of Class 1 nickel for batteries.

title: Nickel Reignites Blistering Rally as Prices Spike by 15% Limit
summary: The article headline reports that nickel has reignited a blistering rally, with prices spiking by around 15% and reaching a limit. This signals intense short-term buying pressure and suggests nickel supply/demand expectations are moving higher immediately.

title: Nickel Turmoil Is Back With Another 15% Limit-Up Spike on LME
summary: The article headline says nickel turmoil has returned, with another 15% limit-up spike on the LME. Such a sharp limit-up move implies immediate, strong upward pressure on nickel prices over the coming days as buyers chase higher quotes and short positions are constrained.

title: How My Great-Uncle Swindled Hitler Out of Precious Canadian Nickel Before WWII
summary: The article says nickel has been in tight supply, with demand driven by electric-car batteries and Russia providing about 20% of high-grade nickel. Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and sanctions are described as triggering a supply crisis and a sharp London Metal Exchange nickel price jump, with heavy trading losses at Tsingshan.

title: China Aluminium Billet Inventory Extended Downward Trend_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says China’s aluminium billet inventories fell to 151,900 mt on March 24, down 24,400 mt (13.85%) from a week earlier, with biggest drops in Wuxi and other regions. The decline follows faster cargo pick-up after pandemic transport issues eased, and inventories are expected to keep falling next week.

title: Copper Inventory Pivot Surfaced Earlier Than in Previous Years, Fat Chance for Arbitrage_SMM
summary: SMM says China’s post-CNY copper inventory pivot appeared earlier than prior years as inventories fell sharply across Shanghai and Guangdong while overall stock declined. With low global inventories, the SHFE/spot-futures spread moved from contango to backwardation. Supply concerns (high LME prices, shipping delays) and weaker scrap economics support bullish near-term copper.

title: SMM Evening Comments (Mar 24): Shanghai Nonferrous Metals All Closed with Gains amid Energy Supply Concerns and Lingering Pandemic, Nickel Hit Limit Up Again_SMM
summary: SMM reports Shanghai copper and aluminium rising on energy-supply and cost worries linked to Europe gas settlement, alongside demand suppression from spreading COVID. It also highlights aluminium inventory declines and nickel-related logistics disruptions and weak supply/demand, with SHFE nickel hitting limit up after LME gains.

title: Bulls Returned to SHFE Nickel Market, But Spot Trades Were Sluggish amid Tight Supply and High prices_SMM
summary: SHFE nickel hit the daily ceiling and prices surged ~17% to 245,740 yuan/mt, lifting SMM1# refined nickel about 15.7% the same day. Tight domestic supply due to a closed import window and worse shipments to Shanghai suppressed trades, while low steel-mill inventories supported NPI prices and potential further gains.

title: China Ferronickel Imports Rose YoY in both January and February 2022_SMM
summary: SMM cites customs data showing China’s ferronickel imports rose year-on-year in January (391,900 mt) and February (324,500 mt), with Indonesia the largest supplier. The higher inflows suggest improved nickel supply availability, potentially influencing near-term nickel market expectations.

title: Infinitum Copper Commences Geophysics Survey At La Adelita Project
summary: Infinitum Copper commenced a ~3-week magneto-telluric geophysical survey at its La Adelita project in Mexico after crews prepared the grid and identified the Pericos copper zone. The program aims to refine geology for future development; no production, permitting, or supply changes are announced.

title: Barrick Gold (GOLD.US) CEO: Zambian Copper production is expected to increase further_SMM
summary: Barrick’s CEO said the company sees further opportunity to increase copper output in Zambia’s copper belt, leveraging the “pro-business” Zambian government and recent power improvements. Canadian firms’ interest in Zambian copper assets is noted, alongside Barrick’s continued investment posture and Lumwana operations.

title: Russia, nickel and the global impact on the mining sector
summary: The article argues that Russia-related disruption after the Ukraine invasion—sanctions, reduced shipping/trader participation, and lack of bank financing—has tightened nickel supply flows and triggered major price spikes on the LME. It expects ongoing trade-flow disruption and continued volatility, supporting near-term bullish pressure for nickel.

title: Apple Uses World's 1st Low-carbon Aluminium In IPhone SE
summary: Apple said it will use low-carbon aluminium in iPhone SE, sourced from Canada-based ELYSIS’s direct carbon-free smelting process. Apple links the move to green-bond investments and prior partnerships with Alcoa and Rio Tinto to develop recycled and hydropower-based aluminium. The announcement is supportive but not a clear near-term price driver.

title: 10 Commodity Dividend Stocks With Over 4% Yield
summary: The article lists commodity dividend stocks and emphasizes Southern Copper (SCCO), noting it produced 958,200 tons of copper in 2021, exceeded guidance, and reported higher revenue and record net sales. It also references rising broader commodity prices tied to the Russia-Ukraine backdrop and economic reopening.

title: Nickel bolts to daily limits on supply worries
summary: Nickel surged to LME and SHFE daily price limits on persistent Russia-Ukraine supply worries and possible short-covering in thin volumes. Russia supplies about 10% of global nickel and also produces aluminium. Aluminium, also linked to Russia supply risk, initially rose but ended lower as market sentiment cooled.

title: The United States and the United Kingdom Agree to Cessation of Section 232 Tariffs on Steel and Aluminum | Husch Blackwell LLP
summary: The U.S. and UK agreed to stop U.S. Section 232 tariffs on steel and aluminum imports from the UK from June 1, 2022, and the UK will lift retaliatory tariffs on $500m+ of U.S. exports. The move is intended to ease supply-demand gaps and support U.S. producers under ongoing concerns about China overcapacity.

title: Apple to Produce Next iPhone SE Model Using World's First Commercial-Purity Low-Carbon Aluminum
summary: Apple says its next iPhone SE models will use “low-carbon,” commercial-purity primary aluminum made through Elysis’ carbon-free smelting technology, enabled by Green Bonds investment. The company cites reduced component carbon footprint and hydropower-based production in Quebec, but provides no volume figures to gauge near-term aluminum price impact.

title: LME Bans Orders Outside Daily Price Limits After Nickel Mayhem
summary: The headline says the LME banned orders outside its daily price limits after a “nickel mayhem” episode. Such an exchange rule change directly affects nickel market trading and volatility, but the available excerpt does not specify whether it reflects net supply/demand stress or simply temporary disorder.

title: Aluminum prices soar as Australia hits Russia with alumina export ban
summary: Australia imposed an immediate ban on alumina/aluminum ore and bauxite exports to Russia, stopping shipments to Rusal and tightening Russian alumina supply (about 20% sourced from Australia). This is expected to limit Russia’s aluminum output, and aluminium prices reportedly jumped up to 5.1% to about $3,554/ton.

title: Peru approves expansion of Las Bambas copper mine despite protests
summary: Peru approved MMG’s plan to expand the Las Bambas copper mine in Apurimac, targeting the Chalcobamba pit and related infrastructure. The project involves a first-phase $130 million investment and is expected to lift output to 380,000–400,000 tonnes of copper in concentrate annually, despite ongoing local protests.

title: Future iPhones Will Be Made From Carbon-Free Aluminum
summary: Apple says future iPhones (including iPhone SE) will use “carbon-free” aluminum produced at commercial scale by ELYSIS, whose smelting generates oxygen rather than greenhouse gases. The announcement suggests growing premium demand for low-carbon aluminium supply, but no volumes or immediate market-wide effects are specified.

title: Copper and aluminum prices pick up and inventories continue to be removed [institutional review]_SMM
summary: The piece reports that copper and aluminium prices rose as inventories declined sharply. For copper, improving domestic demand and tight scrap supply provided support, despite a backdrop of prior rate hikes. For aluminium, cost stabilization boosted electrolytic smelter profits and drove a rebound, with inventories falling materially week-on-week.

title: Copper and aluminum prices pick up and inventories continue to be removed [institutional review]_SMM
summary: Copper prices rose week-on-week as domestic growth improved, scrap supply stayed tight, and inventories fell sharply. Aluminum also rebounded, supported by cost-side stabilization and improved electrolytic smelter profits, while inventories declined materially. Overall, both markets show near-term supportive inventory and demand/supply conditions.

title: Shanghai Nickel Jumps to Record With China Import Window Closing
summary: Shanghai nickel reportedly surged to a record level as China’s import window neared closure. The move suggests the market is anticipating reduced near-term nickel inflows, tightening available supply and lifting prompt prices on expectations of higher costs or limited availability.

title: SMM Analysis on Operating Rates of Chinese Aluminium Processing Enterprises by Different Sector under the Impact of Pandemic_SMM
summary: SMM says China’s major aluminium processing enterprises’ average operating rate fell to 68.6%, with declines across plate/sheet, strip, wire and cable logistics disruptions, and a sharp drop in extruders due to pandemic shutdowns. Secondary alloy rates also slipped as scrap restrictions and poor demand constrained output and trades.

title: SMM Morning Comments (Mar 25): Base Metals Closed with Losses on Inflating US Dollar except Nickel_SMM
summary: SMM reports most base metals fell as stronger US data and a rising US dollar weighed on prices: LME copper -1.1% and LME aluminium -3.12%, with spot activity hit by COVID logistics disruptions. However, nickel bucked the trend, with LME limit-ups and SHFE nickel up 8.51% amid supply/market constraints.

title: [Announcement] SMM Suspends Offering Premiums/Discounts of #1 Jinchuan Nickel, #1 Imported Nickel and Nickel Briquette_SMM
summary: SMM said it is suspending its premiums/discounts for #1 Jinchuan nickel, #1 imported nickel, and nickel briquette because nickel futures have deviated significantly from near-term supply and demand fundamentals. SMM’s outright nickel prices remain available based on ongoing research for specified products.

title: Colored Aluminium Struts for Paris's Newest Skyscraper
summary: HEKLA Tower in Paris will use colored anodized aluminium struts for its façade brise soleil panels, supplied from Sandalor’s range of finishes. The piece highlights aluminium’s durability and corrosion resistance but provides no quantities or market-relevant supply/demand signals that would likely move aluminium prices in the near term.

title: Traders in China Strike Rare Deal With Russia's Rusal on Alumina
summary: Traders in China reportedly struck a rare deal with Russia’s Rusal for alumina. Because alumina is the primary feedstock for aluminium smelters, such arrangements can influence near-term alumina availability and thereby affect expectations for aluminium production costs and supply, offering modest price support.

title: Nickel Metal Hydride Global Market Report 2022
summary: The report forecasts strong growth for nickel metal hydride (NiMH) batteries, citing expanding EV and electronics use and improved manufacturing. Since NiMH batteries rely on nickel, higher expected demand may support nickel demand sentiment. It provides no direct nickel supply, inventory, or price catalysts.

title: Aguila Copper Corp.: Aguila Copper Signs Airborne Geophysical Contract for Cora Copper Project, Arizona
summary: Aguila Copper Corp. signed a contract for a high-resolution helicopter-borne magnetic and radiometric survey at its Cora copper project in Arizona, supporting drill targeting for the 2022 field season. The update is exploration-focused with no operational output, supply change, or market-policy impact for copper.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports Dropped 300,000 wmt to 6.117 Million wmt_SMM
summary: SMM says nickel ore inventories at Chinese ports fell 300,000 wmt to 6.117 million wmt as Philippine rainy-season effects eased only gradually and shipments remained weather-limited. NPI prices stayed high, so production continued but purchases were more “rigid” due to higher ore costs. Near-term decline likely persists, affecting nickel supply tightness.

title: SMM Expects Alumina Imports to Drop Further in March Following a Slump in January-February _SMM
summary: SMM says China’s alumina imports fell in Jan-Feb and expects March inflows to drop further (only 50,000–100,000 mt) as the import window is closed and the China-overseas price gap narrows. Overseas alumina prices jumped ~41.5% and Rusal’s Ukrainian alumina refinery shut down, tightening supply.

title: Copper Inventory in Domestic Bonded Zone Down 28,800 mt_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports China domestic bonded zone copper inventories fell 28,800 mt to 302,600 mt between March 18 and March 25. The drop reflected increased shipments and focused exports of Russian copper to overseas delivery warehouses, while logistics hindered domestic smelter exports into bonded zones, limiting arrivals.

title: Inventory of Refined Nickel in Bonded Zone Slightly Increased _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that refined nickel inventories in China’s Shanghai bonded area rose in early week: nickel briquettes up to 2,100 mt and nickel plates to 5,300 mt. The build is attributed to falling overseas nickel prices and improved import margins amid China’s refined nickel shortage, while LME nickel price weakness may extend.

title: Copper, aluminium slip on profit-taking in thin trade
summary: Copper and aluminium eased in thin trade as investors booked profits, with three-month copper down 0.9% and aluminium slightly lower. Nickel also fell 4.6% after earlier extreme gains. While potential further Russian sanctions support supply uncertainty, short-term selling dominated prices.

title: Copper, aluminium slip on profit-taking in thin trade
summary: Copper and aluminium slipped in thin trade as investors booked profits, with three-month copper down 0.9% and aluminium slightly lower. The prospect of further Russian sanctions added some supply-uncertainty support, keeping the outlook murky. Nickel fell 4.6% after prior record highs, reflecting volatility and funding pressure.

title: LME nickel limps back but tensions are not going away: Andy Home
summary: LME three-month nickel remains volatile after a March 8 breakdown and week-long suspension, with multiple limit days and expanding trading bands. Large short positions linked to Tsingshan and other shorts, falling LME stocks, and delivery/liquidity frictions from Russian supply uncertainty suggest margin-driven de-risking and continued downside risk.

title: Nickel market trading freeze and reversal of 5,000 trades proves that markets are RIGGED
summary: The piece recounts the LME’s March 8 halt of nickel trading after a short squeeze linked to a large Chinese short position. Nickel reportedly spiked to above $100,000/ton as margin calls forced buying back contracts. Trading later resumed with limits, and 5,000 trades worth about $4 billion were canceled.

title: PNG Copper Inc. Announces Commencement of Drilling
summary: PNG Copper Inc. announced it has started drilling four cored holes totaling 235 meters on the Doriri nickel-palladium prospect on its PNG Copper property, targeting completion by end of April 2022. The release provides drilling scope and history but no results or production volumes.

title: US agrees to lift taxes on British steel, aluminum affecting bourbon industry
summary: The U.S. and the U.K. agreed to remove tariffs on British steel and aluminum imports below new quotas. The change is expected to end related tariffs affecting Kentucky bourbon/whiskey. By easing aluminum import duties, it may support improved market sentiment and pricing for aluminum over the coming days.

title: Vale to supply Northvolt with low-carbon nickel products for batteries_SMM
summary: Vale said Vale Canada and Northvolt agreed on a multi-year deal for Vale’s low-carbon nickel products for lithium-ion batteries. Vale highlighted its certified lower-carbon nickel round cakes, and Northvolt aims to cut battery emissions via clean energy and recycling. The agreement supports near-term sentiment for nickel demand.

title: Africa's Top Bauxite Exporter Guinea Posts 4% Rise in Shipments
summary: Guinea, the world’s top bauxite exporter, posted a 4% rise in shipments. Because bauxite is the key upstream input for aluminium refining, improving export flows can strengthen near-term expectations for aluminium supply and support prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Apple Continues Its Green Bonds Initiative, Plans to Use Carbon Free Aluminum in iPhone SE / Digital Information World
summary: Apple announced it will partner with Canadian firm Elysis to use aluminum smelted in a fully carbon-free process for future iPhone SE models. The project is part of Apple’s green bonds program, aimed at boosting ecofriendly manufacturing and renewable energy. It implies incremental demand for low-carbon aluminium supply.

title: Gold advances; nickel prices struggle to find footing
summary: Gold rose as investors weighed sanctions and growth prospects, but the focus for industrial metals is nickel. The LME nickel market remains highly volatile and illiquid after a short squeeze tied to Tsingshan, with trading disruptions and enlarged default-fund plans. Nickel was down 5.5% on Friday amid continued squeeze-risk.

title: Saudi firm to help Pakistan assess Reko Diq gold, copper quantity - Pakistan
summary: Pakistan’s Balochistan chief minister defended a revised agreement for the Reko Diq copper-and-gold project with Barrick Gold, saying a Saudi firm will set up a refinery in Gwadar to assess mineral quantities. The deal includes investment commitments, royalties, and a timeline tied to starting work, boosting near-term copper project certainty.

title: Aluminum spill causes fire at manufacturing plant
summary: A small fire broke out at the Mercury Marine Plant 17 in Fond du Lac, Wisconsin after molten aluminum spilled on March 27. About 30 workers were evacuated safely. Firefighters and plant engineers contained and removed the molten aluminum over more than an hour. No injuries were reported.

title: Domestic inventories continue to decline, supporting short-term copper prices [institutional review]_SMM
summary: The report cites ongoing declines in domestic copper warehouse receipt inventories and low-shock LME warehouse levels, with spot premiums rising versus futures and LME spot discounts narrowing. It also notes operational updates for major copper projects in Zambia and Congo, while tight recycled copper supply is partly offset by abundant concentrate supply and a stronger dollar.

title: Tempest Minerals hits copper sulphides in maiden drilling at Meleya project
summary: Tempest Minerals says its maiden deep drilling at the Meleya project’s Orion target intersected multiple zones of copper-bearing sulphides, including 10m of copper-bearing semi-massive sulphides and additional disseminated and stringer veins. The company plans further drilling, but the report provides no production or reserves.

title: Domestic Aluminium Social Inventory Rose 13,000 mt from Last Thursday_SMM
summary: SMM said China’s domestic aluminium social inventory increased by 13,000 mt from last Thursday to 1.05 million mt as of March 28. Gains in Wuxi and Gongyi reflected concentrated arrivals and hindered warehouse shipments, while some regions fell on lower arrivals. Resumed production remains below last year; COVID-linked logistics frictions affect flows and may influence prices.

title: Low Inventories to Continue to Support Aluminium Prices, Pandemic Disrupted Downstream Production _SMM
summary: SHFE and LME aluminium rose on the week amid geopolitical and macro developments, but the piece attributes support mainly to low inventories and relatively stable supply. It also flags COVID outbreaks disrupting aluminium processing and transport, which may curb downstream demand. Net effect is near-term trading with possible mild downside correction.

title: MHI Group to Conduct Feasibility Study for Applying CO2 Capture Technology at Aluminium Smelting Plant in Bahrain
summary: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries EMEA and Engineering have begun a feasibility study under an MOU with Aluminium Bahrain (Alba) to apply CO2 capture technology at Alba’s aluminium smelting plant in Bahrain. The project uses MHI’s KM CDR Process and is positioned as the first application in aluminium, but is not yet a firm deployment.

title: Vedanta Launches Low Carbon Green Aluminium Products
summary: Vedanta launched Restora and Restora Ultra, low- and ultra-low-carbon aluminium lines produced with renewable power and recycled content. The company says products are independently verified and aim to meet growing global demand for lower-emissions aluminium, supporting its broader carbon-neutral target. The update is more commercial than supply-disruptive.

title: March 28th LME aluminum inventory decreased by 7075 tons Klang warehouse dropped the most_SMM
summary: SMM data show LME aluminum inventories fell on March 28, totaling a decline of 7,075 tons, with the Klang warehouse dropping the most. Reduced visible aluminum stocks in key LME locations can tighten near-term supply expectations and provide upward price support in the coming days.

title: Aluminium Inventory of SHFE and LME Fell While LME Aluminium Inventory Hit a New Low_SMM
summary: LME data show aluminium inventories fell again after a sharp jump, with latest levels reaching a new 15-year low. SHFE inventories also continued de-stocking, dropping for a second consecutive fortnight and falling to a more than one-month low. Lower stocks are generally supportive for aluminium futures.

title: China's Exports of Aluminium Ingots in the First Two Months of 2022 Mainly Came from Bonded Warehouses_SMM
summary: Customs data show China exported 30,700 mt of unwrought non-alloy aluminium in the first two months of 2022, with ordinary ingots (29,000 mt) largely shipped from bonded warehouses. With a 15% tentative export tax on ordinary ingots and an export window still constrained, analysts expect March exports to rise.

title: Copper slips after Shanghai lockdown; nickel slumps
summary: Copper gained modestly after prior losses despite concern that Shanghai’s COVID lockdown could curb China demand. Nickel fell sharply amid uncertainty around Tsingshan short positions and thin trading. A firmer dollar and recession fears also weighed, while aluminium rose slightly, indicating limited immediate pressure there.

title: Copper slips after Shanghai lockdown; nickel slumps
summary: Copper rebounded after two sessions of losses despite renewed worries that Shanghai’s planned COVID lockdown could curb China demand. Nickel fell sharply amid thin trade and uncertainty around Tsingshan’s major short position. Investors also cite recession risk from US yield curve inversion and a firmer dollar.

title: Rusal Can't Access Alumina From Australia JV as Pressure Builds
summary: The article headline says Rusal cannot access alumina sourced via an Australian joint venture, as pressure builds around the arrangement. If feedstock access is disrupted, it can tighten near-term alumina availability for refiners and increase aluminium production costs, supporting aluminium prices in the coming days.

title: UK, US aluminium and steel deal sees end of blue jeans duties
summary: The UK and US agreed to resolve the Section 232 tariff issue, with the US expanding removal of steel and aluminium tariffs and re-opening tariff-free access for UK aluminium exporters to the US effective 1 June 2022. The UK will also suspend retaliatory rebalancing measures on US goods, including blue jeans.

title: U.S.-U.K. Dispute Over Steel and Aluminum Tariffs Resolved | Faegre Drinker Biddle & Reath LLP
summary: The U.S. and U.K. agreed to end their Section 232 steel and aluminum tariff dispute. From June 1, 2022, the U.S. will apply tariff-rate quotas allowing U.K. duty-free exports of certain steel and aluminum, contingent on the U.K. suspending retaliatory tariffs on U.S. goods.

title: LME nickel price closes week at $35,000; aluminium, zinc up 6%
summary: LME three-month nickel ended the week at ~$35,491/t after hitting a wide range; the exchange also introduced order-limit compliance rules. Aluminium closed near $3,605/t, up 6% on the week, with very low LME stocks and trader concerns that high energy prices could force more smelters offline.

title: Australian alumina ban helps send key US aluminium premium back to peak
summary: Fastmarkets reports the US aluminium P1020A Midwest premium rose to 38–40 cents per lb after Australia announced it would stop selling alumina to Russia. The move is expected to constrain Rusal’s metal output, supporting higher LME aluminium prices and firmer scrap and producer offers.

title: LME nickel price closes week at $35,000; aluminium, zinc up 6%
summary: The LME reports nickel’s 3-month price closing near $35,500 after volatile limit moves, amid new rules restricting orders outside price limits. It also notes aluminium at ~$3,605 with +6% weekly gains, very low LME stocks, and concerns that high energy costs could push more smelters offline, tightening supply further.

title: The United States And The United Kingdom Agree To Cessation Of Section 232 Tariffs On Steel And Aluminum - International Law
summary: The U.S. and UK agreed to end U.S. Section 232 tariffs on UK steel and aluminum imports effective June 1, while the UK lifts retaliatory tariffs on $500m+ of U.S. exports. Commerce said duty-free aluminum imports will help narrow a supply-demand gap, supporting U.S. market conditions.

title: Atacama Copper Announces Initial Exploration Results at the ...
summary: Atacama Copper announced initial exploration results from its Placeton and Caballo Muerto projects in Chile, highlighting copper- and molybdenum-related geochemical anomalies, alteration zones, and IP/magnetics targeting two high-priority porphyry targets. The company plans an April IP survey and immediate drilling, but no production changes are discussed.

title: Anglo Looks to the Sea as Water Scarcity Hits Chile Copper Mines
summary: The article’s headline says water scarcity is hitting Chilean copper mines. Limited water availability can disrupt mining operations and reduce near-term mine output. That supply risk can worsen short-term copper market expectations, creating downward pressure on prices over the next days to a few weeks.

title: Britishvolt and Bakrie's VKTR team up for sustainable EV battery nickel
summary: Britishvolt and VKTR plan to form a joint venture in Indonesia to develop sustainable nickel refining capacity and provide nickel sulfate for EV battery production. The project targets secure nickel supply amid elevated raw-material prices and ongoing sanctions, reinforcing Indonesia’s expanding nickel processing and battery-chain investments.

title: Metals generally rebounded, Shanghai tin closed up 2%, Shanghai nickel decline narrowed to 5.57% [overnight market]_SMM
summary: An SMM overnight wrap reports rebounds in base metals. Shanghai copper rose 0.81%, Shanghai nickel declined but narrowed (down 5.57%), and Shanghai aluminium fell slightly (about -0.13%). LME showed only lun nickel down (over 9%) while LME copper rose modestly and aluminium was flat. No new metal-specific driver is detailed.

title: Britishvolt and Bakrie's VKTR team up for sustainable EV battery nickel | Kat Country 98.9
summary: Britishvolt and VKTR form a joint venture to develop sustainable nickel refining capacity in Indonesia and supply nickel sulphate for EV batteries, with potential battery plant plans. The move targets a secure nickel supply amid surging raw materials prices and Indonesia’s expanding role in laterite processing.

title: Britishvolt and Bakrie's VKTR team up for sustainable EV battery nickel | WKZO | Everything Kalamazoo
summary: Britishvolt and VKTR announced a joint venture to develop sustainable nickel refining capacity in Indonesia and supply nickel sulphate for high-performance EV batteries, potentially using renewable energy. With Indonesia a major nickel producer, the initiative and broader EV battery projects support expectations for nickel demand.

title: Copper up for 2nd session on bargain-buying, Shanghai nickel falls
summary: London copper edged higher for a second session, supported by bargain-buying, but China’s planned Shanghai lockdown and rising COVID cases weighed on demand expectations. In contrast, Shanghai nickel dropped more than 5%. Chile’s Codelco plans a “non-core” asset offering, a minor producer-development signal.

title: Copper up for 2nd session on bargain-buying, Shanghai nickel falls
summary: London copper edged higher for a second session, supported by bargain-buying, though COVID-19 spread in China’s key consumer regions and a two-stage Shanghai lockdown raised demand concerns. In contrast, Shanghai nickel dropped over 5%, reflecting stronger negative sentiment and likely weaker near-term outlook for industrial metals demand.

title: Overnight SHFE Nickel Corrected and Is Returning to the Fundamentals_SMM
summary: SMM says SHFE nickel has been correcting downward as longs cut exposure and futures pulled back. Pandemic-related delays and weak spot trading limit near-term demand, while nickel briquette and pure nickel transactions stay poor. NPI remains firm only due to high ore/smelting costs, but overall pure nickel demand is weak.

title: Nimy Resources uncovers nickel at surface during drill hole preparations at Mons
summary: Nimy Resources reports nickel-bearing gossan uncovered during drill-site preparations at its Mons nickel project in Western Australia. Portable XRF readings show up to 0.96% nickel, with additional anomalous copper and cobalt and proximity to older nickel intersections. Further geochemical sampling will test the near-surface extent.

title: Global Aluminum Inventories Continue to Fall, Aluminum Smelters' Profits Are at the Best Level in History_SMM
summary: SMM reports that global aluminium inventories are continuing to fall and that downstream demand recovery has pushed Chinese smelter profits to record highs. It also highlights COVID-driven production cuts and transport disruptions in multiple regions. LME and SHFE aluminium stocks fell week-on-week, suggesting tighter supply and bullish pricing pressure.

title: London copper eases on China demand worries, Shanghai nickel falls
summary: London copper eased as China’s widening COVID-19 outbreak and Shanghai’s planned lockdown heightened concerns over near-term industrial demand. The softer tone on growth weighed on metals sentiment. Shanghai nickel also fell nearly 5%, reflecting the broader downturn in China-linked consumption expectations.

title: Metal most floating red Shanghai nickel decline widened to 6.48% black series rally continued to narrow [SMM afternoon review]_SMM
summary: SMM reports a mixed midday session: Shanghai nickel fell sharply to expand its decline to 6.48%, while copper rose modestly (~0.64%) and aluminium ended slightly lower (~-0.15%) after an intraday rally. The piece links moves to a weaker oil complex, a slightly softer dollar, and concerns over China fuel demand.

title: London copper eases on China demand worries, Shanghai nickel falls
summary: London copper fell as COVID-19 infections and a planned two-stage Shanghai lockdown in top metals consumer China fueled concerns over near-term industrial demand. Shanghai nickel dropped about 4.7% on the same growth/demand outlook fears. Commentary pointed to potential impacts on Chinese industrial production.

title: NickelX gains shareholder approval to acquire Cosmos South project
summary: NickelX received shareholder approval to acquire the Cosmos South nickel project in Western Australia’s Wiluna belt. The company will exercise the option, proceed with formal agreements, and earn a 100% interest by funding at least $500,000 of exploration over 24 months. Preliminary work includes airborne magnetic surveys.

title: FLSmidth A/S: FLSmidth to deliver three SAG mills, three ball mills and cyclones to the Josemaria copper mine in Argentina
summary: FLSmidth was selected to deliver three SAG mills, three ball mills and cyclones to the Josemaria copper-gold mine in Argentina. The deal is worth about DKK110m booked in Q4 2021 and DKK490m in Q1 2022, with deliveries scheduled by late-2023, signaling progress toward copper production.

title: FLSmidth to deliver three SAG mills, three ball mills and cyclones to the Josemaria copper mine in Argentina
summary: FLSmidth was selected to supply gearless SAG mills, ball mills and cyclones for the Josemaria copper-gold project in Argentina. The order value was booked in parts during Q4 2021 and Q1 2022, with equipment deliveries scheduled for late 2023, supporting long-run copper mining operations.

title: Copperstone Resources submits an environmental permit application for the Viscaria mine
summary: Copperstone Resources filed an environmental permit application to reopen the Viscaria copper mine in Kiruna, Sweden, including extensive plans for water management, tailings recycling, and environmental safeguards. The company frames the filing as a milestone toward restarting copper production, prompting a supportive supply outlook for copper.

title: Copperstone Resources AB: Copperstone Resources submits an environmental permit application for the Viscaria mine
summary: Copperstone Resources submitted its environmental permit application to restart the Viscaria copper mine in Northern Sweden. The filing covers environmental impacts, water management, tailings recycling, and mitigation measures. Company statements frame this as a milestone toward recommencing copper production, supporting near-term expectations for copper supply.

title: Vietnam's nickel demand expected to increase | Business | Vietnam+ (VietnamPlus)
summary: Vietnam is expected to see rising demand for battery metals, with nickel benefiting from growing electric-vehicle uptake. The piece notes nickel’s current use in battery applications is set to increase and highlights Vietnam’s nickel resources and plans for additional mining and processing, including factories targeting nickel outputs.

title: LME to Raise Initial Margins of Copper and Aluminium Trading from March 31_SMM
summary: SMM reports the LME will increase initial margin requirements for copper from $638/mt to $650/mt and for aluminium from $262/mt to $280/mt, effective after the close of business on March 31, 2022. Higher margins can curb leverage and near-term speculative demand.

title: Alumina Prices Rose Slightly, and COVID-19 still Affected the Shipment of Goods _SMM
summary: SMM says COVID-19 continues to affect transport efficiency, but northwest aluminium smelters are more willing to restock. Demand ticked up, helping alumina plants and traders hold firm prices. Smelters are resuming production and southwest alumina demand is rising, though April new capacity may curb gains. Alumina prices rose slightly.

title: LME to Raise Initial Margins of Copper and Aluminium Trading from March 31_SMM
summary: SMM reports the LME will increase initial margins for copper to $650/mt from $638/mt and for aluminium to $280/mt from $262/mt, effective after the close of business on March 31, 2022. Higher margin requirements can reduce leverage and near-term trading appetite.

title: Copper Scrap Prices Increased along with the Rising Copper Futures Prices_SMM
summary: SMM reports Shandong bare bright copper scrap prices rose early in trading, tracking an increase in copper futures. Weak availability of raw materials reduced buyer bargaining power, but poor orders for secondary copper rod producers limited how sharply scrap could rise. The cathode-scrap spread is expected to remain stable next days.

title: Marimaca infill drilling extends copper oxide mineralisation at the MOD
summary: Marimaca Copper Corp. reported results from the first seven reverse circulation drill holes at its Marimaca Oxide Deposit in Chile. Six of seven holes intersected broad near-surface green copper oxide mineralisation, with several grades above the 2019 resource model and indications the deposit remains open at depth and to the southeast.

title: Marubeni: Japan's aluminum inventory increased by 0.8% month-on-month at the end of February_SMM
summary: Marubeni said aluminium stocks in Japan’s three main ports (Yokohama, Nagoya and Osaka) rose 0.8% month-on-month to 294,600 tons at end-February, up from 292,300 tons at end-January. The end-December level was 296,500 tons.

title: Antofagasta expects high copper prices for next 12 months, CEO says
summary: Antofagasta CEO Ivan Arriagada said copper fundamentals remain solid and prices should stay at recently high levels over the next 12 months, citing relative supply tightness and the role of copper in energy transition. The company targets steady output despite Los Pelambres drought, while continuing Twin Metals progress.

title: Sumitomo Metal sees global nickel demand for battery use at 410,000 in 2022
summary: Sumitomo Metal is reported to see global nickel demand for battery applications at 410,000 in 2022. The headline suggests improving demand expectations for battery-related nickel consumption, which can be supportive for nickel prices in the near term, though the excerpt lacks details on timing or supply response.

title: Inomin Mines Inc.: Inomin Makes New Critical Minerals Discovery at Beaver Hitting 252 Metres of 20.6% Magnesium, 0.16% Nickel, and 0.33% Chromium
summary: Inomin Mines reports significant drill results at its Beaver nickel-cobalt property: a 252m interval grading 20.6% magnesium with 0.16% nickel, plus near-surface silver and copper from another hole (0.29% copper over 3m). Discoveries remain open, supporting improved short-term sentiment for nickel and, to a lesser extent, copper supply potential.

title: China's GEM Sells 9% Stake in Indonesias Nickel Project to South Korea's EcoPro
summary: Chinese metals recycler GEM sold a 9% stake in its Indonesian battery-grade nickel processing JV to South Korea’s EcoPro BM and agreed funding to support construction. EcoPro will supply loans to the project, which targets 150,000 tons/year nickel sulfate and supplies high-nickel ternary precursors, supporting expected nickel demand.

title: Accumulated Social Inventory of Aluminium Slightly Suppressed SHFE Aluminium Prices_SMM
summary: SHFE aluminium prices slipped early, with weak recent futures performance attributed to slower unloading of domestic ingots and rising downstream demand worries. China’s aluminium social inventory rose to 1.052 mln mt. Despite rapid supply recovery, downstream consumption stayed soft under high prices and pandemic effects, keeping aluminium prices pressured.

title: SMM Insight into Short-term Aluminium Price Outlook amid Tight Supply and COVID-Induced Downstream Output Cuts _SMM
summary: SMM says the mid-March upward cycle in SHFE aluminium has ended and prices are correcting. Tight global supply and record-low LME inventories support levels, while pandemic disruptions reduce downstream production, slowing ingot/billet shipments and adding bearish pressure. Domestic smelter profits remain strong; inventories are still only slightly higher.

title: SMM Comments: SHFE Nickel Moved Downwards Affected by LME Market_SMM
summary: SMM says SHFE nickel (2204) fell on March 29, with weak trading, lower volume and open interest, and reduced long positions. It attributes pressure to pandemic-related transport and subdued spot demand, weak downstream demand (briquette/dissolution, April sulphate output), and less active stainless steel operations, while watching LME nickel and macro/geopolitics.

title: Mitsubishi Expands Copper Trading Business as Peru Mine Ramps Up
summary: Mitsubishi is reported to be expanding its copper trading business as a Peru mine ramps up production. The development points to changes in near-term copper availability and trading activity, which can influence short-term market expectations for supply and pricing.

title: Chinese mining interests in South Africa hangs in balance as nickel giant faces huge loss
summary: The piece argues Russia’s war on Ukraine is adding turmoil to nickel markets and notes Chinese nickel producer Tsingshan Holding Group faces multi-billion-dollar losses. It raises uncertainty around Tsingshan’s nickel mining interests in South Africa, which could affect short-term nickel supply expectations and price direction.

title: China eases US concern by hunting details of Russia sanctions
summary: Chinese firms and officials seek granular guidance to comply with US/EU sanctions on Russia, easing some Washington concerns. It also reports traders shipping 27,216 tonnes of alumina to Moscow-based Rusal, indicating continued procurement of aluminium feedstock despite sanctions pressures.

title: Los Andes Copper Ltd.: Los Andes Copper Corporate Update
summary: Los Andes Copper provides a corporate update on its Vizcachitas Chile copper-molybdenum project, reporting initial diamond drilling results (0.50% copper equivalent) and additional holes awaiting assays. The company plans to seek lifting of an injunction to resume drilling and update its resource and preliminary feasibility study.

title: Kaiser Aluminum to break ground on $150M addition
summary: Kaiser Aluminum will break ground on a $150 million expansion at its Newburgh, Indiana plant, adding a 100,000-square-foot production bay and a new 665-foot coating line. The operation produces about 310,000 metric tons of flat-rolled aluminum annually and serves food and beverage packaging.

title: Culpeo Minerals hits copper sulphides in first drillhole at Lana Corina
summary: Culpeo Minerals says its first drillhole at the Lana Corina project in Chile intersected visible copper sulphide mineralisation, with chalcopyrite increasing with depth and referencing strong historical copper intervals. The company plans further drilling and will report assays later. It remains exploration without immediate supply impact.

title: tsingshan: How the nickel turmoil exposed the London Metal Exchange and Chinese giant Tsingshan
summary: The piece examines how nickel turmoil, which included a surge after the Russia-Ukraine conflict, exposed perceived weaknesses in the London Metal Exchange and highlighted risk-control needs for Tsingshan and its banks. It also spotlights Tsingshan’s controlling owner Xiang Guangda amid scrutiny of the episode’s drivers.

title: The trend of internal and external market diverges Shanghai Aluminum down more than 1% and the black line weakens [SMM market tracking]_SMM
summary: SMM market tracking reports broad weakness in China’s non-ferrous complex early March 30: Shanghai nickel fell 2.75% and Shanghai aluminum dropped 1.5% (inner market), while Shanghai copper declined slightly. Overseas trade improves marginally for some contracts, but epidemic/logistics frictions and shifting macro sentiment keep pressure on metals near term.

title: Overnight SHFE Aluminium Dropped amid Easing Russia-Ukraine Tensions_SMM
summary: Overnight SHFE and LME aluminium fell sharply after opening higher, with LME down 4.33% on the day. Easing Russia-Ukraine tensions and macro guidance were bearish. Fundamentals were mixed: new capacity ramped up, transport remained restricted, while LME stocks declined 7,800 mt. Overall sentiment turned bearish for aluminium.

title: CSPT Sets Spot Copper Concentrate TCs at $80/mt for Q2 2022_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that China Smelters Purchase Team (CSPT) finalized a guide spot treatment charge (TC) for copper concentrate of $80/mt for Q2 2022. The adjustment affects smelter procurement economics for concentrates, but the article does not indicate a major change in broader copper supply or demand conditions.

title: LME to hold independent review into nickel crisis
summary: The LME said it will run an independent review into the nickel trading chaos earlier this month after prices surged more than 50% to about $100,000/tonne and the exchange suspended nickel trading. Trading resumed with new daily price limits and OTC position reporting requirements.

title: Overnight SHFE Nickel Dropped on Expectations of Shrinking Demand_SMM
summary: SHFE nickel fell overnight as market participants withdrew capital and adjusted for weaker near-term demand. Downstream buyers stayed cautious amid sharp nickel price swings, import losses tightened briquette supply, and Wuxi stainless procurement was disrupted by pandemic closures. Nickel sulphate output signals also weakened. Nickel volatility and muted transactions persisted.

title: Country's First Aluminium-body Metro Train Flagged Off for Pune Metro Project
summary: MoHUA officials flagged off India’s first aluminium-body metro train for Maha Metro’s Pune project. The coaches use lighter aluminium car bodies (about 6.5% lighter than stainless steel), with 34 trains and 102 coaches planned. Speakers cite energy efficiency, longer life, and Make-in-India/Atma Nirbhar goals.

title: Rusal: earnings increase by 40% in 2021 Aluminum production is basically flat. Sanctions against Russia will have a negative impact._SMM
summary: Rusal said 2021 earnings rose due to higher LME aluminium prices, but new sanctions on Russia and tighter trade (including an Australian real-time export ban on alumina/alumina ores to Russia) may disrupt operations. Rusal also temporarily closed its Nikolaev alumina refinery, raising supply-risk for aluminium/alumina.

title: Hot copper: what's driving the latest charge?
summary: Copper is moving higher on multiple near-term bullish signals: a continuing supply deficit, stronger Chinese demand, and sliding LME/terminal inventories. The piece also flags Chile-related production cost and investment uncertainty plus sanctions-linked Russian supply risk. Recent copper discoveries lifted exploration stocks, reinforcing momentum.

title: Global Battery Sector's Demand for Nickel Likely to Reach 410,000 mt in 2022_SMM
summary: Sumitomo Metal Mining said global nickel demand for rechargeable battery use will rise over 20% in 2022 to above 410,000 mt, driven by firm EV growth. It also expects the nickel supply shortfall to narrow, as Indonesia’s nickel pig iron output increases. Overall the demand outlook is supportive for nickel.

title: Indonesia's claim that banning nickel exports spurs downstreaming is questionable
summary: The article challenges Indonesia’s claim that its raw nickel export ban boosts downstreaming. It argues the policy has reduced mining revenues via forced domestic selling at lower prices, distorts smelter economics through tax holidays, and risks trade retaliation after an EU WTO case. It concludes the evidence is weak.

title: LME aluminium rebounds as Russia-Ukraine optimism fades
summary: LME aluminium rebounded after a near 5% prior-session drop as optimism around Russia-Ukraine talks faded, reducing a supply-related risk premium. A softer U.S. dollar supported metals, but China demand worries from a COVID surge capped gains. Russia sanctions remain a key supply overhang for aluminium, nickel and copper.

title: The epidemic continues to be seriously affected by ferronickel plants in many areas in the north [SMM concern]_SMM

summary: Great Atlantic Resources began 2022 prospecting and rock geochemical sampling at its Mascarene Property, targeting the Wheal Louisiana copper–nickel–cobalt occurrence. Historic and limited sampling reported anomalous copper and cobalt, with chalcopyrite-bearing veins intersected in recent drilling. Results will be assayed, but no production or supply changes are indicated.

title: LME faces U.K. regulatory review over nickel market turmoil
summary: The piece flags that the LME faces a U.K. regulatory review amid “nickel market turmoil.” Such oversight can affect market structure, hedging, and investor confidence in nickel contracts. However, the excerpt provides no concrete policy changes or operational disruptions to quantify a clear bullish or bearish price effect.

title: Comet to buy Glencore's Mt Margaret copper project in Australia
summary: Comet Resources agreed to buy Glencore’s Mt Margaret copper project in Queensland, issuing shares to Glencore’s affiliate and arranging payments through a third party. Mt Margaret is described as a past-producing, partially pre-stripped open-pit asset with sizeable copper resources. The deal supports copper sentiment but won’t alter supply immediately.

title: City watchdog to probe London Metal Exchange over nickel trading chaos
summary: UK regulators (Bank of England and FCA) are investigating the LME over nickel trading chaos that halted a market for a week after nickel surged ~250% in two days to over $100,000/t, then retraced sharply. Probes include LME Clear, transparency, and potential trading limits/fines.

title: Union Workers ratify five-year contract with Kennecott Utah Copper
summary: United Steelworkers ratified a five-year labor agreement with Kennecott Utah Copper covering 1,300 hourly mine workers. The contract includes lump-sum payments, yearly wage increases, and maintained/improved health and life insurance benefits, with many terms effective immediately. The deal follows rejection of an earlier offer in 2022.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel Announces Closing Previously Announced Acquisition of Extensive Land Package Near Langmuir
summary: EV Nickel Inc. closed its acquisition of land and mineral claims in Ontario’s Shaw Dome area, including royalty agreements and plans for reprocessing geophysical data and drilling later this year. The company is positioned as a nickel exploration firm targeting Class 1 nickel for EV batteries, but no production changes are announced.

title: Pan Global Resources Inc.: Pan Global Drills 6.7m at 3.1% Copper and 17.5g/t Silver at La Romana, Escacena Project, Southern Spain
summary: Pan Global Resources reported additional drill intersections at its La Romana discovery in southern Spain, including 6.7m at 3.1% copper and other copper-rich intervals, and plans to add 20 more holes. The update is exploration-focused with no immediate production impacts, limiting short-term price pressure for copper.

title: FLSmidth A/S: FLSmidth to supply ball mills, SAG mills and thickener solutions to Southeast Asian copper-gold mine
summary: FLSmidth will supply SAG mills, ball mills and thickener solutions for a large copper-gold mine in Southeast Asia. The project aims to increase processing capacity at the existing operation. The contract is valued at about DKK 360 million and booked in Q1 2022, supporting copper production expectations.

title: Copper production in Chile fell sharply in February_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Cochilco said Chilean copper production dropped 7.5% in February. While Codelco rose slightly year-on-year, output fell at key private/joint-venture mines: Escondida down 14.3% and Collahuasi down 11.2%. The broader decline signals weaker near-term copper supply.

title: The second largest copper producer in the world enters a state of emergency and the price of Lun copper is close to an all-time high again._SMM
summary: Peru declared a state of emergency and imposed curfews amid transport strikes and violence tied to high oil, tolls, and basic-material prices. As the world’s second-largest copper producer, unrest and inflation risk disruptions and tighter supply expectations, while government considers possible excess-profit mining taxes.

title: US Copper Corp. Benefits from Biden's Defense Act Order on Critical Minerals
summary: US Copper Corp. says Biden’s Defense Act memorandum expanding domestic production of critical minerals could help advance its Moonlight-Superior Project in California toward restart. The order allocates resources and funding to mining feasibility studies for minerals needed in the clean-energy transition, which the company says requires more copper production.

title: Peru enters a state of emergency Renton copper is once again approaching an all-time high._SMM
summary: Peru declared a state of emergency and imposed curfews amid transport strikes and unrest tied to high fuel, tolls and food prices. The piece highlights Peru’s role as the world’s second-largest copper producer and says the government is evaluating excess-profit mining taxes, raising near-term supply-risk fears and supporting copper prices.

title: LME copper firms on Chile supply concerns; strong dollar caps gain
summary: London copper rose for a second session as traders worried about supply from Chile after February output fell 7.5%. Gains were tempered by a firmer U.S. dollar and lingering concerns over Chinese demand, with China holiday/lockdown measures affecting sentiment. LME also plans an independent review into last month’s nickel chaos.

title: CME Group To Launch Micro Copper Futures On May 2
summary: CME Group plans to launch micro copper futures on May 2. The new contract could improve price discovery and hedging/liquidity for copper exposure, potentially influencing trading interest. The announcement does not reference any immediate shift in copper fundamentals like supply, demand, or inventories, so price impact is likely modest.

title: Copper touches four-week peak on supply concerns
summary: Copper reached a four-week high as supply risks grew. Chilean output fell 7.5% in February, and pressure for further sanctions on Russia raised concerns about copper supply. The rise in Chinese smelter TC/RCs also suggested supply conditions remained tight enough to support higher prices.

title: Zijin Mining, China Minmetals and BHP Complete Copper Concen...
summary: Zijin Mining, China Minmetals, and BHP completed a two-step copper concentrate trade via MineHub’s blockchain platform, with assay exchange and greenhouse-gas data shared through the transaction chain. The release highlights process innovation and adoption in concentrates trading, with no stated change to supply volumes or pricing terms.

title: Canada Nickel reports highest test grade extracted from Timmins site
summary: Canada Nickel says infill drilling at its Crawford nickel sulphide project in Timmins yielded the highest-grade interval to date, with results including core lengths of 0.71% nickel and sections above 1.0% nickel. The firm positions the project for a feasibility study to advance future nickel supply.

title: Western Mines Group to drill bedrock conductors at Mulga Tank nickel-copper-PGE project
summary: Western Mines Group will drill nine bedrock conductor targets at its Mulga Tank nickel-copper-PGE project in Western Australia following an MLEM geophysical survey. The program targets potential nickel sulphide intersections (and associated copper/PGEs) to verify models, with mobilization planned next week.

title: Domestic continuous depots to temporarily support copper prices [institutional review]_SMM
summary: The piece links temporary domestic support measures to copper price expectations, citing falling domestic warehouse receipt inventories but rising LME copper stocks and widening spot discounts.
