summary: SMM said Chinese nickel ore port inventories rose 375,000 wmt WoW to 5.585 million wmt as of July 22, with Ni content at 43,900 wmt. Shipments are subdued in peak season due to weaker ore/NPI profits and lowered buying intentions, but inventories are still building.

title: Bonded Zone Inventory of Nickel Decreased this Week as the Price Ratio Improved_SMM
summary: SMM reports bonded-zone nickel inventory fell to about 6,500 mt this week, down 1,300 mt WoW, with declines in nickel briquette and nickel plate. The drop is linked to lower nickel futures, improved domestic alloy demand for overseas pure nickel, and a recovered SHFE/LME nickel price ratio.

title: Europe's Energy Crisis Risks Slashing Aluminum Production
summary: Europe’s energy crisis is reported to risk slashing aluminum production. With electricity and power-intensive smelting facing higher costs or instability, aluminum output could be curtailed, affecting near-term supply expectations. The headline implies bearish pressure for aluminum markets as production risk rises.

title: Japanese company, Nippon Denkai, shifts location for $150 million copper foil plant from SC to Georgia
summary: Nippon Denkai will build a $150 million copper foil plant in Augusta, Georgia instead of South Carolina, targeting EV battery supply. It expects to scale output from 9,500 metric tons to 28,500 metric tons and invest up to $430 million. Officials also highlighted electricity-cost advantages and incentives.

title: Pending copper shortfall threatens energy transition, greenhouse gas reduction goals: S&P Global
summary: S&P Global says energy-transition demand for copper from EVs, solar/wind and power-grid equipment will rise sharply and likely outstrip supply even with record mining and recycling. Regulatory, permitting and long mine-development timelines dampen new supply growth. The report warns net-zero goals may be threatened, implying tighter copper outlook.

title: Falling Copper Prices Weigh On Freeport Mcmoran's Earnings, ...
summary: The article reports that Freeport McMoRan’s earnings were pressured by falling copper prices. It cites a lower average realized copper price, and attributes declines to a stronger dollar and weaker demand signals from China. Inventories are said to be low, but near-term sentiment remains cautious.

title: Scrap iron association moves to prevent copper cable theft from next week
summary: Trinidad and Tobago’s scrap dealers’ association will tighten controls next week to stop theft of TSTT copper cables. It follows a government sub-committee review and the attorney general’s push to shut the scrap industry if theft continues. The association also recommends a three-month halt on copper exports and enhanced customs/police checks.

title: Alumina Prices in North China Rose Mildly on Cost Support _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM said North China alumina prices rose mildly as cost support remained and loss-making refineries reduced spot supply, focusing on long-term orders. Overseas alumina prices slipped slightly, narrowing the domestic-FOB spread, while exports helped ease surplus concerns. Overall, prices are expected to stabilise short term.

title: SHFE Aluminium to Remain under Pressure in the Medium and Long Run _SMM
summary: SMM reports SHFE 2208 aluminium has rebounded on the week after bottoming, while LME aluminium is also higher. Fundamentals cite mixed demand and rising domestic supply/normal smelting, with low inventories supporting prices. ECB rate hikes and weak European PMIs weigh on commodities, leading to a sideways-to-down weekly outlook.

title: Aluminium Smelters still Suffered Losses on Average _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports aluminium smelter costs were mostly stable but remained high versus last year. Real-time smelting costs increased to 18,025 yuan/mt, while losses narrowed to 35 yuan/mt after spot aluminium rebounded to 17,990 yuan/mt. However, aluminium prices remain under pressure and profitability is unlikely to improve soon.

title: Nickel Prices Rose and the Spot Transactions were Poor_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports nickel prices fell on hotter-than-expected US June inflation, raising fears of a 100 bps Fed hike, then rebounded as officials signaled a possible 75 bps hike. Spot premiums and SHFE/LME ratio improved, aiding overseas clearance optimism. Demand remained mixed, leaving spot transactions poor last week.

title: Chalco Acquires 19% Stake in Yunnan Aluminium for 6.6 Billion Yuan_SMM
summary: Chalco plans to acquire a 19% stake in Yunnan Aluminium for 6.66 billion yuan, taking its ownership to 29.10% after completion. The deal (at a 5.5% premium) aims to resolve horizontal competition, improve synergies, and expand “green aluminium” output capacity, benefiting stakeholder profitability and sentiment for aluminium.

title: Aluminium Ingot Inventory Began to Accumulate Slightly _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM said China’s eight major markets’ aluminium ingot social inventories rose to 671,000 mt on July 25, up 3,000 mt from last Thursday, while spot trade eased after prices rebounded. Shipments from key warehouses fell, but arrivals into Wuxi are expected to increase, keeping inventory growth risk elevated.

title: SMM Analysis: Aluminium Prices Fluctuated Upwards and Weekly Shipments of Aluminium Scrap in Linyi, Shandong Jumped 2,000 mt_SMM
summary: SMM reports Linyi aluminium scrap shipments rose to about 7,800 mt in July 18–24, up 2,000 mt week-on-week, alongside a weekly rise in aluminium prices to 17,990 yuan/mt. Improved purchasing demand ahead of peak season and slightly eased supply pressure supported prices, though bearish sentiment could return if prices fall.

title: Pure Nickel Spot Trading was Slack, and the Premiums Fell Slightly_SMM
summary: SMM reports on July 25 that Jinchuan nickel spot premiums fell to 13,500–14,200 yuan/mt as some pure nickel spot supply arrived. NORNICKEL premiums also declined. Nickel briquette trading was slack because futures rose, lowering briquette cost efficiency, and alloy demand remains tied to nickel plate.

title: Chile's largest copper producer will construct a one billion dollars desalinization plant
summary: Codelco, the world’s largest copper producer, will start constructing a US$1 billion desalination plant this year in northern Chile to address a decade-long drought. The project aims to cut fresh-water use by 60% via desalinated seawater and tailings reuse, supporting stable operations around Tocopilla.

title: CME Group Announces Record Copper Options Open Interest
summary: CME Group announced record open interest in copper options. The update signals rising participation in copper derivatives markets, which can increase hedging and speculative positioning. However, without information on option skew, strikes, or implied price moves, it is not a clear bullish or bearish price catalyst.

title: Copper Mountain Mining Announces Q2 2022 Financial Results
summary: Copper Mountain Mining reported Q2 2022 results, with copper output falling to 13.3 million lb due to lower ore grade, throughput limits, crusher issues, and staffing/supply chain disruptions. The company expects higher grades and recovery in H2 after Phase 4 ore release and plant optimization, while discussing higher Q2 costs.

title: MMG suspends copper output guidance after Las Bambas protests in Peru
summary: MMG said it suspended its full-year copper output targets for Peru’s Las Bambas after protests disrupted operations and cut production by about 60% in the second quarter. The mine is currently operating at full capacity, but no new guidance was issued and tensions remain as community truce talks expire.

title: Kaiser Aluminum Corporation Q2 Earnings Summary
summary: Kaiser Aluminum reported a smaller Q2 loss than the prior year, with improved EPS and adjusted earnings, alongside higher quarterly revenue. Analysts’ revenue expectations were also exceeded. As an aluminium producer, the results may signal firmer near-term operating conditions and support aluminium price sentiment over the coming weeks.

title: SMM Analysis: Aluminium Prices Fell back amid Poor Fundamentals _SMM
summary: SMM reports aluminium prices stabilizing after a July 14 low but still drifting sideways amid Fed-meeting caution. SHFE aluminium is down 0.64% and spot A00 ingot prices have eased. Inventories in major Chinese markets rose modestly while downstream demand stayed sluggish, keeping aluminium under pressure.

title: NGOs urge Musk not to invest in Indonesia's nickel industry over environmental worries
summary: NGOs sent an open letter urging Elon Musk not to invest in Indonesia’s nickel sector due to environmental concerns about mining waste and pollution. The note follows Musk’s meetings with President Jokowi and highlights Indonesia’s export ban on unprocessed nickel ore. Tesla’s response was not provided.

title: Copper Price Forecast: US Dollar, FOMC, Miners To Dictate Re...
summary: The piece forecasts copper near-term moves as largely driven by the US dollar and this week’s FOMC. It warns that hawkish Fed signals or weak GDP could strengthen the USD and weigh on prices. It also cites weak sentiment on China demand and a bear-flag technical setup that risks further downside.

title: ICSG: Global Refined Copper Market Saw Oversupply of 5,000 mt in May 2022_SMM
summary: ICSG’s monthly report shows the global refined copper market was oversupplied by 5,000 mt in May 2022, following a revised April deficit back toward oversupply. Production in May was 2.189 million mt versus 2.184 million mt consumption, with a 43,000 mt surplus over the first five months.

title: Copper rises on supply risks and softening dollar
summary: Copper prices rose as supply risks from major producers outweighed demand worries. MMG suspended copper production targets after a 60% output drop at Peru’s Las Bambas mine, while Vale and Antofagasta cut 2022 outlooks. A softer U.S. dollar also boosted prices. Nickel advanced alongside copper.

title: Premiums of Spot Prices Further Declined due to High Pure Nickel Futures Prices_SMM
summary: SMM reports that spot nickel premiums fell further on July 26 as nickel futures remained high. Jinchuan nickel was priced lower and NORNICKEL premiums narrowed, reducing transaction volumes. Nickel briquette prices rose modestly, but trading was weak because briquette economics were worse than nickel plates, the preferred alloy feedstock.

title: NGOs ask Musk to not invest in Indonesia's nickel industry over environmental worries
summary: NGOs sent an open letter to Elon Musk urging Tesla not to invest in Indonesia’s nickel industry, citing environmental damage from mining waste and deforestation. The proposal follows President Jokowi’s meeting with Musk about potential investment. Environmental criticism and potential investor pullback add downside risk to Indonesian nickel supply expectations.

title: Marvel Discovery Corp.: Marvel Mobilizes Crews to Duhamel, Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Property, Lac St. Jean, QC
summary: Marvel Discovery says it has mobilized field crews to the Duhamel Ni-Cu-Co (and Ti-V-Cr) property in Quebec to confirm historical drill holes and conduct prospecting and surveying for new nickel-copper sulphide targets. The update is exploration-focused with no indicated production or supply changes, limiting near-term price impact.

title: Environmental Groups Ask Tesla to Stop Nickel Plans in Indonesia
summary: Environmental groups are asking Tesla to halt its nickel plans in Indonesia. The request raises the risk of project delays or cancellation, which could undermine short-term assumptions about nickel supply, increasing perceived availability tightness and likely weighing on nickel prices in the coming days.

title: Throughput in East China Nonferrous Metals Market Dropped Sharply amid Falling Copper Prices_SMM
summary: SMM data show East China copper scrap throughput fell to 84,600 mt from July 18-24, down 25.61% WoW. The week’s average prices for #1 copper cathode and bare bright copper declined. Falling copper prices and price volatility reduced cargo sales and weakened scrap demand, though SMM expects some pickup.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel Initiates Surface Water Baseline Monitoring Study on Shaw Dome Nickel Project's Langmuir W4 Zone
summary: EV Nickel commissioned Blue Heron Environmental to conduct quarterly surface water baseline monitoring around the Shaw Dome Langmuir W4 Zone to support hydrology/water quality documentation for permitting. The work is scheduled to start immediately and helps advance the project, but it does not indicate near-term nickel production changes.

title: Gungnir Resources Inc.: Gungnir Drills New Ultramafic Horizon, 150 Metres North of Lappvattnet Nickel Deposit, Sweden
summary: Gungnir Resources reported intercepting new ultramafic jack-straw peridotite about 150 metres north of the Lappvattnet nickel deposit in two 2022 drill holes, with minor sulphides and assays pending. The company plans further extensions and additional drilling nearby to test EM anomalies. No price-driving assay or production updates were provided.

title: Gungnir Drills New Ultramafic Horizon, 150 Metres North of Lappvattnet Nickel Deposit, Sweden
summary: Gungnir Resources announced drilling that intersected a new ultramafic (jack-straw peridotite) horizon about 150 metres north of the Lappvattnet nickel deposit in two holes, with assays pending and additional holes planned. The update reinforces exploration potential for nickel mineralization, but near-term supply impacts appear limited.

title: Déjà-vu for copper as the prospect of cuts returns | Hotter on metals
summary: Freeport-McMoRan said the sharp copper price fall stems from economic uncertainty and higher rates, and could prompt adjustments to operating plans. The article compares today to 2015, noting potential production curtailments and lower LME inventories. It adds that escalating power and diesel costs have pressured aluminium output and costs.

title: The Northern Miner Podcast – episode 301: 'Demand continues to grow'—Alcoa buys back stock; aluminum to remain in deficit; smelters struggle for profitablility
summary: The Northern Miner podcast reviews Alcoa’s Q2 earnings call, highlighting rising energy costs, a strong U.S. dollar, and ongoing struggles for smelter profitability. It also notes that aluminum is expected to remain in deficit and demand continues to grow, which tends to underpin near-term price expectations for aluminum.

title: Aluminum Prices Plummet Despite Ongoing Supply Disruptions
summary: The piece reports aluminum prices have fallen despite supply disruptions. It attributes European smelter and refinery closures to surging power and natural gas costs, which are expected to stay high through 2024. Yet recession fears and potential gas rationing imply demand destruction, outweighing supply tightness and pressuring prices lower globally.

title: SMM Review of Copper Rod Industry Dynamics and the Current Consumption Market_SMM
summary: SMM reviews China’s copper rod industry, noting oversupply, low capacity utilization, and demand weakness from wire/cable and enamelled wire amid pandemic disruptions. It discusses rising secondary (scrap-based) rod capacity, competitive pricing, and the role of lower copper prices in operating-rate rebounds. Grid and new-energy orders may support recovery later.

title: LME Nickel Inventories Kept Falling, SHFE Nickel Inventories Refreshed Record Low_SMM
summary: LME nickel stocks have been trending down since late April, with inventories falling further and reaching 60,168 mt as of July 25, near multi-year lows. SHFE nickel inventories also fell for six straight weeks, down 18.24% week-on-week to 1,493 mt as of July 22, a record low.

title: An Indonesian Government Official Says Indonesia Needs to Restrict Export of Nickel Derivatives with Nickel Content below 70%_SMM
summary: Indonesia’s official Eddy Soeparno said the country should restrict exports of BOP and FeNi nickel derivatives with nickel content below 70% to boost domestic downstream processing. The proposal follows Indonesia’s large nickel ore position and active RKEF smelters exporting NPI/FeNi/nickel matte, implying tighter export supply could lift nickel sentiment.

title: Spot Premiums of Refined Nickel Declined at the End of July_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that refined nickel spot premiums fell by late July: Jinchuan premiums averaged 8,750 yuan/mt (-2,750 yuan/mt) and Russian nickel averaged 7,750 yuan/mt (-2,500 yuan/mt). Nickel briquette prices also declined as traders reduced premiums for delivery and nickel futures weakened.

title: Aluminium Scrap Imports Rose Palpably in June amid Supply Tightness in China_SMM
summary: SMM says customs inspection of imported aluminium scrap was relaxed in late June, lifting June imports to 124,600 mt (+220% y/y, +24% m/m) as order backlogs cleared and domestic scrap supply stayed tight. It expects imports to stay stable in July-August, easing supply pressure.

title: SHFE Nickel Once Fell 2.6% after Seven Consecutive Days of Increase, and Spot Trades were Muted_SMM
summary: After seven days of gains, SHFE nickel fell sharply (intra-day down 2.59%, closing down 1.24%), while LME nickel also dropped. Spot refined nickel prices declined markedly and premiums narrowed as sellers lowered offers. Supply rose, downstream demand stayed soft, and weak macro sentiment ahead of the Fed meeting weighed on nickel.

title: Fabled Copper Corp.: Fabled Surface Chip Sampling on Bronson Property Continues to Report Copper Values as High as 5.22% Copper
summary: Fabled Copper Corp. provided additional 2021 surface sampling results from its Muskwa Project in northern British Columbia, including chip and float samples with reported copper grades up to 5.22% Cu. The update is exploratory geology-focused with no immediate implications for supply, exports, or inventories.

title: Analysis: Peru's mining execs 'lose faith' in gov't despite moderate shift
summary: Peruvian mining executives say they are losing faith in President Castillo’s ability to support the sector despite his tax proposals shifting. Reuters cites social protests that caused month-long production halts at two major copper mines and delayed a pipeline of new copper projects worth $53 billion, amid high copper prices.

title: Peru's mining execs 'lose faith' in gov't despite moderate shift
summary: Peruvian mining executives say President Castillo’s moderation hasn’t stopped community protests that have triggered month-long production halts at major copper mines and delayed a large $53 billion project pipeline. While copper prices have fallen but remain high, firms warn instability and permit delays could reduce future supply and investment.

title: Metallic Minerals Corp.: Metallic Minerals Announces Start of Drilling at La Plata Silver-Gold-Copper Project in Southwest Colorado, USA, and Extends Warrant Expiry
summary: Metallic Minerals says it has started its 2022 drilling campaign at the La Plata silver-gold-copper project in Colorado, aiming to extend the Allard deposit and refine copper-silver-gold targets that could lead to an expanded 2023 resource estimate. The company also extends warrant expiry; no production changes are mentioned.

title: Eagle Plains Resources Ltd.: Eagle Plains' Partner Rockridge Commences Drill Program at the High-Grade Knife Lake Copper Project, Saskatchewan
summary: Eagle Plains announced that partner Rockridge has started a ~1,000m summer diamond drilling program at the high-grade Knife Lake copper VMS project in Saskatchewan. The program targets regional zones and infill/expansion around the deposit. Rockridge is fully funded and permitted, with drilling planned through about six to eight holes.

title: Aztec Minerals Corp.: Aztec Commences 10-hole, 3000 meter Core Drill Program at its Cervantes Gold-Copper Project, Sonora, Mexico
summary: Aztec Minerals began a 10-hole, 3,000m core drilling program at its Cervantes gold-copper project in Sonora, Mexico to expand and test oxide cap and deeper copper-gold targets. While it highlights copper-bearing intercepts, it does not change near-term production, so price impact is likely limited.

title: Analysis: Peru's Mining Execs 'Lose Faith' In Gov't Despite Moderate Shift
summary: Peruvian mining executives told Reuters they have lost faith in the government, citing social protests that caused month-long halts at the Cuajone and Las Bambas copper mines and slowed project pipelines. Several expansions are waiting approvals, keeping near-term copper supply and investment sentiment under pressure despite high prices.

title: Nickel market: Automakers and OEMs face scrutiny of ESG credentials | Hotter on metals
summary: Automakers’ ESG scrutiny is increasing for nickel used in EV batteries, with NGOs urging Tesla to halt Indonesian nickel and questioning Russia-linked nickel after Ukraine’s invasion. The piece notes prior ESG controversies in key supply regions and suggests procurement may shift, potentially tightening usable nickel supply for near-term markets.

title: Recession Fears Drive Down Copper Price Despite Demand Overwhelming Supply
summary: Copper prices fell sharply as recession fears dominated markets despite tight inventories and studies projecting long-term demand growth. The article cites IMF downgrades and weaker trade signals, with commentary that “Dr. Copper” reflects economic slowdown expectations. Overall, near-term sentiment is bearish and selling pressure is driving losses.

title: Tiwai Point aluminium smelter begins talks to continue operating after 2024
summary: Tiwai Point, New Zealand’s largest aluminium smelter, has begun negotiations with power companies to secure a new electricity contract beyond 2024. Because a closure would remove aluminium demand and hurt power-company investment plans, the start of talks supports expectations of continued output, modestly bullish for aluminium.

title: SMM Weekly Review of Aluminium Ingot and Billet Inventory_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM said Shanghai aluminium ingot social inventory was 671,000 mt, up on the week, while billet inventory rose to 107,600 mt. Some regions saw increases due to intensive cargo arrivals and sluggish downstream demand. Spot transactions were weak, and inventories are unlikely to fall near term.

title: Yangshan Copper Premium Remained Rangebound at High Levels and Spot Profits Narrowed_SMM
summary: Yangshan copper premiums under warrants stayed rangebound at high levels ($81-97/mt), with average prices flat. Weaker market activity led to softer domestic spot premiums and nearly 200 yuan/mt decline in spot import profits. Transactions stalled amid limited trader offers and scarce inquiries. Pyro-copper and hydro-copper premiums were steady.

title: NORILSK NICKEL ANNOUNCES CONSOLIDATED PRODUCTION RESULTS FOR 1H 2022
summary: Norilsk Nickel reported 1H 2022 output: nickel nearly 100 kt (+26% y/y) but down 6% q/q to 48 kt due to Harjavalta scheduled repairs, while copper rose to 204 kt (+18% y/y) and to 113 kt in Q2 (+23% q/q) due to planned furnace maintenance. Guidance from Russian feed reiterated.

title: DLP Resources Announces Commencement of Drilling at Hungry Creek, Copper-Cobalt Project, Private Placement of Flow-Through Shares & Grant of Stock Options
summary: DLP Resources says it has started an 1,800m drill program at its Hungry Creek copper-cobalt project, targeting the 711 copper zone after encouraging prior copper grab/float samples. The company also plans a flow-through private placement to fund drilling. The news is sentiment-positive but lacks production or supply impact.

title: Ascendant Resources Reports 12 Metres at 3.3% Copper (5.5%
summary: Ascendant Resources reports drill hole ST_31 results at the Lagoa Salgada Venda Nova VMS project, including 12m at 3.3% copper and a newly outlined high-grade copper-dominated lens open at depth. The company says this may upgrade the South Zone block model, supporting feasibility and future resource updates.

title: Anglo American's New Boss Sounds Warning on Future Copper Supply
summary: The piece (via its headline) reports that Anglo American’s new boss warned about future copper supply. Such commentary can shift near-term expectations toward tighter market availability, supporting copper prices as traders anticipate a potential supply shortfall over the coming weeks.

title: Ellwood Group to invest in aluminum tooling plate production
summary: Ellwood Group said it will invest in its Ellwood Specialty Steel plant to add an aluminum tooling plate (ATP) production line. The automated facility includes sawing, machining, quality control, lamination, storage and packaging, aiming to supply customers more reliably with reduced lead times and inventory uncertainty.

title: Hydro Aluminum Henderson announces $15 million investment
summary: Hydro Aluminum plans a $15 million investment in its Henderson, Kentucky recycled-aluminum facility, including a new homogenization furnace and a baghouse dust/air system. The upgrades aim to boost output of certified low-carbon aluminum and enable processing of higher scrap volumes, supporting production for the automotive market.

title: Copper Producers Are Pushing Back on Chile's Proposed Tax Overhaul, with Anglo American ... - Latest Tweet by Bloomberg
summary: Copper producers are pushing back against Chile’s proposed tax overhaul, with Anglo American saying it needs greater regulatory clarity before proceeding with major investments. The development may influence market expectations for future copper supply in the near term, but it does not cite immediate output impacts or clear timing.

title: SMM Analysis of the Surge in China's Exports of Copper Plate and Strip in 2022_SMM
summary: Customs data show China exported 51,300 mt of copper plate and strip in Jan–Jun 2022 (+56% YoY), with June exports up 84% YoY. Imports fell, implying exports outpaced imports. Overseas demand rebounded as lockdowns eased, while high German energy prices limited local supply.

title: Copper rises on weaker dollar, Peru supply risk
summary: Copper prices rose Tuesday, supported by a weaker dollar and supply risk from Peru. Three-month LME copper gained 0.8% and Shanghai September copper rose 1.3% amid ongoing demand worries. The article also reports gains in LME aluminium and ShFE nickel, suggesting broadly positive metal sentiment.

title: Over 300 people charged for copper theft in the last 6 months
summary: Authorities in Trinidad and Tobago report over 300 arrests for copper theft, mainly involving TSTT telecommunications cables and a copper plant. The government is considering a ban on the scrap iron industry, after PM Rowley cited severe sabotage. Dealers oppose shutdown, seeking workable solutions to curb theft.

title: Head of scrap iron group denies buying stolen TSTT copper lines
summary: Scrap Iron Dealers’ Association president Allan Ferguson denies allegations of buying stolen TSTT copper lines, saying his firm won a bid to dispose of aged copper cables. TSTT confirms Ferguson’s company won a contract for copper cable disposal. The dispute centers on provenance and gate passes, with no direct price signals.

title: Analysis: Peru's mining execs 'lose faith' in gov't despite moderate shift | WIN 98.5 Your Country | WNWN-FM
summary: Peruvian mining executives say President Castillo’s failure to restrain social protests has caused month-long copper production halts at Cuajone and Las Bambas and delayed new $53 billion projects. Even with moderated tax proposals, investor confidence is fading, risking further project and expansion delays in Peru, a leading copper producer.

title: China Aluminium Wheel Exports Have Little Chance of Improving in July and August _SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s aluminium wheel exports fell in June to 71,500 mt, down 6% month-on-month and 10% year-on-year. With major destinations accounting for most flows and an off-season slump, wheel plants cite insufficient orders from domestic and overseas buyers, suggesting exports won’t improve in July-August.

title: Premiums of Pure Nickel Continued to Fall amid the End of the Month_SMM
summary: SMM July 29 said pure nickel premiums continued to fall in the spot market. Jinchuan nickel averaged 6,250 yuan/mt (down 1,400 yuan) and NORNICKEL averaged 4,150 yuan/mt (down 1,450). Traders reduced premiums for end-of-month shipments, while ample overseas supply pressured domestic pure nickel.

title: Copper set for fourth straight monthly drop as recession fears bite
summary: Copper is set for a fourth straight monthly decline as recession fears, a weaker demand outlook in China, and an elevated U.S. dollar weigh on prices. Copper is down about 6% this month. Nickel production at Nornickel fell QoQ. LME aluminum is up modestly, indicating weaker bearish spillover to aluminium.

title: Glencore H1 Copper, Zinc Production Down; Cuts FY22 Copper Production View
summary: Glencore said its first-half own-sourced copper production fell 15% to 510,200 tonnes, mainly from ongoing geotechnical constraints at Katanga. The company cut full-year 2022 copper production guidance to 1.06 million tonnes from 1.11 million, keeping other guidance unchanged.

title: Copper Inventory in China Bonded Zone Dropped by 10,200 mt on Week_SMM
summary: China’s bonded-zone copper inventories fell 10,200 mt week-on-week to 266,100 mt as of July 29, with declines in Shanghai and Guangdong. SMM links the drop to a better SHFE/LME ratio and high China premiums boosting customs-declaration demand, while sellers secured warrants and bills of lading, drawing inventories down.

title: Bonded Zone Inventory of Nickel Dropped Slightly due to the Weak Downstream Demand_SMM
summary: SMM reports bonded-zone nickel inventory at 6,300 mt this week, with nickel briquette down 200 mt WoW to 2,700 mt and nickel plate at 3,600 mt. Clearance of overseas pure nickel was lower due to weak downstream demand, though briquette demand improved slightly from ternary batteries and some salt plants.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports Increased by 774,000 wmt WoW_SMM
summary: SMM says Chinese port inventories of nickel ore rose 774,000 wmt week-on-week to 6.359 million wmt as of July 29. Domestic NPI demand is sluggish, keeping nickel ore demand weak and driving downward pressure on ore prices. High freight squeezes mine margins and shipping, and inventories are expected to rise slowly short term.

title: Aluminum Cans Market to Showcase Opulent Growth with a Healthy CAGR of 4.5% Throughout 2021-2031 Accounting for Surge in Eco-Friendly Packaging worldwide
summary: The piece forecasts steady expansion of the global aluminum cans market (notably in North America and China) driven by rising beverage and processed-food consumption and sustainability/recyclability trends. It also notes manufacturers focusing on increasing production capacity to meet demand, implying supportive near-term aluminum demand.

title: Copper touches three-week peak on U.S. rates, supply worries
summary: Copper rallied to a three-week high as expectations for slower U.S. interest-rate hikes weakened the dollar and renewed supply worries tightened the market. LME three-month copper rose 1.5% to $7,875/ton, amid declining inventories and mine output cuts, including weaker Chile data and reduced Glencore guidance.

title: Brazil's largest producer of primary aluminium Albras restores full production | Companies
summary: Norsk Hydro said Brazil’s primary aluminium producer Albras has fully restored production after a February power failure shut line 2, which had reduced output by about 25%. Albras is now running at full capacity of 460,000 tonnes per year, increasing near-term supply expectations for aluminium.

title: Alumina Markets Diverged between North and South China _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports regional alumina price divergence in China, with north China supported by higher costs and expected Shanxi production cuts for environmental reasons. FOB Western Australia prices eased slightly as overseas supply improved. South-west prices remain firm but may soften with future output releases. Alumina is seen fluctuating narrowly this week.

title: China's Bauxite Imports Plummeted 2.56 Million mt MoM in June_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s bauxite imports fell to 9.42 million mt in June, down 21.4% MoM, with Australia and Indonesia both declining sharply. Weather disruptions hurt shipments, and Indonesia’s export ban risk has intensified, prompting Chinese alumina refineries to seek alternative ores. Supply tightness could support aluminium pricing.

title: Pure Nickel Spot Trading was Slack amid the High Futures Prices_SMM
summary: SMM Aug 1 noted that Jinchuan nickel spot premiums were 12,000–13,000 yuan/mt and Nornickel premiums 11,500–12,000 yuan/mt, but spot trading was slack after the contract roll to SHFE 2209. High futures prices hurt nickel briquette cost efficiency and demand, with alloy production still reliant on nickel plate.

title: China Aluminium Plate/Sheet Exports Dropped MoM in June, and Likely to Extend in Following Months_SMM
summary: SMM reports China exported 340,800 mt of aluminium plate/sheet in June 2022, down 6% month-on-month but up 44% year-on-year. Exports weakened as overseas fabrication recovery did not translate into sustained orders, and SMM expects continued MoM export declines in coming months, pressuring aluminium demand expectations.

title: Blackstone steps up journey to green nickel production
summary: Blackstone Minerals says it is speeding development of its Ta Khoa “green nickel” battery-metals processing refinery in Vietnam, progressing feasibility work, pilot testing, permitting, and partner/offtake negotiations. The company plans to start production in about three years, using flexible refinery feedstock options from its nickel operations.

title: Aluminium Ingot Inventory Climbed Further _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM said China’s aluminium ingot social inventories totaled 678,000 mt on Aug 1, up 7,000 mt week-on-week but below last year. Foshan inventories rose for two weeks amid weak trades and steady arrivals. With low arrivals elsewhere, demand remains poor, and inventories may increase further as shipments arrive.

title: Buying Interest in the Copper Spot Market was Suppressed by Multiple Factors_SMM
summary: SMM reports Aug 1 copper cathode premiums in Shanghai rose to 330–410 yuan/mt but still failed to stimulate buying because premiums and SHFE futures remained high. Expected weekend imports of hydro-copper did not arrive, yet backwardation and elevated prices capped demand and pulled quotes lower. Future premiums may fall further.

title: Chilean authorities investigate mysterious large sinkhole near copper mine
summary: Chilean authorities are investigating a large sinkhole that appeared over the weekend near land operated by Canadian Lundin Mining’s copper mine in northern Chile. While the cause is unclear, such ground damage can threaten mine stability, potentially disrupting near-term copper output and expectations.

title: Chile Probes Giant Sinkhole at Lundin Underground Copper Mine
summary: Chile is investigating a giant sinkhole at Lundin’s underground copper mine. Such an incident raises the risk of production disruptions, potential safety shutdowns, and near-term supply concerns, which can weigh on market sentiment for copper prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Koba Resources completes IP survey at Blackpine cobalt-copper project ahead of maiden drilling
summary: Koba Resources completed induced polarisation (IP) surveys over its historic Blackpine cobalt-copper project ahead of maiden drilling in September, following an earlier maiden program at the nearby Colson project. The work targets extensions of copper-cobalt mineralisation, but no production changes are reported.

title: Global Copper Supply Faces a Great Challenge, and Codelco Copper Output Slumped_SMM
summary: Codelco’s copper output fell 9.3% year-on-year in the latest quarter, and Cochilco expects Chile’s annual output to drop further due to declining ore grades, water restrictions and labor union protests. While demand risks are noted, the supply shortfall outlook could support copper prices in the coming weeks.

title: Aluminium Prices Slumped amid Supply Pressure and Subsided Demand as a Result of Lingering Seasonal Low_SMM
summary: Aluminium prices fell sharply on both SHFE and LME after the prior rally, with spot discounts widening. SMM links the weakness to accumulating domestic social inventories, poor downstream demand and lower operating rates, and smelter production pressures from loss-making conditions. High energy costs provide some support, but upside momentum appears limited.

title: Continued Low Demostic and Overseas Inventories Supported the Nickel Prices_SMM
summary: SMM reports SHFE nickel and spot refined nickel prices fell sharply, with spot 1# refined nickel down to about 186,300 yuan/mt. Reasons include weak alloy-sector demand, flat trades, and bearish supply dynamics from increased Indonesian NPI. Low domestic and overseas inventories offer some support, but not to offset the downturn.

title: Sinkhole 25 metres wide prompts investigation near Chilean copper mine
summary: Chilean authorities are investigating a 25-meter-wide sinkhole near Lundin Mining’s Alcaparrosa mine in northern Chile. Sernageomin closed areas around the site as specialists investigate, citing water at the depth. Lundin says the sinkhole stayed stable and affected no workers, but technical analysis is ongoing.

title: WEST MINING REPORTS INITIAL EXPLORATION RESULTS FOR THE BLUE COVE COPPER PROJECT
summary: West Mining reported initial exploration results from its Blue Cove Copper Project in Newfoundland, with multiple rock samples returning grades above 1% and some above 2% and up to 3.56% Cu. The company is awaiting additional soil sampling and ongoing interpretation, with no near-term production or supply impact stated.

title: Mongolia increases export of gold, copper and coal in 2022
summary: Mongolia reportedly increased exports of gold, copper and coal in 2022, with the article citing higher export values and volumes for hard coal over the first half-year. It also notes copper exports rose, suggesting improved supply availability that could weigh on copper prices in the short term.

title: Copper Prices Continued to Rebound amid the Low Inventory and Low US Dollar Index_SMM
summary: SMM reports SHFE and spot copper prices rebounded in early August, citing tight inventories—domestic social inventory at a record-low 69,400 mt and SHFE inventory around 37,000 mt. Supply constraints include import delays and smelter maintenance, plus blister copper tightness, supported by a falling US dollar.

title: Giant sinkhole with 'a lot of water' suddenly opens up near copper mine in Chile
summary: A sinkhole reportedly opened suddenly near a copper mine in Chile, with “a lot of water” flowing into the area. The incident raises the risk of operational disruption, potential damage, or short-term production losses, which can tighten copper supply expectations and support higher prices over the coming days.

title: SHFE Nickel Once Fell by More Than 3%, But Rebounded amid the Low Inventory_SMM
summary: SHFE and LME nickel prices fell sharply before partially rebounding (SHFE down 3.27% at one point). SMM cites lower-than-expected customs clearance, expanded overseas pure nickel profits, and increased Indonesian NPI shipments that raise NPI supply beyond demand. Pure nickel demand remains weak, though low inventories may offer some support.

title: NORNICKEL REPORTS FIRST HALF 2022 INTERIM -8-
summary: Nornickel reports 1H2022 IFRS results, stating revenue was supported by higher nickel and copper prices and production volumes after earlier operational suspensions at mines and a concentrator. It also highlights logistical disruptions and inventory build-up. The company describes a nickel market in surplus overall, implying limited near-term directional price pressure.

title: NORNICKEL REPORTS FIRST HALF 2022 INTERIM -2-
summary: Norilsk Nickel’s interim results note that nickel and copper prices and production volumes moved during 1H 2022, alongside logistical disruptions and macro factors. The company describes nickel price volatility, market surplus dynamics, and copper’s volatility tied to geopolitics, recession fears, and a stronger dollar. Aluminium impacts are not indicated.

title: NORNICKEL REPORTS FIRST HALF 2022 INTERIM -3-
summary: Nornickel reports 1H 2022 results, noting higher nickel and copper prices and recovered volumes after prior mine/smelter disruptions, offset by logistical disruptions and inventory build. It describes nickel market surplus dynamics and copper price volatility, but provides no new operational or trade catalyst that would clearly shift near-term metal prices.

title: NORNICKEL REPORTS FIRST HALF 2022 INTERIM -7-
summary: Nornickel reported 1H2022 IFRS results, noting production recovery after temporary suspensions at its Oktyabrsky and Taimyrsky mines and Norilsk concentrator, but also logistical disruptions leading to lower metal sales and higher inventories. The company discusses nickel market surplus/shortage mix and copper price volatility, reflecting near-term market conditions.

title: Ero Copper Reports Second Quarter 2022 Operating and
summary: Ero Copper reported record Q2 2022 copper production of 12,734 tonnes and reaffirmed full-year output guidance while raising copper C1 cash cost guidance for Caraíba. Results were affected by issues at its domestic smelting customer, shifting more concentrate sales to international customers with longer pricing periods.

title: Ero Copper Reports Second Quarter 2022 Operating and Financial Results Including Record Quarterly Copper and Gold Production
summary: Ero Copper reported its second-quarter 2022 operating and financial results, noting record quarterly production of copper (and gold). Record output from a copper producer can shift short-term supply expectations upward, creating modest downside pressure for copper prices over coming days to weeks.

title: China Copper Cathode Inventory Drops to 6-Year Low, When Will It Rally?_SMM
summary: SMM says China copper cathode inventories in mainstream areas fell to 69,400 mt as of Aug 1, the lowest in six years, driven by low starting levels, reduced stock accumulation, limited net imports, reluctance to sell scrap, and smelter maintenance impacts. Rebound is expected no earlier than mid-August as arrivals increase.

title: BHP to boost nickel exploration spending amid EV boom
summary: BHP’s Nickel West chief said the company will sharply boost nickel exploration spending over the next two years to supply expected EV battery demand. BHP links growth to nickel’s role in EV chemistries and notes expanding exploration activity and existing supply deals with major automakers.

title: LME Nickel Stocks Fell below 60,000 mt, SHFE Nickel Stocks Ended Six Consecutive Weeks of Declines_SMM
summary: LME nickel inventories have trended down since late April, falling further last week to 57,978 mt as of August 1, near multi-year lows. SHFE nickel inventories rebounded 16.61% weekly to 1,741 mt after six consecutive weeks of declines, though remaining historically low, supporting tight supply sentiment.

title: Spot Prices of Pure Nickel were Still High and the Transactions were Poor_SMM
summary: SMM reports that spot nickel prices fell day-on-day, with Jinchuan nickel averaging 8,750 yuan/mt and NORNICKEL averaging 8,150 yuan/mt. Premiums of pure nickel continued to decline, while high futures prices kept buyers wait-and-see. Spot transactions were poor, including for nickel briquettes due to narrower premiums.

title: Spot Premiums of Copper Cathode Slumped to less than 100 yuan/mt due to the Continuous Inflow of Imported Copper_SMM
summary: SMM reports Shanghai copper cathode spot premiums sliding 160 yuan/mt day-on-day to 60-100 yuan/mt over SHFE 2208 due to continuous inflows of imported copper and traders dumping for cash after backwardation eased. With smelter overhauls finished and expectations of more imports, premiums could fall further.

title: COPPER THIEVES CRIPPLE MAYARO
summary: Copper thieves are harvesting telecommunications cables in Mayaro, Trinidad and Tobago, repeatedly disrupting phone, internet, and point-of-sale/ATM services. TSTT attributes outages to malicious theft of fibre optic and copper cables and reports additional fibre cuts. Authorities have arrested 300 people for copper theft since January.

title: Fabled Copper Corp.: Update Report on the 2022 Field Exploration Programs, Increases Land Position
summary: Fabled Copper Corp. reports progress on 2022 field exploration at its Muskwa Copper Project in northern British Columbia. Activities include sampling, geophysics, drone mapping, and a pending drill permit. It also notes a newly found copper occurrence that increased the land package by 254 hectares.

title: Copper Demand Expected to Nearly Double by 2035
summary: S&P Global data cited in the article says copper demand could nearly double by 2035, implying supply may not keep up with electrification-driven growth. It also covers copper exploration drilling updates and recent copper sales/production figures for several miners, reinforcing expectations of ongoing copper tightness. No nickel or aluminium catalysts are mentioned.

title: Two security guards arrested for theft of Transnet copper cable
summary: South Africa’s Hawks arrested two guards accused of cutting and stealing Transnet copper cables in Mooi River. Investigators recovered about 670 meters of copper cable valued around R180,000. The suspects face charges for theft and damage to infrastructure, with a court appearance scheduled soon. Quantities appear minor for copper markets.

title: Hydro Aluminum Metals USA Upgrades-Expands Henderson, Kentucky, Plant
summary: Hydro Aluminum Metals USA will upgrade and expand its Henderson, Kentucky plant with a new homogenization furnace and baghouse to improve automotive specs and increase recycling of broader post-consumer scrap. Work starts August and finishes by September 2024, supported by Kentucky tax incentives tied to investment and job retention.

title: Copper drops on China tensions, prospect of more interest rate hikes
summary: Copper prices eased as U.S.-China tensions over Pelosi’s Taiwan visit raised fears of weaker industrial demand. Markets also discounted the prospect of more Fed rate hikes and recession risks. LME three-month copper fell 1.6%, with aluminium down 1.3% and nickel down 0.8%, reflecting broad metals pressure.

title: Zambia's Growth Target Shaky as Copper Output Drops, Prices Plunge
summary: The piece says Zambia’s growth outlook is shaky as copper output declines, with copper prices plunging. The headline implies weakening supply from Zambia and immediate negative sentiment for copper, which typically translates into expectations of lower demand/supply balance and downward pressure on copper prices over the next days.

title: Pelosi's visit to Taiwan rattles global copper markets, but slowing growth in China still the bigger worry
summary: Copper prices fell for the fourth straight day after Pelosi’s Taiwan visit heightened U.S.-China tensions. While investors see geopolitical risk as less likely to drive more selling, fears of a China-led global slowdown and recession remain the bigger driver, potentially damping construction demand for copper.

title: SMM TOP Talk: Understand Latest Nickel Market from the Perspective of Future Demand_SMM
summary: SMM discusses nickel market drivers, citing capacity bottlenecks and oversupply that have pushed MHP, NPI, and high-grade nickel matte prices lower. It expects primary nickel supply to keep increasing via imports and ongoing NPI flow into China, with near-term nickel prices rangebound but downside risks remaining for NPI and primary nickel.

title: Spot Premiums of Pure Nickel Dropped amid Poor Trades in the Morning Spot Market_SMM
summary: SMM reports that spot premiums for pure nickel fell in Shanghai, with Jinchuan premiums dropping and NORNICKEL premiums also declining. The decreases are attributed to lower Jinchuan ex-factory prices, scarce NORNICKEL trades, and weak demand. Nickel briquette prices also slid, with limited transactions due to poorer cost efficiency.

title: Zambia's Copper Output Declined Sharply, Falling Short of Annual Production Goal_SMM
summary: Zambia’s copper output fell 7.4% year-on-year in H1 2022 to 364,089 mt, with exports also weakening. Output at major First Quantum Minerals mines dropped due to rains and COVID-19 restrictions, making the 2022 production target likely unattainable. The supply shortfall supports expectations for tighter copper availability.

title: McEwen Copper: Los Azules Progress Report #4
summary: McEwen Copper reported drill intercepts at its Los Azules project in Argentina, highlighting long intervals of copper mineralization, including several higher-grade sections (up to 1.38% Cu over 44.0 m). Drilling will resume in October to support an updated PEA, but there is no near-term supply impact.

title: CanAlaska Uranium Ltd.: CanAlaska Announces: Assays Confirm High-Grade Nickel in All Drill Holes from Phase 1 Winter Program Completed at Manibridge
summary: CanAlaska announced winter 2022 drill assay results at its Manibridge nickel project in Manitoba, reporting high-grade nickel-sulphide mineralization in all drill holes and continuity beneath the former mine. The release also notes the mineralization contains copper and cobalt, but provides no production or inventory updates.

title: Atlantic Nickel continues record operational and financial performance in 1H22
summary: Atlantic Nickel reported record 1H22 performance from the Santa Rita nickel sulphide mine in Brazil, including concentrate production and cost figures, and stated it has hedged nickel and copper prices. The update is primarily company-specific without evidence of near-term supply disruption or major demand/policy changes.

title: Experts investigate mysterious 200-foot-deep sinkhole near copper mine in Chile
summary: Experts are investigating a large sinkhole near Lundin Mining’s Alcaparrosa copper mine in Chile’s Atacama desert. While the company reports no impact to personnel or equipment, development work in the underground mine has been temporarily suspended as a safety measure. Disruption at Chile’s major copper source is bearish for prices.

title: The copper conundrum
summary: Thieves stole fibre optic cables, targeting copper despite police believing they sought copper wire. The scrap dealers association links the surge in theft to soaring copper prices and warns exports and utility operations could be disrupted. Authorities are considering shutting the scrap industry or banning copper sales amid rising losses and illegal scrap trading.

title: Nickel 28 Releases Ramu Q2 2022 Operating Performance
summary: Nickel 28 reported Q2 2022 operating performance from its Ramu (Papua New Guinea) nickel-cobalt venture, including 8,128 tonnes of contained nickel and 6,624 tonnes of nickel sales. The company links volatility to LME nickel trading suspension and conflict, while citing stable production and improving demand.

title: [SMM Monthly Forecast] Aluminium Prices Likely to Be Subject to Demand Side amid Potentially Extending Losses_SMM
summary: SMM expects aluminium prices in August to fluctuate but remain pressured by weak downstream demand in an off-season, falling profit-driven reluctance to sell/produce by high-cost smelters, and inventory accumulation risks for ingot and billet. Costs may ease via lower electricity and anode prices, but demand is slow to improve.

title: Copper Inventory in Major Chinese Markets Decreased by 500 mt from Monday_SMM
summary: SMM says copper inventory across major Chinese markets fell 500 mt to 68,900 mt week-on-week, with Guangdong hitting an SMM record low. The decline is attributed to Guangxi smelter overhaul, temporary shutdown of Guangdong lines, and limited imported inflows. High spot premiums may reduce rod producer consumption.

title: Premiums of Spot Prices Further Declined and the Transactions were Poor due to High Pure Nickel Futures Prices_SMM
summary: SMM reports nickel premiums further narrowing as pure nickel spot demand weakens. Jinchuan nickel and Nornickel spot quotes fell versus the prior day. The decline is attributed mainly to high nickel futures prices and weak demand, leading to poor spot trading activity.

title: Lowered Tender Prices by Aluminium Plants Led to reduced Aluminium Fluoride Production _SMM
summary: SMM reports August aluminium fluoride tender prices were cut to 8,500 yuan/mt, with weaker cost support from falling sulphuric acid prices. Lower bidding by aluminium plants reduced aluminium fluoride producers’ profits, prompting some to switch to hydrofluoric acid. SMM expects aluminium fluoride prices to face short-term downside and muted transactions.

title: Strong Fundamentals to Underpin Copper Prices in the Short Term _SMM
summary: SMM reports copper futures falling over multiple sessions, with SHFE copper down and LME copper weaker. It cites hawkish Fed expectations and earlier price declines hurting orders. Offsetting positives include rapid destocking of domestic copper inventories, limited smelter output from maintenance and scrap tightness, and rising cable demand from infrastructure spending.

title: Atlantic Nickel continues record performance in 1H22
summary: Atlantic Nickel and Appian report record 1H22 performance from the Santa Rita nickel sulfide mine in Brazil, including 8,000 t of nickel contained in concentrate, low C1 cash costs of about $4.95/lb net of by-products, and debt-free positioning. The results suggest supportive near-term nickel supply outlook.

title: Green River Gold Corp. Intercepts Highest XRF Nickel Results to Date in Step-Out Drilling at Its Quesnel Nickel/Magnesium/Talc and Expands Its Oversubscribed Flow-Through Share Offering
summary: Green River Gold updates step-out drilling at its Quesnel nickel/magnesium/talc project, reporting the highest nickel readings to date from new XRF-analyzed drill locations, including grades over 0.2%. Drilling continues toward new targets, and assay results are pending. The news is supportive for nickel exploration sentiment.

title: AMAG, Audi develop recycled aluminium wheel alloy for series production
summary: AMAG and Audi developed a new recycled aluminium casting alloy (AlSi7.REC) for car wheels with over 70% recycled content, aiming to meet safety and aesthetic requirements while cutting CO2 versus primary metal. The piece also cites recent Fastmarkets aluminium pricing levels, but provides no large-scale volume impact.

title: Murchison Minerals Ltd.: Murchison Minerals Commences Diamond Drilling at the HPM High-Grade Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project in Quebec
summary: Murchison Minerals says it has commenced Phase III diamond drilling at its HPM Quebec nickel-copper-cobalt project, targeting expansion and delineation at the Barre de Fer zone and the nearby Syrah target. The company plans ~7,500 m and references assay grades, but no production or supply changes are announced.

title: 10,000 Digicel clients hit by copper thefts in 5 months
summary: Digicel in Trinidad and Tobago says 10,000 customers lost service due to vandals cutting lines to steal copper over five months. Digicel notes its network is fibre (no copper), so theft damages infrastructure and forces costly repairs. Thieves are also stealing batteries at cell towers and some cable-wire arrests follow.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports up 20,000 wmt WoW_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s nickel ore port inventories rose 20,000 wmt WoW to 6.32 million wmt (about 50,000 mt Ni content). Mine shipments were poor as ore prices fell and high ocean freight squeezed margins, leading to production cuts. Oversupplied NPI kept downstream pricing rangebound, pressuring ore prices.

title: Nevada Copper Provides Operations and Financing Update
summary: Nevada Copper updated operations and financing for its Pumpkin Hollow underground copper mine. The company is advancing restart planning but restart activities depend on securing long-term restart funding. It is in default on some obligations and seeks interim and additional financing from creditors, including shareholder Pala.

title: Nevada Copper Provides Operations And Financing Update
summary: Nevada Copper reported progress on plans to restart its Pumpkin Hollow underground copper mine, but activities remain in temporary suspension while it seeks long-term restart funding. The company is discussing a larger financing package and may rely on further interim promissory notes. Restart timing depends on securing financing.

title: MDOT leaders work to solve copper theft issue in Jackson
summary: Mississippi transportation officials discuss ongoing theft of copper from interstate highway lighting poles in the Jackson area. Criminals cut and remove copper wiring, causing lights to go out and raising MDOT replacement and repair costs. Officials plan surveillance and law-enforcement action to prevent further thefts.

title: Villagers arrest copper thieves
summary: Police arrested four men for stealing copper cables and recovered 31 metres of 50-pair copper cable. The arrests follow a TTPS reward for vandalism at WASA/TSTT facilities, where copper cable theft disabled the California Booster Station. Repairs are expected to take three to four weeks amid ongoing theft activity.

title: Aluminum Prices Move Sideways As Energy Crisis Persists
summary: Aluminum prices drifted sideways after a weak July rebound as Europe’s gas crunch continued. High energy costs rendered 10%–20% of global smelting unprofitable in June, rising to ~50% in China. Energy rationing could double output cuts, while China expands alumina and aluminum exports, adding supply pressure.

title: Column: Indonesian tax will shake up the nickel export mix again: Andy Home
summary: The Reuters column says Indonesia may introduce an export tax on nickel intermediates such as NPI and ferronickel to push more domestic value-added production (stainless steel and nickel sulfate). It follows prior ore-bans that reshaped trade flows toward China. New rules could tighten near-term nickel supply.

title: MSJ: Govt's proposed copper ban is too little, too late
summary: A political leader says the government moved too late to ban copper exports after scrap dealers had requested it for months. He argues a shorter copper export ban could curb theft and reduce disruption versus a six-month scrap iron ban, which he says strains livelihoods and jobs.

title: China Unwrought Aluminium and Aluminium Semis Exports Fell MoM, but Surged YoY in July_SMM
summary: Customs data cited by SMM shows China exported about 652,200 mt of unwrought aluminium and aluminium semis in July 2022, down 5.01% month-on-month but up 39.05% year-on-year. January–July exports rose 34.9% YoY to 4.16 million mt, indicating weaker near-term outward shipments.

title: Despite Supply Concerns Caused by Overseas Energy Crisis, Aluminium Prices Lack Upward Momentum due to Weak Demand _SMM
summary: SMM reports SHFE and LME aluminium ended the week lower/flat-to-higher but with weak momentum. Europe’s energy/power crisis and poor profitability slow smelter restarts and raise expectations for cuts, while weak downstream demand and rising ingot inventories widen spot discounts. Net effect is rangebound price action.

title: Profits of Smelters Improved Slightly amid Rising Aluminium Prices and Falling Costs_SMM
summary: SMM reports that aluminium smelter costs fell after rounds of cuts to prebaked anode and aluminium fluoride prices. Despite stable power tariffs for most firms, the average smelter cost dropped to 17,884 yuan/mt and profits rose to 635 yuan/mt as A00 aluminium prices increased to 18,520 yuan/mt. Risks remain from price volatility.

title: MIIT Released the Operations of Copper Industry in the First Half of 2022_SMM
summary: China’s MIIT published H1 2022 copper industry operations. Copper cathode output rose to 5.33m mt (+2.5% YoY) and semis to 10.23m mt (+2.4%). Copper imports of concentrate increased to 12.48m mt (+8.6%). The average spot copper price averaged 71,750 yuan/mt (+7.7% YoY).

title: Review and Forecast of NPI and Nickel Ore Prices_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports nickel ore (Ni 1.5% CIF) staying on a downward trend as mines resist sales, low-grade nickel ore nears cost, and plants reduce output. Weak stainless steel prices and frosty ferrochrome demand limit buying. Meanwhile, Indonesian NPI supply returning to China keeps an NPI surplus, keeping downward pressure on nickel-related prices.

title: MIIT Released Operations Situation of Nickel, Cobalt and Lithium Industries in the First Half of 2022_SMM
summary: China’s MIIT released H1 2022 operations for the nickel-cobalt-lithium industries. Nickel output and demand drivers from new energy stayed in growth, but nickel concentrate imports fell 8.3% to 15.1 million mt and refined nickel imports fell 3.7% to 83,000 mt year-on-year.

title: Output of Refined Nickel in July Increased by 2.89% on the Month and is Expected to Further Increase in August_SMM
summary: SMM says China produced 16,000 mt of refined nickel in May, and July output increased 2.89% MoM. The rise was driven by higher alloy military orders and pure nickel demand after low SHFE prices, but weaker steel-mill shipments reduced demand. Some salt plants curtailed production, though output still grew. August output is forecast slightly higher.

title: Australian Broker Call *Extra* Edition - Aug 08, 2022
summary: The “Australian Broker Call Extra Edition” mostly covers ASX equity research. The relevant section is AIS Aeris Resources, where Bell Potter highlights stronger Tritton Copper mine production after a strategy change and raises forecasts. Improved copper output prospects can modestly boost near-term copper price sentiment.

title: Copper demand unlikely to recover until China abandons COVID-zero
summary: Copper prices firmed after stronger-than-expected US jobs data, but the article says sustained gains depend on China abandoning COVID-zero. With China responsible for over half of global copper demand, a meaningful recovery is viewed as unlikely until after China’s National Congress in November.

title: Topic | Copper | WAtoday
summary: Multiple items focus on copper market drivers. BHP’s profits and Rio Tinto’s increased copper output are described as supportive for sentiment. However, analysis of Trump’s new 50% copper tariff warns of longer-lasting pain for US manufacturers due to limited processing capacity, offsetting the bullish news.

title: Topic | Copper | The Sydney Morning Herald
summary: The article argues that Donald Trump’s 50% copper tariff will create longer-lasting pain for US manufacturers because domestic processing capacity is limited. The “unintended consequences” are framed as reduced buying activity or higher costs for copper users, pressuring near-term copper demand and potentially prices.

title: Indonesia says Tesla strikes $5 billion deal to buy nickel products - media
summary: Indonesia’s minister said Tesla has signed a five-year deal worth $5 billion to buy nickel products processed in Morowali, Sulawesi, for use in lithium batteries. The announcement adds visible end-demand alongside Indonesia’s prior nickel-ore export halt, likely supporting nickel prices near term.

title: Indonesia says Tesla strikes $5 billion deal to buy nickel products
summary: Indonesia says Tesla struck a $5 billion deal to buy nickel products. The announcement points to stronger nickel demand associated with Tesla’s supply chain, which can lift price expectations for nickel in the coming days as markets react to potential tightening in availability.

title: Topic | Copper | Brisbane Times
summary: The piece highlights concerns around Donald Trump’s proposed 50% copper tariff. It argues the US has limited processing capacity relative to copper supply, and the tariff would likely cause longer-lasting pain for manufacturers, weakening near-term demand expectations and weighing on copper sentiment.

title: Copper edges higher as low inventories cushion recession worries
summary: Copper prices rose on Monday as low inventories and higher China copper imports (sparked by lower prices) outweighed recession and weaker-demand worries. Improved July export growth in China also eased concerns. Despite broader macro uncertainty, the market was broadly bid, with copper contracts up on both LME and ShFE.

title: Indonesia says Tesla strikes $5 billion deal to buy nickel products – media
summary: Indonesia’s senior minister said Tesla signed about $5 billion of contracts to buy battery materials from nickel processing companies in Morowali, Sulawesi, under a five-year deal. The news points to sustained demand for Indonesian processed nickel. Indonesia’s policies favor domestic supply, which can support nickel prices near term.

title: Topic | Copper | The Age
summary: The excerpt points to a “copper tariff” development in the US, noting a 50% tariff and an imbalance between copper supply and limited processing capacity. It argues the policy will create longer-lasting pain for US manufacturers, weighing on consumption and thus copper demand expectations.

title: Aluminium Ingot Inventory Rose for Three Weeks in A Row _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM said Chinese aluminium ingot social inventories totaled 687,000 mt as of Aug 8, up for three consecutive weeks (+17,000 mt since early August) and higher than end-July. Several regions saw stock increases, while warehouse shipments fell to 128,300 mt and spot discounts widened amid sluggish demand.

title: SMM Analysis: China Copper Output Fell Short of Expectations amid Tight Blister Copper Supply in July_SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s copper cathode output of 840,000 mt in July, below expectations, despite abundant concentrate. Smelter maintenance, technical upgrades, and tight blister copper and scrap availability constrained production, while port inventory buildup slightly improved terms. Additional overseas overhauls and unstable Kansanshi output add near-term supply risk for copper.

title: S&P/ASX200: ASX edges 0.1pc firmer, buoyed by copper stocks
summary: Australian shares edged higher as copper-linked stocks rose following BHP’s multibillion-dollar bid for South Australian copper and nickel miner Oz Minerals. The move boosted sentiment toward copper and nickel supply expectations, helping lift related equities, which can transmit to near-term metal price expectations.

title: Copper Prices Continued to Rebound with the Support of Fundamentals_SMM
summary: SMM reports copper prices rebounding on supportive fundamentals despite macro pressure from hawkish Fed expectations and weaker PMI data. It cites low inventories, rising bonded-zone and LME cash-to-three-month premiums, smelter maintenance reducing supply, and stronger cable and rod demand. Premiums are seen to ease during delivery.

title: Capstone Copper Reports Second Quarter 2022 Results
summary: Capstone Copper reported Q2 2022 production and financial results, including 45,200 tonnes of copper and C1 cash costs of $2.78/lb. Results were impacted by negative provisional pricing linked to lower realized copper prices, while management noted signs of declining diesel and sulfuric acid prices and reiterated guidance.

title: Capstone Copper Corp.: Capstone Copper Reports Second Quarter 2022 Results
summary: Capstone Copper reported Q2 2022 results, including 45,200 tonnes of copper output and higher C1 cash costs. Results were impacted by negative provisional pricing from lower realized copper prices, while management cited declining sulphuric acid and diesel costs and reiterated production guidance, with H2 copper hedges and capital/cost reductions.

title: Canada Nickel Company Initiates Federal Permitting Process for Crawford Nickel Project
summary: Canada Nickel said the federal Impact Assessment permitting process for its Crawford Nickel Project has started after acceptance of the Initial Project Description and publication for a 180-day comment period. The company will respond to a Summary of Issues and advance subsequent documentation. The release does not indicate immediate production changes.

title: Tesla signs contract to buy Indonesia's nickel products worth 5 billion USD-Xinhua
summary: Tesla signed a $5 billion, five-year contract to buy nickel products from two Indonesian suppliers in Morowali, Central Sulawesi, for use in lithium batteries. Indonesia’s government is simultaneously pushing Tesla investment in its EV battery supply chain, highlighting strong expected nickel offtake.

title: Tesla signs contract to buy Indonesia's nickel products worth 5 billion USD
summary: Tesla signed a five-year $5B contract to buy nickel products from two Indonesian producers in Morowali for use in lithium batteries. Indonesia is a major nickel exporter and is seeking deeper EV/battery investment. The deal strengthens visible nickel demand, likely providing bullish support to nickel prices.

title: Indonesia says Tesla strikes $5 bln deal to buy nickel products - media
summary: Indonesia’s cabinet minister said Tesla signed about $5 billion in contracts to buy materials for batteries from nickel processing companies in Indonesia. The deal signals increased near-term nickel offtake for EV supply chains, likely tightening expectations for nickel demand and supporting price sentiment over coming weeks.

title: Barrick Gold Quarterly Profit Beats Expectations After Copper Boost
summary: Barrick Gold reported a nearly 19% rise in quarterly profit, beating expectations mainly due to higher copper output. It produced 120 million pounds of copper in Q2, up 25% from Q1, and remains on track for copper guidance. Inflation lifted copper all-in sustaining costs 15%.

title: Copper Inventory across Major Chinese Markets Added 3,900 mt over Weekend_SMM
summary: SMM says copper inventories across major Chinese markets rose 3,900 mt to 72,800 mt after weekend import clearance and resumed smelter shipments. Despite lower year-on-year levels, near-term supply looks supportive ahead of SHFE 2208 delivery, while demand may weaken from high premiums and price spreads.

title: Fight over Resolution Copper Mine drags on - and both sides expect more - Cronkite News
summary: The story details ongoing legal and regulatory challenges to the proposed Resolution Copper mine near Superior, Arizona. Supporters say it could become North America’s largest copper mine, while opponents cite environmental and cultural impacts. Courts have recently rejected some claims, but appeals and further review continue, keeping start dates uncertain.

title: Indonesia says Tesla strikes US$5bil deal to buy nickel products
summary: Indonesia said Tesla has signed about US$5 billion in five-year contracts to buy nickel battery materials from processing firms in Morowali, Sulawesi. The contracts cover two nickel products used in lithium batteries. The news adds expected demand momentum for processed nickel amid Indonesia’s export restrictions and planned export taxes.

title: Barrick Gold project gets boost from copper | Chatham Daily News
summary: Barrick Gold said higher copper production in Q2 helped lift profit by about 19%. It produced 120 million pounds of copper, up 25% year-on-year, while gold output was roughly flat. Costs rose on inflation, but management highlighted flexibility. The update is mainly company-level, not a broader copper market driver.

title: Lundin Mining suspends Chile copper mine as authorities probe sinkhole
summary: Lundin Mining temporarily suspended underground operations at its Alcaparrosa copper mine in Chile after authorities and the company investigated a sinkhole that expanded in surface diameter. The shutdown followed safety concerns and an official order to halt. Management says the closure is unlikely to materially affect annual guidance for the broader Candelaria complex.

title: Tesla signs $5B deal to buy nickel from Indonesia, minister says
summary: Tesla has signed an estimated $5 billion, five-year nickel purchasing deal with Indonesian firms, including plants in Indonesia’s Sulawesi nickel belt. The contracts strengthen expectations of near-term nickel demand for EV batteries. Environmental groups criticize Indonesia’s nickel pollution, but the announcement itself is supportive for nickel prices.

title: Barrick Gold project gets boost from copper
summary: Barrick reported second-quarter profits rose nearly 19% as copper production increased to 120 million pounds, 25% higher than a year earlier. The company also discussed inflation-driven higher gold costs and updates on Nevada and Dominican Republic projects. The copper output growth is the key immediate link to copper prices.

title: German bank confirms support of Altech Chemicals' high purity alumina project in Malaysia
summary: German KfW IPEX-Bank reiterated full support for Altech Chemicals’ high-purity alumina (HPA) project in Malaysia, including a planned US$190 million senior loan, with Euler Hermes renewing export credit cover. The update follows discussions on financing and bankable progress, enabling work to resume after pandemic-related delays.

title: Chile to seek 'consequences' for sinkhole near copper mine | WKZO | Everything Kalamazoo
summary: Chile’s mining minister said authorities will seek harsh sanctions over a large sinkhole near a copper operation in northern Chile. The regulator suspended operations of a nearby Lundin-run mine after inspections failed to detect “overexploitation.” The disruption raises near-term copper supply concerns and downside risk for prices.

title: Chile to seek 'consequences' for sinkhole near copper mine | Kat Country 98.9
summary: Chile’s mining minister said authorities will pursue harsh sanctions over a large sinkhole near a copper mine in northern Chile. Regulators suspended Lundin’s nearby operation after inspections failed to detect “overexploitation.” Authorities are investigating causes and will reform inspection processes, raising short-term copper supply disruption risk.

title: Copper: BHP's bid for Oz Minerals shows why Copper is the new oil
summary: BHP’s offer for OZ Minerals, focused on copper assets, is presented as part of a broader wave of acquisitions to secure copper supply. The article argues global growth in new copper deposits is insufficient versus expected demand, implying a potential supply tightness narrative that can support copper prices.

title: Chile to seek 'consequences' for sinkhole near copper mine
summary: Chile plans to seek harsh sanctions over a large sinkhole near a copper mine in northern Candelaria. The regulator suspended operations of Lundin’s nearby mine after failing to detect overexploitation earlier. Authorities are investigating causes and may reform inspection processes, increasing near-term copper supply uncertainty.

title: SMM TOP Talk: Heavy Investment in UHV Power Transmission Projects Light up Aluminium Rod Demand in China_SMM
summary: State Grid announced it will start multiple Ultra High Voltage transmission projects and accelerate additional projects, investing over 150 billion yuan. UHV lines in China use aluminium bare overhead conductor (ACSR), implying substantial aluminum rod demand (SMM estimates 700,000 mt+ over construction). Analysts expect supportive effects on aluminium demand and prices.

title: Indonesia Says Tesla Strikes $5 Billion Deal to Buy Nickel Products—Media
summary: Indonesia’s senior minister said Tesla has signed contracts worth about $5 billion to buy battery-related materials from nickel processing companies in the country. Indonesia has been courting Tesla to invest, citing its major nickel reserves. The deals imply strong incremental nickel demand tied to battery production needs.

title: Aluminium foundry fights for survival in European gas crisis
summary: A German aluminium foundry is preparing for temporary shutdowns to survive Europe’s gas crisis, with gas costs more than doubling and likely tripling. Aluminium smelters/foundries depend heavily on natural gas and may reduce output, raising concerns about downstream delivery disruptions across auto supply chains.

title: Indonesia says Tesla strikes $5 billion deal to buy nickel products | Companies
summary: Indonesia’s senior cabinet minister said Tesla agreed to roughly $5 billion in five-year contracts to buy nickel battery materials from processing firms in Morowali, Sulawesi. The nickel feedstock will be used in Tesla’s lithium batteries, reinforcing near-term demand expectations for nickel.

title: Domestic Aluminium Output Increased in July as the Total Operating Capacity Continued to Increase_SMM
summary: SMM says China produced 3.5m tonnes of aluminium in July, up 6.7% y/y, with domestic operating capacity continuing to rise. August output is expected to increase further, while demand for sheets/plate, strip and extrusion weakens. Inventories of ingots and rod may keep rising, weighing on aluminium prices.

title: Domestic Copper Cathode Output is Expected to Increase in August amid the Production Resumption_SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s July copper cathode output at 840,000 mt amid smelter maintenance and technical upgrades. For August, most smelters are resuming, with cathode production expected to rise to about 892,100 mt. Tight blister copper supply remains a key constraint that could cap gains.

title: Aluminium Foundry Fights For Survival In European Gas Crisis
summary: A German aluminium foundry plans rotating shutdowns to survive Europe’s gas crisis as energy costs have doubled and gas prices have surged on reduced Nord Stream 1 flows. Regulators urge further cuts, and carmakers warn output depends on suppliers. Aluminium foundries may curb operations, tightening near-term supply.

title: Altiplano Metals Inc.: Altiplano Discovers New Zone at Maria Luisa; Drills 10.50 Metres of 3.76 g/t Gold and 3.83% Copper
summary: Altiplano Metals reported a new Maria Luisa drilling discovery with copper-rich sulphide breccia, including 10.50m of 3.83% Cu and intervals up to 8.26% Cu, plus additional high-grade chalcopyrite at depth. The company is advancing underground development to test continuity, but no economic reserves are stated.

title: Cobre Limited  Commences Stage 1 Infill Drilling at Ngami Copper Project
summary: Cobre Limited announced stage 1 infill drilling at the Ngami Copper Project, including additional diamond drilling and ongoing geochemical sampling, with assays expected in September 2022. Management frames results as a potential new copper discovery and plans further infill to test continuity and extent, potentially supporting copper sentiment.

title: Great Atlantic Resources Corp.: Great Atlantic Drilling Intersects 6.74% Copper, 34.5 G/T Silver and .6 G/T Gold over .4 Meters as well Nickel and Cobalt also Anomalous Mascarene Property New Brunswick
summary: Great Atlantic Resources reports drill results from its Mascarene Property in New Brunswick, including a 0.40 m intercept grading 6.74% copper (with gold and silver) and other copper-bearing sulfide veins.
