summary: China’s aluminium extrusion exports fell for the third straight month in August to 81,800 mt, down 12.4% MoM and 3.4% YoY. Higher domestic prices, exchange-rate-driven transaction costs, and weak overseas demand hurt orders. Separately, EU smelters cut output due to high energy costs, but the overall export momentum remained weak.

title: Aguila Copper Corp.: Aguila Copper Expands Landholding at the Lida Copper-Silver Project, Nevada in Preparation for Drilling
summary: Aguila Copper Corp granted additional BLM lode claims at its Lida copper-silver project in Nevada to cover an IP chargeability anomaly, extending the secured area to 58 claims over three high-chargeability zones. The company plans drilling in Q4 2022 after obtaining permits and drilling contracts, based on high-grade copper in surface samples.

title: Power Nickel Inc.: Power Nickel Follows Up Release of NI 43-101 Compliant Mineral Resource Estimate on the Nisk Nickel Project With Commencement of Second Round of Drilling
summary: Power Nickel reported its NI 43-101 technical report and mineral resource estimate for the Nisk nickel project and has started a second round of drilling (~5,500 m) to infill gaps and expand high-grade mineralization. The update is intended to grow resource confidence, with only limited copper linkage via NiEq.

title: Was the Increase in SS Contract Caused by SHFE Nickel Prices or Fundamentals Support?_SMM
summary: SMM reports the SS contract rose sharply despite the Fed’s 75bp hike matching expectations. It attributes part of the move to strong SHFE nickel gains earlier in the week. Fundamentals for stainless steel show only slight changes in supply and demand, with holiday activity supporting short-term prices.

title: Surge Battery Metals Inc.: Surge Battery Metals Announces Successful Completion of its Phase 1 Exploration Program on the Ni100 Nickel Project Located in Northern British Columbia
summary: Surge Battery Metals announced completion of Phase 1 exploration on its Ni100 nickel project in northern British Columbia, collecting rock and soil samples targeting ultramafic anomalies. Many samples returned over 2,000 ppm nickel, with ICP results pending and further work (including potential drilling) planned.

title: TRU Precious Metals Corp.: TRU Opens Up New Copper-Gold-Silver Discovery at Golden Rose
summary: TRU Precious Metals announced assay results from a new discovery at its Golden Rose project in Newfoundland, including multiple copper-bearing zones. Highlighted intervals include high-grade copper with associated gold and silver, plus indications the system remains open for expansion. The release is exploration-focused and early-stage.

title: Copper Mountain Mining Receives Reclamation Award
summary: Copper Mountain Mining announced it received an award for mine reclamation and fish habitat offset work at its Wolfe Creek realignment project near its Copper Mountain Mine in British Columbia. The release describes reclamation activities and mine production details, but provides no direct near-term supply, cost, or policy impact for copper markets.

title: Power Nickel Follows Up Release of NI 43-101 Compliant Mineral Resource Estimate on the Nisk Nickel Project With Commencement of Second Round of Drilling
summary: Power Nickel announced a NI 43-101 compliant mineral resource estimate for its Nisk nickel-copper project and has begun a second drilling round (~5,500 m) to infill and expand higher-grade zones. The disclosure may affect market expectations for future nickel/copper supply but not near-term production.

title: CanXGold Mining Corp.: CanXGold Mining Corp Targeting BC's Next Major Copper Deposit Hole #1 Well UnderWay, Now Approaching KM long Anomaly Defined From 2022 Airborne Survey
summary: CanXGold Mining Corp. says diamond drilling has started at its Phoenix property in southeastern British Columbia, targeting a conductive anomaly near the historic Phoenix copper-gold mine. The company frames the work as exploring for potential new mineralization below 160 meters, but no confirmed copper output change is indicated.

title: Tribes seek details on water use at Arizona copper mine
summary: Tribes are seeking additional information on how water is being used at an Arizona copper mine. The request signals potential scrutiny around water rights and environmental/operational constraints, which could lead to disruptions or limits on production. Any operational uncertainty can tighten near-term copper supply expectations.

title: CanXGold Mining Corp Targeting BC's Next Major Copper Deposit Hole #1 Well UnderWay, Now Approaching KM long Anomaly Defined From 2022 Airborne Survey Seite 1
summary: CanXGold Mining Corp says it is targeting British Columbia’s next major copper deposit and that “Hole #1” is underway, approaching a long anomaly identified from a 2022 airborne survey. The update is discovery-focused, but drilling progress may lift near-term expectations for future copper supply prospects.

title: Aluminium Supply Woes Keep Growing As China Orders Output Cu...
summary: The article headline suggests aluminium supply problems are intensifying, implying tighter near-term availability that can push aluminium prices higher. It also references China ordering output related to copper, pointing to potential demand support for copper. However, the excerpt contains no further specifics on volumes or timing.

title: Aluminum Supply Shrinks As Energy Prices Force Smelters To Shutdown
summary: Rising European gas and electricity prices tied to the energy crisis are forcing aluminum smelters to cut output or shut down (including Slovalco, Aldel and prior line closures). China’s aluminum imports have fallen sharply while domestic output hits records, and demand weakens from COVID and heatwaves, weighing on LME aluminum prices.

title: OZ Minerals gives green light to $1.7b copper-nickel mine
summary: OZ Minerals has given the go-ahead and started work on a $1.7 billion copper-nickel mine in remote Western Australia. The company says EV and battery makers are interested in stakes, and the decision may also affect takeover dynamics involving BHP. The project points to future supply, likely modestly pressuring copper and nickel sentiment.

title: OZ Minerals Gives Green Light to A$1.7 Billion Copper Project
summary: OZ Minerals has reportedly given approval for a A$1.7 billion copper project. The decision suggests higher prospective copper supply in coming years, which can improve market sentiment for copper. The effect on spot prices is likely limited and gradual because new production is not immediate.

title: Topic | Nickel | The Sydney Morning Herald
summary: The news roundup is heavily centered on nickel developments in Western Australia, including FIRB approval for Japanese consortium investment in Ardea’s Goongarrie Hub and new DFS drilling/testwork. It also references BHP’s WA nickel shutdown and further Ravensthorpe job losses linked to Indonesian nickel supply, balancing demand-side support.

title: BHP target Oz Minerals hits go on $1.7b nickel mine
summary: Oz Minerals approved its $1.7b West Musgrave project in Western Australia, a copper-and-nickel development expected to start production in late 2025. Management projects nickel entering sustained undersupply, with higher early production volumes. BHP may revisit its Oz takeover bid, reinforcing bullish sentiment for nickel and copper markets.

title: Topic | Nickel | The Age
summary: The article is largely nickel-focused, highlighting BHP’s WA nickel shutdown and additional Australian nickel job losses attributed to cheaper Indonesian nickel, implying weaker near-term nickel demand/supply balance. It also mentions Russia-related factors that “rocket” BHP’s copper outlook, suggesting some copper support.

title: Topic | Nickel | WAtoday
summary: The coverage focuses on nickel in Western Australia, highlighting BHP’s nickel shutdown, redeployment after mine closure, and additional nickel job losses (e.g., Ravensthorpe). It also cites BHP profit write-downs and costs linked to a global nickel price slump, reinforcing near-term bearish nickel sentiment.

title: Aluminium Prices Rebounded after Rate Hikes, but the Growth is up to Subsequent Demand_SMM
summary: After the US Fed’s 75 bp rate hike on Sept 21 (in line with expectations), aluminium prices rebounded sharply on Sept 22, with downstream buyers returning and stocking ahead of the National Day holiday. Traders cite support from possible production cuts, but note accepted Yunnan supply reductions and import pressure may weigh on prices.

title: Topic | Nickel | Brisbane Times
summary: The roundup highlights several nickel developments in Western Australia, including FIRB approval for Japanese investment in Ardea’s Goongarrie Hub and Ardea starting DFS drilling and testwork, which are supportive. Offsetting bearish items include BHP shutting its WA nickel operation and Ravensthorpe moving to care and maintenance amid cheap Indonesian nickel.

title: Bonded Zone Inventory of Nickel Plate Decreased Slightly this Week with the Improvement of Downstream Demand_SMM
summary: SMM said bonded zone nickel inventory fell to 5,480 mt, including nickel plate at 3,230 mt and nickel briquette at 2,250 mt. The decline coincided with recovering downstream/terminal demand, restocking ahead of National Day, and expected steel-mill production resumption, boosting pure nickel demand.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports up 322,000 wmt WoW_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM said China’s nickel ore port inventories rose 322,000 wmt WoW to 7.39 million wmt as of Sep 23. Despite rising stocks, ore trading strengthened and ore prices increased with improving demand signals and firm FOB supply. Imports are expected to keep rising ahead of the rainy season, supporting nickel sentiment.

title: OZ approves development of $1.13bn copper project in Australia
summary: OZ Minerals’ board has approved the $1.13bn West Musgrave copper-nickel project in Western Australia, backed by a A$1.2bn syndicated term loan. The project will include Nebo/Babel nickel-copper and Succoth copper deposits, targeting first concentrate in H2 2025 and long-life production of copper and nickel.

title: Si6 hunting down nickel-sulphide bounty in Botswana
summary: Si6 Metals says soil sampling at its Maibele East, Mashambe and Gobajango prospects in Botswana found elevated copper and nickel and suggests possible nickel-sulphide deposits under ultramafic geology. The company plans more mapping and geophysics but provides no new resource or production, keeping any near-term price effect limited.

title: Indonesian among three arrested over Pandan Indah copper cable theft
summary: Three men were detained for allegedly stealing copper cables (4-core armoured) worth about RM20,000 from Pandan Indah Commercial Park. Workers reported cables missing around 10pm on Sept 16. The news is copper-specific but reflects local theft with limited potential market impact.

title: Lockdown aftermath: Chinese copper giant hits liquidity crisis
summary: Maike, a dominant Chinese copper trading firm, is hit by a liquidity crisis after COVID lockdowns disrupt deliveries and paperwork. Counterparties and lenders grow cautious; some incoming deals pause and creditors shift copper out of China. Financing for metals is reportedly tightening, raising risks to near-term copper import flows.

title: Overseas Alumina Prices Stayed High, While Domestic Prices Fell across the Board_SMM
summary: SMM shows alumina prices eased week-on-week across Chinese regions, while overseas prices stayed high. Despite refinery cutbacks in Shanxi/Chongqing, aluminium smelters reduced output and southwest demand declined, with Guangxi facing excess supply. Market sentiment is bearish and alumina is expected to keep trending down short term.

title: London copper price hits two-month low on strong dollar
summary: London copper slid to a two-month low, falling about 1.1% to $7,352/t, as the U.S. dollar hit a two-decade peak and the Fed outlook turned more hawkish. Weak growth expectations pressured industrial metal demand. LME aluminium also hit an 18-month low, while ShFE nickel dropped 3.1%.

title: Further Decline in Operating Capacity to Shore up SHFE Aluminium Prices_SMM
summary: SMM reports SHFE 2210 aluminium eased to 18,630 yuan/mt (down 0.56% weekly) and LME aluminium to about $2,208/mt (down 4.5%). Output cuts in Yunnan are expanding (up to 18%) and stocks decline, but global rate-hike fears remain bearish, limiting rebounds.

title: Aluminium Costs Declined due to Falling Alumina Prices_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports aluminium smelter costs fell last week as alumina prices dropped on oversupply. Real-time smelter cost eased to 17,888.8 yuan/mt and profits narrowed as A00 aluminium prices dropped. Electricity costs may keep total costs high due to rising coal prices, so smelter profits are expected to fluctuate within a tight range.

title: Aluminium Billet Conversion Margin in Foshan was under pressure and Local Arrivals were Restricted by Multiple Factors_SMM
summary: SMM says Foshan aluminium A00 prices were stable in September, but aluminium billet conversion margins came under pressure. Downstream extruder operating rates did not improve, small producers suffered losses and cut output, and market transactions were weak. Billet inventory fell and arrivals decreased, yet outlook depends on limited downstream recovery.

title: Copper Prices may Fluctuate with some Downward Potential this Week amid the Depreciation of RMB_SMM
summary: SMM says copper faced major macro pressure after a Fed rate hike with more hawkish dot plots, strengthening the US dollar and pulling LME prices down. It notes inventories fell but expected tight spot supply weakened. With RMB depreciation, copper is seen with some downside risk and fluctuating trading.

title: China Aluminium Ingot Social Inventory Extended Decline, Hitting A Year-to-Date Low of 650,000 mt_SMM
summary: SMM reports China aluminium ingot social inventories in eight major markets fell to 652,000 mt on Sep 26, hitting a year-to-date low. Inventories declined in key regions such as Wuxi, Nanhai and Gongyi as warehouse shipments rose and arrivals weakened. Downstream stockpiling for National Day may prolong the drawdown this week.

title: As US Dollar Index Increase, SHFE Nickel Fell but Decline was Limited amid Peak Season_SMM
summary: SMM reports that a stronger US dollar weighed on non-ferrous metals, with SHFE nickel down 3.69% after hitting 202,800 yuan/mt. Spot nickel and briquette prices also fell. However, peak-season demand for stainless steel/new energy, low inventories, and tighter Indonesia NPI keep the decline limited.

title: Anglo American to begin copper shipments from Quellaveco, Peru | Companies
summary: Anglo American said it will start commercial copper shipments from its Quellaveco project in Peru after successful testing and final regulatory clearance. The company revised 2022 Quellaveco guidance downward but expects strong output in 2023-2024 and tightened Chile production due to water restrictions and ore changes.

title: Manitou Gold Intersects 208m and 252m at 0.25% Nickel Confirming Significant Nickel-Cobalt Discovery At Goudreau Project
summary: The article title says Manitou Gold intersected long intervals at low grade (0.25% nickel) and a further interval (0.25% nickel) at its Goudreau project, confirming a significant nickel-cobalt discovery. Such drilling results can lift near-term nickel supply expectations and sentiment.

title: Anglo American to begin copper shipments from Quellaveco
summary: Anglo American says it will begin copper shipments from the Quellaveco project. If shipments ramp in the near term, the added physical supply could increase availability in the market and exert downward pressure on copper prices over the coming days to several weeks.

title: Eagle Metals forced to diversify copper, stainless steel suppliers
summary: Eagle Metals says copper-based purchases dominate its volume and that copper mills remain on allocation, with limited contract flexibility. It also warns European alloy mills could shut due to high energy prices, disrupting US supply of materials like phosphor bronze. Meanwhile, EV and electrification demand is outpacing supply.

title: A "Perfect Storm" Is Brewing In Aluminum Markets
summary: The piece says aluminum supply is shrinking due to smelter shutdowns tied to energy shortages, while demand remains weak, especially in China’s construction. It notes aluminum prices have broken below short-term support after a brief rebound from the Fed’s rate hike. Lead times for cans are long, but prices are still trending down.

title: Nimy Resources intersects up to 427m of nickel mineralisation at Mons project
summary: Nimy Resources says early diamond drilling at its Mons project in WA intersected substantial nickel sulphide mineralisation at the Godley prospect, with about 368m and 427m averaging ~0.14% nickel. It also reported nickel, copper and cobalt mineralisation in ultramafic rocks. Additional drilling and assays are pending.

title: Austral Resources Australia Ltd (ASX:AR1) Lady Colleen Assays Confirm 5m @ 5.74% Copper
summary: Austral Resources announced diamond-drill assay results from its Lady Colleen copper project, including multiple high-grade copper intersections (up to 5m @ 5.74% Cu) and continued evidence of a high-grade core open along strike and down dip. The board approved a scoping study to assess economic potential and update the market.

title: Comex Copper Settles 1.72% Lower at $3.3135 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex Copper futures for September delivery settled down 1.72% to $3.3135 per pound, losing 5.80 cents. The contract has fallen for six consecutive sessions, down 6.95% over that span, with the lowest settlement value since July 21, 2022.

title: Nevada Copper Provides Update on Restart Activities at
summary: Nevada Copper reported progress on Phase 1 restart activities at its Pumpkin Hollow underground copper mine, including advancing a key dike crossing and preparing additional underground development and capital projects. It also updated a planned ~US$93 million liquidity package to fund restart and ramp-up, expected to reduce restart bottleneck risk.

title: Nevada Copper Provides Update On Restart Activities At Pumpk...
summary: Nevada Copper outlined progress toward restarting its Pumpkin Hollow underground copper mine, including Phase 1 development activity and a proposed US$93 million restart financing package. Funding is intended to support restart and ramp-up, with non-binding terms targeted for closing in early October 2022, reducing restart execution risk.

title: Nevada Copper Provides Update on Restart Activities at Pumpkin Hollow and the Proposed Restart Financing Package
summary: Nevada Copper outlines progress toward restarting the Pumpkin Hollow mine, describing Phase 1 development work (dike crossings, capital projects like dewatering and fans) and a planned funding package to enable subsequent underground development and mill startup. The news is primarily supportive for near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Throughput of Aluminium Scrap in Linyi East China Nonferrous Metal Market Continued to Grow as Retailers Shipped their Goods in Panic_SMM
summary: SMM says aluminium scrap throughput in Linyi (Sep 19–25) rose 20% WoW as retailers shipped in panic to mitigate falling prices. A00 aluminium stayed volatile and declined WoW; downstream scrap users bought less. Inventory fell, but oversupply of scrap is expected to persist this week, weighing on aluminium prices. Copper scrap throughput also increased.

title: A 6 Million mt/Year Alumina and New Material Project to Be Built in North-Western China's Gansu Province _SMM
summary: SMM says a signing ceremony took place in Jiayuguan, Gansu for a 6 million mt/year alumina and materials project. The planned upstream alumina refining is intended to extend and integrate the local aluminium chain, covering alumina refining, aluminium smelting, semis and deep processing, potentially improving supply expectations for aluminium.

title: Pure Nickel Prices Declined and the Spot Transactions Improved_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reported that on Sep 27, Jinchuan nickel premiums averaged 4,650 yuan/mt, up versus the prior day, while NORNICKEL premiums averaged 1,550 yuan/mt, down. Despite slightly higher premiums, SHFE nickel stayed low and spot inquiries improved. Nickel briquette prices fell and transactions weakened.

title: China copper smelters hike Q4 2022 TC/RC floor to a five-year high
summary: China’s CSPT set a Q4 2022 copper concentrate TC/RC floor at $93/tonne and 9.3 cents/lb, above Q3 2022 and Q4 2021 levels. The guide affects global treatment charges, reflecting expectations of steadier concentrate demand despite rising overseas supply and ongoing mining/logistics uncertainty.

title: Key Takeaway from SMM Automotive New Materials Summit Forum: Secondary Aluminium to Grow Faster than Primary Aluminium in Terms of Long-Term Supply and Demand under Dual Carbon Goals _SMM
summary: SMM’s summit takeaway argues China’s dual-carbon policies will accelerate low-carbon secondary aluminium growth faster than primary in the long run. It highlights expanding low-carbon supply in Yunnan into 2025, switching to green power, and carbon-related cost pressures (carbon trading and EU CBAM) that influence aluminium pricing.

title: Sharp Decline in Copper Prices Boosted Downstream Purchases, thus Spot Premiums Rose_SMM
summary: SMM reports copper cathode spot premiums at 520-580 yuan/mt over SHFE 2210, stable on the day. Premiums held despite a widening front-/next-month spread, as the market is concerned about tight spot supply. A decline in copper prices spurred downstream restocking and supported sellers’ prices amid low inventories.

title: Weekly Copper Scrap Throughput Rose Again with Sellers Bearish on Copper Prices_SMM
summary: SMM reports East China copper scrap throughput rose to 29,400 mt WoW as pre-National Day stocking increased trading, while SHFE and physical prices fluctuated narrowly. The cathode-vs-scrap spread narrowed but still supported scrap consumption. Near-term, falling copper prices and weaker restocking could thin deals; throughput may drop to ~20,000 mt in Linyi.

title: Rio Tinto to start underground mining at Kennecott copper operations
summary: Rio Tinto said it will start underground mining at its Kennecott copper operations. The move can shift near-term expectations toward higher copper supply, depending on ramp-up pace. While the immediate output increase may be gradual, the headline is directionally bearish for copper prices.

title: Rio Tinto To Invest $55 Mln To Start Underground Mining At Kennecott Copper Operations In US
summary: Rio Tinto said it approved a $55 million investment to start underground mining and expand output at its Kennecott copper operations in Utah. The project targets around 30kt of additional mined copper, with first ore expected in early 2023 and processing via existing facilities, supporting supply expectations.

title: China's Renewable Energy Buildout Will Boost Copper Demand
summary: China’s renewable and grid buildout is expected to raise copper demand, led by EVs and renewable installations, while construction demand declines. Analysts also point to power shortages potentially accelerating grid expansion, and reference a potential supply squeeze. The net effect is supportive for copper prices near term.

title: World Copper Ltd.: World Copper Announces Results from Mancha Amarilla Drilling, Confirms Extension of Mineralization at Escalones Project in Chile
summary: World Copper reports additional drilling at its Escalones project in Chile, confirming that oxide copper mineralization at the Mancha Amarilla target extends at least 150 metres south and reaches depths to 280 metres. The company plans further drilling at East Skarn and skarn targets, aiming to grow resources and improve grades.

title: Copper rises on weaker dollar, slowdown worries weigh
summary: Copper prices rose Tuesday as a softer U.S. dollar made the dollar-priced metal cheaper, but growth and demand concerns from aggressive global rate hikes limited upside. LME copper added 1.2%. The piece also notes small declines in LME aluminium and ShFE nickel amid generally mixed moves across metals inventories.

title: Element 29 Announces Initial Mineral Resource Estimate for the Elida Porphyry Copper Deposit in Peru
summary: Element 29 reported an initial inferred mineral resource for its Elida porphyry copper-molybdenum deposit in Peru, including 321.7 million tonnes grading 0.32% copper. The update informs future drilling and potential project economics but does not indicate near-term production changes, limiting immediate price impact mainly to copper.

title: Element 29 Resources Inc.: Element 29 Announces Initial Mineral Resource Estimate for the Elida Porphyry Copper Deposit in Peru
summary: Element 29 announced an initial NI 43-101 Inferred Mineral Resource at its Elida porphyry copper-molybdenum deposit in Peru: 321.7 million tonnes at 0.32% copper. The update provides project scale and molybdenum/silver grades, but remains inferred with no production timeline, limiting near-term market impact.

title: Norsk Hydro: Hydro responds to reduced aluminium demand, partially curtails production
summary: Norsk Hydro said it is responding to reduced aluminium demand by partially curtailing production. The move can tighten near-term aluminium supply, offering some support to prices. However, the decision is driven by softer demand, which may cap gains and keep price support moderate.

title: Nickel Spreads Collapse as Banks Face Soaring Financing Costs
summary: The article’s headline says nickel spreads have collapsed as banks face higher financing costs. A sharp drop in nickel spread measures typically reflects easing market tightness and/or diminished demand expectations, which can weigh on nickel prices over the coming days as investors adjust positions accordingly.

title: Glencore increases stake in Argentina's MARA copper project
summary: Glencore increased its stake in Argentina’s Mara copper project. The move is generally supportive for copper development expectations, but the article provides no near-term operational details (e.g., output start dates or capacity changes). As a result, any effect on copper prices is likely modest over the coming days.

title: Rio Tinto earmarks US$55M for underground development at Kennecott copper mine in Utah
summary: Rio Tinto earmarks US$55 million to begin underground development and expand output at its Kennecott copper operations in Utah. The project targets higher production at the world’s largest open-pit copper mine, potentially improving short-term copper supply expectations and providing price support.

title: Nodding to the past, looking to the future. Utah's Kennecott again mining copper underground
summary: Kennecott will move part of its Bingham operation underground and invest $55 million in development, targeting over 30,000 tons of high-quality copper over five years. The project also pilots electric mining vehicles and emphasizes air-quality benefits, though critics warn about potential water impacts.

title: Material Matters: Iron Ore, Oil, Aluminium, Nickel & Copper
summary: Analysts cite macro slowdown and power/energy issues to explain large aluminium declines and potential transitory spikes from Russian delivery and potential smelter curbs. Citi notes a recent nickel rally but expects Europe-led demand weakness to dominate. Copper is seen flat but forecast down on recession risk in Europe.

title: Material Matters: Iron Ore, Oil, Aluminium, Nickel & Copper
summary: The piece reviews broker outlooks: it attributes aluminium’s sharp decline to recession and energy-cost-driven production cuts, while noting potential short-lived spikes. For nickel it remains bearish despite a September rally, citing demand slowdown. Copper is expected to stay weak under Europe recession fears, with no bullish near-term catalyst.

title: Material Matters: Iron Ore, Oil, Aluminium, Nickel & Copper
summary: JP Morgan and others cut iron ore forecasts, while Longview and Citi discuss aluminium, nickel and copper. Aluminium is pressured by recession and power-cost-driven smelter cuts, with potential Russian delivery and Yunnan hydropower outages. Nickel is bearish despite a Sept rally, while copper remains range-bound with recession-driven downside risks.

title: Utah Kennecott Copper Mine will again mine underground. Here's why
summary: Rio Tinto’s Kennecott mine in Utah will shift additional mining underground, investing $55 million to develop the lower commercial skarns. Management expects over 30,000 tons of high-quality copper over five years and is piloting electric mining equipment to improve efficiency and emissions, signaling continued copper output.

title: Kennecott resuming underground copper mining for first time in 100+ years
summary: Rio Tinto’s Kennecott mine in Utah plans to resume underground mining at the “Lower Commercial Skarn” deposit after more than 100 years underground operations ceased. Crews are expected to produce ore by early next year, processing it in existing facilities, alongside testing electric mining equipment and completing feasibility work in early 2023.

title: Investment in Indonesia's largest nickel-based industrial park hits US$18bil
summary: Indonesia’s Morowali nickel industrial park (IMIP) has attracted $18 billion in investment over four years, with a new QMB New Energy Materials plant adding output for ternary EV-battery precursors. Analysts expect increased reliance on nickel for electric-vehicle supply chains, implying stronger demand outlook for nickel and upward price pressure.

title: Musk's Tesla will test Indonesia's nickel-powered EV dreams
summary: Indonesia is pushing to lead Southeast Asia in electric vehicle production, supported by natural resources, incentives, and commitments from global automakers and battery makers. The narrative centers on “nickel-powered” EV dreams and notes Tesla CEO Elon Musk is expected to approve plans, potentially boosting near-term nickel demand expectations.

title: Lightweight Vehicles Bring More Opportunities for Cast Aluminium Wheels _SMM
summary: SMM reports discussion at an automotive materials summit that rising policy pressure toward carbon reduction and fuel efficiency is accelerating substitution of steel wheels with lightweight cast aluminium wheels. The piece argues this boosts aluminium billet and casting demand as commercial and exported vehicles adopt aluminium wheels for energy savings and recyclability.

title: MAX Resource Corp.: Max Resource Reports Geophysical Results, New Assays and Mobilization of the Diamond Drill Rig to URU, CESAR Copper-Silver Project in NE Colombia
summary: MAX Resource Corp. reports strong geophysical correlations and channel sampling at its URU-C and URU-CE copper-silver project in Colombia, with drilling expected to start by Oct. 11. It describes drill targeting, expanded TMI/IP surveys, and copper-rich intervals, which can support bullish copper sentiment near term.

title: Lotte to acquire copper foil firm Iljin Materials
summary: Lotte Chemical plans to buy a 53.3% stake in Iljin Materials for KRW2.7tn, taking control of a leading copper foil producer for EV batteries. Iljin supplies firms including BYD and LG Energy Solution, and plans a European plant in Spain, supporting near-term copper demand expectations.

title: Hydro responds to reduced aluminium demand, partially curtails production | Companies
summary: Norsk Hydro says weaker European demand for aluminium billets and uncertainty in the energy market have led to stock buildup. It will partially curtail output at Hydro Karmøy and Hydro Husnes in Norway, following the Slovalco plant closure in Slovakia. The curtailment is expected to start shortly and reduce power consumption.

title: Copper Mountain Mining Announces a 57% Increase in Copper Mineral Reserves at the Copper Mountain Mine and Updated Life of Mine Plan
summary: Copper Mountain Mining announced a 57% increase in proven and probable copper mineral reserves and an updated life-of-mine plan for its Copper Mountain Mine. The revision supports a 65ktpd mill expansion and longer mine life, extending production over decades, with first 20-year average output of ~114 million pounds of copper equivalent annually.

title: Copper Mountain Mining Announces A 57% Increase In Copper Mi...
summary: Copper Mountain Mining reported a 57% increase in Proven and Probable copper mineral reserves and updated a revised life-of-mine plan for its 75% owned Copper Mountain Mine. The plan includes a 65 ktpd mill expansion and higher long-term output, starting in 2028, but does not signal near-term supply changes.

title: Aluminium Bahrain B S C : Alba holds its Board Meeting for Third Quarter of 2022
summary: Aluminium Bahrain (ALBA) held its Q3 2022 board meeting, reviewing safety performance, productivity and financial results, sales amid global logistics challenges, and developments on a proposed Line 7 project. It also discussed Power Station 5 construction linked to decarbonization and noted financing closure with Sinosure for the project.

title: Rio Tinto to resume underground mining at Kennecott copper operations
summary: Rio Tinto said it will resume underground mining at the Kennecott Copper Mines in Utah, after more than 100 years at the site. The company approved $55 million for development capital to add additional volumes of high-quality copper and expand capabilities for larger underground operations.

title: Copper Mountain bulks up BC mine resource, supporting expansion plans
summary: Copper Mountain Mining updated mineral resources and reserves for its 75%-owned copper mine in southern British Columbia and released a revised life-of-mine plan that supports expansion. The positive project update may improve near-term market expectations for future copper supply, offering a modest bullish bias for copper prices.

title: Hindustan Copper CMD expresses plans to increase mine production
summary: Hindustan Copper Limited plans to expand the Malanjkhand Copper Project, increasing copper ore capacity from 2 MTPA to 5 MTPA by developing an underground mine and targeting much higher long-run production. It also mentions resuming operations at Ghatshila. Changes are largely multi-year, so near-term copper price impact is limited.

title: Spot Pure Nickel Premiums Stopped Falling and Stabilised with Improving Market Transactions_SMM
summary: SMM reports spot pure nickel premiums in China stabilising after stopping their fall. Jinchuan nickel premiums rose to 6,000-6,500 yuan/mt, while NORNICKEL premiums increased to about 1,700-1,900 yuan/mt. SHFE nickel was firm and briquette prices also climbed as transactions improved, supporting nickel sentiment.

title: SMM China Aluminium Ingot and Billet Social Inventories as of September 29_SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s aluminium ingot social inventories fell to 619,000 mt as of Sept 29, a weekly drop, hitting a four-year low as downstream buyers stockpiled ahead of the National Day holiday. Aluminium billet inventories also declined to 80,100 mt, helped by weak shipments due to Xinjiang disruptions and holiday demand.

title: Review of Nickel Market Restocking Progress ahead of National Day Holiday [SMM Review]_SMM
summary: SMM reports that ahead of the National Day holiday, market participants are mostly buying nickel on demand but with active restocking preparation. Spot supply is relatively low for battery-grade nickel sulphate, long-term negotiations are underway, and stainless mills are stockpiling NPI. Nickel ore supply is tight after Philippines rainy-season starts, supporting nickel prices.

title: Infinitum Copper Reports 32.25 Metres of 1.74% Copper Equivalent and 20.30 Metres of 0.97% Copper Equivalent in Drilling at La Adelita Project
summary: Infinitum Copper reported diamond-drill results from its La Adelita project in Mexico, including 32.25m grading 1.01% Cu and 19.30m grading 0.54% Cu, expressed as copper equivalent. The company frames the findings as expanding the skarn mineralized system, supporting future drilling plans.

title: Canada Nickel Provides Project Update and Announces US$10 Million Loan Facility
summary: Canada Nickel reported that feasibility work for its Crawford nickel-cobalt project is ~85% complete and it has arranged a US$10 million loan facility with Auramet, expected to close in mid-October. The funding is intended to support permitting and detailed engineering through winter months, keeping the project on track.

title: Aluminum prices, Alcoa jump on report LME could ban Russian metal
summary: Aluminum surged 8% on the London Metal Exchange after a Bloomberg report said the LME may move toward banning Russian metal supplies to its warehouses. The market reacted quickly to tighter supply prospects, while nickel also rose and Alcoa shares jumped 7% in premarket trading.

title: Nickel Prices Continued to Rise, and the PMI Index was Optimistic_SMM
summary: SMM reports the alloy-sector composite PMI stayed in expansion in September and early October, supporting nickel demand expectations. It notes nickel prices had fallen after initial macro pressure from the Fed meeting but eased again as outcomes matched expectations, while spot transactions improved. Fundamentals suggest inventory may not fall sharply, limiting upside.

title: Aluminum Surges Most On Record As LME Considers Russia Ban
summary: Aluminum jumped to an all-time high as the LME weighed a potential ban related to Russian aluminum. Traders appear to be pricing in tighter near-term availability and higher costs if Russian supply is disrupted. The move points to immediate bullish pressure for aluminium prices.

title: Aluminum Stocks Jump on Reports of Potential Russian Ban
summary: Alcoa and Century Aluminum shares rise after reports the London Metal Exchange could ban Russian aluminum. The market reaction suggests traders expect tighter available supply for the LME market if Russian metal is restricted, supporting a bullish near-term outlook for aluminum prices.

title: Aluminum Prices Soar By Record 8.5% As LME Weighs Ban On Russian Metals
summary: Aluminum surged 8.5% on the LME after Bloomberg reported the exchange may discuss blocking new Russian metal deliveries to its warehouses. Russia’s role as a major supplier raises supply-risk concerns. Nickel also jumped about 5%, while copper was cited as potentially affected if Russian flows tighten.

title: Kentucky recoups $15 million investment in failed Braidy Industries aluminum mill
summary: Kentucky says it has recouped its $15 million investment tied to a proposed Braidy/Unity Aluminum aluminum mill that never reached completion and required financing delays. The site is being donated and sold for future development, but there’s no clear near-term change to broader aluminum supply markets.

title: Kentucky recovers $15M from failed Braidy Industries aluminum project
summary: Kentucky says it has recovered its $15 million stake after Braidy Industries/Unity Aluminum failed to build a promised aluminum rolling mill near Ashland. The state also reacquired the land. Unity later merged with Steel Dynamics (Aluminum Dynamics), indicating continued plans for an aluminum plant elsewhere.

title: Ero Copper shares rise on nickel discovery near its Caraiba mill in Brazil
summary: Ero Copper shares rose 9.4% after the company announced a discovery of a regional nickel sulphide system (Umburana System) in Brazil’s Curaçá Valley near its Caraiba mill. The news is expected to lift sentiment around nickel resources, even though near-term output is not indicated.

title: Ero Copper shares rise on nickel discovery near its Caraiba mill in Brazil
summary: Ero Copper shares jump after the company announces discovery of a regional nickel sulphide system in Brazil’s Curaçá Valley, near its Caraíba mill. The find highlights potential future nickel resources, but the output timing is uncertain, suggesting limited immediate support for nickel prices over the next several weeks.

title: Nickel 28 Capital Corp.: Nickel 28 Files Fiscal Q2 Financial Statements
summary: Nickel 28 reported Ramu’s production and financing updates, noting that a 7.6 earthquake triggered emergency protocols and MCC reduced refinery throughput. Ramu is expected to run at reduced capacity for at least two months, while Nickel 28 says nickel prices remain elevated.

title: Kentucky reacquires $15 million set aside for aluminum mill
summary: Kentucky recovered $15 million invested in Braidy Industries for an aluminum rolling mill planned near Ashland, after the project failed to materialize. Gov. Andy Beshear said the land will be donated for future economic development. Braidy was later rebranded as Unity Aluminum and merged with Steel Dynamics.

title: Export Ban Triples Nickel Investment in Indonesia's Morowali
summary: The article headline says Indonesia’s export ban has caused nickel-related investment in Morowali to triple. The development implies faster ramp-up of domestic nickel processing and could improve supply outlook, creating downward pressure on nickel prices in the near term as markets price higher future availability.

title: Downstream Stocking in Aluminium Market Was Modest before the National Day Holiday, Post-Holiday Aluminium Ingot to Accumulate Significantly due to Longer Break by Small and Medium-Sized Downstream Enterprises _SMM
summary: SMM survey indicates many Chinese aluminium downstream processors—especially extruders and secondary alloy plants—will take longer breaks due to weak orders and bearish post-holiday sentiment. While pre-holiday restocking was limited, aluminium ingot and billet inventories are declining pre-holiday but are expected to accumulate sharply after the National Day holiday as output and inventory cycles normalize.

title: SMM Survey on the National Day Holiday Arrangements of Copper Processing Companies in 2022_SMM
summary: SMM surveyed 55 copper processing enterprises on National Day holiday production plans. Many segments (enamelled wire, copper billet, parts of tube) face sluggish demand and longer holidays, with cautious raw-material restocking. Wire/cable orders are steadier, but overall stocking falls short, implying near-term pressure on copper.

title: Aluminum Extends Gains After Record Spike on Russia Supply Fears
summary: Aluminium prices extend gains after a record spike, with the move linked to fears over Russia supply. The headline suggests market participants are pricing in tighter near-term aluminium availability, supporting higher aluminium quotations in the immediate period following the shock.

title: Copper Inventory in Major Chinese Markets Dipped 10,100 mt from Monday_SMM
summary: SMM says copper inventories across major Chinese markets fell to 66,200 mt on Sep 30, down 10,100 mt from Monday, mainly due to downstream pre-holiday restocking. Customs clearance of imported copper was limited. Inventories are expected to rise sharply after National Day as deliveries approach.

title: Vale announces reorganisation of nickel and copper in Brazil
summary: Vale said Brazilian nickel and copper assets will be reorganised into two entities. Copper assets will move to Salobo Metais S.A, while nickel assets will be placed into a new Brazil company. Vale clarified there is no decision on new Base Metals transactions, and assets remain fully consolidated and owned by Vale.

title: Vale announces reorganisation of nickel and copper in Brazil
summary: Vale said Brazilian authorities approved a reorganisation of its base metals operations: copper assets will be transferred to Salobo Metais S.A, while nickel assets will go to a new company Vale will establish. Both sets remain consolidated and wholly owned by Vale, suggesting no immediate production shift.

title: China's spot copper premium to stay elevated as demand improves
summary: The piece says China’s spot copper premium should stay elevated as demand improves. A higher and persistent premium typically reflects stronger near-term buying interest and relatively tighter spot supply against benchmark pricing, which tends to support upward pressure on copper prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: China's Spot Copper Premium To Stay Elevated As Demand Improves
summary: China’s spot copper premium in the main consumer market is expected to stay elevated as government stimulus supports demand and utilization improves across copper wire-rod and tube sectors. Tight supply, record-low visible inventories, and power-curb disruptions further support the premium, keeping import arbitrage active despite volatility from a stronger dollar.

title: Emerita Intersects 14.0 Meters Grading 4.3% Copper Included
summary: Emerita Resources reported additional assay results from delineation drilling at the La Romanera deposit in Spain. Drill holes LR019 and LR023 intersect two lenses of massive sulphides, including a 14.0 m interval grading 4.3% copper. The company is expanding drilling activity and expects a future NI 43-101 resource estimate.

title: Kentucky gov. announces revitalization of aluminum mill project
summary: Kentucky’s governor announced efforts to revitalize an aluminum mill project. The move is likely to improve the aluminum supply outlook by supporting or restarting smelting/processing capacity, which can strengthen expectations for near-term availability and potentially lift aluminum prices in the coming days to weeks.

title: Russia's Rusal denies it plans to deliver aluminium into LME warehouses | WKZO | Everything Kalamazoo
summary: Rusal denied plans to offload aluminium into LME warehouses amid LME consideration of a consultation over whether Russian aluminium, nickel and copper should remain tradable and storable. The uncertainty sparked a buying frenzy, with benchmark aluminium jumping 8.5% to $2,305/t, as traders feared delivery constraints.

title: Aluminum declines after record spike on Russia supply fears
summary: Aluminium prices declined after a record spike attributed to fears over Russian supply. The move suggests the market’s immediate concern about availability from Russia has eased or been reassessed, reducing support for aluminium and applying downward pressure to spot and near-term expectations.

title: Reflecting on the 'rich history' of copper mining in Bingham Canyon
summary: Rio Tinto plans a $55 million investment to resume underground copper mining at its Kennecott mine in Bingham Canyon. The project is expected to produce about 30,000 tons of high-quality copper over the next five years. Environmental groups criticized the history, but the announcement is largely supply-positive for copper.

title: Copper Mountain Mining Files NI 43-101 Technical Report for its Copper Mountain Mine
summary: Copper Mountain Mining filed its NI 43-101 technical report for the Copper Mountain Mine, referring to prior news about a 57% increase in copper mineral reserves and an updated life-of-mine plan. The release mainly serves as formal disclosure, offering modest confirmation for future copper supply rather than a new catalyst.

title: Iran produces more than 120,000 tons of copper cathode in 5 ...
summary: Iran’s Ministry of Industry, Mining and Trade reported copper cathode production of 122,600 tons over the first five months (March 21-August 22), a 2.2% decline versus the same period last year. The Iran Copper Association also discusses targets for future years, but current output is slightly lower.

title: Andy Home :Indonesia's nickel surge bad news for price and pricing
summary: Indonesia’s nickel output is surging, with 41% higher mine production year-on-year and much higher exports of NPI and MHP into China. Analysts say this is shifting the market to a structural surplus, cutting LME nickel price forecasts (Goldman) and implying substantial downside as Class II volumes outpace tight Class I supply.

title: Mitsubishi Power awarded long-term service agreement by Aluminium Bahrain BSC (Alba) to ensure efficient and reliable power supply
summary: Mitsubishi Power signed a long-term service agreement with Aluminium Bahrain (Alba) for a new 680.9 MW combined-cycle gas turbine power block. The deal covers parts, repairs and services to improve reliability and efficiency, supporting Alba’s aluminium production and uninterrupted operations as commercial use begins in Q4 2024.

title: CanXGold Mining Corp.: CanXGold Mining Corp Targeting BC's Next Major Copper Deposit
summary: CanXGold reports completion of the first drill hole at its Phoenix property in British Columbia, targeting a large conductivity anomaly that the company frames as potential copper-related mineralization. The hole reached 337 meters and intersected altered rocks and pyrite, with a second anomaly to be drilled next. No production or resource estimates are provided.

title: Japan's Nittetsu plans 1.4% increase in H2 copper output y/y
summary: Japan’s Nittetsu plans to raise second-half (Oct–Mar) copper output by 1.4% versus the prior year. The company outlines copper production targets for H2 FY22/23 and compares them with H1 FY22/23 and H2 FY21/22 actuals, signaling slightly higher supply expectations.

title: Aluminum Prices Decline On Russian Supply Concerns
summary: The report says aluminium prices are falling on concerns about Russian supply. The implication is that market participants expect supply-related uncertainty tied to Russia to worsen aluminium availability or refine short-term supply expectations, creating immediate downward price pressure in the metal.

title: Latest News | Vedanta's Aluminium Output Rises 2 Pc to 5.84 Lakh Tonnes in Second Quarter of FY23
summary: Vedanta said its aluminium production rose 2% to 584,000 tonnes in the second quarter of FY23. The filing also noted higher mined output at Zinc India and increased power sales. The aluminium uptick points to slightly improved near-term supply visibility for the metal.

title: Global Ferronickel acquires 20% stake in Chinese firm - BusinessWorld Online
summary: Global Ferronickel Holdings acquired a 20% indirect stake in Guangdong Century Tsingshan Nickel Industry (GCTN), a Chinese nickel alloy producer with smelters. The deal links Global Ferronickel’s nickel ore supply with GCTN’s processing capabilities, following prior maiden nickel ore exports to China.

title: Copper rises in thin holiday trade as dollar weakens
summary: London copper rose 0.8% and aluminium gained 1.1% as a softer U.S. dollar followed weak U.S. manufacturing data and lower Treasury yields. Trading stayed thin due to holidays in China and reduced Asian participation, with analysts expecting low demand and sideways price action.

title: Palladium One Mining Inc.: Palladium One Reports 4.8% Nickel, 3.7% Copper (6.8% Nickel Equivalent) over 1.8 Meters from Massive Nickel Copper Sulphides at the New West Pickle Zone of the Tyko Project, Canada
summary: Palladium One reports preliminary assay results from its Tyko Project West Pickle discovery in Canada, including intersections with 4.8% Ni and 3.7% Cu over 1.8m (and other high-grade Ni-Cu intervals). The company highlights exploration success and expects further EM results, supporting bullish sentiment for nickel and copper.

title: Manitou Gold Intersects 230.6 Metres of 0.25% Nickel Equivalent at Goudreau Project Further Confirming Significant Nickel-Cobalt Discovery
summary: Manitou Gold says drilling at its Goudreau project intersected 230.6 metres grading 0.25% nickel equivalent, further confirming a significant nickel-cobalt discovery. The reported assay results can shift near-term expectations for future nickel supply, supporting market sentiment toward nickel prices.

title: TASEKO MINES PROVIDES FLORENCE COPPER PERMITTING UPDATE
summary: Taseko provided an update that the U.S. EPA has concluded the public comment period for a draft Underground Injection Control permit for its Florence Copper project. The company says comments were overwhelmingly supportive and expects issues to be addressed before issuance of the final permit, reducing permitting uncertainty for future copper supply.

title: Helsinki shipyard fails to receive export license to build icebreaker for Norilsk Nickel
summary: Helsinki’s Arctech Helsinki Shipyard said Finland’s foreign ministry refused an export license needed to ship an icebreaker for Norilsk Nickel under sanctions. The license was denied on Sept. 30, 2022. The icebreaker project, planned for 2023 start and winter 2025 delivery, could affect nickel-linked operational logistics.

title: Massive Arizona  copper mine blocked. Copper that is vital to the Dem's EV "revolution" here
summary: The post references a Bloomberg item claiming a massive copper mine in Arizona has been blocked. A blockade implies halted or slowed mining output, tightening near-term copper supply expectations. With no corroborating data provided here, the likely immediate market reaction is bearish for copper.

title: Horizonte Minerals PLC - Araguaia Nickel Project Construction on Schedule
summary: Horizonte Minerals reported progress on its Araguaia nickel project in Brazil: construction is on schedule with ~16% overall completion and planned first nickel in Q1 2024. Capex is forecast higher at US$537m (+12.6%) due to inflation, but key equipment contracts and power upgrades are advancing.

title: Alcoa Urges LME Not to Accept Russian Metal to Avert 'Crisis'
summary: Alcoa urged the LME to avoid accepting Russian metal into the exchange, warning of a potential “crisis.” The argument implies reduced inflows of Russian supply to LME warehouses and tighter availability expectations, which would likely support aluminium prices over the coming days.

title: Falcon Gold Acquires Strategic Nickel Copper Claim Group Contiguous To Go Metal's HSP Property Seite 1
summary: Falcon Gold announced it has acquired a strategic nickel and copper claim group contiguous to Go Metal’s HSP property. While the move could broaden future nickel and copper supply prospects for the issuer, the article does not indicate any immediate production start or inventory impact, limiting short-term price effects.

title: Falcon Gold Acquires Strategic Nickel Copper Claim Group Contiguous To Go Metal's HSP Property Seite 1
summary: Falcon Gold announced the acquisition of a strategic nickel and copper claim group contiguous to Go Metals’ HSP property. Such acquisitions can strengthen expectations for future nickel and copper supply, providing a modest sentiment boost. However, without production timelines, immediate effects on prices are likely limited.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Ltd.: Kamoa Copper Reports Record Quarterly Production of 97,820 Tonnes of Copper in Q3 2022
summary: Ivanhoe Mines says its Kamoa-Kakula complex in the DRC produced a record 97,820 tonnes of copper in concentrate in Q3 2022, with concentrator plants regularly exceeding design throughput. The de-bottlenecking and Phase 3 expansion are progressing, supporting higher future copper output guidance.

title: ALX Resources Corp. Provides Exploration Update on the Flying Vee Nickel Project, Northern Athabasca Basin Area, Saskatchewan
summary: ALX Resources provided an exploration update from its Flying Vee nickel project in Saskatchewan, reporting EM-confirmed conductive trends and newly located gossan and boulder zones with sulphide mineralization, including up to ~2% chalcopyrite locally. It also outlines further planned work, but no production or supply changes.

title: Flying Nickel Mining Corp.: Flying Nickel and Nevada Vanadium Continue to Work Towards Business Combination, Provide Project Updates
summary: Flying Nickel and Nevada Vanadium report continued work toward a proposed combination and provide project updates. Nevada Vanadium details progress toward a draft/final environmental impact statement and expected permits for its Gibellini project. Flying Nickel also expects its Minago nickel project environmental review to conclude by year-end, enabling larger open-pit operations.

title: Stock Market | FinancialContent Business Page
summary: The piece argues decarbonization will drive strong refined copper demand growth while inventories remain in deficit, implying higher copper prices. It also covers Gama Explorations expanding copper- and nickel-related projects through acquisitions and financing, but the clearest near-term market signal is bullish copper fundamentals.

title: Rusal Says 'No Basis' for Any LME Ban on Russian Aluminum
summary: Rusal said there is “no basis” for any LME ban on Russian aluminum. The headline implies less likelihood of an immediate exchange-related disruption to Russian metal supply flows, which can ease bearish expectations and provide support for aluminium prices over the next days to weeks.

title: Granite Creek Copper Ltd.: Granite Creek Copper Closes Tranche of Private Placement Financing
summary: Granite Creek Copper amended and closed a first tranche of a private placement, issuing common-share units and flow-through shares to fund exploration. Proceeds will support the Carmacks copper-gold-silver project and the newly acquired Star copper-nickel-PGE project, plus working capital, subject to regulatory approvals.

title: Nickel primed for another price bounce amid fears of Russian nickel ban
summary: Nickel is poised for another rebound as the LME considers options to manage Russian metal trading, including possible bans on new Russian nickel deliveries. With Russia supplying about 20% of global nickel, a change could mirror March-style Western supply fears, while aluminium could be affected too via similar LME action.

title: Zinc, Copper Gain After LME Bans New Metals from Russian Giant
summary: Copper and zinc reportedly gained after the LME banned new metals from a Russian giant. The move implies tighter availability and improved supply sentiment for metals exposed to Russian origin flows, which can lift near-term price expectations—particularly for copper as flagged in the headline.

title: Zinc, Copper Gain After LME Bans New Metals from Russian Giant
summary: The article headline says copper gained after the LME banned new metal from a major Russian producer. Such an exchange-linked restriction can reduce available supply and alter near-term market expectations, helping lift copper pricing. Zinc is mentioned too, but it is not tracked here.

title: Offshore wind could power Portland aluminium smelter | Companies
summary: ARENA will fund a Spinifex offshore wind farm resource assessment aimed at integrating variable renewable power with the Portland, Victoria aluminium smelter. The smelter can produce 358,000 tonnes per year and is a major power user. The project is positioned to support low-emissions aluminium production via steady electricity supply.

title: Copper Mountain Mining Announces Agreement to Sell the Eva Copper Project and the Australian Exploration Tenements for Total Consideration of up to US$230 Million
summary: Copper Mountain Mining agreed to sell its Eva Copper Project and exploration tenements in Queensland to Harmony for up to US$230 million. Some contingent payments depend on incremental revenue above a US$3.80/lb copper price and on copper resources discovered, making the transaction copper-price linked but mainly corporate in nature.

title: Hefty sentence for copper thief
summary: South African courts sentenced offenders for stealing and damaging Transnet infrastructure, including copper cables and related equipment. Incidents included a thief caught with copper cables worth about R50,000 and another case involving alleged damage at a substation estimated at R300,000. These are localized cases with limited market-wide copper implications.

title: Nevada Copper Provides Update on the Proposed Restart
summary: Nevada Copper updates on advancing a restart financing package for its Pumpkin Hollow underground copper mine, including increased liquidity via Pala’s $25m backstop and progress on key restart milestones. Delays hinge on a potential change-of-control proposal, but funding and execution progress reduce near-term supply interruption risk for copper.

title: Copper falls as dollar firms ahead of U.S. jobs data
summary: Copper prices fell on Friday, extending losses, as a firmer U.S. dollar and hawkish Fed commentary ahead of jobs data increased recession and demand-damping fears. Reuters links the move to tighter monetary expectations. Aluminium was up modestly, indicating less consistent pressure across industrial metals.

title: Harmony Gold to buy Copper Mountain's copper project for $230m
summary: Harmony Gold agreed to buy Copper Mountain’s Eva copper project in Queensland for $230m, including a large copper resource estimate and an open-pit operation targeting over 100 million pounds of copper annually. The deal is pending approvals and due to close in Q1, extending Harmony’s copper exposure.

title: Centaurus postpones construction decision on US$288mn Brazil nickel project
summary: Centaurus has postponed its construction decision for a US$288mn nickel project in Brazil. By delaying the timing of potential production expansion, the move can reduce expected future nickel supply and influence market expectations, typically providing modest support to nickel prices over the following weeks.

title: Flying Nickel Mining Corp.: Flying Nickel Signs Definitive Agreement to Acquire Nevada Vanadium
summary: Flying Nickel signed a definitive agreement to acquire Nevada Vanadium, combining Flying Nickel’s Minago nickel sulphide project with Nevada Vanadium’s Gibellini vanadium project. The transaction is subject to approvals and is expected to close later. While vanadium is not tracked, the news can affect nickel sentiment.

title: Flying Nickel Signs Definitive Agreement to Acquire Nevada Vanadium
summary: Flying Nickel Mining Corp. signed a definitive agreement to acquire Nevada Vanadium’s shares, combining nickel and vanadium project portfolios. The deal is still subject to approvals and expected to close in December 2022. The release highlights battery-metal demand but gives no immediate nickel supply or production figures.

title: Almost all aluminium premiums decline amid worsening global economy
summary: Almost all aluminium premiums fell as discounting widened and demand weakened across regions. US, Rotterdam and other European premiums hit multi-month lows amid “freefall” discounting and liquidity competition. Brazil’s cif premium dropped to a 2022 low amid weak spot interest and uncertainty over import quotas. Japan and South Korea premiums also declined.

title: 'Green' copper premiums the talk of the town in European copper market
summary: European participants are debating and implementing premiums for “green” low-carbon copper. Boliden-style products and Montanwerke-Brixlegg’s planned €295/tonne low-carbon premium are cited, alongside LME moves to delist non-compliant brands. Yet traders warn sustainability definitions and customer price acceptance remain uncertain, tempering immediate price pressure.

title: Harmony to buy Copper Mountain's Eva copper project for up to $230m
summary: Harmony Gold will acquire Copper Mountain Mining’s Eva copper project in northwest Queensland for up to $230m, including a $170m upfront payment and up to $60m contingent. The deal expands Harmony’s copper exposure and reserves, potentially supporting copper market sentiment despite no immediate production changes.

title: Aluminum Prices Stabilize, But Demand Remains Soft
summary: Aluminum prices rebounded early October after a late-September bottom, but the article highlights weakening demand signals: Japan’s aluminum premiums for October–December fell versus earlier producer offers and declined for a fourth straight quarter. Physical delivery premiums across regions are sliding, while global primary output—led by China—keeps rising.

title: Anglo American says it is worried about delays at new Peru copper mine
summary: Anglo American said it is worried about potential delays at its new Quellaveco copper mine in Peru after the government signaled it may re-examine water permits amid local farmers’ concerns. Quellaveco is set to start commercial operations this year and produce ~300,000 tonnes of copper annually, so delays could affect copper supply timing.

title: SMM Review of LME Copper during the National Day Holiday_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reviews LME copper around China’s National Day holiday: it rose on weaker USD and supportive policy signals, then fell after oil rose and US data/Fed guidance revived rate-hike expectations. Inventories stayed relatively low, with limited domestic build. Despite expectations of higher future supply, SMM sees copper rangebound.

title: Copper Inventories in Domestic Bonded Zones Dipped 7,000 mt from September 30_SMM
summary: SMM data show China’s domestic bonded-zone copper inventories fell 7,000 mt from Sept 30 to 51,700 mt by Oct 9. Shanghai dropped 5,000 mt to 41,700 mt and Guangdong fell 2,000 mt to 10,000 mt. The inventory decline was limited by holiday warehouse suspensions, but arrivals may follow after operations resume.

title: What will Happen to Nickel Prices after LME Nickel Rebounded during National Day Holiday?_SMM
summary: SMM reports nickel rose after the LME banned Russian metals during last week, despite a 4.5% drop on Friday. European energy stress and a still-tight refined nickel market support prices. LME inventories fell about 954 mt week-on-week, and stable overseas production limits supply, though liquidity and policy uncertainty may cause volatility.

title: SMM Copper Inventory across Major Chinese Markets Added 16,500 mt Compared with the Pre-holiday Period_SMM
summary: SMM said copper inventory across major Chinese markets rose by 16,500 mt to 82,700 mt after the National Day holiday, less than last year but still a post-holiday build. It also expects inventories to increase further before/after SHFE 2210 delivery as discounts and contract spreads encourage smelter deliveries.

title: SMM Analysis from Macro and Fundamentals Perspectives: SHFE Aluminium to Still Obtain Support from Fundamentals after the National Day Holiday_SMM
summary: SMM reports SHFE aluminium is supported after the National Day holiday by tightened supply—European smelters constrained by high power costs and China’s recent capacity cuts in Sichuan and Yunnan—alongside improving downstream orders and near-all-time-low domestic ingot inventories. Despite cost pressure, price volatility may rise with macro news and LME views on Russian metal trading.

title: Citibank Expects Lower Copper and Nickel Prices in Q1 2023_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Citibank expects weaker commodity pricing in Q1 2023, forecasting copper at $6,200/mt and nickel at $18,000/mt. The bank also downgraded aluminum (and zinc) with an aluminum target of $2,000/mt, signaling broadly bearish expectations that could weigh on industrial metals sentiment.

title: Citibank Expects Lower Copper and Nickel Prices in Q1 2023_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Citibank lowered its Q1 2023 outlook, expecting copper to drop to $6,200/mt and nickel to $18,000/mt. It also downgraded aluminum (and zinc) from a neutral view, projecting aluminum at $2,000/mt for Q1 2023. The revisions suggest bearish sentiment toward these metals.

title: Minerals Council wants tax cut for resources sector to exploit critical materials lithium, copper and rare earths
summary: Australia’s Minerals Council urges the federal government to cut the company tax rate to 25% and make machinery expensing permanent to attract private investment in resources. It argues this would strengthen exports of minerals for decarbonisation and digitisation, including copper, potentially supporting copper sentiment.

title: Aluminum Premiums in Japan Fell 33% in Q4 2022, Highlighting Weak Demand and Abundant Inventory_SMM
summary: Japanese buyers agreed to price Q4 2022 aluminum in Japan at a $99/mt premium over the LME cash price, down 33% from Q3. The continuing decline reflects weak demand, high domestic inventories, slower auto recovery tied to semiconductors, and oversupply concerns amid recession worries.

title: Potential Russian Aluminium Ban might Induce a Turning Point in Aluminium Prices_SMM
summary: SMM reports LME is discussing conditions for a potential ban on new deliveries of Russian metals, which could rebalance global aluminium supply and ease price suppression if Russian output can’t reach LME. It also points to continued regional smelter curbs from high energy costs and further cuts, expecting aluminium prices to rise.

title: Pure Nickel Premiums Rose amid Scarce Sources_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says pure nickel spot prices in Shanghai were quoted at premiums versus SHFE 2211, with Jinchuan premiums averaging about 9,250 yuan/mt and rising sharply. NORNICKEL premiums also increased. Traders cited low inventories and scarce Jinchuan supply. Nickel briquette prices fell and nickel sulphate from briquette had weak transactions.

title: Stellantis Signs Non-Binding MOU with GME for Future Offtake of Battery Grade Nickel and Cobalt Sulphate
summary: Stellantis has signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding with GME for future offtake of battery-grade nickel and cobalt sulphate. While the deal is not binding, it signals incremental demand for battery materials, which is supportive for nickel market sentiment over the coming days to weeks.

title: Carmaker Stellantis strikes nickel, cobalt supply deal for battery production
summary: Stellantis said it signed a non-binding agreement with GME to secure raw-material supplies, including nickel and cobalt sulphate, for electric vehicle battery production. The arrangement may lift market expectations for nickel availability and battery-related demand, supporting nickel prices in the near term despite the deal’s non-binding nature.

title: Stellantis agrees nickel and cobalt supply deal | Companies
summary: Stellantis and GME Resources signed a non-binding memorandum for future sales of battery-grade nickel and cobalt sulphate from Western Australia’s NiWest nickel-cobalt project. Stellantis targets higher BEV mixes under its Dare Forward 2030 plan. The deal is subject to customary approvals and conditions, making timing uncertain.

title: Stellantis agrees nickel and cobalt supply deal
summary: Stellantis signed a non-binding preliminary agreement with GME Resources to secure supplies of nickel and cobalt sulphate for EV batteries. The supply is tied to GME’s NiWest project in Western Australia with planned battery-grade output. A feasibility study is set to start, potentially supporting nickel demand expectations.

title: Downstream Companies were Unwilling to Purchase Goods amid the Expanding Spread between the SHFE Copper Contracts, thus Quotes of Copper Cathode in North China Fell Today_SMM
summary: After the National Day holiday, the spread between front-month and next-month SHFE copper contracts widened, making downstream buyers cautious and reluctant to purchase. As a result, copper cathode premiums in North China fell sharply to average about +90 yuan/mt, with trade around 62,500 yuan/mt, and quotations were lowered or discounted. Premiums are expected to drop further before delivery.

title: Gravita starts Aluminium Recycling Plant in Senegal
summary: Gravita India’s Senegal subsidiary has started commercial production at a new aluminium recycling plant with ~4,000 MTPA capacity. The firm expects additional annual revenue of about Rs. 60 crores and ~20% gross margins. The new recycling output increases availability of aluminium from secondary sources in West Africa.

title: Aluminium and the energy crisis: Is it time for politicians to step in?
summary: An aluminium industry CEO says rising electricity and gas prices—exacerbated by Europe’s gas shortages and the merit-order power pricing system—are the toughest test in the sector’s history. He notes some firms are already cutting production and urges rapid EU/Germany energy price caps to prevent closures and carbon leakage.

title: Copper firms, but demand prospects weigh on sentiment
summary: Copper prices rose, supported by renewed concerns over copper availability in LME warehouses (higher cancelled warrants) and a wider cash premium. However, Chinese demand worries, expectations of further U.S. rate hikes, a stronger dollar, and rising inventories weighed on sentiment. Aluminium and nickel fell on the day amid the same macro backdrop.

title: UK court says Elliott, Jane Street can sue LME for cancelled nickel trades
summary: A UK court approved U.S. hedge funds Elliott Associates and Jane Street to sue the LME over cancelled nickel trades from March, when nickel hit a record above $100,000/t and the LME suspended trading and voided contracts. Damages demands are sizable, though the ruling is procedural.

title: UK Court Says Elliott, Jane Street Can Sue LME For Cancelled Nickel Trades
summary: A UK court permitted hedge funds Elliott and Jane Street to sue the LME over cancelled nickel trades from March. The dispute followed the nickel price exceeding $100,000/tonne and the LME suspending trading and voiding transactions. The ruling is procedural; the LME will file its defence within 28 days.

title: Comex Copper Settles 1.20% Higher at $3.4535 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper front-month for October delivery settled 1.20% higher at $3.4535 per pound, gaining 4.10 cents. The move snapped a two-session losing streak and marked a strong one-day dollar/percentage gain. The contract is up eight of the past 10 sessions and slightly positive month-to-date.

title: How Is Aluminium Market amid Disturbances in China and Abroad and Improving Consumption?_SMM
summary: SMM reports disturbances in aluminium markets driven by production cuts (Hydro in Norway, European curtailments, and China’s Yunnan/Sichuan reductions) and an LME discussion on potentially banning new Russian metals supply. Despite weaker demand and higher LME/Chinese inventories, supply tightening and rising costs are expected to support aluminium prices near term.

title: SHFE Nickel Prices were High in the Morning and Spot Transactions were Weak_SMM
summary: SMM reports that SHFE nickel futures rose in the morning, lifting spot prices roughly 8,000 yuan/mt. Jinchuan nickel premiums increased to an average of 9,750 yuan/mt, while Nornickel premiums fell. Nickel briquette prices rose but transactions weakened as demand/market effectiveness deteriorated.

title: Global Nickel Supply and Demand Outlook 2017-2027 and the Release of Battery Grade Nickel Sulphate Price Index
summary: The piece discusses the rationale for launching SMM’s Battery Grade Nickel Sulfate Price Index and how it may be used in market scenarios. It examines whether nickel intermediate products could displace nickel briquettes in nickel sulfate production and whether capacity using different feedstocks could face near-term constraints.

title: Worker Strike at South African Ports might lead to Falling Copper Anode Shipments to China_SMM
summary: Transnet declared force majeure after South African port workers went on strike over a wage dispute. The disruption is expected to reduce copper anode shipments to China and tighten copper anode supply locally. That should raise pressure on domestic copper anode RCs, though SMM expects the strike may be short-lived.

title: LME copper eases on firmer dollar
summary: LME copper slipped 0.2% and aluminium fell 0.4% as a stronger U.S. dollar, supported by robust labour data and sticky inflation expectations, increased costs for non-dollar buyers. Nickel rose on China’s SHFE, showing mixed momentum across venues rather than a uniform market move.

title: Lotte Chemical to buy major Korean copper foil producer
summary: Lotte Chemical will buy a 53.3% stake in Iljin Materials for 2.7 trillion won, seeking to expand into battery components. Iljin makes copper foil used as an anode current collector, with planned capacity growth and long-term supply contracts, supporting expectations for higher near-term copper demand.

title: MAX Resource Corp.: Max Resource Announces Commencement of Drill Program at URU, CESAR Copper-Silver Project in NE Colombia
summary: MAX Resource announced the start of an inaugural drill program at its URU-C and URU-CE copper-silver targets within the Cesar project in northeastern Colombia, including reported visible chalcocite and channel assay highlights. The news signals exploration progress but does not change near-term copper supply or inventories.

title: Russian aluminium producer Rusal reshuffles sales team
summary: Rusal, a major Russian aluminium producer, reshuffled its sales team as sanctions and market access concerns grow. Some consumers previously indicated they would not buy Rusal aluminium for 2023, while the LME discussed a possible ban of Russian aluminium from trading. Rusal says supplies remain stable.

title: Flying Nickel Mining Corp.: Flying Nickel Drills 69.6 Meters Grading 1.10% Nickel, 0.60 g/t PGM at the Minago Nickel Project in Canada's Thompson Nickel Belt
summary: Flying Nickel Mining reported assay results from three Minago nickel sulphide drill holes, including 69.6 meters grading 1.10% nickel with small copper content. The company plans further assays and metallurgical testing as part of a feasibility study. As an exploration update, it is unlikely to materially change near-term nickel or copper supply expectations.

title: Copper staggers lower on recession fears and firmer dollar
summary: Base metals dropped as recession fears and rising COVID-19 cases in China raised concerns about weaker demand. A stronger dollar also pressured USD-priced commodities. LME aluminium fell, while copper initially slipped but later edged up; Comex copper rose. Nickel declined, reflecting the overall risk-off sentiment.

title: GM invests in Australian metals project to secure nickel, cobalt
summary: GM plans to invest up to $69 million in Queensland Pacific Metals’ Townsville Energy Chemicals Hub to secure nickel for its Ultium EV batteries. The deal is intended to ensure cost-competitive supply of nickel (and cobalt) for growing EV production, supporting longer-dated sourcing and potential market sentiment for nickel.

title: Comex Copper Settles 0.71% Higher at $3.4780 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper futures for October delivery settled 0.71% higher at $3.4780, gaining 2.45 cents per pound. The contract was up for two consecutive sessions, with gains totaling 6.55 cents or 1.92% over two sessions, reflecting modest bullish momentum in copper prices.

title: Electric vehicles: General Motors takes a big stake in Queensland Pacific Metals nickel play
summary: General Motors will take a major stake in Queensland Pacific Metals, investing up to $69 million. The funding is intended to secure nickel and cobalt sulfate supply for GM’s electric vehicles. The move signals increased near-term demand expectations for nickel feedstock, supportive for nickel prices.

title: SHFE Nickel Fell in the Early Trading, and the Spot Trading was Poor_SMM
summary: SMM reports that on Oct 12 SHFE nickel fell early, while spot nickel remained on a downward trend. Jinchuan nickel premiums rose slightly, but overall spot activity was average with weak transactions.
