title: Nickel Inventories in Domestic Bonded Zone Dip 700 mt from October 21_SMM
summary: SMM said China’s bonded zone nickel inventory fell by 700 mt to 3,900 mt in the week to Oct 28. Nickel briquette stocks were 1,050 mt and nickel plate 2,850 mt. Spot pure nickel imports weakened, but some briquettes cleared customs on demand from nickel sulphate producers despite off-season plate demand.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports Up 289,000 wmt WoW_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says nickel ore inventories at Chinese ports rose 289,000 wmt to 8.55 million wmt (67,000 mt Ni content) as October purchases before the Philippine rainy season arrived. Port stocks are expected to keep increasing short term, though growth may be capped by rainy-season disruptions in the Philippines and later decline.

title: Europe's Top Copper Producer Aurubis Is Hit by Cyberattack
summary: The headline says Europe’s top copper producer Aurubis was hit by a cyberattack. Such an event can disrupt smelting/refining operations and affect near-term copper supply availability, often pushing expectations toward tighter inventories and supporting copper prices in the first days after the disruption.

title: Aldel aluminium smelter declared bankrupt as energy prices bite
summary: DutchNews.nl reports that the Aldel aluminium smelter in Delfzijl was declared bankrupt shortly after court protection. Operations had already been curtailed, citing high energy prices and insufficient government support. The closure leaves about 120 workers without jobs and previously stopped processing imported aluminium, reducing supply.

title: Nevada Copper Closes Restart Financing Package and
summary: Nevada Copper closed a restart financing package totaling up to US$123m to fund and ramp up its Pumpkin Hollow underground copper mine and processing operations underway. Financing includes equity, royalty/stream adjustments, KfW facility extension, and working-capital support, improving near-term expectations for copper production and supply.

title: Teck Resources hikes cost of QB2 copper project in Chile again
summary: Teck Resources increased the construction cost estimate for its Quebrada Blanca phase 2 (QB2) copper project in Chile again, adding at least US$500 million. The project’s revised economics raise the prospect of delays or slower progress, which can tighten near-term copper supply expectations and support prices.

title: Nevada Copper Closes Restart Financing Package and Announces Appointment of Randy Buffington to Board of Directors
summary: Nevada Copper says it has closed a restart financing package providing up to about US$123 million to support the restart and ramp-up of its Pumpkin Hollow underground copper mine. This improves short-term prospects for copper production after financing was secured, which can be modestly bullish for copper prices.

title: LMEWEEK-Citi pumps aluminium into LME warehouse system, sources say
summary: Citibank deposited bulk aluminium into LME warehouses in early October as higher interest rates reduced profitability of financing trades and some deals expired. LME aluminium stocks more than doubled, backwardation/premiums eased, and analysts cited slowing demand—together pointing to increased near-term supply and bearish sentiment for aluminium.

title: Chile: Leading copper producer reports 10.4% drop in output
summary: Chile’s Codelco reported copper output fell 10.4% in the first three quarters of 2022 to 1.062 million tons. The drop was driven by lower ore grades, reduced activity, weaker recovery at concentrator plants, and operational difficulties at Chuquicamata smelter/refinery following structural issues.

title: SHFE Aluminium Vulnerable to Decline amid Bearish Sentiment_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports SHFE and LME aluminium fell on the week, with bearish sentiment driven by ECB/Fed tightening expectations, fears of global recession, COVID disruption to downstream demand and logistics, and weaker cost support from lower alumina and thermal coal. EU gas strength may boost smelter output, but overall downside risk persists.

title: Alumina Prices still in Downward Trajectory amid Strong Pessimism _SMM
summary: SMM says the weighted alumina index fell to 2,792 yuan/mt, with most regions down on the week. Some losses and shutdowns capped declines, but import windows remain difficult and more capacity is set to release in Shandong, implying a north China surplus. Southwest output cuts could pressure further, keeping the market pessimistic.

title: Aluminium Costs Declined amid Falling Alumina Prices, Eyes on Coal Market _SMM
summary: SMM says alumina prices inched lower, and thermal coal also fell slightly, while smelter electricity prices were broadly stable. Lower feedstock costs reduced total aluminium smelting costs by 52 yuan/mt and narrowed profit declines, with A00 at 18,300 yuan/mt. Electricity remains the key cost driver, limiting longer-term easing.

title: Nickel Prices Bore Huge Pressure from the Macro Front last Week_SMM
summary: SMM reports nickel faced heavy downward pressure from the macro front after US jobless claims and real GDP growth beat expectations, weakening expectations of slower Fed rate hikes. On supply, liquidity improved, but downstream demand slightly weakened: stainless spot prices fell and high nickel curbed alloy buying, limiting support.

title: Pure Nickel Inventory Grew due to the Poor Spot Trading_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data shows pure nickel inventories in six Chinese regions rose to 7,050 mt last week, up 1,151 mt week-on-week. Nickel briquette stocks increased to 650 mt, and nickel plate inventories rose to 6,400 mt. Higher inventories reflect softer downstream demand and shifting bonded-to-domestic supplies.

title: Nickel Prices Rose first and then Fell last Week amid the Macro Pressure_SMM
summary: In October, China’s pure nickel supply stayed tight amid renewed COVID outbreaks and low trader margins, but last week liquidity improved as SHFE nickel and spot premiums fell. Import profits weakened on surging overseas prices. Downstream stainless/alloy demand was sluggish and off-season approached, leaving sufficient supply and bearish price pressure.

title: Copper Extends Losses on Factory Slump in China, Dollar's Gain
summary: The piece reports that copper prices are extending losses, attributing the decline to China’s factory slump and gains in the U.S. dollar. Softer Chinese industrial activity can reduce near-term demand expectations, while a firmer dollar often pressures commodities by making them costlier for non-dollar buyers.

title: Operating margin of aluminium producers to decline 12 percentage points in 2022-23: Crisil
summary: Crisil Ratings expects Indian aluminium producers’ operating margins to fall by over 1,200 bps to 22–24% in 2022-23, down from 36% last fiscal. The deterioration is attributed to lower realizations and higher production costs, mainly power, which may weigh on supply conditions and sentiment for aluminium prices.

title: Capstone Copper Reports Third Quarter 2022 Results
summary: Capstone Copper reported Q3 2022 copper output of 45.7 kt and highlighted cost inflation pressures, including high sulphuric acid and diesel, alongside declining realized copper prices. The company noted additional 2023 copper hedges and progress on the Mantoverde project, while provisional pricing losses reduced earnings.

title: Kuusakoski: new copper centre to recycle all cables in Finland
summary: Kuusakoski is investing in a new Finnish copper centre to recycle copper- and aluminium-containing cables, radiators and transformers. The plant will crush and separate material and produce cleaner copper and aluminium fractions, claiming ~40 tons of copper per week capacity. Completion is targeted for 2023, enhancing recycled supply locally.

title: Looming Copper Shortage Could Slow The Global Energy Transition
summary: Freeport-McMoRan and analysts warn a significant copper shortage could emerge as energy transition-driven demand rises faster than limited mine supply development. The company says current prices are insufficient to fund new projects, with few major new supplies beyond delayed COVID-era starts. Wood Mackenzie projects a large future deficit without heavy investment.

title: Capstone Copper Corp.: Capstone Copper Reports Third Quarter 2022 Results
summary: Capstone Copper reported Q3 2022 results, including quarterly copper production of 45.7k tonnes and C1 cash costs of $2.76/lb. The quarter saw a lower realized copper price and provisional pricing losses alongside inflationary cost pressures, with input costs like sulphuric acid trending lower. Additional copper hedges were added for 2023.

title: Comex Copper Ends the Month 0.83% Lower at $3.4135 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for November delivery ended the month at $3.4135, down 0.83% (2.85 cents/lb). The contract is down for seven consecutive months, with weakness in recent sessions, and the lowest settlement value since Oct. 19, 2022, reflecting bearish near-term price pressure in copper.

title: Nevada Copper closes financing for Pumpkin Hollow
summary: Nevada Copper has closed a new financing package that brings its Pumpkin Hollow underground copper mine in Nevada closer to restart and ramp-up. The update relates to funding for the two fully permitted components, an underground mine and processing facility, improving near-term production outlook for copper.

title: SMM Analysis of China September Copper Concentrate and Copper Semis Imports_SMM
summary: SMM cites China customs data showing September imports of unwrought copper and copper semis rose 25.6% YoY and 2.4% MoM, linked to traditional peak-season demand and attractive import margins. Copper concentrate imports rose from Peru on Las Bambas recovery, while Chile volumes fell due to mine grade declines, water issues, and accidents.

title: SHFE Nickel Fell on Contracting Downstream Demand_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports SHFE nickel prices falling as upstream sellers become more willing to offer while downstream demand remains weak. Pure nickel spot premiums and nickel briquette prices drop. For NPI, large “invisible” inventory risks future pressure. Alloy-sector civil orders fall, so nickel demand stays soft.

title: China's Imports of Copper Anode Decreased in September_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports China imported 84,800 mt of copper anode in September, down 16.67% MoM, citing reduced shipments from Zambia, Congo (DRC), and South Africa. Maintenance at Zambia/DRC smelters, a CCS production accident, and a Durban Port strike disrupted African anode and blister copper exports, though operations are recovering.

title: Copper Scrap Traders' Active Shipment Failed to Improve the Supply Tightness in China_SMM
summary: China’s copper scrap imports rose in September to 167,000 mt (+7.99% MoM) and 1.36 million mt over Jan–Sep (+9.97% YoY), helped by higher LME copper prices boosting overseas shipments. Despite the higher inflows, domestic supply tightness persisted due to COVID disruptions, so SMM expects imports to stay near current levels.

title: Transactions of Spot Pure Nickel were Thin as Prices were High in the Morning_SMM
summary: SMM reports that on Nov 1 spot pure nickel premiums were much higher, with Jinchuan premiums averaging 8,250 yuan/mt and NORNICKEL averaging 4,250 yuan/mt, both up sharply day-on-day. Spot prices rose in the morning on favourable news, though trade was thin and nickel briquette transactions were weak.

title: Copper faces long-term SHORTAGE as experts expect demand to exceed supply in the coming years
summary: BHP’s CEO warns of a timing mismatch where demand for decarbonization metals rises before supply can scale up, implying an eventual copper shortage. Trafigura notes copper stockpiles cover only about 4.9 days of consumption and could fall further. Multiple research reports project large mine-supply gaps, supporting a copper price rebound view.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Initiates 10,000-metre Drill Program at Copper Creek in Arizona
summary: Faraday Copper Corp. started a planned 10,000-metre Phase II diamond drill program at its Copper Creek copper project in Arizona. The work aims to expand the open-pit resource, delineate underground zones, support metallurgical testwork, and add monitoring infrastructure and new targets. No production changes are announced.

title: European steel and aluminium sectors call for cautious implementation of carbon import levy
summary: EU sectors call for cautious implementation of the CBAM/ETS as part of “Fit for 55”. CBAM would charge importers for emissions certificates from 2026, initially for aluminium and other high-carbon sectors, while companies warn soaring carbon costs and energy prices have already driven unprecedented aluminium capacity idling.

title: First nickel MHP assessment shows demand remains strong with domestic Chinese nickel sulfate prices rising
summary: Fastmarkets’ first nickel MHP assessment finds strong international supply/demand with rising MHP payables (75-78% assessed; offers near ~80%). Limited MHP conversion/refining capacity and a nickel sulfate supply-demand deficit lifted nickel sulfate prices in China for a second week. Underlying LME nickel strength also supported gains.

title: Ero Copper Reports Third Quarter 2022 Operating and Financial Results
summary: Ero Copper reported Q3 2022 results, including 11,189 tonnes of copper production and ongoing cost pressure, noting a $10.3m impact from final settlements on provisionally priced copper concentrate sales and higher operating costs. The firm also disclosed progress and financing guidance for growth projects and ongoing nickel exploration.

title: Odd coalition of Dems, GOP question governor's plan to give company millions for aluminum plant | State Government
summary: Mississippi lawmakers are debating Gov. Tate Reeves’ plan to provide about $240 million in taxpayer incentives for a company to build a new aluminum plant in the Golden Triangle. Democrats and Republicans criticize the lack of detail and vetting, but the deal is unlikely to be stopped, supporting near-term aluminum production expectations.

title: Yangshan Copper Trading Remained Sluggish as Goods Available in the Market were Scarce_SMM
summary: SMM reports Yangshan copper premiums quoted at $135–150/mt under warrants, largely flat day-on-day, with bill-of-lading premiums also steady to slightly higher. The import market is slack, but tight supply of available goods keeps sellers aiming for higher prices, sustaining physical copper support. LME cash to 3M at $65/mt; import losses ~300 yuan/mt.

title: Fabled Copper Corp.: Fabled Copper Reports on the Brad Vein Area with Values as High as 16.05% Copper
summary: Fabled Copper Corp. reported 2022 surface sampling results from its Muskwa Copper Project in northern British Columbia, including multiple rock samples above 0.5% copper and peak assays up to 16.05% copper with gold and silver. The company plans follow-up releases, but no production or supply change is announced.

title: Copper stuck between factory slump and China demand hopes
summary: Copper prices edged lower as bleak near-term manufacturing and metals demand outweighed hopes that China may ease COVID-19 controls next year. Global risk sentiment weakened ahead of a large U.S. rate hike, likely stifling activity. Tight supply and low inventories were cited as support, leaving overall bias mixed.

title: Ghana's Sole Aluminum Smelter Shuts as Pay Strike Threatens Safety
summary: The report says Ghana’s sole aluminum smelter has shut down as a pay strike threatens safety. With one of the key local primary production sources offline, short-term aluminum supply availability may tighten, likely supporting near-term aluminium prices on expectations of reduced output and higher costs.

title: Mississippi lawmakers eye incentives for aluminum plant
summary: Mississippi lawmakers are reportedly considering incentives to encourage development of an aluminum plant. Production incentives typically strengthen the case for new or expanded capacity, supporting near-term expectations for aluminum demand from construction/start-up activity and potential supply outlook.

title: Steel Dynamics Announces Planned State-of-the-Art Aluminum Flat Rolled Mill Site Selection
summary: Steel Dynamics selected Columbus, Mississippi for a greenfield aluminum flat-rolled mill using recycled scrap, targeting 650,000 tonnes of output and product lines for packaging and automotive. The project is expected to start mid-2025, and is positioned as a decarbonized expansion to meet customer co-location needs and supply-chain advantages.

title: Mississippi lawmakers push incentives for aluminum plant
summary: Mississippi lawmakers are seeking approval of nearly $247 million in state incentives for an aluminum plant tied to Steel Dynamics. The project is expected to create around 1,000 jobs by 2029. While company details are undisclosed, the policy push is likely supportive for aluminum investment sentiment.

title: Possible change in China's zero-Covid policy drives base metals prices up; nickel up 8.2%
summary: Base metals prices rose on Tuesday after widespread rumors that China might change/ease its zero-Covid policy. Three-month futures gained for copper (+2.7%), aluminium (+0.9%), and nickel (+8.2%). Analysts said reopening hopes lifted China risk assets and triggered short covering; nickel additionally benefited from strong EV sales.

title: Energy: BHP signs French developer for 24/7 "renewable energy  baseload" to power Olympic dam copper mine
summary: BHP has signed a deal with Neoen for a 70-megawatt “renewable energy baseload” contract to supply round-the-clock electricity to its Olympic Dam copper mine from mid-2025. The wind-plus-battery power will cover about half of the mine’s expected power needs, improving energy supply reliability.

title: Arizona Sonoran Copper rises on thick Parks-Salyer drill hit
summary: Arizona Sonoran Copper says its Parks-Salyer porphyry copper deposit infill drilling returned a 217.7-metre intercept grading 1.01% copper, from multiple additional holes. The updated drilling results bolster confidence in the project’s copper resource potential, which can support sentiment toward copper markets.

title: Lawmakers finalize incentive to bring aluminum mill to Lowndes County
summary: Mississippi lawmakers finalized incentive funding to attract Steel Dynamics’ $2.5 billion aluminum mill complex in Lowndes County. The project is expected to create about 1,000 jobs in seven years and includes multiple facilities. Officials cite workforce training and potential co-located industries, boosting near-term confidence for aluminium-related demand.

title: Thunder Gold Corp. Announces Amended Agreement for the Okohongo Copper Property, Namibia
summary: Thunder Gold announced an amended option agreement for its 95% interest in the Okohongo copper-silver property in Namibia. The deal includes exploration plans, royalties, and milestone payments tied to defining a large copper resource. It does not announce production changes, exports, or policy that would materially affect near-term copper prices.

title: SMM Analysis of Changes in China Aluminium Extrusion Output in 2022_SMM
summary: SMM expects China’s aluminium extrusion output in 2022 to fall 3.86% to 20.11 million mt, mainly due to a sharp drop in construction aluminium extrusion from pandemic-related disruptions and a real estate downturn. Industrial extrusion grows on PV and new energy vehicle demand, but overall output reverses upward trends.

title: Copper eases as Fed's Powell sends prolonged hawkish signals
summary: Copper prices fell as markets digested a hawkish Fed stance signaling prolonged policy tightening, weakening risk sentiment and near-term demand expectations. China’s elevated COVID cases added pressure on industrial and construction activity. The report also notes lower tin and lead, with aluminium dipping and nickel edging up.

title: Aston Bay Holdings Ltd: Aston Bay Announces New Assays Confirming Significant High-Grade Copper at Storm Project, Nunavut
summary: Aston Bay reported final 2022 assay results confirming near-surface high-grade copper at the Storm Project in Nunavut, including multiple strong intercepts (e.g., 19m @ 2.08% Cu). Management says the mineralized envelope may expand and further drilling and beneficiation work are planned for future resource definition and potential direct shipping.

title: Nevada Copper Provides Pumpkin Hollow Update on Restart of
summary: Nevada Copper reported progress toward restarting its Pumpkin Hollow underground mine, including completion of restart financing, development of higher-grade stopes, and capital project work such as ore bin, dewatering, vent shaft and fans. It also secured a long-lead item (jaw crusher) and expects contractor award soon, supporting future copper output prospects.

title: Vedanta Balco tests biodiesel as green fuel alternative for its aluminium smelter
summary: Balco (Vedanta) conducted successful trial runs using biodiesel at its aluminium smelter to preheat molten-metal ladles by reducing moisture before casting. The company frames this as part of its decarbonization plan, including higher renewables/biomass use. The report provides no production impact or timelines.

title: Mississippi lawmakers approve incentives for aluminum plant
summary: Mississippi lawmakers approved nearly $247 million in incentives for an aluminum mill project by Steel Dynamics, including a flat-rolled aluminium production facility and related industrial units. The state says the project is a major job creator with $2.5 billion investment and includes roads, land help, and income tax rebates.

title: Chile copper production down 4.27% in September
summary: Chile’s major copper producers reported weaker output in September. Codelco production fell 7.92% y/y to 123,200 tonnes, and Collahuasi declined 3.5% to 44,500 tonnes. Escondida rose 3.51% to 85,500 tonnes, but overall the headline points to reduced supply growth.

title: Los Andes Copper Ltd.
summary: Investor insight says copper demand is rising due to global electrification and expects markets to stay in deficit. It describes Los Andes Copper’s Vizcachitas project in Chile, highlighting funding and strong project economics, which may support bullish sentiment for copper, though no immediate production change is indicated.

title: Developers are eager to get the aluminum plant up and running
summary: Mississippi lawmakers approved funding to support site preparation for a planned $2.5 billion aluminum mill near Lowndes County, including $81 million upfront for development needs such as land, environmental/engineering work, and some road/bridge repairs. Developers expect ground to break in December, with operations targeted for 2026.

title: Copper prices jump nearly 2% on global supply woes
summary: Copper rallied about 2% as hopes grow that China will ease COVID curbs, boosting demand sentiment. Investors also reacted to supply jitters: Peru’s Las Bambas mine began reducing operations amid blockades, while LME and SHFE copper inventories fell, underscoring tight market conditions.

title: SHFE Aluminium Maintains Momentum on Easing Supply Pressure and Falling Aluminium Ingot Inventory_SMM
summary: SHFE aluminium gained after the Fed’s hike was largely digested, while aluminium prices were supported by easing supply pressure—rumored production cuts at Henan following other provinces—and continued destocking. Social inventories fell sharply and spot premiums stayed elevated despite weaker downstream buying, keeping aluminium near range highs.

title: SMM Forecast for China Aluminium Plate/Sheet, Strip and Foil Output in 2022_SMM
summary: SMM estimates China’s aluminium plate/sheet and strip output in 2022 at 12.9 million mt (+2% YoY), with aluminium foil output at 4.75 million mt (+3%). Food packaging and NEV-driven battery/auto semis support growth, while some foil types fall due to weak margins and demand.

title: Copper Inventories in Domestic Bonded Zones Up 1,200 mt from October 28_SMM
summary: SMM said Chinese domestic bonded copper inventories rose 1,200 mt from Oct 28 to Nov 4, reaching 30,900 mt. Shanghai bonded stocks increased while Guangdong declined. The build is attributed to port arrivals and arbitrage as BC copper prices exceeded domestic prices, prompting inflows into INE warehouses.

title: Constellium SE: Constellium to Join the First Movers Coalition, Supporting the Aluminium Industry's Transition to Decarbonization
summary: Constellium said it is joining the First Movers Coalition to decarbonize the aluminium industry, aiming that by 2030 10% of its primary aluminium purchases are near-zero emissions and at least 50% of its aluminium inputs are recycled. It highlights sustainability targets but provides no short-term pricing impact.

title: Copper Soars by Most Since 2016 on China Reopening Hopes, Dollar Slump
summary: Copper rose sharply, posting its biggest gain since 2016, driven by optimism around China’s reopening and a slump in the US dollar. The combination of improved growth-demand sentiment for industrial metals and weaker currency support tends to boost buying and short-term price momentum for copper.

title: Gold futures settle higher after strong jobs report; copper gains 7.5% on China reopening speculation
summary: Gold futures rose after the October jobs report weakened the U.S. dollar. Copper futures surged 7.6% to the highest since late August, with the week up 7.5%. Analysts linked the rally to speculation that China could ease COVID restrictions, improving demand expectations for industrial metals.

title: Collapse Of Asia's Largest Aluminum Producer Leaves Massive Hole In Market
summary: Zhongwang Holdings, described as Asia’s largest aluminum extrusion producer, has declared bankruptcy after large debts and a prior US duty-evasion case. Traders expect plant takeovers and possible shutdowns, potentially leaving a major domestic aluminum supply hole despite softening demand, supporting higher near-term aluminum prices.

title: Novelis Breaks Ground on Aluminum Recycling Center in South Korea to Expand Sustainable, Low-Carbon Aluminum Production
summary: Novelis broke ground on a $50m aluminum recycling center in South Korea with 100,000 tons/year capacity, expected online in 2024. The project expands recycling capacity by over 20% to 440 kt in Korea and increases processing of different scrap types, aiming to supply low-carbon aluminum sheet using more recycled content.

title: Cannindah Resources Limited  182m of Thick Massive Copper in Hole 14
summary: Cannindah Resources announced assay results from drilling at the Mt Cannindah copper-gold-silver project, with hole 14 intersecting thick massive copper (182m) and multiple high-grade zones. The company says mineralization extends laterally and supports further drilling/exploration in coming months.

title: Smelters' Profits Shrank amid Plummeting Aluminium Prices_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that alumina prices fell, but aluminium smelter costs rose due to higher electricity/thermal power costs, with weighted average power price climbing to 0.463 yuan/kWh. Although full costs increased to 17,890 yuan/mt, A00-based real-time profits fell to 390 yuan/mt as aluminium prices dropped, suggesting bearish near-term sentiment.

title: Low Inventories and Expectations for Output Cuts by High-Cost Smelters to Sustain Aluminium Price Rally in the Short Term_SMM
summary: SMM reports tight aluminium ingot inventories reaching new lows and widening spot premiums. Several aluminium smelters in Henan and Shandong plan heating-season capacity cuts (~200,000 mt) due to cost pressure and environmental requirements. With demand improving and profitability weak, near-term supply tightness is expected to support aluminium prices.

title: US Fed's Rate Hikes and the Vigorous Domestic Market Boost the SHFE Copper Prices_SMM
summary: SMM reports copper gains after the US Fed signaled slower December hikes and strong ADP data boosted risk sentiment. Copper fundamentals also improved near term: LME and SHFE warrants fell, visible stocks stayed low, and a widening spread/short squeeze was seen supporting SHFE prices ahead of delivery.

title: Copper price wobbles as China dismisses COVID-19 reopening hopes
summary: Copper’s price “wobbled” after China dismissed hopes of easing COVID-19 restrictions. While a weaker US dollar briefly lifted metal prices on Monday, the overall move retraced Friday’s sharp rally driven by bets on stronger Chinese demand. Copper, tied to global activity, ended the session lower.

title: Aluminium Ingot Inventory Hits Lowest in 2022, but Rose in Some Areas_SMM
summary: China’s aluminium ingot social inventories in eight major markets fell to 571,000 mt on Nov 7, the lowest level in 2022, down from last Thursday and a month ago. Some areas rose on arrivals, but Wuxi and south China declined; transport restrictions and ongoing rigid downstream restocking underpin the drawdown.

title: Steel Dynamics Plans Columbus, Mississippi, Aluminum Flat Rolled Mill
summary: Steel Dynamics plans to build a next-generation recycled aluminium flat rolled mill in Columbus, Mississippi with 650,000 tonnes annual capacity. The project is supported by state financial assistance for site work and workforce training, positioning increased recycled aluminium supply for beverage packaging and automotive use.

title: Lowndes County officially approves of multi-billion dollar aluminum project
summary: Lowndes County, Mississippi approved resolutions supporting an $81 million upfront state investment and $245 million in bonds to enable a $2 billion aluminium mill project with Steel Dynamics/Aluminum Dynamics. The facility is expected to add about 1,000 jobs, but the timing of output is not specified, implying limited near-term price pressure.

title: Nickel market coverage at LME Week 2022
summary: Fastmarkets’ LME Week coverage says nickel dominated discussions due to high demand and ongoing market transition after the LME nickel contract suspension in March. It highlights investor focus on MHP and volatility, plus tight European nickel cathode supply risk tied to Russian-origin acceptance/sanctions concerns, with premiums remaining elevated.

title: SolGold, part-owned by BHP and Newcrest, has given up a royalty slice to help fund Cascabel copper project in Ecuador
summary: SolGold obtained $50 million in royalty financing via Osisko Gold Royalties to fund its Cascabel copper-gold project in Ecuador. The deal swaps funding for a 0.6% net smelter return royalty. With BHP and Newcrest as major shareholders, the update supports progress toward future copper supply.

title: Novelis breaks ground for aluminum recycling center in Ulsan
summary: Novelis broke ground on a $53 million aluminum recycling center in Ulsan, aiming to reduce carbon emissions and produce 100,000 tons of low-carbon sheet ingot annually from recycled content. Built by a Novelis-Kobe Steel JV, it is expected to begin operating in 2024, implying limited immediate price pressure.

title: Cobalt, nickel group Jervois Global readies $200m raising
summary: Jervois Global is planning a $200m equity raising with UBS to restart its Brazilian refinery. The company focuses on battery metals, including nickel group materials. Restarting refining capacity can ease near-term supply concerns, which may weigh on nickel price expectations over the coming days to weeks.

title: Yangshan Copper Trading Remained Sluggish due to the spot discounts_SMM
summary: SMM reports Yangshan copper spot premiums under warrants were flat, with LME cash to 3M around $10.25/mt and the import window open. Although the SHFE/LME ratio improved and LME backwardation narrowed, high domestic discounts suppressed buying, leaving few quotes and extremely slack transactions.

title: Spot Nickel Trading was Slack amid Fluctuating Spot Pure Nickel Prices_SMM
summary: SMM reports nickel spot trading was quiet on Nov 8. Jinchuan nickel premiums eased to about 5,650 yuan/mt, while NORNICKEL premiums rose slightly. Futures were stable. Imported pure nickel premiums rebounded on supply shortages, but nickel briquette trading remained slack as briquette prices stayed above nickel sulphate.

title: Ivanhoe Electric Inc.: Ivanhoe Electric Confirms East Ridge Discovery at Santa Cruz Copper Project in Arizona
summary: Ivanhoe Electric reported promising drilling results and an East Ridge oxide copper discovery at its Santa Cruz Copper Project in Arizona. Infill hole SCC-084 and step-out/parcel drilling returned high-grade copper intercepts and suggest the mineralization is open for expansion. Results will feed an updated mineral resource estimate.

title: Newcrest approves $140M expansion of Telfer gold-copper operation
summary: Newcrest approved an A$214 million (US$140 million) expansion of its Telfer gold-copper operations, including open pits and underground mines. The investment supports increased future copper production from the West Dome. Markets may price in higher supply expectations, weighing on copper sentiment in the near term.

title: Five appear for theft of copper cables worth R2m
summary: Five men allegedly hijacked a truck carrying copper cables worth about R2m and attempted to offload them using a hired forklift before police raided the warehouse. The driver was reportedly shot and killed. The court case was postponed, but there’s no indication of wider supply or pricing effects.

title: Joint Press Release: BASF and Moleaer™ partner to combine novel technologies in the field of mining to enhance copper recovery at existing mines
summary: BASF and Moleaer announced a partnership combining BASF’s LixTRA leaching reagent with Moleaer nanobubble technology to improve copper recovery from hard-to-leach chalcopyrite ores. The article cites rising copper demand and potential deficits, but it provides no immediate supply, mine output, or inventory changes.

title: BASF and Moleaer partner to combine novel technologies in the field of mining to enhance copper recovery at existing mines
summary: BASF and Moleaer announced a partnership to improve copper recovery from hard-to-leach primary sulfide ores using BASF’s LixTRA leaching aid and Moleaer’s nanobubble technology. The testing claims higher extraction rates for chalcopyrite heap leaching, potentially improving supply efficiency, but near-term output impact is unspecified.

title: Essential Geopolitics Podcast Indonesia's Plan for Nickel Ore
summary: An Essential Geopolitics podcast episode discusses Indonesia’s planned ban on raw ore exports, citing analysis that the government has decided to restrict exports of nickel ore. The move is expected to affect international nickel ore availability, potentially tightening supply and supporting near-term nickel pricing sentiment.

title: Councilman John Lee Seeks to Address Copper Wire Thefts from Street Lights
summary: Los Angeles Councilman John Lee highlighted a more-than-sixfold increase in theft and damage to street lighting systems, including copper wire theft that leaves neighborhoods without light for weeks or months. He requested enforcement and prosecution updates to strengthen the network. The higher theft-driven replacement demand is mildly supportive for copper.

title: Magna plans drilling at Denison nickel-copper project after 'considerable' resource estimate
summary: Magna Mining says its first resource estimate at the Denison Sudbury Basin project shows “significant potential” and plans additional drilling. The project targets nickel and copper, with the company exploring a restart of a past-producing underground mine. The news is more sentiment-driven than supply-increasing immediately.

title: Material Matters: Lithium, Copper & Steel
summary: The piece reports Goldman Sachs lowered copper price assumptions, expecting a 170,000-tonne refined surplus in 2023 driven by weak Chinese property and European industrial demand. Demand growth forecasts were reduced, while the firm notes visible stocks are at 18-year lows. Net effect is bearish copper sentiment near term.

title: Low Inventory and Slowing Output Growth Likely to Underpin Aluminium Price in Nov_SMM
summary: SMM reports aluminium prices softened in Sept-Oct but remain supported by weak supply and falling inventories. Overseas smelters cut output due to high natural gas costs, while Yunnan smelters reduced production for power shortages. With low social inventories around 500,000-600,000 mt in November, prices are expected to find support.

title: China Metallurgical-Grade Alumina Output in November may Fall Amid High Costs _SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s metallurgical-grade alumina output rose but supply surplus is expanding, while alumina prices remain weak and raw material costs increased. Profits have fallen below 50 yuan/mt, and many plants are near break-even. With high operating pressure, further production reductions or stoppages are possible in November.

title: Despite the Pandemic, Refined Nickel Output in October Increases _SMM
summary: SMM reports China produced 15,400 mt of refined nickel in October, marginally higher MoM and up YoY. Despite worse pandemic conditions in north-west China, smelter operations were not disrupted and transportation impacts were limited. November output is forecast to rise slightly to 15,500 mt on resumed/new capacity.

title: Copper slides on China's weak economic data, fresh COVID cases
summary: Copper prices fell after China’s weaker economic indicators and a fresh rise in COVID-19 cases increased concerns about industrial demand. Despite some support from tight physical supplies, three-month LME copper slipped around 0.5% and SHFE copper diverged. Market focus now shifts to US inflation and politics.

title: Chinese copper companies say more mining is needed to boost supply
summary: China’s leading copper producers urged the government to expand ore prospecting and open new mines at home and abroad amid concerns over global supply disruptions. It cites reduced operations at Peru’s Las Bambas due to blockades and a longer Chuquicamata smelter maintenance in Chile, raising short-term supply tightness expectations.

title: Ascendant Resources Reports High-Grade Copper Intercept and Extends Footwall Lens to 550 Metre Strike Length With 200 Metre Step-Out Drill Hole in the Venda Nova South Deposit at Lagoa Salgada
summary: Ascendant Resources said it found high-grade copper intercepts and extended a footwall lens to a 550-metre strike length at the Venda Nova South deposit, using a 200-metre step-out drill hole at Lagoa Salgada. The results are supportive for copper project prospects and potential supply expectations.

title: Xander Resources Engages Drill Contractor for Timmins Nickel Project
summary: Xander Resources engaged a drilling contractor to run a near-term drill program (2,500–4,000 metres) at its Timmins Nickel Project, focusing on a north block near Canada Nickel’s Crawford and Reid discoveries. The release is about exploration activity with no production or reserve updates.

title: Surge Battery Metals Inc.: Surge Battery Metals Announces Drilling Underway at the Hard Nickel Four Project, Decar Nickel District, Central BC
summary: Surge Battery Metals began drilling at its 80%-owned Hard Nickel 4 project in central British Columbia. Early core results show strongly altered peridotite with elevated nickel using portable XRF, with planned magnetic separation to test for awaruite. Follow-up drilling aims to confirm continuity of the nickel-bearing unit.

title: Romios Gold Identifies Major Geophysical Target Beneath Newly Discovered Copper-Tungsten Skarn at The Trek South Project, Golden Triangle, BC
summary: Romios Gold reports a strong IP/MT anomaly at its Trek South project and newly discovered copper-tungsten skarn, with copper assays up to 0.98% Cu and tungsten assays from 0.04%-0.68% WO3. The company highlights drill-ready targets near inferred plutons, which could be mildly supportive for copper sentiment.

title: Morocco: Aterian seeks joint-venture partner to exploit copper holdings
summary: Morocco-based Aterian seeks a JV partner to develop its Agdz copper project and reports high-grade copper and silver discoveries at another Moroccan asset, Azrar. It has acquired a portfolio of Moroccan copper-silver and base metal projects and discusses funding via Rwanda trading, boosting near-term sentiment for future copper supply development.

title: Concerns over a looming lithium price fall key focus at Antaike's nickel and cobalt conference
summary: Participants at Antaike’s nickel and cobalt conference highlighted uncertainty for 2023 but noted bullish pressure in Chinese nickel sulfate markets. Tight current nickel sulfate supply is pushing prices higher, while expectations of increased feedstock supply from Indonesia may ease later. SHFE deliverable-brand decisions and LME Russia-material guidance add volatility.

title: Could Copper Prices Be Poised For A Breakout?
summary: The piece argues copper could breakout as the U.S. dollar cools after Fed hikes and as rumors of China exiting zero-COVID by March 2023 boost sentiment on demand. It notes officials quickly reaffirmed support for restrictions, but suggests reopening could still lift copper prices.

title: First Quantum restarts earn-in exploration at Dreadnought Resources' Money nickel-copper-PGE prospect
summary: First Quantum restarted fixed-loop electromagnetic surveys over the Money nickel-copper-PGE prospect in Western Australia and plans additional drilling targets. Prior 12 holes reported nickel and copper grades, and management highlights similarities to China’s Jinchuan deposit. Results are expected next year.

title: First Quantum restarts earn-in exploration at Dreadnought Resources' Money nickel-copper-PGE prospect
summary: First Quantum restarts FLEM surveys at Dreadnought Resources’ Money nickel-copper-PGE prospect in Western Australia under a 70% earn-in. The survey aims to identify shallow massive sulphides after prior drilling returned meaningful nickel and copper grades. Additional drill targets and results are expected later next year.

title: Nickel Price Less Supported amid Significantly Contained Demand by High Prices_SMM
summary: SMM reports nickel prices are less supported as high prices significantly contain demand across the nickel industry chain. Although SHFE nickel pushed up absolute spot prices, spot premiums declined and transactions were muted. Stainless steel mills limited buying due to losses and weak terminal demand, pressuring nickel sentiment.

title: Copper Is Down on Falling Demand. But a Shortage Looms.
summary: Copper prices are reported lower as concerns about weakening global industrial demand weigh on the market. The article also argues prices may have fallen too far because supply tightness could persist for years, but the near-term narrative emphasizes demand risk driving the current decline.

title: Yangshan Copper Trading Remains Sluggish and the Premiums are under Pressure_SMM
summary: SMM says Yangshan copper premiums under warrants fell to $135–147/mt, down about $5/mt from the prior day. Bill-of-lading premiums also eased. Import trading was sluggish with no early deals, as high import losses deterred buyers, while sellers lowered offers, pressuring copper buying interest.

title: Zambia: Anglo American, Arc Minerals copper prospects lifted as mining cadastre office reopens
summary: Zambia’s mines cadastre office reopened on October 19 after being disrupted by corruption concerns that tainted some prior license grants. The office will accept new mining license applications from November 21, which Anglo American partner Arc Minerals and others view as positive for Zambia’s copper prospects.

title: Copper Fox Metals Inc.: Copper Fox Provides Update on the Van Dyke Copper Project
summary: Copper Fox provided an update on its 100% owned Van Dyke in-situ copper recovery project in Arizona, detailing community engagement and planned access upgrades for well re-entry. It outlines downhole video surveys, hydrogeologic monitoring/testing, and refurbishment of monitoring equipment. The release references the prior PEA but no near-term production changes.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Reports Q3 2022 Financial Results and Appoints Arndt Brettschneider to the Board
summary: Faraday Copper Corp. reported Q3 2022 financial results and outlined ongoing work on its Arizona Copper Creek copper project, including a Phase II drill program, updated mineral resource estimate activity, and geological/metallurgical studies. The company also discussed future milestones for updated MRE and PEA, without any production changes.

title: Metallic Minerals Corp.: Metallic Minerals Acquires Additional Claims at La Plata Copper-Silver-Gold Project in Colorado, USA
summary: Metallic Minerals announced it acquired additional patented claims (Morning Star property) contiguous to its La Plata Cu-Ag-Au project in Colorado. The company highlights potential porphyry copper mineralization and intends to incorporate the claims into 2023 exploration planning. The update is primarily exploration-focused, with limited near-term impact on copper markets.

title: Inclusion of indirect emissions in CBAM could jeopardize EU decarbonization ambitions: European Aluminium
summary: European Aluminium argues that CBAM should not include indirect emissions until an adequate methodology is developed for aluminium’s indirect carbon costs. The group warns inclusion could increase carbon leakage and hurt EU aluminium’s transition to carbon neutrality, citing lost capacity and high electricity costs since 2021.

title: 'Era of cheap' copper prices may be coming to an end
summary: Copper futures are down about 17% year-to-date amid worries over global demand. However, the piece argues prices may have fallen too far because visible copper inventories at global exchanges continue to decline in a long downtrend, suggesting supply remains tight for years.

title: China's No. 1 Nickel Trader Gets Green Light for Hong Kong Listing
summary: China’s largest nickel trader, Lygend Resources & Technology, received approval to list in Hong Kong after filing an updated IPO prospectus. The company plans to raise funds to expand production, citing expected growth in EV-related demand and sales. The development is potentially supportive for near-term nickel market sentiment.

title: Nickel Asia net income up 12%
summary: Nickel Asia Corp. reported attributable net income of P6.90 billion for the first nine months of 2022, up 12% year on year. Revenues increased 2% to P21.51 billion, largely driven by higher nickel ore prices, indicating improved nickel-linked pricing conditions for the company.

title: Let's cop the copper bandits
summary: The article reports copper cable theft across South Africa, including arrests with about 50m of cabling and residents observing multiple street poles felled and stripped over months. Authorities cite copper vandalism hotspots such as Colchester and plan added security, suggesting continued physical copper availability pressure and support for copper prices.

title: Hyundai Motor signs supply deal with Indonesian aluminum producer
summary: Hyundai Motor signed a memorandum with Indonesia’s PT Adaro Minerals Indonesia to secure a stable supply of aluminium as EV and industrial demand grows. The partnership may also expand low-carbon aluminium offerings to support Hyundai’s carbon neutrality goals, though the article gives no volumes or near-term pricing details.

title: Hyundai Motor Company and PT Adaro Minerals Indonesia, Tbk. Signed a Memorandum of Understanding to Secure Aluminum Supply in the Face of Growing Demand for Automobile Manufacturing
summary: Hyundai Motor signed an MoU with PT Adaro Minerals Indonesia to secure stable, low-carbon aluminum supply for growing automobile demand. The deal covers production/supply via AMI’s subsidiary KAI, Hyundai’s early right to purchase, and future negotiation rights for 50,000–100,000 TPA, amid concerns about supply volatility and higher energy costs.

title: Hyundai Motor, PT Adaro Minerals Indonesia Sign MoU To Secure Aluminum Supply
summary: Hyundai Motor signed an MoU with PT Adaro Minerals Indonesia (via its Kalimantan Aluminium Industry subsidiary) to secure stable aluminum supply for rising auto manufacturing demand. The parties plan cooperation on aluminum production and supply, highlighting Indonesia’s low-carbon “green aluminum” using hydropower.

title: NickelX hits massive sulphides in first hole of maiden program at Cosmos South
summary: NickelX intersected a 153-metre-wide zone of massive sulphides in its first drilling hole at the Cosmos South nickel project in Western Australia. The sulphides include pyrrhotite/marcasite with lesser chalcopyrite; intervals will be assayed for nickel and gold. Drilling targets conductive EM anomalies near existing nickel operations.

title: Hyundai Motor Company and AMI signed MoU to secure aluminum supply   | Companies
summary: Hyundai Motor Company signed an MoU with PT Adaro Minerals Indonesia to secure stable aluminium supply for automobile manufacturing. The deal focuses on Indonesia’s low‑carbon, hydro-powered “green aluminium” and grants Hyundai early purchase and future negotiation rights tied to KAI output volumes (50,000–100,000 TPA). Energy-price volatility is cited.

title: SHFE Aluminium to Still Have Upward Potential in the Short Term amid Low Inventory and Positive Macro Front_SMM
summary: SMM reports aluminium prices rising on the week (SHFE and LME) with bullish macro signals from cooler US CPI and China’s easing of COVID controls. Fundamentals are described as positive: stable domestic supply with limited immediate output, force majeure production cuts abroad, and falling social inventories supporting higher aluminium prices near term.

title: Aluminium Ingot Social Inventories in China Extend Declines _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM said China’s aluminium ingot social inventories fell to 553,000 mt on Nov 14, down 23,000 mt on the week and 59,000 mt on the month. Declines were led by Wuxi with limited arrivals, and Gongyi saw inventory drop after railway operations resumed. Stocks are expected to remain low.

title: The Weekly Average Discount of High-Grade NPI Stood at 600 yuan/mtu Against Refined Nickel as of Last Week, 64.9 yuan/mtu Higher Than A Week Ago_SMM
summary: SMM reports weekly high-grade NPI discount to refined nickel at 600 yuan/mtu, widening versus last week. Spot pure nickel premiums fell as pure nickel rose and futures gained more. Military alloy demand held, civil demand weakened, and limited NPI inquiries plus losses for stainless/NPI producers support stable NPI prices and an expanding NPI–nickel spread.

title: VELUX Group Takes Next Step To Decarbonise Aluminium In Roof Windows Together With Novelis
summary: VELUX signed a multi-year partnership with Novelis to supply flat-rolled aluminium for roof windows with around 70% recycled content (about 30% higher than before). The agreement targets lower emissions versus primary aluminium and aims for incremental carbon reductions, but it does not indicate immediate supply or pricing changes for aluminium markets.

title: Nickel Briefly Surges by Limit as Report of Blast Spooks Market
summary: Nickel prices jumped briefly to their limit as a report of an explosion or blast spooked the market. Such events raise concerns about disruptions to nickel supply or operations, prompting traders to bid prices higher over the immediate trading period.

title: Salazar, Adventus reach deal for US$270M Ecuador copper-gold project
summary: Adventus Mining and Salazar Resources say Ecuador’s government investment institution approved a foreign direct investment agreement for the El Domo copper-gold project. The deal supports development of a new copper asset in Ecuador, potentially improving long-run supply expectations, though near-term effects on current copper supply appear limited.

title: LME nickel price soars, narrowly avoids 'disruption event' as base metals futures mostly rise
summary: LME nickel surged 12% (and briefly ~15% to $30,960/t) on low volumes, narrowly avoiding a 15% daily limit that would trigger a disruption event. The move lacked clear nickel-specific news, instead reflecting weaker dollar, macro optimism, and stop-loss/fund buying. Copper rose slightly; aluminium dipped modestly amid stable Russian metal acceptability.

title: Hyundai signs low-carbon aluminium deal in Indonesia
summary: Hyundai Motor Group signed a preliminary MoU with PT Adaro Minerals Indonesia to collaborate on producing and sourcing low-carbon aluminium for its vehicles. The partnership targets initial aluminium output of 500,000 tons per year starting early 2025, with additional cooperation on specifications and production processes.

title: Potential Ban On Russian Metals Pushes Aluminum Prices Higher
summary: Reports of a possible U.S. ban or sanctions on Russian aluminum imports are cited as a bullish catalyst. The article says aluminum prices spiked after the White House consideration became public and could extend gains if restrictions are enacted. It also links Russian supply share to nickel and copper risk.

title: Comex Copper Settles 2.43% Lower at $3.8550 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex Copper futures for November delivery settled 2.43% lower at $3.8550 per pound, falling 9.60 cents. The drop ended a four-session winning streak and marked the largest one-day percentage decline since late October. Prices remain well below the contract’s 52-week high.

title: Gladiator Metals Corp. Announces Option Agreement to Acquire Whitehorse Copper Project
summary: Gladiator Metals entered an option agreement to acquire a 100% interest in the Whitehorse Copper Project in Yukon, highlighting historical high-grade copper intercepts and future drilling and data verification plans. While it improves copper development sentiment, it does not signal immediate mine output or supply changes.

title: Element 29 Resources Inc.: Element 29 Announces Filing of Technical Report for Initial Mineral Resource Estimate at Its Elida Porphyry Copper Deposit in Peru
summary: Element 29 announced filing of an NI 43-101 technical report for an initial Inferred Mineral Resource at its Elida porphyry copper deposit in Peru. The estimate totals 321.7 million tonnes grading 0.32% copper (plus Mo and silver). As an Inferred, non-reserve resource, near-term copper price effects appear limited.

title: Tesla-Backed Nickel Miner Cuts Output After Waste Dam Leak
summary: A Tesla-backed nickel miner is reducing output after a waste dam leak. The incident raises short-term supply concerns by disrupting mining operations and potential remediation and regulatory response, which can tighten nickel availability expectations over the coming days and pressure nickel prices lower.

title: Copper Prices Likely to Upsurge in November with Fundamentals and Macro Front Resonating_SMM
summary: The report expects copper to rise in November, citing macro support from a softer USD after the Fed and mixed US data, and tight physical markets. LME inventories are at very low levels with high cancelled warrants, while SHFE stocks are also lean, increasing short-squeeze risk despite some demand softness.

title: Copper Concentrate Imports in September Hit a New Monthly High_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s copper ore and concentrate imports rose to 2.27 million mt in September 2022, a new monthly high, up 7.7% YoY and slightly MoM. Total Jan–Sep imports increased 8.8% YoY, with notable changes by supplier (Peru up, Chile down).

title: Russia's biggest copper mine in Siberia to begin operation i...
summary: The news reports that Russia’s largest copper mine in Siberia is expected to start operations. A new supply source generally raises expectations for increased copper output over the coming weeks, which can weigh on copper prices as markets anticipate more material availability.

title: Canada Nickel Announces Improved Iron and Chromium Recoveries from Pilot Plant Testing
summary: Canada Nickel reported successful pilot plant testing at its Crawford nickel project, showing improved iron and chromium recoveries and higher iron grade in magnetite concentrate, plus nickel recovery to the magnetic concentrate. The results support the project’s downstream steel/ferrroalloy value proposition and could be mildly bullish for nickel sentiment.

title: Victory Resources Corp.: Victory Stakes New Tahlo Lake Property in British Columbia's Babine Copper-Gold Porphyry District
summary: Victory Resources staked the Tahlo Lake Property in British Columbia’s Babine copper-gold porphyry district near prior copper deposits. The company cites historical and regional geochemical anomalies (notably Cu enrichment) suggesting intrusive-related mineralization, but provides no new production, permits, or near-term supply changes.

title: Bell Copper Corporation: Bell Copper Announces Non-Brokered Private Placement, Big Sandy Drilling
summary: Bell Copper announced a non-brokered private placement (up to C$3m) to fund drilling and exploration at its 100% owned Big Sandy porphyry copper project in Arizona. The release discusses prior copper sulphide/chalcopyrite intersections and planned follow-up holes, but no immediate production or supply change.

title: BeMetals Corp.: BeMetals Defines Priority Copper Targets and Commences Core Drilling at Pangeni Copper Project
summary: BeMetals reports completion of an aircore program and the start of core drilling targeting six copper prospects at its Pangeni project on Zambia’s Copperbelt. It cites encouraging prior copper intersections and discusses geological targets to be tested, with results expected in early 2023.

title: Adventus and Salazar reach agreement with Government of Ecuador in support of El Domo copper-gold project
summary: Adventus Mining and Salazar agreed with Ecuador’s government on incentives for the El Domo copper-gold project, including reduced income tax, exemptions on capital outflow taxes and import duties for equipment, and tax/legal stability until 2033. Final contract signing is expected within 120 days, with construction targeted after approvals.

title: Tribeca Resources Commences Drilling at its La Higuera Copper-Gold-Cobalt Project In Northern Chile
summary: Tribeca Resources began a 2,800m RC and diamond drilling program at its La Higuera IOCG copper-gold-cobalt project in northern Chile, testing covered extensions to historic copper intersections supported by IP/geophysics and mapping. A gravity survey is also underway. No new production or quantified reserve changes are reported.

title: Copper dips on China COVID cases, geopolitical concerns
summary: Copper prices fell as rising COVID-19 cases in China heightened demand uncertainty, with Beijing and Guangzhou reporting more infections. Geopolitical concerns tied to an explosion in Poland also pressured risk sentiment. The article cites declines in LME three-month and SHFE December copper contracts during the session.

title: Imminent Indonesian Tariff Hike Likely to Affect the Entire Nickel Market_SMM
summary: SMM reports ferronickel prices rose in October as stainless steel inventories depleted and mills resumed production, lifting ferronickel demand. Imports fell due to overseas smelter cuts, while Indonesian NPI supply also stayed tight. Markets fear Indonesia may soon raise ferronickel/NPI export tariffs, providing support and limiting upside.

title: Aluminium products maker Arconic offloads Russian operations for $230m
summary: US aluminium products maker Arconic closed a $230m deal to sell its 100% Russian operations to Promishlennie Investitsii. The assets included the Arconic SMZ plant producing fabricated aluminium (extrusions and flat-rolled). The move follows Ukraine-related restrictions and ongoing legal disputes, implying reduced Russia-linked aluminium supply.

title: Indonesia proposes nickel producer bloc at Canada G20 talks
summary: Indonesia’s investment minister proposed an OPEC-like bloc of top nickel producers at talks with Canada, seeking coordinated policies and “fair added value” for nickel. With Indonesia also banning raw ore exports since 2020, the initiative signals potential supply-management, supporting expectations for higher nickel prices near term.

title: Finland's Russian nickel imports bigger than before war
summary: Finnish Customs data show imports of Russian nickel into Finland rose sharply after Russia’s invasion. Finland’s minister for European affairs said the government is ready to ramp up sanctions and support an EU nickel ban if consensus is reached, noting sanctions act gradually.

title: World Insights: China-invested industrial parks bring boom to Indonesia's nickel industry-Xinhua
summary: Xinhua reports that China-backed IMIP and Tsingshan’s Weda Bay industrial park in Indonesia are expanding nickel-focused processing and supporting ferronickel and battery-material supply. It cites large-scale investment, infrastructure improvements, and cleaner HPAL production, which boosts capacity expectations for Indonesia’s nickel industry.

title: Indonesia Proposes Creating An OPEC-Style Group For Nickel Producers
summary: Indonesia’s investment ministry says it proposed to Canada creating an OPEC-style group of major nickel producers to coordinate nickel commodity policies and value addition. The idea follows earlier comments about potentially forming a cartel to manage nickel supply. Indonesia is the world’s biggest nickel miner, so coordination hopes can support nickel sentiment.

title: Nickel Plunges as Illiquid Trading on LME Sparks Fresh Turmoil
summary: The piece highlights renewed turmoil in nickel trading on the LME, noting that nickel plunges as illiquid trading conditions spark fresh market disruption. Such LME liquidity stress typically drives rapid repricing, implying clear downward pressure on nickel prices over the next days.

title: Volatility reigns as nickel plunges after rising 40% in two weeks
summary: The article headline highlights heightened volatility in nickel prices, noting a sharp plunge after a 40% rise over the prior two weeks. The framing implies a rapid reversal and near-term downward pressure on nickel, consistent with a bearish market reaction in the first days.

title: HAIB COPPER: THE HIGH COURT POSTPONES THE VERDICT TO FEBRUARY 23, 2023
summary: Deep-South Resources said Namibia’s High Court postponed its verdict on whether to review a ministerial decision not to renew the company’s exploration and prospecting licence, pushing a decision to February 23, 2023. The delay extends through court closure in December–January, affecting the company’s copper project timeline.

title: LME Steps Up Scrutiny of Nickel Trading as Prices Swing Wildly
summary: The article title says the LME is stepping up scrutiny of nickel trading as nickel prices swing widely. This can influence short-term market positioning and expectations by affecting how trades are conducted or monitored. However, the provided content lacks details on policy measures or physical-market impacts.

title: BHP says strike at Escondida copper mine 'unjustifiable'
summary: BHP disputed union accusations for a strike at its Escondida copper mine in Chile scheduled for Nov. 21 and 23. The company called the strike unjustifiable, but the planned stoppage raises short-term copper supply disruption risk from a major producer, likely pressuring copper prices lower over coming days.

title: Are Nickel Prices Poised For A Breakout?
summary: The article examines whether nickel’s recent rally can sustain amid thin trading volumes and potential breakdown risk, alongside ongoing pressure in stainless spot pricing. It also highlights expectations for the WTO’s final findings on Indonesia’s nickel ore export ban and notes the LME’s decision not to restrict Russian metal as a key variable for sentiment.

title: Governor Reeves will sign legislation Thursday for aluminum plant
summary: Mississippi Governor Tate Reeves will sign legislation for Steel Dynamics’ $2.5 billion aluminium plant in Lowndes County. The project is described as the state’s largest economic development effort, creating about 1,000 jobs. The announcement can improve near-term sentiment for aluminium demand, though timing and magnitude are uncertain.

title: Union shuts down operations at Highland Valley Copper over safety issues
summary: A safety stand down has curtailed operations at the Highland Valley Copper mine in British Columbia, reportedly linked to an incident involving a Bucyrus digging machine. The United Steelworkers union says the shutdown is related to safety concerns, while Teck says it is working with employees for a safe resumption of operations.

title: China-invested industrial parks bring boom to Indonesia's nickel industry
summary: Xinhua describes how China-invested industrial parks in Indonesia (IMIP and IWIP) are scaling ferronickel and battery-material related processing, employing tens of thousands of workers and adding infrastructure. By expanding nickel production capability in major supply regions, the article points to higher future nickel availability, weighing on prices.

title: Cyprium Metals intercepts copper, zinc, gold and nickel from drilling at Cue project
summary: Cyprium Metals reported anomalous copper and nickel mineralisation from reverse-circulation drilling at the Cue project in Western Australia, including long intercepts of copper and a nickel interval. The firm is also working to restart its Nifty copper mine, but no near-term production changes are announced.

title: Cyprium Metals intercepts copper, zinc, gold and nickel from drilling at Cue project
summary: Cyprium Metals reported anomalous mineralisation from RC drilling at its Cue project, including significant copper and nickel intercepts, plus some gold and zinc. It also reiterated work toward financing and restarting its Nifty copper project, which has existing infrastructure and planned H1 FY2024 copper plate production.

title: Antilles Gold confirms high-grade copper porphyry discovery at El Pilar
summary: Antilles Gold confirmed high-grade copper porphyry mineralisation at its El Pilar oxide-sulphide project in Cuba, reporting a 134m intercept with strong copper grades and open depth, plus preliminary gold results. Assays are preliminary pending replication at a certified lab, with further drilling planned; no production impact yet.

title: China-invested industrial parks bring boom to Indonesia's nickel industry--China Economic Net
summary: Xinhua reports that Chinese firms (including Tsingshan) have built and expanded Indonesia’s nickel industrial parks, notably IMIP and Weda Bay/WIIP, in regions like Morowali and North Maluku. It describes ferronickel/HPAL-related production lines, infrastructure, and green power/processing plans, implying increased future nickel supply.

title: MAX Resource Corp.: Max Resource Provides Update on its Maiden Drill Program in the URU District, CESAR Copper-Silver Project in NE Colombia
summary: MAX Resource Corp. provided an update on initial drilling at its CESAR copper-silver project in NE Colombia. Eight holes totaling 1,421m were completed, with visible chalcocite and malachite in core and assays pending for early December. Drilling is moving to the URU-CE zone into mid-December.

title: Codelco begins fully-electric loader trial at Chilean copper mine
summary: Codelco began trials of a fully electric 14t loading shovel at its El Teniente copper mine in Chile. The trial is expected to cut diesel use, emissions, noise, and maintenance costs, with hopes for greater battery-based autonomy. Codelco plans testing for one year while pursuing broader decarbonization goals.

title: Palladium One Mining Inc.: Palladium One Samples up to 2.1% Nickel and 6.1% Copper at the Canalask Nickel-Copper-PGE Project, Yukon, Canada
summary: Palladium One reports grab samples from its Canalask nickel-copper-PGE project in Yukon with assays up to 2.1% Ni and 6.17% Cu, alongside a drone magnetometer survey refining an ultramafic dyke target. Permitting is underway for systematic drilling of historic EM targets.

title: Adventus Mining Announces Award of Mining Contract for El Domo Copper-Gold Project and US$5M Equity Investment Commitment
summary: Adventus Mining said it has been awarded a mining contract for its El Domo copper-gold project and committed US$5 million in equity investment. The contract award can be read as incremental progress toward copper production, which may provide mild near-term support for copper price sentiment.

title: LME tightens restraints as nickel turns unruly again: Andy Home
summary: LME nickel trading has become highly volatile: three-month nickel briefly surged above $30,000 and breached the new daily limit before falling sharply to about $25,800. The LME raised initial margins and increased surveillance amid shrinking liquidity. Supply uncertainty around Russian nickel and market conditions are key drivers of the swings.

title: Canada 'very unlikely' to join OPEC-like group for nickel -gov't source
summary: Canada’s government source says the country is “very unlikely” to join an OPEC-like group aimed at coordinating nickel supply. The comment suggests less probability of producer-led supply discipline, but it is not an immediate policy action, so any effect on short-term nickel prices is likely limited.

title: Vale and GM Sign Long-Term Nickel Supply Agreement in Canada Critical to North American EV Supply Chain
summary: Vale and GM signed a term sheet for long-term supply of battery-grade nickel sulfate from Vale’s proposed Bécancour, Quebec plant, equivalent to 25,000 tonnes per year of contained nickel for GM’s Ultium nickel-based cathodes. Deliveries are targeted to start in 2H 2026, supporting nickel demand outlook.

title: General Motors agrees to buy nickel sulfate from vale to power EVs
summary: General Motors agreed to purchase nickel sulfate from Vale to help power electric vehicles. The contract signals firmer demand for nickel feedstock, which can tighten expectations for near-term supply and provide upward support for nickel prices over the next several days to a few weeks.

title: Salazar Resources Limited: Salazar Announces Award of Mining Contract for El Domo Copper-Gold Project
summary: Salazar Resources said negotiations concluded for a 48-month mining contract for the El Domo–Curipamba open-pit copper-gold project in Ecuador, including pre-strip mining and construction of tailings, waste rock, and mine infrastructure. The milestone is expected to move the project toward production, modestly supporting copper supply expectations.

title: BHP Ups Bid for Copper Miner OZ Minerals to $6.4 Billion
summary: BHP is reported to have raised its bid for OZ Minerals to $6.4 billion. Because OZ Minerals is a copper miner, the deal could affect expectations for future copper supply and production continuity. Still, the article lacks specifics on output timing or disruption, so near-term price impact is likely limited.

title: Tribe continues to fight proposed Arizona copper mine
summary: Proponents and opponents are still fighting over a proposed Arizona copper mine. The continued campaign against the project could delay permitting or development, reducing the near-term outlook for incremental copper supply. That supply risk can support copper prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Vale Canada to supply GM with nickel for EVs, starting in 2026
summary: Vale Canada will supply GM with battery-grade nickel sulfate from a proposed Quebec plant starting in 2H 2026, enough refined nickel for up to 350,000 EVs per year. GM says North American nickel helps EVs qualify for U.S. clean energy tax credits, supporting EV-driven nickel demand expectations.

title: Vale inks nickel deal with GM that could be worth $760M a year
summary: Vale announced its first large-scale EV battery deal in North America with General Motors, supplying nickel for a range of GM vehicles. The agreement is described as potentially worth $760M per year and includes deliveries of 25,000 tonnes, signaling firmer nickel demand outlook.

title: Vale inks deal to supply GM with nickel from proposed Quebec plant
summary: Vale agreed to supply GM with 25,000 tonnes per year of battery-grade nickel sulfate from a proposed Quebec plant beginning in 2026. The nickel will feed GM cathodes for about 350,000 EVs annually and help GM qualify for U.S. clean-energy tax credits under the IRA, boosting near-term nickel sentiment.

title: Comex Copper Settles 2.60% Lower at $3.6895 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex Copper (front month) settled 2.60% lower at $3.6895 per pound, losing 9.85 cents. The contract is down for four consecutive sessions, totaling a 6.62% decline over that span, and reached the lowest settlement since Nov. 7, signaling bearish momentum for copper.

title: Appeals court gives Resolution Copper mine opponents another chance - Cronkite News
summary: A federal appeals court set aside prior rulings and will rehear the legal challenge to the Resolution Copper project on land considered sacred by Apache Stronghold. Opponents want delays to prevent destroying Oak Flat, while supporters say the mine could meet a large share of domestic copper demand.

title: Copper Inventory in Major Chinese Markets Add 10,900 mt from Monday_SMM
summary: SMM says Chinese major-market copper inventories rose to 128,000 mt as of Nov 18, up 10,900 mt from Monday, largely driven by SHFE 2211 copper delivery. Imported arrivals were limited and domestic smelter shipments were low, despite brief spot deficits. SMM expects inventories to fall next week and consumption to improve.

title: 'Opec for nickel' proposal debated
summary: Indonesia’s minister proposed an Opec-like group of nickel suppliers to coordinate policies and boost downstream refining for EV-battery nickel. Australia’s industry body opposes supply-constricting cartels, and Canada is unlikely to join. Still, the plan highlights bargaining power and potential supply coordination, supporting nickel price expectations.

title: Mineral-hungry China funds Indonesia's ambition to dominate EV space; stakes claim on nickel | News | Eco-Business
summary: Eco-Business reports China-backed investment—up to $2 billion via a green fund—aimed at expanding Indonesia’s EV battery and nickel value chain. With Indonesia poised to increase refined nickel supply to meet China’s rising EV demand, the news is supportive for nickel market expectations over the coming weeks.

title: Alcoa lobbying US, LME to sanction Russian aluminium: company
summary: Alcoa executives say they are lobbying the US government for further sanctions on Russian aluminium, after the LME declined to ban or limit Russian-origin brands. The firm argues continued Russian flows into LME warehouses weaken the contract reference price and could prompt tighter supply if sanctions are implemented.

title: Tribe continues fight against proposed Arizona copper mine
summary: Arizona’s Court of Appeals overturned a permit issuance for the proposed Resolution Copper underground mine and ordered the state to restart the Clean Water Act permitting process. The mine is targeted for massive copper output. The decision raises near-term regulatory risk of delay, potentially supporting copper market sentiment.

title: Copper Inventories in Domestic Bonded Zones Dip 3,700 mt from November 11_SMM
summary: SMM survey data show China’s domestic bonded copper inventories fell 3,700 mt from Nov 11 to 24,600 mt as of Nov 18, including declines in Shanghai and Guangdong. The drop is linked to copper entering the domestic market after contract delivery, amid signs of rising cleared imported arrivals at ports.

title: "Tribe Continues Fight Against Proposed Arizona Copper Mine"
summary: Arizona’s Court of Appeals ruled the state environmental agency illegally issued a Clean Water Act permit for the proposed Resolution Copper Mine, ordering ADEQ to restart the process. The San Carlos Apache Tribe opposes the mine, and further appeals are planned, adding uncertainty and potential delay to copper supply plans.

title: Indonesia faces difficult task to create OPEC-like group for nickel
summary: Indonesia’s plan to create an OPEC-like group to coordinate nickel output and pricing faces hurdles because production is largely controlled by private companies rather than governments. Analysts say China-linked firms hold major stakes in Indonesia’s nickel industry, limiting control. Nickel demand growth is noted, but no immediate policy change is confirmed.

title: GM Signs Deal For Canadian Nickel To Reduce Cost Of EV Batteries
summary: GM signed a term sheet with Vale to supply battery-grade nickel sulfate sourced from a proposed Canadian plant in Bécancour. The nickel sulfate equals about 25,000 metric tons per year and will be used in Ultium battery cells. The deal targets lower battery cell costs and a greener supply chain, supporting future nickel demand.

title: Lundin plans to fill in sinkhole near Chilean copper mine
summary: Lundin Mining plans to fill a large sinkhole near its Alcaparrosa underground copper mine in Chile. The firm is expelling leaked water and has reduced inflow rates sharply, investing $10m so far. It also plans to pump 1.3 million cubic metres of water to local industrial users, aiming to seal the affected area.

title: GM's invests $45M to expand Indiana aluminum die casting foundry
summary: General Motors will invest $45 million to expand its Bedford, Indiana aluminum die casting foundry to increase production of EV drive unit castings for Silverado EV and Sierra EV. The castings feed drive units made at GM’s Toledo plant and shipped to EV assembly. GM frames this as part of scaling EV profitability.

title: In AZ, Native Americans continue to fight against proposed copper mine
summary: Arizona’s Court of Appeals ruled the state environmental agency illegally issued a Clean Water Act permit for the proposed Resolution Copper mine and ordered the permit process restarted. The San Carlos Apache Tribe argues the project would destroy Oak Flat, while the company reviews the decision. The mine is projected to produce large volumes of copper.

title: Comex Copper Ends the Week 8.07% Lower at $3.6320 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex Copper’s front-month contract settled at $3.6320, down 31.90 cents (8.07%) for the week. The move follows a two-week winning streak being snapped, with losses across five consecutive sessions and the lowest settlement since Nov. 7, 2022.

title: Trio arrested for allegedly stealing copper cables, holding guards hostage
summary: Mpumalanga police arrested three suspects accused of robbing and stripping copper cables from a plantation in Machadodorp, reportedly holding security guards hostage. Police recovered suspected stolen copper cables from a vehicle and continued to pursue additional suspects. The copper value is yet to be determined.

title: Bullish Macro Front and Low Inventory to Sustain Further Rise in Short-Term Aluminium Prices _SMM
summary: SMM reports gains in both SHFE and LME aluminium prices, driven by a supportive macro backdrop and tight physical supply.
