Domestic social inventories fell to a new low amid limited northwest arrivals and transportation obstacles, while spot premiums widened. Supply outlook is also clouded by carbon-peak policy concerns for thermal-power-produced aluminium.

title: Guangxi Encourages Aluminium Smelters to Resume the Production through Financial Subsidy_SMM
summary: Guangxi province introduced subsidies to encourage aluminium smelters to restart potlines and lift capacity utilisation in Q4. Payments scale with quarter-on-quarter utilisation gains, alongside support for energy-saving upgrades. The move accelerates resumptions in a region with significant idled smelting capacity, increasing expected supply.

title: Citi downgrades Sandfire as BHP seals copper deal
summary: Citi downgraded Sandfire, saying demand for copper is unlikely to appear before the first half of 2023, despite hopes that China’s reopening could support sentiment. Even with copper spot up 7% and Sandfire shares up 24% since mid-September, Citi is “very bearish” for the near term.

title: Dilawar To MCC: Launch Work On Copper Project
summary: The article reports that Dilawar will work with MCC to launch development activities on a copper project. The announcement is directly related to copper investment and future supply prospects. While it may be mildly supportive for copper prices via sentiment, it is unlikely to change near-term fundamentals quickly.

title: Proactive news headlines including Poseidon Nickel, Krakatoa Resources, Brookside Energy and Nova Minerals
summary: The news roundup reports progress on several mining companies, including Poseidon Nickel’s positive bankable feasibility study for the Black Swan nickel project and Blackstone Minerals’ drilling confirming continuity and high grades of nickel/PGE at Ta Khoa. It also notes Dundas Minerals exploring nickel and copper, supporting modest near-term sentiment.

title: Aluminium Ingot Social Inventories in China Hit New Low_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s aluminium ingot social inventories across eight major markets fell to 530,000 mt on Nov 21, the lowest this year and below last month and last year. Warehousing declines in Wuxi and Foshan and fewer incoming cargoes supported the drawdown, though downstream demand cooled after prices surpassed 19,000 yuan/mt.

title: Nickel Prices Fluctuated, and the Nickel Sulphate Produced with MHP Suffered Losses due to the High Raw Material Costs_SMM
summary: Battery-grade nickel sulphate prices in China rose week-on-week, supported by higher nickel raw material costs and continued tight supply. Some nickel salt plants using LME nickel benchmarks reported losses, though MHP-linked production improved after a nickel futures dip. Terminal demand weakened, but prices are expected to remain stable.

title: Copper Pipe and Tube Market: Trends, Opportunities and Competitive Analysis
summary: A PRNewswire piece summarizes a copper pipe and tube market report, citing steady demand drivers such as HVAC/refrigeration growth, construction activity, and automotive production. It forecasts moderate long-run growth to 2027 but provides no specific near-term supply or policy event that would likely impact copper prices immediately.

title: Wallbridge Mining closes sale of Canadian nickel assets to Archer
summary: Wallbridge Mining has sold all its Quebec and Ontario nickel assets, rights, and obligations to Archer Exploration, including a 100% stake in the Grasset nickel sulphide project. Wallbridge will receive Archer shares and retain a 2% net smelter royalty, with the rationale to refocus on gold.

title: Granite Creek Copper Ltd.: Granite Creek Copper Identifies New, High-Priority Resource Expansion Targets at Carmacks Copper-Gold-Silver Project in Yukon Canada
summary: Granite Creek Copper announced IP survey results at its Carmacks copper-gold-silver project in Yukon, identifying new high-priority targets (e.g., Sourtoe Zone, 147 Deep, Gap and 58 targets) for follow-up exploration. It also closed a private placement to fund Canadian exploration expenses. No near-term production changes were disclosed.

title: Nickel Prices Could Be Set For A Rally
summary: The piece argues that rising USD and easing China zero-COVID expectations are lifting copper, while aluminium gains are supported by hopes for China reopening and LME decisions on Russian metal sanctions. Nickel is described as in a short-term bull market with breakout moves amplified by LME liquidity after a short squeeze, though Indonesia supply risks loom.

title: Nickel Prices Rebound to High Levels with Poor Trades in Spot Market _SMM
summary: SMM reports nickel spot premiums widened/rebounded as SHFE nickel rose in the morning. Jinchuan nickel premium averaged 4,250 yuan/mt, while NORNICKEL averaged 2,450 yuan/mt. Nickel briquette prices increased, but spot and briquette trading were described as weak, still priced at premiums to nickel sulphate.

title: Universal Copper Completes 3D Geological Modelling and Identifies Multiple High-Grade Targets
summary: Universal Copper reports completion of 3D geological modeling at its Poplar copper project, identifying higher-grade copper-gold-molybdenum-silver targets and citing recent drill intercepts. The work is intended to guide exploration drilling in 2023, but the release does not imply near-term changes in copper supply or operations.

title: Amarc Resources Ltd.: Amarc's Duke Copper-Gold District To Be Advanced With Funding From Boliden
summary: Amarc Resources said it signed an earn-in agreement with Boliden to advance the Duke porphyry Cu-Au district in British Columbia. Boliden can earn up to 70% by funding staged exploration and development (including $5m committed in 2022/early 2023). Drilling plans are being finalized to expand copper targets.

title: Doré Copper Reports Remaining Results From Its 2022 Infill
summary: Doré Copper Mining reports remaining assay results from its 2022 infill drilling at the Corner Bay property in Québec, highlighting high-grade copper intercepts and continuity of mineralization. The drilling supports an upgrade for a feasibility study and expects feasibility completion in 2024, with further infill planned in 2023.

title: Power Nickel Closes Financing Adding Over $4 Million Dollars; Looks to Expand the Drill Program at Nisk, its High Grade Nickel Sulfide Project, From 5000 Metres to 12,500-15,000 Metres
summary: Power Nickel says it has closed new financing adding over $4 million and plans to expand its drilling program at the Nisk high-grade nickel sulfide project from about 5,000 metres to 12,500–15,000 metres. The update supports sentiment for future nickel supply visibility.

title: Power Nickel Inc.: Power Nickel Closes Financing Adding Over $4 Million Dollars; Looks to Expand the Drill Program at Nisk, its High Grade Nickel Sulfide Project, From 5000 Metres to 12,500-15,000 Metres
summary: Power Nickel closed a CAD$4.19 million financing and will expand its drilling at the Nisk high-grade nickel sulfide project from 5,000 metres to an additional 7,500–10,000 metres, continuing through mid-December and resuming mid-January. Assay results are expected starting next week, supporting nickel sentiment in the near term.

title: Thoothukudi victims turn allies of Sterlite Copper, seek reopening of plant
summary: Victims of the 2018 Sterlite Copper-related firing case are now supporting reopening of the Thoothukudi copper smelting plant, arguing inquiry findings show no plant role in the incident and that environmental clearances were granted. Advocates cite large livelihood losses from closure and urge immediate government action, implying higher copper supply expectations.

title: Market Trading was Slack amid the High Spot Prices of Pure Nickel_SMM
summary: SMM reports Nov 23 nickel market conditions: Jinchuan nickel spot premiums narrowed to 3,600–4,000 yuan/mt and NORNICKEL premiums to 2,300–2,500 yuan/mt. Despite lower premiums, absolute spot prices stay high, with slack spot trading. Steel mill demand is weak, limiting nickel briquette transaction activity.

title: Peru still 'a good place' to invest in copper mining, despite concerns over disruption
summary: Peru’s copper mining has faced disruption from protests and road blockades, raising concerns over potential higher taxes or restrictive mining legislation under President Castillo. However, sources argue the government remains pro-mining with stable contract/legal systems. Recent signs of production recovery and a higher copper concentrates TC index support improving short-term copper sentiment.

title: Codelco to slash copper sales to China by 50% amid production challenges, sources say
summary: Codelco has told major clients it may slash copper deliveries to China by 50% and could lose up to 200,000 tonnes of output next year due to production challenges at the Chuquicamata smelter. Clients say cathode deliveries under evergreen contracts may be jeopardized, tightening market supply.

title: Chilean Copper Giant Codelco to Cut Sales to China Next Year
summary: Chile’s state copper producer Codelco is reported to cut sales to China next year, signaling lower planned copper deliveries to a key market. The change can prompt traders to revise near-term expectations for copper supply and tighten sentiment, likely exerting downward pressure on copper prices.

title: Comex Copper Settles 0.08% Higher at $3.6175 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for November delivery settled slightly higher at $3.6175, up 0.08% (0.30 cent/lb) and extending gains to two sessions. The piece mainly reports price performance and broader percentage changes versus recent highs/lows, without detailing new fundamentals or supply-demand catalysts.

title: Camino confirms continuity of mineralization at new copper discovery in Peru; stock jumps
summary: Camino Minerals says it has confirmed continuity of mineralization at a new copper discovery in Peru, reporting high solubility results over copper oxide intercepts in the Lourdes zone at its Los Chapitos property. The announcement highlights ongoing exploration success, driving a stock jump and positive copper sentiment.

title: Reko Diq contains no strategic mineral other than gold & copper, SC told - Newspaper
summary: Pakistan’s Supreme Court was told that the Reko Diq site contains no strategic minerals beyond copper and gold, based on $240 million studies. The hearing covers a reconstituted mining agreement after Barrick Gold’s earlier dispute and suspension ended. Legal clarity may support redevelopment of a major copper project.

title: Boway Showcases New Line-up of Copper Alloy Strip at Electronica 2022 in Germany
summary: Boway promoted new copper alloy strip products for connectors at Electronica 2022 in Germany, targeting uses in consumer electronics and electric vehicles. The release highlights performance properties of several Cu-based alloys and expansion of production capacity in Germany, but provides no data on volumes or market tightness.

title: EGA purchases Clean Energy Certificates for 1.1 million megawatt hours of electricity supplied by EWEC to support production of CelestiAL solar aluminium
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) bought Clean Energy Certificates covering 1.1 million MWh of solar electricity from EWEC’s grid supply tied to Noor Abu Dhabi to support production of CelestiAL solar aluminium. EGA said the certified solar power enables around 80,000 tonnes of output and supports decarbonization goals.

title: MEED | Smelter signs up for solar aluminium power supply
summary: The headline reports that an aluminium smelter has signed up for solar power supply. If the agreement lowers electricity costs and stabilizes energy availability, it can improve smelter margins and raise expectations for near-term aluminium output economics, which may be supportive for aluminium prices over coming days.

title: Anglo American, Aurubis Join To Develop Assurance On Sustainable Copper Value Chain
summary: Anglo American and Aurubis signed an MoU to develop a copper product offering aligned with the Copper Mark chain-of-custody standard. The effort focuses on technology-driven traceability covering mining, processing, transportation, and market delivery. The article does not cite any near-term changes to supply, demand, or pricing.

title: SMM Updates on China Aluminium Ingot and Billet Social Inventories as of November 24_SMM
summary: SMM says China’s aluminium ingot social inventories fell to a record low of 518,000 mt on Nov 24, down sharply on the week, with fewer cargo arrivals and ongoing supply tightness supported by smelter output cuts and higher aluminium liquid production. Billet inventories rose to 63,000 mt amid regional arrivals.

title: Québec Nickel Corp. Announces Offering of up to $10 Million
summary: Québec Nickel Corp. announced a private placement and flow-through share offering raising up to $10 million to fund working capital and Canadian exploration expenditures for its nickel projects in Québec. The release details deal terms and timing but does not indicate immediate changes to nickel output or market supply-demand conditions.

title: Anglo, Aurubis sign deal to develop green copper traceability
summary: Anglo American and Aurubis signed a deal to enhance green copper traceability using Copper Mark chain-of-custody standards and technology to track the full production cycle. The firms aim to improve Scope 3 emissions transparency and support low-carbon supply-chain demand, but the news does not indicate immediate physical supply or pricing changes.

title: SK On to Build Nickel Production Facility in Indonesia with EcoPro, China's GEM
summary: The headline reports that SK On plans to build a nickel production facility in Indonesia in partnership with EcoPro and China’s GEM. The announcement relates to future nickel supply capacity and could modestly lift market expectations for nickel availability, supporting prices in the short term while production timing remains uncertain.

title: RPT-ASIACOPPERWEEK-Freeport settles six-year high copper charges for 2023 with Chinese smelters
summary: Freeport has agreed six-year-high copper charges for 2023 with Chinese smelters, settling refining/treatment terms at elevated levels. The report points to firmer smelter-related costs or availability in China. While this can influence copper pricing terms, it may be more backward-looking than a fresh near-term supply shock.

title: Los Cerros bolts on PNG copper, nickel targets to boost battery metals push
summary: Los Cerros acquired nickel-copper projects in Papua New Guinea from Footprint Resources and plans diamond drilling and geophysical work. Historical results include a trench assay with 2.6% copper and float nickel sulphide up to 45.8%. The move is exploratory and meant to attract JV partners, not to signal near-term production changes.

title: Los Cerros bolts on PNG copper, nickel targets to boost battery metals push
summary: Los Cerros acquired five nickel-copper projects in Papua New Guinea via Footprint Resources and plans a 3,000m drill program at Kusi and geophysical work at Veri Veri, targeting high-grade nickel sulphide and historical copper-bearing assays. The news boosts exploration activity but offers no immediate supply impact for benchmark copper or nickel prices.

title: SK On to build nickel production facility in Indonesia with EcoPro, China's GEM
summary: SK On will build a nickel MHP facility in Indonesia with EcoPro and GEM, aiming for 30,000 tons of high-purity nickel starting Q3 2024. MHP is used to produce nickel sulfate and EV battery precursors. The project also seeks oxidized nickel ore supply, potentially supportive for nickel.

title: Copper Inventory in Major Chinese Markets Dips 8,300 mt from Monday_SMM
summary: SMM said copper inventory across major Chinese markets fell to 113,400 mt, down 8,300 mt from Monday and 14,600 mt from last Friday. Most regions declined except Guangdong. East China buying increased as prices fell; high Guangdong premiums and transfers supported the flow. Supply rises near month-end may be offset by weaker consumption.

title: Transnet turning up the heat on copper thieves
summary: Transnet Freight Rail and Sasolburg police have arrested six suspects for stealing copper cables worth about R750,000 each, with multiple arrests reported over two weeks. Total recovered cable value is estimated at R3.4 million, and authorities seized vehicles and equipment used in the thefts.

title: IN BRIEF: Technology Minerals finds 28% copper in assay in Spain
summary: Technology Minerals reports grab-sample assay results from its Aramo project in Asturias, Spain, including up to 28% copper, 1.88% cobalt, and 1.68% nickel. The company completed a 3D laser survey for underground mapping. The news is exploration-positive, potentially improving short-term sentiment for copper and nickel.

title: Copper Inventories in Domestic Bonded Zones Up 2,000 mt from November 18_SMM
summary: SMM says copper inventories in China’s domestic bonded zones increased by 2,000 mt to 26,600 mt by Nov 25. Shanghai bonded inventories rose to 23,000 mt while Guangdong eased to 3,600 mt. Customs clearance slowed due to an unfavorable SHFE/LME price ratio, prompting traders to move cargo into bonded warehouses.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports Down 98,000 wmt WoW_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports Chinese nickel ore inventories fell by 98,000 wmt WoW to 8.94 million wmt as of Nov 25, with port inventory down to 4.68 million wmt. Low supply and reduced shipments persist, while NPI plants buy less due to lower NPI prices. Gradual further declines are expected.

title: China's GEM to Build Indonesia Nickel Plant With South Korea's EcoPro, SK On
summary: GEM, EcoPro, and SK On will jointly build and operate an HPAL nickel plant in Indonesia’s Morowali. The facility targets 30,000 tonnes of nickel per year from mixed hydroxide precipitate. It aims to secure stable nickel feedstock and meet US IRA sourcing requirements, supporting market confidence in nickel supply.

title: Nickel firm Lygend looks to fetch $470m in Hong Kong listing
summary: Lygend Resources & Technology plans a HK IPO raising about $470m, using 56% of proceeds to develop its Indonesia HPAL nickel hydrometallurgy project. The project targets large nickel-cobalt compound capacity and has prior phase commissioning, with full lines expected by Q4 2023, potentially supporting nickel production outlook.

title: Lower European aluminium premiums risk deterring imports, freight rates fall
summary: European aluminium premiums (P1020A, Rotterdam) have fallen sharply from earlier record highs as consumer demand weakens and freight rates decline, reducing import appeal. Traders expect further premium drops as destocking continues and the arbitration window with Asia may close. With smelter capacity offline, supply could tighten later, but near-term pressure remains.

title: EQS-News: Asiamet Resources CEO talks latest work on updated feasibility study for BKM copper project
summary: Asiamet Resources’ CEO discusses ongoing work on an updated feasibility study for the BKM copper project. The update could affect market expectations about the project’s potential viability and timing of future copper supply. However, it does not indicate immediate production changes, so near-term price impact is likely modest.

title: EQS-News: Asiamet Resources Ltd: Asiamet Resources CEO talks latest work on updated feasibility study for BKM copper project
summary: Asiamet Resources’ CEO discussed recent work on an updated feasibility study for the company’s BKM copper project. The news is directly related to a copper development pathway, but feasibility-study updates generally do not change short-term supply or inventories quickly, so near-term copper price effects are likely limited.

title: Government lifts scrap-iron trade ban, except for copper
summary: The government ends a six-month scrap-iron trade ban two months early, except dealers cannot handle copper for now. Officials say the rule aims to reduce copper theft and vandalism while introducing new registration, inspection, and licensing controls for scrapyards and exports. Copper remains the industry’s key traded metal.

title: Comex Copper Ends the Week 0.15% Lower at $3.6265 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for November delivery settled at $3.6265, down 0.15% on the week, and down for two consecutive weeks. Despite the weekly decline, prices rose for three straight sessions in the current timeframe, with the latest move up versus earlier declines.

title: SCRAP IRON BAN TO BE LIFTED EARLY, NOT COPPER
summary: The government plans to lift an export ban affecting scrap-metal, earlier than the six-month deadline. However, the export ban will be extended for copper exports, announced by the Attorney General. Extending the copper export restriction is likely to reduce outbound copper availability and pressure copper prices in the near term.

title: Baradar Wants Practical Work Started On Mes Aynak Copper Min...
summary: The news says Baradar wants practical work to begin on the Mes Aynak copper mine. Advancing a major copper project can improve expectations for future supply. Even if production is not immediate, the announcement can provide modest upward support to copper pricing over the coming days to weeks.

title: Power Nickel Inc.: Power Nickel Extends High-Grade Nickel Mineralization at Nisk
summary: Power Nickel reports encouraging drill assay results from the Nisk project, including high-grade nickel-copper-cobalt sulfide and PGE-bearing mineralization. Intercepts extend mineralization further at depth and eastward, and drilling will be expanded. As exploration progresses, this can modestly support nickel and copper sentiment.

title: Lithium prices and nickel prices are rising because of increased demand for electric vehicle batteries
summary: The piece links rising nickel prices to stronger demand for electric-vehicle batteries, referencing Elon Musk’s remarks on which battery minerals matter most. While details are limited, the stated demand-driven move implies higher near-term nickel pricing pressure tied to EV battery market expectations.

title: Aluminium Inventories Extend Declines, but Vary By Region_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says China’s aluminium ingot social inventories fell to 516,000 mt on Nov 28, a new low, down 2,000 mt from last Thursday and 97,000 mt from a month ago. Inventory changes vary by region, while weekly warehouse shipments declined amid fewer arrivals and cautious downstream buying.

title: Copper Inventory across Major Chinese Markets Adds 600 mt over Weekend_SMM
summary: SMM says Chinese copper inventories across major markets rose by 600 mt over the weekend to 114,000 mt, driven mainly by higher stocks in Guangdong. While some regions fell, low import clearance and COVID-19-related efficiency issues weigh on shipments. SMM expects inventory to edge up slightly amid weaker end-month demand.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel Phase 3 Drilling Results: Continued Success Outlining Large-Scale CarLang Nickel Zone
summary: EV Nickel reported assay results from four additional Phase 3 drill holes at its Shaw Dome Project, confirming thick dunite-hosted nickel mineralization in the CarLang A Zone (e.g., ~0.25–0.26% Ni over long intercepts). The company expects remaining assays shortly and a preliminary resource estimate in Q1 2023.

title: Copper Mountain Mining Receives Bondholder Approval for the Sale of the Eva Copper Project and the Australian Exploration Tenements and Announces Bond Buyback Offer
summary: Copper Mountain Mining said it received bondholder approval to sell its Eva Copper Project and Australian exploration tenements to Harmony, with closing expected by Q1 2023. Proceeds fund a bond amendment and a bond buyback offer. The release reiterates Copper Mountain Mine copper-equivalent production outlook but no immediate market shock.

title: GLOBAL ENERGY METALS Assays up to 26.3% Copper, 0.546% Cobalt And 0.309% Nickel from Sampling Program at the Lovelock Project in Nevada
summary: Global Energy Metals reported encouraging assay results from initial field sampling at its Nevada Lovelock project, including copper up to 26.3% and nickel up to 0.309%, plus cobalt. The update is exploration-focused with no production or confirmed reserves, so any short-term price effect is likely limited and sentiment-driven.

title: GLOBAL ENERGY METALS Assays up to 26.3% Copper, 0.546% Cobalt And 0.309% Nickel from Sampling Program at the Lovelock Project in Nevada
summary: Global Energy Metals released sampling results from its Nevada Lovelock project, reporting assays up to 26.3% copper and 0.309% nickel, alongside cobalt. The update is based on limited surface rock sampling and recommends further mapping and potential drilling. It signals exploration potential but does not affect near-term supply.

title: Copper plummets, gold drifts lower
summary: Copper futures fell 1.3% to near a three-week low, with traders citing renewed COVID-19-driven civil unrest in China and concerns about further demand destruction and weaker commodity imports. The piece notes supplies tightening concerns are being ignored, keeping the immediate tone bearish for copper.

title: BHP averts strike at world's biggest copper mine - The Northern Miner
summary: Unionized workers at BHP’s Escondida copper mine in northern Chile accepted the latest offer, preventing a planned strike on Nov. 28 and 30. With no labor disruption, the near-term risk of reduced copper output declines, supporting expectations for steadier supply in the coming weeks.

title: JV Article: Metal Energy expands high-grade nickel zones at past-producing Manibridge mine
summary: Metal Energy expands drilling at the Manibridge nickel sulphide mine in Manitoba, reporting prior high-grade nickel intercepts (assays pending) and planning further 10,000-metre drilling. The nickel belt is described as underexplored, supporting positive sentiment for nickel supply prospects, with minor stated copper co-product potential.

title: Global nickel cartel off the table as Canada rebuffs Indonesia invite
summary: Canada’s trade minister rejects Indonesia’s proposal to join a “nickel cartel” modelled on OPEC. The piece notes Indonesia’s large nickel role in EV batteries and Canada’s lower-carbon, battery-grade nickel ambitions. While Canada will cooperate on trade, its refusal lowers the chance of supply coordination.

title: LME Says It Saved Nickel Market From $20 Billion 'Death Spiral'
summary: BNN Bloomberg reports the LME says it prevented nickel from falling into a $20 billion “death spiral.” Such an intervention would likely ease market stress and support expectations for nickel prices over the coming days as risk premia and liquidation pressure recede.

title: MMG mine in Peru resumes copper output; transportation still halted
summary: MMG’s Peru mine has resumed copper production, which improves short-term expectations for available supply. Still, transportation remains halted, likely delaying shipments to market and limiting the immediate effect on inventories. The net implication is moderately supportive for copper prices within the next days to weeks.

title: CCTV released of Southbank substation explosion during attempted copper theft in Melbourne
summary: CCTV shows a substation explosion in Melbourne during an attempted copper theft. Police say the thief used a spanner to try to steal about $1,000 of copper from a power board, triggering a blast and flames while the man allegedly escaped uninjured. Authorities are investigating.

title: High Nickel Ore Prices may Force the NPI Plants to Suspend Production_SMM
summary: SMM reports sluggish NPI trading as nickel ore supply tightens in the rainy season, keeping ore prices firm. Weak demand from steel mills and higher processing costs lead to slight inventory build and rangebound-to-lower NPI prices. If plants can’t secure cheaper ore, they may suspend production for maintenance.

title: Palladium One Mining Inc.: Palladium One Reports 10.4% Nickel, 3.4% Copper over 2.3 Meters and Adds Second Drill Rig at The Tyko Project, Canada
summary: Palladium One reported high-grade intercepts at its Tyko Project’s West Pickle discovery, including 10.4% nickel and 3.4% copper over 2.3 meters, and resumed drilling with a second rig. The news supports exploration success for nickel and copper, but offers no immediate production change.

title: Ivanhoe Electric Inc.: Ivanhoe Electric Reports Clear Demonstration of the Disruptive Power of Typhoon and Computational Geoscience Software to Find Hidden Porphyry Copper in the United States and Globally
summary: Ivanhoe Electric reported its first drill hole at the Typhoon “Far Southwest” anomaly intersecting chalcopyrite/pyrite copper mineralization at ~1,059 meters depth, plus additional oxide copper at East Ridge. Infill drilling continues to refine resources for the Santa Cruz copper project, with a PEA planned for 2023.

title: Usha Resources Ltd.: Usha Resources Provides Update for Proposed Spin-Out of Nicobat Nickel Project
summary: Usha Resources filed and mailed an information circular for a proposed spin-out of its Nicobat nickel-copper project into Formation Metals. The release describes recent drilling confirming high-grade nickel-copper shoots and outlines transaction conditions. While Ni and Cu are mentioned via grades, it is primarily corporate restructuring, not a market-moving supply or demand change.

title: Xander Resources Commences Maiden Drilling Program at the Timmins Nickel Project
summary: Xander Resources began its first diamond drilling program at the Timmins Nickel Project in Ontario, targeting geophysical conductors near Canada Nickel’s Reid Discovery and other ultramafic-related sulphide trends. Drilling covers 2,500–4,000 metres and aims to test high-priority anomalies that could expand nickel resource expectations.

title: Murchison Minerals Ltd.: Murchison Minerals Confirms Extensive High-Grade Nickel Sulphide Mineralization at the HPM Property with Assays Returning 121.2 metre Interval at 1.36% NiEq.
summary: Murchison Minerals announced drillhole BDF22-002 results from its Barre de Fer zone, reporting 121.2 m at 1.36% NiEq (including higher-grade intervals) and associated copper-equivalent grades in nickel sulphide mineralization. The update supports exploration potential but does not affect near-term production or inventories.

title: C3 Metals Inc.: C3 Metals Receives Drill Permit for Arthurs Seat Copper-Gold Project in Jamaica
summary: C3 Metals received drill permits and plans an initial 5,000m program at its Arthurs Seat copper-gold-silver project in Jamaica. Recent rock-chip assays reported up to 16.5% copper and 4,890 g/t silver. The update supports potential future resource growth but has no immediate production impact.

title: Partnership will use nanobubbles to increase copper recovery
summary: BASF partnered with Moleaer to apply nanobubble technology plus BASF’s LixTRA reagent to enhance copper leaching and recovery, especially from chalcopyrite sulfide ores. The firms cite rising copper demand tied to electrification and potential future supply gaps, implying incremental supply support and bullish sentiment for copper.

title: Copper moves higher on China demand hopes
summary: Copper prices rose 1.1% on Tuesday as investors bet China’s COVID protests could force faster easing of curbs, boosting growth and metals demand expectations. Easier property developer financing also supported the metals-intensive sector. The yuan’s strength made dollar metals cheaper for Chinese buyers, lifting LME copper. Aluminium and nickel rose too.

title: Palladium One Reports 10.4% Nickel, 3.4% Copper Over 2.3 Met...
summary: Palladium One reported drill results featuring grades of 10.4% nickel and 3.4% copper over 2.3 metres. Such assay announcements can lift market expectations for the potential resource base and future supply of nickel and copper, providing modest near-term support to prices.

title: Palladium One Reports 10.4% Nickel, 3.4% Copper Over 2.3 Met...
summary: Palladium One reports drill results including 10.4% nickel and 3.4% copper over 2.3 meters. Such high-grade findings can support market expectations for future nickel and copper output, potentially adding modest upside pressure to prices in the near term.

title: Comex Copper Settles 0.51% Higher at $3.6300 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for December delivery settled 0.51% higher at $3.6300 per pound, up 1.85 cents. The contract gained on the day, marking the biggest one-day dollar and percentage increase since Nov. 22 and extending a multi-day winning run while remaining below earlier highs.

title: Jokowi Vows to Appeal WTO Ruling Against Nickel Ore Export Ban
summary: Indonesia’s President Jokowi says he will appeal a WTO ruling against Indonesia’s nickel ore export ban. The outcome could influence nickel ore export flows and supply expectations for later-stage processing, weighing on nickel prices if markets expect improved availability.

title: WATCH | Government wages war on copper and metal theft
summary: South Africa’s government unveiled proposed regulations to curb theft and illegal trading of copper and other metals, including requirements to disclose buyers/sellers, restrictions on cash transactions, and tighter border controls. By limiting scrap exports and illicit supply, the measures could tighten nearby copper availability and support prices over coming days.

title: Throughput of Aluminium Scrap Plunges amid the Fluctuating Aluminium Prices and the Poor Downstream Demand_SMM
summary: SMM says aluminium scrap throughput in Shandong Linyi fell about 49% week-on-week as downstream demand weakened. A00 spot aluminium prices trended lower and SHFE contracts also declined. Average operating rates for processing firms fell, and aluminium scrap demand remained weak despite slight price drops, with oversupply expected to persist.

title: Nickel Prices Fluctuate at Highs in November, and PMI for Alloy Sector Remains above 50-point mark_SMM
summary: SMM reports the November alloy-sector PMI stayed above 50 (50.24), with production and new orders holding up. SHFE nickel trended higher in November, supported by a softer US CPI and persistent demand for refined nickel from military alloy uses. December PMI is expected to soften slightly, though military orders stay stable.

title: The Final Reading of the PMI in November Stood at 50.17 as Nickel Wire and Nickel Mesh Industry Improved_SMM
summary: SMM reports November’s final PMI for nickel wire and nickel mesh at 50.17, above 50, with orders slightly higher than October as downstream textile/furniture operating rates recovered after the National Day holiday. December PMI is estimated higher, supported by a 0.25% RRR cut and real-estate financing support.

title: Copper Heads for Best Month Since April 2021 on China Optimism
summary: The piece highlights that copper is heading for its best month since April 2021, driven by optimism around China. That framing suggests improving near-term expectations for industrial demand, which tends to support copper prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: European Aluminium sets up independent taskforce to probe certain Turkish imports, sources say
summary: European Aluminium is setting up an independent taskforce to examine whether Turkish aluminium imports harm the European market. Premiums have been declining as imports increase and energy costs squeeze margins, with 6063 extrusion billet and P1020A premiums lower. The taskforce will collect input, but action may not be imminent.

title: Export of copper banned for six months, Patel announced
summary: South Africa announced a six-month ban on exporting copper and copper-alloy waste and scrap, with a permit system for semi-finished copper exports. The government aims to curb theft and vandalism by dampening demand for scrap. Tighter controls begin immediately upon gazetting, likely affecting near-term copper export flows.

title: Indonesia to appeal WTO ruling on nickel ore trade dispute-Xinhua
summary: Indonesia says it will appeal a WTO ruling that found it violated trade rules over its 2020 nickel ore export ban. The EU sued Indonesia, alleging the ban. Indonesia maintains its downstream policy to develop nickel processing. The appeal keeps uncertainty around ore supply tight, supporting nickel sentiment.

title: CanAlaska Uranium Ltd.: CanAlaska Announces: Assays Confirm Nickel Mineralization in Ongoing Phase 2 Summer Drill Program at Manibridge
summary: CanAlaska reported assay results from the first 14 holes of its Manibridge Phase 2 drill program confirming nickel-copper-cobalt mineralization. Intersections include ~0.8% Ni over 20m and ~0.6% Ni over ~20–25m near the historic Manibridge Nickel Mine. Further drilling is planned and two assays are pending.

title: Indonesia to appeal WTO ruling on nickel ore trade dispute
summary: Indonesia says it will appeal a WTO ruling against its 2020 nickel ore export ban after the EU’s complaint. The government argues downstream processing is needed for jobs and investment. The appeal keeps regulatory uncertainty over nickel ore exports, potentially constraining supply and supporting nickel prices near term.

title: Alianza partner Allied Copper intersects 4.26% Copper over 1.06 metres at West Graben Fault Target, Klondike Property, Colorado
summary: Alianza and partner Allied Copper reported initial drilling at the Klondike property in Colorado, with Hole KDB22-05 intersecting 4.26% copper over 1.06 metres within broader anomalous intervals. The article highlights prospects on the West Graben Fault and notes prior and surface copper assays, but does not address production or supply changes.

title: Gold, copper set for best month in 2022
summary: Gold and copper were steady as markets awaited Fed Chair Powell’s speech and key US payroll data. The article says copper is set for its best monthly gain in 2022, helped by expectations that rate hikes may slow and by speculation about potential scaling back of China’s COVID restrictions.

title: NBN Co warns of copper network's mounting costs
summary: NBN Co says copper-based broadband faces rising operational and maintenance costs it can’t avoid, citing higher fault volumes and truck rolls versus fibre. It warns copper degradation will worsen costs and seeks favourable regulatory conditions to fund more upgrades. Estimated copper-to-fibre upgrade costs are $2,000–$3,000 per premises.

title: Goro Nickel Mine Faces Increased Regulation After Tailings Leak
summary: The report says the Goro nickel mine faces tighter regulation after a tailings leak. Additional compliance requirements can increase the risk of operational disruptions, delays, or reduced output. In the near term, this would likely heighten nickel supply concerns and pressure prices lower.

title: Jokowi: Jakarta will appeal WTO ruling on nickel export ban
summary: Indonesia’s Jokowi said the country will appeal a WTO ruling against its 2014 nickel ore export ban. The WTO found Indonesia failed to justify the ban as preventing critical shortages. While the decision disrupted EU supply, Indonesia plans to maintain downstreaming policy to attract processing investment.

title: EDITORIAL | Six-month ban on copper trade may spark economic revival
summary: South Africa’s trade minister announced a six-month ban on exporting copper and copper alloys to curb widespread theft of copper cables and vandalism of infrastructure. The editorial says costs are far beyond the metal’s value and cites major losses for utilities and transport. Temporary restrictions hit legitimate traders and alter export flows.

title: Horizonte Minerals PLC Announces Port Contract Awarded for Araguaia Nickel Project
summary: Horizonte Minerals PLC said it has been awarded a port contract for its Araguaia nickel project. The contract can improve logistics and shipping arrangements tied to nickel operations, which may slightly strengthen expectations for nickel supply readiness. The magnitude and timing of any production impact remain uncertain.

title: South Africa imposes temporary ban  on export of copper scrap to
summary: South Africa imposed a six-month ban on exporting copper and copper-alloy scrap (and most ferrous scrap) to curb rampant metal theft tied to public infrastructure. The restriction, part of a broader three-phase intervention, is likely to reduce global copper scrap flows and support copper price expectations over coming days.

title: SMM China Aluminum Ingot and Billet Social Inventory as of December _SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s aluminium ingot social inventory at 500,000 mt on Dec 1, down 18,000 mt on the week, mainly due to fewer arrivals after some smelters shipped south where premiums were higher. Yet premiums fell on weak downstream consumption. Billet inventories rose slightly and are expected to grow.

title: In Peru's Hills, An Artisanal Miner Boom Frustrates Big Copper's Plans
summary: Artisanal copper mining in Peru’s Andes has surged after high copper prices, using permits that overlap with formal concessions held by Southern Copper’s Los Chancas and MMG’s Las Bambas. The overlap fuels permit disputes and permit cancellations, raising risks of delays and reduced certainty for large-scale copper project development.

title: Canada Nickel Confirms Higher Grade Interval at Reid, Announces Discovery at Sothman
summary: Canada Nickel reported positive drilling assays at its Reid property, including a higher-grade interval (0.29% Ni over 325.5m, with 0.35% Ni over 81.5m) and continued mineralization in multiple holes. It also announced a new discovery at Sothman with all five holes intersecting mineralization (assays pending).

title: Gungnir Resources Inc.: Gungnir Drills 7.0 metres of 1.16% Nickel and Identifies New Footwall Nickel Target at Lappvattnet
summary: Gungnir Resources reported additional near-surface drilling at its Lappvattnet nickel project in northern Sweden, including 7.0 metres of 1.16% nickel and intersections suggesting a new footwall nickel target. Assays for several holes remain pending. The release provides resource context but no immediate production changes.

title: BMW Group invests in novel process for copper extraction
summary: BMW Group, via BMW i Ventures, invests in US startup Jetti Resources developing catalytic leaching to extract copper from previously unused sulfide ores and mine waste. The technology claims lower CO2 and water use and potential to extend existing mine output. The release is supportive for long-run supply, but lacks near-term volume impact.

title: Prime Meridian Resources Corp. La Sarita Copper Silver Project Purchase Option on a Former Copper / Silver Producer
summary: Prime Meridian Resources signed an LOI to purchase a 100% interest in the La Sarita copper-silver project in Sonora, Mexico. Historical sampling at the Puerta Verde 2 mine reported up to 3.8% copper and 774.9 g/t silver, with 3D IP outlining a target. No production or quantifiable near-term supply impact is stated.

title: Latest News | Business Briefs Odisha CM Inaugurates Vedanta Aluminium Park
summary: Odisha Chief Minister inaugurated Vedanta Aluminium Park in Jharsuguda, a joint venture with IDCO. The park is meant to attract downstream manufacturers that can draw hot (molten) aluminium from Vedanta’s smelter to produce finished products. This can improve near-term sentiment for aluminium demand.

title: BMW invests in low carbon copper firm Jetti
summary: BMW i Ventures invested in Jetti, a low-carbon copper processing technology provider, to help secure critical raw materials amid rising EV demand. The article cites higher copper intensity for electric vehicles and forecasts potential copper shortfalls. Jetti uses leaching instead of smelting, requiring less power and boosting extraction from low-grade sources.

title: Comex Copper Settles 2.27% Higher at $3.8140 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper front-month futures settled 2.27% higher at $3.8140 per pound, gaining 8.45 cents. Prices were higher for three straight sessions and six of the past seven, reaching the highest settlement since Nov. 15, 2022, signaling bullish near-term momentum in copper markets.

title: Copper Inventory in Major Chinese Markets Dips 1,300 mt from Monday_SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s major-market copper inventories at 112,700 mt on Dec 2, down 1,300 mt from Monday. Arrivals were limited and December purchases increased, but smelters shipped more while Guangdong demand was weak. Supplies look higher next week with import arrivals rising, while inventories should fall slightly amid some demand recovery.

title: Hon'ble CM Of Odisha Inaugurates Vedanta Aluminium Park At J...
summary: The article headline says Odisha’s Chief Minister inaugurated Vedanta’s “Aluminium Park” at J. The event implies progress toward expanding aluminium production in India, improving the medium-term supply outlook. Such announcements typically support aluminium prices via improved growth/supply expectations, but near-term magnitude is uncertain.

title: Constellium SE: Constellium to lead £10m CirConAl project to develop lower carbon, lower cost recycled aluminium alloys with automakers and suppliers
summary: Constellium will lead the £10m CirConAl project to develop lower-carbon, lower-cost aluminium extrusion alloys using post-consumer scrap, supported by a UK government grant. The consortium will prototype and test high-strength recycled-content alloys for automotive components and develop scrap sorting to prevent downcycling.

title: Global firms SMS, LOTTE cooperate on new EV-focused US aluminium plant
summary: LOTTE and SMS are collaborating on an EV-focused aluminium project in Elizabethtown, Kentucky, producing 36,000 tonnes/year of cathode foil for lithium-ion batteries. The piece links EV investments and the US policy backdrop to expectations of higher aluminium demand, alongside commentary that aluminium premiums have recently been stable.

title: The PMI for China Aluminium Processing Sectors Stayed in the Contraction Territory for Two Consecutive Months in November_SMM
summary: SMM data shows China’s aluminium processing-sector PMI fell to 42.4 in November, staying in contraction for a second month. Production disruptions, weaker domestic and overseas demand, and pandemic-related transport constraints reduced new orders across segments, with construction extrusion and wire/cable particularly weak. PMI is expected to remain below 50 in December.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports Down 23,000 wmt WoW_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says nickel ore inventories at Chinese ports fell 23,000 wmt WoW to 8.92 million wmt, with Philippines shipment outflows declining and inflows slowing. Meanwhile, NPI plants faced losses from weaker NPI prices and steel mills cut output, reducing ore demand. Stocks may decline only modestly short term, with imports elsewhere still sizable.

title: China's aluminium ADC 12 export window opens following gains in MJP market
summary: China’s ADC 12 aluminium scrap export window opened after strong gains in Japan’s MJP market. Japanese offers were lifted on tight spot scrap availability, keeping prices supported. However, Chinese domestic prices stayed flat on limited spot activity, and restocking demand is weak amid slow end-market inquiries and earlier holidays.

title: EPA proposes restrictions on plans to build copper, gold mine in AK
summary: The EPA proposed restrictions that would block or limit plans for the Pebble mine in Alaska’s Bristol Bay region, citing unacceptable adverse effects on salmon habitat. The copper project faces further regulatory hurdles before a final determination, potentially tightening expected copper supply prospects.

title: Sustainable Copper Firm Jetti Receives BMW Investment
summary: BMW took a stake in U.S. copper miner Jetti Resources to secure raw material supply for electric vehicles. Jetti’s low-power leaching technology targets copper from low-grade resources, potentially expanding supply while cutting emissions. With EV demand rising, the investment and reported production gains are supportive for copper sentiment.

title: Miners Turn To Bacteria And Other New Ways To Leach Copper From Waste Rock
summary: Rio Tinto, Freeport-McMoRan and others are deploying new (including bacteria-based) leaching methods to extract copper from waste rock stored at mine sites. The firms say the approach could boost copper recovery and add production within a few years while avoiding lengthy permitting, supporting near-term supply expectations.

title: EQS-News: Poseidon Nickel Ltd: Poseidon Nickel fully funded as it moves towards decision to proceed at Black Swan
summary: Poseidon Nickel Ltd said it is fully funded and progressing toward a decision to proceed with its Black Swan nickel project. While it does not indicate immediate production, moving the project forward can increase expectations of future nickel supply, which may weigh on nickel prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Short Term Outlook Dims For Copper Prices
summary: The article expects weaker near-term copper prices, citing a widening refined copper market deficit and mixed production trends (Chile down, DRC up). It highlights rising China consumption uncertainty amid renewed COVID restrictions and protests, noting the copper index fell and March Comex copper dropped to about $7,915/ton.

title: Opinion: The London Metal Exchange's near-death nickel experience
summary: An opinion piece recounts the LME’s near-collapse in March when nickel prices surged violently, triggering massive margin calls at LME Clear and raising default contagion risk. It links the melt-up to sanctions worries after Russia’s invasion and hidden OTC short positions, leading the LME to suspend and cancel nickel trades.

title: IGO Group nickel mine fire knocks out production for several weeks
summary: IGO’s Nova mine in Western Australia remains shut after a fire at the power station, with output suspended pending an investigation. Production is not expected to resume before mid-January, removing several weeks of supply from a nickel-copper-cobalt operation and likely pressuring nickel and copper prices lower.

title: Cobre Limited  Thick High-Grade Copper Assay Results at Ngami
summary: Cobre Limited reported high-grade assay results from drill hole NCP20A at its Comet Target in Botswana’s Kalahari Copper Belt. Results include a 30m copper-silver intersection averaging 1.25% Cu and standout intervals up to 10.9% Cu, reinforcing the potential for an economic deposit and more drilling.

title: Antler deep drilling unearths high-grade copper for New World Resources
summary: New World Resources reported “exceptional” deep drilling results at its Antler copper project in Arizona, including an 8.1% copper interval over 10.7 metres and ongoing mineralisation open at depth. The company says results could raise overall resource grade and indicated tonnes as scoping and pre-feasibility studies continue.

title: Copper hits 3-week high after more Chinese cities ease COVID curbs
summary: Copper rose to a three-week high as more Chinese cities eased COVID curbs, lifting expectations for fuller economic reopening. A weaker U.S. dollar also supported LME prices. The article notes aluminium and nickel gains as well, reflecting improved short-term demand sentiment for industrial metals.

title: Giga Metals to Exit Copper Exploration Project in Brazil
summary: Giga Metals said it will exit copper exploration in Piaui State, Brazil, because the program has not generated enough support to justify ongoing budgets. The company plans to focus instead on its Turnagain nickel project, while previous work targeted sediment-hosted copper mineralization. Near-term price effects are likely minimal.

title: Aluminium Ingot Social Inventories rise from Last Thursday, but Remain at Historical Low_SMM
summary: China’s aluminium ingot social inventories in eight major markets rose to 507,000 mt on Dec 5, up 7,000 mt from last Thursday, but still near historical lows. Several regions saw limited arrivals or improved pick-up constraints, while weekly warehouse shipments increased slightly yet stayed low vs last year.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel Announces Non-Brokered Flow-Through Private Placement for up to C$1.0 Million
summary: EV Nickel Inc. announced a up to C$1.0 million non-brokered flow-through private placement to fund exploration of its Shaw Dome nickel project in Ontario. Proceeds will be used for Canadian flow-through mining expenditures. No production changes, mine disruptions, or trade/policy measures affecting nickel prices were mentioned.

title: Constellium To Lead £10M CirConAl Project To Develop Lower Carbon, Lower Cost Recycled Aluminium Alloys With Automakers And Suppliers
summary: Constellium will lead the £10m CirConAl project with automakers and suppliers to develop lower-carbon, lower-cost recycled aluminium extrusion alloys, supported by a UK government grant. The consortium aims to increase use of post-consumer scrap through improved sorting and blending, supporting a circular aluminium supply chain.

title: US, EU Weigh Climate-Based Tariffs on Chinese Steel and Aluminum
summary: The headline says the US and EU are considering climate-based tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum. If such tariffs are enacted, they would likely reduce imports and lift the cost of available supply in US/EU markets, creating upward pressure on aluminium prices over the following days to weeks.

title: US, EU Weigh Climate-Based Tariffs on Chinese Steel and Aluminum
summary: The US and EU are reportedly weighing climate-based tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum. Such trade barriers could limit Chinese aluminum inflows, tightening supply for import-dependent buyers and supporting expectations for higher aluminium prices over the coming days and weeks.

title: US, EU weigh climate-based tariffs on Chinese steel, aluminum -Bloomberg News
summary: The US and EU are weighing new climate-based tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum to curb carbon emissions, amid concerns about Chinese overcapacity and pressure on domestic industries. While still early-stage and not formally proposed, tariff prospects could tighten aluminium import supply expectations. Copper effects appear indirect through wider market sentiment.

title: Unstable pit closed at Highland Valley Copper near Logan lake | iNFOnews | Thompson-Okanagan's News Source
summary: Teck Resources said Highland Valley Copper near Logan Lake temporarily closed the Valley Pit due to geotechnical instability. The pit will reopen after remediation and safety confirmation. Teck reports no worker-safety or environmental risk and says operations continue with stockpiled ore, but the disruption can pressure near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Copper rises as China COVID easing sparks demand hopes
summary: Copper prices gained as China began easing COVID-19 curbs, boosting hopes for demand recovery in the top consumer. LME three-month copper rose 0.5% and Shanghai January copper edged slightly lower. Gains were limited by signs of softer imported copper demand and slowing inventory withdrawals, while the dollar stayed steady.

title: Gravita India's subsidiary commences aluminium recycling plant in Togo-West Africa; stock rises ~3%
summary: Gravita Togo SAU began commercial production of aluminium cast alloys at a new recycling plant in Togo with ~4,000 MTPA capacity. The firm plans to procure local scrap and serve die-casting demand from Asia. Sourcing and network expansion could marginally increase expected aluminium supply, supporting prices.

title: AZZ has announced its plan to construct a new aluminum coil coating facility in Washington, Missouri. The facility is expected to be operational in 2025.
summary: AZZ Precoat Metals plans to build a new aluminum coil-coating facility in Washington, Missouri, expected to start operations in 2025. The company says it has secured long-term customer commitments for over 75% of the new capacity, aiming to strengthen service to a growing aluminum market.

title: Yangshan Copper Trading Remains Sluggish due to the Poor Demand_SMM
summary: SMM reports sluggish Yangshan copper trading as demand remains weak. Yangshan premiums under warrants stay around $65-80/mt, with bill-of-lading premiums and import losses dynamics shifting modestly. LME contango widened and quotes were lowered; hydro- and pyro-copper were traded at reduced levels under warrants.

title: Pacton Gold: Pacton Files Technical Report for High-Grade, District-Scale Copper Project in Labrador, Canada
summary: Pacton Gold filed an NI 43-101 technical report for the Adeline copper project in Labrador, Canada, tied to its proposed acquisition and pending financing and regulatory acceptance. The news is copper-specific, but the transaction is exploration-stage and approval-dependent, so immediate influence on copper prices is likely small.

title: Aluminium drops on uncertainty over China reopening
summary: LME aluminium fell 0.9% and copper slipped 0.2% as markets weighed uncertainty over China’s easing of zero-COVID restrictions. Despite earlier optimism for stronger demand, investors took a wait-and-see stance amid a firmer U.S. dollar after strong U.S. services data, pressuring dollar-priced commodities.

title: U.S. Aluminum Plants Producing Huge Amounts Of Greenhouse Gases
summary: Investigative reporting says Century Aluminum’s Sebree, Kentucky smelter vents large amounts of CF4 and other perfluorocarbons, far more than its Iceland plant. Environmental advocates argue older U.S. smelters should be required to adopt technological fixes to cut climate pollution, which could affect operating costs and supply in the near term.

title: Glencore Says This Time Is Different for Coming Copper Shortage
summary: The piece’s headline says Glencore believes this time is different regarding an upcoming copper shortage. If the market interprets this as stronger-than-expected near-term supply tightness, it would likely raise expectations for copper inventories and pricing, creating upward pressure over the next days to weeks.

title: Candente Copper Reconstitutes Board of Directors
summary: Candente Copper Corp. announces a reconstituted board following Fortescue-related majority voting outcomes. The company states it will advance its Cañariaco project, including planned high-priority drilling in 2023. No production, permitting, funding, or supply/transport changes are announced that would affect near-term copper prices.

title: Chile: Marimaca Copper Reports Further Positive Higher-Grade Results from Northern MOD Infill Drilling
summary: Chile’s Marimaca Copper reports additional positive higher-grade results from northern infill drilling at its MOD. Better-than-expected grades can improve the perceived resource outlook and future production economics, typically supporting copper market sentiment. The impact on near-term spot prices is likely modest due to longer development timelines.

title: Comex Copper Settles 0.58% Higher at $3.8115 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for December delivery settled 0.58% higher at $3.8115 per pound, gaining 2.20 cents. The contract rose on eight of the past 10 sessions. The piece frames current performance versus recent 52-week high/low and year-to-date movement, signaling modest positive price momentum.

title: Copper price to hit record in 2023, Goldman Sachs forecasts; Glencore bullish
summary: Goldman Sachs forecasts copper prices will reach record levels as a looming supply shortage meets growing demand, leaving the physical market in deficit in 2023. Glencore’s CEO also expects a “huge deficit,” reinforcing a bullish near-term supply-tightness narrative for copper.

title: China Nov copper imports rise on brighter demand outlook
summary: China’s unwrought and copper-product imports rose 5.8% in November, supported by expectations of stronger demand next year as Beijing backs the property sector and eases COVID restrictions. Customs data show more inflows and bonded stocks. The article links improved sentiment with higher LME and Shanghai copper prices in November.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel Phase 3 Drilling Results: The A Zone Continues to Deliver and Covers Less Than 15% of the Potential CarLang Trend
summary: EV Nickel reports assay results from three additional Phase 3 holes at its Shaw Dome “CarLang A Zone,” intersecting thick peridotite-dunite hosting nickel with grades around 0.25–0.26% Ni. The company says results confirm continuity along a portion of the trend and will feed a preliminary resource estimate in Q1 2023.

title: Fabled Copper Corp.: Fabled Copper Reports on the New Discovery Target 11 Vein Area
summary: Fabled Copper Corp. announced 2022 surface fieldwork results from its Muskwa Copper Project, including assays from Target 11 and surrounding areas. Several samples show copper mineralization (some >0.5% Cu). The company plans additional releases, but the update is exploratory with no production impact.

title: Ring of Fire Metals, Webequie sign MoU on Canadian nickel project
summary: Ring of Fire Metals (Wyloo Metals’ renamed unit) signed an MoU with Webequie First Nation to collaborate on exploration and negotiations for the proposed Eagle’s Nest mine in Ontario’s Ring of Fire. The deposit is described as high-grade nickel-copper, but the agreement signals partnership framework rather than near-term output.

title: Mining Giant Glencore Sees Huge Deficit In Copper Coming
summary: Glencore says a huge copper deficit is coming, arguing current prices do not reflect the tightness. It highlights lagging mine development, elevated country/operational risks, and reduced copper investment (capex) expectations, while demand is supported by grid expansion and energy-transition targets.

title: Nickel Prices Could See Some Bullish Upside This Month
summary: The article says nickel prices showed a short-term uptrend in December and could see bullish upside this month, supported by the continuation of a range breakout and improving demand expectations from China reopening. Risks include weak stainless demand, recession concerns, and downside from Indonesia’s nickel ore export ban being lifted.

title: 'Nickel and copper's time': Vale to split off metals group to capitalize on battery demand
summary: The headline reports that Vale plans to split off its metals group to better capitalize on battery demand. Because the move is framed around battery-linked metals, including nickel and copper, it may boost sentiment for near-term supply and demand expectations, supporting prices even if immediate physical effects are unclear.

title: Gravita starts Aluminium Recycling Plant in Togo-West Africa
summary: Gravita India says its Togo subsidiary, Gravita Togo SAU, has begun commercial production of aluminium cast alloys from a new recycling plant. Phase 1 capacity is about 4,000 MTPA, with expected incremental revenue and gross margins. The news indicates increased recycled aluminium supply in West Africa.

title: Comex Copper Settles 1.15% Higher at $3.8555 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper front-month futures for December delivery settled 1.15% higher at $3.8555, gaining 4.40 cents per pound. It was the largest one-day dollar and percentage gain since Dec. 1, and copper has risen for two consecutive sessions. The contract is up over two sessions and has hit multi-week highs.

title: Vale to split off copper, nickel group to capitalize on battery demand
summary: Vale plans to split its base metals operations into a separate entity to ensure nickel and copper assets receive dedicated funding. Management expects accelerating battery/EV demand and a premium for battery-grade nickel, projecting higher production. The restructuring aims to attract capital and optimize capacity, supporting bullish sentiment for both metals.

title: Vale to break out copper and nickel assets including Canadian mines
summary: Vale said it will ring-fence its nickel and copper operations into a new Vale Base Metals unit, with Canadian, Indonesian and Brazilian assets, and plans to name a strategic partner in the first half of next year. The move aims to attract capital for base-metal investments as EV battery demand rises.

title: Vale to split off copper, nickel group to capitalize on battery demand
summary: Vale plans to split off its base metals operations into a separate entity, a move aimed at ensuring nickel and copper assets receive sustained capital. Executives cite rising battery and EV demand, highlight North American production, and set ambitious nickel and copper output targets requiring major investment.

title: Vale to break out copper and nickel assets including Canadian mines
summary: Vale said it will ring-fence and split out its copper and nickel assets into Vale Base Metals, including Canadian and Brazilian mines, and later select a strategic partner. The move accompanies plans for major base-metal investment as EV battery demand rises, supporting improved short-term sentiment for copper and nickel supply outlooks.

title: U.S. Floats New Steel, Aluminum Tariffs Based On Carbon Emissions
summary: The U.S. is proposing carbon-emissions-based tariffs on imported steel and aluminum, creating a “club” of lower-emission producers with lower tariff rates and charging higher tariffs for higher-emission exporters. The framework is being discussed with the EU and targets “dirty” metal, potentially altering aluminium supply and pricing in the region.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Provides Update on Preliminary Economic Assessment and Mineral Resource Estimate for the Copper Creek Project in Arizona
summary: Faraday Copper updated the Preliminary Economic Assessment and Mineral Resource Estimate for its Copper Creek copper project in Arizona. The company incorporated new drill results, historical core assays, and geotechnical/metallurgical test work, with the updated study planned for Q2 2023. The news is a technical milestone, not an imminent supply change.

title: Composite Materials Aluminum Alloys Aerospace Global Market
summary: The article promotes a market report on composite materials and aluminum alloys used in aerospace, attributing short-term disruption to the Russia-Ukraine war. It notes sanctions, higher commodity prices, and supply-chain disruptions affecting global markets. The only directly implicated tracked metal is aluminium via aerospace aluminum alloys demand/supply conditions.

title: Amarc Resources Ltd.: Amarc and Boliden Commence Drilling the Duke Copper-Gold District, BC
summary: Amarc and Boliden have started core drilling at Amarc’s 100% owned Duke porphyry copper-gold district in central British Columbia. The program is part of an earn-in agreement where Boliden can build up to 70% by funding exploration and development. Results are expected through 2023, with drilling continuing into early 2023.

title: Gravita starts aluminum-recycling activities in Togo
summary: Gravita began operations at a new aluminum-recycling facility in Lilikopé, Togo, with initial commercial production of aluminum casting alloys. The plant’s first-stage capacity is 4,000 MTPA and expands Gravita’s scrap collection network. The development could marginally increase recycled aluminum supply regionally, supporting prices.

title: WTO rules against U.S. import duties on steel, aluminium, Norway says
summary: A WTO panel has ruled against U.S. import duties imposed in 2018 on steel and aluminium, with Norway saying the U.S. aluminium tariff breaches WTO rules. The decision raises prospects for easing trade barriers affecting Norway, a major aluminium producer, which may support aluminium pricing over coming days.

title: WTO rules against U.S. steel, aluminium tariffs, Norway says
summary: Norway says a WTO panel ruled in its favour against U.S. import duties imposed in 2018 on steel and aluminium. The Norwegian foreign ministry stated the U.S. aluminium tariff breached WTO rules. No immediate U.S. response was provided, and rulings in similar cases are expected later.

title: WTO Rules Against US Tariffs on Steel, Aluminum Imposed by Trump
summary: The article says a WTO decision rules against US tariffs on steel and aluminum imposed under Trump. If upheld, the ruling would likely reduce aluminum tariff uncertainty and improve prospects for cross-border trade, which can support aluminum prices in the coming days.

title: Comex Copper Settles 0.65% Higher at $3.8805 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for December delivery settled up 2.50 cents per pound, or 0.65%, at $3.8805. Prices rose for three straight sessions, reaching the highest settlement value since Nov. 11. The move comes alongside a month-to-date increase of 4.05% and remains well below prior highs.

title: Tiwai aluminium smelter head focused on 'continuing operations'
summary: Tiwai aluminium smelter chief executive Chris Blenkiron said the company is focused on continuing operations beyond 2024 by negotiating new power contracts and exploring green hydrogen use. Tiwai consumes about 12% of New Zealand electricity and produces 330 kt of aluminium annually, largely exported.

title: Copper rises to more than 5-mth high on hopes of strong Chinese demand
summary: London and Shanghai copper prices rose to multi-month highs as China eased COVID-19 curbs and property support improved demand expectations. Goldman lifted its copper price forecast and cited tightening visible stocks. Non-ferrous prices broadly moved higher, with aluminium and nickel also up, supported by a weaker dollar.

title: Copper Inventories in Domestic Bonded Zones Add 4,200 mt from Last Friday_SMM
summary: SMM says China’s domestic bonded copper inventories rose 4,200 mt from Dec 2 to 32,600 mt by Dec 9. Shanghai bonded inventories increased to 29,200 mt, while Guangdong was unchanged. The build followed exports from smelters and bill-of-lading arrivals, with sluggish port inquiries tied to low SHFE/LME ratio and softer Yangshan premiums.

title: Nickel Inventories in Domestic Bonded Zone Up 1,120 mt from December 2_SMM
summary: SMM reports Dec 9 bonded-zone nickel inventories rising to 6,300 mt, including 1,370 mt of briquettes and 4,930 mt of nickel plate. Import spot losses climbed to 30,000 yuan/mt as domestic-outside futures spreads failed to narrow and the SHFE/LME ratio fell. With weak customs clearance and rigid domestic demand, some nickel was redirected to ports.

title: Cordoba, JCHX to jointly develop Colombian copper-gold-silver project
summary: Cordoba Minerals and JCHX will jointly develop Cordoba’s Alacran copper-gold-silver project in Colombia, with JCHX acquiring a 50% stake for $100m. Payments are tied to closing, feasibility study/EIA submission, and EIA approval. The deal could affect copper expectations but appears too slow for near-term price pressure.

title: Enormous New Capacity Will Further Intensify Competition in the Domestic Aluminium Plate/Sheet, Strip and Foil Industry_SMM
summary: SMM says China will add 2.71 million mt of new aluminium plate/sheet, strip and foil capacity before 2025, including 1.04 million mt of battery foil. With global recession and renewed COVID-related demand weakness, producers face insufficient orders, margin cuts, and jeopardized operating rates as competition intensifies.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports Down 29,000 wmt WoW_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM said Chinese nickel ore inventories fell 29,000 wmt to 8.89 million wmt as the Philippines remains in rainy season and port stock declines. Total nickel content is about 70,000 mt. NPI demand is weaker and some plants will reduce output in December, keeping nickel ore prices trending lower.

title: Québec Nickel Corp. Announces Closing of the First Tranche of Its Previously Announced Private Placement
summary: Québec Nickel Corp. announced closing the first tranche of a brokered private placement, raising about $5.6m to fund working capital and nickel-related exploration at its Québec properties. The news is financing-driven with no production, supply, or inventory changes stated, limiting short-term impact on nickel prices.

title: Azimut signs JV agreement with KGHM for Canadian copper-gold property
summary: Azimut and KGHM International sign a JV for Quebec’s Kukamas copper-gold property. KGHM can earn an initial 50% stake by spending $5m over four years and may invest at least $4.2m more to add 20% to fund a PEA. No production timing or near-term supply impact is stated.

title: Analysis-Turbulence Still Haunts LME Nickel, Months On From Trade Debacle
summary: The piece says LME nickel’s benchmark status remains impaired months after the March trading meltdown, with liquidity sliding, high volatility, and abnormal pricing versus Shanghai. Low deliverable nickel supplies mean the contract still matters, but investors have largely stayed away, keeping market confidence fragile.

title: 'Nickel and copper's time,' says Vale vice-president
summary: Vale plans to separate its base metals operations from its iron ore business, covering nickel assets in Canada and copper/nickel production elsewhere. Management says the move will attract capital and better position Vale to meet expected EV and battery demand, with nickel and copper receiving more focused investment.

title: 'Nickel and copper's time,' says Vale vice-president
summary: Vale plans to split its base metals business from its iron ore unit in mid-2023, isolating nickel assets including Sudbury and Voisey’s Bay. Executives cite surging battery-driven demand for nickel and copper, alongside major planned capex to expand output, supporting a bullish near-term sentiment for both metals.

title: APAA Applauds U.S. Government's Support of American Aluminum and Defense of Section 232 Duties in Response to Flawed WTO Report
summary: APAA backed the Biden administration’s response to a WTO panel challenging Section 232 duties covering steel and aluminum. The group argues Section 232 stabilized and saved the U.S. aluminum industry, enabling producers to reinvest and upgrade capacity. It calls for maintaining the program to support domestic aluminum viability.

title: US copper scrap discounts, brass prices flat
summary: US copper scrap discounts for No.1 and No.2 scrap were unchanged in recent assessments, with traders citing quiet physical demand and stable spreads into year-end. Fastmarkets’ Comex March copper settled higher, supporting a floor for brass-related prices. Overall, copper signals are mixed-to-stable and unlikely to drive a major move.

title: Trump era steel and aluminum tariffs found in breach of global rules
summary: WTO ruled that the U.S. breached global rules in imposing steel and aluminium tariffs during the Trump administration. Washington said the findings were flawed and signaled resistance to removing tariffs. China urged the U.S. to respect the ruling, increasing expectations of easing tariff pressure on aluminium trade.

title: WTO Rules Against Trump's Steel And Aluminium Tariffs
summary: The WTO ruled against Trump’s steel and aluminium tariffs. If the tariffs are removed or constrained, it can ease import supply tightness for aluminium into the US, increasing competitive pressure and weighing on prices over the following days to weeks.

title: US duty on steel, aluminium inconsistent with global trade norms: WTO dispute panel
summary: A WTO panel ruled that US customs duties on certain steel and aluminium products are inconsistent with global trade norms. The decision strengthens countries’ cases, including India, which earlier challenged the US. India considers resolving the dispute with the US amicably; the US rejected the ruling.

title: China urges US to correct wrongdoings as WTO rules steel, aluminum tariffs violate its principles
summary: China’s foreign ministry objects to US tariffs it says violate WTO rules and signals it will take necessary measures. The dispute involves tariff exemptions/countermeasures on some US goods, reflecting potential escalation in trade restrictions. Such friction is likely to disrupt aluminium trade flows and pressure prices.

title: Biden admin pushes back against WTO rejection of Trump's tariffs on steel, aluminum
summary: The WTO rejected Trump’s 2018 Section 232 tariffs on steel and aluminum, arguing the national-security basis wasn’t justified. The Biden administration condemned the ruling and says it will not remove the Section 232 duties. Agreements with EU/Japan/UK replace tariffs with quotas, reducing immediate real-world changes.

title: Reviving Reko Diq copper mining project - Newspaper
summary: The report says Pakistan’s Reko Diq copper project in Chagai is expected to resume and complete feasibility by next May, targeting about 150,000 tonnes of copper per year with potential expansion. It cites $1.5bn initial investment, major stakeholder backing, and security/infrastructure needs, supporting copper project sentiment.

title: Copper falls on firmer dollar ahead of central bank meetings
summary: Copper prices fell from near six-month highs as the U.S. dollar firmed on stronger-than-expected U.S. producer inflation, raising concerns about higher-for-longer Fed rates. Markets also turned cautious ahead of central bank meetings. LME aluminium and SHFE nickel also dropped alongside copper.

title: Aluminium Ingot Inventory Stabilises after Continuous Drop_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says China’s aluminium ingot social inventories across eight major markets totalled 500,000 mt on Dec 12, flat week-on-week and still down sharply versus a month and last year. Destocking persists where arrivals are limited; high prices weigh on downstream demand, while some shipments in Foshan continued.

title: Copper Inventory across Major Chinese Markets Adds 3,100 mt over Weekend_SMM
summary: SMM says Chinese copper inventories across major markets totaled 107,900 mt, up 3,100 mt over the weekend. Shanghai rose on higher domestic and imported arrivals; Guangdong fell due to smelter maintenance but should improve next week. Domestic shipments are expected to grow ahead of SHFE 2212, keeping supply higher and inventories likely to rise slightly.

title: Copper Demand Set to Grow Until 2024, says Beroe
summary: Beroe reports copper demand is expected to grow about 3–5% CAGR into 2024, supported by electronics, transportation, and construction, plus supply-chain localization efforts in the US and China and continued innovation in copper products. The market is described as stable/possibly favorable despite earlier recession concerns.

title: Kazakhstan to oblige aluminum, copper, lead producers to supply raw materials to domestic market: 12 December 2022, 13:55
summary: Kazakhstan’s President Tokayev ordered the government to draft legislation requiring large producers to supply more aluminum and copper raw materials to the domestic market. He cited shortages for processors and noted 87% of aluminum and 98.8% of copper are exported abroad. More domestic supply could pressure prices.

title: Kazakhstan to oblige aluminum, copper, lead producers to supply raw materials to domestic market: 12 December 2022, 13:55
summary: Kazakhstan’s President Tokayev instructed the government to draft legislation requiring large producers to supply more raw materials to the domestic market.
