summary: Estimates for PolyMet Mining’s NorthMet open-pit copper-nickel project in Minnesota suggest surging battery-metal demand is offsetting higher development costs. The first phase of the operation near Lake ... indicates investors see demand support for copper and nickel even as project expenses rise.

title: ACQUISITION OF ADDITIONAL SHARES OF NEVADA COPPER CORP. BY MERCURIA
summary: Mercuria reports acquiring an additional 63,411,540 common shares of Nevada Copper through the second tranche of a restart financing subscription, totaling up to US$20 million. The tranche closed on Dec. 29, 2022 at a 15% discounted subscription price. The filing is investment-related and does not cite copper supply or demand changes.

title: Police Blotter: Over $9,000 Of Copper Wiring Stolen From AT&T Facility; Woman Tired Of Waiting On Her Medicine Makes Threatening Gestures
summary: Police report theft of 1,000 feet of copper wiring from an AT&T facility, valued at about $9,410. The rest of the blotter is unrelated incidents (property damage, disputes, and other thefts). The copper theft is localized and unlikely to influence near-term copper market pricing.

title: Rusal looks to supply additional low-carbon aluminium in China
summary: Rusal said it is considering supplying additional low-carbon aluminium to China as EV firms seek lower-carbon metal to meet buyer pressure. Rusal has ~4 Mt capacity and sells 400,000–500,000 tonnes into China, offering a $20–$40/tonne premium at spot prices. LME contract prices are up to $60 higher.

title: Minister: Iran to invest $15 billion on copper production
summary: Iran’s industry minister says the country will invest $15 billion over five years to expand copper production from 280,000 tonnes to over 1 million tonnes and raise exports to more than $10 billion. Investment and exploration are underway, but projects are expected to ramp up gradually.

title: SMM Imported Copper Concentrate Index Dipped $0.39/mt WoW Last Week_SMM
summary: SMM reports the Imported Copper Concentrate Index fell WoW and cites multiple Chilean and Panamanian disruptions: Ventanas port closure after a fire, force majeure at Los Bronces, a community blockade at Los Pelambres, and suspension of Cobre Panama operations. Port inventory declined and SMM expects copper concentrate TCs to trend lower, likely weighing on copper pricing.

title: Alumina Prices Stabilised amid Declining Market Activities_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports alumina prices were flat week-on-week at 2,927 yuan/mt, with unchanged overseas quotes and quiet domestic trading. Rapid COVID spread disrupted bauxite mining and caustic soda shipments, and some refinery staff tested positive. Despite tight spot supply, smelters have finished stocking, and prices are expected to remain flat.

title: Aluminium Prices to Go Down as Social Inventory Could Potentially Enter Seasonal Accumulation Cycle amid the Off-Season_SMM
summary: SMM reports that Guizhou’s second round of power rationing reduced aluminium operating capacity, but downstream consumption remains off-season and weaker new orders persist. Social inventories of aluminium ingots and billets are accumulating and may rise further, adding supply-side pressure. The article expects aluminium prices to fall this week.

title: Sharp Fall in Prebaked Anode Prices to Bring Down Aluminium Smelters' Costs_SMM
summary: SMM says aluminium smelter input costs were steady last week, but a major Shandong producer cut benchmark prebaked anode prices by 400 yuan/mt for January, expected to lower smelting costs by over 200 yuan/mt. Coal and power costs may also ease, while A00 prices fell and profits narrowed.

title: The Profits of Nickel Salt were Limited due to the High Costs_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that nickel-salt and nickel sulphate producers faced limited profits because high-cost nickel inputs and still-heavy high-priced inventories weighed on margins. Nickel sulphate firms stabilized some costs, but lower nickel sulphate prices cut profits further, while downstream ternary precursor buyers reduced purchase prices amid weak demand, leaving the market stalled.

title: GEM Sees Nickel Resource Output Exceeding 20,000 mt of Ni Content in 2023_SMM
summary: GEM says the first phase of Qingmeibang Indonesia’s nickel resources project (30,000 mt Ni content annual capacity) has started operations. The project is ramping up and is expected to produce over 20,000 mt of nickel content in 2023. The update signals additional nickel supply entering the market.

title: Indonesia: the high environmental cost of copper
summary: The piece says Freeport’s CEO is bullish because copper prices are rising, attributing demand growth to Biden’s climate bill and EV expansion. It argues electric vehicles need two to four times more copper than combustion cars, implying stronger copper demand, while also highlighting environmental damage from mining.

title: Iran plans $15bn investment to boost copper production
summary: Iran plans to invest $15bn to expand copper production capacity from 280,000t to over 1 Mt annually and to lift exports from about $1.7bn to more than $10bn. The programme is underway (starting this summer) with projects gradually coming on stream.

title: Complicated 2023 for the Chilean economy as copper prices slide and political stability is fragile
summary: Chile’s economy is weakening, with industrial production and consumption contracting for multiple months. The piece also highlights a lower copper price outlook: an average near US$4/lb with a forecast around US$3.55/lb by end-2023, down from higher 2022 levels, implying bearish near-term copper sentiment.

title: Aluminium Ingot Inventories Accumulate for Three Consecutive Weeks, up 14% during New Year's Day_SMM
summary: Shanghai-based SMM data show China’s aluminium ingot social inventories at 561,000 mt as of Jan 3, up 68,000 mt from last Thursday and rising across most major markets after New Year’s Day. Growth is attributed to higher ingot output and weaker demand, while weekly warehouse shipments fell, indicating added supply pressure.

title: FLSmidth to deliver the world's largest gyratory crusher and station to a South American copper mine
summary: FLSmidth said it will supply a very high-capacity in-pit crushing and conveying gyratory crusher system to a South American copper miner. The contract is about DKK 320 million with delivery during 2023, aiming to improve throughput and maintenance efficiency. No direct near-term supply or trade shock is cited.

title: Black & Veatch to deliver desalination plant for world's largest single-line copper smelter - Chemical Engineering
summary: PT Freeport Indonesia hired Black & Veatch to design and deliver a seawater desalination plant for its Manyar Smelter in East Java. The project will supply desalinated water to support processing of copper concentrates and reduce operational downtime. Manyar is a $3 billion, world-scale single-line copper processing facility.

title: Analysis-Panama And First Quantum Harden Battle Lines Over Key Copper Mine
summary: Panama and First Quantum dispute taxation and contract terms for Cobre Panama, the country’s only major operating copper mine. Talks failed, leading Panama to halt operations and First Quantum to begin arbitration. The disruption risk, plus potential investment slowdown and higher costs, points to immediate bearish pressure on copper sentiment.

title: Copper, gold and silver could soon be mined at mountain near Amlwch
summary: A review of ore deposits at Parys Mountain, near Amlwch on Anglesey, suggests potential extraction of about 75,000 tonnes of copper over the next 12 years. Anglesey Mining has planning permission but still needs permit renewals, environmental work, finance, and a processing plant before mining can begin.

title: Comex Copper Settles 1.04% Lower at $3.7660 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for January delivery settled 1.04% lower at $3.7660 per pound, down 3.95 cents. The contract fell for four consecutive sessions, marking the longest losing streak since late November and the lowest settlement since Dec. 22, 2022, reflecting near-term bearish momentum.

title: SMM Survey on Evolvement of Aluminium Production Curtailment in South-West China in H2 2022_SMM
summary: SMM reports that from August 2022, Chinese aluminium smelters started curtailing potlines due to power rationing. Sichuan nearly shut down in August then partially recovered; Yunnan output fell over 20% and is expected to remain reduced until May 2023. Guizhou smelters cut capacity by ~30% and may reduce further.

title: LME Aluminium Inventory Hits Lowest in over Two Months, SHFE Aluminium Inventory Refreshes One-Month High_SMM
summary: LME aluminium inventories fell again, reaching 450,300 mt as of Dec 30, the lowest in over two months, signaling tighter prompt supply. SHFE aluminium inventories rose weekly to 95,881 mt and hit a one-month high, though they remain close to a six-year low. Net effect is supportive for aluminium.

title: Aluminium Prices Fall 2.22% as Domestic Inventory Has Increased for Three Consecutive Weeks, Attention Should Be Paid to the Pre-holiday Restocking and Inventory Changes_SMM
summary: SMM reports SHFE aluminium down 2.22% to 18,270 yuan/mt and LME aluminium also weaker. Spot prices trend lower as inventories build for three straight weeks, with domestic social inventory rising and downstream plant operating rates falling due to seasonal order weakness and pre-holiday demand slowdown.

title: Losses of Imported NORNICKEL Nickel Expanded and Premiums of Jinchuan and NORNICKEL Nickel Declined Significantly_SMM
summary: SMM reports that imported NORNICKEL nickel losses expanded as LME nickel prices rose. Spot premiums for Jinchuan nickel fell to an average of 6,000 yuan/mt and NORNICKEL nickel to about 6,750 yuan/mt, both down sharply day-on-day. Nickel briquette trading stayed weak due to relative pricing versus nickel sulphate.

title: Potential Risks Facing Nickel Industry Chain When Nickel Prices Hit a New High_SMM
summary: SMM reports nickel prices surged again, with SHFE and LME nickel hitting highs amid very low LME warrants and weak liquidity, driving speculation and extreme volatility. It warns that nickel-linked pricing for intermediates is becoming harder to trade. Nickel sulphate demand is weak and a surplus is expected in 2023.

title: Metal Energy Corp.: Metal Energy Completes 10,000 Metre Drill Program, Acquires 100% of the Manibridge Nickel Project
summary: Metal Energy reports completion of a 10,000-metre drill program and acquisition of full (100%) interest in the Manibridge nickel project in Manitoba. Drill holes intersected visible nickel sulphides, with some assay highlights and remaining results pending, supporting future development potential. It cites high recent nickel demand amid EV and storage growth.

title: Copper slides as demand fears overshadow dollar's influence
summary: Copper fell to two-month lows as traders prioritized demand fears from slowing global growth and rising COVID cases in China, outweighing dollar weakness. Aluminium also dropped on sliding energy prices that raise smelting economics. Nickel plunged alongside the broader base-metals sell-off.

title: Indonesia's Antam targets H2 2023 launch for ferronickel plant
summary: Antam said its Haltim Ferronickel Plant in East Halmahera will start operating in the second semester of 2023 after power and construction phases progress. The plant’s annual capacity is 13,500 tonnes, lifting Antam’s ferronickel capacity to 40,500 tonnes per year, potentially increasing nickel supply expectations.

title: Analysis: Panama, First Quantum Harden Battle Lines over Key Copper Mine - Latest Tweet by Reuters
summary: Reuters’ analysis highlights hardened “battle lines” between Panama and First Quantum regarding a key copper mine. The dispute raises uncertainty over mine operations and potential production delays or disruption, which can increase near-term supply risk. Such conditions often weigh on copper price expectations over days to weeks.

title: Global Commodities Holdings to launch nickel trade platform in February
summary: Global Commodities Holdings will launch a nickel trade platform with a nickel index intended to underpin future contracts competing with the LME. The initiative follows last March’s chaotic LME nickel trading suspension and seeks direct physical-market trading, potentially improving price discovery and sentiment for nickel in the coming weeks.

title: Conversion Margins of Re-Melt Aluminium Billets Barely Rise amid Faltering Demand, Despite Falling Aluminium Prices_SMM
summary: SMM reports that LME-tracked A00 aluminium prices started weak, falling alongside declines in aluminium scrap prices. Lower scrap costs eased billet conversion margins, but demand is faltering as downstream firms close early for Chinese New Year and logistics slow. Conversion margins vary by region (e.g., south China 270–390 yuan/mt).

title: SMM Aluminium Ingot and Billet Social Inventories as of January 5_SMM
summary: SMM said China’s aluminium ingot social inventories rose to 576,000 mt on Jan 5, after a sharp weekly increase, despite still-near historical lows. Aluminium billet inventories also climbed to 79,700 mt. Muted spot demand around the New Year and expected further stock builds point to bearish near-term price pressure.

title: Guizhou Power Grid Imposes a Third Round of Power Rationing on Local Aluminium Smelters_SMM
summary: Guizhou Power Grid imposed a third round of winter power rationing on local aluminium smelters due to severe heating demand and falling hydropower output. Five producers must cut combined consumption by 500,000 kW within five days. Prior rounds already curtailed output, cumulatively affecting ~940,000 mt and likely extending shutdowns into early January.

title: SHFE Nickel Prices Fell for Two Consecutive Days amid Growing Pure Nickel Supply and Macroeconomic Pessimism_SMM
summary: SHFE nickel prices fell for a second consecutive day, dropping about 5% in the session, as Tsingshan-related nickel matte supply grows and macro sentiment turns pessimistic on expectations of a Fed interest rate hike. Inventories abroad rose, while tightness in domestic stocks eased, keeping nickel weak near term.

title: Magna Mining Inc.: Magna Mining Intersects 4.0 % Nickel over 31.1 Metres at the Crean Hill Mine, Sudbury
summary: Magna Mining reported additional drill results from the Crean Hill 101 Footwall Zone, including 31.1m at 4.0% Ni and also notable associated Cu grades. The company says results show continuity of high-grade massive sulphide mineralization and expects further assays. This is exploration-focused, not production-related.

title: Green River Gold Corp. Reports Additional Assay Results at Its Critical Minerals Discovery at the Quesnel Nickel Project, Encountering 128 Meters of 21.3% Magnesium, 0.188% Nickel, 0.139% Chromium, and 0.01% Cobalt
summary: Green River Gold Corp. reports additional assay and drilling results from the Quesnel Nickel Project, noting consistent nickel mineralization at depth at the Deep Purple Zone 2 target. Six more winter drill holes are planned, but the announcement is exploration-stage and does not indicate immediate production impacts for nickel.

title: Lion Copper and Gold Announces Agreement for Stage Two Work Program with Nuton, a Rio Tinto Venture, and an Advance on Stage 3 Work Program Funding
summary: Lion Copper and Gold said Rio Tinto’s Nuton venture agreed Stage 2 funding of $5m and advanced $2.5m for Stage 3 toward development and exploration of its Yerington Nevada copper projects. The release highlights copper mineralization results and Nuton leach technologies aimed at improving recoveries and low-carbon copper production.

title: Panama ministers summoned to clarify doubts about flagship copper mine's status
summary: Panama ministers were reportedly summoned to clarify doubts about the status of a flagship copper mine. While the full details are behind a paywall, such inquiries typically relate to operational or regulatory uncertainty that can quickly change market expectations for copper supply and near-term price sentiment.

title: Lion Copper and Gold Corp.: Lion Copper and Gold Announces Agreement for Stage Two Work Program with Nuton, a Rio Tinto Venture, and an Advance on Stage 3 Work Program Funding
summary: Lion Copper and Gold announced agreement with Rio Tinto’s Nuton venture for Stage 2 funding of $5m and an advance on Stage 3 funding of $2.5m for the Mason Valley project in Nevada. The release highlights ongoing permitting, studies, and a 17,000-ft drilling program targeting copper prospects and prior mineralization.

title: Rusal Eyes Growing Demand for Low-Carbon Aluminium in China and Shares Its Views on the Price Advantage of Low-Carbon Aluminium over Thermal Power Aluminium at the SMM Annual Metals Conference_SMM
summary: SMM reports Rusal’s view that low-carbon aluminium demand is accelerating, with premiums versus thermal-power aluminium remaining in China ($20-40/mt) and Europe ($40-60/mt). It links demand to China’s carbon peak/neutrality and EV makers’ adoption, and notes stable low-carbon supply and certifications.

title: 2023 Chinese New Year Holiday Arrangements of Companies in Copper Industry Chain_SMM
summary: SMM surveys Chinese copper industry-chain firms as CNY approaches amid a renewed COVID outbreak. Many copper rod, pipe, sheet/strip, and wire/cable makers plan earlier closures due to weaker orders and lower operating rates. Resumption dates are mostly unchanged for some large firms, but overall demand appears soft pre-holiday.

title: Copper rises on China demand hopes; Shanghai nickel hits 1-mth low
summary: Copper prices rose as expectations grow that China will support its ailing property sector, improving demand outlook and helping inventory restocking. LME copper was up 1.2%. Nickel fell sharply to a one-month low on supply expectations after Tsingshan’s new electronickel project started production. Aluminium also edged higher.

title: Copper rises on China demand hopes; Shanghai nickel hits 1-mth low
summary: Copper prices rose on hopes China will add property-sector support measures, improving the near-term demand outlook. LME three-month copper and SHFE February copper both increased, while Chile production fell. In contrast, Shanghai nickel fell on supply expectations from Tsingshan’s new project starting production. Aluminium also edged up.

title: Copper Inventories in Domestic Bonded Zone Add 2,800 mt from December 30, 2022_SMM
summary: SMM says copper inventories in China’s domestic bonded zones increased by 2,800 mt from Dec 30, 2022, led by a rise in Shanghai (+3,000 mt) while Guangdong fell slightly. With sluggish imported trading ahead of Chinese New Year, SMM expects bonded inventories to grow further, weighing on sentiment.

title: Copper Mountain Mining Provides Operational Update on Ransomware Attack
summary: Copper Mountain Mining reports that after a Dec. 27 ransomware attack, its Copper Mountain Mine resumed crusher and mill operations by early January and is stabilizing at full production. The company says it kept shipping copper concentrate on schedule during downtime from inventory to Vancouver, limiting immediate copper supply disruption.

title: TASEKO ANNOUNCES 2022 SALES AND PRODUCTION RESULTS FOR THE GIBRALTAR COPPER MINE
summary: Taseko reported 2022 Gibraltar copper sales of 101 million pounds and production of 97 million pounds, but noted December output was hit by an unplanned mill downtime triggered by a sitewide power outage and extreme cold. Throughput fell to ~63,000 tons/day in December versus ~88,000 in October-November.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports Down 370,000 wmt from Last Friday_SMM
summary: SMM says nickel ore inventories across Chinese ports fell 370,000 wmt to 8.81 million wmt as of Jan 6, with Ni content down to about 70,000 mt. Supply tightness from poor Philippines weather is cited, and further declines are expected, with demand possibly improving after Chinese New Year.

title: Copper hits 3-week high on China hopes, weaker dollar
summary: Copper rose to a three-week high on a weaker U.S. dollar and optimism that China will boost property demand. LME three-month copper climbed about 1.2%. The piece also references Chile output declines supporting copper, while nickel weakness reflects Tsingshan project-related supply expectations and aluminium advanced.

title: Copper Mountain reopens mine after ransomware attack
summary: Copper Mountain Mining said it reopened its southern British Columbia copper mine after a Dec. 27 ransomware attack. The company restarted its primary crusher and reported deliveries were unaffected. The restart should ease near-term supply disruption concerns, providing a modest supportive tone for copper markets.

title: Mineral Trade Body Calls For Tariff Removal On Bauxite Expor...
summary: A mineral trade body is urging tariff removal on bauxite exports. Since bauxite is the key raw material for alumina and ultimately aluminium production, removing export tariffs could ease supply expectations and support aluminium prices in the near term.

title: B.C. adds plastic and aluminum items that can be recycled
summary: British Columbia expanded its blue-bin recycling list to include additional aluminum items such as foil baking dishes and pie plates, alongside many single-use plastics. The policy aims to divert disposable materials from landfills and cites improved recycling technology, but provides no quantified supply effect for aluminum.

title: Saudi Arabia to ramp up copper mining to meet rising global demand
summary: AL-Monitor reports that Saudi Arabia intends to increase copper mining output to satisfy rising global demand. The announcement is expected to influence near-term market expectations for copper supply and balances, potentially supporting trading sentiment, depending on how quickly production changes versus global demand growth.

title: Fluor wins EPCM contract for gold-copper mining project in Greece - Chemical Engineering
summary: Fluor won an EPCM contract for Eldorado Gold’s Hellas Gold Skouries project in Greece. The mine is expected to produce about 67 million pounds of copper annually, with construction starting in 2023 and first production targeted for 2H 2025. The contract may modestly support copper supply expectations.

title: Comex Copper Ends the Week 2.71% Higher at $3.9085 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for January delivery ended the week up 10.30 cents (2.71%) to $3.9085/lb, marking its largest weekly net and percentage gain since early December 2022. It also rose strongly over the last two sessions and recorded its highest settlement since mid-November 2022, with gains today as well.

title: London Metal Exchange chair steps down after nickel shambles
summary: The LME chair is stepping down following the nickel market scandal that culminated in a short squeeze, a week-long market closure, and cancelled trades. Investor backlash, legal action against the LME, and investigations by the FCA and BoE’s PRA are highlighted, with an independent inquiry due in days.

title: Copper Mountain Mining Corporation Provides Operational Update on Ransomware Attack
summary: Copper Mountain Mining resumed production after a Dec. 27 ransomware attack that disrupted IT systems. Crushing and mill operations restarted, the mill reached full production by Jan. 4, and the company continued shipping copper concentrate to Vancouver using mine inventory while maintaining its planned schedule. Systems are being stabilized and safeguards added.

title: Andy Home: New year, new nickel market after LME's 2022 meltdown?
summary: The Reuters column reviews the LME’s six-day nickel trading suspension in March 2022 and notes reduced volumes and liquidity after the contract’s return. It describes Global Commodities Holdings’ proposed physical-deliveries-based nickel index and possible futures partners, arguing spot price discovery needs separation from futures activity.

title: The Indonesian Government Announces a Bauxite Ore Export Ban; To Be Imposed in June 2023
summary: Indonesia’s government said it will ban exports of bauxite ore starting June 2023 to push domestic processing and refining. The policy follows a prior nickel ore export ban that encouraged smelting investment. The bauxite restriction can tighten supply of feedstock for alumina production, supporting aluminium price expectations.

title: Northwest Copper Releases Positive PEA On The Kwanika-Stardu...
summary: Northwest Copper says it has released a positive PEA for the Kwanika–Stardu copper project. A favorable economic assessment can boost expectations for eventual development and future copper supply, supporting sentiment toward copper prices over the coming days as traders react to improved project outlooks.

title: The search is on for a new nickel price discovery process to replace the LME.
summary: The piece notes that in March 2022 the LME suspended nickel trading for six days, disrupting global pricing and creating uncertainty. It says market participants are now working to develop a new nickel price discovery process to replace the LME, aiming to restore clearer benchmark pricing and reduce market opacity.

title: Queensland Nickel: More questions than answers on Clive Palmer's $1.5b deal
summary: Clive Palmer’s planned $1.5 billion sale of Queensland Nickel to Zero Carbon Investek is under review by Australia’s FIRB due to unknown beneficial owners and critical-minerals national security sensitivity. The buyer claims large recoverable nickel value and a potential restart, but approvals and capex needs make near-term supply impact uncertain.

title: UPDATE 1-Alcoa's Australia unit flags 30% production cut at alumina refinery
summary: Alcoa’s Australia unit signaled a 30% production cut at its alumina refinery. The reduction in alumina output can tighten supply of refining feedstock for primary aluminium, potentially raising expectations for higher aluminium prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: What Are the Causes behind Frenzying Nickel Price in 2022? Will It Re-stage in 2023?_SMM
summary: SMM reviews 2022 nickel price volatility tied to Russia-Ukraine risks, later COVID/macro effects, and changing supply-demand fundamentals. It notes lower LME/SHFE inventories but still highlights rising output and expected primary nickel surplus in 2023, mainly from oversupply of NPI, implying nickel prices likely fall overall.

title: Alcoa cuts WA alumina production, Alinta Energy raids stockpiles as gas crisis bites
summary: Alcoa has reduced output at its Kwinana alumina refinery in Western Australia, taking a refining unit offline as a Chevron-related outage worsens gas availability. Alinta Energy tapped stored gas to boost domestic supply, but gas shortages still forced lower alumina production. South32 also curbed gas use and awaits a Wheatstone restart.

title: SMM Imported Copper Concentrate Index Dips $1.44/mt WoW last Week_SMM
summary: SMM says its imported copper concentrate index fell $1.44/mt WoW as Chile’s Ventanas port shut after a fire disrupted concentrate shipments and suppressed spot TC quotes for Feb–Mar cargoes. It also cites weaker Chile output, royalty bill review, mine disruptions, and rising Chinese port concentrate inventories.

title: Shrinking Supply and Cost Support to Put A Brake on Decline in Aluminium Prices _SMM
summary: SMM reports that Guizhou imposed a third round of power rationing on local aluminium smelters, cutting domestic operating capacity to about 40.1 million mt, while new/restared output has not yet materialized. Demand softness and rising social inventories drove the earlier selloff, but shrinking supply and cost support may stabilize prices this week.

title: Plummeting Aluminium Prices Pushed Smelters into Loss-Making Territory  _SMM
summary: SMM reports prebaked anode benchmark purchase prices fell 400 yuan/mt MoM, helping reduce some smelter power costs as coal prices dropped. Nonetheless, aluminium A00 prices plunged to around 17,700 yuan/mt and turned smelters from profit to losses, implying weak profitability and continued pressure.

title: Alumina Prices Barely Changed amid Declining Market Activities_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports alumina prices changed marginally week-on-week (SMM weighted index +2 yuan/mt). Overseas quotes were flat. With bauxite still tight, north China refineries stayed cautious, while Guizhou curtailments from power rationing slightly supported southern prices. Aluminium smelters completed winter stockpiling, so spot trading remained subdued and prices are expected stable.

title: Copper Inventories across Major Chinese Markets Add 5,000 mt from January 6_SMM
summary: SMM says Chinese copper inventories totaled 122,500 mt as of Jan 9, up 5,000 mt from Jan 6 and sharply year-on-year. COVID-19 cases disrupted production and pre-holiday shutdowns increased stockpiling. Smelters sped up shipments to dump in-plant inventories, while processing demand stayed cautious, implying inventories may keep rising.

title: Northwest Copper Reports 41.20 Metres of 3.20% Copper Equivalent at Stardust From Drilling in the 421 Zone
summary: Northwest Copper says it has drilled 41.20 metres of 3.20% copper equivalent in the 421 zone at its Stardust project. The reported results can strengthen expectations for potential future copper supply, providing a mild supportive cue for copper prices in the near term as investors react to exploration progress.

title: Alcoa's Australia unit flags 30% production cut at alumina refinery
summary: Alcoa’s Australia unit expects production at its Kwinana alumina refinery to be cut by about 30% after a gas supply shortage. An JV unit was taken offline, process flows were hit, and the site is using diesel instead of gas. The shortage stems from a Wheatstone gas plant outage.

title: First Quantum Aims to Appeal Panama Order to Halt Copper Mine
summary: First Quantum says it wants to appeal a Panama court order that would halt its copper mine. The move could delay or overturn the shutdown, improving expectations for near-term copper supply and tightening the immediate balance.

title: Copper Market Value to Reach US$ 278.1 Bn by 2031, TMR Study
summary: Transparency Market Research projects continued growth in the global copper market, driven by demand from electronics, telecommunications, construction, automotive/EVs, and medical equipment in emerging economies. It also highlights rising use of oxygen-free copper. The piece is a forecast with no near-term supply disruption or inventory change details.

title: Canada Nickel provides update on Crawford Project
summary: Canada’s Impact Assessment Agency will require a full federal impact assessment for Canada Nickel’s Crawford Project. The review covers Indigenous and public comments and resumes a 180-day planning phase. The company highlights potential net-zero carbon capture, but the added regulatory steps introduce timeline uncertainty for nickel supply.

title: Aluminum Dynamics plans groundbreaking ceremony for early March
summary: Aluminum Dynamics plans a groundbreaking in early March for a $2.5 billion aluminium mill near Golden Triangle Regional Airport in Mississippi. Steel Dynamics will own the mill and construction site activity may begin within weeks, including infrastructure work and permitting. The project includes planned roads upgrades and job creation, supporting aluminium-related market expectations.

title: Alcoa Announces a 30% Reduction in Production for its Kwinana Alumina Refinery_SMM
summary: Alcoa will reduce production at its Kwinana alumina refinery in Western Australia by about 30% after a natural gas supply shortage leads to a unit being taken offline. With an estimated 1.5-month persistence, alumina supply tightens, potentially boosting expectations for aluminium prices.

title: Regulator OKs Lotte Chemical's takeover of copper foil producer
summary: Korea’s FTC approved Lotte Chemical’s acquisition of a copper foil producer (Iljin Materials) via a 53.5% stake deal. Copper foil is used as the anode current collector in EV lithium-ion batteries. The regulator said competition should not be significantly harmed, and Lotte plans funding for the purchase.

title: Aluminium industry wants reduction in customs duty on raw material imports
summary: The Aluminium Association of India urged the Finance Ministry to cut customs duties on critical raw inputs (calcined/raw petroleum coke, caustic soda lye, aluminium fluoride, anodes, calcined alumina) while increasing duties on primary aluminium and aluminium scrap. It also requested removing coal cess to ease power costs and concessional freight for bauxite/alumina.

title: Spot Pure Nickel Trading is Sluggish with the End of Downstream Companies' Stockpiling_SMM
summary: SMM reports sluggish spot trading in pure nickel as downstream companies stop stockpiling. SHFE nickel prices fell slightly despite higher premiums for Jinchuan and NORNICKEL nickel. Nickel briquette trading is also weak, and some traders are less willing to ship ahead of Chinese New Year logistics suspensions.

title: [SMM Annual Report] Global Nickel Likely to be Oversupplied in 2023-2026E_SMM
summary: SMM projects nickel will be oversupplied from 2023 onward, especially from Indonesian NPI and refined supply increases, potentially widened by delays and possible Indonesian export tax changes. It estimates 2023 demand below supply, predicting a nickel price downtrend with volatile fluctuations.

title: Budget 2023: Aluminium industry seeks removal of tax on raw materials
summary: India’s Aluminium Association of India (AAI) urged the Budget to remove taxes on raw materials, arguing that aluminium demand could surge from 4 million tonnes per annum to 10 MTPA by 2030. The group estimates large investment needs to expand capacity, implying cost relief would support production and pricing.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Intersects Massive Copper Sulphide and Provides Exploration Update at the Copper Creek Project in Arizona
summary: Faraday Copper provides an exploration update from its Copper Creek project in Arizona. Phase II drilling has intersected massive copper sulphide (about 15m from 234m) and multiple generative targets show surface copper anomalies; assay results are pending. The company plans further reconnaissance and resource-delineation drilling, without any production changes.

title: LME Nickel Review Recommends Tighter Rules on Market Distortions
summary: The article headline says an LME Nickel Review recommends tighter rules to address market distortions. Such regulatory or governance changes can influence nickel contract trading conditions and expectations in the near term. The excerpt provides no details on implementation or mechanisms, so the likely immediate price impact is uncertain.

title: Metal Energy Corp.: Metal Energy Reports 5 Drill Holes Intersecting Shallow High-Grade Nickel Mineralization at Manibridge Project
summary: Metal Energy reported assay results from five Phase Two drill holes at its Manibridge project in Manitoba, intersecting shallow, stacked zones of high-grade nickel sulphide mineralization. Results include thick intervals and continuity along strike and dip, supporting potential resource expansion. Copper-cobalt is mentioned, but aluminium is not.

title: Metal Energy Reports 5 Drill Holes Intersecting Shallow High-Grade Nickel Mineralization at Manibridge Project
summary: Metal Energy reports five drill holes intersecting shallow, high-grade nickel sulphide mineralization at its Manibridge project, including thick stacked zones and composite results up to 65% host rock mineralized. The announcement strengthens near-term market expectations for nickel supply potential and carries a modest positive link to copper via Ni eq reporting.

title: LME to decide nickel reforms by end of first quarter
summary: LME said it will detail by end-Q1 how it will implement recommendations from an independent report on last year’s nickel trading crisis. The broken contract, limited deliverable stocks and Russia-related supply worries led to disorderly price spikes. LME plans risk/control changes and may restore Asian nickel trading to improve liquidity.

title: Copper retreats after rally on weak demand, profit taking
summary: Copper prices rose to a 6-1/2-month high on expectations that China’s reopening and stimulus-backed lending will boost metals demand. LME futures extended gains despite a holiday-related demand slowdown. Aluminium also climbed and nickel edged up, reflecting broad base-metal optimism tied to China’s improving demand outlook.

title: LME told to tighten volatility controls to stop another nickel crisis
summary: A report commissioned by the LME says the exchange must tighten volatility and risk controls to prevent another nickel market collapse after it canceled about $4 billion in nickel trades during March 2022. Consultants Oliver Wyman recommend upgrades to live trading oversight, potentially affecting near-term nickel market structure.

title: LME To Decide Nickel Reforms By End Of First Quarter
summary: The LME said it will outline by end of Q1 how it will implement recommendations after a nickel trading crisis left the contract with low volumes and liquidity. Reforms include stronger risk controls, better OTC monitoring, and volatility management, plus potential return of Asian nickel trading to boost liquidity.

title: Sama Reports on Four Additional Drill Holes from the Grata Nickel-Copper Prospect, Located in the Ivory Coast, West Africa
summary: Sama Resources reported assay results from four additional drill holes at the Grata nickel-copper prospect in Côte d’Ivoire, with thick intervals grading around 0.30–0.33% nickel and 0.34–0.40% copper in parts of the intersections. Exploration is ongoing and no production or supply disruption is indicated.

title: Sama Reports on Four Additional Drill Holes from the Grata Nickel-Copper Prospect, Located in the Ivory Coast, West Africa
summary: Sama Resources announced assay results from four additional drill holes at the Grata nickel-copper prospect in Côte d’Ivoire, reporting substantial nickel and copper mineralised intervals (with palladium also mentioned). The update is exploration-focused with no production or market supply changes, making any short-term impact on nickel and copper prices likely minimal.

title: First Quantum to appeal Panama order to halt giant copper mine
summary: First Quantum Minerals said it will appeal a Panama government order to halt its large copper mine while negotiations continue on a new contract with the state. Any effective shutdown would reduce near-term copper output and likely pressure copper prices lower, despite the company’s intent to contest the decision.

title: Aluminium Prices Fall From Early-December Peak
summary: Aluminium prices eased from an early-December peak and broader downside pressure remains dominant despite a short-term bounce. China raised aluminum export tariffs, adding some support and volatility, while energy constraints in Europe and China’s demand weakness weigh on prices. Indonesia’s bauxite export ban is June 2023 and may help later.

title: Global copper greenfield investment falls short of demand outlook, experts say
summary: The article says greenfield copper investment is falling short of demand, with experts warning of a large deficit by 2030 and a weak project pipeline. It links Chile’s regulatory and ESG hurdles, declining ore grades, and slower new supply to potential shortages, arguing copper prices may rise with the shortfall.

title: Copper hits 6-1/2 month peak on hopes for China demand
summary: Copper extended gains to a 6-1/2 month peak as investors priced in a quicker China reopening and further stimulus, supported by unexpectedly higher bank lending. LME three-month copper rose 0.8% to $8,926/t. Aluminium also climbed, while nickel edged up on the same demand optimism.

title: First Quantum close to securing new deal for Panama copper mine
summary: First Quantum said it is close to agreeing with Panama on a new contract to keep the Cobre Panama copper mine operating after the government halted discussions and ordered care and maintenance. The company is seeking resolution on tax, surface rights, and expropriation protections, aiming to avoid production stoppage.

title: Timmins nickel project could be one huge carbon sink
summary: Canada Nickel promotes its Crawford Timmins-area project as a low-carbon, large-volume nickel mine, using in-process tailings carbonation to generate carbon credits. The company targets EV/battery makers for financing and seeks federal support under Canada’s Critical Minerals Strategy. Permitting and feasibility are ongoing, but nickel supply sentiment may improve.

title: Ma'aden and Ivanhoe Electric to Establish a 50/50 Joint Venture to Explore for Copper, Gold, Silver and Electric Metals in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
summary: Ma’aden and Ivanhoe Electric plan a 50/50 joint venture to explore for copper (along with gold and silver) in Saudi Arabia. While this is a supply-side development, the article provides no information on immediate mine output. Near-term copper price impact is expected to be minimal.

title: Nickel market chaos: Review urges London Metal Exchange to toughen standards on market distortions
summary: An independent Oliver Wyman review says the LME lacked sufficient tools to curb the short-term distortions during March’s nickel price “chaos.” It urges the exchange to strengthen rules and oversight. The review follows the LME’s week-long nickel trading suspension and the cancellation of large volumes of trades.

title: Bauxite Imports Exceeded 10 Million mt Again in November, Indonesia to Ban Bauxite Exports from June 2023 _SMM
summary: China’s bauxite imports rose to 11.79 million mt in November, with Guinea supplies surging as Indonesian exports are set to be banned from June 2023. SMM expects the ban’s effect on supply to be diluted by other sources and growing Guinea output, implying limited near-term aluminium-price impact.

title: Aluminium Prices to Fluctuate Widely in January amid Production Cuts in Guizhou and Faltering Demand in the Off-Season_SMM
summary: SMM expects aluminium to fluctuate widely in January. Guizhou smelters face power rationing, cutting local capacity, though costs may fall with lower coal and anode prices. Demand remains weak in the off-season and social inventories start accumulating, while off-season inventory expectations weigh on prices.

title: Aluminium Ingot Inventories Fell Before Rising in December, Seasonal Accumulation Cycle Has Begun _SMM
summary: SMM says China’s aluminium ingot social inventories reached 622,000 mt as of Jan 9, up from Jan 5 and end-December, after a December dip tied to delayed arrivals. Early January saw a spike from heavy arrivals and sluggish consumption. Seasonal inventory is expected to build into post–CNY weeks.

title: Nickel Price to Move Rangebound in January_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that pure nickel spot lagged futures in December but social inventories fell sharply as spot cargoes moved to LME warehouses. In January, LME prices drop amid macro/news factors, while imports remain constrained, output rises, and alloy demand restocks ahead of Chinese New Year. Overall, nickel is expected to trade rangebound.

title: Shrinking Battery-Grade Nickel Sulphate Demand can Hardly be Reversed Before the Chinese New Year_SMM
summary: SMM reports battery-grade nickel sulphate prices continued falling in late 2022 due to reduced NEV precursor demand after subsidy cancellation, sharp precursor production cuts, and heavy inventory selling by integrated plants. With demand set to trough end-January and output reductions planned, prices are expected to keep easing in January.

title: SHFE Nickel Price Slump 11.2% in Jan with Frequent Events on Macro and News Front_SMM
summary: SMM reports SHFE nickel fell 11.2% entering January, after December gains. The decline is linked to macro recession worries from Fed remarks, and a shift on the news front as Tsingshan’s electrodeposited/refined nickel commissioning adds supply and weighs on deliverable conditions, alongside rising global visible nickel inventories.

title: Copper Tops $9,000 as China Reopening Boosts Outlook for Demand
summary: The article highlights copper reaching above $9,000, attributing the rally to improving demand outlook as China reopens. By strengthening expectations for industrial consumption in the near term, the news supports higher copper prices and market sentiment toward physical and forward demand.

title: Luminex's Partner Anglo American Commences Drilling at the Medusa Copper Target at Pegasus
summary: Luminex reports that Anglo American has started a maiden five-hole, 3,200-metre drill program at the Pegasus project’s Medusa copper-porphyry target. The company cites geochemical and geophysical signs of copper mineralization and notes further drilling is contingent on initial results. No production or resource updates are provided.

title: NiCAN To Commence Drilling at Wine Nickel Property, Manitoba, Canada
summary: NiCAN says it will begin drilling at the Wine nickel property in Manitoba, Canada. The announcement is exploratory in nature, but it can slightly lift market expectations for future nickel resources and potential supply development. Near-term price impact is likely modest since drilling is not equivalent to production.

title: Golden Arrow Commences Final Drill-Targeting Program and Plans Q1 Drilling at San Pietro Copper-Gold-Cobalt Project, Chile
summary: Golden Arrow commenced an IP-resistivity survey and plans its first diamond drilling program in Q1 at the San Pietro Cu-Au-Co project in Chile. The company aims to refine drill targets for copper and cobalt using geophysics and prior drilling data. It is exploration activity with no immediate production impact.

title: Nickel prices soar and plunge in 2022 volatility
summary: Nickel prices surged above $30,000/t in mid-November but fell sharply the next day amid low liquidity and heightened market monitoring by the LME. It also flags supply-risk events (Goro tailings leak, Indonesian plant rumour) and ongoing Russia-related uncertainty, reinforcing short-term volatility and bearish price pressure.

title: Aluminium Bahrain B S C : Alba to start installing Solar PV Panels over 37,000 m2
summary: Alba, one of the world’s largest aluminium smelters, plans to install solar PV panels over 37,000 m2 at its Bahrain site, delivering more than 6 MW capacity and over 10,000 MWh per year. The project is intended to support ESG/net-zero goals and likely lower power costs for smelting.

title: India set to become net copper importer for fifth year in a row
summary: Government data suggest India, historically a copper exporter, is set to remain a net importer of copper for the fifth straight year in 2022-23. The shift aligns with the May 2018 closure of Sterlite Copper’s 400,000 tpa smelter in Tamil Nadu, reducing domestic supply and lifting import needs.

title: Business News | India Set to Become Net Copper Importer for Fifth Year in a Row
summary: India is likely to remain a net importer of copper for the fifth year in 2022-23 as domestic refined production stayed lower after Sterlite Copper’s Tuticorin smelter shutdown in 2018. Rising consumption from power, electronics, infrastructure and EVs sustains deficits, requiring continued imports and supporting copper tightness.

title: Exclusive-UK Watchdog Blocks LME Plan To Restart Asian Hours Nickel Trade-sources
summary: Britain’s FCA is blocking the LME’s plan to restart nickel trading in Asian hours, saying supervisory controls are inadequate while London is asleep. The LME previously suspended nickel activity for eight days in March 2022 after a spike. Ongoing inactivity has hurt liquidity and volumes, pressuring confidence.

title: Copper Price Tops $9,000 As Economic Bellwether Enters New Bull Market
summary: Copper on the LME surged past $9,000/t and rose for a fifth straight session, up as much as 1.8% on Wednesday. The rally is linked to a weaker US dollar and improving expectations that China’s demand will rebound after the COVID wave. Interest-rate-hike hopes also support copper prices.

title: Copper tops $9,000 for first time since June
summary: Copper prices topped $9,000 per tonne on the LME, up 1.1% and in a fifth straight daily gain, as traders expect China’s border reopening to revive demand. Analysts also note the weaker U.S. dollar could support dollar-priced metals, though some caution copper may not rebound as strongly as other commodities.

title: Exclusive-UK watchdog blocks LME plan to restart Asian hours nickel trade-sources
summary: Britain’s FCA is blocking the LME from restarting nickel trading in Asian hours, citing doubts over supervisory controls and orderly-market management. The LME suspended nickel activity in 2022 after sharp Asian-hour price spikes. Continued delay sustains low volumes and reduced arbitrage versus ShFE, weighing on nickel sentiment.

title: Maaden Aluminum Smelter Cut Production After Operating Problems
summary: Maaden’s aluminium smelter has reportedly cut production after operating problems. Reduced output from an aluminium producer can tighten near-term supply expectations, affecting balance and pricing sentiment. If the disruption lasts, it would likely be supportive for prices, but the immediate market reaction is expected to be bearish on uncertainty.

title: Robbers pull off multimillion-dollar copper heist in Chilean port
summary: Armed robbers in Chile stole 13 shipping containers of copper from a port near San Antonio, taken from Codelco shipments destined for China. Estimated value is about $4.4 million. The heist adds pressure on transport and port security, following prior thefts from northern copper cathode trains.

title: Maaden Aluminum Smelter Cut Output on Operating Issues
summary: The piece indicates Maaden’s aluminum smelter is cutting output because of operating issues. Reduced production from an aluminum smelter can affect near-term supply expectations, potentially supporting price weakness if the disruption suggests lower tonnage availability or longer restart timelines.

title: UPDATE 1-Alcoa reverts to gas for fuelling alumina refineries in Western Australia
summary: Alcoa said it has reverted to gas for fuelling its alumina refineries in Western Australia. The change in refinery fuel sourcing can alter immediate operating costs and production economics, potentially tightening near-term alumina supply expectations and supporting aluminium price sentiment over the coming days.

title: UK watchdog blocks LME plan to restart Asian hours nickel trade-sources
summary: The UK watchdog has blocked an LME plan to restart Asian-hours nickel trading, according to trade sources. The decision could disrupt normal nickel market access and liquidity for Asia-linked participants, affecting short-term trading conditions and price expectations. However, the article provides limited detail on magnitude or timing.

title: Comex Copper Settles 2.15% Higher at $4.1545 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for January delivery settled 2.15% higher at $4.1545 per pound, gaining 8.75 cents. The market extended a five-session rally, reaching its highest settlement since June 15, 2022. It is also up month-to-date and year-to-date, underscoring near-term bullish momentum.

title: SMM Research on Chinese New Year Holiday Arrangements of Remelted Aluminium Billet Producers_SMM
summary: SMM reports that remelted aluminium billet producers in China will take Chinese New Year holidays in phases between early January and later January. Weak off-season orders, sluggish downstream demand, price fluctuations, and COVID disruptions have pressured operating rates. Companies plan to resume around Jan 30–31, with limited finished inventories.

title: SMM Aluminium Ingot and Billet Social Inventories in China as of January 12_SMM
summary: SMM says China’s aluminium ingot social inventories rose to 642,000 mt on Jan 12, up from the prior week, while billet inventories increased to 95,000 mt. Demand is muted around the CNY holiday and prices attract fewer buyers. Inventories are expected to grow further next week, adding pressure to aluminium prices.

title: Operating Rates of Aluminium Extruders Suffered a Seasonal Decline in Dec, with Stocking Volume Lower YoY_SMM
summary: SMM says Chinese aluminium extruders’ average operating rate fell to 36.5% in December, down sharply YoY, with construction extruders—especially in northern regions—cutting production ahead of early CNY. Industrial output was steadier but inventories rose. January operating rates are expected to fall further as plants close.

title: Nickel Sulphate Prices Slumped in December amid Falling Demand, and Will Head for Further Decline in January_SMM
summary: SMM says China’s nickel sulphate market was in a sizable surplus in December due to slowing demand and smelter output not cutting as fast as upstream precursor plants. Year-end liquidity tightening accelerated a sell-off. January prices are forecast to fall again as the glut persists despite weak demand.

title: Power Nickel Inc.: Power Nickel Extends PN-22-009 Nickel Mineralization from 25 to 40m
summary: Power Nickel reports assay results extending the PN-22-009 nickel-copper-Co-PGE mineralized interval to 40.3m, with high-grade Ni-Cu values and plans to extend drilling further in Q1 2023. The update supports continuity of the Nisk resource, but provides no near-term production change.

title: Palladium One Mining Inc.: Palladium One Reports 10.3% Nickel, 2.9% Copper over 1.8 meters at the Tyko Project, Canada
summary: Palladium One reported additional drill intercepts at its Tyko Project in Ontario, including high-grade massive sulphide assays with up to about 10.3% nickel and 2.9% copper over 1.8 meters. The company frames results as reinforcing West Pickle’s potential and plans further exploration to connect mineral zones in 2023.

title: Palladium One Mining Inc.: Palladium One Reports 10.3% Nickel, 2.9% Copper over 1.8 meters at the Tyko Project, Canada
summary: Palladium One reported additional high-grade drill intercepts at its Tyko nickel-copper project, including zones with up to ~10.3% nickel and ~2.9% copper over drill intervals. The release focuses on exploration success and connecting mineralized zones, without any near-term production or supply-change information.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel CarLang A Zone Continues to Expand - Preliminary Resource Estimate Planned for Spring 2023
summary: EV Nickel reported additional drill-hole assay results from its CarLang A Zone at the Shaw Dome Project, confirming thick, broad nickel mineralization in 23 reported holes, with assays pending for five more. The company expects a preliminary resource estimate in spring 2023 and highlights low overburden and development potential.

title: 11 Best Aluminum Stocks To Buy - Insider Monkey
summary: The article discusses recent aluminum market moves, noting that China’s decision to lift COVID restrictions coincided with an immediate jump in aluminum prices. It also references prior recession fears, slowing demand, and rising LME aluminum stockpiles, plus consumers delaying 2023 orders due to inflation and supply-chain issues.

title: Glencore says copper mine in Peru struck by vandals
summary: Glencore said vandals attacked its copper mine in Peru. The incident is expected to disrupt operations and raise short-term supply uncertainty, which typically weighs on copper pricing as markets adjust for potential output losses and timing delays.

title: EV Nickel plans preliminary resource estimate at Carlang A zone in Timmins camp
summary: EV Nickel announced additional assay results from the CarLang area in Ontario’s Timmins camp, reinforcing the zone as a potentially large-scale nickel prospect. The update extends geological confidence around the target and can modestly improve expectations for future nickel supply, supporting nickel market sentiment.

title: Comex Copper Settles 0.76% Higher at $4.1860 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper front-month settled 0.76% higher at $4.1860, gaining 3.15 cents per pound. The move extends a six-session rally, with the settlement at the highest since June 13, 2022. The piece frames copper as trending upward month-to-date and year-to-date.

title: Favourable Policies Boost Aluminium Prices, but Weak Demand and Rising Inventory Limit Increases _SMM
summary: SMM reports aluminium futures and spot prices rising after eased US dollar pressure and supply-side production cuts, including further Guizhou reductions and slow Sichuan/Guangxi restarts. However, off-season demand is weak, and social aluminium inventories continue climbing into January, limiting further price gains as CNY approaches.

title: China Dec copper imports slide as demand cools
summary: China’s December copper imports fell 12.7% y/y to 514,049 tonnes as COVID infections and shrinking factory activity cooled demand. The Caixin/Markit PMI stayed in contraction, and some metal-fabrication plants shut or cut plans early. Copper prices in London were higher than Shanghai, also weighing imports.

title: TCs of Spot Copper Concentrates in the First Quarter of 2023 Set by CSPT is Flat from the Figure in the Fourth Quarter of 2022_SMM
summary: SMM reports treatment charges for spot and long-term copper concentrates for early 2023, with TCs roughly flat versus Q4 2022 but below benchmarks due to fewer traders quoting, delayed settlements, and spot supply disturbances. Disruptions include Chile’s Ventanas fire, Peru port blockages, US truck strike, and mine capacity constraints.

title: A gamechanger for aluminium component production in the car industry
summary: A Norwegian project led by Hydro and partners (HyForge) is developing low-pressure casting that can replace an extrusion step for aluminium suspension components. The process aims to cut defects, scrap, cost, energy use, and carbon footprint, and may increase confidence in using more cast aluminium in car production.

title: China's rapid reopening a 'game-changer' for commodity markets, iron ore, oil, copper rally
summary: China’s faster-than-expected reopening is described as a “game-changer” for commodity markets, driving bullish repositioning and lifting raw-material prices. Softer US inflation reduces pressure for aggressive Fed tightening, weakening the dollar and supporting expectations for global growth, which underpins rallies including copper and likely industrial metals demand.

title: Copper Inventories in Major Chinese Markets Add 13,000 mt from Monday_SMM
summary: SMM says copper inventory across major Chinese markets rose 13,000 mt on the week to 135,500 mt, extending a three-week rise since late December. Drivers include weak downstream buying (CNY holiday) and active eastward smelter shipments. Next week’s imported inflows are low, but overall inventory is expected to grow further.

title: Copper Inventories in Domestic Bonded Zone Add 13,300 mt from January 6_SMM
summary: SMM says China’s domestic bonded copper inventories rose 13,300 mt from Jan 6 to 70,800 mt by Jan 13, with larger gains in Shanghai. The SHFE/LME ratio fall pushed spot imports above 1,400 yuan/mt over the front-month contract, suppressing customs declarations and limiting warrant shipments, while smelters shifted goods into bonded warehouses for delivery after February.

title: LME Expects to Resume Asian Hours Nickel Trade_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: LME expects to resume nickel trading in Asian hours but the FCA says supervisory controls are not yet adequate, requiring tighter monitoring to contain volatility. Past nickel disruptions stemmed from low LME inventories and deliverability/ warrant issues. Meanwhile, falling LME nickel and improving supply suggest price risks are limited near term.

title: TASEKO MINES RECEIVES COMMITMENT FOR ADDITIONAL FINANCING FOR FLORENCE COPPER
summary: Taseko secured an underwritten US$25 million financing commitment to fund SX/EW plant costs for its Florence Copper project. Drawdowns are tied to receiving the final EPA Underground Injection Control permit. The funding improves balance-sheet flexibility ahead of 2023 construction, which can modestly support expectations for future copper supply.

title: Taseko Mines Limited - TASEKO receives Commitment for FLORENCE COPPER FINANCING
summary: Taseko said Florence Copper construction is complete and commissioning of its SX/EW plant is progressing, with wellfield acidification and recovered solution grades meeting levels required for operations. It also reported Gibraltar’s 2025 copper production of 98 million pounds and stronger Q4 output amid prior downtime, with cathode production continuing.

title: LME's Plan to Restart Asian Trading Halted Amid Nickel Chaos
summary: The LME published the final Oliver Wyman report on last year’s nickel trading scandal, citing accumulated short positions as a key factor in the March suspension. UK regulators questioned the LME’s ability to carry out plans to restart Asian trading hours. The restart reportedly faced delays amid ongoing nickel chaos.

title: Taseko secures US$25M loan for Florence Copper processing plant
summary: Taseko secured US$25 million in additional financing to fund the solvent extraction and electrowinning (SX/EW) plant for its Florence Copper processing facility in Arizona. The raise supports construction for commercial copper production, potentially improving short-term expectations for future copper supply.

title: Copper scrap supply to remain tight in China: 2023 preview
summary: Fastmarkets reports that copper scrap supply into China is expected to stay tight into 2023. Narrowing scrap-to-refined differentials in late 2022 reflected strong Chinese competition for material. Post “zero-Covid” disruptions are likely to slow European and Chinese scrap generation, pushing China to secure more overseas scrap at higher prices.

title: MMG's Las Bambas Copper Mines Halted Activities Because of Unrest at Another Nearby ... - Latest Tweet by Bloomberg
summary: Bloomberg reports that MMG’s Las Bambas copper mines halted operations because of unrest at another nearby mining site. The production disruption at a major copper asset increases the risk of short-term supply loss, likely tightening available supply and affecting near-term copper price expectations.

title: Goldman Raises Aluminum Forecasts on Higher Chinese and European Demand
summary: Goldman raised its aluminum price/market forecasts, pointing to stronger demand from China and Europe. Higher expected consumption can tighten near-term aluminum supply-demand expectations, typically supporting aluminum prices over the coming days to weeks as traders adjust to improved demand outlooks.

title: Lithium-Ion Battery Copper Foil Output Drops Slightly in December amid Slowing New Orders of Motive Batteries, to Fall Further in January_SMM
summary: SMM data show lithium-ion battery copper foil output fell slightly in December and is expected to drop further in January as new-energy-vehicle subsidy effects fade and order indices weaken. Some producers switch to electronic-circuit foil during certification delays, reducing lithium-foil demand. Maintenance around CNY also cuts output.

title: Workers clash at Indonesian nickel smelter, killing two
summary: Workers clashed at PT Gunbuster Nickel Industry (GNI) in Sulawesi, killing two and damaging company property and dormitories. Police said operations at the smelter are currently suspended, with dozens detained. The incident followed protests over safety and pay, adding short-term supply risk for Indonesian nickel output.

title: Two workers killed after clashes at Indonesian nickel smelter
summary: Two workers were killed in clashes at PT Gunbuster Nickel Industry (GNI) smelter in Sulawesi, following labor protests over safety and pay. Operations at the smelter are currently suspended while police and the company investigate. Indonesia’s nickel supply tightness risk is heightened near term.

title: Alcoa's Kwinana Alumina Refinery to Cut Production by 30%_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Alcoa will cut Kwinana alumina refinery production by 30% in Western Australia because of natural gas shortages, with one unit already suspended and restart timing undecided. SMM expects output disruptions to last ~1.5 months, reducing supply and supporting higher overseas alumina prices, a bullish signal for aluminium-linked markets.

title: Violence at Indonesia nickel smelter protest kills 2, dozens detained
summary: Clashes at Indonesia’s PT Gunbuster Nickel Industry (GNI) smelter left two workers dead and prompted suspending operations. The unrest stemmed from labour protests citing poor safety and pay. Damage to dormitories and vehicles occurred, dozens were detained, and authorities are investigating, potentially disrupting nickel supply.

title: TCs of Spot Copper Concentrate Trend lower in the Sluggish Market_SMM
summary: SMM reports spot copper concentrate trading was sluggish, with weekly imported concentrate TCs edging lower to $87-89/mt and clean concentrate TCs offered at $81-85/mt. Supply-side disturbances include Ventanas port fire impacts and Las Bambas shipping delays, while concentrate inventories rose but near-term supply improvement remains limited.

title: Robust Aluminium Price Rally Pushed Smelters back into Profit-Making Territory _SMM
summary: SMM reports alumina prices rose slightly while smelter full costs fell 72 yuan/mt to 17,721 yuan/mt, mainly due to modest electricity price declines. Spot A00 aluminium rebounded to 18,460 yuan/mt on Friday, lifting average smelter profits to 738.7 yuan/mt. Short-term costs should remain fairly stable.

title: SHFE Aluminium to Hover Sideways amid Positive Macro Environment and Muted Demand Ahead of Upcoming CNY Holiday _SMM
summary: SMM reports SHFE and LME aluminium rose over the week amid cooling US inflation and less fear of aggressive rate hikes. However, domestic aluminium output is still falling due to power rationing and downstream operating rates weaken ahead of CNY. Social inventories are rising, keeping prices range-bound.

title: Aluminium Inventories Rise Further, But Still Lower than A Year Ago_SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s eight major markets’ aluminium ingot social inventories at 690,000 mt as of Jan 16, up 48,000 mt from Jan 12 and 197,000 mt from end-December. Seasonal build-up is concentrated in Wuxi, Foshan and Gongyi, with spot trading near-stagnant as buyers paused before the break.

title: Alumina Prices Lurched Higher as Natural Gas Shortages Constrained Roasting Capacity of Some Refineries_SMM
summary: SMM reports alumina prices rising domestically and overseas as natural gas shortages limit roasting furnace operations in several Chinese regions. Reduced alumina supply pushes northwest China aluminium smelters to buy from higher-priced areas. Overseas prices also lifted after a refinery production cut, supporting near-term aluminium input costs.

title: Copper slips from 7-month high as physical demand remains weak
summary: Copper prices slipped from a seven-month high as subdued physical demand and concerns over global economic conditions weighed on the market. China’s weaker factory activity and falling copper premiums signaled weak spot demand, prompting a short-term correction. Peru supply disruption and low inventory levels offered limited support.

title: Indonesia intends to limit nickel smelters development
summary: Indonesia plans to limit nickel smelter construction, prioritizing ore processing toward higher-value products and requiring new plants to follow “green” energy principles. The government argues this is needed to maximize value addition, while existing coal-powered smelters may face constraints, potentially limiting future nickel supply growth.

title: 1 Chinese Worker and 2 Locals Died During A Clash at Nickel Company in Sulawesi
summary: Workers and locals clashed with police at the Gunbuster Nickel Industri (GNI) smelter in Morowali, Indonesia, over wages, safety, and layoffs. Multiple workers were arrested and three people died. Authorities blame work-safety and salary issues rather than foreign labor, while the company faces investigation and potential operational disruption.

title: Tree used by thieves to steal copper from Bilston firm to be felled
summary: Wolverhampton councillors approved felling a tree used by thieves to scale a wall and steal copper from Mueller Europe Ltd. The company, which makes copper tubing, reports five copper theft break-ins in two weeks, attributing thefts to the high copper price. Replacement trees will be planted.

title: Indonesia deploys security forces after nickel smelter protest and riot turns deadly
summary: Riots at PT Gunbuster Nickel Industry’s smelter in Indonesia left two workers dead and triggered a heavy security deployment after protests over pay and safety turned violent. The incident at the GNI nickel smelter suggests potential disruption to nickel refining supply in the near term.

title: Nickel Asia board OK's nearly P3B more for RE unit - BusinessWorld Online
summary: Nickel Asia’s board approved an additional P2.92 billion investment into its renewable energy subsidiary EPI, including funding for geothermal operating expenses and related project investments. The disclosure notes the company’s revenues benefited last year from higher nickel ore prices, but the new spend is not a direct nickel production or supply change.

title: Why Copper Prices Are Rebounding In 2023
summary: Copper prices are rebounding after breaking prior highs, with the article citing bullish signals from China’s easing zero-COVID disruption and expectations of a rapid economic rebound. Support also comes from a weaker U.S. dollar as inflation cools. However, construction/property weakness and rural COVID risk could add volatility and pullbacks.

title: China Reopening Boosts Copper Outlook
summary: The piece reports that China’s reopening is boosting the copper outlook. With China representing a large share of global copper demand, expectations for higher industrial activity and demand growth can provide upward support to copper prices over the near term.

title: European copper markets face unclear year: 2023 preview
summary: Sources expect Europe’s copper market to face weak demand risk from a likely recession, but supply is tight: Russian copper imports are declining, LME warehouse stocks are at low levels, and off-warrant inventories have fallen. Record-high annual contract premiums and rising spot premiums suggest bullish near-term pressure on copper in Europe.

title: Chinese national killed in nickel plant riot
summary: A riot and labor protest turned violent at PT Gunbuster Nickel Industry’s smelting facility in Indonesia’s Sulawesi, operated by a unit of China’s Jiangsu Delong Nickel Industry. Workers attempted to enter the plant, clashes with security followed, and heavy machinery was set on fire. Two workers died. Supply disruption risk is near-term.

title: Rio Tinto hints at higher iron ore, copper alumina, aluminium production after a soft year
summary: Rio Tinto indicated it may resume growth in export volumes after a softer year, citing high stockpiles at its Western Australia network and a major mine ramping. It also said it plans higher volumes across its alumina, aluminium and copper businesses, adding supply outlook pressure on prices.

title: Rio Tinto hints at higher iron ore, copper alumina, aluminium production after a soft year
summary: Rio Tinto signaled it may restart growth in export volumes, citing high stockpiles at its Western Australian network and ramping a new mine. It also suggested higher 2023 volumes for its alumina/aluminium and copper businesses, implying increased near-term supply that could weigh on copper and aluminium prices.

title: CaNickel's PEA gives Bucko Lake mine annual yield of 7.8M lb.
summary: CaNickel Mining released PEA and resource estimate results for its Bucko Lake nickel mine, outlining a 13-year project with average annual production of about 7.8 million lb of nickel. The update is a supply-side development that can influence near-term nickel market sentiment.

title: Nordic Nickel selected for inaugural BHP Xplor program
summary: Nordic Nickel was selected for BHP’s inaugural Xplor program, receiving a US$500,000 non-dilutive grant and in-kind support to advance its Pulju nickel sulphide project in Finland. The company has started maiden drilling and plans additional deeper holes using the grant to test EM targets.

title: Riot at Chinese-funded nickel plant kills two - Newspaper
summary: Two workers were killed in a riot at PT Gunbuster Nickel Industry’s nickel smelting plant on Sulawesi, Indonesia, amid protests over labor conditions. A one-day strike preceded clashes and the setting of fire to heavy machinery and vehicles. The disruption risks near-term nickel supply, weighing on prices.

title: UPDATE 2-China's 2022 aluminium output hits record high of 40.21 mln tonnes
summary: China’s 2022 aluminium production reportedly hit a record high of 40.21 million tonnes. Record output signals higher supply availability and can weigh on aluminium price expectations over the coming days to weeks, unless demand improvements or inventory tightness offset the additional production.

title: Production resumes at Indonesian nickel smelter after deadly clash
summary: Production has reportedly resumed at an Indonesian nickel smelter after a deadly clash. The restart should ease near-term supply tightness tied to the disruption, lowering expectations of reduced nickel output from the facility and weighing on nickel prices over the next days as supply risk declines.

title: SHFE Nickel Prices Dipped amid Weakening Demand_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SHFE nickel spot premiums weakened on Jan 17, with Jinchuan premiums averaging 11,500 yuan/mt (down 750 yuan/mt) and NORNICKEL premiums averaging 6,950 yuan/mt (down 200 yuan/mt). Nickel briquette prices also fell about 750 yuan/mt as trading remained subdued amid demand concerns.

title: Indonesian nickel smelter resumes productions after deadly riot
summary: Operations at PT Gunbuster Nickel Industry (GNI), Indonesia, were suspended after weekend riots at the smelter left two workers dead and damaged facilities. Police say production has resumed and hundreds of employees returned under heavy security. The restart of a major nickel processing asset should ease short-term nickel supply tightness.

title: Indonesia Deploys Security Forces After Nickel Smelter Protest Turns Deadly
summary: Indonesia deployed security forces after clashes and rioting at the China-owned PT Gunbuster Nickel Industry smelter in Central Sulawesi. Two workers were killed amid protests over pay and safety. Authorities described broader unrest involving workers and guards, raising risks of short-term nickel refining disruption.

title: Riot at Chinese-funded nickel plant in Jakarta kills two - World
summary: A riot and protest over labour conditions at PT Gunbuster Nickel Industry’s nickel smelting plant in Sulawesi left two workers dead and led to a one-day strike. Employees set fire to heavy machinery and vehicles while trying to enter premises, disrupting operations. The incident is likely to constrain nickel supply.

title: QC Copper and Gold Inc: QC Copper Starts Final Leg of Drilling, Updates on Mineral Resource Estimate and Economic Studies
summary: QC Copper and Gold reports the resumption of drilling at its Opemiska copper project, targeting a final 10,000 meters to support an updated mineral resource estimate expected around June 2023. Management says incorporation of new drill data should increase contained metal content and improve mine economics, boosting copper development sentiment.

title: REPEAT - NorthWest Copper Reports 400 Metres of 1.01%
summary: NorthWest Copper reported additional 2022 Kwanika drill results, including hole K-22-255 intersecting 399.8m at 1.01% CuEq and multiple higher-grade copper-gold zones. The company notes the mineralized system may continue and that results were not in the PEA, with remaining assays pending.

title: QC Copper Starts Final Leg of Drilling, Updates on Mineral Resource Estimate and Economic Studies
summary: QC Copper resumes drilling on the Opemiska Property, completing a planned 10,000 metres to update its Mineral Resource Estimate targeted for June 2023. The updated geologic model is expected to increase contained resources and improve mine economics, supporting potential development of the copper project in Quebec.

title: BHP selects firms to fast-tract copper and nickel exploration
summary: BHP selected seven companies for its BHP Xplor accelerator to fast-track early-stage exploration of copper and nickel. The firms receive funding up to $500,000, mentorship, and in-kind services to accelerate testing of new concepts. The programme may support longer-term supply prospects, but timing is distant.

title: BHP selects firms to fast-tract copper and nickel exploration
summary: BHP selected seven companies for its BHP Xplor programme to fast-track early-stage exploration for copper and nickel. The companies receive funding, mentorship, and services, including cash payments up to $500,000. BHP aims to speed discovery of new concepts and data to build its future pipeline.

title: Flying Nickel Mining Corp.: Flying Nickel Provides Minago Nickel PGM Project Update On Environmental Act License, Impact Benefit Agreement, Feasibility Study
summary: Flying Nickel reported progress on its Minago nickel PGM project in Manitoba, including the status of an environmental act license/notice of alteration review, advancement of an impact benefit agreement, and continued feasibility study and PGM recovery optimization. The update supports expectations for future nickel project development.

title: Tertiary secures environmental nod for Zambian copper project
summary: Tertiary Minerals received Zambian EPB approval for its Mushima North copper project, a required environmental permit before starting field exploration. The company plans to assay recovered 1960s drill core and advance exploration using shared First Quantum Minerals data. The approval supports a more positive near-term copper supply outlook.

title: Exclusive-Glencore copper mine in Peru running at 'restricted' capacity due to protests -source
summary: An exclusive report says Glencore’s copper mine in Peru is running at restricted capacity due to protests. The capacity limitation implies curtailed mine supply, increasing near-term concerns over copper output and delivery schedules, which can affect short-term copper price expectations over coming days.

title: Latin Metals Stakes Large Sedimentary Copper Exploration
summary: Latin Metals Inc. reports staking a 99,000-hectare Mirador sediment-hosted copper project in Argentina and conducting initial sampling. Reconnaissance identified outcropping mineralization, including a sample grading 2.4% copper (with anomalous vanadium). The firm plans further regional surveys to define drilling targets and potential partnerships.

title: Québec Nickel to Kick off Its 2023 Drilling Program at Ducros
