title: Taseko to acquire additional stake in Canadian copper mine
summary: Taseko will buy Sojitz’s stake in the Gibraltar copper-molybdenum mine, increasing its holding to 87.5% and raising attributable copper production by about 17%. The transaction involves upfront and instalment payments plus contingent amounts linked to revenues and copper prices, but it’s mainly ownership-driven, not immediate supply expansion.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Reports 52.38 metres at 1.05% Copper at Copper Creek in Arizona
summary: Faraday Copper reported drill intercepts at its Copper Creek Arizona project, including 52.38 m at 1.05% copper and 19.62 m at 0.24% copper, suggesting improved continuity of near-surface high-grade mineralization and potential pit-shell expansion. While not immediate supply-altering, results likely support copper bullish sentiment.

title: Minto Metals Reports Copper Production of 28.9 Million Pounds for 2022, Provides Production Guidance for 2023 and Announces Changes to Board of Directors
summary: Minto Metals reported copper production of 28.9 million pounds for 2022 and issued 2023 production guidance. Such updates can influence near-term expectations for copper supply and related prices. The supplied article text mainly contains cookie/privacy wording, with no specific guidance changes quoted.

title: Palladium One Discovers New Mineralized Chonolith North of RJ Zone and Reports Drill Results for the Smoke Lake Zone, Tyko Nickel
summary: Palladium One reported drill results from its Tyko Nickel–Copper project, including high-grade intervals (e.g., up to ~3.5% Ni and 1.2% Cu over 3.4 m) and a new mineralized chonolith/feeder dyke discovery north of the RJ Zone. The findings are supportive for near-term nickel and copper sentiment.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Ltd.: Ivanhoe Mines Updates on Its Western Foreland Exploration Activities, Adjacent to the Kamoa-Kakula Copper Complex
summary: Ivanhoe Mines updates exploration at its Western Foreland project in the DRC, adjacent to the Kamoa-Kakula copper complex. The company plans ~70,000 metres of 2023 drilling and expects mid-2023 Mineral Resource estimates and a subsequent PEA for Makoko and Kiala copper targets, based on 2022 drill results.

title: First Quantum halts copper processing in Panama as dispute spirals
summary: First Quantum Minerals halted ore processing at its Cobre Panama copper mine in Panama amid an escalating dispute with the government over tax and royalty payments. The move reduces near-term copper output, worsening supply expectations over the coming days and likely weighing on copper prices.

title: First Quantum copper operations shut down as Panama standoff escalates
summary: First Quantum suspended operations at its Cobre Panama copper mine after Panama maritime authorities refused permits required to load and export concentrates. The company cites full storage and a risk of longer closure. Panama alleges contract and compensation disputes with the miner continue. Negotiations are ongoing, but short-term copper supply is reduced.

title: The Power Play by The Market Herald Releases New Interviews with High Tide Resources, Chesapeake Gold, World Copper and INEO Tech Discussing Their Latest News
summary: The Market Herald released interviews including one for World Copper, which said it expanded the resource estimate for its Zonia Copper Oxide Deposit in Arizona. Indicated resources rose to 450.5 million pounds of copper and inferred to 575.4 million pounds, potentially improving near-term supply expectations for copper.

title: Los Andes Copper prefeasibility for Vizcachitas outlines 'Tier 1 asset'
summary: Los Andes Copper says it has completed a positive prefeasibility study for its 100% owned Vizcachitas project in Chile. The study highlights a large post-tax NPV and an attractive IRR, framing Vizcachitas as a high-quality ‘Tier 1 asset,’ potentially supporting bullish copper sentiment.

title: Citi tips aluminium to be the next iron amid China reopening
summary: Citi ended its iron ore preference and recommended aluminium as the next beneficiary of China’s reopening. It points to multiple supply risks and expects demand recovery from reopening and seasonality to tighten China’s physical aluminium market, supporting a potential rally as near-term balances improve.

title: First Quantum Suspends Ore Processing Operations at Cobre Panama copper mine_SMM
summary: First Quantum said it has suspended ore processing operations at its Cobre Panama copper mine. Cobre Panama produced about 350,000 mt of copper concentrates in 2022 (up 5.7% y/y), implying the shutdown can quickly reduce concentrate supply and weigh on prompt copper market expectations.

title: China's Tianshan Aluminum Sinks on Plan to Buy Three Bauxite Mines in Indonesia for USD30.3 Million
summary: Tianshan Aluminum shares fell after it announced plans to buy three bauxite mines in Indonesia for USD30.3 million, seeking higher-quality feedstock amid China’s domestic bauxite bottleneck. The move targets long-run resource security for its Shihezi electrolytic aluminium capacity, but no immediate output changes are specified.

title: Tianshan Aluminum Acquires Bauxite Mining Rights in Indonesia through Overseas Sub-Subsidiary_SMM
summary: Tianshan Aluminum plans to acquire a 100% stake in PTIntiTambangMakmu via a wholly-owned sub-subsidiary, indirectly controlling three Indonesian bauxite mining subsidiaries. The acquisition secures bauxite supply, which can bolster confidence in alumina/aluminium production feedstock availability and support aluminium market sentiment.

title: Nevada Copper to Restart Pumpkin Hollow Copper Mine in Q3 2023_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Nevada Copper says it plans to restart the Pumpkin Hollow copper mine in Q3 2023, with financing and technical/leadership teams in place to advance the project quickly and safely. The company targets ramping production to planned capacity by year-end, increasing expected copper supply.

title: POSCO, Chinese Firm Sign Preliminary Deal for EV Battery Nickel Production in Indonesia
summary: POSCO and a Chinese firm reportedly signed a preliminary agreement for EV battery nickel production in Indonesia. The deal points to additional nickel supply coming through a new investment pipeline tied to battery demand, which can lift near-term market expectations for nickel prices.

title: High Costs and Insufficient Orders to Keep ADC12 Secondary Aluminium Alloy Prices Rangebound _SMM
summary: SMM reports that Yunnan output cuts lifted A00 aluminium prices to about 18,600 yuan/mt, supporting higher ADC12 secondary aluminium offers. Large ADC12 plants raised quotes to 19,600-19,800 yuan/mt, while smaller ones increased to 19,200-19,400. High costs and weak orders should keep ADC12 rangebound short-term.

title: Prices for Secondary Aluminium Alloys Advanced, to Remain Rangebound in the Near Term _SMM
summary: Secondary aluminium alloy prices in China increased this week, with large-scale producers quoting 19,600–19,800 yuan/mt and small/medium factories 19,200–19,400 yuan/mt. Despite the uptick, the market faces high costs and weak orders, so prices are expected to stay rangebound in the near term.

title: POSCO Holdings starts secondary battery nickel business in Indonesia
summary: POSCO Holdings and China’s Lygend Resources & Technology signed an MOA in Indonesia to cooperate on nickel production for secondary batteries. Plans include building a nickel MHP plant in Sulawesi with 120,000 tons annual capacity, with construction starting in 2024 and production in 2025. The move targets cost-competitive Indonesian nickel.

title: Copper Import Losses Shrink Thanks to Improving SHFE/LME Copper Price Ratio_SMM
summary: SMM reports that while LME copper slipped below $9,000/mt and SHFE 2303 fell below 70,000 yuan/mt, the SHFE/LME price ratio recovered to 7.75. This reduces Chinese copper import losses to under 1,000 yuan/mt, improving near-term arbitrage conditions for copper.

title: SMM survey: Aluminium Smelters in Guizhou still Plagued by Power Shortfalls_SMM
summary: SMM data says Guizhou’s aluminium capacity faces persistent power shortfalls. With hydropower shortfalls and thermal bottlenecks, industrial power supply is unlikely to recover quickly. Smelters can run at full capacity only in June-July, while 236,000 mt transferred from Shandong is delayed by needed shutdowns.

title: Posco, Ningbo Liqin to build nickel processing plant in Indonesia
summary: Posco and Ningbo Liqin signed a preliminary agreement to build a nickel processing plant in Indonesia, targeting 120,000 tons/year of mixed nickel-cobalt hydroxide (MHP) from 2025, with an initial 60,000 tons. The project supports EV battery cathode supply and adds to Indonesia’s nickel value-added processing push.

title: SMM survey: Power Supply Bottleneck Prevents Aluminum Capacity in Sichuan from Fully Recovering _SMM
summary: SMM reports Sichuan aluminum operating capacity remains below pre-power-rationing levels due to continuing power supply bottlenecks. Operating capacity recovered to about 800,000 mt from 1 million mt, with further recovery dependent on full power restoration. New plants by Sichuan Guangyuan Zhongfu and Sichuan Aostar will start only after power improves.

title: Aluminium Output Cuts in Yunnan Put Aluminium Fluoride and Cryolite Prices at Downside Risk _SMM
summary: SMM reports sluggish trading in aluminium fluoride and cryolite, with prices held in specific weekly ranges. It attributes downside risk to aluminium output cuts in Yunnan, saying the cuts have undermined demand for these inputs, which can weigh on the broader aluminium market outlook over coming days.

title: Copper falls on weak China demand, hawkish Fed
summary: Copper prices fell as China demand appeared tepid after the Lunar New Year and markets increasingly priced higher U.S. interest rates for longer. The downturn was partially cushioned by global supply disruptions, including First Quantum’s suspension at Cobre Panama, but overall sentiment turned bearish for copper and broader industrial metals.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports Dip 425,000 wmt WoW_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reported Chinese nickel ore inventories at seven major ports fell 425,000 wmt week-on-week to 7.18 million wmt (56,400 mt Ni content). Inventories at the ports also declined. NPI plant demand improved somewhat, while Philippines rainy-season disruptions kept imports low, suggesting inventories may keep falling.

title: Premium Nickel Resources Ltd. Closes Private Placement Financing
summary: Premium Nickel Resources closed a CAD$7.8m private placement to fund further drilling and underground development at its Selebi and Selkirk nickel-copper-cobalt deposits in Botswana. The funding aims at advancing projects toward a NI 43-101 PEA maiden resource. No immediate production, inventory, or pricing changes are stated.

title: APAA Applauds Biden Administration's Increased Tariffs on Russian Aluminum and Calls for Continued U.S. Support for Domestic Aluminum Market
summary: The American Primary Aluminum Association praised the Biden administration’s 200% tariff on Russian aluminum imports into the U.S., including Russian aluminum embedded in third-country products, alongside Section 232. The group argues the measures will limit dumped Russian supply, protect domestic primary aluminum producers, and improve pricing power.

title: City of Cape Town staff held for copper theft worth over R44m
summary: City of Cape Town workers were arrested for allegedly stealing copper buzz bars valued at over R44 million. Police say the suspects illegally booked out bars from a stock room in 2022 and transported the copper to a local scrap dealer. Authorities are still retrieving the stolen copper and will charge the suspects.

title: Century Aluminum Co (CENX) Issues Statement of Support for New Biden Administration Tariffs on Russian Aluminum
summary: Century Aluminum said it fully supports the Biden administration’s decision to impose a 200% tariff on Russian aluminum imports (and Russian aluminum embedded in downstream products). The company argues Russian producers have flooded the U.S. market with excess supply. The tariff should reduce imports and support domestic aluminum pricing.

title: Century Aluminum Issues Statement of Support for New Biden Administration Tariffs on Russian Aluminum
summary: Century Aluminum said it supports the Biden administration’s decision to impose a 200% tariff on Russian aluminum imports into the U.S., including aluminum embedded in downstream products. The company argues Russian producers have over-supplied and undercut U.S. competitors, and tariffs should strengthen domestic aluminum supply, aiding prices.

title: U.S. to impose 200% tariff on aluminum from Russia -White House
summary: The White House says the U.S. will impose a 200% tariff on aluminum imports from Russia. Such a steep duty is expected to deter Russian shipments and alter near-term supply and pricing dynamics for aluminum, creating downward price pressure where affected trade flows are priced.

title: Kodiak Copper announces a new claim package contiguous with its MPD project in BC
summary: Kodiak Copper announced a new claim package contiguous with its MPD project in British Columbia. The update suggests expansion of its land position over a copper project, which can improve expectations for future resource development and support short-term copper sentiment. The excerpt contains no direct production or pricing impact details.

title: Aluminium prices shrug off 200% U.S. import tariffs for Russia
summary: The news headline says aluminium prices have “shrugged off” newly imposed 200% U.S. import tariffs on Russia. While the tariff should alter cross-border aluminium flows and raise costs for U.S. buyers, market pricing appears to have largely discounted the measure in the near term, limiting immediate price pressure.

title: Comex Copper Ends the Week 3.86% Lower at $3.9550 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper futures for February delivery settled at $3.9550, down 3.86% for the week and lower for four of the past five weeks, including three consecutive down sessions. The settlement is among the lowest of the year, signaling bearish momentum in near-term copper prices.

title: World Copper Ltd.: World Copper Extends Cardero Loans
summary: World Copper Ltd. reports that TSXV accepted consolidation and extension of due dates on related-party loans to February 22, 2024, with bonus warrants issued to the lender. The company remains focused on its Chile copper porphyry projects, but the update does not change copper supply or demand outlook immediately.

title: US Announces Tariffs On Russian Metals Including Aluminium
summary: The US announced tariffs on Russian metals, with aluminium explicitly included. Such trade barriers are expected to curb Russian exports into the US, tightening near-term aluminium availability and raising the likelihood of higher aluminium prices within days to weeks.

title: Aluminum Prices Shrug Off 200 Percent US Import Tariffs for Russia
summary: The US imposed a 200% tariff on aluminium produced in Russia, effectively banning Russian aluminium imports from March 10. Despite the trade shock, LME aluminium prices largely held steady, with traders saying prices might have risen more sharply had sanctions been imposed instead.

title: Column: Nickel's electric dreams turn into a pricing nightmare
summary: The article says the global nickel market swung to a 112,000-tonne surplus in 2022 and that Indonesia’s rapidly growing Class II output is largely non-deliverable against LME/SHFE Class I. LME prices remain elevated but discounts for matte and ferronickel have widened, signaling weaker refined nickel price discovery.

title: Aluminium Prices to Lack Rising Impetus amid Overseas Macro Headwinds and Poor Domestic Fundamentals_SMM
summary: SMM reports that aluminium ingot social inventories have not started a destocking cycle, weakening bullish confidence. Rising coal prices provide some support, but inventory accumulation outweighs production cutbacks in Yunnan. As a result, aluminium prices are expected to stay rangebound this week, with specific SHFE and LME trading ranges given.

title: SMM Aluminium Price Forecast Based On Machine Learning And Technical Indicators (Feb 27-Mar 3, 2023)  _SMM
summary: SMM forecasts that the most-traded SHFE aluminium contract will trade rangebound or decline during Feb 27–Mar 3, 2023. Machine-learning models estimate weekly price ranges with downside scenarios, and technical indicators show trend signals generally bearish with support around 17,900–18,200 and resistance near 18,800–19,000.

title: SMM Aluminium Morning Comment on Feb 27, 2023_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports SHFE 2304 aluminium fell 1.45% and LME aluminium dropped 1.99% after the US dollar strengthened amid still-high inflation and rate-hike expectations. It highlights aluminium ingot inventories staying elevated with no destocking, while rapidly rising coal prices increase cost pressure, keeping prices weak.

title: SHFE and LME Aluminium Weekly Price Review (Feb 20-24, 2023)_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reviews aluminium prices on SHFE and LME for Feb 20-24, 2023. SHFE 2304 aluminum opened near 18,465 yuan/mt, finishing about 18,635 yuan/mt, up ~0.92% on the week. LME aluminum ended around $2,393/mt, down ~0.08%, roughly flat.

title: US Inflation Data Weighed on Copper Prices_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: US PCE inflation came in above expectations, strengthening expectations for a hawkish Fed and weighing on the US dollar and risk appetite, which pushed LME and SHFE copper lower. China copper inventories changed only slightly amid mixed regional demand, while downstream buying turned cautious, expecting slower demand improvement.

title: Aluminium Ingot Inventories Maintain Upward Trend _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says China’s aluminium ingot social inventories were 1.27mn mt on Feb 27, up WoW and far above late January and last year, with most accumulation from Gongyi. Although inventory growth has slowed, the stock level remains high. Prices fell but buying stayed weak, implying bearish near-term sentiment.

title: Spot Premiums of Pure Nickel Fell Further at Month-End_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that pure nickel spot premiums declined further at month-end: Jinchuan nickel averaged about 5,750 yuan/mt and Nornickel about 3,600 yuan/mt, both down versus the previous day. Weak demand and subdued trading coincided with further falls in SHFE nickel and spot quotes, and lower nickel briquette prices.

title: Average Price of Nickel Fall from the Previous Trading Day_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reported that Shanghai nickel premiums weakened on Feb 27: Jinchuan averaged 5,750 yuan/mt (-400) and Nornickel averaged 3,600 yuan/mt (-300). Weak demand and SHFE 2303 nickel deliveries led to mediocre spot trading, while nickel briquette prices also fell as trading stayed poor versus sulphate prices.

title: Copper slips on firm dollar, uncertain China demand
summary: London copper fell as a firmer dollar and uncertainty over China’s demand weighed on prices, even as supply disruptions in Indonesia, Peru and Chile provided some support. Analysts also cited inventory dynamics and a seasonal demand outlook. Aluminium in the region rose slightly, but SHFE aluminium and nickel declined with smelter production cuts.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Announces Acquisition of Mercer Ranch at Copper Creek Project in Arizona
summary: Faraday Copper announced the US$10 million acquisition of the Mercer Ranch land package within its Copper Creek project area in Arizona. Management says the acquisition helps de-risk and advance the early-stage project by securing surface rights, access, water/mineral rights, and potential infrastructure options, but no near-term production impacts are stated.

title: Faraday Copper Announces Acquisition of Mercer Ranch at Copper Creek Project in Arizona
summary: Faraday Copper says it is acquiring the Mercer Ranch within its Copper Creek project area in Arizona. The announcement is copper-related but does not provide evidence of immediate changes in mine output, smelting/refining capacity, or near-term supply flows, so any effect on copper prices is likely minimal in the coming weeks.

title: Trilogy Metals Reports Multiple Intersections of High-Grade Copper, Zinc, Lead, Gold and Silver from 17 Drill Holes Completed in 2022 at the Arctic Project in Alaska
summary: Trilogy Metals reported results from 17 drill holes at its Arctic Project in Alaska, highlighting high-grade copper intersections and copper equivalent grades exceeding 14% over up to 7.3 metres. Positive exploration outcomes can lift near-term sentiment for potential copper supply, supporting copper price expectations.

title: Lifezone Metals Announces Completion of S-K 1300 Technical Report Summary Disclosing a Total of 40.4 Mt Resource Attributable to Lifezone Metals for the Kabanga Nickel Project in Tanzania
summary: Lifezone Metals announced completion of the S-K 1300 technical report summary for the Kabanga nickel project in Tanzania, reporting 40.4 Mt attributable resources containing 2,325 Mlb nickel and 311 Mlb copper (plus cobalt). The TRS is preliminary and supports development progress, not immediate production or supply changes.

title: Nickel 28 Releases Ramu Q4 and Full Year 2022 Operating Performance
summary: Nickel 28 reported Ramu Q4 2022 nickel production of 8,480 tonnes (+33% y/y) and full-year contained nickel of 34,302 tonnes (with 105% of nameplate capacity). The release also notes LME average nickel prices rose strongly in 2022 and highlights improved sales and operating momentum into 2023.

title: McEwen Mining: McEwen Copper Announces an Additional US$30 Million Investment by Nuton, a Rio Tinto Venture
summary: McEwen Copper announced a binding US$30 million investment by Nuton (a Rio Tinto venture). Proceeds will fund advancement of the Los Azules copper project in Argentina and general purposes. The deal includes copper offtake purchase rights and extends exclusivity on copper heap-leach technologies, supporting near-term copper development outlook.

title: Rio Tinto venture Nuton to invest another $30m in McEwen Copper
summary: Rio Tinto’s Nuton will invest an additional $30m by buying shares in McEwen Copper, including funding aimed at advancing the Los Azules copper project in Argentina. Nuton’s exclusivity on copper heap-leach technology is extended, with a production off-take option linked to equity.

title: Stellantis to Invest $155 Million in Sustainable Copper Project
summary: Stellantis said it invested $155 million to produce “sustainable copper” via a stake in McEwen Copper, which owns Argentina’s Los Azules project. Los Azules targets 100,000 tons per year of 99.9% cathode copper starting in 2027. The move supports Stellantis’ net-zero goals.

title: Stellantis invests $155 million in Argentine copper mine
summary: Stellantis invested $155 million to buy a 14.2% minority stake in McEwen Copper’s Los Azules project in Argentina. The project targets 100,000 tons per year of 99.9% purity cathode copper for EV batteries starting in 2027. The move strengthens Stellantis’ raw-material sourcing strategy.

title: Stellantis Announces Strategic Copper Investment in
summary: Stellantis will invest $155 million in McEwen Copper’s Los Azules project in Argentina, acquiring a 14.2% stake. Los Azules plans to produce high-purity cathode copper from 2027 to support electric vehicle battery supply. The company frames the deal as securing strategic copper inputs for electrification plans.

title: Stellantis, Rio Tinto grab stakes in McEwen Copper
summary: Stellantis and Rio Tinto are reported to be taking stakes in McEwen Copper’s Los Azules copper project in Argentina’s San Juan province. The investment interest highlights continued backing for copper development, which can improve near-term sentiment toward copper supply prospects.

title: A $1.5 billion hoard of copper and cobalt is piling up in Congo
summary: The article headline says a $1.5 billion stockpile of copper (and cobalt) is building up in Congo. While cobalt is not tracked here, an accumulating copper hoard suggests inventories are rising and immediate supply tightness is easing, which can pressure copper prices in the coming days.

title: Chile copper mining costs rise, output falls
summary: The report headline says Chile’s copper mining costs are rising while output falls. Such conditions imply reduced near-term mine supply and potentially higher production margins/cost burdens, which can affect market expectations for copper availability in the coming weeks.

title: Trafigura caught in fake nickel scandal
summary: The piece describes Trafigura’s alleged $577m loss from discovering that purported nickel containers contained low-grade materials such as carbon steel instead. Credit lines were withdrawn, containers were inspected, and legal actions followed. It highlights counterparty and document-fraud risk, with potential short-term sentiment effects on nickel.

title: South Korean Government Designates Ten Key Minerals Such as Lithium, Nickel and Cobalt_SMM
summary: South Korea’s Ministry of Industry, Trade and Resources designated 10 “Strategic Key Minerals” for tighter management, including lithium and nickel, for semiconductor and battery supply security. It plans global mineral and supply-demand maps and an early warning system to monitor risks, which may modestly influence nickel expectations near term.

title: Zhejian Hailiang Plans to Invest 5.9 Billion Yuan in Indonesia to Build Copper Foil Project _SMM
summary: Zhejian Hailiang plans to invest about 5.9 billion yuan in Indonesia to build a high-performance copper foil plant via a new subsidiary, targeting 100,000 mt annual capacity in two 50,000 mt phases. The first phase is scheduled for 2023-2025 and the second for 2025-2027.

title: Spot Pure Nickel Premiums Fall amid Increasing Shipments from Upstream Companies_SMM
summary: SMM reports Feb 28 spot premiums for pure nickel falling: Jinchuan premiums average 5,400 yuan/mt (down 350), while NORNICKEL averages 3,000 yuan/mt (down 600). SHFE nickel is said to have bottomed, but upstream firms shipped more toward month-end, weighing on spot demand.

title: Sleepless but not silenced: Indigenous people face off with nickel mine in Philippine tropical sanctuary
summary: Residents in Palawan, Philippines, are protesting the Ipilan Nickel Corporation (INC) mine, citing lack of free prior informed consent and operations in/near protected old-growth forest zones. Local officials and legal groups push for cease orders and even MPSA cancellation, raising the risk of near-term nickel supply disruption to China.

title: New steel, aluminum tariffs imposed on Russia
summary: The United States added tariffs on steel and aluminum imports from Russia to mark the one-year anniversary of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and to economically pressure it to stop the war. The tariff increase is likely to tighten U.S. aluminum supply from Russia in the near term, supporting aluminum prices.

title: Fathom Nickel Inc.: Fathom Announces Completion of Drilling at Gochager Lake and Drill Target Identification at the Albert Lake Project
summary: Fathom Nickel reports completion of drilling at its Gochager Lake project and plans to commence drilling at the Albert Lake Project by March 3, targeting ultramafic Ni-Cu sulphide systems and cobalt. The company expects assays in April but provides no new confirmed production or reserve changes.

title: STELLANTIS N.V.: Stellantis Announces Strategic Copper Investment in Argentina, Reinforcing Commitment to Reaching Carbon Net Zero by 2038
summary: Stellantis said it will invest $155 million for a 14.2% stake in McEwen Copper’s Los Azules project in Argentina, planning to produce 100,000 tons/year of 99.9% cathode copper from 2027. Stellantis cites EV battery needs and aims to secure strategic copper supply for electrification.

title: China's Hailiang to Build USD849 Million EV Battery Copper Foil Plant in Indonesia
summary: Zhejiang Hailiang will invest $849 million to build a copper foil plant in Indonesia for EV batteries, targeting 100,000 tons annually, with Gansu expansion also ramping to supply BYD and CATL. The capacity adds prospective copper demand/supply expectations tied to battery materials, weighing on copper pricing.

title: EV Nickel Defines Resource Estimate at CarLang's A Zone, 1.25m Indicated and 1.16m Inferred Tonnes of Contained Nickel- A Zone Represents First 20% of the Full CarLang
summary: The article headline reports that EV nickel project CarLang has defined an updated resource estimate for its A Zone, stating 1.25 million tonnes indicated and 1.16 million tonnes inferred of contained nickel. As this is an exploration/resource-definition update, it may mildly boost near-term nickel sentiment via improved supply outlook.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel Defines Resource Estimate at CarLang's A Zone, 1.25m Indicated and 1.16m Inferred Tonnes of Contained Nickel- A Zone Represents First 20% of the Full CarLang
summary: EV Nickel reported a maiden NI 43-101 resource estimate for the CarLang A Zone at its Shaw Dome project, totaling ~1.25M tonnes indicated and ~1.16M tonnes inferred contained nickel. The company cites nickel pricing assumptions in pit optimization and positions the deposit as major undeveloped supply, but it is not production.

title: Tycoon in $577m Nickel Suit Told Inspectors He'd Had a Heart Attack: FT
summary: An Indian tycoon sued for missing nickel cargoes told inspectors he had a heart attack shortly before planned checks in Rotterdam. Trafigura alleges shipments contained no nickel, instead carbon steel, and seeks $577m in losses. The story highlights fraud and supply-quality/counterparty risk for nickel.

title: Ford's F-150 Relies On Aluminum That Might Be Making People Sick In The Amazon
summary: Ford’s F-150 Lightning uses substantial aluminum, traced via suppliers to Norsk Hydro’s Alunorte refinery in Brazil. A class-action lawsuit alleges toxic waste contaminates local water, with tests reportedly far above safe levels. Norsk Hydro denies the claims, but legal and regulatory risk could impact aluminium supply expectations and sentiment.

title: Comex Copper Ends the Month 3.10% Lower at $4.0975 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper ended the month 3.10% lower at $4.0975 per pound, marking the largest one-month percentage decline since July 2022 and ending a three-month winning streak. The front-month contract gained on the day (+2.21%), showing short-term rebound after recent weakness.

title: The Northern Miner Podcast: Should governments be funding mines? ft Nickel 28's Anthony Milewski
summary: The podcast features Nickel 28’s chairman discussing recent industrial metals developments in the U.S. after the Inflation Reduction Act and the push to secure domestic supply chains. It also discusses the LME’s credibility in relation to the 2022 nickel short squeeze, which could affect short-term nickel sentiment and positioning.

title: There isn't enough copper in the world — and the shortage could last till 2030
summary: The article warns of a sustained copper deficit through 2023 and possibly beyond, citing challenged South American supply (Peru unrest disrupting Glencore’s Antapaccay mine, Chile output declines) alongside stronger demand expectations from China’s reopening and energy-transition electrification. It links tighter balances to higher copper prices.

title: Power Minerals begins exploration across Musgrave nickel-copper-cobalt-PGE project
summary: Power Minerals has started a multi-element resampling program at its Musgrave nickel-copper-cobalt-PGE project in South Australia, using pXRF on drill core samples and sending selected samples for lab analysis. Results will help define drill targets for upcoming drilling, but no production or confirmed resource changes are reported.

title: Power Minerals begins exploration across Musgrave nickel-copper-cobalt-PGE project
summary: Power Minerals has started a core reanalysis and pXRF sampling program at its Musgrave nickel-copper-cobalt-PGE project in South Australia, processing over 1,000 samples. Selected samples were sent for lab analysis to define drill targets, including the Pink Slipper anomaly. No results or production impacts are reported.

title: SMM PMI in Aluminium Downstream Sectors Rebounded Remarkably and Returned to Expansion Territory in February_SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s aluminium downstream-sector PMI rose to 69.6 in February, up 34.3 points month-on-month, returning to expansion territory. The sharp rebound suggests improved downstream demand for aluminium. This near-term demand outlook is supportive for aluminium price expectations in the coming weeks.

title: SMM Aluminium Scrap Prices in Foshan Rise on March 1_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reported that aluminium extrusion scrap prices in Foshan rose on March 1 to 13,500–14,400 yuan/mt, up 100 yuan/mt from the previous day. The move suggests improved scrap pricing conditions locally, which can provide short-term support to aluminium-related input costs and sentiment.

title: Improving End-User Sectors to Drive Chinese Aluminium Downstream Sectors to Recover Further in March_SMM
summary: SMM says improving Chinese end-user sectors should help aluminium downstream businesses recover further in March. The firm expects aluminium downstream sector PMIs to remain in expansion territory, with attention on how strongly auto and property markets rebound, which could support aluminium demand and price sentiment.

title: Century Aluminum Company (NASDAQ:CENX) Q4 2022 Earnings Call Transcript
summary: Century Aluminum’s earnings call highlights that aluminum markets remain in deficit, driven by energy-related production curtailments in China and Europe. Management expects inventories to stay tight and notes improved power economics after the Ukraine-driven energy crisis, alongside higher premiums and better realized LME/premium conditions so far in 2023.

title: Power Nickel Inc.: Power Nickel Extends Nickel Mineralization In Multiple Holes on its Fall 2022 Drill Program
summary: Power Nickel reported high-grade Ni-Cu-Co sulphide and PGE assay results from multiple holes at its Nisk deposit and said drilling is ongoing toward late April/early May. While discoveries can support bullish sentiment for nickel and some copper supply prospects, there is no immediate production or inventory impact, limiting price moves.

title: What's holding up an energy supply deal on Tiwai aluminium smelter?
summary: Meridian Energy and NZAS are still negotiating an electricity supply deal to keep New Zealand’s Tiwai aluminium smelter operating beyond next year. Issues include power pricing, long-term smelter commitment, waste cleanup, and reduced demand response when hydro lakes are low. No deal is expected for months, leaving output risk.

title: Disruptions to Copper Mine Production in South America Were Below Market Expectations_SMM
summary: SMM reports disruptions at Peru’s Las Bambas and Antapaccay copper operations. Las Bambas suspended molybdenum concentrate production briefly due to auxiliary-material shortages, while copper concentrates were normal; auxiliary supplies later resumed. Antapaccay faced a protest shutdown for 11 days and is still unable to ship ore via Matarani port.

title: Spot Pure Nickel Transactions are Less than Expected Today_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that on March 1 traders offered spot quotes versus SHFE 2304 nickel, with Jinchuan and NORNICKEL premiums rising sharply. Despite the premium increases, SHFE nickel and spot prices fell to 2023 lows. Downstream profit margins did not improve and pure nickel demand remained poor, weakening intraday transactions.

title: Harmony pursues gold and copper assets in Africa and Asia
summary: Harmony Gold Mining said it is pursuing gold and copper M&A opportunities and cited its Wafi-Golpu project. It recently acquired the Eva Copper Project and is redoing its feasibility study, adding sizable copper reserves. The update is project-development oriented with no near-term supply or demand shock indicated.

title: Fabled Copper Corp.: Fabled Copper Reports Values as High as 15.55% Copper on East Extension of the Eagle Creek Copper Occurrence
summary: Fabled Copper Corp. reports 2022 fieldwork results from its Muskwa Copper Project, specifically the eastern extension of the Eagle Creek copper occurrence. Ten float samples were collected; one returned 15.55% Cu and another 6.14% Cu. The company plans further releases on the exploration program.

title: Québec Nickel Corp.: Québec Nickel Intersects Greater Than 1.25% Nickel in Fortin Sill Zone Drilling
summary: Québec Nickel Corp. reported new drilling results from its Ducros Ducros Ni-Cu-PGE project, including a 4.90-metre interval averaging 0.77% Ni and 0.56% Cu, with one-metre samples up to 1.27% Ni and 1.21% Cu. Follow-up drilling is planned; no production impacts are announced.

title: Bell Copper Corporation: Drilling Recommences at Bell Copper's Big Sandy Porphyry Copper Project in Arizona, USA
summary: Bell Copper Corporation reports drilling recommences at its 100% owned Big Sandy porphyry copper project in Arizona, following a prior hole with 200 meters of chalcocite-bearing porphyry. The company builds a new drill pad and continues drilling to bedrock to advance exploration and potential future resource definition.

title: Leading Edge Materials Enlarges Extent of Nickel and Cobalt
summary: Leading Edge Materials says it has identified an expanded zone of cobalt-nickel mineralization at its Bihor Sud project in Romania, with new galleries and planned mapping/sampling after safety inspections and ventilation installation. Trenching proceeded early due to mild weather. This exploration progress could modestly lift expectations for future nickel supply.

title: US aluminium scrap, secondary alloy prices mixed on quieter market
summary: US aluminium scrap and secondary alloy prices were mixed but generally supported by stronger export demand for zorba and twitch, seasonal shredders outages causing short-term tightness, and rising LME three-month aluminium. Non-ferrous auto shred and some turnings increased, while mill grade was quiet and some clip grades eased.

title: European aluminium: high stock levels keep consumer requirements low despite recovery in automotive demand
summary: European automotive production is recovering as chip shortages ease, and aluminium shipments to aircraft and automotive/packaging improve. However, primary foundry alloy demand remains muted due to high downstream inventories and weaker billet/physical demand, keeping aluminium premiums only partially supported. Energy uncertainty and mixed packaging strength cap further upside.

title: BHP seeks to tighten grip on South America's copper sector
summary: BHP is considering expanding its investments in Argentina’s copper sector, building on its existing presence via a stake in Filo Mining. The potential expansion is copper-specific, but the article suggests planning rather than immediate production changes, limiting likely short-term price impact over the coming weeks.

title: Berkeley County's aluminum industry could be getting a newcomer
summary: Glencore and ZEB Metals plan to open a nearby aluminum recycling plant near Century Aluminum’s Mount Holly smelter, using furnaces to process industrial scrap and aluminum dross. The project is aimed at expanding secondary aluminum supply, supported by Glencore’s view that policy-driven demand for critical materials will grow.

title: United States Imposes 200 Percent Duties on Russian Aluminum and All Products Containing Russian Aluminum; Takes Other Actions Targeting Mining & Metals Sector | White & Case LLP
summary: The US government announced February 24, 2023 trade and sanctions actions targeting Russian metals. A key measure imposed 200% duties on Russian aluminum and aluminum-containing products, with additional higher tariffs on other Russian metal products. OFAC also expanded sanctions affecting Russia’s mining and metals sector.

title: BRIEF-Oman signs mineral exploration deal with UK's Knights Bay to extract nickel
summary: Oman signed a mineral exploration agreement with the UK’s Knights Bay to explore for and extract nickel, described as the first deal of its kind with a foreign partner. Initial investment for exploration and evaluation is estimated at $25–$30 million over the first three years, with no near-term output details.

title: Freeport Indonesia: Grasberg Copper Mine has Resumed Operations_SMM
summary: Reuters reports Freeport’s Grasberg copper mine in Indonesia has resumed normal operations after floods damaged smelters and the access road, forcing suspensions in February. Earlier disruptions included a washed-away conveyor belt affecting ore shipments and a lowered Q1 copper sales forecast, suggesting renewed supply support for copper.

title: CME Group Announces Record Aluminum Futures Volume, Open Interest
summary: CME Group said Aluminum futures saw record average daily volume in February 2023 and record average daily open interest, along with rising unique users, extending through December 2024. The announcement emphasizes market liquidity and participation growth rather than any change in aluminum supply, demand, or inventories.

title: American Eagle Gold Corp.: American Eagle Confirms Continuity of Copper-Gold Mineralization at NAK with Multiple Significant Intercepts at Depth and Near Surface
summary: American Eagle Gold reported assays from additional 2022 drill holes at its NAK copper-gold porphyry project, highlighting long copper-equivalent intercepts and multiple copper-rich bornite/chalcopyrite zones from near surface to depth. The update supports exploration continuity but does not indicate immediate production, limiting short-term copper price impact.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel to Present at Multiple Events and Awaits Developments on Clean Nickel , plus Assay Results
summary: EV Nickel Inc. announces upcoming presentations at PDAC and other events and says it is awaiting assay results from its 2023 W4 drilling later in March. It also discusses clean nickel strategy and a previously released CarLang A Zone maiden resource estimate. No new production or pricing data is provided.

title: TNR Gold Corp.: TNR Gold NSR Royalty Update; McEwen Mining's Los Azules Copper, Gold & Silver Project - Close of ARS $30 Billion Investment by Stellantis
summary: TNR reports an update on McEwen Mining’s Los Azules copper project in Argentina, where Stellantis closed an ARS $30 billion investment into McEwen Copper. Proceeds are intended to advance the copper project’s development, with Stellantis holding rights to purchase copper output tied to its equity.

title: Oman's inks mining pact to extract nickel for global EV industry
summary: Oman’s Ministry of Energy and Minerals signed a mining concession with Knights Bay for Block 21, giving the UK firm rights to extract high-purity nickel with zero carbon emissions. The project includes exploration and appraisal and plans to process battery minerals (nickel and cobalt) for EV industry demand.

title: Copper Fox Announces 2023 Schaft Creek Program
summary: Copper Fox announced its 2023 program for the Schaft Creek copper-gold-molybdenum-silver project, including a C$17.2m work plan with geotechnical/metallurgical drilling, environmental baseline sampling, and permitting updates. It focuses on improving mine design and reducing costs, but no near-term production changes are stated.

title: Sky Gold Corp. Completes Acquisition of Three Nickel-Copper-Cobalt-Platinum Group Element Properties in the Shebandowan Greenstone Belt, Northwestern Ontario
summary: Sky Gold Corp. says the TSX Venture Exchange accepted its 100% acquisition of three nickel-copper-cobalt-platinum group element properties in Ontario. The deal terms include share issuance, cash, and a net smelter/royalty. No production or development timeline is provided, implying limited short-term supply impact for nickel and copper.

title: Sky Gold Corp. Completes Acquisition of Three Nickel-Copper-Cobalt-Platinum Group Element Properties in the Shebandowan Greenstone Belt, Northwestern Ontario
summary: Sky Gold Corp. reports that TSX-V has accepted filing for Sky’s 100% acquisition of three nickel-copper-cobalt-PGE properties in northwestern Ontario. The deal terms involve share issuance and cash payments, plus potential additional consideration if a large, viable ore body is identified—no near-term production impact is stated.

title: Comex Copper Settles 2.02% Lower at $4.0840 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper futures for March delivery settled down 8.40 cents, or 2.02%, at $4.0840, breaking a three-session winning streak. The move is described as the largest one-day dollar and percentage drop since Feb. 24, with LME copper cash also weaker.

title: Imports of Aluminum Proclamation from the White House
summary: The Biden Administration issued a proclamation imposing 200% tariffs on aluminum articles produced in Russia and on products with any primary or derivative aluminum smelted or cast in Russia. The article also says CBP is increasing UFLPA enforcement for aluminum, issuing detention notices, potentially reducing available U.S. supply and pressuring prices lower.

title: SMM Aluminium Scrap Prices in Foshan Rise on March 3, 2023_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that aluminium extrusion scrap prices in Foshan, a major Chinese scrap trading market, rose to 13,600–14,450 yuan/mt on March 3, up 25 yuan/mt from the prior day. The move suggests firmer secondary aluminium scrap valuation that can support nearby aluminium price sentiment.

title: SMM A00 Aluminium Prices Rise on March 3, 2023_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reported Shanghai A00 aluminium prices at 18,530–18,570 yuan/mt on March 3, up 20 yuan/mt from the prior day. The update reflects a modest day-over-day rise in the tracked aluminium benchmark, pointing to slightly stronger near-term aluminium pricing.

title: Copper set for weekly gains, investors eye China demand
summary: London copper was set for a weekly gain as stronger-than-expected China manufacturing and services data boosted demand sentiment, while declining SHFE inventories suggested improving tightness. Markets also weighed a firmer dollar and potential additional U.S. sanctions on China. Aluminium rose slightly; nickel fell on the day.

title: SMM Survey: Power Rationing Jeopardised Aluminum Capacity in Yunnan_SMM
summary: SMM reports that two rounds of power rationing in Yunnan cut operating aluminum capacity by more than 40%. Current operating capacity is 3.26 million mt versus 3.37 million mt a year earlier. The curtailments imply lower local supply and tighter aluminum availability in the near term.

title: Aluminum Smelters in Yunnan to Still Face Risks of Power Shortages in 2023_SMM
summary: Yunnan’s electricity authority warns the province will still face power shortages and uncertainty in 2023. Aluminium smelters there cannot run at full capacity due to power rationing, with actual power consumption and production likely far below expected levels, implying tighter aluminium supply in the near term.

title: Copper Inventories in Chinese Bonded Zone Increased This Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data shows Chinese bonded copper inventories rose 11,700 mt to 185,200 mt by March 3, with growth mainly in the Shanghai bonded zone. The rise reflects domestic smelter exports and arrivals under bill of lading. Import losses remain 600–1,200 yuan/mt, prompting traders to warehouse more, and inventories may grow further next week.

title: Bonded Zone Inventory of Nickel Drops Slightly from February 24_SMM
summary: SMM says bonded zone nickel inventory fell 1,000 mt to 5,600 mt week-on-week as of March 3. Nickel plate stock dropped to 4,130 mt, while briquettes were flat at 1,470 mt due to low stainless steel demand. Spot trading picked up slightly amid lower nickel prices.

title: Adani Enterprises' subsidiary wins bid for Ballada bauxite block
summary: Adani Enterprises said its subsidiary, Mundra Aluminium Ltd, was named preferred bidder for the Ballada bauxite block in Odisha. The LOI covers a large bauxite resource and positions the company for bauxite/alumina processing and aluminium operations, potentially supporting near-term aluminium supply expectations.

title: UK Regulator Launches Probe Into LME Nickel Trading Halt
summary: The UK Financial Conduct Authority launched an enforcement investigation into the London Metal Exchange’s nickel trading halt decision and its systems and controls around Jan. 1 to March 8, 2022. The regulator appears focused on stopping trade, not on canceling trades. Bank of England reviews also flagged LME Clear shortcomings.

title: Workers at Chinese-owned Indonesian nickel plant file complaint over working conditions
summary: Three Chinese migrant workers filed a human-rights complaint alleging abuse and unsafe conditions at a nickel processing estate in Indonesia, including alleged forced overtime, lack of protective equipment, and withholding passports. The company denied involvement with the IMIP Morowali complex. Allegations could heighten scrutiny and disrupt nickel operations.

title: Slovenian Talum to stop producing aluminum amid high electricity prices-Xinhua
summary: Slovenian producer Talum said it will stop primary aluminum production in April because high electricity prices make smelting unprofitable. It will continue downstream aluminum products and may restart later if conditions improve. The move also implies job cuts and output reduction from primary operations.

title: Slovenian Talum to stop producing aluminum amid high electricity prices
summary: Slovenian primary aluminium producer Talum says it will halt primary output in April because high electricity prices make production unprofitable. The company already runs only 11 of 160 cells and has been cutting output. The planned curtailment reduces near-term aluminium supply, likely supporting prices.

title: Century Aluminum CEO Jesse Gary Thanks the Biden
summary: Century Aluminum’s CEO thanked the Biden administration after a White House roundtable on industrial innovation and decarbonization. The company said it supports federal investment to maintain U.S. aluminum manufacturing capabilities and protect jobs, framing a thriving domestic aluminum market as essential to national and climate objectives.

title: Peru Copper Mines Rev Back Up To Full Power After Protest Hit, Data Show
summary: Reuters data show key Peruvian copper mines, including Las Bambas and Antapaccay, are running at full power again after protests and blockades previously disrupted electricity usage and output. The easing of transport blockages should support a short-term supply rebound, which is typically bearish for copper prices.

title: Peru copper mines rev back up to full power after protest hit, data show
summary: Data show Peru copper mines have resumed operations at full power after protests previously disrupted output. The normalization of supply from Peru reduces short-term production risk and may ease any tightness concerns, which is generally supportive for nearby copper prices.

title: Global Copper Busbar Market 2022-2028: Investments in Transmission & Distribution Infrastructure Bolster Growth
summary: ResearchAndMarkets’ report on the global copper busbar market cites rising transmission and distribution infrastructure investment and broader construction activity as key growth drivers. It forecasts strong market expansion and links busbars’ copper demand to green-economy power initiatives, while only broadly warning that copper raw-material price fluctuations could impede growth.

title: Aluminum Dynamics groundbreaking set for next week
summary: The article says Golden Triangle’s development entity will hold a groundbreaking next week for “Aluminum Dynamics,” a new $2.5 billion aluminum mill in Lowndes County, Mississippi. Steel Dynamics will own the mill. The update focuses on logistics and community services, with no mention of imminent output.

title: Slovenian Talum To Stop Producing Aluminum Amid High Electri...
summary: Slovenian Talum plans to stop producing aluminium because electricity costs are too high. The production halt implies reduced near-term aluminium supply from the plant, which can support prices as the market anticipates tighter availability while the higher power-price environment persists.

title: Vietnam province at risk of losing forest to bauxite mining - VnExpress International
summary: Vietnam’s Lam Dong province faces pressure over an approved plan to expand bauxite mining, which would clear large areas of forest. The province urged Vinacomin and local authorities to reconsider the plan. Current bauxite projects Tan Rai and Nhan Co target about 650,000 tons of aluminum each annually.

title: Copper Prices Gained Ground on Positive Macro Data, Views on Direction This Week_SMM
summary: SMM reports copper prices rebounded on better global macro data, including stronger China manufacturing PMI and improving eurozone indicators, while US inflation signals triggered dollar volatility. Copper benefited from recovering consumption, falling Chinese inventories, and tighter spot supply as smelters increased exports with limited arrivals. Spot quotes are expected to firm.

title: SMM Aluminium Morning Comment (Mar 6, 2023)_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM’s Mar 6 commentary says SHFE 2304 aluminium and LME aluminium saw small moves, with fears of further US/Europe rate hikes weighing on commodities. Offsetting this, China’s economic recovery and expectations of supportive policies around the Two Sessions are expected to keep aluminium prices rangebound in the short term.

title: SHFE and LME Aluminium Price Review (Feb 27-Mar 3, 2023)_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that SHFE’s most-traded April 2023 aluminium contract (2304) rose to close at 18,775 yuan/mt for the week, up 140 yuan/mt. LME aluminium also increased, trading at $2,417.5/mt as of Friday, up $73.5/mt or 3.14% on the week.

title: SMM Aluminium Price Forecast Based on Machine Learning and Technical Indicators (Mar 6-10, 2023)_SMM
summary: SMM’s Mar 6-10, 2023 forecast for the most-traded SHFE aluminium contract (and SMM A00 average) projects prices fluctuating upward or forming an inverted V pattern. Machine-learning ranges and technical indicators show more bullish than bearish signals, with resistance near 18,800–19,100 and support around 18,200–18,300.

title: Aluminium Market Eying on "Two Sessions" amid Mixed Macro Front and Fundamentals_SMM
summary: SMM reports that fears of further interest rate hikes in Europe and the US may weigh on commodity prices, including aluminium. Offsetting factors include China’s economic recovery and expectations of favorable policy signals around the “Two Sessions.” Overall, SHFE and LME aluminium are seen trading in a wide but rangebound band.

title: Mines Insist on High Nickel Ore Quotes, which are Unacceptable for Downstream Sectors_SMM
summary: SMM reports Ni 1.5% ore CIF prices at about $72/wmt, steady week-on-week, with low Philippines shipments. Supply tightness is pushing mines to seek higher ore quotes, but NPI demand looks weak: traders restocked earlier, hedgers may lower prices, and NPI plants may reject higher ore costs. SMM expects further NPI declines.

title: Iron Ore And Copper Drop On Lack Of Beijing Spending Pledges
summary: The piece reports that copper (along with iron ore) declines as Beijing fails to provide spending pledges. The implied message is softer near-term Chinese demand sentiment, which can reduce expectations for copper consumption and weigh on prices in the coming days.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports Fall 172,000 wmt WoW_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says Chinese nickel ore inventories fell 172,000 wmt week-on-week to 7.0 million wmt (55,000 mt Ni content) by March 3, citing low recent arrivals and rigid NPI purchasing. It expects inventories to keep trending lower, potentially around 6 million before the end of the Philippines rainy season.

title: Amount of Imported Nickel Ore Arriving at Ports Totall 498,000 wmt as of February 24_SMM
summary: Nickel ore arrivals at Chinese ports totaled 498,000 wmt as of Feb 24, up 27% week-on-week, with shipments landing at several major ports. The ore is mainly for delivery to NPI plants in Shandong, Jiangsu and Liaoning. Overall imports remain low and downstream demand is rigid, limiting stock build-up.

title: Nickel Sulphate Prices to be 39,000-40,000 yuan/mt_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports pricing pressure on NORNICKEL nickel affecting nickel sulphate spreads and near-zero electrowinning profits. Ternary demand is weak and firms prefer cheaper liquid nickel sulphate, while nickel sulphate supply is tight due to delayed Indonesia raw-material line commissioning and late February restarts. Costs support prices; expected range is 39,000–40,000 yuan/mt this week.

title: Raw Material Supply Tightness Weighs Heavily on Nickel Salt Enterprises_SMM
summary: SMM reports nickel sulphate enterprises’ margins fell further as demand rose but new MHP capacity commissioning was delayed. Nickel salt plants faced high-priced raw materials and tighter high-grade nickel matte supply (some matte lines switched to NPI). Lower downstream purchase prices pushed firms toward reduced profits or losses.

title: LME faces FCA probe over 2022 nickel trading suspension
summary: The UK FCA has opened an enforcement investigation into the LME’s 2022 suspension of nickel trading, examining conduct and controls around 1 Jan to 8 Mar 2022 after a surge in nickel prices linked to Russia-Ukraine supply concerns. The Bank of England also flagged governance and risk-management shortcomings at LME Clear.

title: McEwen Copper: Los Azules – Initial Exploration and Solid
summary: McEwen Copper reported drill results from the Los Azules porphyry project in Argentina, including 1,052 m averaging 0.29% Cu and a delineation intercept of 236 m at 1.39% Cu (including 42 m at 2.78% Cu). The company says continuity and expansion potential have been de-risked, supporting copper sentiment.

title: Broadened US tariff on Russia aluminium triggers LME contango jump
summary: The US announced a 200% tariff on aluminium imports from Russia and on products containing Russian-sourced aluminium, effective March 10/April 10. Following the news, traders rushed to sell Russian holdings, pushing the LME cash price down sharply and widening cash–3-month contango, indicating near-term bearish pressure on aluminium.

title: SMM A00 Aluminium Prices Fall on Mar 6, 2023_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reported that Shanghai’s SMM A00 aluminium prices were 18,450–18,490 yuan/mt on Mar 6, down 80 yuan/mt from the prior Friday. The update is a direct spot-price movement for aluminium, signaling near-term bearish pressure for the metal.

title: Aluminium Ingot Inventories Temporarily Stabilise, Withdrawals from Warehouses Rise Slightly_SMM
summary: SMM says China’s social aluminium ingot inventories held at 1.27 million mt as of March 6, flat on the week but up versus late January and last year. Warehouse outflows increased slightly and some storage capacity constraints appeared, while in-transit volumes declined. Aluminium billet inventories rose marginally, with lower billet outflows.

title: Thiess receives $104m contract for Chile copper mining project
summary: Thiess won a A$155m ($104.8m) letter of agreement to provide mining operations, maintenance, and asset management services for Minera Centinela’s Llano greenfield copper project in Chile. Work is planned to start this month, with emphasis on sustainability and efficient production. Likely limited immediate effect on copper prices.

title: Electric Royalties Ltd.: Electric Royalties to Acquire 0.5% Gross Revenue Royalty on Kenbridge Nickel Project in Ontario, Canada
summary: Electric Royalties announced it will acquire a 0.5% gross revenue royalty (with options for additional royalty) on the Kenbridge nickel project in Ontario. The project is described as nickel-copper mineralized, with a preliminary economic assessment using assumed Ni and Cu prices, but no near-term production changes are stated.

title: Provenance a problem for US tariff on Russian aluminium
summary: The US may face difficulties enforcing provenance checks for Russian aluminium under a proposed 200% tariff, but Russian volumes into the US are small. LME warranting of aluminium in US warehouses was suspended and premiums rose slightly, suggesting limited but supportive pricing pressure for aluminium.

title: UK Financial Conduct Authority opens investigation into LME's March 2022 suspension of nickel futures
summary: The UK FCA has opened an investigation into the LME’s March 2022 suspension of nickel futures, reviewing trading activity from early 2022 until the March 8 halt. The suspension followed a brief nickel surge above $100,000/t. FCA highlights transparency and risk management as LME may adjust market structure.

title: UK regulator FCA steps up its nickel investigation
summary: The UK FCA announced an enforcement investigation into some of the LME’s conduct and controls between Jan. 1, 2022 and the nickel contract suspension on March 8, 2022. The article notes the probe relates to the period of disorderly nickel trading and adds ongoing uncertainty for LME nickel confidence.

title: Copper slides as China's growth target disappoints
summary: Copper fell 1.5% on Monday after disappointment with China’s ~5% growth target hurt sentiment for industrial metals. Traders also pointed to rising LME inventories and attention ahead of Powell testimony and U.S. non-farm payrolls, which could shift rate and dollar expectations. Aluminium also declined.

title: Pacific Ridge Exploration Ltd.: Pacific Ridge More than Doubles Size of Land Position at Chuchi with the Acquisition of the Chuchi South Porphyry Copper-Gold Project
summary: Pacific Ridge Exploration acquired an option to earn up to a 75% interest in the Chuchi South porphyry copper-gold project adjacent to its Chuchi property in British Columbia. The company plans drilling and development of copper-gold targets. The release is exploration-focused without any near-term production or supply-impact details.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel Welcomes Ontario Government Investment in its Clean Nickel Strategy
summary: EV Nickel Inc. announced it received CAD 500,000 from the Ontario government for its “Clean Nickel” strategy, including R&D on bioleaching and carbon capture to produce lower-carbon nickel from its Shaw Dome project near Timmins. The non-dilutive funding supports innovation for EV battery supply.

title: Alcoa mining: US aluminium giant plans riskier mining near Serpentine Dam and massive new exploration
summary: Alcoa is seeking approval for expanded bauxite mining and exploration near Perth’s Serpentine Dam in jarrah forest, amid government concerns that runoff from cleared slopes could damage drinking water quality. The WA EPA has 28 days to decide whether to investigate, raising the risk of operational constraints and supply delays.

title: Queensland Premier Annastacia Palaszczuk commits  $5b to build CopperString energy project from Townsville to Mount Isa
summary: Queensland’s Premier announced a $5 billion plan to take over and build the CopperString 1100-kilometre electricity transmission project from Townsville to Mount Isa, aiming to expand grid access and connect industries. The move is expected to raise near-term expectations for copper demand from transmission infrastructure.

title: Aluminum's Amazon Footprint | Human Rights Watch
summary: Human Rights Watch highlights claims from Bloomberg that Ford’s aluminum supply chain is linked to deforestation and harm in Brazil’s Amazon, involving bauxite mining and refining impacts on land, water, and communities. It also notes past forced-labor allegations in China tied to a U.S. import ban, raising compliance risk for aluminum.

title: Canada Nickel Confirms High Grade Near-Surface Mineralization at Texmont
summary: Canada Nickel reported assay results from the first 12 holes at its Texmont nickel project, finding near-surface, thick, high-grade mineralization with multiple intervals above 1% nickel and remaining open at depth and to the north. Management highlighted potential near-term, smaller open-pit production, supporting bullish sentiment for nickel supply prospects.

title: Queensland to spend $5bn on 1,100km CopperString power line to unlock renewables potential
summary: Queensland will take control of a $5bn, 1,100km high-voltage CopperString transmission line linking Mount Isa to the national grid. The government says it will enable development of “critical minerals” and large renewable generation, with construction expected to begin next year. Costs have risen and state-owned transmission will build it.

title: Hedge funds sue London Metal Exchange for £80m over nickel debacle
summary: Hedge funds are suing the London Metal Exchange over the cancellation of billions of dollars of nickel trades after the exchange suspended nickel in March following a violent price spike. The FCA is investigating possible misconduct, while other lawsuits are ongoing, increasing nickel market uncertainty.

title: SMM A00 Aluminium Prices Rose on March 7, 2023_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that Shanghai A00 aluminium prices were 18,550–18,590 yuan/mt on March 7, up 100 yuan/mt from the previous day. The note is a market price update, suggesting near-term bullish momentum for aluminium.

title: Goldman Sachs Sees Lithium Prices Going Down Further Alongside Cobalt and Nickel_SMM
summary: Goldman Sachs Commodities Research said lithium prices are expected to fall further and will move lower alongside cobalt and nickel. The note projects a downtrend over the next nine to 12 months, implying bearish sentiment for nickel prices, though the timing extends beyond the immediate weeks focus.

title: China Jan-Feb crude oil and copper imports fall - Stock market news
summary: China’s customs data show copper imports of 879,000 tonnes in January-February, down 9.3% versus a year earlier. The report links softer global economic activity and weak domestic demand to broad import declines. Analysts note demand may improve into March, but near-term flows remain bearish.

title: Copper rises on weaker dollar and China demand hopes
summary: Copper prices edged higher as the dollar weakened and traders anticipated improving China demand from March. LME three-month copper rose slightly, and Shanghai April copper also increased. Aluminium eased on the day and nickel declined, indicating the bullish impulse was strongest for copper rather than industrial metals broadly.

title: SIG leads industry with 100 per cent ASI-certified aluminium sourcing for aseptic carton packs | Press Releases | Asia
summary: SIG says it will source 100% of aluminium used in its aseptic carton packs from January 2023 under Aluminium Stewardship Initiative (ASI) standards worldwide, allowing customers to display an ASI label. The company frames the move as lower-carbon, responsible sourcing, but provides no volume, supply disruption, or pricing details.

title: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk : Positive Achievement of ANTAM Nickel and Gold Segment Unaudited Production and Sales Performance Throughout January 2023
summary: PT Aneka Tambang reported improved unaudited January 2023 performance for its nickel business. Ferronickel production rose to 2,113 tons (+28% YoY) and sales to 2,013 TNi. Nickel ore production reached 1.06 million wmt (+16% YoY) with sales at 1.08 million wmt (+80% YoY).

title: Faraday Copper Announces Closing of Mercer Ranch Acquisition at the Copper Creek Project in Arizona
summary: Faraday Copper said it has completed (closed) its Mercer Ranch acquisition tied to the Copper Creek project in Arizona. The update is a company/asset development step that can marginally improve project progress expectations, but it is unlikely to materially change near-term copper supply or demand within days to weeks.

title: Peru Expects Easing Unrest to Unleash Stalled Copper Shipments
summary: Peru expects unrest to ease, which should restart and release stalled copper shipments. The resumption of export logistics can improve near-term supply availability, easing local tightness. That expectation tends to be supportive for copper, though the magnitude depends on how quickly shipments normalize.

title: Major copper producers unveil plan to reach net zero emissions by 2050 - Stock market news
summary: International Copper Association members, including Codelco, Glencore and Freeport-McMoRan, released a roadmap to cut emissions by 30–40% by 2030 and 70–80% by 2040, reaching net zero by 2050. Plans focus on decarbonising power, efficiency and increased scrap use; scope 3 targets are also set with customers.

title: LME Nickel Inventory Hit a New Low in Recent Years, while SHFE Nickel Inventory Grow 14.72%_SMM
summary: LME data shows nickel inventories dropping to a multi-year low around 43,884 mt before a slight rebound, then easing again to 44,628 mt. SHFE inventories also widened but rose 14.72% last week to 2,884 mt, indicating tighter LME visibility while domestic stocks recovered.

title: B.C. miners increase spending on copper exploration by 84% last year
summary: BC miners increased copper exploration spending by 84% in 2022 to $235 million, according to a BC mineral and coal exploration survey. The report frames copper’s growing importance for clean energy as driving higher exploration budgets. It notes overall exploration spending hitting a decade high, though this is not near-term output.

title: B.C. miners increase spending on copper exploration by 84% last year: report
summary: British Columbia miners boosted copper exploration spending 84% in 2022 to $235 million, with total provincial mineral and coal exploration at a decade high. B.C. produces over half of Canada’s copper and the story links copper demand to renewable power, supporting bullish sentiment for copper.

title: Highland Copper Announces Its Asset Development Strategy and Next Steps at White Pine North in Michigan, USA
summary: Highland Copper announced a sequenced development plan for its Copperwood and White Pine North projects in Michigan. Copperwood, fully permitted, will move into early site works in 2023 and target a construction decision in early 2024, while White Pine North progresses with updated PEA, permitting, and infill drilling. Project output is projected over future years.

title: Aluminum Dynamics kicks off groundbreaking ceremony for new mill
summary: Aluminum Dynamics will begin construction on a $2.5 billion aluminium mill in Mississippi, with Steel Dynamics as owner. The project includes co-locating customers and plans for 1,000 jobs over seven years. It signals future aluminium supply capacity but lacks timing or production ramp details, limiting short-term price impact.

summary: Gulbrandsen inaugurated a new facility in Dahej, India, beginning production of triethylaluminum (TEAL). The company says the move is to meet rising global demand for aluminum alkyls used as co-catalysts in polyolefins, synthetic rubber, pharmaceuticals and other fine chemicals, supporting incremental aluminum-linked demand.

title: Ero Copper Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2022
summary: Ero Copper reported record 2022 copper production of 46,371 tonnes, exceeding guidance, and reiterated 2023 copper production and C1 cost guidance. title: Comex Copper Settles 2.78% Lower at $3.9865 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for March delivery settled 2.78% lower at $3.9865 per pound, down 11.40 cents. The move marked the largest one-day dollar and percentage decline since Feb. 24 and left copper down three of the past four sessions, with LME copper cash also weaker.

title: SMM A00 Aluminium Prices Fell on March 8_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that Shanghai A00 aluminium prices on March 8 traded in the 18,450–18,490 yuan/mt range, down 100 yuan/mt from the prior day. This is a direct, short-term fall in quoted aluminium benchmark pricing, reflecting near-term bearish momentum in the market.

summary: SMM reports SHFE 2304 aluminium fell 0.89% and LME aluminium dropped 1.47% after a weaker open. title: Peru's Mining Production Fell in January, Copper Output Growth Reversed into Decline_SMM
summary: Peru’s mining production fell 3.61% in January. Copper output reversed from a 19% gain in December to a 1.6% decline. title: Chilean Copper Output Increased in January, Codelco Produced 127,000 mt_SMM
summary: Chilean copper output rose in January, with total production reaching 437,900 tonnes, up 2.9% year-on-year. Codelco produced 127,000 tonnes, up 5.1%. title: FPX Nickel Receives Funding from Government of Canada to Scale Up Production of Nickel and Cobalt for EV Battery Supply Chain
summary: FPX Nickel reportedly received funding from the Government of Canada aimed at scaling up production of nickel and cobalt for EV battery supply chains. title: Novelis Demonstrates Commitment to Aluminum Beverage Packaging Innovation with Opening of New Can Customer Solution Center
summary: Novelis opened a new Customer Solution Center in Brazil focused on aluminum beverage can innovation and sustainability. The company expects growing demand for aluminum packaging as consumers shift from less sustainable materials and beverage variety expands, supporting continued need for aluminum can sheet, capacity, and product development.

title: Copper Road Resources Provides Exploration Update
summary: Copper Road Resources reported exploration updates from its Ontario Copper Road Project, including 3,000 metres of step-out drilling confirming near-surface copper at the Breton Breccia and drilling plans for 2023 on additional Cu-Mo-Au-Ag targets. It affects sentiment on future copper supply but not immediate market balance.

title: Indonesian EVs: Harita Nickel courts investors - Mining Technology
summary: Harita Nickel begins a $600m investor roadshow ahead of a public listing, in a broader Indonesian push to retain nickel processing after the 2019 raw nickel export ban. The country’s EV-battery investments and growing nickel export value support nickel demand/supply expectations, with some peripheral copper IPO plans mentioned.

title: Panama, Canadian Group Agree To Reopen Major Copper Mine
summary: Panama and First Quantum Minerals agreed to reopen the Cobre Panama copper mine after a three-month shutdown tied to a tax dispute. The new 20-year concession contract raises Panama state “minimum income” and must still be ratified. The restart should ease supply concerns given the mine’s large output in the region.

title: Panama, Canadian group agree to reopen major copper mine
summary: Panama and a Canadian group have agreed to reopen a major copper mine, signaling restored production after a disruption risk. Such mine restarts can shift near-term supply expectations and influence copper prices over the coming days and weeks as markets reassess availability and inventory outlook.

title: Aurubis starts construction of plant to extract copper and nickel from recycled material, bleed
summary: Aurubis is constructing the Bleed Treatment Olen Beerse (BOB) hydrometallurgical facility to recover copper and nickel from electrolytes/“bleed” streams at its recycling sites, boosting recycling capacity. Production is scheduled for late 2024 with full operations in 2025/26, so near-term price impact is limited despite involvement of both metals.

title: Aurubis starts construction of plant to extract copper and nickel from recycled material, bleed
summary: Aurubis is building the Bleed treatment Olen Beerse (BOB) hydrometallurgical plant to process copper electrolysis bleed and recover metals including copper and nickel. The facility targets higher recovery from electrolyte streams, with commissioning planned for 2H 2024 and full operation in 2025/26, supporting supply expectations.

title: First Quantum finalizes draft contract to restart Panama copper mine
summary: First Quantum finalized a draft contract to restart Panama’s Cobre Panama copper mine after the government’s maritime authority previously blocked permits to load copper for export. The company expects processing to resume within days and restore full production, subject to public consultation and approvals, removing an operational overhang.

title: Panama, First Quantum Agree on Operations at Cobre PanamÁ Copper Mine_SMM
summary: Panama and First Quantum agreed on an operating contract for the Cobre Panamá copper mine, ending a disruption to global copper ore supply. First Quantum plans to recall about 1,000 furloughed workers and resume ore processing operations within days, after suspending processing on Feb 23.

title: SMM A00 Aluminium Prices Fell on March 9_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports Shanghai A00 aluminium prices at 18,440–18,480 yuan/mt on March 9, falling by 10 yuan/mt versus the previous day. The piece is a spot-price update, signaling modest near-term bearish pressure on aluminium prices.

summary: Huatai Securities says China should enter a recovery channel in 2023, with downstream processing operating rates rising sharply from March to April. The report expects the copper and aluminium supply-demand structure to improve, with refined aluminium production restrictions being a key 2023 factor. It also projects a copper shortage turning to surplus in 2024-25.

title: SMM ADC12 Secondary Aluminium Alloy Prices Went Down _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reported that ADC12 secondary aluminium alloy prices in Shanghai were 19,500–19,700 yuan/mt on March 8, down 100 yuan/mt from the prior day. The note is a market price update for secondary aluminium alloy, indicating short-term bearish pricing pressure for aluminium products.

title: China's Burst of Copper Exports Shows Economy Still Struggling
summary: The article headline says China has seen a burst of copper exports, suggesting more copper leaving the domestic market. title: Good Investment Opportunity for Copper, Aluminium as Demand and Supply Structure Improves, Copper Shortage to Turn into Surplus in 2 Years_SMM
summary: Huatai Securities expects China’s recovery to improve copper and aluminium supply-demand conditions. Downstream processing enterprise operating rates should rise from March to April. title: Germany's Speira to end Rheinwerk aluminium smelting due to energy costs - Stock market news
summary: Speira will fully ramp down aluminium smelting at Rheinwerk, ending remaining 70,000 tonnes of liquid aluminium output in 2H 2023, citing still-high power costs. summary: After four weeks of declining, China’s domestic aluminium billet social inventory rose by 7,200 mt to 163,400 mt by Mar 9.
