Nickel futures weakened early, but spot nickel still hovered at high levels; briquette prices edged lower and trading remained slack.

title: Amount of Imported Nickel Ore Arriving at Ports Totall 720,000 wmt as of Mar 31_SMM
summary: SMM says nickel ore arrivals at Chinese ports were 720,000 wmt as of Mar 31, up 28% week-on-week, with more shipments at Lianyungang, Ningde and Jingtang. Nickel ore prices fell last week on weaker NPI prices, but arrivals are expected to rise in early April as Philippines’ rainy season ends.

title: Nickel Ore Prices Drop Palpably on the Falling NPI Prices_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports China’s Ni 1.5% nickel ore CIF price fell $6/wmt to $53/wmt week-on-week. Low supply is offset by weaker demand as NPI prices trend down and producers are cautious about further declines. Trades remain limited and mine quotes ease, suggesting CIF ore prices could drop further if NPI stays weak.

title: Aluminium Ingot Inventory Approaches 1 Million mt, Aluminium Billet Shipments from Social Warehouses Keep Falling_SMM
summary: SMM says China’s social aluminium ingot inventories in eight major markets fell to 1.006 million mt, down 32,000 mt week-on-week and 60,000 mt year-on-year. Withdrawals were stable and smelters’ molten share rose to 71%, reducing ingot arrivals. Stocks are expected to keep declining.

title: SMM Analysis of Aluminium Market from Macro and Fundamentals Perspective_SMM
summary: SMM links softer US recession risks and a steadier dollar/yields backdrop to aluminium, noting China macro remains positive. Fundamentals include stable Yunnan smelter output, marginal gains in Guizhou/Guangxi, higher March output, declining ingot social inventories, and improved wire & cable and extrusion order schedules, supporting sentiment.

title: Chinese Refined Nickel Output to Rise 2.27% MoM in Apr_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM estimates China’s refined nickel output will rise to 18,000 mt in April, up 2.27% month-on-month. Output growth is attributed to improved profits for some electrowinning producers using MHP and plans to increase scrap-based production, though a northwest company faces reduced pure nickel output after a technological upgrade.

title: Peru sees copper production boost in 2023, lithium permissions pending - minister - Stock market news
summary: Peru expects 2023 copper production to reach 2.8 million tonnes, nearly 15% higher than 2022, after protests and road blockades disrupted output since December but mining is now “working as normal.” The ministry also aims to speed approvals for mining, supporting additional supply visibility.

title: Chile Copper Shipments Rebound in Boost to Tight Global Supplies
summary: Chile’s copper shipments are reported to have rebounded, offering incremental supply support after earlier tightness in the market. While the note frames this as a response within still-tight global supplies, higher outbound flow typically reduces the immediate urgency for copper buying, weighing on prices.

title: Peru expects to produce 2.8 mln tonnes of copper in 2023 - minister
summary: Peru’s energy and mines minister said the country expects 2.8 million tonnes of copper production in 2023. Output was disrupted late last year and early this year by protests and road blockades following the ouster and arrest of former President Pedro Castillo, highlighting supply volatility risks.

title: Comex Copper Settles 0.98% Lower at $3.9865 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for April delivery settled down 3.95 cents per pound, or 0.98%, at $3.9865, ending a two-session winning streak. It is also lower month-to-date and down versus recent settlement highs, reflecting softer near-term sentiment in copper futures.

title: Why the US Ban on Russian Aluminum May Be Lucky Break for Europe
summary: The piece argues the US ban on Russian aluminum removes a portion of supply from the US market and may trigger short-term shortages. It notes Europe’s aluminum smelters have reduced output due to high energy prices, limiting replacement supply and potentially driving a 10–15% rise in US aluminum prices.

title: New EPA Rule Will Expedite Transition to Electric Vehicles
summary: The article claims the EPA will announce new requirements that increase the share of EVs in US new-vehicle sales to 54–60% by 2030 and 64–67% by 2032. It argues automakers will comply and highlights copper producers as beneficiaries, implying higher expected copper demand.

title: Peru will mine more copper in 2023, lithium permits pending
summary: Peru expects copper production of 2.8 million tonnes in 2023, up nearly 15% from 2022, after anti-government protests and road blockades disrupted output. The mining sector is said to be operating normally again, with faster project approvals planned. Lithium permits are also expected, but copper is the focus.

title: Nickel and copper unsung heroes of energy transition
summary: The piece highlights nickel and copper as key “unsung heroes” in EVs. It notes nickel’s role in cathode energy density and that EV batteries contain far more nickel than lithium. It also says EVs and buses use significantly more copper than combustion vehicles, implying stronger demand growth.

title: Copper Prices Will Remain Range-bound at Highs_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM expects copper prices to remain range-bound but at high levels. The market will await Federal Reserve meeting minutes for direction, while consumer demand is expected to provide some support. Overall, the commentary points to limited net movement in the near term rather than a clear breakout.

title: Copper prices edge higher as US dollar slips - Stock market news
summary: Copper edged higher on a softer U.S. dollar, but gains may be limited ahead of U.S. inflation data that could affect Fed rate expectations. China’s slow consumer inflation and ongoing deflation point to demand weakness. LME aluminium fell while nickel was slightly lower, with all moves modest.

title: Copper prices edge higher as US dollar slips
summary: Copper prices edged higher as a softer U.S. dollar provided support, but gains may be capped ahead of U.S. CPI. Markets are focused on how inflation affects Fed rate expectations. The piece also notes small declines in LME aluminium and nickel and highlights weaker China demand indicators.

title: Vedanta : Supreme Court permits Sterlite Copper to open in national interest
summary: India’s Supreme Court permitted Sterlite Copper (Vedanta) to carry out upkeep of its shut copper smelter, viewing it as a national asset and noting benefits for copper self-reliance. The plant has been closed since 2018, and reopening would help domestic supply, supporting copper expectations near term.

title: ABx Group looking to resume Tasmanian bauxite mining | The Advocate
summary: ABx Group says it plans to resume Tasmanian bauxite mining, while its subsidiary Alcore received a $7.5 million grant toward a Bell Bay aluminium smelter bath recycling plant. The project targets converting excess bath into aluminium fluoride for new smelters, but the timing and market size impact on aluminium prices is uncertain.

title: Nickel Sulphate Output to Lose 15.93% MoM in Apr on Shrinking Demand_SMM
summary: SMM says April nickel sulphate supply surplus is unlikely to improve in the near term because ternary precursor demand is expected to decline. It forecasts nickel sulphate output falling 15.93% month-on-month to about 31,000 mt in metal content in April, suggesting weakening demand conditions for nickel downstream materials.

title: Chile Copper Export Earnings Soared in March, Global Copper Tightness Eases Remarkably_SMM
summary: Chile’s copper export earnings rebounded sharply in March after weakness in January-February. Chilean central bank data showed total copper export revenue rose 33% month-on-month to the highest in over a year, indicating easing global copper supply tightness, even as average copper prices fell slightly.

title: Chile Copper Output Rebound after Falling to 6-year Low Substantially Mitigates LME Copper Inventory Shortages_SMM
summary: Chile’s copper output is rebounding after dropping to a six-year low due to water constraints and project delays. With Chile supplying about a quarter of global mine output, the recovery is expected to relieve near-term LME copper inventory tightness, which has been at nearly 18-year lows.

title: Western Copper Partner Rio Tinto Participates in Strategic Investment for C$2.3M
summary: Western Copper & Gold said partner Rio Tinto will invest C$2.3 million by buying 878,809 new shares to maintain its ownership and support the company’s copper-gold project in Yukon. The move follows Mitsubishi’s larger C$21.3 million investment and Rio Tinto’s right to participate.

title: Copper prices gain, but China data weighs ahead of US inflation print - Stock market news
summary: Copper rose 0.6% as the dollar softened, but concerns over weak Chinese economic activity limited upside ahead of U.S. CPI data. Aluminium fell to a multi-week low on softer demand from transport, packaging and construction. Nickel increased 3.3% while overall macro sensitivity remained key for industrial metals.

title: PAN GLOBAL ANNOUNCES POSITIVE METALLURGICAL TEST RESULTS EXCEEDING 86% COPPER RECOVERY FOR THE LA ROMANA COPPER MINERALIZATION, SPAIN
summary: Pan Global announced positive preliminary metallurgical test results for its La Romana copper-tin-silver discovery in Spain, including ~86–90% copper recoveries and ~24–29% copper concentrate grades from conventional flotation. Results also point to lower energy requirements and low deleterious elements, supporting better NSR potential.

title: Copper prices reach one-week high on US dollar weakness
summary: Copper prices climbed to a one-week high after a softer U.S. dollar made dollar-priced metals cheaper. LME three-month copper was up 0.59% to $8,852/t, though analysts warned stronger-than-expected U.S. inflation could curb gains. China inflation demand signals were weaker.

title: More than half of aluminium in LME warehouses produced in Russia - Stock market news
summary: LME data show Russian aluminium dominates LME warehouse stocks (53% or 220,575 tonnes) and Russian copper and nickel are also significant. After US import tariffs, LME suspended Russian inflows into US-registered warehouses, complicating use of Rusal aluminium. Resulting supply tightness expectations support aluminium prices near term.

title: Los Andes Copper Ltd.: Los Andes Copper Files Positive PFS for Vizcachitas With a US$2.77 Billion Post-Tax NPV and 24% IRR
summary: Los Andes Copper filed a positive pre-feasibility study for its Vizcachitas copper-molybdenum project in Chile, highlighting 0.36% copper reserves and an after-tax NPV of $2.776 billion (24.2% IRR) based on a $3.68/lb copper price and large projected annual copper output over a 26-year mine life.

title: Businessman and publisher Giorgos Bobolas dies at 95 – BanksNews
summary: Los Andes Copper reported a positive pre-feasibility study for its Vizcachitas copper project, citing a US$2.77 billion post-tax NPV and a 24% IRR. The development indicates favorable project economics, which can bolster sentiment toward future copper supply, though it is not immediate production.

title: Controversy in Fenix Nickel Project acquisition
summary: Newsweek reports the US government’s involvement in Central American Nickel’s discounted acquisition of Guatemala’s Fenix nickel project, amid sanctions on Solway-linked Russian/Belarus figures. CAN is awaiting US Treasury consent to buy the sanctioned assets and permits, creating near-term uncertainty for nickel supply and operations.

title: Global Commodities' Indonesian nickel indices plan may be a game-changer - Stock market news
summary: GCHL plans Indonesian nickel indices with PT IKI to be used as a reference for transactions, forecasting, and government monitoring of mines and downstream activity. Sources suggest it could become a regulatory benchmark for exports and taxation. The plan also links class 1 nickel pricing to trades on a GCHL platform, supporting nickel sentiment.

title: Russian Aluminum Now Dominates Stockpiles in LME Warehouses
summary: The piece reports that Russian aluminum is now the dominant share of metal stockpiles held in LME warehouses. Concentration of inventories on the exchange can imply improved near-term supply visibility, often weighing on aluminium sentiment and prices in the short term.

title: Copper Prices Stuck In Limbo | OilPrice.com
summary: Copper prices have been trading sideways as markets balance worsening Western economic outlooks (IMF slowdown risk, weaker lending after SVB collapse) against tight fundamentals (falling LME inventories, renewables-driven demand growth, and Chile/peru production changes). Investors turned net short, but supply scarcity limits downside.

title: Copper Junior Files Technical Report on Ariz. Project
summary: World Copper filed an updated NI 43-101 technical report for its Zonia copper project, raising total contained copper despite lower grades, and plans further drilling and an updated PEA. The note frames copper’s longer-term demand outlook but provides no immediate production or trade change, limiting near-term price impact.

title: Comex Copper Settles 0.95% Higher at $4.0245 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for April delivery settled 0.95% higher at $4.0245, gaining 3.80 cents per pound, after being up three of the past four sessions. The piece is primarily a price recap with references to broader index moves and recent highs/lows, not a new supply-demand catalyst.

title: Recent U.S. Actions Affecting Imports Of Aluminum Products And More From Russia - International Trade & Investment
summary: The U.S. issued presidential proclamations expanding punitive tariffs on Russian aluminum. A 200% ad valorem duty applies to aluminum and derivative aluminum articles when primary aluminum is smelted or cast in Russia, later extended broadly. A separate Column 2 increase can add up to 70%, raising landed costs.

title: NICKEL CREEK PLATINUM EXTENDS HIGH GRADE NICKEL-COPPER-PGE MINERALIZATION AT ARCH TARGET - DRILLS 2.57% Ni, 1.61% Cu AND 2.35 g/t TPM OVER 3.84 m
summary: Nickel Creek Platinum reported drill results at its Arch Target in Yukon, intersecting a massive sulphide interval averaging 2.57% nickel and 1.61% copper over 3.84 m, plus other disseminated/semi-massive sulphide zones. Geophysics indicates additional untested mineralization down-dip and along strike.

title: NICKEL CREEK PLATINUM EXTENDS HIGH GRADE NICKEL-COPPER-PGE MINERALIZATION AT ARCH TARGET - DRILLS 2.57% Ni, 1.61% Cu AND 2.35 g/t TPM OVER 3.84 m
summary: Nickel Creek Platinum reported drill results from its Arch Target in Yukon, including a sulphide interval grading 2.57% nickel and 1.61% copper over 3.84 m, plus additional disseminated/semi-massive sulphide mineralization in multiple holes. Geophysics suggests further untested conductivity down-dip and along strike.

title: Peru's copper production recovers in first two months of 2023 | Noticias | Agencia Peruana de Noticias Andina
summary: Peru’s Ministry of Energy and Mines reported that copper production rose in February 2023, reaching 192,334 fine metric tons, up 11.6% year-on-year. Output increased at Cerro Verde, Southern Peru Copper, and Chinalco Peru, lifting accumulated production to 390,955 FMT for the first two months.

title: Copper Prices to Have Support and Fluctuate Widely_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says more smelters are entering April maintenance, but overall copper output is expected to rise slightly month-on-month (+0.26%). Terminal demand remains sensitive and not strongly recovering. Copper inventories are declining, but consumer demand has slowed. With U.S. inflation data pending, prices are expected to have support and trade with wide fluctuations.

title: Copper Prices Went Up as Market Awaiting US Inflation Data_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Copper prices rose in overnight trading, with LME up 0.33% and SHFE 2305 up 0.47%. The market is waiting for U.S. inflation data to gauge the Fed’s rate-hike path; a slightly weaker U.S. index supported prices. Spot activity improved despite subdued spot quotes, with imported inflows losing some impact.

title: Discounts of High-grade NPI Against Pure Nickel to Expand Further_SMM
summary: SMM says traded NPI prices dropped sharply last week as stainless steel mills demanded lower NPI amid their losses. Intensive Indonesian NPI arrivals led traders to dump inventory, pressuring prices. Nickel ore prices may fall further, and high-grade NPI discounts versus pure nickel are expected to widen this week, weighing on nickel.

title: ASX listing delay for Avebury Nickel Mine's Mallee Resources | The Advocate
summary: Mallee Resources’ bid to relist on the ASX has been delayed because it has not yet received the full ~$15.33 million owed from a Myanmar-related sale. Payment timing may push funding/financing options beyond late September, adding uncertainty around ongoing operations at its Avebury nickel mine near Zeehan.

title: Copper supported by weaker dollar, but rising supply caps gains - Stock market news
summary: London copper eased as rising supply and economic pressure offset support from a weaker U.S. dollar ahead of inflation data. Antaike cited a 14% year-on-year jump in China refined output. Aluminium rose modestly amid increasing Russian LME stock share; nickel and other metals were mixed.

title: Copper steadies at one-week high on China economic data
summary: Copper prices steadied at a one-week high after China posted stronger-than-expected bank lending and faster credit growth, supported by continued policy measures post-COVID curbs. Rising copper supply expectations tempered gains. The same macro tone lifted LME aluminium and nickel slightly, alongside cautious sentiment ahead of U.S. inflation data.

title: Copper supported by weaker dollar, but rising supply caps gains
summary: Copper climbed on Wednesday, helped by a weaker U.S. dollar and stronger-than-expected Chinese credit growth ahead of inflation data. However, gains were tempered by rising refined copper output in China, driven by new capacity and adequate raw-material supply. LME aluminium and nickel also rose alongside copper sentiment.

title: Copper eases as supply, macro-economic pressure weigh - Stock market news
summary: London copper prices fell from a one-week high as China’s refined output rose 14% year-on-year, increasing supply, while macro-economic pressure weighed on demand expectations. The weaker U.S. dollar offered some support. Aluminium was slightly higher, while nickel traded with a larger swing amid mixed broader base-metals pricing.

title: WESTERN COPPER AND GOLD ANNOUNCES EXERCISE OF PARTICIPATION RIGHT IN FULL BY RIO TINTO - Western Copper Corp
summary: Western Copper and Gold said Rio Tinto will exercise its participation right in full, subscribing for 878,809 shares and keeping its ~7.84% stake, alongside Mitsubishi’s larger investment. The company is developing the Casino copper-gold project, implying marginally improved copper project funding visibility near term.

title: Copper theft lands ex-Transnet employees in jail for 15 years
summary: South African police sentenced two former Transnet employees to 15 years for stealing copper plates from locomotives. Investigators caught them near a scrap dealer with 58 stolen copper plates. The report highlights criminal theft and recovery of copper, but offers no evidence of wider supply disruption affecting copper prices in the near term.

title: Nickel 28 Capital Corp.: Nickel 28 Adopts Shareholder Rights Plan to Protect Against Creeping Bids and Unequal Treatment of Shareholders
summary: Nickel 28 Capital Corp. adopted a shareholder rights plan to deter “creeping” bids and urged shareholders not to tender to Pelham’s conditional mini-tender, which the board says undervalues the company. Nickel 28 produces nickel-cobalt at Ramu, but the release lacks operational or supply changes impacting nickel prices.

title: Spot Nickel Premiums Fall Today on Rising Futures Prices_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports Shanghai spot nickel premiums easing: Jinchuan nickel averaged 8,250 yuan/mt (down 500) and NORNICKEL averaged 7,250 yuan/mt (down 250). This decline is attributed to slightly firmer downstream demand but rising nickel futures. Nickel briquette prices rose, while transaction activity stayed slack versus nickel sulphate.

title: Mines and Nickel Ore Traders Slightly Cut Their Quotes to Ship amid Falling NPI Prices_SMM
summary: SMM reports nickel ore (Ni 1.5% CIF) prices fell slightly in March, with shipments from the Philippines remaining low after the rainy season. Poor demand in China pushed NPI prices down, discouraging some buyers and leading traders to cut nickel ore quotes to facilitate shipping.

title: Bell Sues Accused Copper Thief in Bid to Deter Rising Network Vandalism
summary: Bell Canada sued an alleged copper wire thief, citing rising telecommunications vandalism and more than 170 incidents over 15 months. The company says stolen copper is resold through scrap buyers and that repairs take 10–12 hours. It urges tougher laws and fines to curb theft, potentially affecting scrap supply locally.

title: Pakistan's copper export to China increases 16.5% in January-Feb 2023--China Economic Net
summary: Pakistan’s copper exports to China rose about 16.5% in January–February 2023, according to sources from the Pakistani Embassy in Beijing. The increase is attributed to growing Chinese demand for copper products and stronger China-Pakistan investment links, including shipments of refined and unwrought copper products.

title: Glencore adds Russian aluminium to LME system, source says
summary: Glencore reportedly added more Russian aluminium to LME-registered warehouses in Gwangyang, lifting Russian stocks’ share and total inventories. Analysts link the build to customer boycotts rather than weaker overall demand. Concern is that larger Russian inventory overhang could weigh on LME benchmark aluminium pricing used in contracts.

title: Ellis Martin Report: Latin Metals Inc.  Discovers New Copper Porphyry and Skarn Mineralization at Auquis, Peru
summary: Latin Metals Inc. said mapping and prospecting at its Auquis Project in Peru identified two new mineralized zones, including porphyry-style copper and skarn mineralization. Grab samples reported high-grade copper in multiple areas, with associated silver and some lead/zinc. No aluminium or nickel impact is mentioned.

title: Advance United Holdings Inc.: Advance United Announces Buck Lake Property Assay Results Having High-Grade Copper and Critical Metals
summary: Advance United reports final drill assay results from its Buck Lake VMS property, highlighting high-grade copper intersections (e.g., 4.59% Cu over 3.2 m) and associated silver and zinc values. This exploration update may slightly influence copper sentiment, but lacks production/inventory implications, so near-term price impact is likely limited.

title: Bell sues alleged copper thief, asks governments to assist with network protection
summary: Bell says it is suing an alleged copper thief after reporting 170+ incidents of copper theft over 15 months, including pole cable cuts causing $3 million in damages and service interruptions in parts of Canada. Bell urges governments to increase fines and amend criminal code for critical infrastructure protection.

title: Bell files lawsuit against accused copper thief to help deter network vandalism
summary: Bell Canada filed a lawsuit against a copper-wire thief and co-conspirators for allegedly stealing copper from its telecommunications network. The company cites over 170 copper-theft incidents in 15 months, causing more than $3M in damages and widespread service interruptions, and urges tougher criminal penalties to deter theft.

title: Hautalampi Nickel-Cobalt-Copper Project, Finland
summary: FinnCobalt’s Hautalampi Ni-Co-Cu project in Finland (about 4.56 Mt at 0.30% Ni and 0.24% Cu) is being developed by Eurobattery Minerals after stake acquisitions. The pre-feasibility study outlines plant design and flotation circuits for copper and nickel. It is project-stage, with limited short-term supply impact.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel Announces Filing of NI 43-101 Technical Report for Previously Announced CarLang Project Maiden Resource
summary: EV Nickel filed an NI 43-101 technical report for its CarLang “A Zone” maiden resource, estimating 1.25M tonnes indicated and 1.16M tonnes inferred contained nickel (with Co as by-product). The release highlights deposit size and future development potential, but provides no near-term production changes.

title: Hautalampi Nickel-Cobalt-Copper Project, Finland
summary: Eurobattery Minerals is advancing the Hautalampi underground nickel-cobalt-copper project in Finland, expanding ownership through acquisitions and completing a pre-feasibility study. The deposit has meaningful nickel and copper reserves and planned flotation processing, but it is still at development stage, limiting short-term supply impact on prices.

title: Harita Nickel raises 673 mln USD as Indonesia's biggest IPO this year
summary: Harita Nickel (PT Trimegah Bangun Persada) raised about $673 million in a 2023 Indonesia’s biggest IPO. The nickel mining and downstream firm says funds will go to debt repayment, capital purchases and working capital. The move follows Indonesia’s push to expand EV-related nickel capacity.

title: Comex Copper Settles 1.49% Higher at $4.0845 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for April delivery settled 1.49% higher at $4.0845, rising 6.0 cents per pound. The contract was up for two straight sessions, gained 9.8 cents over two sessions, and posted its highest settlement since March 31, suggesting improving short-term momentum in copper prices.

title: Rio Tinto bauxite mining: Western Australia's regulator left in the dark about drinking water 'threat', emails reveal
summary: Western Australia’s environmental regulator allegedly learned of Rio Tinto exploration risks to drinking water only via Facebook, highlighting a “gap” in inter-agency handling. The story raises concerns that standard permit conditions are inadequate for sensitive water catchments, potentially leading to tighter restrictions affecting bauxite/mining operations.

title: Mining Stock News - Premium Nickel Resources (TSXV: PNRL) (OTCQX: PNRLF) Announces Filing of NI 43-101 Technical Report on Selkirk Mine in Botswana
summary: Premium Nickel Resources filed an NI 43-101 technical report for its Selkirk Ni-Cu project in Botswana, outlining historic resources and metallurgical work. The company plans additional 2023 exploration/resource drilling and aims for a new compliant resource in Q1 2024, with possible future economic evaluation for an open pit.

title: SMM Aluminium Daily Comment and Forecast (Apr 13, 2023)_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports SHFE and LME aluminium prices rising after softer-than-expected US inflation weakened expectations for May rate hikes and a weaker US dollar. Domestically, aluminium supply is only slightly higher and downstream demand is recovering slowly, so the market is seen as rangebound, with Yunnan power supply and inventories in focus.

title: Abundant Supply Will Leave Aluminium Fluoride Prices Vulnerable To Decline_SMM
summary: SMM reports continued declines in aluminium fluoride prices, with April bids cut to 8,900 yuan/mt and March 11–April 10 seeing further falls. While some aluminium smelters in Sichuan and Guizhou are resuming production, demand support is limited. Abundant supply may pressure prices further in the near term, with uncertain spillover to aluminium.

title: Aluminium Scrap Prices To Stabilise After Rising In March_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that aluminium scrap prices rose in March but weak demand capped further gains. Aluminium extrusion scrap increased by 300–500 yuan/mt and aluminium tense scrap by 100–300 yuan/mt. With both supply and demand growing, aluminium scrap prices are expected to remain rangebound in April.

title: Copper Prices Will Have Upside Room on Weakening Pressure from Dollar_SMM
summary: SMM says markets expect the U.S. to soon end its interest rate hikes, easing pressure from a weakening dollar. With that headwind expected to fade, SMM believes copper prices still have room to rise in the near term. The piece is framed as a market expectation rather than a policy change.

title: Copper Futures Prices Went Up as US Inflation Data Fell Short of Market Expectations_SMM
summary: US CPI in March came in below expectations, lowering market rate-hike expectations and lifting the dollar, which the article says is supportive for copper. LME and SHFE copper futures both rose modestly overnight. Fundamentals are mixed: inventory destocking slows, while optimism for domestic consumption improvement underpins prices.

title: China Jan-march Unwrought Aluminium And Product Exports At 1.4 M… - Stock market news
summary: China’s Jan–March unwrought aluminium and product exports totaled about 1.4 million tonnes, down 15.4% versus the prior year, according to customs data cited by Reuters. The drop suggests weaker export flows, potentially weighing on near-term aluminium market sentiment and pricing.

title: China March copper imports at 408,174 tonnes - customs - Stock market news
summary: China imported 408,174 tonnes of unwrought copper and copper products in March, down 19% from a year earlier, according to customs data. The same report notes aluminium exports of 497,412 tonnes in March. Copper demand expectations may soften, while aluminium impact is less definitive without fuller trade context.

title: Downward Trend of Aluminium Ingot Inventory to Continue in April_SMM
summary: SMM says aluminium ingot inventories fell to about 1 million mt as of April 10, down over 200,000 mt from early March. Downstream production resumption boosted procurement. Aluminium plants increased liquid proportion to a March high of 71%, reducing ingot output. Inventories are expected to keep declining in April, per the SMM ML model.

title: Pakistan's copper export to China increases 16.5 percent in the first two months-- Beijing Review
summary: Pakistan’s copper export value to China rose about 16.5% in the first two months, supported by stronger Chinese demand and increased investment under the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor. Refined copper products are a major item, and the trend is described as ongoing, but no direct global supply shock is indicated.

title: Kamoa-Kakula Copper Mine Kept Copper Production Guidance Unchanged for 2023_SMM
summary: Kamoa-Kakula copper mine in the DRC maintained its 2023 annual copper production guidance at 390,000-430,000 mt. It produced 94,000 mt of copper in Q1. Because guidance was unchanged, the update mainly reinforces existing supply expectations rather than signaling a new shortage or surplus.

title: Operating Rates of Copper Rod Plants Using Copper Cathode Hit Three-Year High in March_SMM
summary: SMM survey data show copper rod producers using cathode ran at a 73.77% operating rate in March, up sharply month-on-month and year-on-year and at a three-year high. Firms cite stronger seasonal wire/cable demand and order acceleration after copper prices fell mid-March, though rates remain below 2018–2019 levels.

title: Operating Rates of Copper Foil to Remain Weak in April_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports copper foil enterprise operating rates at 79.18% in March, down year on year, and estimates April operating rates at about 77.59%—a further month-on-month decline. Rates for electronic circuit and lithium battery copper foil are mixed, but overall production activity remains weak.

title: Nickel Ore Imports Rise in Feb on Subsided Impact of Rainy Season in the Philippines  _SMM
summary: China imported 1.48 million mt of nickel ore in February, up 4.31% month-on-month and 19.26% year-on-year, with higher volumes from the Philippines as rainy-season disruption eased. Port stocks stayed down, but high spot supply and weak demand pushed NPI prices lower, pressuring nickel ore prices, with further growth expected in March.

title: China Copper Cathode Imports Estimated at 260,000 Mt in Mar_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM estimates China’s March copper cathode imports at around 260,000 tonnes. Copper cathode premiums across Japan, South Korea and Southeast Asia remain high, while China’s spot premiums are weak amid ongoing import losses, leading some deliveries to shift abroad. Elevated regional premiums imply supportive near-term copper demand/supply tightness.

title: Xanadu eyes resource update at Mongolian copper project
summary: Xanadu has started a large infill drilling and metallurgical test program at its Kharmagtai Mongolian copper-gold project to upgrade resources and support a forthcoming prefeasibility study. Production expectations remain based on a scoping study, and funding from Zijin helps advance the work, not immediate output.

title: Japan's Mitsubishi Corp looks to invest in nickel, lithium projects
summary: Mitsubishi’s CEO said the company is considering investments in nickel and lithium to support electrification-driven demand. It already holds a stake in a Canadian nickel venture and is assessing nickel project profitability. Mitsubishi also flagged potential reallocation of coal-mine sale proceeds into growth areas like copper and battery metals.

title: Western Copper and Gold : WRN | RECENT AND UPCOMING EVENTS
summary: Western Copper and Gold provides shareholder/event updates on its Casino copper-gold project, highlighting a Rio Tinto participation exercise and a strategic investment by Mitsubishi Materials. It notes upcoming investor conferences and filings but does not announce new production, outages, or policy changes affecting near-term copper supply.

title: Canada Nickel Announces New Nickel Discovery at Midlothian Property with Larger Potential Footprint than Flagship Crawford Property
summary: Canada Nickel reported positive preliminary drill results at its Midlothian property, including near-surface serpentinized dunite with nickel-iron alloy awaruite (up to ~0.49% awaruite in sampled intervals) and high brucite content. The larger target footprint versus Crawford may improve nickel project upside. No assays are finalized.

title: Fathom Nickel releases strong assays from two holes at Gochager Lake Property
summary: Fathom Nickel reported assay results from two drill holes at the Gochager Lake Property, intersecting high-grade nickel-bearing mineralization and testing for cobalt. One section graded 0.22% over 4.2 meters. The company plans a larger drill program later this year, reinforcing positive near-term nickel exploration expectations.

title: Hudbay and Copper Mountain Combine to Create a Premier Americas-Focused Copper Producer
summary: Hudbay agreed to acquire Copper Mountain in an all-share deal to create a ~150,000-tonne-per-year, Americas-focused copper producer. The combined company cites cost synergies and an expanded copper growth pipeline. While it supports long-term copper operations, the release offers no immediate supply disruption for near-term pricing.

title: Hudbay Minerals Inc.: Hudbay and Copper Mountain Combine to Create a Premier Americas-Focused Copper Producer
summary: Hudbay and Copper Mountain announced a definitive all-share acquisition to form a larger Americas-focused copper producer with expected 2023 output above 150,000 tonnes and a pipeline of growth projects. The transaction cites operating synergies and potential valuation re-rating, but provides no immediate operational change to copper supply.

title: Amarc Resources Ltd.: Amarc Completes Phase 1 Drilling Program at Its Duke Copper-Gold District, BC Next Exploration Phase Planned to Commence in June
summary: Amarc reports completion of Phase 1 core drilling at its Duke copper-gold porphyry district in BC, with 11,070 m drilled and initial holes intersecting significant Cu-Mo-Au-Ag mineralization to depth. Phase 2 exploration with surveys and drilling is planned for early summer, funded under a Boliden earn-in agreement.

title: Canada's Hudbay Minerals to buy Copper Mountain Mining in $439-million all-share deal
summary: Hudbay Minerals agreed to buy Copper Mountain Mining in a US$439 million all-share deal to expand its copper portfolio. The combined firm would become a major copper producer in Canada, with expected operating efficiencies. The offer includes an 18% premium and is targeted to close in late Q2 or early Q3.

title: Hudbay Minerals strikes all-stock deal to buy Copper Mountain Mining worth US$439M
summary: Hudbay Minerals announced an all-stock deal to acquire Copper Mountain Mining valued at about US$439 million. The transaction links directly to the copper mining sector, potentially influencing near-term expectations for copper project development and supply outlook, which can modestly support copper prices.

title: Hudbay Minerals strikes all-stock deal to buy Copper Mountain Mining worth US$439M | iNFOnews
summary: Hudbay Minerals agreed to acquire Copper Mountain Mining for US$439M in an all-stock transaction. The combined company would operate three long-life copper mines and pursue additional copper expansion and development. The deal is subject to shareholder, regulatory, and court approvals and offers a 23% premium.

title: Aftermath Silver Files Technical Report on the Berenguela Silver-Copper Project, Peru
summary: Aftermath Silver filed an NI 43-101 technical report for the Berenguela silver-copper-manganese project in Peru and plans advanced metallurgical testwork on drill core to develop recovery flowsheets for copper and other metals. The release updates mineral resources and economic work plans but provides no near-term production change.

title: Aluminum Prices Remain Stagnant As Russian Exports Rise
summary: Aluminum prices have been rangebound after a February decline, with March support and a mild upward bias into April. China’s imports of Russian aluminum nearly tripled in early 2023, offsetting Western trade restrictions amid China’s slow demand from water shortages. Premium signals in Japan and Europe are mixed, keeping prices largely sideways.

title: Hudbay Minerals to buy Copper Mountain Mining | Regina Leader Post
summary: Hudbay Minerals agreed to acquire Copper Mountain Mining for $439 million in an all-stock deal, offering a 23% premium. Copper Mountain’s British Columbia mine cut output nearly in half amid breakdowns and a ransomware shutdown. Hudbay targets bottleneck removal and synergies to raise production and efficiency, reinforcing copper demand sentiment.

title: Hudbay Minerals to buy struggling Copper Mountain Mining for $439 million
summary: Hudbay Minerals will acquire Copper Mountain Mining for US$439 million in an all-stock deal, offering a 23% premium. Copper Mountain’s BC mine saw output nearly halved in 2022 due to equipment breakdowns and a ransomware mill shutdown, but Hudbay expects to expand production by removing milling bottlenecks and adding equipment.

title: Comex Copper Settles 0.97% Higher at $4.1240 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for April delivery settled 0.97% higher at $4.1240, gaining 3.95 cents per pound. The contract rose for three consecutive sessions and is at its highest settlement since March 23, 2023, indicating near-term bullish momentum despite a still large decline from the 52-week high.

title: MetalX and Manna Capital to Build Aluminum Rolling Slab Facility
summary: MetalX and Manna Capital plan to invest over $200 million in a new greenfield aluminum rolling slab facility and recycling campus, targeting 220 million pounds per year of ultra-low carbon aluminum with more recycled content. Operations are expected in 1H 2026, implying limited immediate impact on near-term aluminum prices.

title: Chilean Mining Minister Sees No Large Variation In Copper Price…
summary: Chile’s mining minister said he does not expect large variation in copper prices, aligning with Cochilco’s forecast of about US$3.85 per pound for the year. The Reuters item mainly reflects price expectations and policy outlook, not evidence of immediate changes in mine supply, demand, or inventories.

title: Chile mining minister sees copper 'production slump' reversing
summary: Chile’s mining minister said the country’s recent copper production slump should reverse as tax/royalty discussions ease investor concerns and major projects resume. Chile reported a 5.3% year-on-year copper output drop last year. She expects demand growth from electrification and a stable 2023 average copper price around $3.85/lb.

title: Is Dr. Copper's Lagging Performance Due to the Upcoming Recession?
summary: The piece frames copper as a recession signal (“Dr. Copper”) and points to an inverted yield curve and slowing China growth as reasons for weaker construction and industrial demand. It also notes rising copper recycling and seasonal patterns, but overall concludes copper is likely to face renewed downside risk.

title: Chile Finance Minister Mario Marcel Says He Is Open to Tempering Copper Royalty Bill
summary: Chile’s finance minister Mario Marcel said he is open to tempering a copper royalty bill. Easing the proposed royalty burden would likely be viewed as reducing fiscal pressure on copper producers in Chile, improving near-term supply outlook expectations and supporting copper prices.

title: Chile minister sees copper 'production slump' reversing
summary: Chile’s mining minister said the country’s copper production slump should reverse in coming years, supported by ongoing dialogue with mining firms about planned tax and royalty changes. Chile remains the top global copper producer, and an upcoming CRU World Copper Conference will cover demand, prices and supply.

title: Queensland farmers urged to beef up security amid rising rural crime rates, copper thefts
summary: Queensland police and energy provider Ergon warn of rising rural copper wire thefts, targeting substations, grain infrastructure and solar farms. Ergon says it recorded 10 incidents since the start of the year and is increasing cameras and patrols. Farmers report repeated cable theft, prompting tighter asset security.

title: LATAM POLITICS TODAY-Chile minister sees copper 'production slump' reversing
summary: Chile’s mining minister Marcela Hernando told Reuters that copper production should rebound after a recent slump, helped by ongoing dialogue with mining firms over planned tax and royalty changes that ease industry concerns. Chile is the world’s top copper producer, with executives set to meet April 17 at CRU’s conference.

title: Copper prices hit over six-week high as US dollar slumps
summary: Copper reached a six-week high after US dollar weakness driven by unexpectedly lower US producer prices raised expectations that the Fed is nearing the end of its rate-hike cycle. The weaker dollar supported dollar-priced metals. The article also notes gains in LME/SHFE aluminium and nickel.

title: Copper hits 7-week high as dollar slumps on Fed pause bets - Stock market news
summary: Copper rose to a seven-week high as the dollar slumped after U.S. producer prices unexpectedly fell, strengthening bets that the Fed is nearing the end of its rate hikes. This makes dollar-priced metals cheaper for buyers. LME aluminium and nickel also rose alongside copper.

title: Bearish Demand Outlook Threatens to Weigh On ADC12 Secondary Aluminium Alloy Prices in the Near Term    _SMM
summary: SMM reports weak automobile consumption has driven poor orders for secondary aluminium alloy plants, with other end-sector demand failing to improve. Market liquidity is thin, and while some large producers keep stable output, smaller plants may cut production due to falling orders and shrinking profits. Operating rates are expected flat to lower.

title: SMM A00 Aluminium Prices in East China Surge (Apr 14, 2023)_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that East China A00 aluminium prices rose on Apr 14, quoting 18,690–18,730 yuan/mt, up by 210 yuan/mt on the day. The note presents the daily price range and change, indicating immediate bullish momentum in aluminium in the region.

title: Chinese ADC12 Secondary Aluminium Alloy Importers Suffer Mild Losses_SMM
summary: SMM reports that imported ADC12 secondary aluminium alloy for future arrivals was offered at $2,370–2,400/mt, but importers still posted small losses. The coverage centers on secondary aluminium import pricing and indicates mild downside pressure or weaker near-term trading sentiment for aluminium alloy materials.

title: Egypt to build $2.7bln aluminium smelter
summary: Egyptian Metalco plans a $2.7 billion aluminium smelter project with a capacity of about 600,000 tonnes, negotiating a partner and studying potential sites in Port Said and an eastern Red Sea economic zone. The article does not specify commissioning timing, limiting immediate price implications.

title: Exclusive-Chinese firm imported copper from Russian-controlled part of Ukraine - data - Stock market news
summary: Reuters reports a Chinese firm, Quzhou Nova, bought at least 3,220 tons of copper alloy ingots from the Debaltsevsky plant in Russian-controlled eastern Ukraine between Oct. 2022 and Mar. 2023. The U.S. warned it may blacklist entities aiding Russia’s sanctions circumvention, raising near-term trade risk for copper flows.

title: Exclusive: Chinese Firm Imported Copper From Russian-controlled Part Of Ukraine
summary: Reuters reports a Chinese firm bought at least $7.4 million of copper alloy ingots from the Debaltsevsky Plant in a Russian-controlled part of Ukraine that is under Western sanctions. The U.S. warned it may blacklist entities aiding sanctions circumvention, increasing risk of future supply disruption and price pressure on copper.

title: Lundin's bid for Chilean copper hints at returning investor optimism
summary: Lundin Mining agreed to pay $950 million for 51% control of Chile’s Caserones copper mine and may raise its stake further. Coverage highlights improving investor confidence as Chile’s royalty/tax proposals moderate after earlier concern, while environmental and permitting risks remain under scrutiny.

title: Lundin's Bid For Chilean Copper Hints At Returning Investor Optimism
summary: Lundin agreed to pay $950 million for majority control of Chile’s Caserones copper mine, despite earlier uncertainty over potential royalty and tax changes. The deal is framed as a sign Chile’s moderated mining legislation is encouraging investment and confidence. Environmental permitting and water/strike issues remain, but output is expected to continue.

title: Hudbay agrees to buy Copper Mountain Mining for $439m
summary: Hudbay Minerals agreed to acquire Copper Mountain Mining for $439m in an all-share deal, creating a larger, Americas-focused copper producer. The combined company would hold operating copper mines and an organic copper growth pipeline across Canada, Peru, and the US, with expected cost synergies and accretive returns. Closing targeted for late Q2/early Q3.

title: Chinese firm imported copper from Russian-controlled part of Ukraine - data - Stock market news
summary: Reuters cites Russian customs data showing Chinese trader Quzhou Nova bought at least $7.4 million of copper-alloy ingots from the Debaltsevsky plant in a Russian-annexed region of Ukraine, amid U.S./EU sanctions risks. Such sanctioned copper trade could alter near-term supply expectations for copper, with limited direct data on aluminium.

title: Pure Nickel Bonded Zone Inventory Remains Flat from Apr 7_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports April 14 bonded-zone inventory for pure nickel at 4,300 mt, flat week-on-week, with briquettes at 1,370 mt and plates at 2,930 mt. The SHFE/LME nickel ratio fell and the import window remained closed. Nickel premiums rose (NORNICKEL), weakening transactions, though briquette demand from nickel salt factories persists.

title: Chinese firm imported copper from Russian-held part of Ukraine: Data
summary: Reuters, citing Russian customs data, says a Chinese firm bought at least $7.4 million (3,220 tons) of copper alloy ingots from the Debaltsevsky plant in a Russian-annexed part of Ukraine. US officials warn firms could be blacklisted for sanctions circumvention, potentially affecting copper supply expectations via Russian-linked trade flows.

title: Copper prices head for weekly gain, after touching 7-week high - Stock market news
summary: Copper on the LME reversed from a seven-week high as the U.S. dollar rebounded on expectations of another Fed rate hike. Gains were supported by lower exchange inventories and stronger-than-expected China trade data, but analysts said upside is limited given improving supply and subdued Chinese demand. Nickel and aluminium also rose intraday.

title: LME trial over nickel trading debacle set for June 20-22
summary: Elliott and Jane Street seek damages after the LME suspended nickel trading and voided transactions on March 8 last year, when nickel briefly doubled above $100,000/t. A judicial review runs June 20-22 to judge whether the LME acted lawfully, with a remedies trial planned if needed. Other related lawsuits are stayed.

title: Chinese firm imported copper from Russia-controlled part of Ukraine, data shows
summary: Reuters reports a Chinese firm (Quzhou Nova) imported about 3,220 tonnes of copper alloy ingots (~$7.4m) from the Debaltsevsky Plant in Russia-controlled Ukraine between Oct 2022 and Mar 2023. The US warned it may blacklist entities for sanctions violations, highlighting possible copper supply circumvention.

title: Mitsubishi considers investing in nickel and lithium projects
summary: Mitsubishi says it is appraising investments in nickel projects, citing rapidly rising EV battery demand, and is verifying profitable options given technical and cost hurdles. It is also considering initiatives to increase copper output through mine expansions and new projects, potentially allocating sale proceeds toward copper and battery metals. No clear aluminium link.

title: Copper Inventory in China Bonded Zone Dropped This Week, Declines Can Slow Down Next Week_SMM
summary: SMM data show China’s copper inventories in bonded zones fell 7,300 mt week-on-week to 155,800 mt, with big drops in Shanghai. Bonded drawdowns slowed due to import losses, weaker warrant shipments, and limited customs clearance. Inventory declines are expected to slow further, but overall tightness remains supportive.

title: Copper Inventory in Major Chinese Markets Declined This Week, Will the Drop Continue?_SMM
summary: SMM data shows copper inventories across major Chinese markets fell 4,600 mt to 190,100 mt from April 10, with a larger drop from last week. Purchases continued as prices rose, while high import losses reduced arrivals. Inventories are expected to decline slightly next week as import inflows remain limited.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports up 315,000 wmt WoW_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says Chinese port inventories of nickel ore rose to 6.55mn wmt as of Apr 14, up 315,000 wmt WoW. Nickel ore inventories at seven ports increased by 185,000 wmt. Nickel ore prices were stable, NPI prices inched up, but ore transactions remained poor, and further inventory growth is expected.

title: MMG Is Mining Copper at Capacity in Peru and Trimming Stockpiles After Protests
summary: MMG said it is mining copper at capacity in Peru while trimming stockpiles following protests. The actions point to short-term disruptions or slower warehouse movements despite ongoing production, which can raise concerns about near-term copper availability and weigh on price expectations over coming days.

title: Fitch Sees Scope for 'Digestible' Tax Hike on Chile Copper Mines
summary: The article headline reports that Fitch sees scope for a “digestible” tax hike on Chile’s copper mines. If implemented, higher taxes would likely increase miners’ costs or reduce after-tax returns, potentially tightening near-term supply expectations and weighing on copper prices.

title: Comex Copper Ends the Week 2.02% Higher at $4.1075 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for April delivery ended the week up 2.02% to $4.1075, its largest one-week gain since late March, though it fell 0.40% on the day and snapped a three-session winning streak. The piece provides price performance metrics without referencing specific new catalysts.

title: Gentilly residents without phone, Wi-Fi access due to copper theft
summary: Gentilly residents in New Orleans faced three days without home phone or Wi‑Fi after thieves stripped copper from AT&T infrastructure, including fiber optic copper wiring, cutting lines that also disrupted 911 service. AT&T and crews restore service while NOPD investigates multiple theft cases tied to copper wire removal.

title: China firm buys copper from sanctioned area
summary: A Chinese trader bought about 3,220 tonnes of copper alloy ingots worth at least $7.4 million from a plant in Russia-annexed eastern Ukraine subject to Western sanctions. The US warned it could blacklist firms aiding Russia’s sanctions circumvention. The reported imports suggest copper alloy supplies reaching China despite controls.

title: ME volumes still subdued a year after nickel crisis: Andy Home
summary: A year after the LME suspended nickel trading and cancelled trades, exchange volumes remain below pre-crisis levels, though stabilized. The article cites depressed nickel and sharp aluminium volume declines on both LME and ShFE, with copper activity mixed. It attributes weakness to muted investor appetite and macro uncertainty.

title: Big copper deals to take centerstage in Santiago as demand heats up
summary: Chile hosts the World Copper Conference as major copper deal activity continues (Glencore-Teck, Lundin-Caserones, BHP-Oz Minerals, Rio Tinto and others). Speakers cite green-transition demand but warn supply may fall short due to lower ore grades, higher costs, and limited investment, supporting a copper deficit outlook despite macro uncertainty.

title: Big copper deals to take centre stage in Santiago as demand heats up
summary: Reuters reports that copper producers are holding the World Copper Conference in Santiago amid surging demand and tight supply. Copper prices hit a seven-week high, and commentary from Fitch Solutions expects the market to remain in deficit. Deal activity, including BHP’s Oz Minerals takeover, underscores growth needs.

title: SHFE and LME Aluminium Closed With Gains (Apr 14, 2023)_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reported that SHFE’s most-traded aluminium contract (2305) rose slightly and LME aluminium ended higher, with LME up about 1.1%. The price strength was attributed to macro sentiment: markets expected the US Fed to pause further rate hikes amid recession fears, boosting aluminium.

title: SMM Aluminium Market Daily Comment (Apr 17, 2023)_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says macro sentiment improved as markets bet the US Fed may pause rate hikes amid recession fears, supporting aluminium. On fundamentals, domestic aluminium supply is growing slowly and Yunnan power supply conditions need monitoring. With ingots in a destocking cycle and mixed demand, prices are expected rangebound short term, with both LME and SHFE aluminium up last Friday.

title: Nickel Prices to Bear Pressure from Economic Recession and Electrowinning Nickel Output Increase_SMM
summary: SMM reports firm premiums for NORNICKEL nickel due to warrant delivery and no cleared spots flowing into China. Nickel demand improves with 300-series stainless and alloy output, supporting prices. However, projected electrowinning output growth amid recession-related macro concerns is expected to add supply and pressure nickel prices.

title: Sierra Leone to start adding value to bauxite production – creating thousands of jobs
summary: Sierra Leone’s Vimetco (Sierra Mineral Holdings) met government ministries to plan a new alumina tri-hydrate value-adding plant at its bauxite concession. The project is scheduled to start in 2020 with output expected in June 2022, funded with Afrexim Bank support, aiming to increase local industrial production and export revenue.

title: Amount of Imported Nickel Ore Arriving at Ports Totall 770,000 Wmt as of April 7_SMM
summary: As of April 7, Chinese ports received 770,000 Wmt of nickel ore, up 15% week-on-week. Arrivals increased at Yangjiang, Jinzhou, Ningde and Lanshan. Nickel ore prices dipped slightly on rising NPI prices, while Philippine mines resumed operations slowly, with further arrivals expected in late April.

title: Spot Nickel Trading Remains Slack Today_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports Apr 17 spot nickel trading was slack. Jinchuan nickel premiums rose to an average of 6,900 yuan/mt, while NORNICKEL premiums averaged 6,750 yuan/mt. SHFE nickel prices continued higher and premiums stayed firm, but intraday spot and briquette transactions were weak, keeping price momentum muted.

title: Nickel Ore Prices Drop Slightly on Rising NPI Prices_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Nickel ore (Ni 1.5%) CIF prices in China slipped slightly to $52/wmt as Philippines supply remains limited because many mines haven’t started. NPI prices rose to 1,052 yuan/mtu WoW, but NPI plants hesitate due to unpredictable price trends and low purchase offers, keeping ore quotes firm. Short-term ore pricing likely stable.

title: Nickel Salt Plants Gain Low Profit Margins Last Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports nickel sulphate enterprises shipping at lower levels due to slack demand and low profit margins. April production schedules are planned to dip 15.93% month-on-month, while nickel briquette premiums over nickel sulphate previously widened sharply. Slightly sufficient raw-material supply may push raw-material producers to cut quotes, weighing on nickel-linked prices.

title: Western Metallica Announces Initial Drill Results From Its Nueva Celti Copper Project
summary: Western Metallica reported initial drill results from its Nueva Celti copper project in southern Spain, confirming copper-bearing ore bodies and intersecting shallow and deeper mineralized zones with grades comparable to historical results. The company plans additional drilling and geophysics, with follow-up results expected in early May.

title: Alumina Price Drop To Spill Over From Low-Cost Regions To High-Cost Areas Amid Growing Supply_SMM
summary: SMM reports that alumina transactions are softening: a Gansu smelter bought 35,000 mt at 2,900 yuan/mt, down versus prior deals, while tighter north supply from Shandong is outweighed by inflows from southwest China. New capacity may trigger low-cost-region sell-offs, pushing prices in Shanxi and Henan lower and muting demand after smelter buying.

title: Aluminium Ingot Inventories In China Fall To Lowest Since 2018 When Comparing With The Same Period Of Previous Years_SMM
summary: China social aluminium ingot inventories fell to 935,000 mt as of April 17, the lowest for the same period since 2018. Stocks dropped across major markets, with significant declines in Wuxi and south China. Outflows from warehouses rose week-on-week, indicating tighter short-term supply.

title: Great Southern Copper talks Especularita copper-gold potential
summary: Great Southern Copper’s managing director discusses new rock chip samples from the Especularita Project’s Victoria prospect in Chile. Results reportedly show up to 6.9% copper in outcropping vein-breccias, with about a quarter of samples exceeding 1% copper, supporting drill target definition for potential copper development.

title: Tightest Supply in 18 Years Boosts Copper Ahead of Industry Show
summary: The piece references “Energy & Commodities” and, in particular, a headline stating that copper is being boosted by the tightest supply in 18 years ahead of an industry event. No comparable, specific nickel or aluminium supply/demand catalysts are provided in the excerpt.

title: Comex Copper Settles 1.01% Lower at $4.0660 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper settled 1.01% lower at $4.0660, losing 4.15 cents per pound and marking a fourth-day down trend with two consecutive losing sessions. The move follows declines in LME copper cash and front-month pricing, reflecting near-term bearish sentiment toward copper.

title: Peru Copper Exports Plummet 20% Even as Production Rises
summary: Peru’s copper exports are reported to have plummeted 20% even as production rises. This points to a near-term deterioration in outbound shipment flows or related logistical/export constraints, which can tighten market sentiment around physical availability and weigh on copper prices over the next days.

title: Top Miner Vale Is Looking for Copper in Peru as Demand for EV Metals Surges
summary: The article says top miner Vale is looking for copper in Peru, framing the move alongside a surge in demand for EV-related metals. That combination can support near-term bullish sentiment for copper by reinforcing expectations of stronger demand and potential future supply, though it is exploratory rather than immediate production.

title: Kutcho Copper Corp.: Kutcho Copper Announces $4 Million Financing
summary: Kutcho Copper Corp. announced a non-brokered private placement raising up to C$4 million to fund detailed exploration on its Kutcho copper property in British Columbia, with flow-through proceeds targeted for eligible exploration spending. Remaining funds cover general working capital, subject to regulatory approval. Copper price is referenced only in risk statements.

title: Lumina Gold Announces Positive Cangrejos Pre-Feasibility Study; US$2.2 Billion NPV, 26 Year Mine Life and Production of 371,000 Gold Ounces Per Year and 41 Million Pounds of Copper Per Year
summary: Lumina Gold reported positive preliminary feasibility study results for its Cangrejos project, including an after-tax NPV based on $3.75/lb copper and an estimated 41 million lbs of copper by-product production annually over a multi-year mine life. The update supports long-run development expectations, not immediate supply changes.

title: Aurubis CEO says has stopped buying copper from Russia
summary: Aurubis CEO Roland Harings said the company has ended and not renewed contracts for Russian copper, requesting an LME ban previously due to warehouse-fill risk. He said Aurubis has replaced Russian volumes with other sources and sees strong demand for green-energy cables, while Russian supply remains a market factor.

title: Will we have enough nickel for our EVs in 2030?
summary: The piece reviews nickel supply and demand for EVs, noting Indonesian production growth and muted near-term demand from a slow Chinese reopening and recession fears, which weigh on nickel prices. It also highlights 2022’s extreme nickel volatility tied to the Ukraine conflict and a longer-term EV demand outlook through 2030.

title: Big copper deals to take centre stage in Santiago
summary: Global copper producers meet in Chile this week for their largest gathering since 2019. Talks are expected to focus on a growing mergers-and-acquisitions wave as demand rises and copper supply remains tight. Community and indigenous opposition to new mines is encouraging consolidation among mining firms.

title: Copper Scrap Supply Increased as Sellers Sold Aggressively_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Copper scrap supply rose last week as sellers sold aggressively, but copper rod plants cut output for three weeks on weak end-user demand, tightening scrap-based rod supply. Copper rod made from scrap stayed firm, while #1 bare bright copper averaged 63,220 yuan/mt, up 120 yuan/mt, and the cathode-scrap spread narrowed slightly.

title: Yangshan Copper Premiums Fell Due To Expanding Import Losses and Expectations for More Supply, Losses to Continue_SMM
summary: Yangshan copper premiums fell as import losses widened and the market expected increased supply in late April. Export window gains were brief, warrant demand stayed weak, and seller quotes eased due to higher losses. Bonded zone inventory declines are slowing, and incoming cargoes may be sold off, weighing on copper.

title: Copper Concentrate TCs Rose amid Weak Demand From Smelters_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports higher weekly imported copper concentrate TCs to $82.66/mt as spot trading is muted and smelter inquiries remain limited. Maintenance at Chinese smelters weakens spot concentrate demand, while U.S. port capacity and eased overseas mine disruption (Quebrada Blanca Phase 2) lift supply. Port inventories rise, supporting a bearish near-term copper tone.

title: SMM Survey on Consumption across Copper Downstream Industries_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: An SMM survey shows copper downstream activity weakening: wire and cable new orders slid, State Grid bid volumes fell in April, and enamelled wire orders declined. Copper cathode rod producers’ operating rates dropped to ~65% due to weaker demand, higher inventories, and planned output cuts for late April to May.

title: Barrick Gold: Production of Gold and Copper Declined In First Quarter, But Annual Production Target will be Achieved_SMM
summary: Barrick Gold reported preliminary Q1 production: copper output fell to 88 million pounds, lower than Q4, due to declines at the Luwana and Zaldivar mines. While copper remains on track to meet full-year expectations, the weaker start can increase short-term supply concerns that weigh on copper sentiment.

title: Top Copper Miners Contributed to the Surge in Peru's Copper Production in February_SMM
summary: Peru’s copper output increased to 192,334 tonnes in February, up 11.6% year-on-year, according to MINEM. Growth was attributed to higher production from major miners such as Cerro Verde, Southern Peru Copper, and Chinalco Perú. Arequipa led regional output, followed by Ancash and Moquegua.

title: Anglo American copper project wins environmental approval in Chile
summary: Anglo American said Chile’s committee of ministers approved the environmental permit for the Los Bronces Integrated Project, expanding the open pit and adding a new underground section to access higher-grade ore. The approval advances pre-feasibility work toward board submission. The project is designed to improve air quality and water efficiency.

title: Peru to Approve Lithium Exploration Soon, Expects Copper Output to Surge in 2023_SMM
summary: Peru’s mining minister expects copper output in 2023 to rise about 15% to 2.8 million mt, after earlier production disruptions from political protests and road blockades. The ministry also expects to approve lithium exploration in coming months, but the copper outlook is the immediate market-relevant element.

title: Hefty shortages to help buoy aluminium prices this year - Stock market news
summary: Reuters reports aluminium shortages driven by hydro power problems in China and lingering smelter cuts in Europe after high energy costs and reduced Russian supply. Inventories monitored in Asia are sliding and analysts forecast sizable market deficits, with physical premiums in Europe supported by tight physical availability.

title: Copper edges higher after strong Chinese growth data
summary: Copper rose on Tuesday after faster-than-expected Chinese GDP growth boosted expectations for near-term demand. While some indicators pointed to softer factory orders later in April/May, the data still supported prices. LME aluminium gained on warehouse inflows and March output, and nickel was also higher as industrial metals moved together.

title: It's been a place of worship for centuries. Now a copper mine threatens its future
summary: Tribal leaders in Arizona are appealing to prevent mining at Oak Flat, a sacred site overlying a major copper ore deposit. A 9th Circuit case will weigh whether the proposed copper project violates Indigenous religious rights. The developer says it would underpin jobs and copper supply for EVs and devices.

title: Daily LME Base Metals Inventory Changes (Apr 18, 2023), with Aluminium Inventory Sky-Rocketing_SMM
summary: SMM publishes a daily update on LME base-metals inventory changes for April 18, 2023. The headline emphasizes aluminium inventories “sky-rocketing,” implying a sharp build in warehouse stocks. Such a rapid stock increase can reduce nearby tightness and place mild downward pressure on aluminium prices over the following days.

title: Spot Nickel Trading Remains Sluggish Today_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM said April 18 spot nickel trading in Shanghai remained sluggish. Jinchuan nickel premiums averaged 6,150 yuan/mt, down 750 yuan/mt, while NORNICKEL averaged 6,250 yuan/mt, down 500. Despite lower premiums, NORNICKEL supply was still tight and premiums remained firm. Nickel briquette transactions were slack.

title: Chile Approves Anglo Project in Boost to Copper Supplies
summary: Chile’s approval of an Anglo-linked project is being presented as a boost to copper supplies. By increasing the outlook for future copper production, the approval can improve near-term supply expectations, shifting sentiment toward higher copper prices over the coming days and weeks.

title: BHP, Antofagasta call for more dialog in Chile copper royalty proposal
summary: BHP and Antofagasta urged Chilean lawmakers to keep dialog while considering a proposed copper mining royalty that would raise total tax load up to 48% versus 41% in other jurisdictions. With a Senate vote imminent, concerns over competitiveness and project economics add near-term uncertainty for copper supply outlook.

title: BHP, Antofagasta call for more dialogue in Chile copper royalty proposal
summary: BHP and Antofagasta urged Chile to hold more dialogue on a proposed copper mining royalty. They argue the royalty would leave Chile less competitive, raising the maximum tax load to 48% versus 41% in Australia and Peru. A Senate vote is expected, after Congress shelved prior tax reform.

title: Chile Government Says It Will Reach Deal With Copper Producers Before Key Mining Tax Vote
summary: Chile’s government says it will try to reach a deal with copper producers before a key mining tax vote. The timing suggests policymakers aim to avoid worsening fiscal terms for miners. That can lower perceived supply and investment risk, supporting near-term sentiment for copper prices.

title: MineHub Technologies Inc.: Capstone Copper Completes First Concentrate Assay Exchange Including ALS as Umpire on the MineHub Platform
summary: MineHub says its MineHub Assay Exchange platform, with ALS as umpire lab, was used for a live shipment of about 10,000 MT of U.S. copper concentrate from the U.S. to Japan. The release highlights digitised assay settlement and efficiency, but does not indicate a material supply or demand shock.

title: Comex Copper Settles 0.58% Higher at $4.0895 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper futures for April delivery settled 0.58% higher at $4.0895 per pound, rising 2.35 cents. The move comes after a two-session losing streak, with copper up on six of the past nine sessions. The piece provides performance levels versus recent highs and lows.

title: Recycled aluminum offers energy, emissions an
summary: DOE and Magna announce a shear-assisted processing and extrusion method that turns aluminum scrap and trimmings directly into vehicle parts with major embodied energy and emissions reductions. By eliminating energy-intensive homogenization/preheating and lowering recycling costs, the innovation could increase secondary aluminum availability and adoption in EVs.

title: Aluminium scrap suitable for making new car parts, saving energy, scientists suggest
summary: Scientists at PNNL and Magna propose the “ShAPE” process to recycle aluminium scrap for new car parts using 50% less energy and 90% lower emissions than traditional methods. By avoiding energy-intensive heat treatments and improving scrap quality, recycling costs could fall and increase aluminium component adoption.

title: Mining Stock News - Capstone Copper (TSXV: MHUB) (OTCQB: MHUBF) Completes First Concentrate Assay Exchange Including ALS as Umpire on the MineHub Platform
summary: MineHub reports the first live use of its digital assay exchange platform, with ALS acting as umpire laboratory, for a transaction involving about 10,000 MT of U.S. copper concentrate shipped to Japan. It frames assay digitisation as improving efficiency and transparency, but provides no direct supply or demand shock.

title: Aluminum manufacturing market in Turkey to grow by USD 2,269.92 million during 2022-2027; Increasing demand for power infrastructure will boost the market
summary: Technavio forecasts Turkey’s aluminum manufacturing market to expand through 2027, citing rising demand for power infrastructure as utilities upgrade transmission and distribution gear. It also notes challenges from steel substitution in automotive, and growing secondary aluminum availability, but the net implication is supportive aluminum demand.

title: SMM Daily Aluminium Market Review (Apr 19, 2023)_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports higher prices for aluminium on both SHFE and LME, with the most-traded SHFE contract ending up about 0.79% and LME aluminium up about 2.82%. It attributes the shift from Fed-driven fears to fundamentals, noting China output grows slowly while social ingot inventories keep falling.

title: Aluminium Prices Exceed 19,000 yuan/mt, But Further Upside Room Depends On When Fundamentals Improve Significantly_SMM
summary: SMM reports aluminium prices have risen above 19,000 yuan/mt, with the SHFE 2305 contract up on the day. The piece cites slowly growing China output, end demand gradually improving, and rumours of possible power rationing affecting Yunnan smelters, with market focus on whether fundamentals improve enough for further upside.

title: Copper dips as Fed outlook in focus, tin retreats
summary: Copper dipped in Asia as traders weighed the Fed’s outlook for further interest rate hikes, supporting a firmer dollar and pressuring dollar-priced industrial metals. LME tin retreated after Myanmar mining suspension concerns eased. LME aluminium and nickel also eased, with SHFE aluminium and nickel showing opposing gains.

title: Copper subdued as Fed outlook weighs, tin retreats
summary: Copper fell in Asian trading as traders weighed prospects of additional U.S. Federal Reserve rate hikes, supporting the dollar and pressuring non-ferrous prices. Three-month LME copper declined and Shanghai copper ended lower. LME aluminium dropped and nickel was little changed, reflecting overall market risk sentiment tied to Fed outlook.

title: Chinese Miner Gets Congo Deal to Free Stockpile of Copper and Cobalt
summary: The headline says a Chinese miner has secured a Congo deal to free up a stockpile of copper (and cobalt). Releasing an existing copper inventory into the market would likely increase near-term supply expectations and weigh on copper prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: SMM Midday Comments (Apr 19): SHFE Metals Gained With Nickel Surging, LME Metals Fell Across the Board_SMM
summary: SMM’s midday market wrap notes the dollar was slightly higher and oil slightly lower. SHFE base metals broadly rose, with nickel up 4.36% and aluminium also increasing. In contrast, LME base metals fell across the board. The piece is descriptive and lacks specific drivers for nickel and aluminium.

title: Tight Ferronickel Supply under Small Orders in April, Ferronickel Prices Fell and Varied Greatly across Different Grades_SMM
summary: SMM reports that ferronickel prices for small orders fell as stainless-steel mill demand weakened and NPI prices dropped quickly. While higher-Ni ferronickel (≥35%) stayed firm, 20–25% and <20% grades declined, with some trading tied to NPI averages. The sharp fall hindered trader shipments, though supply is expected to remain relatively scarce into Q2.

title: Bauxite Imports Hit Record Highs and China's Reliance on Guinea Ore Deepened_SMM
summary: China’s customs data show bauxite imports rose 12.5% year-on-year in Jan-Feb 2023, with Guinea supplying 17.12 million mt (+48.7%). January imports hit a record 12.38 million mt, with Guinea again at record levels. Better post-rainy-season logistics boosted shipments; Indonesia’s export ban uncertainty remains.

title: Aluminium Bahrain B S C : Alba's Line 6 New Nameplate Capacity Jumps to 560,000 MT
summary: Aluminium Bahrain (Alba) says it has expanded Reduction Line 6 nameplate capacity to 560,000 mtpa from 540,000 mtpa by increasing current. The creep upgrade was achieved safely and supports operational efficiency and throughput while preparing for Line 7. This signals incremental aluminium supply capacity growth.

title: Palladium One Mining Inc.: Palladium One Intersects Wide Zones of Mineralization at West Pickle, on the Tyko Nickel Project, Canada
summary: Palladium One reported wide intercepts of nickel-copper mineralization at its Tyko Project’s West Pickle Zone, including multiple holes with ~0.6% Ni and ~0.4% Cu over ~28 m, plus higher-grade sections. The zone remains open for expansion toward the RJ Zone, supporting potential future Ni and Cu resources.

title: Palladium One Intersects Wide Zones of Mineralization at West Pickle, on the Tyko Nickel Project, Canada
summary: Palladium One reported final 2022 drill results from the Tyko nickel-copper project in Ontario, including wide intercepts of nickel and copper sulphides at the West Pickle zone and indications the zone remains open for expansion. The update is exploration-focused and does not change near-term production or inventories.

title: Nickel 28 Announces Confirmation of Largest Ever Ramu Cash Distribution and Proposed Resumption of Normal Course Issuer Bid
summary: Nickel 28 says it has received confirmation of a US$9.7 million cash distribution and US$18.1 million debt repayment from its Ramu nickel-cobalt joint venture, driven by H2 2022 operating performance. The company plans to resume its normal course issuer bid to repurchase shares. Ramu timing is expected in April 2023.

title: Secondary aluminium billet premiums narrow up; low-carbon differentials flat
summary: Fastmarkets says secondary aluminium billet premiums in Europe (ddp) narrowed but remained elevated, while low-carbon differentials for value-added products were flat. Market sources cited steadier downstream demand and growing inquiries for recycled/low-carbon material, alongside tighter European ingot availability and lingering low-carbon supply concerns that support aluminium premium levels.

title: Surge Copper Provides Berg Area Reconnaissance Exploration
summary: Surge Copper Corp. reported final 2022 reconnaissance exploration results for the Ootsa–Berg project, including multiple new or expanded copper anomalies and drill intersections with copper grades at Bergette, Sibola, and Sylvia targets. The company outlines planned 2023 follow-up drilling but provides no production or supply changes.

title: Lifezone Metals launches off-take marketing process for nickel, copper and cobalt from the Kabanga nickel project
