summary: Lifezone Metals says it has commenced an off-take marketing process for nickel and copper (and cobalt) from the Kabanga nickel project, retaining marketing rights up to 40% of contained production. The firm expects demand from battery and EV supply chains and engaged RBC Capital Markets to run the process.

title: Surge Copper Provides Berg Area Reconnaissance Exploration Results, a Round-Up of the 2022 Exploration Program and Announces 2023 Initial Exploration Plans
summary: Surge Copper reported final 2022 reconnaissance drill and sampling results for its Ootsa-Berg projects, highlighting expanded copper anomalies and multiple copper intersections at targets like Bergette and Sibola. It also outlined initial 2023 exploration plans. The news is supportive for long-run copper expectations but unlikely to move near-term prices materially.

title: Lifezone Metals launches off-take marketing process for nickel, copper and cobalt from the Kabanga nickel project
summary: Lifezone Metals says it has started an off-take marketing process for nickel (and copper) from the Kabanga nickel project, engaging RBC Capital Markets to monetize up to 40% of contained production. The step supports expectations for future supply contracts and could modestly lift nickel and copper sentiment near term.

title: Factbox-Red-hot copper riding a new wave of consolidation
summary: Glencore offered $22.5 billion to buy Canadian copper miner Teck Resources, part of a wave of copper-industry deals. Reuters cites surging demand and tight supply for copper supporting the green energy transition. The consolidation narrative and supply-tight backdrop point to near-term bullish copper price expectations.

title: Glencore in hot pursuit of Teck with eyes on copper assets
summary: Glencore is trying to win approval for a revised bid to merge with Canada’s Teck Resources, whose plan would split thermal coal and copper. Teck rejects the offers and pushes a restructuring/proposed spinoff, while shareholders and advisors weigh in. The contest focuses on control of Teck’s copper assets.

title: Risk of Global Economy Recession Suppressed Copper Prices_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports the US ISM and labor indicators weakened and eurozone manufacturing stayed in contraction, raising recession and financial-stability concerns. The gold-to-copper ratio increased as a result, which SMM says suppressed copper prices. Fundamentals show easing cathode shortages, sufficient scrap supply, and only slight inventory support.

title: Operating Rates of Copper Semis Producers Topped Expectations in March, but are Expected to Fall in April_SMM
summary: SMM estimates China copper semis output and operating rates rose in March, surpassing expectations on stronger downstream demand and ordering after March price cuts. However, SMM expects operating rates to fall in April across most copper semi sectors, with only copper tube rates remaining high.

title: China's Huayou seeks to build nickel ore processing plant in Philippines: sources
summary: China’s Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt is reportedly seeking to build the Philippines’ third nickel ore processing facility with a local miner. The project would expand domestic processing of nickel ore used in stainless steel and EV battery supply chains, potentially improving processing capacity and influencing nickel supply expectations.

title: Québec Nickel Drills Over 250m of Serpentinized Ultramafic Rock at Ducros Sill Target & Provides Corporate Update
summary: Québec Nickel reports long core intervals of serpentinized dunite/peridotite at its Ducros Ni-Cu-PGE project, with results indicating a potentially large nickel-cobalt exploration target. Native copper is mentioned on fracture surfaces and historical drilling grades include nickel and cobalt. It remains exploration with no immediate supply impact, limiting price movement.

title: Nickel processing firms to invest $10b in PH
summary: Philippines’ Board of Investments says two firms will invest up to $10 billion in nickel processing plants in Leyte. The projects, aimed at supplying nickel for electric-battery precursor production, could boost local processing capacity and value-added exports, improving market sentiment for nickel demand and supply balance in the near term.

title: Talon Metals (TSX:TLO) Intersects up to 6.93% Nickel from Assays at New Raptor Zone, Confirming High-Grade Mineralization
summary: Talon Metals reported high-grade nickel assays (up to 6.93%) from six holes at the newly identified “Raptor Zone” of the Tamarack Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project in Minnesota. The company says results suggest a new nickel-copper system and plans further drilling and related permitting.

title: Angle partners with BioView; First Class hails nickel
summary: The update round-up includes First Class Metals’ West Pickle Lake drilling results, claiming wide intercepts with ~10% nickel and ~4.5% copper. The news may modestly improve sentiment around future nickel and copper supply prospects, but it does not indicate near-term production, refining, or inventory impacts, limiting price effects.

title: Comex Copper Settles 0.43% Lower at $4.0720 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper futures settled 0.43% lower at $4.0720 per pound, losing 1.75 cents. The contract fell on the day and declined in three of the past four sessions. Year-to-date it remains up, but the latest settlement indicates short-term bearish momentum for copper prices.

title: Pampa Metals Corp.: Pampa Metals Advances Buenavista Porphyry Copper Target Drill Testing
summary: Pampa Metals reports progress on drilling at its Buenavista porphyry copper target in Chile, completing about 550m of a planned ~2,100m program. The company expects assays in June and describes geophysical anomalies suggestive of porphyry copper systems. This is exploration-only with no immediate supply impact.

title: Palladium One Intersects Wide Zones Of Mineralization At West Pickle, On The Tyko Nickel Project, Canada
summary: Palladium One reported drill intercepts at its Tyko Project’s West Pickle Zone showing wide nickel-copper sulphide mineralization, including grades up to 2%+ Ni and multi-percent Cu in selected sections, and extensions of strike length toward the RJ Zone. The update supports potential incremental Ni/Cu resource outlook.

title: Alcoa Sees Output Costs Easing as Aluminum Demand Stays Steady
summary: BNN Bloomberg’s weekend edition highlights Alcoa saying its output costs are easing and that aluminum demand is staying steady. This combination suggests improved near-term margins for aluminium producers, supporting market sentiment toward aluminium prices over the next few weeks as cost pressure eases and demand remains intact.

title: Dry season for FTSE 100 miner Antofagasta as drought hits copper mining
summary: The headline reports that a drought during the dry season is impacting miner Antofagasta, disrupting copper mining activity. Reduced water availability can lower output at copper operations, tightening near-term supply expectations and typically applying downward pressure to copper prices over the next several weeks.

title: Rio Tinto Notches 1Q Iron-Ore Export Record, Cuts Fiscal Year Copper Output Estimate -- Update
summary: Rio Tinto reported record 1Q iron-ore exports but downgraded its 2023 mined copper output forecast after disruptions at its Kennecott mine (conveyor outage, record snowfall) and geotechnical issues at Escondida. Kennecott concentrator runs at reduced rates, with ore to be trucked until repairs.

title: Chile faces industry backlash on proposed copper mining royalty bill
summary: Chile’s government faces industry backlash over a proposed copper mining royalty bill that would lower the maximum tax burden on copper producers to 48% from 50% of operating profit and set an average tax rate of 42.1%. Industry argues competitiveness and investments, including at Escondida, could be harmed.

title: SMM Daily Aluminium Market Comment (Apr 20, 2023)_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports aluminium prices rose overnight on both SHFE and LME. It cites improving end demand, growing supply (Guizhou/Sichuan), but ongoing risk of power rationing for Yunnan smelters. A bigger-than-expected drop in aluminium ingot inventories is noted as a key support, though further gains depend on fundamentals.

title: Expectations of Fed Rate Hikes Keep Market Cautious, Copper Prices to Face Resistance_SMM
summary: LME and SHFE copper ended slightly lower as rising U.S. bond yields and Fed rate-hike expectations strengthened the dollar, while BoE actions limited dollar gains. Tight warrant outflows and narrowing import losses were offset by concerns over continued imported copper and weak downstream buying, leading traders to expect rangebound copper.

title: Antofagasta Copper Output Plunged in the First Quarter_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Antofagasta said first-quarter copper production fell to 145,900 mt, down 25.4% from the prior quarter. The decline was driven by reduced water supplies and drought disrupting operations, notably at Los Pelambres, along with lower ore grades at the Centinela mine.

title: Alcoa CEO Warns Russian Aluminum Will Overwhelm LME Warehouses
summary: Alcoa’s CEO warns that Russian aluminium could flood LME warehouses, implying rising near-term stock levels. If additional Russian metal reaches the market faster than demand can absorb, it would likely pressure aluminium prices by weakening prompt tightness and increasing inventory visibility at the exchange.

title: Material Matters: Iron Ore, Critical Minerals, Copper, Gold & Silver
summary: The piece discusses copper and nickel outlooks via broker commentary. Copper is supported by declining LME stockpiles and electrification/renewables themes, but demand risks rise from weaker US and China activity. Nickel sentiment is helped by LME stockpiles at a 14-year low, though no new supply disruption is detailed.

title: Nickel, nuclear subs on latest Pacific blitz agenda
summary: Australia’s foreign minister says expanded cooperation with New Caledonia will include critical mineral mining, explicitly citing future opportunities from nickel mining. A labour mobility program may also expand to cover the French territory, aiming to address labour shortages and promote responsible mining. Nuclear submarine discussions focus on compliance, not metals supply.

title: Copper falls after Fed policymaker signals more rate hikes - Stock market news
summary: Copper prices fell after a Federal Reserve policymaker suggested more U.S. rate hikes because inflation remains “problematic.” The move supported a stronger dollar effect on dollar-priced metals. The article also reported declines in LME aluminium and nickel, consistent with a broader risk-off, tighter-monetary impulse.

title: Telefónica S A : Telefónica closes all its copper central offices
summary: Telefónica said it has notified regulators of the closure of the last 3,329 copper central offices, completing Spain’s move to a 100% fibre-to-the-home network by its centenary in 2024. The switch replaces copper infrastructure with fibre, reducing copper-related demand while citing energy and emissions benefits.

title: Glencore signs loan agreement for Pacific Nickel's Kolosori project
summary: Glencore has signed loan documentation and an amended sales agreement to provide up to $22m funding for Pacific Nickel’s Kolosori nickel project in the Solomon Islands. The loan supports pre-production needs, with drawdowns expected imminently, and Glencore to acquire all nickel output for six years.

title: Awareness of copper supply gap still not meaningful, Trafigura CEO says | Hotter Commodities
summary: Trafigura CEO Jeremy Weir warns that a lack of new copper projects and permitting delays could widen supply tightness and jeopardize net-zero goals. The piece cites a forecast refined copper deficit and EU critical-minerals moves, arguing that policy and fiscal stability are needed to secure future supply, supporting bullish copper sentiment.

title: China needs to mine more bauxite at home, industry official says - Stock market news
summary: China’s aluminium industry official says domestic bauxite supply is lower grade and self-sufficiency is declining, increasing reliance on overseas bauxite. With Indonesia set to stop bauxite exports from June and China planning additional alumina capacity, market participants may expect tighter alumina feedstock and supportive aluminium prices.

title: SMM Weekly Updates on China Aluminium Ingot and Billet Social Inventories as of Apr 20, 2023_SMM
summary: SMM reports China’s aluminium ingot social inventories at 906,000 mt as of Apr 20, down 60,000 mt week-on-week and at the lowest level versus the prior five-year period. Aluminium billet inventories also fell to 152,600 mt, aided by improved warehouse shipments and temporary transport hindrances in Xinjiang.

title: Solis Minerals Ltd.: Solis Announces Exploration Update for Peru Copper Projects
summary: Solis Minerals provided an update on the start of fieldwork for its Peru copper projects, including new Worldview-3 targets at Ilo Este/Ilo Norte and additional concession applications to expand its land position. It plans ground checks and potential drilling after environmental permitting.

title: Norsk Hydro Operations at Aluminum Plants to Resume as Labor Dispute Ends
summary: Norsk Hydro said operations at its Hydro Ardal and Hydro Karmoy aluminum plants and shipments to customers will resume after a labor dispute ended. The prior strike had caused delays, but Hydro expects limited financial consequences. Relief from supply disruption is supportive for near-term aluminium pricing.

title: Comex Copper Settles 1.23% Lower at $4.0220 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex Copper for April delivery settled 1.23% lower at $4.0220, losing 5.00 cents per pound. The contract declined over two consecutive sessions, with the day’s drop the largest since early April, and the settlement at the lowest since April 10, 2023.

title: Codelco sees recovery in copper output with a 17% hike by end of decade -chairman - Stock market news
summary: Codelco’s chairman said the company targets a 17% increase in annual copper production by the end of the decade, to about 1.7 million tonnes. He cited strong demand, project financing, progress at mines and infrastructure updates, and expected operational normalization by July, including links to Los Bronces expansion.

title: Copper industry warns of looming supply gap without more mines - Stock market news
summary: Executives at the World Copper Conference warned supply may fall short of rapidly rising demand for electrification and electronics, with regulatory approvals for new mines at a decade low. Data from the International Copper Association points to a growing deficit even with recycling. Analysts expect copper prices to rise and some substitution into aluminum if shortages bite.

title: Nickel Surplus Weighs On Stainless Steel Prices
summary: The Stainless Monthly Metals Index fell sharply, and the article links continued downside in nickel to a surplus shift reported by the INSG. A 112,000-ton surplus, boosted by Indonesia’s higher production (mostly Class 2), pressures stainless demand sentiment despite lower LME inventories and limited benchmark deliverability.

title: World Copper Ltd.: World Copper Upsizes Financing to $2.1 Million
summary: World Copper Ltd. upsized its financing to about $2.12 million (11,773,333 units) with a second tranche expected around April 28, 2023. Proceeds are for working capital and development. The company is a copper-focused explorer, but the release contains no production or supply changes.

title: Copper industry warns of looming supply gap without more mines
summary: Executives and analysts at the World Copper Conference warn that copper demand for electrification will outpace supply, with mine permitting approvals at the lowest level in a decade. They argue recycling won’t close the gap, implying future tightness and price pressure for copper, and possible substitution into aluminum if shortages emerge.

title: QC Copper and Gold Inc: QC Copper Closes Final Tranche of Private Placement with Quebec-Based Funds
summary: QC Copper and Gold Inc. closed the final tranche of a C$399,999 private placement at C$0.14 per share. Proceeds will fund exploration and development of its Opemiska copper project in Quebec, plus working capital. The release is mainly corporate financing, with no stated production or inventory change.

title: BHP Downgrades Escondida Copper, Nickel Production Guidance for Fiscal Year
summary: BHP downgraded production guidance for its Escondida mine in northern Chile, forecasting lower copper output for the year through June and reducing its annual nickel production estimate, citing heavy rainfall. Despite weaker Escondida copper, BHP kept overall group copper guidance unchanged. Guidance cuts are typically supply-negative.

title: BHP Downgrades Escondida Copper, Nickel Production Guidance for Fiscal Year
summary: BHP cut its FY guidance for Escondida in northern Chile, lowering expected copper output for the year through June to 1.05–1.08 million tons from 1.08–1.18 million. It also trimmed nickel production due partly to heavy rainfall, signaling weaker near-term supply for both metals.

title: BHP iron ore, nickel output slumps
summary: BHP lowered its production targets as its Australian iron ore and coking coal division moves toward the bottom of its ranges. The company also reduced targets for Australian nickel and Chilean copper mines, pointing to weaker near-term supply conditions that may pressure nickel and copper prices.

title: Major mine Capricorn Copper will not be fully operational until 2024 after flood damage
summary: Capricorn Copper’s underground operations were disrupted by unprecedented floods in north-west Queensland, with severe damage including loss of its water treatment plant and large-scale inundation of key tenements. Full usability is not expected until 1H 2024, alongside other mine suspensions, reducing near-term copper supply and raising shortfall risk for exports.

title: SMM Review of Aluminium Alloy Market This Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports aluminium prices near recent highs, supported by expectations of output cuts and declining ingot inventories. Scrap prices rose sharply, keeping secondary alloy production costs high, and ADC12 followed. However, automobile demand stayed weak and transactions were low, so prices are expected to fluctuate narrowly in the near term.

title: Operating Rates of Copper Rod Plants Using Copper Cathode Hit Three-Year High In March_SMM
summary: Operating rates at copper rod producers using copper cathode climbed to a three-year high of 73.77% in March. SMM attributes the rebound to seasonal demand growth in wire/cable and enamelled wire, plus a mid-March copper price drop that spurred downstream orders. Recovery remains below pre-pandemic levels.

title: Policymakers' Hawkish Speeches to Put Pressure on Copper Prices after Price Declines_SMM
summary: SMM reports LME copper at $8,884/mt (down 0.96%) and SHFE 2305 at 68,900 yuan/mt (down 0.83%). Weak US jobs data reinforced recession fears and Fed rate expectations. Spot fell on ample shipments, weak demand, expected warrant sales, and imported inflows, while policymakers’ hawkish remarks weighed on prices.

title: Average Operating Rate at Copper Rod Plants Using Copper Scrap Estimated at 56.08% In April_SMM
summary: SMM estimates copper rod plants using copper scrap will run at a 56.08% average operating rate in April, down 2.67 points month-on-month. Weak real estate demand and high finished inventory are expected to suppress copper rod output, prompting destocking and potential production reductions and product switching.

title: Copper heads for weekly drop on recession fears - Stock market news
summary: Copper slid on Friday and was set for a weekly drop as U.S. data raised recession fears, clouding demand. Three-month LME copper and May SHFE copper both fell. The stronger dollar also weighed on price affordability. LME aluminium was slightly higher while nickel declined.

title: Copper heads for weekly drop on recession fears
summary: Copper fell Friday and is set for a weekly drop as U.S. data sparked recession concerns, weakening outlook for metal demand. The stronger dollar added additional headwind for dollar-priced copper. The piece also notes softer performance in nickel and aluminium contracts alongside copper.

title: Glencore's Q1 copper output dips | MarketScreener
summary: Glencore said it produced 244,100 tonnes of copper in the first quarter. The firm maintained its 2023 production outlook unchanged, suggesting no major revision to broader supply expectations. The quarter’s lower output can still influence near-term sentiment about copper availability and price direction.

title: Copper set for weekly losses amid demand worries - Stock market news
summary: Copper prices edged lower on Friday and were set for weekly losses as recession fears, soft U.S. data, and sluggish Chinese demand pressured the outlook. Rising China refined production and an over-one-year-low Yangshan premium signaled weaker import appetite. LME aluminium and nickel also fell on the same risk-off backdrop.

title: Antofagasta: Any Unexpected Production Shocks will Push up Copper Prices_SMM
summary: Antofagasta’s CEO said the copper market is expected to be volatile, citing a slight supply shortfall. He warned that any unexpected production disruptions would tighten supply further and likely push copper prices higher in the near term.

title: Glencore copper output dips, expects strong trading profit
summary: Glencore’s copper output reportedly dipped, and the company expects strong trading profits. A reduction in near-term copper supply can shift short-term expectations for balance, potentially weighing on copper prices. The profit outlook is not enough to offset the implied output decline within the first weeks.

title: JSE : Copper 360 Limited, Africa's newest copper producer, lists on the JSE
summary: JSE announced Copper 360 Limited’s listing on the AltX Board, describing it as a new South African copper producer based in the Northern Cape with multiple mines and long life-of-mine potential. The piece is mainly corporate/market-access news and provides no near-term supply disruption or output figures.

title: Rio Tinto: Pilbara Iron Ore Shipments Hit All-Time High in the First Quarter, Copper Output at 145,000 mt       _SMM
summary: Rio Tinto reported strong Pilbara iron ore shipments, but also detailed copper performance. Q1 copper concentrate output was 145,000 mt, flat year on year. For 2023, Rio Tinto lowered copper output guidance to 590,000–640,000 mt, citing Kennecott conveyor interruption and Escondida open-pit geotechnical challenges.

title: Glencore reports fall in copper, zinc and nickel output
summary: Glencore said first-quarter copper production fell 5% to 244,100 tonnes due to lower grades and mine delays, while it also reported lower nickel output. It left full-year copper guidance unchanged at 1.04 million tonnes but lifted expectations for trading earnings, suggesting some offset to the near-term supply impact.

title: Glencore reports fall in copper, zinc and nickel output
summary: Glencore said first-quarter copper output fell 5% due to lower grades and mine delays, and it also reported lower nickel production. The company kept full-year copper guidance unchanged but the near-term production weakness can weigh on expectations for prompt supply, adding bearish pressure to copper and nickel prices.

title: Some Japanese aluminium buyers agree to higher April-June premiums
summary: Japan’s aluminium buyers agreed to higher April-June premiums of about $125–$130 per tonne, up from $85–$86 in the prior quarter and the first quarterly increase in six. The rise reflects higher overseas prices and tighter supply, reinforcing the regional premium benchmark tied to LME cash.

title: Aluminium Deutschland warns packaging industry about recyclate shortage
summary: Aluminium Deutschland warns that supply of high-quality post-consumer recyclate for packaging is lagging demand, as EU regulation moves toward higher recycled-content requirements. It notes limited availability of suitable recycled materials, high costs, and production adjustments. The shortage is positioned as supportive for aluminium packaging-related demand.

title: Foreign firms mull $10bln investments in Philippine nickel sector
summary: Foreign firms are considering up to $10 billion in Philippine nickel processing investments, potentially before year-end, aimed at increasing the value of exported nickel. Officials link the shift from raw ore exports to processing for battery-related demand, supporting near-term sentiment for nickel prices; copper is only referenced generally.

title: Goldman Sachs, Trafigura See Copper Price Skyrocketing to All-Time High, Citing Stocking Out_SMM
summary: Goldman Sachs and Trafigura expect LME copper to surge to record levels, citing risk of stocking out if China’s copper imports recover. The piece links the weak early-year price performance to falling Chinese copper imports, notes likely April stabilization, and warns that inventories could run short by year-end amid supply worries.

title: Mining and Metallurgical Norilsk Nickel : Nornickel announces consolidated production results for 1Q 2023
summary: Norilsk Nickel (Nornickel) released consolidated preliminary 1Q 2023 production results. Copper output increased versus the same period last year, while nickel production temporarily declined due to scheduled repairs at Nadezhda Smelter and Talnakh Concentrator. The company also highlighted improved nickel cathode quality and reiterated FY2023 guidance.

title: Mining and Metallurgical Norilsk Nickel : Nornickel announces consolidated production results for 1Q 2023 21 april 2023 0.2 MB
summary: Nornickel reported preliminary 1Q 2023 production results: nickel output fell 9% y/y to 47 kt due to scheduled furnace and grinding mill repairs, while copper output rose 19% y/y to 109 kt. Management reiterated FY2023 guidance, citing operational and logistical risk mitigation and improved nickel cathode quality.

title: Nickel 28 Reminds Shareholders to Reject Pelham's Self-Interested "Mini-Tender" Scheme
summary: Nickel 28 Capital urged shareholders to reject Pelham’s unsolicited mini-tender for shares at roughly no premium. The company links its value to rising electric-vehicle demand for high-grade nickel sulphides from its Ramu nickel-cobalt operation, but the main focus is a corporate action rather than a direct nickel supply/demand change.

title: Copper miner Freeport-McMoRan beats profit estimates - Stock market news
summary: Freeport-McMoRan reported stronger-than-expected profit and cut its annual capex forecast slightly. The miner said average realized copper prices for the quarter were $4.11/lb versus $4.66 a year earlier. The piece also links copper demand hopes to energy transition needs and China’s easing COVID rules.

title: Copper Inventory in China Bonded Zone Dipped This Week but will Grow Next Week_SMM
summary: SMM says China bonded-zone copper inventories fell by 100 mt to 155,700 mt by Apr 21, with Shanghai down and Guangdong up. Weak import profits and low shipments from sellers kept declines slowing. Arrivals under bills of lading should rise next week, and some cargo will shift to Zhejiang, limiting accumulation in Shanghai.

title: Bonded Zone Inventory of Nickel Stays Unchanged from April 14_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports nickel bonded zone inventory in Shanghai holding steady at 4,300 mt as of April 21. Nickel briquettes and plates volumes are also unchanged. The SHFE/LME nickel price ratio declined and the import window stayed closed, indicating tighter near-term flows, though longer-term contracts may raise future arrivals.

title: Norilsk Nickel reports palladium production growth in Q1 — company
summary: Norilsk Nickel said Q1 2023 palladium and platinum output rose, while nickel production fell 9% year on year due to scheduled furnace and mill turnarounds. Copper output increased 19% to 109,000 tons. The company also cited improved nickel cathode quality from operational efficiency.

title: Facing fallout from nickel crisis, LME appoints 'interim' chairman - Stock market news
summary: The LME appointed an interim chairman amid fallout from its 2022 nickel trading suspension, FCA scrutiny, and lawsuits over canceled trades. Industry sources cited uncertainty. The exchange says it will oversee the market as nickel volumes slump and daily price limits remain for nickel, copper, and aluminium trading.

title: Comex Copper Ends the Week 3.10% Lower at $3.9800 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex Copper front-month futures for April delivery settled at $3.9800, down 12.75 cents per pound (-3.10%) for the week and down during most of the past sessions. It fell 1.04% on the day, marked the biggest weekly percentage decline since March 17, and is near the lowest settlement since March 20.

title: Here's what the U.S. plan for EV sales means for critical metals such as copper and lithium
summary: The Biden administration’s proposed vehicle pollution standards aim to electrify a majority of new U.S. vehicle sales within the next decade. If finalized, the policy would increase expected demand for EV “green” metals, including copper and nickel, through higher battery and electrical component requirements.

title: York Harbour Metals Drills 44.93m of 1.292% Copper, Confirms High-Grade Copper-Zinc Mineralization in Phase 4 Drilling Program
summary: York Harbour Metals reported final assay results from Phase 4 drilling at its York Harbour copper-zinc project in Newfoundland, including 44.93m at 1.292% copper and 5.36m at 2.938% copper. The company says results reinforce expansion potential and continues Phase 5 drilling.

title: Demand for copper expected to rise for electric vehicle, green energy needs
summary: The piece argues copper demand should rise as electric vehicles, wind and solar expand, while supply is expected to lag by 2031. It quotes Montana Resources predicting higher copper prices and notes expected copper shortfalls from mine depletion. A Butte cleanup and taxes are mentioned, but the core driver is copper demand tightening.

title: Ero Copper: A copper share, that hardly anyone knows!
summary: The article argues copper is vital for renewables and electric vehicles and references earlier research predicting future copper shortages. It notes copper prices rose modestly over five years with volatility and compares Ero Copper’s stock gains to major peers like BHP and Rio Tinto, without new market-moving events.

title: Butte mines prepare to meet increasing copper demands
summary: The piece says electrification and renewables need substantial copper and argues projected demand growth will outpace supply, citing a forecast supply shortfall by 2031. It quotes Montana Resources noting copper prices above $4/lb historically and expectations of rising prices, implying bullish near-term copper sentiment.

title: BHP Iron Ore Output Hit Record High, Cuts Copper and Nickel Output Forecasts_SMM
summary: BHP’s operating report showed iron ore strength but also reduced guidance for copper and nickel. It cut Escondida’s full-year copper output range to 1.05–1.08 million mt from 1.08–1.18 million mt, citing pit geotechnical challenges. Nickel guidance was lowered to 75,000–85,000 mt due to early-April heavy rainfall.

title: BHP Iron Ore Output Hit Record High, Cuts Copper and Nickel Output Forecasts_SMM
summary: BHP reported Q3 output and updated guidance. It raised/maintained iron ore records, but cut full-year copper guidance for Escondida to 1.05–1.08 million mt and reduced nickel guidance to 75,000–85,000 mt, citing pit geotechnical challenges and heavy rainfall, respectively.

title: Some Japanese Aluminium Buyers Agree To Pay A Premium Of $125-130/mt In The Second Quarter, Soaring 45-53% from Q1_SMM
summary: Japanese aluminium buyers agreed to pay Q2 premiums of $125–130/mt for primary aluminium shipments, up 45–53% from Q1 and above the $85–86/mt premium in January–March. The premium rise exceeds producers’ prior baseline, indicating firmer regional pricing versus LME spot.

title: China Aluminium Scrap Imports Soar YoY in March, with Malaysia Being Top Supplier_SMM
summary: China’s customs data show aluminum scrap (shredded) imports rose in March to 147,882 mt, up 5.22% month-on-month and 36.24% year-on-year. Malaysia remained the top supplier at 22,306 mt, though that was lower versus prior months. Higher scrap inflows can support near-term aluminium supply/demand expectations.

title: China Alumina Imports Plummet In March, With Indonesia Being Top Supplier_SMM
summary: China’s alumina imports fell to 70,008 mt in March, down 61.78% month-on-month and 62.98% year-on-year. Imports from Indonesia, the top supplier, dropped 60.96% month-on-month (to 32,041 mt) despite a large year-on-year increase, implying tighter alumina availability for refiners.

title: Indonesia lures EV carmakers in race to secure nickel supplies
summary: Indonesia is drawing EV carmakers by leveraging its nickel export ban and offering tax holidays and incentives for downstream processing and refining. The policy aims to secure nickel supplies for EV batteries and build an EV manufacturing hub, which can tighten nickel export availability while increasing expectations for nickel demand and conversion capacity.

title: Nickel Ore Inventories at Chinese Ports up 169,000 wmt WoW_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says Chinese nickel ore inventories at seven major ports rose to 6.72mn wmt as of Apr 21, up 169,000 wmt WoW. Total Ni content increased by 53,000 mt. NPI prices firmed to 1,100 yuan/mt, supported by stable ore prices, but rising inventories and less spot shipping may keep inventory trends upward.

title: ING sues ICBC for copper deal losses, seeks $170m in damages: FT
summary: ING is suing ICBC for alleged contract breaches over copper transactions, claiming ICBC released export documents without collecting payment, causing ING losses and contributing to payment delays affecting Maike’s copper trading. Maike is seeking restructuring after liquidity strain and delayed imported copper payments, though scope of physical impact is unclear.

title: Alumina Prices Have Shown No Signs of Stabilising_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports the weighted alumina index at 2,898 yuan/mt, down 15 yuan/mt on the week, with declines across multiple Chinese provinces. Refineries in south China face stronger selling pressure than those in the north amid persistent alumina oversupply. SMM expects alumina prices to keep trending down in the short term.

title: Slack Demand Prevented Secondary Aluminium Alloy Prices From Gaining As Much As Aluminium Scrap Prices_SMM
summary: SMM reports A00 aluminium rising to a four-month high before a slight retreat, while aluminium scrap and extrusion scrap also increased. Higher scrap prices encouraged more selling, but downstream restocking stayed limited due to weak demand and poor profitability. Secondary alloys like ADC12 followed with smaller gains and limited upside momentum.

title: Overseas Alumina Prices to See Limited Downside Room on Delayed Production Resumptions at Alcoa's Kwinana Refinery _SMM
summary: Overseas alumina prices fell but are expected to have limited downside as Alcoa extended output cuts at its Kwinana refinery. The 2.19 Mt/yr plant will keep reductions due to prolonged mine review and approvals. Prior cuts of 438,000 t/yr occurred from natural gas shortages.

title: Alumina Prices Go Down In A Buyer's Market_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports alumina purchases by southwest China aluminium smelters falling 20 yuan/mt to 2,800 yuan/mt as buyers gained bargaining power. North China refineries run at low rates, limiting finished inventory. In Yunnan, capacity has been curtailed due to power rationing, with potential further cuts and local refinery sell-off pressuring spot prices.

title: Pure Nickel Social Inventory Adds 161 mt WoW_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data shows China’s pure nickel inventory rose to 4,936 mt (+161 WoW) alongside higher nickel briquette stocks (+380) and lower nickel plate stocks (-220). Spot nickel prices continued rising, while downstream demand stayed cautious. The closed import window limited new supply, and briquettes may flow into the market from active salt factories.

title: Nickel Sulphate Prices to Rebound in the Near Term_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports battery-grade nickel sulphate prices in Shanghai fell WoW but the decline slowed due to a wider gap between buyer offers and seller quotes and weak demand from ternary precursor producers. Salt plants held prices despite losses risk. A larger nickel sulphate–pure nickel spread drew traders, and a near-term rebound is expected.

title: Nickel Ore Prices Fall Slowly Last Week with the Improvement in Downstream Demand_SMM
summary: SMM reports Ni 1.5% ore averaging $50/wmt CIF, down $2/wmt week on week, as Philippine mine shipments stay low and tighten China’s supply. NPI plants have increased buying as NPI prices rebound to 1,100 yuan/mt. Despite potential upside from rising NPI, SMM expects short-term ore prices to remain stable.

title: Smelters' Profits Improve as Aluminium Prices Exceed 19,000 yuan/mt_SMM
summary: SMM reports that alumina prices fell, cutting smelters’ real-time full costs to 16,888 yuan/mt. Meanwhile, SMM A00 aluminium prices rose 340 yuan/mt to 19,030 yuan/mt, expanding smelters’ profits by 363 yuan/mt to 2,142 yuan/mt. Costs are expected to drop slowly amid a bearish raw-material outlook.

title: Spot Nickel Transactions Picks up Slightly Today amid Dropping SHFE Nickel Prices in Early Trading_SMM
summary: SMM reports April 24 spot nickel premiums: Jinchuan nickel averaged 4,600 yuan/mt (down 300), while NORNICKEL averaged 4,550 yuan/mt (down 150). Although the gap between Jinchuan and NORNICKEL narrowed, spot trading rose slightly as SHFE nickel futures fell. Nickel briquette transactions remained slack amid premiums over nickel sulphate.

title: Spot Copper Concentrate TCs Rose Further_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says the imported copper concentrate index rose to $84.36/mt and traded TCs were near $85/mt, while offers for June shipments from Escondida and Collahuasi were around $81–82/mt. Q2 TCs are expected to keep rising as maintenance reduces spot demand, inventories fell, and supply recovers with new Chile output.

title: Kazakhstan: Copper Production in First Quarter Fell 14.5% Year-On-Year_SMM
summary: Kazakhstan’s statistics bureau reported that copper cathode production fell 14.5% year-on-year in Q1 to 104,734 mt. March output rose versus February but remained down versus last year. Major producers include KAZ Minerals and Glencore’s Kazzinc, making the decline meaningful for regional supply sentiment.

title: Philippines' Nickel Asia to open additional 2 mines, eyes IPO for power unit
summary: Reuters reports Nickel Asia plans to open two additional mines, ramp nickel ore production from Bulanjao, Manicani, Dinapigue and develop Kepha, targeting at least 6 million WMT annually. The Philippines seeks more domestic processing for stainless steel and EV battery supply. Last year’s nickel ore sales fell due to weather.

title: China demand blues push copper to lowest in more than two weeks - Stock market news
summary: Copper prices dropped to a more than two-week low as markets focused on weak demand in China, with manufacturing activity growing slower than expected and inventory overhang weighing on purchases. The article also notes aluminium and nickel easing, while a softer dollar limited losses overall.

title: SMM Daily Comments (Apr 24): SHFE Base Metals Dropped With Nickel Tumbling, Ferrous Metals Prices Slumped_SMM
summary: SMM notes continued weakness in crude oil futures and a rebound in the US dollar index. By intraday close, SHFE prices fell across base metals: nickel -3.24%, aluminium -0.92%, and copper -0.78% (with others also down). The macro backdrop is bearish for metals near term.

title: Weekly Average Discount of High-Grade NPI Stand at 889 yuan/mtu Against Refined Nickel Last Week_SMM
summary: SMM reports high-grade NPI trading at an average discount of 889 yuan/mtu versus refined nickel, widening by 51 yuan/mtu week-on-week. Refined nickel prices rose sharply on futures strength and limited spot availability for warrant delivery. Electrowinning producers may profit; stainless mills restock NPI and prices are expected stable with occasional gains.

title: China demand blues push copper to lowest in more than two weeks
summary: Copper prices fell to the lowest in over two weeks as markets focused on lacklustre demand in top consumer China and slower-than-expected manufacturing activity after COVID restrictions eased. The Yangshan premium weakened further. Aluminium also slid, amid LME warrant cancellation at Gwangyang tied to a build-up of Russian metal.

title: Nickel Asia Corp announces two new mines in Philippines
summary: Nickel Asia Corp says it will expand nickel operations in the Philippines with two new mines and may add a third processing plant, including investigation of a HPAL facility. It cites prior weather and shipping disruptions reducing 2022 output, while projecting industry growth and potential demand shifts from reduced Russian supply.

title: LME brokers see big gains in 2022 from volatility after nickel debacle
summary: Reuters reports that LME brokers and banks benefited in 2022 from volatility following the LME nickel crisis, when nickel prices spiked and trading was temporarily shut. Broker volumes and trading activity shifted, but the story emphasizes past results and a JP Morgan provision rather than new drivers for current nickel prices.

title: Copper deals frenzy doesn't resolve supply issues | Hotter Commodities
summary: Copper is seeing renewed M&A activity, with bids and negotiations highlighted around companies like Teck. Speakers argue anticipated demand growth tied to the energy transition clashes with limited near-term project additions, leaving supply growth constrained. The piece suggests this backdrop supports higher expectations for copper prices despite M&A not adding new units.

title: High copper prices leads to thieves ripping wiring from tractors, farmers say
summary: Farmers in Queensland report a rise in organised copper wiring theft from tractors and other equipment, attributing it to high copper scrap prices. Police are focusing on copper theft and farmers are increasing security. The piece cites copper futures levels and scrap yard buy prices, but provides no global supply impact.

title: Comex Copper Settles 0.68% Lower at $3.9530 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper for April delivery settled 0.68% lower at $3.9530 per pound, losing for the fourth straight session. The contract is down 3.34% over four sessions, with the lowest settlement since March 17, and remains below recent peaks, reinforcing bearish near-term momentum for copper.

title: Major supply gap in copper industry is threatening the transition to green energy
summary: The report warns of a major copper supply gap as mined output growth lags demand driven by electrification, EVs, renewables, and grid build-out. It cites tight market conditions, mine slowdowns in Chile and Peru, declining ore grades, and weaker permitting for new projects, implying stronger near-term upward pressure on copper prices.

title: ASX BHP: BHP appoints South Australian copper tsar Michelle Ash
summary: BHP appoints former Barrick Gold executive Michelle Ash as vice president of growth to drive development of a copper “province” in South Australia after BHP’s takeover of OZ Minerals. The role focuses on growth strategy, but the article provides no immediate production or supply changes that would likely move copper prices.

title: LME copper edges higher as softer dollar lends support - Stock market news
summary: Benchmark LME copper edged up on a softer U.S. dollar, but traders stayed cautious amid concerns over China’s lacklustre demand and uncertainty ahead of the Fed meeting. Meanwhile, LME aluminium fell and nickel dropped more sharply, highlighting mixed momentum across industrial metals.

title: On Earth Day, Vedanta Aluminium Unveils New Material Recovery Facility At Jharsuguda To Encourage Circular Economy
summary: Vedanta Aluminium unveiled a new material recovery facility at its Jharsuguda site to support a circular economy by improving recovery of materials for reuse/recycling. The project is expected to increase the availability of recycled inputs over time, which may modestly soften near-term aluminium price expectations.

title: Copper Prices Went Down as Market Awaiting US Economy Result, and will Face a Lot of Pressure amid Rate Hike Expectations_SMM
summary: LME and SHFE copper prices fell modestly as markets awaited key US economic data and focused on expectations for a Fed rate hike next week. SMM data showed Chinese copper inventories dropped to 176,900 mt, aided by downstream replenishment, but rate-hike expectations are framed as the main near-term pressure.

title: Copper Prices in North China to Move Upward_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: North China spot copper quotes edged up last week, with average discounts narrowing. Cargoes delivered in Shanghai expected to be sold to north China supported prices, while discounted selloffs weighed briefly. End-of-week downstream buying stabilized quotes, and further mild upward movement is expected if copper prices do not decline this week.

title: Spot Copper Prices in Shandong to Rebound_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Spot copper in Shandong saw sharp volatility last week. Prices rose after April contract delivery but later fell as smelters sold large cargo volumes and downstream buyers rejected higher quotes. Discounts narrowed to 150 yuan/mt by last Friday, and the article expects Shandong spot copper prices to rebound this week.

title: Anglo American's first-quarter copper output rises - Stock market news
summary: Anglo American reported first-quarter production of 178,000 tonnes of copper, up 28% versus the prior year. The company also cited a 59% rise in steelmaking coal output to 3.5 million tonnes. The higher copper output may shift short-term supply expectations for copper markets.

title: Copper muted as traders weigh China demand, eye data before Fed meeting - Stock market news
summary: Copper prices were subdued in Asian trade amid concerns over weak China demand and caution ahead of upcoming U.S. economic data and the Fed meeting. A softer U.S. dollar offered some support. LME aluminium and nickel fell on the day, while Shanghai showed mixed moves, reflecting choppy near-term sentiment.

title: Century Aluminum Company to Acquire 55% Interest in Jamalco Alumina Refinery
summary: Century Aluminum Company announced plans to acquire a 55% interest in the Jamalco alumina refinery. Because alumina is the primary feedstock for aluminium smelting, the deal can strengthen expectations around aluminium refining and supply continuity, supporting near-term price sentiment for aluminium over the coming weeks.

title: Century Aluminum Company to Acquire 55% Interest in Jamalco
summary: Century Aluminum agreed to buy Noble’s 55% interest in Jamalco, a Jamaica bauxite mining and alumina production joint venture. The acquisition aims to secure predictable alumina supply for its smelting operations, improving integration and supply-chain control. Transaction was expected to close by end-April 2023.

title: Anglo American's copper output up 28% in first quarter
summary: Anglo American said copper production rose 28% in the first quarter to 178,100 tonnes, mainly due to the ramp-up of its newly opened Quellaveco mine in Peru. The higher output suggests increased near-term copper supply, which can weigh on expectations for copper prices over coming weeks.

title: Aussie down broadly following free fall in Copper
summary: The report says the Australian dollar is weaker mainly due to a sharp drop in copper. It highlights accelerating copper declines, expects deeper fall toward support levels as resistance holds, and warns that further breakdown could extend losses to lower chart targets. It also links currency moves to risk and upcoming CPI/RBA.

title: Horizonte Minerals (TSX:HZM) Progressing Steadily with Araguaia Nickel Mine in Northern Brazil
summary: Horizonte Minerals says its Araguaia nickel project in northern Brazil is progressing, with Line 1 50% complete and production expected to start in Q1 2024. Pre-stripping and ore stockpiling are planned later in the year, targeting initial output of 14,500 tonnes nickel per annum.

title: Comex Copper Settles 2.71% Lower at $3.8460 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex Copper’s front-month contract for April delivery settled 2.71% lower at $3.8460, down 10.70 cents per pound. The move extends a five-session losing streak, marks the largest one-day decline since mid-March, and pushes copper to the lowest settlement value since early January 2023.

title: Axing aluminium from the Critical Raw Materials list was a mistake
summary: The article criticizes the European Commission for excluding aluminium from the EU’s Strategic/critical raw materials listings, arguing it sends the wrong signal and risks further erosion of European aluminium capacity. It cites rising demand, high power prices that have idled output, and calls for policy tools including lower electricity costs and PPAs.

title: Copper Prices Went Down and Will Have Guidance from US Economic Report_SMM
summary: LME copper fell 2.46% to $8,528.5/mt and SHFE copper ended down 1.92% amid banking/US growth worries, a stronger dollar and risk aversion. Import losses narrowed but concerns about incoming copper remain. Tepid domestic demand and waiting for US economic data/Fed guidance keep copper under pressure near term.

title: Nickel Prices to Gain Weaker Support from Pure Nickel Supply Tightness_SMM
summary: SMM reports that Russian nickel cleared recently and flowed into China, easing the imported pure nickel supply shortage and cutting NORNICKEL nickel premiums. NPI supply remains limited but invisible inventory may be released, with traders shipping at lower levels. Demand is soft as stainless futures gains did not translate to higher spot demand, weakening nickel support.

title: Nickel Outlook 2022
summary: The piece says Putin is mulling export limits covering uranium, nickel, and titanium in response to Western sanctions. If nickel-related export restrictions are implemented, they would likely reduce supply available to global buyers and lift expectations for tighter near-term nickel availability, supporting prices.

title: Antilles kicks off Cuban copper-gold drilling campaign
summary: Antilles Gold has begun a 7,000m drilling campaign at its El Pilar copper-gold oxide deposit in Cuba, aiming to build a maiden mineral resource and potentially advance to a scoping study for a small open-pit mine. Recent assays reported multiple copper intervals alongside gold.

title: EGA, Recapp to boost aluminium recycle in schools & universities
summary: EGA and Recapp plan to boost aluminium recycling in schools and universities, aiming to increase the collection and reuse of aluminium scrap via education-linked programs. More recycled material availability can support aluminium feedstock supply and improve sentiment toward aluminium prices over the coming weeks.

title: Hannan Metals Ltd.: Hannan Commences Geophysical Surveys on the Cerro Rolando Copper Porphyry Project in Chile
summary: Hannan Metals says it has started ground geophysical surveys (magnetics followed by potential EM) at the Cerro Rolando copper porphyry project in northern Chile to define drill targets. The work is aimed at permitting and drilling later in 2023. No production or supply disruption is indicated.

title: Teck Raises Construction Cost for Flagship Copper Mine Again
summary: Teck reportedly raised construction costs again for its flagship copper mine. Higher capex can delay ramp-up and increase expected supply tightness if the project faces execution or financing constraints, which can weigh on near-term copper sentiment.

title: PAN GLOBAL COMMENCES DRILLING AT CAÑADA HONDA COPPER-GOLD TARGET IN THE ESCACENA PROJECT, SPAIN
summary: Pan Global Resources announced drilling at the Cañada Honda copper-gold target in Spain’s Escacena project, following an IP survey. Drill hole CHD02 intersected 11m of 0.6% copper (plus gold/silver) but collapsed before reaching the main gravity target; drilling continues on other holes.

title: UAE Business: EGA, Recapp to boost aluminium recycle in schools & universities
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) partners with Recapp by Veolia to install aluminium recycling drop-off points in UAE schools and universities and promote greater collection of scrap. EGA also founded an Aluminium Recycling Coalition and plans a large recycling facility, supporting increased secondary aluminium supply.

title: Is the world running out of copper | Regina Leader Post
summary: A podcast interview cites a sharp decline in major copper discoveries since the 1990s, falling to an average of 1.9 discoveries per year in 2010–2019. It discusses why new discoveries are harder to find and how this could influence mining companies’ strategies and the supply outlook for electrification.

title: SPC Nickel Reports Positive New Assay Results from the West Graham Nickel and Copper Project, Sudbury, Ontario
summary: SPC Nickel announced positive new assay results from its West Graham nickel and copper project in Sudbury, Ontario. Improved assay outcomes can strengthen confidence in the project’s potential resource base, which typically supports market sentiment toward future nickel and copper supply, though it is not immediate production.

title: SPC Nickel Reports Positive New Assay Results from the West Graham Nickel and Copper Project, Sudbury, Ontario
summary: SPC Nickel said it has received positive new assay results from its West Graham nickel and copper project in Sudbury, Ontario. The update is an encouraging exploration development that can lift market sentiment toward future nickel and copper supply, though near-term price impact is likely limited given project-stage uncertainty.

title: Copper recovers but global growth concerns cap gains
summary: LME copper rose 0.7% after a weaker dollar supported prices, but weak Chinese demand and global growth worries capped gains; LME on-warrant stocks increased to a six-week high. Aluminium also edged up despite warehouse inflows, while nickel rose despite a surplus expected to widen this year.

title: Norsk Hydro to supply Porsche with low-carbon aluminium
summary: Norsk Hydro signed with Porsche to supply low-carbon aluminium starting this year, marketed under the REDUXA brand from Norwegian smelters powered by renewables. The deal targets a roughly 60% lower CO2 footprint versus Europe’s average primary aluminium and supports Porsche’s net carbon goals, potentially boosting demand for green aluminium.

title: Mining Stock News: Bolt Metals (CSE: BOLT) Announces New Agreement for Conditional Sale of Cyclops Project
summary: Bolt Metals announced a conditional deal for Nickel Industries Limited to acquire 100% of the Cyclops nickel-cobalt project in Indonesia, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals and reinstatement/extension of the mining permit. Previous permit revocation delayed the prior agreement. Deal completion could shape near-term nickel supply expectations, but timing is uncertain.

title: Comex Copper Settles 0.10% Higher at $3.8500 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex copper front-month settled 0.10% higher at $3.8500, gaining 0.40 cent per pound and snapping a five-session losing streak. The piece frames the move as the largest one-day dollar and percentage gain since April 18, though copper remains down month-to-date and vs. recent highs.

title: Southern Copper : SCC Conference Call 1Q2023 details
summary: Southern Copper Corporation announced details for its 1Q-2023 results conference call and replay. The company is a major integrated copper producer operating in Mexico and Peru. While upcoming commentary can affect short-term copper price expectations via production or guidance, this notice contains no specific copper market or operational figures.

title: Newcrest 3Q Gold, Copper Output Falls; Benefits From Higher Prices
summary: Newcrest said its fiscal third-quarter copper production fell to 31,148 metric tons from 34,564 in the prior quarter. The company expects higher throughput and a lower maintenance schedule to lift output in the June quarter, but the reported decline may add short-term downward pressure on copper sentiment.

title: Sandfire Resources days away from first copper concentrate production at Motheo in Botswana
summary: Sandfire Resources is reported to be days away from producing its first copper concentrate from the Motheo project in Botswana. The milestone implies a near-term increase in copper concentrate supply, which can influence market expectations for availability and support copper sentiment in the coming days.

title: PCG: Chinese vessel carrying 55-MT nickel ore ran aground off Eastern Samar
summary: A Chinese-flagged bulk carrier carrying 55,000 metric tons of nickel ore ran aground off Guiuan in Eastern Samar after strong waves. Authorities initiated assessments, found no leakage, and are preparing for a Singapore salvage team to transfer the cargo to a barge and remove the ship, potentially delaying shipments to China.

title: Philippines to woo investors in nickel ore processing: minister
summary: Philippines’ environment minister said the country is seeking investors to expand domestic nickel ore processing to capture more value from its metal resources. The Philippines is already a major nickel ore supplier to China, but the policy aims to move up the value chain, with limited immediate changes mentioned.

title: Copper eases on tepid China demand, interest rate worries - Stock market news
summary: Copper prices fell as investors weighed worries about higher U.S. rates, a weaker-than-expected demand rebound from China, and risk-off sentiment linked to banking sector troubles. It cites softer Chinese profit trends and holiday-related demand weakness. LME aluminium and nickel also edged down modestly.

title: Copper Prices can Hardly Recover Remarkably, Fluctuated at Low Levels as Market Awaiting Fed Interest Rate Decision_SMM
summary: The article reports LME copper at $8,529/mt and SHFE 2306 at 66,880 yuan/mt, noting low-level trading and subdued recovery prospects. It links price movements to a softer USD and stronger pre-holiday stockpiling, but highlights concerns about upcoming import supply, cautious demand, and uncertainty ahead of the Fed rate decision.

title: Glencore Buys Stakes in Brazilian Aluminum Companies for $775 Million
summary: Glencore agreed to buy 30% of Alunorte SA and 45% of Mineracao Rio do Norte from Norsk Hydro for $775 million, gaining long-term offtake rights. Alunorte refines alumina and MRN mines bauxite in Brazil, giving Glencore exposure to low-quartile carbon alumina. Regulatory approval is required and completion is in H2.

title: New Sandfire boss says good copper assets hard to find
summary: Sandfire’s new boss says copper assets are scarce and the company is seeking growth opportunities, including a major mine up for sale near its Motheo project in Botswana. The remarks reflect heightened acquisition interest in copper, but no specific transaction or production-impact details are provided.

title: Gladiator Metals Corp.: Gladiator Metals Samples 12.5m @ 8.02% Copper at Cowley Park and Commences Drilling at the Whitehorse Copper Project
summary: Gladiator Metals reported assay results from early drilling at its Whitehorse Copper Project (Cowley Park), including 12.5m @ 8.02% Cu and 8.84m @ 1.59% Cu, and commenced a 3,000m diamond drill program plus ongoing core logging of ~10,000m. The update may influence copper sentiment but not near-term supply.

title: Doctor Copper calls in sick in China as metal makers cut production - Stock market news
summary: China copper demand is weakening as orders for copper plates, rods and strips fall and manufacturers cut offers amid softer property, auto and export activity. Operating rates for copper product lines drop sharply in April, reinforcing recession fears and weighing on copper prices after recent declines to one-month lows.

title: Copper wire thefts are on the rise in San Joaquin County
summary: San Joaquin County officials report a sharp rise in copper wire thefts, with 48 phone lines cut in four days and a 139% increase over four months. Theft disrupts 911 and hospital communications. Law enforcement and AT&T are pursuing offenders and recyclers, offering rewards and considering new ordinances.

title: Copper fundamentals support current price levels | Hotter Commodities
summary: Interview commentary at CESCO week says copper fundamentals remain supportive: supply risk and revisions (including Codelco) imply a small refined-copper deficit in 2023, with 2–3% demand growth expected. Physical uptake is described as robust despite softer premiums, and permitting uncertainty could slow supply additions.

title: Has copper demand been unaffected by financing costs and volatility? | Hotter Commodities
summary: Financing costs rose amid inflation and banking stress after the failure of two US regional banks and Credit Suisse’s sale to UBS. Copper demand has not yet seen major disruption, but higher financing costs have begun affecting the European refined copper market. Chile’s mining costs are also sharply higher and uncertain rain drives output guidance.

title: Copper sector M&A inevitable, but not central to Freeport, CEO says | Hotter Commodities
summary: Freeport CEO Richard Adkerson says the company remains focused on organic copper growth rather than using M&A as a strategy, while acknowledging deal-making is inevitable industry-wide. He highlights expected steady copper output and projects such as leaching technology, expansions in Arizona, and Indonesia initiatives, with regulatory monitoring in Chile.

title: Glencore Bolsters Aluminum Position in $1.1 Billion Deal (1)
summary: Glencore and Hydro said Glencore will buy 30% of the Alunorte alumina refinery and acquire 45% stakes in bauxite producer Mineracao Rio do Norte, in a $1.1 billion deal. Hydro will buy 40% of MRN from Vale and sell it to Glencore. The transaction boosts aluminum feedstock access.

title: Shanghai upgrades investment, engineering projects with partners in Singapore, Indonesia
summary: Shanghai’s visits led to new investment and engineering deals with Singapore and Indonesia. In Jakarta, Shanghai Decent Investment signed a framework agreement with Nickel Industries Limited on Project Excelsior in PT Indonesia Morowali Industrial Park, supporting nickel-related development and improving near-term supply expectations, though likely only modestly for prices.

title: Vale Agrees to Sell Bauxite-Producer Stake to Norsk Hydro Unit
summary: Vale agreed to sell its 40% stake in Brazil’s Mineração Rio do Norte SA, the country’s biggest bauxite producer and exporter, to Norsk Hydro’s unit Ananke Alumina for an undisclosed amount, subject to regulatory approval. The divestment is framed as portfolio simplification with limited detail on production impacts.

title: Intrepid Metals Corp.: Intrepid Metals Acquires Additional Mining Claims at Corral Copper Project in Arizona
summary: Intrepid Metals says it acquired 22 additional unpatented lode mining claims, adding 472.5 acres to its Corral Copper Project in Arizona. The project remains an advanced-stage exploration asset with trenching and sampling work planned, but the release provides no immediate production impact for copper.

title: Copper hits six-week low on China demand and recession fears
summary: Copper prices fell to a six-week low as weak Chinese demand signals (falling industrial profits, reduced output for Q2 peak season) and recession fears in Western economies weighed on industrial metals. It also flags holiday-driven demand softness and notes LME aluminium also dropped while nickel rose slightly.

title: Bolt Metals Announces New Agreement for Conditional Sale of Cyclops Project
summary: Bolt Metals announced a conditional agreement for Nickel Industries to acquire 100% of the Cyclops nickel-cobalt project in Papua, Indonesia. The transaction depends on shareholder/regulatory approvals and reinstatement and extension of the mining permit (IUP) after it was revoked. Nickel ore shipment timing affects final payments, linking progress to supply expectations.

title: KCRA Today: Copper wire thefts threaten emergency services, Warriors beat Kings, Roseville semiconductor investment
summary: KCRA reports a 139% rise in copper wire thefts in San Joaquin County over the last four months, with 48 lines cut in four days alone. Officials say the thefts threaten emergency services, implying disrupted copper infrastructure and increased copper diversion into theft/scrap channels.

title: Copper rebounds from near four-month low on China, strong dollar - Stock market news
summary: Copper prices rebounded from a near four-month low after U.S. inflation data strengthened the dollar and weighed on demand concerns, especially in China. Despite early pressure, risk-on sentiment from U.S. stocks supported buying. Aluminium edged slightly lower, while nickel rose.

title: Bucks can't take the Heat | 101 WIXX | Your Hit Music Station
summary: Comex copper futures for the May front-month delivery settled 0.29% higher at $3.8645 per pound, following two consecutive sessions of gains. The write-up notes the move was the largest one-day dollar and percentage gain since April 18, 2023, while also giving context versus recent highs and lows.

title: Comex Copper Settles 0.29% Higher at $3.8645 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex Copper futures for May delivery settled 0.29% higher at $3.8645 per pound, gaining 1.10 cents. The contract is up for two sessions and marks the largest one-day dollar and percentage gain since April 18, though it remains below recent highs and shows mixed month-to-date performance.

title: Copper rebounds from near four-month low on China, strong dollar
summary: Copper prices rebounded from a four-month low as U.S. economic data boosted the dollar but later gains in U.S. stocks and risk appetite encouraged buying. The piece cites fragile China industrial demand, with firms cutting output into the May holiday. LME aluminum edged lower while nickel rose.

title: Codelco to focus on organic copper growth, ready to be Chile's champion for lithium | Hotter Commodities
summary: Codelco says it will focus on “organic” copper growth via new structural projects despite aging mines and lower output, and highlights project execution risks and higher capex. The piece also notes Fastmarkets’ forecast of a refined copper deficit, reinforcing expectations of near-term copper tightness.

title: Electric Royalties Ltd.: Electric Royalties Closes Kenbridge Nickel Royalty Acquisition
summary: Electric Royalties Ltd. announced the closing of its acquisition of a 0.5% gross revenue royalty on the Kenbridge Nickel Project in Ontario, with options to acquire additional royalty interests. The deal supports the company’s nickel exposure for EV battery demand, but it does not indicate immediate supply or demand changes for nickel.

title: World Copper Ltd.: World Copper Closes Financing
summary: World Copper Ltd. announced closing a second tranche of a private financing, issuing 3.33 million units for about $600k gross proceeds, with proceeds earmarked for general working capital and development costs. The company is a copper-focused explorer; no production or supply-impact events are stated.

title: Column: Nickel faces huge supply glut as Indonesian output booms
summary: The Reuters column says Indonesia’s rapidly expanding nickel production is overwhelming demand, with the INSG forecasting a 239,000-tonne supply surplus—the largest in a decade. Although Class I LME stocks are falling, the glut is expected to pressure nickel pricing as intermediates and nickel chemicals grow faster than exchange-traded metal.

title: Egypt Plans To Build A 600,000 Mt/Year Aluminium Smelter_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Egyptian Metal Construction Company plans to spend about $2.7 billion to build a 600,000 mt/year aluminium smelter to serve local demand and exports. The firm is in discussions with potential partners and studying locations in Port Said and Egypt’s Red Sea economic zone, but no near-term commissioning date is given.

title: Japanese Buyers Finalise Aluminium Premiums In The Second Quarter_SMM
summary: Japanese buyers agreed a higher primary aluminium premium for the April–June quarter at $125–130/ton, up 45–53% versus the previous quarter, with other parts of Asia also rising. Japan’s premiums are a regional standard over LME cash, reflecting stronger near-term aluminium physical pricing.

title: Copper set for biggest monthly loss since June 2022 on demand woes
summary: Reuters reports copper is on track for its biggest monthly loss since June 2022, pressured by global headwinds and weak demand from China. It cites lower-than-expected April demand, mixed indicators, property weakness, and only limited offset from supply headwinds and opportunistic buying.

title: Aluminium producer Norsk Hydro's Q1 core profit falls less than expected
summary: Norsk Hydro reported Q1 core profit falling less than expected. The company attributed weaker results to aluminium price declines this year, driven by China boosting production and concerns about global economic slowdown. Hydro expects the aluminium market to be largely balanced in 2023, though risks remain around potential curtailments and supply disruptions.

title: Stellantis Signs Offtake Agreement and Invests in Alliance Nickel for Battery Grade Nickel and Cobalt Sulphate
summary: Stellantis reportedly signed an offtake agreement and invested in an alliance supplying battery-grade nickel and cobalt sulphate. The deal suggests additional secured supply demand for battery nickel, which can support near-term nickel prices as market expectations improve for EV-related metal consumption.

title: Indonesia to allow Freeport, Amman Mineral to ship copper concentrate to 2024 - Stock market news
summary: Indonesia plans to ban exports of unprocessed minerals like copper concentrate in June to boost downstream investment, but it will allow Freeport and Amman to continue shipping copper concentrate until May 2024. The delay, tied to smelter construction setbacks, should raise near-term supply expectations and pressure copper prices.

title: Stellantis Teams Up With Alliance Nickel for Battery Raw-Material Supplies
summary: Stellantis said it agreed with Australia’s Alliance Nickel to secure battery-grade nickel and cobalt sulphate supplies. The carmaker will take an 11.5% stake and has an offtake deal for 170,000 tons of nickel sulphate and 12,000 tons of cobalt sulphate over an initial five-year period from NiWest.

title: Stellantis, Australia's Alliance Nickel ink deal for battery elements supply
summary: Stellantis signed a binding offtake with Australia’s Alliance Nickel to supply 170,000 tons of nickel sulphate over five years, supporting battery materials for EVs. The deal follows broader concerns after Chile’s lithium nationalisation plans, but the immediate, direct impact is increased expected demand for nickel sulphate.

title: Indonesia to allow Freeport, Amman Mineral to ship copper concentrate until 2024
summary: Indonesia will allow Freeport Indonesia and Amman Mineral Nusa Tenggara to export copper concentrate until May 2024, despite a June export ban on raw minerals. The government cites delays in smelter construction and expects completion next year. It hints there will likely be no leniency for bauxite exports, affecting aluminium raw-material sentiment.

title: Pure Nickel Bonded Zone Inventory Stands Flat from Apr 21_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reported that China’s pure nickel bonded zone inventory was flat at 4,300 mt as of April 28, including 1,370 mt of briquettes and 2,930 mt of plates. The SHFE/LME nickel ratio fell and the import window stayed closed, but some spots were still shipped domestically, easing supply tightness.

title: Glencore beefs up industrial aluminium activities | Hotter Commodities
summary: Glencore is expanding its industrial aluminium exposure, including deals across bauxite and alumina assets. The piece also notes its major Rusal/EN+ primary aluminium supply agreement ends in 2024 amid tighter Russia-biz pressure. These developments can affect near-term expectations for aluminium supply and availability in trading markets.

title: Fathom Nickel Inc.: Fathom Nickel Announces $2 Million Private Placement Including Strategic Participation by Crescat Capital LLC
summary: Fathom Nickel announced a C$2m private placement, including Crescat’s participation, to fund follow-up exploration at its Gochager Lake nickel project. The company highlights high-grade nickel intercepts that also contain copper and cobalt, but no near-term production or supply changes are indicated.

title: Stellantis (STLA) signs offtake agreement, invests in Alliance Nickel
summary: Stellantis and Alliance Nickel signed a binding offtake agreement for about 170,000 tons of nickel sulphate over an initial five-year period from the NiWest project in Western Australia, with prices linked to nickel indices. Stellantis also invests in Alliance Nickel, supporting demand expectations for nickel sulphate supply.

title: Copper steady but remains set for monthly loss
summary: Copper prices steadied on the LME after China pledged to boost growth, but weak demand and recession/banking-stress fears capped gains. The contract faces its biggest monthly loss since June. SHFE copper inventories fell sharply, while aluminium and nickel posted smaller gains and losses respectively.

title: 2 dead in collapsed dump site at Indonesia nickel plant
summary: Two people died after a nickel waste dump site collapsed at China-owned PT IMIP in Indonesia’s Sulawesi. Dump trucks were engulfed by black sludge-like material. Investigations are underway into a crack that caused the collapse and potential negligence, adding near-term operational and regulatory risk for nickel smelting.

title: Copper Inventories in China Bonded Zone Increased This Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show China’s bonded copper inventories rose by 2,900 mt to 158,600 mt as of April 28, with gains in Guangdong and Shanghai zones. Cancelled LME warrants and post–Labour Day arrivals increase supply, while the closed import window limits inventory drawdowns, likely pressuring copper prices.

title: SMM INE Copper Comments (Apr 28): Prices Rebounded, Fed to Raise Interest Rates by 25 Basis Points in May_SMM
summary: SMM notes that the most active July copper contract on the Shanghai INE rebounded to 59,660 yuan/mt (+0.95%). Macro panic has eased after weaker US real GDP, while core PCE surprised higher, reinforcing expectations for a 25 bp Fed rate hike in May, supporting near-term trading sentiment for copper.

title: Stellantis Signs Offtake Agreement and Invests in Alliance Nickel for Battery-grade Nickel and Cobalt Sulphate
summary: Stellantis agreed to a binding offtake for battery-grade nickel sulphate (170,000 tons over five years) linked to nickel index prices, covering about 40% of NiWest’s forecast annual production. It also invested in Alliance Nickel, reinforcing secured demand for battery materials and supporting nickel market sentiment.

title: Tech-rooted groups seek to shake up San Francisco politics
summary: Stellantis signed a binding offtake agreement with Alliance Nickel for about 170,000 tons of battery-grade nickel and 12,000 tons of cobalt sulphate over five years, roughly 40% of NiWest forecast output. Nickel sulphate pricing is linked to index prices, reinforcing near-term nickel demand expectations.

title: Copper steady but remains set for monthly loss - Stock market news
summary: Copper prices steadied on Friday after China pledged growth support, but gains were capped by weak demand signals and recession/banking stress fears. Three-month copper was slightly higher yet set for its biggest monthly loss since June. Aluminium rose 1.8%, reflecting a mixed move across industrial metals.

title: 2 dead in collapsed dump site at Indonesia nickel plant - OHS Canada Magazine
summary: Two workers died after a collapse at a nickel waste disposal site at PT Indonesia Morowali Industrial Park (IMIP) in Indonesia’s Sulawesi. Officials cite a possible crack causing waste sludge to collapse and are investigating negligence. The incident follows other deadly accidents at China-owned nickel smelters, highlighting potential operational risk for nickel supply.

title: Stellantis and Alliance Nickel agree nickel and cobalt supply deal
summary: Stellantis agreed with Australia’s Alliance Nickel to buy nickel from the NiWest project for five years, taking about 154,221 tonnes of nickel (roughly 40% of expected output). The deal includes an equity stake and $10.1M investment to fund completion, supporting nickel supply visibility.

title: 2 workers killed in nickel waste landslide at China-owned plant in Indonesia
summary: Two workers died in Indonesia after being buried by a nickel slag landslide at PT Indonesia Morowali Industrial Park (IMIP), a China-linked nickel processing complex. Police and labor authorities are investigating safety procedures amid broader allegations of unsafe conditions and past fatalities at the site.

title: Comex Copper Ends the Month 5.71% Lower at $3.8700 -- Data Talk
summary: Comex Copper’s front-month contract ended the month at $3.8700, down 5.71% on the month, with the largest monthly decline since June 2022. It also fell this week and over the prior two weeks, though the contract was marginally higher on the day after several sessions of gains.

title: 2 bodies found in collapsed dump site at Indonesia nickel plant
summary: Two workers died after a nickel waste disposal site collapsed at PT Indonesia Morowali Industrial Park (IMIP) in Central Sulawesi, where workers were caught by black sludge-like material from ferronickel processing. Police are probing a crack that triggered the collapse, adding to accident and safety concerns at local Chinese-owned smelters.

title: SMM Forecast for Copper Prices Next Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM expects copper to trade in a defined range next week, with macro developments (US GDP slowdown but sticky inflation, plus upcoming PMI/ADP data and US/EU rate decisions after China’s Labour Day) likely to drive sentiment. Resilient domestic demand may cushion declines, while downstream restocking could lift spot premiums.

title: Spot Quotes for Copper Stopped Falling and Rallied On Pre-Holiday Stockpiling_SMM
