title: Churchill Resources Inc.: Florence Lake NI 43-101 Report Identifies 40+ High-Priority Nickel Targets; Taylor Brook Fieldwork Commencing Shortly; Company Strengthens Board
summary: Churchill Resources announced a NI 43-101 technical report for its Florence Lake nickel project, identifying 43 high-priority nickel targets and recommending a 2023 field program and later drilling. It also updates plans for the Taylor Brook project with deeper drilling under prior high-grade Ni/Cu intersections. No production or confirmed new resources.

title: Faraday Copper (TSX:FDY) Announces Results from Copper Creek, Intersects 45.89 Metres at 1.68% Copper, 0.33 g/t Gold and 5.55 g/t Silver Near Surface
summary: Faraday Copper reported new drill intersections at its Copper Creek project in Arizona, including 45.89 m at 1.68% copper and other long intercepts with copper grades up to 0.87%. The company also began gold assaying of historical core. The update is broadly supportive of future copper supply expectations.

title: Tucumã Copper Project, Brazil
summary: The Tucumã (Boa Esperança) copper project in Pará, Brazil is under development, with construction approved in February 2022 and first production expected in late 2024. The project targets about 35,000 tonnes per year of copper concentrate initially, expanding later, with details on mining and processing design.

title: Copper Prices Slide Despite Expected Deficit
summary: Copper prices slid further in April-May as China’s recovery appeared soft: customs data showed lower unwrought copper and copper product imports and manufacturing PMI/new orders weakened. Smelting activity also fell to multi-year lows with maintenance outages. Separately, Chile advanced a copper royalty bill that could be longer-term supportive, but prices remain under pressure.

title: China rushing to invest in new copper smelting capacity – but where's the raw material?
summary: Fastmarkets reports a net jump of at least 3.4 million tpy in new Chinese copper smelting capacity coming 2023-26, but warns concentrates may be insufficient because new mines are limited and additional smelters are also expanding globally. This concentrate squeeze points to firmer near-term copper pricing and premiums.

title: Ankh Capital Inc. Signs Amalgamation Agreement to Acquire Quetzal Copper Limited
summary: Ankh Capital Inc. signed an amalgamation agreement to acquire Quetzal Copper Limited, a private company with four drill-ready copper property options in British Columbia and Mexico. The transaction is subject to approvals and includes a $3m private placement to fund exploration, with no near-term production changes disclosed.

title: Nevada Copper Signs Mining Development Contract With Small
summary: Nevada Copper announced progress on an underground lateral development contract, with mobilization begun and work advancing to deliver developed ore stopes to restart its Underground Mine and milling operations. Management cites steady-state output of about 5,000 tons per day and ongoing ventilation and infrastructure upgrades, supporting near-term copper production outlook.

title: Copper retreats from 5-1/2-month low, but slow China recovery weighs
summary: Copper prices edged higher off a 5-1/2-month low, but the drop was driven by concerns over sluggish Chinese demand. Reuters cites weak April industrial output and shrinking metals-intensive manufacturing. It also warns aluminium demand has fallen in Europe and China, implying further downside risk despite near-term fluctuations.

title: SMM Daily Comments (May 16): Most Base Metals Prices Closed with Losses, SHFE Nickel, Stainless Steel Plunge, Oil Gained on G7 New Measures, US Strategic Petroleum Reserve Replenishment and Supply Concerns_SMM
summary: SMM’s daily wrap shows most SHFE/LME base metals closed lower. SHFE nickel fell over 3% and LME nickel fell 0.9%, while SHFE copper and LME copper dropped about 0.7–0.9%. Aluminium was the exception: SHFE aluminium rose ~0.4% and LME aluminium edged up ~0.24%.

title: Copper recovers from 5-1/2-month low, but slow China recovery weighs
summary: London copper edged higher from a 5-1/2-month low after bargain buying, but prices remain pressured by weak China demand signals. April industrial output and retail sales underperformed, and metals-intensive manufacturing shrank. The report also flags recent aluminum demand slumps in Europe and China as a downside risk.

title: Copper hits 5-1/2-month low as slowing China recovery weighs
summary: Copper trades near a 5-1/2-month low as investors weigh weaker-than-expected China economic data, including softer industrial production and shrinking metals-intensive manufacturing. The slowdown reduces demand expectations and contributes to further copper selling. Aluminium demand is also flagged as slumping in Europe and China, maintaining bearish sentiment.

title: Wave Nickel buys Brazil ops to make Ni-Co MHP with microwaves
summary: Wave Nickel agreed to buy Brazil’s Niquelândia nickel mine and processing plant from CBA to produce nickel MHP using a new microwave process. Output ramp-up is gradual, starting with a demonstration plant by end-2024 and full scale later, with potential cost and emissions advantages. Nickel sulfate/MHP prices have been under pressure.

title: Canada Strengthens Support for 31 Key Minerals Including Copper, Aluminium, Lithium, Rare Earth in Exploration and Development_SMM
summary: Canada announced nearly CAD 360 million to support research, development and expansion in key minerals, including copper, nickel and aluminium, and plans to simplify mining licensing. It also issued a Canada-U.S. joint statement on building a key mineral supply chain, potentially improving medium-term supply expectations and sentiment.

title: Daheim prospect delivers solid copper results for Noronex
summary: Noronex says initial diamond-drilling at its Witvlei project’s Daheim prospect in Namibia returned thick copper mineralisation, including a 14m interval grading 1.1% Cu. Assays below 278m and from a second hole remain pending. The update supports long-term exploration hopes but is not production-related, limiting near-term price impact.

title: Brixton Metals Commences Drilling at its Flagship Thorn Copper-Gold Porphyry Project
summary: Brixton Metals announced it has started its 2023 exploration drilling program at the Thorn Project in British Columbia. The program is fully funded and targets the Camp Creek copper-dominant porphyry zone with two drills and 8–10 deep holes, potentially expanding known copper mineralization laterally.

title: Amarc Resources Ltd.: Amarc Remobilizes to Duke District Initiates Systematic Assessment of Porphyry Copper-Gold Targets
summary: Amarc Resources reports remobilizing exploration crews to its Duke District in British Columbia to survey 16 porphyry Cu-Au targets, funded under a Boliden earn-in agreement. The release describes geophysical/geochemical work to define drill targets for winter 2023–2024, with no production changes or supply disruption indicated.

title: Fortescue Exercises Right to Maintain Stake in Candente Copper
summary: Fortescue exercised a pre-emptive right to keep a 25% stake in Candente Copper (renaming to Alta Copper) by subscribing for nearly 2 million shares at C$0.18 each, for about C$357k. Candente also planned a private placement raising C$500k, subject to exchange approval.

title: St-Georges Releases Overlimit Re-assays for Nickel, Copper, Platinum & Palladium at Manicouagan Critical Minerals Project
summary: St-Georges Eco-Mining reported partial re-assay results for drill hole MN22-03 at its Manicouagan project, including high-grade nickel and copper intersections alongside platinum-group metals. The update improves geological confidence for future resource potential, but remains exploration-focused with no immediate supply impact on near-term copper or nickel prices.

title: Nickel 28 Announces Fiscal 2023 Financial Results
summary: Nickel 28 reported fiscal 2023 results for its 8.56% stake in the Ramu nickel-cobalt operation in Papua New Guinea. The company cited strong production and sales, lower average cash costs, significant debt repayment, and expectations of continued strength in 2023 as EV demand for nickel-rich batteries improves.

title: St-Georges Releases Overlimit Re-assays for Nickel, Copper, Platinum & Palladium at Manicouagan Critical Minerals Project
summary: St-Georges Eco-Mining reported re-assay results for drill hole MN22-03 at its Manicouagan project, including intervals averaging 2.43% nickel and 1.18% copper, with individual quarter-meter samples up to about 3.36% copper and 4.1% nickel. The update boosts exploration sentiment for both metals.

title: Alloy Enterprises Raises $26M to Unlock Aluminum Fabrication at Scale
summary: Alloy Enterprises raised $26M to expand its digital aluminum fabrication process and ramp production of high-throughput, fully dense aluminum parts in the U.S. The company cites a gap between complex aluminum component demand and supply, driven by EV lightweighting and industrial equipment needs, and plans production deliveries this summer.

title: XCana Petroleum Corp. Announces Continued Expansion onto the Table Mountain Critical Mineral Project to Encompass the Past Producing Boyer Copper Deposit
summary: XCana Petroleum Corp. reports completing an 80-acre expansion to gain full ownership of the historically copper-producing Boyer Copper Deposit, adjacent to its Nevada Nickel #73 claim. The company frames the “Table Mountain Critical Mineral Project” as targeting copper and nickel among others, but offers no production timelines.

title: Yukon copper mine shut down amid environmental scrutiny
summary: A small copper mine in Yukon (Minto mine, Minto Metals) is ceasing operations after environmental scrutiny over water treatment plans and failure to post additional closure security. Authorities took control to maintain water treatment and prevent overflow. Output declined earlier this year, and timing to restart is uncertain.

title: Sharing Services Global Corporation (SHRG) Announces MyTravelVentures Inaugural Venture Trip to Cancun, Mexico
summary: KGHM Polska Miedź reported Q1 2023 results with stable copper output from Polish assets, including higher ore extraction (+2.6% YoY) and slightly higher copper in concentrate production (+0.5% YoY). The company also highlighted investment progress and energy/efficiency initiatives, without any abrupt supply disruption.

title: KGHM Polska Mied? S A : Good financial condition and stable copper production - KGHM summarises its results for the first quarter of 2023
summary: KGHM said Q1 2023 revenues rose and it maintained stable copper production from its Polish assets. Ore extraction was up 2.6% year-on-year and copper in concentrate output rose slightly. The company also discussed investment to access new deposits, alongside energy and environmental initiatives.

title: Centinela copper mine's union head says sides far apart in talks to avoid strike
summary: Reuters reports the union at Antofagasta’s Centinela copper mine in Chile says talks with the company are far from agreement. After members voted overwhelmingly for a strike, five days of mediation runs until May 22, with a potential strike beginning May 23 if no settlement is reached, raising near-term copper supply risk.

title: Copper concentrate market to face steep deficit from 2025
summary: Reuters reports analysts expect a steep global deficit in copper concentrate during 2025-2027 as Asian smelters expand faster than new mining projects. China’s refined copper imports are forecast to fall as domestic smelting rises. It also says State Grid’s ultra-high voltage focus may increase aluminium usage, supporting aluminium demand.

title: Kaiser Aluminum Corporation Announces the United Steelworkers Ratification of a New Four-Year Labor Agreement at its Warrick Rolling Mill
summary: Kaiser Aluminum announced that union members at its Warrick rolling mill ratified a new four-year labor agreement effective May 15, 2023. The pact covers about 850 employees and runs through May 15, 2027. The company frames it as supporting sustainable operations for its packaging and other aluminum products.

title: Nickel Industries: Potential & Risks
summary: Nickel Industries is profiled as demand for nickel rises, driven by stainless steel and EV-related expectations. However, the piece warns about regulatory risk in Indonesia (processing rules, potential emissions sanctions) and ESG/low-carbon nickel requirements that could pressure its coal-based production. Net effect on near-term nickel pricing is mixed.

title: New assays move Challenger Exploration closer to maiden resource estimate at El Guayabo copper-gold project
summary: Challenger Exploration released new Phase 2 drilling results at its El Guayabo copper-gold project in Ecuador. The holes intersected significant mineralisation, extending the main discovery zone down dip and along strike, and confirming continuity between anomalies. Management said results pave the way for a maiden mineral resource estimate.

title: Copper Futures Prices Rebounded on Optimistic US Debt Ceiling Negotiations_SMM
summary: Copper futures rebounded, with LME and SHFE contracts rising amid optimism over US debt-ceiling negotiations that supported a steadier macro outlook (rates/dollar). Copper fundamentals also tightened: fewer warrant deliveries, stronger downstream buying, higher spot quotes, and expected imported inflows, prompting short covering despite weaker broader guidance.

title: Nickel Prices Likely to Drop on Expanding Supply_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports spot nickel premiums rose amid low supply while nickel futures fell sharply. With economic recession limiting demand, trades remain weak even as spot activity picks up. However, expected growth in supply—driven by spot inflows for warrant delivery—should push stainless steel spot prices lower, weighing on nickel.

title: Court rejects claim that copper mine land is needed for jaguar preservation - Cronkite News
summary: A federal appeals court overturned a decision blocking land-use findings for the Rosemont Copper mine in Arizona, reviving hopes for the project. Supporters cite major local jobs and revenue, while opponents warn about jaguar habitat and potential water pollution from copper sulfide mining. The ruling could improve copper supply expectations.

title: Copper flat as China demand concerns counter US debt-ceiling optimism
summary: London copper was little changed after a rebound from 5-1/2-month lows. Concerns about weaker-than-expected China industrial output and retail sales supported worries of lower industrial metal demand, offset by optimism that the U.S. debt-ceiling deal could avert default and recession risks.

title: Copper slips as demand fears cast shadow over US debt cheer
summary: London copper fell 0.3% as a firmer US dollar and worries about slowing demand from top consumer China outweighed optimism around a US debt-ceiling deal. Consumption looked lacklustre while inventories rose, with LME copper stocks at the highest since January.

title: Lindian deal to unlock bauxite assets value in Guinea
summary: Lindian Resources signed a six-year Guinea bauxite supply deal with C&D Logistics for 23 million wet tonnes from its Gaoual project, with annual renegotiation from 2025. The firm cites rising demand after Indonesia’s bauxite export ban, but start-up timing limits near-term impact on aluminium prices.

title: China Nonferrous Metal Mining, KAZ Minerals plan to build copper smelting plant in Kazakhstan
summary: Kazakh President Tokayev met Zhang Jinjun of China Nonferrous Mining Corp and discussed deep-processing projects with KAZ Minerals. The Chinese firm plans to build a copper smelting plant in Kazakhstan. The meeting highlighted bilateral cooperation, but the article gives no near-term output, timing, or market-sensitive details.

title: China's Nuode to Build USD553 Million Copper Foil Plant in Belgium
summary: Nuode New Materials plans to invest about USD553 million in Belgium to build a copper foil R&D and production plant for power battery customers. The facility targets 30,000 mt annual capacity, supporting demand from overseas lithium battery makers, but the article doesn’t indicate short-term supply effects or commissioning timing.

title: Copper prices down, hit by strong dollar, rising inventories
summary: Copper prices fell in London as a stronger U.S. dollar reached seven-week highs and LME-registered on-warrant stocks rose to a six-month peak. The article also describes weakness across base metals, with nickel touching a fresh multi-month low and aluminium trading lower, reflecting tighter financial conditions and softer demand expectations.

title: Hudbay and Copper Mountain Announce Filing of Joint Management Information Circular in Connection with Proposed Combination and Support from Largest Shareholders
summary: Hudbay and Copper Mountain filed joint meeting materials for a proposed acquisition where Hudbay will buy Copper Mountain via a court-approved plan. The deal is positioned as creating a larger Americas-focused copper producer with projected 2023 copper output above 150,000 tonnes and cost synergies, subject to approvals.

title: Nickel 28 Releases Letter to Shareholders and Files Meeting Materials for the Upcoming Annual General and Special Meeting of Shareholders
summary: Nickel 28 filed its management information circular and proxy materials for its June 12 shareholder meeting, alongside a board letter urging votes for its nominees amid a takeover attempt by Pelham. The release reiterates the company’s nickel-cobalt exposure via its Ramu joint venture and royalties, but provides no operational or supply changes.

title: China's April aluminum imports rise with domestic supply constrained
summary: China’s April aluminum imports rose 27.1% year-on-year to 222,851 tonnes as domestic supply stayed constrained by lingering power and hydropower issues in Yunnan. Output in the province fell with lower hydropower generation, and analysts do not expect rapid regional production resumption, supporting import-led demand.

title: Chile ups tax burden on copper mining
summary: Chile’s Lower House approved a bill increasing taxation on large copper mining. The measure sets higher effective tax ceilings (46.5% for the largest producers and 45.5% for mid-tier output), with exemptions for small producers. Chile says proceeds will support regional governments; higher mining taxes can weigh on copper expectations.

title: Global Key Base Metals Face Supply Glut, Severe Oversupply for Aluminium, But There Is a Global Copper Shortage_SMM
summary: WBMS reported March 2023 copper cathode output below consumption, leaving a supply shortage of 74,400 mt, while primary aluminium posted oversupply of 148,200 mt and refined nickel oversupply of 5,600 mt. These figures point to tight copper but substantial surplus conditions in aluminium and nickel.

title: Global Key Base Metals Face Supply Glut, Severe Oversupply for Aluminium, But There Is a Global Copper Shortage_SMM
summary: WBMS reported March 2023 copper cathode output of 2.1Mt versus consumption of 2.17Mt, leaving a 74,400t supply shortage. Primary aluminium ran in oversupply (148,200t), and nickel also showed a small oversupply. Overall, the copper deficit is the clearest near-term supportive factor.

title: Sherritt announces death at Cuban nickel/cobalt joint venture
summary: Sherritt reported a worker death at its Moa nickel/cobalt joint venture in Cuba, the second fatality in months. The company says injuries resulted from a fall and that it is implementing immediate safety measures while working with authorities. Moa mines nickel laterite for Sherritt refining, but no production downtime is stated.

title: Alpha Copper Announces Results of Magnetic 3D Inversion
summary: Alpha Copper reports results from a 3D magnetic inversion study at its Star copper-gold project in British Columbia, identifying multiple magnetic anomalies potentially related to porphyry-style mineralization. Management plans follow-up drilling starting in June 2023 to extend mineralization. The release is exploratory and not tied to current supply.

title: Marimaca Copper's resource revamp lobs it into the 'globally significant' arena, says CEO
summary: Marimaca Copper said measured and indicated resources at its Marimaca Oxide Deposit in Chile rose 44%, strengthening the case for an expanded operation. The company expects the updated resource to underpin an upcoming feasibility study. The news is supportive for copper market sentiment, though near-term physical supply impact appears limited.

title: UK introduces sanctions on Russian diamonds, copper, and aluminum
summary: The UK introduced sanctions prohibiting imports of Russian-origin copper, aluminum, and nickel, alongside a wider ban on Russian diamonds. The measure directly restricts Russian metal supply into the UK/market, raising expectations of tighter availability and supporting near-term price strength for industrial metals.

title: Rishi Sunak announces ban at G7 on Russian diamonds, copper, aluminium and nickel
summary: Rishi Sunak at the G7 summit in Japan announces expanded sanctions banning imports of Russian-origin copper, aluminium and nickel, alongside a wider package restricting Russian diamonds. Such measures reduce access to Russian metal supplies for the market and can tighten short-term availability, potentially lifting prices.

title: Rishi Sunak announces ban at G7 on Russian diamonds, copper, aluminium and nickel
summary: Rishi Sunak says G7 leaders will announce wider sanctions on Russia, including a ban on Russian-origin imports of copper, aluminium and nickel. The measures aim to restrict financing and war capacity tied to Russian supply chains, with the UK and allies expected to announce further steps over the weekend.

title: UK introduces sanctions on Russian diamonds, copper, and aluminum
summary: The UK government announced sanctions banning imports of Russian-origin copper, aluminium, and nickel, alongside Russian diamonds, as part of wider restrictions on 86 Russian individuals and firms linked to Russia’s military-industrial complex. The UK’s import ban is expected to tighten supply availability and support prices for the affected metals.

title: Rishi Sunak announces ban at G7 on Russian diamonds, copper, aluminium and nickel
summary: Rishi Sunak said the G7 will ban or restrict imports of Russian diamonds and also extend sanctions to Russian-origin copper, aluminium and nickel. The measures aim to pressure Russia after the invasion of Ukraine. The news signals tighter trade access for Russian metal supply into allied markets.

title: Copper Futures Went Down As US Dollar Rebounded_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: LME copper fell 1.8% to $8,158.5/mt and SHFE copper dipped 0.62% on May 19. A stronger US dollar after solid US data reduced bets on Fed easing and reflected debt-ceiling agreement uncertainty. Despite tight Shanghai spot supply, weak fundamentals underpin expectations of lower copper prices.

title: Copper thieves target telcos, transport, power infrastructure causing $400,000 damage
summary: Copper thieves in Central Victoria have stolen telecom and power cables, including Telstra and NBN wiring near Mount Holden base station, disrupting mobile coverage and damaging infrastructure. Police warn of electrocution risks from exposed wires. Authorities estimate $5,000–$10,000 of copper stolen per incident, with up to $400,000 damage.

title: Nickel prices seen falling as global surplus looms
summary: Reuters reports analysts expect global nickel prices to fall as Indonesia expands nickel capacity and production. Indonesia’s output growth in NPI and MHP is forecast to relieve supply constraints, while production costs decline. CRU and others project the LME three-month nickel contract dropping this year and below $20,000 in 2024.

title: UK's Prime Minister Bans Imports of Russian Diamonds, Copper, Aluminium & Nickel
summary: UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak announced an embargo on imports of Russian diamonds and also copper, aluminium and nickel. Reporting indicates additional restrictions on Russian diamond trade and sanctions targeting firms tied to Russia’s military-industrial sector. The move is aimed at cutting Russian economic inputs into global markets.

title: UK's Prime Minister Bans Imports of Russian Diamonds, Copper, Aluminium & Nickel
summary: The UK Prime Minister announced an embargo banning imports of Russian diamonds and also Russian copper, aluminium, and nickel. UK reporting says sanctions include a broader market freeze and additional measures. Such trade restrictions on Russian metal supply can tighten availability and provide upward price pressure for copper, aluminium, and nickel.

title: UK's Prime Minister Bans Imports of Russian Diamonds, Copper, Aluminium & Nickel
summary: The UK Prime Minister is reported to have announced an embargo on imports of Russian diamonds, including copper, aluminium, and nickel. The measure is part of sanctions related to Russia’s actions in Ukraine, alongside asset freezes and individual/entity restrictions. The EU is also considering diamond trade restrictions.

title: Copper bound for fifth week of losses on strong dollar
summary: Copper is set for a fifth straight weekly decline as the U.S. dollar stays near two-month highs and markets price in additional Fed rate hikes. Weak Chinese demand dampens sentiment. Aluminium and nickel show intraday gains, but the broader macro backdrop caps industrial metals, leaving weekly momentum bearish.

title: Copper Inventory in Major Chinese Markets Declined This Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says copper inventories across major Chinese markets fell to 123,500 mt, down sharply from Monday and last week. Buyers shifted toward cathode as cathode–scrap spreads narrowed and consumption improved. Yet the import window reopening should boost arrivals next week, while demand is expected to soften, leaving inventories to rise slightly.

title: Spot Pure Nickel Premiums Rise Slightly Today amid Supply Tightness_SMM
summary: SMM reported that spot premiums for pure nickel rose on May 19, with Jinchuan premiums averaging 11,650 yuan/mt and NORNICKEL averaging 6,900 yuan/mt. The publication links the premium gains to improving transactions and tighter pure nickel supply, indicating stronger near-term nickel market sentiment.

title: Factbox-British imports of Russian copper, aluminium, nickel and diamonds
summary: Ahead of the G7 Japan summit, the UK is set to unveil sanctions and export controls targeting Russia. Trade Data Monitor shows Britain imported little or no Russian copper, but did import unwrought aluminium and refined nickel from Russia in 2022-2023. Such curbs can reduce Russian metal flows and affect short-term pricing expectations.

title: Factbox-British imports of Russian copper, aluminium, nickel and diamonds
summary: Britain and other G7 states plan new sanctions and export controls against Russia. Factbox data shows UK Russian imports of refined copper were effectively absent in 2021 and tiny via 15,252 tonnes last year; aluminium imports from Russia fell versus 2021; refined nickel imports were much lower or absent in earlier periods.

title: Factbox-British imports of Russian copper, aluminium, nickel and diamonds
summary: The article outlines Britain’s recent imports of sanctioned Russian metals before new G7 sanctions and export controls are announced in Japan. It notes some Russian-origin refined copper was imported previously (none in 2021/2022 refined), aluminium supply from Russia, and Russian refined nickel. Curbs on such flows can tighten supply and lift prices.

title: Lindian enters bauxite supply agreement with C&D Logistics
summary: Lindian Resources signed a six-year bauxite supply agreement to deliver 23 million wet metric tonnes from Guinea’s Gaoual project to C&D Logistics. The contract specifies alumina- and silica-quality limits and follows an Indonesia bauxite export ban, which the company says increased demand for Guinea bauxite.

title: FACTBOX-British imports of Russian copper, aluminium, nickel and diamonds
summary: UK Prime Minister Sunak plans new import bans on Russian copper, aluminium and nickel as part of fresh G7 sanctions. The factbox details limited UK prior imports from Russia (nickel none in early 2023; aluminium and copper past volumes). Reduced Russian trade is likely to tighten supply and support prices.

title: FACTBOX-British imports of Russian copper, aluminium, nickel and diamonds
summary: The UK said it will announce new import bans on Russian copper, aluminium and nickel alongside fresh G7 sanctions at a summit in Japan. Trade data show the UK imported limited Russian volumes—none for refined copper, none early-2023 for aluminium and nickel—while refined nickel and unwrought aluminium imports occurred in 2022.

title: FACTBOX-British imports of Russian copper, aluminium, nickel and diamonds
summary: The UK plans new import bans on Russian copper, aluminium and nickel, alongside new G7 sanctions targeting Russia over the war in Ukraine. Britain imported no Russian refined copper in recent years, while it bought unwrought aluminium and some refined nickel from Russia in 2022. The bans could tighten supply expectations.

title: Copper rebounds on optimism over U.S. debt talks
summary: Copper rebounded 1.2% on LME on optimism that U.S. debt talks will avert a default, lifting broader risk assets and supported by a slightly weaker dollar. The article also notes gains in aluminium and a strong rise in nickel, reflecting macro-driven sentiment despite headwinds from China demand and recession risks.

title: Copper rebounds on optimism over US debt talks
summary: Copper rebounded as investors grew more optimistic that U.S. debt talks will avert a federal default. LME three-month copper rose about 1% and Comex futures gained, supported by a softer dollar and traders covering shorts. The piece also flags headwinds from weak China demand and recession risks ahead.

title: Marimaca Copper (TSX:MARI) Releases Enhanced Mineral Resource Estimate for Marimaca Oxide Deposit
summary: Marimaca Copper released an updated 2023 mineral resource estimate for its Marimaca oxide deposit in northern Chile, incorporating 28,374m of additional drilling. Measured and indicated resources now total 200.3Mt at 0.45% CuT (900kt contained copper). The company continues metallurgical testing and sulphide exploration ahead of a DFS.

title: The Power Play by The Market Herald Releases New Interviews with Nextech3D.ai and Marimaca Copper Discussing Their Latest News
summary: The Power Play interview release includes Marimaca Copper’s updated Mineral Resource Estimate for the Marimaca oxide deposit in Chile. The 2023 MRE incorporates extensive new drilling aimed at upgrading inferred resources to measured and indicated categories. Such updates can bolster expectations for future copper supply, supporting copper sentiment.

title: LME Profits Fall to 8-Year Low as Nickel Crisis Hits Exchange
summary: The article notes that LME profits have fallen to an 8-year low as a “nickel crisis” hits the exchange. While details are limited, the framing suggests significant stress in LME nickel markets, which usually implies near-term weakness for nickel prices due to trading disruptions and higher risk.

title: U.S. Forest Service Pauses Timeline For Rio Tinto Arizona Copper Mine
summary: The U.S. Forest Service told a federal court it is unsure when it can approve a land swap enabling Rio Tinto’s Resolution Copper mine in Arizona. The delay extends a long dispute with Native American groups over Oak Flat. The pause pushes back potential incremental U.S. copper supply expectations.

title: U.S. Forest Service pauses timeline for Rio Tinto Arizona copper mine
summary: The U.S. Forest Service paused the timeline for republishing an environmental report needed for land transfer to Rio Tinto’s Resolution copper mine in Arizona, amid continued reviews with Indigenous tribes. The delay could extend project scheduling and expected copper supply, adding near-term uncertainty for investors despite Rio’s commitment to proceed.

title: FPX Nickel achieves production of battery-grade nickel sulphate from optimized refinery flowsheet
summary: FPX Nickel says hydrometallurgical testwork at its Baptiste project produced battery-grade nickel sulphate and improved the refinery flowsheet with lower purification stages and reagent use. It also yielded cobalt and copper by-products. Results support inclusion in the feasibility study and potential future nickel supply for EV batteries.

title: SBTL Advanced Materials Is Korea's Leading Company in 'Aluminum Pouch Film' for Secondary Batteries
summary: The article says Korea is scaling secondary battery production for EVs and that SBTL makes aluminum pouch film used in these batteries. It also cites a Korean government plan for more than 50 trillion won of investment to gain significant global battery-market share, implying rising aluminium demand.

title: Mine merger afoot at Princeton's Copper Mountain
summary: Shareholders are set to vote on Hudbay Minerals’ proposed all-stock acquisition of Copper Mountain Mining, which operates the Copper Mountain copper mine near Princeton. The combined firm would become Canada’s third-largest copper producer and hold three long-life mines, potentially improving confidence in the copper supply outlook.

title: Overseas Alumina Prices Dip_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says overseas alumina prices fell $5/mt to $340/mt FOB Western Australia last week, or about 2,974 yuan/mt CIF major Chinese ports after freight. The yuan impact is adjusted by ocean freight, with the article noting the US dollar strengthened and the import window has been closed since Jan. 18.

title: Macro Headwinds and Poor Fundamentals to Expose Aluminium Prices to Downside Risks_SMM
summary: SMM reports aluminium prices have weakened in recent trading. It cites macro headwinds from prolonged US debt-ceiling talks increasing market uncertainty and notes fundamentals remain soft: end-user consumption is only recovering while the market is oversupplied. Lower prebaked anode and coal prices reduce cost support, increasing downside risk.

title: Vietnam ranks second globally for bauxite reserves
summary: Vietnam is reported to have the world’s second-largest bauxite reserves (5.8 billion tonnes). Bauxite is refined into alumina and then smelted into aluminium. The province of Dak Nong plans to expand alumina and aluminium smelting, positioning itself as a bauxite-to-aluminium hub, but the article doesn’t cite near-term output changes.

title: Copper Inventory in Major Chinese Markets Fell over Weekend, to Grow This Week_SMM
summary: SMM says copper inventories in major Chinese markets were 122,700 mt on May 22, down slightly from Friday but much higher than a year earlier. Regional flows were mixed, and customs clearance of imported copper is expected to grow this week. SMM expects supply to rise and demand to weaken, leading to slight inventory growth.

title: Copper Prices Rebounded On Falling US Dollar Index_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: LME copper rose to $8,242/mt (+1%) as Fed Chair Powell sounded moderately dovish, lowering the US dollar index and rate-hike expectations. SHFE and other metrics were firm. SMM data showed Chinese copper inventories fell sharply, and narrower scrap–cathode spreads boosted cathode purchases, adding short-term support.

title: Russia Raises Aluminum Exports to China to Near Record Levels as Sanctions Bite
summary: BNN Bloomberg reports Russia is raising aluminum exports to China to near-record levels, attributing the move to sanctions tightening other trade routes. The larger flow into a major consuming region is likely to increase near-term supply expectations and weigh on aluminum prices over the next several days to weeks.

title: Copper pressured by poor demand prospects and higher supply
summary: Reuters reports copper fell on deteriorating demand expectations in China, alongside rising supplies and climbing LME stocks (up 80% since mid-April). Mine resumptions in Peru and a DRC royalty agreement supporting copper exports eased supply worries, widening the cash discount. Other metals were mixed; aluminum slid and nickel edged up.

title: 13 Best Basic Materials Stocks to Buy Now
summary: The article discusses China pessimism and notes that copper prices fell to five-week lows after slower-than-expected Chinese activity data and rising LME warehouse inventories. It frames this as demand uncertainty for commodities as markets reassess China’s recovery, implying near-term bearish pressure for copper.

title: Novelis accelerates aluminum automotive part innovation with introduction of roll forming development line
summary: Novelis announced the startup of a new roll forming development line in Michigan to accelerate R&D and enable large-volume production of high-strength aluminum automotive parts. The company says the technology supports electrification and demand for lighter, sustainable components, potentially supporting higher aluminum usage expectations.

title: Catenae hails court; Golden Metals likes copper find
summary: Golden Metal Resources said soil geochemical sampling at its Garfield project in Nevada identified two significant copper zones, including 950 ppm copper in soil, plus higher copper percentages at other zones. The update is exploration-focused and does not reference production or changes to supply or demand that would drive short-term copper price moves.

title: Adavale secures prospecting licence for nickel project in Tanzania
summary: Australian Adavale Resources secured a prospecting licence for its Kabanga Jirani nickel project in Tanzania and plans additional drilling, DHEM, and AMT surveys. The project is within the Luhuma trend with historic nickel sulphide intersections, while recent work also defined copper-bearing soil anomalies near an adjacent Kabanga deposit.

title: Copper Prices Went Down again amid Severe Market Concerns_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: LME copper fell to $8,144/mt (-1.21%) and SHFE July ended lower, amid Fed hawkishness and debt-ceiling worries. SMM notes weak domestic demand and bearish sentiment. Copper inventories rose where arrivals increased (Shanghai/Jiangsu) while Guangdong fell, but overall the market expects low prices short term.

title: Nuode to invest in the construction of an lithium battery copper foil production base with an annual capacity of 30,000 mt in Belgium_SMM
summary: Nuode plans to invest €500 million in Wallonia, Belgium, to build a lithium battery copper foil production base with 30,000 mt annual capacity. The project aims to strengthen the battery ecosystem and supply chain support for overseas customers. It signals future copper demand, though timing limits short-term price impact.

title: Antofagasta to Start First Round Of Negotiations On Mid-Year Long-Term Contract TCs This Week, Spot Copper Concentrate TCs Remained In Upward Track_SMM
summary: SMM reports spot copper concentrate TCs holding an upward track and Antofagasta preparing to start mid-year long-term contract TC negotiations with Chinese smelters this week. Limited spot activity and sizable offers/counteroffers keep market attention on the negotiations’ outcome, supporting near-term copper sentiment.

title: MVV reports strong Q1 performance at the Serrote Copper-Gold Mine
