summary: Marubeni said its Portland, Victoria aluminium smelter was awarded ASI Performance Standard certification, recognizing environmental and safety initiatives and integrity of operations. The firm also plans to increase renewable power use to cut emissions and support responsible aluminium supply. No immediate production, capacity, or logistics changes are stated.

title: SMM Daily Comments (May 26): SHFE and LME Base Metals Rose across the Board, Aluminium Soared, Iron Ore Skyrocketed, Russia Takes Opposite View against Saudi Arabia_SMM
summary: Crude oil prices rose as expectations shifted on OPEC+ production-cut signals, while the U.S. dollar weakened. Reflecting this risk-on macro backdrop, SHFE and LME base metals increased broadly: SHFE aluminium +3.38%, copper +2.17%, nickel +1.27%; LME aluminium +0.85%, copper +1.31%, nickel +1.29%.

title: Spot Nickel Premiums Fall at Month-end_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reported that spot nickel premiums fell at month-end on May 26. Jinchuan nickel premiums averaged 10,050 yuan/mt, down 600 yuan/mt, while NORNICKEL averaged 6,900 yuan/mt, also down 600 yuan/mt. Nickel briquette prices rose slightly, but transactions were slack amid continued premiums versus nickel sulphate.

title: Sandfire produces first concentrate at Motheo copper mine in Botswana
summary: Sandfire says it has produced first copper concentrate at the Motheo mine in Botswana and is nearing completion of commissioning for a 3.2 mtpa processing capacity. The company expects first shipments by mid-year, with further ESIA approval enabling a mining licence for the A4 pit and planned capacity expansion.

title: US Geological Society denies copper "critical mineral" status
summary: USGS denied a bipartisan bid to classify copper as a critical mineral, despite claims that copper’s supply-risk score exceeded inclusion thresholds and that USGS data are outdated. The European Commission has already listed copper under its raw-material acts. Miners back the request, but the decision may mainly affect forecasting rather than immediate flows.

title: Lifezone begins offtake tendering for Kabanga nickel project
summary: Lifezone Metals has started offtake marketing for products from its Kabanga nickel project in Tanzania, targeting EV companies for nickel, cobalt and copper output. The feasibility work continues and no deal is agreed, but progress toward commercialisation and processing plans supports bullish near-term sentiment for nickel.

title: Hedge Funds Bet Against Copper for First Time in Three Years
summary: BNN Bloomberg’s weekend headline says hedge funds have bet against copper for the first time in three years. Such a shift toward net short positioning typically reflects worsening near-term sentiment and can increase downward pressure on copper prices over coming days as positioning unwinds.

title: Low-Carbon Aluminum Market Report 2023: Growing Research and Development Activities to Achieve Near Zero Emissions Bolsters Sector
summary: PRNewswire promotes a 2023 report on the low-carbon aluminum market, projecting growth and citing stronger adoption in transport/EVs and supportive government pressure for decarbonization. It highlights investment trends toward low-emissions production and recycling partnerships, which could improve near-term outlook for aluminium demand and supply expectations.

title: China's refined nickel imports hit 20-year low - Mining Technology
summary: China’s refined nickel imports fell to 3,204 tonnes in April, the lowest since 2004, with imports from Indonesia and Russia also dropping sharply. Chinese stainless steel mills are shifting toward nickel pig iron (NPI) rather than Class I refined nickel, and EV battery growth may further reduce demand for high-purity nickel.

title: Trafigura Sees Copper Prices Rising to All-Time High on China Economic Rebound and Supply Shortages_SMM
summary: Trafigura said copper could reach all-time highs, even exceeding $12,000/mt, over the next 12 months. The firm links the forecast to a China economic rebound boosting demand and to supply shortages tightening the market. The comments point to upward near-term copper price pressure.

title: Here's How G7 New Sanctions Will Change Global Nickel Trade Flows in 2023 and Impact Nickel Price_SMM
summary: G7 expanded sanctions on Russia, reducing Russian nickel exports to markets like the Netherlands and the US while shifting flows to other buyers (notably Canada and China). At the same time, China’s electrowinning nickel capacity is set to rise sharply, increasing competition and oversupply risk, which the article expects to keep nickel prices pressured lower.

title: NickelSearch lauds CarlingupÃ¢€™s regional potential following B1 nickel hits
summary: NickelSearch Ltd says drilling at Carlingup’s high-priority B1 target in Western Australia has confirmed and extended historical nickel sulphide results, making B1 a second target for immediate follow-up. Additional assays are expected, with diamond drilling planned for early June, but no production timing is provided.

title: Drills Turning, Looking for Copper at Mexico Project
summary: Infinitum Copper started a 2,500-meter, 15-hole drilling campaign at its La Adelita project in Sonora, targeting extensions of high-grade copper mineralization. Prior holes reported strong copper-equivalent grades over meaningful widths, and management plans further drilling to expand the Cerro Grande and test Las Trancas.

title: Panama is ready to cash in on its copper boom
summary: A new concession agreement keeps First Quantum’s Cobre Panama copper project operating after an earlier suspension. The mine is ramping back up, promising government revenue and highlighting robust output logistics. Improved project continuity and supply expectations are mildly bullish for copper prices over the coming weeks.

title: Column: Optimism came hard to the Copper Country in WWI | News, Sports, Jobs
summary: The column describes Lake Superior copper mining technology and production, then says the outbreak of WWI in August 1914 disrupted the world copper market and forced companies to drastically curtail mining. That resulted in reduced working hours and wages, before mining resumed full-time in early 1915.

title: Great Reads: The comeback of the Blue Jay bean, Panama's copper boom, and could book bans happen in Canada?
summary: A Globe newsletter roundup notes that Panama is positioned to benefit from a “copper boom,” citing massive reserves and ongoing efforts by Latin American governments to extract large concessions from mining companies such as First Quantum Minerals. The piece suggests evolving copper supply prospects, though it lacks specifics on timing or volumes.

title: China's refined nickel imports slump to near 20-year lows: Andy Home
summary: China’s refined nickel imports fell to near 20-year lows as mills and EV-battery supply chains shift toward Indonesia’s Class II intermediates (NPI, matte, mixed hydroxide). Class I demand is down sharply, but LME nickel stocks have been falling to multi-year lows, offsetting pressure.

title: Material Matters: China, Coal, Nickel, Zinc & Copper
summary: The piece discusses China’s weak demand outlook, noting copper prices have fallen alongside easing import/steel sentiment. It also details rising nickel production costs (energy, sulphur, and feed inputs) as LME nickel drops below $21,000/t, squeezing margins. For copper, Chile’s royalty bill brings investment clarity into 2024.

title: Material Matters: China, Coal, Nickel, Zinc & Copper
summary: The piece discusses China-driven commodity weakness, including falling copper alongside softer steel demand and inventory effects. It also highlights nickel cost increases and margin squeeze as LME nickel declines below $21,000/t. Separately, Chile approved a copper royalty bill, improving investment clarity from 2024.

title: Alba strengthens ties with Egypt's aluminium sector
summary: Aluminium Bahrain (Alba) met Egyptian officials including Egyptalum to explore mutual cooperation and potential investment, including a prospective partnership involving bauxite as a raw material. The discussion focuses on strengthening economic ties and studying feasibility, without any announced near-term capacity or supply changes.

title: Shanghai copper hits one-week high on US debt deal
summary: Shanghai copper rose to a one-week high after a U.S. debt-ceiling agreement improved risk sentiment and reduced default fears. The July SHFE contract gained about 2.1%. SHFE aluminium and nickel also advanced. Yet China’s economic recovery slowdown and bearish macro sentiment limited support, per Reuters’ cited notes.

title: Denarius Metals Announces Final Drill Results from Completed Phase 2 In-Fill Drilling at Its Polymetallic Lomero Project in Spain, Including 10.25 Meters Grading 0.27% Copper, 4.79% Lead, 9.82% Zinc, 161 g/t Ag and 6.82 g/t Au
summary: Denarius Metals reported final assays from Phase 2 in-fill and validation drilling at Spain’s Lomero polymetallic project. Central drilling mostly returned significant copper mineralization, including up to 1.86% Cu over 6.7–15.7 m, supporting continuity and potential grade upgrades in the resource model.

title: Flying Nickel Mining Corp.: Flying Nickel's Minago Drill Core PGM Assay Program Returns 11.07 meters Grading 0.629g/t PGM+Au, Adding to 1.51% Nickel (Previously Reported) in Manitoba's Thompson Nickel Belt
summary: Flying Nickel Mining Corp. reported additional drill core assay results from its Minago nickel-PGM project in Manitoba, confirming platinum/palladium intersections and reporting composite grades that include ~0.8–1.51% nickel and small copper contents. The update supports resource development but does not indicate immediate changes in production or supply.

title: Power Nickel Inc. Presents in Red Cloud's Virtual Webinar | The Kingston Whig Standard
summary: Power Nickel is hosting a Red Cloud virtual corporate update and highlighting progress on its Nisk nickel sulfide project, including a planned 15,000-metre drill program starting in July and near-term catalysts such as additional assay results and an updated 43-101. Nickel is the only clearly relevant tracked metal mentioned.

title: Environmental News Network - U of T Researchers Grow Micro-Organisms That Can Clean Tailings Ponds and Recover Nickel
summary: U of T researchers, with mining and processing partners including Vale and Glencore, are developing acid-loving bacteria processes to recover nickel from tailings ponds. The project is funded by public Ontario and Canada programs plus industry contributions. It may improve nickel recovery long term, but immediate production impact appears limited.

title: Tomago Aluminium expects to play a bigger role in propping up the energy grid  | Newcastle Herald
summary: Tomago Aluminium says it may be asked to cut power usage more frequently as Australia’s grid becomes less reliable after Liddell’s closure and due to El Nino forecasts and firmed capacity shortages. As an interruptible load, Tomago can drop 600 MW quickly but risks freezing and lost production if power is cut too often.

title: National Copper closing Huntsville and Ardmore Plants
summary: National Copper and Smelting plans to close its Huntsville, Alabama and Ardmore, Tennessee facilities, with the final operating day scheduled for July 24, according to an internal email. The company’s parent firms (Kothar Group and Cyprum Metals) intend the closures. The cause and employment impact are unclear.

title: Copper Prices Rebounded As US Debt Crisis Was Addressed_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports copper rebounded after a US debt ceiling agreement eased market stress, boosting risk appetite and weakening the dollar. SHFE copper rose slightly and inventories in key Chinese markets declined, indicating tight supply. However, consumption softened after the price rebound, limiting further upside in the near term.

title: SMM Morning Comments (May 30): Base Metals Show Mixed Performance, With Copper Outperforming, Growing Risk Appetite Softens Safe-Haven Appeal Of US Dollar_SMM
summary: SMM reports mixed LME/SHFE performance after a U.S. debt-ceiling agreement boosted risk appetite and weakened the dollar, but inflation and expected Fed hikes limit upside. Copper rose slightly yet sentiment may fade amid weaker consumption. Aluminium fell with inventories dropping but fundamentals seen unchanged. Nickel weakened due to falling premiums, rising stocks, and softer demand.

title: Marimaca Copper: Chile's Malimarca Oxide Ore Resources Have Increased Significantly_SMM
summary: Marimaca Copper said proven and probable Marimaca oxide ore resources in Chile rose 44%, reaching 200 million mt at 0.45% copper, plus inferred resources of 37 million mt at 0.38% copper. The update supports its feasibility study for expanding capacity design in Antofagasta.

title: Indonesia puts nickel export levy on hold to devise a price index first
summary: Indonesia, the world’s top nickel producer, is putting plans for a nickel export levy on hold while it develops a nickel price index to reduce volatility linked to LME benchmarks. The index will feed into royalties and the levy calculation. Export tax delay likely supports nickel sentiment near term amid LME uncertainty.

title: Indonesia considering nickel price index - govt official
summary: Indonesia is considering creating a nickel price index this year and has paused plans to tax nickel product exports, a senior government official said. Because Indonesia is the world’s biggest nickel producer, these policy and pricing benchmark signals could influence near-term nickel market expectations and support prices.

title: Business groups  optimistic on UP nickel mining | News, Sports, Jobs
summary: Business groups and officials say northern Minnesota/Wisconsin and Michigan’s Upper Peninsula could boost domestic production of critical minerals for EVs, especially nickel. The article cites the Eagle Mine’s nickel/copper output and Tamarack’s nickel supply agreement with Tesla, alongside USGS mapping funding and supportive federal policies.

title: Copper prices ease as dollar hits two-month peak
summary: Copper fell after the U.S. dollar hit a two-month peak, making dollar-priced metal more expensive for non-USD holders. Risk sentiment improved temporarily, but the stronger dollar kept pressure on the non-ferrous complex. LME nickel and aluminium also declined, suggesting broad near-term bearish momentum for industrial metals.

title: Indonesia Plans to Launch Nickel Price Index This Year and Defer Export Tariffs on NPI and High-Grade Nickel Matte_SMM
summary: Indonesia’s government plans to launch a new nickel price index this year, separate from the current HPM benchmark. It also signaled a deferral of proposed export duties on NPI and high-grade nickel matte, rather than immediate implementation, potentially supporting near-term nickel supply/export flows and weighing on prices.

title: BHP taps Microsoft, AI, to improve recovery at top copper mine
summary: BHP says it is partnering with Microsoft to use AI and real-time plant data to improve ore-processing variables and increase grade recovery at its top copper operations, including Escondida. The company argues digital technology can boost output from existing mines. The plan could modestly support short-term copper supply expectations.

title: BHP : and Microsoft use AI to lift Escondida copper recovery
summary: BHP and Microsoft partnered to use AI and machine learning to optimize concentrator performance at BHP’s Escondida copper mine in Chile. BHP expects improved copper recovery from real-time plant data and Azure-based recommendations. The piece frames it as part of next-generation mining productivity gains.

title: Indonesia Plans to Launch Nickel Price Index This Year and Defer Export Tariffs on Nickel Products_SMM
summary: Indonesia said it plans to launch a new nickel price index this year, distinct from the current HPM benchmark for Indonesian nickel ore. The government also indicated it will defer planned export duties on nickel products such as NPI and high-grade nickel matte, delaying cost pressures and potentially supporting nickel prices.

title: BHP and Microsoft use AI to lift Escondida copper recovery
summary: BHP and Microsoft say they are using AI and machine learning to optimize concentrator performance at Escondida in Chile, aiming to improve copper recovery. The project uses real-time plant data and Azure-based recommendations to adjust operational variables affecting ore processing and grade recovery. Escondida is a major global copper producer.

title: China's Aluminium Plate/Sheet And Strip Exports Fell Significantly In April And To Remain Sluggish In The Future _SMM
summary: SMM reports China exported 228,000 mt of aluminium plate/sheet and strip in April, down 8.56% month-on-month and 30.7% year-on-year. With overseas production normalizing and global demand cooling, exports have trended lower since late 2022. SMM expects 200,000–250,000 mt monthly in the future.

title: SMM Forecast for Copper Prices This Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM expects SHFE copper to trade around 63,000–65,000 yuan/mt and LME copper around $7,850–8,200/mt this week. It notes that a prior sharp price drop is expected to stimulate demand, while inventories continue to fall, spot supply stays tight, and spot premiums rise to 180–300 yuan/mt.

title: Copper Inventory in Major Chinese Markets Dip over Weekend_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM said copper inventories across major Chinese markets totaled 118,300 mt as of May 29, slipping 100 mt from the prior Friday, though still above last year. Stocks fell in Shanghai and most regions, while Guangdong rose. East China’s limited supply and strong consumption lowered inventories, supporting sentiment for copper.

title: Citigroup, Bank of America See Copper Surplus in 2023, But Copper Shortage In the Long Run Will Be Stubborn_SMM
summary: Supply disruptions in Panama, Chile and Peru are said to be taking a backseat, and new mining projects support a slight copper surplus this year. However, WBMS data show a March 2023 copper cathode shortage of 74,400 mt. Net near-term price pressure appears limited by the offsetting signals.

title: Copper slips as investors brace for more bad news from China
summary: Copper prices stayed near a six-month low as investors prepared for Chinese data expected to show continued factory contraction. Demand concerns were reinforced by weak construction activity, low Yangshan import premiums, and LME stocks rising to about 100,000 tonnes. Aluminium and nickel also fell as broader metals sentiment deteriorated.

title: Copper braces for more bad news from China
summary: Copper trades just above a six-month low as investors brace for China’s manufacturing PMI, expected to show a second month of contraction. Demand concerns are reinforced by stagnant construction, low Yangshan import premiums, and LME stocks near 100,000 tonnes. Aluminium is also weaker on the broader demand/risk sentiment.

title: Unleashing Nickel's Potential: Indonesia's Journey to Global Prominence
summary: Indonesia’s export-ban policy on nickel ores, smelter buildout, and potential further restrictions (bauxite ban; possible heavy tax if WTO appeal fails) are positioned to increase processed nickel output while potentially tightening effective supply. Rising EV battery demand is cited, supporting a bullish near-term nickel outlook.

title: Funds keep the bear pressure on copper as LME stocks rise: Andy Home
summary: Reuters reports funds have turned net short of LME copper, reinforcing bear pressure as LME inventories rise sharply and contango widens. The piece cites disappointing China demand, weaker global trade signals, recession fears, and an estimated sizable refined copper surplus, suggesting continued near-term downside risk for copper prices.

title: NewRange Copper Nickel LLC: NewRange Initiates Salvage and Recycle Project at Former LTV Steel Site
summary: NewRange Copper Nickel began an ~$18M salvage and recycle program at the former LTV Steel site to restore electrical systems and refurbish infrastructure for the NorthMet clean-energy critical minerals project. The work will salvage steel and concrete to support safer construction readiness. It reinforces ongoing development of copper and nickel resources.

title: Exclusive-Glencore plans $1.5 billion investment to expand Peru copper mine
summary: Glencore’s Antapaccay is advancing the Coroccohuayco expansion at Peru’s Antapaccay copper mine, investing over $1.5 billion to extend mine life and stabilize output. Production has fallen due to weaker ore grades, and social unrest has delayed the project, with approvals expected in 2H 2024.

title: Outokumpu Oyj : seeks to strengthen the supply chain of sustainable nickel by acquiring a share in the Canadian company FPX...
summary: Outokumpu said it will invest EUR 11 million for a 9.9% stake in Canada’s FPX Nickel to strengthen its sustainable nickel supply chain. The Baptiste project is planned to start producing near decade-end, targeting low-carbon nickel units suited for stainless steel feedstock.

title: Aluminium Bahrain B S C : Alba strengthens ties with Egypt's Aluminium Sector
summary: Aluminium Bahrain (Alba) met Egypt’s public enterprises minister and discussed enhancing cooperation with Egypt’s aluminium producers, including Egyptalum. The companies plan to study feasibility of potential partnerships, with bauxite highlighted as a key raw material. The piece is about investment and integration rather than immediate production or trade changes.

title: Glencore plans US$1.5-billion investment to expand Peru copper mine
summary: Glencore plans to invest over $1.5 billion to expand its Antapaccay copper mine in Peru via the Coroccohuayco project, which would extend mine life and help counter declining ore grades and halted output. The plan remains delayed by local social unrest, with approvals expected in 2H 2024.

title: The Power Play by The Market Herald Releases New Interviews with Hank Payments and FPX Nickel Corp Discussing Their Latest News
summary: The Market Herald released interviews and highlights corporate news, including FPX Nickel closing a private placement with Outokumpu as a strategic cornerstone investor. The financing is a positive signal for FPX’s nickel-related activities and can modestly improve short-term sentiment toward nickel prices, though it lacks operational detail.

title: BHP and Microsoft collaborate on AI in copper extraction
summary: BHP and Microsoft will use AI and machine learning on Microsoft Azure to optimize ore processing and recoveries at BHP’s Escondida copper mine in Chile. While the initiative aims to offset declining grades and improve concentrator performance, the article gives no near-term production targets despite noting a broader copper supply deficit context.

title: Glencore plans $1.5 bln investment to expand Peru copper mine
summary: Glencore plans to invest over $1.5 billion to expand its Antapaccay copper mine in Peru via the Coroccohuayco project. The project aims to extend mine life and lift/ stabilise output after years of falling production due to poorer ore grades and delays from social unrest. Approval is expected in 2H 2024.

title: Congo could seize Peru's No. 2 copper spot as Andean output slows
summary: Congo’s copper production has accelerated and could surpass Peru’s standing over time, while Peru’s output position is at risk due to fewer new projects and ongoing protests. Chile faces political/regulatory uncertainty and depleted mines. The key timing for major rank change is projected for 2026/27, limiting short-term impact.

title: Indonesian copper miner Amman Internasional to raise $880 million in IPO
summary: Indonesian copper miner Amman Mineral’s $880m IPO will finance debt repayment and projects, including completing a copper smelter in Sumbawa with planned cathode output. The Indonesian government’s temporary raw export exemption supports revenue needed to finish the project, reinforcing near-term copper sentiment.

title: BHP Uses Most Cutting-Edge Technology to Massively Boost Productivity at World's Biggest Copper Mine_SMM
summary: BHP said it is working with Microsoft to apply machine learning and AI via Azure to improve recovery rates at the Escondida copper mine in Chile. By using real-time ore-processing data and AI recommendations, operators can adjust variables affecting recovery. Escondida produced over 1 million mt copper last fiscal year.

title: Indonesia is riding strong tailwinds | White & Case LLP
summary: White & Case highlights Indonesia’s strong Q1 deal activity, including Nickel Industries’ March equity placement to fund purchases and raise its stakes in Indonesian nickel projects (including Huayue Nickel Cobalt). It frames the strategy as shifting toward battery-grade/Class 1 nickel for EV demand, which is supportive for nickel sentiment.

title: Copper falls on China PMI data, set for second monthly loss
summary: Copper prices slid after China’s manufacturing PMI came in weaker than expected, below 50 indicating contraction, reinforcing concerns about demand in the world’s top consumer. Copper was set for a second monthly loss and fell 5.8% so far this month. LME aluminium and nickel also declined alongside risk sentiment.

title: Wood Mackenzie: Congo Will Overtake Peru in Copper Production amid Slow Output Growth at Mining Giants, Catch Up with Top Copper Producer Chile_SMM
summary: Wood Mackenzie forecasts that slowing output growth from Andean mining giants could allow the Democratic Republic of Congo to overtake Peru in copper production over the next few years and approach Chile’s level. The report is about longer-term production shifts, with limited direct evidence of near-term disruptions.

title: Glencore Plans To Invest $1.5 Billion In Peru Copper Mine
summary: Glencore plans to invest $1.5 billion in a copper mine in Peru. The spending indicates continued development and support for future copper production capacity, which can improve market sentiment toward copper supply prospects and provide mild near-term upward pressure on prices.

title: Key Takeaway from SMM 2023 Indonesia Nickel and Cobalt Industry Chain Conference: Macquarie Group Says Nickel Demand Growth Will Outpace Lithium, with Battery Being Major Driver_SMM
summary: Macquarie’s Jim Lennon argues Indonesia will supply most of global nickel growth through 2029, and that strong supply versus slowing demand created a nickel surplus in 2022. With underutilized capacity, the market could stay surplus, weighing on LME nickel. Battery demand is growing but supply effects dominate near-term.

title: Indonesian copper miner Amman aims to raise $880 million in IPO
summary: Indonesian copper miner Amman Mineral plans an $880 million IPO to fund debt repayment and projects, notably completing a copper smelter in Sumbawa. The smelter’s capacity would produce substantial copper cathode, supported by a government raw export exemption to May 2024, potentially lifting copper supply expectations.

title: Alro S A : Group and AZERALUMINIUM signed a Memorandum of Understanding aimed to enhance their technical and economic capabilities
summary: ALRO signed an MoU with Azeraluminium to explore cooperation on raw material supply (baked anodes and alumina), aluminum product sales, and processing/marketing of continuous casting coils. The parties also discuss developing a gas-fired power plant on ALRO’s premises, aiming to improve technical and economic capabilities.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Reports 32.27 metres at 0.98% Copper and 103.26 metres at 0.79% Copper within 484.81 metres at 0.42% Copper Outside of the Keel Underground Mineral Resource
summary: Faraday Copper announced drill results from its Copper Creek project in Arizona, including multiple copper-bearing intercepts (e.g., 484.81m at 0.42% Cu and 103.26m at 0.79% Cu within drill hole FCD-23-024). Results are outside the current underground resource, supporting potential expansion, with follow-up drilling planned.

title: Fathom Nickel Inc.: Fathom Nickel Announces the Closing of the First Tranche of Upsized Private Placement
summary: Fathom Nickel closed the first tranche of an upsized private placement to fund exploration at the Albert Lake and Gochager Lake projects in Saskatchewan. Proceeds support Canadian flow-through mining expenditures and general corporate uses. The company targets magmatic nickel sulphides and its resource includes copper by-grade.

title: Faraday Copper Reports 32.27 metres at 0.98% Copper and 103.26 metres at 0.79% Copper within 484.81 metres at 0.42% Copper Outside of the Keel Underground Mineral Resource
summary: Faraday Copper reports assay results from underground drilling at the Keel project: multiple intercepts with copper grades (including 0.98% over 32.27 metres and 0.79% over 103.26 metres) outside the current mineral resource. The news is copper-related but primarily affects project expectations, not near-term market pricing.

title: Copper heads for second monthly drop on dismal China data
summary: Copper prices edged toward six-month lows after May China factory activity contracted faster than expected, reinforcing concerns that the rebound is losing steam. Japan and South Korea output also fell. A weaker yuan pressured dollar-priced metals, while physical premiums rose and LME inventories increased.

title: Global palladium market to swing to surplus in 2024 – Nornickel
summary: Nornickel says the palladium market may swing to a surplus in 2024 as recycling outpaces recovering demand. While palladium is not tracked here, the company also expects the global nickel market surplus to exceed 180,000 tonnes in 2024 versus 200,000 in 2023, implying weaker nickel pricing pressure.

title: Key Takeaway from SMM 2023 Indonesia Nickel and Cobalt Industry Chain Conference: INSG Shares Insights on 2023 Global Nickel Market Outlook and Sees Supply Surplus  _SMM
summary: INSG commentary at SMM’s Indonesia nickel and cobalt conference projects the global primary nickel market to return to surplus in 2023, citing ongoing supply growth (including rising Indonesian output) and a reported 51,000 mt surplus in Q1 2023. Demand growth is viewed as slower amid macro uncertainty.

title: SMM Daily Comments (May 31): Base Metals Mostly Fell with SHFE Nickel Plunging, Ferrous Metals Dropped across the Board, Oil Down on Iran's Full Return to Oil Market and Contentious Opinions within OPEC_SMM
summary: SMM’s May 31 market wrap says crude oil slipped and the U.S. dollar rose, with supply-side headlines around Iran/OPEC. Base metals mostly fell: SHFE nickel plunged 4.81%, SHFE copper was slightly down, and SHFE aluminium rose modestly. LME metals were largely lower, with aluminium nearly flat.

title: Zambia orders halt to work on copper mine in Lower Zambezi park
summary: Zambia’s environmental agency ordered a halt to mining-related activities at Mwembeshi Resources’ Kangaluwi copper project in Lower Zambezi park after violations of environmental conditions. The order also stops related road and building work. The company said it expects to resume once benchmarks are met, while campaigners seek licence cancellation.

title: Copper mining firm to use AI to increase extraction rates
summary: BHP’s Escondida in Chile will use AI and Azure-based analytics on real-time concentrator data to improve ore processing and grade recovery. The initiative aims to extract more value from existing resources as copper is expected to face future supply shortfalls from green energy and battery demand.

title: LME launches two consultations on reforms in wake of nickel crisis
summary: LME launched two consultations to reform market rules after last year’s nickel crisis, including expanded warehouse reporting on off-warrant inventories and changes to how closing prices are set. The VWAP-based closing method would include more aluminium, copper and nickel contracts. Timing is June–July, not immediate rule changes.

title: LME's nickel crisis: major developments since trading halt crisis
summary: The article recounts major developments in the LME nickel trading crisis, including a halt and trade cancellations after prices spiked above $100,000/ton, regulatory probes and independent reviews, disputes over delivered “bagged” nickel, and later steps to resume trading and revive the nickel contract via reduced waiting times and fees.

title: Copper miner Amman aims to raise Rp12.94 trillion through IPO
summary: Indonesian copper miner Amman Mineral Internasional launched an IPO to raise up to Rp12.94 trillion. Proceeds will fund construction and expansion of a copper smelter and processing facilities, plus related power generation. The planned additional capacity could influence near-term expectations for copper supply and pricing sentiment.

title: Helix Resources picks up large new copper tenement
summary: Helix Resources says results from a regional targeting program indicate growing copper potential in the Cobar-Nyngan area of central NSW. It has applied for a 585 sq km exploration licence near existing Tritton copper operations and along the Collerina Copper Trend, aiming to discover new copper resources.

title: Billion-dollar sale of copper mine wins FIRB approval
summary: Metals Acquisition Corp said Australian FIRB approval has been obtained for investments by Osisko Bermuda Limited and Glencore in its acquisition of the CSA Copper Mine from Glencore. The $1.1 billion deal is now free of further Australian foreign investment approvals, bringing it closer to closing.

title: World's top copper producer closes smelter in 'Chile's Chernobyl'
summary: The report headline states that the world’s top copper producer has closed a smelter in Chile. A shutdown of refining capacity can reduce near-term availability of refined copper and tighten supply expectations, which generally supports copper prices in the coming days and weeks.

title: World's Top Copper Producer Closes Smelter In 'Chile's Chernobyl'
summary: Chile’s state-owned Codelco closed its Ventanas smelter, a major facility for refined copper output. The shutdown, prompted by severe environmental concerns, curtails near-term copper supply from the world’s leading producer. The reduced output is likely to tighten market expectations and support higher copper prices.

title: Resolution Copper wins right to side against tribes in mine suit
summary: A federal court allowed Resolution Copper to join the U.S. government as a defendant in Apache Stronghold’s lawsuit to stop the Oak Flat copper mine land swap. The decision keeps the project’s legal fight active while regulators’ timelines appear unsettled, which may support expectations for eventual copper supply.

title: Chile shuts down state-owned copper smelter after decades of pollution
summary: Chile’s Codelco shut down the Ventanas copper smelter after decades of pollution in Quintero Bay. President Boric said the smelter contributed over 60% of the area’s sulfur dioxide emissions. While a Codelco refinery continues, the closure reduces smelting capacity and may tighten short-term copper supply expectations.

title: Global Spike In Aluminium Prices Drives NZ Smelter's Profit
summary: Rio Tinto’s Pacific Aluminium subsidiary reported 2022 results tied to a global aluminium price surge in the first half of 2022 after Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and higher energy costs. Aluminium prices later fell and stabilised. The smelter operated at 333,689 tonnes and continued Tiwai remediation, seeking energy solutions beyond 2024.

title: Spot Premiums Of Norilsk Nickel Fall Sharply, Market Share Of Chinese NPI May Shrink As Indonesia Plans To Defer Export Tariffs On Nickel Products_SMM
summary: Spot premiums of Norilsk nickel fell sharply as large arrivals and a sell-off pressured the market. Indonesia’s plan to defer export tariffs on nickel products may erode the market share of domestic NPI. With nickel supply described as ample, the article highlights downside risks for nickel pricing.

title: Tiwai Point smelter's underlying profits hit by see-sawing aluminium prices
summary: Pacific Aluminium Smelters’ underlying profit fell year-on-year as Tiwai Point aluminium prices cooled in the second half of the year. Earlier gains followed Russia’s invasion and higher energy costs. Management expects cost control amid a cyclical aluminium environment and notes prices have dropped from post-invasion highs.

title: Commerzbank Lowers Price Forecast for Copper, Aluminium, Zinc and Nickel for 2023 and 2024_SMM
summary: Commerzbank lowered its 2023-2024 price forecasts, reducing expected end-2023/end-2024 levels for copper, aluminium, and nickel versus prior estimates. Copper and nickel forecasts fell materially, while aluminium was also marked down. The change reflects revised expectations, not an immediate physical market disruption.

title: Commerzbank Lowers Price Forecast for Copper, Aluminium, Zinc and Nickel for 2023 and 2024_SMM
summary: Commerzbank cut its end-2023 and end-2024 forecasts for copper (to $9,000/$9,400), aluminium (to $2,600/$2,800), and nickel (to $23,000/$20,000) versus prior estimates. The revisions imply weaker expected market conditions, typically bearish for metal sentiment and pricing.

title: Commerzbank Lowers Price Forecast for Copper, Aluminium, Zinc and Nickel for 2023 and 2024_SMM
summary: Commerzbank cut its forecasts for industrial metal prices, including copper, aluminium, and nickel, for end-2023 and end-2024. Copper and nickel targets were reduced materially, while aluminium was lowered versus prior estimates. The revision may affect market sentiment, but it is largely a medium-term view rather than an immediate shock.

title: Business.Scoop » Global Spike In Aluminium Prices Drives NZ Smelter's Profit
summary: Rio Tinto’s Pacific Aluminium reports 2022 results for New Zealand Aluminium Smelters, stating profits were driven by a first-half 2022 spike to record-high aluminium prices after Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and higher energy costs. Prices later fell and stabilised. The release focuses on financial performance and remediation, not new price-moving developments.

title: SMM Indonesia Nickel and Cobalt Industry Chain Conference: Global Nickel & Cobalt Supply and Demand Prospect, Impact from NEV Development_SMM
summary: SMM’s conference outlook links NEV growth and high-nickel ternary batteries to rising nickel demand (especially via battery use). It also describes nickel sulfate supply expansion led largely by Indonesia, while noting China faces raw-material shortages and production cost pressure. Net effect favors tighter nickel fundamentals and support for prices.

title: Avante Mining : Initiates Work On The TL Nickel Project
summary: Avante Mining announced it is commencing preparatory work on the TL Nickel Project, including re-logging and targeted sampling of historic core ahead of planned 2023 drilling. The release cites historic grades for nickel (and associated copper) and expects resampling results soon, but provides no production or immediate supply impact.

title: SMM Daily Comments (Jun 1): Base Metals Mostly Rose with SHFE Aluminium Surging, Ferrous Metals Rose across the board, Iron Ore Skyrocketed_SMM
summary: SMM’s daily comments show broad base-metal strength alongside firm energy and mixed FX. SHFE aluminium jumped 2.04% and SHFE copper gained 1.4%, while SHFE nickel slipped 0.17% by end of intraday. The piece suggests near-term bullish pressure for aluminium and copper.

title: Glencore to Massively Expand Copper Capacity_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Glencore said it will invest about $1.5bn to expand the Antapaccay copper mine in Peru, raising the previously cited $590m plan. The Coroccohuayco project would extend mine life to 2045–2050 and target ~250ktpa for the first decade. Output has fallen due to lower ore grades.

title: Nickel Creek Platinum Announces Updated Mineral Resource Estimate at Nickel Shäw Project
summary: Nickel Creek Platinum announced an updated mineral resource estimate for its 100%-owned Nickel Shäw Project in Yukon. Measured and indicated tonnage increased, with contained nickel rising to 2.47 billion lbs; copper is present at 0.13% grade. The update supports progress toward a pre-feasibility study.

title: Canada Nickel Continues to Intersect High-grade, Near-surface Mineralization at Texmont Project
summary: Canada Nickel reported final assay results from the Texmont Project, confirming continued high-grade, near-surface nickel mineralization. Most drillholes intersected >1% Ni and several intersected higher-grade intervals close to surface. Management highlighted potential for near-term smaller-scale open-pit production and expects a resource and PEA later in 2023.

title: PAN GLOBAL INTERSECTS HIGH GOLD GRADES AND COPPER MINERALIZATION NEAR SURFACE AT CAÑADA HONDA TARGET IN THE ESCACENA PROJECT, SPAIN
summary: Pan Global reports positive diamond-drill assays at its Cañada Honda target in Spain’s Escacena Project, including near-surface copper mineralization (e.g., 13m at 0.5% Cu). Drilling is expected to accelerate at other targets, but the news does not imply imminent supply changes.

title: Copper Fox Provides Update for Mineral Mountain Copper Project
summary: Copper Fox announced compilation results for its 100%-owned Mineral Mountain project in Arizona ahead of planned geophysical work. The company reports modeled copper-molybdenum zones and outcrop sampling returning up to 2.72% Cu, with further petrography pending. It is an exploration update with limited immediate effect on copper supply-demand.

title: Pan Global Resources Inc.: PAN GLOBAL INTERSECTS HIGH GOLD GRADES AND COPPER MINERALIZATION NEAR SURFACE AT CAÑADA HONDA TARGET IN THE ESCACENA PROJECT, SPAIN
summary: Pan Global reports continuous channel sampling at its Cañada Honda discovery in Spain, confirming a wide near-surface gold zone and copper-gold VMS-style mineralization. Assays include 0.16% copper over 6m, with a 3-km gravity/EM anomaly suggesting a large system and potential expansion drilling.

title: Excelsior Mining Corp.: Excelsior Mining Announces the Permit Amendment for Well Stimulation at the Gunnison Copper Mine is Now Effective
summary: Excelsior Mining said the amended underground injection (UIC) permit for well stimulation at its Gunnison Copper Project is now effective after the appeal period. The company plans early field trials and believes stimulation could improve wellfield performance and reduce reliance on downstream raffinate neutralization, supporting copper production outlook.

title: LME loses benchmark status in part of nickel market -Bloomberg News
summary: Eramet’s CEO said the LME has lost benchmark status for part of the nickel market, with Shanghai Metals Market becoming the reference for pricing ferronickel. She cited a growing mismatch between nickel stored in LME warehouses and the underlying fundamentals. LME also announced consultations after last year’s nickel trading crisis.

title: Eramet no longer sees LME as benchmark for ferronickel -report
summary: Eramet said LME is losing benchmark status for ferronickel pricing as Shanghai Metals Market indices increasingly set prices for nickel ore/ferronickel. It cited a disconnect between LME pricing of pure nickel and physical inventory fundamentals. The company noted limited LME indexation for its products.

title: A Mining Legend Says Copper is in the Buy Zone - The Globe and Mail
summary: The article argues copper is in a “buy zone,” citing declining LME warehouse stocks, tight supply, and rising demand tied to decarbonization (EVs, wind). It expects copper to avoid breaking key support around $3.15 and sees bullish upside despite bearish technicals. Spillover to other base metals is suggested.

title: LEADING EDGE NOTES ASSAYS AT 30% NICKEL AND 4.7% COBALT AT
summary: Leading Edge Materials reports assay results from Bihor Sud showing high-grade Co-Ni mineralization, including ~30% nickel and supporting ~1 km Co-Ni potential, with access delays due to high radon now resolved. The company plans further underground channel sampling and drilling, reinforcing nickel supply upside expectations.

title: LEADING EDGE NOTES ASSAYS AT 30% NICKEL AND 4.7% COBALT AT BIHOR SUD
summary: Leading Edge Materials reports positive trench and underground gallery wall assays at Bihor Sud, highlighting high-grade Co-Ni mineralization with nickel assays exceeding 30% in samples from gallery G7, alongside Zn-Pb-Ag results. Improved access after radon-related ventilation delays enables further underground sampling and drilling plans.

title: Novelis Enters Long-Term Agreement to Supply Aluminum Beverage Can Sheet to The Coca-Cola System
summary: Novelis signed a long-term supply agreement with Coca-Cola Bottlers to provide aluminum beverage can sheet for North American Coca-Cola brands, supported by closed-loop recycling. The deal ties to capacity expansion at the Bay Minette, Alabama plant. Continued contracted capacity and expected demand growth support aluminum demand sentiment.

title: Glencore to expand Peru copper mine with $1.5bn investment
summary: Glencore plans to invest about $1.5bn to expand its Antapaccay copper mine in Peru, advancing the delayed Coroccohuayco project after ore-grade issues reduced output. The program aims to extend mine life to 2045/2050 and lift sustained production, supporting copper supply expectations despite prior social unrest delays.

title: Chinese Aluminum Producer Orders New Cold Rolling Mill from Primetals Technologies
summary: Shandong Nanshan Aluminum ordered a new cold rolling mill with Primetals UCM technology for its Longkou plant, targeting expansion into higher-end, including automotive, aluminum products. The mill’s capacity is about 180,000 tons, with improved rolling stability and reduced spare work-roll costs. Startup is planned for mid-2025.

title: Copper Prices Trounced By Falling Demand
summary: Financial Times via Goldman reportedly cut its average copper forecast and copper futures hit a six-month low. The move is linked to recession fears in Europe, weak Chinese manufacturing, a firm U.S. dollar, increased speculator shorts, and rapidly rising LME inventories amid contango-driven inflows. DRC/Peru supply is described as calmer.

title: Dr. Copper's weak performance suggests more economic woes ahead
summary: The piece notes copper’s “Dr. Copper” nickname and highlights that prices are on track for their biggest quarterly percentage loss in a year. It frames the weak performance as a signal of deteriorating global economic conditions, suggesting softer near-term demand and continued downside pressure for copper.

title: Minnesota to revamp copper-nickel mining rules over light, noise pollution concerns
summary: Minnesota regulators decided existing nonferrous mine siting rules are insufficient to prevent noise and light impacts on the Boundary Waters and will reopen rules, potentially expanding protective buffer zones. The change is another obstacle for Twin Metals’ proposed copper-nickel mine, already affected by prior federal actions.

title: Minnesota to revamp copper-nickel mining rules over light, noise pollution concerns
summary: Minnesota regulators decided existing nonferrous mine siting rules are insufficient to protect the Boundary Waters from noise and light impacts. The DNR will expand the buffer zone, potentially affecting the Twin Metals copper-nickel project. The change could delay permitting, adding supply risk for copper and nickel in the coming weeks.

title: Aransas Pass Police seeking suspects in string of copper line thefts
summary: Aransas Pass Police are investigating multiple fiber and copper line thefts from Frontier in Texas, with roughly 616.7 feet of copper strand stolen and about 900 feet of fiber cut. The company estimates replacement and repair costs near $60,000-$70,000. The impact appears localized and unlikely to move copper prices materially.

title: Indonesia's Abundance In High-Grade Nickel Ore Resources Attract Massive Investment From Chinese Stainless Steel Enterprises_SMM
summary: SMM says Indonesia has the world’s richest nickel ore reserves (25.4 million mt nickel content in 2021) and higher-grade lateritic ore than the Philippines. It attributes Chinese mining and stainless steel investment demand to Indonesia’s ample resources and comparatively less stringent environmental rules for local production.

title: Udokan Copper helps restore Siberian sturgeon population as part of its ESG program
summary: Udokan Copper released Siberian sturgeon fry into the Chara River as part of its ESG program. The company also highlights using hydrometallurgy instead of pyrolysis and plans to cut production carbon intensity by 75% by 2030. It confirms plans for cathode copper and concentrate output from the Udokan project.

title: Eramet Says SMM Has Become Benchmark for NPI Pricing as LME Lost Benchmark Status in a Key Sector of Nickel Market_SMM
summary: Eramet said LME lost benchmark status in a key nickel market segment after a major short sale, with SMM becoming the benchmark for NPI pricing. The piece also notes Commerzbank cutting price forecasts for copper, aluminium and nickel for 2023-2024, signaling a bearish outlook for these metals.

title: Copper Inventory in Major Chinese Markets Fell for Four Consecutive Weeks_SMM
summary: SMM says copper inventories across major Chinese markets totaled 111,100 mt as of June 2, down for a fourth consecutive week. Shanghai and Guangdong saw the largest declines, with only small increases in Jiangsu. An import inflow is expected next week, but SMM still forecasts inventory to fall slightly further on improving demand.

title: Copper Inventory in China Bonded Zone Dropped This Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s bonded-zone copper inventories fell 13,000 mt week-on-week to 101,600 mt, with declines in both Guangdong and Shanghai zones. Import profits narrowed, keeping buyers sidelined and reducing bonded-zone shipments, though month-end arrivals are increasing. Bonded inventory declines are slowing as early-June arrivals grow.

title: LME Has Lost Benchmark Status in a Key Part of the Nickel Market_SMM
summary: Eramet says ferronickel pricing is increasingly benchmarked to a Shanghai Metals Market index rather than the LME since last year’s LME short squeeze and trading disruption. The LME nickel contract remains challenged, with falling volumes and diverging prices across nickel intermediates, some also pressured by Indonesian supply.

title: SMM Indonesia Nickel and Cobalt Industry Chain Conference: Evolution Trend of Nickel Structural Supply under Prosperous Development of NEV_SMM
summary: SMM discusses trends in nickel structural supply tied to high-nickel ternary cathode pathways, with weighted nickel consumption from Chinese precursors rising toward 2025. It also notes Commerzbank has lowered price forecasts for copper, aluminium, zinc and nickel for 2023-2024, suggesting weaker price expectations.

title: Nickel Inventories in Domestic Bonded Zone up 300 mt from May 26_SMM
summary: SMM says China’s bonded-zone nickel inventories increased to 4,200 mt as nickel briquettes and nickel plates rose to 1,670 mt and 2,530 mt. The gain was driven by deliveries for long-term orders and intensified arrival of imported pure nickel at ports from late May through early June, adding supply and pressuring prices.

title: Independent Proxy Advisory Firms, ISS and Glass Lewis, Support Hudbay's Plan of Arrangement with Copper Mountain and Recommend Shareholders Vote "FOR"
summary: Proxy advisers ISS and Glass Lewis recommend shareholders vote FOR Hudbay’s acquisition of Copper Mountain. The deal is expected to be accretive with synergies and increased copper production scale (Copper Mountain’s mine). It is primarily a governance/transaction announcement without new near-term copper supply-demand changes.

title: Fitch Says Falling Commodity Demand Causes Industrial Production To Cool Rapidly And Softer Commodity Prices Such As Copper Are Clear Signs Of Economic Slowdown_SMM
summary: Fitch attributes slower global trade to tighter monetary policy, reduced fiscal support, and weakening consumer goods demand. It says supply chain issues are easing and that falling commodity demand has rapidly cooled industrial production. Fitch points to softer commodity prices, including copper, as clear indicators of economic slowdown.

title: SMM Daily Comments (Jun 2): All Metals Closed Higher with SHFE Nickel Leading Gains, Coke Surged_SMM
summary: Markets ended higher: the article cites a two-day fall in the US dollar and two-day rise in crude oil, with SHFE nickel up 4.04%, SHFE aluminium up 1.71%, and SHFE copper up 1.5%. LME copper, aluminium and nickel also rose. Commerzbank lowered longer-term forecasts for copper and aluminium.

title: Copper driven towards first weekly gain since April
summary: Copper prices were set for their first weekly gain in seven weeks after a surprise rise in China’s Caixin manufacturing activity boosted demand hopes. A U.S. debt-default deal, Senate debt-ceiling legislation, and expectations of no further Fed hikes weakened the dollar and lifted risk assets. Aluminium and nickel also rose.

title: Oil and Copper Are Sputtering | InvestorPlace
summary: InvestorPlace discusses weak Chinese demand (PMI below 50 and stalling recovery) and notes that disappointing construction activity is weighing on commodities. It specifically says copper has dived below $8,000/ton, framing the move as a barometer effect from China’s slowdown rather than a supply-only story.

title: Sterlite Copper to open Thoothukudi plant for maintenance work
summary: Sterlite Copper received permission from the Tamil Nadu administration to carry out maintenance/upkeep work at its Thoothukudi plant, citing Supreme Court direction. Such maintenance can temporarily influence copper production and near-term supply expectations, though the report provides no details suggesting a major or extended shutdown.

title: Congo Halts ERG's Copper Mining Project After Waste Leakage
summary: Congo has reportedly halted ERG’s copper mining project after waste leakage. The stop raises near-term uncertainty about copper supply and could weigh on expectations for production volumes. Traders may adjust short-term supply risk premiums, influencing copper prices over the coming days and weeks.

title: National Copper & Smelting to close Huntsville, Ardmore locations
summary: National Copper and Smelting announced it will close its Huntsville and Ardmore-area facilities, with phase-down beginning over the next several weeks and about 115 workers affected. The closures reduce local copper product processing capacity, which can modestly tighten near-term copper supply expectations and support prices.

title: Green meets with JISCO Alpart about bauxite mining project
summary: Jamaica’s Mining Minister Floyd Green met with JISCO Alpart to discuss restarting and reopening the Alpart bauxite-alumina plant in Nain, St Elizabeth. Talks focused on the stalled modification process, feasibility of continued mining, and a prospective timeline for operations resuming, with government support indicated.

title: 2 alleged copper thieves under arrest after stolen copper found in vehicle
summary: A traffic stop in Eastern Jackson County, Missouri led to two arrests after copper was found stolen from utility lines. AT&T reports residents lost internet/phone service when copper was cut from phone lines. Officials call copper theft a serious local problem, but the report offers no market-wide supply impact.

title: Peru April copper production jumped 30% -gov't
summary: Peru’s Ministry of Energy and Mines said April copper production rose 30.5% year-on-year, with fine output jumping to 221,999 tonnes versus 170,168 a year earlier. The strong performance at mines such as Las Bambas and Cerro Verde boosted first-four-month output, adding incremental market supply.

title: Arrests made after large amount of stolen copper found during traffic stop
summary: Two people were arrested after a traffic stop turned up a large amount of stolen copper in Jackson County, Missouri. Officials cite copper theft as a growing problem that disrupts AT&T phone and internet services and forces costly replacements. A reward was offered after thefts, indicating ongoing disruption.

title: Copper stocks: Analysts say buy these miners and shares as prices soar
summary: CNBC highlights that analysts at Citi and Goldman expect copper to rebound sharply, with Citi projecting large upside in a base/bull case. It cites a significant deficit phase and persistent negative mine-supply shocks, while China demand is stronger than growth concerns. The piece recommends gradually building copper exposure.

title: Zambia Halts Kangaluwi Copper Project_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Zambian authorities said Mwembeshi Resources must immediately stop all activities at the Kangaluwi copper project in the Lower Zambezi River National Park, a wildlife-rich area. The suspension halts development of the $494 million project, raising near-term supply disruption risks for copper markets.

title: South32 weighs tilt at Botswana copper mine Khoemacau, hires RBC
summary: South32 has hired RBC Capital Markets to prepare an indicative bid for Botswana’s Khoemacau Copper Mining, valued at more than $2 billion. The report suggests potential M&A interest in an operating copper asset, but offers no information on near-term output changes, sanctions, or disruptions.

title: Copper under pressure from demand worries and dollar
summary: Reuters reports copper fell on Monday due to demand worries, notably in top consumer China, and a stronger dollar. Copper later partially recovered as the dollar retreated. The piece cites rising LME warehouse stocks and supply concerns from cancellations, while aluminium and nickel also declined.

title: Codelco Closes Ventanas Copper Smelter to Reduce Pollution_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Codelco closed the Ventanas copper smelter on Chile’s central coast following an environmental pollution incident, completing the official shutdown after 59 years of operation. The smelter’s capacity is about 150,000 mt/year, reducing refined copper supply and supporting short-term copper price expectations.

title: Chile's Copper Production Fell In April and Still Low Compared with The Same Period In Recent Years_SMM
summary: Chile’s INE data shows copper output in April declined 1.1% year-on-year to 417,279 mt and remained the lowest for that month compared with recent years. Production also fell notably from March. Mine disruption weakened, but new capacity commissioning was very limited. Chilean manufacturing output dropped 6.4%.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Announces Kamoa-Kakula Achieved Record Copper Production of 35,856 Tonnes in May
summary: Ivanhoe Mines said its Kamoa-Kakula Copper Complex in DRC produced a monthly record 35,856 tonnes of copper in concentrate in May, up from 34,826 tonnes in April. It also logged a new daily ore milling record, with Phase 1 and 2 operating above-design recoveries.

title: Key Economic Indicators Show Economies of Various Countries Are Slowing Down, But Copper Prices will Rebound_SMM
summary: US debt-ceiling concerns eased and expectations shifted toward the Fed pausing rate hikes in June, weakening the dollar. SMM attributes copper’s rebound to reduced downside constraints, firmer spot premiums, and active downstream buying on dips, despite slower PMI readings and lower cathode-rod operating rates.

title: LME aluminium stocks battle comes with a Russian twist :  Andy Home
summary: Reuters reports another raid and volatility in LME aluminium stocks after 132,700 tonnes were cancelled in May. Russian aluminium inventories have surged, boosted by weaker Western self-sanctioning and displacement after US 200% import duties. Cancellations are concentrated in Port Klang, raising competition and contract differentiation, though outright prices remain in $2,200–2,300 range.

title: 10 Best Copper Stocks to Buy - Insider Monkey
summary: The article promotes copper stock picks and argues copper demand is rising from infrastructure, EVs, renewables, and technology. It also cites company updates such as higher planned or actual copper output (e.g., production growth at specific mines). Overall, it’s more long-term sentiment than a clear near-term supply shock.

title: Persistent Oversupply Will Continue To Weigh On Alumina Prices_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports the alumina index at 2,844 yuan/mt, down week-on-week, with deals showing falling price levels in north China. New alumina capacity ramp-ups in Hebei and Shandong are increasing pessimism amid oversupply. Refineries cut caustic soda and reduce costs, but prices are declining faster, and alumina is expected to stay weak this week.

title: Copper-gold project in Cordillera region expected to operate commercially by 2026
summary: CELSIUS Resources’ Philippine unit expects its Maalinao-Caigutan-Biyog copper-gold project to reach commercial operations by 2026. It has an environmental compliance certificate, is awaiting DMPF approval, and is preparing for its mineral production sharing agreement. Mines bureau priority status supports fast-tracking, but timing is distant.

title: Québec Nickel Suspends Field Work at Ducros Due to Forest Fire Risk
summary: The article says Nickel in Quebec (Ducros) is suspending field work because of forest fire risk. The move points to short-term operational disruption at the project site, potentially reducing near-term nickel supply continuity and increasing availability concerns, which can pressure nickel prices downward in the coming days.

title: Firefighters extinguish smouldering lead, copper at Port of Newcastle | The Macleay Argus
summary: Firefighters spent about seven hours extinguishing a deep-seated self-combustion of copper concentrate piles at Aurizon Port Services at Carrington (Port of Newcastle). Crews used hazardous materials equipment and cooled the material while staff removed the top layers. No buildings were damaged, but handling and export flow could be disrupted.

title: Firefighters extinguish smouldering lead, copper at Port of Newcastle | Muswellbrook Chronicle
summary: Firefighters spent about seven hours cooling and extinguishing smouldering material at Aurizon Port Services at the Port of Newcastle after copper (and lead) concentrate piles began to self-combust. Staff repeatedly removed the top layer to reach hot material. Crews left around 4.30pm; no buildings were damaged.

title: Firefighters extinguish smouldering lead, copper at Port of Newcastle | Port Macquarie News
summary: Firefighters responded to a smouldering fire at Aurizon Port Services at Carrington, where 10m-high piles of copper and lead concentrate began to self-combust. Crews cooled the material for about seven hours while staff removed the top layers. The fire did not damage buildings and was extinguished the same day.

title: Firefighters extinguish smouldering lead, copper at Port of Newcastle | The Advertiser - Cessnock
summary: Firefighters spent about seven hours extinguishing deep-seated smouldering material at the Port of Newcastle after copper concentrate piles began to self-combust at Aurizon Port Services. Staff removed the top of the pile during cooling, and hazardous materials crews were involved. The incident disrupted handling at the port, pressuring copper logistics.

title: Firefighters extinguish smouldering lead, copper at Port of Newcastle | The Singleton Argus
summary: Firefighters extinguished a “deep seated” smouldering fire at the Port of Newcastle involving large piles of copper (and lead) concentrate at Aurizon Port Services. Crews cooled the material for about seven hours and removed the top of the pile to reach smouldering material. No building damage was reported.

title: Firefighters extinguish smouldering lead, copper at Port of Newcastle | Gloucester Advocate
summary: Firefighters responded to a smouldering fire at Aurizon Port Services at Carrington, where 10m-high piles of copper and lead concentrate stored at the Port of Newcastle began to self-combust. Crews cooled and removed material for about seven hours before extinguishing the smouldering beneath, suggesting temporary copper handling disruption.

title: Bagged Avebury nickel on its way to China | The Advocate
summary: Avebury Nickel Mine is trucking 4,500 tonnes of nickel concentrate to Burnie Port for loading on a vessel to China over Tuesday to Thursday. It discusses ramping up production while noting nickel prices are below desired levels and the mine is near break-even.

title: Firefighters extinguish smouldering lead, copper at Port of Newcastle | Port Stephens Examiner
summary: Firefighters spent about seven hours extinguishing a “deep seated” smouldering fire at the Port of Newcastle involving roughly 10m-high piles of copper concentrate (and lead). A hazardous materials crew and multiple appliances responded, and staff removed the top layers until the smouldering material was fully extinguished. No building damage reported.

title: Weekly Forecast: Low Inventories Will Lift Aluminium Prices, But Poor Demand Will Inhibit The Upside Room_SMM
summary: The weekly outlook notes that despite the US passing the debt ceiling bill, recession fears persist. It says low aluminium inventories should support prices, but weak demand may cap gains. SMM forecasts SHFE aluminium around 17,900–18,800 yuan/mt and LME aluminium at $2,170–2,350/mt this week.

title: Shanghai copper near 4-week high on Chinese stimulus hope
summary: Copper prices in Shanghai and London rose toward a four-week high as investors priced in potential Chinese stimulus and supportive policy for property, while LME on-warrant copper inventories fell sharply. Nickel also increased, reflecting broader metal demand expectations, whereas aluminium was slightly lower in the session.

title: Glencore to Expand Antapacay Copper Mine in Peru, Address Declining Copper Ore Grades_SMM
summary: Glencore plans to invest $1.5 billion to expand the Antapacay copper mine in Peru and address declining ore grades, with feasibility work expected to be approved in 2H 2024. Separately, Codelco previously restricted operations at its Ventanas Chile smelter due to environmental pollution, affecting copper processing capacity.

title: Chilean Tax Hike Will Deter Copper and Lithium Mine Investment, Push Japanese Mining Companies to Other 24 Countries_SMM
summary: Japanese miners warn Chile’s newly approved mining tax overhaul will reduce profitability and deter new copper and lithium mine investment, though it won’t force exits of existing projects. Higher taxes and royalties raise development risk, potentially weighing on expectations for future copper supply and pressuring prices in the near term.

title: Indonesia Will Launch Nickel Price Index Applied for Domestic Policies and Deter Export Duties on Nickel Products_SMM
summary: Indonesia said it will launch a domestic nickel price index for use in export-tax and domestic ore pricing formulas, aiming to reduce reliance on LME nickel. The government also proposed postponing export duties on nickel products such as NPI and high matte, which could support nickel market sentiment short term.

title: Indonesia Will Ban Smelters of Low-Grade Nickel Products_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Indonesia’s government will ban the construction of smelters processing low-grade nickel products, citing an excess of existing RKEF projects and limited high-grade resources lasting only about 9–10 years. Officials are discussing pausing new low-grade refining capacity, which may tighten future nickel supply expectations.

title: Rumours Say Yunnan Will Grant 2 Million Kw Power To Local Aluminium Smelters To Resume Production After Being Disturbed By Power Rationing_SMM
summary: Rumours in China’s Yunnan province suggest up to 2 million kW of power will be granted to local aluminium smelters to restart production after power rationing. Increased rainfall boosts hydropower generation, and some capacity could resume in late June, increasing near-term aluminium supply expectations.

title: Copper Prices Bounced Up As Slowing US Services Weigh On US Dollar Index, Copper Inventory Below The Same Period Last Year For The First Time_SMM
summary: Copper rebounded as US services growth slowed, weakening the US dollar and supporting LME and SHFE prices. The piece also highlights that China’s major-market copper inventories fell versus both the prior week and year-ago levels due to limited weekend arrivals and steadier downstream buying, keeping near-term supply tighter than last year.

title: Spot Premiums For Copper In North China To Fall This Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: North China spot copper premiums rose last week, averaging about 140 yuan/mt, supported by tight supply from smelter maintenance and limited prompt goods. However, downstream buying was reluctant amid weak consumption; smelters lowered prices. If prices keep rebounding while demand stays weak, premiums are expected to fall this week.

title: South32 hires RBC for Botswana copper bid -source
summary: South32 hired RBC Capital to help it prepare a bid for Botswana’s Khoemacau copper mine. The asset produces about 60,000 tonnes of copper annually, with expansion plans to double output. The report is exploratory around a potential acquisition valued above $2 billion, implying limited immediate supply impact.

title: Aston Bay Holdings Ltd: Aston Bay and Partner American West Metals Announce Additional Outstanding Copper Intersections at the Storm Copper Project, Nunavut
summary: Aston Bay and American West Metals reported assays from five additional drill holes at the Storm Copper Project (Nunavut), confirming thick, near-surface copper sulfide mineralization with grades up to about 7% Cu. Management says results support resource growth and potential low-cost open pit mining, while further testing and studies continue.

title: Sterling Metals Corp.: Sterling Metals Resumes Drilling at Sail Pond Project, Testing for Additional High-Grade Silver and Copper at Heimdall North Discovery Target
