title: Heavy Rains in Chile Cause Floods, Shut Down Some Copper Mines
summary: Heavy rains and flooding in Chile have led to the shutdown of some copper mines. The production disruption is likely to reduce near-term copper supply and tighten prompt availability, creating upward pressure for copper prices over the next few trading sessions.

title: Power group EDF signs 10-year contract with aluminium firm Trimet France
summary: EDF, now fully state-owned, signed a 10-year power supply contract with aluminium producer Trimet France for 22 TWh from 2024 onwards. The deal, disclosed by the French government, could reduce cost/uncertainty for Trimet’s aluminium production, supporting expectations for aluminium supply and price.

title: SMM Morning Comments (Jun 26): Zinc, Aluminium And Lead Prices Closed With Losses_SMM
summary: SMM’s morning comments report aluminium prices fell in both SHFE and LME trade ahead of the Dragon Boat Festival. It expects further pressure post-holiday from prospects of US rate hikes. Supply is set to rise due to restarted idled capacity in Yunnan and more ingot arrivals, while demand remains weak.

title: Aluminium Prices May Drop On Seasonal Lull_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports both SHFE and LME aluminium fell around the Dragon Boat holiday. It attributes renewed downside risk to expected US rate hikes, capacity restarts in Yunnan boosting supply, and larger post-holiday ingot arrivals pressuring spot premiums. Softer demand outlook and low inventories may cap losses.

title: $20M CopperString contract and vanadium battery trial announced | The North West Star
summary: Queensland’s government awarded a $20 million contract for early works on the CopperString 2.0 1,100-km transmission line, intended to connect Townsville and Mount Isa and support the region’s critical minerals and energy transition. While the vanadium battery trial is noted, the copper linkage is via transmission-line construction demand.

title: London copper rebounds on low supplies; firm dollar weighs
summary: London three-month copper rose 0.2% to $8,406/t as Chilean mining disruptions from heavy rains and declining visible inventories supported prices. Firm USD and demand uncertainty in China limited gains, with analysts noting factors had been priced in. SHFE aluminum, nickel, and other base metals fell on softer sentiment.

title: Valor inks earn-in agreement at Peruvian copper-gold project
summary: Valor Resources signed an earn-in agreement with Barrick Gold for the Charaque copper-gold project in Peru, including an option to acquire 70% via cash and exploration spending. The company expects to concentrate on drilling at its nearby Picha copper project; no near-term production impact is described.

title: SMM Review and Forecast of Copper Prices_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: The piece forecasts rangebound copper prices, citing a USD index swing after Fed pause/possible hawkish tone, and China policy support via LPR and NEV purchase-tax exemption. Copper cathode social inventories fell sharply and spot premiums stayed firm, supporting prices, but hawkish Fed commentary could lift the dollar and cap gains.

title: China's Copper Concentrate Imports Hit A Record High In May_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s copper concentrate imports reached a record 2.56 million mt in May, up 16.8% YoY and 21.6% MoM. SMM attributes the jump to fading disruptions at overseas mines and resumed shipments. Import flows also rose from several key suppliers, with some country-level declines.

title: Amarc Resources : and freeport LAUNCH COMPREHENSIVE EXPLORATION PROGRAM aCROSS THE joy Copper-Gold district
summary: Amarc Resources and Freeport launched a 2023 airborne and ground exploration program across the JOY Cu-Au district in British Columbia, including surveys and road/bridge rehabilitation for planned drilling. The release is copper-specific but exploration-only, with no production changes, so any short-term impact on metal prices is likely small.

title: China Unwrought Aluminium Alloy Imports Declined In May_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s unwrought aluminium alloy imports fell sharply in May 2023 (down 27.7% YoY and 11.6% MoM), reflecting weak domestic demand and intense price competition. Overseas ADC12 quotes declined and the yuan weakened, narrowing the import window. Arrivals are expected to stay near 80,000 mt, pressuring domestic prices lower.

title: Amarc Resources Ltd.: Amarc And Freeport Launch Comprehensive Exploration Program Across The Joy Copper-Gold District
summary: Amarc and Freeport launched a 2023 airborne and surface exploration program at the Joy copper-gold district in British Columbia, targeting porphyry Cu-Au trends and preparing for drilling in 2024. The company reports prior copper intercepts and will rehabilitate access roads/bridges to enable ongoing work.

title: Class 1 Nickel Completes Geochemical Soil and Biogeochemical Sampling Program at its River Valley PGE Project, near Sudbury, Ontario
summary: Class 1 Nickel reports completion of soil and biogeochemical sampling at its River Valley PGE project near Sudbury to define drill targets for platinum-group elements. The geology described includes contact-style PGE-Cu-Ni sulphide mineralization, but the release contains no production or supply impact that could move nickel prices soon.

title: Copper escapes widespread declines across base metals
summary: Copper rose 0.4% on the LME as declining warehouse stocks and rain-impacted mining in Chile offset a strong dollar and growth concerns. The cash-to-3-month premium increased on tighter availability. Aluminium and nickel fell with other base metals on disappointing macro data, including weaker manufacturing and growth outlooks.

title: The Power Play by The Market Herald Releases a New Interview with Canadian Copper Discussing Their Latest News
summary: The Market Herald releases an interview covering Canadian Copper Inc.’s planned acquisition of VM Canada’s 72% interest in the Murray Brook Joint Venture in New Brunswick. The move is tied to an 18 million tonne VMS deposit. Such resource expansion can lift near-term expectations for copper supply prospects.

title: Billionaire Miner Friedland Warns of a Copper 'Train Wreck' as Supply Stalls
summary: Billionaire miner Friedland warns that copper could face a “train wreck” as supply stalls. The claim points to near-term supply disruption risks, which typically reduce available material and can lift copper prices as market participants adjust expectations within coming weeks.

title: Robert Friedland warns of a copper 'train wreck'
summary: Billionaire miner Robert Friedland cautions that copper could face a “train wreck” as mining struggles to expand fast enough. He argues clean-energy and transport policies will boost demand, but supply is unlikely to keep pace, raising the risk of destabilizing price moves in the near term.

title: Global Copper Pipes and Tubes Market is expected to be
summary: Future Market Insights expects the global copper pipes and tubes market to grow at a 3.2% CAGR, driven by increased HVAC installations and rising EV/charging-station deployment. The report also cites demand from energy and sustainability applications, implying stronger copper end-use consumption. No immediate supply constraints are mentioned.

title: Copper rises on dwindling inventories
summary: Copper prices rose as low supplies outweighed tepid demand concerns. The LME cash premium to the three-month contract widened, while on-warrant copper inventories fell to the lowest level since Oct 2021. Chinese SHFE and bonded inventories also declined. Aluminium and nickel rose too, suggesting broader support.

title: Copper slips on economic worries despite upbeat China comments
summary: Copper prices fell as signals of more stimulus from China were offset by worries about slower global growth and rising interest rates in the West. LME three-month copper eased to about $8,371/t, while inventories tightened but spreads strengthened, pointing to some prompt tightness.

title: Metals Acquisition Limited Ships First Copper Concentrate from CSA Copper Mine
summary: Metals Acquisition Limited says it has shipped the first copper concentrate from its CSA Copper Mine, departing Newcastle for customers in Asia. The cargo contained about 2,300 tonnes of copper (and 28,000 ounces of silver). The news signals initial mine throughput and incremental copper supply into the market.

title: EDF and Trimet ensure secure energy supply for French aluminium production | Companies
summary: EDF and Trimet signed a long-term electricity supply contract for Trimet’s French primary aluminium smelter in Saint-Jean-de-Maurienne. The deal covers up to 22TWh over as long as ten years with flexible terms to balance risks. Secure power supply lowers production risk for about 150,000 tpa capacity.

title: Billionaire miner Robert Friedland warns of a copper 'train wreck' as supply stalls
summary: Billionaire miner Robert Friedland warns copper could face a “train wreck” as mining expansion lags accelerating clean-energy and geopolitical demand. He cites plateauing Chile output, tougher deposit economics, scarce funding, and very low copper physical inventories. Although some analysts expect gradual gains, the supply risk skews bullish.

title: Billionaire miner Robert Friedland warns of copper train wreck
summary: Billionaire Ivanhoe Mines executive Robert Friedland warns of a copper “train wreck” as supply growth lags demand driven by clean energy, transport electrification, and defense-related needs. He cites low inventories and plateauing Chile output with deteriorating ore quality, suggesting a tightening market and potential sharp upside.

title: Billionaire miner Friedland warns of a copper 'train wreck' as supply stalls
summary: Billionaire miner Andrew Friedland warns copper faces a potential “train wreck” as the mining industry struggles to expand supply. He expects demand to accelerate due to clean-energy and transport initiatives and countries prioritizing domestic supply chains. The supply-demand imbalance implies upward pressure for copper prices in coming weeks.

title: New Report Spotlights Urgent Need to Revitalize U.S. Aluminum Manufacturing to Meet Climate, Economic, and National Security Goals
summary: BlueGreen Alliance released a report urging revitalization of U.S. aluminum manufacturing as clean-energy demand (solar and EVs) rises. It notes many U.S. smelters have closed and highlights China’s higher emissions. The report cites federal incentives (45X, 48C, and DOE grants) to reopen and retrofit smelters, which could lift aluminum sentiment.

title: Amcor and Aludium collaborate on 'low-carbon' aluminium product for use in screwcaps | Article
summary: Amcor Capsules and aluminium supplier Aludium launched a certified, independently verified ‘low-carbon’ aluminium product for screwcaps, claiming over 50% lower carbon footprint versus typical European primary aluminium and over 80% versus primary in China. Emissions are ISO-certified cradle-to-gate, but the article doesn’t cite broader pricing impacts.

title: EU's Net-Zero Goal Hits India's Aluminum Sector Hard
summary: EU’s CBAM will begin in October 2023, requiring EU importers to declare embedded emissions. The article argues Indian primary aluminum faces higher carbon costs (about $1,500–$1,600/ton) due to higher emission intensity, hurting exporters’ competitiveness in Europe and weighing on aluminium pricing.

title: Peru Plans to Extend Military Presence in Bid to Keep Copper Shipments Flowing
summary: The item says Peru plans to extend its military presence to help keep copper shipments flowing. By aiming to prevent disruptions to export logistics, the measure would likely lower immediate supply risk for the copper market, supporting expectations for steadier near-term physical availability and prices.

title: Copper Can Go Up 10 Times, Warns Billionaire Mine-Owner
summary: Billionaire mining investor Robert Friedland warns the copper market is moving toward a supply crunch as accelerating demand outpaces new mine supply. He cites rising costs, limited funding, low physical inventories, and reports that EVs require far more copper. The implication is near-term bullish upside for copper prices.

title: LG : Chem Starts Mass Production of Single-Crystal High-Nickel Cathodes in Korea
summary: LG Chem began mass production in Korea of single-crystal high-nickel cathodes for next-generation batteries, with first shipments to clients in July. Production is set to expand to additional capacity (Gumi plant) by 2027 and exceed 50,000 tons annually. Cathodes rely on nickel, boosting demand outlook.

title: Norsk Hydro : Hydro to supply low-carbon aluminium to UK bicycle company Brompton
summary: Hydro will supply low-carbon aluminium with a mine-to-metal CO2 footprint to Brompton for folding bikes, including exploration of applications using post-consumer recycled aluminium. The companies plan development trials in Q4 2023 and aim for end-of-life recycling and decarbonization, with broader net-zero initiatives extending to 2050.

title: Global exchange copper stocks sink to 15-year lows: Andy Home
summary: LME copper inventories have fallen to 15-year lows, with very limited available stock for immediate delivery and cash-to-three-month backwardation rising to the highest premium since late last year. Similar tightness appears across CME and ShFE, alongside falling bonded stocks and stronger Chinese premiums.

title: Blaze at Indonesian nickel smelter kills worker, wounds 6
summary: A blaze at Indonesia’s Gunbuster Nickel Industry (GNI) smelter in Central Sulawesi killed one worker and injured six. The 1.8 million tonne-per-year plant has faced prior deadly fires and riots. Indonesia’s push for downstream nickel continues, but safety scrutiny and disruption risk could affect near-term nickel supply.

title: Atalaya Mining stands by April copper output guidance
summary: Atalaya Mining reported 2022 copper production of 52,300 tonnes, down 6.8% versus 2021 due to lower grades and throughput, partly linked to a transport-sector strike that caused plant stoppages. The company says late-2022 performance continues and keeps 2023 copper guidance at 53,000–55,000 tonnes.

title: Copper sinks on weak China industrial profits, rate hike outlook
summary: Reuters reports copper prices slipping as weak China industrial profits raise concerns about reduced metals demand and margins. A further U.S. rate hike outlook also dampens growth sentiment. Despite tight global exchange inventories and high treatment charges, copper faces near-term bearish pressure.

title: Hot Chili Limited  Releases Corporate Presentation Outlining the Results of the Preliminary Economic Assessment for Its Costa Fuego Copper-gold Project
summary: Hot Chili released a corporate presentation with results from a preliminary economic assessment for its Costa Fuego copper-gold project in northern Chile. The company highlights low-capex development factors and resources, but it does not announce near-term production, sales, or an operating disruption. Impact is mainly sentiment on future supply.

title: Osisko Announces Royalty Transaction With Hot Chili on the Costa Fuego Copper-Gold Project in Chile
summary: Osisko agreed to buy a 1.0% copper net smelter return (NSR) royalty and a 3.0% gold NSR royalty on Hot Chili’s Costa Fuego copper-gold project in Chile for $15m. The release highlights a PEA targeting ~95 kt/y copper in early years and advanced permitting.

title: Clayton Utz assists in US$150m copper and silver stream transactions
summary: Clayton Utz advised Osisko Bermuda on US$150m copper and silver stream transactions with MTAL. Proceeds helped MTAL fund the acquisition of Glencore’s CSA copper mine in NSW, alongside additional financing. The deal’s completion and structure can support expectations for future copper supply commitments.

title: These copper and uranium miners are favoured by Scotiabank
summary: Scotiabank highlights near-term upside for miners, citing copper’s surprising tightness and very low inventories (~5 days) from ongoing supply-side challenges. It expects a volatile but attractive commodity pricing environment, with copper preferred over other base metals, while macro uncertainty—especially China—remains.

title: Arizona's Oak Flat is sacred land to some Native Americans but proposed as a giant copper mine
summary: Arizona’s Oak Flat sacred site faces a proposed Resolution Copper mine led by Rio Tinto and BHP. The project’s permitting has stalled amid legal fights over an environmental impact statement, including efforts to halt a land swap. The mine targets copper, with potential supply implications if delays persist.

title: Rio Tinto invests nearly $1 billion in Kennecott as EVs fuel demand for copper
summary: Kennecott (Rio Tinto) announced it will invest nearly $1 billion and open a second underground mine at its Bingham operations, citing rising copper demand fueled by EV growth. The expansion signals increased copper supply efforts, while the demand linkage supports a constructive near-term copper outlook.

title: Canada Nickel : Investor Presentation
summary: Canada Nickel’s June 2023 investor presentation reviews the Crawford nickel sulphide project, including a preliminary economic assessment, permitting progress, and expected next study milestones (feasibility later in 2023). By emphasizing potential future supply outside Indonesia/China, it can support sentiment for nickel prices, though details are forward-looking.

title: Russian Aluminum Stockpiles Undermine LME's Credibility
summary: Russian aluminum inventories in LME warehouses have risen sharply (over half at times, reaching around 68% in May). Producers warn the buildup could overwhelm storage and undermine LME credibility. With buyers avoiding Russian metal, the article suggests a supply-demand imbalance that may weigh on aluminum prices.

title: Nickel 28 Files Fiscal Q1 Financial Statements
summary: Nickel 28 reported Q1 results for its Ramu nickel-cobalt joint venture, including 9,016 tonnes of contained nickel production and 7,914 tonnes sold. It also noted actual cash costs net of by-product sales fell 32% to US$3.12/lb, with a strong cash balance and distributions to the company.

title: Stellar Resources found a deep zone of zinc, lead and copper | The Examiner
summary: Stellar Resources says it struck a heavily mineralised zone containing zinc, lead and copper north of Scamander, with drilling continuing toward 750 metres. The company frames the result as the top of a metal-rich hydrothermal system. This is exploration news; it may affect expectations but lacks immediate supply impact details.

title: Vortex Metals to acquire majority stake in Chilean copper project
summary: Vortex Metals signed a non-binding letter of intent to acquire up to an 80% stake (with an earn-in to 60%) in Chile’s Illapel copper-gold exploration project adjacent to the Rio 27 mine. The deal involves payments, share issuance, and exploration spending, with future feasibility to enable further stake acquisition.

title: Federal Reserve's Hawkish Speech Weighed Down Copper Prices_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: The piece reports LME and SHFE copper prices fell, attributing weakness to a hawkish Federal Reserve and ECB stance that keeps rate-hike risk elevated. It also cites tight east China spot supply but rising south China inventories, weaker downstream demand, and smelters cutting spot quotes, with off-season consumption ahead.

title: Blaze at Morowali nickel smelter kills worker, wounds 6
summary: A fire at Indonesia’s Gunbuster Nickel Industry (GNI) smelter in Morowali killed one worker and injured six others. The statement says an investigation is underway. The plant is a major nickel smelting operation, and repeated incidents signal potential disruption risk for near-term nickel supply.

title: Blaze at Indonesian nickel smelter kills worker, wounds six
summary: A fire at Indonesia’s Gunbuster Nickel Industry (GNI) nickel smelter in Central Sulawesi killed one worker and injured six. The incident at the 1.8 million tonnes/year facility owned by Jiangsu Delong Nickel Industry raises concerns about safety and could disrupt nickel output in the near term.

title: Commodities : Copper eases as firm dollar, lacklustre China data weigh - Stock market news
summary: Copper prices fell as a firmer dollar after Fed comments made dollar-priced metals costlier and tepid China data dampened demand expectations. LME aluminium was slightly lower and SHFE nickel fell, reflecting broader risk- and demand-sensitive selling across industrial metals.

title: Vedanta likely to sell copper plant in Tamil Nadu for Rs 4,500 crore
summary: Vedanta is weighing selling its Tamil Nadu copper plant at up to Rs 4,500 crore after restarting plant “restart activities” following Supreme Court directions. The unit had been shut for years due to a TNPCB pollution order. Funding from the sale would support Vedanta’s debt repayment and capex plans.

title: Copper slides on strong dollar, weak data from China
summary: Copper slid as weak China data hurt the demand outlook and a stronger U.S. dollar made dollar-priced metals pricier. Reuters also notes LME aluminium fell and SHFE nickel dropped amid the same macro/fx pressures. Powell’s comments kept rate-hike expectations elevated, weighing on base metals sentiment.

title: Commodities : Copper slides on strong dollar, weak data from China - Stock market news
summary: Copper prices fell as weak China economic indicators hurt the demand outlook, while a stronger US dollar made dollar-priced metals costlier. Powell’s comments on possible additional rate hikes reinforced rate-hike expectations. LME aluminium also declined, while nickel was mixed, reflecting broader macro-driven pressure across base metals.

title: PJX Resources Inc.: PJX Resources Commences 2023 Exploration With Discovery of New Iron-Oxide Zone That Expands Copper-Gold-Silver Potential on Dewdney Trail Property
summary: PJX Resources announced field work on its Dewdney Trail Property and discovery of an additional iron-oxide breccia zone with localized copper mineralization, expanding copper-gold-silver potential from porphyry-related intrusions. The company plans drilling and further surface exploration, with no production, supply, or demand impacts stated.

title: Prospect of higher rates, strong dollar push copper to one-month low
summary: Copper hit a one-month low as hawkish Fed/rate-hike prospects strengthened the dollar and raised growth-demand fears. Weak China factory activity and very low LME exchange stocks (15-year lows) heighten volatility. Aluminium fell ~1% on lower LME inventories; nickel remained weak after an 11-month low.

title: BeMetals Corp.: BeMetals Commences 2023 Copper Exploration Program at Pangeni Project in Zambia, Reports Motivating Drill Results, and Updated Exploration Targets
summary: BeMetals announced the start of a 2023 exploration program at its Pangeni copper project in Zambia’s Copperbelt, including initial drilling results with copper grades up to 1.19% and plans for 5,000m of aircore and 2,000m of follow-up core drilling. Management highlights improved targets near key stratigraphic contacts.

title: IMF reignites debate over Indonesia's nickel export ban - Regulations
summary: The IMF, in its latest Indonesia country report, urges Jakarta to phase out mineral export restrictions and avoid extending them to other commodities. The stance targets Indonesia’s current nickel export ban policy and warns that unilateral export measures can destabilize trade, investment, and growth—potentially easing nickel supply expectations.

title: Prospect of higher rates, signs of weak China demand push copper to one-month low
summary: Copper prices fell to a one-month low as hawkish Fed messaging raised rate-hike expectations, strengthening the dollar and pressuring growth sentiment. Weak China demand signals and very low LME copper inventories reduced market buffering, increasing volatility. Aluminium also dropped on thinner LME stocks, while nickel weakened alongside broader base-metal risk.

title: Ellis Martin Report: Western Copper and Gold Corporation's Dr. Paul West-Sells
summary: The article features an interview with Western Copper and Gold CEO Dr. Paul West-Sells, focusing on copper market fundamentals and the company’s Casino copper-gold project in Canada’s Yukon. It cites major investor interest in the project but does not provide immediate production, supply, or policy changes likely to move copper prices soon.

title: Copperstone granted land allocation
summary: Swedish authorities granted Copperstone Viscaria land allocation for the Viscaria project, the last land-related decision needed to start planned mining operations. The company is also progressing an environmental code permit, with a main hearing expected in February 2024. The milestone supports expectations for eventual copper supply.

title: Nickel Prices Soften Amid Indonesia Supply Boost
summary: Nickel prices soften as Indonesia increases output, supporting a growing surplus in the global nickel market. While prices remain elevated versus pre-pandemic levels due to EV battery demand, the article notes Indonesia’s stepped-up production and forecasting of sustained surplus that likely weighs on near-term prices.

title: Mirasol Announces Vania Drill Campaign at Inca Copper-Gold
summary: Mirasol announced an airborne mobile MT geophysical survey and planned drilling in late July at its Inca Copper-Gold project in Chile. Targets include Vania North and South, interpreted as potential concealed copper porphyry, plus newly defined Vania East and Vania SW anomalies. No production or supply guidance was provided.

title: Nickel crisis 2022: Financial Conduct Authority missing in action as London Metal Exchange come close to bankruptcy
summary: The article says the UK regulator (FCA) was largely passive during the run-up to the LME’s 2022 nickel crisis, including March 7 when nickel surged after a missed margin call. It recounts regulatory questions sent later and references a legal dispute with traders.

title: TELF AG Copper Cathode Rod Producers Maintain Normal Production Amidst Challenging Market Dynamics
summary: TELF AG reports that key copper cathode rod producers maintained near-scheduled output (~80.33%) despite falling copper prices and difficulties sourcing copper scrap. It attributes tight scrap supply to seller caution during the downturn, then notes stabilization/rebound restored marginal scrap availability, keeping production broadly steady.

title: Electrical accident at Chile's El Teniente copper mine leaves one dead
summary: Codelco said an electrical accident at its El Teniente copper mine in central Chile caused one death during generator installation at the Andes Norte expansion. Work in the affected area was immediately halted and an investigation launched by the company and Chile’s mining regulator. Recent rainfall halted some operations, but underground work continued.

title: Copper Prices Fell As US Job Market Remains Strong_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: LME copper fell 0.81% to $8,181/mt and SHFE copper 2308 ended down 0.53%. The drop is linked to strong US GDP revisions and labor-market data raising expectations for additional Fed rate hikes, alongside weaker spot demand and three straight days of inventory increases in south China.

title: Electrical accident at Chile's El Teniente copper mine leaves one dead | WKZO | Everything Kalamazoo
summary: Codelco said a fatal electrical discharge occurred during generator installation at its El Teniente mine’s Andes Norte expansion project in Chile. Work was halted and an investigation launched, involving contracted firm Zublin. El Teniente continued underground operations and the article cites no confirmed broader output loss.

title: Commodities : Copper rises, but set for biggest quarterly drop since Sept 2022 - Stock market news
summary: Copper rose on Friday amid hopes of Chinese stimulus, but remained set for its biggest quarterly decline since Sept 2022 due to weak Chinese data and expectations of further U.S. rate hikes. Aluminium and nickel showed smaller day gains but were still down on the quarter/year, reflecting demand worries and firm dollar.

title: Stellantis Signs Offtake Terms and Invests in Kuniko for Supply of Norwegian, Low Carbon Nickel and Cobalt Sulphate
summary: Stellantis and Kuniko signed a binding offtake term sheet securing 35% of future annual production of nickel sulphate and cobalt sulphate for nine years, alongside a €5m equity investment. Funds support Norwegian battery metals exploration including nickel and copper, potentially strengthening near-term demand expectations for nickel.

title: Sandvik wins automation order from Chilean copper miner Pucobre
summary: Sandvik said it received an order worth about SEK 100 million from Chilean copper miner Pucobre to supply autonomous loaders with AutoMine® Multi-Lite for underground operations in Atacama. Deliveries run through 2023-2024, with the order booked in Q2 2023. The deal supports automation plans but details no immediate output changes.

title: Copper Inventories in Major Chinese Markets Added This Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data shows Chinese copper inventories at 99,100 mt, up 11,400 mt from Monday and 15,900 mt from June 21 after seven weeks of decline. Increases are attributed to large arriving shipments in Shanghai and Guangdong, while buyers hold back due to cash flow issues ahead of mid-year settlement. Next week’s imports should add supply, keeping inventories elevated.

title: Zambia's Mopani Copper Mines losses deepen amid search for new investor
summary: ZCCM said Mopani Copper Mines’ losses deepened and copper output fell to 72,694 tons after a 45-day smelter maintenance shutdown. It is seeking a new investor to fund about $300 million of expansion and $150 million for operations, which could affect supply timing. The ramp target is over the coming years.

title: IMF reignites debate over Indonesia's nickel export ban - Fri, June 30 2023
summary: The IMF urged Indonesia to phase out mineral export bans and avoid extending restrictions to other commodities, warning that trade uncertainty and unilateral measures can weigh on investment. Indonesia is considering downstream value-addition; the prior nickel ore ban and bauxite ban are central. This guidance could increase expectations of more raw-material supply.

title: Aya Gold & Silver to acquire Tirzzit Copper Mine in Morocco
summary: Aya Gold & Silver agreed to buy the Tirzzit copper mine in Morocco for about $4.9m, securing seven copper-silver permits including mining licences. The company plans new fieldwork using historical drill and geophysical data, subject to approvals. It adds copper supply potential, but near-term price effects likely minimal.

title: Can China's cheaper nickel sulfate make its way overseas?
summary: China’s nickel sulfate exports have risen sharply in April and May as traders exploit wider price gaps versus Japan and South Korea. The piece highlights cost-driven competition between China sulfate and ex-China MHP-based production and notes regulatory/geopolitical constraints. Premium nickel sulfate prices show mixed recovery, supporting nickel-positive sentiment.

title: Gloomy China sentiment puts copper on track for first drop in three quarters
summary: Copper is set for its first quarterly decline in three quarters as gloomy China demand prospects and worsening factory activity weigh on prices. Inventories in Shanghai rose sharply. The piece also notes aluminium and nickel falling on the same day, pointing to broader bearish sentiment.

title: Zambia's Mopani copper project posts $298m loss amid takeover talks
summary: Zambia’s Mopani reported a $298m annual loss as copper production fell to 72,694 tonnes from 87,618t, attributing the decline to a smelter shutdown for maintenance and refurbishments. With the government selecting a buyer and funding needs for expansion, near-term copper supply expectations look weaker.

title: Amcor Capsules and Aludium collaborate on low carbon footprint aluminium
summary: Amcor and aluminium supplier Aludium say they have developed and independently verified low-carbon aluminium technology for wine and spirit screwcaps, targeting <4 tonnes CO2e per tonne of aluminium. The lower footprint comes from higher recycled content and low-carbon primary aluminium, positioning the material for sustainability-driven demand.

title: Stellantis signs agreement for supply of battery-grade nickel and cobalt sulphate
summary: Stellantis signed an offtake term sheet with Kuniko to purchase battery-grade nickel and cobalt sulphate tied to Kuniko’s Norwegian exploration projects, committing to acquire 35% of output under a binding nine-year arrangement. Stellantis also plans a EUR 5m equity investment, supporting project advancement.

title: EU countries seek to stretch raw material targets, add aluminium
summary: EU countries agreed to amend the Critical Raw Materials Act by raising recycling targets to 20% and processing targets to 50%, and adding aluminium, alumina and bauxite to the strategic raw materials list. The act also covers copper via higher extraction goals, aiming to reduce supply risks for clean-tech supply chains.

title: LG Chem Starts Mass Production Of Single-Crystal High-Nickel Cathodes
summary: LG Chem has started mass production of single-crystal high-nickel cathodes for next-generation batteries, with initial shipments planned from July and production expansion at Gumi by 2027. Because these cathodes use high nickel content and are intended for upcoming EV battery formats, the news is supportive for nickel demand.

title: Bulls And Bears Face Off As Copper Outlook Flashes Mixed Signals
summary: The piece weighs mixed signals for copper: prices cooled after a rally supported by China stimulus, while price action has been largely sideways. It cites potential bullish drivers like long-run supply shortfalls and renewables demand, but also bearish risks from slower demand recovery and substitution to materials like aluminum.

title: Stellantis invests in Kuniko's Norway nickel, cobalt mining project
summary: Stellantis has bought a nearly 20% stake in Norway’s Kuniko, a nickel and cobalt supplier, and agreed on nine years of future production offtake tied to its Norwegian exploration projects. Stellantis will invest about $5.5 million to fund further battery-metals development, reinforcing EV supply-chain demand signals.

title: Iberdrola invests in LatemAluminium to boost the green industry | REVE News of the wind sector in Spain and in the world
summary: Iberdrola will take a 20% stake in LatemAluminium and invest about €120M through 2024 in a large-scale recycled aluminium project, aiming for 30,000 tonnes of rolled aluminium and first outputs in early 2024. The partnership targets decarbonised production via renewable power and green hydrogen.

title: Ministry denies involvement in alleged illegal nickel ore exports
summary: Indonesia’s Energy and Mineral Resources Ministry denies involvement in alleged illegal nickel ore exports to China. The KPK is investigating claims that China received up to 5.3 million tonnes from 2020 to mid-2022 despite a nickel ore export ban. The probe could trigger enforcement and reduce supply.

title: Stanislav Kondrashov Telf AG on Trends and Prospects for the Global Nickel Market in 2023
summary: The piece discusses INSG data and a conference view that global nickel supply is set to exceed demand in 2023, creating a surplus. It highlights rising mine and primary nickel production, especially from Indonesia, alongside ongoing consumption growth. The net near-term implication is weaker price pressure for nickel.

title: Los Angeles Metro Suffers Third World-style Wave of Copper Wire Theft
summary: Los Angeles Metro is experiencing repeated theft of copper wires used to power rail cars, delaying service and contributing to growing repairs to stolen infrastructure copper, including street and freeway lights. The piece links the trend to similar rail theft problems abroad, but the impact appears largely localized.

title: Philippine Supreme Court Issues 'Writ of Nature' vs. Altai, DENR Over Nickel Mining Ops in Sibuyan, Rodne Galicha Confirms | HNGN
summary: Philippine Supreme Court issued a writ of nature against Altai Philippines Mining Corporation and DENR/MGB over Sibuyan Island nickel operations. It remanded the case to the Court of Appeals and denied residents’ request for a temporary environmental protection order. DENR’s cease-and-desist order remains in force, potentially limiting nickel output.

title: INDONESIA: Nickel All the Way | Asian Legal Business
summary: Indonesia’s nickel sector is described as booming, with EV and green-energy demand driving IPO funding and expanding downstream processing plans. It reiterates Indonesia’s prior nickel export ban and WTO dispute, while highlighting new support measures (export restrictions/taxes) to boost local value-added production. Potential election-related pauses are mentioned.

title: Zambia to Pick Investor in Mopani Copper Mines This Month
summary: Zambia says it will pick an investor for Mopani Copper Mines this month. The decision can affect market expectations for copper supply and operational continuity at a major copper producer. Near-term price reaction would depend on whether the investor likely supports timely production and whether disruption risk is reduced.

title: Mallee Resources reports promising target at Avebury Nickel Mine | The Advocate
summary: Mallee Resources updated its resource estimate for the Avebury Nickel Mine near Zeehan and identified an exploration target within the mining envelope that could potentially double the current resource. The company says the target remains open along strike and at depth, implying longer-lived nickel production potential.

title: Commodities : Copper buoyed by investor hopes on China, but demand worries weigh - Stock market news
summary: Copper rose on LME and SHFE as investor sentiment improved on hopes for China stimulus after weaker-than-expected factory contraction. However, the article flags increased supplies and subdued demand, with falling operation rates for copper users. Aluminium and nickel also edged up, reflecting the broader tone but not distinct catalysts.

title: Copper 'crime ring' arrested over $780,000 heists
summary: Police in Melbourne arrested six people in connection with alleged $780,000 copper thefts from telecommunications infrastructure since January. Officers seized about $95,000 worth of copper during raids and said repeated cable cuts disrupted power and internet services. Charges include theft of copper cabling and related offences.

title: US Core PCE in May Missed Market Expectations, Copper Futures Prices Rebounded Last Friday Evening_SMM
summary: US core PCE missed expectations and US consumer spending cooled, contributing to sharp copper price swings. LME and SHFE copper rebounded late last week. Chinese copper inventories rose sharply on increased arrivals and weak downstream demand in South China, though mid-year settlement is expected to lift demand, supporting a near-term strength view.

title: Police arrest six involved in $780,000 copper theft operation | The Border Mail
summary: Police arrested six men in an alleged organised copper theft syndicate involving about $780,000 in stolen copper cabling. Suspects used power tools to cut telecom cabling, damaging pits and disrupting internet, power, and transport signalling. A charged man appears in court on September 21.

title: Melbourne 'copper 'crime ring' arrested over $780,000 heists
summary: Victoria Police arrested six people in Melbourne over alleged thefts of copper cabling worth over $780,000 from telecommunications infrastructure. Police say the copper cuts caused power and internet disruptions. Raids seized about $95,000 of copper and charged suspects face court, highlighting damage to critical networks.

title: Central Banks Hawkish Language Continue To Weigh On Copper Prices_SMM
summary: Hawkish remarks from the Fed and ECB, plus potential BOJ/YCC adjustments, are expected to keep rates higher for longer and support a stronger US dollar, pressuring copper. In China, copper cathode social inventories rose on imports and liquidation, though still near historically low levels.

title: China stimulus hope and falling inventories buoy copper
summary: Copper firmed as hopes for Chinese stimulus rose amid slowing industrial activity, while LME-registered inventories fell 30% since June 6 to 69,700 tons. Cancelled warrants at 50% and warrant-led tightness boosted cash premiums. Other industrial metals were weaker, with aluminium, zinc and nickel down.

title: Codelco's El Teniente Copper Mine Suffered Electricity Accident, Production In The Area Stopped_SMM
summary: Codelco said an electricity accident killed one person at its El Teniente copper mine in central Chile, prompting work stoppages in affected areas. While underground operations may continue, production in Sewell and Rojo remained halted, adding to disruptions from earlier heavy-rain shutdowns in southern Chile.

title: Disruptions from Chile Floods on copper mine were Weaker than Expected_SMM
summary: Codelco resumed production at the Andina copper mine after Chile floods caused a brief outage; key equipment was intact but roads were damaged. El Teniente was not affected by weather, but an electrical accident stopped production while investigations continue. Water buildup and road traffic restrictions also reduced logistics efficiency.

title: Import Losses Continued To Narrow, Yangshan Copper Premiums Seen Rising_SMM
summary: Yangshan copper premiums for July under warrants and bill of lading rose week-on-week, while import losses to the SHFE July contract narrowed and turned into import profit. Better SHFE/LME ratio and eased cashflow issues lifted quotes; arrivals and clearance should increase demand slightly, supporting higher copper premiums.

title: SMM Review Of Spot Copper Market In Shanghai Last Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports Shanghai spot copper premiums fell early due to month-end settlement-driven stock liquidation, then rose as sellers lifted quotes, exceeding 300 yuan/mt versus next-month invoices. Shanghai inventories increased, bonded inventories declined, SHFE warrant stocks stayed low, and copper backwardation widened sharply, suggesting near-term tightness.

title: Daily Updates on SHFE Base Metals and Stainless Steel Warrants (July 3), With Nickel Critically Low_SMM
summary: The article provides daily updates on SHFE base metals and stainless steel warrants, including a July snapshot. It highlights that nickel is at critically low levels on SHFE, indicating tighter near-term availability. Such inventory constraints can raise market expectations and provide upward price pressure for nickel.

title: Arc Minerals slightly widens loss but says copper outlook still strong
summary: Arc Minerals reported a wider pretax loss in 2022 but said copper prospects remain strong. It is reorganising licenses for a planned JV with a subsidiary of Anglo American covering its copper interests in north-west Zambia, including potential funding and a 70% Anglo stake. The company cites supportive global demand and Zambian investment priorities.

title: Peru Makes Plans To Ensure Normal Copper Ore Shipments_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Peruvian authorities plan to keep the military on the mining corridor to prevent community-related road blocks that have previously delayed copper ore shipments. The route is used by Las Bambas, Antapaccay, and Constancia to move semi-finished copper to seaports. Officials aim to maintain flows to China smelters as a state of emergency nears expiry.

title: Aluminium Bahrain B S C : Alba Chairman visits Mitsubishi Heavy Industries facilities in Japan
summary: Aluminium Bahrain (Alba) reports on-schedule progress for PS5 Block 4, a US$265m expansion that adds a gas-turbine combined-cycle block to its 220kV infrastructure. The project is expected to reduce GHG emissions and increase capacity upon completion in Q4 2024, supporting reliable, cleaner power for aluminium smelting.

title: ING Groep suing Chinese copper trader He Jinbi over unpaid debt - Bloomberg
summary: ING is suing Chinese copper trader He Jinbi after unpaid debt tied to ING’s guarantee obligations over Triway. The dispute follows Maike’s restructuring after a liquidity crunch, leaving thousands of tonnes of copper stranded in warehouses and supporting regional premiums, as it struggles to pay suppliers. Related suits highlight continued delivery/payment disruptions.

title: U.S. Lifts Tariffs On Indian Steel And Aluminum
summary: The U.S. confirmed India will remove retaliatory tariffs tied to Section 232 steel and aluminum measures, and most Indian imported steel and aluminum will face no additional scrutiny. A market access agreement would approve most Indian applications via exclusion processes, ending five years of harsher duties.

title: Lotte's new copper foil unit eyes 30% global market share by 2028
summary: Lotte Energy Materials (Lotte Group) plans to expand high-end copper foil output for EV lithium-ion batteries, targeting 30% global share by 2028. It aims to raise capacity to 240,000 tons/year and set up operations in Spain and potentially North America, supporting copper foil demand growth.

title: Freeport-Mcmoran: Analysts Bullish Ahead Of Growth Copper's Spurt
summary: The article headline reports analysts are bullish on Freeport-McMoRan and expects a growth-driven “spurt” in copper. While details are not provided in the excerpt, the framing suggests improved near-term copper demand or production outlook, which would likely support copper prices over the next several days to weeks.

title: Chinese Aluminium billet market saw muted transactions and even negative conversion margins_SMM
summary: SMM reports muted aluminium billet trading in China, with soft downstream demand weighing on conversion margins. A00 aluminium prices edged up during the week, but the weekly average fell. Despite lower billet stocks from fewer arrivals, suppliers cut offers as market confidence collapsed, suggesting continued margin declines amid off-peak demand.

title: Spot Alumina Prices Rallied In South-West China And Stopped Falling In North China_SMM
summary: SMM says the alumina spot market in China stopped falling and rebounded, especially in southwest regions such as Guangxi, Guizhou and Chongqing, as Yunnan aluminium smelters resumed operations. Ore scarcity in northern provinces also stabilized prices, while alumina futures held around 2,800 yuan/mt.

title: Commodities : Copper eases as dollar firms, China data signals weak demand - Stock market news
summary: Copper prices eased as the U.S. dollar firmed and China’s June factory activity slowed, signaling weaker demand. Low copper inventories provided some support, but LME copper fell and LME aluminium and nickel also slipped, reflecting cautious near-term sentiment tied to macro data.

title: Alma Metals Upbeat On Future Of Briggs Copper Project
summary: Alma Metals said it is upbeat about the future of its Briggs copper project. The statement is supportive for sentiment around potential future copper supply, but it is unlikely to significantly alter near-term supply-demand conditions within days to four weeks, so the immediate price impact is likely limited.

title: Lotte's New Copper Foil Unit Eyes 30 pct Global Market Share by 2028
summary: The article says Lotte is creating a new copper-foil business unit aimed at capturing about 30% of the global market share by 2028. While the timing is partly long-dated, the announcement points to incremental copper-foil demand, which can modestly support near-term copper expectations.

title: Lotte Aims to Ride EV Boom to Become Copper Foil World Leader
summary: Lotte says it aims to ride the EV boom to become a world leader in copper foil. The strategy implies increased demand for copper foil used in EV-related electronics and battery supply chains, which can modestly support short-term copper price sentiment.

title: Metso Outotec Oyj : to deliver a large minerals processing equipment package to Kansanshi copper mine in Zambia
summary: Metso Outotec said First Quantum Minerals placed an additional order worth over EUR 20 million for flotation and other processing equipment for the Kansanshi copper mine in Zambia. The Kansanshi expansion is described as increasing copper production, but the news is an equipment/capex update without clear immediate output impact.

title: Aluminium Ingot Social Stocks In China Decline_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reported China’s aluminium ingot social stocks across eight major markets at 506,000 mt as of July 3. This is down 16,000 mt from the previous Thursday and 228,000 mt from a year earlier, indicating lower available inventory and potentially tighter near-term supply conditions.

title: Lotte confident of surpassing SK in high-end copper foil market
summary: Lotte Energy Materials said it aims to overtake SK Nexilis in high-end copper foil by targeting 30% market share by 2028, highlighting thinner copper foil suited for EV battery needs. It also discussed credit-rating-driven stock weakness and exploring new overseas factory sites, with only limited immediate impact signals on copper prices.

title: PAN GLOBAL DRILLS 1.3% COPPER AND 0.5 G/T GOLD OVER 5.1M WITHIN 20M AT 0.5% COPPER AND 0.3 G/T GOLD AT CAÑADA HONDA IN THE ESCACENA PROJECT, SOUTHERN SPAIN
summary: Pan Global Resources reported follow-up drilling at its Escacena Project’s Cañada Honda target in Spain, including 5.1m at 1.3% copper (plus 0.5 g/t gold) within 20m at 0.5% copper. Mineralization is described as open and increasing down-dip along a gravity anomaly.

title: Pan Global Resources Inc.: PAN GLOBAL DRILLS 1.3% COPPER AND 0.5 G/T GOLD OVER 5.1M WITHIN 20M AT 0.5% COPPER AND 0.3 G/T GOLD AT CAÑADA HONDA IN THE ESCACENA PROJECT, SOUTHERN SPAIN
summary: Sego Resources reported new copper porphyry discovery from recent drill holes at the Escacena Project in southern Spain. Several holes intersected copper porphyry mineralization with chalcopyrite in potassic-altered host rocks, and the company plans follow-up drilling, which could incrementally boost expectations for future copper supply.

title: Midland in Partnership With Rio Tinto Identifies New Targets and Resumes Drilling on the New Santos Nickel-Copper Zone, Tête Nord Project
summary: Midland Exploration, with Rio Tinto, resumes drilling at Quebec’s Tête Nord project to test new geophysical targets near the Santos nickel-copper discovery and the Palmeiras and Savane showings. The company reports prior drill intersections with Ni-Cu grades and schedules additional holes, subject to local forest-fire conditions.

title: Midland in Partnership with Rio Tinto Identifies New Targets and Resumes Drilling on the New Santos Nickel-Copper Zone, Tete Nord Project
summary: Midland Exploration, partnering with Rio Tinto, resumed drilling on the Tete Nord project near the Santos nickel-copper discovery and identified additional gravity/geophysical targets. The maiden drill program reported multiple Ni-Cu mineralized intercepts (e.g., 1.10% Ni and 0.71% Cu). Drilling is planned in early July.

title: Midland in Partnership with Rio Tinto Identifies New Targets and Resumes Drilling on the New Santos Nickel-Copper Zone, Tete Nord Project
summary: Midland Exploration, partnered with Rio Tinto, plans to resume drilling on the Santos nickel-copper zone at the Tete Nord project in Quebec, adding six holes totaling up to 1,900 metres. Earlier drilling intersected Ni and Cu mineralization and new gravity survey targets will be tested in Santos and nearby showings.

title: Gloomy demand outlook weighs on copper prices
summary: Copper prices fell 0.5% to a four-week low after weak manufacturing data pointed to slowing demand in China, the US and the euro zone. LME and SHFE copper stocks declined sharply, suggesting tighter supply, but the demand outlook dominated. Aluminium edged lower and nickel retreated as macro headwinds persisted.

title: Price not right: 'Discrimination' blamed for illegal nickel exports - Regulations
summary: Indonesia’s Corruption Eradication Commission is investigating alleged illegal nickel ore exports that violate the country’s nickel export ban, after a mismatch between Indonesian and Chinese shipment data. Experts link the activity to a domestic-export price gap. The probe may trigger tighter supervision and policy changes affecting nickel supply expectations.

title: India Launches Anti-Dumping Investigation On Chinese Solar Panel/Module Aluminum Frame_SMM
summary: India’s Ministry of Commerce and Industry launched an anti-dumping investigation into imports of solar panels/modules aluminum frames from China. The inquiry covers multiple aluminium frame types under customs codes 7610 and 7616 and several subheadings. The measure could raise landed costs and support demand tied to aluminium frames.

title: Copper Smelting Market Growth Research Report, Development Strategy, Explosive Factors of Revenue by Key Vendors Demand
summary: The piece is a market-research promotional article on copper smelting, noting oxygen flash smelting dominates share and highlighting growth drivers such as increased mining activity and efficiency. It lists major smelters and provides long-range market projections, but contains no immediate events that would likely shift copper prices soon.

title: Podcast: 'Scarcity alarms' for copper and silver, ft Global X commodities analyst Roberta Caselli
summary: In a podcast segment with Global X’s Roberta Caselli, the analyst points to precarious supply conditions in the LME and flags surprising scarcity in copper. The discussion frames near-term fundamentals as supportive for copper, while other comments focus more on energy-transition themes affecting uranium and oil.

title: Copper Prices Went Down Amid the Lack of Solid Economic Data_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: LME copper fell 0.25% to $8,359/mt and SHFE 2308 slipped 0.26%. Spot prices in East China dropped on imported copper inflows and weak consumption, with traders selling cargoes. Despite some declines in south China inventory from lower arrivals, transactions were subdued and demand is expected to keep shrinking if prices stay high.

title: Price not right: 'Discrimination' blamed for illegal nickel exports - Wed, July 5 2023
summary: Indonesia’s anti-graft agency is investigating alleged illegal exports of nickel ore that bypass the country’s export ban, with China reportedly receiving large volumes despite restrictions. Experts cite a big domestic-versus-international price gap and argue the policy failed, suggesting supervision changes or replacing the ban with tariffs.

title: Wyloo Metals makes bold bet on clean nickel
summary: Wyloo Metals, led by Andrew Forrest, is buying Mincor Resources for $760m and focusing on “clean” nickel sulphides for EV battery supply. It highlights sustainability-driven avoidance of laterite deep-sea tailings and considers a Kwinana processing plant. The moves imply supportive expectations for battery-grade nickel demand and supply.

title: Andrew Forrest's Wyloo looks for more nickel deals as it seals Mincor buy
summary: Wyloo has crossed 90% ownership in Mincor and expects to complete the acquisition soon, attracted by the Cassini nickel sulphide deposit in Western Australia’s Kambalda district. Wyloo says nickel is its main focus, expects to build on Mincor’s mine life, and links resources to planned battery-chemicals processing.

title: Ardea Resources inks agreement with Japanese firms for nickel-cobalt project feasibility
summary: Ardea Resources agreed with Japanese firms (Sumitomo Metal Mining, Mitsubishi, Mitsui) to progress feasibility and final investment planning for the Kalgoorlie Nickel Project Goongarrie Hub. The company projects A$3.18bn capex and long-run output of ~30,000 tonnes nickel annually. It supports Japan’s push for battery-mineral supply.

title: Xanadu hits new shallow copper-gold deposits
summary: Xanadu Mines says shallow exploration at its Kharmagtai copper-gold project in Mongolia has intersected high-density porphyry mineralisation, including copper intervals (e.g., multi-meter grades around the 2–3% range) and higher-gold zones. Results support a larger resource upgrade and progressing the prefeasibility study toward production.

title: Andrew Forrest's Wyloo gains control of ASX-listed nickel miner Mincor Resources
summary: Wyloo, controlled by Andrew and Nicola Forrest’s investment group, raised its stake in ASX-listed nickel miner Mincor to about 90.87% and will compulsorily acquire remaining shares at $1.40 each. Mincor’s Kambalda project produces nickel sulphides used in battery demand, but no near-term output changes are described.

title: Nordic Nickel
summary: Nordic Resources pitches its Pulju project in Finland as a major future supplier of battery-grade nickel, citing an updated JORC resource for the Hotinvaara prospect and proximity to other Cu-Ni sulphide deposits. The EU’s Critical Raw Materials Act names nickel as strategic, boosting near-term sentiment for nickel.

title: Hannan Metals Ltd.: Hannan Exploration Update on The Sortilegio Alkalic Copper-Gold Porphyry in Peru
summary: Hannan Metals provided exploration results on the Sortilegio alkalic Cu-Au porphyry discovery in Peru and outlined progress on Peru drill permitting for the Valiente project. The update includes encouraging copper-bearing outcrop/veinlet sampling, but no near-term production or shipment changes. Overall impact on copper prices is likely limited.

title: Mayville Engineering Company Completes Acquisition of Mid-States Aluminum
summary: Mayville Engineering Company completed its acquisition of Mid-States Aluminum, a vertically integrated custom aluminum extrusion and fabrication producer. MEC expects the deal to add $30–$35 million in net sales and $4–$6 million in adjusted EBITDA in fiscal 2023, implying incremental aluminum processing demand. Net effect is moderately supportive for aluminium.

title: Zambia says deal with India's Vedanta over disputed copper assets imminent
summary: Zambia said a deal with Vedanta over disputed Konkola Copper Mines assets is imminent, potentially resolving outstanding supplier payments and technical issues after prior state takeover and liquidation. The government hopes to attract fresh investment and advance the Konkola Deep Mining project, aiming to restart production sooner.

title: Aston Bay Holdings Ltd: Aston Bay and American West Metals Announce Additional Copper Intercepts and Commencement of Summer Drilling Program at the Storm Copper Project, Canada
summary: Aston Bay and American West report additional high-grade, thick near-surface copper intercepts at the 4100N Zone of the Storm Copper Project, with mineralization open laterally. RC delineation drilling has recommenced and diamond drilling is planned to test deep targets. Nunavut funding of CAD 250,000 supports ongoing exploration.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Ltd.: Ivanhoe Mines Reports Record Quarterly Production of 103,786 Tonnes from Kamoa-Kakula Copper Complex for Q2 2023
summary: Ivanhoe Mines’ Kamoa-Kakula copper complex in the DRC produced a record 103,786 tonnes of copper in concentrate in Q2 2023, up 11% QoQ, with higher throughput following debottlenecking. The company also cites additional production records, despite maintenance shutdowns and grid instability, and maintains 2023 copper guidance.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Reports Record Quarterly Production of 103,786 Tonnes from Kamoa-Kakula Copper Complex for Q2 2023
summary: Ivanhoe Mines says its Kamoa-Kakula Copper Complex (DRC) produced a record 103,786 tonnes of copper in concentrate in Q2 2023, up 11% QoQ, aided by debottlenecking and higher throughput. It also cites strong recoveries, ongoing grid-stability upgrades, and progress on Phase 3.

title: Copper and other base metals fall on weak demand outlook
summary: Copper fell on the LME alongside other base metals as global PMI data signaled weaker growth and services activity, dimming near-term demand for industrial metals. Citi warned metals consumption will remain under pressure. The stronger dollar added further pressure. Aluminium and nickel also declined.

title: Northstar samples high-grade copper on Miller Gold property
summary: Northstar Gold reported high-grade copper assays from limited surface grab samples at its Cam Copper Mine on the Miller property, with grades up to 31.8% Cu and a weighted average of 14% Cu, plus associated silver. The company plans ground truthing and follow-up drilling to test down-plunge extensions.

title: Lara Exploration Ltd.: Lara Reports Further Higher-Grade Copper Intercepts at the Planalto Project
summary: Lara Exploration reported follow-up drill results from the Cupuzeiro target at the Planalto Copper Project in Brazil, including intercepts with relatively high copper-equivalent grades and indications that higher-grade zones may extend vertically beyond 300m and remain open. The update pertains to ongoing drilling progress and future expansion.

title: Wyloo Metals purchases nickel-focused Mincor Resources
summary: Wyloo Metals agreed to buy 90.87% of Mincor Resources for A$760m, adding Mincor’s mainly producing nickel sulphide assets in Western Australia. Management frames the move as building an integrated nickel business, including plans for downstream processing for battery cathode materials in Kwinana. The acquisition is broadly supportive for nickel sentiment.

title: LME to tighten daily price limits for aluminium, copper to 12% from July 24
summary: The LME said it will tighten daily price limits for outright contracts in aluminium and copper on all venues to 12% from 15%, effective July 24. The exchange noted the limits became permanent tools after March 2022 market moves. The change targets volatility rather than underlying supply-demand.

title: LME to tighten daily price limits for aluminium, copper to 12% from July 24
summary: The LME will cut daily price limits for outright aluminium and copper contracts to 12% from 15% across its venues starting July 24. The exchange says the tighter limits apply to permanent daily limit rules introduced after the March 2022 nickel spike, aiming to curb extreme volatility.

title: Mining Stock News: Lara (TSXV: LRA) Reports Further Higher-Grade Copper Intercepts at the Planalto Project
summary: Lara Exploration reported follow-up drill intersections at its Planalto Project, including 47.22m at 0.652% copper equivalent and 41.51m at 0.737% copper equivalent, suggesting higher-grade zones extend over 300m vertically and remain open to depth. The update is exploration-stage and mainly signals potential future copper supply.

title: Firetail to buy majority stake in Valor's Peruvian copper assets
summary: Firetail Resources agreed to buy up to 80% of Valor’s Peruvian copper assets (Kiwanda, holding Picha and Charaque concessions). The projects are drill-ready for near-term exploration, with cash payments and potential share/performance-right issuance after approvals. The deal offers exposure to the copper market but no near-term production impact is indicated.

title: Chile's Codelco Seen Ending 2023 With Copper Production In Lower… - Stock market news
summary: Chile’s Codelco is expected to end 2023 with copper output below prior expectations, with production seen in a lower estimated range of 1.35–1.42 million metric tons, according to the company chairman. Reuters reports the update as demand-supply expectations shift toward tighter near-term supply.

title: Chile's Codelco says 2023 copper production further hurt by heavy rains
summary: Chile’s Codelco said last month’s heavy rains will cause about 7,000 tonnes of lost 2023 copper production, including 2,000 tonnes from El Teniente and 5,000 tonnes from Andina. Operations were paused or briefly halted, pushing output forecasts to the lower end of its 1.35–1.42 million tonnes range.

title: Mink Ventures Corporation: Mink Ventures Commences Option for Warren Copper Nickel Project, Timmins, Ontario
summary: Mink Ventures announced it is issuing shares and warrants to commence an option on the Warren copper-nickel project in Ontario. The drill-ready property has historical Cu and Ni mineralized zones (A, B, C) and plans for a summer diamond program, but no production or definitive new supply is stated.

title: Planned Wyoming Mine May Help Avoid Copper Supply 'Train Wreck'
summary: The piece warns that copper demand could outpace supply, describing a potential “train wreck” scenario and citing statements that copper prices might rise sharply. It discusses the planned CK Gold Project in Wyoming (including 248 million pounds of copper) and highlights permitting and financing progress tied to future supply stability.

title: COPPER WIRE CAPER: Ottawa police looking for two suspects in $100,000 theft
summary: Ottawa police are seeking two suspects after a break-in at a business in early June, when thieves allegedly stole over $100,000 worth of copper wiring. The release provides suspect and vehicle details but no indication of wider supply disruption. The event is localized and unlikely to move copper prices materially.

title: Mink Ventures Commences Option for Warren Copper Nickel Project, Timmins, Ontario
summary: Mink Ventures announced it has issued shares and warrants to commence an option for the Warren copper-nickel project in Ontario. The company describes drill readiness, identified Cu-Ni mineralized zones, and plans for upcoming exploration expenditures. Historical assays and grades are cited, but no production or near-term supply shift is indicated.

title: SMM Morning Comments (Jul 6): Copper, Zinc and Lead Prices Showed Mixed Trends Overnight_SMM
summary: SMM reports mixed overnight moves in copper: LME copper fell 0.44% while SHFE rose slightly; spot premiums dropped on low-priced importer shipments in east China and weak downstream demand, with inventories in south China falling due to lack of arrivals. title: China Copper Anode Imports Increased In May, And Are Expected To Continue The Upward Trend In June, Driven By Improving SHFE/LME Copper Price Ratio_SMM
summary: China’s copper anode imports rose to 88,800 mt in May and are expected to keep increasing in June due to a favorable SHFE/LME price ratio and tightening domestic anode supply. summary: Rumours of power rationing in Leshan, Sichuan, are mentioned alongside recovering Yunnan aluminium output. title: Citi Research Cautious about Copper Prices in Three Quarters, Iron Ore Prices to Have Support from Policy Stimulus_SMM
summary: Citi Research said it remains cautious on copper for the next three quarters, forecasting an average around $8,000/mt and trading $7,500–8,500/mt, citing weak growth outside China and a China recovery not strongly reliant on metals. It also noted policy-stimulus support for iron ore, but copper focus dominates.

title: Copper Prices Edged Down On Hawkish Minutes of the Federal Reserve's Meeting Last Month_SMM
summary: LME copper fell 0.44% to $8,322.5/mt as SHFE 2308 rose slightly. Hawkish Federal Reserve minutes boosted expectations for further 2023 hikes, weighing on macro sentiment. Spot quotes weakened due to low-priced imported shipments, suppressed downstream demand, limited arrivals in south China, and softer buying interest.

title: Nickel Prices Under Pressure As US Fed's June Meeting Sends Hawkish Signal_SMM
summary: SMM reports nickel prices are under pressure after minutes from the US Fed’s June meeting signaled further tightening. In China, domestic nickel spot premiums declined and high prices curbed purchasing interest. SMM expects nickel to move sideways but remain under downward pressure.

title: Nickel Mining at a Feverish Pitch as EV & Other Green Tech Demand Surges
summary: The piece highlights heightened activity around Canadian nickel projects, citing EV/battery demand and reporting drilling and borehole electromagnetics results from Fathom Nickel’s Gochager Lake. While this supports expectations for future nickel supply, it is primarily exploration-focused and not a clear immediate market-wide supply or inventory shock.

title: Commodities : Copper falls on firmer dollar, hawkish Fed - Stock market news
summary: Copper prices fell in London and Shanghai on a firmer U.S. dollar and hawkish Fed expectations for further rate hikes. LME aluminium eased marginally while nickel rose. Chinese smelters raised copper concentrate treatment charges, citing abundant supply and flat demand growth, but the macro factor pressured copper.

title: Commodities : Copper falls on firm dollar, fragile demand outlook - Stock market news
summary: Copper is set for a third straight session of declines as a firmer U.S. dollar and weak global economic data weigh on demand expectations. title: Freeport Indonesia awaits export permit as copper concentrate piles up
summary: Freeport Indonesia is still awaiting a government export permit, after its permit expired when Indonesia banned raw mineral exports in June. title: Avante Mining Corp.: Avante Mining Assays up to 1.85% of Nickel from Historic Core Samples and Receives Drilling Permits at the TL Nickel Project
summary: Avante Mining reports re-sampling results from historic core at its TL Nickel Project, with nickel assays up to 1.85% and copper assays up to ~1.84%. title: Vedanta, Zambia Nearing Deal over KCM Copper Mine Dispute_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Zambia is reportedly close to resolving a dispute with Vedanta over Konkola Copper Mines (KCM) and the future of some state-owned mines. title: Bauxite Ore Export Ban; Developing a Domestic Mineral Refining & Processing Industry in Indonesia
summary: Indonesia imposed a June 2023 ban on bauxite ore exports to force development of domestic processing/refining. Tightening bauxite-to-alumina logistics can support aluminium input costs. title: NorthWest Copper Identifies Lorraine Boundary Target
summary: NorthWest Copper identified a new “Boundary Target” near its Lorraine copper-gold project, based on geophysical reinterpretation and surface geochemistry reporting up to 11% Cu. title: PAN GLOBAL REPORTS NEAR-SURFACE COPPER-TIN MINERALIZATION AT ROMANA WEST IN THE ESCACENA PROJECT, SPAIN
summary: Pan Global reports visible copper and tin mineralization from initial holes at the Romana West target of Spain’s Escacena project, with IP geophysics expanding the chargeability anomaly westward. title: Pan Global Resources Inc.: PAN GLOBAL REPORTS NEAR-SURFACE COPPER-TIN MINERALIZATION AT ROMANA WEST IN THE ESCACENA PROJECT, SPAIN
summary: Pan Global Resources announced a 10,000-meter 2026 drill program at Spain’s Escacena and Cármenes projects. No production change is announced.

title: Erdene Expands Mineralization at Zuun Mod Molybdenum-Copper Project in Khundii District
summary: Erdene reports expanded mineralization from a 12-hole program at its Zuun Mod molybdenum-copper porphyry project in Mongolia, including long Mo and Cu intervals and copper anomalism north of the deposit. While it may support longer-term copper supply expectations, there are no near-term production changes.

title: Horizonte Minerals wins approval for Araguaia nickel project
summary: Horizonte Minerals received environmental approval from the Para State Secretariat to begin mining at its wholly owned Araguaia nickel project in Brazil. The permit allows initial work to establish ore stockpiles ahead of commissioning and plant start-up next year, reducing commissioning delays and supporting nickel supply expectations.

title: Deal of the week: Iberdrola Purchases 20% of Latem Aluminium
summary: Iberdrola will invest €120m for a 20% stake in Spanish recycler and “green” aluminium producer Latem Aluminium, funding a new large-scale scrap-based recycling project. The output is slated for early 2024, with additional talks to use Latem aluminium in solar panel frame construction, supported by renewable power supply to cut emissions.

title: Hammer to acquire stakes in Element's Australian copper projects
summary: Hammer Metals agreed to re-acquire an 80% interest in Element’s Mount Dorothy and Cobalt Ridge exploration tenures in Queensland’s Mt Isa region, tied to copper (and critical elements) prospects. title: Horizonte obtains approval for Araguaia nickel project in Brazil
summary: Horizonte Minerals received environmental approval from Brazil’s Pará state authority to begin mining at its Araguaia nickel project. The permit enables ore stockpiling and commissioning preparation before plant start-up next year. The project’s planned output of ferronickel and nickel adds to near-term supply expectations for nickel.

title: Russia's Nornickel sees 'certain progress' in selling accumulated reserves of metals -Interfax
summary: Norilsk Nickel said it has made “certain progress” selling accumulated metal reserves built up in 2022, according to Interfax (via Reuters). The report implies additional near-term supply reaching the market, which is most relevant for nickel given the company’s core output, though figures and delivery timing are not specified.

title: Goldman Sachs says rising EV usage to power higher copper demand
summary: Goldman Sachs said rising EV adoption should boost copper demand, citing copper’s role in EV power and charging. It noted EVs drove much of the recent increase in copper use and expects strong China EV sales. The note also flags copper per EV may decline over time, but sentiment remains bullish.

title: How Biden can help Arizona's water crisis by preventing copper mining at Oak Flat
summary: The article argues the Biden administration could halt or revise the planned Resolution Copper mine at Oak Flat, which would permit large groundwater withdrawals via a long-standing Arizona legal loophole. It cites delays and criticism of the mine’s environmental review and calls for repealing a mandated federal land swap.

title: Ero Copper to Release Second Quarter 2023 Financial
summary: Ero Copper Corp. announced it will publish its Q2 2023 financial and operating results on Aug. 3, followed by a conference call on Aug. 4. The company is a Brazilian-focused copper producer (via Caraíba Operations). The item is an investor update with potential but unspecified near-term copper market implications.

title: Both SHFE And LME Aluminium Closed With Losses Overnight, Supply Pressure Is Emerging In Chinese Market_SMM
summary: SMM reports SHFE and LME aluminium futures closed lower overnight. title: China Dominates World's Nickel Supply Needed for U.S.-Made Electric Cars
summary: A report says China’s rapid expansion into Indonesia’s nickel operations has given it dominant control of nickel needed for EV batteries in the U.S. The Inflation Reduction Act’s mineral-sourcing requirements may exclude Indonesia and invite scrutiny of Chinese firms’ involvement, weakening U.S. supply prospects and near-term nickel demand outlook.

title: Commodities : London copper gains as dollar eases; demand, Fed's rate uncertainty weighs - Stock market news
summary: London copper rebounded 0.3% as the dollar eased, but gains were capped by uncertainty over Chinese demand and expectations for further U.S. Fed rate hikes. LME aluminium rose 0.6% and nickel edged up slightly, reflecting mixed sentiment across metals tied to broader risk assets.

title: Aluminium Billet Social Stocks In China Begin To Drop, But Still At Three-Year High_SMM
summary: SMM data show China’s aluminium billet social stocks fell 10,200 mt WoW to 136,100 mt as of July 6, though they remain near a three-year high.
