title: Aluminium Ingot Social Stocks In China Begin To Build Up, With Further Accumulation Expected For Rest Of July_SMM
summary: SMM data show China’s eight major markets’ aluminium ingot social stocks rose to 525,000 mt as of July 6, up on-week and above July 3, though still below last year. Increased arrivals and smelters producing ingots, amid off-season demand, pushed spot premiums down quickly and fueled bearish sentiment for July.

title: SMM Review and Forecast of Copper Concentrate Market in June_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports June copper concentrate prices and spot TCs rising, supported by more active spot trading and buyer inquiries for August–September shipments. It also cites Peru’s Las Bambas armed protection ending early July with potential disruptions, Chile mine resumes after floods, and Teck’s Quebrada Blanca Phase 2 nearing first shipments.

title: Bofa Cuts Nickel Price Forecast To $22,063/t In 2023 ($23,222/t…
summary: BofA reduced its nickel price forecast for 2023 to $22,063/t from $23,222/t previously, while keeping the 2024 forecast unchanged at $21,250/t. The downgrade signals softer expected nickel market conditions, which can weigh on near-term nickel price expectations.

title: First Nation calls for review of Copper Mountain mine extension | iNFOnews | Thompson-Okanagan's News Source
summary: A First Nation is asking the BC government to review an extension of the Copper Mountain mine near Princeton, seeking an environmental assessment and consent before approving the life-of-mine plan. The New Ingerbelle pit expansion would extend operations by about 12 years, so potential delays could affect near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Commodities : Copper trades in tight range as demand outlook, Fed rate jitters weigh - Stock market news
summary: Copper edged up but remained in a tight range as investors weighed U.S. Fed rate expectations and a pending jobs report against China demand outlook. China’s property and new-energy activity supported demand, while expanding domestic supply from smelters and rising aluminium output capped gains. Aluminium and nickel also saw modest moves.

title: Copper Inventory in China Bonded Zone Plunged This Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s bonded-zone copper inventories fell 5,600 mt week-on-week to 61,200 mt, with declines in both Guangdong and Shanghai zones. The influx of LME-delivered cargoes has pressured spot premiums and kept warrant trades subdued. With more imports arriving after customs next week, bonded inventories are expected to drop further, supporting copper tightness.

title: Indonesia probes possible illegal nickel ore exports to China
summary: Indonesia’s ministry is probing allegations that nickel ore continued to be exported to China despite a ban since 2020. China imported 5.56 million tons between 2020 and May 2023, prompting investigations into misclassification and possible illegal shipments. Any crackdown could tighten nickel ore supply and support nickel prices.

title: Copper concentrate production in Armenia in 5 months of 2023 down 25.6%
summary: Armenia’s copper concentrate production fell 25.6% year-on-year in January–May 2023 to about 137,192 tons, according to the National Statistics Committee. The report also notes smaller declines for zinc and molybdenum, but the main signal is reduced copper concentrate supply that could pressure copper prices.

title: Peru copper miners say red tape snarling red metal production ramp-up
summary: Peru’s copper miners say bureaucratic delays and political uncertainty are snarling efforts to ramp up stalled output. With hundreds of administrative steps for mining approvals, projects such as mine-life extensions and new builds are delayed. The government plans process reviews with the World Bank, but change will not be overnight.

title: Analysis-Peru copper miners say red tape snarling red metal production ramp-up
summary: The analysis reports that copper miners in Peru say bureaucratic “red tape” is snarling efforts to ramp up red metal production. If ramp-ups are delayed, near-term supply growth could be slower than expected, which tends to pressure copper price expectations over the following days to weeks.

title: Indonesia Is Investigating Massive Illegal Nickel Ore Exports to China for Causing Huge Losses of Royalties and Export Taxes_SMM
summary: Indonesia is investigating alleged illegal exports of nickel ore worth 14.5 trillion rupiah to China dating back to early 2020. Authorities say 5.3 million mt of ore were illegally shipped, causing estimated losses of royalties and export taxes. Possible enforcement tightening could reduce near-term nickel ore flows to China.

title: Copper up as LME stocks fall; focus on US jobs data
summary: Copper rose about 0.6% on Friday as LME-registered warehouse stocks fell to their lowest since April. The market shifted to the upcoming U.S. jobs report, which could influence risk appetite, rate expectations, and the dollar, indirectly affecting copper demand. Aluminium edged up slightly, while other metals fell.

title: Filtration and Separation - Metso to deliver separation equipment to Zambian copper mine
summary: Metso will deliver flotation and separation equipment, including TankCell cells, Concorde Cell high-intensity units, ColumnCell units, and thickeners, to Zambia’s Kansanshi copper mine. The upgrade is described as energy efficient and aimed at improving fine/ultrafine flotation performance. No immediate production shock is mentioned.

title: Optimum Ventures Announces Entry Into Arrangement Agreement With Blackwolf Copper and Gold Ltd.
summary: Optimum Ventures announced an arrangement to be acquired by Blackwolf Copper and Gold, involving Blackwolf’s high-grade Niblack copper-gold-zinc-silver project. The transaction details focus on share exchange ratio and approvals, with no stated near-term production changes, so any influence on copper prices is likely indirect and limited.

title: India, US mutually resolve major WTO issues, including disputes on steel and aluminium
summary: The US agreed to clear 80% of aluminium applications and 70% of steel applications for India-origin products as India and the US resolved six trade disputes outside the WTO. The decision should improve immediate market access and potentially support aluminium pricing through improved export inflows and reduced trade friction.

title: BofA Cuts Price Forecast For Most Commodities Including Copper, Lead, Zinc and Nickel for 2023 and 2024_SMM
summary: BofA Global Research lowered its commodity price forecasts, including copper and nickel. Copper forecasts for 2023 and 2024 were reduced versus prior estimates, and nickel’s 2023 forecast was also cut, while 2024 stayed unchanged. The revisions point to weaker expected market conditions for these metals.

title: Goldman Sachs Bullish on Copper Prices as Increased Use of Electric Vehicles Boosts Copper Demand_SMM
summary: Goldman Sachs told investors EV adoption is a key driver of bullish copper prices, projecting copper demand rising as EV production lifts consumption. It expects strong China EV sales for the rest of 2023 and links copper’s electrical properties to EV power applications, despite later declines in copper per vehicle.

title: BofA Cuts Price Forecast For Most Commodities Including Copper, Lead, Zinc and Nickel for 2023 and 2024_SMM
summary: BofA Global Research lowered its price forecasts for several commodities. Copper forecasts were reduced for 2023 and 2024, and nickel’s 2023 forecast was also cut (2024 unchanged). The changes suggest weaker expected prices, but the impact is mainly forecast-level.

title: Jindal to invest Rs 100-150 crore in Bhiwadi plant to increase aluminium capacity -
summary: Jindal Aluminium Ltd plans to invest ₹100–150 crore to expand its Bhiwadi plant capacity by 60,000 tonnes per annum, after prior investments. The company cites rising demand and focuses on improving productivity and reducing costs through technology. The capacity boost increases near-term aluminium supply expectations.

title: Gupta must file defence in Trafigura nickel fraud case by July 12 - court
summary: A London court set a July 12 deadline for Prateek Gupta and related firms to file their defence in Trafigura’s nickel cargo fraud case. Trafigura alleged some 25,000 tonnes were not high-grade nickel, with early containers found to contain carbon steel, and booked a 590-million impairment.

title: Barrick CEO wants to search for more copper in Zambia and Congo
summary: Barrick’s CEO said the company wants to explore for additional copper in Zambia and the DRC and to expand/extend its Lumwana mine in Zambia, currently producing about 267,000 mt of copper. The miner may invest more and extend mine life to 2060, but figures were not provided.

title: Man wanted for stealing copper wiring from NC power stations
summary: Investigators in North Carolina are searching for a suspect accused of breaking into Duke Energy power substations and stealing copper wiring used to ground equipment. Police say the man caused about $40,000 in damage and attempted another break-in. Authorities warn it could cause outages and serious injury.

title: Avebury nickel miner Mallee Resources in deep trouble if no deal | The Advocate
summary: Mallee Resources’ Avebury nickel mine restart is under pressure, with the outcome of a July 27 shareholder vote determining whether a Hartree-backed funding/warrants deal proceeds. Poor ramp-up, site issues, and a declining nickel price have left the company cash-strapped and vulnerable to closure or insolvency.

title: The rush for nickel: 'They are destroying our future'
summary: The report describes nickel mining in Indonesia near Labengki Island, where residents say mine waste enters coastal waters during the rainy season, causing sediment damage and harming fishing. While officials argue licensed firms manage waste, they admit supervision gaps and ongoing illegal mining, raising risk of enforcement and supply disruptions.

title: Commodities : Copper retreats on China inflation data; supply risks limit losses - Stock market news
summary: London copper slipped after China inflation data missed expectations, deepening demand worries. The dollar firmed on expectations for further Fed rate hikes. While low inventories and potential supply disruptions supported prices, Chilean output fell and Peruvian miners face red tape, limiting losses. Nickel fell; aluminium rose slightly.

title: Commodities : Copper eases as China data disappoints; supply issues weigh - Stock market news
summary: London copper fell 0.5% as disappointing China inflation data signaled slower recovery in the top metal consumer, weighing on demand expectations. Softer global economic sentiment added pressure. Despite supply issues and low inventories, copper inventories declined. Nickel also edged down, while aluminium was largely unchanged.

title: China's CMOC resumes copper, cobalt shipments from Congo TFM mine
summary: CMOC says it has resumed normal copper exports from its Tenke Fungurume (TFM) mine in the DRC after resolving a royalty dispute with state miner Gecamines. Shipments restarted from April 29, with copper sold based on market needs, implying higher near-term supply availability.

title: Historic Arizona mining town backs copper project
summary: Arizona’s Superior and Native groups are contesting permits for Resolution/Rio Tinto’s proposed Oak Flat underground copper mine, delaying a land transfer pending an additional environmental impact statement and court review. The mine is positioned as a major future copper supply source, so the approval risk supports near-term copper price expectations.

title: Jindal Aluminium To Invest Rs 100-150 Crore In Bhiwadi Plant To Increase Aluminium Capacity -
summary: Jindal Aluminium plans to invest ₹100–150 crore to expand capacity at its Bhiwadi plant by 60,000 tpa, building on prior capex. Management cites rising aluminium demand and aims to improve productivity and reduce costs via R&D. India already has sufficient aluminium capacity, limiting immediate price impact.

title: Copper prices fall on weak China data
summary: Copper prices fell on the LME after weak China economic data renewed concerns about slower demand for growth-linked base metals. Weak inflation indicators raised expectations for more stimulus but signaled sluggish recovery. A stronger U.S. dollar also weighed. Warehouse stocks were low, offering some support, but supply/demand outlook stayed bearish.

title: GeoProMining Group of Companies plans to build copper smelting plant in Armenia
summary: GeoProMining said it plans to build a copper smelting plant in Armenia. Two international firms are preparing a feasibility study for the project linked to its Zangezur copper-molybdenum combine. It also noted suspension of the Sotk gold mine due to shelling, but the copper focus is on expanding smelting capacity.

title: 3rd arrest made in ongoing string of copper thefts plaguing Colorado Springs
summary: Colorado Springs police arrested a third suspect in a series of copper thefts, including suspects returning to a target property to cut copper pipes and wiring. Multiple arrests occurred over July 6-7. The report does not quantify volumes, and the activity appears localized, making broader copper price impact unlikely.

title: Palladium One Receives Class 1 Exploration Permit and Begins Field Exploration Program on Canalask Nickel Project, Yukon, Canada
summary: Palladium One announced receipt of a Class 1 exploration permit and started site work, including clearing access trails and planning an EM survey at its Canalask nickel-copper project in Yukon. The company reports prior magnetometer work and historic grab samples with >2% nickel and ~6% copper, but no production changes.

title: Callinex Announces High-Grade Copper Maiden Mineral Resource Estimate at its Pine Bay Project in Manitoba
summary: Callinex announced a high-grade maiden mineral resource estimate for its Pine Bay Project in Manitoba, including significant copper content (Rainbow: 3.44 Mt at 3.59% CuEq; Pine Bay: 1.0 Mt at 2.62% Cu). The company also highlighted fully funded drilling to expand resources further.

title: Peru copper production up 35% in May
summary: Peru’s ministry of energy and mines said the country’s copper production rose nearly 35% in May versus the prior year to 234,781 metric tons. The Reuters report highlights stronger output from a key global supplier, which can increase near-term supply expectations and weigh on copper prices.

title: Mining Stock News: Magna Mining (TSXV: NICU) (FSE: 8YD) Intersects 6% Nickel in Additional Footwall Zone at the Crean Hill Project
summary: Magna Mining reported new diamond drilling assays at its Crean Hill project, including intervals with 6.0% nickel and also copper (e.g., 2.2% Cu in one 2.2m run). The results extend nickel zones beyond existing resource models, but no near-term production changes were announced.

title: SHFE And LME Aluminium Close With Gains, China's Latest CPI And PPI Data Extends Decline_SMM
summary: SHFE and LME aluminium finished higher on the day, but the piece flags negative macro data (China CPI/PPI decline) and off-season demand. It also points to restarts of idle Yunnan aluminium capacity bringing more late-July supply, potential Sichuan power rationing, and rising social inventories—factors likely to pressure prices.

title: High purity alumina plant receives more funding - Manufacturers' Monthly
summary: Queensland awarded Alpha HPA over $21 million to fund Stage 2 of its Gladstone high purity alumina project, enabling full-scale production. The facility uses solvent extraction/refining to produce 4N/5N alumina and aluminium salts for high-tech uses like lithium-ion batteries and semiconductors, supporting expanded aluminium processing capacity.

title: Great Southern Copper shares rise on "exciting results" at Teresita
summary: Great Southern Copper said assay results from its Especularita project’s Teresita prospect were “exciting,” reporting up to 5.97% copper and 13.7 g/t gold from 160 rock chip samples. The company expects the findings to generate multiple drill targets, with further sampling and surveys pending.

title: Commodities : Aluminium prices rise on weaker dollar and China demand hopes - Stock market news
summary: Reuters reports LME aluminium rising 1.5% to about $2,179/ton, driven by a weaker U.S. dollar and hopes for stronger Chinese demand. Beijing’s extension of property-market support underpins base metals sentiment, while investors await U.S. inflation and Chinese trade data.

title: Western Metallica Reports Results From the 1st Phase Drill Program at Its Nueva Celti Copper Project
summary: Western Metallica reported results from the first phase drill program at its Nueva Celti copper project, including multiple copper-bearing intercepts (e.g., up to ~0.6–1.7% Cu over drilled intervals) and evidence of continuity of sulphide mineralization over ~300 metres. The company says findings suggest higher-grade copper zones at depth and potential expansions.

title: Canada Nickel Announces Latest Drill Results at Midlothian Property Confirming Significant Discovery
summary: Canada Nickel announced drill assay results from its Midlothian property, reporting long mineralized intervals with ~0.26–0.29% nickel and dominant nickel-bearing minerals (awaruite/heazlewoodite). Mineralogy also shows high brucite content linked to its carbon storage process. The update is sentiment-positive for nickel supply expectations.

title: Metallic Minerals Corp.: Metallic Minerals Launches First Phase Drill Program at the La Plata Copper-Silver-Gold-PGE Project in Southwest Colorado, USA
summary: Metallic Minerals started a first-phase 2023 drill program at its La Plata copper-silver-gold-PGE project in Colorado, targeting step-out resource expansion from a prior high-grade hole. The release outlines expected drill meters and copper-equivalent grades, but provides no production impact, making any near-term copper price effect limited.

title: CanAlaska Uranium Ltd.: CanAlaska Signs LOI to Option Four North Thompson Nickel Belt Projects in Manitoba to Valterra Resource Corporation
summary: CanAlaska signed a LOI with Valterra to allow Valterra to earn up to an 80% interest in four North Thompson Nickel Belt projects in Manitoba. The deal includes staged cash, share issuance, and exploration expenditures near Vale’s Thompson nickel operations, with a joint venture after earn-in milestones.

title: Rio Tinto to make low-carbon alumina
summary: Rio Tinto and Sumitomo will invest $111 million to build a world-first hydrogen plant at Rio’s Yarwun alumina refinery in Gladstone. The hydrogen project aims to cut carbon emissions by replacing natural gas in the energy-intensive calcination process, potentially improving future alumina economics and supply expectations for aluminium.

title: Aluminium prices rise on weaker dollar and China demand hopes
summary: Aluminium prices rose about 1.5% on Tuesday to the highest since late June, supported by a weaker U.S. dollar and improving China demand expectations. Beijing extended property support measures, and LME aluminium inventories fell. However, a wider cash/3-month discount suggested plentiful near-term supply.

title: Deep-South stock soars after Namibia renews copper project licence
summary: Canada’s Deep-South Resources said Namibia renewed its prospecting licence for two years for the Haib copper project, allowing it to resume work. The permit ends a long-running court battle. The update reduces regulatory uncertainty and improves near-term sentiment for potential future copper supply.

title: Valterra Resource Corporation: Valterra Signs Letter of Intent to Option Properties in the Thompson Nickel Belt, Manitoba
summary: Valterra signed a non-binding letter of intent to option mineral exploration licenses in Manitoba’s Thompson Nickel Belt, adjacent to the Thompson Nickel Mine. The company plans geophysics and diamond drilling and may earn up to 80% interest, with additional payments after a feasibility study. It targets nickel sulphide deposits.

title: Weak construction output hampers European aluminium premiums and steel market price
summary: Fastmarkets reports falling European aluminium premiums as weak construction output reduces demand. Producers extend maintenance breaks and traders cite physical demand down 30-45% this year. Aluminium 6063 extrusion billet premiums in North Germany and Italy and Rotterdam ingot premiums have declined over recent weeks, reflecting lower inquiries and postponements.

title: Japanese buyer agrees to pay Q3 aluminium premium of $127.5/T -source
summary: A Japanese buyer agreed to pay a Q3 aluminium premium of $127.5/ton over the benchmark price for July–September shipments, slightly below the prior quarter and below producers’ initial $165–180 offers. With Japan the biggest aluminium importer in Asia, the deal points to near-term support for aluminium premium pricing.

title: Copper Prices Vulnerable As Global Manufacturing Slows
summary: The piece says copper prices have moved sideways after a June rally faded, with demand signals weakening as China manufacturing growth slows and U.S. manufacturing remains in contraction. It also notes LME inventories fell sharply, supporting prices and preventing a renewed downtrend. Overall momentum looks uncertain.

title: Rio Tinto and Sumitomo to build Gladstone hydrogen pilot plant to trial lower-carbon alumina refining
summary: Rio Tinto and Sumitomo will build a hydrogen pilot plant in Gladstone to test using hydrogen in alumina calcination at the Yarwun refinery. The program is supported by Australia’s ARENA and includes a 2.5MW electrolyser and calciners retrofit, with operation targeted for 2025.

title: TELF AG Publishes Report Highlighting Notable Shifts in China's Copper Market
summary: TELF AG reports that China’s bonded-zone copper cathode inventories fell by 5,100 MT to 66,800 MT from June 21-30. It also says high domestic spot premiums flipped copper import losses into profits. However, long-term contract deliveries may reduce near-term tradable availability.

title: Podcast: 'Good time to buy gold': CPM Group's Jeffrey Christian on BRICS currency, silver and copper inventories
summary: In a CPM Group podcast, Jeffrey Christian discusses rumours of a BRICS gold-backed currency and reviews silver and copper market fundamentals. He argues that low copper inventories may not be as alarming as some commentators suggest, implying limited near-term downside risk for copper despite inventory concerns.

title: Rio Tinto (ASX: RIO) bets on hydrogen to cut aluminium emissions
summary: Rio Tinto will trial hydrogen processing and retrofit calciners at its Yarwun alumina refinery to replace natural gas with clean hydrogen, supported by ARENA funding. The goal is lower emissions under Australia’s safeguard mechanism. If successful, it could reduce alumina decarbonization costs and support aluminium production prospects.

title: Alumina refinery trial swapping gas power for hydrogen
summary: Rio Tinto’s Yarwun alumina refinery in Queensland received $32 million for a pilot to replace natural gas with renewable hydrogen, including electrolyser and burner retrofits. The trial targets lower calcination emissions and could reduce the refinery’s annual emissions. If successful, it supports longer-term decarbonised aluminium supply chain prospects.

title: Romania's aluminium group Alro sells Sierra Leone bauxite mines
summary: Romanian aluminium group Alro/Alum Tulcea agreed to sell its Sierra Leone bauxite mines after an unsolicited offer. The mines supply bauxite to the group’s alumina refinery. The article gives production and valuation history but no immediate disruption, volume change, or pricing terms, implying limited short-term impact on aluminium markets.

title: Atalaya Mining reports higher copper production in second quarter
summary: Atalaya Mining reported copper production rose in Q2 2023 to 14,212 tonnes from 13,386 a year earlier, with higher ore mined and slightly improved grade. The firm maintained full-year guidance of 53,000–55,000 tonnes, citing strong plant throughput and recoveries. Copper prices mentioned as softer, with improved near-term supply balance.

title: Rio Tinto and Sumitomo to build hydrogen-powered alumina refinery
summary: Rio Tinto and Sumitomo will build a hydrogen-powered plant and retrofit calciners at the Yarwun alumina refinery in Gladstone, Australia, to lower emissions from the calcination process. The AUD111.1m trial starts in 2024 and operates in 2025, producing about 6,000 tons of alumina annually with reduced CO2.

title: China credit data, lower dollar sustain copper prices
summary: Reuters reports copper prices were supported by stronger-than-expected China credit and new loans, alongside a lower U.S. dollar ahead of U.S. inflation data. However, doubts about a meaningful demand pickup and concerns about China’s property sector weighed on sentiment. LME copper stocks fell sharply.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Reports 17.70 metres at 0.96% Copper and 0.12 g/t Gold within 101.31 metres at 0.45% Copper at Copper Creek in Arizona
summary: Faraday Copper reports assay results from six drill holes at its Copper Creek project in Arizona, including several copper intercepts (e.g., 17.70 m at 0.96% copper). The company discusses potential resource expansion and upcoming metallurgical and Phase III drilling, with no immediate production impact.

title: McEwen Copper: Los Azules – Latest Assay Results
summary: McEwen Copper reported new infill drilling results from the Los Azules project in Argentina, including long intercepts such as 398 m at 0.75% Cu (and 124 m at 1.43% Cu). New assays align well with the resource model and slightly exceed it, reinforcing positive project outlook.

title: Surge Copper Commences 2023 Exploration Program
summary: Surge Copper Corp. announced it has commenced its 2023 field exploration program at the Berg-Ootsa district, including planned diamond drilling starting the week of July 17 and continued surface copper-in-soil anomaly work. The company targets expansions of higher-grade zones, resource conversion, and additional metallurgical data.

title: Faraday Copper Reports 17.70 metres at 0.96% Copper and 0.12 g/t Gold within 101.31 metres at 0.45% Copper at Copper Creek in Arizona
summary: Faraday Copper reported assay results from its Copper Creek project in Arizona, highlighting 17.70 metres at 0.96% copper and additional zones within 101.31 metres grading 0.45% copper. The announcement is a positive update for the project’s resource potential and may support near-term copper sentiment.

title: Québec Nickel Intersects 152 Metres of 0.21% Nickel + 114 ppm Cobalt at Ducros Sill
summary: Québec Nickel reports drill results from the Ducros Sill showing long intersections of ~0.19–0.21% nickel with associated cobalt, confirming a large ultramafic intrusion extent. Such exploration updates can affect sentiment around future nickel supply, but it is not a near-term production or trade shock.

title: Rio Tinto Gets Funding to Cut Emissions with Green Hydrogen at Alumina Refinery
summary: ARENA will fund Rio Tinto’s Yarwun alumina refinery trial using green hydrogen calcination, replacing fossil gas with hydrogen burners to cut emissions. The pilot electrolyzer is 2.5 MW and commissioning is slated for 2025. While supportive for long-term alumina decarbonisation, near-term price effects should be limited.

title: Flying Nickel Mining Corp.: Flying Nickel's Minago Drill Core Assay Program Returns 4.99 Meters Grading 0.713 g/t PGM + Au, In Addition to Prior Reported 0.31% Nickel in Manitoba's Thompson Nickel Belt
summary: Flying Nickel reported final PGM assay results from its Minago Nickel PGM project in Manitoba, including an interval grading 0.31% nickel (0.289 g/t Pt, 0.42 g/t Pd, 0.004 g/t Au) over 4.99 meters. The program completed on schedule and supports future resource updates.

title: Commodities : Sliding dollar propels copper to 2-1/2-week high - Stock market news
summary: Copper rose to 2-1/2-week highs as the dollar tumbled after softer U.S. June inflation data and stronger China credit/loan figures supported base metals sentiment. Despite doubts about a demand pick-up, technical signals and cash market tone helped. Aluminium and nickel also climbed in tandem with the move.

title: Copper Cos. Watch for Investment to Return to Chile
summary: Chile’s mining tax reform has been finalized, reducing multi-year uncertainty that had weighed on copper investment. The article highlights renewed activity and planned financing for copper projects, alongside forecasts of a future copper supply shortfall driven by EVs and electrification, implying supportive near-term sentiment for copper prices.

title: Elemental Altus Royalties Corp.: Elemental Altus Increases NSR Royalty on Caserones Copper Mine
summary: Elemental Altus increased its NSR royalty interest in Chile’s Caserones copper-molybdenum mine by buying additional shares tied to the royalty, raising its effective NSR to 0.473%. The mine is producing copper cathodes and concentrates, but the release is primarily corporate/ownership-related, not an operational supply shock.

title: Gupta says Trafigura employees proposed substituting nickel -court document
summary: Court documents in a Reuters report show Gupta’s defence arguing Trafigura employees proposed substituting other materials for nickel in trades. The dispute centers on alleged lower-grade or different metals shipped as nickel, after Trafigura booked a $590 million impairment and inspected containers. The claims likely pressure nickel sentiment.

title: Drilling expands footprint for Filo del Sol copper project in Argentina
summary: Filo Corp. released new assay results from three drilling holes at its expanding Filo del Sol copper-gold project in San Juan, Argentina. The results indicate a growing potential project footprint, improving expectations for future copper supply development. The news can lend modest support to copper prices despite no immediate production impact.

title: Andrew Forrest blazes a nickel trail
summary: Nickel has underperformed this year, but the article argues for a bounce-back. It cites Forrest’s completion of the Mincor Resources takeover, a revival of HPAL processing in Western Australia, and Japanese trading-house support for Ardea’s Kalgoorlie project, alongside concerns about environmentally acceptable nickel supply.

title: TELF AG Releases Report on the Current State of Nickel Sulfate
summary: TELF AG’s report analyzes nickel sulfate demand drivers for Europe and North America, where EV and battery growth keep nickel sulfate in focus. It notes Europe’s sustainability requirements and North America’s IRA/geopolitical compliance create differentiated premiums and higher costs, while domestic production remains limited and regions rely on Asia imports, supporting nickel-linked prices.

title: Commodities : Copper prices hit three-week high as dollar drops - Stock market news
summary: Copper hit a three-week high as the dollar fell, making dollar-priced metals cheaper for non-USD holders. LME three-month copper was near unchanged but earlier rose to a recent high. In the same session, LME aluminium edged down and nickel declined, suggesting mixed near-term moves.

title: Alma Metals: A new entry into the top 10 copper resource club
summary: Alma Metals, an ASX-listed company, announced a significant upgrade to its copper resource estimate, propelling it into the top 10 copper resource rankings. The coverage frames the update as a major milestone for future supply potential, which may offer mild support to copper market sentiment in the near term.

title: World first hydrogen pilot for low carbon alumina - Manufacturers' Monthly
summary: ARENA will fund a $32.1 million pilot with Rio Tinto and Sumitomo to deploy hydrogen calcination at the Yarwun alumina refinery. The project retrofits a calciners’ fuel use with a hydrogen burner supplied by an on-site electrolyser to cut emissions and potentially improve steam recycling, supporting longer-term alumina decarbonisation.

title: China's June copper imports fall 16.4% as soft demand persists
summary: China’s June copper imports fell 16.4% year-on-year to 449,649 tonnes, pressured by strong domestic production and weak demand amid factory-gate price deflation and contracting manufacturing. The article also cites a 18.9% decline in June aluminium product exports, indicating softer trade flows alongside subdued industrial demand.

title: China June copper imports at 449,649 metric tons, down 16.4% y/y
summary: China’s June unwrought copper and copper product imports fell to 449,649 tonnes, down 16.4% year-on-year, according to customs data. The report also shows Chinese aluminium exports of primary, alloy and semi-finished products totaled 492,631 tonnes, down 18.9% year-on-year, suggesting weaker metal trade flows.

title: Copper theft causes power outage
summary: Copper theft in Tulsa caused an emergency power outage for some customers while utilities repaired damage from thieves stealing wiring from homes, businesses, and substations. Local officials say theft happens several times a week and that PSO and law enforcement offer rewards and prosecute, but the article lacks market-scale figures.

title: Rio Tinto and Sumitomo to build world first hydrogen plant for low carbon alumina | Companies
summary: Rio Tinto and Sumitomo will trial hydrogen calcination at the Yarwun alumina refinery in Queensland, funded by Australia’s ARENA. The 2.5 MW electrolyser will supply hydrogen to retrofit a calciners to reduce process emissions. It’s a test project aimed at feasibility, not immediate scale.

title: Talon Metals Drilling Intersects Entirely New Area of Nickel Mineralization
summary: Talon Metals said its maiden drill hole in Minnesota’s newly named “Raptor Zone” intersected 4.21 meters of semi-massive nickel sulphide at ~296 meters depth, stepping 450 meters from prior drilling. The company highlights similar textures to previously known material and continues exploration at the Tamarack nickel-copper project.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: Talon Metals Drilling Intersects Entirely New Area of Nickel Mineralization
summary: Talon Metals announced a maiden drill hole (23TK0482) in Minnesota’s Tamarack Nickel-Copper-Cobalt project intersected 4.21 meters of semi-massive nickel sulphide at ~296 m depth, with assays pending. The discovery expands known nickel mineralization in an untested ‘Raptor Zone,’ supporting future nickel supply expectations.

title: Barrick Gold's reports higher gold, copper outputs for second quarter
summary: Barrick Gold said Q2 copper output rose to 107 million pounds from 88 million in Q1, driven by higher production at Lumwana in Zambia, and expects copper AISC to fall 7%-9%. The update also covers higher gold output but the copper production and cost outlook are the key near-term market signals.

title: Barrick sold one million ounces of gold and 101 million pounds of copper in Q2 | iNFOnews
summary: Barrick Gold said it sold 101 million pounds of copper in Q2, alongside 107 million pounds of preliminary copper production. The company expects to meet full-year copper guidance, with a higher second-half profile. It also noted realized copper pricing 3–5% below the market due to provisional pricing adjustments.

title: Barrick says it sold one million ounces of gold, 101 million pounds of copper in second quarter
summary: Barrick says it sold 101 million pounds of copper in the second quarter and that preliminary production totaled 107 million pounds. The firm is on track for full-year copper guidance and cites realized copper pricing 3–5% below the average market price due to provisional adjustments. Full results are due Aug. 8.

title: Canada issues final conclusion on anti-dumping probe into Vietnamese copper pipe fittings | Business
summary: Canada is issuing a final conclusion on an anti-dumping and countervailing probe into Vietnamese copper pipe fittings. Authorities consider whether terminating duties would further harm Canada’s manufacturing sector. A continued five-year duty regime would keep tariffs in place; otherwise, Canada would remove them. Final decision is due Nov. 22.

title: Castillo Copper study shows AUD28 million value for Big One deposit
summary: Castillo Copper said a preliminary pit optimisation study for its Big One deposit at the NWQ project shows an AUD28 million NPV and potential output of about 6,266 tonnes of copper (1.4% head grade). The company plans to use results to seek a development partner and pursue a mining license, offering development confidence rather than immediate supply shocks.

title: Australia: Rio Tinto and Sumitomo to build Gladstone hydrogen pilot plant to trial lower-carbon alumina refining
summary: Rio Tinto and Sumitomo will build a hydrogen pilot at the Yarwun alumina refinery in Gladstone to trial using hydrogen in the calcination step, supported by ARENA co-funding. The 2.5MW electrolyser and calciners retrofit should operate from 2025, producing about 6,000 tonnes of alumina annually with lower emissions.

title: Talon Metals Corp. Drilling Intersects Entirely New Area of Nickel Mineralization
summary: Talon Metals announced drill results that intersected a previously untested zone of semi-massive nickel sulphide at the Tamarack Intrusive Complex, within the newly named Raptor Zone. The maiden hole returned 4.21 meters of nickel mineralization at shallow depth, with assays pending, and suggests expansion beyond the known resource area.

title: Dollar Woes Persist, Aussie Capitalizes on Copper's Revival
summary: The dollar stays weak on softer-than-expected inflation and jobless-claims data, while risk-on sentiment lifts stocks and lowers yields. The AUD gains on the back of a strong copper rebound. The piece also sets bullish near-term copper retest/target levels, with further upside expected.

title: Atex Resources (TSXV:ATEX) Reports Results from Phase III Drill Campaign at Valeriano Copper-Gold Project, Intersects 0.84% CuEq over 670 Metres
summary: Atex Resources reported partial assay results from two final Phase III drill holes at its Valeriano copper-gold project in Chile, including long intercepts of 0.84% and 0.64% CuEq with associated copper, gold, and molybdenum grades. The data will support a future resource update and Phase IV drilling.

title: World first hydrogen pilot for low carbon alumina | REVE News of the wind sector in Spain and in the world
summary: ARENA will fund a $111.1m hydrogen calcination pilot at Rio Tinto’s Yarwun alumina refinery, using a 2.5MW electrolyser and retrofitted calciners to replace fossil process heat. The project aims to reduce emissions from alumina refining and demonstrate feasibility for broader rollout, supporting Australia’s alumina exports.

title: Chinese-Owned Mine Hit by More Delays in Key Peru Copper Expansion Project
summary: The piece reports that a Chinese-owned mine faces additional delays in a key copper expansion project in Peru. The extended timeline raises concerns about slower incremental copper output versus prior expectations. That supply risk can tighten near-term availability and support bullish pricing for copper over the coming weeks.

title: McEwen shares rise on on new drill results from Los Azules copper project
summary: McEwen Mining shares rose after its majority-owned unit, McEwen Copper, reported encouraging results from earlier drilling at the Los Azules copper project in Argentina. The update improves perceived potential of the copper resource, which can lift market expectations and sentiment toward copper.

title: TASEKO MINES PROVIDES FINANCING UPDATE FOR FLORENCE COPPER
summary: Taseko Mines reported an increase in its corporate revolving credit facility to US$80 million, with funding available to support capital needs of the Florence Copper project as permitting nears completion. Management also discussed additional financing arrangements around Gibraltar, aiming to secure construction capital for commercial production.

title: Lundin Mining Corporation: Lundin Mining Announces Closing of the Acquisition of Majority Interest in the Caserones Copper-Molybdenum Mine in Chile and Commitments for New $800 Million Term Loan
summary: Lundin Mining announced the closing of its acquisition of a majority interest in the Caserones copper-molybdenum mine in Chile and provided updated mineral resource and reserve estimates. The company highlights copper resource growth and reserve adjustments, supporting incremental expectations for future copper production, though not immediate output.

title: Austin Energy says people are stealing copper from transformers
summary: Austin Energy says people are stealing copper from transformers. The theft reduces the copper available to maintain and repair grid equipment and forces utilities to replace or secure affected transformers, tightening local copper supply expectations in the near term and supporting copper prices.

title: Lundin Mining Announces Closing of the Acquisition of Majority Interest in the Caserones Copper-Molybdenum Mine in Chile and Commitments for New $800 Million Term Loan
summary: Lundin Mining closed its acquisition of a 51% stake in the Caserones copper-molybdenum mine in Chile and secured $800 million in term-loan commitments to fund the deal. The company reiterates Caserones copper production and cost/capex guidance for 2H23 and discusses future output potential, supporting copper sentiment.

title: Rise in copper theft affecting service, Austin Energy says
summary: Austin Energy says copper theft in Austin has risen, with more than 20 major incidents in the first six months of 2023. Thieves pry open transformers and cut energized/isolated equipment to steal copper conduit and wiring, causing tens of thousands in repair costs and diverting supply and staff resources.

title: Microcap Adds to Dominant Land Package at Nickel Project, Shares Flirting With 52-Week Highs
summary: The piece notes LME nickel around $21,000/mt and highlights rising nickel production in Indonesia and China amid stockpile building after Indonesia’s ore import ban. It also covers Fathom Nickel’s acquisition of additional land and planned geophysics and drilling, with historic intersections reporting both nickel and some copper.

title: Cobre Limited Significant Copper Anomaly Uncovered at Kitlanya West
summary: Cobre Limited reports aircore and shallow RC drilling at its 100%-owned Kitlanya West project in Botswana found a consistent 2.5 x 1 km copper anomaly at the Tlou Target, with up to 165 ppm Cu in shallow samples and minor copper sulphide/chrysocolla. Follow-up infill and diamond drilling is planned.

title: Nordic Nickel hits more wide zones of nickel at its Pulju project in northern Finland
summary: Nordic Nickel’s maiden drill program at the Pulju (Hotinvaara) project in northern Finland returned wider disseminated nickel sulphide zones, including high-grade intervals. Management says results confirm and expand the mineralisation footprint and indicate potential to re-evaluate and grow the nickel resource. Early exploration supports nickel sentiment but not immediate supply.

title: Commodities : London aluminium, zinc set for biggest weekly gain since January - Stock market news
summary: Aluminium and copper were set for their biggest weekly gains since January/March as the US dollar stayed near 15-month lows. Softer-dollar dynamics made dollar-priced metals cheaper for other currencies. LME aluminium rose on the week, copper was up strongly, while nickel was slightly lower on the day but showed no bearish weekly turn.

title: Bauxite, alumina earnings set to double
summary: Jamaica’s filings project bauxite and alumina earnings to more than double in 2023, citing the reopening and ramp-up of Jamalco and firmer world prices, though Alpart remains shuttered and costs are rising for energy and caustic soda. Overall, improved output and demand are expected to support aluminium prices.

title: Taseko Mines Limited - Taseko Mines Provides Financing Update for Florence Copper
summary: Taseko reported an increase in its corporate revolving credit facility to US$80 million and other financing initiatives intended to support construction of the Florence Copper project. With permitting nearing an end and financing plans advancing, the company reduces project execution risk, supporting expectations for future copper supply.

title: Copper Inventories in China Bonded Zones Plunged This Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says China’s bonded-zone copper inventories fell 1,900 mt from July 7 to 59,300 mt by July 14, with declines largely in Shanghai. A deteriorating SHFE/LME ratio and import losses versus SHFE front-month reduced shipments, slowing inventory drawdowns. However, reopening of the export window could boost bonded stock accumulation.

title: Zambia plans to choose buyer of Mopani Copper Mines by month-end
summary: Zambia plans to choose a buyer for Mopani Copper Mines by month-end and expects to resolve an outstanding issue in its dispute with Vedanta over Konkola Copper Mines (KCM). Officials cite lack of capital as a constraint at KCM. Resolution and new investment could improve copper supply outlook.

title: Chery Auto's eQ7 lightweight aluminum-based electric SUV rolls off line
summary: Chery’s mass-produced eQ7 electric SUV has rolled off the assembly line using Chery’s aluminium-based lightweight electric platform (S5X) with integrated die-casting. The aluminum alloy body structure cuts curb weight by about 30%, supporting incremental aluminium demand as production ramps.

title: Copper pulls back on doubts about rates, China stimulus
summary: Copper eased after two strong sessions as investors reconsidered expectations for an early Fed pause on interest rate hikes and grew concerned China may not deliver additional stimulus. The U.S. dollar firmed slightly, making dollar-priced commodities costlier, contributing to a 0.5% drop in three-month LME copper.

title: JPMorgan downgrades this aluminum stock ahead of earnings
summary: JPMorgan downgraded Alcoa ahead of earnings, citing weaker near-term aluminum fundamentals. The analyst expects planned China smelting restarts amid muted demand to weigh on global prices and worsen the U.S. Midwest premium. Increased Russian supply and possible oversupply/discounting also pressure the aluminum price outlook.

title: Trade body flags possible EU ban on Russian aluminium, but not Rusal
summary: Europe’s aluminium trade group urged EU sanctions on Russian aluminium should avoid targeting Rusal, the main Russian producer. The letter discussed possible restrictive measures tied to EU foreign policy, noting sanctions on Russian aluminium products are currently limited. Reduced Russian supply risk would likely support aluminium prices in the near term.

title: Europe's aluminium industry group recommends not to sanction Rusal — Reuters
summary: Europe’s aluminium industry group urged the EU not to impose sanctions that target Rusal, citing Rusal’s strategic role in global aluminium supply. The letter argues sanctions would threaten European industry. Rusal accounts for about 5.6% of global aluminium production, so policy risk could affect prices.

title: Gone Crypto, Vanished Silver, Stones Instead of Nickel: 3 Bizarre Frauds
summary: The news highlights an unusual fraud involving nickel: 54 metric tons of heavy metal stored in a Rotterdam warehouse was reportedly replaced with stones instead of the promised nickel. The event undermines confidence in LME-backed storage and physical contract security, potentially pressuring nickel prices through near-term supply/counterparty risk concerns.

title: Vedanta in Advanced Stage of Deal With Zambia Over Copper Mine
summary: Vedanta is reported to be in an advanced stage of a deal with Zambia over a copper mine. The update suggests progress on the operational or ownership framework for the project, which can improve near-term expectations for copper supply and support prices.

title: IGO slashes value of its new Cosmos and Forrestania nickel mines by 75pc, shares fall 5.5pc
summary: Western Australian miner IGO reduced the assessed value of its Cosmos nickel project and Forrestania nickel operation by about 75%, flagging a large writedown. The move casts doubt on plans for a WA nickel processing hub for battery materials, weighing on nickel project outlook and sentiment. Shares fell on the news.

title: China's June aluminium output climbs as Yunnan eases power curbs
summary: China’s June primary aluminium output rose to 3.46 million tonnes as smelters in Yunnan resumed production after power curbs were eased. With more hydropower availability and lower coal and alumina prices, daily output increased month-on-month. The supply boost from the top producer is likely to weigh on aluminium prices.

title: Vedanta Step Closer to Regain Control Over Zambia Copper Assets
summary: Vedanta said it is in advanced talks with Zambia to regain control of the Konkola Copper Mines complex, seized in 2019. The prolonged dispute has hurt production, contributing to Zambia’s falling copper output. Separately, KCM agreed to repay power supplier debt, with one remaining issue to finalize a broader deal.

title: Copper wilts on demand fears after soft Chinese data
summary: Copper prices fell on demand fears after weak Chinese economic data. Reuters reports softer stimulus expectations, rising non-ferrous output including aluminium, and signs inventories may grow, pressuring the copper spot premium and futures. Aluminium and nickel also declined on the same risk-off demand outlook.

title: Royal Road Minerals Limited: Royal Road Minerals Provides Exploration Update from Its Santo Domingo Porphyry Copper and Gold District; San Juan Province, Argentina
summary: Royal Road Minerals reports exploration results from its Santo Domingo porphyry copper-gold project in Argentina, including a reported 1,000 by 600-meter copper anomaly and planned scout drilling in early August. The update is preliminary and pertains to potential resources, not current copper supply or demand.

title: Oil and Copper slide after China concerns
summary: Disappointing Chinese economic data weakened global sentiment, pressuring copper lower. The article says copper’s rebound is constrained after resistance rejection around 3.9501, with bullish signals capped by trend-line resistance. A break of key support near 3.6706 would suggest the prior decline may resume.

title: Latin Metals Discovers New Copper Mineralization at Mirador
summary: Latin Metals says it has located additional outcropping sediment-hosted copper mineralization at its Mirador project in Argentina and is advancing drainage sampling. It also acquired full control of the Ventana copper project for cash consideration. The news is early-stage exploration with no production impact, but may support copper sentiment.

title: Mining Stock News: TNR Gold (TSXV: TNR) NSR Royalty Update - Los Azules Copper, Gold & Silver Project
summary: TNR Gold announces an NSR royalty update tied to McEwen Copper’s Los Azules project in Argentina. The release highlights favorable infill drilling intercepts, including 398m at 0.75% Cu and sub-intervals up to 1.43% Cu, with improved grade alignment versus the resource model. This boosts near-term copper project confidence.

title: SolGold's Cascabel copper mine license renewed for 25 years
summary: SolGold said Ecuador granted a 25-year renewal for its Cascabel copper-gold project license. The company expects the renewal to provide stakeholders with confidence in current management’s ability to advance the project. The update mainly affects expectations for future copper supply rather than immediate output.

title: Material Matters: Copper, El Nino & Iluka
summary: The piece argues that a weakening Chinese property and construction sector—about 20% of China’s copper demand—could pressure copper prices in coming months, citing slowing transactions and soft liquidity. It also notes El Nino could disrupt copper supply from South America and create aluminium supply risks in China, but net near-term signals remain cautious.

title: SMM Copper Morning Commentary_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports LME and SHFE copper prices fell for the session, with declines of 2.03% (LME) and 0.93% (SHFE). It cites China copper inventories rising by 8,400 tonnes to 125,400 tonnes after poor spot consumption from high prices, suppressing demand. Macro data uncertainty keeps trading range-bound.

title: Commodities : Copper edges up in London as dollar hovers near 1-year low - Today at 11:50 pm
summary: Copper edged up on the LME as the weak dollar supported USD-priced metals, but sentiment was pressured by weak Chinese economic data. China signaled consumption-support policies that could help later demand. LME aluminium and nickel rose modestly, indicating broadly mixed, low-magnitude moves rather than a strong directional shock.

title: China's aluminium imports rise 10.7% y/y in H1
summary: China’s aluminium imports rose 10.7% year-on-year in H1, with June volumes also higher. The increase reflects constrained domestic supply from hydro-power shortages in Yunnan, where production is only starting to resume. Bauxite imports also rose, while demand remains mixed, with some support from EVs and solar.

title: LME and SHFE aluminum both closed with losses, but bullish macro sentiment may buoy SHFE aluminum this week_SMM
summary: SHFE and LME aluminum both closed lower last Friday, but softer US CPI boosted risk sentiment and weakened the dollar, lifting non-ferrous prices. China stimulus hopes and limited immediate supply impact are offset by power-rationing fears in southwest, higher smelter costs from alumina, and weak downstream demand with rising inventories.

title: KPK Urged to Investigate Alleged Smuggling of Nickel Ores to China
summary: Indonesia’s anti-corruption agency (KPK) is urged to investigate alleged smuggling of about 5 million tons of unprocessed nickel ore to China, despite a 2020 export ban. Reports cite origins in Sulawesi and North Maluku and focus on potential bribery and enforcement gaps, potentially affecting near-term nickel ore flows and risk.

title: Indonesia raises export tax rates for copper, zinc and iron
summary: Indonesia’s finance ministry raised export tax rates for copper concentrate to 5%-10% depending on smelter-construction progress, effective July 17 through December 2023. It also increased taxes for iron and zinc-related products. The copper policy change is likely to curb concentrate exports and weigh on copper prices near term.

title: Constellium (CSTM) to Sell Three German Extrusion Plants to Vaessen Aluminium for EUR 48.8M
summary: Constellium signed a binding deal to sell three German soft-alloy aluminium extrusion plants (Landau, Crailsheim and Burg) to Vaessen Aluminium for €48.8M. The facilities supply building, transportation and industrial markets. The sale is expected to close in the second half of 2023, subject to approvals.

title: Constellium to Sell Three German Extrusion Plants to Vaessen Aluminium
summary: Constellium agreed to sell three German soft-alloy extrusion plants to Vaessen Aluminium for €48.8 million. The facilities produce extruded aluminium for building, transportation and industrial markets. The deal is expected to close in the second half of 2023, subject to approvals. The announcement mainly concerns company asset reshuffling rather than market-wide aluminium fundamentals.

title: Indonesia hikes export taxes for copper, zinc and iron - finmin
summary: Indonesia’s finance ministry said new regulations will raise export tax rates on copper concentrate to 5%–10%. The move, alongside a prior June ban on raw mineral exports, aims to force more domestic smelting. The policy likely reduces concentrate exports and can pressure copper markets over coming days.

title: Copper prices fall as weak China growth worsens demand outlook
summary: Copper fell in London as weak China GDP growth raised concerns about consumption and metals demand. Investors stayed cautious ahead of any large stimulus, while aluminium and nickel also declined alongside the broader base-metals selloff. The weaker demand outlook outweighed a slightly weaker U.S. dollar support.

title: Barrick sold one million ounces of gold and 101 million pounds of copper in Q2 - MRO Magazine
summary: Barrick said it sold about 101 million pounds of copper in Q2 and produced roughly 107 million pounds, alongside Q2 gold sales. The company reiterated full-year copper guidance and noted its realized copper price should run 3–5% below the quarter’s average market price due to provisional pricing adjustments.

title: Great Southern Copper identifies high-grade copper
summary: Great Southern Copper PLC said assays from 33 rock chips at its Abundante prospect in Chile returned up to 3.4% copper, with 60% of samples above 0.5% and 39% above 1%. The firm is using drone magnetics to define drill targets, signaling continued copper exploration momentum.

title: Canadian North Resources Inc. Reports the Assay Results from the Spring Drilling Program: Significantly Expanding the Near-Surface Mineralized Zones of Nickel, Copper, Cobalt, Palladium and Platinum at the Ferguson Lake Project in Nunavut, Canada
summary: Canadian North Resources reported spring drilling assay results at its Ferguson Lake project, expanding near-surface mineralized zones with intersecting nickel and copper grades (plus cobalt and PGMs). The update supports expectations for further resource definition and potential future supply, providing modest near-term bullish sentiment for Cu and Ni.

title: PH nickel miners betting on transition to clean energy
summary: Philippine nickel miners via the Nickel Industry Association argue that the global transition to clean energy, smart cities, and China’s infrastructure spending will raise nickel demand. They cite nickel’s use in EV batteries and stainless steel for construction and renewable technologies, but impacts are described as medium-to-long term.

title: Canadian North Resources Inc. Reports the Assay Results from the Spring Drilling Program: Significantly Expanding the Near-Surface Mineralized Zones of Nickel, Copper, Cobalt, Palladium and Platinum at the Ferguson Lake Project in Nunavut, Canada
summary: Canadian North Resources reported assays from 6,151 metres of spring drilling at its Ferguson Lake project, expanding near-surface zones with copper and nickel mineralization (plus cobalt and PGM). It is an exploration definition update with no stated production or supply disruption, so near-term price impact is likely limited.

title: Title V/Clean Air Act: Sierra Club Petition to Object to Berkley County, South Carolina, Aluminum Reduction Minor Permit Modification | Mitchell, Williams, Selig, Gates & Woodyard, P.L.L.C.
summary: Sierra Club and the Environmental Integrity Project filed a Clean Air Act Title V petition urging the EPA Administrator to object to revisions to Century Aluminum of South Carolina’s operating permit for its aluminum reduction facility. The petition targets the plant’s sulfur dioxide emissions-related permitting changes.

title: China Settles Congo Copper And Cobalt Mining Dispute For $2 Billion
summary: CMOC settled a $2 billion dispute with Congo’s Gecamines over royalties at the Tenke Fungurume mine, where copper exports were suspended for a year. The agreement (including settlement fees and arrears dividends) reduces disruption risk and supports near-term expectations for copper supply continuity, with limited spillover effects beyond copper.

title: Russian Aluminum Accounts For 80% Of LME Stockpiles
summary: Russian-origin aluminium rose to over 80% of LME warehouse inventories, renewing concerns it could weigh on overall aluminium prices as non-Russian supply is effectively constrained. However, the U.S. lifted most tariffs on Indian aluminium imports, adding support. Net near-term price pressure is mixed, leaving aluminium direction uncertain.

title: Imperial Drilling Intersects 115 Metres Grading 0.67% Copper and 0.85 g/t Gold at Mount Polley
summary: Imperial Metals reported drill results from Mount Polley showing an interval of 115 metres grading 0.67% copper, plus other wide copper-bearing intercepts. Management said results could expand the Springer zone, potentially support reserve conversion, and extend mine life, improving near-term supply expectations for copper.

title: Rio Tinto Expects Strong 2023 Iron-Ore Sales; Cuts Guidance for Alumina, Refined Copper -- Update
summary: Rio Tinto expects stronger iron-ore shipments but cut 2023 guidance for alumina to 7.4–7.7 million tons, citing plant stability and bauxite disruption from heavy rainfall, and reduced refined copper output to 160,000–190,000 tons due to a broader Kennecott smelter rebuild. The changes may weigh on copper and aluminium-linked markets.

title: Rio Tinto Expects Strong 2023 Iron-Ore Sales; Cuts Guidance for Alumina, Refined Copper -- Update
summary: Rio Tinto raised its iron-ore shipment outlook but cut production guidance for alumina and refined copper. Alumina guidance was lowered amid efforts to improve plant stability and disruption at Weipa due to heavy rainfall. Refined copper output guidance fell due to a wider rebuild of the Kennecott smelter in the U.S., raising costs.

title: Funds don't buy into Doctor Copper's green credentials : Andy Home - Today at 08:00 pm
summary: Reuters notes funds have largely avoided copper despite Citi’s view that it is a key ‘green energy transition’ trade. Near-term pricing is driven more by weak manufacturing—especially China—than supply-demand imbalance. Speculative positioning is close to flat and trading remains choppy, limiting immediate price direction for copper.

title: Rio Tinto Expects Strong 2023 Iron-Ore Sales; Cuts Guidance for Alumina, Refined Copper
summary: Rio Tinto said 2023 iron-ore shipments are expected in the upper half of its guidance, but it cut production estimates for other commodities, including alumina and refined copper. Reduced outlook for alumina and refined copper supply is likely to weigh on near-term expectations for copper and aluminium prices.

title: Rio Tinto Expects Strong 2023 Iron-Ore Sales; Cuts Guidance for Alumina, Refined Copper
summary: Rio Tinto said 2023 iron-ore shipments are expected to be in the upper half of guidance, but it reduced production estimates for other commodities, including alumina and refined copper. The guidance cuts imply weaker near-term supply expectations, weighing on refined copper and aluminium-related markets.

title: Copper Market Morning Comment (July 19)_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM’s morning note cites softer copper sentiment after the contract rollover: the price center of gravity shifted slightly downward, spot premiums keep falling, and high inventories limit holders’ confidence. Downstream replenishment improved marginally, but demand remains cautious due to high prices. Trading is thin as markets await the Fed rate decision, expecting volatile highs.

title: Commodities : Copper under demand pressure, weak dollar caps losses - Today at 09:59 pm
summary: Reuters reports copper prices dipped, pressured by weak Chinese demand and a widening spot discount alongside rising inventories, while China refined output is expected to rise as new projects come online. A weak dollar limited losses. Aluminium and nickel saw small gains in China trading, but copper remained under demand pressure.

title: Xanadu chases Mongolian copper-gold resource jump
summary: Xanadu Mines says infill drilling at its Mongolian Kharmagtai project has identified a new high-grade copper-gold core at the White Hill deposit, with several long intervals grading above 1% copper equivalent. Results also match or exceed 2021 resource-assay grades, supporting potential resource upgrades.

title: Antofagasta cuts full-year copper output forecast
summary: Chilean miner Antofagasta lowered its full-year copper output forecast to 640,000–670,000 tonnes from 670,000–710,000 tonnes. The revision was driven by persistent water shortages and lower ore grades, implying reduced copper supply. Such supply-negative guidance can pressure copper prices in the coming days.

title: Antofagasta cuts 2023 copper output forecast
summary: Antofagasta cut its 2023 copper output forecast to 640,000-670,000 tonnes from 670,000-710,000 because persistent water shortages in drought-hit Chile affect smelting and concentrator operations. The company produced 295,500 tonnes in H1. The downgrade signals weaker copper supply outlook.

title: Antofagasta Says H1 Copper Production Up 10%, But Cuts Annual Outlook
summary: Antofagasta said H1 copper output rose 10% to 295,500 tonnes on higher throughput at Los Pelambres, with Q2 up 2.5% q/q. Still, it cut full-year copper guidance because of delays in completing a desalination plant and concentrator expansion amid water scarcity in the first half.

title: Copper slips on lacklustre China demand outlook, rising inventory
summary: Reuters reports copper prices fell as China’s demand outlook looked lackluster and inventories increased. Weak spot buying and a slower growth expectation for the power sector weighed on sentiment, while expectations of rising Chinese refined supply added pressure, despite some support from a weaker US dollar.

title: Antofagasta increases copper output but lowers 2023 guidance
summary: Antofagasta said Q2 copper production rose 2.5% quarter-on-quarter, supported by improved throughput at the Los Pelambres desalination plant. However, construction delays and environmental factors are expected to impact full-year output, prompting reduced 2023 copper guidance to 640,000–670,000 tonnes from 670,000–710,000.

title: Low-Carbon Aluminum Market Size Expected to Reach USD
summary: The article forecasts growth for the low-carbon aluminum market, citing increased demand for lightweight materials in EVs and government incentives for decarbonization. It argues higher adoption and improved production processes boost scalability, supporting broader aluminum uptake across automotive, construction, and electrical uses. No specific near-term supply shock is mentioned.

title: Xanadu Mines Ltd.: New High-Grade Copper-Gold Zone Emerging at White Hill
summary: Xanadu Mines and Zijin report infill drilling at Mongolia’s Kharmagtai project, defining a new high-grade copper-gold core at White Hill, including intervals over 1% eCu. The company says results may improve PFS pit optimization and support a resource upgrade toward ore reserve timing in 2024.

title: Rio Tinto Sees Strong Iron-Ore Sales; Cuts Guidance for Alumina, Refined Copper -- Commodities Roundup
summary: Rio Tinto reported strong iron-ore sales but cut full-year guidance for alumina and refined copper. The article also cites falling base metal prices amid weak Chinese demand. Together, reduced guidance for refined copper and alumina can lower near-term expectations for copper and aluminium supply.

title: Rio Tinto Sees Strong Iron-Ore Sales; Cuts Guidance for Alumina, Refined Copper -- Commodities Roundup
summary: Rio Tinto reported strong iron-ore sales but cut guidance for alumina and refined copper. In the same commodities roundup, Antofagasta also reduced copper production guidance amid delays and water constraints. Market commentary highlights weak China-driven demand, contributing to lower copper and aluminium prices.

title: Copper Lake Identifies New Priority Targets and Provides
summary: Copper Lake Resources reports an exploration update at its Marshall Lake copper-zinc-silver VMS property, identifying new drill targets (MT conductor and build-up conductor) and citing encouraging drill intercepts with high copper grades. The company plans additional geophysics and deep drilling in 2023, but no production or supply changes are stated.

title: Visionary Metals Corp.: Visionary Metals Prepares Drill Program at King Solomon Nickel Project and Increases Land Package
summary: Visionary Metals plans a 4,500m drill program and increased claim control at its King Solomon nickel sulfide project in Wyoming, following a prior discovery with reported nickel grades and battery-grade sulfide. It also outlines additional nickel anomalies at Tin Cup, supporting incremental bullish sentiment for nickel exploration.

title: Chairman of Chinese aluminium giant Chalco resigns after two years
summary: Chalco said its chairman, Liu Jianping, resigned for a “work adjustment.” Reuters notes this comes days after Bloomberg reported a Chalco unit terminated some aluminium contracts during a government-led investigation into market deals. Chalco said the resignation is unrelated, but contract terminations may affect near-term aluminium market expectations.

title: Lundin Mining Corporation Closes the Acquisition of 51% of the Caserones Copper-Molybdenum Mine in Chile
summary: Lundin Mining closed its purchase of a 51% stake in Chile’s Caserones copper-molybdenum mine. The mine produced about 69,700 tonnes of copper in 1H23, with guidance of roughly 110,000–120,000 tonnes of copper for 2024–2025, and potential funding for an additional 19% stake. Ownership change only.

title: Tanzania to Pay $100 mln+ in compensations for expropriated Nickel Project
summary: ICSID ruled Tanzania must pay Indiana Resources over $100 million in damages plus compounded interest and legal costs for the unlawful expropriation of the Ntaka Hill nickel project. The company said it is moving to enforcement as payment continues to rise until Tanzania pays, but no production timeline is given.

title: Copper drifts lower on lack of China stimulus, rising output
summary: Copper prices fell as investors worried China’s stimulus may disappoint and demand remains weak, while strong domestic Chinese refined output hit record levels. The Yangshan import premium eased, signaling lower import appetite. In the same session, aluminium and nickel also declined amid softer overall metal sentiment.

title: Shape Corp. Pioneers Advanced High Strength, Complex Roll Formed Aluminum Applications for the Automotive Industry
summary: Shape Corp. and Novelis announced a roll-formed aluminum line for automotive structural components using high-strength 6xxx and 7xxx sheet alloys. The collaboration aims to accelerate development and market introduction of lighter, low-carbon parts with higher recycled content. This suggests incremental demand for aluminum sheet products.

title: Copper miners squeezed by lower prices, higher labor costs
summary: Reuters reports major North American copper miners face lower Q2 profits due to reduced realized copper prices, falling about 11% to $3.85/lb, amid fears of slowing global growth and weaker Chinese demand. Labor costs remain high, squeezing margins, and the earnings outlook is pressured by these factors.

title: Antofagasta slashes copper production targets
summary: Antofagasta reduced its full-year copper production guidance to 640,000–670,000 tons from up to 710,000 tons, citing drought-driven water shortages that disrupt smelting and processing and delays at the Los Pelambres mine from sea swells. Costs rose, and the guidance cut signals tighter copper supply ahead.

title: BHP Increases Annual Copper, Iron-Ore Output
summary: BHP said it raised copper output by 9% to 1.72 million tons in fiscal 2023, driven by higher grades at Escondida and a production record at Olympic Dam, and expects 1.72–1.91 million tons in fiscal 2024. This suggests greater supply, but likely limited immediate price impact.

title: Analysis: MIND ID to gain majority stake at Vale to drive Nickel downstreaming
summary: Indonesia’s mining holding company MIND ID plans to raise its stake in PT Vale Indonesia to gain majority control and speed nickel downstreaming. title: Zijin Mining : Kamoa-Kakula Achieves Record Quarterly Copper Production of Nearly 104,000 Tonnes in Q2 2023
summary: Zijin Mining’s Kamoa-Kakula copper complex in the DRC produced a record 103,786 tonnes of copper in concentrate in Q2 2023, up 11% quarter-on-quarter, aided by completed debottlenecking and higher throughput. The Phase 3 expansion is on track and includes additional power for processing and smelting.

title: Copper Inventory across China Major Markets Accumulated  _SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show China’s mainstream copper stocks rose 8,400 mt to 125,400 mt as inventories increased in Guangdong, Jiangsu and Tianjin. Stabilized prices and SHFE July contract deliveries reduced spot consumption, with low warehouse shipments and more delivered arrivals driving the build. Spot traders lack confidence amid tight but uncertain supply.

title: [SMM Copper Morning Analysis] Copper Prices Still Range-Bound; UK CPI Data Below Market Expectations _SMM
summary: LME and SHFE copper ended higher but effectively range-bound, with subdued volumes. UK CPI missed expectations, weakening the pound and boosting the US dollar index, while East/South China spot premiums fell. Traders note off-season demand softness and inventory accumulation, and consumption remains weak ahead of the Fed meeting.

title: Nickel Morning Meeting Minutes July 20_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Nickel prices fell sharply in the morning, with the report expecting further downside in the near term. Weak downstream buying—given high shock prices—reduces demand. title: World first hydrogen pilot for low carbon alumina
summary: ARENA announced $32.1m for Rio Tinto and Sumitomo to trial hydrogen calcination at the Yarwun alumina refinery in Queensland. title: Global miner Anglo American's first-half copper production surges 42%
summary: Anglo American said first-half copper production rose 42% to 387,200 tonnes, driven by ramp-up of the Quellaveco mine in Peru. While the firm kept its full-year copper volume outlook unchanged, it increased unit costs for copper and nickel. The output strength may lift supply expectations near term.

title: Anglo American 2Q Copper Production Rose; Backs Full-Year View
summary: Anglo American said second-quarter copper production rose to 209,000 tonnes, up 56% year-on-year, driven by Quellaveco’s ramp-up to commercial levels in Peru. The company trimmed copper unit cost guidance but left full-year production guidance unchanged, suggesting improving supply visibility without a major forecast shift.

title: Australian Dollar Rebounds Notably on Employment Data, Resurgence in Copper and Yuan
summary: Australia’s dollar rebounds on strong employment data, a resurgence in Chinese yuan, and an accompanying rebound in copper prices. People’s Bank of China increased a parameter for cross-border corporate financing, aimed at supporting RMB stability. Commentary also notes that weaker CNH would pressure AUD, but copper is cited as rising.

title: Emirates Global Aluminium, Itochu sign deal to boost aluminium production
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) and Itochu signed an MoU to cooperate on growing aluminium production, decarbonisation and support for UAE industries in EGA’s supply chain. The deal builds on a prior agreement and aims to help meet rising aluminium demand, potentially improving supply outlook for the metal.

title: UAE Business: EGA, Itochu sign MoU to boost aluminium production
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) and Itochu signed an MoU to cooperate on aluminium production growth, decarbonisation, and expanding UAE supply-chain industries. title: Hedonova Achieves Remarkable Profit, Yet Exits Indonesian Nickel Investment Due to ESG Concerns
summary: Hedonova reports a profitable 11.21% nickel co-investment in Indonesia but exits the position due to ESG concerns about mining practices, including acid-leaching waste contamination and harm to local communities. title: Noronex inks drill contract for Namibian copper project
summary: Noronex has signed a drill contract to begin a 4,000m RC program at its Humpback copper project in Namibia’s Kalahari Copper Belt, targeting copper-silver prospects Fiesta and Blowhole. The plan follows historical high-grade intersections and aims to test mineral continuity and expand drilling coverage.

summary: Green River Gold reports assay/XRF results from its Quesnel Nickel Project, stating multiple drill holes continue intersecting nickel-bearing serpentinized peridotite from bedrock surface across the Deep Purple anomaly. title: Commodities : Hopes of additional China economic support lift copper prices - Today at 06:17 am
summary: Copper prices rose in London, reversing a four-day decline, driven by hopes China will introduce further stimulus for its troubled real estate sector, potentially via mortgage easing. The yuan’s strengthening improved purchasing power. LME also showed broad gains, with aluminium and nickel higher alongside copper.

title: Green River Gold Reports Assay Results and Again Intersects Nickel, Magnesium, Cobalt, and Chromium Beginning at the Bedrock Surface for the 45th Consecutive Hole
summary: Green River Gold reported assay results from the first 2023 drill hole and continued XRF/assay consistency across multiple holes at its Quesnel Nickel Project, with nickel, magnesium, cobalt, and chromium intersected from bedrock surface. title: Business News | Hedonova Achieves Remarkable Profit, Yet Exits Indonesian Nickel Investment Due to ESG Concerns
summary: Hedonova announced it closed a nickel co-investment in Indonesia with an 11.21% profit, citing utilization of a high-grade nickel asset for electric-vehicle supply. title: Copper miner Freeport-McMoRan profit slides 60% in second quarter
summary: Freeport’s export permit expired June 10 as Indonesia started a raw mineral export ban, and the company has not shipped copper since. title: Copper miner Freeport's profit slides 60% on lower output, Indonesia woes
summary: Freeport’s copper profit fell 60% as lower output and Indonesia’s raw export ban halted shipments after June 10. A 75-day maintenance shutdown at PT Smelting added pressure. title: New EV Innovations Put A Dent In Copper Demand
summary: Goldman Sachs and CRU Group cut forecasts for copper used per EV, citing efficiency efforts such as compact batteries, thinner copper foil, and higher-voltage designs that reduce wiring. title: Peru's Quellaveco copper mine produces 137,800t in H1
summary: Peru’s Quellaveco mine produced 137,800 tonnes of copper in the first half of 2023. Production figures can influence near-term copper supply expectations and price sentiment, but the excerpt does not state whether output beat or missed market forecasts.

summary: Copper Fox Metals’ fact sheet outlines its copper-focused assets (Schaft Creek JV and Van Dyke ISCR) and provides PEA economics with explicit copper price sensitivity (e.g., $0.25/lb copper changes EBITDA and NPV).
