summary: Zambia’s copper production is seen falling to a 14-year low, highlighting a sharp decline in output from a key supplier. With lower near-term supply expectations, the market may tighten and support copper prices in the coming days and weeks, assuming the production shortfall is sustained.

title: SHFE Aluminum Went Down Overnight, China Voices Support For Economy  _SMM
summary: SHFE aluminum (2308) fell slightly overnight to close near 18,225 yuan/mt, and LME aluminum closed around $2,193/mt. summary: Jamaica’s government will grant Windalco two years of relief from the bauxite production levy, foregoing about US$10 million in payments. summary: Itochu announced an MOU with Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) to support aluminium production growth and sustainable, lower-carbon aluminium supply for global customers. summary: Norsk Hydro says Russian aluminium is rapidly increasing in LME-registered inventories, reaching 80% of available stocks in June, and threatens the benchmark contract’s integrity. title: Norsk Hydro: Well positioned in declining markets,  low-carbon aluminium gaining ground
summary: Hydro reports lower Q2 2023 EBITDA due to lower aluminium and alumina sales prices and weaker volumes. summary: Hydro reported Q2 earnings roughly in line with forecasts and raised 2023 capex guidance to 20.5 billion crowns from 16.5 billion, citing inflation/currency effects and additional funding for its planned Alumetal acquisition. summary: Norwegian aluminium producer Hydro raised its 2023 capital expenditure guidance and reported Q2 core earnings in line with analyst forecasts. title: Glencore Backs Full-Year View After 1st Half Copper Production Slipped but Met Expectations
summary: Glencore backed its full-year guidance after first-half copper production slipped 4.4% to 488,000 mt, but remained in line with its expectations for mine sequences at Collahuasi and Antamina. title: Copper Inventories in China Bonded Zone Jumped This Week_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show China’s bonded copper inventories rose 1,600 mt to 60,900 mt by July 21, with Shanghai and Guangdong both adding stocks. summary: Copper and most industrial metals eased after investors were disappointed by China’s modest stimulus aimed at boosting consumption. title: Copper, aluminium ease on disappointment on Chinese stimulus
summary: Copper and most industrial metal prices edged lower as investors were disappointed by modest Chinese stimulus aimed at consumption. summary: BNN Bloomberg’s piece, titled “Nickel’s at a Crossroads as Supply Boom Hits LME, Macquarie Says,” points to expectations that additional nickel supply is pressuring LME balances. That backdrop implies weaker pricing near term as market participants anticipate more supply than demand.

summary: Adani’s Kutch Copper plans to start operations at its Mundra greenfield copper refinery from March, initially targeting 0.5 Mtpa refined copper, with eventual capacity up to 1 Mtpa. summary: Delhi Police Crime Branch arrested two men for stealing copper wires from NDPL transformers across Outer North and North districts. The probe reportedly cracked 55 theft cases. summary: Copper, aluminium and nickel prices in London fell as China’s stimulus promise lacked specific measures, dimming hopes for demand growth. Traders also turned cautious ahead of the widely expected U.S. Federal Reserve rate decision. Three-month copper dropped ~1% and nickel fell ~2.5%.

title: 'Copper's unique characteristics could see it make oil's 2008 bull run look like child's play': Citi analyst
summary: Citi’s Ephrem Ravi reiterates a highly bullish copper thesis, arguing decarbonisation-driven demand and climate-mitigation needs should lift prices substantially by 2025, with a bullish skew even if near-term trading is within a broad $7,500–$8,500/t range. The note also highlights potential investment inflows overwhelming the physical market.

title: Pact signed for offtake of output from Oman copper-gold project
summary: Al Hadeetha Resources signed an exclusive eight-year offtake with Trafigura for full output of copper concentrate from Oman’s Wash-hi Majaza Copper-Gold project. Pricing is linked to the LME Grade A copper cash settlement. The deal supports financing for construction, implying supportive sentiment for copper demand/supply expectations.

title: First Quantum Starts Output at Africa's Biggest Nickel Mine
summary: First Quantum is reported to have started output at Africa’s biggest nickel mine. The restart/production ramp is expected to improve near-term supply availability, which can weigh on nickel prices as buyers adjust to potentially higher output expectations over the coming days and weeks.

title: Chile's Cochilco Sees Avg Copper Prices At $3.85/pound In 2023 V…
summary: Chile’s Cochilco reduced its forecast for average 2023 copper prices to $3.85 per pound, down from a prior estimate of $3.90, according to a Reuters statement. The revision signals slightly weaker expected copper pricing, which can negatively affect copper market sentiment in the near term.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel Announces Completion of NI 43-101 Technical Report for Previously Announced Updated Resource Estimate on the High-Grade W4 Deposit
summary: EV Nickel announced completion of an NI 43-101 technical report for its High-Grade W4 nickel deposit, reporting a resource expansion to 31.3M lbs measured+indicated at 0.98% Ni and 12.1M lbs inferred. The release notes NiEq modeling includes copper, but no near-term mining or sales changes are stated.

title: China's Aluminum Imports Skyrocket Amid Domestic Supply Shortages
summary: China’s aluminum imports jumped in 2023 H1 as domestic supply fell below demand. Customs data show a 10.7% year-on-year increase to 1.2 million tons, including higher June volumes. Output constraints in power-cut regions and rising bauxite and Russian aluminum imports point to tighter near-term availability.

title: TELF AG Explores the Copper Market Surplus and its Impact on Base Metals and Battery Materials - July 26, 2023
summary: TELF AG, citing the ICSG, highlights a 384,000-tonne refined copper surplus in the first four months of 2023 despite a decline in LME warehouse stocks. It links this surplus to weaker physical demand and investor confidence, noting copper’s 2.1% three-month decline and potential knock-on effects for battery-related costs.

title: Commodities : Copper rises on easing dollar as Fed's rate-hike cycle seen ending - Today at 11:48 pm
summary: Copper prices rose Thursday as a weaker U.S. dollar made dollar-priced metals cheaper, alongside expectations the Fed’s rate-hike cycle is near its end. Markets also looked for Chinese property-sector stimulus, though China’s weak data tempered gains. Aluminium and nickel prices increased as part of the broader metals uptick.

title: SMM Exclusive: China Copper Scrap Market Research_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM discusses China’s copper scrap market, emphasizing that recycling supports copper supply amid limited ore resources. It estimates 2022 scrap supply (2.27 million mt) vs demand (3.98 million mt) and expects imported scrap to fall under tighter policies while domestic PCR growth rises, easing supply tightness.

title: UNSW partnership to advance aluminium manufacturing
summary: Jamestrong and UNSW’s SMaRT Centre will commercialise a MICROfactorie recycling technology to recover aluminium from mixed, previously non-recyclable waste and use it in aerosol can production. The project includes an $8 million aluminium casting line in Taree, expected to complete by mid-2024, expanding capacity and reshoring slug supply.

title: Rio Tinto's $1.7billion write-off of aluminium refineries due to the costs of Australia's carbon emissions reduction scheme
summary: Rio Tinto warned Australia’s carbon emissions scheme and insufficient renewable power make aluminium refining uneconomic, citing a $1.7bn write-off and $1.2bn loss linked to abatement costs. The tightening decarbonisation requirements and costly clean-tech investment threaten future capacity, creating bearish sentiment for aluminium supply and pricing.

title: Noronex to extend footprint over Kalahari Copper Belt
summary: Noronex filed two new full permit applications over prospective ground on Namibia’s Kalahari Copper Belt, adjacent to the Botswana border, targeting the copper-bearing NPF–D’Kar contact. The company plans additional RC drilling at nearby Blowhole and Fiesta prospects. Prior drilling reported encouraging copper intercepts, but no near-term output changes.

title: Antilles confirms gold upside at El Pilar copper deposit
summary: Antilles Gold confirmed additional assay results at the El Pilar copper deposit in Cuba, including long intercepts with notable copper grades and shallow gold mineralisation. The company is progressing mine planning and prefeasibility for a joint venture open-pit “Nueva Sabana” operation, with ongoing metallurgy and negotiations for concentrate sales.

title: Kodiak Copper Corp.: Kodiak's West Zone Drilling Intersects 0.51% CuEq over 158 m, Within 0.34% CuEq over 533 m from Surface, and Discovers New High-Grade Copper-Gold-Silver and Mineralized Breccia Zones
summary: Kodiak Copper reported early 2023 drilling results from its MPD copper-gold porphyry project in British Columbia, including copper grades and copper-equivalent intervals over substantial depths, plus discovery of a new high-grade structurally hosted zone and mineralized hydrothermal breccia. The news is exploration-focused with no immediate supply impact.

title: Teck Resources misses quarterly profit estimates, lowers annual copper output target
summary: Teck cut its 2024 copper output target by about 15% to 330,000–375,000 tonnes, citing delays in commissioning of its QB2 Chile copper mine. While management expressed confidence production will reach full potential by year-end, the forecast reduction implies weaker near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Ltd.: Ivanhoe Mines Announces Highly Promising Preliminary Testwork for Improving Copper Recoveries at Kamoa-Kakula
summary: Ivanhoe Mines reported preliminary metallurgical testwork at Kamoa-Kakula indicating that copper recoveries from tailings could be increased by liberating copper from the tailings stream, producing ~40% Cu concentrate and potentially higher recoveries. If developed, this could raise production post-Phase 3 and improve revenues and cash flow.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Announces Highly Promising Preliminary Testwork for Improving Copper Recoveries at Kamoa-Kakula
summary: Ivanhoe Mines said preliminary metallurgical testwork at its Kamoa-Kakula copper complex could materially improve copper recovery from Phase 1 and 2 tailings. Results suggest about 65% of contained tailings copper recoverable, yielding ~40% copper concentrate processed on-site, with potential higher output and improved economics post-expansion.

title: Analysts mark down copper forecasts as output ramps up
summary: Analysts cut copper, aluminium, and nickel forecasts as supply ramps up. Copper faces a soft patch with mine output rising and a stated surplus widening. Aluminium prices likely face pressure as Yunnan smelters restart after hydropower-related curbs ease. Nickel drops amid stronger Indonesian production and higher-grade conversion.

title: Reliance Steel & Aluminum Co. Reports Second Quarter 2023 Financial Results
summary: Reliance Steel & Aluminum reported Q2 2023 results and expects Q3 tons down due to seasonal factors and one less shipping day. It also forecasts pricing decline and “temporary downward pressure” on gross margins, driven by declining prices for flat-rolled products including common alloy aluminum.

title: Teck Resources misses profit estimates, lowers annual copper output target
summary: Teck Resources reported profits below estimates and reduced its annual copper production target. The downgrade signals weaker copper supply expectations, which can tighten the near-term market balance in the eyes of investors. This tends to pressure copper prices lower in the following days and weeks as guidance is digested.

title: Teck announces employee death, lowers production guidance at copper mine project
summary: Teck announced an employee death and lowered production guidance at its copper mine project. The reduction in expected output raises concerns about near-term supply availability and operational disruption, which can influence copper price expectations over the coming days as markets reassess throughput and timing.

title: Copper creeps higher on hopes US rate hikes are over
summary: Copper edged higher on hopes that U.S. rate hikes have peaked, helped by dollar weakness. However, gains were capped by weak China data and continued concerns about lacklustre demand, with lower Chinese industrial profits and softer import premiums. Aluminium and nickel also rose modestly despite demand worries.

title: Teck announces employee death, lowers production guidance at copper mine project | iNFOnews
summary: Teck said it is progressing talks to sell its steelmaking coal business, while also reporting a fatality at its QB2 copper mine. Crucially, it lowered annual copper production guidance for QB2 in Chile to 330,000–375,000 tonnes from 390,000–445,000 tonnes due to construction and commissioning issues.

title: BHP president Geraldine Slattery warns 'same job, same pay' labour hire laws could have $2bn hit on copper growth plans
summary: BHP’s president Geraldine Slattery said Australia’s proposed “same job, same pay” labour hire rules could worsen labour cost and productivity problems, potentially delivering a $2bn hit to BHP’s copper growth plans. The expected impact is reduced copper supply momentum due to higher operating costs.

title: Teck cuts copper guidance on lower output at QB2 - The Northern Miner
summary: Teck Resources cut its copper production targets for the year after its Quebrada Blanca 2 open-pit mine in northern Chile delivered lower-than-expected output. The guidance reduction signals reduced copper supply expectations, which can weigh on nearby copper price sentiment as markets adjust to tighter supply outlooks.

title: Alaska asks US Supreme Court to strike down the rejection of a proposed copper, gold mine
summary: Alaska is asking the U.S. Supreme Court to overturn the EPA’s rejection of the proposed Pebble copper-and-gold mine in Bristol Bay. The EPA cited risks to aquatic ecosystems supporting salmon fisheries and would bar related discharges. The outcome could influence near-term copper supply expectations, though price impact is unclear.

title: Teck lowers copper outlook as profit falls | Regina Leader Post
summary: Teck lowered annual copper production guidance after delays at its flagship Quebrada Blanca 2 project in Chile. QB2 output is expected at 80,000–100,000 tonnes versus prior 150,000–180,000, trimming total copper guidance. The company cited weaker commodity prices and lower volumes amid inflationary costs.

title: Teck lowers outlook at biggest copper project as it eyes shift away from coal
summary: Teck lowered annual production guidance for its Quebrada Blanca 2 copper project in Chile after delays in construction and commissioning. QB2 copper output guidance falls to about 80,000–100,000 tonnes from 150,000–180,000 tonnes, and total copper guidance is reduced. The company cited lower commodity prices and higher costs.

title: Alaska asks Supreme Court to strike down rejection of a proposed copper, gold mine
summary: Alaska asked the U.S. Supreme Court to overturn the EPA’s January decision blocking the proposed Pebble copper-and-gold mine in southwest Alaska. The EPA cited Clean Water Act concerns about impacts on Bristol Bay salmon habitat, which would restrict construction and future similar proposals.

title: Peru's Southern Copper starts legal action to evict illegal miners
summary: Southern Copper said it has started legal action to evict illegal miners occupying part of its Los Chancas copper project in Peru’s Apurimac region. The company is seeking to restore development progress and confiscate illegally extracted minerals, aiming to support planned long-run copper production.

title: TELF AG Unveils Article in Base Metals and Battery Materials Report on Nickel
summary: TELF AG says nickel has fallen sharply (about 2.7% over three months) and attributes the drop to weak Chinese demand. Despite China’s announced incentives to accelerate EV/NEV adoption, TELF AG reports the expected pickup in nickel demand has not materialized, raising concerns for base metals.

title: LME's Russian aluminium dilemma set to become more acute: Andy Home
summary: Reuters reports pressure on the LME to reconsider accepting Russian aluminium in its warehouse system. Russian aluminium dominates warranted stock, while China’s Russian-brand imports are rising but recent data suggest a fading appetite and possible surplus as drought eases and production rebounds. Weaker demand and loose LME spreads imply bearish near-term pricing.

title: Peru's Southern Copper starts legal action to evict illegal miners | WKZO | Everything Kalamazoo
summary: Southern Copper said it has started legal action to evict illegal miners occupying Peru’s Los Chancas project, which has been delaying development. The company also seeks to confiscate illegally extracted minerals. Southern Copper aims to expand copper output, with Los Chancas targeting production of about 130,000 tons/year.

title: China's first aluminum-based lightweight platform launched by Chery--China Economic Net
summary: Chery launched China’s first aluminium-based lightweight S5E pure electric platform, emphasizing new aluminium alloy body materials, extrusion molding, and die-casting processes. The redesign is expected to improve safety, reduce manufacturing energy and emissions, and increase material utilization—implying incremental aluminium demand associated with new EV production.

title: Nigeria seeks to restart production at $2.5bln aluminium smelter
summary: Nigeria’s vice president says the government is re-engaging with RUSAL and other partners to restart operations at the idle ALSCON aluminium smelter. ALSCON has 193,000 tonnes annual capacity and is majority owned by RUSAL. A restart would add aluminium supply expectations, influencing nearby market sentiment.

title: Saudi Arabia Ventures Into Copper And Nickel Mining
summary: Saudi Arabia’s Ma’aden and the Saudi Public Investment Fund plan a $3.4 billion deal to buy a 13% stake in Vale’s base metals business through the Manara Minerals joint venture. The stake covers copper and nickel operations, signaling mining ambitions tied to the energy transition, but no immediate output shift is specified.

title: Saudi Arabia Ventures Into Copper And Nickel Mining
summary: Saudi Arabia’s Ma’aden and the Saudi Public Investment Fund will buy a 13% stake in Vale’s base metals business in a $3.4bn deal, creating the Manara Minerals joint venture. The acquired assets include copper and nickel operations, aligning with the energy-transition demand narrative.

title: Industry groups urge LME to resist calls to ban Russian aluminium
summary: Five European industry groups urged the LME to resist calls to ban Russian aluminium from its system. They argue restrictions would harm Europe’s aluminium value chain. The LME said it will follow government sanctions and monitor market orderliness; Russian aluminium share in LME inventories has risen sharply.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk : United Tractors Recorded a Net Income of Rp11.2 Trillion in the First Half of 2023
summary: PT United Tractors reported H1 2023 earnings and segment performance, including coal and construction machinery results. The key market-related item is its subsidiary’s June 2023 subscription agreement to buy a 19.99% stake in Nickel Industries Limited for A$943 million, subject to shareholder and exchange approvals.

title: Reliance Steel & Aluminum Co. (NYSE:RS) Q2 2023 Earnings Call Transcript
summary: Reliance’s Q2 2023 call reports sequential weakness from falling stainless and common alloy aluminum prices, noting these products see downward pricing pressure that “follows the LME.” Management says aluminum commodity price declines pressured margins and expects average selling prices to decline further in Q3 due to declining flat-rolled commodity prices.

title: Southern Copper takes legal action against "illegal miners" at Los Chancas
summary: Southern Copper has filed legal complaints and sought court remedies to evict more than 75 illegal miners occupying its Los Chancas copper project in Peru. The company alleges improper registration in formalisation records and says artisanal activity and weak oversight have jeopardised its long-term targets.

title: Blackwolf Copper and Gold Ltd. Commences Drilling at the Cantoo Project in Alaska's Golden Triangle
summary: Blackwolf Copper and Gold began a maiden drill program at the Cantoo Mountain Project in Alaska. The company cites a surface outcrop of a 30m vein with reported copper grade (5.8% Cu) alongside gold and silver. Results are expected early September, but the update is largely company-specific.

title: Ivanhoe eyes higher copper output from tailings reprocessing
summary: Ivanhoe Mines said reprocessing tailings at its Kamoa-Kakula copper complex in the Democratic Republic of Congo could increase copper output. The update highlights operational expansion at the producer, which can shift short-term expectations for copper supply and production volumes.

title: Rusal considers restart of aluminium smelter in Nigeria
summary: Rusal is in discussions with Nigeria about restarting the Alscon aluminium smelter in Nigeria. Alscon previously produced 22,000 tonnes before Rusal suspended operations in 2013 due to unreliable gas supply and low aluminium prices. Rusal confirmed talks but gave no details; it owns 85% of Alscon.

title: Surge Copper : Files NI 43-101 Technical Report for the Berg PEA
summary: Surge Copper filed an NI 43-101 technical report for its Berg Project PEA. The report supports planned development economics based on long-term commodity assumptions, including US$4.00/lb copper, but it does not announce any immediate production, supply disruption, or policy change. Copper market impact is likely minimal.

title: Chile's Codelco sees lower copper output, more stoppages in 2023
summary: Codelco lowered its 2023 copper output forecast to 1.31–1.35 million tonnes from 1.35–1.45 million, citing more production halts in the second half. Output slipped 14% year-on-year, with El Teniente disruption after a rock explosion and higher costs reducing margins.

title: Codelco Lowers Copper Output Guidance as Chile Mining Woes Worsen
summary: Codelco lowered its copper output guidance as Chile’s mining conditions deteriorate. The cut in expected production points to weaker near-term copper supply from the world’s key producing region, which can increase market tightness only later but generally weighs on spot and short-term copper price expectations immediately.

title: Codelco Lowers Copper Output Guidance as Chile Mining Woes Worsen
summary: Codelco has reportedly lowered its copper output guidance as Chilean mining conditions deteriorate. Weaker production expectations increase concerns about near-term copper supply, which can tighten market balance over the coming days to weeks and support upward price pressure in copper.

title: Glencore in advanced talks for Argentina copper stake
summary: Glencore is reportedly in advanced talks to acquire Pan American Silver’s 56% stake in Argentina’s Mara copper project, potentially announced soon. The move would increase Glencore’s exposure to copper. The development is positive for copper sentiment, though it is a company-specific M&A headline rather than a supply shock.

title: Southern Copper Is Getting More Optimistic on Stalled Peru Mine
summary: The piece (per its title) says Southern Copper has grown more optimistic about resolving a stalled mine in Peru. That would improve expectations for copper supply returning sooner or staying less disrupted, typically weighing on prices in the coming days as markets adjust for higher expected availability.

title: Saudi Arabia nickel deal to test Canada's new foreign investor rules
summary: Canada’s new foreign-investor rules will be tested by Saudi Arabia’s planned 10% stake purchase in a Brazilian base-metals unit linked to Vale, which runs major Canadian nickel assets. The government will apply enhanced national-security scrutiny and require approvals that could take up to 200+ days, though Vale expects no hurdles.

title: Chile's Codelco sees lower copper output, more stoppages in 2023 | WSAU News/Talk 550 AM · 99.9 FM
summary: Chile’s Codelco cut its 2023 copper output forecast to 1.31-1.35 million tons from 1.35-1.45 million, citing additional production stoppages in the second half. A rock explosion at El Teniente disrupted work and affected output. Profit fell sharply and costs rose, reinforcing supply pressure.

title: Chile's Codelco sees lower copper output, more stoppages in 2023 | WKZO | Everything Kalamazoo
summary: Codelco lowered its 2023 copper output guidance to 1.31–1.35 million tonnes from 1.35–1.45 million, citing more expected production halts in the second half after problems at El Teniente. First-half copper output fell 14% and costs rose sharply, reinforcing bearish near-term supply expectations for copper.

title: Ellis Martin Report: Kodiak Copper Corp. Discovers New High-Grade Copper-Gold-Silver and Mineralized Breccia Zones
summary: Kodiak Copper announced drill intersections at its MPD copper-gold porphyry project in British Columbia, including intervals grading 0.51% CuEq over 158 m and broader copper mineralization to 539 m. The release also highlights new high-grade copper-gold-silver zones and breccia, suggesting potential for further copper resources.

title: SKC, Toyota Tsusho join hands for copper foil venture in N. America
summary: SKC and Toyota Tsusho will co-invest in a North America joint venture to manufacture and supply battery-grade copper foil for EV lithium-ion batteries. The partnership targets long-term supply deals with potential customers and expands SK Nexilis capacity, likely lifting expectations for copper demand tied to battery materials.

title: Commodities : London copper prices set for best monthly gain since January - Yesterday at 11:48 pm
summary: Reuters reports London copper is set for its strongest monthly gain since January, rising on hopes for further Chinese stimulus and expectations that the Fed will pause rate hikes. Softer inflation supports a weaker dollar. LME aluminium also rose, while nickel edged lower, reflecting overall bullish sentiment.

title: Copper Set for Monthly Gain as Optimism Returns on China Demand
summary: The piece’s headline says copper is set for a monthly gain as optimism returns on China demand. While the excerpt provides limited additional detail, the core message is improved near-term demand expectations from China, which would generally support copper prices in the short term.

title: Avebury Nickel Mine still running after shareholders dump deal | The Advocate
summary: Avebury Nickel Mine remains running after shareholders rejected a deal that would have given lender offtake partner Hartree control beyond 50%. Mallee says discussions with Hartree and other shareholders are ongoing and the mine is operating well, while the government offers payroll tax relief to sustain jobs and production.

title: Commodities : London copper set for best month since January - Today at 03:35 am
summary: London three-month copper was up on prospects of further China stimulus and expectations that the Fed may pause rate hikes after cooling U.S. inflation. The dollar outlook turned less supportive. Chinese property support prospects were cited as improving demand expectations. LME aluminium rose, while nickel eased.

title: Indonesia allows Freeport, AMNT to export copper concentrate until 2024_SMM
summary: Indonesia will allow Freeport Indonesia and AMNT to keep exporting copper concentrate through an export license despite a ban that started in June. AMNT received a license for 900,000 wmt valid July 24, 2023 to May 31, 2024, supported by approvals involving the ESDM.

title: Indonesian copper concentrate export license resumed, no casualties in El Teniente accident_SMM
summary: Indonesia’s copper concentrate export license was resumed, allowing 900,000 mt to ship from late July, affecting concentrate supply and smelter feed expectations. SMM notes spot concentrate is oversupplied and port inventories in China rose, but buyers expect TCs to improve on Peru emergency extension, China smelting delays, and Quebrada Blanca Phase 2 shipments.

title: Power Nickel Inc.: Power Nickel Exercises Option & Adds to Management Team as It Expands Its Focus on Nisk
summary: Power Nickel exercised options to acquire 50% and expand to 80% ownership of the Nisk nickel-PGM project in Quebec, including completion of prior payments and work expenditures. The company also hired management for continued exploration and a feasibility study. No new production or supply disruption is announced.

title: First Quantum: Total copper production in the second quarter increased by 35% from the previous quarter_SMM
summary: First Quantum Minerals said its total copper production rose 35% quarter-on-quarter to 187,175 mt in Q2. The increase was driven by improved ore grades at Cobre Panamá (Panama) and Kansanshi and Sentinel (Zambia), alongside higher production at Cobre Panamá and Sentinel. This suggests stronger near-term copper supply.

title: Copper climbs to one-month high on hopes for China stimulus
summary: Copper prices climbed to a one-month high as traders priced in hopes for further China stimulus to support post-COVID demand. Weak Chinese manufacturing data and a higher U.S. dollar limited gains, while rising LME stocks and fewer cancelled warrants eased availability worries. Aluminium rose; nickel fell on the day’s broader sentiment.

title: Glencore Buys Remaining Stake in Mara Copper Project for $475 Million
summary: Glencore will buy Pan American Silver’s remaining 56.25% stake in the Argentine copper project Mara for $475 million, taking full ownership and operation. Mara is projected to produce about 200,000 tons of copper per year once operational, with royalties to Pan American Silver. Completion is expected in Q3.

title: Glencore to buy Pan American's stake in Argentina copper project for $475 million
summary: Pan American Silver said it will sell a 56% stake in Argentina’s MARA copper project to Glencore for $475 million, giving Glencore full ownership. The deal is expected to close in Q3 2023 and is part of Pan American’s asset optimization, with proceeds repaying debt.

title: Kintavar Files NI 43-101 Report for Maiden Copper and Silver Mineral Resource Estimate at Sherlock Zone, Mitchi Project; Starts PEA Work
summary: Kintavar Exploration filed its NI 43-101 technical report for the Mitchi project’s Sherlock Zone, presenting a maiden copper-and-silver mineral resource estimate, and has engaged Sedgman Novopro to complete a PEA starting August. title: Kintavar Files NI 43-101 Report for Maiden Copper and
summary: Kintavar Exploration filed an NI 43-101 technical report for its Mitchi copper-silver project, detailing a mineral resource estimate using a copper cut-off grade and copper-price-based economic assumptions. title: Pan American to sell stake in Argentine copper project to Glencore for $475 million
summary: Pan American Silver will sell a 56% stake in Argentina’s Minera Agua Rica Alumbrera (MARA) copper project to Glencore for $475 million. The deal gives Glencore full ownership and expands its copper portfolio. Completion is expected in Q3 2023 as Pan American divests non-core assets.

title: Pan American to sell stake in Argentine copper project to Glencore for US$475-million
summary: Pan American will sell a 56.2% stake in Argentina’s MARA copper project to Glencore for $475m, lifting Glencore’s ownership to 100% and granting Pan American a royalty on future copper production. title: Glencore Buys Argentina Copper Stake in $475 Million Deal
summary: Glencore is reported to be buying a copper stake in Argentina in a $475 million deal. title: Global Electrodeposited Copper Foils Market Projected to Grow at 9.2% CAGR Through 2033, Driven by 5G and IoT Technologies | Persistence Market Research
summary: Persistence Market Research forecasts growth for the electrodeposited copper foils market, driven by 5G/IoT, consumer electronics PCBs, EV and renewable-energy battery demand, and flexible electronics. title: Glencore buys Argentina copper stake in US$475M deal
summary: Glencore plans to buy a copper stake in Argentina in a deal worth US$475 million. No immediate production disruption is stated.

title: Codelco copper output falls amid operational delays
summary: Codelco lowered its annual copper production forecast to 1.31–1.35 million tonnes from 1.35–1.45 million after operational delays and mining accidents, including a rock explosion at El Teniente affecting the Andes Norte Project. Output fell to a quarter-century low, tightening near-term supply expectations and supporting copper prices.

title: Copper Takes Aussie Higher ahead of RBA
summary: Commodity currencies are firmer ahead of Australia’s RBA decision, with the Aussie rebound attributed primarily to copper’s strong rally. The piece highlights copper technical confirmation, expects further upside as long as key support holds, and notes a breakout would strengthen the bullish outlook.

title: Mining Stock News: Gold Royalty (NYSE American: GROY)  Announces Acquisition of Royalty Over Capstone's Producing Copper-Silver Cozamin Mine
summary: Gold Royalty Corp. agreed to buy a 1% net smelter return royalty over Capstone’s producing Cozamin copper-silver mine in Mexico for $7.5 million, expected to close in August 2023. The royalty revenue is tied to copper outputs but the news does not indicate immediate production or supply changes.

title: Chile's Codelco to explore copper deposit with Rio Tinto
summary: Codelco said it will partner with Rio Tinto to explore a potential copper deposit at northern Chile’s Agua de la Falda project, after Rio Tinto buys Pan American Silver’s stake. title: Great Southern loss widens, Walkers Crips profit up
summary: Alliance News summarizes earnings updates. summary: Codelco and Rio Tinto have formed a partnership to explore Rio Tinto’s Agua de la Falda copper asset in Chile’s north. summary: Shareholders provided $3 million in extra equity funding and a standstill agreement for Mallee Resources’ Avebury nickel mine, allowing repayment of July loan principal and interest within two weeks. summary: SMM reports that global aluminium scrap production is set to expand strongly over coming decades, supported by carbon neutrality and circular economy policies. summary: SMM reports China’s aluminium scrap supply and demand have risen, helped by carbon neutrality and circular-economy policies. summary: McEwen Copper reported new drilling results from the Los Azules project in Argentina, with wide enriched-zone intercepts such as 386 m at 0.66% Cu (including 196 m at 0.99% Cu). summary: Faraday Copper reported final Phase II drill results from its Copper Creek project in Arizona, including 30.5 m at 0.95% Cu and 14.84 m at 1.61% Cu near surface, plus further evidence of breccia mineralization above the American Eagle footprint.
