title: Ronbay Announces its Global Development Strategy to Implement a Project of 40,000-Ton-per-annum High-nickel Ternary Cathode and 20,000-Ton-per-annum Lithium Ferromanganese Phosphate in Korea
summary: Ronbay says it has started a 40,000-ton-per-annum high-nickel ternary cathode project in South Korea and also launched 20,000-ton-per-annum LMFP capacity. It plans further global capacity growth. The high-nickel cathode expansion implies increased near-term nickel input demand and supports nickel prices.

title: Commodities : Copper rebounds as China vows to resolve local government debt risks - Today
summary: Copper rebounded after three weekly declines as China’s central bank pledged to resolve local government debt risks and cut the one-year lending rate, boosting sentiment. Low inventories also supported prices. LME and SHFE showed small gains in aluminium and nickel as well, reflecting broader risk-on demand expectations.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Nickel Market On August  21_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says nickel prices were mainly driven by macro factors but also supported by concerns over Indonesia nickel ore mine investigations, which firmed nickel ore prices. Inventories of nickel plates rose on overseas arrivals, expected to add supply, while reduced procurement sentiment and higher input costs may limit demand, keeping volatility.

title: Interest rates, copper network depreciation costs drive Chorus profit drop
summary: Chorus reported a 61% profit drop, citing higher interest rates and increased depreciation costs after shutting down copper network areas and expanding fibre. It said copper connections fell by about a third to 240,000 remaining, reinforcing a transition away from copper broadband. No explicit aluminium market linkage was provided.

title: Process and Control Today | Top aluminum producer and recycler Novelis to increase uptime following ABB modernization
summary: Novelis is upgrading its Oswego, New York hot rolling mill with ABB to replace obsolete drives and controls, including switchgears, transformers, and medium-voltage motors. The project aims to increase uptime and reliability and improve energy efficiency, with commissioning expected by end-2023. This supports aluminum sheet output.

title: China calls for immediate removal of US tariffs imposed on aluminium and steel products_SMM
summary: China’s trade ministry urged the US to immediately remove Section 232 tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminium imports after a WTO tribunal ruled the US levies were illegal. The ministry said it is reviewing the findings. The prospect of tariff relief would improve aluminium import prospects and likely support prices.

title: Nickel ore inventories at Chinese ports up 256,000 wmt WoW_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports Chinese nickel ore port inventories at 7.087 million wmt as of Aug 18, up 256,000 wmt week-on-week. Across seven major ports, inventories rose to 3.637 million wmt, up 266,000 wmt. The buildup occurs during peak shipment season and aligns with expectations, reducing perceived ore tightness.

title: Commodities : Copper rebounds on low stocks; China concerns cap gains - Today
summary: Copper prices rebounded after a third weekly fall, supported by sharp SHFE stock declines and low inventories plus expectations of autumn demand. However, gains are capped by weak Chinese economic/property data and liquidity risks. China cut the one-year lending rate, adding support, while aluminium and nickel rose modestly.

title: Posco, MC to produce nickel for EV batteries in the Philippines
summary: Posco Future M and MC Group will form a joint venture in the Philippines to process MHP into high-purity nickel sulphate for EV battery cathodes, sourcing nickel ore from MC Group’s Palawan mine. The move expands refined nickel supply linked to cathode production and could bolster near-term nickel demand expectations.

title: Copper Road Resources Commences Summer 2023 Diamond Drilling Program in Batchewana Bay, Ontario
summary: Copper Road Resources announced the start of a 2023 1,000-metre diamond drilling program at its JR Zone copper project in Ontario. The company targets shallow copper-rich porphyry and Richards breccia zones and plans to test previous intercepts. The release is exploratory and not a production or supply disruption update.

title: Tsingshan starts 50,000-ton nickel plant in Indonesia -sources
summary: Tsingshan Group began commercial production of refined nickel at its Morowali (Indonesia) plant, with ultimate capacity of 50,000 tonnes, according to three sources. The plant has started making nickel plate and Tsingshan may seek LME deliverable status. Additional Chinese brands are also expected after LME changes.

title: Mirasol Resources (TSXV:MRZ) Reports That Preliminary Drilling at Sobek Copper-Gold Project Yields Inconclusive Results
summary: Mirasol Resources said its preliminary drilling at the Sobek copper-gold project in Chile was inconclusive and suspended early due to winter weather, with two holes halted by depth and structural factors. The company plans follow-up drilling in Q4 2023 and notes surface anomalies with up to 2,200 ppm copper.

title: Nickel firm eyes Texas for $400 million EV battery-metal plant
summary: Wave Nickel says it is pursuing a $440 million Texas refinery to produce nickel sulfate for EV batteries, supported by U.S. incentives. It plans feedstock from a planned Brazilian microwave plant and cites a current nickel-sulfate glut tied to Indonesian supply, suggesting future tightening as projects develop slowly beyond China/Indonesia.

title: US Copper Corp.: US Copper Corp Completes Drill Program at Moonlight-Superior Copper Project in California
summary: US Copper Corp. reports completion of a 2023 exploration drilling program at its Moonlight-Superior copper project in California, targeting oxide caps and collecting samples for assay results expected in September. It highlights a large copper resource and mentions U.S. copper critical-materials support, but provides no immediate production impact.

title: Talon Metals' shares rise on high-grade nickel-copper and PGE results in Minnesota
summary: Talon Metals’ shares rose as drilling at its Tamarack nickel-copper-cobalt project in Minnesota returned high-grade results, including a long intercept with meaningful nickel and copper grades. The upbeat exploration update can support sentiment for nickel and copper by improving expectations for future supply.

title: A company from Turkey - interested in building a copper processing plant in our country
summary: Romanian officials say a Turkish company may join to build a copper ore processing plant tied to Cupru Min Abrud’s output. The goal is to add value in Romania rather than export raw ore. Talks with Cupru Min and the prime minister are ongoing, though the project details remain undecided.

title: Talon Metals Corp. Drills 101.71 Meters (333 Feet) of 3.04% Nickel Equivalent At the Tamarack Nickel Project
summary: Talon Metals announced drilling results from the Tamarack Nickel Project: 101.71 meters at 3.04% nickel-equivalent, including 1.94% nickel and 1.84% copper. The work, supported by a Columbia ARPA-E grant, also targets novel processing to lower CO2 footprint and increase nickel/copper recovery, improving future supply outlook.

title: KGHM Polska Mied? S A : has entered into long-term agreement with NKT. The Company will sell copper wire rod with a total value up to PLN 14.2 billion -Today at 03:06 am
summary: KGHM signed a long-term sales agreement with NKT to supply copper wire rod for 2023–2027, with a total value up to PLN 14.2 billion depending on options. The contract reinforces steady demand and delivery of copper semi-products used in wire and cable for the energy transition.

title: Bauxite miner in Perth drinking water catchments 'can't live with' delays
summary: Alumina Limited says further regulatory oversight is acceptable, but administrative delays tied to environmental permitting in Western Australia hurt productivity. The company reported a $US42.9 million underlying half-year loss and stopped its interim dividend, attributing weakness to modest alumina prices and permitting-driven operational challenges, which may pressure aluminium sentiment.

title: NKT A/S : secures copper for future growth by signing long-term contract with major European copper producer -Today at 03:36 am
summary: NKT signed a long-term agreement with KGHM to purchase a minimum 52,500 tons of copper wire rod annually from 2023 to 2027, with options to expand. NKT says copper is critical for power cables for renewables and electrification, supporting its supply security and growth.

title: How to play a looming copper bull market with demand set to rise
summary: The piece argues copper is set for higher prices as the energy transition boosts demand for electrification, transmission, EVs and renewable technologies. It notes supply constraints from permit/financing challenges, ongoing M&A and mine ramp-ups, and miner stock re-ratings tied to stronger copper-price environments.

title: NKT signs long-term contract with European copper producer - Windtech International
summary: NKT signed a long-term agreement with KGHM to supply at least 52,500 tons per year of copper wire rod from 2023-2027, with options to expand quantities and extend the contract. KGHM is an integrated producer with mines, smelters, and rod facilities in Europe, helping secure NKT’s copper needs.

title: NKT signs long-term contract with European copper producer
summary: NKT signed a long-term supply agreement with KGHM for a minimum of 52,500 tons per year of copper wire rod from 2023–2027, with options to increase volume and extend the deal. The contract secures a substantial share of NKT’s copper needs for power cable production, supporting copper demand sentiment.

title: Palladium One Mining Inc.: Palladium One Discovers Highly Anomalous Nickel, Copper and Cobalt Values Between the West Pickle and RJ Zones on Tyko Ni
summary: Palladium One reports highly anomalous nickel (up to 785 ppm) and copper (up to 431 ppm) soil geochemistry between the West Pickle and RJ Zones at its Tyko Ni-Cu-Co project, supported by ultramafic mapping and geophysics. The news may modestly improve sentiment on future Ni/Cu supply, though no production change is indicated.

title: Palladium One Mining Inc.: Palladium One Discovers Highly Anomalous Nickel, Copper and Cobalt Values Between the West Pickle and RJ Zones on Tyko Ni
summary: Palladium One reports highly anomalous nickel and copper (plus cobalt) soil results at its Tyko project, linking the West Pickle and RJ zones via interpreted chonolith/feeder dykes. It also states it earned an 80% interest in the Pezim II block. The news supports exploration potential but is not production-related.

title: Copper extends gains on firmer Chinese demand, weak dollar
summary: Copper prices rose for a fourth straight session, supported by firmer Chinese refined copper demand (ICSG) and additional Chinese monetary support, alongside a weaker US dollar. Reuters also reported LME aluminium and nickel rising that day, indicating a broader, sentiment-driven lift across industrial metals.

title: No new Novelis deals to buy Russian aluminium since Ukraine war
summary: Novelis, owned by Hindalco, said it is still honouring pre-war contracts with Rusal but has not signed any new deals for Russian aluminium since the Ukraine invasion. With 2024 contract talks approaching, consumers’ reluctance to buy Rusal metal may tighten supply expectations, supporting aluminium sentiment.

title: Copper trapped between old and new super-cycles : Andy Home - Today
summary: Reuters says copper’s direction is unclear as China’s property slump weighs on the “old” super-cycle while energy-transition demand (EVs, renewables) supports the “new” cycle. LME three-month copper has oscillated in a tight range since May, with fund positioning swinging between large longs and shorts.

title: Copper extends gains on firmer Chinese demand
summary: Copper prices rose for a fourth session, up 1.2% on the LME, driven by stronger-than-expected Chinese refined copper consumption data and additional Chinese monetary/support measures. The piece cites ~9% growth in apparent demand in the first half and improved yuan sentiment, lifting investor demand expectations.

title: Ministry of Commerce: China demands the United States to immediately cancel the steel and aluminum 232 measures in violation of WTO rules_SMM
summary: China’s Ministry of Commerce says the U.S. steel and aluminum 232 tariffs violate WTO rules and demands their immediate cancellation. The ministry argues the tariffs have been challenged since 2018 and faces continued refusal by the U.S. to implement WTO rulings. The piece signals possible trade pressure on aluminium flows.

title: Copper trapped between old and new super-cycles
summary: The piece links copper’s current price struggle to diverging narratives: China’s property and growth slowdown versus rising energy-transition demand (EVs and renewables). It cites range-bound LME prices and shows speculative positioning simultaneously building both long and short exposure on CME and LME, signaling no consensus on direction.

title: Analysis: Govt, Faisal Basri lock horns over downstream nickel policy
summary: Indonesia’s Jokowi and economist Faisal Basri spar over the government’s nickel downstream policy, with Faisal arguing it disproportionately benefits China and Jokowi citing export and tax gains. Neither side announces immediate changes to quotas, tariffs, or production, so near-term nickel price impact is uncertain despite the policy debate.

title: SMM Nickel Morning Meeting Minutes on August 23_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SHFE 2309 nickel closed higher on Aug 22, but intraday trading and volumes/open interest weakened, suggesting fund outflows. The report links the strong trend mainly to Indonesian nickel ore quota conditions and also cites China’s lower LPR supporting sentiment. Weak spot deals and higher upstream selling point to near-term rangebound trade.

title: Kazakhstan and Mongolia among 4 largest copper exporters to China
summary: Akipress reports that Kazakhstan and Mongolia are among four countries that supply a large share of copper exports to China, citing an Asian Development Bank report. The piece is descriptive and does not mention any export changes, disruptions, or policy measures that would directly pressure copper prices in the next days.

title: Surface sampling by Challenger Gold at El Guayabo copper-gold project indicates extension of high-grade core
summary: Challenger Exploration reported surface channel sampling at its El Guayabo copper-gold project in Ecuador suggesting mineralisation extends about 200 metres above the current resource boundary. Assays included copper grades around 0.02–0.06%, with targets remaining open. The findings are exploration-positive for future copper output.

title: Palladium One Discovers Highly Anomalous Nickel, Copper and Cobalt Values Between the West Pickle and RJ Zones on Tyko Ni
summary: Palladium One announced highly anomalous nickel and copper soil results between the West Pickle and RJ zones at its Tyko project, including values up to 785 ppm Ni and 431 ppm Cu. The company also earned an 80% interest in the Pezim II claim block. No production or supply impact is indicated.

title: Global Refined Copper Market Was Oversupplied by 213,000 tons in the First Half of the Year_SMM
summary: ICSG reported the global refined copper market was oversupplied by 213,000 tonnes in the first half of the year. It cited a 90,000-ton supply gap in June and a 58,000-ton shortage in May, alongside June production of 2.25 million tonnes versus consumption of 2.34 million tonnes.

title: Rising Production In China, DRC Drives Global Copper Glut In First Half of the Year_SMM
summary: ICSG reported the global refined copper market shifted from a 196,000-ton deficit in the first half of 2022 to a 213,000-ton surplus in Jan–Jun 2023. China and the DRC increased output while demand softened in the EU, Japan and the US. June still showed a smaller deficit.

title: Zambia's copper fantasy  - The Africa Report.com
summary: The report argues Zambia’s government copper-production target (3mt by 2030) lacks credible plans, noting mines lack expansion capacity and new-mine timelines are unrealistic. It highlights production stagnation despite earlier forecasts and raises doubts about additional copper supply for the renewable transition, potentially weighing on copper sentiment.

title: Commodities : Copper rises with improved Chinese demand prospects - Today
summary: Copper and most base metals rose in London as improved demand prospects from top consumer China—supported by upbeat Chinese copper consumption data and speculation of further government measures—boosted sentiment. A stronger yuan and weaker dollar supported dollar-priced metals. LME aluminium and nickel also increased alongside copper.

title: Moneta Gold Inc.: Moneta Expands Loveland Nickel Property in Timmins Region
summary: Moneta Gold announced it completed transactions to expand its Loveland Nickel property near Timmins, adding claims around the Cominco and Hollinger zones. The release cites historical intercepts and resource grades for nickel and some copper, but provides no development timeline or production affecting near-term metal supply.

title: Copper rises with improved Chinese demand prospects
summary: Copper rose for a fifth straight session on improved Chinese demand prospects, upbeat consumption data and speculation of further Chinese support measures. Tight LME-monitored stockpiles near a 15-year low also helped. A stronger dollar eased, keeping base metals generally higher, with aluminium and nickel also moving up.

title: Technology license awarded to purification process for recycled aluminium melts
summary: REMADE and Phinix licensed a patent-pending purification technology to remove metallic impurities from recycled aluminium melts. Designed to widen recycled aluminium’s end-use, including EV manufacturing, it targets higher recycling rates and lower energy costs versus virgin production. The news is supportive of recycled aluminium supply and sentiment.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Nickel Market On August 24_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM comments on the nickel market: SHFE nickel opened 169,950 yuan/mt and closed 169,080 yuan/mt. Trading volume and open interest fell. The report links Indonesian nickel ore quota policy and China’s lower one-year LPR to upside support, but spot transactions remain depressed with weak downstream demand.

title: HKEX expected to cover damages in LME nickel lawsuits
summary: HKEX, which owns the LME, is expected to cover damages in LME nickel lawsuits tied to last year’s cancellation of billions of dollars of nickel trades. Lawyers say clearing members should not bear damage awards or settlements under LME rulebook treatment of non-default losses, per sources and confirmation.

title: Copper: Stay Out For Now - FNArena.com
summary: The report keeps a neutral daily trend and notes copper remains in a corrective mode, with key resistance above $4.40 and support at $3.56/$3.19 on Nymex copper futures. It advises staying sidelined until a breakout sticks, suggesting limited near-term directional conviction absent a technical trigger.

title: American Copper Development Corporation: American Copper Development Corporation Completes 134 line-km Titan 160 DCIP and MT Survey Over the Lordsburg Property, New Mexico
summary: American Copper Development Corp. reports preliminary DCIP/MT survey results over its Lordsburg property in New Mexico, identifying porphyry-style signatures and historic high-grade copper zones. The company plans a ~5,000m drill program mid-February to test copper mineralization at depth. It’s a sentiment-driven exploration update, not a supply change.

title: Horizonte Minerals hires operations manager for Araguaia nickel site
summary: Horizonte Minerals hired Fernando Marino as operations director for its Araguaia nickel project in Brazil, citing his experience commissioning and ramping up mining and nickel/ferronickel operations. The company says Araguaia construction is about 65% complete, signaling potential progress toward future nickel production.

title: London copper retreats on disquiet about global growth, rates
summary: London copper pulled back 0.7% after a five-session rally, driven by unease over high interest rates and weaker global growth expectations, which outweighed tentative demand optimism from China. Technical resistance also limited upside. LME aluminium and nickel fell alongside copper as investors awaited Jackson Hole.

title: BlackRock Latin American Investment Trust Plc
summary: BlackRock’s Latin America investment trust reports November outperformance versus its Latin America equity benchmark and highlights that Ero Copper helped performance as copper prices rose. The piece discusses regional macro and portfolio changes, but only copper is directly tied to metal price movement, via the cited miner’s benefit.

title: Investegate | Company Announcement
summary: The announcement is a BlackRock Latin America investment trust monthly performance update. It notes Peru outperformance “helped by a rise in copper prices” and mentions exposure to Southern Copper. It also discusses expectations of rate cuts and broader commodity support, but provides no direct copper supply event.

title: New Singapore commodity exchange aims to launch EV nickel contract this year
summary: Abaxx Commodities Exchange, getting final Singapore approvals, plans to launch nickel sulphate futures by year-end—aimed at EV battery nickel pricing. It says the contract will provide better price discovery and allow delivery between sellers and buyers. The piece contrasts with current LME/QME refined nickel contracts and recent nickel market volatility.

title: Nickel scam: Trader Kataman Metals allegedly pays $5 million for containers filled with rubble
summary: Lawsuits in London and Singapore allege that a trader purchased a cargo purported to contain nickel but received containers filled with rubble instead. The case follows an earlier large alleged fraud involving Trafigura-linked entities. While not a supply disruption, it raises concerns about physical nickel market integrity.

title: Nickel Creek Platinum Announces Positive PFS for its Nickel Shäw Project
summary: Nickel Creek Platinum reported a positive pre-feasibility study for its Nickel Shäw Ni-Cu-Co-PGM project in Yukon, with NPV and IRR calculated using nickel and copper price assumptions (US$11/lb and US$4/lb). The update supports development sentiment and potential future supply, but no immediate output changes were announced.

title: Commodities : Copper falls as firm dollar weighs - Today
summary: Reuters reports copper fell on Friday as a strong U.S. dollar increased costs for non-dollar buyers. Three-month LME copper dropped and SHFE October copper weakened. It also cites weaker China demand data and shows aluminium and nickel easing on SHFE, indicating broader near-term pressure from FX and macro sentiment.

title: Novelis building $2.5 billion Alabama aluminum mill in milestone project | Made in Alabama: Alabama Department of Commerce
summary: Novelis is building a $2.5 billion aluminum mill in Baldwin County, Alabama, with 600 kilotonnes per year capacity and a recycling center adding capacity for 15 billion beverage cans annually. The plant is scheduled to commission mid-2025 and uses renewable power and recycling-focused operations, boosting future aluminum output.

title: London copper set for best week in a month
summary: Reuters reports London/LME copper is set for its biggest weekly gain in four, supported by Chinese policy measures stabilizing the yuan and hopes for stronger consumption in coming months. A firmer dollar caps gains. Aluminium is nearly flat, while nickel edges slightly higher, reflecting limited spillover.

title: The Case for Copper as the Top 'Bullish Energy Transition Trade'
summary: The piece frames copper as the best “bullish” investment tied to the shift from fossil fuels to renewable energy, suggesting rising demand expectations for copper from electrification and renewables. It is a thematic/argumentative view rather than a report of immediate supply disruptions or inventory changes.

title: Codelco's new CEO Alvarado tasked with finding fixes for copper slide
summary: Reuters reports Codelco’s new CEO Ruben Alvarado will tackle a sharp copper production decline to its lowest level in 25 years, address rising costs and debt, and manage operational setbacks. Codelco is also tasked with developing Chile’s lithium push. The production focus is supportive for short-term copper sentiment.

title: European copper premiums under pressure; import conditions favorable in China
summary: European copper cathode premiums fell as weak demand in Germany and Europe, high financing costs, and subdued spot liquidity pushed sellers to offer more material back to traders. US premiums also softened with thin spot activity. In contrast, China premiums rose on improved import arbitrage and tighter spot availability.

title: Copper on track for strongest week in a month
summary: Copper is set for its strongest week in a month after LME prices rise on expectations of a China housing-demand uplift, supportive seasonal consumption, and short-covering. China policy and “no lockdowns” help sentiment. Stocks elsewhere are low, raising volatility risk. Aluminium and nickel also tick higher.

title: Joint monitoring mechanism between India, US at final stage for exports of steel, aluminium items
summary: India and the US are nearing a deal on a joint monitoring mechanism for Indian exports of steel and certain aluminium products to America without extra Section 232 duties. Washington will clear most steel and aluminium exclusion applications, but monitoring aims to prevent import surges. Copper is not mentioned and likely unaffected.

title: Nation's first cobalt and nickel refinery breaks ground in Lawton, Oklahoma
summary: Westwin Elements broke ground on the first U.S. refinery targeting cobalt and nickel in Lawton, Oklahoma, aiming to start construction by October and operations sometime in 2024. Backers cite national security and cite heavy global dependence on Congo and China. The announcement is supply-positive for nickel but largely future-dated.

title: Global Aluminum Market Set For Major Shake-Up
summary: China’s aluminium sector faces domestic capacity limits and power-driven output uncertainty, prompting China to expand smelting and supply chains into Indonesia and Vietnam. Indonesian bauxite export bans and new alumina refinery approvals raise supply prospects. Analysts therefore expect global aluminium prices to face downward pressure from increased capacity.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Nickel Market On August 28_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: The SMM nickel morning comment reports the SHFE 2309 nickel contract rising modestly, but says trading sentiment remains cautious. US unemployment claims were lower than expected, supporting the dollar and pressuring commodities. In fundamentals, spot transactions were depressed and downstream inventory stayed high, limiting demand support. Nickel is expected to fluctuate.

title: Hot Chili eyes expansion of Chile copper-gold project
summary: Hot Chili says it will expand its Chile Costa Fuego copper-gold project by seeking an option to acquire the adjacent Cometa concession from Bastion Minerals. The deal follows a large PEA with high copper-equivalent resources and ongoing drilling and prefeasibility work, implying longer-term copper supply potential but limited near-term production impact.

title: Commodities : Shanghai copper climbs on China's latest move to support stock market - Today
summary: Shanghai copper rose 0.6% on Monday, supported by China’s move to halve stock-trading stamp duty to prop up its struggling stock market. The firm U.S. dollar and rate-hike prospects from the Fed weighed on sentiment, but copper’s economic bellwether role still lifted prices. SHFE aluminium edged up 0.2%.

title: Domestic and overseas macro news bolstered copper prices last week_SMM
summary: China’s PBOC cut MLF rates to support liquidity, boosting economic confidence. Softer US/EU growth data weakened rate-hike expectations and the dollar, helping copper higher. Despite subdued downstream purchases from higher prices, social copper stocks remain historically low. The article expects SHFE and LME copper to trade within stated ranges this week.

title: Pure nickel social inventory will rise further_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says China’s pure nickel social inventory across six regions rose to 6,679 mt in the week ending Aug. 25. Nickel briquettes fell while nickel plates increased. Despite SHFE nickel prices rising, downstream firms bought less as raw material costs increased, and with demand weakening, inventories are expected to keep building into early September.

title: PT Vale Indonesia, Chinese firms sign nickel agreement
summary: PT Vale Indonesia said it will work with Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt and PT Huali Nickel Indonesia to jointly process limonite nickel ore in Indonesia. The plan includes building high-pressure acid leaching facilities targeting about 60,000 tons of nickel and ~5,000 tons of cobalt per year for EV battery supply chains.

title: China's Zijin Mulls $3.8 Billion Expansion of Serbia Copper Mine
summary: Bloomberg’s piece highlights that China’s Zijin is mulling a $3.8 billion expansion of its copper mine in Serbia. The potential investment points to increased copper production capacity, which can influence near-term expectations for copper supply and market tightness.

title: Police Blotter: Thieves Steal $30,000 Of Copper Wire; Woman Wants Man Camping In Her Backyard To Leave
summary: A work site employee reported that thieves cut and stole about 15 feet of copper wire (around 180 pounds) from two AT&T units, with repair costs estimated near $30,000. The theft disrupted local phone and internet service, but there’s no broader supply impact cited for copper markets.

title: Overview of import and export data for Chinese aluminium industry chain_SMM
summary: China customs data show July exports of primary aluminium rising sharply YoY, while bauxite imports also increased strongly MoM and YoY. Primary aluminium and scrap imports rose, and alumina imports jumped MoM amid lower overseas alumina prices. However, prebaked anode export prices fell to a two-year low, with several downstream exports down YoY.

title: Egypt Aluminum's profits hike 47.6% YoY in FY2022/23
summary: Egypt Aluminum Company (Egyptalum) reported a 47.6% YoY increase in FY2022/23 net profit after tax to EGP 3.692 billion and higher revenues of EGP 22.045 billion. The update highlights improved performance for Egypt’s largest aluminium producer, but provides no immediate market-moving drivers.

title: NorthWest Copper Activist Group Refuses to Address Five Key Shareholder Concerns
summary: NorthWest Copper warns shareholders about an activist group’s refusal to address concerns and urges a vote for its nominees. The company argues the activist proxy fight could require using treasury funds and may already force deferrals of its 2023 exploration program in British Columbia, potentially affecting near-term copper project progress.

title: Weekly aluminium ingot outflows from warehouses in major consuming areas in China (Unit: kt) _SMM
summary: SMM data show weekly aluminium ingot outflows from warehouses located in China’s major consuming regions. Rising outflows indicate inventory reduction in the domestic distribution system, which can imply improved near-term tightness for spot supply and offer support to aluminium prices in the short term.

title: Copper now classified as US critical mineral, and rightly so
summary: The article argues the US DOE’s July 31 decision to classify copper as a critical material validates the metal’s importance to energy security and the clean-energy transition. It projects tightening supply versus rising electrification/EV demand, citing forecasts and existing deficits, which should support near-term copper prices.

title: MTB Metals Corp.: Drilling Underway on MTB's Telegraph Copper-Gold Project in BC's Golden Triangle
summary: MTB Metals reports drilling is underway at its Telegraph copper-gold porphyry project in British Columbia’s Golden Triangle. The first hole intercepted significant copper sulfide mineralization and associated alteration/chargeability features, supporting a potentially larger porphyry system. Drilling is scheduled through end-September.

title: Kombat produces first sale-ready copper concentrate
summary: Trigon Metals says its resuscitated Kombat Mine in Namibia has produced first sale-ready dried copper concentrate at the 1,000 t/day mill. Early runs processed 436 tonnes of ore with ~79.5% recovery and 33.5% concentrate grade, with targets to ramp output next month.

title: Southern Empire Resources Corp.: Southern Empire Pursues the Suaqui Verde Copper Deposit in Northwestern México
summary: Southern Empire entered an agreement to potentially acquire up to 100% of Cuprum’s Suaqui Verde copper project in Sonora, Mexico. The oxide/enriched copper deposit could be developed via heap leach or in-situ leaching with SX/EW to cathode copper. The news is exploratory and acquisition-focused.

title: Top Copper-Producing Nation Chile Sees Mining Costs Jump 29%
summary: Chile, the world’s top copper producer, reportedly saw its mining costs jump 29%. Rising production costs can squeeze margins and raise the risk of constrained supply or slower output growth, which tends to pressure near-term copper price expectations over the following days to weeks.

title: Copper prices to surge in oil-like rally by 2025: Citi
summary: Citi’s commodities team says copper is an energy-transition “bull trade” and that recent declines reflect cyclical weakness and slower China demand rather than a lasting downturn. It frames a bull scenario with higher prices over 2025, while noting a downside case if growth and Chinese recovery disappoint.

title: Transatlantic Mining Corp.: Transatlantic Mining: Drilling to Commence at the Monitor Projects Big Elk Copper Prospect
summary: Transatlantic Mining Corp. announced mobilization of a diamond drill rig to commence an initial program at its Monitor Copper-Gold Project, targeting the Big Elk copper prospect. The company plans up to 1,000 metres of drilling to test prior near-surface copper anomalism (reported up to 30% copper).

title: Zijin mulls multi-billion expansion of Serbian copper mine
summary: China’s Zijin Mining Group is reportedly considering a multi-billion expansion of its Cukaru Peki copper mine in eastern Serbia. The report frames copper demand growth versus supply constraints, but the mine expansion prospect implies more supply later, potentially easing copper price expectations in the near term.

title: JV Article: Archer's Grasset nickel deposit is getting its 'day in the sun'
summary: Archer Exploration is advancing exploration at its Grasset nickel sulphide deposit in Quebec, reporting high-grade nickel/copper intercepts and DHEM survey conductive plates yet to be drill-tested. The work aims to expand resources at depth in H1 and H3 zones, supporting expectations of future nickel supply.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Aluminium Market On August 29_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports SHFE 2310 aluminium ended higher after opening around 18,620 yuan/mt, with LME closed. It cites supportive domestic policies, but notes Fed-rate speculation adds macro uncertainty. On fundamentals, supply grows while ingot output is limited; imports may slow destocking. Net imbalance is mild; prices expected to fluctuate upward this week.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Nickel Market On August 29_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM’s morning note says SHFE nickel fell as Powell indicated the Fed could raise rates again, strengthening the dollar and weighing on commodities. Spot transactions were depressed, and Norilsk nickel was sold at a discount for the first time. Downstream inventory remains high, limiting demand support, so nickel may fluctuate.

title: Commodities : Copper rises as dollar softens ahead of key US data - Today
summary: Copper prices rose as the dollar weakened ahead of major U.S. data, while China’s stock-market-support measures improved risk sentiment. LME three-month copper gained 0.5% and Shanghai October copper edged up. LME aluminium rose, but nickel fell, indicating mixed effects across metals tied to macro and sentiment.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Copper Market On August 29_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM’s morning comment says SHFE August 2309 copper closed slightly higher. Sentiment is tied to Powell’s speech and rising odds of a November rate hike. Copper inventories in mainstream areas rose to 77,400 mt, mainly from imported inflows, while downstream procurement is expected to weaken as higher prices curb demand.

title: Bunzl profit up; Rio Tinto sells copper project stake
summary: Rio Tinto and First Quantum completed a La Granja joint venture in Peru, where Rio described the deposit as one of the largest undeveloped copper projects. The update also notes Rio is selling its majority stake. In the near term, limited change to copper supply is expected because the project is not yet producing.

title: Rio Tinto, First Quantum form JV for Peruvian copper project
summary: Rio Tinto and First Quantum have finalized a JV to develop Peru’s La Granja copper project, with First Quantum taking a 55% stake for $105m and planning additional $546m investment. Work will initially focus on feasibility, drilling, and metallurgical studies, with construction only after approval.

title: Vale, Huayou, Huali partner on nickel processing in Indonesia
summary: Vale’s Indonesia unit plans to build HPAL facilities with Huayou and Huali in Malili, targeting 60,000 tonnes of nickel annually in MHP for further battery processing. The project follows related Vale–Huayou HPAL work at Pomalaa and other nickel developments, signaling continued Indonesian processing expansion.

title: Abaxx Commodities Exchange to launch nickel sulphate futures contract
summary: Abaxx Commodities Exchange plans to launch the first physically settled nickel sulphate futures contract. Nickel sulphate is key to EV batteries, and the contract aims to improve price discovery and hedging for supply needed for rising demand. The initiative could bolster confidence in nickel’s battery-linked demand.

title: Rio Tinto completes sale of 55% stake in Peru copper project
summary: Rio Tinto completed the sale of a 55% stake in Peru’s La Granja copper project to First Quantum Minerals for USD105 million, after regulatory approvals. First Quantum will invest up to USD546 million to sole fund costs through feasibility, with future spending shared under 55/45 ownership.

title: Copper gains after China's move to support housing market
summary: Copper prices rose 0.9% after China announced measures to support housing loans and stock trading, improving risk appetite and prompting funds/CTAs to cut short positions. Markets await China PMI data for demand signals. Aluminium also edged higher, while nickel was slightly down, reflecting mixed metal-specific flows.

title: Sibanye says still in race for Zambia's Mopani Copper Mine assets
summary: Sibanye says it remains on the shortlist to buy Zambia’s Mopani Copper Mine assets, in a government process expected to select a bidder by end-July. The company is pursuing a copper portfolio expansion amid weaker recent profits. The article also notes prior nickel asset purchases, but without further near-term specifics.

title: Zijin plans $3.8bn investment to expand Serbian copper mine
summary: Zijin Mining plans about $3.8bn to expand Serbia’s Cukaru Peki copper-gold mine, adding infrastructure, power supply, and flotation capacity and extending drilling to near 2km depth. The project targets around 1.2mt copper production by 2025, up sharply from 2017 levels, reinforcing copper supply growth expectations.

title: Kataman brings lawsuit against New Alloys Trading over alleged nickel fraud
summary: US trader Kataman sues New Alloys Trading alleging a nickel cargo purchase was replaced with virtually worthless steel waste and that the shipment sat at port from August 2022 to March 2023. Kataman claims it paid $3.3m for LME-branded nickel to be resold.

title: Sibanye still in race for Zambia's Mopani Copper Mines
summary: Sibanye is still among potential buyers for Zambia’s state-owned Mopani Copper Mines, with Zambia aiming to choose a bidder by late July and moving into due diligence and exclusive negotiations. The company’s broader expansion includes nickel assets, but the near-term market focus is copper supply and ownership expectations.

title: Nickel miners propose 'one-stop shop' for permits
summary: The Philippine Nickel Industry Association urged the government to create a “one-stop shop” to fast-track mining permits, arguing this would reduce regulatory uncertainty and boost investor confidence. It linked timely exploration and extraction permits to the viability of long-lived nickel processing plants. No policy decision or immediate production change was announced.

title: European secondary aluminium prices steady, scrap under pressure
summary: Fastmarkets reports European secondary aluminium prices for pressure-diecasting ingots stabilizing but still trending lower since early January. New DIN230/DIN239 assessments are introduced as producers cite overcapacity, smelter coverage problems, and a sharp drop in scrap inflows (~15%). Auto demand worries and potential production cuts add bearish sentiment.

title: Bureau of Industry and Security on Proposed Section 232 steel Aluminum Tariffs Rule
summary: BIS proposed changes to the Section 232 exclusion process for US steel and aluminum tariffs, including tighter eligibility for general approved exclusions, creation of a denied-exclusion framework, and new certification/evidence requirements showing reasonable sourcing attempts from the US or specified partnered countries. Comments are due Oct. 12, 2023.

title: Rio Tinto sells 55% stake in La Granja Peru copper project to First Quantum
summary: Rio Tinto sold 55% of its stake in the La Granja copper project in Peru to First Quantum for $105m, with First Quantum also planning to fund up to $546m to take the project through feasibility and toward development. The deal targets future copper supply needs, but near-term price impact is unclear.

title: Weston Aluminium contributes $200,000 towards environmental projects | Newcastle Herald
summary: Weston Aluminium agreed to pay $200,000 toward environmental and community projects after an EPA investigation found breaches of its environmental licence linked to a 2021 fire at the Kurri plant. The findings included improper waste storage, failure to notify authorities, and unlawful waste transport, prompting remediation and revised waste management.

title: Peru slashes growth outlook amid falling copper investment
summary: Peru cut its growth forecast to 1.1% for 2023 amid a weaker first-half 2023 contraction and warned further revisions are possible. It expects private mining investment to fall 4.5%. The report also notes declining copper price assumptions for 2023-24, pressuring copper sentiment.

title: Sibanye brings in Chinese partner for Mopani Copper Mines bid
summary: Sibanye Stillwater says it will bring a Chinese investor as a partner if it wins the bid for Zambia’s Mopani Copper Mines. The company is on a shortlist competing with Zijin. The partner is meant to reduce technical and investment risk, but the article provides no immediate supply shock.

title: Weston Aluminium contributes $200,000 towards environmental projects | Gloucester Advocate
summary: Weston Aluminium will pay $200,000 following an Environment Protection Authority investigation into breaches at its Kurri plant, linked to a 2021 fire. The EPA found problems with waste storage, labelling, segregation, notification, and illegal transport causing land pollution. The company will clean up, remediate, improve practices, and pay EPA costs.

title: Weston Aluminium contributes $200,000 towards environmental projects | Port Stephens Examiner
summary: Weston Aluminium agreed to pay $200,000 for environmental initiatives after an Environment Protection Authority investigation found breaches of its waste-storage and notification obligations following a 2021 Kurri plant fire. The company is revising its fire waste management plan, improving segregation and labelling, cleaning up waste, and funding remediation and EPA costs.

title: S.Korea's Gwangyang is the new LME aluminium battleground : Andy Home - Today
summary: LME aluminium storage is shifting to South Korea’s Gwangyang, now holding about half of exchange light-metal and most live warrants. Inflows are largely Russian-brand metal displaced by U.S. tariffs and self-sanctioning. Weak demand drives super-contango and stocks-financing activity, fueling a “storage wars” queue that may affect short-term pricing dynamics.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Copper Market On August 30_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports copper prices rising on the day (LME up about 1.15%, SHFE also higher). The U.S. JOLTS data eased labor-market pressure, boosting bets on fewer Fed hikes and a weaker dollar. South China copper inventories fell for nine straight days, tightening spot supply and helping sentiment despite lukewarm downstream buying.

title: Commodities : London copper dips in cautious trade ahead of key data - Today
summary: London copper edged down 0.1% to $8,443/t as traders stayed cautious ahead of key China and U.S. economic data that could steer interest-rate expectations and demand outlook. LME aluminium rose 0.3% while nickel fell 0.2%, indicating mixed, low-magnitude pressure across industrial metals.

title: Nickel Industry Pushes For Streamlining Of Permitting Process
summary: Philippine officials and the Nickel Industry Association urge streamlining mining permitting via a potential “one-stop shop,” cutting approval timelines from 5–10 years to 6 months to 1 year. They cite rising nickel ore demand for EV batteries and stable production, seeking regulatory predictability to accelerate nickel development.

title: London copper eases in cautions as traders await macro data
summary: London copper slipped as traders took a cautious stance ahead of key U.S. and China data. A softer dollar and China mortgage easing in Guangzhou limited declines. Copper premiums widened on higher London–Shanghai spreads. Nickel fell and aluminium edged up, reflecting mixed macro-driven sentiment rather than a specific metal supply shock.

title: Indonesian nickel smelters turn to Philippines for ore as local supply tightens
summary: Indonesia delayed mining quotas and suspended operations at a key Antam site, tightening local nickel ore availability. Smelters began importing low-grade Philippine limonite ore as a stopgap. Local prices rose 8% this week. Philippine ore prices in China jumped, reflecting tighter Indonesian supplies and boosting near-term nickel sentiment.

title: Commodities : Copper recoils on unease over soft economic data - Today
summary: Copper prices slipped on concerns about weaker global growth and metals demand, with investors reassessing softer U.S. jobs data. Losses were moderated by signs of support for China’s property sector. Aluminium rose, while nickel eased, reflecting mixed sentiment ahead of further China manufacturing data.

title: Taseko Mines Limited - Taseko Mines: Florence Copper Permitting Update -Today at 08:31 am
summary: Taseko announced that a Programmatic Agreement with the US EPA, covering treatment and protection of cultural resources, has been executed for its Florence Copper project and is now in effect. Management said this is an important step in the EPA permitting process and indicates progress toward a final permit decision.

title: Copper recoils on unease over soft economic data
summary: Copper prices fell 0.2% on weaker economic-growth concerns, but losses were moderated by China property-sector support measures, including mortgage easing in Guangzhou. The green transition was cited as underlying support. Aluminium rose while nickel declined, reflecting mixed macro-demand signals across industrial metals.

title: Abaxx to launch nickel sulfate futures by year-end, president says | Hotter Commodities
summary: Abaxx said it aims to launch nickel sulfate futures by year-end after MAS regulatory review. The contract targets EV-relevant nickel sulfate and seeks to bridge the physical market shift away from Class 1 nickel toward intermediates like nickel matte/MHP. Nickel sulfate and its premium were also assessed higher recently.

title: Peru slashes economic growth outlook on copper investment slump
summary: Peru lowered its 2023–2024 growth outlook, citing weak private investment in the copper industry, El Niño disruption, and social unrest. Private investment in mining and metals is expected to fall, though mining output may still rise this year. As a major copper producer, the outlook is bearish for near-term copper sentiment.

title: Crown Holdings Expands Aluminium Stewardship Initiative (ASI) Certifications to Asia Pacific Region
summary: Crown Holdings expanded Aluminium Stewardship Initiative (ASI) Performance Standard certifications to two beverage packaging plants in Thailand, bringing its total ASI-certified facilities to 12, alongside plants in Brazil and Mexico. The release highlights sustainability, ESG training, and responsible aluminum value-chain practices without mentioning any production or supply changes.

title: Taseko Mines Limited - Taseko Mines: Florence Copper Permitting Update
summary: Taseko said construction at its Florence Copper project is complete and wellfield acidification and SX/EW plant commissioning are progressing, with copper cathode expected within weeks. It also reported improved Gibraltar copper output in Q4 (higher grades and recoveries) and 2025 sales of 99 million pounds.

title: Chile's Codelco risks being downgraded by Moody's as copper production slumps
summary: Moody’s is reviewing a potential ratings downgrade for Codelco, citing slumping copper production, higher costs and worsening financial pressure. Codelco cut its 2023 output goal due to delays in deposit improvement projects, with production not expected to approach historical levels until 2030.

title: Benton Resources Inc.: Benton Receives Conditional Regulatory Approval for Great Burnt Copper-Gold Option and Expands Disclosure of Outstanding Net Smelter Returns
summary: Benton Resources received conditional TSX Venture Exchange approval for an option to earn 70% of Spruce’s Newfoundland Great Burnt copper-gold project, pending disclosure of NSR royalties. The release details copper resource grades and royalty structures, but no production start or supply change is announced.

title: Gold Royalty Completes Acquisition of Existing Royalty on Producing Copper-Silver Cozamin Mine
summary: Gold Royalty Corp. completed its acquisition of a 1% NSR royalty on portions of the producing Cozamin copper-silver mine in Mexico for US$7.5 million. The royalty is tied to copper production and includes an option for additional concessions, but the announcement mainly reflects investor financing rather than operational changes.

title: Kolkata Metro Railway plans to replace steel third rail with composite aluminium third rail; move estimated to save Rs 210 cr capital investment | Indiablooms
summary: Kolkata Metro Railway plans to replace about 35 RKm of steel third rail with composite aluminium third rail in stages (Dumdum–Shyambazar, Shyambazar–Central/J D Park–Tollygunge, and Tollygunge–Kavi Subhash). The move is intended to cut resistance losses, reduce substations, and lower capex and lifecycle costs, supporting aluminium demand.

title: South Korea's Gwangyang is the new LME aluminium battleground
summary: South Korea’s Gwangyang port has become a major LME aluminium storage hub, with 256,650 tonnes in LME-registered warehouses—about 49% of the global aluminium stock network. The shift highlights intensifying aluminium warehouse competition and may affect near-term sentiment given supercontango/weak demand references.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Aluminium Market On August 31_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports aluminium prices rising overnight on both SHFE and LME. It attributes the positive tone to supportive domestic policies and improved sentiment ahead of September peak season. Fundamentals remain constructive with low ingot inventories and limited ingot production. Imports after the window and Southwest capacity may slow destocking, but accumulation should stay limited.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Nickel Market On August 31_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM’s morning comment reports SHFE nickel rising in the Aug 30 night session but with lower volume and falling open interest. It flags US ADP employment data as a key macro driver for the US dollar, while fundamentals show weak spot transactions, discounted shipment offers, and high downstream inventories suppressing demand. Nickel expected to fluctuate.

title: Sandfire Resources at 'exciting juncture' as it ramps up global copper assets in shift away from WA
summary: Sandfire Resources is described as being at an “exciting juncture” while it ramps up global copper assets, including a shift away from Western Australia. The move signals increased corporate focus on copper, which can influence market expectations around future copper supply and demand in the near term.

title: Commodities : London copper set for first monthly fall since May as China data disappoints - Today
summary: London copper fell and was set for its first monthly drop since May as disappointing China manufacturing data extended weak growth signals. Tepid consumption outweighed hopes for policy support. A stronger U.S. dollar also weighed. Nickel and aluminium prices edged down/inched higher, but the overall macro tone was negative for metals demand.

title: SMM Exclusive: Introduction Of Nickel Industry Chain Amid New Background _SMM
summary: SMM outlines nickel’s industry chain, arguing that demand for ternary precursor materials and intermediate products (nickel matte, nickel sulfate, MHP) is increasing, while Philippines nickel ore shipments are less stable seasonally. It also cites Indonesia’s export-ban related policies and expanding integrated capacity as affecting nickel supply and pricing expectations.

title: Si6 rigs primed to test Botswana nickel sulphide deposit
summary: Si6 Metals plans a 10,000m drilling program next month at its Botswana Maibele nickel sulphide project, targeting extensions and depth to upgrade the Maibele North resource. Drilling also targets copper-silver mineralisation at Dibete and Airstrip. It may improve future supply expectations for nickel and some copper, but near-term price impact is limited.

title: Hydro's Sunndal primary aluminium smelter will switch from fossil fuel to biomethane_SMM
summary: Norsk Hydro said its Sunndal primary aluminium smelter will shift from fossil fuels to locally sourced biomethane to cut emissions. The plan involves replacing most natural gas at the casthouse and anode production facility, with energy secured from 2024 as biomethane plants are developed. The move targets lower-carbon aluminium demand in Europe.

title: SMM Exclusive: Future Market Trend Of Bauxite In China_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM discusses China’s limited bauxite resources and worsening high-grade ore shortages. It notes Indonesia—one of China’s top suppliers—planned to stop export of raw commodities and banned bauxite exports in June 2023. With imports reaching record levels in 2022, the article implies ongoing supply tightness.

title: HOCHTIEF : Thiess secures A$240 million nickel contract in Central Halmahera, Indonesia -Today at 03:34 am
summary: Thiess (via contract partner HOCHTIEF) was awarded a A$240 million, 3.5-year nickel mining contract near Central Halmahera, Indonesia. Work includes mine development, haul roads, and ore loading/hauling. The deal expands Thiess’ Indonesian nickel operations and supports expectations of continued nickel output in the region.

title: Global energy transition will boost long-term demand for aluminium, EGA says
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) said the global energy transition will raise long-term aluminium demand, citing growth in usage in solar and wind over coming decades. It also notes aluminium prices have fallen about 17% from January highs due to economic weakness, implying no immediate supply-demand shock within weeks.

title: Lifezone Metals Reports Completion of Tembo Zone Infill Drilling at the Kabanga Nickel Project with 41 m Intersect at 2.07% Ni, including 16.4 m at 2.77% Ni
summary: Lifezone Metals announced completion of infill drilling at its Kabanga nickel project in Tanzania, highlighting multiple high-grade nickel intercepts (e.g., 41 m at 2.07% Ni). The results support an upcoming Mineral Resource estimate and DFS, improving expectations for future nickel supply. Copper is also present in assays.

title: Hydro's Sunndal Aluminium Plant Aims to Cut Emissions with Local Biomethane Integration
summary: Hydro’s Sunndal aluminium plant plans to replace 70% of natural gas with locally sourced biomethane to cut CO2 emissions by about 20,000 tonnes annually. The biomethane supply depends on Enova support for a Havila project starting in 2024. The move supports Hydro’s goal of zero-carbon aluminium.

title: Copper slides as Chinese data reinforces demand distress
summary: Copper fell 1.1% after China’s manufacturing PMI contracted for a fifth month, reinforcing demand distress. A stronger U.S. dollar added drag, and LME warehouse stocks rose sharply. Aluminium rose on expectations of robust Chinese demand and low inventories. Nickel was also down, reflecting weaker sentiment.

title: SLAM Identifies 20 km Gold and Copper Trend
summary: SLAM Exploration announced it identified a 20 km trend of gold and copper mineralization at its Shadow Lake project in New Brunswick. Grab samples returned assays up to 3.39% copper, with additional copper-molybdenum results. Soil assays are pending, so near-term tradable copper supply impact is limited.

title: Copper producer Aurubis says it has identified 'considerable discrepancies' in metal inventory
summary: Aurubis said it identified “considerable discrepancies” in its target metal inventory. The company noted related damages could be in the low three-digit-million-euro range and that losses would affect fiscal 2022/23 results. The disclosure adds short-term uncertainty around copper availability and production economics.

title: Peru's Minsur to invest at least $2.25 bln as it expands copper operations
summary: Peru’s Minsur said it will invest at least $2.25 billion to expand copper operations, including $1.8 billion at the Justa mine and $450 million for modernization of Minera Raura. Justa copper reserves are expected to rise 30%, and the mine produced 126,036 tonnes of copper last year.

title: Commerce Proposes Revisions to Section 232 Steel and Aluminum Tariff Exclusions Process
summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce proposed revisions to the Section 232 steel and aluminum tariff exclusions process, including expanding General Approved Exclusions, creating General Denied Exclusions, and adding stricter requester and objector certification/evidence rules. Commerce estimates fewer exclusion requests, potentially limiting tariff-free aluminum supply.

title: Peru's Minsur to invest at least $2.25 billion as it expands copper operations
summary: Minsur plans to invest at least $2.25 billion to expand its copper operations in Peru. Such large expansion spending can shift market expectations about future copper availability and production growth, which may support copper prices in the near term. The timing of output ramp-up remains uncertain.

title: Lifezone reports strong results at Kabanga nickel project ahead of feasibility
summary: Lifezone Metals reported strong high-grade infill drilling results from its completed program at the Kabanga nickel project in northwest Tanzania, ahead of the project’s feasibility stage. The update strengthens confidence in the project’s resource potential, which can improve market sentiment for nickel supply prospects in the near term.

title: Commodities : Copper prices climb as China stimulus lifts demand outlook - Today
summary: Copper prices rose 0.8% early Sept 1 as China issued further measures to revive its crisis-hit property sector, including easing borrowing rules and lowering mortgage rates. The improved demand outlook supported broader industrial metals, with LME aluminium and nickel also up around 0.8-1.1% despite a strong U.S. dollar.

title: Copper prices went down as US core PCE rose mildly_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: LME and SHFE copper prices fell modestly as US core PCE rose moderately but inflation-adjusted consumption increased more than expected and the US dollar rebounded. At the same time, East China spot premiums rose on tighter spot supply and South China inventories continued falling, while downstream buying stayed cautious under high prices.

title: SMM Weekly Updates On China Aluminum Ingot Social Inventory As Of August 31_SMM
summary: SMM says China’s aluminum ingot social stocks were 493,000 mt on Aug 31, slightly higher WoW but still far below last year and at a five-year low level. Cargo arrivals rose, but demand/outflows in East China kept total inventory under 500,000 mt. SHFE aluminum’s upward trend is cited, with projected mild accumulation.

title: US aluminium scrap imports from Canada show a rising trend Y-T-D totalling 166,000 tonnes_SMM
summary: US imports of aluminium scrap from Canada increased in May 2023, rising 6.99% month-on-month to 35,200 tonnes after April’s decline. Year-to-date imports for the first five months climbed 8.5% year-on-year to 166,000 tonnes, indicating improving scrap supply into the US market.

title: Japanese aluminium stocks in July 2023 record a fall of 1.9% M-o-M across three major ports_SMM
summary: Marubeni data shows Japanese aluminium stocks at Yokohama, Nagoya and Osaka fell 1.9% month-on-month in July 2023 to 350,600 tonnes. June stocks rose slightly. On a year-on-year basis, stocks declined, but the month-to-month drop is relatively small.

title: Thiess secures nickel contract in Central Halmahera
summary: Thiess won a AUS$240 million contract to deliver full-scale mining operations for a nickel project in Central Halmahera, Indonesia, for 3.5 years. The deal strengthens regional operating capacity and indicates ongoing nickel production investment, which can be mildly supportive for nickel price expectations despite limited immediate volume detail.

title: Copper at 4-wk high on new Chinese property support
summary: Copper hit a four-week high as China announced measures to support its crisis-hit property market and manufacturing activity expanded. Analysts attributed the rally to improving demand indicators such as new orders in PMIs and expectations of metals restocking as construction resumes. Aluminium and nickel also rose alongside copper.

title: Scrap Metal Scam Led to Massive Losses at Europe's Top Copper Producer
summary: Europe’s top copper producer Aurubis said a scrap-metal scam involving falsified supplier details and internal sampling cover-ups created serious recycling inventory shortfalls and could cost low three-digit million euros. It now expects weaker operating earnings, potentially tightening near-term copper supply sentiment and adding bearish pressure to copper prices.

title: Huge theft rocks Europe's largest copper producer
summary: Aurubis, Europe’s largest copper cathode producer, said an inventory review found significant discrepancies tied to suspected criminal activity, with damages potentially in the low three-digit million euros. The theft may prevent the firm from meeting its profit forecast. The shares fell about 12%, highlighting supply-inventory concern.

title: Massive Copper Theft Scandal Sends Shockwaves Through Metal Market
summary: Aurubis said it found inventory discrepancies after scrap suppliers manipulated shipment details and employees helped conceal a copper shortfall. The missing metal was detected over weeks in processing. Losses could reach the low three-digit-million-euro range, forcing it to cut earnings guidance. Shares fell sharply.

title: FTSE 100 Bounces Back Amid Rising Oil, Copper Prices
summary: FTSE 100 rebounded as basic resources and energy stocks rose. Rio Tinto and Glencore gained on higher copper prices, while BP and Shell benefited from oil rebounding to year-high levels. Other company items were mostly unrelated. The piece offers market-move context rather than a new copper catalyst.

title: Aurubis alleges criminal activity after copper, precious metals invoices manipulated
summary: Aurubis says it may face large losses after discovering discrepancies in its metals inventory tied to manipulated invoices for shipments that never reached its site. The affected inputs include copper and precious metals. The firm has downgraded forecasts and is investigating potential criminal activity, raising near-term risk perception in metals markets.

title: LME's Reputation On The Line After Nickel Fiasco
summary: The piece argues nickel remains weak after the March LME squeeze, citing continued decline in the Stainless MMI, lower volumes versus pre-LME shutdown levels, reduced liquidity and hedging constraints, and risk aversion among market participants. It also highlights reputational damage and lawsuits, expecting fallout to last months or longer.

title: Lion Copper and Gold Corp.: Lion Copper and Gold Provides Update on Water Rights
summary: Lion Copper and Gold reports that Nevada’s State Engineer issued a notice declaring forfeited the company’s water rights for three permits supporting its Yerington copper projects. The company plans to seek reversal and may file a judicial review petition within 30 days, pending remand-related legal steps.

title: Andrew Forrest's nickel dream drives Wyloo boss
summary: Wyloo Metals’ boss discusses its $760 million takeover of Mincor Resources, securing nickel assets in Western Australia and previously held BHP assets in Canada’s Ring of Fire. Management cites improved economics as nickel prices rise and potential mine restarts plus EV-related offtake interest, supportive of near-term nickel sentiment.

title: Copper Crime Ring Is Latest Scandal to Rock the Metals World
summary: Aurubis AG disclosed a large-scale fraud in scrap-metal shipments used to feed its Hamburg copper smelters, with potential losses in the low three-digit-millions of euros. The scandal could affect confidence in copper recycling inputs and near-term operating/earning outlook, adding bearish pressure to copper expectations.

title: Abaxx offers sulphate solution for broken nickel market
summary: Reuters reports that Abaxx Commodities Exchange is proposing a physically settled nickel sulphate futures contract to create pricing for the expanding EV battery nickel sulphate market. It reviews LME stock depletion of Class I nickel and the lack of deliverable hedging for intermediate products. The piece focuses on a new pricing venue rather than immediate fundamentals.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Aluminium Market On September 4_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM’s morning comment tracks SHFE 2310 and LME aluminium trading on Sep 4, showing modest gains. It attributes support to high molten aluminium output proportions and continuously low ingot inventories, while macro uncertainty from potential Fed rate hikes remains. Peak-season September-October demand is expected to help, but prices may fluctuate.

title: Copper thieves create chaos amid insatiable demand
summary: A rise in copper thefts has damaged NSW power poles, rail infrastructure, and telecommunications, with thieves motivated by high copper scrap prices on international markets. Authorities cite weak enforcement and increased thefts, creating local scrap scarcity for compliant operators and utilities, though the article doesn’t show a broad global copper supply disruption.

title: MOU signed with Compagnie des Bauxites de Guinée for Gaoual Bauxite Project
summary: Lindian signed an MOU with Guinea’s CBG to explore supplying bauxite from its Gaoual project to CBG’s production, including feasibility study work and negotiation of potential sales terms. The Gaoual resource is high-grade in alumina. The deal may modestly improve sentiment toward aluminium feedstock prospects.

title: Commodities : Shanghai nickel jumps to near 4-month high on supply jitters, firm demand - Today
summary: Shanghai nickel jumped about 5% to near a four-month high as rising ore prices and tighter supply from Indonesia followed delays in issuing mining quotas. Strong September stainless steel production and a stainless steel futures rally boosted sentiment, pushing SHFE nickel contract gains despite a firming dollar headwind.

title: Philippines says H1 nickel ore output up 40% y/y
summary: The Philippines’ Mines and Geosciences Bureau said H1 nickel ore output rose 40% to 16.87 million dmt. It is also expecting additional increases as four more mining projects are set to start between 2023 and 2025, improving nickel ore supply for stainless steel and EV battery feedstock.

title: Commodities : Shanghai nickel hits near 4-month high on supply worries, firm demand - Today
summary: Shanghai nickel jumped nearly 4% to a nearly four-month high on supply worries. Reuters attributes the move to higher ore prices and tighter Indonesian nickel ore availability after delayed mining quotas, alongside firmer demand from China’s stainless steel sector and improving sentiment.

title: Zambia's Mopani Copper Mine H1 losses worsen as output slumps
summary: Mopani Copper Mines in Zambia reported worsening H1 losses to $196 million as production slumped to 14,946 tons from 20,000 tons a year earlier and costs rose. ZCCM is seeking a new investor after taking over from Glencore, with plans to expand output via further funding.

title: Aluminium aerosol can market grew by 6.6% in first half of 2023, says AEROBAL
summary: AEROBAL says global shipments of aluminium aerosol cans rose 6.6% in the first half of 2023 to just over 3.2 billion units, led by personal care, pharma and EU/US demand. It also notes sustainability-driven push for recycled aluminium, while limited scrap availability and inflation are risks.

title: China property, demand jitters weigh on copper prices
summary: Copper prices fell as markets worried about slower demand from China’s property sector and as LME-registered copper inventories rose sharply. A softer US dollar limited losses, but copper still declined. Aluminium also eased, while nickel dropped amid concerns over Indonesia delaying mining quota issuance for nickel supply.

title: Metals One's Norway project shows high-grade nickel-copper-cobalt
summary: Metals One said initial diamond drilling at its SRH Rana project in Norway confirmed high-grade nickel-copper-cobalt sulphide mineralisation at the Bruvann prospect. Reported intercepts include 1.0%+ nickel with copper grades around 0.14–0.18%. The mineralisation is open along strike, with further drilling planned by the farm-in partner.

title: Metals One's Norway project shows high-grade nickel-copper-cobalt
summary: Metals One said early diamond drilling at its SRH Rana project in Norway confirmed high-grade nickel-copper-cobalt sulphide mineralisation, including intercepts with up to 1–2% nickel and notable copper values. The company expects further drilling updates. Near-term fundamentals likely remain unchanged, limiting price impact on nickel and copper.

title: Phoenix Copper notes metallurgical potential at Empire
summary: Phoenix Copper says metallurgical testing at its Empire mine in Idaho indicates robust copper recoveries using flotation and sulphuric acid leaching. Navarre Creek drilling is underway. While results may improve future project economics, they do not imply near-term supply changes, limiting any immediate effect on copper prices.

title: China property market and demand jitters weigh on copper
summary: Copper prices retreated 0.9% to $8,425 as traders worried about China demand, particularly slower property activity, and about rising LME warehouse inventories. Losses were limited by a softer dollar. Aluminium also fell. Nickel edged lower, despite separate supply concerns tied to Indonesia mining quota delays.

title: Domestic nickel processing critical for clean tech ambitions — DTI
summary: The Philippines’ DTI said domestic downstream nickel processing is critical for clean-tech ambitions. Trade Secretary Alfredo Pascual urged private firms to invest or partner globally to upgrade nickel-related value chain activities, aiming to secure a stronger role in clean technology supply chains through sustainability and increased processing capacity.

title: Copper Futures Contract Prices Went Down Overnight_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Overnight trading saw LME copper dip about 0.49% and SHFE copper fall about 0.44%. SMM data show Chinese inventories rose to 96,700 mt (+8,100 mt on the week), driven by higher imports and arrivals, while downstream demand remains weak due to high prices. Copper gains appear limited.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Aluminium Market On September 5_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports SHFE and LME aluminium prices rose slightly in the previous session, but notes that concentrated arrivals of aluminium ingots have increased social inventory, weakening price support. It highlights macro uncertainty from the Fed’s shifting rate stance and says near-term prices may face downward pressure, pending peak-season consumption data.

title: Commodities : Copper eases as inventories rise, demand worries linger - Today
summary: Copper fell as LME exchange inventories rose and investors worried about demand amid soft economic data from China. Reuters also noted weaker Chinese services activity, while aluminium declined and nickel showed a slight/offset move. The net effect reflected near-term demand concerns and inventory pressure.

title: IMF, WTO criticisms, nickel-plated colonialism
summary: The IMF and WTO criticized Indonesia’s policy banning exports of unprocessed nickel, arguing it conflicts with WTO rules. The EU requested WTO mediation and the panel confirmed the EU’s claims. The article suggests potential policy reversal or regulatory pressure, which could increase expectations for nickel export supply.

title: [INTERVIEW] Korea urged to set realistic rules for aluminum can recycling
summary: Novelis urges Korea’s environmental ministry to set more realistic rules for classifying aluminum beverage-can scrap as “circular resources.” The recycling process requires low contaminants, and Novelis recommends a higher allowable contamination rate and more consumer cleanliness. It also plans $50m investment in an aluminum recycling center in Ulsan.

title: Fastmarkets launches European nickel sulfate premium assessments to bring transparency to diverging global nickel markets
summary: Fastmarkets launched monthly European premium assessments for nickel sulfate on an in-warehouse Rotterdam basis to improve transparency in nickel-rich battery cathode markets. Nickel sulfate is a key feedstock for NMC lithium-ion batteries. The move reflects regional nickel sulfate price divergence and rising EV demand, but the article does not cite a near-term supply shock.

title: SMM Exclusive: Introduction of NPI and High-Grade Nickel Matte Projects to be Invested and Constructed in Indonesia in the Future_SMM
summary: SMM reports Indonesia’s NPI and high-grade nickel matte projects, noting 14 NPI projects in production and plans for roughly ten more within three years. It also highlights increased high-grade nickel matte production capacity, despite limited current output, with growing relevance to new-energy nickel demand for batteries.

title: Zijin Mining : to Acquire Ultra-Large, Undeveloped Copper Mine in Tibet for Nearly 1.65 Billion RMB -Today at 04:20 am
summary: Zijin Mining agreed to buy a 48.591% stake in Tibet Zhonghui Industrial for RMB 1.646 billion, gaining effective control of the Zhunuo ultra-large undeveloped copper mine. The project targets high-altitude open-pit mining and processing with nameplate capacity of 24 Mtpa and ~99,000 tpa copper after ramp-up.

title: Peru copper output increase drives mining expansion in July_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Peru’s INEI said the domestic mining sector rose 13.35% in July 2023 versus a year earlier, led by an 18.1% jump in copper production. This production growth suggests improved supply availability from a key global copper source, which is generally a near-term bearish factor for copper prices.

title: Fears alarms and lifts to stop working as copper network switch-off deadline looms
summary: The UK is ending new PSTN line sales from today, with permanent switch-off planned for 2025. BT expects to recover up to 200,000 tonnes of copper by stripping obsolete legacy telecom equipment as it expands fibre broadband.
