title: Epiroc and Kamoa Copper Strengthening Partnership in Democratic Republic of the Congo
summary: Epiroc won an almost EUR 60 million order to supply underground haulage, loading and drilling equipment for the expansion of the Kamoa-Kakula copper mining complex in the DRC. The project is expected to grow into one of the world’s largest, lowest-emissions copper mines. Delivery starts in 2024.

title: Copper down on weak China service data, uncertainty over property measures
summary: Copper prices in London fell as weak China services data raised doubts about the post-pandemic recovery and whether Beijing’s property-support measures will translate into real metal demand. The article also notes broad LME softness, with aluminium and nickel down, alongside weaker global activity and a firmer U.S. dollar.

title: Chile's Copper Output in July Increased by 0.94% from A Year Ago_SMM
summary: Chile’s July copper output rose 0.94% year-on-year to 434,089 mt, though it fell from June. Shipments of Chilean copper concentrate to China declined sharply. Despite weaker shipments, domestic supply is described as ample and concentrate treatment charges remain above $90/dry metric tonne.

title: SMM Analysis: Peruvian Minsur will invest at least $2 billion to expand copper and tin business_SMM
summary: Minsur says it will invest at least $2 billion over five years to expand copper and tin activities. It plans about $543 million for underground work at Justa, plus $381 million for processing and site improvements. Copper output in 2022 was 125,488 mt, while tin and smelter upgrades are also planned.

title: Noronex copper angels partying at Fiesta prospect
summary: Noronex reports drilling results from the Fiesta copper prospect in Namibia, including a 45m intercept grading 0.8% copper from depth, with multiple additional high-grade intervals and a broader Kalahari Copper Belt target. The company plans further drilling at Fiesta and the Blowhole prospect, but no production impact is mentioned.

title: Infinico Metals Corp.: Infinico Metals Corp Acquires the Nicobi Nickel Project in Quebec
summary: Infinico Metals agreed to acquire full interest in the Nicobi Ni-Cu-Co project in Quebec, with plans to reprocess historic drilling and geophysical data and begin further drilling and downhole EM work in 2024. The announcement supports nickel sentiment and modestly relates to copper given reported grades.

title: Canadian Copper Inc.: Canadian Copper Provides Update on Murray Brook Asset and Exploration Plans
summary: Canadian Copper Inc. provided an update on integrating its Murray Brook asset and submitted a permit request for a 12-hole, 2,300m exploration program. title: CanAlaska Uranium Ltd.: CanAlaska Announces Spinout of 5 Nickel Properties and other Assets and Sets Date for Annual General & Special Meeting
summary: CanAlaska approved a spinout of five nickel properties (36,174 hectares) plus $1 million cash into a new company, Core Nickel, to be held pro rata by current shareholders. Core Nickel will pursue exploration and development of the nickel assets. Uranium remains with CanAlaska.

title: Zambia agrees to return control of Konkola Copper Mines to Vedanta Resources
summary: Zambia agreed to return control of Konkola Copper Mines (KCM) to Vedanta after a prolonged ownership dispute. The deal allows Vedanta to resume operating KCM’s mines and smelter, backed by pledges to invest over $1.2 billion, repay debts, and recapitalize the largely idle underground operations.

title: Zambia's Largest Copper Mine Dodges Liquidation
summary: Zambia’s largest copper mine avoided liquidation after receiving a $1 billion cash injection from its parent company, ending a years-long legal dispute. The government said the funding stabilizes operations and prevents a potential production disruption, which can bolster near-term copper supply expectations and sentiment.

title: Commodities : Copper giant Codelco offers bonds to fund larger $4.1 bln spend - Today
summary: Chile’s Codelco launched a New York bond offering to finance above-plan $4.1 billion investments amid weak production and cost overruns. title: Zambia agrees to hand disputed copper assets back to India's Vedanta
summary: Zambia agreed to hand back control of Konkola Copper Mines (KCM) to Vedanta, ending a dispute that began with the 2019 seizure of assets. summary: Solus Advanced Materials’ unit will build a C$700 million copper-foil facility in Quebec for EV lithium-ion batteries, with full capacity targeted for 2026. title: South Korean Firm Opening Copper Foil Plant in Quebec for Use in Electric Vehicles
summary: Volta Energy Solutions, a South Korean unit of Solus Advanced Materials, plans to produce battery copper foil in Granby, Quebec, for electric vehicles. summary: South African miners and unnamed Chinese investors are bidding for Botswana’s Khoemacau copper mine. The competitive process follows weaker copper prices, but ownership changes may influence near-term supply expectations and support sentiment.

summary: Vedanta said Zambia has returned ownership and management of Konkola Copper Mines (KCM), allowing it to restart copper operations. summary: The piece announces a ResearchAndMarkets report projecting strong growth for the global copper cables market, with copper LAN cable demand expected to grow at ~9% CAGR to $11.8B by 2030. It adjusts data center growth but offers no near-term supply or policy shocks affecting copper prices.

summary: Codelco, the state-run Chilean copper miner, raised $2 billion via 10- and 30-year bond notes to finance a demanding capex portfolio and structural projects. title: South Korean firm opening copper foil plant in Quebec for use in EVs
summary: The report says a South Korean company is opening a copper foil plant in Quebec to supply electric vehicles. Copper foil is a key input for EV-related wiring and battery/efficiency components, suggesting additional demand for copper that can support prices in the near term.

summary: Solus Advanced Materials broke ground on its first North American copper foil plant in Quebec, investing CAD750m, with soft loans from Canada. summary: South Korea’s Solus unit, via Volta Energy Solutions, will build a C$700 million copper foil plant in Quebec to supply EV lithium-ion batteries. Copper foil is used as an anode collector. The project is part of Canada’s EV supply-chain push, alongside other battery-material investments.

summary: Ivanhoe Electric announced completion of an Initial Assessment for its Santa Cruz underground copper project in Arizona, outlining ~1.0Mt copper cathode and 0.6Mt concentrate over a 20-year life, with low-carbon onsite renewable power assumptions and projected costs. summary: FPX Nickel says its Baptiste nickel project in central British Columbia would require at least US$2.2 billion in capex and, if developed, could remain a high-margin supplier of battery metals or nickel concentrate. summary: The Watchlist releases interviews covering FPX Nickel’s preliminary feasibility study for the Baptiste nickel project and Nicola Mining’s letter of intent to form a joint venture to explore its New Craigmont copper project. summary: Bell Copper closed a non-brokered private placement, raising about C$547k to fund ongoing drilling and exploration at its Big Sandy porphyry copper project and working capital. summary: A miner died during a shift at the Avebury Nickel Mine near Zeehan. Mine management confirmed the death and said underground operations have ceased temporarily while employees are supported. summary: Macron’s visit to New Caledonia emphasized nickel’s strategic role for France and Europe. summary: Copper prices fell to the lowest in over a week as a firm dollar and weaker yuan weighed on demand sentiment in China. summary: Copper prices fell to their lowest in more than a week as a firm U.S. dollar made dollar-priced metals more expensive and the market awaited additional economic stimulus. summary: CMOC says it will increase copper production at Tenke Fungurume (TFM) after ending a dispute that led to an export ban until May. The firm plans more output and has resumed shipments, expecting to de-stock by month-end from around 240,000 tons in stock, boosting near-term supply.
