title: Copper Rises as China Cuts Reserve Requirements to Boost Economy
summary: Copper is reported to rise after China cuts reserve requirements to boost economic growth. The stimulus narrative can improve near-term expectations for infrastructure and manufacturing demand, which generally supports copper usage and bids, creating upward pressure on copper prices over coming days.

title: Gama Explorations Inc.: Gama Explorations Announces New Geophysical Targets on the Tyee Nickel Copper Cobalt Project in Quebec
summary: Gama Explorations reported processed airborne EM/geophysical results identifying new near-surface drilling targets on its Tyee nickel-copper-cobalt project in Quebec, including permits for a temporary camp and submitted drilling applications for priority conductors. The company plans ground validation and potential drilling, but provides no assay or resource update.

title: TASEKO MINES ANNOUNCES RECEIPT OF FINAL PERMIT FOR THE FLORENCE COPPER PROJECT
summary: Taseko said the US EPA issued the final Underground Injection Control permit for its Florence Copper Project, clearing a major regulatory step. With approvals in place, the company plans to begin construction of the wellfield and SX/EW plant. The project targets 85 million pounds of copper annually over 22 years.

title: Copper firms ahead of major Chinese indicators
summary: Copper prices rose as China’s measures to support economic recovery eased concerns from high LME inventories. Traders also await key Chinese data on home sales, property investment and industrial production, which could clarify demand prospects. The dollar’s strength remained a counterforce, but copper still gained on supportive expectations.

title: Canada's Taseko gets EPA nod for Arizona copper mine
summary: Taseko said the U.S. EPA granted a final Underground Injection Control Permit for its Florence Copper Project in Arizona. The project is permitted and construction could start soon, targeting 85 million pounds of copper per year over a 22-year mine life with operating costs of $1.11/lb.

title: Taseko Mines Limited - Taseko Mines Announces Receipt of Final Permit for the Florence Copper
summary: Taseko says construction at its Florence Copper project is complete and wellfield operations plus SX/EW commissioning are progressing, with copper cathode expected within weeks. It also reports higher 2025 and Q4 Gibraltar copper production, aided by increased grades, despite earlier downtime and an accident.

title: Aluminium sector surging in India, but hampered by labour shortages -Hindalco exec
summary: Reuters reports India’s aluminium sector is growing as government infrastructure spending and expanding auto and housing demand support rising consumption. Hindalco’s executive notes demand could nearly double by 2033, but project approvals and skilled labour shortages have already delayed expansions, limiting near-term capacity gains.

title: Taseko Mines Shares Jump on Permit for Copper Project
summary: Taseko Mines shares surged after the U.S. EPA issued a final Underground Injection Control permit for its Florence Copper Project in Arizona. With Arizona approvals already in place, the company can begin construction of the commercial production facility. The permitting news lifted Taseko shares sharply in early trading.

title: Taseko Mines Announces Receipt of Final Permit for the Florence Copper
summary: Taseko Mines said the US EPA issued a final Underground Injection Control permit for the Florence Copper Project. The permit is required for the project’s underground operations, which are expected to produce about 85 million pounds of copper annually. The announcement supports progress toward future copper supply.

title: Taseko Mines Shares Surge On Receiving Final UIC Permit For Florence Copper Project
summary: Taseko Mines shares jumped after the U.S. EPA issued a final Underground Injection Control permit for the Florence Copper Project in Arizona. The mine is slated for about 85 million pounds of annual copper output. The permitting milestone increases confidence in future copper supply and boosts sentiment around copper.

title: Top News: Michigan nuclear plant, coal plant and nickel mine stir up controversy - and more
summary: The roundup highlights a Defense Department award of $20.6M to support prospecting for nickel mine projects in Michigan and Minnesota, alongside prior DOE backing for ore processing in North Dakota. While this may improve longer-run nickel supply outlooks, it is mainly early-stage and likely limits near-term price impact.

title: DRC: massive expansion in cobalt, copper mining leads to human rights abuses — AI report – The North Africa Post
summary: Amnesty International reports that DRC industrial-scale mining expansion for batteries has driven forced evictions and severe abuses around copper and cobalt projects, especially near Kolwezi. While it may influence risk premia or future compliance scrutiny affecting copper supply expectations, the article doesn’t announce immediate shutdowns or trade restrictions.

title: China aluminium output hits record-monthly high in August
summary: China’s primary aluminium output hit a record monthly high in August, aided by resumed capacity in Yunnan as hydropower constraints ease. With September output expected to match August, and consumption uncertainty, higher supply may lift inventories and weigh on aluminium prices in the coming weeks.

title: Nickel Sulfate Prices Remain Stable_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports battery-grade nickel sulfate price at 31,529 yuan/ton on Sept. 14, up 1 yuan but essentially unchanged. Procurement of precursor companies is weaker and electrolytic nickel end purchasing has slowed, with less transaction activity. Costs remain strong and with stable downstream demand, nickel sulfate stays flat.

title: Aluminium deals delayed in Europe by cautious buyers amid weak demand
summary: European aluminium deals for 2024 are being delayed as industrial customers fear overbuying amid slumping demand across end-use sectors. Germany’s economic weakness is cited, premiums for aluminium billets in northern Germany have fallen sharply, and companies remain hand-to-mouth, waiting until later to finalize tonnages.

title: Widgie Nickel: A needle in a haystack – a nickel SULPHIDE hit with width and grade
summary: Widgie Nickel reports a major nickel sulphide drilling result, described as a “needle in a haystack” hit with notable width and grade, including an exceptionally high 20% nickel figure. Management discusses the find on an ASX media segment, which may improve near-term sentiment for nickel supply prospects.

title: Commodities : Codelco ends long-term mined copper deals to China clients from 2025 -sources - Today
summary: Reuters reports Codelco will end long-term copper concentrate sales to Chinese clients from 2025 and renegotiate terms to include intermediate products (blister/anode). While some customers protested, sources say concentrate needs will coincide with expected deficits. Codelco cites production outlook uncertainty; its output has been slipping.

title: Taseko Mines Limited Announces Final Permit for the Florence Copper Project
summary: Taseko Mines said the US EPA issued a final Underground Injection Control permit for the Florence Copper Project. The company expects 85 million pounds of annual copper capacity when operations begin, with stated production economics. The news is a permitting milestone, likely affecting longer-term supply expectations more than near-term prices.

title: Copper up on positive Chinese industrial data
summary: Copper rose on Friday after China’s August industrial data signaled stabilization, easing fears of slowing demand from the world’s largest metals consumer. A stronger yuan and softer dollar also supported dollar-priced buying. Aluminium fell on record Chinese production; nickel declined alongside broader base-metal moves and rising inventories.

title: Lundin aims to strengthen Chilean presence after approval of project at key copper mine
summary: Reuters reports Lundin Mining’s $600 million project at its key Candelaria copper mine in Chile has been approved, allowing operations to extend for another decade. The project includes new facilities, continued copper output, and about 1,500 additional jobs. Candelaria produced 126,300 tonnes in 2022.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel Completes Closing of Oversubscribed C$2.1M Private Placement
summary: EV Nickel Inc. closed an oversubscribed C$2.1M non-brokered private placement to fund continued exploration and advancement of its Shaw Dome nickel project in Ontario. The company issued shares and warrants and plans to use proceeds for project work and general corporate purposes. No immediate production or market supply actions are announced.

title: Jokowi Says Nickel Exports See17-Fold Increase Through Domestic Processing Initiative
summary: President Jokowi said Indonesia’s nickel export value rose 17-fold since the 2020 ban on unprocessed ore exports, boosting processing output, taxes, and royalties. He noted EU resistance and WTO disputes over lost value-added opportunities. Jokowi also signaled similar policies for copper, bauxite, and tin.

title: Is The LME Losing Its Grip On Global Nickel Pricing?
summary: The piece reports nickel prices (via the LME nickel contract) continuing to slide to multi-year lows, with lower highs/lower lows signaling bearish momentum. It highlights low liquidity and evolving benchmark structure (possible SHFE/Abaxx contracts), alongside a bearish stainless market that points to soft demand and pricing pressure for nickel-linked costs.

title: China's Aug aluminium imports rise on demand hopes, thin stock
summary: China’s August aluminium imports rose 20% month-on-month as demand hopes improved and domestic inventories stayed tight, with SHFE stocks falling below 100,000 tons. Imports increased further on higher Russian purchases. Aluminium production and bauxite imports also climbed, reinforcing active consumption and near-term support for prices.

title: Copper largely flat ahead of Fed rate decision, outlook
summary: Copper and other base metals were largely flat in Asia as markets awaited the U.S. Federal Reserve’s Sept. 20 rate decision and guidance. Analysts said the Fed outcome would steer metals and energy. Reported moves were minimal: copper near-flat, aluminium slightly higher on LME, and nickel marginally up.

title: Nickel Sulfate Prices Expected Remain Stable_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports battery-grade nickel sulfate around 31,500–32,000 yuan/ton, up modestly and then stabilized. Manufacturers are mostly sold out September spot stocks and expect production cuts, but precursor transactions are weaker and electro-nickel purchasing has slowed. With demand steady and costs high, prices are expected to remain stable next week.

title: Lotte to build US copper foil plant
summary: Lotte Energy Materials plans to build a US copper foil plant to supply EV battery makers meeting US IRA local-content rules. Copper foil is crucial for batteries, and the firm also signed long-term supply arrangements including with Tesla. The move strengthens expectations for near-term copper demand in EV supply chains.

title: Camino Minerals Corp.: Camino Receives Start of Activities Authorization for the Next Drilling Targets at the Los Chapitos Copper Project in Peru
summary: Camino Minerals said it received first-phase start-of-activities authorization to begin earth-moving at its Los Chapitos copper project in Peru, enabling road construction and preparations for the next drill campaign. The permit covers about half the approved EIA area, with drilling potentially starting in December. Additional targets include the Lourdes copper discovery.

title: Russia increases alumina imports from India_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Russia has increased alumina imports from India to feed its large Siberian aluminium plants after alumina supply was disrupted by a Ukraine suspension and Australia’s ban on exports to Russia. Rusal expanded sourcing (India/Kazakhstan) to keep output and contain costs, potentially supporting near-term aluminium supply.

title: Commodities : China demand angst, LME inventories weigh on copper - Today
summary: Reuters reports copper sentiment was pressured by renewed China demand concerns tied to a worse property sector and by LME approved warehouse inventories rising more than 170% since mid-July. Despite support from expectations that global rate tightening is nearing its end, copper traded flat and pressured by piling stocks.

title: China demand angst, LME inventories weigh on copper
summary: Copper trades down as concerns grow over China’s property sector and potential demand weakness. LME-approved copper inventories have surged more than 170% since mid-July. Despite expectations that interest rate tightening may be ending, the inventory build and softer macro outlook pressure copper prices.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Reports Fatality at the Kamoa-Kakula Copper Complex
summary: Ivanhoe Mines reported a fatal accident at the Kakula underground mine within the Kamoa-Kakula copper complex in the DRC. Underground mining has been temporarily ceased while an investigation is carried out. Concentrators continue operating on surface ore stockpiles, but near-term copper supply is likely reduced.

title: RI nickel reserves could be depleted in 15 years, minister warns
summary: Indonesia’s energy minister Arifin Tasrif warned that, at current nickel ore consumption, Indonesia’s reserves could be depleted in about 15 years. The forecast is tied to high production and growing demand from smelting and EV battery supply chains. Recycling and further exploration are cited as potential ways to extend life.

title: Glencore took low volumes of Rusal aluminium, contract could go to 2025
summary: Reuters reports Glencore bought only small volumes of potential Rusal aluminium supply under an existing contract that may be extended to end-2025. After Glencore stopped new Russian purchases, existing obligations remain and unfulfilled backlog could release larger quantities to rivals, adding supply expectations and pressuring aluminium prices.

title: NEW STUDY FROM CROWN HOLDINGS AND IAI ACTIONS CRITICAL STEPS TO STRENGTHEN GLOBAL ALUMINUM BEVERAGE CAN RECYCLING
summary: Crown Holdings and the International Aluminium Institute released a study outlining measures to strengthen beverage can recycling in several countries, aiming to reduce CO2 and increase recycling rates. Better collection and recycling systems should boost recycled aluminum supply versus primary production, potentially offering modest near-term support for aluminium prices.

title: Canada Nickel Closes Previously Announced US$12 Million Loan Facility with Auramet International, Inc.
summary: Canada Nickel closed a US$12 million secured loan facility with Auramet to fund working capital and continue permitting and detailed engineering for its nickel-cobalt sulphide project. The financing supports project progress and potential future nickel supply, but the transaction is not a direct near-term supply or demand shock.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Nickel Market On September 19_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports SHFE nickel rose modestly, with the most-traded contract closing higher and volume up while open interest fell. It notes pure nickel spot transactions improved alongside a downward trend in futures. Ahead of the Fed decision on Sept 21, SMM expects a slight nickel price rebound.

title: Copper prices inched lower as market worried about consumption_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: LME and SHFE copper prices fell over the session as markets worried about consumption. SMM data showed Chinese copper inventories rose in major hubs, helped by continued imported copper arrivals and weaker downstream demand under high prices. Macro concerns—inflation rebound and expectations that the Fed is near the final rate hikes—also pressured sentiment.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Aluminium Market On September 19_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM’s morning note says SHFE 2310 aluminium and LME aluminium rose overnight. It attributes support to low inventories and low warehouse receipts, despite an open import window, rising overseas ingot supply, and inventory build in ingots and billets from weak downstream operating rates. Near-term outlook is high-level oscillation.

title: Commodities : Copper subdued on Fed watch, China demand concerns - Today
summary: Copper prices edged lower as markets awaited central bank decisions, with the Fed meeting raising expectations that rates may stay high. Demand worries from China’s slowing rebound and higher exchange inventories also pressured prices. Nickel slipped slightly, while aluminium was marginally up, reflecting mixed sentiment across metals.

title: Nickel Sulfate Price Increased_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that on Sept 18 the battery-grade nickel sulfate index rose to 31,707 yuan/ton (+75). The spot range for battery-grade nickel sulfate increased to 31,800–32,100 yuan/ton (+200). Spot availability is low, procurement demand persists, and strong cost support keeps fundamentals tight.

title: Philippines' Philex says looking at venturing into nickel mining
summary: Philex’s CEO said the company is looking into entering the nickel mining space as the global transition to green energy continues. The statement is exploratory and lacks details on timing or scale, but it suggests future nickel supply participation, modestly improving sentiment for nickel.

title: Commodities : Copper falls as Fed meeting, China demand concerns in focus - Today
summary: Copper prices fell in Asian trade as markets awaited the Fed’s two-day meeting and worried about a faltering China rebound, with expectations for weaker demand and higher exchange inventories. Traders also monitored yuan depreciation affecting dollar-priced metals demand. LME aluminium and nickel edged lower alongside copper.

title: T2 Metals Corp.: T2 Metals Receives Drill Permit for the Sherridon Copper-Zinc Project, Manitoba
summary: T2 Metals received a drilling permit for its Sherridon copper-zinc project in Manitoba after more than ten years without exploration. The 2023 core drilling program (at least 1,600 metres) will target Lost and Cold copper-rich zones, with a drill start described as imminent and plans to share details shortly.

title: American Eagle Drills 102 Metres of 1.04% Copper Equivalent within 473 Metres of 0.62% Copper Equivalent from Surface in NAK23-11
summary: American Eagle Gold reported drilling at its NAK copper-gold project, including 102 m of 1.04% copper equivalent within 473 m of 0.62% CuEq from surface. The company highlights improving grades and scale, with assays pending for additional holes. This supports bullish sentiment for copper supply expectations, though not near-term output.

title: Copper heads lower ahead of Fed meeting, as inventories build
summary: Copper prices fell ahead of a U.S. Fed meeting as traders expected higher-for-longer rates to dampen industrial metals demand and as LME inventories continued building. Reuters also notes declines in aluminium and nickel, reflecting broad risk-off sentiment tied to demand uncertainty, China weakness, and tighter financial conditions.

title: Announcement of SMM's New Electro-deposited Nickel Price Point_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM publishes and updates its methodology for setting an electro-deposited nickel spot benchmark, including data collection rules, cut-off times, and calculation as the SHFE Shanghai nickel main contract plus premium/discount ranges. It explains price range publication and correction/force-majeure handling, aiming to provide a transparent reference for settlements.

title: Announcement on SMM's New Electro-depositednickel Price Point_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM publishes a methodology announcement for its electro-deposited nickel (Ni9996) spot price benchmark, detailing data inputs, premium/discount calculation versus SHFE nickel, and daily release timing/cut-offs. The benchmark is an indicative reference for physical spot settlement, not a direct signal of nickel fundamentals or an external shock.

title: Sun Summit Identifies New Zone of Copper Mineralization Near CR; Completes Expansion Drill Program at Buck Main
summary: Sun Summit Minerals reports surface sampling at its Buck Project in central British Columbia, discovering a new zone of copper mineralization near the CR area. Rock samples returned up to about 1.00% Cu. The company also completed a 3,736m drill expansion program at Buck Main, with assays pending.

title: Sun Summit Minerals Corp.: Sun Summit Identifies New Zone of Copper Mineralization Near CR; Completes Expansion Drill Program at Buck Main
summary: Sun Summit Minerals reports discovery of a new copper mineralized zone at its Buck Project in central British Columbia, with surface rock samples returning up to 1.00% Cu and drill program progress at Buck Main. The release is an exploration update and does not indicate near-term production changes.

title: PAN GLOBAL ONGOING DRILLING EXTENDS STRIKE OF LA ROMANA NEAR-SURFACE COPPER-TIN-SILVER MINERALIZATION TO 1.35 KILOMETERS
summary: Pan Global reports drilling results extending the La Romana copper-tin-silver mineralization by 150m westward to a 1.35km strike length at its Escacena project in Spain. Copper/tin grades appear to increase to the west and drilling is ongoing. The update is exploratory and not tied to near-term production changes.

title: Copper slips ahead of Fed meeting, as inventories build
summary: Copper prices extended losses ahead of the Fed meeting as investors expect higher rates to persist, weighing on industrial demand. LME copper inventories continue building, rising sharply since mid-July. China growth concerns, weaker yuan pressure, and weak demand contribute to the broader downside, with aluminium and nickel also falling.

title: PNG Mineral Resources Authority to Conduct Technical Site Visit at Freeport's Yandera Copper Project
summary: Papua New Guinea’s Mineral Resources Authority is scheduled for a technical site visit to support renewal of Exploration License EL 1335 covering Freeport Resources’ Yandera Copper Project. The company expects the review to follow shortly, keeping the permit current while progressing feasibility and financing plans.

title: NexGen Mining Announces Extension to Letter of Intent to acquire Electrum Copper Corp.
summary: NexGen Mining said it extended a non-binding letter of intent to acquire Electrum Copper Corp. for shares. Electrum owns Mexico copper projects (Candela and Don Indio). Definitive terms are still pending and subject to due diligence, with closing targeted for on/before March 31, 2024.

title: Decade Resources Ltd.: Decade Announces Surface Copper Values at the Nobody Knows Copper Project, Part of the Copper River Project, Terrace BC
summary: Decade Resources reports surface assay results from the Nobody Knows No 2 zone at its Copper River project in British Columbia, noting bornite and chalcopyrite with silver and plans to resume drilling within days. The update is exploratory and does not indicate near-term production or supply impacts.

title: China files appeal against WTO panel report on US steel, aluminium tariffs
summary: China has appealed a WTO panel ruling on U.S. steel and aluminium tariffs. The panel found China’s counter-duties on U.S. goods were inconsistent with WTO obligations after the U.S. imposed 25% steel and 10% aluminium import tariffs. The appeal could influence expectations for aluminium trade and prices.

title: Arras Minerals Corp Announces Assay Results from Holes Bg23025, Bg23026 and Bg23027 from the Ongoing Drill Program At the Beskauga Copper-Gold Deposit and Surrounding Area
summary: Arras Minerals reported assay results from three drill holes at the Beskauga copper-gold deposit, including 500m+ continuous mineralization zones located about 1 km outside the main resource. Results include 0.08–0.17% copper and copper-equivalent grades up to 0.57%, indicating continued mineralization expansion potential.

title: Supply, demand and costs led to a rally in nickel sulphate prices [SMM Analysis]_SMM
summary: SMM reports nickel sulphate prices rallied on tight spot supply, constrained arrivals, and expectations of high-grade nickel matte shortages linked to Indonesian ore quota issues. Profit inversion at salt producers may trigger production cutbacks, while dip buying and rigid replenishing demand from cathode precursor makers keeps inventories tight.

title: Mining Stock News: PNG Mineral Resources Authority to Conduct Technical Site Visit at Freeport's (TSXV: FRI) (OTCQB: FEERF) Yandera Copper Project
summary: Papua New Guinea’s Mineral Resources Authority is scheduled to conduct a five-day technical site visit to support renewal of Exploration License EL 1335 covering Freeport Resources’ Yandera copper project. The company will update on project status and financing plans, aiming for license renewal and continued feasibility and exploration work.

title: Commodities : Copper slips ahead of Fed meeting as inventories build - Today
summary: Copper prices fell as LME inventories built and traders grew cautious before the Fed meeting, fearing “higher rates for longer” could damp metals demand. China’s lacklustre growth and yuan depreciation pressures also weighed. LME aluminium edged down, while nickel was flat after briefly hitting a 14-month low.

title: Universal Copper Ltd.: Universal Copper Amends Poplar Property Option Payment Terms
summary: Universal Copper Ltd. announced an amended payment schedule for its Poplar Copper Project option agreement, extending/reshaping cash payments through 2027 to maintain its right to earn 100% interest. The company plans to focus resources on exploration of higher-grade mineralization at the copper property in British Columbia.

title: Thieves stole nearly $200 million from Europe's largest copper producer
summary: CNN reports fraud and theft totaling about €185 million at Aurubis, Europe’s largest copper producer. An inventory found inflated invoices based on manipulated scrap/input samples showing higher copper content than delivered. Aurubis cut its pretax profit forecast by ~€170 million; police and prosecutors investigate insiders and others.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Nickel Market On September 20_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM’s Sep 20 morning comment reports the most-traded SHFE nickel contract fell to 161,670 yuan/mt and open interest declined, while trading volume dropped. Spot activity weakened after advance purchasing ended. Macro attention is on the Fed decision, but SMM expects nickel prices to keep fluctuating downward.

title: Si6 beats jungle drums on Botswana copper-silver
summary: Si6 Metals says initial reverse-circulation drilling at its Dibete copper-silver project in Botswana found visible copper sulphides (chalcopyrite/chalcocite) and some copper oxide in trenches. A diamond rig has arrived to test deeper targets, with assays expected next month, supporting bullish sentiment toward copper prospects.

title: Commodities : Copper edges up on softer dollar ahead of Fed decision - Today
summary: Copper in London edged up on a softer dollar, ahead of an expected steady Fed decision, but LME-registered copper inventories are building and reaching the highest since May 2022, limiting upside. Nickel rose and aluminium edged higher in LME/SHFE, reflecting day-to-day macro and flows rather than a major supply disruption.

title: Nordic Nickel intersects wide sulphide zone beyond current Finnish nickel-cobalt resource
summary: Nordic Nickel’s drilling at the Pulju project in Finland expanded the Hotinvaara prospect, intersecting disseminated sulphides 500m south of the current mineral resource boundary. The company says the mineralised footprint is larger and drilling continues, with assays pending and an updated resource estimate expected by year-end.

title: Nickel Sulfate Prices Continue to Rise_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports battery-grade nickel sulfate rising to 31,803 yuan/ton on Sept. 19, up 96 yuan from the previous working day. Prices for 31,900–32,400 yuan/ton increased as spot availability remained low, while strong cost support and continued replenishment demand supported further gains.

title: Commodities : Copper moves in tight range ahead of Fed rate decision - Today
summary: Copper prices moved in tight ranges ahead of a U.S. Fed decision as rising LME inventories to the highest since May 2022 and higher-for-longer rate expectations/dollar strength limited upside. Aluminium edged up slightly. Nickel rose but faced a large surplus backdrop alongside concerns over Indonesia’s refusal to approve new output quotas.

title: Copper Fox Provides Update on Schaft Creek Program
summary: Copper Fox reported progress on the 2023 Schaft Creek geotechnical drilling and metallurgical testwork at its joint venture with Teck. The program is aimed at pit design, hydrogeology, and refining metal recovery and tailings characterization, with results expected later in 2023. No immediate production or supply change was announced.

title: True North Copper's Mt Oxide Project gets a boost | The North West Star
summary: True North Copper says new diamond-drilling at its Mt Oxide Project (Vero Resource) returned high-grade intersections, including 7.65% copper over 4m, extending the resource potential. The company also notes rising copper sulphate production at Cloncurry, improving cashflow to fund further exploration.

title: Copper rises with improved China demand hopes, weaker dollar
summary: Copper prices rose in London as optimism about China’s base-metals demand eased worries about the crisis-hit property sector. The move also benefited from a weaker U.S. dollar ahead of the Fed decision. The rally came despite rising LME copper inventories, which remain elevated. LME aluminium also increased.

title: Aurubis: $198m stolen from Europe's largest copper producer
summary: Aurubis said it found a €185m (~$198m) copper metals shortage after an extraordinary inventory, with evidence that inflated invoices for scrap/input materials for copper production were based on manipulated samples. The firm expects to miss profit targets, partially offset by insurance, and is investigating potential insider-linked theft.

title: CopperCorp Officially Granted Razorback Cu-Au-REE License in Tasmania, Plans Drill Campaign for Q4 2023
summary: CopperCorp announced it has been granted a new Razorback Cu-Au-REE exploration license in Tasmania and plans drilling in Q4 2023. The company highlights historical intercepts including copper mineralization and nearby operations at Mt Lyell. The release is exploratory and does not indicate immediate supply changes.

title: CopperCorp Resources Inc.: CopperCorp Officially Granted Razorback Cu-Au-REE License in Tasmania, Plans Drill Campaign for Q4 2023
summary: CopperCorp received a new Razorback Cu-Au-REE exploration license in Tasmania and plans drilling in Q4 2023. The company cites historical copper intercepts (e.g., 13.4m @ 1.6% Cu) and consolidated the Skyline Project land position, but no production or near-term supply impact is indicated.

title: Pentagon gives mine developer $20M to find nickel in Michigan
summary: The Pentagon awarded Talon Metals a $20.6M Defense Production Act grant to accelerate nickel exploration and development in Michigan and Minnesota, including the Tamarack project supplying Tesla. Officials cite national-security and battery demand needs amid reduced reliance on foreign nickel. The funding supports equipment and hiring, improving near-term supply expectations.

title: German aluminium industry 'in crisis mode' as EU marks material's strategic value | Article
summary: Germany’s aluminium industry says it remains in crisis as EU adds aluminium to the Strategic Raw Materials list. A survey shows most firms face poor energy supply and high prices, with expected negative impacts, capacity cuts, and reduced orders. There’s also a recycled-material shortage, alongside modest growth in aerosol can shipments.

title: Pershing Resources Company, Inc. Re-Affirms Significant Land Position and Sets Plans for an Exploration Drilling Program on Its Wholly Owned New Enterprise Copper Project in Northern Arizona
summary: Pershing Resources says it has paid BLM annual maintenance fees to secure mineral rights for its wholly owned New Enterprise copper project in northern Arizona and plans a three-phase exploration drilling program after reviewing contractor bids. The property targets untested copper porphyry-related mineralization near existing mines, but no near-term output changes are announced.

title: Barrick Says Big Miners Show Interest in Pakistan Copper Project
summary: BNN Bloomberg’s segment reports that big mining companies, including Barrick, are showing interest in a copper project in Pakistan. The news may support copper sentiment by hinting at potential future supply investment, though it does not indicate a specific, near-term production ramp or policy change.

title: Philex targets nickel mining amid rising demand for electric vehicles
summary: Philex Mining plans to expand into nickel after studies and sampling in Zambales, aiming to position itself as a nickel supplier for electric-vehicle demand. The company is also progressing its Silangan copper-gold project. Philex notes its mining scale is small, but the EV-driven nickel focus is supportive for nickel sentiment.

title: Copper Fox Metals Inc.: Copper Fox Announces 2023 Third Quarter Operating and Financial Results
summary: Copper Fox Metals reported Q3 2023 financial and operating updates, including ongoing exploration at multiple projects and an updated mineral resource estimate for the Eaglehead copper porphyry. The release details copper grades and contained copper but does not indicate production, sanctions, or major supply disruptions that would directly move near-term copper prices.

title: Top Philippine nickel miners may spend US$2bil on new processing plants
summary: Philippine nickel miners Nickel Asia and another top producer plan about US$1 billion each to build new processing plants. Nickel Asia is pursuing a third HPAL plant near its southern Davao project and is in final talks to secure operating rights. The investments support the government’s push for downstream capacity.

title: China Baowu puts deal for Tsingshan nickel assets on hold - report
summary: Baowu has delayed a planned transaction to acquire Tsingshan’s Indonesian Morowali nickel-related assets, citing management changes and shrinking profits amid weaker nickel and steel results. The hold raises uncertainty around the sale of ferro-nickel lines and coincides with Tsingshan ramping refined nickel output in Indonesia.

title: Australia proposes ending anti-dumping investigation on Vietnamese copper pipes
summary: Australia’s Anti-Dumping Commission has issued findings in its anti-dumping probe of Vietnamese copper tube products and recommended terminating the investigation for Vietnam. The earlier termination was revoked, but the latest report again finds no significant dumping and asks for feedback, potentially lowering duty risk and supporting copper tube imports.

title: Upward Growth In Nickel Sulfate Price_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says battery-grade nickel sulfate prices rose on September 20, supported by still-healthy demand from the electro-nickel and upstream segments. Spot nickel sulfate supply is tight and hard to source, pushing prices higher. Indonesian policy to stop issuing 2023 nickel ore quotas may further strengthen cost support, leaving room for more gains.

title: Anaheim sees spike in alarming trend: thieves smashing streetlights to steal copper wire
summary: Anaheim reports dozens of streetlights vandalized as thieves steal copper wire from light boxes and utility poles. Police link it to higher copper thefts and recyclers’ scrap resale, while the city replaces copper with aluminum wire and tamper-proof fixtures. Repairs may take weeks, but the event is geographically limited.

title: Harita Nickel has big plans for EV boom
summary: Harita Nickel says its Obi island facilities have started Indonesia’s first nickel sulfate production operation and process MHP for EV battery cathode precursors. The company expects 240,000 tonnes of nickel sulfate annually and has expanded HPAL-linked production. This boosts near-term nickel supply-demand expectations tied to EV demand.

title: Copper falls to five-week low on hawkish Fed, strong dollar, high stocks
summary: Copper prices slid to a five-week low as the Fed signalled restrictive rates for longer, boosting the dollar and pressuring risk appetite. LME inventories rose to the highest since May 2022, widening the near-term discount. Nickel and aluminium also fell on the same macro and demand/sentiment backdrop.

title: Magna Mining Intersects 5% Nickel Equivalent over 7 Metres in the 105 Footwall Zone at Crean Hill
summary: Magna Mining released additional assay results from the Crean Hill diamond drill program, reporting high-grade nickel mineralization in the 105 Footwall Zone, including 4.2% Ni and 0.9% Cu over 7.0 metres. The company highlights nickel tenor and additional precious-metal enrichment as exploration continues.

title: Pershing Resources Re-Affirms Significant Land Position and Sets Plans for an Exploration Drilling Program On Its Wholly Owned New Enterprise Copper Project in Northern Arizona
summary: Pershing Resources reports it has paid BLM annual maintenance fees to secure mineral rights for its wholly owned New Enterprise copper project in northern Arizona and is reviewing contractor bids for a planned three-phase exploration drilling program. The targets are described as copper porphyry-related but remain undrilled and early-stage.

title: Southern Copper sees Peru output hitting 400,000 T this year - exec
summary: Southern Copper expects its Peru copper output to rebound 17% to 400,000 tons this year, after last year’s decline caused by protests that paralyzed the Cuajone mine. The firm also targets higher companywide copper production, supported by investments and progress at key Peru projects.

title: Southern Copper Expects Output Of The Metal At Its Per…
summary: Southern Copper said it expects output from its Peru mines to rise 17% this year versus 2022, to about 400,000 tonnes. The Reuters report indicates increased supply from a major producer, which can pressure near-term copper balances and typically weighs on copper prices within weeks.

title: The Oregon Group predicts copper supply gap - Canadian Manufacturing
summary: The Oregon Group report expects a near-10 million metric ton copper supply gap due to supply underinvestment, geopolitical pressures, aging infrastructure, and weaker exploration, despite sizable reserves. It also projects rapid demand growth tied to decarbonization. The outlook supports a bullish bias for copper prices and related copper ETFs.

title: Learning about Black Butte: Ten years in, high-grade copper project continues to move forward
summary: A group visits Sandfire Resources’ office to learn about the Black Butte copper project in Montana. The mine, if built, would produce thousands of tons of copper annually to support demand tied to renewable-energy growth. The article frames the project as continuing to move forward over ten years.

title: Commodities : Copper heads for weekly loss as hawkish US rate path spurs dollar - Today
summary: Reuters reports copper prices in London rose slightly on Friday but were set for a weekly decline as LME inventories swelled and the U.S. dollar firmed on higher-for-longer Fed expectations. Analysts cite uneven China growth and tighter financial conditions. Nickel is near multi-month lows on surplus data; aluminium is up.

title: Nickel Sulfate Prices Tend to Rise_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports battery-grade nickel sulfate at 31,949 yuan/ton on Sept 21, up 54 yuan/ton, with spot scarcity and strong purchasing activity supporting prices. The high precursor price is only partly transmitted downstream, but electro-nickel margins remain attractive. Cost support may strengthen after Indonesia ends nickel ore quotas starting in 23 years.

title: SMM Weekly Updates On China Aluminum Billet Social Inventory As of September 21_SMM
summary: SMM reports China aluminum billet social inventories jumped from under 70,000 mt to over 90,000 mt in mid-September due to higher arrivals and persistent oversupply sentiment. The traditional peak season and pre-holiday stockpiling slightly improved consumption, pulling stocks to 85,100 mt by Sept 21, with declines mainly in South China and Wuxi.

title: Copper on track for weekly loss due to strong dollar, high inventories
summary: Reuters reports copper is on track for a weekly loss as the US dollar strengthens following Fed signals, while LME-registered copper inventories remain at their highest since May 2022. Reduced risk appetite and a wider near-term discount point to ample supply and an oversupplied market.

title: Giga Metals Announces Positive Pre-Feasibility Study for the Turnagain Nickel-Cobalt Deposit
summary: Giga Metals announced a positive NI 43-101 pre-feasibility study for the Turnagain nickel-cobalt project in British Columbia. The study outlines large, long-life production of high-grade nickel concentrate and favorable economics under nickel price assumptions, which can support bullish sentiment for nickel development prospects.

title: Giga Metals Announces Positive Pre-Feasibility Study for the Turnagain Nickel-Cobalt Deposit
summary: Giga Metals announced a positive pre-feasibility study for the Turnagain nickel-cobalt project in Canada, projecting long-life output of nickel/cobalt concentrate with low impurities and favorable costs. Mitsubishi highlighted the project’s low-carbon profile and potential role in growing nickel demand for batteries. The update improves development outlook for nickel supply.

title: Giga Metals Corporation: Giga Metals Announces Positive Pre-Feasibility Study for the Turnagain Nickel-Cobalt Deposit
summary: Giga Metals announced a positive pre-feasibility study for the Turnagain nickel-cobalt project in British Columbia, showing production of nickel-cobalt concentrate with positive post-tax economics. The company highlights demand growth for battery-related nickel products and positions the project to attract strategic investors, supporting nickel sentiment.

title: Copper Is About To Soar
summary: The author forecasts copper prices will rise, citing electrification and proposed nuclear reactor additions that would require substantial new transmission infrastructure. With limited new discoveries and declining grades at existing mines, the piece suggests copper could face eventual shortage dynamics. It also notes copper-related ETFs and miners reflecting prior rallies.

title: South Africa 'will be Africa's copper king'
summary: South Africa’s Northern Cape (Springbok) is forecast to become a major copper-producing region, potentially surpassing the DRC within 10 years, as Copper 360 grows its resource base and plans additional processing capacity. The piece links copper demand to electrification and power-grid expansion, arguing global supply remains tight.

title: FPX Nickel signs battery supply chain MOU with JOGMEC and Prime Planet Energy & Solutions
summary: FPX Nickel signed a non-binding MOU with JOGMEC and Prime Planet Energy & Solutions to explore vertical integration of FPX’s Baptiste Nickel Project into nickel sulphate and battery cathode active materials for PPES’ supply chain. The deal may support feasibility and permitting, but no binding agreement or timeline is set.

title: Aluminum Oxide Shortage Pushes Russia To Diversify Supply Chain
summary: Russia has increased alumina imports from India and elsewhere after disruption to Ukrainian alumina refining and related export curbs. Rusal, a major aluminum producer, still faces a supply gap and relies on higher-cost imports, pushing alumina costs higher while demand for aluminum end-markets persists.

title: ENRG Elements to divest 90% of non-core Ghanzi West copper-silver project
summary: ENRG Elements said it will sell 90% of its Ghanzi West copper-silver project in Botswana to Kavango Resources for $2.5 million. The company will use proceeds to fund other projects amid political uncertainty in Niger. The deal changes ownership but offers no near-term copper supply impact.

title: Commodities : Copper eases on hawkish Fed and ahead of China holiday - Today
summary: London copper fell 0.3% as risk sentiment weakened on expectations of higher-for-longer U.S. interest rates and a stronger dollar, while China’s Sept. 29–Oct. 6 holiday reduced near-term buying ahead of the shutdown. LME aluminium and nickel also declined, reflecting broad macro-driven pressure.

title: Nickel Sulfate Prices Expect to Rise_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports battery-grade nickel sulfate increasing to around 32,000-32,500 yuan/ton, citing tight August–September spot stocks, greater-than-expected September production reductions, and active precursor demand. Electro-nickel buyers are strengthening purchases despite limited inventory. High raw-material costs and narrowing sulfate-to-nickel spreads provide further support, with expectations for continued gains this week.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Nickel Market On September 25_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says Fed policy expectations turned bearish for nickel: after the Fed held rates, Powell’s remarks kept alive the possibility of further hikes, pressuring prices. Fundamentals show slightly weaker spot transactions and softer stainless demand with possible production cuts. Electroplating demand is stable, while nickel sulphate cost support limits downside.

title: Billionaire-backed KoBold Metals plans new Zambian copper mine within a decade
summary: KoBold Metals will spend about $150 million to accelerate studies for the Mingomba copper project on Zambia’s Copper Belt, aiming for production within a decade and completing additional studies in 2024. The firm uses AI to search for several critical metals, including nickel, but the article only quantifies copper resources.

title: Commodities : Copper falls on hawkish central banks, higher inventories - Today
summary: Copper prices fell on Monday as central banks reiterated a “higher-for-longer” stance, dampening risk sentiment, growth and likely metal demand, and a stronger dollar. Higher inventories added pressure. LME aluminium and nickel also declined, reflecting broader negative metal market sentiment.

title: Gloomy demand outlook, rising stocks hammer copper price
summary: Copper prices fell toward four-month lows as concerns grew over China’s demand, helped by rising LME-registered stocks and expectations of further inflows that widened cash discounts. A stronger US dollar weighed on dollar-priced metals. Aluminium and nickel also declined on the broader industrial metals selloff.

title: Torr Announces Staking of Highway Accessible Kolos Copper-Gold Project in South-Central British Columbia
summary: Torr Metals announced claim staking for the highway-accessible Kolos copper-gold project in British Columbia, noting historical high-grade copper and gold-in-soil/rock grab results and planned 2023 soil/rock sampling and geophysics. The release concerns exploration progress, not near-term production or supply changes.

title: C3 Metals Intersects 280m at 0.43% Copper and 0.24 g/t Gold (0.60% CuEq1) Within 391m of Porphyry Copper-Gold Mineralization; Broadest Mineralized Interval Ever Reported at Bellas Gate, Jamaica
summary: C3 Metals announced assay results from drill hole PVT0900-002 at its Bellas Gate project in Jamaica, intersecting 390.7m of copper-gold mineralization including 279.5m at 0.43% Cu. Management cites the broadest copper-gold interval reported to date and plans continued drilling. Impact is mainly sentiment, not supply.

title: ValOre Drills High-Grade PGE and Nickel-Copper
summary: ValOre Metals reported initial drill assays from the Pedra Branca project in Brazil, including an interval with 0.37% nickel and 0.11% copper alongside high-grade PGE+Au. The company highlights potential resource expansion from step-out drilling, but the information remains exploration-scale and unlikely to quickly shift nickel or copper prices.

title: ValOre Drills High-Grade PGE and Nickel-Copper
summary: ValOre announced assay results from drilling at Brazil’s Pedra Branca project, including a high-sulphide PGE-Ni-Cu interval with 0.37% nickel and 0.11% copper over 71.8 m. The company highlights resource expansion potential, but no production or logistics changes, implying only modest short-term price effects.

title: ValOre Drills High-Grade PGE and Nickel-Copper Mineralization 150 m South of Trapia 1, Pedra Branca Project: 71.8 m at 1.59 g/t 2PGE+Au, including 8.15 m at 10.54 g/t 2PGE+Au, 0.37% Ni and 0.11% Cu -September 25, 2023 at 07:02 am EDT
summary: ValOre reported initial assays from 2023 core drilling at its Pedra Branca PGE (plus Ni-Cu) project in Brazil. Results include intervals of high-grade 2PGE+Au with associated nickel (0.37%) and copper (0.11%). The release suggests resource expansion potential but does not imply near-term production changes.

title: China powers global aluminium output to record high : Andy Home - Today
summary: Reuters reports global primary aluminium production hit an all-time high in August, largely due to higher Chinese smelter output from improved hydro power. Inventories on the Shanghai Futures Exchange are historically low, imports are rising, exports are down, and there’s limited evidence of surplus, suggesting strong demand absorbing supply.

title: Velocity Provides Exploration and Drilling Update, Iglika Copper Gold Project, Bulgaria
summary: Velocity Minerals reports initial drilling results from the Iglika copper-gold project in Bulgaria under a funding arrangement with Dundee Precious Metals. All five holes intersect anomalous copper/gold mineralization in skarn targets, with cited copper-rich intercepts. The article is exploration-focused and does not affect near-term production supplies.

title: Capstone Copper Expands Revolving Credit Facility to $700 Million and Extends Maturity to September 2027
summary: Capstone Copper amended its revolving credit facility to increase commitments to $700 million and extend maturity to September 2027, improving liquidity and funding for its Mantoverde development project. The terms include adjusted term SOFR plus a 2.000%–2.875% margin, with standard covenants. It does not indicate immediate mine output changes.

title: Mining Stock News: Velocity (TSXV: VLC) Provides Exploration and Drilling Update, Iglika Copper Gold Project, Bulgaria
summary: Velocity Minerals reports initial drilling results at its Iglika copper-gold project in Bulgaria, funded by Dundee Precious Metals under an option to earn a 75% interest. All drill holes intersected anomalous copper (with associated gold and zinc) and Phase II drilling is expected pending permitting.

title: Are Consumers Willing To Pay A Premium For Low-Carbon Aluminum?
summary: LME aluminum has traded sideways with a modest August rise, but the article characterizes the broader aluminum market as bearish, citing falling prices and Midwest premium declines, weak demand (except trucks/trailers), and difficulty booking deals. Hydro’s lower-carbon aluminum plans may carry a premium, though consumers are price-sensitive.

title: DMCI Mining expects record nickel ore shipments - BusinessWorld Online
summary: DMCI Mining expects record nickel ore shipments in 2023-24, citing robust first-half production at Zambales Diversified Metals Corp. and shipment progress toward annual targets. An amended ECC doubling permitted output supports higher volumes, which could increase nickel supply expectations even as DMCI notes higher prices from Surigao closures.

title: Flying Nickel Announces Private Placement Raising Up to $450,000
summary: Flying Nickel Mining Corp. announced a non-brokered private placement of up to 5,000,000 shares at $0.09 each to raise as much as $450,000. Proceeds will fund exploration and general working capital for its Minago nickel project in Manitoba, subject to TSX Venture approval.

title: Flying Nickel Mining Corp.: Flying Nickel Announces Private Placement Raising Up to $450,000
summary: Flying Nickel Mining Corp. announced a non-brokered private placement raising up to $450,000 to fund exploration and general working capital for its 100% owned Minago nickel project in Manitoba. The company sells up to 5,000,000 shares at $0.09, subject to exchange approval. This is a modest nickel-supply funding update.

title: Panama Union Workers Block Highways Over Copper Mine Contract
summary: Union workers in Panama are blocking highways tied to a copper mine contract dispute. Such actions can interrupt transport of ore and supplies or delay production, raising expectations of near-term copper supply tightness. That typically supports upward price pressure over the coming days as markets react to disruption risk.

title: Upward Trend of Nickel Sulfate Prices_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports nickel sulfate prices rising on September 25, with battery-grade indices increasing versus the prior working day. Downstream procurement strengthened ahead of the National Day holiday, while high costs and tight supply expectations (including potential production cuts) supported price sentiment. The widened spreads indicate firm support and possible further upside.

title: Material Matters: Lithium; Aluminium; Oil
summary: The piece highlights aluminium price support from China’s Yunnan province, where hydro-driven electricity supply is failing to meet rising power demand. This is causing aluminium production curtailments and ongoing power deficits. With capacity caps approaching and limited power alternatives, it expects a structural/global aluminium supply deficit that keeps prices supported.

title: Nexans awarded Copper Mark label for responsible copper production
summary: Nexans said its Montreal and Lens facilities received the Copper Mark label for responsible and sustainable copper rod production after independent audits. The firm frames this as support for the energy transition and plans to seek the label for other sites in Peru and Chile. No immediate volume or supply disruption is stated.

title: China powers global aluminium output to record high: Andy Home
summary: Global primary aluminium output hit an all-time high in August as China’s smelters ramped up following improved hydro-electric power supply. The International Aluminium Institute revised higher China and non-China production, while ShFE stocks stayed very low and imports rose, suggesting strong near-term off-take but increasing supply pressure ahead.

title: Germany: Rising copper thefts hit infrastructure, businesses – DW – 09/26/2023
summary: Germany is seeing rising copper thefts, costing Deutsche Bahn millions and causing hundreds of hours of train delays. A major Aurubis theft involving nearly $200 million worth of copper created inventory discrepancies and missed profit guidance. The broader risk of disrupted copper availability supports a mildly bullish near-term outlook for copper.

title: Copper dragged down by China demand concerns, strong dollar, high stocks
summary: Copper prices fell on concerns about China’s demand, especially the property sector, alongside high LME warehouse stocks and a strong U.S. dollar with higher-for-longer rate expectations. Cash copper discounts widened, signaling weaker near-term sentiment. The piece notes broader base-metals weakness, including lower nickel.

title: Germany: Copper theft growing, hits infrastructure, business – DW – 09/26/2023
summary: Germany is seeing rising copper thefts, including thousands of railway delays and losses of about €6.6 million in 2022 for Deutsche Bahn. Aurubis disclosed a major nearly $200 million theft and inventory discrepancies. The article suggests stolen copper moves through recycling/trade channels, implying tighter available supply.

title: C3 Metals Expands Permitted Drill Area by 74% at Jasperoide Copper-Gold Project, Peru
summary: C3 Metals said Peru’s Ministry of Energy and Mines approved a modified environmental impact drill permit for its Jasperoide copper-gold project, expanding the permitted area 74% with additional drill platforms and holes to test new skarn targets near its MCZ deposit. The update is exploration-focused, not near-term production.

title: Gladiator Recommences Drilling at the Whitehorse Copper Project and Strengthens Executive Team
summary: Gladiator Metals recommenced a 4,000m diamond drill program at the Cowley Park copper prospect within its Whitehorse Copper Project in Yukon, testing high-grade copper skarn extensions. The company cites prior high-grade copper intercepts and states it is fully funded with $8.2m cash, expecting results over coming months.

title: Comprehensive Analysis Of Global Aluminum Alloys Market And Key Industry Players Unveiled
summary: The piece forecasts growth in the global aluminum alloys market, citing demand strength from construction and manufacturing and noting large-scale aluminum production volumes. It also highlights high production costs and competition from steel. Overall, it signals improving aluminum alloy demand but lacks concrete near-term pricing catalysts.

title: Taha, Ta'ziz to expand Bahraini aluminium by-product exports
summary: The article headline says Taha and Ta’ziz plan to expand Bahraini exports of aluminium by-products. The move suggests higher aluminium-related trade activity, which may influence near-term market balances by changing availability for buyers abroad and supporting aluminium price expectations.

title: Germany: Copper theft hits crucial infrastructure, business – DW – 09/26/2023
summary: Germany is facing rising copper thefts that damage rail and other infrastructure and cause significant delays and costs. Aurubis, Europe’s largest copper producer, reported a major theft with sizable inventory discrepancies and missed profit guidance, highlighting tighter copper availability and potential near-term price support.

title: TRANSFORMA PROVIDES UPDATE ON MAC NICKEL PROPERTY AND ANNOUNCES OFFERING OF CRITICAL MINERALS FLOW-THROUGH SHARES
summary: Transforma Resources provided an update on its MAC Nickel Property, with initial sampling results pending, and announced a small flow-through share financing to fund further exploration. The company targets battery-metal quality nickel/awaruite deposits in British Columbia. No production, shipping, or definitive resource changes were disclosed.

title: Aston Bay : and American West Metals Confirm Discovery of Sediment Hosted Copper System at Depth and 76m of 2% Cu from 32m at Thunder from the Storm Copper Project, Canada -September 26, 2023 at 09:41 am EDT
summary: Aston Bay and American West report assay results from the Storm Copper Project in Canada confirming a deeper sediment-hosted copper system and high-grade near-surface Thunder mineralization. Intersections include 76m at ~2% Cu from 32m and up to 49.6% Cu near surface, supporting exploration potential but not production.

title: Aston Bay Holdings Ltd: Aston Bay and American West Metals Confirm Discovery of Sediment Hosted Copper System at Depth and 76m of 2% Cu from 32m at Thunder from the Storm Copper Project, Canada
summary: Aston Bay reported diamond-drilling results from the Storm Copper Project in Nunavut, confirming a deeper sediment-hosted copper system, including 76m @ ~2% Cu from 32.4m at the Thunder prospect and up to 2.7% Cu at depth. The findings strengthen future resource potential but do not imply immediate supply changes.

title: Aston Bay and American West Metals Confirm Discovery of Sediment Hosted Copper System at Depth and 76m of 2% Cu from 32m at Thunder from the Storm Copper Project, Canada
summary: Aston Bay and American West report diamond drilling results from Canada’s Storm Copper Project: all holes intersected sediment-hosted copper at depth, including 76m at 2% Cu from 32.4m at Thunder and up to 2.7% Cu in a 24m thick interval. The discovery supports upside for future copper supply potential.

title: Robot Funded by Can Manufacturers Institute to Save More Than 1 Million Aluminum Beverage Cans Annually from Landfill
summary: Can Manufacturers Institute (CMI) funded an AI/robotics lease at a California MRF to capture over 1 million aluminum beverage cans per year that would otherwise be landfilled. Caglia expects to recover about 32,000 pounds annually, with revenue shared via deposit-return and UBC sales. The program supports broader UBC recovery investments.

title: Something unusual is happening in copper markets that hasn't been seen in 30 years
summary: Copper markets are showing unusual signals as spot copper falls and the LME three-month spread widens to the widest level since 1994, pushing the futures curve into extreme contango. Traders interpret this as a sign of weaker near-term physical demand and potential macro headwinds.

title: Copper Prices Stuck As Stockpiles Skyrocket
summary: Copper prices remain range-bound, while LME inventories have more than tripled since mid-July to the highest since May 2022, signaling weak demand. The UAW strike may delay EV expansion that would otherwise support copper demand, keeping upside limited and supporting sideways-to-cautious pricing.

title: FLSmidth to deliver three Top Service Design (TSUV) gyratory crushers to a South American copper mine
summary: FLSmidth will deliver three Top Service Design (TSUV) gyratory crushers to a South American copper mine. The deal, valued at about DKK 200 million, upgrades and overhauls existing crushers to improve efficiency and maintenance safety. Two units will be installed in existing foundations, reducing construction costs. Delivery is expected in 2024.

title: FLSmidth A/S: FLSmidth to deliver three Top Service Design (TSUV) gyratory crushers to a South American copper mine
summary: FLSmidth will deliver three improved TSUV gyratory crushers to a South American copper mine under a DKK 200 million order. The company will overhaul existing crushers to boost efficiency and reduce maintenance risk. Delivery is expected in 2024, with installation using existing foundations to limit construction costs and environmental impact.

title: Buy This Mining Stock Now for the Inevitable Copper Shortage
summary: The piece forecasts an inevitable copper deficit driven by rapid grid, wind/solar, and EV electrification demand versus slowing discovery and declining ore grades at major mines. It cites multiple consultancies projecting a sizable supply shortfall and suggests higher copper pricing, reinforcing bullish expectations for copper.

title: Peru to keep copper and investments flowing with unrest in check
summary: Peru’s Prime Minister says the government will curb social unrest to prevent disruptions to copper mining and shipments. Blockades that previously affected copper supply have been cleared and police mobilized. Copper output is up ~20% through July, supporting near-term supply expectations despite investment risks.

title: Nickel 28 Files Fiscal Q2 Financial Statements
summary: Nickel 28 reported results for its quarter ended July 31, 2023, highlighting Ramu’s performance. It disclosed nickel production and sales volumes in MHP, profitability from the nickel mine, and cash costs of US$3.92/lb net of by-product sales. Reduced production was tied to maintenance and upgrades.

title: Peru Is Approaching Peak Copper — For Now — as New Mines Stall
summary: The piece suggests Peru is nearing peak copper output “for now” as newly planned mines stall. With fewer incremental projects coming online, the market may tighten near-term copper availability, boosting price expectations over the next days to weeks.

title: London copper rises as China's Aug industrial profits surge
summary: London copper rose as China’s August industrial profits surged 17.2% year-on-year, surprising markets and improving risk sentiment. Reuters attributes the move to expectations of steadier demand in China, though the dollar stayed firm. LME copper was up while aluminium was flat and nickel eased.

title: Copper Cathode Market to grow by USD 7.82 million during 2022-2027 | Rising demand for copper cathode from construction, electronics, and automotive industries to drive the growth
summary: Technavio’s report projects growth in the copper cathode market, driven by rising demand from construction, electronics, and automotive industries and improvements in electrolytic refining efficiency. It also notes that copper price volatility can pressure demand-supply gaps, but the overall tone points to supportive copper fundamentals.

title: Copper falls on firm dollar, China property worries
summary: Copper prices fell as the US dollar held near a 10-month high, making dollar-priced metals more expensive. China Evergrande/re-sale concerns and broader property worries weighed on sentiment, though improving industrial profit declines offered limited support. LME aluminium and nickel also dipped, reflecting softer demand expectations.

title: Avante Mining Identifies New Zone of High-Grade Nickel up to 1.9% Ni from Maiden Drill Program at Voisey's West
summary: Avante Mining reported initial assays from a maiden drill program at its Voisey’s West nickel project, including intercepts up to 1.9% Ni and nickel-equivalent grades. Results confirm a magmatic sulfide system and suggest potential expansion at depth, with remaining drill-hole assays pending.

title: QC Copper Updates on Opemiska Resource
summary: QC Copper reports it has completed most technical work toward an updated Mineral Resource Estimate for its Opemiska copper project in Quebec, with the initial MRE expected within 60 days. The company cites extensive drilling and data work, pending final auditing and reporting. It signals potential future copper supply but no near-term market shock.

title: China's property market troubles weigh on copper
summary: Copper hovered near four-month lows as concerns about China’s troubled property market intensified, including new problems around Evergrande. Traders cited weaker demand expectations for construction/power use, a strong US dollar pressuring dollar-priced commodities, and rising LME copper warehouse stocks as bearish factors.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EVNi Clean Nickel R&D- Bioleaching Successfully Produces End-Product for Battery Plants
summary: EV Nickel reports optimization of its tank bioleaching on the W4 sulphide zone, achieving >90% Ni extraction and successful precipitation of nickel-rich mixed hydroxide precipitate for battery-plant use. Results progress to a pilot plant phase, potentially enabling localized nickel processing and supply-chain changes.

title: Copper is critical to climate. The world is way behind on production
summary: Reports cited in the article warn that copper supply may not keep up with rapidly rising demand from EVs, wind, solar and grids. Mining investment and project sanctioning have lagged, with long lead times for new mines. Customers are also showing some demand destruction, but shortage risk dominates.

title: Silver Mountain Discovers New High Grade Copper Vein and
summary: Silver Mountain Resources announced discovery of the Natividad vein at its Reliquias mine in Peru, describing “copper rich” mineralization with strong chalcopyrite and drill intercepts containing up to ~4.57% Cu in initial holes. Management plans further drilling to test continuity for potential future mine planning.

title: China's property market troubles pin copper to 4-month low
summary: Copper hovered near a four-month low as concerns about China’s property market deepened with Evergrande-related police surveillance. Weak industrial profit data and expectations for softer manufacturing orders weighed on demand. Rising LME warehouse stocks and a stronger US dollar further pressured prices.

title: Glencore : announces funding decision on Koniambo Nickel -September 27, 2023 at 11:05 am EDT
summary: Glencore announced it will fund Koniambo Nickel SAS only until Feb. 29, 2024 due to continued financial losses and unfavorable cost and market conditions. The company expects site activities to continue but will seek alternative funding and operational solutions, creating near-term uncertainty for nickel supply.

title: Glencore To Stop Funding Its Struggling Koniambo Nickel Mine
summary: Glencore plans to stop funding its struggling Koniambo nickel mine. The move raises concerns about reduced nickel output and potential delays in production recovery, tightening near-term supply expectations. That typically supports nickel prices as traders price a higher risk of supply shortfalls over coming weeks.

title: India's Rising Aluminum Appetite Shakes Global Market Dynamics
summary: India’s government-led infrastructure and green-energy agenda is driving higher aluminum consumption, supported by projects like rail/metro electrification and EV uptake. Reuters’ reporting and ICRA forecasts point to demand growth outpacing global trends, with efforts to expand bauxite supply, which should underpin aluminum prices despite weaker global demand outlooks.

title: Talon Metals staff are energized about the importance of developing their nickel project
summary: Talon Metals says Department of Defense funding will accelerate its Tamarack nickel project, with $20 million in government investment and $21 million in matching funds. The company is expanding drilling and planning construction in 2026, with processing in North Dakota. The news is supportive for nickel supply expectations.

title: Peru Grapples With Red Tape That's Burying Giant Copper Projects
summary: The article says Peru is struggling with permitting and regulatory “red tape” that is delaying or derailing major planned copper projects. Such setbacks can raise expectations of reduced or postponed supply growth, which typically weighs on copper prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Commodities : Copper prices fall on firm dollar, rising inventories - Today
summary: Copper fell on the LME, pressured by a firm dollar and rising LME warehouse inventories. The Reuters report also notes LME nickel easing and aluminium edging lower, alongside mixed moves in Shanghai. Overall, the cited macro and inventory factors point to near-term bearish sentiment for industrial metals.

title: Copper, Iron Ore Slip on Hawkish Fed, Slow Demand Before Holiday
summary: Copper prices are reported to slip as markets react to a hawkish Federal Reserve stance, while demand is described as slow before the holiday period. The combination is expected to weigh on near-term buying sentiment and pricing for industrial metals like copper over the coming days.

title: Copper rebounds after traders square positions ahead of China holiday
summary: Copper prices rebounded as traders squared positions ahead of China’s Sept. 29-Oct. 8 holiday, after earlier losses in the session. LME three-month copper rose, though a firm U.S. dollar limited gains. The report also notes rising LME copper stockpiles and mixed moves in nickel and aluminium.

title: Buenassa plans to build $350m copper-cobalt smelter in Congo
summary: Buenassa plans to invest $350m in a copper-cobalt smelter in the DRC, supported by the government, aiming to formalise artisanal mining and concentrate cobalt at the refinery. The project could increase copper processing and improve supply expectations from Congo, providing modest support to copper prices over coming weeks.

title: Start-up Atlas raises $27 million for new nickel technology for EV batteries
summary: Atlas Materials raised $27 million to develop technology that processes low-grade saprolite nickel ore into mixed hydroxide precipitate (MHP) for EV batteries. It plans a North America pilot plant later, with production targeted for 2027. Low-emissions processing and byproduct sales are highlighted, implying longer-run supply optionality.

title: Nickel Nationalism Working Well For Indonesia
