title: Mount Isa mines to cease copper operations in 2025, Glencore announces | Dungog Chronicle
summary: Glencore announced Mount Isa’s underground copper mines and copper concentrator will close in 2025, citing end-of-mine-life, low ore grades, and extraction limits. The copper smelter/refinery will keep operating for longer, but the mining shutdown still implies reduced copper output/feed into the system.

title: Glencore to close huge Australian Mount Isa copper mine
summary: Glencore will close its Mount Isa underground copper mine in Australia, with copper production ending in the second half of 2025 after 60 years. Mount Isa is among Australia’s largest copper producers. The shutdown signals reduced future supply, which can support near-term copper price expectations despite operations elsewhere continuing.

title: SMM Analysis And Forecast Of Impact Of The 2023-2024 Heating Season On Alumina Industry_SMM
summary: SMM says orange heavy-air-pollution alerts in Shandong led alumina refineries to cut roaster operation by about 50% for Oct. 14–22. With the heating season, emission-control restrictions may persist into Q4, keeping domestic alumina supplies tight and potentially supportive for aluminium prices.

title: Nickel Sulfate Supply and Demand Remains Weak_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports the battery-grade nickel sulfate index at 32,235 yuan/ton on Oct 17, down 1 yuan/ton from the prior day. Trading activity remains weak and participants take a wait-and-see stance. Supply and demand for nickel sulfate are described as still weak, with no change in quotations.

title: Mount Isa Mines copper mining closure a 'bitter pill' | North Queensland Register
summary: Glencore plans to close its Mount Isa copper operations, ending underground mining and related concentrator activity in 2025 and ceasing copper mining after 60 years. The transition is toward zinc and copper smelting/refining. Politicians urge government action, but the announced mine shutdown implies reduced near-term copper supply.

title: Antofagasta Q3 Copper, Gold Production Increase; Backs Outlook
summary: Antofagasta said Q3 copper production rose 16% to 173,600 tonnes, mainly due to higher output at Los Pelambres and Centinela. It also reiterated full-year copper guidance of 640,000–670,000 tonnes and expects 2024 copper output to rise as Los Pelambres Phase 1 expands.

title: Glencore copper mine closure will have a ripple effect
summary: Glencore will shut down its Mount Isa underground copper mine in Queensland in 2025, citing end of mine life from low ore quality and ageing infrastructure. With around 191,612 tonnes of cathode produced in 2022, the closure signals reduced future supply and prompts a bullish repricing for copper.

title: Mount Isa Mines copper mining closure a 'bitter pill' | The North West Star
summary: Glencore announced it will cease copper mining at Mount Isa from 2025, with underground operations and the concentrator closing in the second half of 2025. Over two years, activity will transition toward zinc assets and copper smelting/refining. Local leaders and politicians urge government action to mitigate impacts, highlighting potential copper supply risk.

title: Mount Isa residents, businesses brace for turbulent future as closure of Glencore copper mine looms
summary: Glencore announced it will close its Mount Isa copper mine in 2025, affecting 1,200 jobs and prompting local businesses to brace for weaker activity. Town and union concerns center on transparency and economic fallout, with government seeking other projects to replace output. Copper supply expectations could soften.

title: Funds Return to LME Nickel With $4.6 Billion in Short Positions
summary: Funds have returned to the LME nickel market, building $4.6 billion in short positions. Such positioning generally signals bearish expectations and can add incremental selling pressure in the near term, weighing on nickel prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Torq Resources Inc.: Torq Drills Two New Discoveries at Margarita IOCG Project: 42 m of 1.1 g/t Gold and 0.48% Copper on New Structure Near Falla 13 Discovery, 132 m of 0.48% Copper at Cototuda Target
summary: Torq Resources reported initial drill results from its Margarita IOCG project in Chile, including 132 m of 0.48% copper at the Cototuda target and additional copper oxide intervals at the Margarita corridor, plus 42 m of 0.48% copper in a sulphide zone near the Falla 13 discovery. Follow-up drilling and metallurgical tests are planned.

title: NioCorp Developments : Produces Ingot of Aluminum-Scandium Metal Alloy Using Environmentally Superior Process -October 18, 2023 at 07:42 am EDT
summary: NioCorp announced successful pilot-scale production of a 1 kg aluminum-scandium (Al-Sc) ingot and progress toward aluminum-scandium master alloy, using a process said to improve yields and reduce emissions. The company expects eventual commercial production, but the current milestone is small and unlikely to affect near-term aluminum prices.

title: TNR Gold NSR Royalty Update - Los Azules Copper, Gold and Silver Project - McEwen Copper Announces $10 Million Additional Investment by Nuton, a Rio Tinto Venture
summary: TNR Gold says McEwen Copper will receive an additional $10 million investment from Nuton (a Rio Tinto venture) to advance the Los Azules copper project in Argentina. The proceeds support development and extend exclusivity for copper heap-leach technologies. TNR holds a small NSR royalty on the project.

title: Copper, other base metals rise after stronger China economic data
summary: Copper and other base metals rose in London after China posted better-than-expected GDP growth, supporting expectations for higher demand from the world’s top consumer. The piece cites improving consumption/industrial activity and robust non-ferrous output alongside relatively low Chinese stockpiles, driving gains in copper, aluminium and nickel.

title: Great Southern Copper shares up on strong results at Aurelia prospect
summary: Great Southern Copper shares rose after encouraging exploration assay results at the Aurelia prospect in Chile, including rock chips up to 6.8% copper and multiple samples above 1% copper. The firm plans further geophysical and petro-chemical surveys to plan potential drill testing next year.

title: Argentina's copper export plans opposed by environmentalists
summary: Environmentalists and local residents oppose Argentina’s MARA copper project, arguing it could harm water resources and face hurdles under the National Glaciers Law and environmental impact assessment requirements. Glencore’s acquisition may move the project forward, but ongoing legal and social resistance raises delay risk for future copper supply.

title: Canada Nickel : Investor Presentation - October 2023 -October 18, 2023 at 11:52 am EDT
summary: Canada Nickel’s October 2023 investor presentation highlights the Crawford nickel sulphide project, presenting economic returns and progress on permitting. It argues global nickel supply is concentrated in Indonesia/China while demand growth from EVs is accelerating. Overall, the content supports a tighter nickel market outlook versus existing supply.

title: Ford, GM, Pepsi, Ball Corp., Rivian, SunPower and 8 more leading companies call for federal investment in clean aluminum
summary: A letter from major manufacturers and buyers urges the U.S. Department of Energy to heavily invest in American-made “clean aluminum” using Inflation Reduction Act funds. It cites curtailments from high fossil-fuel energy costs and argues DOE support could secure low-cost power and expand primary aluminium supply, helping prices.

title: Future uncertain for Mount Isa after Glencore announces closure of copper operations in 2025
summary: Glencore announced it will stop copper operations at Mount Isa (Enterprise, X41 and Black Rock) and the copper concentrator in 2025, citing remaining ore as not economically viable. The copper smelter/refinery may continue to 2030, but mine output closures point to reduced copper supply.

title: Copper inches higher on China data, firm dollar caps gains
summary: Copper prices edged up as China’s better-than-expected GDP and signs of improving consumption/industrial activity supported demand expectations. Gains were modest due to a firmer U.S. dollar and higher Treasury yields as markets expected rates higher for longer. LME zinc, tin, lead fell while aluminium rose. Nickel was down on SHFE.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Nickel Market On October 19_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports the SHFE most-traded nickel contract fell overnight to close slightly lower, with lower volume and open interest. Macro uncertainty about potential US rate hikes pressured commodities broadly. Fundamentally, electrowinning demand was stable, but Norilsk spot transactions were sluggish, leading SMM to expect nickel prices to edge down further.

title: Romanian aluminium group Alro seals new contract with Airbus
summary: Romanian aluminium producer Alro announced a renewed multi-year contract with Airbus to supply aluminium flat rolled products used in aircraft manufacturing. The agreement renews the prior 2016 deal and highlights Alro’s capacity and ongoing investments. The new orders provide clearer demand visibility for aluminium.

title: Copper plods higher on China optimism, curbed by dollar
summary: Copper rose 0.6% on LME support from stronger-than-expected Chinese growth, consumption and industrial activity, plus hopes for additional stimulus. Gains were capped by a firmer dollar as U.S. yields approached 5%. Aluminium’s cash discount narrowed, indicating tighter LME inventories; nickel slipped slightly.

title: As of 15:00 CST October 19, the SMM copper cathode spot trading intensity index was decrease39.02, a decrease of 33.13 from the day before _SMM
summary: SMM data show that as of 15:00 CST on Oct 19, the copper cathode spot trading intensity index decreased by 39.02, down 33.13 from the previous day. The reported drop suggests reduced spot trading activity and potential near-term softness in copper demand sentiment.

title: Nickel Sulfate Market Weak_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM says the Shanghai battery-grade nickel sulfate index fell slightly to 32,234 yuan/ton on Oct 18, with activity weak and the day largely flat. Tight raw-material supply keeps a pricing-support mentality, but downstream precursor buying remains cautious with no clear raw-material gaps.

title: Ero Copper's Tucumã Project Achieves Major Milestone at Over 70% Physical Completion - On Track for First Copper Production in H2 2024
summary: Ero Copper says its Tucumã Project is now over 70% physically complete, with mine pre-stripping advancing and first sulphide ore expected in early November. Main processing equipment and electrical infrastructure are being installed, and commissioning is planned before year-end for first copper concentrate in H2 2024. This progress supports copper supply expectations.

title: Los Andes Copper Ltd.: LME Week 2023: Positive Copper Sentiment
summary: Los Andes Copper cites LME Week discussions showing copper as the top base-metal upside pick for 2024. It notes ongoing weakness across base metals but emphasizes a projected longer-term copper supply deficit tied to green-transition demand, referencing analyst views of significantly higher copper prices in 2025.

title: LME Week 2023: Positive Copper Sentiment -October 19, 2023 at 07:35 am EDT
summary: Following LME Week 2023, the article says copper drew the most upside expectations in 2024 (53% poll) and emphasizes a projected long-term supply deficit driven by green-transition demand. Analysts cited potential for a large copper price rise by 2025, supporting bullish sentiment despite current base-metal price weakness.

title: Decade Confirms Discovery on the Nobody Knows Copper Project and Updates Surface Exploration at Treasure Mountain, Terrace BC
summary: Decade Resources said it continued to core significant copper sulphide intercepts at its Nobody Knows No 2 zone, outlining copper mineralization and reporting assays from the first two shallow holes. It also updated surface work at Treasure Mountain with malachite staining and bornite, awaiting further assays.

title: Ghana To Produce More Aluminium Products Locally
summary: Ghana’s GIADEC aims to reduce reliance on imported aluminium products by expanding local downstream production. The piece cites Ghana’s large bauxite resources, a concession awarded to Rocksure, and existing use of VALCO output by local manufacturers for cables, hollowware and roofing sheets, supporting higher aluminium processing demand.

title: Ero Copper's Tucumã Project Achieves Major Milestone at
summary: Ero Copper says construction progress at its Tucumã IOCG copper project is 70% complete, with earthworks finished, key processing equipment on site, and first sulphide ore expected in early November. The company targets commissioning by year-end and first concentrate production in H2 2024, supporting copper supply expectations.

title: Decade Resources Ltd.: Decade Confirms Discovery on the Nobody Knows Copper Project and Updates Surface Exploration at Treasure Mountain, Terrace BC
summary: Decade Resources reports continued drilling at its Nobody Knows No 2 zone within the Copper River project, outlining copper sulphide mineralization and providing early assay results only for two shallow holes. It also updates Treasure Mountain surface exploration with high-grade bornite and malachite-stained copper carbonate observations. Further assays pending.

title: Zimbabweans get lengthy prison terms for copper cable theft
summary: Two men were sentenced to 10 years each in Pretoria for stealing eight pieces of copper signal cables from South Africa’s Prasa. Prosecutors said each cable was valued at R3,000 and the damage required costly replacement and repairs, while a prior proposal to curb copper scrap exports was also mentioned.

title: Ero Copper Corp. Provides an Update on the Excellent Progress Being Made At the Company's Tucumã Project
summary: Ero Copper Corp. reported that construction and EPC activities at its Tucumã copper project remain on schedule, with the project about 70% complete. Work includes mine pre-stripping progressing toward first sulphide ore in early November, substantial concrete and steel progress, and key processing equipment installations ongoing.

title: CLARIFICATION NEWS RELEASE: Decade Confirms Discovery on the Nobody Knows Copper Project and Updates Surface Exploration at Treasure Mountain, Terrace BC -October 19, 2023 at 12:25 pm EDT
summary: Decade Resources reports continued drilling at the Nobody Knows No 2 zone intersecting copper sulphide mineralization, outlining copper along strike and depth with partial assays showing bornite and associated silver. It also updates surface exploration at Treasure Mountain with copper-stained zones and high-grade grab samples, awaiting further assay results.

title: World Pumps - Metso supplies slurry pumps for new copper and zinc concentrator in Portugal
summary: Metso will supply slurry pumps and other process equipment for Almina’s new concentrator project in Portugal, including grinding, flotation, filtration, and thickening. The delivery is planned around end of Q2 2024, with commissioning targeted for end of Q1 2025. This supports future copper concentrate production but is distant.

title: Copper edges lower as US dollar strengthens
summary: Copper prices edged lower as the U.S. dollar strengthened following a surge in the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield. Three-month LME copper fell 0.1%. Aluminium was also slightly down, while nickel gained modestly, reflecting mixed but generally softer pricing linked to currency pressure and tempered China stimulus hopes.

title: Bob and Robbie Katter call public meeting to discuss Glencore closure of copper mine | The North West Star
summary: Bob and Robbie Katter are holding a public meeting in Mount Isa to discuss Glencore’s decision to cease copper mining in 2025. The MPs describe the move as important for the town and future local outlook. The announcement is likely to affect near-term expectations for copper supply.

title: Auteco Minerals Limited completed the acquisition of Green Bay copper-gold project in Newfoundland, Canada from Rambler Metals and Mining Plc.
summary: Auteco Minerals completed its AUD 68 million acquisition of the Green Bay copper-gold project in Newfoundland from Rambler, after court approval and subject to remaining shareholder steps. The announcement is copper-relevant but provides no near-term output or timing changes, so it is unlikely to materially move copper prices within weeks.

title: Nickel Sulfate Price Still At High Level_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports the battery-grade nickel sulfate index at 32,113 yuan/ton on Oct 19, down 121 yuan/ton day-on-day. Tight raw material supply keeps some price support from salt factories, but downstream buyers remain cautious, prompting slightly lower quotes. Overall sentiment is mixed and nickel sulfate stays high.

title: Robbie and Bob Katter claim Mount Isa's copper mine is viable, call for government intervention | The North West Star
summary: Glencore plans to wind up Mount Isa copper operations in 2025, and politicians dispute the company’s claim the mine is not economically viable. The Queensland government is funding worker support and past smelter maintenance, while calls grow for state intervention to keep copper mining—and smelting—operating.

title: ERG Plans $800 Million Reboot of Idled Congo Copper-Cobalt Mine
summary: ERG plans an $800 million reboot of an idled Congo copper-cobalt mine, signaling potential resumption of copper production after downtime. Such restart initiatives can shift near-term supply expectations and affect copper markets within days to weeks, depending on credibility, timing, and how quickly operations could restart.

title: Lion Copper and Gold Announces Amendment of Stage 2 Program of Work Agreement
summary: Lion Copper and Gold announced an amendment extending Stage 2 of an earn-in work program by nine months to complete a pre-feasibility study using Rio Tinto’s Nuton copper leaching technologies at its Yerington Copper Project. Rio Tinto plans near-term funding advances tied to completed Stage 2a and approvals.

title: As of 15:00 CST October 20, the SMM copper cathode spot trading intensity index was decrease57.84, a decrease of 18.32 from the day before _SMM
summary: SMM data show that as of 15:00 CST on Oct. 20, the copper cathode spot trading intensity index was 57.84, down 18.32 from the previous day. The decline suggests reduced spot trading activity, which can point to softer short-term demand sentiment for copper cathodes.

title: Sonoran Desert Copper Corporation Announces that the TSX Venture Exchange Approves the Cuatro Hermanos Project Acquisition
summary: Sonoran Desert Copper Corporation said the TSX Venture Exchange approved the exploration right assignment agreement for its Cuatro Hermanos project in Mexico. The company will make cash payments and incur work expenditures for 100% ownership, with minor royalty and concession fee details. The news is a project milestone, not near-term production impact.

title: Omani firm set to produce copper, gold from OMCO legacy assets
summary: Oman’s Green Tech Mining & Services, backed by OMCO, plans to move from pilots to commercial production by reprocessing OMCO legacy sites. It targets copper output from 15 million tonnes of tailings and contaminated groundwater in Suhar starting from late 2023, with further ramp and gold production in 2024. Invested in a copper tailings remediation plant.

title: Mining Stock News: Lion Copper and Gold (TSXV: LEO) Announces Amendment of Stage 2 Program of Work Agreement
summary: Lion Copper and Gold extended Stage 2b of its option earn-in agreement with Rio Tinto’s Nuton copper leach technologies for work toward a pre-feasibility study at the Yerington copper project. Rio Tinto plans to fund Stage 3 advances after Stage 2a, supporting development assessment but not immediate output.

title: Mining Stock News: Sonoran Desert Copper Corporation (TSXV: SDCU) Announces that the TSX Venture Exchange Approves the Cuatro Hermanos Project Acquisition
summary: TSX Venture Exchange approval allows Sonoran Desert Copper to acquire the Cuatro Hermanos concessions under an exploration-right assignment agreement. The project is a copper/molybdenum porphyry in Sonora, Mexico, with planned payments and work expenditures. The filing is pending a NI 43-101 report, signaling progress toward development.

title: Kazakh miner ERG plans $800 million revamp of DRC copper, cobalt mine
summary: ERG plans to invest $800 million to revamp its Comide copper-cobalt mine in the DRC, including a hydrometallurgical plant and mine development. Output expansion toward ~120,000 tonnes of copper cathode annually is targeted for completion by end-2025, implying limited immediate supply impact and likely little near-term copper price pressure.

title: Aluminium Demand Gets Boost From Backlog In Aircraft Production
summary: The piece argues aluminum demand is being supported by a growing aircraft backlog as air travel rebounds and production lags. Aerospace manufacturers use large shares of aluminum in aircraft components, and sanctions and supply-chain disruptions raise sourcing challenges, supporting firmer aluminum demand and potentially higher near-term prices.

title: First Quantum's Flagship Copper Mine Wins Approval in Panama
summary: First Quantum’s flagship copper mine in Panama has reportedly received approval. Such approvals typically improve confidence in project development and future copper supply availability, which can support near-term copper sentiment as markets look ahead to potential increases in supply.

title: Aluminum Prices Swing Amid U.S.-EU Tariff Talks
summary: Aluminum prices are described as sideways after an end-September spike and October pullback. The article links price behavior to U.S.-EU discussions on Section 232 aluminum exemptions and possible future tariff action, while noting Russian-origin discounts are being absorbed by buyers and overall price moves remain driven by broader trends.

title: Panama's president gives final approval to major copper mine contract
summary: Panama’s president approved legislation enabling a renewed 20-year contract for First Quantum’s Cobre Panama copper mine. The law guarantees Panama minimum annual income of $375 million and follows changes to limit the subsidiary’s remit to copper and associated minerals. Protests occurred, but officials said it boosts investor confidence.

title: The rush for electric vehicles is changing lives for better and worse in Indonesia's nickel industry
summary: ABC Indonesia reports on IMIP’s expansion and Indonesia’s shift to producing EV battery-grade nickel, citing rising demand tied to electric vehicles. It also documents environmental and health concerns over coal dust, deforestation, and contested HPAL waste and sea discharge rules, creating both supply-supportive and risk-bearing narratives.

title: Pairs in Focus This Week – S&P 500, EUR/USD, USD/CAD, Copper
summary: The piece notes copper has declined for several weeks and is testing $3.50 support. If $3.50 breaks, it could quickly move toward $3.25. A modest relief rally is possible only on a move above $3.65, while $4.00 is framed as a ceiling.

title: Home | Asean Nickel & Chromium & Manganese & Stainless Steel Industry Chain Summit 2023  | 28-29 November 2023
summary: The conference description highlights that nickel prices have been pressured by a full-scale surplus: increased Indonesian ferronickel supply and strong refined nickel output in China led to supply-demand imbalance and continued price declines. It also notes related cost declines for stainless steel and mentions upcoming discussions on nickel-market dynamics.

title: Copper dips amid Middle East worries, rising stocks
summary: Copper prices opened lower on Monday as Middle East conflict concerns intensified after fears Israel-Hamas could broaden, while LME/SHFE copper stocks rose. Three-month LME copper fell 0.4% and Shanghai December copper dropped 0.8%. Aluminium also dipped slightly; nickel was slightly higher.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Nickel Market On October 23_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: The SMM morning note cites stronger-than-expected US retail sales but a higher December Fed hike probability, with a USD spike then retreat and commodity pressure. For nickel, new electrowinning capacity is ramping, imports of nickel plates keep declining, and demand weakens amid reduced 300-series output and lower downstream orders. Prices seen weak but stable this week.

title: SHFE aluminium to stabilise, eyes on whether social inventory will fall_SMM
summary: SMM reports SHFE aluminium seen stabilising as China’s supply stays steady, with new Inner Mongolia capacity expected to start and no major smelter cuts anticipated. Downstream demand was average, while real-estate-linked caution weighed on construction extrusion. However, social aluminium ingot inventory fell 10,000 mt, supporting prices.

title: Copper falls on geopolitical risks, rising stocks
summary: Copper prices fell as investors worried that the Israel-Hamas war could broaden in the Middle East, while LME inventories rose and Chinese import demand improved. Softer copper demand indicators were also noted. Aluminium also dipped alongside the broader metals move, reflecting risk-off sentiment.

title: China's market woes weigh on Copper and Aussie
summary: China’s Shanghai index continued falling below 3000, and arrests/investigations involving Foxconn and related risk sentiment weighed on foreign investors. Despite optimistic GDP/retail/industrial data, the bearish mood dragged copper toward last week’s low near 3.5129, warning a break could accelerate selling.

title: Govt rolls out mandatory norms for copper products, drums, tin containers
summary: India’s government issued mandatory BIS quality norms for copper products (and also drums/tins) under Quality Control Orders, effective six months after publication. Products cannot be produced, sold, imported, or stocked without a BIS mark. The stated aim is to curb imports of substandard goods and boost domestic manufacturing, supporting compliant copper demand.

title: As of 15:00 CST October 23, the SMM copper cathode spot trading intensity index was decrease111.16, a decrease of 53.32 from the day before _SMM
summary: SMM data shows that, as of 15:00 CST on Oct. 23, the copper cathode spot trading intensity index fell by 111.16, down 53.32 from the previous day. The update reflects reduced spot trading activity in copper cathodes, suggesting weaker near-term demand sentiment.

title: Downside Space for Nickel Sulfate May be Limited_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports battery-grade nickel sulfate prices stabilizing around 32,000–33,000 yuan/ton, with wider price ranges. Raw materials remain tight and high, providing strong cost support tied to the LME nickel coefficient, but electro-nickel buyers face losses and procurement stagnates, limiting demand and constraining downside.

title: Govt rolls out mandatory quality norms for copper products, drums, tin containers
summary: India’s DPIIT issued mandatory BIS quality norms for copper products (including wire rods, solid drawn copper and copper tubes) and for drums and tin containers, effective six months after notification. Goods without BIS marks cannot be produced, sold, traded, imported or stocked, aimed at curbing substandard imports and boosting compliant domestic manufacturing.

title: Copper Drops to Lowest Since November as Demand Outlook Darkens
summary: Copper prices dropped to the lowest level since November as market sentiment turned toward a darker demand outlook. The move suggests investors are repricing near-term consumption expectations, likely weighing on copper fundamentals in the coming days as trading reacts to weaker demand signals.

title: South32 Q1 Alumina Production Increases; Maintains Annual Production Guidance
summary: South32 said Q1 alumina production rose to 1.29 million tonnes from 1.26 million tonnes a year earlier, with sequential growth of 3%. Quarterly aluminium output increased to 288,000 tonnes from 279,000 tonnes, also rising sequentially. The company maintained annual guidance amid continued low-carbon aluminium growth.

title: Copper hits 11-month low, focus on China and Middle East
summary: Copper prices fell to 11-month lows as China’s property crisis and fading hopes for stimulus reduced demand expectations, while Middle East conflict risk hurt sentiment. Traders also pointed to rising SHFE and LME warehouse inventories weighing on prices. The article notes three-month aluminium was down 0.7%, reflecting broader industrial-metals weakness.

title: Carolina Rush Commences Drilling at Brewer Gold-Copper Project
summary: Carolina Rush Corporation begins a 2,000-meter core drilling program at its Brewer Gold-Copper Project. The company aims to expand known copper mineralization and test new zones, citing prior drill results with copper grades near 0.15–0.27%. No aluminium-related developments are mentioned.

title: Excelsior Mining Provides Update on Mining Activities at Gunnison and JCM Copper Projects
summary: Excelsior Mining updated activities at its Gunnison Copper Project and Johnson Camp Mine (JCM), highlighting ongoing leaching tests using Nuton technology, progress on Nutonrelated work within budget, and completed well-stimulation modelling to improve flow and recovery. Construction could start in H1 2024 subject to approvals and working capital.

title: Russia's Nornickel: Q3 nickel output higher q/q, palladium output drops -October 23, 2023 at 08:48 am EDT
summary: Russia’s Nornickel said Q3 nickel output rose 21% quarter-on-quarter to 53,945 tonnes, boosting near-term supply expectations for a major nickel producer. Full-year guidance remains intact. Although Western suppliers avoiding Russia could create longer-term operational constraints, the reported production increase is supportive for nickel.

title: Mining and Metallurgical Norilsk Nickel : Nornickel announces Consolidated Production Results for 9M 2023 -October 23, 2023 at 08:52 am EDT
summary: Norilsk Nickel reported consolidated 9M 2023 production results. Nickel output fell 9% y/y to 145 kt due to scheduled furnace repairs and concentration grinding mill maintenance. Copper output fell 4% y/y to 304 kt mainly from cathode-quality adjustments. Q3 showed q-o-q increases for both metals.

title: SK Nexilis' first copper foil shipment bodes well for Sabah's ambitions, says Minister
summary: Sabah’s minister said SK Nexilis Malaysia’s first export of copper foil is a milestone toward making the state export-focused. The inaugural shipment ceremony at its Kota Kinabalu industrial park highlights growing copper-foil export activity, which may marginally improve supply expectations for copper in the near term.

title: Copper touches lowest since November as demand outlook darkens
summary: Copper prices slid as much as 1.2% to $7,856/tonne on the LME, the lowest since November, as borrowing costs rose and industrial spending slowed. The move broke below a long-held tight trading range. Prices later recovered some losses but ended near unchanged, reflecting weak demand expectations.

title: Canada Nickel : Investor Presentation - October 2023 -October 23, 2023 at 04:41 pm EDT
summary: Canada Nickel’s investor presentation emphasizes the Crawford nickel sulphide project’s economics, permitting progress, and potential production scale, including carbon capture-related incentives. It argues medium/long-term nickel supply is constrained outside Indonesia/China and positions Crawford as a new source. The update is likely supportive for nickel sentiment in the short term.

title: Century Aluminum Reaches Agreement on New Three-Year Mt. Holly Power Contract
summary: Century Aluminum said it reached final approval on a new three-year electricity contract with South Carolina’s Santee Cooper for its Mt. Holly aluminum smelter. The 295MW power deal starts Jan. 1, 2024 and runs through Dec. 2026, helping maintain operations at current capacity and reduce curtailment risk.

title: Nickel Sulfate Quotation Stable_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that on Oct 23, the battery-grade nickel sulfate index was 32109 yuan/ton, up 1 yuan from the prior working day. The battery-grade range stayed at 32000–33000 yuan/ton. Even with weaker nickel prices, a high raw-material coefficient and cautious downstream buying kept quotations stable.

title: Russia's Rusal in $262 mln deal to buy stake in Chinese alumina firm
summary: Rusal agreed to buy a 30% stake in Chinese alumina producer Hebei Wenfeng New Materials for about $262 million, pending approvals. The investment would secure roughly 1.44 million tons of alumina to offset Russia’s shortage caused by Australia’s export ban, supporting Rusal’s aluminium production.

title: Aluminium-maker Hydro Q3 lags forecast
summary: Norwegian aluminium producer Hydro said third-quarter adjusted core profit fell more than expected and warned that aluminium markets are challenging and uncertain. Reuters notes LME aluminium cash was slightly higher at the time of reporting, but the earnings miss and cautious outlook can weigh on near-term sentiment around aluminium prices.

title: Teck Resources misses quarterly profit estimates, trims copper output forecast
summary: Teck Resources reported weaker-than-expected quarterly profit and cut its 2023 copper production outlook to 320,000–365,000 tonnes from 330,000–375,000. It also raised QB2 Chile project capital cost guidance amid cost and risk pressures. The update likely worsens near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Anglo American Lowers Copper Output View Despite Rise in Production
summary: Anglo American reported higher Q3 copper output but slightly cut its full-year copper production guidance to 830,000–870,000 tons from 840,000–930,000, citing ore hardness and an electrical substation fire at Chile’s Los Bronces mine. Realized copper prices rose, but supply outlook worsened for 2023.

title: Anglo American Q3 Copper Equivalent Production Edges Down
summary: Anglo American said Q3 copper-equivalent production fell 1% year on year but rose 4% sequentially. Copper output increased 42% on Quellaveco ramp-up, while Chile production dropped 4%. Nickel output declined 7% due to lower grades; guidance shifts were modest versus prior estimates.

title: Nickel and cobalt - in hot demand - Mittelstand Cafe
summary: The piece argues that clean-energy and electric-car growth will sharply increase nickel demand for batteries. It says Indonesia wants to become an industrial heavyweight by processing its large nickel resources domestically and references strong competition among buyers and processing concentrated in China. Overall, it implies supportive near-term nickel price sentiment.

title: Anglo American Quarterly Copper Output Jumped; Coal and Diamond Fell Sharply -- Commodity Comment
summary: Anglo American said Q3 copper production rose 42% overall, including higher output from Peru’s Quellaveco and gains at Collahuasi and El Soldado, partially offset by declines in Chile due to ore hardness and an electrical substation fire. summary: SMM reported that its copper cathode spot trading intensity index as of 15:00 CST on Oct 30 declined to 56.6, down 28.17 from the prior day. The publication presents this as reference data, suggesting reduced spot trading activity in the copper market.

title: From Copper Crisis to Opportunity with Solaris Resources' (TSX:SLS) Warintza Project
summary: The piece argues copper faces tightening supply amid demand growth, pointing to near-term disruptions such as Peru protests affecting mining output. It emphasizes a persistent copper shortfall risk and increased interest in new projects, including Solaris Resources’ Warintza, suggesting supportive sentiment for copper prices over the near term.

title: Virgin Islands Warns St. Croix Tap Water Contaminated With Lead And Copper
summary: Authorities in the U.S. Virgin Islands warned residents on St. Croix not to drink tap water after tests found high levels of lead and copper. The Water and Power Authority is flushing water lines and conducting additional tests to determine the source and scope of contamination. The issue stems from earlier late-September testing.

title: First Quantam's giant Panama copper mine faces referendum on future
summary: Panama will hold a referendum on whether to revoke First Quantum’s licence for the Cobre Panama copper mine after widespread unrest. The renewed 20-year contract sparked protests, highway blocks and legal challenges. Political risk around copper output threatens supply expectations, contributing to selling pressure.

title: Ero Copper Agrees with Vale Base Metals to Enter into Earn-in Agreement for a 60% Interest in the Furnas Copper Project
summary: Ero Copper agreed with Vale Base Metals on an earn-in deal to gain 60% of the Furnas copper project in Brazil’s Carajás region. Ero will fund staged exploration and studies, with Vale retaining an option for free carry and offtake rights. News boosts copper project outlook but not immediate supply.

title: DORÉ COPPER MINING CORP: Doré Copper Reports Excellent Concentrate Grades and Recoveries With Low Impurity Element Concentrations From Flotation Tests at Its Corner Bay Project
summary: Doré Copper Mining reported lock-cycle flotation test results for its Corner Bay copper-gold project, citing copper recoveries up to 98.2% and concentrate grades up to 29.6% with low deleterious impurities. The company says results support the planned ore-sorting and flotation flowsheet for its feasibility study.

title: Arizona Sonoran Copper Company Inc. Announces Drill Assays from 5 Holes At Cactus East and 4 from Parks/Salyer
summary: Arizona Sonoran Copper Company announced new drill assay results from holes at its Cactus East and Parks/Salyer properties and began exploratory drilling at the MainSpring area. The company highlights continuity and grade in oxide/enriched zones. This is copper-specific but likely too small for near-term global price moves.

title: Class 1 Nickel Reports Multiple Diamond Drill Hole
summary: Class 1 Nickel reported assay results from 2022–2023 diamond drilling at its Somanike Ni-Cu sulphide project near the former Marbridge mine in Quebec, including multiple nickel intersections above cut-off grades. It also notes associated copper/PGE mineralization and generates new geophysical drill targets.

title: Panama protestors break into copper mine port
summary: Activists broke into the Puntan Rincón port used to ship copper from Minera Panamá’s Cobre Panamá mine amid widespread protests after a new mining concession was approved. Operations and safety are threatened, and Panama’s Supreme Court is considering a constitutional challenge, with an opinion due in about ten business days.

title: Copper Extends Weekly Gain as Global Metal Inventories Decline
summary: The article’s headline says copper is extending a weekly gain as global metal inventories decline. Lower inventory levels usually signal tighter nearby availability, improving market balance and supporting upward expectations for copper prices over the next days to weeks.

title: SMM Morning Comment For Copper Market On October 31_SMM | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports LME and SHFE copper prices ended higher, with attention on macro data (slower German inflation, weaker GDP, lower US borrowing forecast) and expectations of a Fed pause. Copper inventories in China’s mainstream areas fell to a new yearly low, though demand may soften as prices rise and cash flow tightens.

title: Nickel odium: critics pan BoE role in LME meltdown
summary: The article examines the 2022 nickel trading disruption on the LME, when nickel prices surged and large nickel trades were cancelled. Critics argue the UK’s supervisory model and the Bank of England’s role may have failed. It focuses on regulatory accountability rather than new immediate drivers for nickel fundamentals.

title: CopperString project receives $1.3 billion from the Queensland government | Queensland Country Life
summary: Queensland approved $1.3 billion for the CopperString transmission project to secure easements and advance construction toward a mid-2024 start. The 500/330/220 kV lines and new substations will procure significant transmission equipment and involve extensive works, implying incremental copper demand support for near-term pricing.

title: Aluminium Smelters In Yunnan Province Are Now Subject To Renewed Output Cuts Just About Two Months After They Have Recovered From Previous Production Cutbacks_SMM
summary: Yunnan aluminium smelters face renewed dry-season output cuts after prior curtailments. Provincial authorities plan to manage industrial electricity demand as the dry season approaches. SMM says four smelters will cut capacity by 9%-40%, totaling ~1.15 million mt, potentially lowering daily output from ~15,000 to ~12,000 mt, affecting domestic supply in early 2024.

title: As of 15:00 CST October 31, the SMM copper cathode spot trading intensity index was decrease35.14, a decrease of 21.46 from the day before _SMM
summary: SMM data at 15:00 CST on Oct. 31 show the copper cathode spot trading intensity index decreased by 21.46 from the previous day (to -35.14). The lower index points to weaker spot market participation and activity, which can weigh on short-term copper price expectations.

title: QC Copper Closes Its Acquisition of 10% Interest in Ontario's Largest Copper Resource, Thierry Copper Mine
summary: QC Copper closed a deal acquiring a 10% interest in Cuprum, which owns the Thierry copper mine in Ontario. title: Canadian Critical Minerals Inc. Completes Sale of Controlling Interest in Thierry Copper Mine
summary: Canadian Critical Minerals completed the sale of a controlling 61% interest in its Cuprum subsidiary holding the Thierry copper mine to Orecap, with CCMI retaining 39%. Proceeds are used to discharge a loan and fund exploration, including copper resource expansion milestones. No immediate production impact is stated.

title: Orecap Invest Corp.: Orecap Closes Acquisition of Ontario's Largest Copper Resource, Thierry Copper Mine
summary: Orecap Invest Corp. closed a controlling stake acquisition in Ontario’s Thierry Copper Mine, described as the province’s largest primary copper resource. The release cites new drill intercepts supporting near-surface expansion potential and mentions historical Ni content in prior operations and PEA estimates. No immediate production or delivery changes are reported.

title: Orecap Closes Acquisition of Ontario's Largest Copper Resource, Thierry Copper Mine
summary: Orecap Invest Corp. completed the acquisition of a controlling interest in the Thierry copper mine in Ontario, described as the province’s largest primary copper resource. The release highlights recent underground drilling intercepts and a prior PEA with projected copper and some nickel production, but no near-term output change.

title: VR samples widespread high-grade copper-silver mineralization at New Boston in Nevada, and submits drill permit application to the BLM.
summary: VR Resources reported widespread high-grade copper-silver mineralization at its New Boston porphyry project in Nevada and submitted a BLM Notice of Intent to drill. The results are grab-sample based and non-production, so the update is more likely to marginally support copper sentiment than drive immediate copper price moves over days to weeks.

title: Ero signs deal to earn into Vale's Brazilian copper project
summary: Ero Copper agreed with Vale Base Metals to earn a 60% stake in the Furnas copper project in Brazil through phased exploration, engineering and development milestones over five years, with sole funding by Ero and a free carry on future construction. The news supports longer-term supply expectations but not near-term output changes.

title: China manufacturing data weighs on copper market sentiment
summary: Copper fell Tuesday as weak October China manufacturing data renewed demand concerns, prompting selling despite support from a softer dollar and falling LME/cross-exchange stocks. The article notes aluminium also slipped and nickel retreated, indicating broader base-metal sentiment tied to China’s industrial outlook.

title: World Bank: Copper Prices Will Fall Further In 2024 Before Rebounding In 2025, Main Demand Drivers In Coming Years Will Come From Electric Vehicles, Renewable Energy And Related Grid Infrastructure_SMM
summary: The World Bank’s Commodity Market Outlook says copper prices dropped in 3Q 2023 from sufficient supply, higher inventories, and weak demand. It projects another ~5% decline in 2024 on weak demand and strong supply growth, with a rebound in 2025 driven by recovery and clean-tech demand.

title: Chinese wire rod giant Amer to wind up Shanghai copper trading book - sources
summary: Reuters reports Amer International’s Shanghai copper trading unit Arc Resources is closing its order book and terminating many copper contracts for the rest of 2023 due to financial stress from China’s troubled property sector. The unit is also seeking buyers for Africa-origin cathodes and diverting cathode tonnages, suggesting added near-term copper supply.

title: Falcon Gold Corp.: Falcon Gold Expands Ground In Great Burnt Copper District, Central Newfoundland
summary: Falcon Gold acquired 91 claims (2,275 hectares) in Newfoundland’s Great Burnt Copper District, an area described as copper-rich and hosting Besshi-type massive sulphide resources. The company cites historic drilling with high copper grades and says exploration and drill plans are in permitting, without any immediate production or supply impact.

title: DMCI nets P20b as coal, nickel prices normalize
summary: DMCI Holdings reported lower first-nine-month net income, attributing the drop partly to coal and nickel prices “normalizing.” The firm cited China’s economic slowdown and global oversupply as reasons for double-digit contractions in nickel index prices, while power businesses offset some losses.

title: Falcon Gold Expands Ground In Great Burnt Copper District, Central Newfoundland
summary: Falcon Gold acquired 91 claims in Newfoundland’s Great Burnt Copper District, hosting copper-rich massive sulphides. The belt has an indicated copper resource and historic drilling reported high-grade copper intervals. The company is preparing for permitting and future exploration, with no immediate production or inventory impact.

title: Mining Stock News: QC Copper (TSXV: QCCU) (OTCQB: QCCUF) Closes Its Acquisition of 10% Interest in Ontario's Largest Copper Resource, Thierry Copper Mine
summary: QC Copper closed an acquisition for a 10% interest in a private company owning Ontario’s Thierry copper mine project. The asset is described as large and infrastructure-ready, with drilling intersections reported as copper (plus minor nickel). The news is corporate/development oriented and does not indicate immediate production or supply changes.

title: Taseko Mines Announces that the UIC Permit for Florence Copper is now Effective
summary: Taseko Mines said the US EPA has confirmed no appeals and that the final Underground Injection Control (UIC) permit for its Florence Copper project is now effective. The permit approval clears a major regulatory hurdle toward commissioning a planned low-cost copper cathode production source in Arizona, supporting copper expectations.

title: Press Release - The Northern Miner
summary: Sandbox Royalties announced acquisitions of gold purchase and royalty/stream assets, including a 1.0% GRR on Southern Copper’s El Pilar project and a partial NSR royalty on Artemis Gold’s Blackwater. These transactions may affect expectations for copper-related cash flows, but there is no immediate operational or supply change described for copper or aluminium.

title: Copper slides as China manufacturing slowdown dents demand outlook
summary: Copper prices fell as China’s manufacturing activity missed expectations, with Caixin/S&P and official data pointing to weaker demand prospects. Higher Chilean copper output added to supply concerns. The article reports LME and Shanghai copper contracts easing, ahead of U.S. data and a Fed meeting.

title: China's Yunnan begins aluminium production cuts as dry season begins
summary: Yunnan’s aluminium smelters began cutting output this week to comply with electricity curbs expected to last until April. The cuts target 9%–40% of capacity, reducing about 1.15 million tonnes, as the dry season and hydropower shortages constrain production.

title: Metso Outotec Oyj : receives orders for three copper anode casting shops -November 01, 2023 at 03:05 am EDT
summary: Metso Outotec said it received EUR 13 million of orders for three copper anode casting shops from major copper producers in Japan and China. The projects include engineering and fully electric, automated anode casting technology used to produce most world copper anodes, supporting copper smelting capacity and quality.

title: Taseko Mines Limited - Taseko: UIC Permit for Florence Copper now Effective -November 01, 2023 at 03:01 am EDT
summary: Taseko said the U.S. EPA confirmed no appeals were received and the final Underground Injection Control (UIC) permit for its Florence Copper project is now effective. The company views this as enabling a clear path to commercial production of projected low-cost copper cathode, which can support copper price sentiment.

title: POSCO, Lotte to cooperate in copper foil business
summary: POSCO International and Lotte Energy Materials signed an MoU for POSCO to supply 600,000 tons of copper over 10 years for copper foil used to cover battery anodes. POSCO will also sell mill-berry and granulated copper scrap to Lotte. The deal supports stable demand for copper foil materials.

title: As of 15:00 CST November 1, the SMM copper cathode spot trading intensity index was decrease15.07, a decrease of 20.07 from the day before _SMM
summary: SMM reports that, as of 15:00 CST on November 1, its copper cathode spot trading intensity index fell by 20.07 to 15.07 versus the previous day. The data is stated as reference only, but the decline suggests reduced spot market activity and near-term demand softness for copper.

title: T2 Metals Intersects Copper-Zinc Massive Sulphide at the Sherridon VHMS Project, Manitoba
summary: T2 Metals announced completion of a 12-hole drill program at its Sherridon copper-zinc VHMS project in Manitoba, with 9 holes intersecting intervals containing >20% chalcopyrite and/or sphalerite. The company is logging and sampling with assays pending. No production or verified copper output changes were stated.

title: T2 Metals Corp.: T2 Metals Intersects Copper-Zinc Massive Sulphide at the Sherridon VHMS Project, Manitoba
summary: T2 Metals completed a 12-hole, 1,500m drill program at its Sherridon copper-zinc VHMS project in Manitoba, with 9 of 12 holes intersecting >20% chalcopyrite or sphalerite and near-surface massive/semi-massive sulphides. Assay results are pending and no production or market impacts are stated.

title: Stantec : awarded C$16-million contract to provide mining tailings management for global copper mines -November 01, 2023 at 06:46 am EDT
summary: Stantec was awarded a C$16 million engineering and technical services contract by Codelco to support tailings management at multiple copper deposits in Chile, including reviews of third-party engineering deliverables and evaluation of thicker/paste/filtered tailings technologies. The work supports safe, sustainable copper mining but does not signal immediate supply shocks.

title: Orecap acquires stake in Cuprum
summary: Orecap Invest acquired a 45% stake in Cuprum, which owns the past-producing Thierry copper mine in Ontario. CCMI will receive warrants and milestone payments tied to NI 43-101 resource expansions. CCMI also uses proceeds to fund the Bull River Mine loan. Thierry includes copper and nickel.

title: Mosaic Minerals Starts Drilling on Gaboury Nickel
summary: Mosaic Minerals begins a minimum 2,000-meter drilling program at its Gaboury nickel project in Quebec to assess nickel potential in the Pike Nickel zones. Results from earlier drilling indicated ultramafic rocks with up to ~1% nickel-bearing sulfides. The release also notes lithium exploration work.

title: Visionary Metals Corp.: Visionary Metals Provides King Solomon Nickel Project Update Including Site Visit with State and Federal Lawmakers
summary: Visionary Metals announced progress at its King Solomon nickel project in Wyoming, completing over 3,000 m of RC drilling with reported nickel-cobalt intersections (e.g., 0.23% Ni over 44 m) and battery-grade nickel sulfides. The update is exploratory and does not indicate production or near-term supply changes.

title: Visionary Metals Provides King Solomon Nickel Project Update Including Site Visit with State and Federal Lawmakers
summary: Visionary Metals reports it has completed over 3,000 m of reverse circulation drilling and found nickel mineralization at its King Solomon project in Wyoming, including a 44 m interval of 0.23% nickel and 17 m of 0.43% nickel, plus battery-grade nickel sulfides. It also highlights ongoing drilling plans.

title: Verofax Wins at Emirates Global Aluminum Ramp-Up Programme 2023
summary: Verofax was selected in Emirates Global Aluminum’s ramp-up programme. The article links the initiative to the EU’s Carbon Border Tax rules, which can impose up to 35% tariffs on non-compliant high-emission exports such as aluminum. It argues this creates opportunity for low-emission UAE exporters and EGA trade competitiveness.

title: Extrusion Aluminum Trade Remedy Update - International Trade & Investment
summary: A U.S. trade remedy petition (antidumping and countervailing duties) was filed on Oct. 4, 2023, targeting alleged dumped and subsidized extrusion aluminum imports from 15 countries, covering more than $3 billion in accused shipments. The update notes recent Commerce initiation and ITC procedural developments.

title: Bears bet big that nickel can close the product gap
summary: Bears are heavily positioned short on LME nickel, with the 3-month price around $18,000/t after a steep slide this year. The International Nickel Study Group forecasts rising supply surpluses due to Indonesia’s rapid output growth. While Indonesia’s processing may improve LME deliverability, timing remains uncertain.

title: Copper Miner First Quantum Has Lost Half of Its Value This Week
summary: BNN Bloomberg highlights that copper miner First Quantum has lost roughly half its value over the week. While the excerpt doesn’t detail specific production disruptions, the stock collapse suggests growing market worry about the company’s prospects, potentially pressuring expectations for near-term copper supply and sentiment.

title: Flying Nickel Closes First Tranche Private Placement for Proceeds of $207,166
summary: Flying Nickel Mining Corp. closed the first tranche of a non-brokered private placement, raising $207,166 by issuing 2.30 million shares at $0.09. Proceeds will fund exploration and general working capital for its Minago nickel project in Manitoba. The update is company-specific and not tied to immediate supply changes.

title: Sibanye-Stillwater set to take over Mt Lyell copper mine | The Examiner
summary: Sibanye-Stillwater says it will exercise its option to acquire the idle Mt Lyell copper mine in Tasmania and is undertaking feasibility work to restart the operation. title: Sibanye-Stillwater to purchase Tasmnanian copper mine | The Advocate
summary: Sibanye-Stillwater confirmed it will exercise its option to purchase the Mt Lyell copper mine in Tasmania, where a feasibility study is underway to reopen the idle underground operation. summary: Sibanye-Stillwater confirmed it will exercise an option to buy Tasmania’s Mt Lyell copper mine and is conducting a feasibility study for reopening. summary: Reuters discusses LME nickel bears increasing net shorts to the biggest since 2018, alongside an INSG outlook for large and widening global nickel oversupply driven by Indonesian mined production growth. Yet it notes Indonesia’s shift toward higher-purity Class I output and LME brand approvals that may close the product gap, making timing uncertain.

title: Key Takeaway From SMM Metal Industry Annual Conference: Evolvement Of China Aluminum Capacity _SMM
summary: SMM’s conference takeaway outlines China’s aluminum capacity reaching near-maximum levels, with operating rates recovering and Yunnan largely resuming production. Despite earlier energy-constraint disruptions, output is now near full capacity, increasing operating availability. The piece highlights persistent southwest supply pressure, which likely limits aluminum price upside.

title: Indonesia: New "Catastrophic" Footage Shows Uncontacted Tribe Near Nickel Mine
summary: A new video shows an uncontacted Indigenous tribe in Indonesia warning outsiders to stay away as bulldozers destroy nearby rainforest on Halmahera. summary: Ivanhoe Mines reports an updated greenhouse gas assessment confirming Kamoa-Kakula as a lowest-carbon major copper mine, with a planned 46% intensity reduction after its on-site direct-to-blister smelter and increased hydropower from Inga II Turbine #5 (expected Q4 2024). summary: Teck Australia entered an option deal to acquire Redbank West copper tenements in Northern Australia from NT Minerals. summary: Star Royalties says it has closed the restructuring of its “Copperstone” stream. summary: Southern Copper’s call reviews copper market dynamics: LME copper is up year-on-year, but the market is expected to be in a surplus (~170,000 tons) with inventories rising 24% since June. summary: Ero Copper reported Q3 2023 operating results, including 10,766 tonnes of copper production and reaffirmed full-year copper guidance, with cost updates reflecting a stronger BRL. title: Panama lawmakers scrap plan to annul copper mine concession
summary: Panamanian lawmakers will not include annulment of the Cobre Panama copper mine concession in new legislation, shifting efforts toward a broader ban on new mining concessions. summary: The article argues Indonesia’s nickel downstreaming is overly dependent on China’s investments, smelter partnerships, and market demand. title: Copper set for second straight weekly gain on softer dollar
summary: Copper gained for a second straight week as a weaker U.S. dollar supported commodities amid subdued sentiment after poor Chinese economic data. LME aluminium rose modestly and LME nickel edged higher alongside broader risk-driven moves, suggesting macro/FX factors dominated rather than fresh metal-specific fundamentals.

title: First Quantum to Keep Churning Out Copper Despite Panama Turmoil
summary: The piece says First Quantum plans to keep producing copper even as turmoil in Panama continues. That suggests the company is managing operational risk and reducing the likelihood of an immediate supply shock. Near-term copper price impact is therefore likely limited, with direction uncertain without output figures.

title: Panama Congress Backtracks on Plan to Void Copper Mine Contract
summary: Panama Congress backtracked on a proposal to void a copper mine contract. By avoiding potential legal or operational disruption to the mine, the move likely reduces near-term supply uncertainty. That supports sentiment for copper prices in the coming days and weeks, even without more details on output or timing.

title: Ero Copper Reports Third Quarter 2023 Operating and Financial Results
summary: Ero Copper reported Q3 2023 results, including 10,766 tonnes of copper production at Caraíba and reaffirmed full-year copper production guidance. Management noted weaker metal prices and a stronger Brazilian real affected financials, and described FX hedging. The update is mainly company-specific with limited immediate broader copper-market impact.

title: US Virgin Islands declares state of emergency after lead and copper found in tap water in St Croix
summary: US Virgin Islands declared an emergency in St Croix after tests found tap water containing lead and copper. Officials warned residents not to drink or use it for cooking, though showering and cleaning are considered safe. The territory froze bottled-water and related product prices while sampling continues and federal help is requested.

title: Thor Energy Increases Its Interest In Alford East Copper Oxide Project To 80%
summary: Reuters reports Thor Energy Plc increased its interest in the Alford East copper oxide project to 80%. The update is a company ownership change related to future copper production, but the excerpt provides no immediate operational or supply timing details that would likely move copper prices in the near term.

title: North Maluku tribe fights to protect forest from nickel mining
summary: Members of the Hongana Manyawa tribe in North Maluku blocked heavy equipment entering the Aki Sangaji River to stop logging tied to nickel mining at Mount Topu Blewen. The protests have disrupted activity since 2020, with deforestation and water contamination reported, raising potential near-term supply risk for nickel.

title: Russia's Nornickel board recommends dividend, approves stock split
summary: Norilsk Nickel said its board recommended a nine-month dividend of 915.33 roubles per share and approved a stock split to boost liquidity. The company previously skipped 2022 dividends citing negative geopolitics. The news is primarily about corporate actions, with no stated change to nickel production or supply.

title: Capstone Copper Corp.: Capstone Copper Reports Third Quarter 2023 Results
summary: Capstone reported Q3 2023 results, with copper production of 40.3 kt impacted by unplanned downtime and maintenance, and guidance reiterated for H2 output of 83–93 kt. title: Capstone Copper Reports Third Quarter 2023 Results
summary: Capstone Copper reported Q3 2023 results including copper production of 40.3 kt, higher C1 cash costs, and impacts from unplanned downtime and maintenance. title: Russia's Nornickel Resumes Dividend Payout, Plans Share Split
summary: Russia’s Nornickel says it is resuming dividend payments and plans a share split. As a key nickel producer, the move signals improved profitability/cash flow prospects, which can bolster market confidence and support near-term nickel demand/supply expectations.

summary: SMM says China’s domestic aluminum ingot stocks jumped to 657,000 mt (highest in nearly six months), with accumulation driven by backlog shipments after transport recovery, continued imported ingot inflows despite the spot import window, and weak downstream demand. Off-season pressure and reduced production reinforce supply overhang in coming weeks.

title: Copper prices gain as weaker dollar offsets rising stocks
summary: LME three-month copper rose about 0.3% to $8,164.5/mt as a weaker U.S. dollar after key U.S. data supported prices, offsetting bearish pressure from higher exchange-registered copper inventories. Copper’s year-to-date weakness persists on softer China demand expectations. LME aluminium also gained.

title: Barrick CEO questions value of Teck's biggest copper project
summary: Barrick CEO Mark Bristow questioned the value of Teck’s Quebrada Blanca 2 copper project after Teck increased expected capital costs again to about $8.6–$8.8 billion. The article links overruns and delays to concerns over low-grade economics, potentially denting near-term copper supply sentiment.

title: Copper's Shifting Significance: From Economic Health To Green Energy
summary: A column discusses whether copper’s “Dr. Copper” role as an economy bellwether is fading as green-energy demand rises. title: Why might Panama cancel a copper mine contract?
summary: Panama’s abrupt moves around First Quantum’s Cobre Panama contract—via referendum/proposed law and ongoing court review—spark investor alarm and raise fears over copper supply from the mine (~1% of global output).
