summary: European Aluminium urges the EU to expand sanctions on Russia beyond bans on certain Russian aluminium products, advocating inclusion of Russian primary aluminium metal. It notes most Russian aluminium exports to the EU remain outside current measures, and highlights the EU’s significant import volumes. Additional restrictions could tighten supply in coming weeks.

title: Panama formally orders First Quantum to shut down flagship copper mine
summary: Panama has formally ordered First Quantum to shut down its flagship copper mine. The directive raises concerns about an imminent reduction in copper output and supply availability. Markets typically respond by re-pricing near-term copper supply risk, contributing to downward pressure on copper prices over the next several sessions.

title: Panama Formally Orders First Quantum to Shut Down Flagship Copper Mine
summary: Panama formally ordered First Quantum to shut down its flagship copper mine. The decision raises expectations for a near-term reduction in copper supply and potential disruption to production and exports. Traders would likely price in tighter physical availability and supply risks for copper over coming weeks.

title: Panama Protestors Defeat First Quantum Minerals' Copper Mine
summary: Panama’s Supreme Court ruled First Quantum’s Cobre Panamá copper mine contract unconstitutional due to legal and environmental violations, leading to a shutdown. Protests also blocked sea access and export/equipment logistics. First Quantum is suing Panama internationally. The supply disruption is supportive for short-term copper prices.

title: Australian nickel miners BHP, Wyloo Metals, Chalice Mining relieved after Indonesian fails in bid for access to Inflation Reduction Act incentives
summary: Australian nickel producers (including BHP, Wyloo Metals and Chalice Mining) said they are relieved after the US did not grant Indonesian rivals access to Inflation Reduction Act clean-energy subsidies. Indonesian firms had hoped for subsidy access as soon as this month, but President Widodo failed to secure a deal with Biden.

title: Indonesia Thinks Its Nickel Export Ban Is Working
summary: Indonesia believes its ban on exporting unprocessed nickel is boosting domestic value-added. The country has invested heavily in nickel smelting capacity, with downstream provinces showing double-digit growth. The ban has increased nickel-related export value substantially, suggesting improved supply concentration and near-term supportive conditions for nickel prices.

title: Golden Metal Resources PLC Announces Garfield :High-Grade Copper & Gold Assay Results
summary: Golden Metal Resources announced overlimit assay results from its Garfield project in Nevada, including high-grade copper occurrences (up to 4.27% Cu in reported overlimit samples) alongside gold and silver. The results suggest the project could host a significant copper deposit, boosting bullish sentiment for copper prices.

title: Nornickel : 2023 has been tough, but still not a disaster -December 11, 2023 at 05:06 am EST
summary: Nornickel’s 2023 has been difficult, though not described as a disaster. The article notes trimmed medium-to-long-term estimates and highlights rapid redirection of sales to Asia. By focusing on the company’s nickel revenue and market access rather than a specific disruption, near-term price pressure appears limited.

title: Aluminium hits weakest in more than three months on fund selling
summary: Aluminium prices fell to their weakest in over three months as speculative funds increased selling, driven by expectations of rising LME inventories ahead of the Third Wednesday prompt. Weak China data and a strong dollar pressured the wider metals complex, with copper and nickel also declining.

title: Camino Minerals Corp.: Camino Signs Contract to Commence Copper Exploration Drilling in December at Los Chapitos, Peru
summary: Camino Minerals says it has contracted a rig to complete 2,000 meters of core drilling at its Los Chapitos copper project in Peru, mobilizing mid-December and starting work December 22. The program targets copper oxide and possible sulphide mineralization along the Diva Structural Fault and is funded via an earn-in payment.

title: Tighter supplies to create tailwind for copper prices
summary: Copper on the LME is heading toward four-month highs as Anglo American cut 2026 and 2025 output guidance and put parts of operations in Chile on care and maintenance while adjusting Peru plans. Analysts also flag weaker Vale guidance and potential Cobre Panama restart delays, tightening projected balances.

title: India spent Rs 27,131 cr in FY23 on import of copper: Govt
summary: India’s government said copper import spending rose to Rs 27,131 crore in FY2022-23 from Rs 21,985 crore in FY2021-22, citing low domestic copper reserve availability and higher demand for refining. Growth in construction, telecom, electricals, renewables, and EVs is driving the uptick, potentially tightening supply.

title: Freeport Announces License Renewal for Yandera Copper Project, One of the World's Largest Undeveloped Copper Projects
summary: Freeport announced it has renewed the license for its Yandera copper project, described as one of the world’s largest undeveloped copper assets. While the renewal supports the project’s ability to progress toward development, it is not an immediate production change, so near-term copper price effects are likely modest.

title: Dozens feared dead after landslide buries informal copper miners in Zambia
summary: A landslide at an open-pit copper mine near Chingola on Zambia’s copper belt buried informal miners digging illegal tunnels. Eleven deaths have been confirmed, one survivor recovered, and up to 26 remain missing. Heavy rain also flooded tunnels, requiring pumping and clearing as rescue efforts continue.

title: ValOre Defines Nickel-Copper Sulfide Mineralization in Salvador Drill Core at Pedra Branca PGE Project
summary: ValOre reported assays showing nickel-copper sulfide mineralization in all four 2023 drill holes at its Pedra Branca Salvador target, with grades including ~0.26–0.29% Ni and ~0.10–0.13% Cu over tens of metres. The company says further discovery could add Ni-Cu credits in future estimates.

title: ValOre Defines Nickel-Copper Sulfide Mineralization in Salvador Drill Core at Pedra Branca PGE Project
summary: ValOre Metals reported assay results from four drill holes at its Pedra Branca project, confirming nickel-copper sulfide mineralization with cited Ni grades up to 0.50% and Cu up to 0.18%. The company frames it as exploration upside for future resource estimates; no production or supply disruption changes are mentioned.

title: Aluminium prices fall as funds step up selling of commodity
summary: Aluminium prices fell to a three-month low as CTA/speculative funds increased selling and expectations of rising LME inventories grew. Weak China metals data and a strong U.S. dollar weighed on broader base metals markets. Aluminium is down about 10% since early October, with potential warehouse supply concerns next week. Copper also slipped.

title: Zambia Buries Copper Miners Killed In Mudslide
summary: Zambia buried nine miners killed in a mudslide, while rescuers searched for dozens trapped underground from an incident nearly two weeks earlier. The disaster highlights disruption risk for local copper mining, which can affect near-term expectations for copper output and supply.

title: Peru copper output up nearly 2% in October as Antapaccay surges
summary: Peru’s copper output increased 1.9% in October to 240,097 tonnes year-on-year, driven mainly by a nearly 36% rise at Glencore-controlled Antapaccay and ~7% growth at Southern Copper. Peru is the world’s second-largest copper producer, and the data suggests improving short-term supply conditions.

title: Jubilee Metals in partnership to invest in copper waste rock asset
summary: Jubilee Metals says it secured one of Zambia’s largest copper waste rock assets and partnered with International Resources to fund processing. Preliminary sampling shows >1.5% copper zones. The company expects modular copper units to be constructed within 12 months, targeting >20,000 tpa at low costs.

title: Marubeni expects Japanese aluminium premiums to rise in later 2024
summary: Marubeni expects Japanese aluminium premiums to hold at $75-$95/ton in Q1 2024, then rise later in 2024 as Asian supply tightens and domestic demand firms. Premiums are benchmarked to the LME cash price. A producer’s offers reflect slack demand and high inventories, but tighter supply should support prices.

title: Jubilee Metals forms Zambian copper recovery venture with UAE's IRH
summary: Jubilee Metals partnered with IRH to form a JV for copper waste-rock retreatment at Zambia’s Mopani Copper Mine. IRH will fund the ~US$50m project via equity and shareholder loans. The venture targets processing 350m tonnes of waste rock to produce over 20,000 tpa of copper, with work starting early 2024.

title: Freeport granted licence renewal for PNG copper project
summary: Freeport Resources received PNG approval to renew the exploration licence for its Yandera copper project, covering drilling and studies and allowing progress to a definitive feasibility study and eventual development decisions. The company cited large undeveloped copper resources and potential future supply as copper demand rises.

title: East Star hails open pit potential of Verkuba copper deposit
summary: East Star Resources says drilling at the Verkhuba copper deposit in Kazakhstan confirms multiple mineable, open-pit style ore intervals, with thick mineralisation above a copper-equivalent cut-off. Reported zones are predominantly copper-rich, with some zinc and silver. The update supports development potential but does not signal immediate production.

title: Copper Fox Reports Results of Mineralogical Study for Van Dyke Copper Project
summary: Copper Fox announced results of mineralogical and solubility testwork for its Van Dyke in-situ copper recovery project in Arizona. The study highlights low calcium gangue and iron oxides, which should reduce CO2/gypsum formation during leaching and supports expected acid consumption and copper solubility. Drill core logging has begun.

title: Metso Outotec Oyj : to deliver copper concentrator plant equipment to the Minera Arqueros greenfield project in Chile -December 12, 2023 at 06:05 am EST
summary: Metso Outotec announced it will deliver key equipment for Minera Arqueros’ greenfield copper sulfide concentrator plant in Chile, including crushing, milling, and flotation cells. The order value exceeds EUR 10 million. It reflects copper project investment, but does not signal a near-term supply or demand disruption.

title: Copper Fox Metals Inc.: Copper Fox Reports Results of Mineralogical Study for Van Dyke Copper Project
summary: Copper Fox reported results of mineralogical and solubility testwork for its Van Dyke ISCR copper project in Arizona. The study finds low calcium gangue and iron oxide, with copper minerals largely soluble in leaching solutions, potentially improving leaching kinetics. A geotechnical program is also underway.

title: Copper rises with weaker dollar, tighter supply prospects
summary: Copper prices rose in London as a weaker dollar improved currency buying power and tighter supply prospects next year were reinforced by recent mine closures/disruptions. The piece also cites China stimulus hopes supporting metals demand. Aluminium also gained, while nickel edged lower, suggesting mixed cross-metal performance.

title: As of 15:00 CST December 12, the SMM copper cathode spot trading intensity index was decrease 22.32, a decrease of 10.54 from the day before
summary: SMM data show that the copper cathode spot trading intensity index fell to 22.32 as of 15:00 CST on Dec 12, down 10.54 from the previous day. The report is reference data and suggests reduced copper spot trading activity in the immediate term.

title: Drilling at MTB's Telegraph Project Confirms Mineralization in Line with Golden Triangle Porphyry Copper-Gold Deposits
summary: MTB Metals reports first-hole results from the Telegraph Project in BC’s Golden Triangle, intersecting 107m of 0.38% CuEq and a 6m interval grading 1.07% CuEq, with additional mineralization nearby; assays for two other holes are pending. Results are framed as comparable to local copper-gold porphyries.

title: MTB Metals Corp.: Drilling at MTB's Telegraph Project Confirms Mineralization in Line with Golden Triangle Porphyry Copper-Gold Deposits
summary: MTB Metals reports assay results from its first hole at the Telegraph Project in BC’s Golden Triangle, intersecting 107 m of 0.38% CuEq within broader mineralized intervals and noting additional assays pending. The company frames the results as comparable to regional porphyry copper-gold deposits, but no production impact is indicated.

title: Copper ore processing plant fined over $26,700 for sludge leak in northern Vietnam
summary: Vietnam’s Lao Cai Province fined Ta Phoi Copper JSC after a sludge leak from a copper tailings pond affected local households and farmland. Authorities ordered the plant to stop production, halted environmental outflows the same day, and required relocation and compensation. The incident signals potential near-term copper processing disruption.

title: Solaris secures $80m to support Ecuadorean copper project
summary: Solaris Resources secured an $80m funding package from Orion to advance Ecuador’s Warintza copper project, including $60m senior debt and additional equity commitments. Funds will support exploration, infill drilling, technical/environmental studies, and permitting. Initial drawdown is planned in tranches tied to milestones.

title: The world's copper supply is suddenly looking scarce
summary: Forecast copper surplus into 2024 has flipped as major disruptions hit supply. Panama ordered First Quantum to shut its Cobre Panama mine, removing ~400,000 tons/year, and Anglo American will cut South American copper output by ~200,000 tons. Analysts now expect deficits, tightening inventories and supporting bullish price pressure.

title: Copper growth loses steam after U.S. inflation data
summary: Copper prices reversed earlier gains after U.S. CPI reinforced expectations that the Fed will keep interest rates higher for longer. A weaker outlook for early rate cuts supported the dollar, weighing on growth-sensitive industrial metals. The piece also notes nickel and aluminium price movements alongside copper, while supply disruptions remain supportive.

title: Material Matters: Lithium; Copper, Aluminium: 2024 Outlook
summary: Morgan Stanley notes China’s copper and aluminium output is at record highs but inventories/trade suggest absorption rather than buildup, implying solid domestic demand. It also flags supply-side risks—aluminium production cuts in Yunnan and copper disruptions in Chile/Panama—plus potential China policy easing that could support prices into 2024.

title: Material Matters: Lithium; Copper, Aluminium: 2024 Outlook
summary: The piece expects China’s copper and aluminium demand to stay solid despite all-time-high output, with data suggesting metals are being absorbed rather than stockpiled. It also flags potential supply disruptions—aluminium cuts in Yunnan and copper disruptions in Chile/Panama—plus possible China growth easing as supportive.

title: Copper dips as China fails to meet investors' stimulus hope
summary: Copper prices fell after China’s Central Economic Work Conference readout disappointed investors by omitting large fiscal stimulus measures, worsening expectations for demand from the world’s top consumer. LME three-month copper and Shanghai January copper both dipped, while nickel also declined and aluminium rose modestly.

title: Nickel North Provides Update on Option Agreement to Sell up to 100% Interest in Hawk Ridge
summary: Nickel North Exploration announced amended and restated option agreement terms for selling interests in its Hawk Ridge nickel-copper project in Quebec to 1844 Resources. The amendment adjusts cash/deposit timing and share payments for staged option exercises up to 100% ownership. It is an exploration-deal update with no stated production changes.

title: Ivan Vella's IGO warns of another writedown amid job losses at nickel project
summary: IGO’s Ivan Vella-led IGO warned investors to expect another write-down on its Western Areas nickel assets after job losses began at the Cosmos nickel project. The company says the $1.3 billion acquisition value may be impaired again, indicating weakening nickel project outlook and potential supply uncertainty.

title: Europacific Metals Inc.: Europacific Plans 1,000 Meter Drill Program at Miguel Vacas Copper Project, in Southern Portugal
summary: Europacific Metals plans a 1,000-meter drill program in early 2024 at its Miguel Vacas copper project within the Borba 2 license in Portugal. The company aims to confirm extensions and quality of an oxidized blanket for potential heap-leach development and to support initial resource estimation.

title: Automotive Megatrends Drive 4.8% CAGR in Copper Demand until 2034, Reports IDTechEx
summary: IDTechEx reports automotive copper demand will grow strongly through 2034, driven mainly by EV electrification and increasing wiring in complex vehicles. It forecasts copper use rising to around 5MT annually by 2034, while acknowledging possible offsets from aluminum substitution and design changes such as thinner gauges and wireless communication.

title: December's Aluminum Prices Are Still Supported By Low Inventories, Despite Cautious Macroeconomic Sentiment Subduing Bullish Activity
summary: The report expects December (Dec 12–Jan 10) aluminium prices to be supported by low ingot/primary aluminium inventories, driven by supply discipline and downstream restocking after low prices. However, a cautious macro backdrop, seasonal demand softness, and abundant East China spot supply limit bullish activity, keeping SHFE downside risk more balanced.

title: Jubilee Metals partners IRH for copper recovery in Zambia
summary: Jubilee Metals and IRH plan to recover copper from a 60+ year waste-rock dump in Zambia’s Northern Copperbelt using modular processing units. The project targets about 2,000 tonnes of copper per month, funded via a joint SPV. Jubilee will design and operate processing and fast-track production after drilling and sampling.

title: Europacific Metals Inc. Plans 1,000 Meter Drill Program at Miguel Vacas Copper Project, in Southern Portugal
summary: Europacific Metals plans a 1,000-meter drilling program at its Miguel Vacas copper project in Portugal to confirm and expand mineralization and define an initial resource for potential short-term open-pit heap leaching. The update supports copper project expectations, but no output is scheduled, limiting immediate price impact.

title: Greatland Gold finds anomalous gold and copper at Scallywag tenement
summary: Greatland Gold reported anomalous results from drilling and geophysical work at its Scallywag tenement in Western Australia, including a peak copper intercept of 2 metres at 0.17% copper. It also identified a potential conductor at depth near its Havieron area, with further work planned for 2024 targets.

title: Oversupply concern pushes aluminium to near 15-month low
summary: Aluminium prices fell to their lowest in nearly 15 months as oversupply expectations outweighed demand hopes. LME data showed funds’ net short positions at the highest since May 2020. The firmer U.S. dollar also pressured base metals, with aluminium weaker and copper and nickel also down.

title: Urgent Call for Sanctions on Russian Primary Aluminium by the European Union
summary: European aluminium industry leaders call on the EU to expand sanctions by banning Russian primary aluminium imports, saying the current 12th package covers only a limited set of aluminium products. They estimate most Russian exports, especially primary metal, remain outside measures and argue a broader ban would curtail supply and support resilience in EU downstream chains.

title: As of 15:00 CST December 13, the SMM copper cathode spot trading intensity index was decrease 26.74, a decrease of 4.42 from the day before
summary: SMM data show the copper cathode spot trading intensity index as of 15:00 CST on Dec 13 decreased to 26.74, down 4.42 from the previous day. This points to softer spot market activity for copper, which may weigh on near-term expectations and prices.

title: Benton Expands the Great Burnt Copper Deposit with Three New Drill Holes, Including One Intersection of 18.18m Grading 3.07% Copper
summary: Benton Resources reported assay results from three new drill holes at the Great Burnt Copper deposit in Newfoundland, including intervals up to 3.07% Cu over 18.18m. The company says the discovery expands the high-grade system along strike and down plunge, but the article does not indicate production timing or market supply changes.

title: Benton Resources Inc.: Benton Expands the Great Burnt Copper Deposit with Three New Drill Holes, Including One Intersection of 18.18m Grading 3.07% Copper
summary: Benton Resources announced assay results from three new drill holes at the Great Burnt copper deposit in Newfoundland, reporting wide and high-grade copper intersections including 2.38% Cu over 24.17m and 3.07% Cu over 18.18m. Management says results expand the system along strike and up dip.

title: Air Enforcement: Tennessee Air Pollution Control Board Proposed Order/Civil Penalty Assessment Addressing Mt. Pleasant Secondary Aluminum Recycling Facility | Mitchell, Williams, Selig, Gates & Woodyard, P.L.L.C.
summary: Tennessee’s Air Pollution Control Board issued a proposed order assessing a $7,500 civil penalty on Tennessee Aluminum Processors’ secondary aluminum recycling/smelting facility in Mt. Pleasant. The order follows an April 2023 inspection, cites alleged permit violations, and requires corrective actions within 30 days, with appeal rights.

title: Québec Nickel Corp. Completes 2023 Exploration Programs at Its Ducros Nickel-Copper-PGE Project
summary: Quebec Nickel Corp. says it has completed 2023 exploration at its Ducros Ni-Cu-PGE project in Quebec, drilling 17,815 metres in 50 holes and advancing a scoping-level metallurgical study. It reports discovery of large nickel-cobalt-bearing ultramafic intrusions and new targets from AI, with environmental baseline work started.

title: South32 Invokes Force Majeure at Colombia Ferro-Nickel Operation
summary: South32 has invoked force majeure at its Colombia ferro-nickel operation, signaling an interruption to production. Such disruptions can lower near-term ferro-nickel availability and tighten nickel supply expectations, which usually weighs on nickel prices over the first days of the event.

title: Copper Shortages Are Looming and Four Stocks to Benefit
summary: The piece argues copper shortages are looming as underinvestment, slower mine approvals, declining ore grades, and regulatory/community constraints limit new supply. It notes demand growth from electrification and highlights instances of copper production interruptions and higher costs at operations, reinforcing near-term tightness expectations.

title: Teck's Quebrada Blanca and Carmen de Andacollo Operations Achieve The Copper Mark Verification -December 13, 2023 at 05:24 pm EST
summary: Teck announced its expanded Quebrada Blanca and Carmen de Andacollo operations received Copper Mark verification. Quebrada Blanca is ramping up to full production and is expected to double Teck’s annual consolidated copper output. The Copper Mark covers responsible production criteria, but the stated ramp-up is the copper-relevant element.

title: Peru: Production of copper, other metals continues growing | Noticias | Agencia Peruana de Noticias Andina
summary: Peru’s national copper production reached 240,097 fine metric tons in October 2023, up 1.9% year-on-year, with accumulated output up 14.3% versus the same period of 2022. The Ministry’s bulletin attributes gains to Antapaccay, Hudbay Peru and Southern Peru Copper.

title: World copper supply hit by closures and operational setbacks
summary: The report says the forecast copper surplus entering 2024 has largely disappeared due to closures and operational setbacks, removing expectations of a comfortable surplus. It notes big new projects were expected to keep supply ample before later-decade tightening tied to EV and renewable demand growth.

title: Weak US dollar and improvement of domestic macroeconomy bolstered copper prices, support for copper prices remains in December
summary: Copper prices rose in November mainly on a weaker US dollar and improving US/China macro conditions. Additional support came from tight copper concentrate supply (falling concentrate TCs), low social cathode inventories, high spot premiums/backwardation, and supply expectations after Panama mine maintenance. December is expected to remain supportive despite some stock build.

title: Nickel price collapse claims Aussie miner Panoramic
summary: Panoramic Resources was placed into administration and its Savannah nickel mine is expected to be sold or recapitalised, with Trafigura positioned to take control. The article links the company’s trouble to nickel prices halving this year, equipment failure, and bad weather disrupting transport routes.

title: Tomago Aluminium ready to cut energy usage to support grid stability | Newcastle Herald
summary: During a heatwave, NSW’s grid operator warned of significantly reduced electricity reserves. Tomago Aluminium, the state’s largest power user, may cut production on short notice—up to 600 MW off the grid within minutes—to stabilize supply. The plant seeks constant power, and outages risk write-offs and process disruption.

title: WA miner Panoramic Resources enters voluntary administration as nickel price drops by almost half
summary: Panoramic Resources, operator of the Savannah nickel mine, has entered voluntary administration as nickel prices have fallen 44% over the past year. The firm says it will keep mining on a trade-on basis short-term. Analysts cite recession fears and increased Chinese-linked Indonesian nickel supply weighing on prices.

title: Panoramic nickel: Battery metals sound good, they just don't always work out that way
summary: Panoramic Resources, an Australian nickel producer, has called in administrators as nickel prices hit three-year lows. The company cites repeated setbacks at its ageing Savannah project and years of poor acquisitions, reflecting continued financial stress in the nickel market.

title: Tomago Aluminium ready to cut energy usage to support grid stability | Port Stephens Examiner
summary: NSW’s power grid is under strain during a heatwave, with AEMO warning of reduced electricity reserves. Tomago Aluminium, a large interruptible power user, is ready to cut production within minutes to stabilize supply. Officials urge demand reduction, and further summer shortfalls are possible, risking smelter outages or modulation curtailment.

title: Mitsubishi, Freeport completes copper smelter expansion in Indonesia
summary: Mitsubishi Minerals and Freeport Indonesia’s JV PT Smelting inaugurated an East Java smelter capacity expansion, raising copper-concentrate processing to 1.3 million tonnes from 1 million. The move supports Indonesia’s planned copper concentrate export ban next year and alongside Freeport’s new $3 billion smelter boosts total capacity to 3 million tonnes.

title: RTG Mining Inc.: Further High-Grade Copper and Gold Mineralisation Identified at Chanach
summary: RTG Mining reported encouraging exploration at its Chanach gold-copper project in Kyrgyz Republic, including trench results with elevated copper grades and broad copper anomalism across 6.5km of skarn structures. While supportive for long-term copper potential, it is an early-stage drilling update with no immediate supply impact.

title: Canada One Announces MMI Survey Results; Anomalous Levels of Nickel, Copper and Silver Encountered at Abitibi East Project, Timmins, Ontario
summary: Canada One Mining reported SGS lab results from an MMI soil survey at its Abitibi East project, identifying anomalous nickel and copper ion zones and planning follow-up surveys and electromagnetic work. The findings suggest potential nickel and copper mineralization, but no production or supply impact is stated.

title: Canada One Announces MMI Survey Results; Anomalous Levels of Nickel, Copper and Silver Encountered at Abitibi East Project, Timmins, Ontario
summary: Canada One Mining reported MMI soil survey results at its Abitibi East project, identifying anomalous nickel and copper ion responses in multiple target areas and planning follow-up surveys and drilling. While positive for potential future discovery, the release provides no production or supply-change details.

title: Copper posts biggest single-day gain in nearly 1 year
summary: Copper rallied sharply, gaining 2.8% to around $8,565/t on Thursday, the biggest daily jump in nearly a year, driven by a weaker dollar and expectations of Fed rate cuts. The move was reinforced by mine closures and production cuts. Aluminium and nickel also rebounded on the macro sentiment shift.

title: As of 15:00 CST December 14, the SMM copper cathode spot trading intensity index was decrease 56.56, a decrease of 29.82 from the day before
summary: SMM data show the copper cathode spot trading intensity index fell to 56.56 as of 15:00 CST Dec 14, down 29.82 from the previous day. The decline points to reduced spot market activity, which may imply weaker near-term demand sentiment for copper.

title: Mining Stock News: Seabridge Gold's (TSX: SEA) First Drill Test of Snip North Confirms Promising Copper-Gold Porphyry Target
summary: Seabridge Gold announced results from its first drill test at the Snip North target in British Columbia’s Golden Triangle, confirming an intact copper-gold porphyry system. The company reports long drill intercepts of gold-copper mineralization and expects further drilling to vector toward higher copper grades, pending additional work to define widths.

title: The World Could Soon Face A Copper Supply Deficit
summary: Panama’s Supreme Court canceled First Quantum’s Cobre Panama operating license, removing about 400,000 tons/year of copper supply, while Anglo American cut 2024 production targets by 200,000 tons and lowered outputs through 2025. With demand from EVs and renewables still strong, analysts warn of a move toward deficit and higher prices.

title: Workers at Chilean copper mine approve contract offer
summary: Workers at Antofagasta’s Centinela copper mine in Chile voted to approve a new labor contract, ending the risk of a strike. By lowering the probability of near-term production disruptions, the news is supportive for expectations of copper supply over the coming days and weeks.

title: LEADING EDGE RECEIVES CONTINUED HIGH GRADE COBALT-NICKEL RESULTS FROM SYSTEMATIC GALLERY CHIP SAMPLING, BIHOR SUD PROJECT, ROMANIA
summary: Leading Edge Materials reports further high-grade Co-Ni-Au assay results from Gallery 7 at the Bihor Sud project in Romania, extending the mineralized zone by about 250 m to roughly 400 m. Samples show elevated cobalt and nickel grades (including 13% Ni), reinforcing exploration upside and supporting nickel sentiment.

title: Mining Co. Finds Large, High-Grade Copper and Nickel Deposits
summary: Stillwater Critical Minerals announced drilling intercepted new “N series” sulfide-rich mineralization at its Stillwater West property in Montana, including copper and nickel sulfide. The company reports high-grade NiEq from a drill hole and plans expanded drilling in 2024, improving prospects for future copper and nickel supply.

title: Mining Co. Finds Large, High-Grade Copper and Nickel Deposits
summary: Stillwater Critical Minerals says drilling at its Stillwater West (Montana) intercepted new “N series” sulfide mineralization, including 2.89% nickel-equivalent over 400.8m, and copper-nickel sulfides. While the discovery is supportive for future supply expectations, it offers no near-term production or inventory implications for copper or nickel prices.

title: Copper Jumps Most in Eleven Months on Fed Pivot, Supply Cuts
summary: Copper is reported to have jumped the most in eleven months, with gains attributed to expectations of a Fed pivot and to supply cuts. The combination suggests near-term supply tightness alongside a more supportive macro/discount-rate backdrop, likely driving immediate upward pressure in copper prices.

title: China Nov aluminium output at 3.54 mln metric tons - stats bureau
summary: China’s primary aluminium production fell 2.2% to 3.54 million tonnes in November versus the prior month, according to the National Bureau of Statistics. Through the first 11 months, aluminium output rose 3.9% year on year. The report provides near-term supply context for aluminium markets.

title: China Nov aluminium output climbs with new capacity
summary: China’s November primary aluminium output rose 4.8% year-on-year to 3.54 million tons as major regions added new capacity to meet solid demand. While some production cuts occurred in Yunnan due to dry seasonal conditions, overall supply was higher, which typically pressures aluminium prices short term.

title: Copper steady as dollar under pressure from dovish Fed
summary: London copper was steady after a sharp prior-session jump as dovish Fed expectations pressured the dollar near four-month lows. Three-month LME copper was almost flat, while January SHFE copper rose. In the same session, aluminium fell and nickel declined, though the week trend was mixed and copper ended stronger weekly.

title: UK sanctions on Russian metals spark panic: palladium surges nearly 12%, copper prices hit biggest intraday gain in 11 months
summary: The UK announced new sanctions restricting imports of certain Russian-made metals and banning exports of dual-use goods. The restricted list includes copper, nickel and aluminium. Markets reacted with sharp overnight moves: palladium jumped nearly 12% and copper logged its largest intraday gain in 11 months, indicating immediate supply-risk pricing.

title: Jubilee Metals : to raise £10m for copper expansion -December 15, 2023 at 02:50 am EST
summary: Jubilee Metals Group plc said it plans to raise £10m to support copper expansion. The funding plan implies investment toward increasing copper production capacity, which can lift market expectations for future copper supply and improve near-term sentiment around copper prices.

title: Mitsubishi Materials : Initiation of a Procedure for the Copper Mark - Committed to participate in the Copper Mark Assurance Framework at domestic copper smelters, Naoshima Smelter & Refinery and Onahama Smelter & Refinery -December 15, 2023 at 03:16 am EST
summary: Mitsubishi Materials says it has initiated procedures to qualify for the Copper Mark Assurance Framework at its Naoshima and Onahama copper smelter and refinery sites, with qualification expected in fiscal 2025. The company highlights responsible production efforts, renewable energy use, and expanded E-scrap processing capacity, aimed at stable electrolytic copper supply.

title: Jubilee Metals to raise GBP10 million to fund copper project in Zambia
summary: Jubilee Metals plans to raise GBP10 million to fund its “Green Copper” project in Zambia, following acquisition of a large copper waste-rock asset and a partnership with International Resources Holding. Funds will cover initial payments and expansion at its Sable refinery and other copper-related developments.

title: Li3 Lithium Shifts Focus to its 100%-Owned Northern Lights Copper Project Located in Nevada in Close Proximity to Nevada Copper's Producing Mine
summary: Li3 Lithium said it is shifting resources from its Zimbabwe lithium project to its 100%-owned Northern Lights copper project in Nevada, near Nevada Copper’s producing Pumpkin Hollow mine. The company reports surface sampling of ore-grade copper and plans EM survey and reverse-circulation drilling, supporting bullish sentiment for future copper supply.

title: Li3 Lithium Corp: Li3 Lithium Shifts Focus to its 100%-Owned Northern Lights Copper Project Located in Nevada in Close Proximity to Nevada Copper's Producing Mine
summary: Li3 Lithium says it is prioritizing its 100%-owned Northern Lights copper project in Nevada and plans an accelerated EM and reverse-circulation drilling program to define grade and thickness. Surface sampling reports ore-grade copper over up to 4 meters width, supporting further development potential.

title: BHP issues dire warning on nickel mines
summary: BHP warned that Australia’s critical minerals strategy overhaul offers no relief for the struggling nickel industry. BHP said its Nickel West operations face the same pressures that have led to mine closures, with further job losses at its mines. Panoramic Resources also entered administration this week.

title: ASCU, Nuton to establish JV for Arizona copper project
summary: Arizona Sonoran Copper (ASCU) signed an option agreement with Nuton (Rio Tinto subsidiary) to form a JV for the Cactus copper project in Arizona. Nuton will deploy heap-leach technologies, with up to $33m total funding and Nuton paying $10m. The tests aim to improve extraction rates and advance toward a PFS.

title: Jubilee Metals raises GBP13 million to fund Zambia copper operations
summary: Jubilee Metals raised GBP13 million via a share placing, with net proceeds earmarked to fund its Zambian copper operations. Management plans to accelerate a newly acquired copper waste rock project, expand sulphide recovery at its Sable refinery, and progress related Mufulira slag development and working capital.

title: B.C.'s Copper Mountain expansion won't require environmental review
summary: British Columbia’s EAO ruled that the Copper Mountain mine expansion near Princeton does not require a full environmental review because additional land disturbance is below the legal threshold, despite Indigenous and environmental objections. The permitting will proceed via the Major Mines Office, extending mine life while not implying immediate supply shocks.

title: Century Aluminum Applauds Treasury Guidance on 45X
summary: Century Aluminum says it welcomes U.S. Treasury interpretive guidance clarifying Section 45X of the Inflation Reduction Act for the U.S. primary aluminum industry. The company expects benefits from the 45X advanced manufacturing tax credit, potentially improving smelter economics, and plans an investor call to discuss the impact on 45X.

title: Century Aluminum Applauds Treasury Guidance on 45X Clarifying Application to U.S. Primary Aluminum Industry
summary: Century Aluminum said it welcomes U.S. Treasury interpretive guidance clarifying how Section 45X of the Inflation Reduction Act applies to the U.S. primary aluminum industry. The company, a major domestic aluminum producer, expects benefits from the advanced manufacturing tax credit and will discuss the guidance’s impact on an investor call.

title: Century Aluminum (CENX) Applauds Treasury Guidance on 45X Clarifying Application to U.S. Primary Aluminum Industry
summary: Century Aluminum praised U.S. Treasury guidance clarifying how Section 45X of the Inflation Reduction Act applies to the U.S. primary aluminum industry. As the largest domestic primary aluminum producer, it expects benefits from the advanced manufacturing tax credit tied to smelters, potentially supporting aluminum economics and near-term sentiment.

title: Indonesia likely to continue nickel bans under new president
summary: Indonesia’s leading political candidates are expected to maintain Jokowi’s nickel ore export restrictions. Since the 2020 ban, foreign investment has flowed into domestic smelting, increasing nickel pig iron output. With Indonesia producing a large share of global nickel, continued export limits could tighten supply dynamics and support nickel prices near term.

title: Roadmap for the orderly closure of copper mine
summary: Panama’s MICI reported that after a court ruling voiding parts of the mining contract, an order was sent to the Cobre Panamá company on December 5 to end operations, covering extraction, processing, transport, export and marketing. A roadmap for orderly closure will be presented and technical groups formed in coming days.

title: Battery metals: Critical minerals snub risks Australian nickel jobs says Luca Giacovazzi, boss of Andrew Forrest's Wyloo Resources
summary: Wyloo Resources’ Luca Giacovazzi says nickel’s omission from Australia’s expanded critical minerals list is disappointing as weak nickel prices endanger hundreds of mining jobs. The same day, Australia’s industry department warned of continued “downward pressure” on nickel in 2024 from Indonesian miners poised to oversupply nickel markets for years.

title: Copper slips as steady dollar counters supply headwinds
summary: Copper futures opened lower as a steadier U.S. dollar amid uncertainty about the Fed’s rate path pressured prices. Three-month LME copper fell and Shanghai January copper dipped slightly. Offsetting support came from tightening copper concentrate supply, including weaker processing fees linked to fears around First Quantum’s Panama Cobre mine.

title: China's Nov aluminium imports rise amid robust demand, concerns over supply
summary: China’s aluminium imports rose 34.2% year-on-year in November to 343,109 tons, driven by strong domestic demand and expectations of lower output. Thin inventories and Yunnan’s hydropower-driven output curbs are expected to reduce production into early next year, supporting aluminium prices despite weaker US/EU demand.

title: Robert Friedland, Ivanhoe Mines: Any disruption can send copper soaring -December 15, 2023 at 01:46 pm EST
summary: Robert Friedland of Ivanhoe Mines says copper prices must rise to around $15,000/tonne to spur new mine investment. He discusses China demand, global inventories, and the risk of further supply disruptions, arguing that any additional disruption could cause a very sharp copper price spike in the near term.

title: Antofagasta : A reliable copper proxy amid another supply disappointment -December 18, 2023 at 05:38 am EST
summary: The piece says Antofagasta is a reliable copper proxy and points to Anglo American cutting medium-term copper production guidance. It argues the red metal market should tighten after the supply disappointment, implying prices should benefit. Target price is adjusted upward, consistent with bullish copper expectations.

title: UAE Business: Kings Aluminium starts work on $204m Abu Dhabi plant
summary: Kings Aluminium Industries has begun construction of a $204m Abu Dhabi manufacturing and recycling plant at Kezad. The facility will process molten aluminium, billets and aluminium waste, using raw material sourced from Emirates Global Aluminium. The project expands downstream aluminium capacity and recycling activity, supporting regional aluminium demand.

title: Copper slips, but prospect of tight supplies sustains sentiment
summary: Reuters reports copper eased on worries about weak Chinese demand, but sentiment was supported by mine closures/disruptions suggesting tighter supplies and supply concerns around Panama’s Cobre mine. It also notes aluminium fell after LME warehouse stock jumps, then rebounded. Nickel dropped as other base metals moved with risk appetite.

title: Canada Nickel Provides Financing Update
summary: Canada Nickel said it extended the repayment date of a US$12 million loan facility with Auramet to January 18, 2024, paying an extension fee and issuing warrants. The update is intended to advance permitting, engineering, and financing/offtake initiatives during the extension period, supporting near-term project continuity.

title: Evolution acquires majority stake in Australian copper-gold mine
summary: Evolution Mining has completed its acquisition of an 80% stake in CMOC’s Northparkes copper-gold mine in NSW, paying A$594.7m upfront and A$75m contingent. The mine holds large copper reserves and long-life assets, but the deal signals ownership change rather than immediate supply shocks.

title: Copper price jumps following anticipation of interest rate cuts in 2024
summary: Copper prices jumped on Thursday as markets priced in potential Fed interest rate cuts, which would support growth and increase demand while lowering the dollar and borrowing costs. The move was reinforced by supply disruption concerns, including the closure of First Quantum’s flagship copper mine in Panama after protests and a court ruling.

title: TNR Gold NSR Royalty Update - Los Azules Copper, Gold and Silver Project - McEwen Copper Completed Over 18,000 Metres In New Drilling Campaign
summary: TNR Gold reports McEwen Copper is advancing the Los Azules copper project in Argentina, with 18 drill rigs on site and over 18,000 metres drilled. The update supports progress toward a feasibility study and increased project confidence, potentially improving copper sentiment, but without any immediate production impact mentioned.

title: Aluminium billet premiums fall in key global locations except for US market
summary: Fastmarkets reported aluminium 6063 extrusion billet premiums easing in Europe, Spain, Thailand and Brazil, citing reduced liquidity, weak end-demand, and producers trying to clear inventories with discounted offers ahead of holidays. US premiums ticked up slightly, but most regions saw lower loss-making levels.

title: Jubilee Metals raises $16.6m to fund Zambia copper recovery
summary: Jubilee Metals raised about $16.6m to fund copper recovery efforts in Zambia, including initial payments for a waste rock dump project and expansion of sulphide recovery circuits at its Sable refinery. The company also targets 2,000 tonnes monthly extraction via a partnership, aiming to bring production forward faster.

title: Long-delayed Minnesota copper-nickel mining project wins a round in court after several setbacks
summary: The article title says a long-delayed Minnesota copper-nickel mining project won a court round after several setbacks. That outcome improves the project’s prospects to proceed, which can modestly raise near-term expectations for future supply and support copper and nickel prices.

title: Minnesota Court of Appeals affirms air permit for NewRange Copper Nickel
summary: Minnesota’s Court of Appeals upheld the MPCA air permit for NewRange Copper Nickel’s proposed copper-nickel mine and processing at the former LTV site in Hoyt Lakes. Environmental groups had challenged the permit, but the decision reduces regulatory uncertainty for development, with no immediate production timing stated.

title: Chile copper miner Codelco reaches contract agreements with 3 unions
summary: Chile’s Codelco avoided an immediate strike risk by reaching agreements with unions at its Ventanas division and its supervisors’ union. The deals were broadly accepted in votes and help maintain operations amid production challenges. Reduced disruption risk is supportive for short-term copper supply expectations.

title: Minnesota Court of Appeals affirms air permit for NewRange Copper Nickel
summary: Minnesota’s Court of Appeals upheld the state’s air permit for NewRange Copper Nickel’s planned copper-nickel mine at the former LTV site in Hoyt Lakes. The ruling removes a regulatory hurdle after environmental groups challenged the permit, but it doesn’t signal near-term production, limiting immediate price effects.

title: Court upholds air permit for proposed copper nickel mine
summary: A court upheld the air permit for a proposed copper-nickel mine, lowering regulatory uncertainty. By improving the prospects that the project can proceed toward development and eventual production, the decision is likely to support market expectations for increased future supply. This can be bullish for copper and nickel prices.

title: Court upholds air permit for proposed NewRange Copper Nickel mine
summary: A court upheld the air permit for the proposed NewRange copper-nickel mine, removing a permitting obstacle and lowering the risk of further development delays. The decision improves the project’s outlook and can affect near-term sentiment by increasing expectations of future supply for both copper and nickel.

title: Opinion: Teck Resources is amassing the cash to slowly triple its copper production
summary: Opinion piece says Teck expects about US$9B from selling its coal business and plans to spend it on copper-focused projects, aiming to triple copper output via brownfield extensions and later greenfield decisions after the Quebrada Blanca cost-overrun review. Investors responded positively, supporting near-term copper sentiment.

title: Copper prices flat as traders cautious ahead of BOJ decision
summary: Copper prices were largely flat as traders stayed cautious ahead of a Bank of Japan decision and assessed US rate-cut prospects. Strong Chinese refined copper production and rising imports weighed on the Yangshan premium. Aluminium weakened on rising LME inventories and nickel also declined.

title: Si6 winds up Botswana drilling, nets more nickel-copper
summary: Si6 Metals completed its first-phase drilling in Botswana, reporting high-grade copper-silver intercepts at Dibete and strong visual nickel-copper sulphide mineralisation at Maibele North, with assays pending in three to four weeks. The results are positive for resource potential, but no near-term supply impact is indicated.

title: Aluminium Powder Market to Hit USD 2.70 Billion by 2030
summary: The article forecasts growth in the global aluminium powder market from about $1.84B in 2023 to $2.70B by 2030, citing rising demand from construction (brick production), solar cells, automotive, and aerospace/defense. It notes production methods, capacity expansions by players, and COVID-related supply chain disruptions.

title: BHP ASX: BHP rules out return to Broken Hill as it passes on copper project buy
summary: BHP told Havilah Resources it will not exercise its option to buy the Kalkaroo copper project near Broken Hill. This decision ends BHP’s inherited rights linked to its OZ Minerals acquisition earlier this year. Havilah’s shares fell about 24%. The change is project-specific rather than a major supply disruption.

title: Nickel miner AKP set to go public, prepares for acquisition by Korean firm
summary: Indonesia’s Adhi Kartiko Pratama (AKP) begins an IPO on Jan. 9 and expects proceeds from selling shares held by major investors. LX International will acquire a controlling stake and plans to expand nickel production capacity, signaling continued nickel supply efforts linked to EV battery demand.

title: Minnesota copper-nickel mining project wins a round in court | News, Sports, Jobs
summary: Minnesota’s Court of Appeals affirmed an air emissions permit for the proposed NewRange copper-nickel mine near Babbitt, concluding regulators adequately considered possible expansion plans. The project remains delayed with other permits still contested, but the ruling reduces one near-term regulatory hurdle for copper and nickel supply expectations.

title: Minnesota copper-nickel mining project wins a round in court | News, Sports, Jobs
summary: Minnesota’s Court of Appeals upheld a state agency decision granting an air emissions permit for the proposed NewRange/PolyMet copper-nickel mine. Environmental groups had argued “sham permitting” and possible future expansions. The permit win is partial, but it lowers near-term regulatory risk for potential copper and nickel output, subject to remaining court and regulator steps.

title: SILVER ONE EXPANDS ITS LAND POSITION TO COVER POTENTIAL PORPHYRY COPPER SYSTEMS AND AREAS OF SILVER MINERALIZATION AT ITS PHOENIX SILVER PROJECT, ARIZONA
summary: Silver One Resources announced additional staking at its Phoenix Silver Project in Arizona to cover areas tied to magnetic anomalies along a 30+ km porphyry copper belt. The company cites select rock samples returning >1% copper and plans further geophysical work and 2024 drilling. It’s an exploration expansion without immediate production changes.

title: Copper climbs on expectations of tightening supplies
summary: Copper prices climbed as supply worries intensified: mine closures, falling LME-approved inventories, and a high share of cancelled copper warrants signaled more copper leaving the exchange. Traders also cited uncertainty around First Quantum’s Cobre Panama and production guidance cuts from Anglo American.

title: Andromeda to sell South Australia copper-gold project
summary: Andromeda Metals agreed to sell its exploration licence EL5984 covering parts of the Moonta copper-gold project in South Australia to ECL’s EMR unit. The transaction reallocates interests supporting ECL’s ISR copper investigations at Alford West, with Andromeda retaining cash and equity-linked payments. No near-term copper output is announced.

title: International Court Ruled Guatemala Violated Indigenous Rights By Allowing Nickel Mine On Tribal Land
summary: An Inter-American Court ruled Guatemala violated Indigenous Q’eqchi’ property and consultation rights for allowing a large nickel mine on tribal land. The court ordered an immediate halt to mining, required new legislation and a land title process within six months, and barred additional mining without community approval.

title: Serabi Gold plc: Matilda Copper Project - Exploration results confirm project potential
summary: Serabi Gold reported drilling results from the Matilda copper prospect in Brazil, with 12 of 19 assay results returning encouraging copper grades above 0.2% Cu over intervals >10m. The company outlines an exploration target range and plans further deeper drilling and geophysics work in 2024.

title: Funds less negative on copper as supply landscape shifts: Andy Home -December 19, 2023 at 08:08 am EST
summary: Reuters reports funds have trimmed bearish copper positioning and turned marginally net long as macro pressure eases and market expectations for supply change. It cites the closure of First Quantum’s Cobre Panama mine and production guidance downgrades at Anglo American and Vale, reducing confidence in a 2024–2025 surplus.

title: Premium Nickel Reports Assays and Extension of Historic Resource at Selebi North Underground
summary: Premium Nickel Resources reports additional assays from underground drilling at the Selebi North Ni-Cu-Co sulphide mine in Botswana, including intervals with Ni and Cu contributions to NiEq. The company says intersections confirm down-plunge extension of mineralization beyond the historic resource, supporting future resource estimation, but no immediate supply changes.

title: Nickel plan sidelined as govt pushes EV market with new incentives
summary: Indonesia unveiled revised EV investment tax incentives allowing duty- and VAT-free imports of EVs (CBU/CKD) and extending local content timelines. The policy aims to accelerate EV market development before domestic production ramps up, which could raise expectations for battery metal demand, supporting nickel sentiment over the near term.

title: Funds less negative on copper as supply landscape shifts
summary: Funds have trimmed bearish bets and flipped marginally net long copper on LME and CME as macro pressure fades and supply expectations weaken. Lower Chinese treatment charges, First Quantum’s Cobre Panama closure, and downgraded guidance from Anglo American and Vale point to less resilient supply and reduced surplus risks.

title: Court upholds permit for Minnesota copper-nickel mining project
summary: A Minnesota appeals court upheld a key air emissions permit for the proposed NewRange copper-nickel mine near Babbitt, after regulators reconsidered potential expansion scenarios. The decision is a win for Glencore/Teck, but other major permits remain unresolved, keeping near-term output uncertain for copper and nickel markets.

title: Court upholds permit for Minnesota copper-nickel mining project
summary: A Minnesota appeals court affirmed regulators’ decision granting an air emissions permit for the proposed NewRange copper-nickel mine near Babbitt, overturning claims of “sham permitting.” The project is still stalled by other court and regulatory issues, but the ruling lowers uncertainty for potential future copper and nickel supply.

title: Panama rejects Orla Mining's concessions for copper-gold project
summary: Panama rejected Orla Mining’s requests for three concessions for the Cerro Quema copper-gold project and cited a reserve-area classification and a newly passed moratorium (Law 407) on granting/renewing mining concessions. The decision follows court rulings disrupting Cobre Panama operations, adding copper supply-permitting uncertainty.

title: AGENCE EUROPE - EU and US agree to extend suspension of steel and aluminium ...
summary: The European Commission said the EU and US extended the suspension of EU “rebalancing” tariffs on certain US products, including aluminium, until 31 March 2025. This delays the reimposition of tariffs that were scheduled around early January 2024, easing trade barriers and potentially increasing aluminium import availability.

title: Aluminum Retreats From Six-Week High With LME Inventory in Focus
summary: The piece notes that aluminum has pulled back from a six-week high, with attention on LME inventory levels. A retreat suggests improving near-term supply conditions or reduced tightness expectations, leading traders to price in softer demand/supply balance for the coming days.

title: Provinces fines Red Cris copper gold mine operators $25,000
summary: British Columbia fined Newcrest $25,000 for failing to install electrified fencing at the Red Chris copper-gold mine. Regulators cited repeated non-compliance with perimeter fencing requirements and potential risks from wildlife interactions. Although further penalties are possible and a shutdown was threatened if fencing was not fixed, no shutdown is reported.

title: Nickel 28 Capital Corp.: Nickel 28 Files Fiscal Q3 Financial Statements
summary: Nickel 28 reported Q3 results for its 8.56% stake in the Ramu nickel-cobalt operation in Papua New Guinea. Ramu produced 8,979 tonnes of contained nickel in MHP, with cash costs net of by-product credits falling 29% to $2.77/lb and distribution proceeds supporting strong quarter cash generation.

title: Provinces fines Red Chris copper gold mine operators $25,000
summary: British Columbia fined Newcrest $25,000 for failing to install functioning electrified fencing at the Red Chris copper-gold mine. The penalty follows repeated non-compliance with a 2019 environmental order and prior warnings, with deficiencies later rectified. A further penalty is pending; no explicit shutdown or output disruption is stated.

title: Matilda Copper Project - Exploration results confirm project potential
summary: Serabi Gold reported drill results from the Matilda copper prospect in Brazil, with 12 of 19 holes returning copper grades above 0.2% Cu over intervals >10m and potential for a larger mineralised system at depth. The company plans further 2024 drilling; the target remains conceptual with no resource yet.

title: Shanghai copper gains on tighter supply, weaker dollar
summary: Shanghai copper rebounded after a two-session slide as global inventories tightened and mine supply disruptions supported the market. A weaker U.S. dollar also provided tailwinds amid expectations of Fed rate cuts. The London copper market followed a rally tied to closures and lower LME-approved warehouse stocks.

title: LS Cable develops new raw material for copper foil
summary: LS Cable & System says it developed “CuFlake,” a new raw material for copper foil that uses copper pieces instead of copper wire, potentially reducing processing steps and costs. The company completed sample testing and plans commercialization next year, with goals for higher copper-foil sales. It also targets aluminum EV components.

title: Funds less negative on copper as supply landscape shifts: Andy Home
summary: Funds have cut bearish copper positions as macro headwinds ease after Powell signaled rates may be near their peak. The shift is reinforced by supply signals: lower Chinese smelter treatment charges, First Quantum’s Cobre Panama closure, and production guidance downgrades from Anglo American and Vale, reducing expected surplus for 2024-25.

title: ENEOS : Notice regarding transfer of partial shares in Pan Pacific Copper Co., Ltd. (change in consolidated subsidiary (sub-subsidiary)) and partial interest of Los Pelambres Copper Mine -December 20, 2023 at 03:13 am EST
summary: ENEOS/JX Metals will transfer 20% of its shares in Pan Pacific Copper Co. and reduce its interest in the Los Pelambres Copper Mine to Marubeni as part of a partnership restructuring. Pan Pacific will shift to equity-method accounting. The company expects no material impact on earnings; no copper supply or price guidance is provided.

title: Marubeni : Investment Decision for an Expansion Project at Centinela copper mine in the Republic of Chile -December 20, 2023 at 03:07 am EST
summary: Marubeni, with Antofagasta, finalized investment in expanding Chile’s Centinela copper mine, including a new concentrator plant to double copper concentrate capacity. Total annual copper output is projected to rise by ~140,000 tonnes, increasing Marubeni’s equity copper volume by ~40,000 tonnes. Production starts in 2027.

title: Marubeni : Acquisition of Interests in Los Pelambres Copper Mine and Pan Pacific Copper Co., Ltd. -December 20, 2023 at 03:07 am EST
summary: Marubeni agreed to buy an additional stake in Chile’s Los Pelambres copper mine and a 20% stake in Pan Pacific Copper (PPC). Los Pelambres produces ~400,000 tons of copper annually and PPC supplies largely copper cathodes in Japan/Asia. The transactions expand Marubeni’s copper supply chain involvement.

title: Elval at COP28:We are committed to unleashing the circular potential of aluminium -December 20, 2023 at 03:35 am EST
summary: Elval, an aluminium canstock/rolling division, highlighted at COP28 its push for higher circularity of aluminium beverage cans. The company supports policies to raise recycling rates, noting targets of up to 80% by 2030 and 100% by 2050, and claims increased recycled content metrics.

title: Aurubis CEO says he expects strong copper market to continue in 2024
summary: Aurubis CEO Roland Harings said the copper market should remain strong in 2024, citing expected demand growth for copper products from Europe’s renewable-energy transition and digitalisation. He also expects good concentrate supply from new mining projects and stable recycled supply. Aurubis’ earnings fell after a metal theft but outlook remained upbeat.

title: Mytilineos S A : becomes the largest bauxite producer in the European Union -December 20, 2023 at 05:07 am EST
summary: Mytilineos said the Hellenic Competition Commission approved its acquisition of Imerys Bauxites Greece, increasing its annual bauxite production to over 1.2 million tonnes and making it the largest EU producer. The company links the added bauxite to ensuring supply for its historic aluminium operations and gallium extraction activities.

title: As of 15:00 CST December 20, the SMM copper cathode spot trading intensity index was decrease 28.14, a decrease of 38.03 from the day before
summary: SMM data shows the copper cathode spot trading intensity index decreased 28.14 as of 15:00 CST Dec. 20, which is 38.03 lower than the previous day. The report reflects weaker copper spot trading momentum, suggesting near-term bearish sentiment for copper prices. No nickel or aluminium information is provided.

title: Japan's Marubeni to invest in $4.4 billion copper expansion project in Chile
summary: Marubeni plans a $4.4 billion expansion in Chile, building a new concentrator plant to double copper concentrate capacity and boost Centinela mine output by 140,000 tons, plus increased equity output. It also agreed to acquire additional stakes in Minera Los Pelambres and Pan Pacific Copper. Production starts in 2027.

title: Copper touches 4-1/2 month high on strong Chinese imports
summary: Copper rose to a 4.5-month high as China increased November copper cathode imports and physical premiums rebounded, suggesting stronger spot buying and restocking. Users aimed to refill stocks amid thin inventories. The move was tempered by a firmer dollar, which raises costs for non-USD buyers.

title: Alta Copper Corp.: Alta Copper Announces Closing of Non-Brokered Private Placement

The incident is expected to disrupt nickel refining operations temporarily, affecting near-term supply availability and pressuring nickel prices lower in the coming days.

title: Death toll rises to 18 in furnace explosion at Chinese-owned nickel plant in Indonesia
summary: An explosion at a furnace at a Chinese-owned nickel plant in Indonesia has reportedly killed 18 people. The incident is expected to disrupt nickel production while operations are halted and investigations conclude, potentially reducing short-term supply and pressuring nickel prices downward in the coming days.

title: Aluminum Production Hub Qinghai Issues Power Rationing Emergency Plan, But Smelters Are Unaffected For Now
summary: After an earthquake in Gansu, China’s Qinghai issued emergency power and load-management measures for relief. Aluminum smelters face a 10% reduction in power load (438,000 kW), equating to about 280,000 mt annualized capacity impact. Current operations are normal, but risk of further disruption remains.

title: Shanghai aluminium rises for ninth session amid supply concerns
summary: Shanghai aluminium futures gained for a ninth straight session as China inventories fell and upstream feedstock supply concerns grew. A Guinea fuel shortage tightened bauxite, raising fears of reduced alumina capacity and lower aluminium supply, though alumina prices eased after a prior record. LME was closed for Christmas.

title: Indonesia Probes Deadly Blast at Tsingshan-Linked Nickel Plant
summary: Indonesia is reportedly investigating a deadly blast at a nickel plant linked to Tsingshan. Such an incident can disrupt production, damage equipment, and reduce near-term nickel output, typically worsening supply expectations and weighing on nickel prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: 13 Killed, Dozens Injured in Explosion at Indonesian Nickel Plant.
summary: An explosion at a nickel plant in Indonesia’s Sulawesi killed at least 13 workers and injured dozens, reportedly triggered during furnace repair when a flammable liquid ignited and caused nearby oxygen tanks to explode. With Indonesia the top nickel producer, the outage poses short-term supply risk, supporting higher nickel prices.

title: Indonesia nickel plant explosion death toll rises to 18
summary: An explosion at a Chinese-funded nickel-processing plant in Indonesia’s Morowali Industrial Park killed 18 people, with dozens injured. The blast occurred during repairs to a nickel smelting furnace after residual slag contacted flammables. Repeated safety incidents raise the likelihood of short-term production disruption, supporting nickel prices downside-risk.

title: Death toll in Indonesia nickel plant blast rises to 18 as China calls for emergency response
summary: An explosion at a Chinese-funded nickel smelter in Indonesia’s Sulawesi suspended operations, with the death toll rising to 18 and injured workers receiving treatment. The furnace was damaged during repairs. Indonesia’s nickel industry is a major global supply source, so disruptions can lift near-term nickel price expectations.

title: Mining and Metallurgical Norilsk Nickel : Nornickel approves budget for 2024 -December 26, 2023 at 05:56 am EST
summary: Norilsk Nickel’s board approved a 2024 budget including about USD 3.6 billion capex, with investment focused on mining and processing growth, equipment upgrades, energy/fuel infrastructure, and repairs at the Nadezhda flash smelter. The plan also reflects higher taxes via temporary export duties through 2024 and aims to manage costs and working capital.

title: Indonesia nickel plant blast death toll rises to 18
summary: An explosion at a Chinese-funded nickel-processing plant in Morowali, Indonesia, killed 18 workers and injured dozens. The blast occurred during furnace repairs and involved residual slag contacting flammables. The incident at a Tsingshan-linked facility raises near-term production disruption and operational risk concerns for nickel supply.

title: Death toll in Indonesia nickel smelter fire rises to 18
summary: A fire at a China-owned nickel smelter at PT Indonesia Tsingshan Stainless Steel in Indonesia’s Morowali region has killed 18 people, with 44 injured. The plant will be closed indefinitely pending investigations. The molten slag leak and furnace wall collapse are under review, risking near-term nickel output disruption.

title: As of 15:00 CST December 26, the SMM copper cathode spot trading intensity index was decrease 34.4, a decrease of 15.54 from the day before
summary: SMM data show that the copper cathode spot trading intensity index fell 34.4 as of 15:00 CST on Dec 26, down 15.54 from the previous day. The drop signals reduced spot market activity and potentially weaker near-term demand conditions for copper.

title: The death toll rises to 18 in a furnace explosion at a Chinese-owned nickel plant in Indonesia
summary: A smelting furnace explosion at a Chinese-owned nickel plant in Indonesia’s Sulawesi killed 18 workers and damaged key equipment. Police ordered the operator (PT Indonesia Tsingshan Stainless Steel, under PT IMIP) to halt production while investigating possible negligence. The incident follows other fatal disruptions at nickel smelters in the region.

title: Death toll rises to 18 in a furnace explosion at a Chinese-owned nickel plant in Indonesia
summary: A furnace explosion at a Chinese-owned nickel plant (PT Indonesia Tsingshan Stainless Steel/PT IMIP) in Indonesia’s Sulawesi killed 18 people. Authorities ordered the smelter to stop operations pending an investigation into potential negligence, highlighting recurring safety incidents at Indonesian nickel plants and potential short-term supply disruption.

title: Blast at Indonesian nickel plant rattles China's "Belt and Road" initiative
summary: An explosion at the PT Indonesia Tsingshan nickel smelting furnace on Indonesia’s Sulawesi island killed 18 workers and prompted police to halt operations until an investigation is completed. The blast, tied to China’s Belt and Road-linked industrial assets, highlights potential near-term nickel supply disruption risks.

title: Death Toll Rises to 18 in Furnace Explosion at Chinese-Owned Nickel Plant in Indonesia
summary: A smelting furnace explosion at a Chinese-owned nickel plant in Indonesia’s Sulawesi has killed 18 people, and police ordered the plant to halt operations while an investigation proceeds. The incident adds to safety/fatality issues at nickel smelters in Indonesia, likely reducing near-term nickel output.

title: Explosion at a Chinese-owned nickel plant in Indonesia leaves 18 dead
summary: An explosion at a Chinese-owned nickel smelting furnace in Indonesia’s Sulawesi killed 18 workers and damaged the facility. Police ordered the plant to halt operations until investigations finish. The incident adds to prior accidents at Indonesia-China nickel projects, risking near-term nickel processing downtime.

title: 18 dead in Chinese-owned nickel plant explosion in Indonesia
summary: An explosion at a smelting furnace at a Chinese-owned nickel plant in Indonesia killed 18 people, according to the report. The incident likely disrupts nickel output and raises short-term supply risk, which can improve expectations for nickel pricing within days to the next few weeks.

title: Turbulent Times For China's Aluminum Industry
summary: The piece highlights conflicting signals for China’s aluminum market: Golden World Innovation cut pay and furloughed staff amid the real estate-driven demand downturn, while other reports show rising primary aluminum production and revised higher output estimates. Fitch expects Chinese and broader demand to improve in 2024.

title: Copper steadies amid dollar weakness, supply concern
summary: Copper prices were steady to slightly higher as a weaker U.S. dollar supported demand and tight global raw-material supply concerns persisted after recent mine closures. LME aluminium fell, while nickel rose on the same day’s market tone. Shanghai prices were mixed, with copper little changed and aluminium slightly up.

title: Hundreds of Indonesian nickel workers rally to press safety demand
summary: Hundreds of Indonesian nickel workers rallied to demand stronger occupational safety, threatening a strike. A Sunday fire at a nickel smelter furnace killed workers and led to an operation suspension while police investigate. Other plants in the Morowali park run normally, but safety scrutiny is increasing.

title: Indonesian Workers Protest After Deadly Blast At Nickel Plant
summary: Hundreds of workers protested outside a Chinese-funded nickel-processing plant in Indonesia after an explosion killed at least 18 and injured dozens. Unrest centers on safety, furnace maintenance, and working conditions at the Morowali Industrial Park, a key nickel hub.

title: Hundreds of Indonesian nickel workers rally to demand safety at work
summary: Hundreds of Indonesian nickel workers rallied demanding stronger workplace safety standards after a fire killed 18 people. Labour groups threatened strikes if demands aren’t met. A spokesperson said operations at the Morowali industrial park, the world’s biggest nickel ore producer, have not been affected and talks are ongoing.

title: Workers protest in Indonesia after blast at Chinese-funded nickel plant
summary: Workers in Indonesia protested after an explosion killed 18 at a Chinese-funded nickel processing plant in Morowali. Smelter operations were suspended during investigations, while unions demanded stronger health and safety compliance and threatened a strike. The manpower ministry pledged tighter safety laws amid ongoing hospital treatment.

title: Indonesian nickel workers demand better safety
summary: Hundreds of nickel workers in Indonesia rallied for improved safety after a fire killed 19 employees. Police investigations suspended operations at one smelter at the Morowali industrial park, though other plants reportedly run normally. Authorities also pledged stronger safety enforcement, and unions threatened further strikes if demands aren’t met.

title: Indonesia investigates fatal explosion at Chinese-owned nickel plant
summary: Indonesia’s police are investigating a deadly explosion at the Chinese-owned Indonesia Tsingshan Stainless Steel nickel plant in Sulawesi. Operations at the facility were temporarily halted while investigators probe the incident. The fire killed 18 workers and injured 40+, adding disruption risk for near-term nickel output in a key producing region.

title: Base metals rise on Chinese data; aluminium hits eight-month high
summary: Base metals rose in London on improved Chinese industrial profits. Aluminium hit an eight-month high on technical buying by CTAs and supply concerns after a Dec. 18 blast at Guinea’s main fuel terminal handling bauxite-related inputs. Copper and nickel also increased as the dollar eased and Indonesia-related supply focus strengthened.

title: Explosion Kills 19 at Chinese Nickel Smelter in Indonesia -- Commodities Roundup
summary: An explosion at a Chinese nickel smelter in Indonesia killed at least 19 workers and injured dozens, with fire and hot steam disrupting operations during routine maintenance. The incident highlights safety concerns in Indonesia’s rapidly expanding nickel industry, raising risks of near-term supply disruption for nickel used in stainless steel and EV batteries.

title: Surge Copper Acquires 100% Interest in Berg
summary: Surge Copper says it will acquire full ownership of the Berg Property from Thompson Creek/Centerra Gold for stock consideration, consolidating its copper-focused Berg-Huckleberry-Ootsa district. The PEA cites long-term copper price assumptions and contained resources, but the deal itself does not imply immediate production or supply changes.

title: Awale Resources Ltd.: Awale Commences New Diamond Drill Program at the Odienné Copper-Gold Project, Secures Additional JV Funding with Newmont
summary: Awalé Resources begins a 4,000-meter diamond drill program at its Odienné copper-gold project with Newmont and secures an additional $750,000 in JV funding, lifting the 2023 exploration budget to $3.75 million. Final assay results from the summer program are expected in January.

title: Indonesia nickel smelter fire death toll increases to 18
summary: A fire at Indonesia Tsingshan’s nickel smelter in Morowali has killed 18 people and prompted authorities to investigate, with smelter operations paused. Indonesia is a major nickel producer and export ore bans push feed into smelting. The shutdown threatens near-term nickel supply, pressuring prices lower.

title: The death toll rises to 18 in a furnace explosion at a Chinese owned nickel plant in Indonesia - OHS Canada Magazine
summary: A furnace explosion at a Chinese-owned nickel plant (PT Indonesia Tsingshan Stainless Steel within PT IMIP) in Indonesia’s Sulawesi killed 18 workers. Police ordered the plant to halt operations until an investigation is completed, indicating near-term disruption to nickel smelting supply while authorities examine negligence and causes.

title: Tartisan Nickel Corp. Closes $1,350,000 Flow-Through Financing at $0.17 per Share with a Two-Year Escrow Period
summary: Tartisan Nickel Corp. closed a $1.35 million flow-through financing at $0.17 per share to fund exploration, development, and advancement of its Kenbridge Nickel Project in Ontario, plus it issued shares for debt. The announcement is related to nickel activity but does not indicate immediate production or supply changes.

title: Uncertainty in global copper
summary: The article highlights uncertainty in copper supply after Panama’s court ruled First Quantum’s Cobre Panama contract unconstitutional and the mine was put on care and maintenance, while workers at Peru’s Las Bambas struck. Output cuts could tighten balances and shift the market toward deficit, supporting prices.

title: Copper at Highest Since August as Market Weighs Fed Cuts, Supply
summary: Copper is reported at its highest level since August as markets weigh expectations for Fed cuts alongside supply considerations. The combination points to improved near-term sentiment for industrial demand from easier financial conditions and potential support from tighter or riskier supply conditions.

title: Series Of Copper Thefts Sets Back Property Owner's Affordable Housing Renovations
summary: A property manager says copper thefts have damaged multiple rental properties, with repairs exceeding $60,000 and copper stolen from units and an AC system. The owner reports replacement costs and higher out-of-pocket deductibles, making affordable-housing renovations harder. The thefts appear tied to local scrapyards and repeated theft activity.

title: CSPT cuts spot copper concentrate guidance TCs for Q1 2024 | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
