Chalcopyrite-bearing sulfide mineralization was encountered across multiple drill holes. The company says results extend continuity along strike and warrants further delineation.

title: Asian aluminium demand anticipated to gradually recover, sources say | 2024 preview
summary: Asian aluminium demand is expected to gradually recover, with Japan’s automotive sector supporting consumption and China approaching production capacity, encouraging more imports. Aluminium premiums in Shanghai and Japan showed recent strength versus earlier in 2023. A December fire in Guinea raised bauxite supply disruption concerns, adding upward cost risk.

title: Canada Nickel secures strategic investment from Korea's Samsung SDI
summary: Canada Nickel secured an $18.5 million equity financing from Samsung SDI, which plans to take a stake in the company and has options tied to the Crawford nickel-cobalt project. The deal highlights battery end-user demand and supports sentiment for future nickel supply from a long-life mine.

title: Codelco Caps Worst Year in Quarter Century With Copper Production Drop
summary: The piece highlights that Codelco is on track for its worst year in about 25 years, with copper production falling sharply. As a leading producer, the reported output decline affects short-term supply expectations and can move copper prices in the near term as traders reassess market balance and inventories.

title: Canada Nickel Shares Rise on $18.5 Million Samsung SDI Investment
summary: Canada Nickel shares rose after Samsung SDI agreed to invest $18.5 million for nearly a 9% stake and to subscribe for 15.6 million shares. Samsung SDI also gains the right to purchase a 10% equity interest in nickel production from the Crawford project in Timmins, Ontario, supporting sentiment for nickel supply.

title: Korean battery maker Samsung SDI investing in Canada Nickel
summary: Samsung SDI agreed to invest US$18.5 million for an 8.7% stake in Canada Nickel and will also have rights to buy an additional 10% stake in the Crawford project in Ontario. The deal includes access to nickel-cobalt production for battery/EV supply chains, supporting nickel demand expectations.

title: Korean battery maker Samsung SDI investing in Canada Nickel | iNFOnews | Thompson-Okanagan's News Source
summary: Samsung SDI agreed to invest US$18.5 million for an 8.7% stake in Canada Nickel and received options to buy additional stake rights tied to the Crawford nickel-cobalt project in Ontario. It will also gain rights to future nickel-cobalt production, reinforcing perceived nickel supply support for EV supply chains.

title: Copper Declines as Traders Mull Rate Path After US, China Data
summary: Copper is reported to fall as traders recalibrate the expected interest-rate path following recent US and China data releases. The market’s focus is on how the new macro signals may affect growth, risk sentiment, and financing conditions, which can influence copper demand expectations in the near term.

title: Canada Nickel receives investment from Samsung SDI - Canadian Manufacturing
summary: Canada Nickel announced a subscription agreement with Samsung SDI to invest US$18.5 million for shares at C$1.57, giving Samsung SDI about 8.7% ownership. The firms also position the investment as a long-term partnership to advance the Crawford nickel sulphide project for EV battery supply chains, supporting nickel sentiment.

title: Copper's Critical Role in Green Energy Transition
summary: The piece argues copper should firm as green-energy policies accelerate demand (EVs, power grids, renewables) while supply prospects tighten. It references ICSG shifts toward deficits, COP28 renewable targets, and real disruptions/production pauses and planned output cuts, including Cobre Panamá and Anglo American actions.

title: Giant nickel numbers underpin Ardea share price hike
summary: The piece describes Ardea Resources’ sharp share rally after upgrades to its Goongarrie Hub nickel-cobalt resource and a pre-feasibility study. It highlights large contained nickel, estimated production of ~30,000 tonnes/year, and favorable unit costs, which can bolster market expectations for nickel supply and sentiment.

title: Copper prices subdued as investors assess demand outlook
summary: Reuters reports copper prices were subdued as investors took a cautious stance ahead of China’s upcoming GDP and industrial production data, while renewed hopes for a US rate cut supported sentiment. Mine-side disruptions helped, but a slump in China copper charges could squeeze smelter margins and reduce refined output.

title: London copper prices steady as US dollar weakens
summary: London copper held steady as a weaker U.S. dollar supported prices, while investors awaited China data for demand outlook. China’s unchanged policy rate and softer pre-holiday replenishment weighed, but mine-side disruption could reduce refined output. LME aluminium edged up, while nickel fell slightly amid mixed moves across metals.

title: Ravensthorpe nickel mine to cut 30 per cent of workforce as mining suspended for three years amid weaker metal prices
summary: First Quantum Minerals will suspend mining at the Ravensthorpe nickel operation in Western Australia for up to three years and cut 30% of staff, while continuing to process ore stockpiles. The decision follows weaker nickel prices and is intended to preserve viability until nickel prices recover.

title: Samsung SDI invests $18.8m in Canada Nickel Company
summary: Samsung SDI invested $18.8m for an 8.9% stake in Canada Nickel, a Toronto-based junior developing Ontario’s Timmins-Cochrane camp/Crawford Nickel sulphide project. The move is intended to secure critical nickel inputs for EV battery production, boosting confidence in future nickel supply demand.

title: Dollar pressures copper while zinc jumps on smelter shutdown
summary: Copper prices fell after the dollar strengthened and Chinese demand worries resurfaced when the central bank left key rates unchanged. Aluminium also declined and nickel retreated. Separately, Nyrstar will suspend zinc smelting in the Netherlands due to high energy costs, potentially tightening Europe’s zinc market but not directly tracked metals.

title: Samsung SDI to buy into Canadian nickel miner | Yonhap News Agency
summary: Samsung SDI will buy an 8.7% stake in Canada Nickel for $18.5 million and obtain 10% of nickel-cobalt output from its Crawford project, plus further production rights for 15 years. The deal aims to secure battery mineral supply in North America, potentially supporting near-term nickel demand expectations.

title: Oversupply sets tone for China's nickel market | 2024 preview
summary: The article forecasts continued bearish conditions in nickel as China and Indonesia capacity expansions have turned the refined nickel market from short supply to oversupplied. LME and SHFE nickel prices collapsed in 2023, and analysts expect ongoing surpluses in 2024, though less severe than 2023.

title: London Metal Exchange's growing Russian aluminium problem : Andy Home - 2024-01-15
summary: Reuters reports Russian aluminium in LME warehouses more than doubled in December, reaching 90% of warranted stocks. While blanket sanctions are absent, the LME tightened delivery rules around penal import duties and the UK barred post-Dec. 15 acquisitions for physical delivery. EU measures are also expanding, increasing uncertainty.

title: First Quantum's Ravensthorpe nickel mine cuts jobs
summary: First Quantum will cease mining at Western Australia’s Ravensthorpe nickel and cobalt mine as part of a cost reduction plan, cutting more than 300 jobs. The decision follows large operating losses and continued nickel price declines, implying reduced near-term nickel supply and potential price support.

title: Samsung SDI to buy into Canadian nickel miner
summary: Samsung SDI will acquire an 8.7% stake in Canada Nickel and secure rights to 10% of nickel-cobalt production from the Crawford project in Ontario, with an option for additional output for 15 years. The deal is aimed at stabilizing battery raw-material supply and signals firmer nickel demand.

title: Chile's Cochilco raises 2024 copper price projection to $3.85/lb
summary: Chile’s Cochilco raised its 2024 copper price projection to $3.85 per pound from $3.75, citing normalization of US monetary policy and mainly stronger demand linked to the energy transition and electric vehicles. The update is a direct, near-term supportive signal for copper market expectations.

title: First Quantum to suspend mining operations at Australian nickel mine
summary: First Quantum Minerals said it will reduce operations at its Australian nickel mine by suspending mining at the Shoemaker Levy ore body. The move directly lowers near-term nickel output, tightening expected supply and likely providing upward support for nickel prices in the short term.

title: First Quantum Halts Australian Nickel Mine on Weak Metal Prices
summary: First Quantum says it is halting operations at an Australian nickel mine, attributing the decision to weak nickel prices. The move signals continued price softness in the nickel market, likely reinforcing bearish near-term expectations for nickel demand and pricing.

title: Canada's First Quantum to suspend mining operations at Australian nickel mine
summary: First Quantum is suspending production at its Ravensthorpe nickel mine in Australia, citing low nickel prices amid weaker steel and EV demand. It also remains heavily impacted by Panama’s Supreme Court forcing closure of its Cobre Panama copper mine, driving asset sales and refinancing efforts.

title: First Quantum to cut Australian nickel mine output, slash workforce
summary: First Quantum said it will cut production at its Australian Raventhorpe nickel mine and reduce the workforce by about 30%, citing a significant downturn in nickel prices. The article links the prior price weakness to high supply and low demand, with Raventhorpe already running losses.

title: Rio Tinto Annual Iron Ore, Aluminum Output Rises
summary: Rio Tinto said 2023 production of aluminum rose to about 3.3 million tons (up 9%), aided by full operations at the Kitimat smelter, and mined copper output increased to 620,000 tons (up 2%). The higher supply profile could pressure near-term copper and aluminum prices.

title: Rio Tinto Annual Iron Ore, Aluminum Output Rises -- Update
summary: Rio Tinto said 2023 production of aluminum rose to about 3.3 million tonnes on a return to full Kitimat smelter output, while mined copper increased to about 620,000 tonnes. Refined copper fell due to a Kennecott smelter rebuild, with stable production expected in Q1 2024.

title: First Quantum Minerals struggles amidst weak nickel prices: Ravensthorpe operation suspended
summary: First Quantum Minerals says it is suspending mining at its Ravensthorpe nickel operation because weak global nickel prices make the mine uneconomic. The decision follows another WA nickel/cobalt mine suspension in the past week and comes as the firm struggles after Cobre Panama’s copper licence loss and major share declines.

title: Alcoa hits out at 'politicisation' of Kwinana alumina refinery closure south of Perth
summary: Alcoa criticised “politicisation” of its decision to close the Kwinana alumina refinery near Perth. The company says it will stop alumina production later this year, cutting hundreds of jobs, citing market pressures and costs. The dispute challenges claims that government policies caused the shutdown.

title: IPOs: Copper developer Metals Acquisition Corp to raise $200m for ASX debut
summary: Metals Acquisition Limited, owner of Glencore’s CSA copper mine in western New South Wales, has begun site visits ahead of a proposed ASX listing. The company plans to raise about $200m and issue a prospectus by late January. The news is mainly about corporate financing, with no fresh production or trade impact stated.

title: Indonesia produces 535,200 metric T of nickel in ferronickel in 2023 -mining ministry
summary: Indonesia’s mining ministry data show 2023 production of 535,200 tonnes of nickel in ferronickel and 71,400 tonnes of nickel matte. Ferronickel output rose 3.6% but missed a 628,600-tonne target, while nickel matte production fell 6% and also undershot the 75,000-tonne target.

title: Australia sends biggest copper concentrate shipment to China since 2020
summary: Australia shipped 27,500 tons of copper ores and concentrates to China in November, the largest monthly volume since China’s informal ban began in 2020. The surge, supported by customs data, suggests China may be easing restrictions tied to an inquiry into COVID-19 origins, potentially improving concentrate availability and sentiment for copper.

title: Indonesia produces 535,200 metric T of nickel in ferronickel in 2023, misses target
summary: Indonesia produced 535,200 metric tons of nickel in ferronickel and 71,400 tons of nickel matte in 2023, according to the mining ministry. Ferronickel rose 3.6% but fell short of a 628,600-ton target, while nickel matte output declined 6% and missed the 75,000-ton target.

title: Samsung SDI buys stake in Canadian nickel miner for battery expansion
summary: Samsung SDI bought an 8.7% stake in Canada Nickel for $18.5 million, gaining an initial purchase right for 10% of the planned mine’s nickel production and options to expand over time. The move aligns with Samsung SDI’s North American EV battery ramp-up using high-nickel chemistries.

title: Copper slips on firm dollar, offset by China stimulus hopes
summary: Reuters reports copper fell as a firm U.S. dollar pressured dollar-priced commodities, but losses were tempered by hopes for additional China stimulus, including potential new debt issuance. The piece notes that macro expectations for rate cuts shifted, influencing broader metal sentiment, with aluminium slightly up and nickel modestly down.

title: Indonesia says 'strong indication' of safety procedure violation in nickel fire
summary: Indonesia says there is a strong indication that safety procedures were violated in connection with a nickel fire. Such findings typically trigger investigations and potential corrective actions or shutdowns, which can disrupt nickel operations and tighten near-term supply expectations, supporting nickel prices in the coming days.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Discovers New Mineralized Breccia 800 Meters Southeast of the Existing Mineral Resource
summary: Faraday Copper reports early Phase III drilling at its Copper Creek (Arizona) project, including the Starship breccia discovery with multiple copper-bearing intercepts (e.g., 0.37% Cu over 72.01m). The company suggests potential to increase open-pit resources, but results are exploration-stage and not immediate production.

title: Indonesia to Inspect All Smelters After Deadly Nickel Blast
summary: Indonesia plans to inspect all smelters after a deadly nickel blast. The move is likely to increase the probability of temporary shutdowns, slower commissioning, or operational disruptions at refining facilities, which can reduce near-term nickel supply and weigh on nickel prices over the coming days.

title: Palladium One Mining Inc.: Palladium One Announces Electromagnetic (EM) Survey Results for Canalask Nickel
summary: Palladium One reports new EM survey results at its Canalask nickel–copper project in Yukon, confirming an untested conductor and refining drill targets for the 2024 field season. The release cites historical intercepts with ~Ni and Cu grades, but provides no production or timing to affect near-term supply.

title: SRQ Resources: Additional Nickel-Copper Intercepts at Lac Brulé's Ultramafic Intrusive Complex
summary: SRQ Resources reported assay results from October 2023 drilling at Lac Brulé in Quebec, finding ultramafic-hosted sulfide mineralisation with intercepts including 0.49% nickel and 0.36% copper, and veins returning up to 6.49% copper. The company plans follow-up drilling, but no production changes were announced.

title: Barrick Gold's fourth-quarter copper, gold output rise sequentially
summary: Barrick Gold said its copper production rose sequentially in the fourth quarter, reaching 113 million pounds versus 112 million pounds in the prior quarter. Total preliminary output for the quarter also increased for gold. The update is company-specific and indicates only a marginal change in supply.

title: Ero Copper's Tucumã Project Reaches Over 85% Physical
summary: Ero Copper reports Tucumã Project construction at over 85% completion, with power line tie-in ahead of schedule and commissioning activities starting. Mechanical completion and ore-through milestones are laid out for Q1–H1 2024, targeting first concentrate in H2 2024, which could modestly support copper supply expectations.

title: Ero Copper's Tucumã Project Reaches Over 85% Physical Completion - On Track for First Copper Production in H2 2024
summary: Ero Copper said its Tucumã project is over 85% physically complete and moving from construction to commissioning, with power line energization and pre-stripping ahead of schedule. First copper concentrate production is planned for H2 2024, supporting expectations for future copper supply.

title: SRQ Resources: Additional Nickel-Copper Intercepts at Lac Brulé's Ultramafic Intrusive Complex
summary: SRQ Resources reported October 2023 drill results from the Lac Brulé Ni-Cu ultramafic intrusion, including 160m of ultramafic intrusions with 34.35m of mineralisation and assays up to 6.49% Cu plus 0.49% Ni. The release is an exploration update, not a supply disruption or production change.

title: Indonesia says 'strong indication' of safety procedure violation in deadly nickel fire
summary: Indonesia said it has a strong indication that a safety procedure violation contributed to a deadly fire at a nickel smelter in Sulawesi. The blaze erupted on Dec. 24 at a furnace operated by Tsingshan Stainless Steel Indonesia within the Morowali nickel hub, killing 21 workers.

title: Teck Resources says 2023 copper production fell short of guidance
summary: Teck Resources said 2023 copper production came in at 296,500 tonnes, below its 2023 guidance of 320,000–365,000 tonnes, citing slower ramp-up at the QB2 project and a geotechnical fault at Highland Valley Copper. The company also outlined a 2024 copper output range of 465,000–540,000 tonnes.

title: Talon Metals Reports New Assay Results Outside of the Tamarack Resource Area: 9.31% Nickel Equivalent in the Raptor Zone -January 16, 2024 at 07:35 am EST
summary: Talon Metals reported new drilling assay results from the “Raptor Zone” at its Tamarack Ni-Cu-Co project in Minnesota. Results include a 5.93m intercept grading 2.92% nickel and 1.73% copper (4.09% NiEq), including 2.2m at 6.84% Ni and 3.80% Cu (9.31% NiEq).

title: Taseko Mines Limited - Taseko Mines Provides Update on Florence Copper
summary: Taseko reported it signed a definitive agreement to sell a US$50 million copper royalty (1.95% of gross copper revenue) and expects Mitsui financing drawdowns. With funding pending, site work and wellfield drilling will accelerate, supporting construction of a planned SX/EW plant and future Florence copper cathode supply.

title: Barrick Gold 4Q Gold Output Rises Over 3Q, Copper Unchanged
summary: Barrick Gold said its fourth-quarter gold output rose versus the prior quarter, but copper production was unchanged sequentially and in line with its guidance. It reported about 113 million pounds of copper in 4Q and expects to release more detail with full-year results on Feb. 14.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: Talon Metals Reports New Assay Results Outside of the Tamarack Resource Area: 9.31% Nickel Equivalent in the Raptor Zone
summary: Talon Metals reported new drill assay results from its Tamarack “Raptor Zone,” including a 5.93m intercept grading 2.92% Ni and 1.73% Cu and a 2.2m section grading 6.84% Ni and 3.80% Cu (9.31% NiEq). Drilling shows potential for a 250m strike length and increased exploration upside.

title: Teck Resources says 2023 copper production fell short of guidance | iNFOnews | Thompson-Okanagan's News Source
summary: Teck Resources said 2023 copper production totaled 296,500 tonnes, below guidance of 320,000–365,000 tonnes, citing slower ramp-up at QB2 and a localized geotechnical fault stabilized at Highland Valley Copper. The firm provided 2024 production forecasts, but the miss highlights weaker copper supply expectations.

title: As of 15:00 CST January 16, the SMM copper cathode spot trading intensity index was decrease 46.08, a increase of 12.26 from the day before
summary: SMM data for Jan 16 (15:00 CST) shows the copper cathode spot trading intensity index decreased by 46.08, which is reported as an increase of 12.26 versus the previous day. The note is informational and does not provide direct fundamental drivers for copper pricing.

title: Visionary Metals Intercepts Broad Zones of Disseminated, Magmatic Nickel Mineralization in 2023 Drill Program
summary: Visionary Metals reported 2023 RC drilling results from its King Solomon nickel project in Wyoming, finding disseminated magmatic nickel sulfides across most holes and planning spring EM surveys and 2024 core drilling. The release is exploratory and does not indicate production, inventories, or immediate supply changes that would move nickel prices near term.

title: Visionary Metals Corp.: Visionary Metals Intercepts Broad Zones of Disseminated, Magmatic Nickel Mineralization in 2023 Drill Program
summary: Visionary Metals reported 2023 RC drilling at its King Solomon Nickel Project in Wyoming, finding disseminated nickel mineralization and magmatic sulfides across most holes, with follow-up EM surveys and expanded core drilling planned for 2024. The release improves project prospects but does not affect near-term nickel supply.

title: Canadian miner Barrick reports higher fourth-quarter copper, gold output
summary: Barrick Gold said its copper output rose sequentially in Q4 to 113 million pounds from 112 million in the prior quarter. The miner expects copper all-in sustaining costs to fall 2%–4% versus the previous quarter, helped by lower capitalized waste stripping at its Lumwana mine in Zambia. Results follow on Feb. 14, 2024.

title: QC Copper To Begin Drilling on Cooke and Robitaille Mines of Opemiska
summary: QC Copper and Gold announced the start of drilling at the Cooke and Robitaille mines within the Opemiska Copper Mine Complex, aimed at defining near-surface “Opemiska style” copper mineralization. The release follows an earlier resource update and highlights higher copper grades, but no near-term production impact is specified.

title: QC Copper and Gold Inc: QC Copper To Begin Drilling on Cooke and Robitaille Mines of Opemiska
summary: QC Copper and Gold begins drilling at the Cooke and Robitaille mines within its Opemiska copper mine complex to characterize near-surface “Opemiska style” mineralization and potentially expand open-pit material. The company also references an updated copper Mineral Resource Estimate, but no immediate production or supply changes are announced.

title: Ero Copper's Tucumã Project Reaches over 85% Physical Completion - on Track for First Copper Production in Second Half of 2024
summary: Ero Copper says its Tucumã Project is over 85% physically complete, with key electrical and processing components installed and commissioning underway. The company expects first copper concentrate production in H2 2024, with multiple commissioning milestones from March to June 2024, including ore through crushing, milling, and flotation.

title: India-U.S. Trade Deal Eases Export Duties for Steel and Aluminum
summary: India and the US have set up a Joint Monitoring Mechanism to support exports of specific steel and aluminum products to the US without additional duties. The US also agreed to allow larger volumes of aluminum and steel imports from India without supplementary tariffs, easing trade frictions and supporting aluminum sentiment.

title: London copper dips on dollar strength, China data in focus
summary: London copper edged lower as a firmer dollar pressured greenback-priced metals, with traders cautious ahead of China’s GDP and industrial-output releases. Nickel and aluminium had mild gains/declines in the same session. Market focus stays on near-term demand cues from top consumer China and FX rate expectations.

title: BHP faces nickel choice this year as high-cost Australian miners suffer
summary: Reuters reports nickel producers in Australia are buckling under sharply higher Indonesian supply and weak demand as EV makers shift toward cheaper LFP batteries. Nickel prices are near three-year lows, prompting restructures and potential project delays by BHP and others, reinforcing bearish near-term expectations for nickel.

title: Australia's nickel producers reel from supply glut
summary: Reuters reports Australian nickel producers are responding to a supply glut and a sharp nickel price slide over the past year linked to higher Indonesian supply. Firms including First Quantum, Panoramic, IGO and BHP cut jobs or production and register impairments, indicating continued weak near-term nickel pricing expectations.

title: Factbox - Australia's nickel producers reel from supply glut
summary: A Factbox reports that Australia’s nickel producers are being affected by a supply glut. Excess supply can weigh on expectations for spot and contract nickel prices over the coming days as buyers face easier availability, increasing the likelihood of downward price pressure.

title: Indonesia says 'strong indication' of safety violation in deadly nickel smelter fire
summary: Indonesia said there was a strong indication of safety procedure violations behind a deadly Dec. 24 fire at a nickel smelter in the IMIP industrial park on Sulawesi, operated by Tsingshan. Authorities are investigating; officials called for firm enforcement. The incident raises near-term disruption and regulatory risk for nickel supply.

title: Hopetoun residents say job cuts at First Quantum Minerals' Ravensthorpe nickel mine a blow to town
summary: Hopetoun residents say First Quantum’s suspension of mining at the Ravensthorpe nickel mine and planned workforce cuts are a blow to their community. The company will keep producing nickel from ore stockpiles and plans to resume mining if prices recover, implying near-term nickel supply tightening.

title: China 2023 aluminium output hits record high but growth rate slows
summary: China’s primary aluminium output hit a record 41.59 million tonnes in 2023, though growth slowed to 3.7% due to power shortages and weather-related production cuts in the southwest (including drought in Yunnan). December output rose 4.9% year-on-year, alongside higher total nonferrous metals production.

title: London copper falls on China data, dollar pressure
summary: London copper fell as China’s weaker growth data raised concerns about demand, while a firmer U.S. dollar weighed on dollar-priced commodities. LME copper dropped 0.5%. Nickel was slightly higher, but aluminium slid 0.5%, reflecting a broadly cautious macro tone for industrial metals.

title: China 2023 aluminium output up 3.7% y/y at 41.59 mln metric tons -stats bureau
summary: China’s primary aluminium production rose 3.7% in 2023 to 41.59 million tonnes, with December output up 4.9% y/y. Total production of 10 non-ferrous metals increased 7.1%, including copper and nickel, suggesting broadly higher supply that could pressure industrial metal prices, especially aluminium.

title: K2 Gold Samples 208 g/t Gold and High-Grade Copper in Rocks Recovered at Mojave Project
summary: K2 Gold reported rock/grab sampling results at its Mojave Project, including multiple samples at Soda Canyon with copper grades above 1% (notably 1.87% Cu) and trace-to-4.11% Cu across targets. The release focuses on exploration and EIS permitting timelines, with no production or delivery implications.

title: K2 Gold Corporation: K2 Gold Samples 208 g/t Gold and High-Grade Copper in Rocks Recovered at Mojave Project
summary: K2 Gold reported high-grade rock sampling results at its Mojave Project, including gold and copper. Copper at the Soda Canyon target reached 1.87% from one sample, with additional >1% copper results pending overlimit assays. The news is early exploration, offering limited near-term supply implications for copper.

title: FPX Nickel Gets C$14.5 Million Investment from Sumitomo Metal Mining for 9.9% Interest
summary: FPX Nickel said it received a C$14.5 million investment from Sumitomo Metal Mining for a 9.9% stake, issuing shares at a premium. The funding will support exploration and development at its Baptiste nickel facility in British Columbia, which the company estimates could produce ~59,100 tonnes annually over decades.

title: Platinex Consolidates W2 Copper-Nickel-PGE Project Acquiring Historical Resource
summary: Platinex announced it acquired additional claims to fully control its W2 copper-nickel-PGE project in Ontario’s Ring of Fire, including historical drill intervals reporting Cu and Ni grades. The company plans exploration and consolidation but provides no near-term production or supply disruption details, limiting immediate price impact.

title: Archer Exploration Extends Mineralization to Depth in H1 Discovery Zone of Grasset Nickel Project
summary: Archer Exploration reported results from two December 2023 holes at its Grasset nickel project, extending the H1 discovery zone to ~430m depth with nickel grades up to 2.97% Ni over massive sulphides. The company plans further drilling in late January; copper is present but as a byproduct.

title: Vizsla Copper to expand Woodjam project in Canada
summary: Vizsla Copper said it is expanding its Woodjam copper-gold project in British Columbia by staking and buying additional exploration territory. The new claims target porphyry-related copper-gold potential. The deal involves issuing shares and a 2% NSR royalty, pending regulatory approvals. No production changes were announced.

title: Australian Nickel Giants Struggle Against Indonesia's Supply Dominance
summary: A Reuters report says rising Indonesian nickel output is pressuring high-cost Australian producers such as BHP, contributing to nickel’s roughly 40% year-on-year fall and continued weakness around $16,000/ton. Analysts cite near-term challenges, producer restructuring plans, and cost increases versus falling prices.

title: Copper thieves bring down 500-foot Oklahoma radio tower
summary: Copper thieves in Choctaw County, Oklahoma cut guide wire and stole eight to 10 sections of copper tubes from a 500-foot radio tower, toppling it and knocking a station off the air. The sheriff estimated copper losses of several hundred dollars and total damage near $500,000.

title: Canada's First Quantum submits copper mine preservation plan to Panamanian government
summary: First Quantum submitted a preservation and management plan to Panama after the government halted production at the Cobre Panama copper mine. The company cites an “abrupt and unusual” cessation and continuing access constraints from protests and blockades, implying ongoing supply disruption. Preservation and disruption costs run into tens of millions monthly.

title: First Quantum submits copper mine preservation plan to Panama government
summary: First Quantum submitted a preservation plan for its Panama copper mine after the government halted production following protests, and the Supreme Court ruled the operating contract unconstitutional. The mine was a major revenue source, and the plan implies continued disruption with preservation costs running in the tens of millions of dollars per month, reducing near-term copper supply.

title: Aluminum Price Forecasts Challenged by Global Market Dynamics
summary: Aluminium prices eased in early January after a December rise, with markets largely brushing off 2023 alumina supply jitters. UK sanctions increased Russian-origin aluminium in LME warehouses (now ~90% of stocks), but LME/CME pricing correlation remains intact and premiums diverge, leaving net near-term direction uncertain.

title: AOTH Top Metals of 2024 Part 1- Copper
summary: The piece argues copper should improve in 2024 as supply constraints persist and global inventories risk staying tight, citing disruptions like the Cobre Panama shutdown and lower-than-expected output from major producers. It also points to weaker US dollar expectations from likely Fed rate cuts, supporting a bullish near-term copper outlook.

title: BHP Downgrades Full-Year Coal Targets, Reviewing Nickel Plans
summary: BHP downgraded full-year metallurgical coal output and raised costs, while also reviewing options for its Australian nickel business. The company said nickel pricing is at a cyclical low and Nickel West is being actively optimized with a carrying-value assessment ongoing, reflecting a downturn and adding uncertainty for nickel supply and sentiment.

title: Los Pelambres boosted Antofagasta copper production in 2023
summary: Antofagasta said its 2023 copper production rose 2% to 660,600 tonnes, helped by strong output from its Los Pelambres and Centinela operations. The update indicates better near-term copper supply from Chile, which can influence market expectations over the coming weeks.

title: BHP Reviews Nickel Plans Amid Market Rout -- Update
summary: BHP said it will rethink nickel plans after nickel prices halved amid a supply glut from low-cost producers like Indonesia and lagging demand. The company signaled potential write-downs of Nickel West assets and is optimizing operations. Other miners are suspending or curbing nickel output, adding bearish near-term pressure.

title: Copper rises in London as dollar eases
summary: Copper prices rose in London as the dollar eased, rebounding from a six-week low, but remained on track for a fourth straight weekly decline. The report also notes LME aluminium up and nickel slightly down, reflecting mixed, currency-driven moves rather than a clear sustained trend.

title: BHP report: Nickel prices dive as cost cuts considered
summary: BHP said it is evaluating options to mitigate the impacts of a sharp drop in nickel prices, including possible write-downs and cost cuts for its West Australian nickel operations. The news follows closures and suspensions at WA nickel mines by other producers, reflecting weak demand and margin pressure.

title: Foreign-backed nickel hub in Indonesia causing mass deforestation -report
summary: A Reuters report says an Indonesia nickel industrial park tied to mainly Chinese firms has contributed to mass deforestation, with over 5,300 hectares cleared since 2018. The environmental scrutiny follows Indonesia’s push to expand nickel processing and EV supply chains, increasing potential compliance and permitting risks for nickel output.

title: BHP Reviewing Nickel Assets to Mitigate Drastic Price Slump
summary: The piece states that BHP is reviewing its nickel assets as a response to a drastic nickel price slump. This signals ongoing weakness in nickel markets and potential readjustments to production or investment, which can sustain downward pressure on nickel prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: BHP faces nickel choice this year on low prices
summary: Australian nickel producers are struggling as Indonesian rivals add sharply to supply, pushing nickel prices lower. Analysts expect the weak price environment to force BHP Group to reconsider its nickel strategy this year. With supply pressure and low prices highlighted, near-term nickel sentiment skews bearish.

title: China's 2023 aluminium imports rise on robust demand
summary: China imported 3.06 million tonnes of unwrought aluminium in 2023 as consumption grew, supported by demand from solar and autos. Imports were encouraged by higher China prices and rising Russian shipments. December imports jumped, and bauxite imports also rose, underpinning aluminium feedstock availability.

title: BHP Reviews Nickel Plans Amid Market Rout -- 2nd Update
summary: BHP says it will review its nickel plans as the market endures a downturn, with nickel prices about halved since the start of 2023 amid supply growth, especially from Indonesia. It may write down nickel assets, cut/slow spending at Nickel West, and other producers suspend operations due to weak realized pricing.

title: Pasadena cracking down on copper wire thefts after recent surge; reward offered
summary: Pasadena, California is stepping up enforcement and offering rewards after a surge in copper wire thefts from street lights and traffic signals. Officials say stolen copper must be replaced, increasing equipment and labor costs, with hundreds of lights impacted over the past year. The county approved a $20,000 reward pool.

title: Foreign-backed nickel hub in Indonesia causing mass deforestation--report | The Asahi Shimbun: Breaking News, Japan News and Analysis
summary: A Reuters report says Indonesia’s Weda Bay nickel processing hub, backed largely by Chinese firms including Tsingshan and Eramet, has cut thousands of hectares of forest since 2018. Environmental groups warn the nickel industry could worsen deforestation as Indonesia increases scrutiny of miners and reforestation efforts.

title: Material Matters: Lithium; Copper; Aluminium; 2024 Outlook
summary: Morgan Stanley suggests China’s copper and aluminium output is being absorbed rather than piling up, supported by resilient property completions and continued demand. It flags supply-side risks—aluminium cuts in Yunnan and copper disruptions in Chile/Panama—as upside factors. Citi also expects further copper strength on China easing expectations.

title: Material Matters: Lithium; Copper; Aluminium; 2024 Outlook
summary: The piece expects solid near-term demand for copper and aluminium in China, with output at record highs but inventories indicating absorption rather than buildup. It flags potential supply disruptions (aluminium cuts in Yunnan; copper disruptions in Chile/Panama) as upside risks and notes Citi’s base case for a copper run-up over coming weeks.

title: Copper rebounds in London as dollar dips
summary: Copper prices rebounded in London after a six-week low as the dollar eased, making dollar-priced metals cheaper. Three-month copper rose on the LME, but the market is still set for a fourth straight weekly decline due to fading expectations of early U.S. rate cuts. Aluminium edged up; nickel eased.

title: Foreign-backed nickel hub in Indonesia causing mass deforestation: Report
summary: A report alleges nickel processing at Indonesia Weda Bay Industrial Park—backed by Chinese firms including Tsingshan and Huayou—has cleared over 5,300 hectares of tropical forest since 2018. With Indonesia increasing scrutiny of miners and demanding reforestation, tighter enforcement could disrupt nickel operations and weigh on near-term nickel prices.

title: Lithium and nickel: BHP's warning on battery minerals is striking
summary: BHP’s December quarter update highlights “structural” changes disrupting the nickel sector and raising concerns about the viability of its Nickel West project in Western Australia. The warning points to weakening industry conditions around nickel supply and investment, which is typically bearish for nickel price expectations in the near term.

title: Zambie : God and the Price of Copper - Afriques en Lutte
summary: The article says Zambia’s downturn is driven by falling copper export prices to China, alongside a depreciating kwacha and electricity shortages affecting mines. It links lower copper prices to reduced profitability, higher operating costs, and past mine closures, suggesting continued bearish pressure on copper markets.

title: Foreign-backed nickel hub in Indonesia causing mass deforestation -report - Society
summary: A Reuters report says US NGO Climate Rights International documented deforestation at Indonesia’s Weda Bay nickel processing hub (IWIP), citing satellite imagery. Investors include Tsingshan and Eramet. Indonesia aims to expand nickel value-add and EV output, with officials promising greater scrutiny of mining.

title: CopperCorp Commences Drilling at Razorback
summary: CopperCorp began a 2024 diamond drilling program at its Razorback rare earth and copper property in western Tasmania, testing Cu-Au and REE targets. The release cites historical high-grade intersections but does not indicate production, permitting disruptions, or supply changes. Thus, any near-term price impact is likely limited and sentiment-driven.

title: Premium Nickel Reports Assays at Selebi North Underground
summary: Premium Nickel Resources reported new underground drill assays from the Selebi North Ni-Cu-Co deposit in Botswana, including zones grading ~1.84% Ni and ~1.85% Cu (within NiEq). The company plans further down-plunge drilling to support a future MRE, with no immediate production or export implications stated.

title: As of 15:00 CST January 18, the SMM copper cathode spot trading intensity index was decrease 38.08, a increase of 6.1 from the day before
summary: SMM data show the copper cathode spot trading intensity index decreased to 38.08 as of 15:00 CST Jan 18, down versus the prior reading (a reported change of 6.1 from the day before). Lower trading intensity suggests weaker spot activity, typically weighing on short-term copper prices.

title: Phoenix Copper down as Empire mine feasibility study nears completion
summary: Phoenix Copper said its pre-feasibility study for the proposed Empire open-pit copper and silver project in Idaho is nearing completion, with results expected early in Q2 2024. The study covers mine planning, reserves, environmental work and cost estimates. Near-term production impact appears absent, limiting copper price influence.

title: Aluminum Producer Alcoa Reports Q4 Earnings Beat
summary: Alcoa reported Q4 EPS loss of $0.56 versus analysts’ $0.84 loss and revenue at $2.6 billion. The company cites weaker prior aluminium benchmarks (down 15% in 2023) and expects shipments around 2.3 million tons in 2024, after Q4 shipments fell 3% year-on-year.

title: Glencore, Trafigura target spot prices for mined copper sales, sources say
summary: Glencore and Trafigura propose Asian smelters’ treatment charges for 2024 copper concentrate sales to be linked to spot-market benchmarks, with caps (mid-$60s/t). The proposal responds to much lower spot processing charges (~$40/t) driven by tight concentrate supplies and rising Chinese smelting capacity, ahead of Lunar New Year slowdown.

title: Chile's Codelco to invest $720 million more in Chuquicamata copper mine
summary: Codelco filed an environmental permit request to modify its Chuquicamata Subterranea underground project, investing $720 million. The changes are intended to allow the mine to reach authorized production of 140,000 tons per day, after years of delays and cost overruns, as Codelco’s output has hit a 25-year low.

title: Material Matters: Copper & Iron Ore
summary: Brokers (via Longview and UBS) forecast near-term copper price weakness, arguing the metal is elevated versus indicators of Chinese activity. They point to a weaker Chinese credit impulse, decelerating power-grid investment, continued property deflation, and a likely US dollar rally as key near-term headwinds. Long-term copper fundamentals remain bullish.

title: MACAU DAILY TIMES 澳門每日時報Chinese, French funded nickel hub stoking deforestation on Indonesia island: report
summary: An AFP dispatch, citing a US NGO report, says a Chinese/French-financed nickel smelting hub at Weda Bay Industrial Park on Halmahera has driven deforestation and air and water pollution, relying on multiple coal plants. The report urges mitigation of emissions and tailings handling, with concerns about Indonesia’s nickel expansion and labor risks.

title: Job and business opportunities for CopperString Project | The North West Star
summary: Queensland’s CopperString project is progressing quickly, with Powerlink recruiting Townsville-based apprentices and releasing multiple works packages for suppliers and services. The initiative supports construction and logistics for the SuperGrid connection, expected to boost near-term copper-intensive electrical infrastructure demand and, secondarily, other grid metals like aluminium.

title: Copper advances on weaker dollar, but heading for weekly loss
summary: Copper prices edged up on Friday as the dollar retreated, but Reuters notes the contract is on track for a fourth straight weekly decline amid weak Chinese economic data and concerns over rate cuts. Aluminium and nickel also moved modestly, reflecting broader FX/macro sentiment.

title: SMM data: SMM A00 aluminium prices and discounts & premiums | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM publishes reference market data for Shanghai A00 aluminium prices, including prevailing discounts and premiums. The note emphasizes the figures are processed from public information and internal modeling and are for reference only. No additional policy, supply disruption, or demand shock is described, implying limited incremental price pressure.

title: Centaurus gets technical approval for Brazil nickel project
summary: Centaurus Metals received technical approval from Brazil’s National Mining Agency (ANM) for its Mining Lease Application (PAE) for the Jaguar Nickel Sulphide Project. Pending environmental clearance for the mining lease (LI), the company expects to secure permits in H2 2024. Approval reduces permitting risk and supports nickel supply expectations.

title: Copper rebounds on technical signals and lower LME stocks
summary: Copper prices in London rebounded on Friday, supported by oversold technical signals and lower LME on-warrant copper stocks hitting a four-month low after cancellations. Gains are tempered by cautious trading ahead of Chinese New Year and a firmer dollar. Aluminium and nickel also ticked up alongside copper.

title: Power Nickel Commences 2024 Drill Program
summary: Power Nickel started its 2024 winter drill program at the Nisk nickel sulfide project in Nemaska, Quebec, targeting new zones and continuing drilling at Nisk Main and other targets. The update is aimed at extending high-grade nickel-copper PGM mineralization, which may support near-term nickel sentiment.

title: Removing rare-earths drives demand for copper in EV motors
summary: The article says efforts to remove rare-earth magnets from EV motors can raise copper use by shifting toward induction and wound-rotor, magnet-free designs with more copper windings. It also discusses winding-efficiency improvements and limited aluminum substitution, but expects copper demand for EV motors to grow strongly through 2034.

title: Benton Resources Inc.: Benton's Prospecting and Trenching Program Returns More High-Grade Copper and Gold Results within the Great Burnt Project; Engages Grove for Investor Relations Services
summary: Benton Resources reported additional trenching/prospecting results from its Great Burnt copper-gold project in Newfoundland, including grab samples up to 4.35% copper near AEM conductors. The company plans further trench enlargement and channel sampling in 2024. The update is exploratory and may support copper sentiment modestly.

title: InvestorNewsBreaks – Canada Nickel Company Inc. (TSX.V: CNC) (OTCQX: CNIKF) Provides Corporate Updates
summary: Canada Nickel reported corporate updates including extending a US$12 million Auramet loan repayment to Feb. 16, 2024, and entering agreements to acquire additional mining claims in Ontario in exchange for shares and cash. It also notes equity issuances tied to exploration agreements and bank fees for flow-through financing.

title: Pampa Metals Corp. Commences Follow-Up Diamond Drill Testing at Piuquenes Copper-Gold Porphyry Project
summary: Pampa Metals commenced follow-up diamond drilling at its Piuquenes copper-gold porphyry project in Argentina to test depth and lateral extension of high-grade mineralization. Up to four holes are planned to validate a potential 1,000 m mineral column. The update is exploratory with no stated near-term supply effects.

title: Thieves take off with quantity of copper wiring in Rideau Lakes area
summary: Ontario Provincial Police say thieves stole copper wiring from utility poles in the Rideau Lakes area, causing lengthy communication disruptions and ongoing repairs. The amount stolen is unspecified, suggesting localized copper removal rather than a broad supply shock. The story also references rising copper theft activity elsewhere.

title: Surge Copper Completes Acquisition of 100% Interest in Berg
summary: Surge Copper Corp. says it has completed its acquisition of a 100% interest in the Berg Property, issuing shares to the seller and terminating a prior option agreement. The project is copper-bearing, but the news is mainly corporate/transactional and does not cite immediate production, inventory, or policy changes affecting copper prices.

title: Nickel mine 'rapidly advancing': CEO | North Bay Nugget
summary: Canada Nickel Company says its Crawford nickel sulphide project is “rapidly advancing,” with environmental permitting ongoing and plans to finalize construction in 2025 and start building in 2026. The CEO cites agreed highway and Hydro One re-routing plans and potential milling arrangements, alongside new core investors, supporting bullish sentiment for nickel.

title: Nickel mine 'rapidly advancing': CEO | Elliot Lake Standard
summary: Canada Nickel’s CEO says the Crawford Nickel Sulphide Project near Timmins is “rapidly advancing,” with continued environmental permitting, planned road and power-line rerouting, and discussions about processing at existing mills. The update includes EV-driven nickel demand narratives and new investor confidence, lifting sentiment for nickel.

title: Nickel mine 'rapidly advancing': CEO
summary: Canada Nickel’s CEO says the Crawford Nickel Sulphide Project is “rapidly advancing,” with feasibility completed, environmental permitting underway, and highway/power-line rerouting progress. The company is also discussing milling options with regional infrastructure partners. Major investors (Agnico Eagle, Anglo American, Samsung) back the project, bolstering nickel supply expectations.

title: Nickel mine 'rapidly advancing': CEO | Mid-North Monitor
summary: Canada Nickel Company says its Crawford Nickel Sulphide Project is “rapidly advancing,” with feasibility completed, environmental permitting underway, and construction targeted for 2026–2027. The CEO cites limited global nickel supply growth and investor backing, and notes permitting steps for highway and power-line rerouting. Overall tone supports nickel bullish sentiment.

title: Nickel mine 'rapidly advancing': CEO | Sault This Week
summary: Canada Nickel says its Crawford Nickel Sulphide Project north of Timmins is “rapidly advancing.” The CEO cites ongoing environmental permitting, agreed highway and Hydro One rerouting, and discussions about milling options. With major investors backing the project and EV-driven nickel demand, the update is sentimentally supportive for nickel.

title: Nickel mine 'rapidly advancing': CEO | The Daily Press
summary: Canada Nickel says its Crawford Nickel Sulphide Project near Timmins is “rapidly advancing,” with progress on feasibility, environmental permitting, and planned construction (2026) toward production (2027). The CEO cites limited global supply growth and describes investor backing, infrastructure rerouting, and ore-processing discussions, bolstering nickel sentiment.

title: Nickel mine 'rapidly advancing': CEO | Cochrane Times-Post
summary: Canada Nickel says its Crawford Nickel Sulphide Project near Timmins is rapidly advancing, with environmental permitting ongoing and agreed plans for rerouting Highway 655 and hydro lines. The company is also discussing ore processing options locally. Investor backing (Agnico Eagle, Anglo American, Samsung) supports sentiment for nickel, but output is years away.

title: Another fire at nickel smelter in Indonesia's Sulawesi, no injuries
summary: A fire broke out at a nickel smelter in Morowali, Indonesia, leading the operator to shut four furnaces, with three down for about 12 hours and one pending investigation and repair. It follows another fatal fire at the same industrial park in December. The safety procedure violation is under investigation.

title: Commander Intersects 140 m of 0.1% CuEq in Drilling at Burn Porphyry Copper Property, British Columbia
summary: Commander Resources reported 2023 drilling results from its Burn porphyry copper-gold property, including a highlight of 140 m grading 0.08% Cu and copper-equivalent intervals. The article discusses geology, alteration and future follow-up drilling plans, but provides no near-term production or supply impact for copper prices.

title: Benefits of CopperString for local businesses and Queenslanders | North Queensland Register
summary: The article reports progress on Queensland’s CopperString and SuperGrid, including Powerlink hiring Townsville apprentices and releasing numerous works packages for local suppliers. It frames CopperString as an essential electrical project tied to critical minerals and regional investment, supporting expectations of near-term demand for power-grid materials, especially copper.

title: S32 ASX: Nickel glut prompts rethink for South32's Colombian mine
summary: South32 says it is retooling its Cerro Matoso ferronickel mine in Colombia as an Indonesia-fuelled nickel glut disrupts the global market. The company may take measures to avoid outcomes seen in other miners shutting or cutting costs, highlighting pressure on nickel prices.

title: Nickel price: Andrew Forrest shutsters mines as nickel dominoes tumble
summary: Andrew Forrest’s Wyloo will place West Australian nickel mines near Kambalda into care and maintenance from May 31, citing a supply glut after nickel prices collapsed. The move follows losses from cheaper supply linked to China-backed Indonesian operations and is expected to cut about 1,000 jobs. Supply risk supports nickel.

title: Are You Anti-Nickel?: Gibran Asks Muhaimin during Debate
summary: In Indonesia’s vice-presidential debate, one campaign criticized the other for “anti-nickel” messaging as Tesla’s shift toward LFP (iron phosphate) batteries reduces nickel needs. The Prabowo-Gibran camp defends nickel exports to serve EV supply chains, but the LFP narrative pressures nickel demand expectations.

title: Australian Tycoon Forrest Shuts Nickel Mines After Prices Crash
summary: The headline says an Australian tycoon is shutting nickel mines after nickel prices have crashed. A mine shutdown tied directly to falling prices typically signals ongoing market weakness and can influence short-term supply expectations and sentiment around nickel demand and production economics.

title: Nickel Price Crash Seen Strengthening Indonesia's Grip on Supply
summary: The article headline suggests nickel prices have been falling sharply and that this downturn is strengthening Indonesia’s control over nickel supply. Such a development points to altered supply expectations or market leverage that can influence short-term nickel pricing, potentially adding downside pressure in coming days.

title: Wyloo Metals: Andrew 'Twiggy' Forrest closes WA nickel mines as price slumps
summary: Wyloo Metals will place its West Australian nickel mines into care and maintenance after nickel prices slumped. Because Wyloo is a major ore supplier, BHP is closing its Kambalda processing circuit as third-party ore becomes uneconomic. The article cites rising costs and supply coming to market while nickel prices fall.

title: Copper rises as softer dollar lends support
summary: Copper prices rose 0.3% on the LME and 0.7% on the SHFE as the U.S. dollar weakened ahead of major central bank meetings. The softer dollar makes greenback-priced metals cheaper. Aluminium and other base metals also edged up, while nickel was slightly higher on LME but lower on SHFE.

title: Andrew Forrest's Wyloo Metals to shutter Kambalda nickel mines after prices slump
summary: Wyloo Metals will temporarily pause mining at its Kambalda nickel operations and put parts of the local supply chain into care and maintenance after nickel prices have fallen sharply. The move follows recent shutdowns/cuts by other WA producers and comments about an oversupplied market dominated by Indonesian supply.

title: Indonesian VP hopeful slams Jokowi's nickel investment policy
summary: Indonesia VP candidate Muhaimin Iskandar criticizes President Jokowi’s downstreaming policy that uses export bans to force foreign companies to invest in mineral processing. He argues the policy caused environmental damage and limited local benefits, while foreign workers dominate new jobs, raising uncertainty around Indonesia’s nickel-related export stance.

title: Xanadu adds copper-nickel project to Mongolian operations
summary: Xanadu Mines agreed to earn up to 80% of Mongolia’s Sant Tolgoi project, which hosts multiple shallow copper-nickel targets, and plans initial mapping, geochemistry and geophysics work to start in March. The farm-in could lead to a JV, but no production is announced, limiting near-term metal price effects.

title: Xanadu adds copper-nickel project to Mongolian operations
summary: Xanadu Mines agreed to farm into the Sant Tolgoi project in Mongolia, targeting shallow magmatic copper and nickel mineralisation across multiple prospects. It can earn majority stakes by funding exploration over 24 months, with further upside from additional drilling. The move is exploration-led, with no immediate production impact.

title: Surge Copper concludes Berg Property acquisition in Canada
summary: Surge Copper finalized the acquisition of a 100% stake in the Berg Property in British Columbia from Thompson Creek Metals. The project is expected to produce significant copper over a 30-year life, but the transaction is corporate in nature with no immediate production or supply disruption details.

title: Focus on poor demand prospects weighs on copper
summary: Copper prices slipped as traders focused on poor demand prospects, particularly in China, alongside subdued activity. Outflows from LME warehouses and a softer dollar offered some support, but overall sentiment stayed weak until after Lunar New Year. Aluminium also fell, with expectations of market surpluses due to record Chinese production.

title: Managem to increase revenue thanks to gold, copper projects – CEO – The North Africa Post
summary: Managem’s CEO said the company aims to raise revenue by 50% and double copper output at Morocco’s Tizert mine via significant investment. Gold production has resumed in Sudan, but copper expansion is planned for 2025, so the supply implication is more future-oriented than immediate for copper prices.

title: Vital Battery Metals Field Program Outlines Significant Cu-Au-Zn Soil Anomaly at Sting Copper Project
summary: Vital Battery Metals announced soil sampling results at its Sting Copper Project, finding a multi-station Cu-Au-Zn anomaly including 0.27% copper in soil and correlation with bedrock source geology. The release supports drilling prospectivity, but provides no production or supply changes that would move near-term copper markets.

title: Copper Supply Disruptions Fuel Market Uncertainty
summary: Copper prices are described as still trapped in a long sideways trend, even as supply risks persist. The piece cites Cobre Panama’s closure (~1% of output) and deep LME contango suggesting oversupplied spot, with high inventories and muted demand. Fed/dollar expectations may limit near-term breakout risk.

title: Eramet's New Caledonia nickel plant runs reduced output after power incident
summary: Eramet’s SLN Doniambo nickel plant in New Caledonia is running at significantly reduced output after furnace cathodes broke, destabilizing the power grid and triggering a two-hour outage. The plant is kept running off a floating power unit, while negotiations to rescue the territory’s loss-making nickel industry continue, with energy a key issue.

title: Nickel Prices Keep Slumping Even as Mines Close
summary: The news item highlights that nickel prices are still slumping despite mine closures. This suggests ongoing bearish sentiment in the nickel market and continued pressure on prices in the near term. While mine shut-ins may tighten supply, the overall market reaction remains downward.

title: Global Copper Cables Market Growth Trajectory
summary: The news item is a market-research description forecasting growth in the global copper cables market (powered by power distribution, data transmission, and smart grid development) and noting “volatility in prices of raw materials.” It provides no immediate copper supply, demand, or pricing catalyst, so near-term impact on copper is likely limited.

title: Two charged after copper theft cuts internet, phone for thousands
summary: Calgary police charged two people after copper telecom wire theft knocked out internet and phone service for over 2,000 residents. The theft involved entering manholes in early December, with evidence tied to resale of copper wire. Damage is estimated at $276,000; a third suspect remains at large.

title: Aurubis In Talks To Terminate Contracts Of CEO And Two Other Executives After Copper Scam
summary: Aurubis said it is discussing the early termination of its CEO and two other executives following large losses from fraud at its Hamburg copper producer. The fraud relates to discrepancies in copper inventory and irregularities in samples from recycling input shipments, prompting governance and operational uncertainty.

title: Presidential debate failed to tackle ESG issues in nickel mining - Regulations
summary: Critics say Indonesia’s vice-presidential debate didn’t adequately address ESG issues in the country’s nickel downstream sector. Activists highlight environmental impacts from industrial parks and argue regulations and carbon policies may be needed. The piece notes Indonesia is pushing nickel refining for batteries and steelmaking, alongside calls for emissions controls.

title: Crisis Talks Held as Lithium and Nickel Prices Crash and Mines Close
summary: Mining firms will meet Australia’s government amid concerns that lithium and nickel prices are falling sharply as mines close. The piece links the minerals to EV battery manufacturing, implying ongoing supply and market-price stress. The only tracked metal mentioned is nickel, which likely faces near-term bearish pressure.

title: Ministry of Ecology halts Kazakhmys's copper concentrator in court
summary: Kazakhstan’s Ministry of Ecology moved in court to suspend operations of 31 enterprises, including Kazakhmys LLP’s copper concentrator. The action follows legal steps announced by Minister Erlan Nysanbayev. Halting concentrator output can reduce copper concentrate supply, likely weighing on near-term copper price expectations.

title: Andrew Forrest wants tax credits, royalty relief to save nickel industry
summary: Wyloo Metals, owned by Andrew Forrest, is seeking a 10% production tax credit for downstream nickel processing, royalty relief, and increased access to government funding. The push follows Glencore’s warning about the sector’s difficulties in Australia, implying policymakers could act to ease nickel production stress.

title: Orion achieves 'important milestone' at Okiep Copper Project
summary: Orion Minerals secured surface rights for about 12,000ha over the Okiep Copper Project, clearing a land-use conflict and allowing environmental, water-use and rezoning applications to proceed. The company mobilised drills for a 3,000m programme to support geotechnical and metallurgical validation for the Flat Mines deposits.

title: Copper Fox Provides Analytical Results for 2023 Geotechnical Drilling Program at Schaft Creek Project
summary: Copper Fox reported analytical results from geotechnical drilling at the Schaft Creek project, with several drillholes intersecting copper-molybdenum-gold-silver mineralization and quantified copper grades via copper-equivalent cut-offs. The program is aimed at updating an open pit mine plan and slope stability, without any immediate production or supply-impact guidance.

title: Probe Gold Intersects up to 1.17% Copper over 9.5m and
summary: Probe Gold reported expanded copper mineralization at its La Peltrie project, including 0.13% Cu over 513.5 metres and higher-grade intercepts up to 1.17% Cu over 9.5 metres. The results suggest a larger Cu-Au-Mo system open at depth and along strike, but remain exploration-stage.

title: As of 15:00 CST January 23, the SMM copper cathode spot trading intensity index was decrease 37.47, a increase of 2.43 from the day before
summary: SMM data for Jan 23 (15:00 CST) shows the copper cathode spot trading intensity index decreased to 37.47, which is 2.43 higher than the day before. The reported change suggests softer spot activity at the time of the observation. SMM notes the figures are for reference only.

title: World Copper Announces Appointment of Gordon Neal as CEO
summary: World Copper announced CEO leadership changes and an Escalones Project update. Chile’s presidential decree created new protected sanctuaries, and management says the decree covers the Escalones area. The company is assessing the decree’s full regulatory and permitting impact and may adjust plans to advance the project in compliance.

title: 13th package of sanctions: EU prepares embargo on Russian aluminium
summary: The EU is preparing the next sanctions package, including an embargo on Russian aluminium. By limiting access to Russian metal supplies, the measure could tighten European aluminium availability and push prices higher over the coming days as traders reprice supply risk and replacement sourcing needs.

title: Politico: EU may sanction Russian aluminum as part of next package
summary: Politico reports the EU may sanction Russian aluminum as part of its next package. If implemented, the measure could restrict Russian supply into European and global markets, tightening availability and likely supporting higher aluminium prices over the coming days as traders price in reduced exports.

title: Velocity Receives Positive Drill Results from Iglika Copper-Gold Project, Southeast Bulgaria
summary: Velocity Minerals reports positive drill results from the Iglika copper-gold project in southeast Bulgaria, including 4.0m at 0.47% copper and over 70m of consistent copper mineralization in one hole. A second drill rig has been mobilized and assays for another hole are pending, with further drilling planned.

title: Latin Metals Inc. Acquires Terraza Copper Project Juyay Province, Argentina
summary: Latin Metals Inc. acquired the Terraza copper exploration project in northwest Argentina via staking, expanding its ground holdings in an emerging sediment-hosted copper belt. The company plans drainage surveys, prospecting, mapping, and sample analysis (with some delays due to equipment service), with results expected later from ongoing exploration.

title: China's Surge in EV Exports to Europe Sparks Aluminum Industry Concerns
summary: China’s EV exports to Europe surged in 2023, prompting EU concern and potential anti-subsidy/anti-competitive probes. The piece highlights Europe’s aluminum industry “crisis mode,” a continuing surplus, high energy-cost stress, and rising Chinese aluminum imports, implying increased competitive supply pressures that are bearish for aluminium prices.

title: Zambia rushes to rescue 7 trapped in Chinese-owned copper mine
summary: Zambian authorities are pumping out water and mud to rescue seven miners trapped in a Chinese-owned Macrolink copper mine near Ndola. The incident occurred after water entered the shaft, trapping six more workers after one escaped. Zambia is a major copper producer, and mining disruptions can affect near-term supply expectations.

title: Marvel Discovery Corp.: Marvel Completes 3 Holes at Duhamel, Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project North of Quebec City
summary: Marvel Discovery reports it has completed three drill holes at its Duhamel Ni-Cu-Co project in Quebec, with all holes intersecting target conductors and noting nickel and copper assay highlights from recent and historical results. Drilling delays were due to flooding, and management reiterates bullish views on Ni/Cu supply.

title: LA councilmembers call for police task force as surge in copper wire theft leaves many streets dark
summary: Los Angeles councilmembers called for a police task force after a surge in copper wire theft left thousands of streetlights inoperable. Officials cite about 38,000 feet of copper wire stolen from the 6th Street Viaduct and millions in repair costs. Thieves sell scrap copper to recycling centers, increasing secondary supply.

title: Marvel Completes 3 Holes at Duhamel, Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project North of Quebec City
summary: Marvel Discovery reports completion of three drill holes at its Duhamel Ni-Cu-Co project after weather-related delays, with wide sulphide mineralization intervals and historic/analog grades including ~1%+ nickel and ~0.3–0.4% copper over meters. The release notes further survey plans and management’s bullish view on nickel and copper prices.

title: FPX Nickel closes $14.4M equity investment from Sumitomo Metal Mining
summary: FPX Nickel closed a $14.4M private placement led by Sumitomo Metal Mining to fund exploration and development of its Baptiste nickel project in British Columbia. The company will also continue environmental and feasibility work. The financing improves project progress, but does not signal immediate nickel supply changes.

title: Aluminum Jumps After Report EU May Sanction Russian Metal
summary: The article’s headline says aluminium prices jump after a report that the EU may impose sanctions on Russian metal. EU sanctions would likely restrict Russian supply into the market, tightening availability and raising near-term price expectations for aluminium.

title: True North Copper signs agreement with Glencore | The North West Star
summary: True North Copper has signed a binding offtake and toll-mining deal with Glencore to toll treat up to one million tonnes per year of copper concentrate from its Cloncurry project and give TNC full access to concentrate processing. Glencore will purchase 100% of copper metal produced, boosting production certainty.

title: With LFP batteries all the rage, experts differ on future of nickel in EV industry - Regulations
summary: An election debate highlights disputes over Indonesia’s nickel strategy and EV batteries. LFP batteries’ rise—used in Tesla Model 3/Y and free of nickel—is cited as undermining nickel demand. Critics argue Indonesia’s nickel export ban constrained ore supply and accelerated shifts toward nickel-free alternatives.

title: Funds sell copper as weak demand trumps supply pressures: Andy Home -January 23, 2024 at 08:00 pm EST
summary: Reuters says fund managers have turned increasingly bearish in copper, flipping from net long to the largest CME net short since mid-2022. Despite supply-related factors like mine closures and falling smelter treatment charges, weak global manufacturing demand—especially in China—has dominated sentiment, weighing on prices in January.

title: Aluminium edges higher as sanction jitters fuel supply woes
summary: Aluminium prices edged higher as traders weighed risks that the EU could impose sanctions on Russian aluminium imports. Poland and Baltic states urged an import ban, tightening expectations for supply. LME and SHFE aluminium rose, while other metals were mixed and copper was nearly flat.

title: New Caledonia's Prony Resources faces cash crunch on nickel slump
summary: Reuters reports New Caledonian nickel producer Prony Resources faces an alarming cash crunch due to a large nickel price slump, worsened by production below budget. The company is awaiting potential French monetary support for the territory’s nickel sector. Nickel demand is supported by batteries, but cash stress raises near-term downside risk.

title: Funds sell copper as weak demand trumps supply pressures: Andy Home
summary: Funds have flipped copper positioning to the largest net short since mid-2022, favoring a weak global demand outlook over supply stress. While smelter treatment charges have fallen and mine disruptions (e.g., Cobre Panama) suggest tighter concentrate, investors highlight China and broader manufacturing contraction, keeping near-term copper bearish.

title: Sava Drilling Results at Target West Verify New South Greenland Copper District
summary: Amaroq Minerals reported drill results from its Sava Target West in South Greenland, intersecting copper mineralisation from surface and indicating a new ~120km copper district. The company cites porphyry-style and skarn-like copper/molybdenum grades and plans further drilling and surveys. No immediate production impact is described.

title: Robert Friedland, founder of Ivanhoe Mines: Copper supply no longer keeps pace with global demand - 2024-01-23
summary: Ivanhoe Mines’ Robert Friedland says copper supply no longer matches global demand, with historic mines facing declining ore grades and reserves. He expects prices to rise despite China property weakness, arguing strong defence demand and possibly easier US rates could support copper. He highlights a $15,000/tonne level needed for new investment.

title: Barrick expedites Lumwana copper mine expansion in Zambia
summary: Barrick Gold has fast-tracked the Super Pit expansion at its Lumwana copper mine in Zambia, targeting first copper production in 2028 and around 240,000 tonnes annually. The $2bn project is part of Zambia’s effort to rejuvenate its copper sector, but timing implies limited near-term supply impact.

title: Amaroq Minerals Ltd. Announces Provisional Results from Its 2023 Exploration Programme on the Sava Copper Project
summary: Amaroq Minerals reported provisional results from its 2023 exploration programme on the Sava copper project in South Greenland. The company’s modelling suggests the project lies within a newly identified copper belt and targets a copper–molybdenum porphyry-style system at Target West. No near-term production impact is indicated.

title: Glencore to procure copper from TNC's Cloncurry project
summary: True North Copper (TNC) signed two agreements with Glencore for its Cloncurry, Queensland copper concentrate. Glencore will buy 100% of concentrate from the project, while toll-milling enables processing up to one million tonnes of ore annually at the Mt Isa Smelter. The deal aligns pricing with market terms plus charges/credits.

title: Koryx Copper Intersects 202 Metres at 0.49% Cu Eq,
summary: Koryx Copper reported first assay results from Haib’s 2023/2024 drilling in southern Namibia, highlighting wide, high-grade copper (and copper-equivalent) intersections, including intervals up to 202 metres at 0.49% CuEq. Management says grades were underestimated, but the release does not indicate production changes. Nickel and aluminium are not addressed.

title: Copper production boosts FreePort-McMoRan results past Wall Street expectations
summary: Freeport-McMoRan’s quarterly earnings and revenue beat Wall Street expectations, and its copper volumes came in above the company’s earlier estimate. The firm expects 2024 copper production to broadly match year-end 2024 totals (with gold output higher), implying improved short-term copper supply expectations.

title: Samsung SDI stake in Canada Nickel highlights EV materials focus
summary: Samsung SDI took an 8.7% stake in Canada Nickel and secured rights tied to the Crawford nickel-cobalt project, contingent on construction. The piece frames IRA sourcing rules that penalize non-compliant nickel/cobalt as driving new supply partnerships, potentially tightening “eligible” nickel availability and supporting prices.

title: Highland Copper Announces Initiation of Drilling Program at White Pine North Project
summary: Highland Copper announced that its joint venture started a winter drilling program at the White Pine North copper project in Michigan. The program will collect metallurgical and geotechnical data for mine development through Q2 2024. Results may refine the 2023 preliminary economic assessment, subject to weather and compliance work.

title: Don't stake it all on nickel - Editorial - The Jakarta Post
summary: The Jakarta Post editorial says Indonesia is overreliant on nickel for EV batteries, but rapid battery evolution is moving toward nickel-free LFP chemistries used by BYD and Tesla. It warns carmakers may show less interest in Indonesian nickel. The piece notes most nickel smelting is already tied to steel, reducing EV-driven downside.

title: Australian lithium and nickel miners to ask for tax credits and emergency funds to weather global price crunch
summary: Australian lithium and nickel miners plan crisis talks seeking tax credits, royalty relief and emergency funding after lithium prices fell over 80% and nickel down about 40%. Mines are suspending production and processing is curtailed. Policymakers consider targeted fiscal support to protect Australia’s energy-transition supply and workforce.

title: Copper price strengthens on back of China's economic stimulus and ongoing supply disruptions
summary: Copper strengthened overnight as China unveiled banking liquidity support and better US activity improved demand expectations. At the same time, supply risks—including Panama’s plan to close the Cobre Panama mine and wider geopolitical disruptions—kept concerns about tight supply elevated. Fitch/BMI forecasts support prices via constrained supply and a weaker dollar.

title: Copper dips from 3-week high on caution after China policy support
summary: Copper prices fell after two sessions of gains as traders reassessed optimism about China’s policy support, including reserve cuts and potential stabilisation funding. The piece also notes declines in LME aluminium and nickel, with slower physical nonferrous consumption and mixed global macro data capping rallies.

title: Nickel miners could pay less to mine in Western Australia amid royalty relief crisis talks
summary: Western Australia’s mines minister is considering royalty reforms and potential payment deferrals for nickel producers as the industry faces global oversupply and nickel prices have fallen sharply. Mines have reportedly closed and jobs were cut, while talks aim to reduce operating costs and keep marginal supply viable.

title: Nickel miners explore for taxpayer dime to ease industry pain
summary: Nickel miners in Western Australia urge federal and state support as nickel prices slump amid Indonesia’s surge in processed nickel output. The federal resources minister said production tax credits and possible royalty relief are under consideration. Several WA mines have already paused or closed, including Wyloo’s shutdown, highlighting near-term market stress.

title: QC Copper and Gold Inc: QC Copper's Details Artificial Intelligence Targeting for Drill Program
summary: QC Copper and Gold reports Windfall Geotech’s final AI analysis for its Opemiska project in Quebec, identifying five drill targets around historical copper-gold areas and outlining planned 2024 drilling and IP surveys. It reiterates existing Measured/Indicated copper grades but provides no production or supply-impact event.

title: Arizona Sonoran MainSpring Drilling Intersects Near Surface Mineralization; Intersects 1,053 ft (321 m) of 0.20% Total Copper from 147 ft (45 m) depth
