Zinc concentrate production dropped 18% and molybdenum output rose. The copper decline could slightly weaken supply expectations, though it largely reflects full-year performance.

title: Anglo American's Brazilian iron and nickel mines get IRMA 75 approval
summary: Anglo American said its Barro Alto nickel and Minas-Rio iron ore mines in Brazil received positive IRMA 75 audit approval. The company framed the result as transparency and responsible sourcing progress toward IRMA standards by 2025. The news is more sustainability-focused than a near-term change to nickel supply or demand.

title: Tsingshan's 2023 nickel output jumps to record high
summary: Tsingshan said its 2023 nickel output jumped 27% to a record 1.12 million tonnes, adding to global supply. Reuters links the higher volumes to continued price pressure on LME nickel, which already fell sharply last year, and notes expectations for a growing surplus could push prices lower further.

title: Industry "chill and harsh", it is expected that the operating rate of the copper foil industry will hit a new low in February [SMM Analysis]
summary: SMM says copper foil enterprises’ operating rate fell to 58.5% in January and is expected to drop to 47.14% in February, with lithium-battery copper foil falling to 43.42% and electronic-circuit foil to 53.8%. Weak downstream orders, lower replenishment, and Spring Festival shutdowns are cited, implying softer copper demand.

title: FLSmidth to deliver HPGRs to a copper concentrator in the Asia Pacific region
summary: FLSmidth announced an order (~DKK 300m) to supply HPGR comminution technology to upgrade a copper concentrator in the Asia Pacific. The upgrade targets increased throughput, lower power consumption, and longer roll life amid harder ore and falling grades. Equipment delivery is scheduled for 2025.

title: Spot market is coming to an end due to the rhythm of downstream stocking, and the trading sentiment of the nickel spot market has cooled down
summary: The piece links nickel price movement to futures short covering (open interest down while prices rise), and describes Spring Festival-affected downstream stocking nearing its end and sentiment cooling. Spot supply is relatively tight due to holidays, while pure nickel arrivals increase supply. Overall outlook is slow/slightly upward nickel prices with weak fluctuation.

title: Hundreds of jobs to go as nickel price slump claims Tasmania's Avebury mine
summary: Receivers of Mallee Resources have closed the Avebury nickel mine in Tasmania, ending hundreds of jobs. The shutdown follows multiple closures since December, blamed on a nickel price slump and increased nickel supply from Indonesia. Reduced operating supply from Avebury could limit near-term nickel availability.

title: FLSmidth A/S: FLSmidth to deliver HPGRs to a copper concentrator in the Asia Pacific region
summary: FLSmidth said it received a DKK 300 million order to supply HPGR comminution technology to upgrade a copper concentrator in Asia Pacific. The HPGRs and auxiliary equipment are intended to address harder ore and lower grades, boosting throughput and reducing power use. Delivery is scheduled for 2025.

title: Vast Resources quarterly copper concentrate grade falls
summary: Vast Resources said its Baita Plai polymetallic mine produced 24,178 tonnes of copper in Q4 2023, but the copper concentrate grade fell to 18% from 23% in 2022. Management blamed mining an area with lower-grade ore, while quality improved after quarter-end as higher-grade zones were accessed.

title: Nortec Confirms Priority Copper Drill Target at Sturgeon Lake VMS Project, Ontario, Canada
summary: Nortec Minerals reports final soil and ground EM results confirming a drill-ready, highly conductive VMS prospect with copper-silver anomalism (e.g., 297ppm Cu) at Ontario’s Sturgeon Lake project. The company plans to drill test priority targets in its next exploration campaign. The news is copper-focused, with no aluminium implications.

title: Nortec Minerals Corp.: Nortec Confirms Priority Copper Drill Target at Sturgeon Lake VMS Project, Ontario, Canada
summary: Nortec Minerals reports final soil sampling and initial ground EM results confirming a copper-silver rich, drill-ready northeast target at its Sturgeon Lake VMS project in Ontario. Multiple anomalous copper soils and an untested late-time EM conductor indicate potential for a new copper discovery, but no drilling has occurred yet.

title: Deal Signed To Export DR Congo Copper Via US-backed Corridor
summary: Trafigura and Ivanhoe Mines signed a major agreement to export copper from the Democratic Republic of Congo along a US-backed rail corridor. The deal aims to move DRC output more efficiently through the planned logistics route, potentially affecting short-term copper shipment expectations and market pricing.

title: Surge Copper Announces 2023 Surface Exploration Results Identifies New Porphyry Exploration Target Adjacent to Berg
summary: Surge Copper reports 2023 surface exploration at its Berg Property in B.C., highlighting new porphyry targets (SW Berg and NE Sibola) based on geophysical results and large copper-in-soil anomalies. No drilling confirmation or production changes are announced; the update is early-stage exploration-focused.

title: Core Nickel Corp.: Core Nickel Provides Corporate Update, Including Plans for Winter Drill Program at Its Halfway Lake Property
summary: Core Nickel Corp. provided a corporate update on its inaugural ~1,000 m winter drilling program at the Halfway Lake nickel property in Manitoba, targeting the historical W62 anomaly with prior results of 18.9 m at 0.68% Ni (including 3.05 m at 1.32% Ni). Drilling is expected to start in early March.

title: Core Nickel Provides Corporate Update, Including Plans for Winter Drill Program at Its Halfway Lake Property
summary: Core Nickel Corp. announced it is planning its inaugural ~1,000 m winter drilling program at its Halfway Lake nickel project in Manitoba, targeting the historical W62 zone. Drilling is set to start in early March and aims to test magnetic anomalies based on earlier nickel-rich intersections.

title: Copper retreats on Chinese demand uncertainty
summary: Copper fell on Wednesday as uncertainty over Chinese demand and a near-term economic slowdown outweighed hopes of improved green-energy demand. Three-month LME copper dropped, with wider cash discounts/contango. The piece also notes aluminium edging lower and nickel slipping slightly, reflecting broader metal sentiment tied to China data.

title: Max Resource Discovers 5 New Copper and Silver Targets at CESAR
summary: Max Resource reports discovering five new copper-silver mineralized outcrops at its AM-14 area within the Cesar Copper-Silver Project in Colombia. The company cites lateral continuity between targets and has begun channel sampling, awaiting assay results. The update affects long-term exploration sentiment, not immediate supply.

title: Kendrick Resources discovers new drill targets at Espedalen nickel complex
summary: Kendrick Resources said new ground magnetic and electromagnetic surveys at its Espedalen nickel complex in Norway outlined two prospective drill areas. The company expects further technical studies and drilling to expand the Stormyra deposit, building on historical resources of nickel and copper. Impact on metal prices is likely limited due to exploration stage.

title: Mytilineos SA takes on Ghana's new bauxite mine and refinery project
summary: Mytilineos has agreed with Ghana’s GIADEC to build an alumina refinery and develop a new bauxite mine in Ghana. The plan supports Ghana’s push toward a fully integrated aluminium industry. While it may influence future aluminium supply expectations, the article gives no near-term production timelines.

title: Silicon Valley Startup Claims Massive Copper Discovery in Africa
summary: KoBold Metals says its AI-driven exploration in Zambia’s Mingomba project has found a huge, high-grade copper deposit near major existing mines. The company plans further exploration and may seek partners for a large development bill, but the article stresses new copper output will take years, while near-term prices depend on softer demand indicators.

title: Avebury Nickel Mine closure: More than 200 West Coast jobs lost | The Advocate
summary: Avebury Nickel Mine near Zeehan is set to close, ending operations after years of trouble and unsuccessful sale efforts. Receivers cite sustained low LME nickel prices, linked to expanded Indonesian supply, making production uneconomic. The mine will move to care and maintenance, implying reduced near-term nickel supply.

title: Deputies: Sumter, Clarendon farmers face up to $10K in damage after copper wire theft
summary: Deputies in Sumter and Clarendon counties report thieves stealing copper wire from irrigation equipment, causing up to about $10,000 in damage to farmers. Local sheriff investigators are working together to solve the thefts. The story focuses on local crimes and calls for community vigilance, with no broader market impact mentioned.

title: Copper Fox Metals Inc.: Copper Fox Announces 2023 Year-End Operating and Financial Results
summary: Copper Fox reported audited 2023 results and detailed ongoing work at its copper projects, including metallurgical testwork at Schaft Creek, drill rehabilitation at Van Dyke expected to finish in April, and permitting/drilling preparations at Mineral Mountain and Eaglehead. Teck’s 2024 Schaft Creek program is expected by end-February.

title: Avebury Nickel Mine closing: More than 200 West Coast jobs to vanish
summary: The troubled Avebury nickel mine near Zeehan will close and move to care and maintenance, ending production and reducing employment. The decision is attributed to sustained weak LME nickel prices and expanded Indonesian supply. Receivers cite an inability to sell the asset under current nickel market conditions, implying reduced supply.

title: Avebury Nickel Mine closure: Job losses hit West Coast workers | The Advocate
summary: Tasmanian Avebury Nickel Mine is returning to care and maintenance after a sustained collapse in nickel prices, leading to over 200 job losses. Local leaders say the closure will harm regional supply chains. Reduced nickel production capacity could support short-term nickel price expectations, despite limited market detail in the article.

title: Anglo American posts 24% rise in annual copper output
summary: Anglo American said its annual copper output rose 24% and kept 2024 guidance at 730,000–790,000 tons. The market context is mixed: analysts still expect a copper deficit from 2024 due to mine shutdowns in Panama and lower supply outlooks from major producers, limiting the net price impact.

title: Anglo American Q4 Nickel Production Rises 9%
summary: Anglo American said Q4 nickel output rose 9% due to better operational stability, while copper production fell 6% as Los Bronces in Chile declined despite higher output from Peru’s Quellaveco. These company-level production changes may influence short-term supply expectations, but no market-moving disruptions are cited.

title: Major aluminum smelter in Romania invests USD 2.75 mln in electric furnace
summary: Romanian aluminum producer Alro plans a USD 2.75 mln investment to install an electrically heated furnace, replacing three gas-fired furnaces for its wrought division. The change is intended to improve efficiency, better control aging temperatures, and reduce reliance on natural gas as part of a greener production strategy.

title: Anglo American Production Fell as Expected on Lower Copper, Iron Ore Output -- Commodity Comment
summary: Anglo American said overall output fell 7% in 4Q, largely due to lower copper output and planned slowdown at iron ore operations. Copper production declined 6% as Los Bronces faced lower grades/harder ore. Nickel production rose 9% on improved stability, partially offsetting metal supply pressures.

title: In WA, nickel job losses not enough to stop Indonesia critical minerals deal with Indonesia
summary: Western Australia plans to proceed with a critical minerals trade pact with Indonesia despite concerns that Indonesia’s drive for EV battery production has flooded global markets with cheap nickel. The resulting pricing pressure has led to local mine closures and job losses, highlighting bearish near-term nickel supply expectations.

title: DLP Resources Inc.: DLP Resources Confirms Extension of Copper, Silver and Molybdenum Mineralization to NE of Aurora Drilling with Values of up to 2.25% Cu and 195g/t Ag and 182ppm Mo in Rock Samples
summary: DLP Resources reported rock sampling results for the NE extension of its Aurora porphyry copper-molybdenum project in southern Peru, identifying anomalous copper over an area about 700m x 500m (including 2.25% Cu). The company plans to expand drilling in 2024, but no immediate supply impact is indicated.

title: Canada Nickel Company's NetZero Metals Intends to Develop Downstream Nickel & Stainless-Steel Processing Facilities in Timmins Region
summary: Canada Nickel’s subsidiary NetZero Metals plans two downstream facilities in Timmins: a large nickel processing plant and a stainless-steel/alloy production unit, using CO2 storage linked to the Crawford nickel project. Feasibility is underway and production is targeted for 2027, implying limited immediate nickel-price impact.

title: Global aluminium premiums mixed amid low activity
summary: Fastmarkets reported mixed aluminium P1020A premium moves: US premiums widened downward on muted spot activity and bearish sentiment, while Brazil and MJP premiums rose on deal reports and tightness. Europe and South Korea premiums stayed supported due to limited availability despite flat demand. The Missouri smelter curtailment was largely priced in.

title: Xanadu on mission to become Mongolia's next copper producer
summary: Xanadu says its partnership with Zijin provides funding certainty for Mongolia’s Kharmagtai copper-gold project, including a PFS update and plans for eventual first concentrate production in 2027. It also cites rising market expectations for copper concentrate tightness, but near-term supply impact is distant.

title: Canadian Miner Plans $1 Billion Nickel Processing Plant for EVs
summary: The piece highlights a Canadian miner’s plan to invest about $1 billion in a nickel processing plant aimed at EV demand. Such announcements can affect short-term nickel sentiment by shaping expectations for EV-linked nickel demand and the pace of future processing capacity.

title: EU unable to prohibit Russian aluminum
summary: Politico reports the EU is expected to avoid a comprehensive import ban on Russian aluminum in its next sanctions package. Despite pressure from Baltic and Poland producers to restrict Russian supply, Italy and other industrial consumers oppose due to potential price and availability impacts for aluminum.

title: Jubilee Metals shares up as Zambia copper unit progresses
summary: Jubilee Metals says its Roan copper concentrator in Zambia is on track for commissioning by end of Q1, with manufacturing and testing of a 50,000 tonnes/month processing module completed. Engineering for a new concentrate line at Sable Refinery is underway, construction planned for Q2, and options for Munkoyo project have been agreed.

title: Canada Nickel plans $1-billion EV nickel processing plant in Ontario
summary: Canada Nickel plans a US$1 billion nickel processing plant in Ontario for EV supply chain needs, targeting 80,000+ tons annually and operations by early 2027, plus an additional US$2 billion stainless steel/alloy facility. The company links its plans to reduced reliance on Indonesia/China amid recent nickel price declines.

title: Capstone Copper Corp.: Capstone Copper and Orion Announce Closing of C$431 Million Bought Deal
summary: Capstone Copper closed a C$431.2 million bought deal equity offering at C$6.30/share. Net proceeds will fund near-term growth initiatives and engineering for Chilean projects (Mantoverde optimized and Santo Domingo), plus exploration and working capital. The release is primarily capital-raising, not an immediate supply or demand catalyst for copper.

title: Canadian miner plans US$1 billion nickel processing plant for EVs
summary: A Canadian miner plans a US$1 billion nickel processing plant focused on EV-related supply. The project highlights investment in nickel refining capacity tied to battery demand, which can improve market sentiment and near-term expectations for nickel supply/demand balance.

title: Abu Dhabi's KEZAD to get alumina factory in 2025
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) signed an agreement to supply alumina to a new UAE complex at KEZAD, targeting first production in 2025. The plant will make specialised alumina derivatives, substituting imports and supporting industries including aluminium. The feedstock is from EGA’s Al Taweelah refinery.

title: Hot commissioning of Oman copper concentrator project begins
summary: Al Hadeetha Resources says hot commissioning at Oman’s Al Wash-hi Majaza copper-gold concentrator has begun, with copper ore expected to enter commissioning within 7–10 days. The project is set to start producing copper concentrate for export under an eight-year offtake with Trafigura, priced off LME Grade A copper.

title: Canada Nickel plants would upgrade Ontario processing
summary: Canada Nickel plans to build two >$1B processing plants near Timmins, including a nickel processing facility feeding its Crawford nickel sulphide project and a large stainless-steel/alloy plant. Feasibility and design work is underway with targeted 2027 startup, supported by major investors and clean-carbon ambitions.

title: US Congressman accuses Alcoa, Century, Rio Tinto of anti-competitive behavior in aluminium market | Hotter Commodities
summary: US Congressman Ken Buck accuses Alcoa, Rio Tinto, and Century Aluminum of anti-competitive behavior by charging beverage customers using a tariff-inclusive price despite most aluminium being tariff-exempt. He urges a US Justice Department antitrust investigation and broader False Claims Act liability, targeting US Midwest aluminium premium transparency.

title: Canada Nickel plans to raise $1 billion for nickel-processing plant
summary: Canada Nickel’s unit NetZero Metals plans to raise about $1 billion to build an Ontario nickel-processing plant, aiming for 80,000 tonnes annually, with production starting in 2027. It also develops a nickel mine in Ontario. The move targets “clean” nickel supply for North America, where battery demand is expected to rise.

title: Mining Stock News Bite - Canada Nickel Company's (TSXV: CNC) (OTCQX: CNIKF) NetZero Metals Intends to Develop Downstream Nickel & Stainless-Steel Processing Facilities in Timmins Region
summary: Canada Nickel Company’s subsidiary NetZero Metals plans to develop two facilities in Timmins—a nickel processing plant and a stainless-steel/alloy production facility—using carbon storage from its Crawford Nickel project. The project is in selection and feasibility stages, with production targeted for 2027, implying little immediate effect on nickel prices.

title: Domestic demand is cold before the holiday, which is expected to drag down copper prices to a certain extent.
summary: The piece expects copper to soften into the Spring Festival. It cites cold domestic demand with most firms entering holiday mode and limited spot transactions, plus macro pressure from a firmer dollar and higher U.S. yields. It also notes mixed inventory trends (LME down, SHFE up) supporting loose near-term supply.

title: Vulcan Minerals Inc. - Red Cross Lake Delivers Stellar Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Soil Anomaly in Newfoundland
summary: Vulcan Minerals reports highly anomalous soil geochemical results at its Red Cross Lake nickel-copper-cobalt project, including peak nickel of 3,936 ppm and elevated copper values, with drilling and permitting planned for 2024. The release is exploration-focused and does not indicate any immediate marketable supply changes.

title: Nevada Copper Corp. Provides Pumpkin Hollow Operations Update
summary: Nevada Copper Corp. updated restart activities at its Pumpkin Hollow underground mine, citing bottlenecks in process plant systems being mitigated. It reports commissioning progress across paste plant, dewatering, and ore handling infrastructure, plus infrastructure work leading to installation and commissioning of the crushing system, improving output ramp prospects.

title: Vulcan Minerals Inc. - Red Cross Lake Delivers Stellar Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Soil Anomaly in Newfoundland
summary: Vulcan Minerals reports strong soil geochemical anomalies at its Red Cross Lake nickel-copper-cobalt project in Newfoundland, including very high nickel and associated copper values, plus plans to initiate permitting and drilling in 2024. The release is exploration-focused with no confirmed resource or production impact, making near-term price effects limited.

title: Mining company to build two nickel processing plants in Timmins, Ont.
summary: Canada Nickel plans to build two facilities in Timmins, Ontario: a nickel processing plant and a stainless steel/alloys plant to support the EV battery supply chain. The company targets zero-carbon production using its carbon storage tech, with operations expected in 2027. Ontario also aims to make Timmins a nickel hub.

title: Canada Nickel looking for government funding, partners to build plants
summary: Canada Nickel seeks government funding and partners to build a large nickel processing facility in northeastern Ontario, targeting EV battery and stainless-steel supply-chain needs. The company cites a lack of new processing capacity amid rising projected nickel demand. Governments indicate willingness to explore proposals; project timelines extend to 2027.

title: Atacama Copper Corporation Announces TSXV Conditional Approval of Business Combination and Filing of Filing Statement
summary: Atacama Copper announced TSXV conditional approval of a planned business combination with TCP1 and filed a related statement on SEDAR+. Project-related context is provided for its Placeton/Caballo Muerto copper project in Chile, but the release is mostly procedural with no operational changes or supply impacts cited.

title: Copper smelters feel pain as treatment and refining charges plummet | Hotter Commodities
summary: Fastmarkets reports copper treatment and refining charges (TCs/RCs) for concentrates in cif Asia Pacific nearing all-time lows, down 53% from early January. The plunge follows mine disruptions and lower 2024 guidance, while smelting capacity additions are set to increase demand for scarce concentrate.

title: Canada Nickel looking for government funding, partners to build EV supply chain plants in Timmins
summary: Canada Nickel says it is seeking government funding and partners to build a large nickel processing facility and a steel plant in Timmins, Ontario, aimed at closing a gap in EV supply chains. The company is not yet in feasibility and expects production only from 2027, constraining immediate price effects.

title: Canada Nickel Co. introduces plans for new processing facilities, but funding remains uncertain
summary: Canada Nickel plans to build two processing facilities near Timmins, including a large nickel-processing plant partly aimed at electric-vehicle feedstock demand. The roughly $1 billion project depends on uncertain funding but management expects substantial government support via critical-mineral tax credits and funds. Approval of the Crawford mine is targeted next year.

title: Copper rebounds, gains capped by demand worries and firm dollar
summary: London copper rebounded after a near-three-month low, rising about 0.5%, but gains were capped. The story cites mine-side supply support and new-energy demand optimism, offset by China’s property crisis, weak consumer-price data, rising Chinese inventories, and a steady/strong U.S. dollar.

title: SMM Aluminium Ingot January Production Analysis & February Forecast
summary: SMM reports January 2024 aluminium ingot output rising slightly YoY, with stable electrolytic production and higher operating rates. February is expected to see stable overall electrolytic output and capacity around 42m tons, with Yunnan production dependent on clearer electricity supply. Downstream activity may soften during Spring Festival.

title: SMM Copper Cathode January Production Analysis & February Forecast | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports China’s copper cathode output fell in January and forecasts a further decline in February on maintenance plans and lower Spring Festival operating rates. It also highlights ultra-low copper concentrate processing fees causing smelter losses and planned reductions in concentrate grade/quantity, expected to affect output later (March).

title: Nickel Sulfate Production Review and Forecast | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Shanghai non-ferrous metals review reports January 2024 nickel sulfate production at 35,200 mt, up 13.9% MoM on recovery in downstream precursor demand. For February, production is forecast to fall to 29,000 mt amid Spring Festival-related holiday dynamics and expected plant shutdowns.

title: Exxaro Sharpens M&A Focus After Copper Mine Loss to China
summary: The headline says Exxaro is adjusting its M&A strategy after a copper mine loss involving China. That suggests a change in expected copper supply and ownership structure, which can tighten near-term market perceptions and support higher copper prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Prismo Metals Inc.: Prismo Metals ZTEM Survey Identifies Priority Drill Target at the Hot Breccia Copper Project in Arizona
summary: Prismo Metals reported that a heliborne ZTEM geophysical survey at its Hot Breccia copper project in Arizona identified a priority conductive drill target. Historic holes showed local copper and zinc, and the firm is preparing permits and planning drilling in 2024, including deep holes to test the anomaly.

title: Infinitum Copper ZTEM Survey Identifies Priority Drill Targets at Hot Breccia in Arizona
summary: Infinitum Copper announced completion of a ZTEM geophysical survey at its Hot Breccia copper project in Arizona, identifying a priority drill target beneath conductive ground. Historic drill data suggest copper-bearing intervals, though drilling is not yet underway and permits are expected in Q1 2024.

title: Prismo Metals ZTEM Survey Identifies Priority Drill Target at the Hot Breccia Copper Project in Arizona
summary: Prismo Metals reports that a heliborne ZTEM survey identified a new deep conductive drill target at its Hot Breccia copper project in Arizona. The company cites historic copper/zinc indications and expects permits in Q1 2024 to drill. The update is copper-focused with no immediate market-wide impact described.

title: Jubilee Metals plans copper expansion in Zambia
summary: Jubilee Metals plans to expand copper production in Zambia to 25,000 tonnes per year by upgrading the Roan concentrator and expanding its Sable Refinery processing circuits. A new 50,000t/month modular unit is being prepared for shipment, with concentrate grade improvements supporting higher cathode and concentrate output capacity.

title: Jubilee provides Zambia copper expansion update
summary: Jubilee says it is making progress expanding copper operations in Zambia. The company is developing Roan Concentrator and Sable Refinery facilities, securing waste rock licences, and reporting early test work from the Munkoyo project with grades of 1.5%–3%. It remains on track for a 25,000 tpy copper target.

title: Norilsk Nickel revises 2024 Capex to $3-3.2 bln, CFO says
summary: Norilsk Nickel revised its 2024 capital expenditure outlook down to $3–3.2 billion from about $3.6 billion, citing clarified technical parameters and payment procedure optimization. The CFO said the board approved the earlier higher budget, indicating a shift toward reduced spending by the company amid 2024 planning.

title: Copper's Fall An Early Signal of Global Slowdown
summary: Copper prices fell to the lowest level since November, nearing $8,200/t and breaking out of a two-month consolidation range. The drop under the 200-day moving average and weakening RSI suggest further downside risk toward the ~$7,900 area. The sell-off is framed as evidence of slowing global production and softer macro sentiment.

title: Canada Nickel to build $1bn nickel processing facility
summary: Canada Nickel Company, via NetZero Metals, plans to invest around $1bn to build a nickel processing facility in Timmins, with capacity above 80,000t/year. A second stainless/alloy plant is also planned. Both are scheduled to start in 2027, limiting immediate price impact.

title: NetZero Metals announces intention to develop nickel and stainless-steel processing facilities
summary: NetZero Metals, a subsidiary of Canada Nickel Company, intends to build a nickel processing facility and a stainless-steel and alloy production facility in Ontario’s Timmins Nickel District. The projects are still in site-selection and feasibility stages, with nickel production targeted for 2027, and focus on low-carbon output using the Crawford project’s carbon storage.

title: Government to support workers of the closed Avebury Nickel Mine | The Advocate
summary: Tasmania will support workers laid off after the Avebury Nickel Mine was moved to care and maintenance. Resources Minister Felix Ellis cites retraining and funding measures. While details are labor-focused, the closure implies curtailed nickel output, which can tighten near-term supply expectations and support nickel prices.

title: Stanislav Kondrashov: trends and prospects of the global copper market — Пресс-релизы
summary: London and Shanghai copper prices are mixed as easing US policy supports sentiment, while worries about falling copper demand—especially in China—are heightened by a Moody’s downgrade. Lower Chinese port inventories/import supplies support prices, but lower concentrate processing costs may reduce concentrate supply.

title: Timmins news: Canada Nickel to build 'largest nickel processing plant in North America'
summary: The piece’s headline says Canada Nickel will build two nickel processing plants in northern Ontario, including the “largest nickel processing plant in North America.” Expanded processing capacity can shift near-term expectations for nickel supply and throughput, which may be modestly supportive for nickel prices. No supporting capacity timeline or volumes are provided.

title: BHP ramps up cost-cutting as axe hangs over thousands of nickel jobs
summary: BHP told suppliers and workers at its West Australian Nickel West operations it must cut costs to survive amid the nickel rout. The company is estimated to be losing up to $50 million per month at current nickel prices, with tough board decisions looming and thousands of jobs threatened.

title: Copper Prices Stagnate Amid Global Uncertainty
summary: Copper prices are described as stuck in a sideways range after weakness early January and a rebound later in the month. Evergrande’s liquidation raises concerns for China property-driven copper demand, but robust imports, falling LME inventories, tighter ore supply, and EV/renewables support counterbalance the bearish risk.

title: Avebury Nickel Mine closure: 200 jobs lost, some positives remain | The Advocate
summary: Avebury Nickel Mine is closing and moving into care and maintenance, eliminating 200 jobs, because nickel prices collapsed after cheaper Indonesian product flooded the market. A sale deal was not finalized and receivers chose to stop further losses. The situation reflects weak nickel demand/supply balance in the near term.

title: Copper slightly up tracking dollar; China closed for new year
summary: Copper was marginally higher on Monday, tracking a slightly weaker U.S. dollar, while trading volumes were expected to be dampened as China—top consumer—closed for Lunar New Year. LME aluminium fell, nickel rose, and the report said focus would switch to supply-side issues after the holiday.

title: Indonesia names two Chinese nationals suspects over nickel smelter fire
summary: Indonesia is investigating a Dec. 24 furnace fire at an ITSS nickel smelter in the IMIP hub, which is owned by China’s Tsingshan and local partner Bintang Delapan. Police have named two suspects, and manpower authorities say a safety-procedure violation may be involved, potentially disrupting nickel processing.

title: China, Indonesia face deeper output cuts to tackle nickel price slide
summary: China and Indonesia are expected to cut nickel output by at least 100,000 tons this year, with deeper curbs possible to remove oversupply and high inventories, especially nickel pig iron. Analysts cite losses and note additional cuts may be needed to balance the market, potentially supporting prices in the near term.

title: ASX LTR: Liontown boss says more lithium, nickel mines will close without bailout
summary: Liontown Resources CEO Tony Ottaviano argues the government should act with royalty relief rather than further talk of bailouts for the lithium sector, citing a precedent after lithium price crashes in 2020. He warns more mine closures could follow without tangible support, including for nickel producers.

title: Glencore to Sell Stake in Struggling New Caledonia Nickel Mines
summary: Glencore is reported to sell its stake in struggling nickel mines in New Caledonia. The move could affect market expectations for near-term nickel supply and operations, potentially weighing on nickel prices as investors reassess production outlook and continuity risk tied to the assets being divested.

title: Glencore to transition New Caledonia nickel plant to "care and maintenance"
summary: Glencore decided to transition its loss-making Koniambo Nickel SAS operation in New Caledonia to “care and maintenance,” citing high operating costs and very weak nickel market conditions. The move follows inability to justify funding ongoing losses and will include a search for a potential new industrial partner.

title: Glencore to Sell Stake in Nickel Operation
summary: Glencore said it is looking for a buyer for its 49% stake in the Koniambo nickel joint venture in New Caledonia, citing continued losses amid weak nickel prices. Glencore will fund operations per budget while transitioning KNS to care and maintenance, then seek a new industrial partner.

title: Glencore to halt New Caledonia nickel plant and sell stake
summary: Glencore said it will sell its 49% stake in New Caledonia’s Koniambo Nickel SAS and place the processing plant in “care and maintenance” for six months while it seeks a new investor. The move follows high costs and very weak nickel market conditions despite proposed French support.

title: Glencore to sell stake in struggling New Caledonia nickel mines
summary: Glencore plans to sell its stake in struggling nickel mines in New Caledonia. The move highlights financial and operational pressure at the assets, increasing near-term uncertainty around nickel production and investment, which can negatively affect market expectations for supply over coming days to weeks.

title: Nornickel 2023 profit plunges 51% on lower commodity prices
summary: Nornickel reported a 51% year-on-year plunge in 2023 profit, attributing the fall to lower commodity prices, including a 16% drop in LME nickel and a 4% decline in copper. The company sold all production, but revenue and EBITDA fell amid weaker metal pricing and costs.

title: Glencore to Sell Stake in Nickel Mine Amid Price Rout -- Update
summary: Glencore will seek a buyer and transition its 49% stake in the Koniambo Nickel joint venture in New Caledonia to care and maintenance, citing continued losses and slumping nickel prices. The company stops further funding, echoing Trafigura’s earlier decision, raising expectations of reduced nickel supply.

summary: France’s minister will visit New Caledonia as Glencore plans to exit Koniambo’s Northern Province stake, moving the mine into care-and-maintenance and raising workforce uncertainty. Other nickel operations face deadlines and losses, with only partial €200m rescue and a €140m Prony loan. Overall nickel supply risk rises.

title: BHP's value of assets hit by nickel price drop
summary: BHP said it will write down about US$2.3bn of the value of its Western Australian nickel assets due to “current market conditions.” The move is linked to a nickel price drop and BHP’s difficulty competing with a flood of cheaper nickel shipments from Indonesia, signaling bearish sentiment for nickel.

title: Industrial Metals Monthly: Nickel's Price Plunge Shutters Mines
summary: The piece says nickel is down sharply as LME prices hit multi-year lows. It cites supply surges from Indonesia’s expanding smelting capacity and notes mine suspensions/production scale-backs by BHP, Panoramic, First Quantum, and Glencore. Despite cuts, Indonesia’s output keeps the nickel market in surplus, pressuring prices further.

title: Nickel crash blindsides boardrooms and Australia's wealthy investors
summary: The article describes a severe nickel market downturn blamed on Indonesia’s increased HPAL supply and weaker EV-driven demand expectations. BHP shuts and writes off its nickel investment, while other Australian nickel producers idle projects or sell assets. Companies cite ongoing unprofitable conditions, indicating further near-term bearish pressure on nickel prices.

title: Nickel to be placed on critical minerals list, giving WA miners access to $4 billion fund
summary: Australia’s resources minister will add nickel to the critical minerals list, allowing WA nickel miners to apply for funding from a $4 billion federal critical minerals loan facility. The announcement follows worries about mothballing at BHP’s Nickel West and mine curtailments, which could threaten supply and jobs.

title: Nickel sector 'at risk', added to priority mineral list
summary: Australia has added nickel to its Critical Minerals List, granting priority access to federal funding (Critical Minerals Facility and related grant programs). The move follows facility mothballing and scaling back at struggling producers. Officials still forecast nickel prices remain relatively low through 2024 due to oversupply, tempering bullish sentiment.

title: Copper hits 1-week peak as US rate-cut hopes boost risk appetite
summary: Copper prices climbed to a one-week peak after weaker-than-expected U.S. retail sales revived expectations for a June Fed rate cut and lifted risk appetite. Three-month copper on the LME rose 0.4% to $8,344/t. A firmer dollar faced some offset, but the macro-driven sentiment remained supportive.

title: France offers loan to New Caledonia nickel firm Prony to avert collapse
summary: France agreed to provide a €140m loan and additional annual energy subsidies to Prony Resources in New Caledonia to avert the nickel producer’s collapse. The aid is intended to keep operations running until 2026 while negotiations find a buyer. Reuters links the stress to high costs, political tension, and weaker prices.

title: Mount Isa Transition Fund supports future prospects after copper mine closure | The North West Star
summary: Queensland announced a $20 million Mount Isa Transition Fund after Glencore’s decision to cease copper mining at Mount Isa, which will lead to job losses before the 2025 closure. The government aims to support “shovel-ready” projects and accelerate resources activity in the Northwest Minerals Province.

title: Australia lists nickel as 'critical mineral' to unlock billions in support
summary: Australia classified nickel as a “critical mineral,” enabling companies to access A$4 billion in government support and related grants to develop battery chemicals. The move targets an industry under pressure after Indonesian supply boosted and slashed nickel prices, while the government acknowledges low prices may persist amid surplus.

title: 'We can't cash grant them out of this problem': Government plans to handle the nickel collapse
summary: Australia’s Resources Minister Madeleine King said the challenges from the nickel market collapse cannot be solved overnight and that the government “can’t cash grant” the industry out of the problem. The article cites BHP’s warning for its WA nickel arm, with thousands of jobs at risk, reinforcing bearish near-term nickel expectations.

title: Mining crisis: Nickel miners thrown 'sovereign' lifeline
summary: Australia’s Albanese government is preparing to directly support Western Australian nickel miners, potentially through a US-style green initiative and a $4 billion federal loan facility. Resources Minister Madeleine King added nickel to the official critical minerals list amid fears of “sovereign capacity” after an Indonesian supply glut pressured the market.

title: North Bay Resources Announces Acquisition of Copper Island Project with Assays up to 14.7% Cu and Appointment of New CEO
summary: North Bay Resources announced an agreement to acquire 100% of the Copper Island Red-Bed Copper Project in British Columbia, citing geochemical results up to 14.7% Cu and listing historic copper mineral occurrences. The release also appoints a new CEO and includes share consolidation details.

title: Peru approves US$2B Antamina copper mine expansion
summary: Peru’s environmental regulator has approved Antamina’s long-awaited permit for a US$2 billion expansion, extending mine operations from 2028 to 2036. The decision supports longer-term supply visibility for copper (Antamina is the country’s largest copper-zinc mine), which can pressure copper sentiment near term.

title: Rusal to add Abramovich to lawsuit against Potanin over nickel miner pact
summary: Rusal has moved to add Abramovich and Crispian Investments to a lawsuit against Potanin over a 2012 shareholder framework tied to Nornickel. The dispute centers on dividends and alleged asset transfers. Britain’s sanctions cover Potanin/Abramovich, but the article gives no evidence of immediate nickel or aluminium supply disruptions.

title: Australia classifies nickel as critical mineral amid industry crisis
summary: Australia added nickel to its critical minerals list, unlocking access to A$4bn and other grant-linked facilities funded under a broader A$6bn stimulus to keep struggling producers afloat. The move follows oversupply from lower-grade Indonesian ore driving weak nickel prices, but also coincides with some planned output cuts.

title: BHP plans WA nickel operations closure amid price drop
summary: BHP plans to shut down Nickel West in Western Australia, with the Kambalda concentrator entering care and maintenance in June, citing a sharp fall and deteriorating outlook for nickel prices. The company will cut costs, reassess capital plans, and record a large impairment tied to the expected closure.

title: Copper, this dog will hunt
summary: The piece is bullish on copper, pointing to major near-term supply shocks: a strike at Peru’s Las Bambas and the Panama government ordering First Quantum to end Cobre Panama operations. It also highlights strong Chinese import demand, stimulus prospects, and supportive macro expectations for copper prices.

title: Western Australia offers royalty relief to struggling nickel producers
summary: Western Australia will offer a 50% royalty rebate for 18 months to nickel producers when prices are below $20,000/tonne, plus access to federal critical-minerals loans and grants. The move targets struggling high-cost producers after Indonesian supply pushed nickel down about 40% year-on-year, supporting sentiment.

title: Royalty rebates for nickel industry to ride out slump
summary: Western Australia will provide an 18-month royalty rebate to nickel producers when quarterly nickel-in-concentrate prices average below US$20,000/t, aiming to help them withstand the current slump and preserve jobs. title: Officials spar over 'criminalization' of copper wire theft
summary: Los Angeles City Council debated measures to curb copper wire theft, including creating a police-led task force and a rewards program. Reports cite large thefts, such as copper wires taken from the 6th Street Viaduct, with major repair costs. The discussion also addressed enforcement against metal buyers and possible prevention via solar lighting.

summary: Western Australia will offer nickel producers a 50% royalty rebate starting March quarter 2024 for 18 months under a Nickel Financial Assistance Program. title: Western Australia to offer royalty relief to embattled nickel industry
summary: Western Australia will provide a 50% royalty rebate to local nickel producers over 18 months via a Nickel Financial Assistance Program, starting March 2024, if quarterly nickel-in-concentrate prices average below $20,000/ton. title: Australia's Nickel Industry Seeks Relief as Global Supply Glut Hits Hard
summary: Australia added nickel to its commodities subsidy list under a A$3.9bn stimulus fund to help producers amid a global nickel supply glut, particularly from Indonesia and China. title: Inside the Kambalda Hotel, the pub at ground zero of Australia's nickel woes
summary: Kambalda, a core town for Australia’s nickel industry, is portrayed as facing imminent mine closures after the nickel industry collapsed. summary: SMM reviews the Spring Festival nickel market: domestic pure nickel production rose, while downstream buying was strong but inventories still accumulated, suggesting demand was less optimistic. title: Australian nickel: Anthony Albanese plans tax credits to help nickel miners
summary: Australia is fast-tracking production tax credits aimed at preventing the ailing nickel mining sector from shutting down, as BHP and others warn they may need to cease operations and cut jobs. title: Indonesia's nickel supremacy: China's backing and Australia's decline
summary: The article argues Indonesia has gained dominance in refined nickel by banning exports, expanding downstream processing, and attracting Chinese investment and financing for smelting power. title: South32 says prime minister Anthony Albanese fix for Nickel has a big problem
summary: South32’s CEO urges the Albanese government to reassess how long it will support Australia’s struggling nickel sector as nickel prices have fallen sharply. title: Australian PM Moves to Save Nickel Industry as China Floods Market
summary: Australia is fast-tracking production tax credits and extending a WA 50% royalty discount to protect struggling nickel miners after warnings that a supply glut from Indonesia and China could force mine shutdowns. title: Copper edges lower as dollar steadies; trading resumes in China
summary: Copper prices edged lower as a steadier U.S. dollar reflected doubts over the timing of Fed rate cuts after hotter January inflation. summary: Australia added nickel to the critical minerals list, allowing access to A$4 billion in federal support. summary: Ahead of the holiday, nickel prices fluctuated downward. summary: Merdeka Copper Gold said 2023 output rose across its portfolio, including copper from the Wetar mine and nickel via production of nickel pig iron and nickel matte. summary: Kefi Gold & Copper shares rose after its Saudi Hawiah joint venture reported an additional copper-gold-zinc-silver deposit discovery at Abu Salal. summary: Copper prices fell Monday after China’s central bank held key medium-term lending policy rates steady, disappointing markets. summary: Faraday Copper reported Phase III drill results at its Copper Creek project in Arizona, including intersections with 0.85% and 0.62% copper over substantial intervals in the American Eagle area. title: PROSPECT RIDGE RESOURCES DISCOVERS A HIGH-GRADE COPPER VEIN SYSTEM ALONG THE NORTHWESTERN EXTENSION OF THE COPPER RIDGE ZONE ON THE KNAUSS CREEK PROPERTY
summary: Prospect Ridge Resources announced that outcrop samples from the Knauss Creek property show a northwestern extension of the Copper Ridge Zone with additional high-grade copper, alongside gold and silver. The results are based on outcrop sampling from a single property, suggesting potential future supply but with limited near-term impact on copper markets.

title: American Pacific Announces 2024 Drilling and Exploration Programs at the High-Grade Copper-Gold Madison Project
summary: American Pacific Mining announced Phase I and II drilling plans for its 100%-owned Madison high-grade copper-gold project in Montana, including 1,350 m of diamond drilling this spring. The release highlights historical copper grades and aims to confirm/extend mineralization, but no production or supply change is stated.

title: Trending : Rio Tinto Cuts Dividend as Profit Hurt by Lower Aluminum, Copper Prices -February 21, 2024 at 07:50 am EST
summary: Rio Tinto cut its dividend after 2023 profits fell, with management citing lower aluminum prices as the biggest driver, alongside weaker copper. Iron ore offset some of the decline because it produced most EBITDA and free cash flow. The report is focused on financial outcomes, not a fresh metal disruption.

title: Trending : Rio Tinto Cuts Dividend as Profit Hurt by Lower Aluminum, Copper Prices -February 21, 2024 at 07:50 am EST
summary: Rio Tinto cut its dividend after 2023 profit fell due to lower aluminum and copper prices, though iron ore offset some of the decline. The company said falling aluminum prices were the biggest driver of reduced profits. The piece is based on full-year results commentary and does not cite new market shocks.

title: Benton Commences Phase 2 Drilling at the Great Burnt Copper-Gold Project and Considers Options for the High-Grade Uranium Discovery at Kepenkeck Joint Venture
summary: Benton Resources commenced Phase 2 diamond drilling at its Great Burnt copper-gold project, targeting down-dip extensions and infill of the Main deposit. The program aims for at least 3,000 m of drilling, with prior results including 25.42m at 5.51% Cu. The firm also considers uranium options, which is separate.

title: Freeport Resources Inc.: Freeport Announces 2 Year License Renewal for Yandera Copper Project, One of the World's Largest Undeveloped Copper Projects
summary: Papua New Guinea approved renewal of Freeport Resources’ Yandera copper exploration license through Nov. 19, 2025. The company plans a definitive feasibility study, partner discussions, and further exploration. It cites expectations of a future copper deficit from the energy transition, but no near-term production changes are described.

title: Freeport Announces 2 Year License Renewal for Yandera Copper Project, One of the World's Largest Undeveloped Copper Projects
summary: Freeport Resources said Papua New Guinea approved a two-year renewal of the Yandera Copper Project exploration license through November 19, 2025. The extension allows the company to begin a definitive feasibility study and pursue strategic partners, improving project continuity and supporting copper supply expectations.

title: Nicola Mining Inc. Engages Dias Geophysical to Conduct IP Survey at New Craigmont Copper Project
summary: Nicola Mining contracted Dias Geophysical to run a 3D Induced Polarization (IP) survey over its New Craigmont copper project near Merritt, B.C., targeting late April/early May. The company aims to generate drilling targets at MARB-CAS and West Craigmont, building on prior IP and drilling correlations.

title: First Quantum Signs $500 Million Copper Deal With Investor
summary: The article headline says First Quantum has signed a $500 million copper deal with an investor. Such financing/investment news can improve expectations for future copper supply and project momentum, typically supporting near-term copper sentiment. The provided text contains no further details to gauge immediate physical market impact.

title: First Quantum signs US$500 million copper deal with investor
summary: First Quantum reportedly signed a US$500 million copper-related deal with an investor. Such large contracting/offtake announcements can improve near-term visibility on copper sales and supply, potentially tightening expected market balance and supporting copper prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: NetNewsLedger - American Pacific Announces 2024 Drilling and Exploration Programs at the High-Grade Copper-Gold Madison Project
summary: American Pacific Mining outlined its 2024 drilling and exploration plans for the Madison high-grade copper-gold project in Montana, including a near-mine Phase I program and a regional Phase II program to define or extend Cu-Au mineralization. The release provides drilling scope, contractor engagement, and prior copper output figures.

title: Export Finance Australia readies support for beleaguered nickel sector
summary: Australia’s government expanded access to its critical minerals export-finance fund for nickel projects as producers cut operations and BHP considers care and maintenance after price plunges tied to Indonesian oversupply. The policy support, plus tax credits and royalty relief, aims to limit supply disruption and stabilize nickel expectations.

title: U.S. Aluminum Market Roiled by Closure of Major Smelter
summary: U.S. aluminum prices fell further in early February and stayed within a long-term range despite the closure of New Madrid, a Missouri smelter cutting ~30% of domestic primary output. The Midwest Premium briefly spiked then retraced as other supply and balanced/slight-surplus conditions persisted amid strong Chinese production and muted demand.

title: Arizona Sonoran Announces a Positive Pre-Feasibility Study for the Cactus Mine Project with a US$509M Post-Tax NPV and 55 kstpa Copper Cathode over 21 Years
summary: Arizona Sonoran reported a positive NI 43-101 pre-feasibility study for its Cactus mine in Arizona, proposing heap-leach SXEW production of ~55 kstpa of LME Grade A copper cathodes over 21 years. The study cites robust economics (US$509M post-tax NPV) under a $3.90/lb copper assumption, supporting bullish copper sentiment.

title: Eramet in talks with France to offload debt from SLN nickel unit
summary: Eramet is in talks with France to offload €320m in SLN nickel unit debt from its balance sheet, including a new €60m government loan meant to keep operations running at least until April. France is also offering support to other nickel processors in New Caledonia, reducing collapse risk.

title: Aluminium prices rise as Biden weighs new Russian sanctions
summary: Aluminium and nickel futures rose as traders speculated that a new US sanctions package against Russia could target metals and disrupt supplies. The market is watching potential restrictions on Russian producers and trading flows, building on UK curbs already affecting Russian aluminium linked to LME infrastructure and Rusal.

title: Glencore keeps faith in Australian zinc, nickel as coal buoys profit
summary: Glencore’s CEO said the company has no plan to shut its loss-making zinc mines in Queensland, and Australia’s nickel mines are still profitable despite weaker nickel prices. The statement came alongside results supported by strong Australian coal earnings, implying less immediate nickel supply risk.

title: Kaiser Aluminum Corporation Q4 Earnings Summary
summary: Kaiser Aluminum reported Q4 earnings of $7.6 million versus a loss a year earlier, with adjusted earnings of $9.8 million. Revenue declined to $722 million from $776 million. The improving profitability could modestly support near-term sentiment for aluminium, though weaker sales temper the upside.

title: IGO profit halves amid nickel slump, shine off lithium
summary: IGO’s net profit halved as nickel prices fell, prompting further impairment of its Cosmos and Forrestania nickel assets. It also reported weaker profit from its stake in the Greenbushes lithium operation due to lower prices and volumes. IGO noted collaboration to improve refinery performance but nickel weakness drove writedowns.

title: Kaiser Aluminum Corporation Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2023 Financial Results
summary: Kaiser Aluminum reported Q4 and FY2023 results, including shipments and a realized price per pound, alongside “hedged cost of alloyed metal” tied to the Midwest Transaction Price. The company notes strong aerospace demand and destocking dynamics, but the release is mainly historical financial disclosure without a specific near-term aluminium price catalyst.

title: Brazil's Vale says its Sossego copper mine operating license has been suspended
summary: Vale announced the operating license for its Sossego copper mine in Brazil has been suspended. The suspension raises the risk of an immediate production disruption and slower supply ramp, tightening near-term copper availability expectations and typically supporting bearish price pressure in the coming days.

title: Material Matters: Aluminium, Platinum, and Gas
summary: Analysts expect a more supportive setup for aluminium in 2024. They cite restricted supply (including capped China output and lower trends elsewhere) alongside improving demand from aircraft recovery and accelerating EV production in China. Overall, fundamentals point to higher aluminium prices rather than a reversal.

title: Arizona Sonoran Copper Company Inc. Announces Positive Pre-Feasibility Study for the Cactus Mine Project
summary: Arizona Sonoran Copper announced a positive NI 43-101 pre-feasibility study for its Cactus Mine in Arizona, outlining potential production of about 55 ktons (110 million lbs) of LME Grade A copper cathodes via heap leach/SXEW. It highlights long life, reserves, and low-cost power, but remains a pre-feasibility stage.

title: Shanghai nickel hits 3-week high amid supply concerns
summary: Shanghai nickel jumped over 3% to a three-week high as investors speculated that upcoming U.S. sanctions on Russia could disrupt exports. Russia is a major nickel and aluminium producer. Indonesia mining-permit issuance also weighed on supply, while China’s rate cut and a weaker dollar supported broader metal sentiment including copper.

title: Why there's no silver bullet for the nickel pickle facing the Albanese government
summary: The article explains Australia’s nickel downturn, with prices down sharply over 12 months and several Western Australian producers moving to care-and-maintenance amid an Indonesian supply glut. It also covers BHP’s concerns and government actions (critical-minerals listing, royalty relief), but not an immediate reversal in market conditions.

title: IGO ASX: IGO boss says review of dud nickel buy 'confronting'
summary: IGO’s CEO says it was “confronting” to learn that poor assumptions and due diligence underpinned IGO’s $1.3 billion nickel-asset purchase. The company already cut asset value by about 75% in July and may be forced to write off up to 90% more, worsening nickel sentiment.

title: Old Anglesey Aluminium chimney set to come down end of March
summary: A public notice states the 122-metre chimney at the old Anglesey Aluminium site will not be demolished on March 1 as planned, with dates now expected toward end-March pending emergency services and health-and-safety approvals. The site is being redeveloped under the Anglesey Freeport initiative, but no metal supply impact is cited.

title: Teck Resources beats Q4 profit estimates on coal sales, copper prices
summary: Teck Resources reported Q4 profit above estimates, aided by higher steelmaking coal sales and strong copper prices. The company cited record quarterly copper production and notes copper price gains driven by demand, weaker dollar, lower inventories, and China stimulus, with analysts expecting further near-term support from potential U.S. rate cuts.

title: Aluminum Prices Soar After Biden Says "Major" Sanctions Package Against Russia Is Imminent
summary: Aluminium prices rise sharply following comments from President Biden that a major sanctions package against Russia is imminent. Market participants are likely pricing heightened risks to Russian supply and related logistics/trade. The expected outcome is tighter near-term aluminium availability, supporting upward price pressure over coming days.

title: First Quantum to receive $500m from Jiangxi Copper
summary: First Quantum Minerals will receive a $500m prepayment from its largest shareholder Jiangxi Copper to support finances after the shutdown of its Panama flagship copper mine. The arrangement requires delivery of 50,000 tonnes of copper anode annually from Zambia’s Kansanshi at market prices, helping stabilize copper supply and sentiment.

title: Teck Resources fourth-quarter profit beats targets on strong coal sales, copper output
summary: Teck Resources reported profit ahead of expectations, driven by record copper production and higher realized copper prices. Teck attributed the stronger copper pricing to supply shortages that are accelerating into next quarter. It also raised full-year production guidance, citing increases across mines including Quebrada Blanca and Highland Valley.

title: A supply glut of nickel is squeezing Australia out of the market
summary: The article says nickel prices have fallen sharply, with five Western Australian producers scaling back or entering care and maintenance. It blames a global nickel supply glut, mainly from Indonesia, driving the price plunge and investor uncertainty. Governments are discussing support measures, but expectations of a rapid rebound are low.

title: The dust of the Indonesian presidential election has settled, and the approval of nickel ore quota has been blocked, what will be the subsequent price trend of ferronickel? [SMM Analysis]
summary: SMM analysis says Indonesia’s delayed RKAB approval tightens nickel ore supply, pushing up nickel ore costs and NPI production costs. However, both Indonesian and China nickel pig iron output are forecast to decline while stainless demand stays weak/off-season. With possible oversupply, nickel pig iron/ferronickel prices face further downside.

title: Association Denies Claims China Benefits Most From Nickel Domestic Processing  ​​​​​​​
summary: Indonesia’s Mining Association denies claims that China benefits most from Indonesia’s push for domestic nickel processing. The group says Chinese investors pay taxes and contribute, while acknowledging technology gaps and need for better knowledge transfer. Foreign workers are said to be only a small share of the workforce.

title: Report reveals 76% aluminium can collection rate in 2021
summary: A report says the aluminium beverage can recycling rate in the EU/UK and nearby countries rose to a record 76% in 2021, lifting recycled tonnage to about 570,000 tonnes. Industry groups push for higher separate collection targets and deposit return systems to secure more separately collected UBCs for remelting.

title: Teck Resources reports Q4 profit up and record copper production
summary: Teck Resources reported higher Q4 profit and ramped up operations at its Quebrada Blanca mine, producing a record 103,000 tonnes of copper in the quarter. Results show improved revenue and stronger output versus the prior year, signaling heightened near-term copper supply.

title: Teck Resources reports Q4 profit up and record copper production | iNFOnews | Thompson-Okanagan's News Source
summary: Teck Resources said Q4 copper production hit record levels, rising to 103,000 tonnes from 65,000 a year earlier, led by ramped operations at its Quebrada Blanca (QB2) mine in Chile. It also increased output at Highland Valley and Antamina. Teck expects progressively stronger QB production.

title: Premium Nickel Resources Ltd. Announces High Extraction Rates for All Metals in Recent Metallurgical Testwork Supporting Low Carbon Metal Production
summary: Premium Nickel Resources reports phase two metallurgical testing of its Selkirk and Selebi Ni-Cu-Co projects in Botswana using the Platsol hydrometallurgical process. Results show very high extraction of nickel and copper into leach solution and high recoveries to precipitates, supporting development of low-power, low-pollution production.

title: Aranjin Announces Final TSXV Approval for the Australian Copper Project Acquisition
summary: Aranjin Resources reported final TSXV approval for its acquisition of an 80% interest in three Australian copper projects (Bangemall, Gawler and Western Wood). Shares held in escrow for consideration were released after approval. The release is administrative and does not signal near-term output changes for copper.

title: Mycelx starts strongly; Great Southern in Chile deals
summary: Great Southern Copper PLC reported it has signed two letters of intent for exploration at Chile’s Especularita project, covering high-priority prospects Cerro Negro and Artemisa. Management said the prospects could indicate porphyry copper-type mineralisation at depth, expanding exploration potential and supporting copper-focused sentiment.

title: Horizonte Minerals doubles capex estimate for Brazil nickel project to US$1bn
summary: Horizonte Minerals said it doubled the capital expenditure estimate for its Brazil nickel project to about US$1 billion. The higher capex points to increased development cost and potential changes in project economics, which can reduce near-term supply expectations and weigh on nickel sentiment over coming weeks.

title: InvestorNewsBreaks – Canada Nickel Company Inc. (TSX.V: CNC) (OTCQX: CNIKF) Announces Initial Assay Results, Large Intervals of Mineralization at Mann Property
summary: Canada Nickel reported final assay results from initial exploration drilling at its Mann Property, part of its nickel-sulphide project portfolio. The company says all initial holes intersected large intervals of mineralization and plans more drilling at Mann Southeast in summer 2024. The update may support nickel sentiment but is early-stage.

title: Almadex Samples 0.59% copper and 0.18 g/t gold in Outcrop
summary: Almadex Minerals reports first-pass rock chip sampling at its Radio porphyry copper-molybdenum-gold target in Nevada, with select samples returning up to 0.59% copper and 0.18 g/t gold. The company discusses alteration mapping and aims to advance the project toward a drill decision, without production impacts.

title: McEwen Copper Reports Improved Copper Recovery
summary: McEwen Copper announced Phase 1 bio-heap leaching test results for the Los Azules project in Argentina, lifting average copper recovery to 76.0% (from 72.8% in the prior PEA) and reducing net sulfuric acid consumption by 8.3%. The company says this increases modeled cathode output and NPV.

title: Mcewen Copper (MUX) Reports Improved Copper Recovery
summary: McEwen Copper announced Phase 1 metallurgical test results for its Los Azules heap-leach project in Argentina, with average copper recovery rising to 76.0% versus 72.8% in the prior PEA. Net acid consumption fell 8.3%, increasing modeled life-of-mine copper output and NPV.

title: Teck reports record copper production, awaits regulatory approval of Glencore deal
summary: Teck announced record copper production and said it is awaiting regulatory approval of its Glencore deal. The production update points to stronger near-term copper supply, which can support prices over the coming days, while the M&A approval adds limited timing uncertainty rather than a direct negative signal.

title: EV Boom Sparks North American Nickel Frenzy: Get Ready for a Supply Shakeup
summary: The piece argues the EV boom is driving higher nickel demand and notes North American efforts to build domestic nickel production. It highlights Lundin’s Eagle Mine restart/catalyst and Fathom Nickel’s Albert Lake and Gochager Lake drilling plus a $4.57 million funding round, suggesting improved near-term supply outlook and support for nickel.

title: Teck announces $500-million share buyback following mine sales, record copper production
summary: Teck announced a $500-million buyback funded by proceeds from selling its steel-making coal business, alongside record copper production. It said the Quebrada Blanca QB2 copper expansion in Chile remains on schedule, with guidance suggesting copper output could roughly double in 2024 as operations stabilize.

title: Copper market facing supply constraints as Teck reports record production: analyst
summary: The analysis suggests copper prices could be supported because, despite Teck reporting record production, the market still faces supply constraints. That combination points to near-term tightness in copper availability, which can strengthen expectations for price levels over the coming days to weeks.

title: Bangkok Post - A tale of nickel and copper
summary: Bloomberg’s column ties BHP’s first-half results to nickel and copper fundamentals for the energy transition. It cites Chinese Indonesian battery-grade nickel flooding the market and a BHP nickel impairment, while copper prices are down less and BHP highlights drilling and processing progress amid long-term supply deficits.

title: Bangkok Post - A tale of nickel and copper
summary: Bloomberg discusses BHP’s challenges in nickel and copper. It says Chinese refiners are flooding battery-grade nickel from Indonesia, pushing nickel prices ~40% lower and hurting profitability, including a likely US$2.5B nickel impairment. Copper prices are down ~7.7%, with some progress at Escondida but large future supply gaps.

title: EV Minerals Corporation: EV Minerals Highlights Historic Main Zone Results at EV Nickel Project in Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean Region, Quebec
summary: EV Minerals reports updated desktop compilation of 1989 drill holes at its Quebec EV Nickel-Copper-Cobalt project, highlighting wide nickel and copper intercepts and potential for resource expansion pending confirmatory drilling. The release is exploratory, with no production or supply changes, making near-term price impact on nickel and copper likely minimal.

title: Shanghai nickel hits 3-month high on potential sanctions on Russia
summary: Shanghai nickel rallied to a three-month high as investors priced potential U.S. sanctions on Russian metals, raising supply-risk expectations. The Shanghai March contract rose 5.1% and LME nickel held around multi-week highs. Russia’s role as a key refined nickel and aluminium producer supported broader gains.

title: Lithium output rises, nickel falls at Australia's IGO
summary: IGO reported higher lithium volumes but lower nickel output in Australia, citing weaker nickel grades and recoveries at Nova and reduced concentrate production at Forrestania following mine closure. It also placed the Cosmos nickel project into care and maintenance due to the global nickel price slump, with LME nickel down sharply year-on-year.

title: Process and Control Today | ABB supports sustainable growth at US aluminum alloys mill with order win
summary: ABB won an order for four electromagnetic stirrers to support expansion of a U.S. aluminum melting and casting complex. The technology is claimed to boost productivity, lower energy use, and reduce dross, improving furnace efficiency and yield. This strengthens near-term expectations for aluminum production and supply.

title: Supreme Court Asks Vedanta How Could It Operate Tuticorin Copper Plant Despite Expiry Of Its Hazardous Waste Authorisation
summary: India’s Supreme Court is hearing Vedanta’s plea to reopen its Sterlite copper plant in Tamil Nadu after an earlier dismissal tied to the expiration of hazardous-waste authorization. The case outcome could determine whether copper output resumes sooner, affecting short-term supply expectations and supporting copper prices.

title: Zijin Mining receives approval for expansion of Tibet copper mine
summary: Zijin Mining received local government approval to expand its Julong copper project in Tibet. The second phase will add about 200,000 metric tons per day of capacity, lifting total capacity to roughly 350,000 metric tons. The project investment is about 17.5 billion yuan and is expected to enter operation in 2025.

title: Crude oil fell slightly, domestic metals rose, Shanghai nickel rose more than 4%, lithium carbonate rose 2.72%, alumina rose 2.08% [SMM Afternoon Review]
summary: SMM’s afternoon review shows broad gains in domestic base metals: Shanghai nickel rose ~4.1% and aluminum edged up, while spot copper prices in Guangdong (1# electrolytic and wet) increased day-on-day. The piece cites higher Shanghai premiums and constrained shipments, despite weak downstream pickup and concerns about next week’s warehouse receipts.

title: Crude oil fell slightly, domestic metals rose, Shanghai nickel rose more than 4%, lithium carbonate rose 2.72%, alumina rose 2.08% [SMM Afternoon Review]
summary: SMM’s afternoon review shows domestic base metals mostly rising: Shanghai nickel jumped 4.1% and alumina and aluminium were higher, while Shanghai copper and copper spot premiums also increased. Spot copper in Guangdong rose versus the previous day amid improved arrivals but cautious downstream buying. Oil eased slightly; broader macro was mixed.

title: Nickel heads for biggest weekly gain in seven months
summary: Nickel prices were set for the biggest weekly gain in seven months as new Western sanctions against Russia spurred covering of bets on lower nickel prices. LME three-month nickel rose to about $17,510/t. The piece notes aluminium’s reaction was muted and copper had a milder supportive bounce.

title: Zijin to expand Tibet copper mine expected to be world's largest
summary: Zijin Mining Group announced government approval for the second phase of expansion at its Julong copper project in Tibet. The permit will allow Zijin to raise the mine’s capacity. The decision implies increased future copper supply, which is likely to support near-term copper price sentiment.

title: EV Minerals Enters into Definitive Agreement for Previously Announced Acquisition of Nickel Projects in Sudbury, Ontario
summary: EV Minerals entered a definitive purchase agreement to acquire 100% of the Baldwin and Lunge nickel projects in Sudbury, Ontario, including assumption of a 2% NSR with a right to buy back 1% NSR for $1 million. Deal completion depends on corporate and regulatory approvals, implying modest near-term support for nickel sentiment.

title: EV Minerals Corporation: EV Minerals Enters into Definitive Agreement for Previously Announced Acquisition of Nickel Projects in Sudbury, Ontario
summary: EV Minerals will acquire 100% of the Baldwin and Lunge Sudbury nickel projects from Graycliff Exploration. Deal consideration includes 2,000,000 shares and a $25,000 cash payment, with an existing 2% NSR that can be partially bought back. Regulatory approvals are required; no production updates are provided.

title: China's Aluminum Sales to EU Plunge 30% Due to New Carbon Tariff
summary: China Nonferrous Metals Industry Association data show China’s aluminum exports to the EU fell about 30% in 2023, with trade value down 26%, attributed to the EU CBAM carbon border tariff. Although charges start later, importers must report emissions, encouraging lower EU orders.

title: Should Resolution Copper open a mine at Oak Flat? | Opinion
summary: The opinion piece supports Resolution Copper opening the Oak Flat mine, citing extensive community and tribal engagement, permanent protection for Apache Leap, and potential job creation. It claims the project is essential for the clean-energy transition and could boost Arizona’s economic value, implying increased copper supply.

title: ASX 200 LIVE:  ASX rises; TPG, Endeavour drop; Alumina jumps on takeover bid
summary: Australia’s ASX edged up while energy stocks fell with oil prices. The key metal-linked item was Alumina shares jumping after it backed an all-share takeover from US partner Alcoa. Because alumina is the main input to aluminium smelting, expectations around supply and ownership support near-term aluminium sentiment.

title: US giant Alcoa set to take over Alumina in $3.3b deal
summary: Alcoa agreed to buy Alumina Limited in a $3.3b all-stock deal, moving from a joint venture structure to full control of assets spanning bauxite mines, alumina refineries and aluminium smelting. The transaction includes the Portland smelter and could be seen as supportive for aluminium production outlook and continuity.

title: US aluminium maker Alcoa makes $2.2 bln offer for Australia's Alumina
summary: Alcoa made a non-binding, conditional all-stock $2.2 billion buyout proposal for Australia’s Alumina, increasing its upstream alumina exposure and simplifying governance. Alumina and Alcoa jointly own the Kwinana alumina refinery. The deal is not certain to become binding, but could support sentiment for aluminium-linked supply.

title: Alcoa Makes $2.2 Billion Bid for Australian Partner Alumina
summary: Alcoa is reported to be making a $2.2 billion bid for an Australian partner associated with alumina. A deal that strengthens alumina sourcing and refining outlook can improve near-term expectations for aluminium supply, which may support aluminium prices despite deal timing and execution uncertainty.

title: U.S. aluminum maker Alcoa makes US$2.2-billion offer for Australia's Alumina
summary: Alcoa made a non-binding, conditional $2.2bn all-stock buyout proposal for its Australian JV partner Alumina, increasing exposure to upstream alumina and linking shareholders to both alumina and aluminum. The parties co-own the Kwinana alumina refinery. The offer is uncertain, tempering near-term aluminum price impact.

title: Copper slips on firmer dollar, higher China inventories
summary: Copper prices opened the week lower as the dollar firmed and higher inventories in top consumer China weighed sentiment. Three-month LME copper fell 0.4% and Shanghai March copper slid 0.3%. The piece attributes pressure to upcoming U.S., Japan, and Europe economic data influencing rates.

title: SMM Aluminium Market Morning Comment (Feb 26)  | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM’s morning note reports weaker aluminum pricing on SHFE and LME amid softer macro sentiment. It flags possible Guinea nationwide strike risk to bauxite supply, while noting domestic smelters run steadily and downstream demand is resuming with peak season. Low inventories support, but an ingot import window may limit gains.

title: Alcoa Offers $2.2 Bln To Buy Alumina
summary: Alcoa agreed on terms to acquire Alumina Limited for about $2.2 billion in an all-stock transaction, valuing the offer at a 13.1% premium. The integration would expand Alcoa’s alumina holdings and includes smelter interests, potentially tightening expectations around alumina supply for aluminium production.

title: Fortescue's Forrest urges LME to separate nickel contracts into 'dirty' and 'clean'
summary: Fortescue founder Andrew Forrest urged the LME to classify nickel contracts as “clean” and “dirty” to give buyers better choice amid a collapse in nickel prices after cheaper Indonesian supply surged. He argues Australian nickel is higher-standard, supporting calls for a green premium and reducing reputational and compliance risk for EV batteries.

title: Copper falls on firmer dollar, rising inventories in China
summary: Copper prices fell as a firmer U.S. dollar reduced demand and investors looked ahead to major economic data. China’s inventories rose in the top consumer market, reflecting higher January output and slower post-holiday purchasing. LME three-month and SHFE March copper both declined during the session.

title: Critical minerals: Andrew Forrest undeterred in green energy ambitions as nickel and lithium miners head to Canberra
