summary: Andrew Forrest’s Wyloo Metals plans to shortly shut down West Australian nickel mines bought last year. The decision follows months of weaker global nickel prices blamed on Indonesia’s rapid nickel-industry expansion. The move highlights deteriorating profitability and near-term uncertainty for nickel supply and sentiment.

title: Alcoa Offers to Buy Australia's Alumina for $2.2 Billion. The Stock Slips.
summary: Alcoa reportedly offered $2.2 billion to buy out its Australian partner, increasing its participation in global alumina and bauxite markets. Because alumina and bauxite are key feedstocks for aluminum production, the move may improve perceived upstream security and affect expectations for aluminum costs, though the deal status limits certainty.

title: Indonesia mining ministry working to approve more nickel, tin quotas, official says
summary: Indonesia’s mining ministry approved mining quotas (RKAB) covering 145 million tonnes of nickel ore and 14 million tonnes of bauxite, following earlier delays. The ministry is working on further RKAB approvals, currently focusing on nickel and tin, which may lift expected near-term supply for nickel and aluminium feedstock.

title: Alcoa makes $2.2bn buyout offer for Australia's Alumina
summary: Alcoa proposed a $2.2bn all-stock offer to buy out Alumina’s stake in an Australian joint venture, increasing Alcoa’s ownership of bauxite/alumina assets and a smelter interest. The conditional deal includes a 13.1% premium and aims to simplify governance, potentially improving upstream aluminium supply outlook.

title: Zijin gets approval for Julong copper project expansion in Tibet
summary: Zijin Mining received approval to expand its Julong copper project in Tibet, lifting capacity from 200,000 tonnes/day to nearly 350,000 tonnes/day and requiring 17.46bn yuan in self-financed investment. New production is expected only by end-2025, limiting immediate short-term price impact despite the scale.

title: Aluminium hits one-month low after Shanghai stocks jump
summary: Aluminium fell to a one-month low after Shanghai inventories jumped and the U.S. did not impose sanctions on Russian metal, easing supply-risk fears that had supported prices last week. LME aluminium weakened despite earlier expectations of a sanctions package, while nickel also softened on the same news backdrop.

title: Indonesia could wipe out global nickel rivals according to the CEO of a French mining firm
summary: Eramet’s CEO says Indonesia’s low-cost nickel producers could squeeze out global rivals, with Indonesia possibly exceeding 75% of “highest class” pure nickel in five years. The piece links prior Indonesia-led oversupply and demand headwinds (stainless steel and EV battery shifts) to continued nickel price weakness.

title: Far North Queensland copper mine set for recommissioning
summary: Revolver Resources plans to fast-track recommissioning studies for the high-grade Dianne copper mine in Far North Queensland, supported by a A$1.3m grant from the Queensland Critical Minerals and Battery Technology Fund. The company aims for full operations within 18 months, contingent on approvals and financing, aligning with rising global copper demand.

title: Alcoa Stock Slides After $2.2 Billion Takeover Offer for Alumina—Key Price Levels to Watch
summary: Alcoa’s shares fell after a $2.2 billion all-stock offer to buy its Australian joint-venture partner Alumina. The deal targets refining/smelting assets (AWAC) and alumina supply through bauxite mining investment, but it comes as the aluminum sector faces weaker demand and Alcoa halted an unprofitable refinery.

title: Alcoa: agreement to acquire Alumina -February 26, 2024 at 07:32 am EST
summary: Alcoa said it agreed on terms to acquire Australia’s Alumina Limited, consolidating its position as a major bauxite and alumina producer. The transaction would issue Alumina shareholders 0.02854 Alcoa shares per Alumina share. The board plans to recommend the deal subject to expert review.

title: Core Nickel Receives Conditional Approval for $207,300 Grant from Manitoba Mineral Development Fund and Receives Exploration Work Permits for Halfway Lake
summary: Core Nickel received conditional approval for a C$207,300 (nonrepayable) grant from Manitoba’s mineral development fund to support Q1 drilling on its Halfway Lake nickel exploration targets and also obtained a multi-year exploration work permit valid to 2026. The news is nickel-specific and supportive of exploration momentum.

title: Wider Europe Briefing: Will The EU Ban Russian Aluminum?
summary: The briefing says the EU is considering sectoral sanctions that could expand beyond the current targeted import ban and potentially include broader import/export restrictions on Russian aluminum. It cites large current EU import volumes from Russia and notes some supply decoupling, but a wider ban could still tighten supplies and lift aluminum sentiment.

title: Alcoa aims to take out Australian partner Alumina in $2.2 billion deal
summary: Alcoa proposed a $2.2 billion all-stock buyout of Australian partner Alumina to gain greater upstream exposure and simplify operations. Alumina’s 40% stake in AWAC covers bauxite, alumina refining and aluminium smelting, including interests in Australia and other countries. The deal’s impact is primarily on aluminium market expectations.

title: Premium Nickel Reports 110.75 Metres of 2.56% NiEq at Selebi North Underground
summary: Premium Nickel Resources reported additional underground drilling assay results from the Selebi North (SNUG) nickel-copper-cobalt sulphide deposit in Botswana. The highlight is SNUG-23-067 with 110.75m at 2.56% NiEq (including intervals up to 4.40% NiEq). Drilling and BHEM surveys continue to extend mineralization down plunge.

title: Schuler Incorporated Canton: New Competitive Output & Cost Savings for Aluminum Hot Stamping
summary: Schuler North America and MetalForming Magazine announce a webinar on FAST aluminum hot-stamping technology, claiming furnace-free processing, lower forming temperatures, and major energy (80%) and cycle-time reductions versus solution heat treatment. The release suggests improved productivity for aluminum parts in auto and aerospace, potentially supporting aluminum demand expectations.

title: Fortescue's Forrest urges LME to separate 'clean' nickel contracts
summary: Fortescue’s Andrew Forrest urged the LME to classify nickel contracts as “clean” and “dirty” to give buyers choice and enable a green premium for lower-carbon Australian nickel. The push follows price weakness after more Indonesian nickel supply entered the market and comes alongside job losses and mine maintenance.

title: European and American sanctions on Russia & RKAB review blocked, detonating market sentiment, driving nickel prices to rise sharply, can nickel prices continue to strengthen in the future?
summary: US/EU sanctions tied to alleged Russia developments and EU asset freezes are expected to disrupt Russian metal supply. With Russian nickel a major share of global and LME deliverable inventory, and with RKAB/Indonesia nickel-ore approval delays plus tight nickel-salt and ferronickel supply, nickel prices jumped sharply.

title: Macro sentiment dissipated, nickel prices fluctuated downward today【SMM Nickel Brief Comment】
summary: SMM reports Shanghai nickel falling on Feb 26, with weaker intraday activity and declining volume/open interest, suggesting longs are cautious and bulls are closing. Macro sentiment is said to be largely priced in, while faster Indonesia RKAB review reduces expectations of tight nickel ore supply. Outlook is weak nickel price fluctuation.

title: Traders' reluctance to sell mentality strengthens ferronickel prices rise [Nickel pig iron daily review]
summary: Nickel pig iron/ferronickel prices increased, with SMM 8–12% high-nickel pig iron averaging 945 yuan per nickel point. The report links gains to Indonesia’s RKAB policy effects lifting nickel ore prices and higher input costs, alongside expected February production declines. Demand is weakening, but RKAB approval shortfalls provide emotional support.

title: Aluminium, nickel avoid direct sanctions | Hotter Commodities
summary: The UK, US and EU added measures to penalize Russia, but they avoided direct sanctions on Russia-origin aluminium and nickel. US imports are already minimal due to high tariffs, while Europe could be more affected: Russian shares in EU aluminium and nickel imports have fallen, and new logistics issues may tighten supply.

title: Aluminium, nickel avoid direct sanctions | Hotter Commodities
summary: The UK/US/EU imposed new measures against Russia, including attempts to directly sanction Russian aluminium and nickel. US exposure is limited, but EU imports of Russian aluminium (~10% of ingot imports) have fallen and EU nickel sourcing has declined. Alternative supply faces duties and shipping disruptions, tightening availability.

title: Australia plans tax relief to shield miners from nickel price slump
summary: Australia plans 50% royalty relief for Western Australian nickel producers when quarterly average nickel prices fall below $20,000/t. The March 2024–18 month rebate is repayable later. It follows nickel’s >40% fall amid Indonesia supply and is meant to support struggling miners and critical-minerals financing.

title: Glencore's 2023 metals profits down on lower cobalt, nickel and zinc prices
summary: Glencore reports lower 2023 metals EBITDA driven by weaker market prices for cobalt, nickel, and zinc. The piece cites nickel price declines on LME and oversupply from Indonesian MHP. It also notes higher copper and nickel operating costs (including less by-product credits), but offers no clear near-term trigger for price direction.

title: Aluminium and nickel not included in US sanctions on Russia
summary: US announced new Russia sanctions affecting 500+ entities, but not the base metals industry. Aluminium and nickel had risen beforehand on expectations sanctions would restrict supplies. After the announcement, aluminium fell 1.1% and nickel gains faded (1.2% down to 0.3%). Nickel remains oversupplied and aluminium outlook weakens with China demand concerns.

title: Aluminium and nickel not included in US sanctions on Russia
summary: The US announced Russia sanctions affecting over 500 entities but excluding the base metals industry. Aluminium and nickel had initially risen on expectations sanctions would restrict supplies. After the announcement, aluminium fell 1.1% as gains were unwound, while nickel dropped toward 0.3%, with nickel described as oversupplied.

title: New Zealand Aluminium Smelters | Scoop InfoPages
summary: New Zealand Aluminium Smelters (NZAS) says it will cut electricity consumption at its Tiwai Point aluminium smelter by 100 MW from early August after a request from Meridian Energy, linked to persistently low lake levels. This likely reduces smelting activity and near-term aluminium output.

title: Lifezone Metals Announces Two-Phased Development Plan For The Kabanga Nickel Project In Tanzania
summary: Lifezone Metals reported progress on its two-phased Kabanga nickel project in Tanzania, including definitive feasibility study work, high locked-cycle nickel recovery to concentrate (with strong copper recoveries) and completion of key process testwork. It also received the environmental impact assessment certificate for the Kahama hydromet refinery, supporting potential future nickel/copper supply.

title: Alcoa Makes $2.2 Billion Offer For Australia's Alumina
summary: Alcoa has offered $2.2 billion to buy Australia’s Alumina in an all-stock deal, aiming to expand its share of global alumina and bauxite markets. The purchase would increase Alcoa’s ownership of bauxite mines and alumina refineries and is subject to approvals and a shareholder vote.

title: Kinterra Capital's Cannon Resources Advances Exploration at Fisher East Nickel Project to Support EV Battery Supply Chain
summary: Kinterra’s portfolio company Cannon Resources expanded the nickel sulphide resource at its Fisher East project, increasing JORC-indicated/inferred resources 75% and doubling the sulphide resource in under six months. The project targets IRA-compliant nickel for EV batteries, with further metallurgical work and permitting planned.

title: Copper Falls as Inventories Surge in China After Lunar New Year
summary: Copper is falling as inventories in China rise after the Lunar New Year holiday period. The build in stored material signals improving near-term supply and weaker demand timing, which can pressure spot and front-month expectations for copper prices over the coming days.

title: Montana Supreme Court overrules lower court on copper mine
summary: The Montana Supreme Court heard arguments over whether a copper mine near White Sulphur Springs should have received approval. The update notes the high court overruled a lower court decision, potentially affecting the mine’s ability to move forward and thereby influencing near-term expectations for copper supply.

title: Montana Supreme Court rules in favor of major copper mine | iNFOnews | Thompson-Okanagan's News Source
summary: Montana’s Supreme Court ruled the Black Butte copper mine’s environmental review was adequate, overturning a 2022 decision that had revoked its permit and halted work. Development can resume, after preliminary activity began in 2021. Conservation groups plan to continue legal challenges over water use impacts.

title: Montana Supreme Court rules in favour of major copper mine sponsored by Vancouver company
summary: Montana’s Supreme Court ruled Monday that officials adequately reviewed the environmental effects of Sandfire Resources’ Black Butte copper mine, overturning a 2022 decision that revoked its permit. Preliminary work can proceed, though a separate water-permit challenge remains pending. The decision reduces near-term risk of lost copper output.

title: SMM Aluminium Market Morning Comment (Feb 27)  | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM’s morning comment says SHFE 2404 aluminium and LME aluminium edged slightly lower overnight. It notes Guinea bauxite strike impact is limited, smelters run steadily, and downstream demand is gradually resuming into peak season with low/weak inventory growth supportive. But rising ingot supply and a reopened import window cap upside.

title: Indonesia to keep flooding the global market with nickel until at least 2028 according to S&P Global
summary: The report says Indonesia is set to keep flooding global markets with nickel until at least 2028, citing S&P Global. Persistent higher Indonesian output suggests continued oversupply conditions. That typically weighs on nickel prices over the coming days and weeks as traders adjust expectations for supply and pricing.

title: Nickel falls after Indonesia says it is working to approve more mining quotas
summary: Nickel prices fell after Indonesia said it is working to approve more mining quotas, expected to ease tight ore supply in the world’s top nickel producer. The Reuters report cites fresh approvals and prior fears of tighter supply, but notes that Russia-related sanctions did not include metals.

title: Tesla chairwoman Robyn Denhom tackles Canberra on tax breaks for nickel, lithium miners
summary: Tesla chair Robyn Denholm joins Wyloo’s nickel mining executives to lobby Canberra for production tax credits and other support for Australia’s critical minerals sector. The delegation is set to meet the resources minister and Treasury officials, seeking incentives that could strengthen nickel miner economics and supply expectations.

title: AWC ASX: no 2023 dividend for Alumina shareholders
summary: AWC-listed Alumina reported a full-year loss as alumina and aluminium prices fell. Western Australia permitting issues forced processing of very low-grade bauxite. The firm’s managing director said it may need a dilutive equity raising unless it accepts Alcoa’s $3.3bn takeover offer, and shareholders will not receive a 2023 dividend.

title: Battery metals: More pain for nickel, lithium as supply deluge bites
summary: The piece highlights renewed pressure on battery metals. Nickel faces further downside as falling prices and higher costs squeeze miners’ margins, with BHP writing down nickel assets and Wyloo shutting multiple nickel mines. In contrast, copper is viewed more positively on expectations of supply shortage, while lithium is also under strain.

title: Nickel under pressure as supply concerns ease
summary: Reuters says nickel prices fell on Tuesday after easing supply-hit fears. Indonesia’s mining ministry is working on delayed mining quota approvals, while seasonal weak stainless-steel demand further weighs on consumption. The dollar’s weakness provided some support, but SHFE and LME nickel stayed under pressure.

title: SMM Analysis: Nickel Ore Quota Raises Concerns, What is the Current Approval Progress?
summary: SMM reports Indonesia has approved 145 million wet metric tons of 2024 nickel ore quota as of Feb 26. Under the new rule set, approvals are slower due to shorter reporting intervals for operating mines versus annual approvals for exploration. The quota covers about 60% of 2024 demand, implying tightness until further approvals.

title: The performance of nickel inventories on the two major exchanges is differentiated, and the Shanghai nickel inventory has reached a new high for more than three years!
summary: LME nickel inventories in London fell last week to about 69,972 tonnes, but the key takeaway is Shanghai nickel stockpiles: they kept accumulating for four consecutive weeks, rising 11.23% to 17,758 tonnes, the highest in over three years. Analysts note declining inventories tend to support prices, while rising inventories are bearish.

title: First Quantum Secures $500 Million Copper Prepayment Deal with China's Jiangxi
summary: First Quantum secured a $500 million copper prepayment deal with Jiangxi Copper, providing liquidity while it navigates the closure of its Cobre Panamá mine. The agreement covers annual deliveries of 50,000 tonnes of copper anodes from Zambia’s Kansanshi mine at market prices, supporting near-term supply expectations.

title: Infinico Metals Corp. Intersects 1.37% Nickel over 51.94 Metres and Discovers Extension of Mineralization in a 120 Metre Step Out at Its Nicobi Magmatic Nickel Sulphide Project
summary: Infinico Metals reported assay highlights from the Nicobi magmatic nickel sulphide project, including 1.37% Ni over 51.94 m and additional step-out mineralization in a 120 m down-plunge extension. Intercepts also contain copper and cobalt. The results are exploration news with no near-term production or supply impact.

title: Mink Ventures Completes Drill Program at Warren Copper Nickel Project, Timmins, Ontario
summary: Mink Ventures reported completion of a 507-meter, six-hole drill program at its Warren copper-nickel project in Timmins, Ontario. All holes intersected sulphide mineralization and assays are pending; historical trench/grade ranges were cited. No production or confirmed resource upgrade was announced, so near-term Cu and Ni impacts are likely limited.

title: Osisko Metals Establishes a Technical Consultation Committee to Develop the Pit Dewatering Plan for Gaspé Copper
summary: Osisko Metals created a technical consultation committee to develop a dewatering plan for the flooded Mount Copper open pit at Gaspé Copper, Quebec, aiming to enable improved in-pit evaluation and possible restart. The company plans permitting steps after studies and stakeholder reviews, but no production or supply impact is announced.

title: Copper super-bulls bide their time in the options market
summary: The piece highlights choppy copper futures with funds repeatedly flipping shorts and longs within a tight trading range, but contrasts this with LME copper options showing a strong upside bias. Call open interest exceeds puts, and long-dated high-strike call positions imply speculative bullish bets on higher copper prices ahead.

title: Stanislav Kondrashov from Telf AG: the Fed's turn and supply cuts are the main reasons for rising copper prices — Пресс-релизы
summary: The piece argues copper prices are rising because disruptions at major mining operations have reduced supply and tightened the market, countering earlier expectations of a 2024 surplus. A Fed-driven weaker dollar and stronger Chinese currency improved purchasing power. It also notes aluminium gained 3.6% amid the same factors and UK sanctions added trade uncertainty.

title: Sandfire America scores legal win for Montana copper project
summary: Sandfire Resources America shares surged after Montana’s Supreme Court reversed a lower-court decision and reinstated the permit for its Black Butte copper project. The legal win cuts permitting risk for copper supply timelines, improving expectations and providing a modest bullish impulse to copper sentiment over the near term.

title: Sterling Metals Corp.: Sterling Metals Provides Update on its Acquisition of the Copper Road Project in Ontario
summary: Sterling Metals will resume trading after announcing it will acquire 100% of the Copper Road Project in Ontario from Copper Road Resources. The project features historical drilling and confirmation of porphyry-hosted copper (and molybdenum) mineralization. Sterling outlines early Phase 1 exploration work ahead of future campaigns after closing.

title: Montana Supreme Court approves Smith River copper mine
summary: Montana’s Supreme Court has approved the Smith River copper mine. The ruling improves permitting certainty, which can raise expectations of future copper supply and reduce perceived supply risk. That outlook may exert mild near-term downside pressure on copper prices, though additional steps and timelines remain before output begins.

title: Project Report 2024: Setting Up An Aluminium Wire Drawing Manufacturing Plant
summary: The article outlines a 2024 project report for establishing an aluminium wire drawing manufacturing plant, covering process, costs, and market outlook. It cites growth drivers such as increased use of aluminium wiring in electrical, automotive, aerospace, construction, and telecommunications, plus risks from fluctuating raw material prices and regulations.

title: Copper flat as rising stockpiles offset mine supply tightness
summary: Copper prices were range-bound as higher inventories in Chinese exchange warehouses offset tightness from mine supply disruptions. The piece cites LME and SHFE copper contracts largely unchanged, while ore-market tightness has lowered processing fees and squeezed smelter margins, potentially implying future refined output adjustments.

title: Government to set up $450m manganese refinery, ban export of raw bauxite
summary: Ghana plans a US$450m manganese refinery and will introduce a law to ban exports of raw bauxite. The government also references aluminium value-chain initiatives via GIADEC. Blocking raw bauxite exports could tighten upstream bauxite availability, generally supportive for near-term aluminium supply expectations.

title: Nickel miners press Labor for 'temporary' production tax credits
summary: Andrew Forrest and Tesla-backed efforts seek temporary Australian production tax credits to rescue the struggling nickel industry. The proposal, modelled via AMEC and assessed by economist Chris Richardson, would involve about a 10% nickel production tax credit, far exceeding prior Labor support levels for car makers.

title: Noronex ramps up JV stake in Namibian copper project
summary: Noronex will increase its stake in the Witvlei copper project in Namibia by acquiring Thunder Gold’s remaining 25% interest, lifting effective ownership to 95% via its subsidiary Larchmont. The deal is structured with shares and a deferred $1m payment tied to feasibility. It reiterates potential copper resource growth but no near-term output changes.

title: Copper falls on firm dollar, rising stockpiles
summary: Copper prices edged down as a firm U.S. dollar pressured greenback-priced commodities and Chinese exchange warehouses saw inventory spikes. SHFE copper and LME copper both declined, with SHFE inventories more than doubling in two weeks. Aluminium and nickel also fell on the day, reflecting softer near-term sentiment.

title: Tighter Indonesian nickel ore supply boosts prices, curbs smelter output
summary: Indonesia’s government delayed issuance of nickel ore production quotas (RKAB), slowing mining and tightening ore availability. Smelters curtailed output due to thin stocks, while Indonesian nickel ore prices rose about 14% in February and nickel pig iron hit a near three-month peak, boosting near-term nickel price expectations.

title: Copper held down by China's property woes and strong dollar
summary: Copper prices resumed falling on a stronger U.S. dollar and worsening China property-sector news, with a liquidation petition against Country Garden hurting demand expectations. LME three-month copper slipped and SHFE inventories rose, indicating weak post–Lunar New Year consumption. Aluminium and nickel also fell on the same day’s risk backdrop.

title: Constellium to lead Close the Loop project to accelerate automotive aluminium circularity
summary: Constellium will lead the “Close the Loop” project with French recycling partners to develop technologies for dismantling, sorting and remelting aluminium from end-of-life vehicles. The initiative is funded under France 2030 and aims to produce impurity-tolerant automotive alloys, highlighting lower energy use versus primary metal and circularity benefits.

title: Torr Metals Inc.: Torr Metals Reveals Major Expansion Adjacent to Highway: Three Potential Porphyry Centres Within Multi-Kilometre Copper-Gold Soil Anomalies at the Kolos Project
summary: Torr Metals reported additional soil assay results at its Kolos Project in British Columbia, expanding multi-kilometre copper-gold anomaly footprints with copper >200 ppm in multiple zones and widespread Cu/Au anomalies. The company notes the site has never been drill tested and plans more pending assays, implying exploration upside rather than supply impact.

title: Jim Chalmers to push for incentives for sustainable mining amid concerns over Australian nickel
summary: Treasurer Jim Chalmers will push G20 incentives for environmentally sustainable critical minerals, citing concerns over Australia’s nickel industry amid rising Indonesian competition. He argues current market structures don’t reward improved ESG output and signals possible differentiated trading or carbon-tariff approaches that could support higher-standards nickel producers.

title: "Montana Supreme Court Rules In Favor Of Major Copper Mine"
summary: Montana’s Supreme Court ruled 5-2 that officials adequately reviewed the environmental effects of the Black Butte copper mine, overturning a 2022 decision that revoked the permit and blocked work. The mine can proceed, easing supply uncertainty around copper production and supporting near-term price sentiment.

title: On February 28, the average price of SMM8-12% high-nickel pig iron was 960 yuan/nickel point (ex-factory tax included), which was 10 yuan/nickel point higher than the previous working day
summary: On Feb 28, SMM8–12% high-nickel pig iron averaged 960 yuan/nickel point, up 10 yuan from the prior session. The rise is attributed to Indonesia’s RKAB policy supporting nickel ore prices, lifting ferronickel costs, and expectations of production cuts, despite weaker stainless demand.

title: Newmont Corporation Joins the International Copper Association
summary: International Copper Association (ICA) announced Newmont’s membership addition after a board election. Newmont produces copper among other metals and stated it will engage on safe, sustainable copper production. The article focuses on industry collaboration and sustainability goals, with no specific supply or demand changes for the next weeks.

title: TNR Gold NSR Royalty Update - Los Azules Copper, Gold and Silver Project - McEwen Copper Reports Improved Copper Recovery
summary: TNR Gold’s royalty update highlights McEwen Copper’s Phase 1 metallurgical tests at Argentina’s Los Azules project, showing average copper recovery improved to 76% (up 3.2%) and 8.3% lower net sulfuric acid consumption versus the prior PEA. The changes increase modeled copper cathode production and project economics.

title: TNR Gold Corp.: TNR Gold NSR Royalty Update - Los Azules Copper, Gold and Silver Project - McEwen Copper Reports Improved Copper Recovery
summary: TNR Gold’s royalty interest in the Los Azules copper project is linked to McEwen Copper’s Phase 1 heap-leach test results. Average copper recovery is said to rise to 76% (up 3.2%) and net acid consumption falls 8.3%, boosting modeled copper cathode output and NPV.

title: EU Member States Clash on Sanctioning Russian Aluminum
summary: EU member states are pushing for stronger sectoral sanctions on Russian aluminum, including possible import/export bans, arguing current levels help fund Russia’s war. The EU has only a targeted ban on certain Russian aluminum products so far. Broader restrictions could disrupt regional supply and lift aluminium price expectations.

title: Houston copper wire theft: Law enforcement noticing rise in infrastructure vandalism often involving valuable metal
summary: Houston law enforcement reports a rise in copper wire theft from utility poles, with 38 cases over 12 months and ongoing reports. Thieves cut and remove copper wire to sell to scrapyards, sometimes targeting fiber optic cables too. Authorities warn disruptions can follow, and they’re coordinating to investigate.

title: Charges laid in Yarmouth County copper theft
summary: Four men were charged with stealing copper near Nova Scotia Power’s Tusket Falls site in Yarmouth County. Police investigated a break-in and arrested suspects after a van was stopped. The utility is reportedly replacing copper cables with lower-value material to deter further thefts, which may reduce copper demand locally.

title: New Caledonia's nickel crisis prompts call for 'economic, social state of emergency'
summary: New Caledonia’s nickel industry is under crisis: Glencore is withdrawing from Koniambo and the site has shifted to “care and maintenance,” while Eramet’s SLN needed a French government loan to avoid bankruptcy. A proposed “nickel pact” aims at competitiveness as Eramet warns SLN could be wiped out within five years.

title: Dozens voice opposition to Upper Peninsula copper mine
summary: Michigan’s Strategic Fund board is weighing a proposed $50 million grant for Highland Copper’s Copperwood project to extract copper from western Upper Peninsula. Opponents cite environmental and tourism risks and long-term waste stability concerns, while supporters argue for jobs and renewed copper demand. No decision deadline is set.

title: Indonesia Says Its Nickel Supply Will Keep Global Prices Low
summary: The article’s headline says Indonesia will keep nickel supply sufficient to hold global prices down. If markets take this as evidence of sustained supply and limited upside risk, nickel could face near-term downward or at least limited upward pressure as buyers anticipate easier availability.

title: Amaroq Minerals Ltd.: Significant New Nickel-Copper Discovery at Stendalen
summary: Amaroq Minerals announced a significant new Ni-Cu discovery at its Stendalen project in South Greenland, reporting over 140m of disseminated nickel-copper sulphides and potential for higher-grade massive sulphides. The company plans additional geophysics and up to three drill rigs in 2024, boosting exploration upside for nickel and copper.

title: Amaroq Minerals Ltd.: Significant New Nickel-Copper Discovery at Stendalen
summary: Amaroq Minerals reported a new high-tenor nickel-copper discovery at its Stendalen project in South Greenland, with 140m of disseminated magmatic sulphides intersected in the first scout hole and plans to scale drilling in 2024. It remains an exploration update with no production or immediate supply change.

title: Copper Fox Announces 2024 Schaft Creek Program
summary: Copper Fox announced its 2024 program for the Schaft Creek copper-gold-molybdenum-silver project, operated by Teck (75%/25% JV). The plan includes 4,500m of drilling, continued metallurgical and environmental baseline studies for permitting, geotechnical and facilities work, and solar camp upgrades to support prefeasibility by end-2024 or early-2025.

title: Copper Fox Metals Inc.: Copper Fox Announces 2024 Schaft Creek Program
summary: Copper Fox outlines its 2024 program for the Schaft Creek copper-gold-molybdenum-silver project, managed with Teck. The plan includes C$18.7m of expenditures, 4,500m of drilling, metallurgical/geotechnical studies, ongoing environmental baseline work, and completion of a solar power facility. No immediate production or market-impact changes are stated.

title: Spot transactions picked up, ferronickel prices remained stable [Nickel Pig Iron Daily Review]
summary: SMM reports nickel pig iron (8-12% grade) averaged 960 yuan/nickel point, flat vs the previous working day. Indonesia’s RKAB policy is said to have lifted nickel ore prices and production cut expectations may reduce ferronickel supply. Yet off-season stainless demand and weaker output keep demand soft, leaving ferronickel largely stable.

title: India top court rejects Vedanta's plea to reopen Sterlite Copper's smelting unit, source says
summary: India’s top court rejected Vedanta’s request to reopen Sterlite Copper’s smelter in Thoothukudi. The 400,000-tonne-per-year unit has been shut since 2019 following state action after fatal protests. The ruling keeps additional copper refining capacity offline, supporting tighter supply expectations.

title: Alta Copper Corp.: Alta Copper Announces Positive Metal Recoveries and Provides Project Update
summary: Alta Copper announced positive metallurgical results for its Cañariaco Sur copper-gold porphyry, with flotation copper recoveries up to 97.4%, and said grindability is favorable. The company is advancing an optimized PEA for early April, pursuing a drill permit for ~47,000 meters, and assessing mine infrastructure options, supporting copper project outlook.

title: India News | SC Dismisses Vedanta's Plea Against Closure of Copper Smelting Plant in Thoothukudi
summary: India’s Supreme Court dismissed Vedanta’s plea seeking to reopen its Thoothukudi copper smelting plant, confirming the closure after protests and police firing in 2018. The court cited residents’ health concerns and upheld lower-court rejection of reopening in 2020. The decision sustains reduced refined copper supply prospects.

title: Strategic Metals Ltd.: Strategic Metals' Partner Benjamin Hill Mining Intercepts 211.65 Metres Of 0.46 Grams/Tonne Gold In Maiden Drill Program At The Alotta Gold-Copper-Molybdenum Project, Yukon
summary: Strategic Metals announced that its partner Benjamin Hill intersected porphyry-style mineralization at the Alotta gold-copper-molybdenum project in Yukon, with reported coincident copper and gold soil anomalies and chalcopyrite mineralization. Drilling is expected to resume in May 2024, but the findings are early and exploratory.

title: 'Serious Violations' : Supreme Court Dismisses Vedanta's Plea To Reopen Sterlite Copper Smelter In Tamil Nadu's Tuticorin
summary: India’s Supreme Court dismissed Vedanta’s plea to reopen the Sterlite copper smelting plant in Tuticorin, citing repeated breaches and serious violations. By denying permission to restart the unit, the ruling maintains reduced copper smelting output, which can tighten near-term refined copper supply expectations and weigh on prices.

title: Zonte makes a discovery at the K6 target, drilling intersects multiple copper zones
summary: Zonte Metals reported discovery results from seven drill holes at the K6 target of its Cross Hills Copper Project in Newfoundland and Labrador. All holes intersected visible copper, including 11.2m of 0.42% Cu and higher-grade intervals. Mineralization remains open along strike and to depth.

title: SC rejects Vedanta's plea against closure of copper plant in TN
summary: India’s Supreme Court rejected Vedanta’s bid to reopen the closed Sterlite Copper smelting plant in Thoothukudi, upholding closure over repeated pollution and health concerns. The court declined to interfere with the High Court’s decision. Keeping the copper smelter shut can marginally tighten local copper supply expectations.

title: SC upholds closure of Sterlite Copper plant in TN's Thoothukudi
summary: India’s Supreme Court dismissed Vedanta’s plea to reopen the Sterlite Copper smelter in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, upholding the 2020 decision that the plant stay closed for environmental violations. The shutdown follows 2018 protests and fatalities. The ruling maintains reduced copper smelting supply while the site remains closed.

title: European aluminium premiums face new wave of support from buoyant Asian markets
summary: European aluminium premiums for in-whs/duty-unpaid Rotterdam and other regional benchmarks have risen as higher freight costs and Europe’s need for imported tonnage tighten availability. Traders cite buoyant Asian (mainly China) sentiment, improved arbitrage after Lunar New Year, and wider contango as supportive despite weak near-term demand.

title: SC dismisses Vedanta's plea to re-open Sterlite copper smelter plant at Thoothukudi in Tamil Nadu
summary: India’s Supreme Court dismissed Vedanta’s plea to reopen the Sterlite copper smelter at Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu. The decision prevents the resumption of copper smelting capacity, limiting near-term refined copper supply and potentially tightening availability, which can weigh on copper prices over the coming days.

title: SMM Analysis: Nickel Ore Quota Arouses Concern What is the current approval progress?
summary: SMM reports that Indonesia has approved 145 million wet tons of nickel ore quota for 2024, but under the new multi-year approval system the approval pace has slowed. With expected 241 million wet tons demand, the approved quota covers about 60%, and further approvals are expected to increase supply coverage.

title: Low-Cost Nickel from Indonesia is Flooding The Market
summary: The article argues Indonesia is flooding the market with low-cost nickel, sustaining a global surplus and keeping prices under pressure. It describes closures or reviews of non-Indonesia supply (including Western Australia) and mentions Reuters’ view that China and Indonesia may cut output to limit losses.

title: EV Minerals Corporation: EV Minerals Sampling Program Returns High-Grade Results Including 1.28% Nickel and 2.54% Copper at the Lunge Project in Sudbury, Ontario
summary: EV Minerals reported assay results from surface sampling at Ontario’s Lunge Project tied to a proposed acquisition, including multiple grab samples above 1% nickel and several above 1% copper (to ~2.54% Cu). The company plans a 2024 baseline exploration program; results are not production or resource updates.

title: Seismic Shift: Indonesia Floods Market With Cheap Nickel, Sparking Wave Of Unprofitable Mines
summary: The article headline claims Indonesia floods are delivering “cheap nickel” to the market and triggering a wave of unprofitable mines. Increased near-term supply from nickel operations would tend to weigh on nickel prices over the coming days, unless demand offsets the added availability.

title: Adani's $1.2 billion copper smelter to import concentrates from Peru, Chile, Australia
summary: Adani’s Kutch Copper plans to start operations in weeks at a $1.2 billion Mundra smelter, sourcing copper concentrates from Peru, Chile and Australia. Initial capacity is 500,000 tonnes, scaling to 1 million. India’s current refined shortfall and strong demand underpin the project’s near-term market implications for copper.

title: London nickel retreats on easing supply worries
summary: London nickel prices fell after easing worries about supply from Indonesia’s nickel output. Three-month nickel on the LME declined, reversing part of the prior rally as investors reassessed the balance of supply and demand. The report cites Indonesia’s resilience via margins and benefits to its battery industry.

title: Adani's $1.2 Billion Copper Smelter to Source Concentrates from Peru, Chile, Australia
summary: Adani’s Kutch Copper plans to start operations soon at a $1.2 billion copper smelter in Mundra, sourcing concentrates from Peru, Chile and Australia. Initial capacity is 500,000 tpa, ramping to 1 million by 2028/29. The project aims to boost India’s refined copper supply amid demand exceeding output.

title: Major Blow for Vedanta as Supreme Court Rejects Plea to Reopen Sterlite Copper Smelter Plant in Tamil Nadu
summary: India’s Supreme Court denied Vedanta’s request to reopen the Sterlite copper smelter in Tamil Nadu, citing repeated regulatory breaches, including failure to remove copper slabs and issues over hazardous waste disposal and consent conditions. The ruling keeps Sterlite shut, risking immediate copper supply shortfalls given the plant’s large output share.

title: Nickel May Flip to Deficit on Indonesia Hurdles, Macquarie Warns
summary: BNN Bloomberg highlights a Macquarie warning that nickel may flip to a market deficit as Indonesia faces hurdles. The report implies reduced near-term supply availability from Indonesia, which would tighten fundamentals and likely add upward pressure to nickel prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Inside a copper output plunge at No. 1 global producer Codelco
summary: Reuters reports major operational troubles at Codelco’s Chuquicamata Subterranea underground project, including equipment failures, tunnel collapses, and chronic maintenance lapses. Production has fallen well short of earlier targets, with construction now delayed to 2025 and additional investment announced. The developments raise near-term Chilean copper supply concerns.

title: Adani's $1.2 Billion Copper Smelter to Import from Peru, Chile, Australia
summary: Adani’s Kutch Copper Ltd plans to start operations soon at a $1.2 billion 500,000 tpa copper smelter in Mundra, scaling later to 1 million tpa. It will source copper concentrates from Peru, Chile and Australia to meet India’s growing copper demand and reduce supply shortfalls.

title: Indonesia: Will ensure adequate nickel supply | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Indonesia’s deputy minister overseeing nickel processing said LME nickel is unlikely to rebound above $18,000/t and that the government will ensure full market supply to reduce EV manufacturers’ costs. He added nickel should stay above $15,000/t due to potential smelter cuts below that level, balancing downside.

title: Why do nickel prices suck? Miners seek answer to pressing question
summary: The article focuses on why nickel prices have fallen, citing a supply glut (including growing Indonesian nickel inflows), weaker-than-expected demand amid an economic hangover, and investor uncertainty about EV nickel usage. It notes ongoing 2024 price declines and reduced financing for nickel projects, reinforcing near-term bearish sentiment.

title: Aluminum: The peak consumption season is approaching, and the future price is expected to rise
summary: SMM reports tighter alumina supply after Spring Festival, stable electrolytic aluminium output, and declining social aluminium ingot inventories to low multi-year levels. With downstream enterprises resuming and peak consumption approaching, weak ingot accumulation is expected to persist, supporting higher aluminium prices. Upside is capped and risks remain.

title: Indonesian Nickel Will Always Be in Demand, Gov't Says
summary: Indonesia’s government official said Indonesian nickel will remain in demand regardless of EV battery chemistry, arguing nickel is used not only for NMC batteries but also stainless steel and other materials. The piece also reiterates Indonesia’s domestic processing push and its halt on unprocessed nickel-ore exports. Net near-term price effect seems limited.

title: Spruce Ridge Completes Oregon Nickel Assets Acquisition with RAB Capital
summary: Spruce Ridge Resources completed its acquisition giving it an 80% interest in Homeland Nickel, which holds the Cleopatra and Red Flat nickel laterite deposits in southwest Oregon. The company plans permitting and up to 70 near-surface drillholes to assess grade and laterite thickness, alongside milestone-based study and construction payments.

title: Aluminum Imported Products May Be Subject to Duties
summary: The US Department of Commerce is investigating alleged unfair trade in aluminum extrusions and is expected to set preliminary CVD duties on March 4 and preliminary AD duties on May 1 for multiple countries, with broad product scope tied to extruded aluminum portions. If imposed, duties could curb US import volumes.

title: Nickel market surplus just 36,000t this year: Macquarie
summary: Macquarie cut its 2024 nickel surplus forecast to 36,000t from 125,000t, citing stronger Chinese demand and corrected NPI/ferro-nickel accounting. With Indonesian ore licence controls and planned supply curtailments, the bank expects LME nickel prices may have bottomed near $16,000/t and have upside potential.

title: U.S. appeals court rejects bid to block land swap for Rio's Arizona copper mine
summary: A U.S. appeals court rejected efforts to block a land swap needed for Rio Tinto and BHP’s Resolution Copper project at Oak Flat in Arizona. The ruling keeps the project on track to meet part of U.S. copper demand, which can improve near-term supply expectations despite ongoing opposition.

title: In blow to Native Americans, US court approves land swap for Rio's Arizona copper project
summary: A U.S. appeals court narrowly upheld approval of a land swap enabling Rio Tinto’s Resolution Copper project in Arizona. Native American groups opposing Oak Flat lost the latest legal bid. The ruling keeps the pathway open for a mine over a large copper reserve, boosting supply expectations for copper tied to renewables and EVs.

title: Element 29 Receives Environmental Permit for Flor de Cobre Copper Project and Announces Partnership with GlobeTrotters on Exploration Activities
summary: Element 29 Resources said it received Peru’s environmental permit (DIA) for exploration drilling at its Flor de Cobre “Atravesado” porphyry copper target and is seeking final authorization to initiate exploration activities. The company also partners with GlobeTrotters to advance drilling and reduce costs.

title: Element 29 Resources Inc.: Element 29 Receives Environmental Permit for Flor de Cobre Copper Project and Announces Partnership with GlobeTrotters on Exploration Activities
summary: Element 29 Resources said it received environmental permit approval for exploration drilling at its Flor de Cobre (Atravesado) copper project in southern Peru and is proceeding with authorization steps for drilling. It also announced a partnership to advance exploration and potentially reduce costs, but no production is started.

title: EV Minerals Closes Acquisition of Nickel Projects in Sudbury, Ontario
summary: EV Minerals has acquired the Baldwin and Lunge nickel projects in Sudbury, Ontario, assuming a 2% NSR and gaining the right to buy back 1% for $1 million. The company also frames its broader EV Nickel Project as nickel-copper-cobalt. The announcement is sentiment-supportive but lacks near-term production impact.

title: In blow to Native Americans, U.S. court approves land swap for Rio's Arizona copper mine
summary: A U.S. appeals court upheld a land swap allowing Rio Tinto and BHP to proceed with the Resolution Copper project at Oak Flat, rejecting Native American challenges. The mine could supply over a quarter of U.S. copper demand, and the ruling improves near-term supply-development certainty.

title: Macquarie flags nickel deficit as Indonesian permit delays drag growth
summary: Macquarie said nickel markets could face an unexpected deficit this year as delays to Indonesian mine permit approvals slow processing timelines. The bottleneck may hinder growth in local nickel production, which needs to sustain output levels as demand continues to rise, increasing near-term supply uncertainty for the metal.

title: 9th Circuit rejects challenge to Arizona copper mine; Apache vow to appeal
summary: A divided 9th Circuit rejected Apache Stronghold’s religious challenge to the Resolution Copper mine at Oak Flat, allowing the land transfer case to stand. The project is described as potentially supplying up to one quarter of U.S. copper demand, which could support expectations of future copper supply despite ongoing environmental review.

title: Divided 9th Circuit rejects Apache religious challenge to copper mine on sacred land
summary: A U.S. 9th Circuit panel rejected Apache’s religious challenge against a copper mine planned on sacred land. By upholding the lower decision, the ruling reduces the risk of project delay or disruption, which can support expectations for copper supply availability in the near term.

title: Nickel North Terminates Option Agreement with 1844 to Sell up to 100% Interest in Hawk Ridge
summary: Nickel North Exploration terminated its option agreement with 1844 Resources to sell up to a 100% interest in the Hawk Ridge nickel-copper project in Quebec, effective Feb. 29, 2024, citing market conditions. The announcement is an exploration-stage deal update rather than an operating supply shock.

title: The Monday Report - 04 March 2024
summary: The report says Chinese restocking is underway and frames it as supportive for battery mineral producers, with battery-related commodity prices turning higher. It notes several base- and battery-miner company share gains, including Nickel Industries, implying improved near-term sentiment for nickel prices.

title: The Chinese Jiangxi Copper Company buys shares in First Quantum
summary: Jiangxi Copper bought C$287.5m of shares in First Quantum as the miner faces pressure from the forced closure of its flagship Cobre Panamá copper mine in Panama. The closure followed a court ruling voiding the state contract, prompting refinancing and $20bn arbitration plans amid major market-value declines.

title: SMM Nickel Market Morning Comment (Mar 4) | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports nickel prices rose due to slower approval of Indonesian nickel ore mining quotas under RKAB, raising ongoing concerns about ore supply despite a 2024 quota of 145 million wmt. Spot trading is subdued, downstream purchasing is limited by high prices, but smelters ramp output, and nickel is expected to trend slightly higher this week.

title: Xanadu nails early copper-gold recovery rates in Mongolia
summary: Xanadu Mines says rougher flotation testwork on ore from its Kharmagtai project in Mongolia produced early copper recoveries up to 98% (and gold 95%) and is in line with or better than study assumptions. The company also highlights a prior resource upgrade boosting contained copper and continued PFS progress.

title: Europe to battle with US for aluminium if EU opts for Russian ban
summary: Reuters reports the EU may soon propose new import bans on Russian aluminium. Buyers would compete for Middle Eastern supplies, while Europe faces a shortfall of about 500,000 tons. The piece cites prior Rusal sanctions causing sharp LME jumps and warns that LME transaction limits would spike premiums and prices.

title: Copper mine a bad investment | News, Sports, Jobs
summary: Local opponents argue Michigan’s proposed $50 million grant to Copperwood for a metallic sulfide copper mine would fund “waste” rather than copper and create major environmental risks via a large tailings disposal facility near Lake Superior. They cite potential negative economic impacts, seeking to block or defund the project, implying reduced copper supply expectations.

title: US court green lights land transfer for Resolution Copper project
summary: The US 9th Circuit upheld a decision allowing the federal government to transfer land in Arizona to Rio Tinto and BHP for the Resolution Copper project. The ruling overcomes an indigenous opposition challenge at Oak Flat, potentially improving prospects for future US copper supply and supporting copper prices.

title: Copper gains capped by persistent demand concerns
summary: Copper prices climbed to one-week highs ahead of China’s parliament meeting that may unlock growth stimulus. Softer USD supports dollar-priced metals, but gains are capped by fears that China’s construction weakness and slowing solar/EV-related demand will reduce copper consumption. Warehouse stocks are also elevated.

title: Power Restored After Interruption at CSA Copper Mine
summary: A storm damaged a 132kV power line near the Nyngan CSA copper mine, causing more than 26 hours without grid power. Production was disrupted for about three days including restart and ramp-up. The company estimates 400–500 tonnes of copper output will be deferred from the March quarter into June.

title: Faraday Copper Announces New Breccia Discovery at Area 51, Intersecting 1.29% Copper over 11.36 Meters Within 45.75 Meters at 0.48% Copper
summary: Faraday Copper said it has made a new breccia discovery at Area 51, reporting drill intercepts such as 1.29% copper over 11.36 meters within 45.75 meters at 0.48% copper. The announcement is a positive exploration signal that could support near-term copper sentiment.

title: Western miners hope superior ESG credentials can revive their fortunes amid devastating nickel crash
summary: Western nickel producers face losses and mine closures as nickel prices have fallen sharply to around US$17,500/t. The article attributes the decline to expanding China- and Indonesia-controlled supply, including NPI exports for EV batteries. While ESG/tariff actions are proposed, near-term messaging stresses continued glut and weak prices.

title: Global Nickel Inventories and Increased Supply Impact Nickel Prices Fluctuating Downward [SMM Nickel Futures Commentary]
summary: SMM reports Shanghai nickel futures fell on March 4, alongside decreasing open interest and stop-loss/long liquidation signals. Fundamentally, the decline is attributed to a significant increase in global nickel inventories last week, which implies higher supply and continued downward pressure on nickel prices.

title: Nickel prices continued to rise last week | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports Indonesia approved a large 2024 nickel ore quota, expected to accelerate, though ore supply concerns remain. Spot activity was muted as high nickel prices reduced downstream buying and lowered nickel plate demand. Traders cut premiums to sell. Despite bearish fundamentals, macro remains supportive and nickel is expected to trend slightly higher.

title: Interest grows for low-carbon aluminium in East Asia, but willingness to pay premium mixed
summary: Fastmarkets reports growing customer inquiries for low-carbon aluminium in East Asia, especially from automakers, and launched a corresponding low-carbon differential for Japan and South Korea. Despite mixed willingness to pay, the assessed cif Japan spot premium rose to $120-130/tonne, reflecting tight supply and expectations of higher Q2 premiums.

title: Jiangxi Copper raises stake in First Quantum Minerals
summary: Jiangxi Copper bought more shares in First Quantum for C$287.5m as First Quantum continues refinancing after Panama ordered the Cobre Panama copper mine shut. Additional capital supports the company’s balance sheet, and the group remains tied through anode supply from Zambia’s Kansanshi mine to Jiangxi.

title: Judges say Resolution Copper land swap can proceed in fight over massive AZ mine
summary: A Ninth Circuit ruling on March 1 cleared a key legal hurdle for Resolution Copper’s planned federal land swap. The decision lets the company move forward with development of a major Arizona copper project near Superior, projected to supply about a quarter of U.S. annual copper demand.

title: Perenco's Cameroon subsidiary commences challenging drilling campaign
summary: Lion One Metals reports discovery of copper porphyry-style mineralization at the Wailoaloa prospect near its Tuvatu project in Fiji. Drilling (notably TUDDH-687) intersected multiple zones of anomalous copper with reported composite grades and assays pending for other holes. No production or market supply data is provided.

title: Pure nickel social inventory | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data shows nickel inventories in Shanghai’s bonded zone rose slightly to 4,260 mt and pure nickel social inventories across six regions increased to 27,461 mt. The SHFE nickel price rose last week, but downstream demand was cautious due to high prices, leading to reduced buying and expectations of modest further inventory increases.

title: First Quantum Touts Interest in Its Zambia Copper Operations
summary: First Quantum highlights renewed interest in its Zambia copper operations. The message points to ongoing commitment to copper output in Zambia, which may reduce perceived supply risk and improve near-term expectations for copper availability, potentially supporting copper prices over the next few weeks.

title: ACTOM Distribution Transformers continues to support Kamoa Copper Mine
summary: ACTOM Distribution Transformers said it won an order to supply NECRT equipment for grounding collector power transformers at the Kamoa Copper Mine in the DRC. The article frames this as continued investment in the mine’s energy infrastructure, supporting reliable power transmission, including renewable generation. It is equipment-focused, with no direct copper price data.

title: Native Americans and mining interests continue legal battle over sacred land atop massive copper deposit
summary: A federal appeals panel upheld a lower court’s denial of a preliminary injunction against transferring Oak Flat land for Resolution Copper’s large mine. Native groups argue the land is sacred; the ruling favors continued project progress, lowering near-term legal-delays risk for a major copper supply source.

title: Falcon Gold Corp: CORRECTION BY SOURCE: Falcon Receives Drill Permit Approval at Great Burnt Copper Project Adjacent to Benton, Central Newfoundland
summary: Falcon Gold received drill permit approval for its Great Burnt copper project in Newfoundland and plans up to 1,100 metres of diamond drilling to test geophysical targets. The property is adjacent to known copper-rich deposits (including prior high-grade drilling), but no immediate production changes are announced.

title: Copper Rises as Inventories Fall With China Meeting in Focus
summary: Copper prices are reported to be rising, attributed to falling inventories alongside attention on a forthcoming China meeting. The combination of lower stock levels (suggesting tighter near-term availability) and potential improvements in China-linked demand expectations is supportive for copper in the coming days.

title: Nickel crisis: Macquarie nickel veteran Jim Lennon thinks the rout is ending
summary: Macquarie nickel veteran Jim Lennon says the prior year’s nickel turmoil may end sooner than expected. He cites a major forecast change after a China trip, with unexpectedly strong Chinese demand and potentially slower Indonesian growth rebalancing the market after prices fell nearly 50%.

title: BHP sees tightening copper market on back of global decarbonisation efforts
summary: BHP says global decarbonisation pathways require major increases in critical minerals and forecasts tightening copper markets. It updated short-term balances to a refined copper deficit and very tight concentrate supply, citing Cobre Panama closure, other shortfalls, and new Chinese smelting. Fitch/BMI also supports higher copper prices amid supply constraints.

title: Nickel rush needs a rethink - Editorial - The Jakarta Post
summary: The Jakarta Post editorial claims Indonesia’s nickel dominance and downstreaming have quickly increased smelter output, contributing to a global nickel supply glut and pushing prices far below prior highs. It cites Indonesia’s rising share of global supply, discusses losses and potential closures abroad, and warns reserves may deplete before EV battery demand grows.

title: Material Matters: Copper; Iron Ore; Chinese Property
summary: UBS expects copper to move toward a fundamental inflection as supply growth slows: multiple downgrades to 2024 mine output guidance and tightness from concentrate shortages should outweigh demand growth deceleration. It forecasts a 2024 deficit and lifted price outlooks, pointing to potential copper upside over coming months.

title: Alara Resources commences production at copper-gold mine in Oman
summary: Alara Resources says it has overcome manufacturing defects and started concentrate production at its Al Wash-hi–Majaza copper-gold mine in Oman. With new high-speed mill couplings from China, it plans to ramp to full capacity within 2–3 months and ship an initial ~1,000 dmt of copper concentrate in April 2024 under an offtake with Trafigura.

title: Nickel: Investors more optimistic on the commodity price after last year's rout
summary: Investors are becoming more optimistic about nickel after last year’s rout. Macquarie’s nickel strategist Jim Lennon says unexpectedly strong Chinese demand and the possibility of slower Indonesian growth may help rebalance the market, potentially reducing bearish sentiment and supporting prices over the coming weeks.

title: Romanian aluminum maker Alro is required EUR 2.7 mln in supplementary VAT, profit tax
summary: Romanian aluminum producer Alro says it was required by Romania’s tax authority ANAF to pay about EUR 2.7 million in supplementary VAT and profit tax after an investigation covering 2016–2021. Management is challenging the decision as illegal and plans legal steps. No direct production or export impact is mentioned.

title: Copper prices consolidated rangebound amid firm US dollar | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Copper prices in early March have turned rangebound, supported by limited negative fundamentals but pressured by a firm US dollar and Fed commentary pushing out rate-cut expectations. China policy optimism and possible home-appliance-related demand help, yet TCs falling, oversupplied cathode, and rising inventories keep sentiment mixed.

title: The cost side provided strong support to nickel sulphate prices | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports strong cost-side support for nickel sulphate prices. MHP prices are rising as overseas projects face economics that could reduce or stop production (e.g., Goro, First Quantum). Huafei is not at full output and circulating MHP supply is tight, while nickel salt and refined producers compete for feedstock.

title: Nickel sulphate prices climbed amid tight supply | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Shanghai SMM reports battery-grade nickel sulphate prices rising to about 28,517 yuan/mt as supply remains tight. Nickel salt factories are restarting slowly amid scarce, expensive raw materials and low inventories. Demand from ternary cathode/precursor chains is active, supporting further price increases this week.

title: CANEX Metals Inc.: Canex Options an Advanced Copper Gold Porphyry in British Columbia
summary: CANEX Metals entered a low-upfront option to earn 100% of the Louise copper-gold porphyry in British Columbia. The company highlights historic copper resources and strong past copper grades, plans to compile data, and proposes modern deep-looking IP work. No production or immediate supply impact is stated.

title: EGA's 2023 profit falls amid global aluminium price slump
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium reported lower 2023 profit as revenue fell alongside weaker global aluminium benchmark prices. EGA cited lower average realised LME pricing versus 2022 and said demand remained weak, though it offset declines with higher volumes. Aluminium prices have stayed under pressure after retreating from 2022 highs.

title: First Quantum touts interest in its Zambia copper operations
summary: First Quantum says multiple parties want to buy a minority stake in its Zambian copper operations, after the company closed its Panama copper mine and needs balance-sheet support. It expects due diligence via a data room. The Zambian business includes Kansanshi/Sentinel copper and a nickel ramp-up.

title: Premium Nickel Reports Down Plunge Extension of Selebi North Massive Sulphide Mineralization
summary: Premium Nickel Resources reports additional assay results from underground drilling at its Selebi North Ni-Cu-Co mine in Botswana, extending massive sulphide mineralization down plunge. Highlights include intersections with ~2.25% NiEq and underlying nickel and copper grades. The release is exploration-focused, with limited immediate market impact on nickel/copper prices.

title: TNR Gold Corp.: TNR Gold NSR Royalty Update - Los Azules Copper, Gold and Silver Project - McEwen Copper Updates on Assay Results at Los Azules
summary: TNR Gold, via its 0.4% NSR royalty on the Los Azules copper project, highlights McEwen Copper’s newly reported assay results from the 2022–2023 drilling campaign, including long intercepts grading ~0.63% Cu and up to ~0.92% Cu. The company says work is funded for ongoing drilling toward feasibility.

title: TNR Gold NSR Royalty Update - Los Azules Copper, Gold and Silver Project - McEwen Copper Updates on Assay Results at Los Azules
summary: TNR Gold (via its 0.4% NSR royalty interest) highlights assay updates from McEwen Copper’s Los Azules project in Argentina, including thick, higher-grade copper intercepts (e.g., up to 446 m at 0.63% Cu). The company states the project is progressing toward feasibility by Q1 2025.

title: ALUMINIUM DUNKERQUE ENTERS INTO USD 375 MILLION OF NEW BANK FACILITIES
summary: Aluminium Dunkerque (a major European aluminium smelter) secured USD 375 million in new bank facilities that refinance existing debt. The loans include interest-rate benefits tied to carbon and water-reduction targets. No capacity expansion or disruptions are announced; the update mainly concerns financing and sustainability-linked costs.

title: First Quantum Expects to Ship Trapped Panama Copper Within Weeks
summary: First Quantum said it expects to ship trapped copper from Panama within weeks. The update reduces uncertainty over delayed shipments and near-term availability, which can affect copper price expectations over the coming days to a few weeks. Traders may adjust short-term supply assumptions accordingly.

title: First Quantum expects to ship trapped Panama copper within weeks
summary: First Quantum expects Panama officials to authorize sales of 120,000+ tonnes of copper concentrate stockpiled near the port serving the shuttered Cobre Panama mine. Shipping out the material after closure could release value tied to current copper prices and bolster a tight global concentrate market, with timing dependent on administrative approvals.

title: District of Columbia Leads Trade Investigation for Aluminum Extru
summary: Washington, DC is leading a trade investigation into aluminum extrusions, with potential triple-digit import tariffs depending on dumping and subsidization findings. The probe covers multiple products and countries and urges companies to review supply chains and sourcing. Firms can submit comments and participate in ITC proceedings.

title: First Quantum receives interest in Zambia copper mines
summary: First Quantum Minerals is taking interest in selling minority stakes in its Zambian copper operations (Sentinel and Kansanshi) after a Panama mine closure hit revenues. The company is opening its data room for due diligence, with no timetable or terms disclosed, while raising financing to stabilize its balance sheet.

title: US copper scrap exports fall in 2023 but expectations for long-term demand increases remain
summary: US International Trade Commission data show US copper scrap exports fell 5.18% in 2023 versus 2022 as export activity slowed, despite higher shipments to China (+12.32%) and Malaysia (+8.56%). China remains the dominant destination and demand is described as present but reduced, keeping scrap supply tight and prices supported.

title: Commerce Department Announces Affirmative Preliminary Subsidy Determinations on Imports of Aluminum Extrusions from China, Indonesia, Mexico, and Turkey, Wiley Rein LLP Reports
summary: U.S. Commerce announced affirmative preliminary countervailing subsidy determinations on aluminum extrusion imports from China, Indonesia, Mexico, and Turkey, setting preliminary duty rates and ordering Customs to suspend liquidation and collect cash deposits. Final rates may change, and antidumping duties are scheduled for early May 2024.

title: London exchange rejects bid to have 'green' nickel recognised
summary: The London Metal Exchange rejected an Australian (with US backing) bid to recognize “clean” nickel. The proposal aimed to differentiate Australian nickel from “dirty nickel” amid a China-linked supply glut from Indonesia. The rejection reduces the chance of a clean-nickel premium, worsening near-term sentiment for nickel prices.

title: Lithium and nickel bear market far from over, warns Goldman Sachs
summary: Goldman Sachs cautioned that the rebound in nickel prices is not the end of the battery metals bear market. The rally may reflect traders covering shorts, and analysts expect nickel prices to revert to a sell-off, potentially dropping as much as 25% over the near term.

title: Copper extends downward path on firm dollar, China outlook concerns
summary: Copper prices extended their decline as a steady U.S. dollar reduced demand appeal and traders were disappointed by China’s lack of new policy support at parliament. Analysts noted limited signs of construction ramp-up. The article also shows LME aluminium and nickel falling alongside copper, reinforcing bearish sentiment.

title: Nickel falls on improved supply prospect from Indonesia
summary: Nickel fell on expectations of better supply from Indonesia after approvals for mining production quotas from over 120 mineral companies, reducing fears of ore shortages from delayed approvals. Sentiment was further pressured by steady dollar strength and weaker China stainless-steel prices amid slow demand and limited policy measures.

title: Some Louisville interstate lighting out once again as copper wire thefts persist
summary: Kentucky Transportation Cabinet says copper thieves have stolen wire powering interstate streetlights in Jefferson County, leaving 25 interchanges inoperable and causing about $1 million damage since 2020. Authorities cite repeated thefts over multiple interstate stretches and offer a $5,000 reward for arrests.

title: How will the strike in Guinea affect the alumina and aluminum prices? [SMM analysis]
summary: Guinea unions’ announced and then initiated an indefinite strike raised early bullish sentiment for domestic alumina and aluminum futures. During the strike, road/rail and port handling were partially disrupted, but bauxite supply was “extremely limited” in impact and recovered quickly, leaving bauxite largely stable.

title: Eramet reaches deal to convert debt of New Caledonia nickel unit
summary: Eramet reached an agreement with the French government to convert €320 million of loans to its loss-making New Caledonia nickel unit SLN, plus intra-group debt, into a quasi-equity instrument. This removes debt payments and reinforces SLN’s balance sheet, supporting continuity of nickel processing as negotiations continue.

title: China Hongqiao (01378.HK) boosts cash flow, awaits new bond issue
summary: China Hongqiao’s cash-flow is strengthening, supported by robust 2023 growth in primary and electrolytic aluminium output and a widening electrolytic supply-demand gap that has lifted aluminium prices. The bond/financing discussion centers on investor demand and potential future issuance versus repayment, without citing any immediate production disruption.

title: [Tight Supply Stage Raw Material Costs Drive Up Nickel Sulfate Prices Strongly [SMM Nickel Sulfate Daily Review]
summary: SMM says battery-grade nickel sulfate prices rose March 6 amid tight supply: recycling-based salt plants resumed slowly due to strong waste material profits, inventories stayed low, and downstream replenishment demand continued. Rising MHP costs tied to LME nickel (81 coefficient level) caused losses for some plants, reinforcing strong near-term price pressure.

title: Copper rises on weaker dollar, lower stocks; nickel falls on improved supply
summary: Reuters reports copper rose on a weaker dollar and falling LME exchange stocks, but gains were capped by concerns over insufficient China policy stimulus and weak construction demand. Nickel fell as supply prospects improved from Indonesia and stainless steel prices in China weakened. Aluminium edged up slightly.

title: Copper rises on weaker dollar, lower stocks; nickel falls on improved supply
summary: Copper rose on a weaker dollar and continued declines in LME-registered exchange stocks, though gains were capped by concerns over lack of China stimulus and weak housing demand. Nickel fell as supply prospects improved from Indonesia and China stainless steel prices trended down. Aluminium was slightly higher.

title: Armenia's production of copper concentrate up 23.7% in January 2024
summary: Armenia’s copper concentrate production rose 23.7% year-on-year to about 26,780 tons in January 2024, according to the National Statistical Committee. Zinc concentrate and molybdenum-related outputs declined. The copper increase points to stronger near-term concentrate supply expectations.

title: Bonnell Aluminum Commenting on Preliminary Countervailing Duty Ruling
summary: Bonnell Aluminum says it is pleased with the U.S. Department of Commerce’s preliminary countervailing duty ruling on unfairly traded imports of aluminum extrusions. The decision implies higher landed costs for affected imports, likely reducing import pressure and supporting expectations for aluminum extrusion-related prices in the near term.

title: LME states position on low-carbon nickel premiums as calls grow for new pricing mechanisms
summary: The LME discussed growing calls for reforms and potential low-carbon (“green”) nickel pricing mechanisms. It says fast-tracked eligible brands have improved deliverable liquidity and price convergence, while producers question whether ESG-linked definitions can be standardized. The LME is not planning contract changes and will publish transaction/value data on low-carbon class 1 nickel.

title: With Copper Prices Under Pressure, What's the 2024 Forecast for FCX Stock?
summary: The piece argues copper prices are under pressure as China’s property sector troubles weigh on the largest copper end-use. While it cites a potential 2024 supply deficit and low inventories as a downside cushion, it warns there are few near-term catalysts without clearer Fed-rate path and Chinese economic signals.

title: Aluminium producer Alcoa agrees US$2.2bn deal to acquire Alumina
summary: Alcoa agreed to acquire Alumina for US$2.2bn, expanding its bauxite and alumina footprint and increasing vertical integration into aluminium smelting and casting. Alumina’s board plans to recommend the sale. The announcement follows weak Australian conditions and a recent Kwinana alumina refinery closure, but improves upstream positioning for aluminium.

title: Adani Group to Launch $1.2 Billion Copper Smelter Project in India
summary: Adani Group, via Kutch Copper Ltd, plans to start operations of a $1.2 billion copper smelter in India in the coming weeks, sourcing concentrates from Peru, Chile and Australia. The project targets meeting India’s growing copper demand and reducing supply shortfalls, potentially adding refined copper supply.

title: Alara starts copper concentrate production in Oman
summary: Alara began producing copper concentrate at its Al Wash-hi–Majaza mine in Oman (1 Mtpa capacity). Output is expected to reach full potential over 2–3 months, with about 1,000 dry tonnes scheduled for delivery to Trafigura in April 2024. A tailings filter issue is being addressed but planned rates remain unchanged.

title: Indonesia has approved a quota of 145 million wet tons of nickel ore till now (for next three year)
summary: Indonesia has approved a quota of 145 million wet tons of nickel ore for the next three years under a new multi-year approval system. The quota covers about 60% of expected 2024 ore demand, with further approvals expected to rise, improving nickel ore availability prospects.

title: Zambia: KoBold Metals copper discovery accelerates global race for critical minerals
summary: KoBold Metals confirmed a substantial copper discovery at its Mingomba mine project on the Zambia–DRC border. The report frames it as accelerating the global race for critical minerals, but it does not indicate immediate production start, capacity changes, or export disruptions that would quickly move copper prices.

title: Marvel Discovery Corp.: Marvel Completes Drilling at Duhamel, Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project, North of Quebec City
summary: Marvel Discovery completed drilling at its Duhamel Ni-Cu-Co (and Ti-V-Cr) property north of Quebec City, reporting multiple disseminated and massive sulfide intercepts including chalcopyrite. The release anticipates assays and further geophysics but provides no confirmed resource estimate or production timeline, limiting near-term market impact for copper and nickel.

title: Marvel Completes Drilling at Duhamel, Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project, North of Quebec City
summary: Marvel Discovery reports successful drilling and multiple sulfide mineralization intersections at its Duhamel Ni-Cu-Co project in Quebec, including chalcopyrite-rich mineralization and historic nickel/copper grade highlights. The release is exploration-focused and does not indicate production, so any effect on short-term nickel or copper prices is likely negligible.

title: Marvel Completes Drilling at Duhamel, Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project, North of Quebec City
summary: Marvel completed Phase 1 drilling at its Duhamel Ni-Cu-Co (and Ti-V-Cr) project north of Quebec City, reporting multiple sulfide intersections and chalcopyrite/pyrrhotite intervals. The company plans further geophysics while waiting for assays. This is exploration news; it is not tied to immediate market supply changes.

title: Marvel Completes Drilling At Duhamel, Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project, North of Quebec City
summary: Marvel Discovery completed Phase 1 drilling (5 holes, 1,218m) at the Duhamel Ni-Cu-Co and Ti-V-Cr project in Quebec, intersecting multiple sulfide-rich intervals, including chalcopyrite-bearing mineralization. Results are promising for nickel and copper, but no resource estimate or production schedule is provided.

title: Marvel Completes Drilling At Duhamel, Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project, North of Quebec City
summary: Marvel Discovery Corp. reported completion of Phase 1 drilling at the Duhamel Ni-Cu-Co project in Quebec, intersecting multiple sulfide-rich intervals including disseminated and massive zones. Chalcopyrite and other mineralization were observed, suggesting potential for nickel and copper. The update is exploratory with no immediate supply figures.

title: Infinitum Copper Amends the Terms of the C$450,000 Private Placement
