summary: Infinitum Copper amended the terms of its C$450,000 private placement, extending warrant exercise duration to 36 months and increasing gross proceeds via 22.5 million units at C$0.02. Funds are intended for establishing mining operations at the La Adelita copper project and general corporate purposes.

title: Encouraging oxide leach recovery for copper & gold at Kharmagtai
summary: Xanadu and Zijin report encouraging oxide leach column testwork for the Kharmagtai project, with copper extraction up to ~93% from oxide samples and plans to extend tests into a PFS heap/column design. While supportive for potential future copper production, it is not a short-term supply move.

title: Encouraging oxide leach recovery for copper & gold at
summary: Xanadu and Zijin report promising column leach results for Kharmagtai’s oxide material in Mongolia, achieving up to 93% copper extraction in tests, with further pilot column work planned for June–July 2024. The work aims to convert oxide “waste” into an earlier revenue source via heap leaching.

title: Help the coppers find the copper, EPD seeks public assistance in recent copper thefts
summary: Eugene Police Department is asking for public help after recent copper cable thefts targeting CenturyLink/Lumen infrastructure. Police say thieves used access equipment and may sell copper to scrap yards, disrupting 9-1-1, public safety, and Eugene Airport operations. Losses cited include $125,000-plus from a theft and over $1 million in 2023.

title: Mining, processing 100% Nevada Copper team effort
summary: Nevada Copper says its Pumpkin Hollow underground mine and surface mill are in the hands of company employees as the operation gears up for full production. The report outlines processing steps and ramp-up activity, implying more copper output approaching full rates, which can increase supply expectations and pressure copper prices.

title: Copper Climbs to One-Week High After Powell's Remarks on Rates
summary: Copper rose to a one-week high after remarks from Fed Chair Powell on interest rates. Rate expectations can influence industrial metal pricing via the US dollar, financing costs, and broad risk sentiment. The article ties the move in copper directly to the Powell comments rather than specific supply or demand factors.

title: KYTC asking public for help in stopping copper wire thieves
summary: Kentucky’s transportation department is offering a $5,000 reward after repeated thefts of copper wire from highway light poles left large sections of Louisville interchanges dark. Officials cite nearly $1 million in lighting repair costs since 2020 and urge reporting. The localized copper scrap losses are not market-moving.

title: French government throws more lifebuoys at New Caledonia's beleaguered nickel industry
summary: France agreed to convert €320m of prior loans into debt “quasi-equity” for Eramet’s SLN and plans further aid tied to reforms to lower nickel production costs. Koniambo is in care-and-maintenance and Prony gets a €140m loan, alongside an emergency jobs plan—reducing near-term supply risk for nickel.

title: China Jan-Feb copper imports rise 2.6% to 902,000 tons, customs says
summary: China’s unwrought copper imports in January-February rose 2.6% year-on-year to 902,000 tons, with arrivals of concentrate up 0.6% to 4.66 million tons. Analysts attribute the increase to improving domestic demand, despite limited demand around the Lunar New Year and ample inventories.

title: China's Copper Smelters to Discuss Production Cut as Fees Slump
summary: China’s copper smelters are reportedly set to discuss potential production cuts as treatment/refining fees slump. The move would likely reduce refined copper supply availability in the near term, tightening market balances and adding upward pressure to copper prices over the next days to four weeks.

title: Vedanta Considers Review Petition on Copper Plant Closure India Infoline
summary: Vedanta said it is exploring legal options, including a review petition, after India’s Supreme Court dismissed its bid to reopen the Thoothukudi copper smelting plant shut in 2018 over pollution concerns. The ruling keeps copper refining capacity constrained, potentially tightening supply expectations for copper.

title: First Quantum Minerals Wants to Sell Copper
summary: First Quantum Minerals is seeking Panamanian authorization in coming weeks to sell more than 120,000 tonnes of copper concentrate stored near the Minera Panama port. The sale could raise $200–$300 million depending on copper prices, while the government required financial guarantees and detailed preservation costs for the mine.

title: Former CEO and directors of company linked to S$1.5b nickel investment fraud case charged
summary: Singapore’s MAS charged former Envysion Wealth/Hui Xun Asset Management executives in connection with a cited billion-dollar nickel investment fraud case involving alleged false promises of nickel purchases. The allegations center on investor money raised for nickel trading/returns, but no concrete data is provided on real nickel flows affecting near-term prices.

title: We will now refine bauxite mined in Ghana - President Akufo-Addo
summary: Ghana’s president says the country is moving away from exporting raw bauxite and will refine bauxite into alumina for supply to VALCO and the wider aluminium value chain. He frames this as a shift to domestic processing that should support aluminium production and related demand for industrial inputs.

title: Global producers call for LME to introduce green premium for nickel
summary: Global nickel producers including BHP and Andrew Forrest are urging the LME to introduce a green price premium and formally distinguish “dirty” from sustainably produced (“green”) nickel. Indonesia’s low-cost supply has driven a slump, while PT CNGR’s bid for a ‘good delivery brand’ could reshape nickel pricing via ESG-linked differentials on the LME.

title: Ghana To End Bauxite Exportation
summary: Ghana’s President Akufo-Addo said the country is ending exports of raw bauxite and will refine local bauxite into alumina to supply the VALCO smelter and downstream aluminium manufacturing. Agreements for new mines and an alumina refinery with GIADEC aim to strengthen the bauxite-to-aluminium value chain and boosting production.

title: Granite Creek Copper Ltd.: Granite Creek Copper Announces $1,600,000 Private Placement Financing
summary: Granite Creek Copper announced a non-brokered private placement raising about $1.5 million to fund general corporate purposes and advancement of strategic initiatives. The company focuses on copper projects in Yukon and also holds a Star copper-nickel-PGM project. The financing is not tied to near-term production changes or supply disruption.

title: Copper Lake Commences Drilling on Its Marshall Lake Copper-Zinc-Silver VMS Property, Northwestern Ontario
summary: Copper Lake has started drilling on its Marshall Lake copper-zinc-silver VMS project in northwestern Ontario. The commencement of exploration drilling improves prospects for defining or expanding copper resources, which can modestly support near-term market expectations for copper supply potential.

title: Chinese Copper Producers to Discuss Output Curbs Amid Low Fees
summary: More than a dozen Chinese copper smelters are expected to discuss output curbs next week after treatment and refining fees (TC/RCs) for processing concentrate into finished copper fell to the lowest levels since 2013. With concentrate supply tighter and smelter overcapacity rising, a production cut could support copper prices.

title: Generation Mining – Targets Copper in Two Phased Exploration Program including Drilling and AI
summary: Generation Mining says it has begun a phased (up to 8,000 m) exploration drilling program on high-prospectivity copper targets north and west of its Marathon Palladium-Copper project in Ontario. The winter and summer programs aim to extend and test potential copper mineralization using drilling, EM, and AI-based prospectivity analysis.

title: Ero Copper Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2023 Operating and Financial Results
summary: Ero Copper reported Q4 2023 copper production of 11,760 tonnes and 43,857 tonnes for full-year 2023, with improved mill throughput and reaffirmed 2024 guidance for 59,000–72,000 tonnes of copper in concentrate. The company also outlined progress toward H2 2024 concentrate production from Tucumã and expects consolidated C1 cash costs of $1.50–$1.75.

title: Man posing as worker steals thousands of pounds of copper wiring, metal from Las Vegas Strip resort: police
summary: Police allege a man posed as a maintenance worker at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas and stole about 2,500 pounds of copper piping plus other metals over months, later selling copper to a recycler. This is a localized diversion of scrap copper rather than a supply shock affecting market-wide pricing.

title: Capstone Copper CEO expects company to deliver industry-leading growth
summary: Capstone Copper’s CEO says announced supply shocks—First Quantum’s Panama suspension and Anglo American’s copper production cuts—have pulled the market from a small 2024 surplus into potential deficit. He expects structural tightness driven by long mine lead times and decarbonization demand, supporting higher copper prices.

title: France promises more help to New Caledonia's beleaguered nickel industry
summary: France will convert and provide financing tied to a March “nickel pact” to rescue New Caledonia’s struggling nickel producers, including Eramet’s SLN and loans for Prony. Koniambo production has stopped, but aid and cost-reduction reforms aim to prevent further disruption amid tough Indonesian/Chinese competition.

title: Panama asks First Quantum to suspend visitor program at disputed copper mine
summary: Panama asked First Quantum to suspend a community visitor program at the disputed Cobre Panama copper mine, saying the miner lacked government consultation. The broader dispute includes an earlier shutdown order tied to environmental protests. The article does not indicate immediate production changes from the visitor suspension.

title: Nickel from China, Indonesia could face tariffs over market manipulation concerns, Ottawa says
summary: Canada says Western countries may consider tariffs on nickel from Indonesia and China over concerns about market manipulation. Indonesia’s share of nickel supply has surged, contributing to a major global oversupply and an 80% price collapse. Producers face mine closures and surplus pressure, implying near-term bearish sentiment for nickel.

title: Nickel price collapse: Pentagon pitched Australian nickel investment
summary: The Pentagon discussed with Australia’s resources minister options to co-invest with the Australian government in an Australian nickel project after a collapse in nickel prices. The decline has triggered closures and write-downs of projects, reflecting a glut. Potential funding support could ease downside sentiment for nickel.

title: Nickel price collapse: BHP needs big green premium to match Indonesian producers
summary: The LME’s rejection of a separate index for “green premium” nickel is described as a setback for Australian producers such as BHP and Wyloo Metals. Without a differentiated pricing mechanism, their ability to earn higher premiums over Indonesian nickel suppliers is weakened, reinforcing broader bearish sentiment after nickel’s price collapse.

title: Battery evolution erodes Indonesia's nickel edge - Economy
summary: Experts argue Indonesia may need to adjust its nickel downstream strategy as EV makers increasingly consider lithium iron phosphate (LFP) batteries, which use iron cathodes rather than nickel. The shift is linked to nickel price fluctuations, with forecasts of LFP gaining market share by 2025.

title: Battery evolution erodes Indonesia's nickel edge
summary: Experts say Indonesia may need to adjust its nickel downstream strategy as EV makers consider alternatives. The report cites expectations that momentum will build behind lithium iron phosphate (LFP) batteries rather than nickel-based chemistries, potentially weakening nickel demand outlook and weighing on prices.

title: Australia, US engage in critical nickel talks - Australian Mining
summary: Australia’s Resources Minister met US Defence officials to discuss co-investing in an Australian nickel project amid weakening nickel prices that have forced some operations into reduced output or care and maintenance. The talks aim to preserve the nickel supply chain, alongside prior discussions on investment incentives and infrastructure support.

title: Global Aluminium Production Holds Steady in February with Notable Regional Developments
summary: SMM data show primary aluminium production outside China holding steady in February, with utilization slightly lower. Regional changes include Alumar’s restart ramp-up in Brazil and UC Rusal’s Taishet ramp-up, but Europe fell due to Neuss shutdown. Upcoming US New Madrid closure is expected to reduce March output and utilization.

title: In February, the national refined nickel output fell slightly by 3%, and the output is expected to rise slightly in March [SMM data]
summary: SMM reports China’s February refined nickel production at 24,600 tonnes, down ~3% from January due to fewer Spring Festival working days but up 42.2% year-on-year. March output is forecast to rise to ~25,000 tonnes, though higher raw-material prices may constrain some outsourced production.

title: China's Sinomine to Buy African Copper Smelter For USD49 Million
summary: Sinomine plans to buy a 98% stake in Dundee Precious Metals Tsumeb, a Namibia smelter that processes high-arsenic copper concentrate. The capacity could rise to 370,000 tons after renovation. The deal supports Sinomine’s copper growth strategy, potentially improving refined copper supply outlook.

title: EV Nickel Announces Pro-rata Participation by Strategic Investor and Upsize to Private Placement
summary: EV Nickel upsized its previously announced private placement of flow-through shares to fund Canadian exploration expenses for its Shaw Dome nickel project in Ontario. A strategic investor increased participation to maintain its pro-rata stake. The announcement supports sentiment toward the company’s nickel resource pipeline but not immediate supply volumes.

title: Norsk Hydro : Mendubim solar plant starts commercial operations and begins delivering clean energy to Alunorte alumina refinery -March 08, 2024 at 09:19 am EST
summary: Norsk Hydro said its 531 MW Mendubim solar plant began commercial operations in Brazil and started delivering power to the Alunorte alumina refinery under a 20-year PPA. About 60% of output is purchased by Alunorte, supporting lower-carbon alumina and downstream aluminium production, with decarbonization milestones and CO2e avoided cited.

title: Positive macroeconomic factors helped increase copper prices | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: A SMM note says copper prices rose on positive China GDP/inflation guidance and weaker US dollar after Powell signaled cautious rate cuts. While copper cathode inventories and some rod stock increased and demand stayed weak, tight ore supply reduced smelter feed, supporting backwardation and near-term prices.

title: Available spot cargoes tightened, Yangshan copper premiums firm | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Yangshan copper premiums for April under bill of lading rose to around $56/mt, with EQ copper import premiums up to about $18/mt. Tight spot cargo availability and African port congestion reduced March arrivals, while LME inventories fell to ~110,000 mt, supporting firm/bullish copper pricing despite weaker ratio dynamics.

title: A symposium of copper smelters will be held in Beijing, Adani's Mundra copper smelter to commence
summary: SMM reports falling spot copper concentrate TCs and tighter concentrate supply, with copper concentrate inventories at Chinese ports dropping. China’s nonferrous industry association will hold a copper smelter symposium in Beijing. Adani’s Mundra smelter is expected to start soon, adding refined output potential.

title: Copper Fees Plunge Close to Zero in Test For China's Smelters
summary: The article headline says copper fees for China’s smelters have plunged close to zero in a test for smelting operations. A rapid fall in processing/refining charges usually reflects changing concentrate demand and supply conditions, influencing expectations for refined copper output and thereby pressuring near-term copper prices.

title: Taseko Mines optimistic for Arizona copper project as profit rises
summary: Taseko reported higher revenue and profits in 2023 and increased copper production at its Gibraltar mine to 122.6 million pounds (+26%) with copper sales up 19%. It also detailed ongoing construction for its Florence Arizona copper project, supporting positive copper sentiment despite first output expected in late 2025.

title: Chile copper production up 0.51% in January - Cochilco
summary: Chile’s Cochilco reported total copper production up 0.51% to 433,800 mt in January. Codelco output fell 15.6% to 107,000 mt, while BHP’s Escondida rose 4.5% to 97,500 mt and Collahuasi increased 21.6% to 52,200 mt, supporting copper supply expectations.

title: Copper production by Chile's Codelco slides, others climb in January
summary: Chile’s copper production was mixed in January. Codelco output fell nearly 16% year on year to 107,000 tonnes due to delays in expansion projects and rising costs, while BHP’s Escondida rose 4.5% and Collahuasi gained almost 22%. Overall national output was nearly flat, up 0.51%.

title: New Orleans City Council president asking state police to step in and handle copper thefts on I-10
summary: New Orleans City Council president Helena Moreno asks state police to investigate copper thefts from interstate lighting on I-10. The stolen copper leaves miles of lights out for months, forcing costly repairs and affecting safety. Officials say thefts persist despite prior efforts and are considering alternatives like solar or stronger protections.

title: Nickel price collapse: Green premium won't save Australian nickel says Metals Acquisition boss Mick McMullin
summary: Metals Acquisition boss Mick McMullen says the nickel market has “fundamentally shifted” and that China, the world’s largest buyer, is unlikely to pay a green premium. He adds that even a premium may not be enough to make nickel mined outside Indonesia economically attractive, reinforcing bearish sentiment.

title: China Hongqiao Group Limited: China Hongqiao (01378.HK) Profits Surge, New Offshore Bond Issuance Expected
summary: China Hongqiao reports a surge in 2023 profits, attributing it to a widening supply-demand gap for electrolytic aluminum that lifted aluminum prices. The article discusses stability in its offshore bond prices and investor expectations regarding future offshore issuance near the bond maturity, reinforcing positive sentiment for aluminum producer cash flows.

title: London copper prices steady on supply tension, weaker dollar
summary: London three-month copper prices were steady as traders weighed lower LME inventories and tight global supply. Mine-side disruptions since December have reduced Chinese smelter margins and could curb output. LME stocks fell to the lowest since August, and a weaker U.S. dollar added support.

title: London copper prices buoyed by supply headwinds, weaker dollar
summary: LME three-month copper rose as inventories fell to the lowest since last August and supply tightness emerged from mine disruptions that squeezed smelter margins. Output at Chile’s Codelco dropped nearly 16% year-on-year in January. A weaker dollar also supported prices, despite soft China consumption.

title: Zambia's Chambishi copper smelter scales back capacity amid power cuts, sources say
summary: Zambia’s Chambishi copper smelter is scaling back output by roughly one-fifth because power shortages from drought have prompted electricity rationing. The plant, producing ~250,000 t/year, may consider diesel generators while Zesco plans to reduce supply further. The cut is expected to weigh on near-term copper processing.

title: Copper theft at Walvis Bay causes 'huge damage'
summary: Police in Walvis Bay are investigating the theft of about 1.2 tonnes of copper wire from overhead power lines, reportedly using a jaw saw to cut poles. The theft caused damage and blackouts in parts of the town, disrupting internet and radio communications. Investigations are ongoing.

title: Emerita Resources Corp.: Emerita Intersects 68.9 Meters Grading 0.7% Copper; 0.3% Lead; 0.5% Zinc, 0.91 g/t Gold and 36.2 g/t Silver, Including 9.4 Meters Grading 0.9% Copper; 0.3% Lead; 1.4% Zinc, 1.59 g/t Gold and 37.8 g/t Silver At La Romanera Deposit
summary: Emerita Resources reported new drilling assays at the La Romanera massive sulfide VMS deposit, including a 68.9m interval averaging ~0.66% copper and up to ~1.34% Cu, alongside Au. The company is also permitting additional drill platforms and reactivating El Cura drilling. No production or supply changes were stated.

title: Emerita Intersects 68.9 Meters Grading 0.7% Copper; 0.3%
summary: Emerita Resources reported additional assay results from its La Romanera VMS deposit drill hole LR167, including a 68.9m massive sulphide interval with copper grades averaging 0.66% and ranging up to 1.34%. The company says the zone is part of an evolving feeder structure and plans more drilling.

title: Core Nickel Announces Start of Drill Program at Halfway Lake Project
summary: Core Nickel announces mobilization and start of its 2024 winter drill program (~1,000 metres) at the Halfway Lake nickel project in Manitoba. Targets focus on the historical W62 zone and nearby magnetic anomalies. The work is fully funded using a Manitoba Mineral Development Fund grant, supporting exploration continuity and nickel upside sentiment.

title: Copper steady ahead of Chinese loan data and U.S. inflation numbers
summary: Copper steadied ahead of Chinese loan data and upcoming U.S. inflation figures, with traders watching for demand signals and for earlier Fed rate cuts that could weaken the dollar. Support came from lower LME warehouse stocks. Nickel edged up on reduced short bets, and aluminium rose slightly.

title: Spruce Ridge Resources Ltd. Announces Binding Letter of Intent to Acquire Shamrock Nickel Property in Oregon
summary: Spruce Ridge Resources said it signed a binding letter of intent to acquire the Shamrock nickel sulphide property in Oregon. The project’s historic results report nickel and copper grades above 1.0%, with reported bulk flotation recoveries. The deal is a sentiment-positive step for future nickel and copper supply expectations.

title: Core Nickel Corp.: Core Nickel Announces Start of Drill Program at Halfway Lake Project
summary: Core Nickel announced mobilization for its 2024 winter drill program at the 100% owned Halfway Lake nickel project in Manitoba. The ~1,000m drilling targets the historical W62 zone with previously reported nickel mineralized intercepts, supported by MMDF grant funding. It is a positive development for nickel exploration sentiment.

title: Scatec-led giant solar park to help green Brazilian aluminium refinery
summary: A Scatec-led solar park project in Brazil is intended to support decarbonisation efforts at the Alunorte aluminium refinery. By providing renewable power to the smelter/refinery, the initiative aims to make aluminium production “greener,” which can improve expectations for continued operations and sentiment toward aluminium prices.

title: China Copper seeks to acquire overseas mines amid tight supply, chairman says
summary: China Copper chairman said domestic rich resources are scarce and a supply deficit this year has driven the company to seek overseas near-production copper mines. Smelters were hit after the Cobre Panama closure, while demand from EVs, renewables and construction remains strong, keeping copper tightness in view.

title: China Copper seeks to acquire overseas mines amid tight supply, chairman says
summary: China Copper’s chairman said China’s shortage of rich domestic copper resources and a surprise supply deficit this year are pushing Chinese firms to seek overseas, near-production mines. Tightening raw materials after Cobre Panama’s closure hit Chinese smelters, while strong EV and renewables demand persists.

title: The fundamentals are weak, and the upward trend of ferronickel prices is hindered [Nickel Pig Iron Daily Review]
summary: SMM reports March 11 high-nickel pig iron at 956.5 yuan/nickel point, unchanged day-on-day. Indonesian smelter production fell 10–20% due to nickel ore shortages. Stainless steel demand is sluggish and policy effects from RKAB approvals are fading, leading expectations of limited upward room for ferronickel prices.

title: Nickel prices fluctuated in a wide range in the morning, and the spot transaction was generally weak [SMM nickel spot afternoon comment]
summary: SMM reports that on March 11 nickel premiums were mixed: Jinchuan premium averaged 1350 yuan/ton and Russian nickel premium averaged -250 yuan/ton. Trading in the spot market was weak, with deals concentrated during a downward price move and downstream mostly doing rigid replenishment. Nickel bean prices rose slightly day-on-day.

title: Declining Demand for EVs Is Weighing on the Nickel Market
summary: The article says nickel prices are sliding due to market oversupply, especially rising Indonesian supply, alongside weakening EV demand. It notes nickel’s role in EV batteries and references falling EV sales, reduced subsidies, and destocking by Chinese battery raw-material firms, all weighing on sentiment and pricing into 2024.

title: Recovery of global aluminium demand depends on interest rates in the US and Europe
summary: CBA CEO Luciano Alves says low global demand continues to pressure aluminium markets, depending on improving interest-rate-driven demand in the US and Europe and slower Chinese construction momentum post-lockdown. Brazil demand remains favorable, with stronger Q4 production and sales. Premium assessments and LME spreads are noted, implying mixed near-term sentiment.

title: Carbon Tariffs to Reshape Aluminum Market Dynamics in the EU
summary: A potential EU ban on Russian aluminum could reduce supply to Europe, pushing up physical premiums as buyers seek non-Russian alternatives and raising uncertainty around LME pricing. Separately, CBAM carbon tariffs on imported aluminum are expected to increase landed costs and shift demand toward lower-carbon supply and scrap.

title: With gold soaring, should advisors seek an alternative in copper?
summary: The piece contrasts gold’s surge with copper lagging year-to-date, then argues copper demand is rising globally. It highlights the clean-energy transition—wind/solar and EVs—as a key driver of future consumption, while noting China property worries. Overall, it remains constructive on copper’s outlook and price discovery.

title: Australia's Alumina agrees an all-stock buy-out offer from US-based Alcoa
summary: Australia’s Alumina Limited agreed to an all-stock buyout offer from U.S. aluminium producer Alcoa, formalizing a scheme implementation deed. The transaction links to alumina supply for aluminium smelting, but it is primarily a corporate acquisition and not an immediate production or trade shock, implying limited short-term price pressure.

title: Alcoa Enters into Binding Agreement to Acquire Alumina Limited
summary: Alcoa announced a binding agreement to acquire Alumina Limited in an all-stock transaction, aiming to strengthen its position in bauxite and alumina. The company expects completion in Q3 2024 and provides no near-term funding need based on AWAC cash forecasts, implying limited immediate aluminium price impact.

title: Australia's Alumina agrees $2.2 bln all-stock buyout offer from US-based Alcoa
summary: Alumina Limited agreed to be acquired by U.S. aluminium producer Alcoa in a $2.2 billion all-stock deal. Alcoa said the merger would eliminate A$12 million annual overhead costs. Alumina’s main asset is a 40% stake in an alumina and aluminium joint venture, spanning mining, refining and smelting.

title: Banks, gold stocks lift Australian shares; Alumina up on accepting $2.2 bln bid
summary: Australian shares rose, with Alumina jumping 8.7% after accepting a $2.2 billion buyout bid from Alcoa. The move highlights attention on the alumina-to-aluminium supply chain. Investors also awaited U.S. inflation data for rate-cut clues, but the standout metal link was the Alumina takeover news.

title: Market is waiting for more key data [SMM Copper Morning Comment] | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Copper prices rose overnight on weaker USD and support from crude oil and gold, but the report highlights rising domestic inventories and delayed consumption recovery, suggesting potential downside pressure. It also notes the market is awaiting Chinese financial data and US core CPI, which will likely guide near-term copper direction.

title: Alcoa To Buy Alumina In $2.2 Bln All-stock Deal
summary: Alcoa agreed to buy Alumina Limited in a $2.2 billion all-stock deal, bringing control of alumina feedstock used for aluminium production. The company also offers short-term liquidity support for AWAC equity calls if net debt exceeds a threshold, but expects none in 2024. Closing is targeted for Q3 2024.

title: Alcoa to buy Australian partner Alumina in $2.2 billion all-stock deal
summary: Alcoa announced a $2.2 billion all-stock deal to buy Australian alumina producer Alumina, taking full control of a major supplier of alumina and bauxite used in aluminium refining. Deal terms lifted Alumina shares sharply and comes amid prior bauxite permit issues and Kwinana alumina production plans, shaping near-term aluminium supply expectations.

title: Alcoa's takeover Alumina Limited would help struggling aluminium makers, fund says
summary: Allan Gray backs Alcoa’s $3.3 billion takeover of Alumina Limited, arguing rationalisation is needed after Alcoa plans to shut the Kwinana alumina refinery and potentially consider other closures. With no new smelting capacity expected, the fund expects aluminium prices to rise as demand improves.

title: Man charged with copper wire theft from Rutherford business | Newcastle Herald
summary: Police in Rutherford allege a man stole more than three kilometres of copper wiring from a manufacturing business, worth over $22,000, across four incidents in a week. Officers seized alleged stolen cabling and charged the accused with four counts of larceny. No broader supply-market disruption is described.

title: Alcoa signs binding $2.2bn deal for Alumina buyout
summary: Alcoa agreed to acquire Australia JV partner Alumina in a $2.2bn all-stock deal, offering a 19.5% premium via a share swap ratio. The transaction will unify upstream aluminium assets through AWAC and improve capital structure. Such upstream consolidation can mildly support near-term aluminium market sentiment.

title: Thesis Gold Step-Out Drilling at Bingo Zone Intersects 20.00 Metres of 8.46 g/t Gold, 36.96 g/t Silver, and 1.72% Copper
summary: Thesis Gold reported step-out drill results at its Bingo Zone with notable copper grades, including a 20m interval grading 1.72% Cu alongside gold and silver, and links the copper to enargite/chalcopyrite mineralization. The company frames copper as a key exploration focus, but provides no production or supply impact.

title: Thesis Gold Inc.: Thesis Gold Step-Out Drilling at Bingo Zone Intersects 20.00 Metres of 8.46 g/t Gold, 36.96 g/t Silver, and 1.72% Copper
summary: Thesis Gold reported new step-out drill results at its Ranch Project’s Bingo Zone, including multiple intercepts containing copper (e.g., up to 1.72% Cu) alongside gold and silver. Copper is linked to massive enargite and chalcopyrite, suggesting potential for broader mineralization, but no immediate supply disruption.

title: Alcoa: firm agreement to acquire Alumina -March 12, 2024 at 08:31 am EDT
summary: Alcoa announced a binding agreement to acquire Australia’s Alumina Limited for an implied equity value of about $2.2 billion. The deal would expand Alcoa’s position as a major bauxite and alumina producer. Boards recommend shareholder approval, aiming for value creation, potentially supporting expectations for aluminium supply.

title: Lion Copper and Gold Announces Commencement of the Yerington Copper Project Pre-Feasibility Study and Drilling Operations
summary: Lion Copper and Gold said drilling and pre-feasibility work have begun at its Yerington, Nevada copper project, funded through an $11.5m program. Activities include core/rotary drilling, sulfide metallurgical and heap-leach optimization, and permitting and exploration at related targets, potentially improving future copper economics.

The project is still in early due diligence with no timeline, but it signals potential incremental U.S. aluminum foil demand growth.

title: Hot money pushes copper to new highs
summary: Copper prices surged to new highs on Friday as fund buying (“hot money”) pushed LME and SHFE contracts higher. The rally also drew support from Antaike data that Chinese smelters agreed to lower operating rates and adjust maintenance/postpone projects due to weak profits and losses.

title: TSX futures gain as copper surges on China's potential output cut
summary: Reuters reports Canada’s TSX rose as materials led gains. Copper climbed about 2% to a near one-year high, breaking out above $4, as investors weighed a potential output cut in China. Oil also strengthened, reinforcing a broadly risk-on cyclical tone for base-metal miners and related stocks.

title: Alaska Energy Metals Files Updated NI 43-101 Technical Report for the Eureka Deposit, Nikolai Nickel Project, Alaska, USA
summary: Alaska Energy Metals filed an updated NI 43-101 technical report for its Eureka deposit in Alaska, combining Eureka West and East and upgrading part of the resource to indicated. The company reports higher in-situ nickel and associated copper, and plans further drilling in 2024.

title: Alaska Energy Metals Files Updated NI 43-101 Technical Report For The Eureka Deposit, Nikolai Nickel Project, Alaska, USA
summary: Alaska Energy Metals filed an updated NI 43-101 technical report for its Eureka deposit at the Nikolai nickel project in Alaska. The update connects deposits and upgrades part of the resource to indicated, reporting sizable nickel and copper contained metal. Investors may view this as supportive for near-term nickel and some copper sentiment.

title: Breaking Mining News: Alaska Energy Metals (TSXV: AEMC) (OTCQB: AKEMF) Files Updated NI 43-101 Technical Report for the Eureka Deposit, Nikolai Nickel Project, Alaska, USA
summary: Alaska Energy Metals filed an updated NI 43-101 technical report for its Eureka nickel project, upgrading and expanding the deposit and reporting Indicated resources of 813 Mt at 0.29% NiEq plus associated contained nickel and copper. It also notes metallurgical work for ferrochrome, but no near-term production changes.

title: Pebble sues EPA to revive Southwest Alaska copper and gold mine prospect
summary: Pebble Limited Partnership sued the EPA to overturn the agency’s Clean Water Act veto that halted the Pebble copper-gold mine prospect in Southwest Alaska. Separate takings claims seek compensation. The dispute centers on whether environmental harm findings improperly preempted permitting, potentially affecting near-term expectations for copper supply.

title: MiningNewsBreaks – Fathom Nickel Inc. (CSE: FNI) (FSE: 6Q5) (OTCQB: FNICF) Well Positioned to Capitalize on World's Ongoing Energy Transition
summary: Fathom Nickel highlights plans to develop two nickel projects (Albert Lake and Gochager Lake) with high-grade nickel sulfide aimed at EV battery demand. It cites expected EV sales growth and nickel’s growing share in batteries. The news may modestly support nickel sentiment but provides limited near-term supply detail.

title: DOD Awards $7 Million to Enhance Domestic Nickel and Cobalt Supply Chains
summary: The U.S. Department of Defense awarded $7 million under the Defense Production Act Investment program to Doe Run to demonstrate a hydrometallurgical plant for separating nickel at its Viburnum, Missouri facility. The project aims to scale domestic nickel processing to reduce reliance on unstable sources, potentially supporting nickel supply sentiment.

title: Nikkei: S. Korea, Japan, Germany to Join Forces on $2.5 Bln Loan for Chile Copper Mine
summary: Nikkei reports that South Korea, Japan and Germany plan to join forces on a $2.5 billion loan to support a copper mine project in Chile. The financing improves prospects for future copper supply and investor expectations, which can be supportive for copper prices in the coming weeks.

title: BHP ASX: BHP stands down contracts at West Musgrave nickel and copper project
summary: BHP will stand down about a quarter of workers on its West Musgrave greenfield nickel and copper project in Western Australia. The project is remote and 21% complete. BHP says it remains committed, but prior write-downs and hints it could suspend work raise near-term supply uncertainty for both metals.

title: BHP ASX: BHP stands down contracts at West Musgrave nickel and copper project
summary: BHP has paused roughly a quarter of workforce activity on its West Musgrave nickel and copper project in Western Australia, where 21% of work was completed in February. The company says it remains committed despite earlier large nickel write-downs and potential suspension warnings, raising supply-timing concerns.

title: Top Miner BHP Stands Down 25% of Nickel Project Workforce: AFR
summary: BHP is reportedly standing down 25% of the workforce on a nickel project, according to AFR. The move signals near-term disruption to nickel production or progress, raising expectations of reduced supply availability and typically weighing on nickel prices in the following days and weeks.

title: Bell Installs Aerial Alarms On Its Network To Help Fight Copper Theft, Resulting In Local Arrests
summary: Bell is installing aerial alarms to detect and deter copper cable theft from its telecommunications network. The company reports copper theft accounts for 87% of physical security incidents and is increasing, with hundreds of incidents since 2022. While arrests are improving local cases, Bell says stronger laws and enforcement are still needed.

title: Copper upstages iron ore's influence on the Australian dollar
summary: Copper is gaining influence on the Australian dollar as a China growth indicator. Copper surged to the highest in 11 months on fears of undersupply after Chinese smelters—processing about half of mined copper globally—agreed to production cuts to deal with plunging processing fees.

title: MIN ASX: MinRes to retrofit WA nickel plant for lithium processing
summary: Mineral Resources (Chris Ellison) will acquire Poseidon Nickel’s Lake Johnston WA concentrator and tenements for $15 million, plus a royalty stream. The plan is to retrofit the nickel infrastructure for lithium processing under a lithium strategy, implying reduced nickel processing capacity in Western Australia.

title: China's Jan-Feb aluminium output climbs amid higher profit margins
summary: China’s primary aluminium output in January-February rose 5.5% year-on-year to 7.1 million tonnes, supported by higher smelter profit margins. Average smelter profits in February increased 50% versus a year earlier, though profits later slipped as alumina costs rose. Growth in nonferrous metals overall was also reported.

title: Copper moves mixed as tight supply concern offset demand worry
summary: Copper prices were mixed as tight supply concerns outweighed demand uncertainty. LME copper eased slightly while SHFE copper hit record highs on expectations of potential smelter output cuts in China. China’s industrial output and retail sales rose, but real estate remained weak. Aluminium and nickel also drifted lower.

title: Speak up against copper mine plan | News, Sports, Jobs
summary: The piece urges Michigan to oppose taxpayer-funded support for the proposed Copperwood copper mine near Lake Superior and a state park. It cites expected environmental harm and toxic waste storage. If opposition slows or prevents the mine, it could reduce near-term copper supply expectations, pressuring copper prices lower.

title: Yunnan aluminium ramp-up to add over 500,000 T capacity, industry experts say
summary: Yunnan aluminium smelters are restarting output after China Southern Power Grid allocated additional electricity to the aluminium industry. Experts estimate the ramp-up could restore roughly 500,000-530,000 tonnes of annual capacity after earlier drought-driven curbs. The added supply from China’s key region may weigh on global aluminium prices.

title: Boliden to invest $463 mln at Swedish copper smelter
summary: Boliden plans to invest about $463.5 million in a new tank house at its Rönnskär copper smelter in Sweden to expand refining capacity after a prior fire. The company expects copper cathode and precious-metal production to reach full capacity by the second half of 2026, starting the project this year.

title: London copper slips, Shanghai hits fresh high amid output worries
summary: London copper eased 0.5% while Shanghai copper reached fresh highs on expectations of potential smelter output cuts in China, but analysts cautioned that consumption is slow and inventories keep rising. The report also shows softer LME aluminium and nickel, while SHFE aluminium rose and nickel fell.

title: AFRY : signs framework agreement with Copperstone -March 18, 2024 at 05:11 am EDT
summary: AFRY signed a two-year framework agreement with Copperstone Resources to support the planned reopening of the Viscaria copper mine in Kiruna, Sweden. The work focuses on sustainable mining and engineering services for process, automation, environment, and circular/re-mining practices. Copperstone targets up to 30,000 tonnes of copper annually.

title: MinRes signs heads of agreement to acquire WA nickel plant
summary: MinRes signed an agreement to acquire Poseidon Nickel’s Lake Johnston nickel concentrator plant in Western Australia, paying consideration on execution and completion. MinRes plans to convert the facility to process lithium ores for its Goldfields operations, though the asset is initially a nickel concentrator, affecting near-term nickel supply expectations only modestly.

title: Indonesia says nickel miner Vale to build another $2 bln HPAL plant
summary: Indonesia’s investment ministry says Vale Indonesia is exploring a new $1.9 billion HPAL project in Sulawesi, targeting 60,000 tons of nickel in MHP annually for EV batteries. The plan would be Vale’s third HPAL project, alongside existing Pomalaa and Sorowako builds, indicating potential future nickel supply growth.

title: Copper steady after recent rally, China data supports
summary: Copper steadied after a rally, supported by improving Chinese macro data and a softer U.S. dollar. A rare agreement by China’s smelters to cut output boosted sentiment and helped prices break key technical levels. Copper trades near $9,061. Nickel fell on higher LME warehouse stocks; aluminium was slightly lower.

title: Canada Nickel Makes New Discovery at Newmarket Property, Achieves Best Drill Results at Reid to Date and Announces Grant of Options and RSUs
summary: Canada Nickel reports positive initial assays from 2024 drilling: at Newmarket, two holes intersect nickel mineralization (e.g., 373m of 0.24% Ni), and at the Reid property, a best interval to date (675m of 0.25% Ni including higher grades). More drilling is planned and a resource target is outlined.

title: Put sanctions on Russian-origin aluminium not on Rusal, industry group says
summary: European Aluminium is lobbying the EU to expand sanctions by banning Russian-origin aluminium (excluding Rusal from current measures). While some Russian aluminium products are already covered, primary aluminium imports remain outside. EU imports have declined but are still significant, and a broader ban could tighten supply and lift aluminium prices.

title: Quetzal Copper Announces Resumption of Trading on TSX Venture Exchange
summary: Quetzal Copper Corp. said TSX Venture Exchange has granted final approval for its qualifying transaction and its shares will resume trading. The company plans to begin exploration and drilling in 2Q 2024 at the Princeton and Big Kidd copper projects in British Columbia, signaling renewed activity but not broader market impact.

title: Cordoba Minerals Corp.: Cordoba Minerals Announces Revised Perseverance Joint Venture Agreement with Bell Copper
summary: Cordoba Minerals and Bell Copper amended their Perseverance joint venture/earn-in terms, adjusting required spend to C$14.2M by April 24, 2026 to earn an 80% interest in a copper porphyry project in Arizona. The company plans exploration including a Typhoon IP-resistivity survey once funding and system availability allow.

title: Shanghai nickel fluctuated downward today, and the spot transaction improved [SMM Nickel Brief Comment]
summary: SMM reports Shanghai nickel main contract fell to 139,950 yuan/ton, down 1,920 yuan/ton from the prior close, with higher volume and open interest, shorts adding more positions. Spot transactions remain weak, though some downstream purchased after afternoon declines, leading SMM to expect continued price fluctuations.

title: Aluminium demand to benefit from 'under-appreciated' role in energy transition
summary: The piece highlights fast-growing aluminium use tied to the energy transition, especially in China’s solar PV industry and EV supply chains. It cites sharply rising aluminium consumption for solar panels and grid expansion, suggesting stronger demand momentum. It also notes some low-carbon aluminium scrutiny but overall points to supportive demand trends for aluminium prices.

title: Black mass market waits to see the effect of higher nickel and lithium prices
summary: Black mass market participants observe higher nickel (SHFE/LME) alongside a lithium price uptick, but say downstream demand for black mass remains weak and oversupply persists. Recyclers report limited ability to raise operating rates, and nickel black mass payables are largely unchanged week on week, with buyers still negotiating quality-based copper/aluminium thresholds.

title: Bell Copper Corporation: Bell Copper and Cordoba Minerals Amend Earn-In Terms at Bell's Perseverance Porphyry Copper Project, Arizona
summary: Bell Copper and Cordoba amended the earn-in terms for the Perseverance porphyry copper project in Arizona. Cordoba must spend C$14.2 million by April 24, 2026 to earn 80% interest. Timing remains similar, but the path consolidates phases. It’s an exploration JV update, not a production or supply change.

title: BHP cuts number of contractors at Australian nickel unit
summary: BHP cut about a quarter of contractors at its West Musgrave nickel and copper project and is reviewing whether to pause its Australian nickel division amid a severe nickel price slump and operational losses. The move follows warnings of difficulty in the nickel sector as supply surges pressured prices.

title: "Pebble Sues EPA To Revive Southwest Alaska Copper And Gold Mine Prospect"
summary: Pebble Limited Partnership sued the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency seeking to overturn its decision to halt the Pebble Southwest Alaska copper and gold mine project. The company also filed takings claims for compensation after the EPA blocked the prospect on state land. Outcome timing is unclear, limiting immediate copper price pressure.

title: Celsius gets mining permit for Philippines copper-gold project
summary: Celsius Resources’ subsidiary Makilala Mining obtained an MPSA mining permit for its MCB copper-gold project in the Philippines, the first copper project approved in 15 years. The permit grants exploration, development and production rights for 25 years (renewable), enabling the company to finalize funding and advance development plans.

title: Indonesia says nickel miner Vale to build another US$2-billion high-pressure acid leaching plant
summary: Indonesia’s investment ministry says PT Vale Indonesia is exploring a new US$1.9-billion HPAL plant on Sulawesi, intended to produce nickel MHP for EV batteries. The facility would be Vale’s third HPAL project, with potential 60,000 t/y output. Existing Vale HPAL projects and MIND ID’s stake support nickel-focused sentiment.

title: Norsk Hydro : Bringing more post-consumer aluminium scrap back to life in North America -March 18, 2024 at 12:48 pm EDT
summary: Norsk Hydro, through its North American recycling and Hydro Extrusions unit, has agreed with Sims Alumisource to access about 36,000 tonnes of additional post-consumer aluminium scrap. Hydro says improved scrap processing will raise melt productivity and availability of alternative scrap sources for billet casting.

title: Is a Copper Crisis Coming? Prices Hit New Highs on Smelter Cuts
summary: Copper prices hit new highs as ore shortages force Chinese smelters to cut production. Plunging treatment and refining charges near zero indicate tighter concentrate availability, with multiple smelter maintenance outages. Mining disruptions (e.g., Las Bambas setbacks, Cobre Panama closure) and declining LME stocks reinforce a widening supply deficit outlook.

title: The losses of nickel salt plants deepened last week | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports battery-grade nickel sulphate prices rising on tight supply, with slow recovery in hydrometallurgical recycling and active restocking supported by better vehicle sales. MHP supply shortages and elevated nickel prices increase raw material costs, widening nickel salt producers’ losses. Outlook remains bullish but upside may be limited.

title: Move over gold, copper is now breaking out, according to the charts. How to play it
summary: CNBC’s Katie Stockton says copper is “breaking out” on charts, resolving a long-term basing phase and clearing resistance near $3.97/lb. The author highlights COPX’s breakout and indicators suggesting upside follow-through, pointing to bullish near-term momentum for copper prices and copper miners’ stocks.

title: Rusal profit plunges 84.3% in 2023 on reduced prices
summary: Rusal reported net profit of $282m in 2023, down 84.3%, blaming lower realised aluminium prices (down 18% to $2,439/t) and weaker demand amid economic uncertainty. The company also cited geopolitical restrictions and supply-chain disruptions affecting export channels, while noting higher primary aluminium/alloy sales volumes.

title: US DoD stabilises critical metal supply chains in nickel and cobalt
summary: The US Department of Defense granted Doe Run Resources $7m under the Defense Production Act to complete a demonstration-scale hydrometallurgical plant in Missouri to improve extraction and separation of nickel (and cobalt). The project supports domestic processing and supply-chain resilience for defense demand, which can offer near-term nickel price support.

title: ECAs and banks forge US$2.5bn deal for Chile copper mine
summary: Japan, Canada and Korea export-credit agencies and a bank consortium agreed to finance a US$2.5bn expansion of Chile’s Centinela copper mine and refinery. The project targets a 140,000 tonnes/year output boost and includes offtake for increased copper concentrate supplies, supporting long-term copper availability.

title: Support GIADEC to develop Ghana's Integrated Aluminium Industry – Asantehene
summary: Ghana’s GIADEC selected Mytilineos as a strategic partner to develop Nyinahin bauxite resources and build refinery capacity, aiming to end raw bauxite exports. The program includes expanding/modernising VALCO smelter capacity, supporting a fully integrated aluminium value chain and future aluminium production in Ghana.

title: US must improve copper mine permitting process, Freeport CEO says
summary: Freeport CEO Richard Adkerson urged U.S. lawmakers and regulators to improve the mine permitting process to move projects from verbal acceptance to approvals, without easing environmental standards. He said Freeport is working on local support and discussed possible expansion of its Miami, Arizona copper smelter and increased copper leaching use.

title: Artificial intelligence: Copper's time is now, analysts say as traders witch from iron ore
summary: Australia-driven commodity rotation is highlighted as iron ore traders shift toward copper. Copper has surged nearly 6% to an 11-month high above $9,000/ton, supported by concerns over mine and smelter supply in China and optimism for stronger demand tied to the energy transition and AI-linked activity.

title: Joe Wheeler EMC still offering $1,000 reward for information on copper thieves
summary: A local Alabama utility, Joe Wheeler EMC, is offering a $1,000 reward after thieves stripped grounding wires from 26 poles. Officials say the stolen material is copper-clad wire, not pure copper, and repairs have required manpower and replacement costs. The incident is localized and unlikely to move regional copper prices meaningfully.

title: Indonesia issues nickel production quotas for 152.62 mln metric tons
summary: Indonesia’s mining ministry has issued nickel ore production quotas totaling 152.62 million metric tons so far this year, alongside tin quotas. The government has approved production for 191 miners and is still processing more than 500 proposals, indicating ongoing supply management in a key nickel-producing country.

title: GIADEC, Mytilineos S.A. set to begin exploration on project 3 of Nyinahin bauxite concession
summary: Ghana’s GIADEC and Mytilineos plan to start exploration of bauxite at the Nyinahin hills (project 3), with the goal of establishing the country’s first refinery plant and reducing raw bauxite exports. It includes plans for environmental compliance and future mineral resource estimation.

title: Copper falls as dollar rises, investors lock in profits after rally
summary: Copper fell on the LME as investors took profits after a rally and the dollar strengthened ahead of the Fed decision. The article cites weaker near-term China buying intentions. It also notes losses in nickel and aluminium, reflecting broader base-metal sentiment plus easing supply disruption signals from Indonesia.

title: Indonesian nickel ore quota approvals accelerate, Shanghai nickel fluctuates downward today [SMM Nickel Futures Review]
summary: Shanghai nickel fell during the March 19 session, with declining volume and open interest suggesting longer positions were closing. The key catalyst was Indonesia’s completion of nickel ore quota approvals for 107 companies, easing expectations of tight ore supply, plus signs intermediate production tightness may ease in April. Nickel is expected to stay weak.

title: Freeport Commences Discussions with Strategic Partners for Yandera Copper Project, One of the World's Largest Undeveloped Copper Projects
summary: Freeport said it has begun discussions with strategic partners to advance the Yandera copper project and noted recent copper price strength above $9,000/t. The release attributes the rally partly to curtailed Chinese smelter output from copper-concentrate shortages and a forecast deficit starting as early as 2025.

title: The massive copper mine that could test the limits of religious freedom
summary: The Ninth Circuit declined to stop construction of Arizona’s Oak Flat (Chí’chil Biłdagoteel) copper mine on land sacred to the San Carlos Apache Tribe and other Indigenous nations. The ruling lowers the likelihood of an immediate halt, easing near-term supply risk for copper.

title: Canadian North Resources Reports Substantial Increase of Copper, Nickel, Cobalt, Palladium and Platinum NI 43-101 Compliant Mineral Resources for its 100% owned Ferguson Lake Project in Canada
summary: Canadian North Resources reported a 172% increase in NI 43-101 indicated mineral resources at its Ferguson Lake project, including copper (66.1 Mt, 1,093 Mlb) and nickel (678 Mlb), with cobalt and PGM values also stated. It signals exploration potential, but provides no immediate production or supply disruption for prices.

title: Freeport Resources Inc.: Freeport Commences Discussions with Strategic Partners for Yandera Copper Project, One of the World's Largest Undeveloped Copper Projects
summary: Freeport says it has started discussions with strategic partners for the 100% owned Yandera copper project after renewing its license. The release links recent copper price strength to Chinese smelter output curtailments from copper concentrate shortages, highlighting potential looming copper deficits and supportive sentiment for copper.

title: Vista Metals to invest $60 Million in Aluminum Casting Facility in Bowling Green
summary: Vista Metals plans a $60 million investment to build a 75,000+ sq ft aluminum casting facility in Bowling Green, Kentucky, creating 50+ jobs. The company positions the expansion to support customers’ aerospace growth and improve supply-chain reliability, implying higher near-term demand expectations for aluminum.

title: Boliden to invest $463m to boost Swedish copper smelter capacity
summary: Boliden announced a $463.5m investment in a new tank house at its Rönnskär copper smelter to expand copper cathode production after a prior fire. Capacity remains at 230 kt, with full ramp-up expected by 2H 2026. Additional investments support tailings use across Boliden mines.

title: BHP cuts contractors at Australian nickel mine amid price crisis
summary: BHP cut roughly a quarter of contractor staff at its West Musgrave nickel and copper project in Western Australia, citing the impacts of a global nickel price crisis. The company is also reviewing capital spend and business plans after shutting Nickel West, amid losses tied to nickel oversupply and a weaker outlook.

title: LME plans to list Saudi port as a copper and zinc delivery point
summary: LME is consulting to list Saudi’s Jeddah port as an LME copper delivery point, aiming to expand warehouse locations to serve the Middle East, North and East Africa. The change depends on approvals and warehouse-insolvency policy amendments, likely limiting immediate directional price pressure.

title: Nickel ore prices slightly rebounded | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Shanghai Non ferrous Metals reports Ni 1.5% ore prices rebounded to about $46/wmt CIF, up $0.6. The rise is linked to Surigao’s rainy season reducing Philippines-to-China exports, lowering spot transactions, and coinciding with lower Chinese port inventories and weaker weekly arrivals.

title: Metal Prices Fall on Demand Concerns for Aluminum, Zinc
summary: Industrial metal prices fell as demand uncertainty weighed on sentiment. Copper gave up recent gains but remains up on the week amid digestion of possible supply concerns. Aluminium declined on concerns over short-term demand despite steady Chinese supply expectations. The piece also notes zinc weakness, though zinc isn’t tracked here.

title: Automotive Aluminum Market To Reach US$ 59.6 Billion By 2032
summary: The IMARC report forecasts growth of the global automotive aluminum market, attributing it to rising electric-vehicle production, fuel-efficiency/emissions standards, and improvements in aluminum alloys and manufacturing. It highlights aluminum’s lightweighting and heat-dissipation roles, suggesting increasing automotive demand could support aluminium prices despite the longer 2032 horizon.

title: Barrick shuts down water supply after uranium found at copper mine in Zambia
summary: Barrick says uranium was found above Zambia’s limits in drinking water at a small section of its Lumwana open-pit copper mine in Zambia, prompting an immediate halt of that water supply and switching workers to bottled/municipal water. Barrick calls the incident isolated with negligible health risk and no damage to production plans.

title: Local Aluminum plant shutting down in Buckhannon
summary: A Novelis aluminum plant in Buckhannon, West Virginia is set to close on June 14, with the state document citing 80 jobs affected. Officials did not disclose the reason. The shutdown reduces local aluminum processing activity and could modestly weigh on near-term aluminum demand expectations.

title: Interra Copper Corp.: Interra Copper Issues Letter to Shareholders
summary: Interra Copper Corp. issued a shareholder update on 2024 exploration work for its BC copper-gold projects Rip and Thane, including planned geochemical and geophysical surveys and possible drilling, while divesting Chile assets due to higher claim fees. It cites strong metals pricing, especially copper, but no supply shock is announced.

title: BHP ASX: WA jobs at nickel west in doubt
summary: BHP has reduced contractors and deferred a 1000-bed camp plan linked to rebuilding infrastructure at its Kalgoorlie nickel smelter, with ageing assets at risk of being mothballed. The company seeks to clarify the outlook for its loss-making nickel division, creating near-term uncertainty for nickel supply.

title: Peru copper production dips 1.2% in January
summary: Peru’s copper production fell 1.2% in January year-on-year to 205,375 tonnes. The decline followed a 17% drop at MMG’s Las Bambas and a 13.4% fall at Freeport-McMoRan’s Cerro Verde. The article cites ministry data and compares it with higher December output.

title: Donald Trump warns Kevin Rudd; BHP cuts contractors at Kalgoorlie nickel smelter; Canva, WiseTech, Culture Amp no longer require degrees
summary: The Financial Review brief reports that BHP is cutting contractors at its Kalgoorlie nickel smelter. Alongside other unrelated items, this personnel change is the only element directly tied to industrial metals, potentially indicating disrupted or reduced nickel production capacity in the near term.

title: Shanghai nickel, tin fall as Indonesia ramps up mining quota approval process
summary: Shanghai nickel prices fell about 2% as fears of tight supply from Indonesia eased. A mining ministry official said Indonesia is accelerating the approval process for issuing mining production quotas, with progress already reported on nickel ore. Tin also declined, while LME nickel showed a smaller rebound.

title: Council set to approve new bylaw targeting copper and metal theft
summary: Brantford council is set to approve a bylaw targeting scrap-metal theft, restricting dealers from certain metals and banning cash transactions. Salvage yards must issue traceable payments for items such as copper tubing/piping and wiring. Officials cite nearly $1 million in two-year losses and aim to deter theft by limiting quick resale.

title: Council set to approve new bylaw targeting copper and metal theft | The Stratford Beacon Herald
summary: Brantford council plans to approve a bylaw restricting scrap dealing related to copper and other metals to curb theft. The measure tightens salvage yard licensing, bans cash transactions, and requires traceable payments and documentation. Officials say theft losses have neared $1M over two years, mainly affecting copper tubing, piping and wiring.

title: Council set to approve new bylaw targeting copper and metal theft | The Woodstock Sentinel Review
summary: Brantford council plans to approve a bylaw restricting transactions for certain metals, including copper tubing, piping, and wiring, and banning cash dealings in salvage yard sales. The goal is to curb theft that harms homes and infrastructure. Restrictions aim to improve traceability via cheques or e-transfers.

title: Susan McDonald Urges Listing Copper as Critical Mineral | The North West Star
summary: Susan McDonald urges adding copper to Australia’s critical minerals list to protect supply chains and unlock financing and international investment. She cites nickel disruption after delays to show potential job risks. The piece notes copper prices rising on mine/smelter supply concerns, while processing fees have fallen.

title: Council set to approve new bylaw targeting copper and metal theft | Sarnia & Lambton County This Week
summary: Brantford council is set to approve a bylaw aimed at reducing copper and metal theft. It would restrict prohibited metal dealing and require traceable, non-cash salvage-yard transactions for copper tubing, piping and wiring. Officials say the rules should discourage theft that currently supplies quick-cash scrap.

title: Copper (HG) Short Term Pullback Should Find Buyers
summary: The piece provides short-term Elliott Wave guidance for Copper (HG), describing an impulse rally from the 2.9.2024 low followed by a pullback. It highlights a support zone around 3.98–4.03 and states that if the pullback holds above 3.978, copper should turn higher or bounce.

title: Seco/Warwick S A : Three Vortex® furnaces for Aluminum Coil Annealing to be delivered to India -March 20, 2024 at 04:56 am EDT
summary: SECO/WARWICK says Jupiter Aluminum Industries (JUPALCO) in India ordered three Vortex 2.0 annealing furnaces, plus cooling chambers and a loader, for a new rolling mill/heat-treat facility. The equipment is intended to shorten coil annealing cycle times, improve quality, and expand domestic aluminum production.

title: Much work left to be done in aluminum industry, govt admits - Economy
summary: Indonesia’s government says the aluminium downstream industry still has major gaps: only two smelters operate with limited capacity, leaving most domestic demand dependent on imports. Inalum is expanding its Batubara smelter to add 25,000 tonnes this year and studies further capacity, but timing uncertainties limit near-term impact.

title: Hannan Metals Ltd.: Hannan Discovers a New Thick Style of High-Grade Sediment Hosted Copper in Peru
summary: Hannan Metals announced a discovery of thick, high-grade sediment-hosted copper-silver mineralization at its San Martin West project in northern Peru, including channel results such as 5.8 m at 3.1% Cu. The company plans further sampling and a future drill program, with mineralization interpreted to extend at depth.

title: Nickel prices rose sharply in February, and continued to accumulate inventory, putting pressure on nickel prices in late March [SMM analysis]
summary: SMM analysis says nickel prices rose in February, supported by a weaker US dollar, favorable domestic policies, and tighter supply from slower Indonesian ore quota approvals. For March, sentiment on ore quotas is easing while demand recovers. However, rising inventories are expected to pressure nickel prices in late March.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: Talon Metals Reports 12.7 Meter Intercept Outside of the Resource Area Assaying 7.5% Nickel Equivalent
summary: Talon Metals reported drill results from hole 23TK0447 at its Tamarack project, outside the current resource area, including 12.7m grading 6.04% Ni and 2.68% Cu (7.5% NiEq) and additional disseminated sulphides. The company links its thesis to nickel’s recent price decline and plans more updates soon.

title: Talon Metals Reports 12.7 Meter Intercept Outside of the Resource Area Assaying 7.5% Nickel Equivalent
summary: Talon Metals reported drill results from the Tamarack Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project, including a 12.7m intercept assaying 6.04% Ni and 2.68% Cu (7.5% NiEq) outside the resource area, plus additional disseminated sulphides. Management cites the need for high-grade production amid falling nickel prices.

title: Constellium joins aluminium producers exploring hydrogen power to decarbonize operations
summary: Constellium said it successfully trialed hydrogen instead of natural gas in casthouse burner testing in France, aiming to decarbonize aluminium production and reduce emissions intensity. The move supports growing low-carbon aluminium demand and potential premiums, but reported timelines are for later industrial testing, limiting near-term price pressure.

title: East Star awarded second copper porphyry exploration licence in Kazakhstan
summary: East Star Resources announced it received a second copper porphyry exploration licence in Kazakhstan, funded initially by a US$500,000 BHP Xplor grant. The licence covers 121 km2 with historical soil anomalies and a silica lithocap near existing Kounrad copper assets. The work will be mapping and soil sampling.

title: Barrick looks to explore new gold, copper deposits in DR Congo
summary: Barrick says it wants to explore additional gold and copper prospects in the Democratic Republic of Congo after success with its Kibali mine. It previously indicated interest in expanding copper exploration in Zambia and the DRC to grow on the African copperbelt, with no immediate production or supply figures provided.

title: Nickel sulfate price review | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: The article attributes the post-holiday rise in nickel sulfate prices to tighter supply-demand conditions in finished products versus raw materials. Wet intermediate supply shrank due to slower Indonesia ramp-ups and scrap availability remained weak, while downstream inventory drawdowns intensified the mismatch. Prices rose faster than raw materials and profits recovered, but further upside may be limited.

title: China Copper Smelters to Discuss Fees as Crisis Roils Sector
summary: A report on China copper smelters says they will discuss processing fees as a crisis roils the sector. Changes in smelter treatment and refining economics can affect near-term refined-copper supply expectations and market pricing, though the provided excerpt lacks details on whether fees are being raised or cut.

title: Indonesia Aims to Cap Nickel Prices at $18,000
summary: Indonesia, the dominant player in nickel supply, plans to keep LME nickel prices below $18,000/mt. The government moved quickly to address quota-approval delays that had raised deficit fears. Still, the stated pricing cap and low-cost production could pressure nickel toward lower levels despite a recent rebound.

title: Quest Critical Metals Streamlines Focus to Advance Tisova/Klingenthal Copper VMS Project
summary: Quest Critical Metals says it will relinquish its option on the East Bull Palladium project to cut ongoing costs and focus on advancing its Tisova/Klingenthal copper/cobalt VMS prospect and a Minas Gerais lithium project. The release provides no specific near-term production or supply changes.

title: Copper Fox Announces 2024 First Quarter Operating and Financial Results
summary: Copper Fox reported Q1 2024 financials and ongoing copper-focused exploration at projects including Van Dyke, Schaft Creek, Mineral Mountain and Sombrero Butte. The company highlighted drilling results and testwork, with plans and budgets to advance projects toward permitting and prefeasibility, but provided no immediate production or supply change.

title: BSE : Accredited Warehouse for deposit & delivery of Copper & Zinc. -March 21, 2024 at 03:59 am EDT
summary: BSE/ICCL informed members that an ICCL accredited warehouse is available for deposit and delivery of copper (and zinc) under contract specifications. Members are advised to confirm storage space before arranging deliveries. The update is primarily about settlement/warehouse logistics rather than a fundamental copper supply-demand change.

title: EGA's pilot plant revolutionises bauxite residue: a path to sustainable soil solutions
summary: EGA reviewed progress on a pilot plant to convert caustic bauxite residue into “Optimised Bauxite Residue” for manufactured soil (“Turba”). The project targets operational production in 2024 and aims to reduce landfill waste. It highlights environmental benefits and potential efficiency improvements, but provides no immediate aluminium market impact.

title: UAE Business: EGA to acquire recycled aluminium producer Leichtmetall
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) agreed to acquire German recycler Leichtmetall, adding about 30,000 tonnes/year of secondary-aluminium billet capacity using renewable energy and recycling technologies. EGA also references an ongoing large recycling plant in the UAE. The deal supports long-term circular supply but is unlikely to force near-term aluminium price moves within weeks.

title: Indonesia's RKAB approval is slow and superimposed on the Spring Festival effect, ferronickel imports in February fell 17% month-on-month
summary: China’s February nickel pig iron imports fell MoM, with Indonesia-linked volumes down 14–17% MoM, attributed to slow Indonesian nickel mine RKAB approvals and the Chinese New Year holiday. Despite YOY growth, the delay suggests near-term tighter nickel supply, while recovery is expected as approvals accelerate.

title: Russian nickel and fertiliser continues to flow into Finland
summary: Yle reports that Russian nickel continues to move by rail into Finland and flows to the Nornickel Harjavalta smelter despite checkpoint closures, because nickel is not covered by EU sanctions. The report also notes that freight strikes have not halted these shipments, suggesting steady near-term nickel supply to the EU.

title: Adaro's KIPI aluminum smelter aims for full operation by early 2026 - Companies
summary: Adaro Minerals’ KIPI aluminium smelter in Indonesia aims to start producing 250,000 tonnes of aluminium ingots by Q3 and reach full operation by early 2026. It currently focuses on securing reliable 24/7 electricity and plans to sell output to domestic and export markets, with part reserved to reduce imports.

title: Indonesia approves 152.6mn t of nickel mining quotas
summary: Indonesia’s government approved 152.62mn tonnes of nickel mining quotas for 2024 (RKAB). Industry sources cited limitations and said approved ore quotas appear far below 2024 demand and may not be fully mined. Given nickel ore demand projections and constraints on ore supply to smelters, near-term nickel availability looks tighter.

title: Bauxite mining: GIADEC, Mytilineous commit to long-term partnership with Nyinahin-Mpasaaso
summary: GIADEC and Mytilineos announced the start of bauxite exploration at the Nyinahin-Mpasaaso concession in Ghana’s Ashanti region, with a program aimed at building an integrated aluminium value chain from bauxite to alumina and aluminium production. The project includes local participation and environmental commitments, which may support aluminium supply expectations.

title: BHP trims contractor headcount at Kalgoorlie nickel smelter
summary: BHP reduced contractor headcount at its Kalgoorlie nickel smelter and halted a new precipitation system, citing the current rout in nickel prices and an industry surplus—especially from Indonesia and China. The firm is also assessing whether to deactivate nickel operations if prices do not improve.

title: Exclusive-UAE conglomerate seeks to gatecrash China's JHCX Zambian copper deal
summary: International Resources Holding’s 80% stake in Zambia’s Lubambe copper project is up for sale, with UAE oil-major-linked investor IRH seeking to outbid or complicate JCHX’s January purchase deal. Government approvals are pending. The deal competition highlights intensified African copper securing efforts, potentially tightening near-term supply expectations.

title: Exploring Mining Podcast Interview with David Kelley CEO, and Geologist at Chakana Copper (TSXV: PERU) (OTCQB: CHKKF)
summary: Investorideas.com publishes a podcast interview with Chakana Copper CEO/geologist David Kelley. The discussion centers on a fully funded drill program beginning in April for the Soledad Project in Peru, emphasizing high-grade copper-gold-silver mineralization and investor interest. The news is supportive for copper sentiment via exploration upside.

title: Lifezone Metals Announces Receipt of Licence from Government of Tanzania for the Kabanga Nickel Project Multi-Metal Processing Facility at Kahama
summary: Lifezone Metals says Tanzania issued a licence for its Kahama multi-metal processing facility, allowing refining of nickel and copper (and cobalt) from the Kabanga Nickel Project using hydromet technology. The refinery is planned within a Special Economic Zone with tax benefits, supporting improved in-country beneficiation prospects.

title: Nickel: Contrarian opportunity or portfolio suicide?
summary: The article argues the nickel market is facing continued pressure as Indonesia’s nickel laterite mines increase output and add new supply. This supply influx is described as flooding the market, implying weaker near-term balance and downward price pressure for nickel.

title: Unified aluminium industries call for a joint trade committee
summary: Canada, the U.S. and Mexico’s aluminium industry associations urge creation of a North American Aluminium Trade Committee, expanded import monitoring—especially by Mexico—and stronger enforcement against unfair aluminium imports. The push is tied to CUSMA’s ongoing review, with measures aimed at reducing trade distortions in the region.

title: Antofagasta launches desalination plant for Los Pelambres copper mine in Chile
summary: Antofagasta inaugurated a $2 billion desalination plant supplying Los Pelambres, aiming to mitigate severe drought impacts on copper output in Chile. The mine will start using desalinated water at the coast and pump 400 liters per second, reducing pressure on inland water sources. This supports ongoing copper production despite water stress.

title: EV Minerals Corporation: EV Minerals Highlights Historic North Zone Results Providing Compelling Drill Targets at EV Nickel Project in Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean Region, Quebec
summary: EV Minerals reported historic drill targets and selected intercepts from its EV Nickel-Copper-Cobalt project in Quebec, including multi-metre grades of nickel and copper and plans for follow-up drilling after assay results. The update may modestly support market sentiment for nickel and copper supply potential, but it is exploratory with no immediate production impact.

title: EV Minerals Highlights Historic North Zone Results Providing Compelling Drill Targets at EV Nickel Project in Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean Region, Quebec
summary: EV Minerals reports compelling North Zone drill targets and historic assay intersections at its EV Nickel-Copper-Cobalt project in Quebec. Multiple intervals include >1% nickel and meaningful copper grades, supporting potential resource expansion via infill drilling. The company plans follow-up work and metallurgical evaluation, but no near-term production change is stated.

title: Southern Copper outlines US$700mn plan to upgrade Peru's Cuajone mine
summary: Southern Copper says it will invest about US$700mn to upgrade Peru’s Cuajone mine. The project is directly linked to copper output and could affect medium-term supply expectations. With limited timing and production-outage details in the available text, the immediate price impact on copper is uncertain.

title: EGA To Acquire Leichtmetall, European Producer Of High-Strength Recycled Aluminium
summary: EGA will acquire Leichtmetall, a German producer of high-strength recycled aluminium billets, for full ownership. The company plans to use renewable energy and secondary aluminium (about 80% of inputs). The move strengthens EGA’s European recycling footprint and supports growth in low-carbon aluminium supply.

title: deadline for negotiations on the return of New Caledonia's nickel industry
