summary: France set a March-end deadline to finalize an agreement to restore New Caledonia’s nickel industry, including €200m/year in subsidies for energy and investment in electricity production. The plan targets cost reductions versus Indonesian competition and seeks more European supply, easing bankruptcy/supply disruption risks.

title: Refined nickel imports remain at low levels, with export volumes falling sharply.
summary: Refined nickel imports stay depressed as Russian nickel inflows decline, with difficulties signing long-term Russian contracts. Indonesia’s supplies rise, but refined nickel exports fell in February due to Spring Festival logistics disruptions and increased nickel sulfate prices, which led some producers to prioritize sulfate output over refined nickel.

title: Archer Exploration Provides 2024 Winter Drilling Results at Grasset Nickel Project
summary: Archer Exploration reported winter 2024 drilling results from its Grasset nickel sulphide project in Quebec, including intersections of high nickel (e.g., 2.67% Ni) with some copper content. The company frames results as extending mineralization at depth but provides no production, shipment, or inventory changes.

title: "Why A Shrinking US Aluminum Industry Is Tricky News For Clean Energy"
summary: The piece says the U.S. is producing less aluminum even as cleantech and clean-energy deployment increase demand for the metal. It references Alcoa’s $2.2 billion deal to expand global supply while domestic output declines, and notes policy pressure to cut emissions from aluminum production.

title: Lifezone secures licence for Kabanga nickel project in Tanzania
summary: Tanzania awarded Lifezone Metals licences to operate a multi-metal hydromet facility at its Kabanga project, including production of nickel and copper (and cobalt). The Kahama Refinery licence follows SEZ and mining licence steps, leveraging existing Buzwagi infrastructure and aiming for local production with lower transport and operating costs.

title: Vista Metals Plans Bowling Green, Kentucky, Specialty Aluminum Operations
summary: Vista Metals plans to build a 75,000+ sq ft specialty aluminum products facility in Bowling Green, Kentucky, backed by state tax incentives and workforce support. The company will add over 50 jobs and produce specialty aluminum for aerospace, defense, automotive and industrial uses, signaling incremental aluminum processing demand.

title: Castillo Copper completes sale of two Broken Hill exploration licences
summary: Castillo Copper said it completed the sale of two Broken Hill exploration licences in Zambia for up to AUD300,000, receiving Rimfire shares and leaving it with retained interest. The update is a portfolio streamlining transaction; it provides no details on production or broader supply changes for copper.

title: Congo overtakes Peru on copper output, still behind on exports
summary: Reuters reports that the DRC overtook Peru as the world’s second largest copper producer in 2023, with output of about 2.84 million tonnes versus Peru’s 2.76 million. Peru still leads on exports (about 2.95 million tonnes) due to stock sales, while Peru expects output to rise to 3 million in 2024.

title: Commodity Corner: Booming demand spurs copper price to new high
summary: The piece’s headline says “booming demand” is driving copper prices to a new high. While the excerpt provides little detail on volumes or supply changes, the framing indicates near-term demand-led upward pressure for copper, which is most consistent with bullish copper price movement.

title: Century Aluminum decarbonizing proposals could get federal money
summary: Bloomberg reports that Century Aluminum’s decarbonizing proposals may qualify for federal funding. Any subsidy or financing support for aluminium smelters can improve margins or reduce near-term cost pressure and encourage continued output, which typically supports sentiment toward aluminium prices in the coming weeks.

title: Lifezone Metals Announces Receipt Of Licence From Government Of Tanzania For The Kabanga Nickel Project Multi-Metal Proc...
summary: Lifezone Metals said Tanzania issued licences for its Kabanga Nickel Project, including a Kahama Refinery licence within a special economic zone. The refinery uses hydromet technology to produce finished nickel (and other metals such as copper/cobalt) in-country. The announcement strengthens expectations of future supply and refining capacity.

title: Thieves climbing cell towers to steal copper wire in Houston
summary: Houston and nearby counties are seeing increased theft of copper trunk cables from cell phone towers. Operators say repairs can cost $10,000–$25,000 per incident, with dozens of cases investigated. The theft diverts physical copper into scrap channels, tightening short-term copper availability and supporting a modest price tone.

title: Fortescue eyes developing its copper assets, not looking at Cobre Panama
summary: Fortescue’s founder said the company is considering developing its copper resources but has not decided when or whether to proceed. He also said Fortescue is not looking at First Quantum’s idled Cobre Panama mine, which shut after Panama’s top court ruled its contract unconstitutional. No firm near-term copper supply change is announced.

title: BOI approves first copper mining project in PH in last 15 years
summary: Philippines’ BOI approved Celsius Resources’ first new copper mining project in 15 years after DENR granted an MPSA. The 25-year agreement gives Celsius’ subsidiary exclusive rights to develop and produce copper in the MCB project area. Funding discussions will follow, but output ramp-up is not immediate.

title: High copper prices muted spot trades | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Spot copper prices versus SHFE contracts weakened as spot discounts expanded and downstream purchases remained poor. Buyer and seller divergence is expected in late March, while smelters await export and long-term contracts near month-end. High copper prices are forecast to suppress end-user demand, keeping spot premiums low.

title: EcoPro Invests US$11 Mln in Nickel Smelting Factory in Indonesia
summary: EcoPro Invests around US$11 million in a nickel smelting factory in Indonesia. The headline implies expansion of nickel processing capacity, which can shift expectations for near-term nickel supply availability. Such capacity-related developments typically influence nickel prices through sentiment about inventories and refined output.

title: Queensland Boosts Eva Copper Mine in Cloncurry | The North West Star
summary: Queensland’s government has granted Eva Copper Mine near Cloncurry priority status, allowing the Coordinator-General to coordinate remaining approvals. The mine could supply additional copper concentrate to Mount Isa’s smelter, supporting expanded copper mining and smelting and boosting local supply for energy-manufacturing uses.

title: EcoPro invests $11 mil. in nickel smelting factory in Indonesia
summary: EcoPro said it invested $11 million for a 9% stake in Indonesia’s Green Eco Nickel, a smelter processing 20,000 tons of nickel annually. The firm also cited an earlier $86 million nickel smelting investment in Morowali and plans more Indonesian nickel processing projects to secure supply for battery precursors.

title: Copper rises as China stock build slows
summary: London copper rebounded, up 0.5%, as China’s inventory build in SHFE-tracked warehouses slowed for the first time this week. SHFE inventories still remain high, but analysts cite signs of end-of-accumulation and potential Q2 smelter maintenance effects. LME aluminium and nickel also edged higher.

title: EcoPro invests $11m to secure stake in Indonesian nickel smelter
summary: EcoPro invested $11m for a 9% stake in Indonesia’s Green Eco Nickel smelter, operated by GEM, to expand nickel supply for lithium-ion battery materials. The smelter produces about 20,000 tons/year. EcoPro plans to scale ownership and process nickel into nickel sulfate for precursors.

title: DOWA : CARIBOO COPPER CORP. Share Transfer -March 25, 2024 at 02:13 am EDT
summary: Dowa Holdings says its subsidiary will sell its 25% stake in Cariboo Copper Corp. to Taseko Mines. Cariboo holds a stake in Canada’s Gibraltar copper mine. Dowa cites a shift toward recycling and ends related tolling arrangements, but the announcement does not specify any immediate mine output disruption.

title: PBBM's Australian Visit Yields Permit For PHP14 Billion Copper Mining Project
summary: The Philippine government granted a Mineral Production Sharing Agreement for Celsius Resources’ Makilala unit to develop the Maalinao-Caigutan-Biyog (MCB) copper project. The 25-year permit covers exploration and commercial production rights. The article emphasizes initial investment, taxes/royalties, and indigenous consent steps, but no immediate output is stated.

title: Top 10 nickel-producing countries in 2023 - Mining Technology
summary: The piece reviews nickel supply concentration and notes nickel prices averaged about $22,942/mt in Q3 2023, 11.6% lower year-on-year. It attributes weakness to soft China battery-sector demand and rising supply, especially from Indonesia. It also forecasts further nickel price declines in 2023 and 2024 as supply grows.

title: Tragedy strikes: 2 Thai workers killed in Juei Feng Aluminium plant blast
summary: An explosion at Juei Feng Aluminium’s Kaohsiung plant killed two Thai workers and injured several others. Taiwanese authorities investigated, and Kaohsiung officials suspended plant operations and fined the owner. The incident is linked to a control-system error involving moisture contacting liquid aluminium, suggesting supply disruption.

title: Max Resource Reports High-Grade Assays at AM-14, Cesar Project Including 2.2% Copper and 12.8 g/t Silver over 5.2m
summary: Max Resource Corp. reported high-grade rock chip assay results at the AM-14 target of its Cesar copper-silver project in Colombia, including 2.2% copper over 5.2m and 4.8% copper over 2.2m. The release is exploration-focused and signals potential resource growth rather than near-term supply changes.

title: Copper pipe imports and exports from January to February increased significantly [SMM analysis]
summary: SMM analysis using customs data shows China’s copper pipe imports rose to 3,430 tons in Jan–Feb 2024 (+35.5% YoY) and exports to 58,694 tons (+13.3% YoY). The piece links this strength to increased domestic and overseas air-conditioner activity and improved production costs for imported tube inputs.

title: Century Aluminum to Get up to $500 Million in U.S. Funding For New Aluminum Smelter
summary: Century Aluminum said it is negotiating for up to $500 million in U.S. government funding to build the first new U.S. primary aluminum smelter in 45 years. Selected by the Energy Department, the project would double U.S. primary capacity, boosting supply-chain resilience for green energy.

title: The volume of raw materials has led to the weakening of nickel fundamentals, and today's Shanghai nickel disk is volatile and downward [SMM Nickel Brief Comment]
summary: SMM reports Shanghai nickel closed lower on March 25, with reduced trading volume and open interest suggesting position lightening and a mild downward bias. Fundamentals are viewed as weakening: nickel mine approval is progressing faster and Indonesian intermediate output is rising, easing expectations of tight raw-material supply. Nickel is expected to remain weak and volatile.

title: 【SMM Daily Report: Weak Demand Leads to Nickel Iron Price Decline】 | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that 8–12% high-nickel pig iron averaged 942.5 yuan per nickel point on March 25, down 2.5 yuan from the prior working day. Despite faster nickel ore quota approvals, nickel iron production remains low in March. Persistent weak stainless steel demand and resulting inventory build keep nickel iron prices under pressure.

title: Century Aluminum Selected by U.S. Department of Energy to Receive $500 Million Investment to Build New Green Aluminum Smelter to Accelerate Industrial Decarbonization
summary: Century Aluminum was selected by the U.S. DOE for up to $500 million to negotiate funding for a new green primary aluminum smelter. The project aims to build the first U.S. primary smelter in 45 years, expanding domestic capacity and decarbonizing production under Industrial Demonstrations Program support.

title: Arras Minerals Corp.: Arras Minerals Defines a New 14KM Copper Soil Anomaly on the Elemes Project, Kazakhstan
summary: Arras Minerals reported results from 14,000 soil samples at its Elemes project in Kazakhstan, defining a second 14-km copper-in-soil anomaly (“Aimandai”) alongside the previously announced Berezski target. The work is exploration-focused and does not change near-term copper supply or demand, limiting price impact.

title: EcoPro acquires stake in nickel processor
summary: EcoPro invested US$11m for a 9% stake in Indonesia’s Green Eco Nickel, a nickel smelting plant in Sulawesi with 20,000 tonnes/year capacity, aiming to secure refined nickel for its battery materials affiliate. It also plans further investments, building on a prior stake in another nickel refining facility.

title: TSX futures set to open lower on copper weakness
summary: TSX futures are set to open lower as most base metals retreat against a steady U.S. dollar, while crude oil rises on tighter supply tied to Middle East and Russia-Ukraine conflicts. The headline points to copper weakness, suggesting near-term bearish sentiment for copper alongside broader market risk factors.

title: Ivanhoe Electric Inc.: Ivanhoe Electric Announces Completion of Earn-In to Acquire a 60% Interest in the Samapleu-Grata Nickel-Copper Project in the Ivory Coast
summary: Ivanhoe Electric completed its earn-in to secure a 60% interest in the Samapleu-Grata nickel-copper project in Ivory Coast. A 2024 PEA from Sama highlights potential 16-year open-pit production of copper and nickel concentrates with reported NPV/IRR, improving expected future supply economics for both metals.

title: Ivanhoe Electric Inc.: Ivanhoe Electric Announces Completion of Earn-In to Acquire a 60% Interest in the Samapleu-Grata Nickel-Copper Project in the Ivory Coast
summary: Ivanhoe Electric completed its earn-in to hold 60% of the Samapleu-Grata nickel-copper project in Côte d’Ivoire. Sama’s 2024 preliminary economic assessment forecasts a 16-year open-pit producing annual copper concentrate and nickel concentrate, based on long-term copper and nickel price assumptions. The update is preliminary and not expected to shift supply soon.

title: FBM to acquire 85% stake in Coolgardie Nickel
summary: Future Battery Minerals will acquire an 85% stake in the Coolgardie Nickel subsidiary holding the Miriam Project near its Kangaroo Hills lithium asset in Western Australia. The project is positioned as drill-ready for spodumene and contains high-grade lithium samples. Deal closing is mid-May 2024, subject to conditions.

title: Indonesia nickel ore prices rebounded | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Indonesia’s nickel ore prices rebounded as rainy-season conditions in Surigao reduced Philippine export volumes, limiting spot availability. Indonesian laterite ore grades rose and downstream smelters face thin inventories and higher purchasing costs. Chinese port nickel ore stocks fell WoW, indicating tighter near-term supply into late March.

title: 10 Stocks Receiving a Massive Vote of Approval From Wall Street Analysts
summary: The article summarizes Wall Street analyst upgrades across various stocks. The only clear industrial-metals link is Southern Copper Corporation (copper miner), upgraded to Buy with a higher price target. While the immediate stock move is modest, the positive analyst tone may buoy short-term expectations for copper.

title: Century Aluminum Stock Rises 8% After Winning U.S. Funding
summary: Century Aluminum shares jumped after the U.S. Energy Department selected the company for up to $500 million to begin negotiations for a new primary aluminum smelter. The project would be the first in 45 years and could double U.S. primary capacity, boosting aluminium-related sentiment.

title: Nickel prices dropped last week because of the waning optimism | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Nickel prices fell last week, with SHFE ending at 134,710 yuan/mt (-5.05% WoW). The selloff is linked to faster Indonesia RKAB approvals easing fears of scarce supply, weak nickel sulphate transactions, and expectations of higher refined output alongside cautious downstream demand.

title: Taseko to become sole owner of Gibraltar copper mine in BC
summary: Taseko said it will buy the remaining 12.5% interest in the Gibraltar copper mine in British Columbia from Dowa Metals & Mining and Furukawa, making Taseko the sole owner. Gibraltar is Canada’s second-largest open-pit copper operation, but the announcement does not mention immediate production changes.

title: Ivanhoe Electric earns into 60% of nickel-copper project in Côte d'Ivoire
summary: Ivanhoe Electric says it has completed its earn-in to acquire a 60% interest in the Samapleu-Grata nickel-copper project in Côte d'Ivoire after meeting the agreed expenditure requirements. The update relates to ownership of a future nickel and copper resource but does not indicate near-term output changes.

title: Aluminum company says preferred site for new smelter is a region of Kentucky hit hard by job losses
summary: Century Aluminum says northeastern Kentucky is its preferred site for a new, lower-emissions primary aluminum smelter. The project could receive $500 million from the U.S. Department of Energy and create about 1,000 permanent jobs. While still pending, it signals potential increased aluminum supply capacity in the U.S. within months.

title: Canada's next big problem could be copper theft. Here's why
summary: Bell Canada warns of increased copper theft targeting telecommunications substations in Ontario, New Brunswick and Quebec. It reports ~1,000 incidents since Jan 2022, mostly theft of copper cables. Bell links theft incentives to world copper prices and calls for stronger laws and recycler controls.

title: Ghana's decades-old ambition to build an integrated aluminium industry faces a new hurdle: the clean energy transition
summary: The article argues Ghana’s effort to build an integrated aluminium industry is being delayed by clean-energy transition uncertainties, power costs, and potential carbon-border charges on exports to Europe. It also highlights constraints on financing green smelting and possible environmental resistance to bauxite mining, clouding aluminium supply prospects.

title: Why are boat owners being urged to switch to aluminium anodes?
summary: UK boat owners and builders are being urged to switch sacrificial anodes from zinc to aluminium. The article cites environmental concerns over zinc (including cadmium) and says aluminium anodes are now cheaper and last longer, implying higher aluminium demand. It also mentions research showing copper contamination signals in sediments.

title: Buy THIS Copper Stock Before Next Week
summary: The piece urges buying a copper-linked stock, citing rising EV and infrastructure demand and possible near-term supply tightening. It points to continuing supply disruptions in Peru and Panama, Chinese copper smelter cuts, and broader support for domestic copper production, implying bullish pressure on copper prices.

title: Will China's Economic Slowdown Stall the Aluminum Price Rally?
summary: The article says aluminum prices are stuck in a sideways trend despite a modest rally to an 11-week high, and questions whether China-linked demand and supply will support further upside. It cites Chinese dry-season output constraints and improved port premiums, but also weak broad demand and eroding aluminum-copper correlations.

title: Aluminum company says preferred site for new smelter is Ky. region hit hard by job losses
summary: Century Aluminum is positioning northeastern Kentucky as the preferred site for a new, lower-emissions primary aluminium smelter, supported by a $500 million DOE grant. The project is expected to create construction and permanent jobs and expand U.S. primary aluminium capacity, boosting near-term sentiment for aluminium markets despite remaining approvals.

title: Aluminum company says preferred site for smelter is region hit hard by job loss
summary: Century Aluminum is considering northeastern Kentucky as the preferred site for a new low-emissions primary aluminum smelter, supported by a $500 million U.S. Department of Energy grant. The plant could add about 1,000 permanent jobs and potentially expand U.S. primary aluminum capacity, supporting aluminum supply/demand expectations despite pending decisions.

title: Planned aluminum smelter will permanently employ 1,000 in rural KY: governor
summary: Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear said Century Aluminum plans a new primary aluminium smelter in northeastern Kentucky, supported by a $500 million DOE grant and aiming to create about 1,000 permanent jobs. The deal is not finalized, but the project’s expected supply expansion and clean-energy design could support near-term aluminium sentiment.

title: Preparing For Copper Price Upside
summary: The piece argues copper’s rally is just beginning, citing China-related supply catalysts. Chinese smelters are reportedly agreeing to cut production amid shortages of raw material, while treatment and refining charges have fallen sharply, indicating concentrate disruptions. Banks like ING, UBS and Macquarie forecast continued supply deficits and rising copper prices.

title: Aluminum company looking to build in Northeast Kentucky
summary: Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear said Century Aluminum is considering building the first new U.S. primary aluminum smelter in 45 years in Northeast Kentucky, supported by up to $500 million from the DOE. The project could add construction and permanent jobs and expand U.S. primary aluminum capacity. Final site is pending.

title: SMM copper market morning comment (Mar 26) | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: LME and SHFE copper prices opened lower but recovered slightly, closing near $8,863/mt and 72,340 yuan/mt. The commentary cites softer US dollar, potential OPEC+ crude output cuts, and higher crude prices as supportive. Copper inventories in China’s mainstream regions fell by 7,700 mt to 387,300 mt, with rigid demand persisting.

title: Indonesia's Antam to start building new nickel smelter, HPAL plant in 2025
summary: Antam, in partnership with CBL, plans to begin construction in 2025 of an RKEF nickel plant and an HPAL plant to produce EV battery feedstock in Indonesia. Feasibility studies are ongoing, including potential use of natural gas instead of coal. The move supports “green nickel” and expands processing capacity plans.

title: Copper near two-week low as yuan weakens
summary: Copper hit its lowest in nearly two weeks as the Chinese yuan weakened, eroding China’s purchasing power for dollar-priced commodities. LME copper also faced pressure from higher LME-approved inventories. The move coincided with softer prices in nickel and aluminium-related signals, reinforcing bearish near-term base-metal sentiment.

title: Xanadu sets sights on Mongolian copper-gold at Red Mountain
summary: Xanadu Mines has started a 5,000m diamond drilling program at Mongolia’s Red Mountain, targeting shallow high-grade gold and porphyry copper-gold and copper sulphide lodes. Prior assays included significant copper grades, and new holes are planned for copper-rich prospects. The update is copper-positive for sentiment but not production-related.

title: KEFI Gold and Copper : GM Statement -March 26, 2024 at 03:24 am EDT
summary: KEFI Gold and Copper updates shareholders on progress toward financing approvals for the Tulu Kapi project in Ethiopia and development/feasibility work for copper-gold projects in Saudi Arabia (GMCO). It outlines approvals, next steps, and planned procurement and resettlement, but provides no near-term copper output changes.

title: Indonesia's Antam will start construction of a new nickel smelter, HPAL, in 2025
summary: Indonesia’s Antam plans to start construction in 2025 of two nickel processing facilities, including RKEF to make nickel matte and HPAL to extract battery materials from nickel ores. Feasibility work is ongoing, with Antam considering natural-gas power for HPAL, subject to economic viability.

title: Aston Bay Holdings Ltd: Aston Bay and American West Metals Announce Geophysical Program Set to Begin at the Storm Copper Project, Canada
summary: Aston Bay and American West announced a 2024 geophysical program at the Storm Copper Project in Nunavut, using high-powered moving loop EM and planned RC drilling to generate new copper drill targets near surface (0–200m) and at depth (200–500m) across multiple prospects. No production or market-impacting changes were announced.

title: Pampa Metals Corp.: Pampa Metals Intersects Wide Interval of Copper Mineralization with Bornite Rich Core in Second Drillhole at Piuquenes, San Juan Province, Argentina
summary: Pampa Metals reported completion of diamond drillhole PIU-02 at its Piuquenes copper-gold project in Argentina, intersecting supergene copper enrichment and primary copper sulphides (including bornite-rich mineralization) to 870m. Assays are pending. The update may marginally support copper sentiment but does not alter near-term supply materially.

title: Prismo Metals Assays up to 5.69% Copper at the Hot Breccia Project in the Arizona Copper Belt
summary: Prismo Metals reported February assay results from its Hot Breccia Project in Arizona’s copper belt, including a sample assaying 5.69% copper. The company interprets the results as evidence of a potential porphyry-skarn copper system at depth, but provides no near-term production impact.

title: Tartisan Nickel Corp. Retains Northwest Solutions Inc. to Complete the Kenbridge Nickel Project All-Season Access Road; Names Gregory Edwards as First Nations Liaison
summary: Tartisan Nickel Corp. hired Northwest Solutions to complete design, permitting, and management for an all-season access road for its Kenbridge Nickel Project, alongside Indigenous community liaison efforts and internal finance/communications support. The release flags 2024 permitting and baseline-study work, but provides no production or supply-volume change for nickel.

title: Nine Mile Metals Announces Certified Assays of 0.44% Copper over 136.31m in Drill Hole WD-24-02, Including 1.32% Cu - 8.84 g/t Ag over 40m, at the Wedge Mine, Bathurst, New Brunswick
summary: Nine Mile Metals announced certified assays from drill hole WD-24-02 at the Wedge Mine, reporting 0.44% copper over 136.31m and a main copper zone assaying up to 1.32% Cu (including 2.03% Cu over 15.4m). Results confirm a larger VMS system; no immediate production changes.

title: Northstar Commences EM Surveys Targeting Cam Copper VMS Extensions at Miller Copper-Gold Property
summary: Northstar Gold began surface and borehole EM surveys at its Miller property Cam Copper Mine area, targeting extensions of high-grade Besshi-type VMS copper mineralization across a 900-metre strike length. It follows prior drilling that intersected massive chalcopyrite with copper grades up to 14.8% over 2.45 metres.

title: Century Aluminum secures $500m US DOE boost for new smelter
summary: The US DOE has selected Century Aluminum for negotiations on up to $500m in funding to build a new “green” primary aluminium smelter. Backed by US infrastructure/IRA programs, the project aims to expand domestic aluminium capacity and supply chains, potentially supporting aluminium prices via improved supply outlook and investment sentiment.

title: Kenorland Announces Manitoba Mineral Development Grant at the South Thompson Nickel Project
summary: Kenorland Minerals received a $300,000 Manitoba Mineral Development Fund grant to support exploration at its South Thompson Nickel Project, including a large-scale VTEM survey to identify drill targets. The release highlights nickel belt geology and historical results, but no near-term production impacts or supply disruptions.

title: Kenorland Minerals Ltd.: Kenorland Announces Manitoba Mineral Development Grant at the South Thompson Nickel Project
summary: Kenorland Minerals received a $300,000 Manitoba Mineral Development Fund grant to advance exploration at its South Thompson nickel project, including a large-scale VTEM electromagnetic survey to find drill targets. The announcement improves nickel exploration activity, but it is early-stage and unlikely to affect near-term nickel supply expectations.

title: US aluminium, copper industries to receive $900 mln from Energy Department program to cut emissions
summary: The US Department of Energy will fund five-plus industrial decarbonization projects with $900 million targeting aluminium producers and recyclers, including low-carbon smelting and advanced zero-waste recycling, plus a large Advanced Copper Recycling Facility. The subsidies may support supply expectations by boosting capacity and recyclate output.

title: US aluminium, copper industries to receive $900 mln from Energy Department program to cut emissions
summary: The US Department of Energy will provide $900 million under an industrial decarbonization program for low-emissions aluminium smelting/casting and advanced aluminium recycling, plus a large expansion of copper recycling into high-purity output. The subsidies aim to boost competitiveness and reduce emissions, supporting expectations for metal supply and scrap recovery.

title: Pampa Metals Intersects Wide Interval of Copper Mineralization with Bornite Rich Core in Second Drillhole at Piuquenes, San Juan Province, Argentina
summary: Pampa Metals says a second drillhole at its Piuquenes project in San Juan Province, Argentina intersected a wide interval of copper mineralization with a bornite-rich core. The update is a positive exploration development that may lift market sentiment toward future copper supply from the project.

title: Michigan Strategic Fund Approves $50 Million Grant for Highland Copper's Copperwood Project
summary: Michigan Strategic Fund approved a $50 million performance-based grant to Highland Copper for its Copperwood copper project, pending final state appropriations. Funds will reimburse infrastructure work such as roads, communications and bringing power to the site, potentially improving project momentum for future domestic copper supply.

title: Copper Exploration in South America in 2024: Solaris Resources (TSX:SLS), Freeport McMoRan, Lundin Mining
summary: The article discusses copper exploration and production updates in South America. Freeport’s Cerro Verde faces lower 2024 copper sales due to grades and recoveries. Lundin highlights stable copper guidance and higher recoveries at Chapada. Solaris receives Zijin financing to advance its Warintza project, supporting future expansion.

title: Century Aluminum to build green aluminium smelter in the US with DOE grant
summary: Century Aluminum won a US DOE grant under the Industrial Demonstrations Program to build a green primary aluminium smelter in Ohio/Mississippi River Basins. The company claims it could double US primary capacity. Support highlights high energy-cost-driven curtailments, but no near-term commissioning timeline is provided.

title: Copper concentrate market participants lost amid 'unstoppable' declines in TC/RCs
summary: Fastmarkets reports copper concentrate TC/RCs for cif Asia Pacific at a new all-time low ($5.90/tonne), down sharply from prior levels, after mine disruptions such as Frist Quantum’s Cobre Panama closure. Participants expect further declines, potential smelter rate cuts, and tighter concentrate supply, including risk of reduced Indonesian exports.

title: Copperwood Resources gets $50 million grant from state for Copperwood Mine
summary: Michigan approved a $50 million grant to Copperwood Resources (Highland Copper) to build the Copperwood Mine, a $425 million project. Backers cite jobs and “critical material” supply benefits, while environmentalists criticize potential damage. The development funding supports future copper supply expectations, modestly supportive for copper sentiment.

title: Coppernico Metals Inc.: Coppernico Receives Main Permit to Commence Drilling Activities at its Sombrero Project in Peru
summary: Coppernico Metals said its Peruvian subsidiary received the start-of-activities permit to commence drilling at the Sombrero copper-gold project in Ayacucho, Peru, with only a water permit expected next. Drilling plans are contingent on financing and listing, aiming to test multiple copper targets within the permitted area.

title: SMM Nickel Market Morning Comment Fully (Mar 27) | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM’s morning nickel comment reports SHFE nickel weakening and expects continued mild decline. It attributes softer raw-material tightness to faster nickel-ore approvals and ramping Indonesian intermediate output, while downstream spot buying recovered only because prices fell sharply. Overall, it forecasts weak nickel price fluctuations.

title: China's monthly alumina import and export data in February 2024 | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China exported 139,200 mt of alumina in February 2024 while importing 292,200 mt, leaving net imports of about 153,000 mt. Alumina trade can affect near-term aluminium smelting economics, but the article only presents customs figures without linking them to cost, inventories, or policy-driven disruptions.

title: Copperwood Mine project gets $50M in state grant funding for site preparations
summary: Michigan approved a $50 million state grant from the Michigan Strategic Fund to prepare the site for Highland Copper’s Copperwood mine in Gogebic County. While full operations are projected for 2027, the funding supports near-term development, improving perceived future copper supply prospects.

title: Indonesian copper miner Amman targets higher concentrate output of 833,000 dmt in 2024
summary: Indonesia’s PT Amman Mineral Internasional says it targets 833,000 dmt of copper concentrate in 2024, up about 54% from 2023, supported by high-grade ore from its Batu Hijau Phase 7. Rainfall had previously reduced 2023 production and sales by 32%, indicating recovery.

title: Indonesian miner Amman asks for copper export ban delay
summary: Indonesian miner Amman is asking the government to delay/relax a planned June export ban on copper concentrate, arguing smelter progress and tax reliance. The government aims to push domestic smelting, but Freeport warned it may cut output if no leniency is granted. Amman is expanding storage to keep mining.

title: The Michigan Strategic Fund Board approves funds for Copperwood Mining Project in Gogebic County
summary: Michigan Strategic Fund approved a $50 million infrastructure readiness grant for Highland Copper’s Copperwood project in Gogebic County. Funding aims to support long-lived roads/utilities for the planned copper mine. Proponents cite jobs and development; opponents raise environmental concerns. Grant approval pending final legislative committee approval.

title: Copper Fox Commences Hydrogeology Data Collection at Van Dyke Copper Project
summary: Copper Fox began hydrogeology data collection at its 100% owned Van Dyke in-situ copper recovery project in Arizona, installing monitoring stations and continuing lab work to support an updated hydrogeological model for permitting. Water quality and formational water chemistry reportedly fall below regulator thresholds.

title: Copper touches two-week low, awaits clarity on smelter cuts
summary: Copper prices fell to a two-week low as markets waited for details from upcoming Chinese smelter meetings on production cuts. Recent gains had looked overbought. Uncertainty over cut timing and expectations of 3% higher China output, plus seasonal inventory buildup and a wider LME cash discount, weighed on sentiment.

title: Michigan approves $50m funding for Copperwood Project
summary: Michigan approved $50m in performance-based funding from the Strategic Outreach and Attraction Reserve Fund for Highland Copper’s Copperwood Project. The grant supports site preparation and infrastructure such as roads, communications, and power delivery. The state views the project as a future US domestic copper source for clean energy, boosting near-term copper sentiment.

title: Exclusive-First Quantum execs discuss investment, disputed copper with Chinese officials
summary: First Quantum executives discussed investment and a dispute involving Chinese buyer Jiangxi Copper, including the possibility Jiangxi could gain board influence and buy disputed copper concentrate inventory. Jiangxi has invested heavily in First Quantum and is a major Chinese copper producer/smelter facing feedstock shortages.

title: A new aluminum smelter could be coming to northeastern Kentucky
summary: Kentucky officials say the U.S. Department of Energy awarded Century Aluminum $500 million to build a new primary aluminum smelter in northeastern Kentucky, potentially doubling U.S. primary capacity while using carbon-free electricity. The project location and funding are subject to change during negotiations.

title: Copper 360 and DRD Gold subsidiary consider joint venture
summary: Copper 360 signed a 12-month MoU with Far West Gold Recoveries to assess the economic viability of treating copper tailings at multiple O’Kiep-area dams. The company estimates 50–60 million tonnes of material and up to 450,000 tonnes of copper in situ. A JV could follow if results are favorable.

title: TNC to restart mining at Cloncurry Copper Project in Q4 FY2024
summary: True North Copper plans to restart mining at its Cloncurry Copper Project in Queensland in early Q4 FY2024, beginning at the Wallace North site. The company will build ore stockpiles, start haulage mid-May 2024, and process oxide via heap leach and sulphide via toll milling. Ramp-up increases over three months.

title: Five copper plays amid supply-driven price surge
summary: Copper prices surged early March, and the article links the move to supply failing to keep up with demand. It cites low Chinese TC/RCs cutting refined output, smelter maintenance and production cuts, and disruptions from major mines and project delays. It also expects Fed rate cuts to weaken the dollar and boost copper further.

title: Copper wire theft at Edmonton rail yard pegged at $10K; four charged
summary: Edmonton police arrested three men and seek a fourth after nearly $10,000 worth of copper wire was stolen from a Canadian National Railway storage yard. Police say thieves cut fencing to access the yard. Authorities note theft disrupts local infrastructure projects, but the reported losses appear limited.

title: Nickel Prices Expected to Drop Further in 2024
summary: The article argues nickel prices are likely to drop further in 2024. It cites forecasts of a continued global surplus supported by higher Indonesian production and expanding China refining capacity, which previously drove nickel to multi-year lows. Potential output cuts are mentioned, but the overall market outlook remains bearish.

title: Refined Nickel Production Review & Forecast  | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s February refined nickel output was 24,600 mt (-3% MoM, +42% YoY) with operating rates still high. March production is estimated to rise to 25,000 mt (+1.6% MoM), supported by sustained nickel price gains, though higher raw-material costs and weaker domestic spot demand limited feedstock availability. Import clearances declined.

title: Aluminum Corporation of China Net Profit Rose on Cost Savings, Higher Other Income
summary: Chalco reported 2023 net income up 60% due to cost savings and higher other income, but revenue fell 22.7% mainly because alumina selling prices declined. The firm cautioned that sluggish global growth and insufficient effective demand could raise uncertainty for commodity prices. No specific disruption or policy change was cited.

title: New Orleans copper thieves prompt 100 overpass light outages, city says
summary: New Orleans officials report copper thieves stripping streetlight wiring, causing outages and lengthy repair backlogs. The city is considering new infrastructure plans, including switching to lower-incentive materials such as aluminum, similar to Minneapolis. The coverage is municipal and likely has limited near-term impact on global copper or aluminum prices.

title: Indonesia's Merdeka Copper Gold targets Tujuh Bukit gold mine output of 100,000-120,000 ounces this year
summary: Merdeka Copper Gold said it targets 14,000–16,000 metric tons of copper from the Wetar mine and 85,000–92,000 tons of nickel in nickel pig iron plus up to 55,000 tons of nickel in matte this year. These output forecasts are disclosed without any immediate disruption or policy change.

title: Adaro's KIPI aluminium smelter ramps up for full production by early 2026
summary: Adaro Minerals plans to start aluminium ingot production at its KIPI smelter in Indonesia, targeting 250,000 tonnes by Q3 this year and full production by early 2026. The US$2 billion project will sell to domestic and export markets, supported by efforts to secure continuous electricity supply.

title: Jiangxi Copper Sees Higher Prices as It Plans to Raise Output
summary: The piece’s headline states that Jiangxi Copper is seeing higher prices as it plans to raise output. That suggests the company’s pricing outlook has improved and near-term production plans could influence expectations for copper supply and demand over the coming weeks.

title: Business News | Celebrating Two Years: Jindal Aluminium's Rs 400 Crore Investment Spurs Growth, Creates More Than 1000 Jobs
summary: Jindal Aluminium marks two years since starting Bhiwadi operations, detailing an additional Rs 300 crore investment and the ramp-up of a newly acquired plant. The company says extrusion capacity rose by 40% and monthly production reached higher engineered aluminium volumes, supported by added foundry and finishing facilities. Quotes cite rising engineered aluminium demand.

title: Celebrating Two Years: Jindal Aluminium's INR 400 Crore Investment Spurs Growth, Creates More Than 1000 Jobs
summary: Jindal Aluminium announced two years of operations at its Bhiwadi facility and a further INR 300 crore investment after acquiring assets. It says production began in January 2022 and expanded extrusion capacity by about 40%, with engineered aluminium output rising as new foundry and downstream equipment came online.

title: True North Copper to commence mining at Cloncurry Project | The North West Star
summary: True North Copper says it will commence mining ore at its Cloncurry Copper Project (Wallace North) in early Q4 FY24, after monsoonal weather delays. The ramp-up will build ore stockpiles, with haulage expected mid-May 2024. Oxide ore goes to heap leach; sulphide to Glencore toll milling.

title: Adani starts USD 1.2 bn copper plant; to boost India's metal production
summary: Adani’s Kutch Copper began operations at its $1.2bn Mundra, Gujarat greenfield refinery/smelter, dispatching the first batch of copper cathodes. Phase I targets 0.5 Mtpa refined copper with full 1 Mtpa expected by FY29, aiming to reduce India’s copper imports and boost local supply.

title: Adani's Mundra Copper Unit commences operations, paving the way for sustainable growth
summary: Adani’s Mundra copper refinery unit has begun operations, with maiden dispatches of copper cathodes to customers following commissioning of a greenfield project. The first phase targets 0.5 MTPA, with plans to scale in a second phase. Article also highlights ESG and India’s growing copper demand drivers.

title: Adani starts $1.2 billion copper plant
summary: Adani Group’s Kutch Copper in Mundra, Gujarat has commissioned the first phase of a $1.2 billion greenfield copper refinery, dispatching maiden cathodes and targeting 500,000 tonnes of refined copper annually. The project aims to cut India’s import dependence and supports energy-transition copper demand growth.

title: Freeport warns copper export ban could cost Indonesia $2 billion in lost revenue
summary: Indonesia’s copper export ban begins in June to push miners to use domestic smelters. Freeport Indonesia says its Gresik smelter won’t reach full capacity by then and warns an export freeze would cut production and reduce state revenues by about $2 billion. It negotiates a delay/relaxation with the government.

title: Adani's copper unit in Mundra begins operations, to generate 7,000 jobs
summary: Adani’s Kutch Copper commissioned the first unit of its Mundra greenfield copper refinery/smelter and dispatched an initial batch of cathodes to customers. The $1.2 billion project targets 0.5 MTPA in the first phase, with plans to expand. The company links copper demand to EVs, renewables, and grid investment.

title: Copper rises amid output cut update, China data
summary: Copper prices rose as top Chinese smelters agreed on plans for a 5%-10% production cut due to tight raw-material supply. China’s industrial profit improvement and a stronger yuan fixing supported buyer purchasing power, though copper gains were partly capped by inventory build-ups. Aluminium and nickel also edged higher.

title: India to send teams to Chile seeking lithium and copper assets, source says
summary: India will send delegations to Chile in April to scout for lithium and copper resources and to facilitate asset purchases. Chile is the top copper supplier and a major lithium producer. The move reflects India’s push for energy-transition minerals, potentially tightening near-term copper expectations, with only indirect relevance to aluminium.

title: UAE's IRH plans bid for stake in Zambia's Lubambe copper mine
summary: IRH, after buying a 51% stake in Zambia’s Mopani Copper Mines, said it intends to bid for an 80% stake in the Lubambe Copper Mine. The planned transaction follows a report that JCHX Mining agreed to buy the stake, signaling potential further copper investment in Zambia.

title: Copperwood Mine Project grant OK'd | News, Sports, Jobs
summary: Michigan’s Strategic Fund Board approved a $50 million performance-based grant to Copperwood Resources/Highland Copper for construction of the Copperwood underground copper mine. The project is projected to produce concentrate via milling and flotation and has strong local support, though opponents cite environmental concerns.

title: Overview of the output of the world's top ten copper ore producing countries in 2023
summary: The article reviews 2023 copper supply/output by major producing countries and notes a global refined copper supply shortage (WBMS/ICSG). It highlights production drops in Chile (incl. Codelco) and the U.S., while also referencing expectations that 2024 may remain tight due to reduced mine supply.

title: C3 Metals Inc.: C3 Metals Jamaica Copper-Gold Exploration Update and Discovery Targets
summary: C3 Metals reported continued drilling at its Bellas Gate copper-gold project in Jamaica, including long intercepts and expanded altered/mineralized footprint at the Provost porphyry prospect. The company is testing multiple targets with two rigs and awaiting assays for additional holes. Impact on near-term copper prices is likely limited.

title: Aldebaran Resources Inc.: Aldebaran Expands Known Mineralization at the Altar Copper-Gold Project
summary: Aldebaran reported drill-hole results from the Altar copper-gold project in Argentina, extending the known mineralized footprint and converting some near-surface rock from waste to mineralization. All holes intersected copper-bearing mineralization (reported as CuEq). The update supports a future resource revision but does not change near-term production.

title: India Looks to Buy Lithium and Copper Assets in Top Producer Chile
summary: India is sending a delegation to Chile, a leading copper and lithium producer, to explore acquisitions of overseas assets to bolster its energy-transition supply. The move is part of India’s broader strategy to secure critical minerals abroad. The article does not specify deal volumes, limiting short-term price pressure.

title: Adani's copper unit in Mundra begins operations
summary: Adani’s Kutch Copper commissioned the first unit of its Mundra greenfield copper refinery/smelter and dispatched its maiden cathode batch to customers. Adani is investing about $1.2bn for initial capacity, with further expansion planned. The move signals ramp-up of domestic copper supply and integration into downstream products.

title: Explaining the copper conundrum - The Northern Miner
summary: The Northern Miner explains the “copper conundrum,” noting that copper miners themselves are aware of a potential shortage. It highlights a prior warning from Glencore’s CEO and links the discussion to major projects, implying tighter supply expectations that could buoy copper prices in the near term.

title: Santo Tomas Copper Project, Mexico
summary: The Santo Tomás project in northern Sinaloa, Mexico is being developed as an open-pit copper mine by Oroco Resource. The PEA targets average output of about 292 million pounds of copper per year over the first five years of full production, with phased mining and flotation-based concentrate processing.

title: Europacific Metals Inc.: EuroPacific Announces Hiring of Drill Contractors for Miguel Vacas Copper Project, Portugal
summary: Europacific Metals announced drilling contractors for its Miguel Vacas copper project in Portugal, with work scheduled to start in early April. The program will confirm extensions and quality of an oxidized copper blanket for potential open-pit heap leaching and refine an initial resource estimate. No production changes are stated.

title: IRH, Jubilee Metals set up JV for Zambia copper recovery project
summary: IRH has moved ahead with a JV with Jubilee Metals to process over 260mt of copper-containing waste rock in Zambia, targeting production of more than 20,000t of copper concentrate annually from Q2 2024. The project adds modular plant capacity at Roan and supports higher copper output expectations.

title: EV Nickel Announces Closing of $5.12 Million Flow-Through Financing
summary: EV Nickel Inc. announced it closed a $5.12 million flow-through financing, raising funds to develop its Shaw Dome nickel exploration assets in Ontario. The proceeds are earmarked for eligible Canadian exploration and “critical mineral” expenditures. The release does not indicate immediate production changes or supply disruption impacting near-term nickel prices.

title: Koryx Copper Closed a Non-Brokered Private Placement Totaling $1,505,250
summary: Koryx Copper closed a C$1.505 million non-brokered private placement, issuing units with warrants, and plans to use proceeds for further exploration at its Namibia and Zambia copper projects plus general working capital. No production, mine restart, or near-term supply change is mentioned.

title: EuroPacific Announces Hiring of Drill Contractors for Miguel Vacas Copper Project, Portugal
summary: EuroPacific said it is hiring drill contractors for the Miguel Vacas copper project in Portugal. The move suggests increased development activity at the mine site, improving expectations for project progress and future copper supply. This is unlikely to change output immediately, but can be mildly supportive for copper prices.

title: Europacific Metals Inc. Announces Commencement of Drilling At the Miguel Vacas Copper Project
summary: Europacific Metals announced the immediate start of a drilling program at its Miguel Vacas advanced copper project in Portugal, including 11 shallow holes and one deeper undercut hole to confirm prior results and evaluate oxidation and sulphide potential. Authorizations are cleared, with drilling scheduled for early April 2024.

title: Large reward offered for information on recent copper thefts
summary: Antero Resources is offering a $3,500 reward for information leading to arrests over recent copper thefts from its well pads in multiple West Virginia counties. The sheriff’s office says several thefts occurred, potentially disrupting local copper handling, but the article gives no volume or market-wide implications.

title: Shanghai copper heads for biggest monthly gain in 16 months
summary: Shanghai copper prices were steady but set for their biggest monthly gain in 16 months as copper smelters agreed to curb output amid shortages of ore and concentrate. The piece notes stronger base-metal sentiment, with aluminium and nickel also rising, consistent with expectations of tighter supply.

title: [SMM Nickel Spot Market Midday Review] [Shanghai nickel continues its downward trend
summary: SMM reports Shanghai nickel continues falling in early trading. JinChuan’s premium rose to 2,700-3,000 yuan/ton, while Russian nickel remains at a discount (-500 to 0). Trading is steadier as downstream buying recovers, but SMM says nickel plate arrivals lift supply this week. Nickel bean prices fall.

title: Nickel price decline triggers bearish sentiment in the nickel sulfate market, with supply and demand tensions temporarily unchanged as transaction prices remain stable.
summary: Battery-grade nickel sulfate is trading at 30,500–31,000 yuan/ton, with average prices unchanged. Nickel price fluctuations have weakened downstream psychological procurement levels. Inquiry activity is slightly softer and precursor procurement is nearing completion by mid-April, but temporary nickel sulfate supply-demand tensions are unchanged, keeping transaction prices stable.

title: Crews prioritize major streets hit by copper thieves, some locations become repeat targets
summary: Clark County in Las Vegas is rushing repairs after repeat streetlight copper thefts on major thoroughfares like Lamb Road and around Bonanza and Mt. Hood. Officials plan changes including using aluminum wire instead of copper and altering placement and power systems. They also plan a regional copper-theft task force.

title: US talks often with Congo's Gecamines on cobalt and copper, official says
summary: The U.S. State Department says it regularly talks with Congo’s Gecamines on supply deals and potential new mines/projects. A prior Mineral Security Partnership agreement with Gecamines helped spur investment, reflecting efforts to diversify critical mineral supply chains. The focus and context are directly tied to copper supply.

title: Adani starts operations at $1.2bn copper plant in Gujarat, India
summary: Adani’s subsidiary Kutch Copper has begun the first phase of a $1.2bn copper smelter in Mundra, Gujarat, targeting 0.5 million tonnes per year of refined copper with plans to scale to 1Mt by FY29. The project is expected to reduce India’s copper import dependence and support the energy transition.

title: Indonesia to Quadruple Battery-Grade Nickel Output by 2030
summary: Indonesia plans to quadruple battery-grade nickel production by 2030 while also increasing nickel output for stainless steel. The push comes even as nickel prices have declined due to ample supply and slowing EV demand, leading some miners to shut operations or consider cutbacks.

title: Shanghai copper closed higher and recorded its largest monthly gain in 16 months.
summary: Shanghai copper closed higher, with a 5.4% monthly gain, the strongest in 16 months. Chinese smelters agreed to cut output due to shortages of copper ore and concentrates. Codelco reported lower profits and the lowest production in 25 years, reinforcing supply-tightness expectations despite higher Chilean output.

title: Russia's Nornickel: Some EU clients refuse to buy produce made of Russian metal - 2024-03-29
summary: Nornickel said some EU clients refuse to buy products made with Russian metals, citing voluntary self-sanctions, along with banks avoiding Russian payments and difficulties with ports, shipping and insurance. The company’s Finnish unit was affected. Nornickel expects lower nickel output, potentially tightening near-term nickel supply.

title: [Indonesia Sticks to Nickel Production Expansion Plan, Competitors Forced to Shut Down Mines]
summary: Indonesia plans to proceed with nickel production expansion even as oversupply forces competitors to shut mines. The deputy minister targets higher battery-grade nickel and nickel pig iron capacity by 2030 and in the next three years. With nickel prices down 30% amid rising Indonesian supply, industry players warn low-cost output could crush rivals.

title: Apache group wants to protect Oak Flat from proposed copper mine
summary: Apache Stronghold is appealing a 9th Circuit decision that allowed the Resolution Copper project near Oak Flat to proceed, arguing it violates religious protections. The proposal is a large open-pit copper mine. Legal uncertainty and potential delays to production prospects could affect short-term copper supply expectations.

title: Montana Supreme Court hears arguments over copper mine's water use
summary: Montana Supreme Court arguments center on whether the planned Black Butte Copper Mine’s proposed groundwater use meets the state’s “beneficial use” requirement. Conservationists argue the permit should cover the mine’s total intended water, while the operator says stored/returned water isn’t “used.” The outcome may affect project timing.

title: Reward offered in multi-county copper thefts
summary: Antero Resources is offering a $3,500 reward after copper thefts from its West Virginia facilities in several counties. Officials say about 200 feet of copper were taken from five locations in Ritchie County. Copper is valued at roughly $3 per pound as salvage, but the amount is likely too small to move copper prices.

title: Supreme Court hears arguments on water permits for copper mine near Smith River
summary: The Supreme Court is hearing arguments regarding water permits for a copper mine near Smith River. Decisions affecting water access can delay or constrain mine operations, altering near-term copper supply expectations. This typically supports copper prices as markets price potential operational disruptions and tighter availability.

title: Two to appear in Zeerust court for alleged theft of copper cables - SABC News - Breaking news, special reports, world, business, sport coverage of all South African current events. Africa's news leader.
summary: Two men are set to appear in Zeerust Magistrates’ Court for alleged theft and possession of copper cables. Police stopped a vehicle on the R49 near Lekubu village and found copper cables worth about R600,000–R650,000. Investigations linked the cables to an earlier theft case.

title: Russia's Nornickel: Some EU clients refuse to buy products made of Russian metal - 2024-03-30
summary: Nornickel said some EU clients are refusing to buy products made with Russian metals, including battery materials from its Harjavalta plant. The company faces payment, port, shipping, and insurance constraints and now expects nickel output to fall in 2024, indicating weaker near-term flows affecting nickel demand expectations.

title: Indonesia vows to speed up nickel output despite global glut
summary: Indonesia said it will continue expanding nickel production despite a global supply glut that has already pushed competitors to shut mines. The government expects battery-grade nickel capacity to reach 1 million tonnes by 2030 and nickel pig iron to rise modestly, which implies continued supply pressure and likely downside pricing for nickel.

title: French 'nickel pact' to bail out New Caledonia's industry delayed
summary: France’s promised “nickel pact” to rescue New Caledonia’s nickel industry will not be signed by late March and awaits Congress endorsement. The aid follows a downturn driven by low global nickel prices and cheaper Indonesian dominance, but reforms and cost-cutting are required, adding near-term uncertainty.

title: Copper climbs on positive China industrial data
summary: Copper futures rose in early April after China’s manufacturing activity expanded in March for the first time in six months, supporting demand expectations. LME copper climbed, while LME aluminium rose and nickel also edged higher. Investors further watched expectations for Fed rate cuts in June.

title: SMM nickel market morning comment fully (Apr 1) | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM’s nickel market comment says nickel prices stayed around 130,000 yuan/mt but continued a weekly downward trend, influenced by US macro and a stronger dollar amid delayed rate cuts. Spot pure nickel remained relatively strong, yet downstream buying softened and cost support weakened as nickel sulfate economics normalized.

title: Indonesia to reportedly ratchet up nickel production despite supply glut that is killing WA miners
summary: The West Australian reports that Indonesia is likely to increase nickel production even as a supply glut is already pressuring the market and damaging Western Australian nickel miners. Extra Indonesian output would add to oversupply expectations, weighing on nickel prices in the coming days to weeks.

title: Aluminium giant warns of relatively high risks associated with bauxite supplies from Guinea
summary: Chalco warned that bauxite supplies from Guinea carry relatively high risks, noting Guinea provided about 70% of China’s bauxite imports. The company cited vulnerabilities to strikes and policy changes, while China’s declining domestic output increases dependence on Guinea. Any disruption or tighter supply could lift near-term aluminium price expectations.

title: Weak supply and demand to prevent aluminum prices from going up | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM discusses aluminium fundamentals: Yunnan smelters resuming (over 500k mt by end-April) while other capacity stays constrained by drought and power limits. Costs eased slightly as alumina fell, but bonded inventories rose and spot transactions were sluggish. With weak processing fees and steady demand, aluminium prices are expected to trade sideways, limiting upside.

title: Japan, U.S., Philippines to build supply chain for nickel, Nikkei says
summary: Japan, the U.S. and the Philippines plan to announce cooperation on building a nickel supply chain after a summit on April 11, according to Nikkei. Nickel is a key input for electric-vehicle batteries. The initiative may improve supply expectations, providing modest near-term support to nickel prices.

title: Austria's RHI Magnesita to buy US-based alumina producer Resco
summary: RHI Magnesita plans to buy U.S. alumina producer Resco for up to $430 million, expanding alumina-based refractories supply for U.S. customers. The acquisition will restructure the combined supply chain over about two years with €60 million one-time costs, subject to merger approval.

title: 【SMM Daily Review: Weak Market Sentiment at the Beginning of the Month Puts Pressure on Nickel Pig Iron Prices】
summary: SMM reports 8–12% high nickel pig iron at 930 yuan per nickel point on April 1, down 1.5 versus the prior day. Despite faster nickel ore quota approvals, output is still expected low. With Qingming holiday and weak stainless demand, stocks are building and prices are expected to stay weak.

title: The long and short sides are in a wait-and-see trend, and nickel prices fluctuate to close [SMM Nickel Brief Comment]
summary: SMM’s April 1 brief reports Shanghai nickel main contract trading with a lower opening dip (to 129,050 yuan/ton) before recovery and a modest day close at 131,600 yuan/ton (+0.91%). Volume and open interest fell, indicating both longs and shorts reduced positions and the market remained cautious.

title: LME aluminium price: Low carbon aluminum fetches green premium, says Capral chief executive Tony Dragicevich
summary: Capral’s CEO says low/zero-carbon aluminium can command a ~5% “green premium,” which may support aluminium prices. Separately, the resources minister links EU sustainability pricing pressure to a backdrop of Indonesian glut driving down nickel and forcing mine closures, creating bearish momentum for nickel despite aluminium optimism.

title: Copper climbs on China demand, raw material supply concerns
summary: Copper prices rose as China demand outlook improved and fears of tighter raw material supply, particularly copper concentrate, emerged. LME three-month copper climbed 1.1% and SHFE May copper rose as manufacturing activity strengthened. Aluminium and nickel also edged higher, while macro worries over Fed rate cuts weighed on yields.

title: SMM Nickel Market Morning Comment Fully (Apr 2) | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports the SHFE nickel contract closed higher but spot trades weakened overall. It attributes soft sentiment to rising this-week nickel supply from increased overseas nickel plate arrivals and lower nickel-bean prices. Nickel sulfate demand inquiry is still moderate, while ferronickel remains weak due to deadlock demand.

title: Hindalco shares soar: India puts Thailand's aluminium imports under scrutiny
summary: India’s DGTR is conducting a mid-term review that could lead to increased anti-dumping duties on aluminium foil imports from Thailand. The move aims to protect domestic manufacturers such as Hindalco, and investors reacted positively, implying reduced import inflows may support aluminium prices over the coming weeks.

title: Copper Rises on Nascent Optimism Over Outlook for China Economy
summary: Copper prices are reported to be rising as investors express nascent optimism about the outlook for the Chinese economy. The market takeaway is improved near-term industrial demand expectations, which tends to support copper buying and lift prices over coming days.

title: In the Trough of Nickel Cycle: Value Regress Perceived in Lygend Resources (2245.HK)
summary: The piece discusses the 2023 nickel downturn and profit impairments at miners/traders, but highlights signs of a bottoming process. It notes Shanghai nickel futures rising over 10% since late January and expects improving supply-demand, supported by stainless steel production growth and rising NEV/HPAL nickel sulfate demand.

title: Copper lifted by supply concerns, better demand prospects
summary: Reuters reports copper rose after a long weekend as concerns over tighter raw-material (copper concentrate) supplies led Chinese smelters to cut production and bring maintenance forward. An improved China manufacturing outlook and a seasonal demand pickup further supported sentiment, offsetting subdued holiday trading. LME aluminium edged lower while nickel rose.

title: In the Trough of Nickel Cycle: Value Regress -2-
summary: The piece discusses nickel prices staying low in 2023 amid global oversupply and Fed-driven dollar strength, citing large profit declines for miners and nickel producers. It notes a recent rise in Shanghai nickel futures since late January and argues for marginal bottoming support from improving demand (stainless steel, NEVs).

title: Hyundai Motor ends Indonesia aluminium deal after climate campaign by K-pop fans | The Asahi Shimbun: Breaking News, Japan News and Analysis
summary: Hyundai Motor ended a non-binding aluminum supply memorandum with Indonesia’s Adaro Minerals after a climate campaign by K-pop fans urged the automaker to stop buying aluminium produced with coal power. The companies chose not to renew after expiry, and Hyundai said it would explore other opportunities independently.

title: Robust Chinese manufacturing data boosts copper
summary: Copper rose to a more-than-week high on expectations of stronger demand from China’s improved manufacturing activity and production cuts by top smelters due to raw-material shortages and low refining fees. Aluminium also climbed to a three-month peak as funds bought, supported by higher Japanese premiums. Strong dollar capped gains.

title: Harita Nickel books Rp 5.61t in profit in 2023 despite headwinds - Companies
summary: Harita Nickel (Trimegah Bangun Persada) reported Rp 5.61 trillion net profit in 2023, up 20.4% y/y, citing increased revenue, operational efficiency, and higher nickel processing and mining revenue. Management noted headwinds from falling nickel prices but highlighted production optimization on Obi Island.

title: Azimut and KGHM Discover Nickel-Copper-PGE Mineralization on the Kukamas Property, James Bay Region, Quebec
summary: Azimut and KGHM report 2023 exploration at the Kukamas Property, including a newly discovered amphibolite-hosted nickel-copper-PGE showing with up to 1.36% Ni and 0.12% Cu in grab samples. The target remains untested by drilling, and a partner-funded follow-up program is planned for 2024.

title: QC Copper Intersects 0.72% CuEq Over 27 Metres at Cooke-Robitaille
summary: QC Copper announced 2024 winter drill results from the Cooke-Robitaille trend, reporting multiple high-grade composite intersections (e.g., 0.72% CuEq over 27 metres and higher-grade subintervals). The company expects potential resource growth beyond the Opemiska pit, but no production or supply changes are indicated.

title: Metso and Almalyk MMC sign agreement for Uzbekistan copper smelter
summary: Metso and Almalyk MMC signed a frame agreement for process-technology deliveries for Almalyk’s new Uzbekistan copper smelter. The project is planned to produce 300,000 tpa of copper cathodes and 1.8 million tpa of sulphuric acid, with equipment contracts to be finalized later this year.

title: Surge Copper Announces C$3.8 Million Strategic Investment by African Rainbow Minerals Limited
summary: Surge Copper announced a C$3.8 million private placement with African Rainbow Minerals at a premium, to fund advancement of its Berg project and related exploration. ARM will hold about 15% post-financing. The Berg deposit contains pit-constrained copper resources, so the funding modestly supports near-term copper development sentiment.

title: Surge Copper Announces C$3.8 Million Strategic Investment
summary: Surge Copper announced a C$3.8m strategic private placement with African Rainbow Minerals at a premium, with proceeds earmarked for advancing its Berg project and exploration. The Berg asset is a copper porphyry and the release references copper in its PEA economics, which can modestly bolster copper-sector sentiment near term.

title: The long and short sides showed a wait-and-see trend, and the nickel price fluctuated and closed
summary: On April 1, the Shanghai nickel main contract opened at 131,190 yuan/ton and closed at 131,600 yuan/ton, up 680 yuan/ton (+0.91%). Trading volume was lower and open interest edged down, suggesting reduced positioning and a wait-and-see stance, while price ultimately finished higher after an early dip.

title: At the beginning of the month, the market transaction sentiment was weak, and the price of nickel pig iron was under pressure
summary: The article reports SMM high-nickel pig iron averaging 930 yuan per nickel point, slightly lower day-on-day, and expects ferronickel output to stay low due to nickel ore quota timing. With Qingming holiday effects and weak stainless-steel demand, upstream supply accumulates, pushing ferronickel prices lower.

title: Flying Nickel Provides Minago Project Update Regarding Project Community Engagement Activity
summary: Flying Nickel announced completion of a community quarry partnership at its Minago nickel project in Manitoba. The project will strip near-surface limestone for 7,500 tonnes of construction material and build all-weather exploration roads to enable future drilling. The release frames this as engagement capacity building, not an output or supply change.

title: Motoring: Hyundai Motor ends Indonesia aluminium deal after climate campaign by K-pop fans
summary: Hyundai Motor and PT Adaro Minerals Indonesia ended a non-binding aluminium supply memorandum after a climate campaign by K-pop fans urged Hyundai not to source coal-powered aluminium. Hyundai said it would pursue other opportunities, and Adaro confirmed the agreement would not be renewed. Smelting aluminium is energy-intensive and coal-based emissions heavy.

title: Nickel Ore & NPI Price Review and Forecast | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports nickel ore prices broadly unchanged WoW, with port stocks rising as the rainy season ends and Philippine transactions set to resume. However, high-grade NPI prices fell sharply WoW due to weak stainless steel demand, inventory accumulation, and lower stainless steel and nickel-related pricing, leading to a bearish outlook for April.

title: How transparency in mining contracts helped DRC secure $4 billion more Chinese contracts on major copper and cobalt projects
summary: The DRC renegotiated its “mines for infrastructure” contract with China after contract terms were disclosed, leading to an additional $4 billion in partnership earnings. The $7 billion agreement covers copper and cobalt projects, with critics noting earlier undervaluation of copper reserves and profits largely accruing to Chinese firms.

title: Lancaster Resources Closing of Spin-Off of Nelson Lake Copper Corp.
summary: Lancaster Resources says its spin-off of Nelson Lake Copper Corp. closed, issuing shares and creating a separate reporting issuer. Nelson now holds 100% of the Nelson Lake Copper Project in Saskatchewan via one mining claim block. The release is mainly corporate restructuring with no direct operational or supply changes.

title: African Rainbow Minerals Limited Acquires Shares of Surge Copper Corp.
summary: African Rainbow Minerals will subscribe for 39.6 million shares of Surge Copper Corp. in a private placement at C$0.095 per share, targeting about a 15% non-diluted stake. Closing is expected in four to six weeks and remains conditional. The deal is an investment in a copper company, not an immediate supply change.

title: Bill provides hope, lacks enforcement for reducing copper wire theft in Minnesota
summary: Minnesota considers a bill targeting copper wire theft by requiring licenses for anyone reselling copper wire, modeled after a catalytic converter theft crackdown. City data show $1.2 million spent on repairs and about 2,000 streetlight outages in February. The bill lacks direct enforcement, limiting near-term copper supply-demand effects.

title: Copper trends higher on bullish demand outlook
summary: Copper prices rose as bullish demand expectations were boosted by improving manufacturing activity in China and a surprise uptick in U.S. factory activity. Supply worries also supported the market, with copper concentrate shortages prompting Chinese smelters to plan output cuts. Copper extended gains on both LME and SHFE.

title: Paul Lennon: Tasmanian bauxite mining set to resume in 2024 | The Advocate
summary: ABx Group says Tasmanian bauxite mining at its DL130 project is expected to resume in the September quarter, supplying Adelaide Brighton Cement with 90,000–120,000 tonnes over five years. The company also plans Queensland bauxite work and exports later. More bauxite supply can modestly support aluminium-linked sentiment.

title: Paul Lennon reports resumption of Tasmanian bauxite mining | The Examiner
summary: ABx Group says Tasmanian bauxite mining at its DL130 project is expected to resume in the September quarter, after progressing projects in 2023. It also plans Queensland bauxite mining and exports in 2025, with an Adelaide Brighton Cement supply deal for 90,000–120,000 tonnes.

title: Hyundai ends Indonesia aluminium deal after climate campaign by K-pop fans - Environment
summary: Hyundai cancelled its 2022 memorandum with Adaro to buy aluminium from PT Kalimantan Aluminium Industry after a climate campaign by K-pop fans. The article notes aluminium smelting is energy-intensive and Adaro plans to use hydropower. Activists said the move reduces coal-linked emissions.

title: PAN GLOBAL REPORTS POSITIVE TIN METALLURGY RESULTS FROM LA ROMANA COPPER-TIN-SILVER DEPOSIT, SPAIN
summary: Pan Global reported positive tin metallurgy results from the La Romana copper–tin–silver deposit in Spain, using conventional gravity separation to produce premium tin concentrate. It also notes prior copper metallurgy results showing saleable high-quality copper concentrates. The update is a de-risking milestone for the Escacena project.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Reports Q1 2024 Production Results for the Kamoa-Kakula Copper Complex
summary: Ivanhoe Mines said its Kamoa-Kakula complex produced 86,203 tonnes of copper in concentrate in Q1 2024 and maintained 2024 guidance (440,000–490,000 tonnes). Higher recoveries and record throughput were achieved despite southern DRC grid instability, with work underway on Inga grid upgrades and added power.

title: Copper nears two-week high on healthy demand outlook
summary: Copper prices rose to a nearly two-week high, helped by a healthier demand outlook as China’s manufacturing activity expanded after six months of contraction. Support also came from a stronger/stabilizing yuan. LME copper gains were limited by base-metal profit-taking, while Shanghai warehouse inventories rose slightly.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Ltd.: Ivanhoe Mines Reports Q1 2024 Production Results for the Kamoa-Kakula Copper Complex
summary: Ivanhoe Mines said its Kamoa-Kakula complex produced 86,203 tonnes of copper in concentrate in Q1 2024 and maintained 2024 guidance of 440,000–490,000 tonnes. The Phase 3 concentrator is tracking ahead for May commissioning, while DRC grid upgrades and added backup/Zambian power improve stability after power intermittency.

title: BeMetals Corp.: BeMetals Reports Further Positive Copper Intervals from 2023 and Commences Follow Up Drill Program at Pangeni Copper Project in Zambia
summary: BeMetals reports additional positive copper drill results from its Pangeni Project in Zambia, including long intervals with grades up to 0.70% Cu, and it has commenced an expanded follow-up core drilling program targeting extensions and grade continuity. Results are expected in Q2 2024.

title: More Nickel in America: Talon Metals 2024 Exploration Plan -April 03, 2024 at 07:35 am EDT
summary: Talon Metals outlined its 2024 exploration plan for the Tamarack nickel-copper project in Minnesota and nickel targets in Michigan. The program includes a large drilling campaign and is partly funded by a US Department of Defense cost-share, boosting near-term expectations for expanded domestic nickel supply and sentiment.

title: Core Nickel Engages Integral Wealth Securities as Market Maker
summary: Core Nickel Corp. announced hiring Integral Wealth Securities as a market maker for its shares on Canada’s CSE, a routine liquidity arrangement. The release also reiterates its nickel exploration properties and historical resource grades in Manitoba. Overall, it is more investor/stock related than a near-term nickel fundamentals driver.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: More Nickel in America: Talon Metals 2024 Exploration Plan
summary: Talon Metals provided an update on its 2024 drilling and exploration at the Tamarack nickel-copper-cobalt project in Minnesota and nickel prospects in Michigan. About half the program is funded by US DoD, with a 30,000-meter drilling plan aimed at expanding high-grade nickel-copper resources. The initiative could modestly support nickel sentiment.

title: The tight supply and demand pattern has gradually eased, and the price of nickel sulfate has declined [SMM nickel sulfate daily review]
