summary: SMM’s nickel sulfate daily review shows battery-grade nickel sulfate falling on April 3, with weaker transaction activity and lower downstream acceptance of high-priced material. The overall transaction price range has shifted down as spot tightness from early April gradually eases after increased supply, leaving continued downside risk.

title: The final increase was +0.81% [SMM Nickel Brief Comment]  | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports that on April 3 the main Shanghai nickel contract opened at 133,430 yuan/ton and closed at 133,450 yuan/ton, up 860 yuan/ton from the prior close. Trading was weaker with lower open interest, and the contract rebounded after an early dip before finishing +0.81% higher.

title: Copper Standard Announces Commencement of Drilling at Colpayoc Project
summary: Copper Standard Resources says it has started Phase I drilling (about 5,000 meters in 18 holes) at its Colpayoc project in Peru, targeting porphyry copper/gold beneath existing oxide gold mineralization. The program is fully funded by an oversubscribed $5 million private placement and aims to expand resources ahead of Phase II.

title: Xtract Resources enters joint venture for Zambian copper project
summary: Xtract Resources entered a joint venture to acquire a majority interest in Zambia’s Silverking copper mine licence via staged exploration spending. It aims to follow up on high-priority copper targets and could earn 51% then 70% stakes based on additional investment. No near-term production is stated.

title: Benton Drilling Expands Great Burnt Copper Deposit, Arranges $3 Million Private Placement
summary: Benton Resources announced drill results expanding its Great Burnt copper deposit, including multiple high-grade intercepts and indications the system may extend further down plunge. The company also plans a $3 million private placement. Despite improved copper prospects, there is no immediate production or supply adjustment.

title: Benton Resources Inc.: Benton Drilling Expands Great Burnt Copper Deposit, Arranges $3 Million Private Placement
summary: Benton Resources reported additional high-grade copper drill intercepts that expand its Great Burnt copper deposit by about 50 m down plunge, with indications the system remains open for further growth. It also announced a $3 million private placement. The update is copper-supply related but not production-impacting.

title: Hot Topics in International Trade - April 2024 -  Aluminum Extrusions II – Scope Modifications Proposed, Dept. of Commerce Questioning Manageability | Braumiller Law Group, PLLC
summary: The piece outlines proposed scope modifications in the U.S. AD/CVD investigation on aluminum extrusions, focusing on whether parts and subassemblies containing non-extruded aluminum components qualify for scope exclusions. Commerce is questioning manageability of duties on partial assemblies and is due to issue further determinations around May 1, after a preliminary CVD finding.

title: Idaho Copper Corp. signs agreements to commence ore sorting
summary: Idaho Copper Corporation said it hired engineering firms to begin core scanning, bucket-level ore sorting testing, and metallurgical work for its Idaho CuMo copper-molybdenum-silver project, aiming to update its preliminary economic assessment within 6–9 months. The company plans to use today’s metal prices in the valuation.

title: Idaho Copper Corp. signs agreements to commence ore sorting program and update its PEA
summary: Idaho Copper Corporation said it has hired firms to begin ore sorting, core scanning, and metallurgical testing for an updated PEA for its CuMo project. Management expects a revised assessment in 6–9 months and notes that updated valuation will use today’s metal prices. No immediate market supply/demand disruption is indicated.

title: Couloir Capital Ltd: Couloir Capital Is Pleased to Announce It Has Initiated Research Coverage on Fathom Nickel
summary: Couloir Capital initiated/updated research coverage of Fathom Nickel, highlighting continued 2024 exploration on two Saskatchewan properties. Initial drilling on the Albert Lake Project is underway with assays expected by late April, followed by additional surveys and more drilling on the Gochager Lake Property. The news is exploration-focused, with no clear market-supply impact.

title: Couloir Capital Is Pleased to Announce It Has Initiated Research Coverage on Fathom Nickel
summary: Couloir Capital initiated and updated research coverage on Fathom Nickel, highlighting drilling at the Albert Lake and Gochager Lake properties in Saskatchewan. The firm expects assay results by end of April and further drilling later in 2024, potentially improving perceived nickel exploration prospects and near-term nickel sentiment.

title: MiningNewsBreaks – Fathom Nickel Inc. (CSE: FNI) (FSE: 6Q5) (OTCQB: FNICF) to Present in Red Cloud's Virtual Webinar Series
summary: Fathom Nickel announced it will present a live virtual corporate update webinar hosted by Red Cloud Financial Services on April 9, 2024. The release does not mention any project or production changes; it only invites registration and provides for a replay. Nickel market impact is likely limited.

title: Copper Hits 14-Month High With Demand Rising and Supply Squeezed
summary: The piece reports copper hitting a 14-month high, attributing the move to strengthening demand alongside a supply squeeze. The combination suggests tighter near-term balance and upward pressure on physical and benchmark copper pricing over the coming days.

title: Columbia Falls Aluminum Company property sold, development eyed
summary: Columbia Falls Aluminum Company property was sold for over 2,400 acres for residential and commercial development, pending EPA review for site safety. The closure of the aluminum plant created job losses and developers hope new projects help. The contaminated Superfund portion is excluded, with timelines to follow.

title: Material Matters: Pressure On Dividends, Steel & Iron Ore
summary: Morgan Stanley’s commodity update highlights a strengthening bullish narrative for copper, expecting supply disruptions to drive a large deficit that persists into 2025, supported by AI/data-centre demand. It also prefers nickel for near-term upside based on rapid supply-side response to low prices and ongoing supply tightness.

title: Copper Rises to 14-Month High as Powell Affirms Fed Rate Stance
summary: The article’s headline reports copper rising to a 14-month high. It links the gain to remarks from Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell affirming the Fed rate stance, which can influence real rates and the U.S. dollar. The news therefore points to near-term upward pressure on copper prices.

title: 8 ways to ensure Indonesia's nickel sector is sustainable
summary: The article examines how Indonesia can make its nickel downstreaming and mining more environmentally and economically sustainable. It highlights that export-ban disruption and oversupply have pressured nickel prices, and discusses potential measures like limiting smelter expansion, improving data and emissions controls, and using incentives more effectively.

title: Copper climbs to highest level since January 2023
summary: London-traded base metals rose on April 4, led by copper hitting the highest level since January 2023. Gains were linked to a softer dollar, expectations of lower U.S. rates after Powell’s remarks, stronger-than-expected Chinese manufacturing data, and planned Chinese smelter output cuts amid raw-material shortages.

title: Copper hits yearly high on global growth optimism
summary: Copper is trading at its highest level in over a year as investors grow optimistic about global economic growth and expect monetary easing from major central banks. The piece cites improving manufacturing expectations, including in China, and rate-cut prospects as key drivers, with technical levels suggesting a continued bullish outlook if support holds.

title: Copper prices hit 14-mth highs on China optimism, tight supply outlook
summary: Copper prices jumped to 14-month highs as China optimism supported demand expectations and potential output cuts by major Chinese smelters/refiners tightened the supply outlook. Improving Chinese PMIs boosted manufacturing sentiment, while disrupted global mine supplies and near-zero treatment charges encouraged 5%–10% production cut consideration.

title: 8 Ways To Ensure Indonesia's Nickel Sector Is Sustainable
summary: The article reviews Indonesia’s nickel downstreaming push—aiming for many new smelters—and ongoing controversies including oversupply-driven nickel price declines and the 2021 export-ban dispute. It suggests limiting expansion, reassessing incentives, and improving sustainability. Overall, the tone implies continued supply pressure and weak near-term nickel pricing.

title: Vedanta's aluminium output rises 4 pc in Q4
summary: Vedanta said its aluminium production rose 4% to 598,000 tonnes in Q4 FY24 versus the prior year. Alumina production at its Lanjigarh refinery increased 18% to 448,000 tonnes on improved operational performance. This points to better supply conditions for aluminium in the near term.

title: Indonesian coal firm Harum buys nickel processing stake
summary: Indonesian coal producer Harum Energy bought a 51% stake in Blue Sparking Energy, which operates nickel processing/refining and an HPAL project in North Maluku. Harum also previously increased its stake in nickel smelter Westron Metal. The moves reflect ongoing diversification into nickel production capacity.

title: Prospector Provides Update on Key Ontario Nickel and Gold Projects
summary: Prospector Metals updated its Devon nickel project in Ontario, contracting a VTEM airborne survey and citing recent field sample results with up to 0.53% Ni and 1.125% Cu (plus PGE/Co trace). The company is also progressing other projects, but no production or concrete supply impacts are described.

title: NevGold Stakes Highly Prospective Zeus Copper Project Within The Hercules Copper Trend, Washington County, Idaho
summary: NevGold announced it staked ~20 km² of claims for the Zeus copper project adjacent to the Hercules copper porphyry discovery in southwestern Idaho, citing copper mineralization and alteration indicators. Planned 2024 geological work and drill testing could attract additional attention to regional copper prospects, modestly supportive for copper sentiment.

title: Koryx Copper Intersects 168.60 Metres at 0.40% Cu Eq
summary: Koryx Copper reported assay results from three holes at its Haib Copper project in Namibia, including wide intervals of CuEq and confirmation of shallow higher-grade mineralization at Pit 1. The company states results are above the prior indicated resource grade, but no production timing or supply changes are announced.

title: TSX futures gain as copper advances; rate cut hopes strengthen
summary: TSX index futures rose as materials-linked stocks gained alongside higher base metal prices. The article notes copper reached its highest level in over 14 months, supported by a weaker dollar and stronger hopes for global interest-rate cuts, which can lift metals sentiment and near-term demand expectations.

title: NevGold Corp.: NevGold Stakes Highly Prospective Zeus Copper Project Within The Hercules Copper Trend, Washington County, Idaho
summary: NevGold announces it staked the Zeus Copper Project adjacent to the Hercules copper trend in Idaho and plans geochemical, geophysical, and drill testing activities starting in 2024. The release cites indications of copper mineralization and porphyry alteration but provides no production, supply disruption, or inventory impact.

title: Cash flow difficulties pressure Brazilian aluminium scrap dealers
summary: Brazilian aluminium scrap dealers are facing cash-flow problems as final dealers/recyclers increasingly pay via invoices with 30–180 day delays instead of cash within 1–2 days. Industry sources cite slower market conditions and longer payment terms from large companies, raising working-capital stress and potential downward pressure on scrap prices.

title: Freeport Commences Internal Project Optimization Review for Yandera Copper Project, One of the World's Largest Undeveloped Copper Projects and Announces Private Placement
summary: Freeport Resources announced an internal optimization review for its 100% owned Yandera copper project after a PNG license renewal. The review explores new direct sulphide leaching technology to potentially cut capex, opex and transport costs. The company also begins discussions with strategic partners and raises funds via a private placement.

title: Mosaic Announces Latest Results on Gaboury Nickel
summary: Mosaic Minerals reported remaining drill results from its Gaboury project, confirming nickel potential over more than 4.5 km and identifying Ni-Cu magmatic mineralization potential. The geology also shows zinc, cobalt, copper and gold. The company plans further drilling and surveys, but no immediate production or supply-market change is provided.

title: Vedanta Aluminium Expands Capacity, Aims for Global Top Three Position
summary: Vedanta Aluminium commissioned a 1.5 mtpa alumina facility at its Lanjigarh refinery, expanding nameplate capacity from 2 mtpa to 5 mtpa and raising total capacity to 3.5 mtpa. Management said it strengthens raw material security and reduces costs for its Jharsuguda and BALCO smelters.

title: Xtract forms JV to earn into Zambian copper mine
summary: Xtract Resources formed a joint venture to earn into a majority stake in Zambia’s Silverking copper mine and exploration licence. The company must invest $500,000 over 18 months to reach 51%, with optional expansion to 70% after further funding. Potential resources would be assessed for future proceeds.

title: Mosaic Announces Latest Results On Gaboury Nickel
summary: Mosaic announced drilling results at its Gaboury Nickel project in Quebec, estimating intersection thickness at ~70% of the core interval and concluding the property has potential for magmatic Ni-Cu mineralization. Management plans more intensive drilling and surveys across magnetic anomalies, supporting expectations for additional nickel-bearing zones.

title: Attempted copper theft: Cutting down power poles in Ellsworth Co.
summary: Authorities are investigating vandals in Ellsworth County who cut down power poles with a chainsaw in an attempt to steal copper. The utility says there was no copper on the poles and warns the act is dangerous. While copper theft attempts suggest scrap interest, no quantity was removed.

title: In Brief: House Prices; Soft Landings; Copper Deficit
summary: The brief notes copper has been a 2024 standout, with spot prices near 12-month highs. It attributes the rally to pull-forward of 2024 deficit expectations after recent supply cuts and project disruptions. A soft landing, expected Fed cuts, and a weaker US dollar are cited as supporting demand and price momentum.

title: Copper Near 14-Month High as Global Supply Risks Support Prices
summary: The article headline reports copper trading near a 14-month high, attributing the move to global supply risks that are supporting prices. This suggests market participants are pricing in increased near-term copper supply tightness, which should exert upward pressure on copper over the coming days.

title: Vedanta Aluminium Expands Alumina Refining Capacity To 3.5 Million Tonnes Per Annum (MTPA)
summary: Vedanta Aluminium commissioned a 1.5 MTPA expansion at its Lanjigarh alumina refinery, raising capacity to 3.5 MTPA from 2 MTPA and supporting a planned 5 MTPA nameplate level. Management says the upgrade strengthens raw-material security and lowers costs for its aluminium smelters in Jharsuguda and BALCO.

title: Kishida, Biden, Marcos to agree to bolster nickel supply chain | The Asahi Shimbun: Breaking News, Japan News and Analysis
summary: Japan, the US, and the Philippines plan to cooperate to strengthen the nickel supply chain, with a joint statement expected after the April 11 Washington summit. The Philippines is cited as a leading nickel producer, while China’s dominance in processing/refining is a key concern. EV and fuel-cell demand is expected to keep rising.

title: Zambia's copper output may rise to 1 million tons by 2026 as mines expand
summary: Zambia’s copper output fell in 2023, but new investments and mine developments—especially the return of Mopani and Konkola after ownership disputes and expansion at Kansanshi—could lift production toward above 1 million tons by 2025-26. Broader capacity plans in Zambia raise near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Capstone Copper Corp.: Orion Undertakes A$593 Million Sale of Capstone CDIs on the ASX
summary: Capstone Copper announces Orion’s block trade sale of 62.4 million Capstone CDIs on the ASX at A$9.50 per CDI, raising about A$592.8 million, with proceeds to Orion and no company funding. The release contains no operational or supply-demand changes for copper.

title: Zambia could raise copper output by one million tonnes a year by 2026
summary: Zambia’s finance minister says copper output could rise to about 1 million tonnes per year by 2026 as investments expand capacity. Mopani and KCM are expected to resume, Kansanshi is expanding, and new ventures target copper extraction, implying increased supply that could pressure prices.

title: Copper: Zambia eyes a million ton output by 2026
summary: Zambia plans to raise copper production to about one million tonnes by 2026, after output fell for a third year in 2023. The government expects mine restarts and rehabilitation following investments and new/returned operators at Mopani and Konkola, alongside work at Kansanshi.

title: Atico drilling grows El Roble copper mine in Colombia
summary: Atico Mining says its drilling at the El Roble copper-gold project in Colombia produced strong results, aimed at infilling mineralization and potentially extending massive sulphide bodies. The company frames the findings as expanding the mine’s copper resource base, which could support expectations for higher future copper supply.

title: True North Copper to restart mining at Cloncurry | North Queensland Register
summary: True North Copper says it will restart mining at its Cloncurry project, with ore stockpiling starting first and haulage expected to begin mid-May 2024. Oxide ore will be heap-leached at the operations hub and sulphide ore toll-milled with Glencore, following a signed toll agreement.

title: Major street repeatedly hit by copper thieves will finally get new repairs, safeguards
summary: Las Vegas county crews will perform a fifth round of repairs to Lamb Boulevard after repeated copper theft targeting street-light wiring. Officials say wiring has been replaced four times since January 2023 and delays reflect staffing and supply-chain issues. New safeguards will install wiring atop tall lights to deter further thefts.

title: Mining billionaire Andrew Forrest urges China to demand greener nickel, FT reports
summary: Andrew Forrest urged China to require higher environmental standards across its supply chain, focusing on nickel processing in Indonesia. He warned EV manufacturers to be wary of Indonesian nickel due to extraction’s environmental costs. The move could pressure Indonesian producers, affecting near-term nickel availability and pricing expectations.

title: Aluminum prices remained high before the holiday, and processing fees in the aluminum rod market were sluggish [SMM analysis]
summary: Ahead of the Qingming holiday, SMM data shows aluminium A00 prices rose and discounts narrowed. The piece attributes support to destocking of aluminium ingot inventories and firmer downstream processing demand, with improving spot receiving sentiment. It expects aluminium to remain strong and volatile after the holiday, despite oversupply pressure in rod processing fees.

title: The price of ferronickel operated under pressure during the week, and the electrolytic nickel discount narrowed by 12.8 yuan/nickel point compared with last week
summary: During the week, ferronickel and SMM 8-12% high nickel pig iron prices weakened, with ferronickel trending downward. Supply remains constrained despite faster nickel ore quota approvals, while stainless-steel demand is weak and inventories are slow to clear. The article concludes the market mismatch persists and ferronickel prices are expected to stay weak.

title: Best stocks to play the 'explosive' up move in copper, per Strategas
summary: CNBC highlights an “explosive” rally in copper futures, reaching the highest since January 2023, and notes that Strategas expects copper-linked stocks to benefit. It cites potential near-term catalysts such as Indonesia extending Freeport-McMoRan’s mining license and an improving copper outlook for Southern Copper.

title: Copper hits 14-month high with demand rising
summary: Copper jumped about 3% to a 14-month high as signs of US and China demand rebounds coincided with fast-mounting supply risks. Analysts cite tighter mine production after a Panama closure and potential Chinese smelter output cuts amid near-zero processing fees, while traders watch Shanghai inventories.

title: SMM Aluminum Market Morning Comment (Apr 8)  | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: The report notes gains in SHFE 2405 and LME aluminum prices, driven by bullish macro sentiment after strong US employment data delayed rate cuts and by China’s “trade-in” and car loan policies. It also cites slowly rising domestic supply but closed import window, falling ingot inventories, and stronger EV/PV demand expectations.

title: SMM Nickel Market Morning Comment (Apr 8) | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SHFE nickel rose for five straight days to around 133,450 yuan/mt by Apr 3. Slow Indonesian nickel ore approvals have left little new quota for two weeks, keeping ore premiums high and supply tight. Markets also watch potential effects from US/Japan/Philippines supply cooperation and macro expectations for June Fed cuts.

title: London copper weighed down by Fed rate cut uncertainty; Shanghai copper hits record high
summary: London copper slipped 0.6% as investors weighed uncertainty over fewer-than-expected U.S. Fed rate cuts, after strong jobs data reduced near-term cut expectations. In contrast, Shanghai copper rose 2.1% to a record high. LME aluminium and nickel fell, while SHFE aluminium and nickel increased.

title: Chalice Mining seeks environmental approval to make a mine out of Tim Goyder's famed nickel-copper discovery
summary: Chalice Mining is seeking environmental approval to develop a mine based on Tim Goyder’s well-known nickel-copper discovery. If approved, it would reduce permitting uncertainty and improve expectations for future nickel and copper supply, which can provide a mild supportive effect on prices in the coming weeks.

title: New bill aims to curb "rampant" copper wire theft in Saint Paul
summary: A new bill in Saint Paul aims to curb “rampant” copper wire theft. By reducing theft-driven losses and the need for replacement wiring, the measure may lessen near-term copper demand linked to security and repairs. The impact is likely modest because it is geographically limited.

title: SMM Nickel Market Morning Comment Fully (Apr 8) | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SHFE nickel strengthened for five straight sessions, reaching 133,450 yuan/mt by April 3. The key driver is tighter Indonesian nickel ore supply as quota approvals are slower than expected, keeping ore premiums elevated. Market also weighs US/Japan/Philippines nickel cooperation after April 11 and Fed rate-cut timing.

title: Copper hits 14-month high with support from momentum-following funds
summary: Copper on the LME reached its highest since January 2023, rising on momentum-following fund demand, stronger-than-expected German industrial output, and broader commodity sentiment. Aluminium also hit a multi-month high amid gains in Shanghai after China’s trading break, reflecting rising demand optimism and speculative longs.

title: Core Nickel Completes Winter Drill Program at the Halfway Lake Project, with Sulfide Mineralization Identified in All Three Drillholes
summary: Core Nickel announced it completed a 2024 winter drill program at its Halfway Lake nickel project in Manitoba, reporting visual sulfide mineralization in all three drillholes and expanded testing of the W62 Zone framework. Assay results are still pending, and no production, supply, or market structure changes were stated.

title: Nickel pig iron in the country declined, concentrated low nickel iron, high nickel iron increased steadily [SMM analysis]
summary: SMM reports China’s nickel pig iron output fell 2.82% m/m in March, while ferronickel output declined due to slower Indonesia RKAB approvals, rainy-season disruptions in the Philippines, tighter nickel ore supply, and ongoing profit inversion leading some plants to stop. April output is expected to keep declining, supporting nickel demand/supply balance.

title: Australian miner wants China to demand greener nickel from Indonesia - Markets
summary: Australian miner Andrew Forrest urges China and other buyers to demand higher environmental standards for nickel supply from Indonesia, after Indonesian processing faced criticism. The push aligns with LME changes to report low-carbon nickel trading and follows prior nickel price declines tied to heavy Indonesian supply.

title: Stainless Steel Market Sees Mixed Signals Amid Falling Nickel Prices
summary: Nickel prices reversed after peaking around March 13, falling about 5.56% month over month. Stainless market sentiment softened as nickel retraced and distributors described Q1 as slow. LME nickel inventories ballooned to the highest since May 2022, reinforcing a bearish near-term outlook amid still-oversupplied conditions.

title: Little demand for low-carbon aluminium; global differentials broadly steady
summary: Fastmarkets reports steady low-carbon aluminium differentials in Europe and Asia, with limited liquidity. Red Sea disruptions lift aluminium billet premiums in Europe amid tight primary/secondary supply, but consumers show little appetite to pay the low-carbon upcharge. Some regional interest exists, yet demand remains tepid overall.

title: AI could add 1 million tons to copper demand by 2030, says Trafigura
summary: Trafigura says AI and data centres could add up to one million tons to copper demand by 2030, worsening supply deficits that are already projected to tighten the market. It cites rising demand beyond previously modeled balances and references an expected deficit widening in 2025, supporting bullish sentiment for copper.

title: Copper Hits Fresh 14-Month High on Supply Fears, China Optimism
summary: The article headline says copper has reached a fresh 14-month high, driven by supply concerns and improved sentiment around China. Both factors tend to tighten perceived near-term supply while supporting demand expectations, creating upward price pressure for copper in the coming days.

title: Gold, Silver and Copper Shine Again - The Globe and Mail
summary: The article reports copper futures rising to a 14-month high above $4.24/lb, up 5.67% for the week. It links the rally to strong demand for solar panels and added supply risk from disruptions at major mines, citing logistical problems in Congo and droughts in Zambia. ETFs also gained alongside copper.

title: Copper wire theft bill making its way through Minnesota Legislature
summary: Minnesota lawmakers advanced a bill to reduce copper wire theft from cities, including a state licensing requirement for sellers. Supporters cite safety risks and repair costs from repeated streetlight outages, while some scrap-recycling stakeholders oppose the plan, saying it burdens small businesses. The bill now moves through committees.

title: Shanghai copper hits all-time high on demand optimism, supply cut prospect
summary: Shanghai copper hit an all-time high as London prices neared a peak, supported by better-than-expected manufacturing data, hopes for US/Europe rate cuts, and expectations of China smelter output cuts due to tight raw-material supply. Funds increased metal buying, though physical demand remained weaker.

title: Vietnam's top miner Vinacomin to invest $7.3 bln to boost alumina, aluminium production
summary: Vietnam’s state miner Vinacomin plans $7.3 billion (182 trillion dong) to expand alumina and aluminium production, funding bauxite exploration and five refining projects in Dak Nong. The goal is to meet Vietnam’s rising aluminium demand. The announcement may gradually affect regional supply expectations, but near-term price impact appears limited.

title: Vietnam to invest $7.3 billion to boost alumina, aluminium production
summary: Vietnam will invest $7.3 billion via Vinacomin to expand bauxite exploration and refining projects in Dak Nong. Plans include raising alumina capacity at Nhan Co Alumina to 2 million tons/year and tripling the Dak Nong complex to about 2 million tons/year alumina and 0.5–1 million tons/year aluminium.

title: Copper Trades Near 15-Month High as Supply Outlook Tightens
summary: Copper is trading near a 15-month high as market expectations shift toward a tighter supply outlook. This suggests less availability versus demand in the near term, supporting stronger copper prices over the coming days as traders adjust to improved balance dynamics.

title: Nickel Industries attracts strong interest for its Indonesian supply
summary: Nickel Industries is seeing strong investor interest for its Indonesian HPAL project, aiming to supply 70,000–80,000 tpa of nickel products from Sulawesi in 2H25, with some stake potentially sold from Tsingshan. With Indonesian supply rising and oversupply already depressing LME nickel, added output prospects are bearish.

title: Shanghai copper hits all-time high on demand optimism, supply cut prospects
summary: Shanghai copper hit a record high as London prices hovered near 14-month highs, supported by stronger-than-expected manufacturing data and hopes for U.S./Europe rate cuts. Additional support comes from prospects of China smelter output cuts amid tight raw-material supply. Despite a weaker cash premium, the price action is strongly upward for copper.

title: More than 25 manufacturers are interested in buying nickel from Australian company Nickel Industries
summary: Nickel Industries says over 25 car and battery makers are interested in buying nickel from its Indonesia HPAL smelter, aimed at producing nickel cathode and battery feedstocks. The firm argues it may qualify for LME low-carbon nickel, but buyers want lower prices. Recent oversupply pressured nickel sharply in 2024.

title: Copper firms on fund buying despite rising inventories
summary: Copper prices neared a 14-month high as fund buying and expectation-driven macro momentum lifted forward prices, with China reopening sparking catch-up demand. Despite rising LME inventories suggesting ample supply, traders noted strong arbitrage toward LME warehouses and prospects of smelter output cuts due to raw-material constraints in China.

title: PTX Metals Announces Update on W2 Copper-Nickel-PGE Project
summary: PTX Metals provided an update on its W2 Cu-Ni-PGE project drill program, including progress on a planned 2,500-metre campaign and ongoing modelling of historical drill data after recent claim consolidation. It cites historical grades averaging 0.58% copper and 0.37% nickel but provides no production impact.

title: Talon Metals Corporate Update: Advancing a Secure Domestic Nickel Supply to Meet U.S. Government Requirements -April 09, 2024 at 07:35 am EDT
summary: Talon Metals outlined progress on Minnesota permitting for its Tamarack nickel-copper-cobalt project and development of a DOE-funded Battery Minerals Processing Facility in North Dakota. The update includes NEPA/trial site steps and R&D partnerships aimed at improving nickel recovery and increasing copper recovery from concentrates, supporting future U.S. supply.

title: Talon Metals Corporate Update: Advancing a Secure Domestic Nickel Supply to Meet U.S. Government Requirements
summary: Talon Metals outlined progress on permitting for its Tamarack nickel-copper project and work toward its DOE/grant-funded North Dakota battery mineral processing facility. The company highlights accelerated exploration and processing plans to improve nickel recovery and concentrate quality, alongside R&D that could improve copper recoveries. The overall outlook is supportive for nickel prices.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: Talon Metals Corporate Update: Advancing a Secure Domestic Nickel Supply to Meet U.S. Government Requirements
summary: Talon Metals provides an update on permitting for its Tamarack underground nickel-copper project and progress toward a DOE-funded North Dakota battery mineral processing facility. The company highlights steps to secure an industrial site, conduct NEPA/tribal consultation, and advance processing to increase nickel recovery. Overall, it supports expectations for domestic nickel supply.

title: Disruptive technologies, approaches needed to carry decarbonization forward for aluminium industry
summary: Golden Aluminum was selected by the US Department of Energy for up to $22.3 million to fund its Nexcast aluminium mini-mill project. The technology is designed to expand capacity, broaden cast/rolled grades, use more scrap, and cut energy and emissions, potentially strengthening future aluminium supply prospects.

title: Those who deal in copper will need license under state proposal
summary: The proposal described in the title would require copper dealers to obtain a license under a state plan. If implemented, the licensing process could restrict near-term copper trading activity and tighten available market supply, potentially supporting higher copper prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Thunderstruck Announces Private Placement and Exploration Plans for Regional Copper District
summary: Thunderstruck Resources announced a private placement of up to CAD 1 million to fund work programs for the Rama-Senikura copper/gold prospect in Fiji, including defining drill targets and starting core drilling. The company cites strong copper prices and aims to advance an exploration-stage project near Newmont’s Namosi.

title: Great Southern to "aggressively" explore Chilean prospect
summary: Great Southern Copper said recent reconnaissance drilling at Chilean projects Teresita and Abundante confirmed mineralisation consistent with copper targets. Fifteen holes over 1,018 metres returned evidence of mineralisation in each hole, prompting plans for further geochemistry and larger drilling. The update is early-stage and mainly exploratory.

title: Rockridge Receives Exploration and Drilling Permit for its Flagship Knife Lake Copper Project in Saskatchewan
summary: Rockridge Resources says it has received a three-year exploration permit for its Knife Lake copper project in Saskatchewan, enabling geophysical work and up to 70 drill holes. Management links the move to rising global copper prices and demand and plans future drilling, but no near-term production or supply changes are announced.

title: EU carbon tax likely to have minimal effect on domestic primary aluminium producers
summary: ICRA said the EU’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), effective Jan 1, 2026, should have limited impact on India’s primary aluminium producers because the initial coverage excludes most indirect emissions from electricity used in smelting. Export costs are estimated at USD 50–140/tonne (2–6% of prices).

title: Trafigura: AI Boom Could Spark a Copper Shortage
summary: Trafigura’s chief economist warned AI boom–driven data-centre growth could widen copper’s deficit, on top of an already large projected shortage by 2030. The piece also highlights threats of Chinese production cuts due to raw-material supply issues, which analysts say could tighten the market and push copper prices higher.

title: Copper in second bull market this century, say analysts
summary: Citi analysts say copper has entered a new secular bull market, citing mine disruptions that threaten refined supply into China and falling smelter processing fees that may force output cuts. The piece also points to expectations of easier Fed policy supporting demand, despite China’s property slowdown.

title: Bank of America gives the best stocks to play gold and copper
summary: Bank of America raised its year-end copper forecast to $9,321/mt for 2024 (about +8%), citing tightening mine supply that constrains refined output and steady demand supported by energy-transition themes. It also notes copper futures reaching recent highs, reinforcing a bullish near-term outlook for copper.

title: Copper trades near 15-month high as Citi sees 'explosive' growth
summary: Copper is trading near a 15-month high as supply worries and improved demand expectations fuel bullish positioning. Mine disruptions are threatening refined-copper output at Chinese smelters, while investors anticipate stronger Chinese manufacturing-driven consumption. The price has risen over 15% in two months.

title: ASX: Australian shares poised to drop as global rally falters: Copper near 15-month high; Gold near fresh record
summary: The article highlights an upcoming US CPI release that will shape Federal Reserve expectations for interest-rate cuts. Core inflation is expected to ease slightly to 3.7% year-on-year. Falling Treasury yields and steadier US shares support risk sentiment, which is generally bullish for industrial metals like copper and, indirectly, aluminium and nickel.

title: Aluminum Extrusions II – Scope Modifications Proposed, Dept. Of Commerce Questioning Manageability - International Trade & Investment
summary: US trade proceedings in the “Aluminum Extrusions II” AD/CVD case focus on proposed scope modifications for “parts and subassemblies.” Petitioners seek narrower coverage and more exclusions, while Commerce questions administrability and disparate treatment. The outcome could change expected duty burden on imports, influencing near-term aluminium-related pricing sentiment.

title: New bill aims to curb copper wire theft across Minnesota
summary: St. Paul is proposing legislation to curb rampant theft of copper streetlight wiring, citing 2,000 thefts last year and $1.2 million in repairs. The bill would tighten dealer recordkeeping and require seller licensing. The city is also exploring switching some fixtures to solar or aluminium wiring.

title: Altona Rare Earths strikes copper deal in Botswana
summary: Altona Rare Earths’ shares jumped after it said it struck a deal to acquire the majority of an Ignate African Mining copper and silver asset in Botswana. The move is expected to change corporate control over copper production plans, which may modestly support near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Copper prices are rising. That's good for the economy.
summary: Copper futures are rising and are at the highest since mid-2022, supported by improving economic conditions in China and the U.S. and ongoing energy-transition demand (solar, wind, batteries, EVs, data centers). Analysts also cite supply impediments, including Panama’s ruling that led to a mine closure and potential mining slowdowns.

title: Capstone Copper Provides MVDP Commissioning Update; First Quarter 2024 Results to be Released on May 2, 2024
summary: Capstone Copper reported that first ore was introduced to the Mantoverde Development Project grinding circuit in March, completing a key commissioning milestone and keeping the project on track for first saleable concentrate in Q2 2024. Results are scheduled for May 2, 2024 after market close. Total capital remains unchanged.

title: Capstone Copper Corp.: Capstone Copper Provides MVDP Commissioning Update; First Quarter 2024 Results to be Released on May 2, 2024
summary: Capstone Copper reports that first ore was introduced to the Mantoverde Development Project’s grinding circuit in March, completing a key commissioning step. The company reiterates timing for first saleable concentrate in Q2 2024 and notes copper sulphide processing expansion. The progress can lift near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Violent clashes in New Caledonia as nickel pact exacerbates tensions
summary: Violent unrest in New Caledonia is disrupting access to nickel mining and transport routes near extraction sites, with trucks blocked and roads intermittently closed. Northern authorities threaten to suspend mining permits over unpaid guarantees, while the French “nickel pact” seeks industry reforms amid political deadlock, raising near-term nickel supply risk.

title: Gold surges, copper reaches high, oil dips ahead of US inflation report
summary: Gold and silver surged and traders looked positioned for CPI-driven market moves. Against this backdrop, Comex copper rose nearly 6% over the past five sessions, touching $4.335/lb (highest since early 2023) and settling around $4.29. The piece signals positive momentum for copper into the inflation data.

title: Copper Crisis Alert: Is a Supply Crisis Coming as Copper Prices Hit Record Highs?
summary: Bank of America warns a copper supply crisis may be coming as copper hits a 14-month high. The bank attributes risk to constrained mine supply, inefficiencies and mining disruptions in key producing regions, and continued demand tied to EVs and renewables, suggesting prices could rise further.

title: Copper prices are climbing - Marketplace
summary: Copper futures are rising and are reported at the highest levels in nearly two years, attributed to strengthening demand. The piece also discusses potential impacts of a federal shutdown and economic conditions on transportation and households, but does not provide specific drivers for nickel or aluminium.

title: New Law Takes Aim At Copper Thieves
summary: Minnesota introduced new legislation to curb copper wire theft that has damaged infrastructure and caused outages and unlit public spaces. The bill requires copper wire sellers to be licensed and wholesalers to verify permits. Violators could lose operating rights, aiming to reduce copper diversion.

title: Clark County combats copper wire theft with novel overhead-strung replacement
summary: Clark County Public Works is replacing stolen light-pole wiring in Las Vegas. Crews have repeatedly had to replace copper underground/standard wiring, prompting a change to overhead-strung aluminum wire that is less attractive to thieves. Officials cite frequent theft and costly repairs, but the scope appears local.

title: Bill aimed at curbing copper wire theft gets first Senate committee hearing
summary: Minnesota lawmakers are advancing a bill requiring licenses to sell copper wire scrap to reduce theft. Police say copper is hard to trace, so licensing/regulation would be used instead. Industry groups warn the $250 annual license fee could cool recycling, diverting some copper from scrap markets and pressuring copper prices down.

title: Copper Rallies Toward $9,500 on Supply Risks, Demand Optimism
summary: Copper is reported to be rallying toward $9,500, supported by perceived supply risks and improving demand sentiment. The article’s provided excerpt does not mention nickel or aluminium-specific developments, focusing instead on factors that would tighten copper availability or raise near-term consumption expectations.

title: China's March refined nickel output and April forecast | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s refined nickel output was 24,900 mt in March, slightly higher MoM and up strongly YoY, but down versus January due to maintenance shutdowns. SMM forecasts April refined nickel production around 25,900 mt, about +4% MoM, as suspended plants restart and new capacity ramps up.

title: China's March nickel sulphate output and April forecast | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s nickel sulphate output rose sharply in March on resumed wet-process recycling and demand recovery, keeping supply comparatively tight. With NCM chain destocking easing and EV auto sales improving, smelters raised operating rates. April output is expected to increase but still face demand support, sustaining higher nickel sulphate prices.

title: Altona enters option deal for Botswana copper-silver asset
summary: Altona Rare Earths signed an option agreement to acquire up to an 85% stake in the Sesana copper-silver asset in Botswana’s Kalahari Copper Belt. The deal includes cash, share payments, and phased exploration spending, with technical work set to start in 2024. No immediate production changes are discussed.

title: Aluminium hits 14-month peak on fund buying in buoyant market
summary: Aluminium prices surged to a 14-month peak as hedge funds bought the sector on optimism for the global economy. Better-than-expected manufacturing expansion in China and the U.S. boosted demand expectations. LME copper neared a 14-month high, while nickel also gained, reflecting broad bullish fund flows.

title: Constellium and PyroGenesis partner to advance plasma burner technology in aluminium melting process
summary: Constellium and PyroGenesis will test plasma torch burners at industrial scale in a Constellium aluminium casthouse after successful laboratory trials. The plasma-heated furnace aims to improve efficiency and cut direct emissions, with Constellium claiming up to threefold reduction versus a benchmark burner. This supports aluminium decarbonization efforts.

title: Gold prices hit record highs ahead of CPI data, copper gains
summary: Gold neared record highs, but industrial metals saw copper outperform: LME and U.S. copper futures rose to 15-month peaks. The move reflects hopes global factory activity is bottoming out, expectations for tighter Chinese supply due to refinery production cuts, and anticipation of more China economic data.

title: Hannan Metals Ltd.: Hannan Identifies Another Large Porphyry Gold-Copper Target at Valiente, Peru
summary: Hannan Metals reports surface sampling at its Valiente project in Peru identifying an 1,800m by 400m gold-rich copper porphyry-epithermal target (Previsto East) with anomalous copper and gold in boulders and soils. This is early greenfields exploration with no production impact, so any copper price effect is likely limited.

title: Nickel pig iron upstream quotation rose slightly due to nickel series disk shocks [Nickel pig iron daily review]
summary: SMM reports the average price of SMM8–12% high-nickel pig iron rose slightly to 931.5 yuan per nickel point. High nickel ore costs kept Indonesian ferronickel output relatively steady, while some China producers paused. Post-holiday sentiment improved with higher stainless steel disk prices.

title: Base metal stocks in Shanghai bonded warehouses mixed in March; aluminium up 150%
summary: Fastmarkets reports sharp month-on-month swings in Shanghai bonded stocks: aluminium jumped over 150% as sellers held back expecting better future arbitrage terms; nickel bonded inventories fell due to exports; copper bonded inventories rose as prolonged arbitrage losses reduced imports and reflected smelter routings/maintenance-driven delivery changes.

title: Nickel premiums flat in Europe, China, amid quiet market conditions
summary: Nickel premiums in Europe (briquettes, uncut cathode and 4×4) were unchanged week-on-week, supported by some Indonesian material inflows but with quiet trading. In China, nickel full plate premiums were also steady as import arbitrage losses widened and overseas demand remained sluggish, keeping prices range-bound.

title: Copper to Rise 30% in Next 12 Months, BofA's Blanch Says
summary: Bank of America’s Francisco Blanch says the long-anticipated copper shortage is now a reality and expects copper to rise at least 30% over 12 months. He attributes gains to inelastic demand from power-grid and data-centre buildouts, plus renewables and electric vehicles, supporting bullish expectations for copper.

title: Canadian mining stocks feature in Wall Street's new love for copper
summary: Wall Street strategists highlighted a “second secular bull market” for copper, driven by decarbonization demand (renewables, grid, EVs) and an AI/datacenter tailwind. Citi and BofA raised copper targets and upgraded Canadian copper miner coverage, citing tight supply constraints and steady demand, implying upward near-term copper price pressure.

title: Copper climbs to 2024 high as Wall Street banks raise price forecasts
summary: Copper futures are trading at fresh highs, extending the rally, as major banks raised 2024 outlooks and pointed to acute mine-supply constraints limiting concentrate availability for China’s smelters and refiners. Demand expectations for US/Europe and energy-transition uses improve, supporting a near-term copper deficit narrative.

title: As prices shoot up, Shanghai Futures Exchange slaps limits on both gold and copper as contracts hit new highs
summary: SHFE moved to cool volatility after copper futures surged to an all-time peak, imposing maximum intraday position opening volumes effective April 12. The exchange cited significant price rallies. The policy is aimed at restricting new positions, potentially moderating short-term momentum in copper trading.

title: Europacific Metals Inc.: EuroPacific Announces Start of 2024 Drill Program Targeting Shallow High-Grade Copper Deposit at Miguel Vacas
summary: Europacific Metals announced the start of its 2024 drill program at the Miguel Vacas copper project in Portugal, targeting shallow oxide copper for potential open-pit heap leaching and follow-up deeper sulphide drilling. The company cites prior high-grade Cu intersections and plans 11 shallow holes.

title: Calcutta HC orders execution of arbitration award against Hindustan Copper
summary: Calcutta High Court ordered execution of a foreign arbitration award against Hindustan Copper stemming from a contract with Centrotrade for copper concentrate supply. The court said it could not revisit enforceability after Supreme Court rulings. The dispute focused on the payable sum and compound interest during enforcement proceedings.

title: Europacific Metals Inc. Announces Start of 2024 Drill Program Targeting Shallow High-Grade Copper Deposit At Miguel Vacas
summary: Europacific Metals began its 2024 exploration drill program at the Miguel Vacas copper target in Portugal, planning at least 1,500 m of drilling in shallow oxide copper zones and follow-up deeper sulphide testing. The company aims to confirm high-grade Cu results and advance a preliminary open-pit resource estimate.

title: Universal Copper Ltd.: Universal Copper Announces Securityholder Approval for Acquisition by Vizsla Copper
summary: Universal Copper announced that securityholders overwhelmingly approved the plan of arrangement to be acquired by Vizsla Copper, including option and warrant adjustments and a planned court order. Completion is expected in April 2024 subject to closing conditions. The article is corporate/transaction focused and does not cite supply or policy changes for copper.

title: Material Matters: Bullish Copper, Bearish Lithium
summary: The piece is strongly bullish on copper, citing Citi and Morgan Stanley expectations for a widening 2024 deficit due to accelerating global mine disruptions, lower supply growth guidance, and mine closures. Demand is supported by improving manufacturing indicators, China refined flows, and faster data-centre/AI and grid investment growth.

title: Cheap coal, cheap workers, Chinese money: Indonesia's nickel success comes at a price | Indonesia
summary: Indonesia has surged as the world’s leading nickel refiner, supported by cheap coal, ore and labour, and claims it has pushed prices so low that peers face losses. It also notes potential exits by companies like BHP and Glencore, implying ongoing supply pressure for nickel despite investment tied to batteries and EVs.

title: Cheap coal, cheap workers, Chinese money: Indonesia's nickel success comes at a price
summary: The report describes Indonesia’s rise as the world’s top nickel refiner, powered by coal and supported by Chinese investment, alongside severe local pollution and alleged environmental violations. It cites heavy-metal contamination, worker safety concerns after a deadly smelter explosion, and potential scrutiny—factors that can raise nickel risk and weigh on prices.

title: Copper trades in tight range as firmer dollar weighs
summary: Copper prices traded in a tight range as the U.S. dollar firmed after stronger-than-expected U.S. inflation, pushing back expectations for rate cuts and weighing on metal demand. Support came from supply-side disruptions and improving China manufacturing. Aluminium edged up slightly; nickel and tin fell on the session.

title: Calcutta HC Orders Execution Of Arbitration Award Against Hindustan Copper
summary: Calcutta High Court ordered execution of a foreign arbitration award against Hindustan Copper stemming from a copper concentrate supply agreement with Centrotrade. The court said prior Supreme Court rulings prevent rehearing of enforceability. The dispute centered on the amount payable and compound interest, with HCL contesting during proceedings.

title: Overseas Primary Aluminium Production Quarterly Review - Q1 2024 | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports Q1 2024 primary aluminium output outside China at 7,461.5 kmt, with varied utilisation rates by region. Venezuela remains weak due to inefficient smelters, while Brazil’s Alumar restart supported production. Russia saw a slight rise, Europe excluding Russia fell after Germany’s Neuss shutdown, and U.S. output dropped after New Madrid closure but was partly offset by Warrick restart.

title: Atalaya first-quarter output lower but notes robust copper price
summary: Atalaya Mining reported Q1 copper production fell 12% to 10,666 tonnes due to lower grades and recoveries, but kept annual guidance at 51,000–53,000 tonnes. Management cited ongoing supply challenges and rising renewables and technology demand supporting copper prices recently, with copper trading near multi-month highs.

title: Copper Fox Provides Update for Mineral Mountain Project

summary: Camino announced intercepts of new copper mineralization at its Los Chapitos project in Peru, including 1.34% Cu over 25m from surface and 0.79% Cu over 12.7m in new areas. The results are positive for copper resource potential and may modestly support copper price expectations.

summary: Copper Fox Metals provided an update on its Mineral Mountain porphyry copper project in Arizona, highlighting geophysical chargeability targets and stating the BLM has found the plan of operations compliant but requires public comment and an NEPA environmental review before drilling approval. summary: Canada Nickel says it has begun FEED for the Crawford nickel sulphide project, with engineering led by Ausenco. The update supports improving nickel project development outlook and potential supply expectations.

summary: Flying Nickel announced an updated Mineral Resource Estimate for its Minago nickel-PGM project, reporting a 41.95% increase in in-pit measured & indicated nickel and an inaugural platinum and palladium resource. The estimate uses nickel/Pt/Pd price assumptions for pit optimization but gives no near-term production or inventory changes.

title: Camino Minerals Intercepts 1.34% Cu Over 25m From Surface and 0.79% Cu Over 12.7m in New Areas of Copper Mineralization at Los Chapitos, Peru
summary: Camino Minerals announced drilling results from the Los Chapitos project in Peru, reporting copper intercepts of 1.34% Cu over 25m from surface and 0.79% Cu over 12.7m in newly identified areas. The findings are supportive for resource potential, but do not indicate immediate supply changes.

title: Copper project sale vote set
summary: Shareholders of Copper Road Resources will vote April 30 on whether to approve Sterling Metals’ purchase of the Copper Road Project, a 24,000-hectare property containing two former copper mines that closed in the early 1970s. The cash proceeds are intended for working capital and other property search activities.

title: Output from Chilean copper miner Codelco dips 1.6% in February
summary: Codelco said its total copper production in February fell 1.6% year-on-year to 103,700 metric tons. Escondida output rose 34% to 97,500 tons, and Collahuasi increased 2.5% to 45,200 tons, but overall production was lower, hinting at tighter short-term supply.

title: Junior Copper-Gold Stock News: Benjamin Hill (CSE: BNN) Announces Staking of 18 Additional Mineral Claims and Spring Drill Program at Alotta
summary: Benjamin Hill Mining Corp. announced staking 18 new claim blocks at the Alotta copper-gold porphyry project and plans up to five drill holes totaling 2,500 metres after winter. The update expands the property over geophysical/geochemical anomalies near the larger Casino copper-gold deposit.

title: MiningNewsBreaks – Canada Nickel Company Inc. (TSX.V: CNC) (OTCQX: CNIKF) Advances Engineering at Crawford Nickel Sulphide Project
summary: Canada Nickel says it has started front-end engineering design for its Crawford nickel sulphide project, led by Ausenco, while continuing financing and permitting. Management targets a mid-2025 construction decision and first production by year-end 2027, implying longer-dated nickel supply potential but no immediate output change.

title: Peru: Copper production up 14% over past two months | Noticias | Agencia Peruana de Noticias Andina
summary: Peru’s energy and mines minister Romulo Mucho said copper production grew 14% over the past two months. He also referenced Ministerial Resolution 125-2024-Minem allowing mining firms to produce 10% more copper without major new capital spending. Additional copper project work is underway, supporting higher output expectations.

title: Celsius Resources receives permit extension for Sagay Copper Project
summary: Celsius Resources said it received an extension of permits for its Sagay Copper Project. Extending regulatory approval can lower development uncertainty, but it typically affects future supply rather than near-term market tightness, so any copper price impact is likely limited in the next days to weeks.

title: Copper, the metal of the future, caught in the crossfire
summary: Bloomberg highlights heavy pressure in the LME cash–3-month spread, pointing to ample near-term copper supply but concern about tighter conditions later. Chinese demand expectations were revised down after weaker-than-needed stimulus, while higher interest rates pull traders toward futures. Supply compression forecasts and smelter constraints could support higher prices.

title: How to Invest in Copper While the Red Metal Is Red-Hot
summary: Copper prices are rising sharply as forecasts shift from surplus to deficit. The article attributes the move to mine output cuts and shutdowns (Panama/First Quantum, Anglo American, Codelco) and Chinese smelter production cuts, while manufacturing activity indicators improve. Banks also raise copper price forecasts amid tightening supply expectations.

title: Japan Q2 aluminium premiums set at $145-$148/T, up 61%-64% Q/Q, sources say
summary: Japan’s aluminium shipment premiums for April to June were set at $145-$148/mt, up 61%-64% quarter-on-quarter, far above $90/mt in January-March. Reuters sources attribute the jump to tighter aluminium supply in Asia, suggesting improved physical pricing conditions for the metal.

title: Noronex ups stake in flagship Namibian copper project
summary: Noronex has increased its stake to 76% in its Witvlei copper project in Namibia’s Kalahari Copper Belt, after buying shares from Thunder Gold. The resource already contains over 100,000 tonnes of copper with exploration upside. Management says the streamlined ownership should attract partners to advance development and exploration.

title: Copper prices soaring and investors are cashing in on the 'reflation trade'
summary: The piece argues that copper is breaking out of a long $8,000–$9,000 per tonne range as prices soar, framing the move as investors taking part in a “reflation trade.” It highlights positioning in metals and energy, implying positive near-term sentiment for copper, though without specific new fundamentals.

title: China March copper imports at 474,000 metric tons - customs
summary: China’s unwrought copper imports rose 16% year-on-year in March to 474,000 metric tons, according to customs data. The increase from 408,174 tons a year earlier signals higher import demand from the top copper consumer, which may support market sentiment and near-term copper pricing.

title: Nickel Price Forecast: Top Trends That Will Impact Nickel in 2024
summary: The article forecasts nickel to remain rangebound in 2024 despite a holdover surplus from 2023. Indonesia’s expanding output and China’s production keep supply elevated, while China’s slower real-estate recovery weighs on demand. INSG expects oversupply to persist; EV and stainless demand offer partial support.

title: Instant View: China's March imports of copper and iron ore rise y/y -April 12, 2024 at 03:58 am EDT
summary: China’s customs data show March copper imports at 474,000 mt, up 16% y/y, alongside weaker exports and lower overall imports. Analysts attribute the double-digit growth to a low base and earlier shipment bookings on improved demand expectations, though late-month consumption was dampened by higher copper prices.

title: Collective Mining Ltd. Reports High Concentrate Grades from Metallurgical Work on Apollo of 30.5% Copper, 1,280 G/T Silver and 28.7 G/T Gold
summary: Collective Mining reported successful flotation and gravity test work on its Guayabales Apollo porphyry, achieving up to 30.5% copper concentrate and high recoveries (e.g., copper up to 95.3%). While supportive for potential future copper supply, it is exploration-stage with no near-term production impact.

title: U.S., Japan, Philippines Boost Ties With Chip, Nickel Deals for Luzon
summary: The U.S., Japan and Philippines outlined “Luzon Economic Corridor” initiatives, including U.S. funding plans for a Philippine ore-to-nickel and cobalt processing plant by Eramen Minerals. The cooperation also covers infrastructure and logistics, which could support nickel project development, though output timing is not immediate.

title: Copper's Run Continues With Surge to Highest Since June 2022
summary: The piece highlights that copper is continuing its rally, with prices surging to their highest level since June 2022. This suggests strong near-term upward momentum in copper markets, likely reflecting improving short-term expectations for supply-demand conditions and price strength.

title: Orion offloads 8.3% stake in Capstone Copper for $386.9m
summary: Orion Resource Partners’ funds sold an 8.3% stake in Canadian copper miner Capstone Copper for $386.9m via a secondary offering, reducing Orion’s holding to 12%. The deal brought new institutional investors and may improve Capstone’s index prospects, but it does not cite any operational supply changes.

title: Can Namibia tap its copper potential?
summary: The piece links the clean-energy electrification transition to rising copper demand and argues Namibia could help close a projected supply shortfall. It cites restarting projects at the Kombat copper project and other licenses, but notes Namibia is still a minor producer and investor impact is uncertain due to constraints and export rules.

title: Bulls jump deeper into copper amid supply challenges, AI-fueled demand
summary: Copper prices are expected to keep rising as supply tightens amid mine shutdowns and delayed or uncertain projects, including Cobre Panama’s closure and weak output from Chile’s Codelco. Demand is forecast to accelerate from AI data centers, EVs and electrification, supporting higher price outlooks and potential further upside.

summary: Refined nickel inventories increased in April: social stocks rose 16% MoM and bonded zone inventory gained 12% MoM. SMM links the rise to stronger exports from domestic plate producers as SHFE–LME price spreads widened, tepid downstream buying, and arrivals of overseas plates late March.

title: The customs clearance volume of refined nickel dropped significantly in January-February
summary: China’s refined nickel customs clearance/import volumes dropped sharply in January-February, indicating continued weakening domestic demand. The article attributes the fall to sluggish downstream demand and increased substitution toward newer electro-deposited nickel brands, which are cheaper and comparable to Russian material. Further declines are expected in March.

title: The long and short sides reduced the trading of Shanghai nickel main combination and finally rose and fell -1.19% [SMM Nickel Brief Comment]
summary: SMM reports Shanghai nickel’s main contract opened at 138,820 yuan/ton and closed at 138,250 yuan/ton, down 1.19% on the day. Intraday trading weakened, with lower open interest and reduced long/short activity. Price rose after a soft start, peaking near 138,990, then eased into the close.

title: Quetzal to acquire Cristinas copper project in Mexico
summary: Quetzal Copper agreed to acquire Polaris Resources’ Cristinas copper project in Chihuahua, Mexico, via option payments and assumption of vendor payments, plus planned exploration investment through Dec 2025. The project has historic 1970s oxide copper mining and 2014 high-grade drilling, but the deal is not large enough to sway near-term copper prices.

title: Canada Nickel Ramps Up Ontario's Crawford Project: 'We Are Confidently Moving Into This Next Phase'
summary: Canada Nickel says it has started FEED for the Crawford nickel project in Ontario and is advancing financing and permitting toward a mid-2025 construction decision and first production by end-2027. summary: Zambia’s Luanshya copper mine has restarted after nearly 20 years, following a $500 million revival project by CNMC. summary: Bell Copper reports completion of drilling (hole K-23) at its Perseverance porphyry copper project in Arizona under an earn-in JV with Cordoba. summary: Tajik Aluminium Company (Talco) increased primary aluminium production by 27% year-on-year in Q1 2024 to about 19,731 tons. title: What do US election years mean for the aluminium midwest premium?
summary: Fastmarkets’ base metals analyst Andy Farida reviews charts on how US election years may influence the aluminium Midwest premium. summary: Copper smelting reductions look likely as treatment charges (TCs) remain extremely low amid persistent concentrate tightness. summary: Antofagasta’s CEO says refined copper is expected to run a 200,000–300,000 tonne deficit in 2024 as demand improves and end-2023 production revisions tighten the balance. summary: YKK said it will begin purchasing alloy wires made from low-carbon aluminum for aluminum-alloy zippers starting in FY2024, gradually expanding use. title: Codelco Eyes Partnerships to Help Boost Ailing Copper Production
summary: Codelco is reportedly looking for partnerships to help raise output at its ailing copper production operations. summary: Saudi Arabia is expected to invest up to $1 billion next month in the Reko Diq copper-gold project in Pakistan’s Chagai district. title: Barrick Gold reports lower preliminary gold, copper output for Q1
summary: Barrick Gold said its preliminary Q1 production fell sequentially, with copper output dropping to 40,000 tonnes from 113 million pounds previously. Management cited lower ore grades and maintenance at its mines. The reduction in near-term copper supply expectations is likely to weigh on copper pricing in the short term.

title: Osisko Metals Reports Preliminary Metallurgical Testwork Results From Gaspé Copper
summary: Osisko Metals reported preliminary metallurgical and grindability testwork for its Gaspé Copper Project, showing ~92% average copper recoveries, ~65% molybdenum recoveries, and commercially encouraging concentrate grades and flotation performance. The company says results feed into an ongoing PEA and updated resource work, without any near-term production commitment.

title: Amarc Resources Ltd.: Amarc Introduces The JO Porphyry Copper-Gold Discovery In The Duke District
summary: Amarc Resources reports discovery of a new JO porphyry copper-gold target within the Duke district in British Columbia, with geophysical anomalies and rock samples grading 0.18% Cu. Boliden funds continued exploration, and reconnaissance drilling is planned for the 2024 summer season.

title: Fathom Nickel Inc.: Fathom Intersects Rottenstone-Like Nickel Tenor in Drillhole AL24077 at the Albert Lake Project
summary: Fathom Nickel reports results from its Q1 drilling at the Albert Lake project, highlighting drillhole AL24077 with 0.42% Ni over 2.01 m and ~10% nickel tenor in ultramafic host rock. BHEM and geochemical anomalies suggest further potential along strike, awaiting additional drilling and assay updates.

title: Possible impact on the global aluminium market as the US and UK launch a new round of sanctions against Russian aluminium
summary: The US and UK announced sanctions blocking Russian aluminium from LME/CME delivery and banning imports, with similar restrictions for Russian copper and nickel. Aluminium prices jumped immediately, as non-Russian deliverable supply was expected to tighten. RUSAL said output continues, but deliverable warrants are dominated by Russia.

title: Canadian miner Barrick reports lower preliminary gold, copper output for first quarter
summary: Barrick Gold reported lower-than-expected preliminary output in Q1, citing planned mine maintenance and operational issues. Gold costs were expected to rise, and importantly copper production fell sharply to 40,000 tonnes due to lower grades at Zambia’s Lumwana mine, alongside higher AISC, weighing on near-term copper supply outlook.

title: Western Copper and Gold looks to raise $25.2m in bought deal
summary: Western Copper and Gold agreed to raise about C$34.8m gross via a bought-deal equity offering to fund permitting and engineering for its Yukon Casino copper-gold project, plus some working capital. The company frames the project as economically viable, but the financing is unlikely to swing near-term copper prices.

title: Drilling - Konkola West Copper Project, Zambia  | Company Announcement
summary: Tertiary Minerals says drilling has begun at the Konkola West Copper Project in Zambia, targeting extensions of known copper deposits. The company also notes other copper-focused projects and defined copper-in-soil anomalies. The news is exploration-related and unlikely to materially affect near-term copper supply balances or prices.

title: Global Commodities excludes Russian nickel from its new trading platform
summary: Washington and London prohibited metal exchanges from accepting new Russian-produced aluminium, copper, and nickel and barred imports into the U.S. and Britain. The change removes delivery of Russian Class 1 nickel from Global Commodities Exchange, following recent sanctions, tightening supply and supporting higher prices for these metals.

title: Trafigura CEO Says Copper Must Surpass $10,000 to Meet Demand
summary: Trafigura’s CEO said copper needs to surpass $10,000 to meet demand. The statement suggests the market may currently be undersupplied versus expectations, potentially tightening near-term availability. Such guidance can influence trader sentiment and support copper prices in the coming days as participants reprice balance-of-market outlook.

title: MiningNewsBreaks – Fathom Nickel Inc. (CSE: FNI) (FSE: 6Q5) (OTCQB: FNICF) Reports on Results of Drill Program at Albert Lake Project
summary: Fathom Nickel reported Q1 drill results from its Albert Lake Project in Saskatchewan, including 0.42% Ni over 2.01 meters and a very high nickel tenor (~10%) in Rottenstone-like ultramafic rock. The company said assays for Gochager Lake are due next month, supporting bullish nickel sentiment.

title: Copper Prices Surging As First Quantum's $10B Mine in Panama Sits Idle
summary: Cobre Panamá, First Quantum’s $10B mine in Panama, has been idle since November after tax and labor disputes led to unrest and a national referendum. The mine previously provided about 1.5% of global copper. With supply tightening, copper spot prices have risen over 11% this year.

title: Australia news live: baby injured in Bondi attack leaves intensive care; Albanese to announce $400m loan to Queensland alumina project
summary: Australia’s federal government plans to provide $400m in loans to a Queensland alumina facility and fast-track support for a graphite project. The alumina funding is relevant to the aluminium supply chain, potentially improving expectations for aluminium production inputs and project progress in coming weeks.

title: Man arrested after 'massive amounts' of copper, wiring stolen from Bibb County building
summary: A man was arrested after a February burglary at a vacant Bibb County building where thieves reportedly removed “massive amounts” of copper and electrical wiring, fixtures, and other items. The incident caused estimated thefts and damage totaling about $3 million, and the suspect faces burglary charges.

title: Rio Tinto : 2024 First Quarter Operations Review
summary: Rio Tinto’s first-quarter operations review (Apr 16, 2024) cites higher copper production (+7% y/y) and improved output from key sites after downtime, and higher aluminium output (+5% y/y) with Kitimat back to full capacity. Full-year guidance is unchanged, suggesting stable near-term supply expectations.

title: Podcast: Nickel 28 CEO Anthony Milewski on battery metals, EVs and green nickel
summary: The podcast with Nickel 28’s CEO focuses on nickel market developments, arguing that miners are struggling because Indonesia—holding about 70% of global supply—has created oversupply and keeps prices under pressure. It also touches on shifting demand narratives for nickel amid EVs, AI, and the energy grid.

title: Rio Tinto aims to keep Resolution's copper in US, executive says
summary: Rio Tinto executive says Resolution’s planned output from Arizona would be sold inside the U.S. if approved. The project is delayed and faces Native American legal opposition, with Biden having paused a decision in 2021. The dispute highlights potential U.S. supply constraints amid strong copper demand expectations.

title: A $10 billion Panamanian copper mine has been sitting idle since November - and it's part of why the metal's price is surging
summary: The headline says a $10 billion Panamanian copper mine has been idle since November. It attributes part of copper’s recent price surge to this prolonged shutdown, implying reduced mine output and tighter near-term supply conditions for copper markets.

title: Material Matters: Base Metals, Coal & Iron Ore
summary: Analysts at Morgan Stanley and UBS expect upside price support for aluminium, copper, and nickel after new UK and US bans on Russian metal deliveries to LME/CME warehouses. Russia contributes notable supply shares, and restrictions could disrupt trade flows and increase non-Russian premiums, despite limited US inflows.

title: Rio Tinto aims to keep Resolution's copper in US, executive says | The Mighty 790 KFGO
summary: Rio Tinto’s executive said the company wants all copper from its Resolution mine to be sold in the U.S. if regulators approve the project, while opponents pursue legal challenges. The mine would materially increase U.S. supply, but regulatory uncertainty keeps near-term supply expectations tight, supporting copper prices.

title: Half a million hectares of Indonesian forest under threat from nickel mining, study finds
summary: A study finds accelerating deforestation tied to Indonesia’s nickel mining, including illegal clearing in protected areas and pollution concerns. With Indonesia pushing to expand for EV batteries, advocates urge stronger enforcement, responsible mining standards, EV supply-chain audits, and possible moratoriums on new coal refining capacity—risks that could pressure nickel markets.

title: Antofagasta backs guidance despite drop in copper production
summary: Antofagasta reported Q1 copper production down 11% due to lower grades at Centinela and maintenance at Los Pelambres delaying concentrate movement. It kept annual copper guidance unchanged, citing rescheduling of delayed output into later quarters. First-quarter cash costs rose, but no change in full-year expectations was signaled.

title: Biden Seeks To Triple Tariffs On Chinese Steel And Aluminum
summary: Biden is seeking to triple tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum. If implemented, the higher duty would likely discourage imports and increase costs for downstream users, weakening near-term aluminum demand expectations and exerting downward pressure on aluminum prices. Steel is mentioned but is not tracked here.

title: Biden wants to hike tariffs on imports of Chinese steel and aluminum
summary: Biden is asking the U.S. Trade Representative to triple Section 301 tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum and potentially raise cumulative tariffs (to 50% for steel and 35% for aluminum, after Section 232). The move aims to deter cheap Chinese exports. It should support aluminum prices and modestly lift industrial metal sentiment, including copper.

title: Biden wants to triple China tariffs on steel, aluminum imports
summary: Biden asks the U.S. to triple tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum imports, arguing subsidies distort competition. The move targets aluminum directly and could reduce or reroute China’s sales into the U.S., supporting aluminum prices. The article also discusses overcapacity concerns and denies any tariff-driven inflation impact.

title: Biden Seeks Higher Tariffs on Chinese Steel, Aluminum to Support US Firms
summary: The article’s headline says the Biden administration is seeking higher tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum to support US firms. Tariffs on aluminum imports would likely reduce supply availability in the US, improving pricing conditions and potentially pushing aluminium prices higher in the near term.

title: Biden pushes to triple tariffs on Chinese steel, aluminum - World
summary: Biden urged the US to triple existing Section 301 tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminium, citing unfair competition from China’s subsidies and high-emissions overproduction. The move follows a USTR probe into China’s shipbuilding and logistics practices. Officials also seek to curb tariff evasion via Mexico, supporting domestic metal demand.

title: Record low copper TCs hitting Chinese smelter competitiveness | Hotter Commodities
summary: Record low copper concentrate treatment charges CIF Asia Pacific are hitting Chinese smelters, signaling severe concentrate tightness. Supply disruptions (including suspension at Cobre Panama) and lower mine output guidance have reduced availability. Smelters’ competitiveness worsens as new capacity changes curtailment risk, prompting calls for more production cuts in China.

title: Codelco in talks for new copper smelter, chairman says | Hotter Commodities
summary: Codelco chairman says the company is in talks with investors to build new smelting capacity in Chile to replace the closed Ventanas smelter. Codelco is prepared to supply concentrate, amid tight spot concentrate markets and plummeting concentrate treatment/refining charges after supply disruptions.

title: Australia provides $256mn to high-purity alumina plant
