summary: Australia will provide A$400m in loans to Alpha HPA for a high-purity alumina processing facility in Queensland, with contingent drawdowns linked to securing letters of intent for 10,000 t/yr output. Smaller state grants support related stages and a separate HPA project is planned in WA.

title: PAN GLOBAL INTERSECTS 11 METERS AT 2.36G/T GOLD AND 22 METERS AT 0.41% COPPER, EXPANDING CAÑADA HONDA COPPER-GOLD DISCOVERY, SPAIN
summary: Pan Global reported stepout drill results from its Cañada Honda Cu-Au discovery in Spain, including a 22m intercept grading 0.41% copper and indications that copper-gold mineralization is expanding westward and is open downdip/east. The update is broadly supportive for copper expectations, though effects are likely modest.

title: Alcoa (AA) Climbs on Report Biden to Call for Higher Tariffs on Chinese Steel, Aluminum
summary: Alcoa shares rose on a Bloomberg report that President Biden will propose higher tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum during a Pennsylvania visit. The tariff move could limit Chinese aluminum imports into the U.S., tightening supply expectations and supporting near-term aluminum price sentiment.

title: Zambia Copper Mines Hit by State Utility's Warning of Power Cuts
summary: Zambia’s copper mines face disruption after the state utility warned of potential power cuts. The likely effect is reduced electricity availability for mining and processing operations, which can lower near-term copper supply expectations and pressure copper prices over the coming days.

title: Impact of UK and US Restrictions on Russian Copper Transactions on Global Copper Market
summary: The UK and US imposed new sanctions limiting LME/CME trading for Russian-produced aluminium, copper, and nickel from April 13 onward and the US banned imports of these metals. LME regulations may prompt holders to warehouse remaining eligible stock, increasing visible inventories and supporting price pressure amid supply-risk concerns.

title: Biden Proposes Tripling Tariffs on Chinese Steel, Aluminum
summary: President Biden proposed tripling tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum imports, following pressure from labor unions to extend tariffs on Chinese goods. The higher duties would raise the landed cost of Chinese aluminum into the U.S., likely tightening supply and supporting near-term aluminum pricing expectations.

title: President Joe Biden calls for U.S. to triple tariffs on Chinese steel, aluminum imports
summary: The White House asks the U.S. Trade Representative to consider tripling the average 7.5% tariff on certain Chinese steel and aluminum imports, citing unfair, emissions-intensive competition and market “cloaking” via Mexico. The move is likely to support U.S. aluminum pricing, with limited indirect impact on broader metals sentiment.

title: Biden pushes to triple tariffs on Chinese steel, aluminum
summary: Biden urged the U.S. to triple Section 301 tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum, citing “unfair competition” and China’s industrial overcapacity and below-market pricing. The USTR also launched a probe into China’s shipbuilding, maritime and logistics trade practices following union petitions, aiming to protect U.S. producers and workers.

title: Asiamet hails "outstanding" high grade copper sample results
summary: Asiamet Resources said grab samples from its BKM copper deposit in Central Kalimantan assayed 24.0% and 23.3% copper. The company called the results “outstanding,” noting they reinforce upside potential and align with a mine plan targeting high-grade starter pits to deliver copper feed early in the project’s life.

title: Biden Pushes To Triple Tariffs On Chinese Steel, Aluminum
summary: Biden urged the US to triple tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum, citing unfair competition from China’s subsidies and overcapacity that lead to underpriced imports. The USTR is also probing China’s shipbuilding, maritime, and logistics trade practices. Tariff escalation is likely supportive for aluminum prices over days to weeks.

title: NWC taps investors to raise funds for Antler Copper Project
summary: New World Resources secured about A$20.4m to fund further development and fast-track exploration drilling at its Antler Copper Project in Arizona. The placement supports assessment of new high-priority targets and advancement toward production, with management citing a favourable copper market outlook.

title: Biden plans to slap 15% tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminium as part of trade war with Beijing started under Donald Trump
summary: Biden plans to triple steel tariffs on China and increase tariffs on certain Chinese products including aluminium, raising them to 25% from 7.5% or zero. The move is intended to protect US steel and aluminium producers and counter China’s manufacturing overcapacity, which could tighten near-term market expectations.

title: Five key talking points ahead of Fastmarkets' Bauxite & Alumina Conference
summary: Fastmarkets’ conference preview says alumina supply tightness is dominating sentiment after Kwinana’s alumina refinery curtailment, Guinea bauxite shipment delays, and Gladstone gas-pipeline issues. It also points to LME aluminium strength above $2,400/tonne and rising physical premiums. US/UK restrictions on Russia-origin trading may support aluminium, copper and nickel.

title: As Biden visits Pittsburgh, he proposes tripling tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum
summary: President Biden, speaking in Pittsburgh, pledged to oppose the U.S. Steel sale and proposed tripling tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum. Supporters say it will strengthen domestic industry, while critics warn tariffs raise consumer costs. Officials also claim measures are targeted to counter China’s export surge.

title: Column-Funds buy back into copper's super-cycle credentials: Andy home
summary: Reuters says funds are buying back into copper’s “super-cycle” narrative as LME three-month copper hit multi-month highs. Long positions on the LME and CME reached record levels, amid expectations of supply constraints and demand from energy transition and AI data centres, even as physical users report weaker orders.

title: Biden seeks higher tariffs on Chinese steel, aluminum to support U.S. firms
summary: The article says President Biden is seeking higher tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum to support U.S. firms. Higher aluminum tariffs would likely reduce China’s ability to sell into the U.S., tightening near-term supply and improving pricing support for global and U.S.-linked aluminum markets over coming weeks.

title: Biden aims to triple tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum imports
summary: Biden said he will urge the U.S. trade representative to consider tripling tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum imports from 7.5% if an investigation finds anti-competitive practices. The White House cites unfair competition from low-priced, higher-emissions Chinese products and aims to prevent tariff avoidance via Mexico.

title: Funds buy back into copper's super-cycle credentials: Andy home
summary: Reuters reports copper near its highest since June 2022, helped by new U.S./UK sanctions on Russian metal and, mainly, funds increasing long exposure to record levels on the LME and CME. The bullish narrative cites supply constraints, AI-driven data centre demand, and rotation into commodities despite weak manufacturing data.

title: Biden wants to triple tariffs on Chinese steel, aluminum
summary: The White House said China is flooding the U.S. with artificially cheap steel and aluminium and that President Biden wants to triple related tariffs. If implemented, the higher cost of Chinese metal imports would likely tighten U.S. aluminium supply and lift domestic pricing expectations over the coming days to weeks.

title: Biden Seeks Steep Tariffs Hike on Some Chinese Steel, Aluminum Imports
summary: The Biden administration reportedly seeks to more than triple tariffs on some imports of steel and aluminum from China to 25% from 7.5%, alongside existing Trump-era duties. U.S. measures aim to protect domestic producers as Beijing faces accusations of excess capacity and dumping. Alcoa shares rose on the news.

title: Aluminum Prices Chase 2023 Highs
summary: Aluminum prices have been rallying into early April, reaching the highest levels since February 2023. LME investment funds shifted to a large net-long bias, while aluminum premiums across the U.S., Europe, and Japan rose sharply. Drought reduced Yunnan output in February, supporting supply concerns, despite expected recovery later in Q2.

title: Biden proposes 25% tariff hike on Chinese steel and aluminum
summary: US President Joe Biden proposed a 25% tariff increase on selected Chinese steel and aluminum imports as part of a protectionist trade strategy. While steel is not directly tracked here, the aluminum tariff is likely to reduce import competitiveness and support near-term aluminum price expectations by tightening supply into the US.

title: Mining Stock News Bite - Gold Copper stock Doubleview Gold Corp. (TSXV: DBG.V) Gains on TSX Venture
summary: Doubleview Gold Corp.’s stock rises without a new release, with the article citing recent drill-hole results at its Hat Porphyry project showing significant copper and gold intervals and near-surface continuation. These updates may support copper-related sentiment, but the piece contains no nickel or aluminium supply/demand catalyst.

title: Biden Mulls Tripling Tariffs on Chinese Steel and Aluminum
summary: Biden is considering tripling Section 301 tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum imports to counter low-priced Chinese production and protect U.S. steel jobs. The move could raise U.S. aluminum import costs and support prices, though timing is uncertain. Authorities also weigh inflation concerns and a related U.S. Steel transaction.

title: Biden wants higher tariffs on China steel, aluminum
summary: The article headline says President Biden wants higher tariffs on China steel and aluminum. Tariff increases against Chinese metal imports can reduce US-bound supply, lift landed costs, and tighten near-term availability. That dynamic is generally supportive for aluminium prices over the following days to weeks.

title: Biden says he'll urge U.S. trade rep to consider tripling tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum imports
summary: Biden said he will urge the U.S. trade representative to consider tripling tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum imports from 7.5%, contingent on findings from an ongoing investigation into alleged anti-competitive practices. He also cited efforts to prevent China-origin steel and aluminum transiting Mexico to dodge tariffs.

title: Fathom Nickel Inc. (CSE: FNI) (FSE: 6Q5) (OTCQB: FNICF) Sees Great Potential Across Its Saskatchewan Nickel Projects
summary: Fathom Nickel highlights exploration progress on two Saskatchewan nickel projects (Albert Lake and Gochager Lake) and frames nickel demand growth around the EV transition, citing forecasts of a large demand increase by 2030. The story supports bullish sentiment for nickel, though it is primarily long-term and promotional.

title: Biden triple tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminium, denies trade war
summary: Biden announced tripling tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminium imports while denying a new trade war. The policy aims to support US workers in battleground states. The article suggests it is unlikely to hurt iron ore and coal demand, but the aluminium tariff change is likely to affect near-term aluminium supply and pricing.

title: Materials Up as Copper, Aluminum Test Highs -- Materials Roundup
summary: Copper and aluminium rose to multi-year highs as industrial and metals futures climbed on inflation expectations and reported shortages. Demand improved, while additional sanctions on Russian smelters constrained supply. The roundup notes traders seeking inflation-resilient niches, with precious-metals sentiment also in focus.

title: Materials Up as Copper, Aluminum Test Highs -- Materials Roundup
summary: Metals futures rose toward multi-year highs as shortages and inflation expectations boosted demand. The article says copper and aluminium both cleared their highest levels since 2022 and 2023, respectively, driven by improving global demand and supply constraints from new sanctions on Russian smelters.

title: BHP's iron ore output rises; still reviewing plans for nickel ops
summary: BHP reported higher third-quarter iron ore output from Pilbara, helped by ramp-up at the South Flank mine and better efficiencies. Separately, it said it is reviewing plans for its Western Australian nickel operations and will update on nickel by FY24 results in August 2024, implying uncertainty without immediate supply changes.

title: Biden says he'll urge US trade representative to consider tripling of tariffs on steel, aluminium imports from China
summary: Biden said he will urge the US Trade Representative to consider tripling tariffs on steel and aluminium imports from China, contingent on an investigation finding anti-competitive practices. If implemented, the higher tariffs would raise China-origin aluminium costs and likely support US aluminium pricing in the near term.

title: BHP to decide on future of nickel business by August, trims met coal estimates
summary: BHP said it will announce by August the fate of its Western Australian nickel operations, aiming to optimize and preserve value. The company also trimmed Queensland metallurgical coal output estimates due to wet weather, but nickel-specific production impacts were not stated. Indonesian supply pressure has already weighed on nickel prices.

title: US-China relations: President Joe Biden triples tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminium, denies trade war
summary: The US President Biden dismissed fears of a renewed trade war while tripling tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminium imports. The policy aims to bolster support in US battleground states and is likely to affect aluminium supply and pricing near term by raising costs of Chinese imports.

title: Australia's Titan Minerals to sell up to 80% of Ecuador copper project to Hancock
summary: Titan Minerals said Hancock Prospecting will acquire up to 80% of its Linderos copper project in Ecuador for as much as $120 million, subject to due diligence. The announcement boosted Titan’s shares sharply, and the transaction suggests progress toward copper project development, modestly supporting copper sentiment in the near term.

title: Biden calls for increased tariffs on foreign steel, aluminum in Pittsburgh speech
summary: In a Pittsburgh speech, President Biden urged increased tariffs on foreign steel and aluminum. Tariffs can reduce aluminum imports and improve the competitiveness of domestic supply, which may tighten availability and lift expectations for near-term aluminum prices. Direct impact magnitude depends on implementation timing and scope.

title: The economic effects of U.S. tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum
summary: The article discusses a Biden proposal to triple U.S. tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum. It notes that earlier tariffs increased steel prices and shifted import flows. The same tariff pressure on Chinese aluminum could raise U.S. aluminium import costs, supporting upward near-term price expectations.

title: BHP's energy coal fires up, axe swings over nickel jobs
summary: BHP said it may move Nickel West into care and maintenance and will decide on WA nickel operations by August. Nickel volumes fell 4% to 19 kt in the quarter, affected by severe weather and Kwinana refinery maintenance. The review risk adds near-term nickel supply uncertainty.

title: Rinehart Expands Ecuador Push With Stake in Copper-Gold Project
summary: The headline says Gina Rinehart’s company is expanding its Ecuador position by taking a stake in a copper-gold project. While this is relevant to copper through future supply expectations, the provided article content lacks production, ramp-up, or timeline details, so near-term price effects are likely limited.

title: BHP (ASX:BHP) Russia sanctions put a rocket under BHP's copper outlook
summary: BHP says fresh US/UK sanctions affecting Russian metal flows and an LME trading ban on certain Russian metals will squeeze existing supply. The piece also cites expected refined copper supply pressure (from concentrate constraints) over 3–6 months and notes BHP’s nickel outlook could change in Western Australia.

title: Chile president says Codelco copper output to grow in 2024
summary: Chile’s President Gabriel Boric told a copper industry conference that Codelco production is expected to rebound and grow slowly in 2024, reaching about 1.7 million tons by 2030. He also suggested copper prices should rise, supporting bullish sentiment for nearby copper contracts.

title: BHP Q3 Iron Ore Production Rises; Says On Track To Meet Copper And Iron Ore Production For FY
summary: BHP said its Q3 total copper production rose to 465.9 thousand tonnes from 405.9 thousand tonnes a year earlier and reiterated FY2024 copper guidance of 1.72–1.91 million tonnes. With supply expectations improving in the near term, the market could price in softer copper tightness over coming weeks.

title: World News | Biden Says He'll Urge US Trade Representative to Consider Tripling of Tariffs on Steel, Aluminium Imports from China
summary: Biden said he will urge the US Trade Representative to consider tripling tariffs on aluminium imports from China if an anti-competitive practices investigation confirms subsidised, dumping behaviour. He accused China of funding steel producers and routing imports via Mexico, and described related actions to protect US industrial jobs.

title: Gina Rinehart builds big copper portfolio in Ecuador while spotlight on rare earths, lithium investments
summary: Gina Rinehart is investing further in copper by agreeing to buy an 80% stake in Ecuador’s Linderos project for up to $120 million. The piece also notes her broader resource focus, including rare earths and lithium, but the explicitly detailed transaction is tied to copper growth prospects.

title: BHP posts strong output for copper, iron ore, energy coal
summary: BHP reported higher copper output in its nine-month operational review, citing record production at Spence and strong performance at key Chile and South Australia operations. It cut metallurgical coal guidance due to wet weather and fatalities. Nickel output fell slightly, and BHP is evaluating options for its Nickel West business.

title: Rinehart's Hanrine to join Titan Minerals in Ecuadorian copper hunt
summary: Titan Minerals and Hanrine (Hancock Prospecting subsidiary) propose a joint venture to explore Ecuador’s Linderos copper project, with earn-in milestones up to 80% ownership and planned drilling and funding. The deal signals confidence in a large-scale copper porphyry system, modestly supportive for near-term copper sentiment.

title: Total bauxite imports in January-February 2024 increased by 4% YoY, with monthly imports in January reaching a record high
summary: China’s bauxite imports rose 4% YoY in Jan-Feb 2024, but domestic supply remains tight as some mines stopped before CNY. Refineries increased imported ore use, lifting prices; Guinea CIF bauxite rose to $71/mt vs $58/mt from Australia. SMM expects shipments to stay active and supply improve modestly.

title: Aluminum rod market failed to return to the peak season in March due to new production capacity and output cuts
summary: Aluminium rod production rose in March on new capacity and capacity recoveries, but shipments stayed weak due to downstream caution from high aluminium prices. Some regions reduced output amid competition and inventory. With surplus supply and persistent inventory pressure into April, processing fees look stable, suggesting bearish near-term aluminium sentiment.

title: Sierra Metals Reports Q1 2024 Production Results, Including Record Quarterly Copper Equivalent Production at Bolivar
summary: Sierra Metals reported Q1 2024 production results from its Bolivar copper mine and Yauricocha polymetallic mine. Bolivar achieved record quarterly copper-equivalent production, with higher access and higher grades driving copper, silver, and gold output gains. Overall throughput rose versus Q1 2023, supporting near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Eagle Royalties Ltd.: Encouraging Results Reported by Fathom at Albert Lake Nickel/PGE Project
summary: Eagle Royalties reviewed Fathom Nickel’s Winter 2024 results at the Albert Lake nickel project. Drilling (including AL24077) reportedly intersected elevated nickel tenor similar to the nearby Rottenstone Ni-Cu+PGE deposit, with BHEM and geochemistry anomalies suggesting a robust ultramafic target. Eagle highlights royalty dispositions but no production change yet.

title: NevGold Announces Positive Copper Porphyry Potential at the Zeus Copper Project in the Hercules Copper Trend, Idaho
summary: NevGold reports positive results from a geological review and 3-D modeling of its newly staked Zeus copper project in Idaho’s Hercules trend, citing similarities to the Hercules porphyry discovery. The company plans an active field program starting in May, but no production or immediate supply impact is announced.

title: Biden Urges USTR To Triple Tariff Rate On Chinese Steel And Aluminum
summary: Biden urged the USTR to consider tripling existing Section 301 tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum, citing unfair competition and subsidized, emissions-intensive Chinese production. The proposed higher tariffs would likely reduce Chinese import flows into the U.S., tightening supply conditions—most directly supportive for aluminium prices over coming days to weeks.

title: FOCUS-Panama election unlikely to shift outlook for First Quantum's copper mine
summary: Reuters reviews Panama’s May election campaigns and protest positions over First Quantum’s Cobre Panama copper mine. Protests led to annulment of the concession and a ban on new metal mining permits. The story suggests candidates are unlikely to reverse closures, supporting ongoing supply constraints and keeping copper tight.

title: NevGold Corp.: NevGold Announces Positive Copper Porphyry Potential at the Zeus Copper Project in the Hercules Copper Trend, Idaho
summary: NevGold announced positive geological review results for its newly staked Zeus Copper Project in Idaho, identifying significant copper porphyry potential and similarities to the Hercules copper porphyry discovery. The company plans further mapping, geochemical sampling, geophysics, and potential drill testing starting May as conditions improve.

title: Universal Copper Ltd.: Vizsla Copper Completes Acquisition of Universal Copper
summary: Vizsla Copper completed its acquisition of Universal Copper via a court-approved arrangement, bringing together copper projects in British Columbia. Management claims the copper market is facing structural undersupply with rising demand from EV, AI and cloud build-outs, citing analyst calls for US$6/lb copper near term.

title: Orion advances Okiep Copper Project acquisition in South Africa
summary: Orion Minerals signed addenda to agreements to acquire a controlling interest in South Africa’s Okiep Copper Project, with IDC approvals still pending. Consideration involves cash and Orion shares and phased asset transfers. Further regulatory approvals are required before the first phase of transactions proceeds.

title: Schlangental Drilling Intercepts 7.0m at 3.52% Copper and 43.09g/t Silver 15km East of Kombat Mine
summary: Trigon Metals reported early drilling results at Schlangental on its Kombat property in Namibia, including intercepts of 7.0m at 3.52% copper and 3.0m at 1.99% copper, alongside elevated silver. The company says this confirms copper mineralization extends beyond the main licence, prompting deeper follow-up drilling plans.

title: China firmly opposes U.S. restrictive measures on Chinese steel, aluminum products: ministry-Xinhua
summary: China’s Commerce Ministry said it opposes new U.S. restrictive measures on Chinese steel and aluminum products, which could triple tariffs. China called the steps unilateral and urged the U.S. to cancel additional tariffs, warning they could undermine global industrial supply chains and prompting retaliation risk.

title: Class 1 Nickel Provides Operations and Exploration Update on Its Advanced Nickel Project, Timmins, Canada
summary: Class 1 Nickel reports progress on an independent review and a pending updated Mineral Resource Estimate for its Alexo-Dundonald nickel project (Alexo South first), plus ongoing work on other deposits, pit shell design, and permitting to evaluate returning to small-scale production. No production timing or supply changes are announced.

title: Class 1 Nickel Provides Operations and Exploration Update
summary: Class 1 Nickel announced completion of the first stage of an independent review for its Alexo-Dundonald nickel sulphide projects and is nearing an updated Mineral Resource Estimate for Alexo South, with other deposit updates underway. The work supports continued exploration and potential return to small-scale nickel production.

title: Brazilian aluminium industry plans further decarbonization
summary: Brazil’s aluminium industry is accelerating decarbonization via renewable power, switching refineries away from coal/heavy fuel oil, and expanding scrap treatment to raise recycled content. Producers also prepare for EU CBAM to avoid imports of higher-emissions material. The article frames a premium for greener aluminium and improved recycling economics.

title: European copper demand strong, with requests to increase order volumes, Aurubis CEO says | Hotter Commodities
summary: Aurubis CEO Roland Harings said discussions with European customers indicate strong demand for copper products, especially wire rod, with requests to raise long-term contract volumes and quotas. The company maintains stable copper premiums for 2024, linking price strength to growing acceptance of copper’s role in electrification.

title: Aurubis not considering cuts amid low copper TCs, CEO says | Hotter Commodities
summary: Aurubis CEO says the firm is unlikely to consider production cuts because it relies on long-term concentrate contracts with little spot exposure and a diversified mine portfolio. The wider market context is sharply lower copper concentrate TCs at record lows, prompting some Chinese smelters to curb output.

title: FPX Nickel secures key expansion to alliance with Japan Organization for Metals and Energy Security
summary: FPX Nickel said it expanded its Generative Alliance with JOGMEC, increasing Year Two funding from $650,000 to $1.5 million to identify and acquire high-quality awaruite nickel properties. The program is evaluating projects across multiple jurisdictions and provinces, with about 120 km2 staked in British Columbia.

title: Class 1 Nickel and Technologies Limited: Class 1 Nickel Provides Operations and Exploration Update on Its Advanced Nickel Project, Timmins, Canada
summary: Class 1 Nickel reports progress on independent review and updated Mineral Resource Estimate work for its Alexo-Dundonald nickel sulphide project in Timmins, including a near-complete updated MRE for Alexo South and ongoing updates for other deposits. The company is also reviewing permitting with an aim to resume small-scale nickel production.

title: Hanrine looks to earn into Titan's Linderos copper project in Ecuador
summary: Titan Minerals has offered a joint venture to Hanrine Ecuadorian Exploration and Mining to earn up to an 80% stake in the Linderos copper project in Ecuador. The project has permitted exploration and earlier drilling confirmed copper porphyry mineralisation. Investment milestones could increase Hanrine’s stake to 80%.

title: Codelco Copper Output Affected by Fatal Accident, Chile Minister Says
summary: Chile’s minister says Codelco copper output is affected by a fatal accident. The disruption suggests short-term production losses and potential tighter near-term copper availability from one of the world’s largest suppliers, which would likely weigh on copper prices over the coming days as the market prices reduced supply.

title: Funds quickly buy back into copper's super-cycle credentials
summary: Reuters reports copper prices hitting a multi-year high and highlights funds rapidly adding long exposure on both LME and CME, with record positions. The rally is attributed largely to expectations of future physical shortages and demand from energy transition/AI rather than immediate physical tightness, despite lukewarm current order books.

title: China firmly opposes U.S. restrictive measures on Chinese steel, aluminum products: ministry
summary: China’s Commerce Ministry said it opposes new U.S. restrictive measures that could triple tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminium products. The ministry called the actions protectionist and urged immediate cancellation. It warned the tariffs could further undermine global industrial and supply-chain stability.

title: BHP's growing love for copper in South Australia
summary: BHP says its March-quarter copper production rose 49% on higher volumes from OZ Minerals mines plus strong Olympic Dam operations and smelter performance. It also discusses potential Olympic Dam smelter upgrades and future Oak Dam development approvals. The backdrop is a near-term concentrate shortage supporting copper prices.

title: China firmly opposes U.S. restrictive measures on Chinese steel, aluminum products: ministry--China Economic Net
summary: China’s Commerce Ministry said it opposes new U.S. restrictive measures that could triple tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum products, calling them unilateral and protectionist. China urged the U.S. to cancel additional tariffs and said it will defend its rights, warning about disruption to global supply chains.

title: Century Aluminum : 2024 Proxy Statement - MarketScreener
summary: Century Aluminum’s proxy notes Section 45X production tax credits for primary aluminum were confirmed by proposed Treasury regulations, strengthening policy support for U.S. aluminum output. It also cites broadly balanced supply/demand, constrained supply, and expectations of accelerating demand in 2024, supportive for aluminum pricing.

title: China firmly opposes US restrictive measures on Chinese steel, aluminum products
summary: China’s Commerce Ministry criticized new U.S. restrictive measures on Chinese steel and aluminum products, saying tariffs could triple. It called the actions protectionist and urged the U.S. to cancel additional tariffs. China warned the move could destabilize global industrial supply chains, while it plans countermeasures.

title: London aluminium set for 6th straight weekly gain after sanctions on Russia
summary: London nonferrous prices rose as sanctions restricted Russian metal supply. The LME banned Russian metal produced on or after April 13 and cancellations of delivery warrants lifted, signalling market nervousness. LME aluminium climbed for a sixth weekly gain; copper and nickel also rose on supply worries tied to Russia being a major aluminium supplier.

title: Over 130ha post bauxite-mining land to be returned for building resettlement areas
summary: Đắk Nông plans to return over 130ha of post bauxite-mining land for resettlement and high-tech agriculture after Đắk Nông Aluminium Co. submits closure paperwork for the Nhân Cơ bauxite mine. Authorities urged faster phased approvals and immediate closure of areas meeting criteria, following ministry instructions.

title: New Caledonia's nickel French 'pact' in limbo
summary: France’s proposed nickel rescue pact for New Caledonia remains unsigned as a special committee re-examines it. Meanwhile Koniambo is mothballed after Glencore exits, Prony/SLN face closure risk, and SLN extraction is halted by blockades. These supply risks, plus cheap Indonesian output, bearishly affect nickel sentiment.

title: Abu Dhabi's IHC arm offers to acquire Vedanta Resources' Zambian copper business
summary: Abu Dhabi’s IHC mining arm IRH has offered more than $1 billion for a 51% stake in Vedanta’s Zambian copper business, including Konkola Copper Mines, as talks continue. The moves follow IRH’s earlier Zambia purchases and aim to fund redevelopment, including the Konkola Deep project, supporting near-term copper sentiment.

title: US low-carbon aluminium units command premium for first time
summary: US Midwest low-carbon aluminium value-added differentials have turned positive, with a reported sale at a small premium over high-carbon units. Sources cite tighter billet availability despite demand pickup for billets and primary foundry alloy. Related 6063 extrusion billet premiums in the Midwest rose on Friday, indicating bullish near-term pricing pressure.

title: Copper hits two-year high as base metals rise on fund buying
summary: Copper hit a nearly two-year high as base metals rallied on ongoing fund buying driven by supply concerns. LME aluminium rose after rules preventing new Russia-made metal from LME/CME warehouses and stock withdrawals reduced exchange availability. Nickel also jumped, gaining momentum after reclaiming key technical levels.

title: Rio Tinto, Saudi Arabia eye stake in First Quantum's Zambia copper mines
summary: Rio Tinto and Saudi Arabia-backed Manara Minerals are reportedly considering stakes in First Quantum Minerals’ Sentinel and Kansanshi copper mines in Zambia. The company may sell up to 30% as it restructures after a Panama mine closure. Multiple Chinese and Japanese firms are also assessing bids, indicating strong deal momentum.

title: Nickel hits 7-month high on talk of China government buying
summary: Nickel prices rose to a seven-month high as LME three-month nickel gained sharply. The move was driven by talk that China’s strategic stockpiler may buy nickel for reserves and concerns over tighter supply from Indonesia. A source said China sought 200,000 tonnes of nickel pig iron or 20,000 tonnes of refined nickel.

title: Doctor Copper Has A Message on Inflation
summary: The post argues copper is a leading indicator for inflation, citing a correlation between copper price movements (shifted forward) and future CPI growth. It highlights copper rising from a December 2023 low to above $4/lb and suggests inflation may keep rising. It also notes China trading limits that may temper speculative-driven spikes.

title: New Orleans S&WB report copper theft at major pumping station
summary: New Orleans Sewerage and Water Board said vandalism and copper theft contributed to a power problem at Pump Station 6 during last week’s flood emergency. An electric feeder cable between the Carrollton water plant and DPS 6 was compromised. The board cites prior similar incidents in the city’s pumping system.

title: Congo Copper Mine Suspended Amid Radiation Concerns
summary: The piece’s title says a copper mine in Congo has been suspended over radiation concerns. Such a stoppage would interrupt near-term mine output, reducing expected copper supply and likely tightening availability, creating immediate bearish pressure on copper prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Securing a Domestic Supply Chain: Why Fathom Nickel Inc. (CSE: FNI) (FSE: 6Q5) (OTCQB: FNICF) Matters for North America
summary: MiningNewsWire argues North America depends heavily on foreign nickel for EV and carbon goals, leaving supply-chain risk. It points to Canada’s potential resurgence in nickel production, citing Fathom Nickel’s large land position and past-producing mine within the Trans Hudson Corridor. The message supports expectations of improved domestic supply.

title: Another way to play the commodity breakout with a copper stock forming a 'bull flag' chart pattern
summary: CNBC chart commentary argues copper is outperforming other metals and shows a breakout above key levels, with targets higher. It attributes strength to improving Chinese demand after stimulative measures, support from infrastructure and green-energy spending, and a supply disruption of about 2% from mine shutdowns in Panama.

title: First Quantum copper mine closure halves Panama's growth
summary: The piece says First Quantum’s US$10 billion Cobre Panama copper mine closure has cut Panama’s growth and worsened investor concerns about downgrades. It details weaker sovereign bond performance and rising risk premia as the IMF and rating firms question fiscal prospects, with the copper mine shutdown presented as a key factor.

title: Breaking Mining News: Alaska Energy Metals (TSXV: AEMC) (OTCQB: AKEMF) Files Amended NI 43-101 Technical Report for the Eureka Deposit, Nikolai Nickel Project, Alaska, USA
summary: Alaska Energy Metals announced filing of an amended NI 43-101 technical report for its Eureka/Nikolai nickel project in Alaska. The company says the report includes only non-material changes and the mineral resource estimate is unchanged from the original. No new production or supply shift is described.

title: Securing A Domestic Supply Chain: Why Fathom Nickel Inc. (CSE: FNI) (FSE: 6Q5) (OTCQB: FNICF) Matters For North America
summary: The piece says North America relies heavily on foreign nickel for EV and clean-energy goals, while Canada’s recent nickel output still falls short of demand. It points to Fathom Nickel’s large holdings in Canada’s Trans Hudson Corridor, including prior producing mineralization, as potential support for future domestic supply.

title: Weekend briefing: Oil price stays calm, cooper & aluminium rise to shine through economic clouds
summary: The weekend briefing highlights that the US and UK barred the LME/CME from accepting new Russian production of aluminium and copper, reducing available traded supply. It also states copper has risen about 16% and aluminium about 20% since late February, reinforcing a near-term bullish price impulse despite softer macro sentiment.

title: Copper Price Forecast: Top Trends That Will Impact Copper in 2024
summary: A copper outlook article highlights that tight supply drivers and power/EV-related demand support prices, but the key 2024 swing is a shift from expected surplus toward deficit. It attributes the change to production shortfalls, notably the shutdown of Cobre Panama and reduced output guidance from Anglo American, with demand potentially softer in early 2024.

title: Shelbyville copper plant playing a role in return of U.S. manufacturing
summary: A deputy U.S. Energy secretary visited Wieland Copper Recycling’s Shelbyville facility to celebrate a $270 million federal grant for a major expansion. The project will add jobs and boost domestic recycling, bringing scrap copper back from abroad (often China) to support U.S. manufacturing.

title: US Ban of Russian Aluminum on Global Exchanges May Impact World Market
summary: The article says the US will block Russian-origin aluminium from being imported and traded on the LME and CME, and that the same Treasury decision covers Russian copper and nickel. The Aluminum Association warns the exchange acceptance limits could affect global aluminium trading, though direct US supply impact is small.

title: Gold Prices: Copper, gold to rise further on demand outlook, macro uncertainties, Antaike says, ET Retail
summary: Antaike says metals with firm fundamentals will rise further, highlighting robust Chinese demand and macro uncertainty. Copper is supported by output-cut concerns from raw-material shortages and demand from new energy and AI-related tech, with expectations of continued capital inflows until US rate cuts. Aluminium is also flagged as potentially gaining.

title: BHP to Announce Decision on Western Australian Nickel Operations by August
summary: BHP said it expects to announce a decision on the future of its Western Australian nickel business in the coming months, as it reviews plans to optimize operations and preserve value. The upcoming update can shift near-term expectations for nickel supply, influencing nickel price sentiment over the next several weeks.

title: The market transaction sentiment has picked up, and the price of ferronickel is expected to be stable and strong in the short term.
summary: SMM reports nickel pig iron/ferronickel prices at 947.5 yuan per nickel point, up on the day. Strong cost support from high nickel-ore prices and limited output cuts counterbalances profit-inversion shutdowns. Russian nickel sanctions lifted pure nickel and stainless steel, pushing ferronickel upstream offers. Stainless steel demand stays firm, so prices are expected stable-to-strong short term.

title: The Indonesian holiday is over, and the nickel ore market is surging?
summary: Philippine nickel ore CIF prices rose over the week amid improving domestic ferronickel signals and slightly higher sea freight rates, while smelters stayed cautious. Indonesia’s nickel ore was mostly stable after Eid, with limited discounting to smelters. A new Philippines bidding round could influence next week’s trends.

title: The market sentiment picks up, and the price of ferronickel is expected to be stable and strong in the short term
summary: The piece expects ferronickel to stay stable and strong short term. It cites nickel ore high prices supporting smelter costs and limited production cuts, while Russian nickel sanctions over the weekend lifted pure nickel and stainless steel prices. Stainless steel spot rebound and firm demand also support higher ferronickel quotes.

title: Pre-holiday stocking was launched, and nickel salt prices remained stable
summary: The SMM battery-grade nickel sulfate index was 30,276 yuan/ton on April 19, up slightly due to automatic weight adjustment, while the battery-grade range stayed 30,100-30,500 yuan/ton. Inquiries picked up and precursor firms launched pre-May Day stocking, but transaction pricing remained mostly discounted low-average, with expectations of stable prices amid tight supply-demand.

title: 【Nickel Ore Weekly Review】Indonesia's holiday is over, the undercurrent of the nickel ore market is surging?
summary: The weekly review reports Philippine nickel ore CIF prices mostly stable, while upstream shipment sentiment improved slightly due to signs of ferronickel recovery and higher sea freight. Smelters remain cautious because ferronickel prices are still in a cost-inversion range. Indonesia’s prices also look stable post-Eid, with a small push to sell lower.

title: Pure nickel and stainless steel disk shocks upward revision, ferronickel prices are stable and strong
summary: Shanghai nickel rose after opening and ended +1.96%. Jinchuan nickel premium and nickel bean pricing were revised higher, while nickel sulfate demand showed improved inquiry activity. Ferronickel prices edged up on cost support from high ore costs and limited output cuts, with Russian nickel sanctions boosting sentiment; stainless steel demand improved.

title: Business.Scoop » Rural New Zealanders Front-of-mind In Commission's Copper Services Investigation
summary: New Zealand’s Commerce Commission begins a formal Copper Services Investigation, considering whether competitive broadband alternatives reduce the need for copper regulation in rural areas outside fibre. Monitoring shows fewer than half of such households are served by copper, as customers shift to satellite and wireless services like Starlink.

title: Nickel at multi-month highs as talks of Chinese purchase fuel supply fears
summary: Nickel prices rose to seven-month highs as market talk of China planning state stockpile purchases triggered concerns about tight supply. Anticipated buying of nickel pig iron, plus wider bullish sentiment and a Russia metals ban raising disruption fears, supported gains not only in nickel but also aluminium and copper.

title: Producing Low Copper Shred for Steel Mills
summary: The piece explains how a scrap yard uses a ballistic separator and polishing drum to produce “low copper” shredded scrap for steel mills, boosting recovery and reducing labor. Copper content of the low-copper stream is reported around 0.16%, with premiums often over $40/ton, implying localized copper scrap value impact.

title: South32 Q3 Alumina Production Edges Up
summary: South32 said Q3 alumina production edged up to 1.240 million tonnes from 1.239 million tonnes a year earlier, while quarterly aluminium output fell slightly to 278,000 tonnes from 279,000. FY2024 production and cost guidance is unchanged; cyclone Megan impacts only its Australia Manganese operations.

title: Copper's momentum intensifies with trade sanctions with 4.7 level as pivotal marker
summary: Copper’s uptrend accelerated as UK and US sanctions target Russian exports of key metals, including copper, aluminium and nickel, to major exchanges (LME/CME). The supply curbs coincide with mining disruptions and improving Chinese industrial activity. Funds also boosted net longs, raising the risk of a speculative push.

title: Russia's Nornickel to move copper plant to China, CEO tells Interfax
summary: Nornickel said it will shut its copper plant near Norilsk due to difficulty cutting emissions after losing access to Western technology. The company plans to build a new copper plant in China closer to consumers. The near-term effect is lower Russian supply, likely weighing on copper prices.

title: Russia's Nornickel to move copper plant to China, CEO tells Interfax
summary: Nornickel said it will shut its copper plant near Norilsk and build a replacement in China closer to consumers. The company cited difficulty meeting emissions requirements after losing access to Western technology. The shutdown can tighten near-term copper supply, weighing on prices despite future relocation plans.

title: South32 copper output down 15% in 3rd quarter; keeps outlook
summary: South32 said Q3 copper production fell 10% y/y to 13,900 tonnes and was down 11% from the prior quarter, though it kept FY guidance unchanged. Aluminium output was slightly lower q/q, and nine-month nickel production declined. Overall results are mixed but copper deterioration is the clearest near-term negative signal.

title: China's monthly bauxite import data in March 2024 | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s customs data shows March bauxite imports of 11.86 million mt, up 5.19% from February but slightly down year-on-year. Guinea remained the largest supplier. Australia’s imports surged MoM, boosting overall feedstock availability for alumina production, which may pressure aluminium prices near term.

title: Copper Fox Completes Final Payment on the Eaglehead Copper Property
summary: Copper Fox Metals says it has completed the final CAD 330,000 installment payment to acquire the Eaglehead porphyry copper project in British Columbia and that the exploration permit was extended to March 31, 2026. The update supports ongoing drilling and potential resource growth, but no near-term supply impact is stated.

title: Mining and Metallurgical Norilsk Nickel : Nornickel announces Consolidated Production Results for 1Q 2024
summary: Nornickel released preliminary 1Q2024 production results. Copper output rose versus 1Q2023, supported by operating efficiency improvements in the Trans-Baikal Division. Nickel production fell temporarily due to buildup of work-in-progress inventory, expected to be processed in Q2. The company also produced premium nickel for Chinese electroplating.

title: Copper demand to boom as new technology drives power consumption, Trafigura says
summary: Trafigura says EVs, power infrastructure, AI/data centres and automation could add at least 10 million tonnes of copper consumption over the next decade. It links stronger demand prospects to the energy transition and highlights tight refined supplies and concentrate disruptions, keeping LME copper near two-year highs.

title: Abu Dhabi's IRH vies for Vedanta's copper assets in Zambia
summary: IRH of Abu Dhabi is reportedly in talks to buy a 51% stake in Vedanta’s Zambian copper assets, KCM, with an offer above $1bn. The aim is to secure investment and potentially revitalize currently unprofitable operations, while Vedanta seeks capital and divestment of part of its holding.

title: Russia's Nornickel cuts nickel production by 10% y/y in Q1
summary: Nornickel cut Q1 nickel production 10% y/y to 42,000 tonnes and said sanctions have constrained development. The U.S. and U.K. also barred imports of Russian nickel (and other metals), limiting export revenues. Together, the supply reduction and trade restrictions point to bearish near-term nickel pricing.

title: Core Nickel Welcomes Paul Reid as a Significant Investor and Provides a Corporate Update
summary: Core Nickel Corp. welcomes a new significant investor and provides a corporate update. It completed a winter drilling campaign at its Halfway Lake nickel belt properties in Manitoba, drilling three holes and intersecting sulfide mineralization in all three. The release highlights ongoing exploration aimed at developing nickel resources.

title: Nevada Copper Provides Financing Update - The Globe and Mail
summary: Nevada Copper said it needs additional near-term funding to complete commissioning and ramp-up of its Pumpkin Hollow Underground copper mine. It is in discussions with third parties and stakeholders, but funding is not assured and could lead to creditor protection if financing is not secured, threatening copper production timelines.

title: Canada Nickel Announces Exercise of Mann Property Option with Noble
summary: Canada Nickel says it exercised an option to acquire an 80% interest in the Mann Nickel Property from Noble, completing required exploration spend and cash payments. The company plans additional 2024 delineation and first-time drilling at targets intersecting nickel-bearing ultramafic rocks, supporting continued nickel project development.

title: Nigeria's $3.2 billion aluminum sinkhole has been untapped for 27 years – The News Chronicle
summary: Nigeria’s ALSCON aluminium smelter near Ikot Abasi remains idle, missing another restart deadline after the planned 2023 timeline. The plant, owned 85% by UC Rusal and 15% by Nigeria’s government, has been delayed since 2007 due to financing and contract issues. The latest setback weakens prospects for local aluminium output.

title: Aston Bay and American West Metals Announce Drilling and Geophysics Underway at the Storm Copper Project, Canada
summary: Aston Bay and American West report that track-mounted RC drilling and moving-loop EM geophysics are underway at Canada’s Storm Copper Project on Somerset Island, Nunavut. The program targets new copper zones near known mineralization and expands infill drilling at Cyclone and Chinook, supporting an upcoming maiden resource estimate in May 2024.

title: Mink Ventures Acquires Copper Project Adjacent to Warren North Claims
summary: Mink Ventures acquired six copper claims adjacent to its Warren North property in Ontario for a royalty consideration. The WNE claims host two copper zones with historical drill intercepts up to 1.2% Cu over short intervals and are untested for additional strike length. Company plans further geophysics and diamond drilling.

title: Lower prices, stubborn costs could weigh on copper miners' quarterly results
summary: North American copper miners are expected to report weaker first-quarter earnings as benchmark copper prices averaged about 5% lower year-on-year, while costs remain stubbornly high. Labor shortages, lower ore grades, weather in British Columbia, and Freeport’s export-permit issues add pressure.

title: Potanin's Interros calls Rusal claims about Nornickel asset sales 'unfounded'
summary: Interros, Nornickel’s largest shareholder, rejected Rusal’s claims that Nornickel undervalued asset sales caused losses to shareholders, citing audit checks. The long-running shareholder dispute also raises concerns that Rusal’s actions could increase sanctions risks for Nornickel, a major refined nickel producer.

title: Copper mining company has eyes on massive Casa Grande site
summary: Ivanhoe Electric is exploring a potential underground mine at the Santa Cruz Copper Project near Casa Grande, Arizona, following acquisition of a large site and associated water, infrastructure, and access. The news signals possible future copper supply, but it remains at the exploration stage with uncertain timing.

title: Lower prices, stubborn costs could weigh on copper miners' quarterly results | WSAU News/Talk 550 AM · 99.9 FM
summary: North American copper miners are expected to report lower first-quarter earnings as average copper prices fell about 5% year over year while costs remain high. Analysts cite demand worries in China, concerns over elevated interest rates, labor shortages, lower ore grades, and weather/export-permit issues affecting output costs.

title: Power Nickel Releases Thick High-Grade Assays of Copper, PGMs, Gold and Silver from its new Lion Discovery
summary: Power Nickel reported thick, high-grade drill assay results from its Lion Discovery, including significant copper and nickel grades alongside PGMs, gold and silver. The update improves market sentiment about potential future Cu/Ni supply, but as an exploration-stage event it is unlikely to materially move prices within days to weeks; aluminium has no direct impact.

title: Nickel Sulfate Price Reiview and Forecast | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Nickel sulphate prices held steady last week, averaging a discount of about 100 yuan/mt versus the SMM nickel sulphate index, despite volatility from negotiations and cost changes. Supply rose steadily while NEV demand improved, but tensions eased only partially. Outlook: nickel sulphate likely fluctuates with nickel prices rather than trending sharply.

title: Macro sentiment drove nickel prices up | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Nickel prices rose last week, first falling on weaker-than-expected US inflation data before rebounding on macro sentiment and industrial chain support. Renewed US/UK sanctions on Russian nickel affected LME delivery terms. Inventory declines and limited raw-material supply, plus expected Q2 demand, were cited.

title: Refined nickel inventory in bonded zone declined slightly | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show refined nickel inventories in China’s bonded zone fell to 4,760 mt and domestic social inventories declined slightly. Sanctions on Russian nickel by the UK and US widened the LME–SHFE price gap, improving export profits and prompting more nickel plate movement toward the bonded zone, which is expected to keep inventories falling.

title: ASX 200 LIVE: Shares set to gain; Wall Street rise on tech rally; Westpac flags $164m hit; Brambles sales up; copper near $US10,000, Tesla down
summary: Australia shares rose on tech strength and inflation focus, while materials were weaker. The key metal call is copper: it is “eyeing” $US10,000 as a ‘super squeeze’ intensifies, suggesting tighter supply/positioning support. Other commodities like gold eased on fading safe-haven demand.

title: Copper output at Chile's Codelco set to rise this year, CESCO says | WKZO | Everything Kalamazoo
summary: Reuters reports CESCO says Chile’s Codelco is poised to raise copper output this year, targeting 1.325–1.390 million tonnes and potentially improving from recent lows. It cites potential rises at Andina, Salvador and Chuquicamata, despite ongoing mega-project delays. Copper rallied earlier this year; demand may face higher prices.

title: Copper output at Chile's Codelco set to rise this year, CESCO says
summary: Reuters reports CESCO expects Chile’s Codelco to improve copper production this year after a prolonged low, targeting 1.325–1.390 million tonnes and potential rises at multiple mines. The piece links this outlook with current price strength and mixed China inventory signals, but highlights possible further upside for copper if supply constraints persist.

title: Getech : Engaged by East Star Resources to Locate Porphyry Copper in Kazakhstan
summary: Getech said it won a contract with East Star Resources to locate porphyry copper deposits in Kazakhstan, supported by BHP Xplor 2024. The work uses Getech’s Globe platform and machine learning to prioritize exploration targets. The announcement is early-stage but supports copper exploration sentiment amid rising demand.

title: Biden Administration Announces New Measures to Protect US Steel, Aluminum, and Shipbuilding Industries | White & Case LLP
summary: The Biden administration announced new trade actions targeting China, including tripling U.S. Section 301 tariffs on Chinese aluminum and maintaining Section 232 tariffs, bringing combined average aluminum tariff rates to about 32.5% plus possible AD/CVD duties. These measures aim to curb Chinese import pressure, supporting expectations for higher aluminum prices.

title: Pima County, local organizations voice concerns on proposed Copper World Mine permit
summary: Pima County and local groups submitted critiques of Hudbay’s Copper World Mine aquifer permit to Arizona regulators, raising concerns about wastewater/tailing storage and proximity to water and sensitive sites. Supporters argue rules are met, while opponents demand more research. ADEQ expects months to review comments and update the permit if needed.

title: Copper eyes $US10,000 as 'super squeeze' intensifies
summary: Traders are increasingly betting on a “super squeeze,” arguing miners won’t be able to raise supply fast enough for strong industrial demand. The market is pushing copper toward $10,000 a tonne, lifting sentiment and the ASX-listed Sandfire Resources shares to a record level.

title: Anglo American Copper Output Jumps, Offsetting Diamond Tumble
summary: Anglo American cut diamond guidance after weaker Q1 diamond output but reported copper production rose 11% year on year to 198,000 tonnes, supported by higher throughput at the Quellaveco mine in Peru. It also saw nickel fall 2% and platinum group metals decline, while coal output increased.

title: Anglo American Q1 Copper Output Up, Cuts Annual Diamond Production Outlook
summary: Anglo American said Q1 copper production rose to 198kt from 178kt, helped by higher throughput at Peru’s Quellaveco and improved grades at Chile’s Collahuasi and El Soldado. Nickel output slipped to 9.5kt from 9.7kt. Full-year copper guidance remains higher than before.

title: Anglo American's Diamond Tumble Buoyed by Copper, Coal -- Commodity Comment
summary: Anglo American reported first-quarter copper output up 11% due to higher throughput and grades at Quellaveco, Collahuasi and El Soldado, partly offset by lower production at Los Bronces. Nickel production was broadly flat at 9,500 tons, with lower throughput largely offset by higher grades. Coal rises, diamonds fall.

title: Mining and Metallurgical Norilsk Nickel : Statement of material fact or other events (actions) which, in the Issuer's opinion, have material effect on the price or valuation of its securities
summary: Norilsk Nickel released preliminary 1Q 2024 production results and reiterated its FY2024 guidance from Russian feed. Nickel output fell 10% y/y to 42 kt, attributed to work-in-progress inventory to be processed in Q2. Copper output rose 1% y/y to 110 kt on higher concentrate processing in Trans-Baikal.

title: Anglo American copper output up year-on-year, diamond slumps
summary: Anglo American said Q1 2024 copper production rose 11% year-on-year to 198,000 tonnes, though it fell versus Q4. Nickel output was down 2% year-on-year to 9,500 tonnes. Overall guidance was largely maintained, with a focus on copper growth options across the portfolio.

title: Anglo American Cuts Diamond Guidance Amid Slow Market Recovery; Copper Output Jumps -- Update
summary: Anglo American cut diamond guidance due to a weak diamond market but reported higher copper production. Copper output rose 11% to 198,000 tons, boosted by strong throughput at Peru’s Quellaveco and higher Chile output. Nickel production fell 2%, while PGM and other segments also declined, overall reflecting mixed conditions.

title: Midnight Sun Mining Corp.: Midnight Sun Announces Cooperative Oxide-Copper Exploration Plan
summary: Midnight Sun Mining announced a cooperative plan with First Quantum to define oxide-copper feed sources from its Solwezi Project near Kansanshi Mine in Zambia. The work targets oxide ore suitable for First Quantum’s SX/EW oxide circuit, using existing logistics and potential acid utilization, supporting possible near-term throughput and cash flow.

title: Midnight Sun Announces Cooperative Oxide-Copper Exploration Plan
summary: Midnight Sun Mining announced a cooperative oxide-copper exploration plan with First Quantum to define feed sources for Kansanshi’s SX/EW oxide copper circuit. Work will start in Q2 2024 at the Kazhiba Dome, where prior drilling showed high-grade Cu. The company suggests oxide ore could support processing feed grades and near-term cash flow.

title: Trailbreaker Commences Drilling at the Liberty Copper Property, BC.
summary: Trailbreaker Resources began its 2024 diamond drilling program at the Liberty copper property in British Columbia, targeting a Cu-Mo porphyry anomaly. The article cites historic Rio Tinto drilling with low-grade Cu and Mo intervals and plans up to 2,000 m of drilling to test the geophysical/soil targets.

title: Seabridge Gold Inc.: Seabridge Readies New Iskut Drill Program to Probe for Copper-Gold Porphyry Discoveries
summary: Seabridge Gold announced a 2024 helicopter-portable drill program at its Iskut Project aimed at testing for the source copper-gold porphyry behind epithermal Cu-Au mineral systems. The company plans ~15,000 meters of drilling at $12 million, with results expected to refine porphyry targets; no production impacts are stated.

title: EVs help boost copper demand
summary: Trafigura told Reuters that EVs, power infrastructure, and AI/automation could add at least 10m tonnes of copper demand over the next decade. It notes tight refined and concentrate supplies, sliding LME warehouse stocks, and recent mine disruptions, with copper at two-year LME peaks, indicating bullish near-term price pressure.

title: Trailbreaker Commences Drilling at the Liberty Copper
summary: Trailbreaker Resources commenced its 2024 diamond drilling program at the Liberty Cu-Mo (±Au/Ag) property in British Columbia, targeting geophysical and geochemical anomalies. The release references a historic Rio Tinto drill interval returning 0.11% copper over 123.1 m, but provides no production or resource updates.

title: Shortages key to copper's upward price trajectory to new peaks
summary: Reuters says copper’s rally toward near $10,000/ton is expected to persist as shortages emerge over coming months. Tightness in concentrate supply, restocking after a manufacturing slowdown, improving China manufacturing surveys, and hopes for rate cuts are supporting prices, which recently hit a two-year peak near $9,988.

title: Getech inks deal with East Star to locate porphyry copper deposits
summary: Getech signed a deal with East Star to locate porphyry copper deposits in Kazakhstan, supported by BHP’s Xplor accelerator. Separately, East Star reported a maiden JORC inferred resource for the Verkhuba deposit, totaling hundreds of thousands of tonnes of copper. The updates are exploration-related rather than production or supply disruption.

title: TMC & SGS Produce World-First Nickel Sulfate from
summary: TMC and SGS report world-first bench-scale production of nickel sulfate made from deep-sea polymetallic nodules using a flowsheet that converts nickel-cobalt-copper matte to nickel sulfate without producing nickel metal. The results support future battery supply, but are still testing and not immediate commercial supply.

title: The Metals Company: TMC & SGS Produce World-First Nickel Sulfate from Deep-Seafloor Polymetallic Nodules
summary: The Metals Company and SGS produced the world’s first nickel sulfate from deep-seafloor polymetallic nodules during bench-scale hydromet testing. The flowsheet processes nickel matte directly to nickel sulfate for battery use and also notes nickel-cobalt-copper matte feedstock, implying potential future supply pathways that may support nickel prices.

title: Getech engaged by East Star to locate porphyry copper in Kazakhstan
summary: Getech won a contract from East Star Resources to use its Globe geoscience platform to locate porphyry copper deposits in Kazakhstan, supported by BHP Xplor 2024. The work is early-stage exploration with a service fee and is aimed at improving targeting efficiency, not changing near-term production or inventories.

title: Nornickel to shift copper production to China amid sanctions
summary: Nornickel plans to close its Arctic copper plant and build a new smelter in China, citing western sanctions that hinder importing equipment and market access. The shift follows LME restrictions on Russian metals and moves Russian copper concentrate toward Asian buyers, potentially tightening western-available copper supply while supporting flows to China.

title: The nickel price crash and the road to recovery in Australia
summary: The article details a prolonged nickel price slump driven by oversupply of cheap low-grade NPI from China and Indonesia, leading to Australian mine cutbacks and closures (First Quantum, BHP) and forecasts staying weak. It also notes modest LME-led price recovery and potential further supply cuts, plus government support measures and LME listing concerns.

title: Nornickel to shift copper production to China amid sanctions
summary: Nornickel plans to close a Russian Arctic copper plant and move copper refining/smelting capacity to China to cope with Western sanctions that restrict importing equipment and accessing markets. The China smelter is targeted for mid-2027 operations. The piece also notes an LME ban on post-13 April Russian metal.

title: Bullishness grows in copper mining sector
summary: RBC points to improving copper sentiment: copper rose 4.5% last week to $4.48/lb, exchange inventories fell 0.9% week-on-week, and net positioning moved more net-long (47.6k from 42.7k). Funds increased gross longs as supply deficits and electrification-related demand keep underpinning prices.

title: Jamaica Bauxite Mining ready to establish Industrial Park at Lydford in St Ann
summary: Jamaica Bauxite Mining Limited plans a $445 million industrial park in Lydford, St Ann, with job creation and logistics support, starting this year. It also mentions supporting agro parks and community water access. The piece is broadly tied to bauxite activity but provides no immediate bauxite production or supply change for markets.

title: Trigon makes new copper, silver strikes at Kombat
summary: Trigon Metals says drilling at Schlangental on the Kombat property in Namibia delivered copper-rich intercepts (up to 3.52% over seven metres and 1.99% over three metres), alongside silver hits. The results follow a new exploration plan and prompt deeper follow-up drilling to confirm continuity of mineralisation.

title: Chile to reach record copper output in 2025, Cochilco says
summary: Chile’s state copper commission (Cochilco) expects Chile to produce a record 5.84 million tonnes of copper in 2025, roughly 6% higher than the 5.51 million tonnes projected for 2024. The increase in expected supply is typically bearish for near-term copper price sentiment.

title: Cochilco Says Chile Expected To Grow Share Of Copper Production…
summary: Reuters reports Chile’s copper commission Cochilco expects Chile to grow its share of copper production in 2024 and 2025, remaining the world’s largest producer. The update signals continued copper supply strength from Chile, but without an immediate shock, likely leaving near-term price effects limited.

title: LME moves to stop gaming of Russian aluminium sanctions-based rule
summary: The LME tightened rules to stop traders gaming Russian-aluminium sanctions by moving metal on sanctioned warrant types and warehouse “rent deals.” It banned Russian aluminium, copper and nickel produced from April 13 onward, with U.S. and Britain also restricting new Russian metal acceptance to cut Russian export revenues.

title: Chile sees record copper production next year
summary: Cochilco expects Chile to produce a record 5.8 million metric tons of copper in 2025, up 6% from 2024. The forecast follows weak output in recent years due to delays at Codelco. Cochilco cites improved production from Teck Resources’ Quebrada Blanca Phase 2 and operations by BHP.

title: Canada and allies considering trade measures against China and Indonesia over manipulation of nickel market, Freeland says
summary: Canada and allies, led by Chrystia Freeland, are considering trade measures against China and Indonesia over alleged manipulation in the nickel market. Indonesia’s rising share and China-linked control have driven a major nickel price collapse. Western miners face losses and closures, motivating potential tariffs or coordinated responses.

title: Buy gold, copper stocks to ride AI, China demand, more: Fund managers
summary: Fund managers and Wall Street analysts remain bullish on copper, citing AI-led data-center demand for power cables and electrical equipment, energy-transition spending, and concerns about supply tightness from mine disruptions and falling Chinese output. They expect copper prices to stay supported despite broader macro uncertainties.

title: Trafigura: EVs, AI And Clean Energy to Massively Boost Copper Demand
summary: Trafigura projects at least 10 million tonnes of additional copper demand by 2035, with AI/data centers and power infrastructure key drivers. The bullish tone is reinforced by supply tightness from mine disruptions (including Zambia drought), smelter output cuts, and U.S./UK restrictions on Russian metal. Citi and BofA forecast large near-term price upside.

title: London copper in tight range as weak China demand, supply woes weigh
summary: London copper stayed in a tight range as weaker China demand after a rally weighed on consumption, while supply disruption from the Cobre Panama mine closure continued to support prices. The report also notes LME actions affecting Russian aluminium and shows modest concurrent moves in aluminium and nickel prices.

title: Zambia copper mine: Vedanta scouts for fundraise options
summary: Vedanta hired Standard Chartered to raise funds for its Konkola Copper Mines (KCM) assets and is discussing partners for short-term and long-term financing. Reports cite International Resources Holdings’ proposed $1bn bid for a majority stake, though Vedanta appears reluctant. Creditors’ meetings and copper-price strength are cited.

title: Power Nickel Extends Momentum - Closes Acquisition on 80% of Nisk
summary: Power Nickel says it has completed acquiring an additional 30% of the Nisk project, bringing ownership to 80%, after filing an NI 43-101 technical report. The company continues to fund expenditures and highlights high-grade drill assays including nickel and copper at the Lion Zone.

title: Vinacomin gears up for key Bauxite-Aluminum projects in Đắk Nông Province
summary: Vinacomin plans major bauxite–alumina–aluminium projects in Đắk Nông, including the Đắk Nông 2 aluminium electrolysis plant prioritised for 2024 construction, and capacity expansion of Nhân Cơ alumina. The program includes power supply preparation and partnerships to secure demand, with aluminium output forecasts rising through 2030 and beyond.

title: Norsk Hydro : Hydro invests NOK 180 million in new scrap sorting facility in the UK to increase low-carbon aluminium capability
summary: Norsk Hydro plans to invest NOK 180 million in a UK scrap-sorting facility using its HySort technology next to its Wrexham recycling plant. The upgrade will improve sorting accuracy and increase capacity for post-consumer aluminium scrap, supporting demand for low-carbon aluminium in automotive, transport, and construction markets.

title: Xanadu buoyed by positive copper-gold flotation testwork
summary: Xanadu Mines says metallurgical testwork at its Kharmagtai copper-gold project in Mongolia using the Eriez HydroFloat system achieved copper recoveries up to 94% and improved recovery of fine sulphide particles. Management expects potential throughput and cost benefits, supporting scoping-study uplift scenarios. Further tests are planned.

title: ADENTRA, Power Nickel At 52-Week Highs On News
summary: Power Nickel announced high-grade multi-element assay results for drill holes PN-24-047 and PN-24-051, including notable copper grades (up to 17.33%) and nickel grades (up to 1.77%). Such exploration success can lift near-term expectations for future supply, supporting copper and nickel sentiment.

title: Carolina Rush to Commence New Drill Program at Brewer Gold-Copper Project
summary: Carolina Rush plans a 3,000-meter drill program starting April 29 at its Brewer Gold-Copper project in South Carolina, targeting the Tanyard Breccia Zone. Prior holes reported copper-bearing results (around 0.3% Cu in the main interval). The release focuses on exploration geometry and extension, not production.

title: Aston Bay Holdings Ltd: Aston Bay Signs Definitive Agreement to Option the Epworth Sediment Hosted Copper-Silver-Zinc-Cobalt Project, Nunavut, Canada; Dr. Elizabeth Turner Joins Advisory Board
summary: Aston Bay signed an agreement to option an 80% interest in the Epworth sediment-hosted copper project in Nunavut, with planned exploration expenditures and near-term geophysical and field work. While the announcement highlights high-grade copper results and future drilling plans, it provides no immediate supply or policy shock for metals markets.

title: Opinion: Quebec has a lot riding on Rio Tinto's green-aluminum project
summary: The opinion says Rio Tinto has delayed plans to replace Quebec’s aging Arvida aluminum smelter and to commercialize its jointly developed Elysis zero-carbon smelting process. Elysis is years behind schedule and may require new smelters if retrofits fail, adding uncertainty for future capacity and competitiveness.

title: Infinico Metals Corp. Identifies New Borehole and Surface Electromagnetic Conductors at its Nicobi Magmatic Nickel Sulphide Project
summary: Infinico Metals reported new borehole and surface EM conductor targets at its Nicobi magmatic nickel sulphide project, including multiple conductive plates and assay highlights such as 51.94m at 1.37% Ni. The company plans follow-up drilling to test down-plunge and strike targets, boosting exploration upside for nickel and some copper.

title: Coppernico Metals Inc.: Coppernico Receives Final Permits to Drill its Sombrero Copper-Gold Project in Southern Peru
summary: Coppernico announced it has received final permits, including water authorization, to drill its Sombrero copper-gold project in southern Peru. With permits secured, the company plans to finalize capital for an initial copper-focused exploration program. Management links the milestone to current rising copper prices and a strong copper outlook.

title: Aston Bay Signs Definitive Agreement to Option the Epworth Sediment Hosted Copper-Silver-Zinc-Cobalt Project, Nunavut, Canada; Dr. Elizabeth Turner Joins Advisory Board
summary: Aston Bay signed an agreement to option an 80% interest in the Epworth sediment-hosted copper-silver-zinc-cobalt project in Nunavut, Canada. The release cites high-grade copper and planning for airborne EM, mapping, and potential drilling. The news is copper-positive mainly via improved future supply expectations.

title: Koryx Copper Intersects 207 Meters at 0.49% and 116 Meters
summary: Koryx Copper released assay results from five new holes at its Haib Copper project in Namibia, reporting multiple long intersections and some of the highest copper-equivalent grades in the project history (e.g., up to 3.95% CuEq). The results reinforce expectations for higher average copper grades and continued resource delineation.

title: Australia invests A$400m in alumina amid global critical minerals race
summary: Australia’s government will inject A$400m into Alpha HPA to build the first high-purity alumina processing facility in Gladstone, Queensland, funded via the A$4bn Critical Minerals Facility. Alumina is the key feedstock for aluminum, supporting expectations for improved aluminum supply capacity.

title: Highland Copper Announces the Successful Completion  of the White Pine North Winter Drilling Program
summary: Highland Copper announced completion of the winter drilling program at the White Pine North Project, drilling 6,593 meters in 10 holes for geotechnical and metallurgical sampling to support feasibility, permitting, and engineering studies. Additional summer hydrogeological and infill/resource drilling is planned. No safety or environmental incidents were reported.

title: Here's what to expect from Aluminum's earnings report
summary: Markets Insider previews an aluminium company’s earnings report due April 25, citing analysts’ consensus EPS and revenue forecasts versus the prior year. The expectations show lower quarterly EPS and revenue growth, suggesting weaker performance outlook, which may modestly affect aluminium market sentiment but lacks direct supply/cost details.

title: Chinese Company Aims To Ramp Up Serbia Copper, Gold Mining
summary: A Chinese mining company plans to increase copper mining operations in Serbia, aiming to make the Balkans country the largest copper producer in Europe. The statement is related to future output expansion, but the report gives no start dates or production scale, limiting any immediate impact on copper prices.

title: First Quantum says probability of taking out copper from Panama mine only after election
summary: First Quantum Minerals said the likelihood of taking out 121,000 tonnes of copper from its disputed Cobre Panama mine can only occur after Panama’s May election. The mine has been kept in preservation after the government ordered a closure last year, implying delayed copper supply. The timing uncertainty adds near-term bearish pressure.

title: Pact to explore projects in green steel, aluminium and renewable energy signed
summary: Oman Electricity Transmission Company and UAE counterparts signed an MoU to start feasibility studies for renewable energy, green steel, and aluminium projects, including electricity connection requirements and investment identification. The deal supports a pipeline for aluminium production powered by renewables, which could modestly lift expectations for aluminium demand within weeks.

title: Class 1 Nickel Updates Resource Estimate on High-Grade Alexo South Nickel Sulphide Deposit – Significant Increases in Indicated and Inferred Resources Over the 2020 Estimate
summary: Class 1 Nickel announced an updated mineral resource estimate for the Alexo South deposit, materially increasing indicated and inferred nickel tonnes and contained nickel pounds versus the 2020 estimate. The company plans further drilling to upgrade resources. No immediate production, trade, or inventory changes are reported.

title: Class 1 Nickel Updates Resource Estimate on High-Grade
summary: Class 1 Nickel announced a 2024 updated resource estimate for the Alexo South Deposit, raising indicated resources and contained nickel (and inferred resources sharply) with 84% of nickel pounds in the indicated category. Drilling is planned to upgrade to measured and extend resources; remaining deposits’ updates are forthcoming.

title: First Quantum could remove copper from Panama mine after election, CEO says
