summary: Copper rallied above $10,000/ton on LME as traders revived expectations of U.S. Fed rate cuts after softer labor-market data. The move coincided with gains in LME aluminium and nickel, supported by the view that lower rates improve growth and weaken the dollar, boosting metals demand.

title: Copperstone Resources : interim report January-March 2024
summary: Copperstone Resources’ interim report notes that on May 6 the Land and Environment Court granted permits for mining and water operations at the Viscaria copper mine in Kiruna, with partial use allowed during any appeal. Management says this significantly reduces risks and supports planned concentrator/infrastructure investments and a 2026 restart timeline.

title: Copper Breaches $10,000 Again as Goldman Sees 'Stockout' Risk
summary: Copper is trading above $10,000 again as Goldman highlights a potential “stockout” risk. The market implication is tighter near-term availability, which can raise expectations for reduced inventories and support higher prices over the next days to weeks.

title: Copper heads towards two-year highs with spotlight on supply
summary: Copper prices are climbing toward two-year highs as traders refocus on tight future supplies, falling LME warehouse stocks, and improving demand hopes from China’s new economic support measures. The piece highlights EV/technology-driven consumption and limited scrap inflows. Aluminium is also rising, indicating supportive broader metals sentiment.

title: Exclusive-Freeport may export up to 900,000 metric tons of Grasberg copper concentrate in second half
summary: Reuters reports Freeport may export up to 900,000 tons of Grasberg copper concentrate from June after Indonesia extends its export licence. The flow helps smelters short of feed as Indonesia’s concentrate export ban and quota system remain. More supply expectations could reduce copper’s near-term upward pressure.

title: Faraday Copper Reports New Gold Assay Results From the Keel Zone Including 0.28 g/t Gold and Confirming 1.34% Copper Over 103.64 Metres at the Copper Creek Project
summary: Faraday Copper reported new gold assays and re-assayed copper from the Keel Zone at its Copper Creek project in Arizona, highlighting intercepts such as 103.64 m at 1.34% copper. The release supports potential gold-by-product value via gold in copper concentrate but does not indicate near-term copper supply changes.

title: Altiplano Reports Q1 2024 Operational Results at Farellon with 2.29% Copper Recovered in March
summary: Altiplano reported Q1 2024 operational results from the Farellon copper-gold mine in Chile, including 292,862 lb of copper sales and copper grade of 1.74% overall, with 2.29% grade in March. It also updates progress at the El Peñón processing plant and notes copper prices have improved recently.

title: Nickel prices fluctuated upward in the morning, and the price difference between nickel beans and nickel sulfate widened [SMM nickel spot afternoon review]
summary: SMM reported Jinchuan nickel premium at 1300–1500 yuan/ton and higher nickel bean prices (140,700–141,500 yuan/ton), up 800 yuan/ton versus the prior day. The nickel bean versus nickel sulfate spread widened to about 1,327 yuan/ton, with purchases still restrained but prices staying elevated.

title: Copper Heads Towards Two-Year Highs With Spotlight on Supply
summary: Copper rose toward two-year highs as traders refocused on tight supplies and improving demand prospects in China. LME copper stocks fell 35% since the start of the year, and expectations of supply deficits plus China’s economic support measures and property-relief steps boosted buying interest.

title: Thunderstruck Resources Ltd.: Thunderstruck Provides Update on Rama Porphyry Copper-Gold Project, Fiji
summary: Thunderstruck Resources provides an update on exploration at its Rama copper-gold project in Fiji, including expanded target areas, planned surveys, and upcoming core drilling. The company comments on a global copper shortage and rising prices, but the news is primarily drilling-focused with no immediate production impact.

title: Thunderstruck Provides Update on Rama Porphyry Copper-Gold Project, Fiji
summary: Thunderstruck Resources updated exploration at its Rama copper-gold project in Fiji, reporting expanded targets and citing recent high copper prices amid a perceived global copper shortage. The article outlines planned 2024 field work and drilling priorities, but provides no production or supply change. Overall sentiment is modestly supportive for copper.

title: Copper hits $10,000 as Goldman Sachs warns of supply risk
summary: Copper briefly traded through $10,000 as risk assets rallied on soft US jobs data and growing expectations of Fed rate cuts. Goldman Sachs lifted its year-end copper target to $12,000/ton and warned of intensifying supply stress, including potential inventory stockouts by Q4, amid tight mine output versus demand.

title: Mexican tariffs said to already be affecting aluminium supply chain and premiums
summary: Mexico’s decree increased aluminium import duties (20–35%), which IMEDAL says is disrupting the aluminium supply chain and raising premiums, including in the US Midwest P1020A. Traders report uncertainty over IMMEX/tariff application. Mexico lacks primary aluminium capacity, so duties may force higher prices for buyers.

title: Solaris Resources (TSX:SLS) Announces Major Progress at Warintza Copper Project with Operations, EIA, and PFS Updates
summary: Solaris Resources reported major progress at its Warintza copper project in Ecuador, including faster drilling, lower drilling costs, and engagement of consultants to advance the EIA submission targeted for H2 2024 and the PFS planned for H2 2025. The update signals improved project execution and study momentum supported by financing.

title: Public hearing set to discuss Mt. Holly Century Aluminum's permits
summary: South Carolina DHEC set a public hearing to review Century Aluminum’s synthetic minor construction and Title V permit modifications for the Mt. Holly smelter. The company seeks to raise utilization from 75% to 100% by adding a fourth smelter, while regulators investigate alumina dust emissions and prior permit changes.

title: Podcast: Global X investment strategist Roberta Caselli on supply constraints in the uranium and copper markets
summary: The episode features a commodities strategist discussing supply constraints in uranium and copper markets. While uranium is the focus of a potential U.S. ban on Russian supply, the discussion also highlights the forces driving copper prices and suggests copper could be heading higher amid tighter supply conditions.

title: Ero Copper Reports First Quarter Operating and Financial Results
summary: Ero Copper reported Q1 results, including copper production of 8,091 tonnes in concentrate at Caraíba and noted commissioning progress at the Tucumã Project toward first copper concentrate in early Q3 2024. The company also entered a non-priced copper prepayment facility and cited a strengthening copper price environment.

title: Ero Copper : First Quarter Results for the period ended March 31, 2024 - MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS
summary: Ero Copper’s Q1 2024 MD&A highlights copper output of 8,091 tonnes in concentrate at $2.30/lb C1 cash costs and guides full-year Caraíba production (lowest quarter in Q1) with cost improvement expected later in 2024. It also reports Tucumã commissioning progress and expects first concentrate in early Q3, supported by a $50m copper prepayment facility.

title: Ero Copper : First Quarter Results for the period ended March 31, 2024 - Ero Copper Reports First Quarter Operating and Financial Results
summary: Ero Copper reported Q1 results and ongoing commissioning at its Tucumã Project, targeting first copper concentrate in early Q3 2024. It also entered a $50m non-priced copper prepayment facility to fund working capital, repaid through monthly copper deliveries. Current focus is company operations rather than market-wide copper supply changes.

title: Southern Copper : SCC Conference Call 1Q 2024 transcript
summary: Southern Copper’s earnings call discussed the copper market, noting LME copper fell in 1Q but that producers’ output cuts have shifted the 2024 outlook toward a potential deficit. The company now estimates supply down ~1% versus prior growth expectations, while demand growth is seen around 2.5% for the year, supporting copper.

title: LME checks Russian aluminium play but is it game over? Andy Home
summary: Reuters columnist reports the LME’s rule tweaks after UK/US bans on taking delivery of post-April-12 Russian aluminium helped slow “warrant-gaming” (stocks moved off and back onto LME). Time-spreads calmed as Chinese buyers absorbed Russian supplies, limiting immediate market stress despite ongoing cancellations and regulatory scrutiny.

title: China's Hailiang Plans Morocco Copper Plant to Tap Western Users
summary: The piece (per the title) says China’s Hailiang plans to build a copper plant in Morocco to serve Western users. If realized, the project could expand copper supply over time, but absent capacity and commissioning details, any immediate price pressure appears limited.

title: Lower energy prices help copper producer Aurubis' first-half profit
summary: Aurubis reported first-half core profit above expectations, aided by lower electricity and gas prices. Second-quarter operating earnings also rose sharply year-on-year. Since Aurubis is a major European copper producer, cheaper energy improves smelting margins and can support near-term copper supply fundamentals.

title: Indonesia nickel reserves enough for further expansions, official says
summary: Indonesia says its nickel reserves are sufficient to expand processing and keep high-grade supply available for years, while industry groups urge a moratorium on new smelters to counter a glut. With nickel already hit by oversupply and producers squeezed, expansion expectations are bearish for nickel prices.

title: Queensland Copper Producer Austral Resources Enters into Receivership
summary: Austral Resources Australia, a Queensland copper producer, has entered receivership after creditor Wingate appointed Deloitte receivers and managers over secured debt linked to its subsidiary Austral Operations. The move puts the company’s operations and workforce at risk, increasing uncertainty around copper output in the near term.

title: Gladiator Announces Further High-Grade Copper Results from Chiefs Trend: 20.44m at 2.17% Copper Returned
summary: Gladiator Metals announced additional assays from ongoing drilling at its Whitehorse Copper Project, reporting multiple high-grade copper-gold intersections (e.g., 20.44m at 2.17% Cu). Results confirm continuity and extensions of the Chiefs Trend mineralization, supporting near-term exploration expectations for copper supply potential.

title: Gladiator Metals Corp.: Gladiator Announces Further High-Grade Copper Results from Chiefs Trend: 20.44m at 2.17% Copper Returned
summary: Gladiator Metals reported additional assay results from ongoing diamond drilling at the Whitehorse Copper Project’s Chiefs Trend, including multiple high-grade copper intercepts over more than 600m of strike. The company says mineralization remains open and plans further work, but no production or immediate supply change is announced.

title: Indonesia to extend copper export permits for Freeport and Amman, president says
summary: Indonesia will extend copper concentrate export permits for Freeport Indonesia and Amman, which otherwise expire May 31. Both companies are building copper smelters expected to start operating in June, but ramp-up will take months. The permits’ extension supports continued concentrate exports while downstream capacity comes online.

title: Indonesia says nickel reserves enough for expansion, despite moratorium call
summary: Indonesia’s investment ministry says nickel reserves are sufficient for expanded processing through both stainless-steel (high-grade NPI) and EV battery feedstocks, with smelters able to be built for different products. Miners have urged a moratorium amid oversupply that previously drove nickel prices down, but no decision is made yet.

title: Chakana Copper Corp.: Chakana Confirms Another Mineralized Breccia Pipe with 23.0m of 0.61 g/t Gold, 1.02% Copper and 26.1 g/t Silver (1.65% Cu-Eq) at Estremadoyro
summary: Chakana Copper Corp. reported additional high-grade copper intercepts from two shallow holes at its Estremadoyro breccia pipe within the Soledad project, including 17.7 m at 0.77% Cu and 23.0 m at 1.02% Cu, plus chalcopyrite/bornite mineralization and a copper halo in wall rock. No production impact is mentioned.

title: Ivanhoe Electric Inc.: Ivanhoe Electric Announces Exploration Alliance with BHP to Accelerate the Search for Copper and Other Critical Minerals in the United States
summary: Ivanhoe Electric and BHP signed a three-year U.S. exploration alliance, funded initially by $15 million from BHP. The program will use the Typhoon geophysical system and inversion software across Arizona, New Mexico, and Utah to identify potential projects for joint ventures targeting copper and other critical minerals including nickel. No near-term production impact is stated.

title: Ivanhoe Electric Announces Exploration Alliance with BHP to Accelerate the Search for Copper and Other Critical Minerals in the United States
summary: Ivanhoe Electric and a BHP subsidiary signed a three-year exploration alliance in the US Southwest, initially targeting areas in Arizona, New Mexico, and Utah. BHP will fund $15 million to support joint 50/50 ventures if projects are identified, using Ivanhoe’s geophysical and inversion technologies to search for copper and other critical minerals.

title: Interpreting Global Nickel and Indonesia Stainless Steel Industries: Supply-Demand Dynamics and Outlook"Stainless Steel Industries
summary: The piece outlines global nickel balances shifting from shortage (2016–2021) to surplus (from 2022 onward), with faster supply growth via refined nickel, NPI and nickel sulfate than demand. It highlights Indonesia’s expanding nickel-intermediate output and stainless-steel exports, mainly for NPI-based production, suggesting capacity increases but with no clear immediate price shock.

title: Production of copper concentrate in Armenia in January-March increased by 55.4%
summary: Armenia’s National Statistical Committee reports that copper concentrate production rose about 55% in January–March 2024 to 79,596 tons versus the same period a year earlier. Output of zinc concentrate fell, while molybdenum concentrate rose slightly; ferromolybdenum fell.

title: EV Batteries: China's Hailiang to build $288 Mln Copper Plant in Morocco – The North Africa Post
summary: Zhejiang Hailiang plans a $288 million copper-foil plant in Morocco for EV lithium battery supply chains. The facility is expected to produce foil, rods, pipes and alloy over time, leveraging free-trade access and lower raw material costs from nearby copper deposits. Construction is slated to take 36 months, limiting near-term price pressure.

title: Commerce Issues Preliminary Antidumping Determination in Aluminum Extrusions Investigations in 14 Countries; Invites Further Comments on Scope | Husch Blackwell LLP
summary: U.S. Commerce issued affirmative preliminary antidumping determinations on aluminum extrusions from 14 countries and concurrent countervailing investigations for selected origins. CBP began collecting antidumping cash deposits from May 7, adding to countervailing duties. The scope was clarified and comments invited ahead of July final determinations, pending possible ITC injury findings.

title: Manitowoc-based Wisconsin Aluminum Foundry acquires manufacturer in Iowa
summary: Wisconsin Aluminum Foundry (WAF) plans to expand after acquiring Iowa casting maker ATEK Metal Technologies. WAF produces aluminum and copper-based alloy castings and is also investing $25 million to add casting and 3D sand printing capacity. The move may slightly lift near-term aluminum demand expectations, but scale is unclear.

title: Bougainville Copper : 2024 ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING
summary: Bougainville Copper held its AGM and said the ABG granted a five-year extension of its EL01 exploration licence for the Panguna project in February. Management cited improved tenure certainty, mobilised action plans to strengthen capacity, and outlined advanced pre-feasibility work. The company also reported being debt-free and financially strong.

title: Indonesia to extend copper export permit
summary: Indonesia will extend copper concentrate export permits for Freeport Indonesia and Amman Mineral Nusa Tenggara, expiring May 31, 2024. The government cited progress on Freeport’s Gresik smelter, nearing completion, targeting up to 600,000 tonnes of copper cathodes yearly. This lowers risk of near-term supply tightness.

title: China April copper imports slide on month as prices rally
summary: China’s unwrought copper imports fell 8.2% in April from March to 438,000 tonnes as a sharp copper price rally dampened buying appetite. Rising LME and SHFE prices drove a higher Yangshan premium, weighing on imports, though concentrate imports increased year-on-year.

title: China April copper imports at 438,000 metric tons
summary: China’s unwrought copper imports rose 7.5% year-on-year in April to 438,000 metric tons, up from 407,294 tons in April 2023, according to customs data. The increase suggests stronger inflows into the top consumer market, which can pressure copper prices short term.

title: Copper edges up in London on China's trade data, property support
summary: Copper in London edged higher on improved China trade data and property-support measures that may bolster near-term demand, with gains capped by a firmer US dollar. LME aluminium also rose slightly, while nickel was mostly flat. SHFE showed copper slightly down, nickel lower, and aluminium higher.

title: Greenwave Technology Solutions Expects to Process Record Volumes of Steel and Copper with Revenues Exceeding $40 Million in 2024
summary: Greenwave Technology Solutions reported it expects 2024 revenues above $40 million, driven by increased capacity at its Cleveland and Virginia Beach metal recycling facilities. Management says a second shredder’s start will improve cash flows and expand copper processing capacity, implying higher nonferrous throughput and supportive near-term expectations for copper markets.

title: In April, the national nickel pig iron metal ton decreased by about 3.4% month-on-month, and the metal ton is expected to increase by about 3.2% month-on-month in May.
summary: SMM reports national nickel pig iron output fell in April due to disruptions (Eid al-Fitr timing, slower Indonesia RKAB approvals, weak ore procurement, higher costs, and some maintenance). Production is expected to rise modestly in May (~+3.2% MoM) as some smelters resume, though resumption is limited by high costs.

title: AU. Shares - Are Mergers and Acquisitions the Solution to Copper Supply Challenges?
summary: The headline centers on copper supply challenges and whether mergers and acquisitions can meaningfully solve a copper deficit, citing Barrick Gold’s CEO skepticism. The focus is on perceived copper tightness rather than a specific new mine, tariff, or inventory change, so any price support would be indirect.

title: Mexico Eliminates Aluminum Import Tariffs to Combat a Shortage
summary: Mexico has eliminated aluminum import tariffs to address a short-term shortage. Removing the tariff should change near-term aluminum supply flows into the Mexican market, influencing expectations for tighter availability and therefore affecting aluminum prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Bearish Nickel Prices Squeeze Steel Mill Earnings
summary: Nickel prices have retraced after rising in April amid signs of a still-oversupplied market. First Quantum halted production at Ravensthorpe after losses, LME inventories keep building, and Indonesian output remains discounted. Falling nickel-linked stainless surcharges are weighing on Outokumpu and other mill earnings, reinforcing bearish near-term sentiment.

title: U.S., China among countries keen to collaborate with Philippines on mining, nickel, minister says
summary: The Philippines’ environment minister said the U.S. and China are among countries interested in collaborating on mining in the country, focused on nickel. She urged the Philippines to boost nickel processing capacity, which supports battery production for electric vehicles. The announcement is supportive for nickel sentiment but not specific on near-term output.

title: China's push for greener aluminium hit by erratic rains, power cuts
summary: Erratic rains and depleted reservoirs in China’s Yunnan have undermined hydropower-dependent plans to relocate aluminium smelting capacity. Smelters are slowing or cutting output 10%–40% amid power cuts and higher electricity costs, delaying new capacity commissioning. The supply disruption is expected to add downside pressure to aluminium prices.

title: China's push for greener aluminum hit by erratic rains, power cuts
summary: Erratic rains and drought in China’s Yunnan have reduced hydropower reliability, leading to electricity-rate hikes and power-cut orders. Aluminum smelters are cutting production 10%-40% and delaying commissioning of relocated capacity. The power bottleneck has slowed China’s green aluminum shift and increased global aluminum price volatility.

title: Opportunity arises for nickel investors with claims of supply glut overblown
summary: Globe Advisor says nickel prices rebounded from early-year lows, citing “overblown” Indonesian supply-glut claims, lower-than-reported nickel inventories, and renewed demand narratives tied to EVs and energy storage. It notes concerns about the traceability and sustainability of Indonesian nickel, but frames the near-term outlook as improving.

title: Copper Above $10,000 as Supply Worries Counter Faltering Demand
summary: The piece highlights that copper is trading above $10,000, driven by supply worries that are offsetting concerns about weakening demand. The net message is that market expectations for near-term copper availability remain tighter than demand conditions, supporting prices despite softer demand signals.

title: LME reports 88% jump in aluminium stocks in LME-registered warehouses
summary: LME-registered aluminium stocks jumped 88% to 903,850 tonnes, the highest since January 2022, with a large deposit in Port Klang, Malaysia. The move follows rent-share warehouse deals involving Russian aluminium. After the inventory data, three-month aluminium prices fell slightly before stabilising.

title: Tertiary gets environmental nod for Zambia copper project
summary: Tertiary Minerals received Zambia EPA EPB approval to begin exploration at its Mupala Copper Project, including soil sampling and surface mapping. The licence sits near major copper and nickel mines and adjacent JV interests involving Anglo American. The news supports incremental copper sentiment but remains early-stage with no production commitments.

title: China's push for greener aluminum hit by erratic rains, power cuts | The Asahi Shimbun: Breaking News, Japan News and Analysis
summary: Erratic rains and drought have cut hydropower reliability in China’s Yunnan, derailing a relocation of “green” aluminum capacity from the north. Smelters have faced power cuts and higher electricity rates, cutting output by 10%-40% and delaying plant ramps, creating near-term supply disruption and aluminum price volatility.

title: Witter eyeing a reopening of Alpart's bauxite plant | News
summary: Franklin Witter says discussions with Alpart could lead to a proposal to reopen the company’s bauxite plant in Manchester. The government is evaluating plant facilities and repurposing options, aiming to restore bauxite production benefits for local communities. Increased bauxite supply expectations are supportive for aluminium.

title: Will copper unleash a new commodities 'supercycle'? – DW – 05/10/2024
summary: Copper has surged to a two-year high on the LME, with momentum inflows cited by Reuters. DW links the rally mainly to decarbonization-driven demand for electrification and to falling/stagnant mine supply after investment shortfalls. Analysts warn new supply takes years, supporting elevated prices despite potential short-term corrections.

title: Fenix Nickel Co. backs Miners Association of El Estor in their request for U.S. Government support to reopen Fenix Mine and reemploy more than 1,700 Workers
summary: Fenix Nickel Co. supports El Estor miners’ association in seeking U.S. government help to reopen Guatemala’s Fenix nickel mine and reemploy over 1,700 workers. The group asks for expedited U.S. export-license issuance, arguing restarting production would reduce local hardship and illegal migration pressures.

title: Sterling Metals : Completes Acquisition of the Copper Road Project in Ontario
summary: Sterling Metals says it has completed the acquisition of the Copper Road Project in Ontario, a brownfield copper-moly-silver-gold asset, and plans to begin a Phase I exploration program in coming weeks. The release focuses on project consolidation and funding, not imminent production or trade/supply disruptions.

title: Sterling Metals Corp.: Sterling Metals Completes Acquisition of the Copper Road Project in Ontario
summary: Sterling Metals completed its acquisition of the Copper Road Project in Ontario, issuing shares and paying cash, and plans to begin Phase I exploration soon. The project targets copper with molybdenum, silver, and gold, supported by recent drilling and prior copper production. No immediate production or supply changes are stated.

title: Copper output from Chile's Codelco down 10% in March
summary: Chile’s Codelco produced 107,300 tonnes of copper in March, down 10.1% from a year earlier, according to Cochilco. As the world’s largest copper miner, the year-on-year decline suggests reduced near-term supply, which typically weighs on copper price expectations over coming weeks.

title: Invest in Copper As Prices Rise Because EVs, Missiles Need It: Druckenmiller
summary: Billionaire investor Stanley Druckenmiller says copper should rise as demand from EVs, grid buildout, data centers, and even defense munitions outpaces slow supply growth due to long lead times. He also initiated a new stake in Freeport-McMoRan, reinforcing bullish market sentiment amid record-high copper pricing.

title: Clarksville Police arrest 2 suspected copper thieves after pursuit into Louisville
summary: Clarksville, Indiana police arrested two men suspected of stealing a large amount of copper and wiring from vacant businesses, causing more than $500,000 in damage. Investigators are checking whether it connects to wider copper thefts affecting Louisville interstate light poles and repairs exceeding $1 million since 2020.

title: CORRECTION FROM SOURCE: Solis Bolsters Copper Landholding in Peru
summary: Solis Minerals reports new copper exploration licence applications covering 6,400 hectares in Peru’s Ilo area, adding to a 43,500-hectare land package. Field visits identified alteration and copper oxide outcrops and drill permitting is underway for multiple prospects, potentially supporting longer-term copper exploration but not immediate supply changes.

title: ICG signs MoU with private sector for manufacturing & supply of indigenous marine-grade aluminum for construction of ships
summary: India’s Coast Guard (ICG) signed an MoU with Hindalco to manufacture and supply indigenous marine-grade aluminium for construction of ships for public and private shipyards. The agreement includes quarterly pricing, priority in supplies and discounts. ICG plans to induct more aluminium-hulled vessels, supporting expected aluminium demand.

title: Solis Minerals Limited Announces an Update on Recent Applications for New Copper Exploration Licences in Peru
summary: Solis Minerals said it has applied for new copper exploration licences in Peru, covering largely underexplored areas previously held by Anaconda Copper. The company plans drone magnetic studies and induced polarization surveys, and is advancing drill permitting across projects near major Cu porphyry deposits like Toquepala.

title: Solis Minerals Ltd.: Solis Bolsters Copper Landholding in Peru
summary: Solis Minerals announced new applications covering 6,400 hectares of copper ground in Peru and states it has identified copper-bearing alteration and mineralisation along strike similar to the Ilo Este porphyry belt. Drill targets and permitting are advancing, but the update is exploratory with no production change.

title: Worldwide - Export Controls & Trade & Investment Sanctions - The United States Initiates Anti-Dumping Investigation On Aluminum Extrusions From Vietnam
summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce launched anti-dumping and countervailing duty investigations on aluminum extrusions and related aluminum products imported from 15 countries, including Vietnam. Alleged dumping margins are provided and deadlines for questionnaire responses and separate-rate applications are set, likely increasing U.S. import costs and supporting aluminium demand/pricing.

title: United States - International Trade & Investment - Written Argument To ITC In AD/CVD Extruded Aluminum ITC Preliminary Injury Investigation
summary: The article summarizes parties’ filings in a U.S. ITC AD/CVD preliminary injury investigation covering extruded aluminum products. Petitioners argue a surge of accused imports harmed U.S. producers and urge cumulation and broad like-product treatment. Opponents cite other factors and request narrower product/country scope or exclusion.

title: Copper Mining Stocks Poised to Benefit from Growing Demand
summary: The piece links clean-energy deployment—solar, wind, EVs—and grid expansion to sharply rising copper demand, while citing supply friction from strikes/protests in top producers, declining ore grades, and expected Russian output declines amid the Ukraine war. It suggests a growing supply-demand gap and potential support for copper prices.

title: Copper lifted by Fed rate cut hopes, supply disruptions
summary: Copper gained on Monday, lifted by expectations of Fed rate cuts after softer U.S. payrolls and improving China demand signals. It was also underpinned by a growing supply deficit that ANZ says may worsen unless prices rise enough to incentivize new greenfield mining investment.

title: Norsk Hydro: New Hydro CEO accelerating growth, value creation and sustainability to change the game for aluminium
summary: Norsk Hydro’s new CEO outlined an agenda to accelerate the company’s 2030 strategy for low-carbon and recycled aluminium, leveraging renewable energy and activities across mining to shipments. He emphasized cost control and growth in recycling and extrusions, while noting weaker market conditions but higher low-carbon aluminium demand growth.

title: The premium of Indonesian nickel ore held steady, while Philippine nickel ore transactions were active
summary: The report says shipping costs and the end of the Philippine rainy season lifted CIF laterite nickel ore prices slightly, while Indonesian nickel ore premiums remained high due to slow RKAB approvals and smelter restocking. Despite active shipments and inventory factors, it expects nickel ore prices to hold steady next week.

title: Refined nickel inventories in bonded area dropped marginally | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports refined nickel inventories in China’s bonded area at 4,460 mt, slightly lower, and expects further declines. UK/US sanctions on Russian nickel widened LME–SHFE price spreads, boosting export profits and encouraging movement of nickel plates into bonded areas. However, downstream demand remains sluggish, leaving social stocks higher.

title: Nickel Sulfate Price Review and Forecast | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Nickel sulfate prices are temporarily steady after a slight rise, with most trades at the lower end of the 30,500–31,000 yuan/mt range. Limited MHP supply and smelters’ losses keep discounts stable at 80% in Q2. April output is tighter than expected, so near-term prices likely remain stable.

title: Max Resource Executes Earn-In Agreement with Freeport-McMoRan Exploration Corporation for the Cesar Copper-Silver Project
summary: Max Resource entered a two-stage earn-in agreement with Freeport to explore its Cesar copper-silver project in Colombia. Freeport would fund C$50 million in expenditures to potentially earn up to 80% ownership. The release focuses on exploration commitments, not near-term output or disruptions.

title: Investors propel copper towards two-year peak
summary: Copper prices climbed towards two-year highs as investors increased long positions, encouraged by expectations of strong demand growth and potential U.S. rate cuts. LME copper rose over 1% to around $10,134/t. Aluminium also gained about 0.8%, reflecting broader positive sentiment alongside copper-specific supply concerns.

title: Mirasol Identifies New Porphyry Targets at the El Potro Prospect and also Extends the VN-Zone by more than 3 km at the Sobek Copper-Gold Project in Vicuña District, Chile
summary: Mirasol Resources announced new and expanded porphyry targets at its Sobek copper-gold project in Chile, extending the VN-Zone by over 3 km and identifying a new “Potro SE” drill-ready target. Follow-up sampling returned copper grades up to 1.8% and coherent copper soil anomalies, despite weather delays.

title: Canada Nickel Achieves Initial Metallurgical Success at Mann Northwest Property
summary: Canada Nickel announced robust early metallurgical test results from the Mann Northwest property, reporting nickel recoveries of 58–59% and nickel/iron concentrate grades meeting expectations. Management says the results confirm process transferability from its Crawford project and supports continued variability and locked-cycle testing. The news is development-oriented, not production.

title: Profits are seriously inverted, and the price of nickel salt is on the rise [SMM Nickel Sulfate Daily Review]
summary: SMM reports May 11 battery-grade nickel sulfate at 30,948 yuan/ton, up 220 yuan/ton day-on-day. Spot supply is tight, but downstream procurement is weakening; nonetheless, strong nickel prices after the holiday have lifted raw-material costs. Mill sentiment remains firm and buyers’ acceptance rises, pushing short-term nickel salt higher.

title: In the short term, the price of ferronickel is stable and strong. | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM reports the May 13 average price of 8–12% high-nickel pig iron (ferronickel) at 967.5 yuan per nickel point, up slightly on the day. Indonesia’s nickel-ore approvals lag, smelter raw-material shortages persist, and domestic output remains constrained, while demand is cautious, leaving ferronickel stable and strong short term.

title: AI's Thirst for Data Center Power Feeds Renewed Demand for Copper
summary: Investopedia reports that AI-driven data center expansion and related power-grid upgrades are boosting demand for copper, which is commonly used in electrical wiring. Bank of America expects global demand could push the market toward a supply deficit by year-end and support additional copper price gains.

title: France backs nickel refinery project to bolster battery supply chain
summary: France is backing a planned private nickel (and cobalt) refinery near Bordeaux to strengthen Europe’s EV battery supply chain and reduce reliance on China. The €300m project would process 20,000 tonnes of nickel per year from 2028, covering part of France’s nickel needs by 2030, amid ongoing approvals.

title: Green Bridge Metals Corporation: Green Bridge Metals Enters into Definitive Agreement to Option World Class Copper-Nickel Exploration Portfolio in Duluth Complex Minnesota
summary: Green Bridge Metals entered a definitive agreement to option an 80% interest in the South Contact Zone copper-nickel exploration portfolio in Minnesota. Acquisition depends on due diligence, regulatory approvals, and minimum $3 million financing, expected by May 30, 2024. It supports future exploration but not near-term output.

title: Record-low copper TC/RCs push miners to agree very-long term deals
summary: Record-low copper concentrate TC/RCs have pushed miners to sign longer-term concentrate deals, often at negative TCs through 2025-2028, reflecting persistent concentrate supply tightness after the Cobre Panama closure. Aggressive bidding by traders suggests continued low charges and procurement challenges for smelters, supporting copper price expectations.

title: Market faces 'unsustainable' double negative with copper concentrates, cathode cif Shanghai both trading at record lows
summary: Fastmarkets reports copper concentrate TC/RCs turning negative for the first time since 2013, with cathode premiums cif Shanghai also falling into record-low negative territory. Traders cite unsustainable “double negative” conditions, widening LME-SHFE arbitrage losses, muted cathode imports, and cautious credit/ counterparty risk among smelters.

title: Freeport enters earn-in on Max Resource's Cesar copper-silver project in Colombia
summary: Freeport-McMoRan invested US$1.6 million in Max Resource to earn a potential stake in the Cesar copper-silver project in Colombia under an earn-in agreement. While the deal supports development prospects for copper supply, it does not indicate immediate output changes, suggesting minimal near-term pricing impact.

title: Century Aluminum, Kraft Heinz get decarbonization money | Crain's Chicago Business
summary: The piece reports that Century Aluminum, along with Kraft Heinz, is receiving decarbonization-related financing. While details aren’t provided in the excerpt, the backing is directed at the aluminium producer, potentially supporting its emissions-reduction efforts and influencing expectations for aluminium production costs and supply outlook.

title: Organised criminals stealing miles of copper cable
summary: Police in southern England report a 20% increase in organised theft of copper cables from industrial sites, including electricity and water infrastructure and solar farms. Authorities warn theft can disrupt power and transport and cause major financial damage. Cable is stolen for onward sale to scrap, implying tighter near-term copper availability.

title: Trafigura Dumps Over 400,000 Tons of Aluminum into LME Warehouses
summary: Trafigura delivered over 400,000 tons of aluminum into LME warehouses, driving inventories up 88% to the highest level since January 2022. The deliveries follow U.S./UK sanctions on Russian aluminum, with discounted Russian material and ongoing oversupply concerns likely weighing on near-term LME aluminum pricing sentiment.

title: Chinese workers return to copper mines in Myanmar
summary: About 80 Chinese workers returned to resume operations at Wanbao’s Chinese-backed copper mines in northwestern Myanmar, where output fell sharply after the 2021 coup. Wanbao says inspections and repairs are underway to restore processing plants, while security escorts continue shipments amid protests and convoy attacks.

title: US Copper : Management's Discussion And Analysis of Operating Results for the Three Month Period & Year Ended December 31, 2023
summary: US Copper Corp.’s MD&A reviews 2023 financial and operating results for its non-producing Moonlight-Superior copper project in California, including 2023 oxide-cap drilling results and plans dependent on financing and copper prices. It notes copper recently declined but remains above the 2018 PEA price; no direct market-moving supply or demand catalyst is stated.

title: Peru copper output flat in March, but up 3.5% in first three months of 2024
summary: Peru’s copper production was about 219,000 metric tons in March, essentially flat versus the prior year, while output in the first three months totaled about 641,000 metric tons and was up 3.5% year-on-year. March was only slightly lower (down 0.1%), signaling steadier supply so far in 2024.

title: Breakfast briefing: China readies new stimulus and the copper price zooms higher
summary: The briefing says China is preparing major stimulus financing via a ¥1tn bond sale, coinciding with copper surging back toward US$10,500/t. It also references LME restrictions on new Russian aluminium, copper and nickel to comply with sanctions, tightening supply and adding upside support.

title: NSW Police arrest three contractors for alleged multi-million dollar copper theft
summary: NSW Police arrested three contractors accused of masterminding theft of over $2.5 million worth of copper cable from multiple sites in Sydney. The stolen copper was allegedly sold as scrap to metal merchants. Police recovered large quantities at scrapyards and during searches, and the suspects face charges and denied bail.

title: Contractors charged over $1 million copper theft
summary: Three contractors were charged with allegedly stealing and selling over $1 million of copper cabling from construction sites in NSW, with police recovering additional stolen copper at scrap yards. Authorities say cases are part of stepped-up efforts to combat copper theft, including dealing in proceeds.

title: Contractors charged over alleged $2.5 million stolen copper plot
summary: NSW Police charged three contractors over an alleged copper theft and resale scheme, claiming they stole and sold more than $2.5 million worth of copper cabling from infrastructure projects since February 2024. Police seized about $200,000 at a scrapyard and found additional cabling during searches, leading to court proceedings.

title: Stellantis, Vale in nickel talks in Indonesian coup
summary: Stellantis is reported to be in talks with Vale and Huayou Cobalt about investing in an Indonesian nickel smelter/HPAL facility to produce battery-grade nickel. The discussions aim to secure supply for Stellantis’ EV expansion, potentially affecting near-term expectations for nickel availability and demand.

title: Copper Climbs to Highest in Two Years as Bulls See Deficit
summary: Copper is reportedly climbing to its highest level in two years, with market bulls pointing to a tightening deficit. The headline suggests worsening short-term supply/demand conditions for copper and improving price momentum, which would be expected to support copper prices in the immediate days following the news.

title: Three contractors charged with stealing more than $3.5 million of copper from Sydney infrastructure sites
summary: Police in Sydney have charged three contractors over alleged theft and unlawful sale of over 300 tonnes of copper wiring worth up to $3.5 million, including additional seizures at scrap yards. The case follows reports of rising copper theft incidents and crackdowns, but does not indicate a broader supply disruption.

title: Anglo American eyes offloading steelmaking coal, nickel and other businesses
summary: Anglo American’s strategy update said it is exploring options to offload its steelmaking coal, nickel, and platinum businesses to become a simpler organisation. The move follows the prior rejection of BHP’s raised takeover offer. The report does not specify timing or production impacts, making near-term nickel effects uncertain.

title: Anglo American eyes offloading steelmaking coal, nickel, diamonds
summary: Anglo American said it is reviewing options that could include demerging or selling its steelmaking coal, nickel, diamonds and platinum units amid a hostile takeover bid from BHP. It will explore options for its nickel mines, but the announcement does not indicate immediate changes to nickel production.

title: Copper hits more than 2-year high despite weaker-than-expected China demand
summary: Copper prices hit their highest level since April 2022, rising on base-metal sector fund inflows tied to expectations of U.S. rate cuts, supply disruptions, and green-energy demand. Despite weaker-than-expected China Q2 consumption due to high prices, LME copper and SHFE copper still advanced, while aluminium rose slightly and nickel eased.

title: Anglo American eyes break-up, steelmaking coal, nickel, diamonds offloads
summary: Anglo American announced a strategic review that could include selling or demerging parts of its nickel business as it fends off BHP’s takeover bid. It plans to explore options for its nickel mines, but provides no clear, immediate production changes, reducing direct short-term price pressure on nickel.

title: Copper Hits More Than 2-Year High Despite Weaker-Than-Expected China Demand
summary: Copper prices rose to their highest level since April 2022, with three-month LME copper up as funds flowed into base metals. The gain occurred even though high prices appear to be dampening Chinese consumer demand, suggesting investors are still pushing prices higher despite softer demand signals.

title: White House: Tariffs Cover Steel & Aluminum; Semiconductors; Ele…
summary: The White House announcement says tariffs apply to steel and aluminium, alongside other sectors. For industrial metals, the explicit inclusion of aluminium suggests the policy could limit aluminum imports and lift near-term pricing expectations, likely supporting aluminium prices over the coming days.

title: Biden hiking tariffs on Chinese EVs, solar cells, steel, aluminum - adding to tensions with Beijing
summary: The news headline says the Biden administration is increasing tariffs on Chinese EVs, solar cells, steel, and aluminum, escalating trade tensions with Beijing. Tariffs specifically on aluminum imports can tighten U.S. supply and raise cost expectations for aluminum, supporting near-term gains in aluminum prices.

title: Biden hiking tariffs on Chinese EVs, solar cells, steel, aluminum — adding to tensions with Beijing
summary: The headline says the Biden administration is hiking tariffs on Chinese EVs, solar cells, steel, and aluminum, increasing tensions with Beijing. Tariffs that specifically target aluminum are likely to affect near-term import flows into the U.S., tightening supply expectations and providing upward support for aluminum prices.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Intersects 0.41% Copper Over 42.02 Metres Expanding Near-Surface Mineralization at Area 51 within the Copper Creek Project
summary: Faraday Copper reported results from five Phase III drill holes at its Copper Creek Project in Arizona, including 42.05 m at 0.41% copper at the Eclipse breccia and other copper-bearing intercepts near Keel West and Old Reliable. summary: The piece notes that LME warehouse queues have returned following a jump in aluminum orders. Rising queues imply slower warehouse deliveries and tighter prompt availability for physical metal, which can increase short-term buy pressure and support aluminium prices over the next days.

summary: The article headline says Europe’s aluminium production is starting to recover because energy prices are falling. Lower power costs can improve smelter economics and encourage higher output, increasing supply conditions in the short term, which usually exerts downward pressure on aluminium prices over the next days to weeks.

summary: Biden’s planned tariff increase on $18 billion of Chinese goods is expected to create an opportunity for India to expand US-bound exports, including aluminium and steel. With prior US duty waivers for Indian shipments, analysts and officials expect Indian aluminium export growth, while also watching for potential Chinese dumping pressures.

title: India's Steel, Aluminium Exports To US Likely To Rise As China Faces Tariff Wall
summary: Biden’s tariff hike on $18 billion of Chinese goods is expected to open opportunities for India to expand exports to the US, including aluminium and steel. title: Chile Copper Commission Cochilco Raises 2024 Average Copper Pric…
summary: Chile’s copper commission Cochilco increased its 2024 average copper price forecast to $4.30 per pound from $3.85 previously. The Reuters item signals higher expected copper market value, which typically supports bullish sentiment toward copper prices in the coming days.

summary: McEwen Copper reported completion of a 70,000-meter feasibility drilling program at Argentina’s Los Azules project, sharing multiple high-grade copper intercepts and suggesting resource updates near the 2023 PEA. summary: Chile’s state copper commission, Cochilco, raised its average copper price estimates for 2024 to $4.30/lb from $3.85/lb and for 2025 to about $4.25/lb from $3.90/lb, according to Reuters. The revision implies stronger expected copper market pricing going forward.

summary: Argus began publishing the INI (Indonesian Nickel Index) in partnership with PT Indeks Komoditas Indonesia, providing new Indonesian export nickel benchmarks. summary: BHP’s bid battle for Anglo American is portrayed as being driven by copper, with a successful deal making BHP the top global copper producer. The article links ongoing price strength—refined copper near record levels and negative TC/RCs—with supply constraints from production issues and insufficient new mine output.

summary: A University of Michigan study says current copper output cannot satisfy the surge in demand from EVs and electricity-grid upgrades. It estimates EVs need several times more copper than combustion cars and that renewable-related copper demand will outstrip mine capacity, implying supply tightness and upward pressure on copper prices.

summary: The Biden administration plans to increase Section 301 tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum, with aluminium tariffs stacking on top of current Section 232 tariffs. summary: China’s primary aluminium production rose 7.2% year-on-year to 3.58 million tonnes in April, according to China’s National Bureau of Statistics. summary: China’s primary aluminium output rose 7.2% year-on-year in April, alongside higher aluminium prices. LME and Shanghai contracts gained strongly in April as investors expected demand from China’s clean energy sector and a softer US dollar supported buying. Some Yunnan operations resumed, while output prospects remain uncertain due to drought.

summary: The article headline says China’s leading copper miner will increase production as supply risks rise. The planned output ramp is expected to add near-term supply to the market, supporting copper sentiment, though the extent and timing of supply-risk easing are uncertain.

summary: Queensland approved the Jericho copper mine near Cloncurry under a lease to AIC Mines, with expected annual production above 20,000 tonnes of copper and expansion of the nearby Eloise mine. summary: Nickel prices jumped sharply after political unrest in New Caledonia. Reuters reports police reinforcements as France moves to regain control of Noumea. summary: Nissan will expand use of low-CO2 aluminum components in vehicles from fiscal 2024 onward, aiming for full recycled aluminum use by 2030. summary: France has declared a state of emergency in New Caledonia after a week of violent protests and is sending additional security forces. summary: The US announced higher Section 301 tariffs on Chinese imports, targeting steel and aluminium and citing China’s overcapacity and dumping. summary: Camino Minerals reports it increased its Los Chapitos copper exploration claims in Peru by 1,700 hectares via an auction, including bids against Rio Tinto. summary: The report says SMM’s 8–12% high-nickel pig iron averaged 973 yuan per nickel point on May 17, up from the prior day. summary: Nickel is reported to jump as unrest disrupts output from a major (No. 3) nickel miner in New Caledonia. Output cuts tighten short-term supply expectations for nickel, typically supporting higher settlement prices in the coming days as market participants price in reduced mine output.

summary: AFCMA petitioned for antidumping and countervailing duties on U.S. imports of disposable aluminum containers, pans, and trays from China, citing large alleged dumping and subsidy margins. The disruption affects Yarwun and Queensland Alumina JV facilities, potentially tightening alumina supply, though Rio says its aluminum production should continue, limiting third-party sale impacts.

title: US releases preliminary conclusion on Vietnamese aluminium anti-dumping probe
summary: The US Department of Commerce issued preliminary conclusions for an anti-dumping/anti-subsidy investigation into Vietnamese aluminium extrusions and products. It set preliminary duty rates ranging from 2.85% to 41.84% depending on companies, with final conclusions expected later. The move may alter US import demand for Vietnamese aluminium.

title: Brixton Metals Commences its Fully Funded 2024 Drill Season at its Thorn Copper-Gold Porphyry Project
summary: Brixton Metals announced it has commenced drilling at its Thorn copper-gold porphyry project, testing multiple new copper targets (Trifecta, Cirque, North) and continuing at Camp Creek. The company highlights prior copper assay results and a planned 12,000–17,000m drill program, but no near-term production or trade change is stated.

title: Aston Bay Holdings Ltd: Aston Bay and American West Metals Announce Thick New Copper Zones Discovered in Drilling at the Storm Copper Project, Canada
summary: Aston Bay and American West reported early 2024 drilling success at the Storm Copper Project in Nunavut, intersecting thick visual copper sulfide zones in multiple holes and identifying over 10 new Moving Loop EM targets. Assay results are pending and drilling continues toward deeper testing.

title: Core Nickel Corp.: Core Nickel Reports Nickel-Bearing Sulfide Mineralization with Nickel Tenors up to 17% in Assay Results from 2024 Winter Drill Program at Halfway Lake
summary: Core Nickel reports 2024 winter drill results from its Halfway Lake project, finding wide packages of nickel-bearing sulfide mineralization in ultramafic rocks, with nickel tenors up to ~17% in assays. The company plans additional VTEM and aeromagnetic work to refine targets for potential economic nickel deposits.

title: Nickel prices are on the rise, upstream quotations are high, steel mills are expected to be weak, and nickel pig iron prices are under pressure [Nickel Pig Iron Daily Review]
summary: Nickel Pig Iron Daily Review reports SMM 8–12% high nickel pig iron averaging 977.5 yuan/nickel point, up on the day. Indonesia’s nickel ore approvals lag, raw material shortages persist, and smelter output remains weak with low operating rates. Demand from steel mills may rise near the procurement cycle, supporting near-term stability.

title: The deepening of profit inversion pushes up the price sentiment of salt plants [SMM nickel sulfate daily review]
summary: SMM reports battery-grade nickel sulfate prices rising to around 32,004 yuan/ton. Limited nickel-salt supply, low finished-product inventories, and high raw-material coefficients deepen profit inversion at salt plants, pushing them to raise prices strongly. Downstream demand is weaker but forced to accept higher prices due to precursor constraints and replenishment needs.

title: Nissan Starts Drive to 100% Low-Carbon Aluminum Car Parts
summary: Nissan will start using low-CO2 aluminum in vehicles from this year and aims to use only green or recycled aluminum in its products by 2030. It is buying low-carbon aluminum sheets and will expand green aluminum parts (wheels, chassis, axles, wires) across Japan, the U.S., and Europe, with ~20% of newly mined input replaced by FY2024.

title: TNR Gold NSR Royalty Update - Los Azules Copper, Gold and Silver Project - McEwen Copper Announces Completion of the Feasibility Drilling Program
summary: TNR Gold reported updates from McEwen Copper on the Los Azules project in Argentina, including completion of a feasibility drilling program and multiple long intercepts with copper grades up to 0.86% Cu. Management expects potential resource increases and extension of mineralization, supporting a feasibility study timeline.

title: Exclusive-Southern Copper's stalled Tia Maria project set to break ground in Peru, VP says
summary: Southern Copper said Peru’s long-stalled Tia Maria project should break ground by end-2024 or in early 2025 after improved “social conditions.” The 120,000 t/year copper mine has faced protests and license suspensions. Peru aims to revive mining and expects production gains from projects like Tia Maria.

title: Southern Copper Eyes Start of Stalled Peru Mine Project as Soon as This Year
summary: The headline says Southern Copper is considering moving forward with a stalled Peru mine project, potentially as soon as this year. If delays are reduced, it can improve expectations for copper supply timing, which may support copper prices over the next days to weeks.

title: What Does $5/lb Copper Mean for the Building Wire Market?
summary: Copper has crossed $5/lb amid two-year highs, with analysts citing depleted inventories and concerns that supply won’t keep pace with rising demand from power grids and renewables. The article highlights production/regulatory and geopolitical risks tightening the market further, with downstream impacts on building-wire costs and theft.

title: CORRECTION FROM SOURCE: Nine Mile Metals Announces Drill Hole WD-24-08 Certified Assay Results of 1.34% Copper Equivalent (Cu-Eq) over 44.00m Including 3.73% (Cu-Eq) over 12.00m and 4.57% (Cu-Eq) over 9.00m
summary: Nine Mile Metals issued a corrected press release for drill hole WD-24-08 at its Wedge VMS target, confirming certified assays. The hole intersected multi-metal mineralization including copper, with 0.95% Cu over 12m in the upper zone and 0.47% Cu over 44m overall, supporting copper-equivalent strength.

title: Indonesian nickel ore premium held stable and Philippine nickel ore transactions were active
summary: The report says Indonesian nickel ore premiums were stable and Philippine laterite ore transactions stayed active, with freight to China still high. It notes China’s nickel ore port inventories rose 210,000 wmt WoW, suggesting more supply entering ports, while NPI smelters showed little added buying interest, keeping prices steady.

title: Refined nickel inventory in bonded zone dropped slightly last week | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: SMM data show refined nickel inventories in China’s bonded zone fell to 4,160 mt last week, and the publication expects further declines. It attributes the tighter bonded supply to riots in overseas nickel raw material areas and rising nickel prices, while domestic social stocks rose slightly on weak downstream demand.

title: Nickel Sulfate Price Review and Forecast  | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Shanghai Non ferrous Metals reports nickel sulphate prices rebounded to 31,000–31,500 yuan/mt. MHP supply remains tight due to downstream smelter losses and continued overseas hydrometallurgy project shutdown concerns, keeping the MHP discount elevated. Weaker orders and inventory pressure cap gains, but cost support should keep prices 31,500–32,000 yuan/mt.

title: Columbiana County Works to Attract Aluminum Operation
summary: Columbiana County, Ohio approved tax-exempt revenue obligations to support a planned Century Aluminum and MX Holdings joint venture for a new American aluminum smelter/secondary billet operation. The project targets a 2026 start, with low-carbon, highly recycled aluminum for automotive, construction, and renewable energy markets. Location incentives are being prepared.

title: What Could Derail The Copper Rally?
summary: Copper has surged, but the article warns the rally may be vulnerable. It cites heavy long speculative positioning, negative Chinese demand signals (Yangshan premium), strong contango, and higher-for-longer rates supporting the USD. It also mentions Cobré Panama closure/resumption uncertainty affecting supply tightness and possible downside correction risk.

title: Copper dragged off record high by subdued physical demand
summary: Copper prices eased from Monday’s record high as investors questioned whether the rally—supported by speculative short covering—can be sustained amid subdued physical demand. China demand softness and refinery output rising also weighed. The piece also flags aluminium up on lower LME warehouse stocks and nickel down on the day.

title: TNR Gold : NSR Royalty Update – Los Azules Copper, Gold and Silver Project – McEwen Copper Reports Improved Copper Recovery
summary: TNR Gold’s update on the Los Azules copper project says Phase 1 heap-leach metallurgical tests achieved 76.0% average copper recovery (up 3.2% vs. prior PEA assumptions) and reduced net acid consumption by 8.3%. The company notes higher modeled life-of-mine copper cathode output, supporting economics.

title: TNR Gold : NSR Royalty Update – Los Azules Copper, Gold and Silver Project – McEwen Copper Updates on Assay Results at Los Azules
summary: TNR Gold updates its NSR royalty interest in McEwen Copper’s Los Azules project in Argentina, highlighting new drill assay results showing thick, continuous mineralization (e.g., 446m at 0.63% Cu, including 76m at 0.92% Cu) and continued progress toward a feasibility study. Sentiment for copper is improved.

title: 3 Stocks To Watch As Copper Surges To Record Highs: 'Something Is Cooking In China'
summary: Copper prices hit record highs, with Bank of America citing tight supply and rising demand from electrification and decarbonization. The piece highlights China building inventories despite seasonal usage, noting Yangshan cathode trading at an unusual discount to LME spot. Upcoming weeks are critical for whether China exports or stockpiles.

title: DMCI Holdings looking to add copper, gold, coal mining assets
summary: DMCI Holdings says it is exploring new copper (and gold) mining assets and possibly an additional open-pit coal mine. It also notes nickel projects are currently not operational due to pending permits, with some expected by year-end. DMCI recently agreed to acquire Cemex Philippines.

title: World Copper Ltd.: World Copper Provides Corporate Update
summary: World Copper provided a corporate update focused on advancing its Zonia copper project toward feasibility and eventual construction/production, alongside continued work on Escalones and a loan extension. The release discusses the current copper supply deficit and US copper demand but lacks any immediate operational or policy catalyst likely to move copper prices soon.

title: Peru's 2024 copper target is realistic, mining magnates say
summary: Peru’s mining executives said the government’s 2024 copper target of 3 million metric tons is realistic. Peru produced 2.76 million tons in 2023 and is seeking more investment, with expansions/permitting progress and plans such as Southern Copper’s Tia Maria. Copper is already near two-year highs.

title: Expeditors International of Washington : BIS Ending 12 General Exclusions of Section 232 Steel and Aluminum Tariffs
summary: A Federal Register notice from BIS ends 12 general approved exclusions from U.S. Section 232 tariffs on steel and aluminum. The removed exclusions include multiple aluminum categories (e.g., tubes, alloy sheets, foil, bars, rods). The changes take effect July 1, 2024, potentially dampening aluminum demand.

title: Copper prices spike, could boost Arizona economy
summary: Global copper prices have surged rapidly, rising for eight straight days and reaching over $5 per pound for the first time. Drivers include demand optimism from green energy, AI/data centers, and military spending, alongside tighter supply expectations and a Comex short squeeze that forced long-covering and boosted July futures.

title: Aluminum Jumps To 23-Month High Amid Ongoing Aussie Production Issues
summary: Aluminum prices rose to a 23-month high as ongoing production issues in Australia reduce supply availability. The tighter market conditions for primary aluminum are expected to increase near-term buying interest and support spot prices, reflecting immediate supply disruption risk rather than a long-term demand change.

title: Copper weighed down by steady dollar, soft demand
summary: Copper prices trended lower as a steady U.S. dollar weighed on demand and China’s physical market weakened after record highs. Higher SHFE warehouse inventories reinforced bearish sentiment. LME aluminium and nickel also edged down, reflecting broader risk-off moves in industrial metals as markets awaited Fed minutes.

title: New Caledonia riots: Why a small Pacific island territory is upending nickel prices
summary: New Caledonia’s second week of deadly riots has included road blockades and an airport shutdown, prompting a 12-day French state of emergency. Because New Caledonia is a major nickel producer, the disruptions raise short-term supply risk and can support higher nickel prices over coming days.

title: Chinese Scientists Develop Stronger, Heat-Resistant Aluminum Alloy
summary: Chinese researchers developed a stronger, heat-resistant aluminum alloy using nanoparticles to maintain mechanical strength at high temperatures for aerospace engine components. The university says it is over six times stronger than traditional alloys and expects industrial use soon, which may modestly support future aluminum demand, but near-term price impact appears limited.

title: King River continues NT copper-gold hunt after rain delay
summary: King River Resources resumes its Northern Territory RC drilling after flooding rains, targeting multiple copper-gold prospects in the Tennant Creek East project area. The program will follow prior geophysical anomalies and nearby high-grade copper-gold results, potentially improving near-term sentiment toward copper exploration output, though still exploratory.

title: MX Holdings and Century Aluminum looks at Columbiana County for a possible location | News, Sports, Jobs
summary: MX Holdings and Century Aluminum are considering Columbiana County for a $130 million high-tech secondary aluminum billet casting facility. The venture plans to use recycled scrap to produce low-carbon billets and aims for production in Q4 2026. Approval includes intent to reimburse expenditures via tax-exempt bonds.

title: Mining Summit 2024: King says BHP prioritised shareholder returns over nickel jobs
summary: Resources Minister Madeleine King warned that BHP’s underinvestment in ageing infrastructure could force thousands of workers into hardship, with BHP flagging it may close its Western Australian nickel operations. She linked the situation to Alcoa’s recent alumina refinery shutdown at Kwinana, citing similar consequences for supply.

title: Copper falls on waning China demand
summary: Copper fell as physical demand in China weakened and inventories rose in the top consumer market. Spot premiums/discounts widened, consumption cooled, and refined output increased, reducing supply-cut concerns. Trading was also cautious ahead of Fed minutes, adding macro pressure. LME/SHFE copper both declined.

title: Record high copper hits demand in China, buyers brace to pay even more
summary: Record copper highs in global markets, driven by a short squeeze and fund inflows betting on a shortage, have damped physical demand in China as consumers cut orders and face higher costs. Despite weaker physical buying and rising Chinese inventories/discounts, SHFE copper surged to a new record, implying further near-term upside risk.

title: Europacific Metals Inc.: EuroPacific Announces First Drill Hole Intercept of 22.8m of 2.76% Cu, Including 9m of 7.49% Cu at Miguel Vacas High-Grade Copper Deposit in Southern Portugal
summary: Europacific Metals reported initial assay results from its 2024 drilling at the Miguel Vacas copper deposit in Portugal, including a continuous 22.8m intercept grading 2.76% Cu and 9m grading 7.49% Cu. The company says the results confirm continuity and extend potential southern mineralization.

title: How is the violent unrest in New Caledonia impacting global nickel prices?
summary: Violent unrest in French Pacific New Caledonia—home to 20–30% of global nickel reserves—has raised concerns of shipping and production disruptions. Nickel prices on the LME jumped sharply, with the article citing supply-risk fears, sanctions on Russian nickel, and broader critical-material shortage outlooks.

title: India's Vedanta Aluminium turning to renewables, not adding coal capacity, CEO says
summary: Vedanta Aluminium, India’s largest aluminium producer, will not add new coal-fired power and is securing 1.3 GW of solar/wind renewables to raise renewable power use. The firm also plans capacity expansion to 3 million tonnes by 2026 and expects a bauxite mine environmental clearance, supporting output growth.

title: PROSPECT RIDGE RESOURCES DISCOVER NEW A HIGH-GRADE SHOWINGS ON THE HOLY GRAIL PROPERTY WEST OF THE COPPER RIDGE ZONE
summary: Prospect Ridge Resources announced new high-grade copper-bearing quartz vein showings on its Holy Grail property near the Copper Ridge zone, including samples up to ~14.8% Cu. The company plans to initiate drill holes on Copper Ridge in summer 2024. The release is exploration-focused and does not affect near-term supply materially.

title: Hannan Metals Ltd.: Hannan Outlines A Significant Copper-Gold Porphyry At Previsto Central, Peru
summary: Hannan Metals announced an extensive copper-gold porphyry discovery at its Valiente Project in Peru, with outcropping mineralization over a 4 km by 1 km area and strong copper-in-soil anomalies. The find is pre-drilling and aimed at de-risking and securing permits, with no immediate production impact.

title: Copper retreats on profit taking, weak physical demand
summary: Copper prices fell as funds took profits after a surge to record highs, while high prices reduced physical demand in China. Copper fabricators cut production amid accumulated unsold wire rod inventories and slower-than-usual withdrawals from SHFE warehouses. Output growth and easing smelter-cut concerns were secondary to demand weakness.

title: Faraday Copper Announces C$20 Million Bought Deal
summary: Faraday Copper Corp. announced a C$20 million bought-deal financing (with an over-allotment option) to fund exploration and development of its Copper Creek copper project in Arizona, plus general working capital. The release is mainly about equity financing and timing of closing, not immediate changes to copper production or inventories.

title: EuroPacific Announces First Drill Hole Intercept of 22.8m of 2.76% Cu, Including 9m of 7.49% Cu at Miguel Vacas High-Grade Copper Deposit in Southern Portugal
summary: EuroPacific announced the first drill hole intercept from the Miguel Vacas high-grade copper deposit in southern Portugal, reporting 22.8m at 2.76% Cu, including 9m at 7.49% Cu. The high-grade result can raise confidence in potential copper resources and provide near-term support to copper sentiment.

title: Rising futures prices drive Chinese battery makers to increase nickel output amid EV slowdown
summary: Rising nickel futures have pushed Chinese battery and precursor makers to increase electrolytic nickel output, including potential additional capacity in May. EV sales growth has slowed, but producers are shifting from nickel sulfate to refined nickel as arbitrage widens. Nickel prices have been trending higher, near recent highs.

title: Copper squeezed in the United States but China has plenty: Andy Home
summary: Reuters reports LME copper hitting a record nominal high as a COMEX/CME short squeeze forces traders to scramble to ship metal into U.S. warehouses. While China has ample inventories and strong imports—keeping ShFE stocks elevated—demand appears to be de-stocking, with the Yangshan premium turning negative, but the squeeze remains near-term bullish for copper.

title: Alaska Energy Metals Secures Option to Acquire the Bambino Nickel – Copper Property and Commences Exploration Programs on Its Quebec Properties
summary: Alaska Energy Metals secured an option to acquire the Bambino nickel–copper property in western Quebec and has begun a fully funded exploration program, including soil sampling and a VTEM survey. The geology targets magmatic sulfide Ni+Cu±PGE mineralization, which may support bullish sentiment for nickel and copper.

title: BeMetals Corp.: BeMetals Discovers Extensive Copper Mineralization of Similar Style to Major Mines and Projects in the Domes Region of the Zambian Copperbelt
summary: BeMetals reported that new core holes at the Pangeni Copper Project in Zambia intersected significant copper sulphide mineralization, extending the footprint to over 1.7 km along strike with grades up to 0.74% Cu. Results are exploration-focused and do not indicate immediate production changes, limiting near-term copper price impact.

title: Alaska Energy Metals Secures Option to Acquire the Bambino Nickel – Copper Property and Commences Exploration Programs on Its Quebec Properties
summary: Alaska Energy Metals secured an option to acquire the Bambino nickel-copper-PGE property in western Quebec and will begin exploration with soil sampling and a VTEM survey. The geology targets magmatic sulfide Ni+Cu±PGE hosted in gabbro sills. The announcement is exploration-stage, implying limited immediate supply effects.

title: What New Caledonia riots mean for the nickel industry
summary: Riots in New Caledonia, a major nickel producer, have halted mining and damaged SLN infrastructure, forcing mines to idle and the processing plant to run at minimum capacity. The disruption supports higher LME nickel prices by reducing output and potentially eroding a global surplus, despite some offset from growing Indonesian supply.

title: Nickel and Dimed: The Green Metal Gamble in New Caledonia
summary: New Caledonia produces about 7% of global nickel, but the article cites near-term disruption risks: metallurgical plants teetering on collapse, Glencore stopping financing for a loss-making mine, and Goro reducing output after a tailings dam leak. With a global nickel glut already weighing on prices, disruptions add bearish sentiment.

title: Class 1 Nickel Updates Resource Estimate on High-Grade Alexo North Nickel Sulphide Deposit – Significant Increases in Indicated Resources Over the 2020 Estimate
summary: Class 1 Nickel announced an updated mineral resource estimate for the Alexo North nickel sulphide deposit, with indicated resources rising to 42,600 tonnes at 0.92% Ni and a higher contained nickel figure versus the 2020 estimate. The company plans further drilling to upgrade and expand resources across the project.

title: Class 1 Nickel Updates Resource Estimate on High-Grade Alexo North Nickel Sulphide Deposit ? Significant Increases in Indicated Resources over the 2020 Estimate
summary: Class 1 Nickel announced an updated NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate for the Alexo North nickel sulphide deposit, combining new and historical drilling data. The update significantly raises indicated resources versus the 2020 estimate and supports continued exploration at the Alexo-Dundonald Nickel Project. This is generally supportive for nickel sentiment.

title: Civil Unrest Shakes New Caledonia's Nickel Industry Amid Global Implications
summary: Civil unrest in New Caledonia has halted mining and damaged/curbed output at Societe Le Nickel’s operations, while Koniambo idled its mine and processing plant. The disruption supported a rally in London Metal Exchange nickel prices to nine-month highs as analysts warned reduced supply could erode a global surplus.

title: Glencore Keeps Russian Aluminum Contract But Metal Flows Dry Up
summary: The news notes Glencore will keep its Russian aluminum contract, but physical metal flows are becoming scarce. That suggests delivery disruptions and reduced near-term availability, which can tighten the aluminium market and support prices over the following days to weeks.

title: The upstream price sentiment is heavier, and the downstream wait-and-see nickel pig iron transaction is under pressure [Nickel Pig Iron Daily Review]
summary: SMM reports nickel pig iron prices (SMM8–12% high-nickel) holding steady but under pressure from heavier upstream sentiment. Limited Indonesian ore approvals and persistent raw-material shortages keep smelter output weak and operating rates low. Demand from steel mills may rise near the procurement cycle, supporting stable-to-strong ferronickel in the short term.

title: Nickel prices continued to pull back in the morning, and the spot market was difficult to trade [SMM nickel spot afternoon review]
summary: Nickel prices continued to ease in the morning, with the spot market difficult to trade. Jinchuan premium was 600-800 yuan/ton (avg 700), while the Russian nickel premium ranged -600 to -300 yuan/ton (avg -450). Downstream demand did not rise materially, keeping sentiment cautious despite recent-high levels.

title: ElvalHalcor Hellenic Copper and Aluminium Industry S A : ANNOUNCEMENT FOR Q1'24 TRADING UPDATE
summary: ElvalHalcor reported Q1’24 trading results, noting that both aluminium and copper metal prices averaged lower than in Q1’23. The company said revenue and segment profitability were pressured by the metal-price decline and subdued European demand. No new operational or regulatory catalyst for copper or aluminium prices was announced.

title: ElvalHalcor Hellenic Copper and Aluminium Industry S A : ANNOUNCEMENT FOR Q1'24 TRADING UPDATE
summary: ElvalHalcor’s Q1’24 trading update links weaker financial results to lower LME benchmark metal prices and subdued industrial demand. It reports average aluminium and copper prices below the prior-year quarter, with reduced segment revenues and profitability. The company expects ongoing geopolitical and macro headwinds through 2024.

title: US looks to decarbonize aluminium industry, spurred by policy and demand
summary: US policy and industry demand are pushing aluminium producers to decarbonize and standardize “low-carbon” definitions. DOE selected Century Aluminum for negotiations on $500m funding for a green smelter to potentially double capacity, while Fastmarkets launched low-carbon differentials. Curtailments from high power costs underscore the market impact.

title: Glencore, Rusal extend aluminium supply contract into 2025, source says
summary: Glencore and Rusal extended their long-term aluminium supply contract into 2025 despite previously low traded volumes. The extension is enabled because Rusal is not directly targeted by Western sanctions. The report also notes an LME ban on Russian aluminium, copper and nickel from April 13, reinforcing near-term supply-tight sentiment.

title: Violence in New Caledonia affects nickel prices
summary: Deadly unrest in New Caledonia has raised concerns about nickel supply disruptions from a region holding 20–30% of global reserves. LME nickel prices jumped from about $18,510/t in early May to above $21,275/t, with broader worries of future shortages for battery and industrial materials.

title: Cameroon's Aluminum Sheets Exports Surge by 80% to CFA6.6bn in 2023
summary: Cameroon exported 3,011 tons of aluminum sheets in 2023, up about 90.8% year-on-year, with revenue rising 80.2% to CFA6.6bn. The gains are expected to strengthen Alucam, whose exports and profitability have been under pressure since Rio Tinto exited in 2014.

title: US Producers File AD, CVD Petitions Against Disposable Aluminum I
