The project is forecast to deliver annual copper production capacity of about 300,000 tonnes. The deal signals additional refining/smelting supply, which can weigh on copper sentiment.

title: OceanaGold Philippines income drops 47.9% as gold, copper output fall
summary: OceanaGold Philippines reported Q1 net income fell 47.9% due mainly to lower output at its Didipio gold-copper mine. Copper production dropped 22% to 3,015 tons and copper recoveries fell with lower feed grades. The firm also reiterated its 2024 production outlook.

title: POWER NICKEL - World-class discovery of strategic metals
summary: The article claims Power Nickel in Quebec has delivered major “miracle drill results” pointing to large deposits of strategic metals, explicitly including nickel and copper. It frames the discovery as a potential supply solution amid critical metal shortages, geopolitical risk, and high tariffs affecting EV-related supply chains, supporting bullish market sentiment.

title: Power Nickel Lion Zone Delivers Hole Assays from 2.60-17.90% CuEq With Hole 59 delivering 1.91 g/t Gold, 73.48 g/t Silver, 9.88% Copper, 6.23 g/t Palladium, 4.56 g/t Platinum, and 0.49% Nickel over 5.59m
summary: Power Nickel reported high-grade drill assays from its Lion Zone, including intervals with 9.88% copper over 5.59m and 0.49% nickel over the same run, plus broader polymetallic results and CuEq context. The news supports project development but does not imply immediate supply changes.

title: Power Nickel Lion Zone Delivers Hole Assays from 2.60-17.90% CuEq With Hole 59 delivering 1.91 g/t Gold, 73.48 g/t Silver, 9.88% Copper, 6.23 g/t Palladium, 4.56 g/t Platinum, and 0.49% Nickel over 5.59m
summary: Power Nickel reported high-grade assay results from its Lion Zone drill program, including 9.88% copper and 0.49% nickel over 5.59m (plus additional Cu and Ni-rich intercepts). The news supports project potential but provides no production, permitting, or supply/inventory change, so near-term metal price impact is likely limited.

title: Copper dips below $10,000 as consolidation continues
summary: Copper prices fell below $10,000 per tonne on the LME, down 1.5%, driven by weak demand expectations from China and persistently high Shanghai physical inventories. Softer U.S. data and rate-cut expectations supported a stronger dollar, adding near-term pressure. Aluminium and nickel also edged lower.

title: Kodiak Copper Corp.: Kodiak Announces $4 Million Non-Brokered Financing
summary: Kodiak Copper Corp. announced a proposed $4 million non-brokered private placement comprising charity flow-through units, HD units, and flow-through shares, with proceeds mainly funding exploration at its British Columbia copper projects. The financing is expected to close around June 21, 2024, subject to TSXV approvals.

title: Canada Nickel Completes Drill Program at Deloro with Resource Estimate Expected in July
summary: Canada Nickel said it completed infill drilling at its Deloro nickel project near Timmins, reporting nickel-bearing intervals and noting an initial resource estimate expected in July 2024. The update improves the project’s resource definition but does not indicate any near-term production or supply impact on nickel markets.

title: Vast Resources shares jump as copper, gold mining ramps up
summary: Vast Resources said ore mined at its Baita Plai mine rose 22% year-on-year in Q1, with copper concentrate grade at 20% (below last year but above the prior quarter). It also cited progress at its Tajikistan operations. Shares rose, reflecting improved output expectations for copper.

title: Indonesia Imposes 7.5% Export Tax on Copper Concentrate Shipments
summary: Indonesia’s finance ministry has introduced a 7.5% export tax on copper concentrate shipments effective immediately. The move targets shipments from the two firms allowed to export despite the raw copper export ban. The tax increases export costs and may reduce near-term concentrate supply flow, weighing on copper prices.

title: Cemac: Mineral prices fell 2.6% QoQ in March 2023 despite gold and aluminum surge
summary: BEAC’s CEMAC report says mineral export prices fell 2.6% QoQ in March 2023, mainly due to weaker iron and manganese prices. It also notes that aluminum prices rose 2.7% during the same period, though not enough to offset declines across other commodities exported by the region.

title: More Nickel in the USA: Talon Metals Extends Nickel-Copper Mineralization in the Raptor Zone by 110 Meters
summary: Talon Metals said it extended nickel-copper mineralization in Minnesota’s Raptor Zone by drilling 110 meters more strike, including 8.91 meters of nickel mineralization with 1.77 meters of massive sulphides in a new hole. Assays are pending, and exploration will continue with step-out drilling in 2024.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: More Nickel in the USA: Talon Metals Extends Nickel-Copper Mineralization in the Raptor Zone by 110 Meters
summary: Talon Metals reported that follow-up drilling at Minnesota’s Tamarack Nickel-Copper-Cobalt project intersected 8.91 meters of nickel mineralization, including 1.77 meters of massive sulphides, extending the Raptor Zone strike length. Assays are pending, but results support expectations of additional nickel-copper resources.

title: More Nickel in the USA: Talon Metals Extends Nickel-Copper Mineralization in the Raptor Zone by 110 Meters
summary: Talon Metals says it extended the Raptor Zone nickel-copper mineralization by 110 meters and intersected 8.91 meters of nickel mineralization, including 1.77 meters of massive sulphides, with assays pending. The update supports potential future nickel and copper supply, but it is exploratory.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: More Nickel in the USA: Talon Metals Extends Nickel-Copper Mineralization in the Raptor Zone by 110 Meters
summary: Talon Metals reported that new drilling in Minnesota’s Raptor Zone extended nickel-copper mineralization and intersected 8.91m of nickel mineralization including 1.77m massive sulphides, with assays pending. The company plans further step-out exploration, signaling potential for a larger mineralized system but no immediate output change.

title: Gold Royalty Completes Vares Copper Stream Acquisition
summary: Gold Royalty Corp. completed its US$50 million acquisition of a copper stream on the Vares Silver Project in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The deal is structured with cash and issued shares, plus an expanded revolving credit facility. The release focuses on financing and cash-flow expectations, not operational copper output changes.

title: Copper Falls Through $10,000 as Exchange Inventories Keep Rising
summary: Copper is falling through $10,000 as exchange inventories continue to rise. Higher warehouse stocks typically imply increased near-term availability and weaker demand expectations, pressuring prices over the coming days. The article’s focus is directly on copper market conditions rather than nickel or aluminium.

title: Protesters aim to stop work at Chinese copper mine in Myanmar
summary: Hundreds of protesters in Myanmar target the Chinese-backed Letpadaung copper mine, alleging it funds the junta. Workers have struck and intermittent protests have continued for years over land, compensation, and pollution, with Chinese personnel arriving to keep work running. Troops guard the site, but disruption risk persists.

title: Copper and this related stock set to make another run at the highs, according to the charts
summary: CNBC’s Chart Investing piece argues copper is supported by robust demand tied to clean energy and AI-related electrification, alongside supply tightness from mining and South America geopolitical barriers. It also frames copper futures and Southern Copper as approaching technical support and potential renewed upside toward prior highs.

title: Economist Faisal Basri: Reveals Nickel Downstreaming Only Benefits China
summary: An Indonesian economist argues that nickel downstreaming largely benefits China, with most added value flowing abroad. The piece also alleges continued nickel ore flows to Chinese processors despite Indonesia’s 2020 export ban. These points could influence near-term nickel supply expectations, but no direct immediate price driver is quantified.

title: Fund managers retain faith in copper
summary: Fund managers remain bullish on copper despite some profit-taking as the CME squeeze dissipates. COTR data show large net long positions on both CME and LME, with only modest trimming. Momentum has faded and prices consolidated above $10,000/t, suggesting limited immediate directional pressure.

title: Copper dips on weak physical demand in China
summary: Copper prices fell after a strong rally as weak physical demand in China weighed on the market. LME three-month copper slipped below $10,000 and SHFE July copper dropped, while SHFE and LME copper stocks rose. Aluminium and nickel also eased, suggesting broadly bearish sentiment in base metals.

title: Weak physical demand keeps copper prices under $10,000/T
summary: Copper prices in London edged up but stayed below $10,000/t due to weak physical demand in China. Rising LME and SHFE inventories, negative import premiums/discounts, and softer Chinese manufacturing weighed on sentiment. While supply-disruption risks were noted, analysts said they were largely priced in and strike effects should be short-lived.

title: China's Unusually Large Copper Stockpiles Fuel Demand Concerns
summary: The article’s headline says China’s unusually large copper stockpiles are building, raising concerns about demand. Elevated inventories in major consuming hubs often imply slower offtake and greater near-term availability, which can weigh on copper prices in the coming days to weeks.

title: C3 Metals Drills 294 Metres at 0.30% Copper and 0.13 g/t Gold (0.39% CuEq1) from Surface at Bellas Gate, Jamaica
summary: C3 Metals reported long drill intercepts at its Bellas Gate, Jamaica project, including 294m at 0.30% copper from surface at the Camel Hill prospect, plus additional copper-gold mineralization at Geo Hill. Results are used to update models and plan more drilling, boosting near-term copper sentiment.

title: Greenwave Technology Solutions' Downstream Processing System Generates Record Revenues as Copper Hits All Time High
summary: Greenwave reported record May 2024 revenues from its downstream metal processing system, citing higher pricing and increased volumes. The release attributes part of copper price strength to strong demand tied to electric vehicles, renewables, and AI. It also notes its Kelford facility recovers copper from shred residue.

title: Benton Cuts Massive Sulphides in First Two Holes Expanding the Great Burnt Copper Deposit and Exposes Excellent Copper Mineralization in Trenching at South Pond 15km North
summary: Benton Resources reports successful initial Phase 3 drilling at the Great Burnt copper deposit, including metres of semi-massive/massive sulphides with visible chalcopyrite, and ongoing trenching at the South Pond area. Reported historical highlights show high copper grades, supporting continued exploration expansion plans.

title: Copper nears 1-month low as real demand lags expectations
summary: Copper prices near a one-month low as real demand fails to match strong electrification-driven expectations. Three-month LME copper slipped below $10,000, with sellers paying China to destock. Funds reportedly sold copper and bought aluminium. Aluminium was also down on the day; nickel fell alongside broader metals weakness.

title: BHP and union to begin talks to avert strike at Chilean copper mine
summary: BHP and the union at Chile’s Spence copper mine will begin five days of government-mediated talks to avert a strike after workers rejected a new contract. The mine is operating normally during mediation, but if no agreement is reached, a strike could start next Wednesday.

title: Rusal Eyes Bauxite Ventures in Sierra Leone to Strengthen Global Footprint
summary: Russian aluminium producer Rusal is in talks with Sierra Leone’s government about securing a bauxite mining concession. The company says it wants to strengthen its raw material base as supply chain disruptions and refinery issues have pushed it to seek more alumina. Rusal already operates in Guinea.

title: German aluminium production declines as third-country imports rise
summary: Germany’s aluminium industry saw Q1 2024 production declines across subsectors, with recycled and semi-finished output down and extrusion hit by rising third-country imports, especially Turkey. High energy costs and weak end-demand (including construction and EV funding cancellations) worsen pressure, suggesting softer near-term aluminium pricing.

title: Indonesia's Merdeka posts lower nickel output in 1Q
summary: Merdeka Battery Materials (MBMA) cut 1Q output at its Sulawesi SCM mine due to wet weather and limited contractor equipment, with limonite and saprolite supplies falling. Its RKEF smelters also produced less nickel in NPI and matte. Guidance for 2024 is steady, but near-term supply is lower.

title: Ironbark to acquire stake in two Queensland copper mining projects
summary: Ironbark Zinc will acquire an 80% stake in two copper exploration projects in Queensland (Simon and Anderson) from Aeon Metals, paying $100,000 with due diligence over 30 days. The company plans initial data compilation, mapping, and sampling near Mt Isa, but the deal is exploratory and small.

title: Mining and Metallurgical Norilsk Nickel : Robots and spider cranes help upgrade Nornickel's flagship facility
summary: Norilsk Nickel is upgrading its Nadezhda Metallurgical Plant in Norilsk, including replacing a flash smelting furnace and implementing a Sulfur Program to cut SO2 emissions. The work uses demolition robots and spider cranes to improve safety and efficiency, and management expects production volumes to rise after repairs.

title: Copper concentrate production grows by 37.2% in January-April in Armenia
summary: Armenia’s National Statistics Committee reports copper concentrate production rose 37.2% year-on-year to 105,160 tonnes in January–April 2024. The increase implies higher concentrate availability versus last year, which may dampen near-term copper price expectations. Zinc and molybdenum output moved in different directions.

title: Breaking Mining News: Alaska Energy Metals (TSXV: AEMC) (OTCQB: AKEMF) Closes Option to Acquire the Bambino Nickel - Copper Property and Commences Exploration Programs on Its Quebec Properties
summary: Alaska Energy Metals said TSX Venture Exchange accepted an option agreement granting it the right to acquire 100% of the Bambino nickel-copper property in western Quebec and will commence exploration programs. The release is an early-stage acquisition/exploration update without any near-term production or supply impact.

title: Breaking Mining News: Alaska Energy Metals (TSXV: AEMC) (OTCQB: AKEMF) Closes Option to Acquire the Bambino Nickel - Copper Property and Commences Exploration Programs on Its Quebec Properties
summary: Alaska Energy Metals said TSX-V accepted an option agreement giving it the right to acquire 100% of the Bambino nickel-copper property in western Quebec and to start exploration. The update is about future project development, with no immediate production or inventory impact for nickel or copper.

title: RCMP Investigating Multiple Copper Wire Thefts Near Whitbourne
summary: RCMP is investigating several thefts of copper wire from substations and power poles near Whitbourne, Newfoundland. Incidents occurred on multiple dates in May, with grounding wires severed. Authorities believe the cases are connected as utilities face replacement needs following the vandalism.

title: Heat-Resistant Aluminum Alloys: A Breakthrough in Aerospace Engineering
summary: Chinese researchers say they developed nanoparticles-enhanced, oxide-dispersion-strengthened aluminum alloys with markedly improved heat resistance beyond typical performance limits. The work, presented as scalable and important for aerospace use, could broaden aluminum’s high-temperature applications. The piece also discusses China’s shift toward greener electricity for aluminum smelting.

title: Copper climbs back above $10,000/t on softer dollar, China demand hopes
summary: Copper futures rebounded above $10,000/t as the dollar softened on expectations of Fed easing and as signs of firmer China demand emerged. LME three-month copper rose 1.6%. LME aluminum and nickel also advanced, with Reuters citing renewed copper buying activity in China.

title: SILVER ONE DISCOVERS ADDITIONAL COPPER AND SILVER SHOWINGS ON ITS PHOENIX SILVER PROJECT IN ARIZONA
summary: Silver One says it found additional copper and silver showings at its Phoenix Silver Project in Arizona, with select samples up to 7.79% Cu. The area is near Freeport McMoRan’s Miami copper mine and BHP’s Ocelot porphyry project, and drilling is targeted for Q3 2024.

title: Copper climbs back above $10,000/t on demand hopes
summary: Copper rebounded above $10,000/t as investors increased bets on U.S. rate cuts after easing labour-market data, lifting demand sentiment and weakening the dollar. LME three-month copper rose 1.5% and Shanghai July copper gained 1.2%. The market also cited tightening concentrate shortages and selective buying after recent declines.

title: Copper's Spike Isn't Justified By Fundamentals, Trafigura Says
summary: Trafigura says copper’s recent spike is not backed by fundamentals. The comment is likely to affect trader sentiment and short-term expectations for copper, potentially encouraging profit-taking if the market is viewed as overextended. The piece appears to be commentary rather than a direct supply-demand development.

title: Copper rebounds ahead of ECB, but upside seen limited
summary: Copper prices rebounded 1% to around $10,027/ton ahead of the ECB’s expected first rate cut, supported by optimism that lower rates may improve growth. Gains were capped by concerns over sluggish demand, especially in China where inventories rose and producer operating rates fell. LME aluminium and nickel also rose.

title: Kodiak Copper Upsizes Private Placement to $6.6 Million
summary: Kodiak Copper Corp. upsized a non-brokered private placement to about $6.65 million, issuing flow-through and non-flow-through units and warrants. Proceeds will fund working capital and Canadian exploration expenses for its copper projects. The release is primarily equity-financing related, with no stated immediate effect on copper supply.

title: Copper concentrate TCs still negative: how? And what does it mean for copper prices?
summary: Fastmarkets reports copper concentrate TCs for Asia Pacific staying deeply negative, reflecting tight concentrate supply amid mine closures, weaker output, and smelter capacity expansions. It ties this upstream tightness to recent all-time highs in LME copper and argues concentrate constraints may translate into refined supply pressure despite contract benchmarks.

title: Nevada Copper Provides Update on Financing Efforts and Liquidity
summary: Nevada Copper reported depleted cash and the absence of binding or adequate financing to continue operations at its Pumpkin Hollow underground mine. The company has started scaling down operations and may seek creditor protection. It also notes director resignations tied to Pala. Funding constraints could limit copper production and supply ramp-up.

title: Surge Copper Announces $1.6M FT Offering To Accelerate Exploration at Berg Project
summary: Surge Copper Corp. announced a non-brokered $1.6M flow-through financing to fund critical-mineral exploration at its Berg project, aiming to intensify drilling/testing of priority targets toward a PFS. The company also referenced prior hard-dollar financing and ongoing reconnaissance work, signaling continued copper supply development.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel Surface Sample Program Identifies Significant Extension Of Large-Scale Nickel Mineralization Along The Carlang Trend
summary: EV Nickel reported assay results from 148 surface samples at its Shaw Dome Project’s CarLang B target, finding that most samples grade around 0.24% Ni or higher, with grades up to 0.34% Ni. The company plans further summer sampling, but no production timeline is provided.

title: Sprott Physical Copper Trust Announces Closing of Initial Public Offering
summary: Sprott Physical Copper Trust closed an IPO of 10,000,000 units at US$10 each, raising about US$100 million. The trust is designed to hold physical copper, and net proceeds will generally be used to purchase copper, creating incremental near-term buying interest that can support copper prices.

title: Hudbay and Multiple Labor Unions Announce Project Labor Agreement Letter of Intent to Support Copper World Mine Project
summary: Hudbay and several unions signed a letter of intent to enter a Project Labor Agreement for constructing the Copper World Mine in Arizona, including plans to produce “Made in America” copper cathode. The project is positioned as a domestic copper supply-chain contributor, supporting sentiment toward future copper output.

title: Nevada Copper plunges as financing stalls - The Northern Miner
summary: Nevada Copper has significantly reduced operations at its Pumpkin Hollow mine after it failed to secure funding and saw two board members resign from its leading investor. The company’s shares fell sharply. The operational scaling down signals near-term supply risk for copper, which can pressure copper prices.

title: Copper eases on soft China demand, US jobs data in focus
summary: London copper eased as softer-than-expected physical demand from China weighed on prices. Markets also awaited U.S. jobs data for guidance on when Fed rate cuts may begin, lifting expectations of cuts after recent labor-market cooling signals. Other LME metals, including aluminium and nickel, were modestly higher.

title: China May copper imports at 514,000 metric tons
summary: China’s unwrought copper imports rose 15.8% year over year in May to 514,000 metric tons, up from 444,010 tons in May 2023, according to customs data. The report indicates higher inbound copper supply into the world’s top consumer, but offers no additional drivers for price direction.

title: China May copper imports jump 15.8% on-year, beat expectations
summary: China’s May unwrought copper imports rose 15.8% year-on-year to 514,000 tonnes, beating expectations despite weak physical consumption. Imports were up 17.4% from April. Analysts cited potential additional Russia-origin flows into China following Western sanctions in April, with DRC shipments also improving.

title: Impact of EU sanctions on aluminum would be disastrous for Europe's industry
summary: The article argues that proposed EU sanctions on Russian aluminium would damage Europe’s industrial supply chain. It notes Russia supplies about one-third of the EU’s primary aluminium and that downstream processing in countries like France and Italy depends on it. The author warns restrictions would raise prices and inflation.

title: Copper slides after mixed China data, US jobs report in focus
summary: London copper fell after mixed China trade data. Better exports contrasted with slower imports and higher-than-expected unwrought copper imports, raising concern that Chinese inventories will grow; SHFE stocks hit a four-year high. Broader macro cues from an upcoming US jobs report and Fed cut expectations also influenced pricing; aluminium and nickel moved mildly.

title: Copper drifts toward 3rd weekly fall, prices break below $10,000/t
summary: Copper on the LME is poised for a third weekly decline, breaking below $10,000/t after mixed Chinese trade data. Better exports but slower import growth and higher unwrought copper imports raise concerns about rising inventories. Traders also await a U.S. jobs report for rate-cut timing, weighing on growth-linked metals.

title: Guinea signs alumina refinery deal with Emirates Global Aluminium subsidiary
summary: Guinea signed a term sheet with a subsidiary of Emirates Global Aluminium to build a 2 million tpy alumina refinery, aiming for initial production of about 1.2 million tpy by September 2026. The deal targets local bauxite refining and includes a partnership with Chinalco, but is not near-term supply.

title: Guinea Inks Major Alumina Refinery Deal with Emirates Global Aluminium
summary: Guinea signed a term sheet with Emirates Global Aluminium’s subsidiary to build a second alumina refinery in Guinea with about 2 million mt capacity by September 2026. Initial output is expected at 1.2 million tonnes annually, building on Guinea’s push to refine bauxite locally and add value beyond exports.

title: Copper Drifts Toward Third Weekly Fall, Prices Break Below $10,000 Per Ton
summary: London copper is set for a third weekly decline and has slipped below the $10,000 per metric ton threshold, with three-month LME copper down about 2% to roughly $9,950. Moves are attributed to mixed China trade data, pointing to softer near-term demand expectations.

title: Don't underestimate world demand for Nickel, CEO says
summary: Canada Nickel’s CEO Mark Selby argues the world demand for nickel is resilient, with growth mainly driven by stainless steel and some battery use. The piece also updates progress on exploration, permits, and plans for processing plants at Crawford, and suggests nickel prices may ramp later this year.

title: Surge Copper Announces Upsize of Private Placement to $2.2M
summary: Surge Copper upsized its private placement to about C$2.2M (charity flow-through and non-flow-through shares) to fund Canadian exploration expenditures for its Berg and Ootsa copper projects. The release is mainly a capital markets announcement and does not indicate immediate changes to copper supply or demand.

title: Abacus to acquire Willow porphyry copper property in US
summary: Abacus Mining & Exploration agreed to acquire full ownership of Almadex’s Willow porphyry copper property in Nevada, pending exchange approval. The deal involves issuing shares and a future top-up provision, with Abacus required to drill a 600m exploration hole by end-2025. Prior work indicates Cu-Mo mineralisation and an NSR royalty.

title: Copper output from Chile's Codelco down 6% in April
summary: Chile’s Codelco reported April copper output of 95,100 mt, down 6.1% year-on-year, according to Cochilco data. Output also fell at Escondida, while Collahuasi rose 1.9%. The production drop from key Chilean supply sources is likely to pressure short-term copper sentiment lower.

title: Tajikistan, China ink deal to revamp TALCO aluminum plant
summary: Tajikistan and China signed a deal to revamp the TALCO aluminum plant. Such upgrades can alter near-term aluminium supply via maintenance timing, refurbishment schedules, and potential efficiency improvements. The article lacks specifics on project timing or capacity impact, so the immediate price direction is uncertain.

title: Zambia Sees KoBold Spending $2.3 Billion on Giant Copper Mine
summary: Zambia plans for KoBold to spend about $2.3 billion on a large new copper mine. The announcement highlights major capital deployment toward copper production capacity in Zambia, which typically boosts market sentiment about future output and helps support copper price expectations over the next few weeks.

title: Guinea, Emirates Global Aluminum Agree on Alumina Plant Deal
summary: The news headline reports that Guinea and Emirates Global Aluminum have agreed on a deal for an alumina plant. Because alumina is a major feedstock for primary aluminium production, the agreement can improve near-term supply expectations and support aluminium price sentiment over the coming days to weeks.

title: Copper wiring a hot item for thieves at solar power plants | The Asahi Shimbun: Breaking News, Japan News and Analysis
summary: Japan is seeing more copper cable thefts at solar power plants as global copper prices have surged. Authorities and local governments are considering ordinances to license and restrict metal buyers. Police report thousands of theft cases in several prefectures, with increased buyer demand for stolen copper wires.

title: Copper hits lowest in more than five weeks on firm dollar
summary: Copper fell to its lowest in over five weeks on a firm dollar and shifting expectations for Fed rate cuts after stronger U.S. jobs data. Physical demand constraints were noted, including a continued discount in China import premiums. Aluminium declined about 1%; nickel was nearly unchanged.

title: Ventilated aluminium wall cladding for data centres
summary: The piece describes ventilated aluminium wall cladding systems for data centres, emphasizing perforated aluminium façades that aid server cooling and energy savings. It notes in-house production capacity at Renson for large orders and mentions demountable façade concepts, implying incremental aluminium demand, though without market-size quantification.

title: Copper recovers from five-week lows with fundamentals in focus
summary: Copper rebounded from five-week lows, rising 0.6% after U.S. jobs data-driven selloff shifted focus to improving fundamentals. Traders expected support from China returning from holiday and cited better China PMI activity, while concerns remain from rising warehouse inventories and weaker Yangshan premium. Aluminium and nickel saw only modest moves.

title: Nevada Copper Files For Relief Under Chapter 11 Bankruptcy Protection
summary: Nevada Copper Corp. filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy after failing to secure additional interim funding. The company has requested court approval for $60 million debtor-in-possession financing to provide liquidity and has indicated it does not expect to continue operations, aiming to preserve assets during restructuring.

title: GAC signs term sheet with Guinea for alumina refinery development
summary: Guinea Alumina Corporation signed a term sheet with Guinea’s government to develop a 1mt/year alumina refinery near Boké. The project is linked to EGA and involves a government equity stake and board appointments. The refinery would expand refining capacity for bauxite feedstock, supportive for aluminium supply expectations.

title: Copper picks up from five-week low as gold stabilises
summary: Copper rebounded 0.6% after dipping to the lowest since May 2, supported by shifting focus to improving fundamentals and expected Tuesday buying as China returns from holiday. The prior sell-off was triggered by strong US jobs data and a stronger dollar. China stocks remain high and premiums weak. Aluminium and nickel saw modest declines/gains.

title: Power Nickel Commences 8,000 Meters Summer Drill Program
summary: Power Nickel begins a 2024 summer drilling program of 20 holes and over 8,000 metres at its Nisk property in Quebec, targeting extensions of high-grade polymetallic sulphide lenses. The program focuses on both the polymetallic Lion Zone (PGE/Pd/Au/Ag/Cu) and nickel-rich Nisk Main. No production or shipments are mentioned.

title: LME Aluminum Queue Jumps to Five Months After Trafigura Delivery
summary: The article headline says the LME aluminum delivery queue increased to around five months after Trafigura made a delivery. A longer queue signals reduced availability for prompt aluminium and expectations of tighter supply, which can put upward pressure on aluminium prices over the next days to weeks.

title: Nevada Copper files for bankruptcy, names new boss
summary: Nevada Copper has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection and will halt its Pumpkin Hollow mine as part of a restructuring process. The company has replaced its CEO as part of management changes. The mine stoppage implies reduced near-term copper output, which can pressure copper prices.

title: Near Record Copper Prices Can't Stop One Miner From Going Bust
summary: The piece centers on a copper miner going bankrupt even as copper prices remain near record highs. The implication is worsening financial stress for the producer, prompting markets to reassess near-term supply outlook and the viability of high-cost output, which can weigh on copper sentiment in the coming days.

title: Cable manufacturers recycle used copper to meet rising demand
summary: Nexans and other cable makers are increasing copper recycling by converting more scrap into copper rods, aiming to raise recycled content. The piece links higher copper demand to electrification and data centers, while noting some aluminum smelters have reduced output due to higher electricity prices, boosting copper’s relative appeal.

title: Plans discussed for Aluminium Industry Complex in Sohar Industrial City
summary: A project team under Opaz and other agencies conducted a field visit in Sohar Industrial City to plan an integrated economic cluster and an “Aluminum Industry Complex.” They met Sohar Aluminium management and downstream factories to identify challenges and investment opportunities, aiming to attract new investment and strengthen Oman’s aluminium production hub.

title: What's Next for Copper Markets? | OilPrice.com
summary: Copper is seeing strong near-term downside after tightening earlier in the year. The LME price reportedly fell to $9,652/ton (down 11.5%), breaking an ascending trend line as China’s economic data disappointed and speculative flows reversed. Mine-closure supply tightness is noted but framed as eventual.

title: Pacific Ridge Closes First Tranche of Financing; Raises $1.68 Million for Inaugural Drill Program at Chuchi Copper-Gold Project In B.C.
summary: Pacific Ridge Exploration closed the first tranche of financing, raising C$1.68 million, to fund general working capital and a diamond drill program at its Chuchi copper-gold project in British Columbia. The company plans to drill 2,400 meters, beginning mid-August, with a second tranche expected shortly.

title: Rio Tinto to acquire Mitsubishi's 11.65% stake in Boyne aluminium smelter
summary: Rio Tinto agreed to buy Mitsubishi’s 11.65% stake in Boyne Smelters Ltd, operator of the Boyne Island aluminium smelter in Australia, and noted it will also raise its stake via a separate Sumitomo purchase. The transaction is subject to approvals and expected in 2H 2024, without disclosed output impact.

title: Codelco Copper Output Hit by Lingering Effects of Rock Collapse
summary: Codelco’s copper output has been impacted by lingering effects of a rock collapse, suggesting temporary supply losses at a key mine/refining source. Reduced production can tighten the near-term copper market balance and increase expectations for higher prices over the coming days and weeks.

title: Kaiser Aluminum closing its Sherman facility
summary: Kaiser Aluminum confirmed it will close its Sherman, Texas facility after 60 years, with production expected to stop by June 30 due to business challenges. Impacted customers will be redirected to other Kaiser sites. The closure affects about 75 employees and may reduce near-term aluminium output.

title: Base metals fall as yuan weakens, LME aluminium discount widens
summary: Base metals fell as the yuan weakened, reducing Chinese buying power. LME/SHFE copper dropped, while aluminium eased amid high inventories, weak physical demand, and a wider LME cash-to-three-month discount reflecting non-tight nearby supply. Nickel moved less consistently, amid broader downside pressure.

title: This Dadar footpath wasn't dug up for repairs, but by crooks after copper wire
summary: Mumbai police arrested five men for stealing ₹6–7 lakh worth of copper wires from underground utility cables near Dadar–Matunga. MTNL reported over 400 telephone lines tripped and cited 105 metres of copper wire stolen. Authorities say thieves dug the footpath nightly to extract and sell the copper as scrap.

title: Mining and Metallurgical Norilsk Nickel : Nornickel installs new furnace at Nadezhda Smelter
summary: Nornickel is reconstructing the pyrometallurgical line at its Nadezhda Smelter by dismantling flash smelting furnace No. 2 and installing a new unit. The smelter processes nickel concentrates and produces copper-nickel matte sent for further processing. The repair is planned to take ~60 days while improving reliability.

title: Indonesia considers terminating permits for nickel pig iron production
summary: Indonesia’s government is reviewing whether to terminate permits for RKEF smelters producing ferronickel and nickel pig iron. Officials said policy aims to reserve limited nickel ore for EV-battery nickel products. Permit termination risk could reduce current nickel supply, affecting short-term nickel price expectations.

title: Records for gold, coffee, copper, cocoa: What commodity prices say about inflation
summary: Record commodity prices are attributed partly to the U.S. economy running hot and possibly insufficiently tight policy. The piece notes copper hit record highs last month, and discusses how Fed expectations, interest rates, and the dollar can move commodity prices via demand and currency effects, supporting near-term upside risk for copper.

title: Orecap Invest Corp.: Orecap Updates on Cuprum Corp., Ontario's Largest Copper Resource
summary: Orecap updates on Cuprum’s Thierry copper project in Ontario, highlighting recent flow-through financing, commissioning of remaining assays from Summer 2023, completion of an updated NI 43-101, and historical resource/PEA details. The project’s CuEq calculations assume copper and nickel prices, but no new supply or production impact is indicated.

title: Copper hits 7-week low on weak yuan, rising stockpiles
summary: Copper prices hit a seven-week low as the weaker yuan reduced purchasing power for China and as LME copper inventories rose after fresh inflows. The piece also describes a contango structure with no imminent shortages, while aluminium and nickel fell amid broader base-metal pressure.

title: Premium Nickel upsizes private placement for Botswana projects
summary: Premium Nickel upsized a C$15m private placement to about C$27.5m to fund exploration and development of its Botswana assets, including the Selkirk nickel-copper-cobalt-PGM mine acquired in 2022. The offering is fully subscribed at C$0.78 per unit, with proceeds also for general corporate and working capital.

title: Alcoa Provides Update on Transaction Milestones for Acquisition of Alumina Limited
summary: Alcoa reported progress toward completing its acquisition of Australia-based Alumina Limited, including filing the definitive proxy, obtaining Brazil’s CADE approval, and receiving indications from Australia’s ACCC. Shareholder and court hearings are scheduled through late July, targeting closing around Aug. 1, subject to approvals.

title: US bars imports from footwear, seafood and aluminum firms over Uyghur labor
summary: The U.S. added three more companies to an entity list tied to the Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act, including electrolytic aluminium producer Xinjiang Shenhuo Coal and Electricity Co. The action bars related imports, potentially tightening aluminium supply and supporting near-term aluminium price expectations as U.S. demand shifts away from sanctioned sources.

title: U.S. bars imports from more footwear, seafood and aluminum firms allegedly linked with Uyghur forced labour
summary: The U.S. expanded an entity list barring imports from companies alleged to use Uyghur forced labor. One newly listed firm is Xinjiang Shenhuo Coal and Electricity Co, described as an electrolytic aluminum producer. The move is intended to keep such goods out of the U.S. market, potentially tightening aluminium supply.

title: Huge aluminium stocks transfer causes LME load-out queue: Andy Home
summary: Reuters reports that LME aluminium stocks surged after US sanctions-related rule changes on Russian aluminium. A large May warranting/dump at Port Klang was followed by cancellations and a lengthy load-out queue (up to 159 days). Warehouse arbitrage and surplus conditions are implied by wider contango spreads and ongoing stock churn.

title: Freeport-McMoRan Is Looking for Ways to Expand Copper Production, CEO Says
summary: BNN Bloomberg highlights that Freeport-McMoRan’s CEO says the company is searching for ways to expand copper production. The prospect of additional output supports near-term bullish sentiment for copper by improving expectations for supply, though details on timing and realized incremental production are not provided in the excerpt.

title: POSCO : strengthens core rechargeable battery material value chain with concurrent groundbreakings for nickel and precursor production plants
summary: POSCO Group and CNGR broke ground in Pohang on a nickel refining joint venture producing 50,000 tons/year of 99.9% high-purity nickel and a precursor plant producing 110,000 tons/year. The complex is meant to supply cathode materials via POSCO Future M, with mass production slated for 2026.

title: Tsingshan plans another 50,000 T nickel LME listing this year, company says
summary: Tsingshan plans to register and list an additional 50,000 tonnes of nickel cathode on the LME in the second half of 2024, following its earlier Dingxing listings. The move is aimed at boosting deliverable high-grade supply amid rising LME nickel inventories and growing surplus that weigh on nickel prices.

title: Bhp And Workers At Spence Copper Mine In Chile Agree To Extend C…
summary: BHP said it and workers at the Spence copper mine in Chile have agreed to extend contract negotiations, pushing off the risk of a strike. The delay reduces near-term disruption to copper production and thus is supportive for expectations of copper supply over the coming days and weeks.

title: Tsingshan Plans Another 50,000 T Nickel LME Listing This Year, Company Says
summary: Tsingshan plans to register another 50,000 metric tons of nickel cathode on the LME in the second half of 2024, after listing 50,000 tons in Q2 from its Dingxing plant. The company expects to apply for 50,000 tons from another smelter this year, adding potential supply.

title: How to play the bull case for copper through ETFs
summary: The piece reviews copper’s pullback after a sharp rally, citing prior drivers like better-than-expected growth, short covering, and mine disruption in Panama, while projecting a near-term range and medium-term tightening. It also notes strong ETF inflows and discusses copper ETF options, with brief substitution to aluminium if prices spike.

title: Kalla Group targets phase 2 nickel smelter completion in 2027 - Companies
summary: Kalla Group says it has concluded phase one of its nickel smelter and will begin gradual operations this year. Phase two of a Rp 10 trillion nickel processing and refining facility in South Sulawesi is targeted for completion in 2027, adding capacity and increasing ferronickel and nickel sulfate output, supported by renewable power.

title: Copper prices bounce ahead of US inflation data, Fed meet
summary: Copper rebounded as the dollar steadied ahead of U.S. CPI and the Fed decision. Traders cited expectations of a dovish statement and lower currency pressure supporting dollar-priced commodities. LME copper rose 0.8% from recent lows, while aluminium was slightly lower and nickel flat, reflecting broad industrial-metal reaction.

title: Sixth Street Bridge plagued by copper thefts six months after city formed task force to combat problem
summary: Los Angeles reports ongoing copper wiring thefts from the Sixth Street Bridge, stripping miles of cable and disabling lighting. A city task force has not eliminated the issue, with repairs estimated at about $2 million for this bridge and over $17 million citywide last year. Officials plan to harden infrastructure against repeat thefts.

title: DHS Adds PRC-Based Seafood, Aluminum, and Footwear Entities to Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act Enforcement List
summary: DHS added three PRC entities to the UFLPA enforcement list, effective June 12, under which CBP applies a rebuttable presumption that the listed entities’ goods are barred from U.S. import. One entity produces electrolytic aluminum in Xinjiang, raising forced-labor compliance risk and potential supply tightness for aluminum imports.

title: New Caledonia nickel industry at standstill amid unrest
summary: New Caledonia’s nickel processing is effectively shut after weeks of unrest. Eramet’s SLN runs smelter furnaces at minimum capacity due to disrupted ore logistics, while Prony halts both its plant and nearby mine for security. Mining is suspended and a rescue package is uncertain, keeping output constrained.

title: Thieves are stealing EV charger station cables for copper
summary: Thieves across the U.S. are cutting and stealing EV charging cables, using bolt cutters to remove copper-containing wiring. The story highlights that copper prices are near record levels (about $5.20/lb), making scrap theft profitable and causing chargers to go offline, pushing firms to add security.

title: Kodiak Copper Corp.: Kodiak Begins 2024 Exploration Program at its MPD Copper Gold Porphyry Project
summary: Kodiak Copper Corp. begins a 2024 exploration program at its 100% owned MPD copper-gold porphyry project in southern British Columbia, mobilizing two drill rigs and planning 10,000 metres of drilling alongside 3D IP and soil geochemical surveys to advance drill-ready targets. No near-term production or supply disruption is mentioned.

title: Ero Copper's Tucumã Project Awarded Operational License -
summary: Ero Copper announced it received the final operational license for its Tucumã copper project in Pará, with construction ~99% complete and commissioning well advanced. Pre-stripping and full mining have started, and first concentrate is expected early in Q3 2024, improving near-term copper supply prospects.

title: Global Copper Foil Market Report 2024-2032: Key Market
summary: A ResearchAndMarkets report highlights growth in the global copper foil market, driven by electronics demand, 5G infrastructure, EV growth, and copper foil applications in PCBs, batteries, shielding, transformers, and energy storage. It is a market study with forecasts through 2032 and no explicit short-term supply or trading disruption details.

title: District Copper Corp: District Copper Adds More Claims to Copper Keg Project in British Columbia
summary: District Copper Corp. reports adding three new claims to its Copper Keg porphyry copper project in British Columbia, increasing the land package and stating it now controls the porphyry target area and associated anomalies. The company plans additional exploration work, with no production or near-term supply changes mentioned.

title: Mining Giant Aims to Boost Copper Output With New Tech Amid Metal Shortage
summary: Freeport-McMoRan says it will boost copper output using new processing technology to recover copper it previously couldn’t access, without opening new mines. The company aims to add 800 million pounds annually over three to five years, starting with 200 million pounds more now, amid an existing copper shortage and high prices.

title: Copper catastrophe: scrap dealers strip SA to fuel stolen red metal export boom
summary: South Africa’s Copper Development Agency warns of a “copper catastrophe” driven by infrastructure theft and scrap dealers exporting stolen copper at high profits. Legitimate users struggle to source legally, as stolen cable and other infrastructure are smelted into ingots/billets and shipped out, tightening effective supply.

title: Green Light Metals Inc.: Green Light Metals Enters into Option Agreement with Integra Resources for Cerro Colorado Copper Porphyry Target in Arizona
summary: Green Light Metals entered a 12-month exclusive option agreement to purchase interests in the Cerro Colorado property in Arizona, described as a copper porphyry target within the Laramide porphyry belt. The deal involves issuing shares/tranches and potential future cash or shares for closing, supporting copper exploration outlook.

title: Major Russian polluter Norilsk Nickel to move some production to China, circumventing sanctions
summary: Norilsk Nickel says sanctions have cut revenues and disrupted payments, deliveries and pricing, limiting copper plant sulfur-equipment upgrades. Separately, the US and UK have banned Russian copper, nickel and aluminium from LME/CME trading. Norilsk plans to move some copper smelting to China later, but the trading bans are immediate.

title: Coppernico Metals Inc.: Coppernico Hires Drill Contractor at its Sombrero Project in Peru
summary: Coppernico Metals said it has hired a Peru-based drilling contractor to start an initial 3,000+ metre diamond drilling program at its Sombrero copper-gold project in Ayacucho, Peru, with mobilization scheduled for July 2024. The update is exploratory with no production guidance, implying limited near-term copper price impact.

title: Nevada Copper shareholders face loss of investment as Elliott Investment circles to provide emergency bankruptcy funding
summary: Nevada Copper’s U.S. subsidiary filed for Chapter 11 and the firm is seeking a $60 million DIP package while exploring a sale. With mining and milling suspended at its Pumpkin Hollow copper mine and severe liquidity stress, near-term output prospects weaken, adding supply-risk sentiment. Copper’s recent highs are noted.

title: Ero Copper's Tucumã Project Awarded Operational License - Commissioning On Track for First Copper Production Early Q3 2024
summary: Ero Copper received the operational license for its Tucumã copper project, with construction ~99% complete and commissioning underway. First concentrate remains expected in early Q3 2024 as flotation and milling commissioning nears completion. The milestone reduces regulatory risk and supports near-term expectations for copper output ramp-up.

title: Chinese Trader's $20 Million Pile of Russian Copper Goes Missing
summary: The piece highlights that a Chinese trader’s reported $20 million pile of Russian copper has gone missing. While details are limited, the implication is reduced nearby physical copper availability, which can add short-term tightness and support prices, though the overall market-wide impact is likely limited.

title: The Overnight Report: CPI Relief - FNArena.com
summary: An “over-night” market note focuses on US CPI driving risk-on sentiment, but the key metals link is nickel-specific: reports say Indonesia is considering terminating permits for Rotary Kiln Electric Furnace (RKEF) smelters. That raises near-term supply risk for nickel refining, supporting expectations of firmer nickel prices.

title: China's vast copper overhang will clear, one way or another: Russell
summary: Reuters columnist says China’s unusual copper stockpile build will work through global balances. With ShFE inflows continuing when they normally reverse, weak property/manufacturing demand and robust imports point to oversupply. Imports of refined copper are expected to ease and surplus to reach world markets, stabilizing but around lower levels near $10,000/t.

title: Copper Falls After Hawkish Fedspeak as Record Rally Loses Steam
summary: Copper prices fall as hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials undermine market expectations for faster rate cuts. The sell-off reflects tighter financial conditions and weaker sentiment toward industrial commodities, causing the prior rally to lose momentum and pressuring copper lower over the near term.

title: Mining All Stars back up to $20 Million Investment in Power Nickel
summary: Power Nickel Inc. plans a flow-through offering of up to $20 million to fund exploration on its Nisk property in Quebec, aimed at expanding its high-grade nickel mineralization. The financing is expected to close before end-June and supports drilling over the next 12–18 months, which may boost nickel sentiment.

title: Ardea nickel testwork brings bank balance boost
summary: Ardea Resources says its mineralised neutraliser (MN) testwork has improved nickel-cobalt inventory by about 16% at the Goongarrie Hub project and received a $1.1m federal grant. A Japanese consortium also committed funds for a definitive feasibility study, supporting development progress that may help nickel supply sentiment.

title: Copper wire theft leaves 6th Street Bridge completely in the dark
summary: Copper thieves have stripped miles of wiring from Los Angeles’ 6th Street Bridge, disabling LED lighting and leaving the viaduct “completely in the dark.” City officials cite thousands of cases statewide and millions in repair costs, and propose enforcement and task forces to curb copper theft and scrap sales.

title: Increasing container costs and tight scrap availability concerns for aluminium industry
summary: Participants report aluminium scrap is very tight in the US, influenced by expanding recycling capacity and stronger scrap demand from China and India, tightening regional supply in North America. Container shortages from Red Sea disruptions and Panama Canal drought have lifted freight and premiums, increasing demand for primary aluminium in the US and Mexico.

title: Copper under pressure on Fed rate cut outlook
summary: Copper prices paused after rebounding, pressured by the Fed’s delayed rate-cut timeline, which steadied the U.S. dollar. Reuters notes profit-taking and highlights rising LME inventories in Taiwan and South Korea. LME aluminium and nickel also fell on the same macro-driven risk/FX move.

title: Draganfly Selected to Partner with First Atlantic Nickel Corp to Help Develop Critical Mineral Project
summary: Draganfly was selected by First Atlantic Nickel to deploy drone-based survey technology to explore the Atlantic Nickel Project in Newfoundland, targeting awaruite (a nickel-iron alloy). The stated goal is to rapidly identify prospective zones to support 2024 exploration and drilling, potentially strengthening future nickel supply expectations.

title: Global nickel prices have probably hit a floor, says Macquarie
summary: Macquarie’s Jim Lennon says global nickel prices likely hit a floor as Indonesian nickel ore supply tightens after slower approval of mining permits and RKAB quotas fall short of demand. He expects excess to narrow, with nickel support from stronger steel demand and improving battery-sector growth.

title: Queensland authorities alarmed by copper theft surge
summary: Queensland authorities report a sharp rise in copper cable theft, with up to 1,000 metres taken in a night and repair bills exceeding A$4.5m annually. Cable is allegedly sold to scrap dealers, while some network sites replace stolen copper with aluminium, shifting demand.

title: Romios Gold Resources Inc.: Romios Begins Field Work to Follow-Up New Satellite Image Study by Photosat Outlining Significant Alteration Zones at the Kinkaid Copper-Gold-Silver Property, Nevada, USA
summary: Romios Gold reports new satellite-image reinterpretation identifying >1 km sericitic alteration zones and additional linear targets on its Kinkaid Au-Cu-Ag property in Nevada. Follow-up field work begins June 14. Boulders along a stream bed returned up to 13.3% Cu, supporting a possible buried porphyry copper system.

title: District Copper Corp: District Copper Commences Field Work at Copper Keg Project in British Columbia
summary: District Copper Corp. begins Phase I field work at its Copper Keg project in British Columbia, including mobilizing crews and contracting soil sampling, with possible follow-on geophysics. The project targets porphyry-style copper mineralization based on prior mapping and assays, but no production or supply change is announced.

title: Idaho Copper receives results from Veracio scanning work
summary: Idaho Copper received TruScan XRF scanning results from the first six drillholes at its Idaho CuMo deposit. The mobile XRF system measured copper and molybdenum grades at 1.5 cm intervals to support ore sorting, potentially reducing waste and enabling a smaller mill. The update is exploratory and not a direct market supply shock.

title: First Atlantic selects Draganfly drones to explore Canada nickel project
summary: First Atlantic Nickel selected Draganfly drones for aerial and magnetic geophysical surveys at its Atlantic Nickel Project in Newfoundland. The drone-based sensing aims to identify high-priority nickel (awaruite) targets and speed exploration ahead of a 2024 drilling program, but it does not change near-term supply.

title: USA Markets - USA and Canada Alumina Market: Projected to Reach USD 5,491.3 Million by 2032 with a 5.1% CAGR
summary: The article summarizes a research study projecting the US and Canada alumina market to grow to about USD 5.49 billion by 2032, with intermediate demand figures for earlier years. Alumina is a primary feedstock for aluminium smelters, so the outlook is modestly supportive for aluminium demand expectations.

title: Nickel market round-up: Is the relief rally here to stay?
summary: Fastmarkets’ nickel market round-up discusses the ongoing “relief rally” in LME nickel during H1 2024, but highlights resistance near the 50-month/50-week moving averages and the $20,000/t psychological level. It expects short-term rebounds to attract buyers, while maintaining a broader bearish tendency into mid-2024.

title: GT Resources Inc.: GT Resources Announces Completion of $1.84 million Non-Brokered Private Placement and Mobilization of Exploration Drill Rigs for the Canalask Nickel-Copper Project
summary: GT Resources completed a C$1.84m non-brokered private placement (flow-through shares) and mobilized exploration drill rigs for the Canalask copper-nickel project in the Yukon. The program targets EM Maxwell plate and downhole surveys to locate massive sulphide mineralization, including historical nickel and up to 6.1% copper assays.

title: Trader faces US$20m hit as copper cargo vanishes
summary: A trader reports a US$20m hit after a copper cargo vanishes. The loss implies copper supply has been disrupted or delayed, reducing nearby availability. In the first-days horizon, missing cargoes can increase expectations of tighter supply and support upward pressure in copper prices.

title: U.S. Automakers Race to Offset the Rise in Copper Prices
summary: U.S. auto makers are reacting to a rise in copper prices, citing higher input costs because copper is critical for conventional and especially EV vehicles. The article also notes strong aluminum price performance. It adds that the Baltimore port resuming operations should ease supply-chain bottlenecks, supporting near-term demand sentiment.

title: Nevada Copper files for Chapter 11, lays off 117
summary: Nevada Copper has filed for Chapter 11 and will lay off 117 workers. The restructuring and cost-cutting raise concerns about continuity of copper mining and near-term production levels, creating uncertainty around supply and potentially weighing on copper prices in the coming days.

title: London Metals Exchange failure on nickel due to its own self-interests: Kevin Rudd says prices kept artificially low by China risk a 20 per cent slump in global supply of the commodity.
summary: Kevin Rudd criticized the London Metals Exchange for not supporting new nickel standards to counter China’s cheap dumping. He warned the practice could trigger a 20% reduction in global nickel supply sources, with officials suggesting current “doing business as usual” is harmful for industry and geopolitics.

title: Global Nickel Prices Have Probably Hit a Floor, Says Macquarie
summary: Macquarie analyst Jim Lennon said global nickel prices may have hit a floor. He expects a recovery supported by strong demand from the steel sector and improving supply dynamics, as Indonesia’s slowdown in nickel ore production permits reduces the existing ore surplus.

title: China's Wuchan Zhongda probes missing copper worth $15 million
summary: China’s Wuchan Zhongda is investigating missing refined copper worth about $15 million after a cargo from Russia allegedly failed to arrive. The loss (~110 million yuan) is described as a small share of profit. Reuters also notes higher Russia-linked copper imports into China earlier in 2024.

title: LME nickel heads for fourth straight week of decline on inventory pressure
summary: Nickel prices on the LME edged up on Friday but were set to fall for a fourth straight week as LME inventories rose. Stock build is linked to Chinese producers ramping high-grade cathode output in Indonesia and China that can be delivered on the LME.

title: Copper drops on dollar and inventories; nickel hits two-month low
summary: Copper prices fell as a stronger dollar and rising LME-registered inventories signaled a supply surplus, widening contango. Nickel dropped to its lowest in over two months, pressured by higher LME and SHFE stocks and increased China high-grade cathode output. Aluminium also eased amid the same bearish complex tone.

title: Copper drops on dollar and inventories; nickel hits two-month low
summary: Reuters reports copper prices slipping and nickel hitting a two-month low, driven by a firmer U.S. dollar and rising LME inventories suggesting a supply surplus. Copper LME stocks jumped 28% in a month. Nickel is pressured by high warehouse stocks and China cathode output increases. Aluminium also fell.

title: Power Nickel announces $20m flow-through offering
summary: Power Nickel announced up to a $20m flow-through offering to fund exploration at its Nisk property in Quebec, targeting eligibility for Canada’s 30% critical mineral exploration tax credit. The raise involves issuing 16m flow-through units at $1.25 with warrants. Closing is pending TSX Venture approval.

title: Cooler inflation backs case for rate cuts, lower dollar and higher copper, silver and gold prices
summary: Cooler US inflation is portrayed as strengthening expectations for Fed rate cuts, which would weaken the dollar and broadly support commodities. The piece specifically ties this to copper, contrasting an earlier decline tied to hawkish guidance with the later “rate cuts/looser policy” bullish case for copper.

title: Inflection Resources selects Fleet Space tech for copper exploration
summary: Inflection Resources selected Fleet Space’s ExoSphere to run ambient noise tomography surveys to map and refine copper-gold exploration targets across Australia’s Macquarie Arc. New priority drill targets at Duck Creek prompted AngloGold Ashanti to upgrade the project phase to include drilling, supporting future copper supply prospects but not current output.

title: Copper Supercycle: Protectionist Moves and High Demand Create Perfect Storm
summary: The piece argues copper is in a “supercycle,” citing protectionist moves and a widening demand-supply deficit from energy transition and AI. It references copper production constraints (Gibraltar strike suspension), output ramp-up (Teck’s QB extension), permitting progress (Ero’s Tucumã), and processing tech (Freeport leaching) to expand copper supply.

title: BHP Copper Miners Accept Wage Offer, Easing Chile Labor Tensions
summary: BHP copper miners accepted a wage offer, easing labor tensions in Chile. The development reduces the probability of work stoppages or disruptions at copper operations, which typically lowers the immediate supply risk premium. As a result, copper prices may face mild downward pressure over the coming days.

title: Union at BHP copper mine in Chile accepts contract, averting strike -sources
summary: A union at BHP’s Spence copper mine in Chile accepted a new contract proposal, averting a potential strike after an earlier tentative agreement required a member vote. With the strike risk removed, near-term production disruption fears ease, which can support copper price sentiment shortly.

title: Union Representing Workers At Bhp's Spence Copper Mine In Chile…
summary: A union representing workers at BHP’s Spence copper mine in Chile confirms acceptance of a new contract. The announcement suggests labor tensions are eased, lowering the likelihood of operational disruption. That can support expectations for more stable near-term copper output and supply conditions.

title: Rising bauxite demand raises dependence risk on guinea's supply
summary: The article says global bauxite demand is rising with growing aluminium usage, but supply is increasingly dependent on Guinea, which provides much of China’s bauxite. It highlights Guinea’s political and labour disruption risk, including a strike that affected key mines, raising concerns about near-term bauxite availability for aluminium production.

title: Copper mine near White Sulphur Springs getting closer to starting construction
summary: Tintina (Sandfire subsidiary) says the Black Butte underground copper project near White Sulphur Springs is moving closer to construction, having completed early site work and seeking funding and bonding before tunneling. The company cites high-grade copper and permits restored after court rulings, but mining likely won’t ramp for more than a year.

title: India's first Metro stretch to be upgraded with aluminum third rails
summary: Kolkata Metro will upgrade a 16.45 km line by replacing steel third rails with aluminium ones. Metro Railway says the change reduces energy loss, operational costs, and maintenance needs, with faster train acceleration and lower emissions. Work starts from Noapara and is expected to finish over the next two years.

title: Zimbabwe targets beneficiating aluminium
summary: Zimbabwe’s government said it wants to boost aluminium beneficiation and processing capacity to meet rising industrial demand. The plan follows a visit to Tajik Aluminium Company (TALCO) and talks about partnering to build similar plants in Zimbabwe, including for aluminium cable production.

title: China May aluminium production surges 7% to highest level in nearly 10 years
summary: China’s primary aluminium production rose 7.2% in May to the highest level in nearly a decade, with output also up year-to-date. Producers cited strong demand growth prospects for solar and EVs and speculative buying. LME and Shanghai aluminium prices hit multi-month highs, implying bullish near-term pressure.

title: Copper dips after China industrial data miss forecasts
summary: Copper prices opened lower as China’s May industrial output missed forecasts, reinforcing worries that the weak property sector will limit demand for industrial metals. A firm U.S. dollar also weighed on copper. The article notes prior speculative-driven May highs followed by downward corrections.

title: China's Hydropower Surge Raises Aluminum Production to a Record
summary: The piece reports that China’s hydropower surge is driving aluminum production to a record level. More power availability can expand smelting activity, raising near-term supply expectations. Without details on demand or库存, the immediate price impact is likely pressured but with moderate uncertainty based on the excerpt provided.

title: Golden Mile enters deal to earn into Arizona copper project
summary: Golden Mile Resources signed a binding term sheet to acquire a 51% earn-in for the Pearl Copper Project in Arizona, with total potential investment of A$12m and an NSR royalty covering copper production. Payments are linked to a JORC-compliant copper resource target, with further options and JV arrangements.

title: Copper nears eight-week low on Chinese factory data
summary: Copper fell to its lowest in almost eight weeks as weak Chinese industrial data clouded demand expectations. LME three-month copper slid to about $9,631/ton and LME copper stocks rose. The same China-focused demand worries coincided with declines in aluminium and nickel prices.

title: Riverside Resources Inc.: Riverside Resources Expands Ariel Copper Project with Acquisition of Adjacent Maria Luisa Copper Property, Sonora, Mexico
summary: Riverside Resources completed acquisition and title transfer of the Maria Luisa copper property adjacent to its Ariel project in Sonora, Mexico, consolidating a larger, fully permitted drill target near the La Caridad copper mine. The release is focused on exploration readiness, not production or discovered reserves, limiting near-term price impact.

title: Record copper prices likely to pause U.S. scrap shipments to China
summary: Record CME copper prices are prompting Chinese buyers to defer U.S. copper scrap shipments because U.S. scrap is priced at a discount to CME/LME benchmarks. China’s concentrate shortages have boosted scrap imports overall, but higher prices are slowing U.S. flow, affecting nearby physical supply dynamics.

title: Energy ministry to investigate latest accident in Morowali nickel plant - Archipelago
summary: Indonesia’s energy and mineral resources ministry will investigate a second work accident at PT Indonesia Tsingshan Stainless Steel’s nickel processing plant in Morowali. Two workers were scalded during furnace slag cleaning, and a prior explosion killed 18 workers. The probe and possible sanctions raise near-term nickel production uncertainty.

title: Ellis Martin Report: Lifezone Metals Limited CEO Chris Showalter-Clean Nickel, Copper, Cobalt and PGEs. Complete Vertical Integration-Listen to the Interview
summary: The piece is an interview with Lifezone Metals’ CEO about the company’s Hydromet technology and its Kabanga Nickel Project in Tanzania. It claims the process could unlock new LME-grade nickel and also copper supply, but offers no near-term operational updates. A feasibility study is due by Q3 2024.

title: Zijin Mining : Tongshan Copper Mine Adds 3.65 Million Tonnes of Copper Reserves
summary: Zijin Mining’s subsidiary Duobaoshan Copper announced a discovery at the Tongshan Copper Mine that adds 3.65 million tonnes of copper reserves from deep ore bodies, confirmed by Heilongjiang authorities. Total project reserves rise to over 5.6 million tonnes of copper, with some associated molybdenum, gold and silver.

title: Kobrea Commences Field Work at Upland Copper
summary: Kobrea Exploration starts field crews at the Upland Copper Project in British Columbia, conducting soil geochemical and passive seismic surveys to infill historical copper mineralization and assess overburden depth. Historical drilling shows copper-rich intervals and expanding targets, but the release provides no immediate production or supply changes.

title: Tempus acquires Prescott copper-base metals project in Canada
summary: Tempus Resources completes the acquisition of the Prescott copper-base metals project in Nunavut, planning an initial airborne gravity survey and subsequent mapping and sampling. The program targets sediment-hosted copper and Mississippi Valley-type zinc-lead deposits. Permitting is underway and exploration is expected to start this month.

title: Copper slides to 8-week low after more soft data from China
summary: Copper is falling to an eight-week low following additional soft economic data from China. The negative data likely reinforces concerns about slower industrial activity and construction demand in the world’s major consumer, weighing on near-term copper market sentiment and price expectations.

title: Behind Copper's Record Rally
summary: The piece says copper has broken $5/lb as demand accelerates for EV charging stations and AI data centers. It notes copper mining output is growing far more slowly than other base metals. With demand rising and supply constrained, the typical market result is higher copper prices.

title: Cornish Metals signs agreement to sell Nickel King Property in Canada
summary: Cornish Metals signed a binding agreement to sell its 100% interest in the Nickel King and Opescal Lake Ni-Cu-Co properties in Canada to Northera for up to C$8m, with staged payments and Northera shares after listing. The deal is intended to refocus on the company’s tin project.

title: 5 reasons why we are entering the next copper super cycle
summary: The piece claims a new copper “supercycle” is emerging, driven by electrification and clean-energy demand versus constrained supply. It cites shortages by 2025 and immediate disruptions including Panama’s Cobre Panama closure, a Peru mine strike, and Chile output misses/drought. It concludes copper prices should rise.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel Provides Update on 2024 Exploration Plan - Initiates Diamond Drill Program on High Grade Target
summary: EV Nickel Inc. reports commencement of a 2024 diamond drill program on high-priority nickel targets including Langmuir #2 and targets within the Shaw Dome property, alongside broader geophysical and metallurgical work for its CarLang trend and existing nickel deposit. The update is exploration-focused with no production or supply impact stated.

title: Nevada Copper Provides Update on Chapter 11 Bankruptcy
summary: Nevada Copper reported an update on its Chapter 11 bankruptcy, including interim court approval for US$20m debtor-in-possession financing to fund care-and-maintenance during restructuring. The company plans a sale process and retains advisors. It operates the Pumpkin Hollow copper project, making the situation potentially supply-negative for copper near term.

title: Barrick Gold Corporation: The Lumwana Mine - Producing Copper for the Future
summary: The piece focuses on Barrick Gold’s Lumwana copper mine in Zambia and its planned “Super Pit” expansion, targeting higher annual copper output and growth from 2024 onward. It highlights Zambia’s role as a major copper producer and the expansion’s costs and timeline, supporting expectations for increased near-term supply.

title: Nevada Copper Provides Update on Chapter 11 Bankruptcy Process and Management Appointments
summary: Nevada Copper reported court orders granting interim approval of debtor-in-possession (DIP) financing, authorizing an initial US$20 million borrowing to fund care-and-maintenance and support for employees during Chapter 11. The company plans a sale process and has appointed new interim executives. The restructuring likely limits copper output.

title: Indonesia's $5 billion deal with Tesla is only part of its all-in strategy on nickel mining
summary: Fortune reports Indonesia’s $5 billion nickel supply deal with Tesla and the government’s push to capture more of the nickel value chain via export restrictions. It highlights Indonesia’s large nickel reserve and refining buildout, but notes environmental risks and weaker EV demand as headwinds.

title: Rebuffed BHP wired for bigger Aussie 'copper province'
summary: BHP says South Australia should become a larger “copper province” by growing existing assets at Olympic Dam, Carrapateena and Prominent Hill, consolidating operations after acquiring OZ Minerals, and running extensive exploration. Management highlights current output targets and synergies via centralized smelting, supporting expectations of steady copper supply.

title: BHP : Anna Wiley at Copper to the World conference
summary: BHP’s representative discusses copper demand drivers from electrification and renewables, and highlights BHP’s South Australia operations, production targets (310–340 kt this FY), and multiple growth projects (Prominent Hill, Carrapateena, Olympic Dam expansion and refinery/smelter studies). The message is investment- and supply-supportive for copper markets.

title: Copper rebounds from 8-week low on bargain hunting
summary: Copper prices rebounded after hitting an eight-week low, with LME three-month copper up 0.7% and SHFE July copper slightly higher. Traders cited bargain hunting alongside firmer US equities, while weaker Chinese May industrial output growth (5.6% vs forecast 6%) continued to cloud demand prospects.

title: VAR migration postponed at LME amid nickel crisis review
summary: LME Clear has postponed planned updates to its margin models, including value-at-risk add-ons, while it continues a review of lessons from the 2022 nickel market blow-up. Market participants say the CCP is balancing margin outcomes for arbitrage trades versus corporate metals hedging. Immediate effects center on nickel trading conditions.

title: Copper edges up from 8-week low on bargain hunting
summary: Copper inched up after falling to an eight-week low as bargain hunters supported bids, with LME three-month copper rising slightly. The rebound was capped by weaker-than-expected China industrial output and weak import premiums, while copper inventories rose. Aluminium and nickel also fell, reflecting subdued overall demand sentiment.

title: Tudor Gold Outlines Strategic Plan for the Next 12 Months Focused on Advancing the Treaty Creek Gold and Copper Project Located in the Golden Triangle, British Columbia
summary: Tudor Gold outlined a 12-month plan to advance its Treaty Creek Goldstorm gold-copper project in British Columbia, including exploration drilling, metallurgical test work focused on producing a copper concentrate, and preparation for a Preliminary Economic Assessment by Q2 2025. The update is development-oriented with no immediate copper supply impact.

title: Riverside acquires Maria Luisa Copper Property in Mexico
summary: Riverside Resources completed the acquisition and title transfer of the Maria Luisa copper property in Sonora, Mexico, consolidating it into its Ariel project and updating drill permitting. The area sits near Mexico’s La Caridad copper mine. With a drill permit in hand, the company plans exploration drilling.

title: More Nickel in the USA: Talon Metals Commences Drilling in Michigan's Upper Peninsula
summary: Talon Metals began drilling in Michigan’s Upper Peninsula at its nickel-copper properties, near the Eagle Nickel Mine and Humboldt Mill. The company is following historic high-grade targets and has partial funding support from the US Department of Defense. The release supports ongoing US nickel exploration rather than immediate production.

title: Arc Minerals commences drilling at Bostwana copper project
summary: Arc Minerals says it has begun a ~3,000 m maiden exploration drilling program at its Virgo copper project in Botswana, following an encouraging induced polarisation survey that identified potential drill targets. The drilling will use RC and diamond holes to test high chargeability anomalies, but it does not imply near-term output changes.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: More Nickel in the USA: Talon Metals Commences Drilling in Michigan's Upper Peninsula
summary: Talon Metals began exploration drilling at the Roland target on its Michigan nickel-copper properties, near the Eagle Nickel Mine and Humboldt Mill. The firm frames the work as follow-up to historic high-grade intercepts, partly funded by a U.S. Department of Defense grant, but provides no production or reserve updates.

title: Adventus, Salazar granted key permit for Ecuador copper-gold mine
summary: Ecuador’s environment ministry granted Adventus Mining and Salazar Resources a water-use permit for their Curipamba-El Domo copper-gold project. The approval lowers regulatory and operating constraints, improving prospects for project progress. The news is supportive for copper sentiment, with limited immediate impact on physical supply.

title: Alleged copper wire thieves wearing high-vis to look like lines workers - police
summary: Police in Christchurch say copper wire thieves have been posing as legitimate lines workers to steal cable from live power lines, cutting electricity to households and businesses. Companies report thefts leading to power surges, outages, and generator purchases. Police charge multiple offenders and note copper theft payoffs.

title: Bell Copper Corporation: Bell Copper Announces Second Tranche Closing of Non-Brokered Private Placement
