summary: Peru’s copper production is expected to be flat in 2024, driven by blockades and unfavourable weather conditions. The disruption to mining activity can limit near-term output, affecting market expectations for copper supply and supporting upward price pressure in the coming days to weeks.

title: Copper buoyed by dollar, but China demand worry dominates
summary: Copper prices firmed on Monday, supported by a weaker dollar and stronger activity in China’s manufacturing, but gains were limited by concerns over Chinese demand as LME and bonded inventories rose sharply. The piece also notes nickel faces headwinds from oversupply and continuing inventory builds, implying downward pressure on prices.

title: High copper concentrate costs, supply deficit to hurt copper smelters from 2025: LME Asia Week 2024
summary: The piece highlights tight copper concentrate availability, rising-to-stressed TC/RCs, and concerns that a higher benchmark treatment fee may be unachievable in 2025. With smelters facing costly raw materials, traders expect heightened risk of output cuts and a difficult end-of-year supply talks outlook.

title: Southern Copper to resume Tia Maria mine development in Peru
summary: Southern Copper will restart development of Peru’s Tia Maria copper mine, following delays tied to environmental issues and community opposition. Management says development activities begin 1 July and production is expected at about 120,000 tonnes annually. The project supports Peru’s copper output growth goals, implying additional supply.

title: Copper Buoyed by Dollar, But China Demand Worry Dominates
summary: Copper prices firmed as a weaker U.S. dollar and stronger-than-expected China manufacturing data supported buying. However, worries over demand in top consumer China and climbing inventories limited gains. Traders noted funds increased purchases when the dollar fell, balancing supply/demand sentiment.

title: Rising Chinese aluminium output pressures alumina supply: Andy Home
summary: China’s primary aluminium output is nearing record highs as Yunnan restarts idle capacity. However, alumina supply is lagging: alumina prices are up about 15% since January and have been volatile due to bauxite feed constraints and refinery disruptions. China is also importing alumina, but shortages remain tight, supporting aluminium costs.

title: Los Angeles moves forward with reward system to curb copper thefts
summary: Los Angeles City Council approved a tiered reward program to curb theft of copper wire and related infrastructure. Rewards range from $1,000 for misdemeanors to $5,000 for felonies, pending Mayor Karen Bass approval. The city is also creating a copper wire task force to target repeat offenders and improve security.

title: Tomago Aluminium appoints Jerome Dozol as new CEO | Newcastle Herald
summary: Tomago Aluminium appointed Jerome Dozol as CEO and plans to transition its energy supply to renewables, targeting 50% renewable power by 2030 and full renewable power by 2035. summary: Tomago Aluminium appointed Jerome Dozol as CEO as the company advances a repowering plan to transition its energy-hungry smelter to renewable power. title: Copper Prices Edge Higher After Jump in Asian LME Withdrawals
summary: Copper prices moved higher after a jump in Asian LME withdrawals, suggesting reduced available stocks in the region and improving short-term supply tightness. Such withdrawal activity can tighten the balance for near-term delivery, providing upward support to copper benchmarks.

summary: Tomago Aluminium appointed Jerome Dozol as CEO, drawing on prior Rio Tinto smelting and refining experience. title: Tomago Aluminium appoints Jerome Dozol as new CEO | The Maitland Mercury
summary: Tomago Aluminium appointed Jerome Dozol as CEO and plans to repower its Newcastle aluminium smelter with more renewable electricity, aiming for 50% renewables by 2030 and full renewable power by 2035. title: Tomago Aluminium appoints Jerome Dozol as new CEO | Dungog Chronicle
summary: Tomago Aluminium appointed Jerome Dozol as CEO and highlighted its repowering plan to transition the energy-intensive smelter to renewable electricity. title: Tomago Aluminium appoints Jerome Dozol as new CEO | The Scone Advocate
summary: Tomago Aluminium appointed Jerome Dozol as CEO and general manager as the Newcastle smelter transitions its electricity supply to renewables. title: Tomago Aluminium appoints Jerome Dozol as new CEO | Muswellbrook Chronicle
summary: Tomago Aluminium appointed Jerome Dozol as CEO and highlights its repowering plan to transition the energy-intensive Newcastle smelter toward renewables. summary: U.S. Customs and Border Protection updated its 2024 General Approved Exclusions for EU aluminium tariff-rate quota administration, removing several HTS tariff codes effective July 1, 2024. summary: Tomago Aluminium appoints Jerome Dozol as CEO as the Newcastle smelter transitions its electricity supply toward renewables. title: Rio Tinto in talks to avert strike at Mongolian copper mine
summary: Rio Tinto is negotiating with workers at Mongolia’s Oyu Tolgoi copper mine after wage cuts triggered a strike in May. With further industrial action possible if demands aren’t met by July 5, output risk rises. The mine targets ramp-up to 500,000 tons copper annually from 2028, but near-term disruptions are the concern.

title: Copper edges higher after LME stock draw in South Korea
summary: Copper rose after stocks withdrawals in South Korea reduced perceived oversupply, with 8,000 tons of fresh LME warehouse cancellations suggesting inventories may fall. China’s import copper discount tightened and physical demand appeared to improve, despite mixed manufacturing signals. LME aluminum and nickel also edged higher.

title: Copper Extends Rebound on Hopes for China Stimulus, US Rate Cuts
summary: Copper is extending its rebound as markets look to China stimulus and anticipate possible US rate cuts. The article frames the move as driven by improved macro-demand expectations and lower-rate hopes, which tend to lift industrial metals sentiment over the coming days.

title: QC Copper Provides Corporate and Technical Update
summary: QC Copper provides corporate and technical updates on its Opemiska copper project, including scoping/PEA engineering studies, drilling plans to expand resources, and compilation of historical data for Cooke & Robitaille. title: American Eagle Gold Corp.: American Eagle Discovers Outcrop of Copper-Bearing Porphyry at Newly Defined IP Embayment Zone; Provides Drilling Update
summary: American Eagle Gold reports discovery of copper-bearing porphyry outcrops in its IP Embayment Zone at the NAK project and says drill hole NAK24-19 intersected chalcopyrite mineralization below 700 m. title: QC Copper and Gold Inc: QC Copper Provides Corporate and Technical Update
summary: QC Copper provided corporate and technical updates on its Opemiska copper project, including scoping-study engineering work and planned diamond drilling to expand resources at Springer/Perry and Cooke & Robitaille. summary: American Eagle Gold reports discovering outcropping copper-bearing porphyry in a newly defined IP Embayment Zone and intersecting chalcopyrite mineralization below 700m in drill hole NAK24-19. summary: Chakana Copper reported initial scout drilling results from the Mega-Gold porphyry target within Peru’s Soledad project. Assays for additional holes remain pending and no production or resource updates were given.

title: Hannan Metals Ltd.: Hannan Doubles Footprint of the Copper-Gold Porphyry at Previsto Central, Peru
summary: Hannan Metals said its Previsto Central prospect in Peru continues to expand, with outcropping porphyry copper-gold mineralization over a large area and soil anomalies growing. The company plans additional IP surveys and drill permitting updates, but the news is primarily exploration progress, not near-term copper supply changes.

title: Copper gains sparked by fund buying built on quicksand
summary: Reuters reports copper up on short-term fund buying, but prices are likely capped by concerns over China demand and a sharp rise in LME-registered copper inventories, which have climbed nearly 80% since mid-May. title: World Copper Identifies New Opportunity at Zonia Copper Project in Arizona
summary: World Copper says historical heap-leach and ISL materials at its Zonia copper-oxide project in Arizona may contain large volumes of unrecovered, acid-soluble copper. The company plans confirmatory drilling and metallurgical testing to verify grade and recoverable pounds. If validated, it could improve early production prospects and economics.

title: Copper extends rebound on hopes for China stimulus, U.S. rate cuts
summary: Copper is reported to be extending its rebound as markets price in hopes for China stimulus and U.S. rate cuts. The expectation of easier financial conditions and stronger economic/demand outlook supports buying interest in copper within the near-term trading horizon.

summary: Freeport said its Manyar Indonesian smelter construction is substantially complete and commissioning has started, with copper cathode production expected in coming months and full ramp-up targeted by end-2024. title: Copper Extends Rebound on Hopes for US Rate Cuts, China Stimulus
summary: Copper prices extended their rebound as markets priced in hopes for US rate cuts and China stimulus. Lower rates can support economic activity and reduce financing costs, while China stimulus expectations boost demand outlook for industrial metals, especially copper, contributing to upward near-term price pressure.

title: Congo Sells Its Own Copper From Joint Ventures for First Time
summary: Congo is reported to have begun selling its own copper from joint ventures for the first time. summary: Abacus Mining announced closing and amending terms to acquire 100% of the Willow porphyry copper property in Nevada, issuing shares and increasing the NSR from 2.0% to 2.5% (with a buyback option). title: Copperwood mine project unfazed by exclusion from state budget
summary: A Wisconsin/Upper Peninsula report says Highland Copper’s Copperwood Mine grant was excluded from Michigan’s 2025 fiscal budget, but the company expects funding to proceed via Senate committee action later this summer. Opponents cite environmental and export concerns, while the company says work continues and timing is the issue rather than cancellation.

title: Rising Chinese aluminium output pressures alumina supply
summary: Reuters reports rising Chinese primary aluminium output from Yunnan as offline capacity restarts, but alumina supply is lagging demand. title: Copper steadied ahead of economic data release
summary: Copper prices steadied ahead of major economic releases. The U.S. dollar softened after moderately dovish Fed signals, supporting prices, while investors awaited manufacturing and jobs data for global demand cues. Supply was also supported by raw material shortages, though Freeport McMoRan flagged lower-than-expected sales due to an export-license delay.

title: BATTERY MINERAL RESOURCES INITIATES NEW DRILLING PROGRAM AND ANNOUNCES ENCOURAGING DRILL RESULTS FROM ITS PUNITAQUI COPPER MINE IN CHILE
summary: Battery Mineral Resources announced encouraging underground drilling results from its Punitaqui copper mine complex in Chile and stated mill operations resumed to produce copper concentrates. summary: Battery Mineral Resources announced results from early 2024 underground drilling and in-fill work at its Punitaqui copper mine complex in Chile. The company reports multiple copper intercepts (with associated silver) that confirm modeled geology and delineate mineralization, potentially supporting higher copper resources and future mill feed.

title: Freeport Indonesia secures copper concentrate export permit
summary: Indonesia allowed PT Freeport Indonesia to continue exporting copper concentrate for the rest of 2024 after securing an export permit, despite the broader ban on raw mineral shipments. The approval is intended to continue until Freeport’s new smelter reaches full capacity, supporting expected concentrate export flows.

title: Strickland wheels in fourth rig for Serbian copper-gold hunt
summary: Strickland Metals adds a fourth diamond rig at its Rogozna Serbia project to increase discovery drilling for copper-gold porphyry targets, with assays expected next month. title: Freeport Indonesia Secures Copper Concentrate Export Permit
summary: PT Freeport Indonesia secured an export permit to ship copper concentrate for the remainder of the year, even as Indonesia maintains a ban on raw mineral exports. The government will allow shipments until Freeport’s new smelter reaches full capacity, easing near-term supply uncertainty for copper.

title: India sells 44,800 tons of unprocessed aluminum to Russian companies | Indiablooms - First Portal on Digital News Management
summary: India supplied 44,800 tons of unprocessed aluminium to Russian companies in April for about $16.5 million, citing Indian customs data. summary: Copper prices rose for a fourth straight session on firmer Chinese demand signs (higher copper rod fabrication utilisation), computer-driven funds buying, and hopes for interest rate cuts that weakened the dollar. title: Midland Begins a Major Exploration Program for Nickel and Copper in Nunavik, Quebec Under Its Strategic Alliance With BHP
summary: Midland Exploration began a 2024 exploration program in Nunavik, Quebec, targeting nickel-copper mineralization under a strategic alliance with BHP. summary: Pan Global Resources reports exploration commenced at the Carmenes project in northern Spain, targeting high-grade copper and nickel (plus cobalt) with recent rock and gossan assays and planning for mapping, geochemistry and drill permitting. summary: Midland Exploration begins a major Ni-Cu(Co) exploration program in Nunavik under an alliance with BHP. summary: Turmalina Metals announced an option agreement to acquire 100% of the Colquemayo Cu-Ag-Au project in Peru, citing historic drill intercepts including 237.3 m at 2.4% copper and other high-grade Cu zones. title: Dore Copper Enters Into an Agreement to Acquire Claims Next to Its Flagship Corner Bay High-Grade Copper Deposit
summary: Doré Copper Mining agreed to acquire SOQUEM’s 56.41% interest in adjacent exploration claims north of its Corner Bay high-grade copper deposit in Québec. title: Nicola Mining Inc.: Nicola Mining Announces Completion of 3D IP Survey and Commencement of Exploration Drilling at the New Craigmont Copper Project
summary: Nicola Mining announced completion of a 3D induced polarization survey and the start of a 2024 diamond drilling program at its New Craigmont copper project in British Columbia, near Teck’s Highland Valley Copper. The company plans ~5,000 m of drilling to test geophysical targets, with potential further drilling later in summer.

title: Nicola Mining Announces Completion of 3D IP Survey and Commencement of Exploration Drilling at the New Craigmont Copper Project
summary: Nicola Mining reported completion of a 3D induced polarization survey and the start of 2024 diamond drilling at its New Craigmont copper project near Teck’s Highland Valley Copper. The survey refined geophysical targets, but the release provides no immediate production or supply changes, limiting short-term copper price impact.

title: LME to Suspend Deliveries of Nickel From Norilsk Finland Plant
summary: BNN Bloomberg reports that the LME will suspend deliveries of nickel from the Norilsk Finland plant. The measure limits prompt physical inflows from that source, tightening short-term nickel availability and likely raising expectations for near-term supply tightness and higher nickel prices.

title: Alumar sells aluminium in Brazilian low-VAT market
summary: Alumar (Alcoa/South32/Rio Tinto) is reportedly selling more aluminium ingot into Brazil’s São Paulo “low-VAT” market (0%–4% ICMS/deferred VAT), improving competitiveness versus the higher-VAT state route (around 12% ICMS). Traders link this to higher premiums and customer demand in São Paulo.

title: Dore Copper Mining Corp. Enters into an Agreement to Acquire Claims Next to Its Corner Bay High-Grade Copper Deposit
summary: Dore Copper Mining Corp. agreed to acquire a 56.41% interest in claims next to its Corner Bay high-grade copper deposit in Quebec, adding potential strike extension and new drill targets. The deal includes cash and share consideration plus contingent payments tied to resource estimates and commercial production.

title: Chile's Codelco sees copper output ticking up in second half of year
summary: Codelco said its copper output fell year-on-year in the first half of 2024 but should rise in the second half, without changing its 2024 copper forecast. The comments came alongside Chile’s lithium-sector dispute involving Tianqi and SQM, though the key immediate signal is improved copper supply outlook for H2.

title: Chilean peso strengthens nearly 1.5% as dollar slips, copper prices climb
summary: Chile’s peso strengthened about 1.45% versus the dollar as the greenback weakened on soft jobs data. Reuters notes that copper prices were climbing at the same time, and copper is Chile’s largest export, making the currency reaction closely tied to near-term copper market moves.

title: UAE'S IHC unit withdraws offer for Vedanta's Zambian copper mines over price
summary: IRH withdrew an offer to buy a 51% stake in Vedanta’s Zambian Konkola Copper Mines after talks collapsed over valuation. Vedanta is seeking funding to settle debts, revive operations, and invest in the Konkola Deep Mining Project. The deal failure reduces near-term investment certainty in Zambian copper supply.

title: LME plans to suspend nickel brand of Nornickel's Finnish plant from Oct 3
summary: The LME said it will suspend from Oct 3 the listing of a Nornickel-produced nickel brand from its Finnish Harjavalta plant. Deliveries will not be accepted for LME nickel contract warrants. The move is linked to the LME’s responsible sourcing audit requirements, not sanctions.

title: Benton Resources Inc. Continues to Expand the Great Burnt Copper-Gold Deposit, Discovers New Copper-Gold Zone and Identifies New 2 Km Long Gold in Soil Anomaly
summary: Benton Resources said its Phase 3 drilling continues expanding the Great Burnt copper-gold deposit, with 7 of 10 holes intersecting massive sulphide and new mineralized zones identified. It also reports preliminary gold assay results and a new 2 km anomalous gold soil trend, with base-metal results pending.

title: This 'Boring' Copper Miner Is Outfoxing Its Competitors
summary: The article argues Rio Tinto is increasing its copper exposure, citing ramp-up potential at Mongolia’s Oyu Tolgoi and a rising copper share of its asset mix. It also claims aluminum demand should rise with the energy transition. The piece is investment/valuation oriented, with limited immediate market-moving details.

title: Will Indonesia ease its ban on bauxite exports? Seems unlikely. | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: Rumours on 3 July claimed Indonesia might ease its bauxite export ban, but industry sources expect the policy to stay for the foreseeable future. The news briefly pressured SHFE alumina futures, which fell 1.7% to RMB 3,824/mt, reflecting expectations for bauxite/alumina supply changes. Capacity growth is still underway.

title: Opinion: Blood nickel: What electric-vehicle hunger has wrought, and how Canada can help
summary: The article criticizes Indonesian nickel production for worker safety and environmental damage and urges consumers and policymakers to shift EV supply chains toward Canadian nickel. It references a Canadian consultation on a potential EV surtax targeting Chinese imports, framing this as a step to redirect demand to cleaner nickel sources.

title: Rio Tinto in talks to prevent strike at copper mine in Mongolia
summary: Rio Tinto is negotiating with workers at its Oyu Tolgoi copper operations in Mongolia to prevent further strike action after wages were cut by as much as 80% following labor-law changes. The risk of output disruption weighs on short-term copper supply expectations, despite talks aiming to resolve the dispute.

title: London copper eases on poor macro data, weaker demand
summary: London copper eased as poor macro data and price-sensitive demand weighed on sentiment. Three-month LME copper fell to about $9,835/t, while LME inventories rose to the highest since Oct 2023. SHFE copper moved higher. LME aluminium was nearly flat and nickel edged up slightly.

title: Ardea launches DFS drilling for giant WA nickel play
summary: Ardea Resources began definitive feasibility study drilling (51,745m in 888 holes) at the Goongarrie Hub nickel-cobalt project in WA, jointly funded with Japanese partners Sumitomo Metal Mining and Mitsubishi. The work aims to upgrade resources to measured status for open-pit mine development, with POW approval pending.

title: Vedanta reports rise in aluminium, iron ore, zinc production
summary: Vedanta’s quarterly update said aluminium production rose about 3% year-on-year to 595,000 tonnes in the June quarter. Zinc India sales also increased, while overseas mined metal output fell. The report is company-specific and lacks broader market inventory or demand context, so near-term aluminium supply expectations improve modestly.

title: Big shareholder seeks probe into Avebury Nickel Mine sale deal | The Advocate
summary: A major shareholder urged Australia’s foreign investment watchdog to investigate and block Hartree’s proposed acquisition of the Avebury nickel mine after low bids and the owner’s receivership. The mine was placed on care and maintenance, workers were laid off, and the restart would likely take at least a year and cost about $100m.

title: Copper steady as potential interest rate cuts balance soft demand
summary: Copper prices held steady as investors weighed optimism over potential U.S. interest rate cuts against worries from rising LME inventories and lacklustre China demand. LME three-month copper was slightly higher, but inventories are far above mid-May levels, limiting upside and prompting a wait-and-see market stance.

title: NorthWest Copper Announces Start of 2024 Lorraine – Top Cat Exploration Drill Program
summary: NorthWest Copper announced the start of its 2024 Lorraine–Top Cat exploration drilling, planned to begin mid-July, targeting geophysical leads at its copper-gold project in British Columbia. The release discusses existing copper grades and potential new mineralization, but no production, supply, or inventory impact is provided.

title: Freeport secures copper concentrate export permit - Companies
summary: Freeport’s PTFI obtained a replacement export permit after the prior permit expired on May 31, allowing copper concentrate shipments to resume until December. The permit follows completion of its Manyar smelter, boosting processing capacity to 3 million tonnes per year, easing disruption and improving short-term copper supply outlook.

title: NorthWest Copper Announces Start of 2024 Lorraine – Top Cat
summary: NorthWest Copper says crews mobilized and drilling is expected mid-July at its Lorraine–Top Cat copper-gold project in British Columbia. The company plans ~1,000 m of drilling to test geophysical/geochemical targets and expand mineralization outside the current resource estimate. No production or supply disruption is announced.

title: NorthWest Copper Corp.: NorthWest Copper Announces Start of 2024 Lorraine - Top Cat Exploration Drill Program
summary: NorthWest Copper announced crews have mobilized and drilling is expected to begin mid-July at the Lorraine-Top Cat project in British Columbia. The program targets copper-bearing porphyry and skarn-related IP/geochemical targets outside the existing resource. The update is exploration-focused, with no immediate production or supply changes.

title: Royal Road wins tender for Saudi copper-gold exploration licences
summary: Royal Road Minerals’ Saudi joint venture won exploration licences for the Al-Miyah area in Asir Province, covering 234 km² with historical copper and gold potential. The company plans mapping, soil sampling, and drone scanning and will fund $3.9m over two years. No near-term production is indicated.

title: Indonesia launches first EV battery plant to take advantage of rich nickel resources
summary: Hyundai Motor Group and LG Energy Solution launched Indonesia’s first EV battery cell plant in West Java with 10 GWh initial capacity, targeting growth to 20 GWh. The project relies on Indonesia’s domestic mineral chain, highlighting its rich nickel resources and prior raw nickel export ban, supporting near-term nickel demand expectations.

title: IRH abandons pursuit of Vedanta's copper mines in Zambia
summary: IRH abandoned negotiations to buy a majority stake in Vedanta’s Konkola Copper Mines in Zambia after valuation disagreements, withdrawing its offer for a 51% stake. Vedanta seeks to sell part of its holdings to raise about $1.2bn for debt repayment and reinvestment in the Konkola Deep Mining Project.

title: Argentina's new investment regime a potential boon to copper projects
summary: Argentina’s congress passed the RIGI investment regime, granting mining tax benefits and looser capital controls. Sources say copper developers were waiting for RIGI approval to proceed with exploration and resolve currency/arbitrage issues. Authorities and industry expect improved competitiveness and investment inflows into copper projects, boosting near-term sentiment.

title: Copper Edges Higher After US Economic Data, Powell Rate Comments
summary: Copper is reported to have edged higher following US economic data and remarks from Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell. The market appears to be reacting to changing expectations around interest rates, which influences the US dollar and overall risk sentiment that typically feeds into near-term copper demand and pricing.

title: London copper heads for first weekly gain in seven weeks
summary: London copper is heading for its first weekly gain in seven weeks, supported by a softer dollar, hopes for U.S. rate cuts and stimulus, and improving physical demand in China. Buyers returned after earlier sidelines, with the China import discount tightening. LME aluminium and nickel also edged higher.

title: Govt makes ISI mark mandatory for steel & aluminium utensils to ensure safety in kitchens
summary: India has made ISI marking mandatory for stainless steel and aluminium utensils under a DPIIT Quality Control Order. The order bars manufacturing, import, sale, distribution, and storage of utensils without the BIS ISI mark, with penalties for non-compliance. For aluminium, compliance requirements may temporarily tighten supply and support demand.

title: Eramet and Huayou Explore EV Nickel Partnership in Indonesia
summary: Eramet and Huayou are exploring an electric-vehicle nickel partnership in Indonesia. The move is aimed at expanding or coordinating nickel supply for EV/battery-related needs, which can support short-term sentiment toward nickel as markets anticipate better availability and demand prospects from the EV supply chain.

title: Copper hits three-week high on interest rate hopes
summary: Copper prices in London hit a three-week high on Friday, supported by hopes of U.S. Federal Reserve rate cuts that weakened the dollar. Three-month copper gained 0.6% to about $9,945/t. The article also notes aluminium and nickel rising as the same macro sentiment improved outlooks for industrial metals.

title: Key China Copper Premium Climbs Above Zero as Orders Pick Up
summary: The article headline says the key China copper premium has climbed above zero as orders pick up. A positive, rising premium usually signals improving physical demand and/or tighter supply conditions in China, which tends to support near-term copper prices.

title: Govt Makes ISI Mark Mandatory For Steel & Aluminium Utensils To Ensure Safety In Kitchens
summary: India’s government mandated BIS/ISI certification for stainless steel and aluminium utensils. A Quality Control Order prohibits manufacturing, importing, selling, or storing utensils without the ISI mark, with penalties for non-compliance. The aluminium requirement may tighten compliant supply and raise near-term demand for aluminium inputs.

title: Copper prices set to retest $10k/t near-term says Citi
summary: Citi analysts expect copper prices to rebound near-term and retest $10,000 per tonne, even as global manufacturing data has softened. The note frames the outlook as a potential near-term support for copper, suggesting buyers may bid up expectations over the coming days to weeks.

title: More Nickel in the USA: Talon Metals Announces Royalty Agreement with Triple Flag for US$8 Million
summary: Talon Metals announced an $8 million royalty financing with Triple Flag for its Tamarack nickel project in Minnesota. The deal adds a net smelter returns royalty and includes warrants, with proceeds earmarked for advancing the nickel and related projects. It is non-dilutive funding, not an immediate supply change.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: More Nickel in the USA: Talon Metals Announces Royalty Agreement with Triple Flag for US$8 Million
summary: Talon Metals announced an US$8.0 million royalty agreement with Triple Flag for its Tamarack nickel project in Minnesota, adding a 1.67% net smelter returns royalty and issuing warrants. Proceeds will fund advancing the Tamarack nickel project and a related Michigan nickel-copper project, with downside protection via a buy-back right.

title: Vedanta says it has arranged $250 million to settle Zambian copper mine debts
summary: Vedanta says it secured $250 million to begin paying creditors of Zambia’s Konkola Copper Mines after regaining control of the copper mine and smelter. The firm aims to restart operations, including a July 8 payment timeline, which may ease supply disruption concerns for copper.

title: Vedanta says it has arranged US$250-million to settle Zambian copper mine debts
summary: Vedanta says it has arranged $250 million to begin paying creditors of Zambia’s Konkola Copper Mines after regaining control and agreeing a settlement with authorities. It plans to revive operations, including a salary increase for workers, and still seeks further funding to advance Konkola Deep Mining and boost copper output.

title: Hudbay may need more permit reviews for Copper World
summary: Hudbay’s “Copper World” project near Tucson faces potential delays because two parts of the mine plan (tailings storage/disposal and related reconfiguration) require separate permitting and possible further public review. ADEQ will decide on the current aquifer permit in August, but opponents seek tougher requirements or rejection.

title: Weekly Ratings, Targets, Forecast Changes - 05-07-24
summary: A weekly stockbroker update notes Nickel Industries lowered Q2 earnings guidance because heavy rain at its Hengjaya mine in Indonesia disrupted ore deliveries to the Morowali Industrial Park. The forecast cut is tied to reduced nickel ore supply flow, implying near-term bearish pressure on nickel price expectations.

title: Copper supported by Fed rate cut expectations, demand outlook
summary: Copper prices inched higher as expectations of U.S. interest rate cuts strengthened and demand outlook improved, helped by softer U.S. job data and rising confidence in China’s recovery. Comex and LME gains reflected short covering tied to shipment delays. Aluminium and nickel also rose modestly on the same macro support.

title: Ardea kicks off DFS on giant WA nickel project
summary: Ardea Resources began a $98.5 million, fully funded definitive feasibility study for its large Goongarrie Hub nickel-cobalt project in Western Australia. Japanese investors (Sumitomo Metal Mining and Mitsubishi) fund the DFS for a 50% stake. The company also expanded DFS drilling and plans approvals, processing and financing over 18 months.

title: London copper dips on weak China physical consumption
summary: London copper eased as China’s physical demand for copper remained weak, with a survey showing lower cable and wire producers’ operating rates. Expectations for U.S. rate cuts and potential China demand recovery, plus a return to a positive Yangshan premium, limited further declines. LME aluminium dipped, nickel rose slightly.

title: WA jarrah forest clearing given green light for Worsley bauxite mining
summary: WA’s environmental watchdog approved South32 to expand clearing for bauxite mining near Boddington, supporting continued feedstock for its Worsley alumina refinery for another 15 years. The EPA imposed rehabilitation and offset conditions, but said climate change may hinder full forest restoration, prompting likely appeals.

title: ASX: UBS tips copper over iron ore and lithium amid supply deficit
summary: UBS prefers copper over iron ore and lithium, citing signs of dwindling supply for the industrial metal. The piece notes LME copper is near a four-week high, up nearly 4% over the week, reflecting market bets that producers will struggle to meet growing demand, supporting bullish sentiment.

title: Ero Copper to Release Second Quarter 2024 Operating and Financial Results on August 1, 2024
summary: Ero Copper Corp. said it will release its Q2 2024 operating and financial results after market close on August 1, 2024, followed by a conference call on August 2. The company is a copper producer with assets in Brazil, so results may later inform copper supply expectations.

title: Canada Nickel Announces Creation of 'ExploreCo' Subsidiary with Spin-out of Eastern Exploration Properties and Consolidation of Crawford Regional Land Package
summary: Canada Nickel announced the creation of an 80%-owned ExploreCo vehicle to consolidate Eastern nickel exploration properties with Noble Mineral Exploration, and to simplify development by consolidating mining and surface rights around the Crawford nickel sulphide project. Transactions remain subject to definitive agreements and approvals; no production timeline was provided.

title: Copper steady as weak dollar counters sluggish demand in China
summary: Reuters reports copper prices steady as a weaker dollar offsets persistent weak demand signals from China and concerns about high inventories. Investors await potential stimulus at China’s July plenum. LME aluminium and lead were little changed, while nickel rose slightly; overall market impact appears range-bound.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Ltd.: Ivanhoe Mines Reports Q2 2024 Production Results for the Kamoa-Kakula Copper Complex
summary: Ivanhoe Mines said Kamoa-Kakula produced 100,812 tonnes of copper in concentrate in Q2 2024 and 186,925 tonnes in the first half. Phase 3 produced first concentrate on June 10 and is ramping toward steady-state in Q3. Improved grid stability boosted mining grades and recoveries.

title: Core Nickel Corp.: Core Nickel Commences Airborne Geophysical Surveys at Halfway Lake and Resting Lake Projects in the Central Thompson Nickel Belt, Manitoba
summary: Core Nickel announced it has started VTEM and magnetic geophysical surveys over its Halfway Lake and Resting Lake nickel projects in Manitoba’s Thompson Nickel Belt. The release cites historical drill intersections and deposits, but it is primarily an early exploration targeting update with no changes to near-term nickel supply or trading conditions.

title: Canada Nickel Announces Creation Of 'Exploreco' Subsidiary With Spin-Out Of Eastern Exploration Properties And Consolidation Of Crawford Regional Land...
summary: Canada Nickel announced plans to create an 80%-owned ExploreCo with Noble, consolidating nickel project mining and surface rights east of Timmins. It also transfers additional mining claims and patents to Canada Nickel to simplify development of the Crawford nickel sulphide project. Transactions are subject to definitive agreements and approvals.

title: Eramet, Zhejiang Huayou in talks for nickel partnership in Indonesia
summary: Eramet is in talks with Zhejiang Huayou to form a battery-grade nickel partnership in Indonesia, potentially involving Eramet supplying ore to Huayou’s HPAL plant in Weda Bay and acquiring a stake in the Huafei HPAL facility. The news cites rising EV-driven demand for HPAL-processed nickel.

title: Not Enough Copper to Support EV Transition, Study Says
summary: A University of Michigan and Cornell study says copper cannot be mined and permitted fast enough to meet EV and renewable-grid targets in time, citing long mine lead times and the need for far more new mines. It suggests hybrids as a more feasible alternative. The main issue raised is copper supply shortfall versus planned demand.

title: Russia's war in Ukraine boosts copper demand
summary: The article says ongoing war-related shell production is consuming and drawing additional copper, with NATO 155 mm shells containing 0.5 kg copper. It notes producers ramping output globally and cites higher copper premiums versus earlier levels, implying increased military demand and price resilience.

title: Sprott Physical Copper Trust Announces "At-The-Market"
summary: Sprott Physical Copper Trust announced an at-the-market equity program to issue up to US$500 million of trust units. Proceeds, if raised, are intended to be used to acquire physical copper under the Trust’s investment restrictions. The program could incrementally increase near-term copper buying demand.

title: Sprott Physical Copper Trust Announces "At-The-Market" Equity Program -- REPEAT
summary: Sprott Physical Copper Trust announced an at-the-market equity program to issue up to US$500 million of additional trust units. If units are sold, proceeds are intended to buy physical copper for the trust. This can add near-term demand, potentially supporting copper prices versus otherwise.

title: Key Takeaway From 2024 SMM LME Asia Week: Global Metals And New Energy Market Outlook And Supply Trends
summary: SMM LME Asia Week coverage highlights a copper concentrate shortage that keeps treatment charges low and may prompt smelter output cuts, supporting copper. It also notes Indonesian nickel projects pushing primary supply into oversupply, weighing on nickel. Aluminium is mixed: renewable demand and tight alumina support, but solar slowdown and cautious H2 views temper gains.

title: Cameroon Exports First Aluminum Ingots to Algeria under AfCFTA
summary: Cameroon began exporting containerized aluminium ingots under AfCFTA, sending 99.4 tons produced by Alucam to Algeria’s Alfilect for use in electrical cable components. The move reflects stepped-up intra-African trade and reduced customs friction, but the shipment scale is modest versus global aluminium markets.

title: Eramet seeks to invest in existing nickel smelter in RI after BASF exits - Companies
summary: Eramet says it is seeking partners to invest in existing or new HPAL nickel ore processing in Indonesia after its BASF project for producing battery-grade nickel (MHP) was delayed. Eramet Indonesia is looking for working or under-construction smelters, potentially boosting future nickel output.

title: Alberta RCMP investigating copper wire theft at oil field site
summary: Alberta RCMP are investigating copper wire theft from an oilfield site near Spruce View, causing significant damage estimated around $100,000. Police cite a broader pattern of wire thefts affecting telecommunications. Stakeholders call for harsher penalties, noting outages and life-safety implications for critical infrastructure.

title: $100,000 damage done by copper thieves to Central Alberta oilfield site
summary: RCMP is investigating copper-wire theft from an oilfield site near Spruce View, Alberta. Police say thieves cut large electrical cable using power tools, causing about $100,000 in damage. Authorities are seeking tips and note similar thefts occur locally, but any direct link is uncertain.

title: Indonesian government looking to ease bauxite export ban
summary: Fastmarkets reports Indonesia is in talks to ease its bauxite export ban because domestic alumina refinery development has lagged. Traders expect potential relaxation within months, with bauxite exports supporting China demand. The story also notes ongoing alumina supply disruptions, implying any added feedstock could reduce tightness and help aluminium economics.

title: Alberta RCMP investigate copper wire theft from oil field site
summary: Alberta RCMP is investigating a weekend theft of large amounts of copper electrical wire from an oilfield site, causing about $100,000 in damage. The theft follows a broader pattern of copper wire thefts affecting telecommunications infrastructure and calls for tougher penalties. The investigation is ongoing.

title: Capstone Copper to Release Second Quarter Results on August 1, 2024
summary: Capstone Copper will release its Q2 2024 financial results on Aug 1, 2024, followed by an investor conference call. Capstone operates multiple copper mines across the Americas (e.g., Pinto Valley, Cozamin, Mantos Blancos, Mantoverde). The notice is mainly procedural and includes no new production or guidance details.

title: Capstone Copper Corp.: Capstone Copper to Release Second Quarter Results on August 1, 2024
summary: Capstone Copper Corp. will release its Q2 2024 results on August 1, followed by an investor call. Capstone operates multiple copper mines in the Americas, including Pinto Valley and Cozamin. The notice could influence short-term copper sentiment, but it contains no new production or guidance details.

title: Copper prices rise slightly; markets eye Fed chair's testimony
summary: Copper edged up slightly in London as traders awaited clues from U.S. Fed Chair Jerome Powell’s testimony, which can move interest-rate expectations, the dollar, and global growth outlook. Improving but fragile physical demand signals from China supported copper. LME aluminum dipped and nickel fell, showing mixed near-term momentum across industrial metals.

title: Copper-moly hits leading EV Resources to big Peru porphyry
summary: EV Resources reported new surface and core drill hits at its Parag project in Peru, including 148m at 0.54% copper and 0.35% molybdenum, and highlighted a potentially large porphyry system. The company is re-emphasizing molybdenum byproduct economics as prices rise, supporting bullish sentiment for copper.

title: Copper prices rise on demand improvement in China
summary: Reuters reports copper prices rose marginally as China’s buying improved over the prior two weeks, supported by better liquidity for industrial buyers. Discounts for imports briefly flipped to a premium, reflecting tighter physical conditions. Gains were limited by caution ahead of U.S. Fed Chair Powell’s testimony, affecting rate-cut expectations.

title: CopperString 2032 launches in Hughenden with $5b investment | Queensland Country Life
summary: Queensland Premier Steven Miles and ministers marked the start of construction on Powerlink Queensland’s $5b CopperString 2032 high-voltage transmission line, progressing site works and sub-station-related activity from Hughenden toward Mount Isa. The project is expected to boost access to the North West Minerals Province and supports demand outlook for copper and aluminium for grid infrastructure.

title: Scandinavian Nickel Interests   | Company Announcement
summary: Kendrick Resources updates on its nickel sulphide projects in Norway and Sweden, highlighting potential new nickel resources and copper present with nickel. It notes EU Critical Raw Materials Act benefits for permitting and financing. The news signals future supply interest but does not imply immediate production or inventory changes.

title: Hedge fund Elliott challenges court verdict it lost against LME on nickel
summary: Elliott Associates is urging a London court to overturn a verdict backing the LME’s cancellation of $12 billion in nickel trades after the March 2022 spike. The hedge fund argues the LME belatedly disclosed “Kill Switch/Trade Halt” documents and internal reports. Jane Street won’t appeal; LME contests the appeal.

title: High Grade Copper Samples Identified at Cinto
summary: Solis Minerals reports results from early sampling at its Cinto Project in Peru, including assays up to 7.14% copper and geochemical signatures similar to the nearby Toquepala porphyry system. The company has secured access, is mapping and planning geophysics and drill permitting, indicating potential future copper supply.

title: Azimut Resumes Drilling at Elmer and Discovers a Copper-Gold Showing by Prospecting
summary: Azimut Exploration resumed drilling at its Elmer Property in Quebec and found a new significant copper-gold showing (“Equinox”) with disseminated chalcopyrite and bornite. Grab samples reportedly reached up to 5.29% Cu. The company is conducting follow-up prospecting and plans a soil geochemical survey; no resources or production are confirmed.

title: Solis Minerals Ltd.: High Grade Copper Samples Identified at Cinto
summary: Solis Minerals announced access agreement and initial reconnaissance mapping/sampling at its Cinto Project in Peru, reporting copper assays up to 7.14% Cu over mapped mineralised areas. The company links geochemistry and alteration to the nearby Toquepala porphyry system and is advancing geophysics and drill permitting.

title: China demand hopes hold copper prices steady
summary: Copper prices steadied after a run-up, supported by hopes for stronger China demand ahead of the July 15-18 third plenum and short-covering tied to expectations for Fed rate cuts and USD direction. However, LME copper warehouse stocks rose to multi-month highs, while aluminium and nickel eased on the day.

title: Surge Copper Announces Renewal of Communications and Engagement Agreement with the Office of the Wet'suwet'en and Thin House of the Gilseyhu Clan
summary: Surge Copper announced a renewal of its communications and engagement agreement with the Office of the Wet’suwet’en and the Thin House of the Gilseyhu Clan for work on its Berg project territory. The agreement formalizes engagement protocols and aims to mitigate environmental and socio-economic impacts, supporting project advancement and reducing community risk for copper development.

title: Nornickel in talks with China Copper to move smelting plant to China, sources say
summary: Nornickel is in talks with China Copper to form a joint venture to move its entire copper smelting base to China, potentially producing 450,000 tonnes annually for domestic Chinese consumption. The plan follows LME restrictions on new Russian copper after April 13, and is still subject to decisions over the next few months.

title: Intrepid Metals Drills 20.20% Cu, 8.51 gpt Au and 250.00 gpt Ag (23.85% CuEq) at its Corral Copper Property in Arizona
summary: Intrepid Metals announced final drill results from its Corral Copper Property in Arizona, including multiple high-grade copper intercepts (up to 20.20% Cu) and strong copper equivalent grades. The company says results validate mineralized trends and will guide further drilling, supporting near-term optimism for potential copper development.

title: Nornickel in talks with China Copper to move smelting plant to China, sources say
summary: Nornickel is in talks with China Copper to move its full copper smelting base to China via a joint venture, with a planned capacity of about 450,000 tonnes per year. The move responds to LME rules restricting Russian copper and Western buying reluctance, likely boosting China-linked supply.

title: Azimut Resumes Drilling at Elmer and Discovers a Copper-Gold Showing by Prospecting
summary: Azimut resumed drilling at its Elmer Property in Quebec and reports a new significant copper-gold prospecting discovery (“Equinox”) with chalcopyrite and bornite. Initial grab samples returned up to 5.29% Cu and associated gold and silver, with follow-up work and soil surveys underway.

title: Exclusive-Nornickel in talks with China Copper to move smelting plant to China, sources say
summary: The piece (via the headline) reports that Nornickel is in talks with China Copper about relocating a smelting plant to China. Such smelting/refining capacity and logistics changes can shift near-term supply expectations for nickel and possibly copper, but timing and magnitude are unclear.

title: PAN GLOBAL ANNOUNCES POSITIVE ORE SORTING RESULT FOR COPPER AND TIN MINERALIZATION AT LA ROMANA PROJECT, SPAIN
summary: Pan Global reports positive x-ray transmission/electromagnetic ore-sorting tests for copper mineralization at the La Romana project in Spain. The company says sorting could remove waste material, raise mill feed grades, improve recovery and lower processing costs, helping optional processing routes. Drilling continues to delineate the deposit extent.

title: Pan Global Resources Inc.: PAN GLOBAL ANNOUNCES POSITIVE ORE SORTING RESULT FOR COPPER AND TIN MINERALIZATION AT LA ROMANA PROJECT, SPAIN
summary: Pan Global Resources announced positive ore sorting results for copper and details multi-target 2026 drilling programs at Spain’s Escacena and Cármenes projects. Escacena aims to expand copper resources at La Romana/Cañada Honda, while Cármenes targets copper-nickel-cobalt mineralization at Providencia and other prospects.

title: Class 1 Nickel Announces Filing of Technical Report on
summary: Class 1 Nickel filed an NI 43-101 Technical Report for an updated Mineral Resource Estimate at its Alexo North nickel sulphide deposit. The update cites a 63% increase in indicated tonnes and an 8% rise in nickel pounds to 42,600 tonnes at 0.92% Ni, supporting further drilling and future studies.

title: Class 1 Nickel Announces Filing of Technical Report on Alexo North Nickel Sulphide Deposit, Alexo-Dundonald Project, Timmins, Ontario
summary: Class 1 Nickel filed an NI 43-101 technical report for an updated mineral resource estimate at its Alexo North nickel sulphide deposit in Ontario. The release cites higher indicated tonnes and nickel pounds, with drilling planned to upgrade resources further. It is a resource update without immediate production changes.

title: Canada Nickel and JV partner Noble to spin out Mann project
summary: Canada Nickel will spin out its eastern exploration properties and the Mann joint venture with Noble Mineral Exploration into a new private company (ExploreCo), 80% owned by Canada Nickel and 20% by Noble. The move consolidates mining rights tied to advancing the firm’s Crawford nickel project, funded initially with $5 million.

title: Canada Nickel, Noble form subsidiary to consolidate Ontario nickel assets
summary: Canada Nickel will form a new subsidiary (ExploreCo) with Noble Mineral Exploration to consolidate Ontario nickel project interests and surface rights around the Crawford Nickel Sulphide Project. Canada Nickel will hold 80% and fund initial costs, aiming to simplify development and potentially unlock value.

title: Copper thieves in Canada causing cell disruption
summary: Copper thieves in Canada are stealing copper wire from telecom sites, disrupting cell service and prompting calls for tougher penalties and better infrastructure security. The target is copper scrap value, suggesting modest support to copper demand for scrap and potential near-term tightening of physical copper availability.

title: Canada Nickel announces creation of ExploreCo subsidiary with spin-out of eastern exploration properties and consolidation of Crawford regional land package
summary: Canada Nickel announced a LOI with Noble Mineral Exploration to create ExploreCo, consolidating eastern nickel exploration properties and surface/patent rights around the Crawford Nickel Sulphide Project. Canada Nickel will hold 80% initially, with subsequent pro rata funding. The move is expected to simplify and accelerate development, supporting nickel sentiment.

title: US Tags Aluminum, PVC as Forced Labor Enforcement Priorities
summary: The US Department of Homeland Security said it is ramping up forced-labor enforcement, naming aluminum among its priority sectors. The action ties to the Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act, which presumes Xinjiang-linked materials involve forced labor unless proven otherwise. The move may increase compliance costs and complicate sourcing, affecting aluminum supply expectations.

title: Canada Nickel Closes Previously Announced US$15 Million Loan Facility with Auramet International, Inc.
summary: Canada Nickel closed a US$15 million secured loan facility with Auramet to fund working capital for its nickel sulfide development project (Crawford). While improved financing can modestly reduce near-term project risk and support expectations for future nickel supply, the transaction size is unlikely to materially move short-term nickel prices.

title: Copper holds steady ahead of China inflation data, firm dollar weighs
summary: London copper was flat ahead of upcoming China inflation data, with a firmer U.S. dollar and demand uncertainty weighing prices. Investors also awaited China’s July 15-18 third plenum for potential stimulus. LME aluminium and nickel were largely unchanged, reflecting muted immediate directional pressure across industrial metals.

title: Norsk Hydro : Pedal to the metal – Hydro and Porsche accelerate collaboration by launching new business model for low-carbon aluminium supplies
summary: Norsk Hydro and Porsche signed a long-term agreement to supply low-carbon primary aluminium and recycled aluminium with at least 75% post-consumer scrap for Porsche’s next-generation sports cars. The deal includes capacity reservation and technical work on higher-recycled-content alloys, reinforcing demand visibility for aluminium and its low-carbon premium.

title: ASX BHP: BHP enlists OZ Minerals' Jack Dermody amid concerns about $1 billion mine expansion at Prominent Hilll copper mine
summary: BHP has hired Jack Dermody from OZ Minerals to support a leadership shake-up linked to cost and schedule hurdles for a nearly $1 billion underground expansion at its Prominent Hill copper mine in South Australia. The focus is on improving delivery of copper growth plans rather than reporting supply disruptions.

title: Salim Group set to acquire major copper mine in Australia - Companies
summary: Salim Group’s ACH Metals Australia plans to acquire Rex Minerals for AU$393 million to take control of the Hillside copper-gold project in South Australia. The deal is subject to FIRB and Rex shareholder approval, with development estimated around $576 million and resources totaling 1.9 million tonnes copper.

title: Copper Fox Announces Results of Geotechnical Investigation at Van Dyke ISCR Copper Project
summary: Copper Fox reports results of a geotechnical investigation for its Van Dyke in-situ copper recovery project in Arizona, including rock quality findings and ground-support needs to support a planned PFS decline design. The work outlines further studies required to reach feasibility but provides no immediate production or supply-impact signal.

title: Copper Fox Metals Inc.: Copper Fox Announces Results of Geotechnical Investigation at Van Dyke ISCR Copper Project
summary: Copper Fox announced results of a geotechnical investigation for its 100% owned Van Dyke in-situ copper recovery project in Arizona. The study supports a PFS decline design and suggests roadheader excavation could be viable with shotcrete and rock bolting. Additional work is still required to reach feasibility.

title: Copper slides to one-week low on China demand concerns, rising stocks
summary: Copper prices fell to a one-week low as investors worried about China’s demand amid a property crisis, weak inflation and a sliding yuan, while LME stocks rose to the highest since Oct 2021. The cash/three-month spread widened, and aluminium and nickel were also slightly lower.

title: Indonesia considers reopening bauxite exports, Bisnis.com reports
summary: Indonesia is reviewing its mid-2023 bauxite export ban after lawmakers asked for reopened shipments. The policy aimed to boost domestic processing, but limited capacity concerns have been raised by miners. A ministry spokesperson said there will be inter-ministerial coordination to reassess the ban, potentially affecting aluminium feedstock availability.

title: RI considers revoking bauxite export ban - Markets
summary: Indonesia’s energy ministry is studying a possible rollback of the bauxite export ban after lawmakers urged repeal. The government is considering limited export quotas instead, aiming to boost development of bauxite regions and increase domestic processing into alumina. A change would likely loosen bauxite/alumina tightness.

title: Churchill Resources Provides Update on the Taylor Brook Nickel Project in Newfoundland & Labrador; Announces $2.5M Private Placement
summary: Churchill Resources updated progress on its Taylor Brook nickel project, highlighting nickel/copper/cobalt soil anomalies and geophysical targeting, with drilling expected mid-August. The company also announced a $2.5M private placement to fund exploration and working capital. The news is nickel-focused but not production-related.

title: Nickel 28 Announces Proposed Normal Course Issuer Bid and Adoption of Shareholder Capital Return Policy
summary: Nickel 28 Capital Corp. announced a proposed normal course issuer bid to repurchase up to 7.15 million shares (about 7.9% of outstanding shares), funded from excess liquidity, alongside a shareholder capital return policy. The news is corporate/financial and does not cite changes in nickel production or supply.

title: First Atlantic Nickel Confirms 30 km Trend at Atlantic
summary: First Atlantic Nickel reports initial sampling confirming a significant 30 km nickel-iron alloy (awaruite) trend at its Atlantic Nickel Project in Newfoundland, with assays up to 2,800 ppm nickel and low sulfur. The company plans follow-up work and a fully funded 5,000-meter drill program, improving potential future supply outlook.

title: First Atlantic Nickel Confirms 30 km Trend at Atlantic Nickel Project and Begins 2024 Exploration Program Following Closing of ~$2.1M Strategic Lead Financing
summary: First Atlantic Nickel says initial sampling at its Atlantic Nickel Project confirmed a significant 30 km nickel trend, with assays up to 2,800 ppm nickel and low sulfur supporting awaruite. The company has closed ~$2.1M strategic financing to begin mapping, geophysics, and a 5,000 m 2024 drilling program.

title: Biden administration to tax foreign-made steel and aluminum imports routed through Mexico
summary: The Biden administration will impose tariffs under Section 232 on steel and aluminum shipments routed through Mexico but made elsewhere. Aluminum faces a 10% tariff, aimed at preventing China and other countries from evading U.S. import taxes. Tariffs begin immediately and could reduce effective near-term aluminum supply.

title: US, Mexico move to thwart China circumvention of US steel, aluminum tariffs
summary: The U.S. and Mexico will require stronger origin documentation and “melted and poured”/primary-aluminum restrictions to prevent China’s tariff circumvention for steel and aluminum shipped via Mexico into the U.S. Aluminum must not contain primary aluminum smelted or cast in specified countries, raising compliance costs and curbing imports.

title: Aluminum Imports From Mexico Must Not Contain Primary Aluminum T…
summary: The White House said aluminum imports from Mexico must not contain primary aluminum smelted or cast in China, Russia, Belarus, or Iran to avoid 10% Section 232 tariffs. The enforcement could constrain eligible volumes entering the US, tightening near-term supply expectations and supporting aluminium prices.

title: Importers Of Steel And Aluminum Products From Mexico Into U.s. M…
summary: Reuters reports that U.S. authorities require importers of steel and aluminum products from Mexico to provide country-of-origin information to avoid tariffs. While aimed at compliance, the risk of tariff exposure can increase landed costs and reduce near-term buying of aluminum products, potentially pressuring aluminium prices.

title: US, Mexico Move to Thwart China Circumvention of US Steel, Aluminum Tariffs
summary: The U.S. and Mexico announced steps to prevent China’s circumvention of U.S. steel and aluminum tariffs via Mexico. Imports from Mexico face 25% Section 232 tariffs unless products are documented as melted and poured in North America, potentially tightening supply and increasing aluminium import costs.

title: US tightens steel, aluminum import rules to curb China tariff evasion
summary: The US is tightening steel and aluminium import rules to reduce China tariff evasion. Stricter trade enforcement is expected to limit aluminium inflows subject to evasion schemes, potentially tightening US supply conditions and supporting aluminium prices in the coming days.

title: Biden targets China with new tariffs on steel and aluminum
summary: The article headline says President Biden plans new tariffs targeting China on steel and aluminium. While steel is not tracked here, aluminium tariffs can reduce import availability and lift expectations for higher U.S. aluminium prices in the coming days as buyers adjust to more costly supplies.

title: Biden announces new tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum from Mexico
summary: The Biden administration announced new U.S. tariffs targeting steel and aluminum imports from Mexico to stop China from evading prior tariffs through transshipment. The plan includes a 25% steel tariff and a 10% aluminum tariff tied to smelting/casting origins in sanctioned countries. U.S.-Mexico measures aim to keep product flows stable and limit excess capacity.

title: Biden targets China with new tariffs on foreign steel, aluminum
summary: The Biden administration announced new U.S. tariffs targeting foreign steel and aluminum imports from China. While the steel element is outside the tracked metals set, the aluminum tariffs can raise import costs and limit near-term availability in the U.S., likely supporting aluminum prices over the coming days.

title: EU Should Add Xinjiang, Aluminum to Forced Labor Database
summary: The US prioritized aluminum for forced-labor enforcement under the Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act, targeting Xinjiang-linked aluminum. The article urges the EU’s Forced Labor Regulation to list Xinjiang and the aluminum sector in its database. Such measures could restrict compliant aluminum imports from China, tightening supply expectations and supporting prices.

title: US Tightens Steel, Aluminum Import Rules To Curb China Tariff Evasion
summary: The US announced stricter steel and aluminum import rules for shipments routed via Mexico to prevent China-origin goods from evading tariffs. Steel duty-free treatment requires melting/pouring in North America; aluminum with primary smelt/cast in China and some other countries faces a 10% tariff. Officials cite reduced import loopholes.

title: Biden administration to tax foreign-made steel and aluminum imports routed through Mexico - LocalNews8.com
summary: The Biden administration will impose tariffs on steel and aluminum imports routed through Mexico that were made elsewhere, aiming to prevent China from avoiding U.S. import taxes. The announcement includes a 10% tariff on aluminum (and 25% on certain steel), which could raise U.S. prices and tighten supply expectations.

title: Biden announces new tariffs on Chinese steel, Mexican aluminum
summary: Biden announced new U.S. tariffs on Chinese steel and Mexican aluminum. Tariffs on aluminum imports typically reduce the competitiveness of imported supply, potentially tightening availability in the U.S. market and pushing aluminum prices higher over the coming days as traders adjust expectations for costs and flows.

title: Biden to tax steel and aluminum imports routed through Mexico
summary: Biden’s administration will levy new tariffs under Section 232 on aluminum shipped from Mexico but smelted or cast elsewhere: 10% on affected aluminum and 25% on certain steel. The move targets China-led evasion routes via Mexico. Tariffs begin immediately and are expected to support US aluminum pricing.

title: US tightens tariffs on Mexican steel and aluminium imports
summary: The US announced tighter rules to stop firms routing steel and aluminium shipments through Mexico to evade tariffs, requiring proof of North American origin for steel and excluding smelting in China, Russia, Belarus, or Iran for aluminium. Officials cite rising Mexican imports as evidence of bypass activity.

title: LME Returns to Court Over $12 Billion Nickel Trading Fiasco
summary: The LME is defending in court against Elliott Investment Management’s attempt to appeal a prior decision to cancel $12bn of 3M nickel futures trades on 8 March 2022 after a sharp nickel price rise and LME suspension. Earlier claims were dismissed; Elliott now seeks appeal.

title: FPX Nickel Reports Value Engineering Studies Outlining Improvements in Mineral Processing Facilities and Validating PFS Project Schedule
summary: FPX Nickel reported value engineering for its Baptiste nickel project, optimizing crushing and concentrator design, validating phased throughput in the PFS, and accelerating Phase 2 expansion to Year 6. The company says the changes improve operability and economics and de-risk a three-year construction schedule for higher nickel output.

title: Biden administration imposes new steel, aluminum tariffs
summary: The Biden administration announced new tariffs covering aluminum shipped from Mexico, targeting imports that were produced elsewhere. The move is expected to tighten near-term aluminum supply into the U.S. Separately, Powell’s comments about potential rate cuts point to easier financial conditions, generally supportive for industrial metals prices.

title: Biden Administration Imposes Tariffs On Steel And Aluminum Shipped From Mexico
summary: The Biden administration announced tariffs on steel and aluminum imports into the U.S. that are shipped through Mexico to circumvent prior duties, with Mexico-origin products exempted. It also imposed a 10% tariff on aluminum from all countries except Canada and Mexico, citing evasion by China, Iran, Russia and Belarus.

title: K92 Mining Announces Strong Q2 Production Results - Record Quarterly Copper Recoveries and Strong Gold Recoveries
summary: K92 Mining reported Q2 results at its Kainantu mine: 1,246,639 lbs of copper and record quarterly copper metallurgical recoveries (95.3%). Production was previously affected by a Papua New Guinea Form 29 temporary suspension of underground operations, but management expects stronger H2 output, reiterating guidance.

title: Pa. lawmakers praise Biden administration tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum routed via Mexico
summary: Pennsylvania lawmakers praised a Biden administration move to impose tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminium, including products routed via Mexico. By increasing the cost of Chinese aluminium entering the U.S., the policy could reduce imports and tighten availability, providing upward support for aluminium prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: US, Mexico agree to new rules on Chinese steel, aluminum imports
summary: The US, coordinated with Mexico, announced stricter rules on steel and aluminium imports to close a loophole allowing Chinese-made goods to enter duty-free via Mexico. Officials said the changes stop circumvention of US tariffs. Reduced China-linked aluminium supply expectations are supportive for aluminium prices in the coming weeks.

title: Elementos tin and copper exploration breakthroughs
summary: Elementos (ELT) says drilling at its Tasmanian Cleveland project intersected high-grade tin and copper, including 3.8% copper over ~350m depth and a higher-grade interval near 8% copper. Management links current tin strength to feasibility optimism and outlines further drilling/geophysics, supporting bullish sentiment for copper-linked upside.

title: Rudi's View: Gold, Healthcare, Staples & Copper
summary: Market commentary highlights broker preferences for copper and aluminium. It notes optimism for copper and that Petra Capital upgraded near-term copper (and zinc) forecasts, while UBS favors copper and aluminium alongside gold and met coal. Overall guidance is tilted supportive for metals sentiment, but lacks direct supply or demand shocks.

title: Copper wire thieves knock out phone and internet services for hundreds of customers
summary: Ziply Fiber reported that copper wire thieves cut telecom cables overnight in Kirkland and near Redmond, knocking out phone, internet, and some 911 service for about 390 customers total. Repairs could take up to 48 hours, and the company says copper theft is increasing locally, costing it substantial repair expenses.

title: Indonesia considers easing bauxite export ban
summary: Indonesia’s Ministry is considering resuming bauxite ore exports, potentially replacing the current full ban with export quotas. The shift aims to balance economic development and processing capacity, as domestic smelters cannot yet handle full output. Increased bauxite availability would likely ease alumina/primary aluminium tightness expectations.

title: Elementos finds new mineralised zone with tin and copper strike | The Advocate
summary: Elementos Limited says drilling at its Cleveland Project intersected high-grade copper (and tin) in a newly identified mineralised zone, with a second hole showing similar but lower grades. Management suggests potential discovery separate from existing resources and plans follow-up targeting copper, tin, silver and gold.

title: US tightens aluminium, steel import rules - World
summary: The US tightened import rules for steel and aluminium from Mexico to prevent China-origin goods evading tariffs. Aluminium consignments containing primary aluminium smelted or cast in China, Belarus, Iran or Russia face a 10% tariff. The change closes a Mexico transit loophole and supports higher aluminium prices.

title: Copper rises on China stimulus hopes, higher inventories cap gains
summary: Copper prices edged higher on hopes for additional China economic stimulus, supported by a softer dollar. However, LME copper inventories rose to the highest since 2021 and the cash/3-month spread widened, signaling abundant near-term supply and limiting upside. Nickel inventories also climbed; aluminium rose modestly.

title: BHP to temporarily suspend western Australia nickel operations
summary: BHP said it will temporarily suspend its Nickel West operations and West Musgrave project in Western Australia from October due to a global nickel oversupply and sharply lower prices. The miner will review by February 2027 and may restart with roughly $300 million annual investment during the transition period.

title: Power One Resources Corp.: Power One Commences Drilling at Its Pecors, Nickel-Copper-PGM-Uranium Project in Elliot Lake, Ontario
summary: Power One Resources announced drilling resumption at its Pecors Property targeting Ni-Cu-PGM mineralization and uranium. The company cites historical uranium intersections and a 2015 drill hole with Cu and Ni grades over 12m. The news starts a planned 1,000–1,400m program but does not change metal supply or demand immediately.

title: Power One Resources Corp.: Power One Commences Drilling at Its Pecors, Nickel-Copper-PGM-Uranium Project in Elliot Lake, Ontario
summary: Power One Resources announced drilling has resumed at its Pecors Property in Ontario, targeting Ni-Cu-PGM mineralization and uranium. The program is exploratory (up to four holes, ~1,000–1,400 m planned) and follows prior delays. No near-term production, trade, or supply disruptions for copper or nickel were stated.

title: BHP to Suspend Australian Nickel Operations Amid Market Slump
summary: BHP said it will suspend its Australian Nickel West mining and processing operations and the West Musgrave project starting in October, citing a sharp fall in nickel prices and expectations of a continuing global glut. The company will review the shutdown later, while near-term sentiment for nickel remains bearish.

title: BHP to suspend Western Australia nickel operations
summary: BHP will suspend its Western Australia nickel operations from October, including the Kwinana refinery and Kalgoorlie smelter, citing global oversupply and weak nickel prices. The move follows nickel price weakness amid Indonesia-led supply growth and ongoing shifts away from some nickel battery chemistries, with care and maintenance planned.

title: Australian nickel: Thousands of jobs at risk as BHP moves to shut down operations
summary: BHP announced it will temporarily suspend WA nickel mining and processing from October 2024, affecting thousands, citing global nickel oversupply and falling prices after a surge of cheaper Indonesian supply. The government criticized the move, but supply disruption prospects could modestly support nickel prices near term.

title: BHP to Suspend Australian Nickel Operations Amid Glut of EV Metal -- Update
summary: BHP said it will suspend its Australian Nickel West nickel mining and processing operations, including the West Musgrave project, in October due to a global nickel glut and oversupply pressures. The firm expects further impairments and plans restart spending, but the decision underscores bearish supply-demand sentiment for nickel.

title: BHP to suspend nickel operations in Australia as price falls
summary: BHP said it will temporarily suspend its Nickel West operations and West Musgrave project in Western Australia from October because nickel prices are depressed amid global oversupply. The company expects a further non-cash impairment charge and will invest during the transition to potentially restart later.

title: WA Nickel to temporarily suspend operations | Company Announcement
summary: BHP announced it will temporarily suspend Nickel West operations and related assets in Western Australia from October 2024, citing persistent global nickel oversupply and lower prices. The suspension includes mining, refining and smelting activities, with a potential restart reviewed later. The move should tighten near-term nickel supply expectations.

title: BHP : commits to ongoing support for the WA nickel industry
summary: BHP says it will temporarily suspend its Western Australian nickel operations because global oversupply has made production uneconomic. The company expects to restart if market conditions improve and will still invest to support potential re-starts, alongside policy advocacy for nickel. The move implies reduced near-term nickel supply.

title: BHP temporarily suspends Western Australia Nickel due to global oversupply
summary: BHP will temporarily suspend Nickel West operations and related Kwinana refinery and smelter activity in Western Australia from October, citing global nickel oversupply and falling forward nickel prices. The company aims to review the suspension by February 2027, with care-and-maintenance during downtime and potential restart support.

title: BHP ASX: BHP shuts down nickel business, arresting losses
summary: BHP will suspend its nickel mining operations in Western Australia after massive losses and a forecast full-year nickel loss of about $450 million. The company cites global nickel oversupply driven by Chinese-backed Indonesian producers, potentially signaling reduced supply and supporting near-term nickel sentiment.

title: BHP suspending WA nickel operations amid global glut
summary: BHP will suspend its Nickel West operations and the West Musgrave project from October because of a global nickel glut and sharply lower prices. The move affects the Kwinana refinery, Kalgoorlie smelter and WA mines. The article cites falling nickel prices and expects ongoing financial pressure.

title: BHP to close Nickel West mines until 2027, blaming global oversupply of nickel
summary: BHP will suspend operations at its WA Nickel West assets—including the Kwinana nickel refinery, Kalgoorlie smelter, and mines at Mt Keith and Leinster—from October until at least 2027. The company cites global nickel oversupply and cites falling future prices, implying a supply reduction that can support nickel sentiment near term.

title: Copper slips as rising stocks highlight poor demand prospects
summary: Copper prices fell as rising LME warehouse inventories and weak demand expectations—especially from China—curbed hopes for stimulus-led recovery. The cash/3-month spread widened, signaling supply comfort. Nickel also faced pressure from doubling LME stocks, though aluminium increased slightly.

title: BHP shuts down Nickel West
summary: BHP announced it is shutting down its Nickel West operations, risking more than 3,000 jobs. The company attributes the decision to the global crash in nickel prices. The shutdown implies reduced near-term nickel supply, which may provide price support within coming weeks.

title: Chile copper miner Codelco struggles to lift output off 25-year low hit in 2023
summary: Reuters reports Codelco’s copper output remains below target after a 25-year low in 2023, with 2024 still expected to be lower than 2023. Mine delays and accidents (e.g., Radomiro Tomic) constrain production, while improvements and project ramp-ups may not be fast enough to reverse the decline this year.

title: A.I. Helped to Spot a Copper Mining Bonanza in Zambia
summary: KoBold Metals, using AI-based exploration, says it has likely found Zambia’s largest copper discovery in over a decade. Estimates reviewed by third parties suggest production of at least 300,000 tons of copper per year once fully operational, with additional high-grade ore potentially still unmapped. The find is geopolitically significant for clean-tech supply.

title: Amman eyes imported copper concentrates for processing - Companies
summary: AMNT, operator of Indonesia’s Batu Hijau copper-gold mine, says it may import copper concentrate or process concentrate from other local miners to meet its downstream mandate, particularly if its own production faces disruptions. The smelter under construction can process large volumes, but timing and volumes remain conditional.

title: Analysis-Chile copper miner Codelco struggles to lift output off 25-year low hit in 2023
summary: The article says Chile’s state miner Codelco is finding it difficult to raise production after hitting a 25-year low in 2023. With Codelco a key source of global copper supply, weaker output prospects can tighten short-term supply expectations and support copper prices.

title: BHP to Suspend Australian Nickel Operations Amid Glut of EV Metal -- 2nd Update
summary: BHP says it will mothball its Australian Nickel West nickel mines and refinery in October, citing unprofitability amid a global nickel glut linked to cheaper Indonesian supply. The suspension could last years and reduce Western output, potentially supporting nickel prices, even as BHP records further losses/impairments.

title: President Biden announces tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum routed through Mexico
summary: Biden announced tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum and on Mexican metals partially made in China, including a 10% tariff on Mexican aluminum containing metal smelted or cast outside North America. The measure targets “tariff evasion” through Mexico and follows earlier higher tariffs on Chinese steel.

title: BHP to suspend Western Australia nickel operations amid global glut-Xinhua
