title: Indonesia optimistic about nickel price stability
summary: Indonesia’s deputy minister said nickel prices should remain stable near current levels as additional capacity from new plants offsets rising EV-driven demand. He noted ore supply risks from declining nickel content and potential policy tweaks to nickel tax holidays amid the 15% global minimum corporate tax regime. Overall, near-term pressure appears mixed.

title: Update on the Luansobe Copper Project  | Company Announcement
summary: Galileo Resources updated on the Luansobe copper project in Zambia. A mining schedule and pit optimisations were completed, with scenarios using 0.25% and 0.5% Cu cut-offs yielding ~70,000t and ~40,000t of projected open-pit copper, plus prospects for additional shallow and deeper underground resources. Permitting and funding remain key constraints.

title: Galileo Resources plc Provides Update on the Luansobe Copper Project, Zambia
summary: Galileo Resources updated shareholders on development progress for the Luansobe copper project in Zambia, including granted small-scale mining licence and mine-design work. The company discussed open-pit optimization scenarios yielding about 40,000–70,000 tonnes of projected copper, but production remains dependent on permits and funding.

title: Armenia sees 14.5% rise in copper concentrate production in January-July 2024
summary: Armenia’s copper concentrate production rose 14.5% in January–July 2024 to 172,937.4 tons, per the National Statistical Committee. The report also notes zinc output up, while molybdenum concentrate and ferromolybdenum production fell. The copper increase suggests greater supply that could weigh on copper prices.

title: S.Africa's ARM pivots to chrome and copper after platinum price slump
summary: ARM says weaker platinum group metals and coal prices cut its annual profit, prompting a pivot toward chrome and copper. It approved a chrome recovery plant at Bokoni and acquired a 15% stake in Surge Copper. South African miners also eye copper assets, but timing to production is long-dated.

title: Camino Minerals Corp: Camino and Nittetsu Extend Again by One Additional Week Exclusive Rights to Negotiate Copper Mine Acquisition in Chile
summary: Camino Minerals and Nittetsu extended their exclusive negotiating rights by one week to finalize documentation for the proposed acquisition of Chile’s Puquios project, a construction-ready copper mine. The deal remains conditional on approvals and deal completion by Sept. 14, leaving some uncertainty on timing.

title: Canada Nickel Announces Receipt of Letter of Interest for up to US$500 million from Export Development Canada
summary: Canada Nickel said it received a Letter of Interest from Export Development Canada for up to US$500 million of long-term debt financing to support the Crawford Nickel Sulphide Project in Ontario. The funding is subject to due diligence and permits, but the milestone improves prospects for future nickel supply.

title: Canada Nickel says Export Development Canada plans to give $500 million loan for mine
summary: Canada Nickel said Export Development Canada is considering a loan of up to $500 million for the Crawford project in Ontario and that the company is seeking remaining funding and permits for construction. It also plans a nickel-processing plant in Ontario to process about 80,000 tonnes annually, supporting nickel supply expectations.

title: The copper supply gap in Australia and beyond
summary: The piece argues global copper demand is rising from electrification and energy transition while supply faces constraints: declining ore grades, labor disruptions, fewer high-quality projects, and a large projected deficit by 2030. It details BHP’s expansion in South Australia (including refining) but says uncertainty remains about fully closing the gap.

title: China launches WTO complaint against Canada over EV, aluminum and steel tariffs
summary: China filed a WTO complaint against Canada over Canadian tariffs on Chinese EVs plus 25% tariffs on steel and aluminium. Canada’s measures take effect next month and are aimed at unfair pricing and environmental/labour standards. China signals retaliation risk, adding near-term uncertainty for industrial demand.

title: Law enforcement commended for R20 million copper recovery
summary: KwaZulu-Natal officials praised law enforcement for arresting a suspect linked to theft of copper worth over R20 million. The recovered copper was found in a scrapyard near Durban. Officials said stolen metals are sold to scrapyards, harming municipalities’ infrastructure, and urged community reporting to combat copper theft.

title: China launches WTO complaint against Canada over EV, aluminum and steel tariffs | iNFOnews
summary: China has filed a WTO complaint against Canada over Canada’s new tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles and 25% tariffs on steel and aluminum, with Canada’s measures set to start next month. Analysts warn retaliation could raise costs and pressure markets, adding near-term uncertainty for aluminum supply and prices.

title: Harmony Gold aims for production from Eva copper mine by 2028
summary: Harmony Gold plans to begin copper production from its Eva mine in Queensland by 2028, after a two-year build and a final investment decision by end of the year, contingent on a Queensland grant. The project is expected to produce up to 60,000 tpa, but near-term copper supply impact is limited.

title: Miningnewsbreaks  Canada Nickel Company Inc. (TSX.V: CNC) (OTCQX: CNIKF) Secures LOI For Up To US$500M From Export Development Canada
summary: Canada Nickel said it received an LOI for up to US$500M in financing support from Export Development Canada to fund its Crawford nickel-sulphide project, alongside expectations of qualifying for additional critical minerals and carbon capture tax credits. The company aims to secure remaining project funding and begin construction after permits.

title: Fairfax India to Acquire 65% of Global Aluminium Private Limited
summary: Fairfax India will invest about $83 million for a 65% stake in Hyderabad-based Global Aluminium, a major Indian aluminium extrusions producer with anodized and powder-coated product capabilities. The transaction is expected to close in Q4 2024 and may modestly influence near-term aluminium-related demand, but no major market supply effects are specified.

title: Canada to Raise Tariffs and Limit Subsidies for Clean Vehicles, Steel, and Aluminum from China | White & Case LLP
summary: Canada announced new tariffs and subsidy limits targeting Chinese imports, including a 100% tariff on Chinese-made clean vehicles and a proposed 25% surtax on specific Chinese steel and aluminium products, provisionally effective mid-October. Tariff escalation and possible future measures were flagged, with potential spillovers to broader metal-linked supply chains.

title: China takes complaint to WTO against Canada over EV, aluminum and steel tariffs
summary: China filed a WTO consultation request against Canada over Ottawa’s late-August tariffs on Chinese-made electric vehicles and on imported steel and aluminium. Canada imposed a 25% tariff on steel and aluminium. Beijing argues the measures violate WTO rules, but trade friction can depress aluminium trade and near-term pricing sentiment.

title: Copper thieves cause $52,000 in damages
summary: Police arrested suspects for stealing copper utility/AT&T communications lines near St. Gabriel, Louisiana, with reported ~$52,000 in damages. Investigators say the thieves stripped plastic, melted copper, and sold it to a recycling center. AT&T reports service is operating normally and is working with law enforcement; copper theft cases may be broader.

title: Tanzania pushes for Kabanga Nickel project
summary: Tanzania’s minerals minister meets BHP officials to support reopening African mining via the Kabanga nickel project under Tembo Nickel. The government backs the investment climate and reports progress. Financing includes mining and a multi-metal refinery using hydrometallurgy, targeting first production in 2025.

title: EU approves Baosteel-Baowu Aluminium-Kobelco joint venture-Xinhua
summary: The European Commission approved an EU merger-regulation filing for a joint venture involving Baosteel, Baowu Aluminum, and Kobelco. The venture will primarily produce automotive aluminium sheets for Chinese automakers at plants in Tianjin and Henan. The Commission found limited EEA competition impact and no major concerns.

title: KTYC launching pilot program to deter copper thefts using solar-powered lights
summary: Kentucky Transportation Cabinet will run a pilot to deter copper wire theft by replacing traditional wired highway lighting on selected I-64 and I-264 ramp locations with solar-powered lights. The program is funded by a $200,000 federal grant and is expected to take four days. It targets reduced copper re-wiring costs.

title: 【SMM Analysis】The price trends of nickel, cobalt, and lithium have diverged, and the procurement volume of ternary and LFP is gradually differentiating
summary: SMM reports China’s lithium battery scrap recycling volumes fell slightly in August, but nickel-cobalt markets diverged. Nickel sulphate prices rebounded modestly after a long decline due to low inventories, boosting demand from hydrometallurgical producers to extract nickel and cobalt from black mass and supporting scrap purchases.

title: Tragic Incident at Chhattisgarh Alumina Refinery: Three Workers Dead, One Injured
summary: Three workers died and one was injured when a coal-filled hopper collapsed at the Maa Kudargarhi alumina refinery in Surguja, Chhattisgarh, on Sunday. Authorities launched rescue efforts and recovered three bodies so far, while one worker remains missing. The incident may disrupt alumina operations feeding aluminium production.

title: Environment solution: New metals refinery for nickel and cobalt opens in Ohio | News, Sports, Jobs
summary: A new refinery focused on nickel (and cobalt) has opened in Ohio. Additional refining capacity can ease expectations about nickel availability and processing capacity in the near term, which often puts downward pressure on nickel prices as markets adjust to improved supply prospects.

title: The stainless steel peak season is not performing well, and the price of nickel pig iron is facing downward pressure
summary: Prices for high-nickel pig iron declined week-on-week, with both domestic (SMM) and Indonesian (NPI FOB) benchmarks weaker and transaction prices starting to soften. Stainless steel spot weakness and macro data below expectations pressured nickel prices (LME/SHFE) and narrowed pig iron–to–electrolytic nickel discounts, keeping nickel bearish near term.

title: "Mafic intrusive units are super rare": Terrain Minerals (ASX:TMX) talks nickel, gallium and gold
summary: Terrain Minerals says a recent airborne VTEM survey identified five bedrock sulphide conductors, including two within its “eye” target in a mafic/ultramafic intrusive setting, a geological style associated with nickel/copper deposits. It frames this as underexplored and potentially economic, though no drilling results are yet provided.

title: Rethinking batteries - with aluminium
summary: A research team developed a prototype aluminium-polymer battery using aluminium foil as the anode and a solid polymer electrolyte based on ionic liquid. Funded further for scale-up and roll-to-roll production testing through 2025, it targets stationary storage for small PV systems, implying potential longer-term aluminium demand.

title: Ducab increases its aluminium capacity
summary: Ducab Metals Business (DMB) plans to double annual aluminium capacity from 55,000tpa to 110,000tpa at KEZAD and expand bare copper output. The company frames the move as supporting growing global demand and UAE industrial strategy, including green aluminium initiatives. It signals incremental supply expansion for aluminium and copper.

title: Copper weakness deepens, adding pressure on Aussie
summary: Spot copper prices fell last week and the downtrend since May is set to deepen. Goldman cut its 2025 copper forecast by nearly a third, citing weaker-than-expected China demand and a less constructive commodities view. Technical resistance supports further declines, weighing on copper-linked AUD.

title: August saw a higher-than-expected increase in the operating rate of copper cathode rods in China. Can the traditional peak season in September continue to meet optimistic expectations? [SMM Analysis]
summary: SMM survey shows China’s copper cathode rod operating rate rose to 74.62% in August, above expectations, and is forecast to rise to 75.86% in September. The report links stronger downstream orders to recent copper price declines below 72,000 yuan/mt and suggests improved production and sales into early September.

title: China Seeks Feedback on Plan to Expand National Carbon Emissions Trading System to Cement, Steel, and Primary Aluminium Industries
summary: China’s Ministry of Ecology and Environment is consulting on expanding the national ETS to cover primary aluminium (plus cement and steel). The plan adds firms above a CO2e threshold, uses free allowance allocations initially, and increases trading/compliance pressure over time, likely raising costs for aluminium producers.

title: Falcon Gold Corp.: Falcon Mobilizes Drill Crews At Great Burnt Copper Project In Central Newfoundland
summary: Falcon Gold mobilizes drill crews to begin an inaugural drilling campaign at its Great Burnt Copper Project in Newfoundland after prior access delays. The release cites high-grade prior copper drilling, outlines testing of geophysical targets, and notes ongoing permitting for additional drilling.

title: China plans to include steel, cement and aluminium in its carbon market in 2024
summary: China is consulting on adding aluminium (along with steel and cement) to its national emissions trading scheme by end-2023. The ETS would expand in stages from 2024–2026 with free initial allowances and quota reductions from 2027. EU carbon tariffs also pressure Chinese decarbonisation of heavy industries.

title: Premiums for low-carbon aluminium necessary to increase green awareness: CBA CEO
summary: CBA’s CEO says green aluminium currently cannot command higher premiums, though volume benefits exist. Fastmarkets’ low-carbon aluminium differentials for Europe/US have been assessed near zero, with recent declines. CBA plans process upgrades and emphasizes value-added product sales, potentially affecting low-carbon ingot supply in the short term.

title: Copper demand drivers, supply challenges and market outlook with Kathleen Quirk, Freeport-McMoRan
summary: Fastmarkets’ podcast transcript with Freeport-McMoRan CEO Kathleen Quirk highlights copper’s demand growth from decarbonization, renewables and EVs, with China still driving over half of global consumption. It also notes dwindling new viable projects and inventory buildup, suggesting a supportive near-term market outlook.

title: Falcon Gold Corp. Mobilizes Drill Crews at Great Burnt Copper Project in Central Newfoundland
summary: Falcon Gold says drill crews and equipment are being mobilized to its Great Burnt Copper Project in Newfoundland after spring access delays from high water. The firm completed 3 km of road. The property hosts reported copper-rich zones, with prior results from neighboring drilling indicating strong copper grades.

title: Nevada Copper Provides Update on Sale Process; Kinterra Designated Successful Bidder
summary: Nevada Copper updated its Chapter 11 sale process and designated Southwest Critical Minerals LLC, an affiliate of Kinterra Capital, as the successful bidder. The company expects court approvals and a potential October closing. It owns the Pumpkin Hollow copper project, but the release doesn’t specify near-term production impacts.

title: Anglo American hired advisers to sell two nickel mines in Brazil, says country head
summary: Anglo American has hired financial advisers to sell two nickel mines in Brazil (Barro Alto and Niquelandia in Goiás), producing about 38,000 tons of nickel annually. The country head says discussions with potential buyers are ongoing but no deal is expected this year, implying limited immediate supply-market disruption.

title: Potential copper mine in Mammoth raising concerns for some residents
summary: Residents in Mammoth, Arizona debate whether exploration for a proposed copper mine on Copper Creek could threaten landscape and groundwater. Faraday Copper says it is in early exploration and expects BLM approvals, with no mining soon. Existing nearby mines and past smelting impacts shape local views.

title: Battery Mineral Resources Corp.: Battery Mineral Resources Announces Third Shipment of Copper Concentrates Produced at Its Mineral Processing Facility at Punitaqui, Chile
summary: Battery Mineral Resources announced its third shipment of copper concentrates from its Punitaqui, Chile processing facility, shipping 1,198 DMT in August (847 DMT from its own mine and 351 DMT to Anglo’s Chagres smelter). It also describes a sulphide mill feed purchase agreement to support ramp-up production.

title: Gov. Andy Beshear attends groundbreaking for aluminum facility in Logan County
summary: Kentucky Aluminum Processors broke ground on a $40 million aluminum recycling and processing facility in Russellville. The plant, a joint venture involving Tri-Arrows Aluminum and Tennessee Aluminum Processors, will process post-industrial and post-consumer scrap for later melt and casting. Officials cite jobs and improved recycled-content output, supporting aluminum activity.

title: Power Nickel Summer Drilling Program Expands The High Grade Polymetallic Lion Zone By 50%
summary: Power Nickel said its summer drilling at the Lion Zone discovery intercepted sulphides and expanded the mineralized footprint, including massive/semi-massive chalcopyrite, with the high-grade portion extending west and deeper. The company expects assays later in September and plans a larger winter drill program, but no production changes are announced.

title: Anax and Artemis partner on copper processing in Pilbara
summary: Anax Metals and Artemis Resources sign an MoU to jointly evaluate processing Artemis’ Greater Carlow copper resource at Anax’s Whim Creek Processing hub in WA. The hub could add a 400,000 tpa concentrator and refurbish heap leach capacity, but the work remains subject to studies, approvals, and future agreements.

title: Vortex Metals Begins Phase One Drilling on Illapel Copper Project
summary: Vortex Metals announced it has started Phase One drilling on its Illapel copper project. The update is focused on exploration progress rather than production, but it can support near-term sentiment around potential future copper supply, offering mild bullish pressure to copper expectations over coming weeks.

title: Copper Slips on Weak China Data
summary: Copper prices fell in London after weak China data increased worries about near-term demand. Three-month LME copper eased 0.1% to about $9,090/mt, after earlier gains. The decline was partly countered by support from a potential drop in stockpiles.

title: PAN GLOBAL INTERSECTS 1.14% COPPER OVER 18 METERS, EXPANDING NEAR-SURFACE MINERALIZATION AT LA ROMANA, SOUTHERN SPAIN
summary: Pan Global Resources reported additional drill results from the La Romana Cu-Sn-Ag discovery in Spain, including 1.14% copper over 18m and higher-grade intervals such as 3.33% copper over 5m. The company says mineralization continuity in the western extension is confirmed and remains open, supporting bullish sentiment for copper.

title: Passage of new mining lease to increase bauxite production - GIADEC
summary: Ghana’s parliament has ratified a mining lease allowing the Ghana Bauxite Company to mine bauxite at Awaso. GIADEC expects the lease to increase bauxite production and supports plans for improved mining and potential refining to build an integrated aluminum industry, boosting near-term aluminium supply expectations.

title: Nth Cycle Begins Operations of First Domestic Commercial-Scale Nickel and Cobalt Scrap Refining System in Fairfield, Ohio
summary: Nth Cycle began operations of its first U.S. commercial-scale nickel/cobalt scrap refining system in Fairfield, Ohio, using electro-extraction to produce nickel cobalt MHP. The modular plant can process up to 3,100 tonnes of scrap and target 900 tonnes of MHP annually, aiming to reduce reliance on China.

title: Copper-Nickel Focused Exploration Advancing at Sant Tolgoi
summary: Xanadu Mines reports continued field work at its Sant Tolgoi copper-nickel exploration project in western Mongolia. Detailed mapping, geochemical sampling, and geophysical modelling are underway, with multiple shallow Cu-Ni sulphide targets identified and early geochemical/geophysical results expected in Q4 2024. No production or supply disruption is mentioned.

title: Vortex Metals Inc. Begins Phase One Drilling on Illapel Copper Project
summary: Vortex Metals began a 3,000-meter Phase 1 drilling program at its Illapel Copper Project in Chile, targeting continuity of Cu-Ag mineralization near the Rio 27 mine. Drilling and sampling are aimed at defining high-priority targets, while the Rio 27 mine remains fully operational.

title: Copper-Nickel Focused Exploration Advancing at Sant Tolgoi Project
summary: Xanadu Mines reports field progress at the Sant Tolgoi copper-nickel exploration project in Mongolia, including geological mapping, geochemical sampling, and geophysical modelling, with multiple shallow Cu-Ni sulphide targets identified. Early geochemical/geophysical results are expected in Q4 2024, but no production or resource changes are announced.

title: Koryx Copper Announces Updated Mineral Resource for the Company's Flagship Haib Copper Development Project in Namibia
summary: Koryx Copper updated the mineral resource estimate for its Haib copper project in Namibia after receiving results from a 2024 drilling program. The resource modeling shows an overall 13–14% grade increase, with cut-off at 0.25% Cu, and plans for a follow-on upsized drill campaign to extend higher-grade zones.

title: Comex Copper Settles 1.08% Lower at $4.0405 — Data Talk
summary: Comex copper futures settled 1.08% lower at $4.0405, reflecting bearish near-term price momentum for copper. The move suggests market participants reduced pricing for copper over the session, consistent with short-term negative pressure rather than a neutral or bullish shift.

title: Horizon Copper Strengthens Financing Capacity with $30 Million Revolving Credit Facility Plus $20 Million Accordion Feature
summary: Horizon Copper announced a US$30 million revolving credit facility with an additional uncommitted US$20 million accordion, totaling up to US$50 million. The company plans to use proceeds for Hod Maden project development, future asset acquisitions and corporate purposes, supporting confidence in its copper project investment plans.

title: Canada Nickel Demonstrates Potential of Timmins Nickel District with Positive Exploration Results from Seven Regional Targets
summary: Canada Nickel announced positive drilling results from 48 holes across seven properties in the Timmins Nickel District, reporting multiple nickel intercepts including higher-grade sections (e.g., up to 2.68% nickel over 6.5 metres). The company is progressing toward publishing additional resources by mid-2025, which is supportive but not immediate supply-changing news.

title: Is Copper A Winning or Losing Bet Right Now?
summary: Copper prices recently fell below $9,000/t after weakening sentiment. The drop is linked to soft U.S. and China data, a sizable LME inventory build, and analyst downgrades including Goldman and BHP cutting China demand forecasts. Longer-term electrification demand remains supportive but is not the near-term driver.

title: Nth Cycle Begins Operations Of First Domestic Commercial-Scale Nickel And Cobalt Scrap Refining System In Fairfield, Ohio
summary: Nth Cycle began operations of its Oyster system in Fairfield, Ohio, a commercial-scale plant to refine nickel scrap (black-mass) and produce nickel-cobalt MHP. The start of domestic recycling/refining capacity aims to reduce U.S. reliance on China and improve sourcing compliance. This is generally supportive for nearby nickel market sentiment.

title: China proposes expanding carbon trading market to cement, steel, aluminum industries
summary: China proposed expanding its national carbon trading market to cover cement, steel, and electrolytic aluminum. The ministry says these sectors are ready to join this year, extending coverage to about 60% of emissions. Inclusion into carbon compliance frameworks may lift costs for electrolytic aluminum producers, supporting aluminium pricing near term.

title: Kentucky Aluminum Processors Plans Russellville, Kentucky, Operations
summary: Kentucky Aluminum Processors plans a new aluminum recycling facility in Russellville, Kentucky, to process dross and scrap from nearby Logan Aluminum’s casting operations. The state preliminarily approved incentives and tax breaks to encourage investment and jobs. The project expands secondary aluminum recycling capacity in the region.

title: MEED | Ducab set to double aluminium production capacity
summary: Ducab Metals Business, a UAE subsidiary of Ducab Group, will double its aluminium product capacity from 55,000 to 110,000 tonnes per year by building a new plant at Kezad near EGA’s smelter. The facility is expected to commission by year-end and start producing in 2025, targeting rising domestic and export demand.

title: Energy Capital & Power  / Press release | Critical Minerals Africa (CMA) to Showcase African Copper Prospects Amidst Growing Global Supply Shortage
summary: Energy Capital & Power’s press release promotes African copper projects amid a projected global supply gap. It cites commissioning of Kamoa-Kakula Phase 3, restarts at Kipushi and Mopani, and expansion plans by CMOC and Glencore, framing Africa as a key source of future copper supply for the energy transition.

title: Vedanta urges India to negotiate end to nickel sulphate duties with Japan and South Korea
summary: Vedanta urges India to renegotiate CEPAs with Japan and South Korea to remove import duties on nickel sulphate used in EV batteries. Nickel sulphate shipments currently face 3.9% (Japan) and 5% (South Korea) taxes. Easing tariffs could boost India’s export demand for nickel sulphate.

title: CopperCorp Resources Inc.: CopperCorp Commences Drilling at Jukes Cu-Au Prospect
summary: CopperCorp Resources began an initial 2-hole, 400m diamond drilling program at the Jukes Cu-Au prospect on its Razorback property in Tasmania. The company will test depth extensions to historically sampled high-grade copper-gold mineralization, with assay results expected over the next month.

title: Critical Minerals Africa (CMA) to Showcase African Copper Prospects Amidst Growing Global Supply Shortage CMA 2024 will promote African copper projects driving the stability of the global supply chain
summary: Critical Minerals Africa (CMA) 2024 will spotlight African copper projects amid a projected global supply gap. The article cites copper output boosts from DRC initiatives (Kamoa-Kakula Phase 3, Kipushi restart, Tenke Fungurume expansion) and Zambia plans including Mopani production resumption, supporting bullish copper sentiment.

title: Alta Copper Corp.: Alta Copper Announces Non-Brokered Financing With Fortescue Ltd.
summary: Alta Copper announced a C$2.5m non-brokered private placement with Fortescue’s unit Nascent Exploration to fund working capital and advance its 100% owned Cañariaco copper project in Peru. Proceeds support drilling permit work and community engagement. It does not signal near-term supply changes, outages, or disruptions.

title: Copper output from Chile's Codelco slides nearly 11% in July
summary: Cochilco said Chile’s Codelco copper output fell 10.7% year on year in July to 111,400 tons, underscoring ongoing efforts to halt production declines. Codelco aims for August output above 115,000 tons. Escondida rose 29% while Collahuasi fell 6% in July.

title: LME inventories of copper, nickel, zinc rise in August
summary: LME data show copper stocks up 29% in August and nickel open-tonnage stocks up 6.7%, with China-origin both rising. Aluminium stocks were broadly unchanged, with on-warrant volumes slightly higher. Rising inventories point to reduced prompt tightness, weighing on short-term base metal prices despite some copper inflow trend softening.

title: LME inventories of copper, nickel, zinc rise in August
summary: LME data show copper warehouse stocks up 29% in August and nickel open-tonnage stocks up 6.7%, with China-origin volumes rising. Copper cancellations increased as China import premiums improved. Aluminium stocks were broadly steady though. Overall, higher inventories suggest reduced near-term supply tightness, bearish for copper and nickel.

title: China, US nickel premiums remain flat amid quiet market; European briquette premium fall
summary: Fastmarkets reports nickel premiums in Europe and China largely unchanged week-on-week, even as LME three-month nickel slipped below $16,000/tonne. European briquette premiums narrowed on lower freight costs and ample availability, while cathode premiums stayed stable amid quiet demand from electroplating and muted import conditions.

title: Nickel outlook still bullish in North America despite slow EV growth, Electra says
summary: Electra Battery Materials says North America’s EV growth will remain strong and will increasingly favor nickel-bearing battery chemistries, with “high nickel” expected to dominate. It highlights potential Indonesian exports of MHP for nickel sulfate production and related refinery plans, though some delegates flag investment uncertainty from higher rates.

title: Putin says Russia should consider restricting exports of uranium, titanium and nickel
summary: Putin said Russia should consider limiting exports of uranium, titanium and nickel in retaliation against the West. The article highlights Russia’s role as the world’s largest producer of refined nickel through Nornickel, implying potential supply disruption that could weigh on nickel prices in coming weeks.

title: Power One Resources Corp.: Power One Completes Drilling On Its Flagship Asset - the Pecors Nickel-Copper-PGM Project Located In Eliott Lake, Ontario
summary: Power One Resources completed three diamond drill holes (1,300m) at its Pecors Ni-Cu-PGM project near Elliot Lake, Ontario, with assays pending. The company targets magnetic anomalies interpreted to host magmatic Ni-Cu-PGM and references historical Cu and Ni intercepts over 12m, but provides no new confirmed results.

title: Power One Resources Corp. Completes Drilling On Its Flagship Asset - the Pecors Nickel-Copper-PGM Project Located In Eliott Lake, Ontario
summary: Power One Resources completed three diamond drill holes (1,300m) at its Pecors Ni-Cu-PGM project in Elliot Lake, Ontario. The company did not provide assay results yet, and drilling targets include EM conductors and magnetic anomalies. A historical uranium estimate is described as non-NI 43-101 compliant.

title: Power One Resources Corp. Completes Drilling On Its Flagship Asset - the Pecors Nickel-Copper-PGM Project Located In Eliott Lake, Ontario
summary: Power One Resources announced completion of three diamond drill holes at its Pecors Ni-Cu-PGM project in Elliot Lake, Ontario. Assays are pending and targets focus on geophysics tied to potential magmatic-hosted nickel-copper mineralization. No resource update, production, or supply disruption is reported.

title: Indigenous group asks US Supreme Court to block Rio Tinto's Arizona copper project
summary: An Indigenous group has asked the US Supreme Court to block Rio Tinto’s planned copper project in Arizona. Legal action that delays or prevents project development would tighten expectations for copper supply in the coming weeks, likely supporting copper prices as markets price-in reduced near-term output.

title: A new green aluminum plant could bring jobs — and clean energy — to Kentucky
summary: Century Aluminum plans a new “green” primary aluminium smelter in northeastern Kentucky and has been slated for up to $500m in U.S. DOE funding, aimed at using carbon-free power and reducing emissions. The project could nearly double U.S. primary output (~600,000 t/year), supporting aluminium supply expectations.

title: 17-year-old arrested in 800kg copper theft
summary: Zimbabwe police arrested suspects for stealing roughly 760kg of copper cables, amid a ZESA crackdown on electricity infrastructure vandalism. The utility is replacing copper cables with aluminium, and the government tightened copper possession rules with higher minimum sentences and origin documentation requirements for dealers.

title: Indigenous group takes fight against Rio Tinto Arizona copper mine to US Supreme Court
summary: An Indigenous group asks the U.S. Supreme Court to block Rio Tinto and BHP from gaining access to Arizona land for the Resolution Copper project. The case challenges a land swap over religious rights tied to Oak Flat, where a massive copper reserve is located. A halt would delay supply.

title: Native non-profit appeals to US supreme court to block Arizona copper mine
summary: Apache Stronghold asked the US Supreme Court to block the land swap enabling Rio Tinto and BHP to build the Resolution Copper mine in Arizona, arguing religious rights violations. The project sits atop a vast copper reserve, and further legal delay could keep copper supply off line, supporting prices in the near term.

title: Bahrain Business: Issues facing aluminium industry highlighted
summary: Alba CEO Ali Al Baqali told the Fastmarkets International Aluminium Conference that primary aluminium producers face challenges including rising smelter costs. He also cited EU CBAM, carbon-emissions reduction and supply-chain sustainability as key drivers shaping costs and demand, with attention to regional market dynamics in MENA and Alba’s low-carbon products.

title: Copper output at Chile's Codelco slips nearly 11% in July
summary: Chile’s Codelco cut copper production 10.7% year on year in July to 111,400 tonnes, as it struggles to halt a broader decline. Escondida rose 29% while Collahuasi fell 6%, leaving mixed supply signals. Codelco targets higher August output above last year.

title: A Strategic Sourcing Framework to Meet U.S. Copper Demand for the Clean Energy Transition
summary: The Copper Development Association’s white paper projects U.S. copper demand could double by 2035 and assesses whether supply can meet it. It advocates an “all-of-the-above” strategy combining more domestic mining and refining, more recycling, and continued trade with reliable partners to ensure copper availability for clean energy.

title: Esperance Port workers brace for job losses as iron ore, nickel, and lithium exports take a hit
summary: Esperance Port workers face potential job losses as major customers shut down over the next year, including First Quantum Minerals’ Ravensthorpe nickel operation and Mineral Resources’ Yilgarn iron ore project, with Arcadium Lithium also mothballing Mt Cattlin. The reduced export outlook affects 2025 trade volumes and associated sentiment.

title: Vladimir Putin says Russia should consider limiting exports of uranium, titanium and nickel in retaliation for Western sanctions, sending shares of the commodities soaring
summary: Vladimir Putin said Russia should consider limiting exports of uranium, titanium and nickel in retaliation for Western sanctions. Reuters reports his comments pushed nickel prices higher and lifted shares of uranium mining firms, signaling market expectations of tighter supply from Russia.

title: Vedanta urges India to negotiate end to nickel sulfate duties with Japan and Korea
summary: Vedanta urged India to negotiate changes to trade pact “rules of origin” with Japan and Korea to remove import duties on nickel sulfate used in EV batteries. Japan’s tariff is 3.9% and Korea’s 5%. Lower tariffs could boost exports and support nickel demand expectations.

title: Canada Nickel Announces Receipt of Support Letter for up to $500 million from Leading Financial Institution
summary: Canada Nickel says it received an additional support letter from a financial institution for up to C$500 million of long-term project debt toward development of its Crawford nickel sulphide project in Ontario. Together with an Export Development Canada letter and expected refundable tax credits, the company advances its financing package timeline.

title: Battery Mineral Resources Corp.: Battery Mineral Resources Drills High Grade Copper Intercepts from the Cinabrio Mine at Its Punitaqui Copper Complex in Chile
summary: Battery Mineral Resources reports high-grade copper intercepts from ongoing underground infill drilling at its Punitaqui (Cinabrio) mine in Chile, including 18.3m at 2.6% Cu and other mineralized intervals. Results are expected to refine resource models and optimize mine schedules, supporting copper production expectations.

title: Belararox to acquire copper exploration project in Botswana
summary: Belararox agreed to acquire 100% of KCB Resources, gaining exploration licences across Botswana’s Kalahari Copper Belt, a region known for major copper-silver deposits. The deal is aimed at future exploration with staged share issuance and funding commitments, but it does not imply immediate copper supply changes.

title: Magna Mining Inc.: Magna Mining Acquires Producing Copper Mine in Sudbury from KGHM International Ltd.
summary: Magna Mining agreed to acquire KGHM’s Sudbury Basin base-metal assets, including the operating McCreedy West copper mine and adjacent nickel-copper operations. Magna plans to continue production after closing and re-invest profits into development and exploration. The deal adds near-term production expectations for copper and nickel.

title: The Impact of Anticipated Interest Rate Cuts on Copper Prices
summary: The article argues that anticipated interest rate cuts would lower borrowing costs, stimulate infrastructure and manufacturing investment, and raise copper demand. It notes copper has risen about 15% year-to-date and suggests investors’ rate-cut expectations and speculation have supported prices. It references Solaris’s EIA submission as context, not a direct price driver.

title: Copper Standard and Pucara agree on merger
summary: Copper Standard Resources agreed to acquire Pucara Gold in a share-swap deal, combining several copper exploration projects in Peru, including porphyry copper targets. The transaction may improve project scale and funding prospects, but it does not signal near-term production changes, making any impact on copper prices likely minimal.

title: Putin calls to limit exports of Russian nickel, uranium, titanium
summary: Putin suggested Russia may limit exports of nickel (along with uranium and titanium) as retaliation for Western sanctions. With Russia a major nickel exporter and a large share of LME-registered nickel linked to Russian origin, markets reacted quickly—Reuters reported a 2.6% jump in three-month LME nickel right after the comments.

title: Arizona's battle over crucial copper mine poised to sway US election
summary: Native American opposition has prompted a legal appeal to the U.S. Supreme Court to block Rio Tinto and BHP’s Resolution Copper mine in Arizona. The project would supply a significant share of U.S. copper demand; uncertainty over approval or freeze adds near-term supply expectations that can move copper prices.

title: Global net zero efforts have fueled a nickel boom that is destroying Indonesia's rainforests and coral reefs   – NaturalNews.com
summary: The piece claims Indonesia’s nickel mining and smelting expansion is accelerating to support EV battery demand, citing major investment deals and large processing plans. It also details environmental damage and pollution impacts, but provides no immediate regulatory action or production stoppage that would reduce near-term nickel supply.

title: Copper Hits 2-Week High as Xi Comments Fuel Stimulus Hopes
summary: Copper prices rose to a two-week high as hopes for Chinese stimulus were fueled by President Xi Jinping’s push to meet the annual economic target. Three-month LME copper was up 0.7% and October SHFE copper gained 1.2%, reflecting improved demand expectations for industrial metals.

title: Spotlights for scrap, alumina, green premiums and Chinese production at International Aluminium Conference
summary: At the International Aluminium Conference, Trafigura said the rising alumina price is the key issue, calling it “terrible” for aluminium producers. Fastmarkets put fob Australia alumina at a six-year high after Australian supply disruptions. Speakers also discussed China’s production cap and scrap shortages, amid focus on low-carbon premiums.

title: Massive copper heist from Rio Tinto-Kennecott under investigation
summary: Salt Lake County police arrested four people after a theft from Rio Tinto Kennecott involving an 8,600-pound, ~99.7% pure copper mold plus additional copper items and plates. Investigators recovered the materials and searched a scrap processor. Rio Tinto is conducting an internal investigation.

title: Core Nickel Corp.: Core Nickel Announces up to $400,000 Flow-Through Private Placement Financing
summary: Core Nickel Corp. announced a non-brokered flow-through private placement to raise up to $400,000. Proceeds will fund VTEM and geophysical surveys and part of a winter drilling program on its 100%-owned Mel and Odei River nickel exploration properties in Manitoba.

title: Core Nickel Announces up to $400,000 Flow-Through Private Placement Financing
summary: Core Nickel Corp. announced up to $400,000 of flow-through private placement financing to fund VTEM and magnetic gradiometer surveys and part of a winter drilling program on its Mel and Odei River nickel exploration properties. The news supports exploration activity but is unlikely to materially move near-term nickel prices.

title: Rising Trends Of India Aluminum Extrusion Market Will Witness Substantial Growthwith In-Detailed Competitor Analysis
summary: A report via Allied Market Research forecasts strong growth for India’s aluminum extrusion market, citing construction demand for lightweight, corrosion-resistant materials and rising customization. While it focuses on market sizing rather than trading data, higher extrusion demand can modestly support near-term aluminum demand expectations.

title: 5 arrested, $147K in stolen copper from Kennecott recovered
summary: Police recovered over 10,000 pounds of stolen copper tied to the Rio Tinto Kennecott mine in Utah. The investigation traced alleged theft of copper mold and smelting byproducts to a recycling plant where additional copper items and payments were found, leading to multiple arrests. Likely limited price impact on broader copper markets.

title: Arizona copper mine: US Supreme Court may consider appeal against Rio-BHP's Resolution mine site
summary: A religious freedom group representing Native Americans has lodged a challenge to Rio Tinto and BHP’s Resolution copper mine lease in Arizona, with the case potentially heading to the US Supreme Court. The mine is a major US copper source, so regulatory uncertainty risks short-term supply disruption.

title: 10 Best Aluminum and Aluminum Mining Stocks to Buy Now
summary: The article argues aluminum prices face near-term downside as China’s property and factory activity remain weak, spot demand is soft, and LME inventories are at their highest since 2021 amid record production. It notes some optimism for Q4 on potential Fed rate cuts, but highlights current oversupply pressures.

title: New Caledonian local consortium makes offer for moth-balled Koniambo nickel plant
summary: A New Caledonian consortium has made an eleventh-hour offer to take over and potentially restart the moth-balled Koniambo (KNS) nickel plant, idling since late August. The proposal could change the project model and target lower output, but depends on Glencore’s handling of KNS’s US$13.7 billion debt.

title: 'Water walk' protests UP Copperwood Mine
summary: Indigenous groups and allies held a “water walk” opposing Highland Copper’s proposed Copperwood Mine in Michigan, citing threats to the river and water resources. Highland argues the project will not draw water from Lake Superior and emphasizes mitigation plans and regulation compliance. Protests could still raise near-term permitting uncertainty for copper supply.

title: Feasibility study completed for Mount Lyell copper mine | The Advocate
summary: Sibanye Stillwater said a class three feasibility study for the Mount Lyell Copper Project has been completed, advancing plans to reopen the mine that has been idle since 2014. The Tasmanian government has invested in restart works and outlined additional assistance if mining resumes. The study is copper-focused.

title: BHP Sees Global Copper Demand Surging Due to the AI Boom and Data Centers
summary: BHP says the AI boom and data-center buildout will lift global copper demand substantially, arguing copper is essential for power and cooling. The firm expects copper demand growth to accelerate alongside the clean-energy rollout, though recent weeks’ weakness linked to China demand keeps sentiment mixed.

title: BHP Group Sounds Alarm on Copper Supply, AI and EV Growth Could Drive Prices Soaring: Report
summary: The report’s headline says BHP has warned of tightening copper supply, while AI and EV growth could boost demand and lift copper prices. The framing suggests near-term expectations for copper market balance are turning tighter, creating upward price pressure over coming weeks.

title: Arizona Sonoran Copper Company Inc Announces Drilling Expands Primary Sulphide Zone Under and Around the Cactus West Pit
summary: Arizona Sonoran Copper reported new infill and step-out drilling results at its Cactus West pit in Arizona, extending the primary sulphide copper zone by up to ~500 ft below prior mineralization. Reported grades are around 0.31–0.44% CuT, with minor molybdenum, supporting ongoing exploration.

title: Kodiak Copper Corp.: Kodiak Expands its MPD Project With Acquisition of Adjacent Aspen Grove Copper-Gold Property
summary: Kodiak Copper announced it will acquire the adjacent Aspen Grove copper-gold property, expanding its MPD district in British Columbia. The claims host historic drilling of near-surface copper-gold porphyry targets, including the Ketchan discovery. The deal is subject to exchange approval; it is exploratory with no production impact stated.

title: Aluminium Rallies on Technical Support, Weaker Dollar
summary: Aluminium prices rose on technical support and key resistance break, helped by lower LME inventories and a weaker U.S. dollar. Investors also increased expectations for a larger Fed rate cut this week. Three-month aluminium on the LME gained about 1.9%, hitting the highest level since late August.

title: Rio Tinto Group (RIO): Among the Best Aluminum and Aluminum Mining Stocks to Buy Now
summary: The piece attributes recent and near-term pressure on aluminum prices to soft spot demand amid record-high China production and rising LME inventories (highest since 2021), suggesting oversupply. It notes possible upside if Fed rate cuts boost growth, but near-term demand concerns dominate.

title: Avery Dennison Corporation (AVY): Among the Best Aluminum and Aluminum Mining Stocks to Buy Now
summary: The article frames aluminum as facing near-term pressure from China’s property slowdown, soft spot demand, and rising LME inventories, despite record Chinese production. It notes potential upside if Fed rate cuts support demand and borrowing costs. It highlights Avery Dennison’s aluminum-related products but offers no direct price catalyst for the metal itself.

title: Reliance, Inc. (RS): Among the Best Aluminum and Aluminum Mining Stocks to Buy Now
summary: The piece argues aluminum prices face near-term downside as soft spot demand persists amid record-high China production and rising LME inventories (highest since 2021), reflecting oversupply. It notes potential support later in Q4 if Fed rate cuts occur, but current demand weakness dominates sentiment.

title: Ardagh Metal Packaging SA. (AMBP): Among the Best Aluminum and Aluminum Mining Stocks to Buy Now
summary: The piece discusses aluminum market conditions, citing sluggish Chinese factory activity and a property sector crisis that dampen demand. It also notes record Chinese aluminum production and rising LME inventories at the highest since 2021, indicating oversupply. A later Q4 recovery is mentioned but near-term pressure appears bearish.

title: Ball Corporation (BALL): Among the Best Aluminum and Aluminum Mining Stocks to Buy Now
summary: The article argues aluminum prices face near-term pressure from weaker global demand, China’s property slowdown, record Chinese output, and rising LME inventories. It also notes possible upside if the Fed cuts rates and borrowing costs ease, plus longer-run vehicle aluminum content trends. Ball is discussed mainly as a packaging demand beneficiary.

title: Saudi Arabian Mining Company (Ma'aden) agreed to acquire remaining 25.10% stake in Ma?aden Bauxite and Alumina Company and Ma?aden Aluminium Company from Alcoa Corporation (NYSE:AA) for $1.04 billion.
summary: Ma’aden agreed to buy Alcoa’s remaining 25.1% stakes in Ma’aden’s bauxite and alumina venture and Ma’aden Aluminium Company for $1.04 billion, moving to 100% ownership. Completion is expected in 1H 2025, subject to approvals, potentially improving supply and refining certainty for aluminium markets.

title: Saudi's Maaden in Talks to Sell Aluminum Units to Bahrain's Alba
summary: Saudi miner Maaden is in talks to sell its aluminum and bauxite/alumina subsidiaries to Bahrain’s Alba in exchange for Alba shares, with regulatory approvals pending. The proposed expanded producer would boost global aluminum capacity and supply reliability, amid buyer anxiety over Russia-related shipment risks. Shares rose on the news.

title: Rise of data centres and AI to further exacerbate global copper demand, warns miner BHP
summary: BHP warns that data centres and AI—through higher electricity consumption and copper-intensive power, cooling, and processor interconnections—will add to copper demand. It projects demand rising to 52.5m tonnes by 2050 and notes a current surplus driven by weak demand, expected to reverse later this decade.

title: South African company Sibaneye-Stillwater eyes New Caledonia nickel mining plant
summary: Reports say Sibanye-Stillwater is the most probable bidder for shares in New Caledonia’s Prony Resources, a nickel plant whose operations were disrupted by unrest and market pressure from Indonesia. Separate coverage notes proposals to restart the moth-balled Koniambo (KNS) nickel plant. Such developments could lift short-term nickel supply expectations.

title: Power knocked out in neighborhood after lines pulled down by suspected copper thieves
summary: Residents report early Monday power outages after suspected thieves pulled down utility lines to steal copper from phone/trunk cables. Police blocked roads while utilities repaired snapped poles and blown fuses; the incident also damaged a power box. It indicates copper theft in local infrastructure, but likely limited market-wide copper price impact.

title: Industry groups ask ITC to reject antidumping and countervailing duties on aluminum printing plates
summary: Industry groups urged the U.S. ITC to reject proposed antidumping and countervailing duties on imports of aluminum lithographic printing plates from Japan and China. They argue the duties would increase costs, limit supply, and harm printing and publishing businesses. A rejection suggests less near-term demand downside for aluminum inputs.

title: Vedanta Aluminium responds to dam breach at Lanjigarh refinery
summary: Vedanta Aluminium said a process water storage pond breached at its Lanjigarh alumina refinery in Odisha due to harsh weather, affecting nearby agricultural land. It mobilised workers and is providing drinking water and medical support. The company stressed there is no disruption to current operations and production continues compliantly.

title: Sibanye considers sourcing nickel for French plant from New Caledonia's Prony
summary: Sibanye is studying New Caledonia’s Prony Resources as a potential source of mixed hydroxide precipitate (MHP) to feed its Sandouville, France plant for battery-grade nickel. The effort follows Prony’s search for investors and its operations being halted since May due to unrest, with Sibanye also exploring Indonesia sources.

title: Ma'aden pursues merger of aluminium operations with Alba
summary: Saudi miner Ma’aden is exploring a non-binding merger of its aluminium subsidiaries with Bahrain’s Alba, potentially creating a large, vertically integrated aluminium producer. The proposal would involve due diligence and regulatory approvals, with the definitive terms still undetermined. Alba flagged the deal as uncertain, limiting immediate price impact.

title: Antofagasta to invest $3.5bn in bid to be top ten copper producer
summary: Antofagasta plans nearly $3.5bn of new investment starting in 2025 to expand operations and become a top ten copper producer. Most spending is in Chile and Peru, including the Nueva Centinela project and mine expansions that should lift copper output by about 144,000 tonnes per year.

title: SABIC sells stake in Aluminium Bahrain to Ma'aden - Chemical Engineering
summary: Ma’aden agreed to acquire SABIC’s 20.62% stake in Aluminium Bahrain (ALBA), subject to conditions. The deal follows talks with ALBA on forming a regional aluminium powerhouse and Ma’aden’s plan to consolidate its aluminium business, including a share exchange with Alcoa.

title: Titan seals pivotal US$120m Ecuador copper deal with Hancock
summary: Titan Minerals signed a US$120m earn-in/JV with Hanrine Ecuadorian Exploration to advance its Linderos copper project in Ecuador. Hanrine will fund initial drilling and exploration milestones to earn up to 80% over 12 years, reflecting confidence in copper discovery potential and boosting near-term sentiment for copper.

title: Hanrine enters deal to earn into Titan's Ecuador copper project
summary: Hanrine signed a JV/earn-in deal with Titan Minerals to acquire up to 80% of Titan’s Linderos copper project in Ecuador by funding exploration, including an initial 5% stake after $2.01m and up to $120m in total. Titan is free-carried during earn-in; drilling is planned.

title: Malaysia's Press Metal inks alumina refinery JV in Indonesia push
summary: Press Metal Aluminium said it is forming a joint venture with Indonesian firms to build a $750 million alumina refinery phase in Indonesia. The move comes after concerns about alumina supply shortages in China, a key raw material for aluminium. Press Metal will hold an 80% stake and expects offtake after commissioning.

title: Flying Nickel Mining Corp.: Flying Nickel Enters Into an Amended and Restated Arrangement Agreement to Sell Its Minago Assets
summary: Flying Nickel Mining Corp. entered an amended arrangement agreement to sell its Minago nickel project and related assets in Manitoba’s Thompson Nickel Belt to Norway House Cree Nation’s subsidiary. The amendment clarifies closing and transfer mechanics; completion remains subject to shareholder, court, and TSXV approvals.

title: BHP's Australian nickel stoppages spoil plans for LME alternative
summary: BHP’s planned suspension of nickel operations in Western Australia has prevented it from committing nickel volumes to new trading platforms, disrupting plans by GCHL and delaying Abaxx’s nickel sulphate contract. Sources cite the shutdown as a setback, prompting the new venues to seek alternative supply, affecting short-term nickel market liquidity expectations.

title: Electric Royalties Ltd.: Electric Royalties Announces Agreement To Acquire Cash-Flowing Copper Stream From Minera Cobre Verde in Chile
summary: Electric Royalties said it will acquire a cash-settled copper stream from Minera Cobre Verde in Chile, giving it rights to 76,000 lb of copper monthly at a fixed $2.75/lb with possible expansion. Payments track the LME monthly spot minus the fixed price, linking cash flows to copper prices.

title: Flying Nickel Mining Corp.: Flying Nickel Enters Into an Amended and Restated Arrangement Agreement to Sell its Minago Assets (Updated)
summary: Flying Nickel Mining Corp. entered an amended arrangement agreement to sell its Minago nickel project and related assets in Manitoba for C$8 million cash plus share consideration to Norway House Cree Nation. The update clarifies closing/transfer mechanics and remains subject to shareholder, court, and TSXV approvals. No direct market-wide nickel supply impact is stated.

title: Falcon Commences Drilling At Its Great Burnt Copper Project, NL
summary: Falcon commenced drilling at its Great Burnt copper project in Newfoundland (NL). The press release indicates active exploration progress, which may improve market expectations for potential future copper supply, providing mild support to copper sentiment in the near term despite limited information on results or development timelines.

title: Press Metal Aluminium Signs Joint Venture Deal for Alumina Refinery in Indonesia
summary: Press Metal Aluminium said it agreed to a joint venture to develop an alumina refinery in West Kalimantan, Indonesia, with Phase 1 capacity of 1 to 1.2 million tonnes per year and potential doubling. The $750 million project is intended to secure alumina supply for its aluminium operations, supporting efficiency and growth.

title: Australia still 'attractive' for alumina producers despite heightened ESG considerations: International Aluminium 2024
summary: Alcoa said it will curtail operations at its Kwinana alumina refinery due to high operating costs and permitting delays, while also citing stronger ESG constraints because operations sit near urban areas. Related Worsley project conditions were challenged. These supply-side pressures help underpin rising alumina prices and are likely supportive for aluminum.

title: The world's first commercial copper die-cast rotor for railway traction motors
summary: Hitachi Industrial Products commercialized a copper die-cast rotor for railway traction motors, designed to be about 15 kg lighter than conventional copper bar-type rotors. The firm says it adapted its aluminum die-casting know-how to copper despite copper’s higher melting point, and will apply the rotor to railway projects.

title: World's leading aluminium company opens unit in Portugal
summary: The municipality said Exlabesa, an aluminium extrusion company, has inaugurated a new aluminium extrusion factory in Soure, Portugal, with two 2,800-tonne lines and 16,000 tonnes annual capacity. It also plans further expansion to 45,000 tonnes. The report implies more processing capacity, but not a near-term supply shock.

title: Perseverance Metals Inc.: Perseverance Metals Discovers New Nickel Zone, Yields 1.82% NiEq over 5.1 Meters at Lac Gayot Project, Quebec, Canada
summary: Perseverance Metals reported a new nickel sulphide zone at its Lac Gayot project in Quebec, including 1.61% Ni over 5.10m, alongside minor copper. The company also highlights that historical drilling may have missed deeper extensions. These are exploration results, not near-term supply changes, but they can support nickel sentiment.

title: 60 People Oppose the Copperwood Mine During the Gichigaming Water Walk
summary: Native and nonnative residents joined a 31-mile “Gichigaming Water Walk” protesting the proposed Copperwood metallic sulfide copper mine near Lake Superior. The group fears cross-border water contamination and has collected 45,000 petition signatures. The project is tied to Highland Copper Company and claims $425 million investment and 380 jobs.

title: Solaris Resources (TSX:SLS) (NYSEAmerican:SLSR) Reports High-Grade Copper Intercepts and Breaks Drilling Record at Warintza Project in Ecuador
summary: Solaris Resources reported high-grade copper-equivalent intercepts from new drilling at the Warintza Project in Ecuador, including a standout 475m at 1.03% CuEq from near-surface. Results extend mineralization beyond the current resource estimate and the company set an August drilling record, supporting progress toward its 60,000m goal.

title: Gide advises KGHM International on the sale of a portfolio of copper mines in the Sudbury Basin, Canada, to Magna Mining
summary: Gide advised KGHM International on selling a portfolio of Sudbury Basin mining assets to Magna Mining, including the active McCreedy West copper mine and several inactive copper mines and exploration projects. The deal is valued around C$30 million and expected to close by end-Q1 2025, with regulatory support provided.

title: Ruling could jeopardize Copper World tailings pipeline plan
summary: A court ruling in Arizona could jeopardize the legal approval of a state right-of-way for a tailings pipeline at Hudbay’s Copper World complex. The decision cited open-meetings notice errors and raised questions about whether the pipeline approval can be ratified or revoked, potentially delaying mine infrastructure.

title: Material Matters: Major Miners Upgraded
summary: Major miners’ ratings were upgraded following broker reviews. Morgan Stanley lifted long-term copper forecasts, saying low prices may boost demand, refined supply growth should slow, and inventory drawdowns could follow; this supports higher copper. Nickel is mentioned with challenged demand but possible supply cuts, making its near-term direction less clear.

title: Copper theft crackdown intensifies in Southern Nevada
summary: Southern Nevada is intensifying enforcement against copper theft, including a Las Vegas ordinance restricting how sellers and recycling yards handle stolen wire (no walk-up cart drop-offs; sellers must arrive by vehicle and wait to be paid). Police cite large thefts, such as 22,000 pounds at a construction site, affecting businesses and resorts.

title: Aston Bay Holdings Ltd.: Aston Bay and American West Metals Thick High-Grade Copper in Deep Drilling at the Storm Project, Nunavut, Canada
summary: Aston Bay and American West report deep diamond drilling at the Storm Copper Project in Nunavut intersected Cyclone-style copper mineralization with assays including 10m at 1.2% Cu and 0.5m at 3.7% Cu. The company expects additional assays soon and highlights the potential for a large deep copper system.

title: Premium Nickel Files NI 43-101 Technical Report: Initial Mineral Resource Estimate of 27.7 MT for the Selebi Mine in Botswana
summary: Premium Nickel Resources filed an NI 43-101 Technical Report for its Selebi Main and Selebi North Cu-Ni-Co sulphide deposits in Botswana, reporting larger inferred/indicated resources and contained nickel and copper. The company notes ongoing drilling to upgrade resources and potential future studies, without any immediate production change.

title: Aston Bay and American West Metals Thick High-Grade Copper in Deep Drilling at the Storm Project, Nunavut, Canada
summary: Aston Bay and American West report deep diamond drilling at the Storm Copper Project in Nunavut has intersected high-grade copper mineralization, including up to 3.7% Cu over 0.5m. Additional assays for a second hole are expected soon, reinforcing potential for a large deep copper system.

title: Marquette County nickel project awarded up to $145M from federal government
summary: The U.S. Department of Energy selected REV Nickel for negotiations for up to $145 million to expand processing at Michigan’s Eagle Mine, producing nickel concentrate and processing battery-related feedstocks. The plan aims to extend mine life and eventually supply nickel for EV batteries, boosting expectations for domestic nickel availability.

title: Investment in aluminium scrap processing key to securing supply amid global shortage
summary: Delegates at an aluminium scrap conference said Europe is very short of aluminium scrap, with wrought-friendly grades increasingly scarce as demand rises and material exports to Asia tighten supply. Investors in processing (e.g., X-ray/LIBS sorting) aim to recover more usable grades, while scrap prices have been rising toward LME parity.

title: US says 'forced labor' designation for RI nickel won't prompt sanctions - Economy
summary: The US Department of Labor added Indonesian nickel to a forced-labor/child-labor suspect commodities list, citing alleged forced labor in nickel industrial parks. The US embassy said the designation carries no sanctions or trade implications, aiming mainly to raise awareness. As a result, near-term nickel pricing impact appears limited.

title: Rio Tinto's Fair Value Estimate Reduced on Lower Iron Ore, Copper, and Aluminum Prices
summary: Rio Tinto reduced its fair value estimate, citing weaker commodity price expectations, including lower copper and aluminum, alongside softer demand linked to the end of the China boom. The article notes China is Rio Tinto’s largest customer and that earnings outlook could decline as commodity demand softens.

title: Reducing Teck's Fair Value Estimate by 3% on Lower Copper and Zinc Prices
summary: The report notes that Teck’s fair value estimate was lowered by 3% because of reduced copper (and zinc) price assumptions. While zinc is not tracked here, the explicit linkage to lower copper pricing points to bearish near-term expectations for copper markets.

title: BHP's Fair Value Reduced by 4%, Driven by Lower Iron Ore, Copper, and Metallurgical Coal Prices
summary: The article title says BHP’s fair value was cut by 4%, attributed to lower iron ore, copper, and metallurgical coal prices. While iron ore and coal are not tracked here, the explicit mention of declining copper prices points to near-term bearish sentiment for copper.

title: Lumwana mine to double copper output
summary: Barrick said its Lumwana Super Pit expansion in Zambia is moving ahead, with a feasibility study completion and permitting approval expected by year-end. The project plans to twin the process circuit and raise throughput from 27Mt to 52Mt, effectively doubling output from 120kt to ~240kt copper annually.

title: Global aluminium aerosol can deliveries increase by 4.4% in 2024, reports AEROBAL
summary: AEROBAL says members’ global deliveries of aluminium aerosol containers rose 4.4% in 1H 2024, led by Europe and the Americas, with deodorant and hairspray demand strengthening. It notes limited access to high-quality recyclate/scrap and ongoing EU “design for recycling” work, suggesting supportive near-term aluminium consumption.

title: Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE): Canadian Securities Exchange Welcomes Listing of Lion Copper and Gold Corp.
summary: CSE welcomed the listing of Lion Copper and Gold Corp. (LEO), focused on advancing the Yerington copper project in Nevada and converting inferred to indicated resources for a prefeasibility study. The piece highlights corporate listing and project progress, with no direct immediate impact on copper supply, demand, or trade flows.

title: Marquette County proposed nickel projects selected for award negotiation up to $145 million
summary: Marquette County projects involving Eagle Mine and Revex Technologies were selected by the U.S. Department of Energy for up to $145 million in award negotiations. Facilities will process residual nickel in mine waste and produce nickel concentrate, while also extracting other metals from lithium-ion battery waste.

title: Indonesia 'Blood Nickel' Risks Too Grave To Ignore
summary: The article warns that Indonesia’s nickel supply chain faces “blood nickel” allegations tied to forced labor and severe environmental damage. Indonesia’s mining employs thousands of Chinese migrant workers under exploitative conditions. It also notes BASF’s withdrawal from a Weda Bay nickel refinery as scrutiny grows, affecting near-term nickel supply expectations.

title: Nickel project will add jobs, life to Eagle Mine | News, Sports, Jobs
summary: The U.S. Department of Energy selected REV Nickel for award negotiations up to $145 million to develop three facilities at Eagle Mine in Michigan. The project will process mine tailings and lithium-ion battery waste to produce nickel concentrate and other critical minerals, potentially extending mine life and adding jobs.

title: Nickel Pig Iron Prices Oscillate Downward, Price Disparity Continues to Widen
summary: High-nickel pig iron prices fell week over week: SMM NPI averaged 979 RMB per nickel point (-7.9), with the Indonesian FOB index down too. Weak stainless steel profits and longer procurement cycles reduced nickel pig iron demand, while supply stayed relatively stable, keeping short-term downside pressure on NPI.

title: 【SMM Analysis】Decline in lithium prices, stable nickel and cobalt prices lead to divergent trends in ternary and LFP scrap purchasing demand
summary: SMM reports lithium chemical prices fell sharply in August, weighing on LFP scrap procurement. By contrast, nickel sulphate remained stable and even rebounded slightly after a prolonged decline due to low inventories. This improved demand for nickel extraction from ternary black mass, supporting ternary scrap procurement despite ongoing price declines.

title: Golden Deeps jags whopper copper-silver hit in NSW
summary: Golden Deeps announced new drill intersections at its NSW Havilah project, including long zones of disseminated copper-silver sulphides and higher-grade chalcopyrite, with pXRF copper grades up to 3.6%. The results extend the target trend and may boost copper exploration sentiment, but remain exploration-stage with no immediate supply impact.

title: China's  primary aluminum imports rose in August, but exports declined
summary: China’s primary aluminium imports rose in August 2024 to about 163,000 mt (+25.7% MoM), lifting cumulative imports Jan-Aug to 1.512 million mt (+100.2% YoY). Primary aluminium exports fell to about 14,900 mt (-21.3% MoM) and cumulative exports dropped 41.3% YoY, indicating higher net import demand.

title: Jokowi Launches Amman Mineral's $1.4 Billion Copper Smelter in W. Sumbawa
summary: President Jokowi inaugurated Amman Mineral’s $1.4 billion copper smelter in West Sumbawa, Indonesia, with capacity to process large volumes of copper concentrates and produce copper cathode (first by end-2024), alongside gold, silver, and sulfuric acid byproducts. The move signals major Indonesia-led copper processing expansion.

title: Core Nickel Corp.: Core Nickel Announces up to $1,500,000 Flow-through Private Placement Financing
summary: Core Nickel announces a $1.5 million flow-through private placement to fund Canadian exploration expenditures on its Thompson Nickel Belt nickel properties in Manitoba. The company highlights historical nickel resources and nearby mills and states it will renounce qualifying expenditures by Dec. 31, 2024.

title: Cobre, BHP plan to form JV to explore copper in Botswana
summary: Cobre and a BHP subsidiary signed a letter of intent to form a JV to explore copper-silver deposits in Botswana, covering Cobre’s Kitlanya West and East projects in the Kalahari Copper Belt. The deal depends on binding documents and due diligence, so it is unlikely to affect near-term copper prices.

title: Nickel Industries buys 51pc stake in Indonesian project
summary: Nickel Industries completed a 51% stake purchase in Indonesia’s Siduarsi nickel-cobalt project in West Papua. The company can raise its ownership to 82.5% if feasibility approval is granted. The deposit is suited to HPAL and could feed MHP and potentially nickel sulphate/cathode production, boosting nickel supply expectations.

title: Lifezone Metals Announces Initiation of Project Financing Process for the Kabanga Nickel Project in Tanzania
summary: Lifezone Metals, with BHP, starts the project financing process for Tanzania’s Kabanga Nickel Project and receives a Letter of Interest from the U.S. DFC, with Societe Generale named lead financial advisor. The update signals advancing funding for a major nickel deposit, supporting bullish sentiment for nickel.

title: Russia's Nornickel opens EV battery R&D centre
summary: Nornickel opened an R&D centre in St. Petersburg to study nickel-containing cathode active materials for EV batteries, with potential decisions within a year on producing cathode materials. The company is a major high-grade nickel producer and is positioning for an EV nickel supply chain despite weak profits and sanctions.

title: Palamina Corp.: Palamina Acquires Aurania's Peruvian Subsidiary and 100% of the Pluma Copper Silver Project
summary: Palamina acquired Aurania’s Peruvian subsidiary holding the Pluma copper-silver project and received a 1% NSR royalty as payment. The deal consolidates Palamina’s copper-silver land bank and includes planned exploration activities (seismic and further drilling elsewhere). No near-term production impact is specified.

title: VR Resources Closes Acquisition of Empire Properties in Northern Ontario and Commences Copper-Gold Exploration
summary: VR Resources has closed the acquisition of mineral properties in northern Ontario and plans to commence copper-gold exploration immediately. The company highlights targets for a disseminated sulfide system containing copper and gold and will undertake advanced 3D DCIP geophysics in the fall. No near-term production or supply changes are indicated.

title: Thieves hunting for copper are vandalizing EV chargers
summary: U.S. EV charger networks are facing rising vandalism, with about 10% of failed charging attempts linked to damaged or missing cables. Executives say much theft targets copper wiring and conduits. Replacement and security costs are increasing, and thieves’ scavenging adds copper scrap availability, weighing on near-term copper pricing sentiment.

title: Revex Technologies awarded $195 Million for its REV Nickel Project
summary: Revex Technologies was awarded $195 million in grants to invest in its REV Nickel Project in Michigan. The project will produce nickel concentrate and other critical minerals using mine tailings and spent lithium-ion batteries. Funding is expected to create jobs and support sustainable reshoring, potentially improving nickel supply expectations.

title: Cobre and BHP sign LoI for Kitlanya West and East copper projects JV
summary: Cobre signed a letter of intent with BHP to create a material earn-in exploration JV covering Cobre’s Kitlanya West and East copper-silver projects in Botswana. The deal follows BHP’s Xplor funding for seismic work and is contingent on definitive agreements and BHP due diligence. Ngami/Okavango remain wholly owned.

title: Indonesia inaugurates 2 copper smelters to boost global mining competitiveness-Xinhua
summary: Indonesia’s President inaugurated two major copper smelters/refineries, including PT Amman Mineral International’s refinery in West Sumbawa (900,000 tons of concentrate capacity per year) and PT Freeport’s Gresik smelter for copper cathode (processing 1.7 million tons of concentrate). The move aims to add value by processing domestic copper rather than exporting raw materials.

title: Looking to diversify into metals, Saudi Arabia acquires shares in Middle East aluminium production
summary: Alcoa announced it will sell its 25.1% stake in a Ma’aden joint venture in Saudi Arabia to Ma’aden’s partner for about $1.1bn. Separately, Ma’aden and Alba agreed to due diligence on a possible combination, while Ma’aden also acquired Sabic’s 20.62% stake in Alba.

title: Junior Nickel Miner Core Nickel Corp. (CSE: CNCO) Gains on News
summary: Core Nickel Corp. (CNCO) reports strong interest in a nickel flow-through private placement and upsizes the offering to 7.5 million FT units at $0.30 each for up to $2.25 million. The news is about financing and exploration properties, not nickel output or supply constraints.

title: 4 Canadian copper firms worth watching for potential takeover
summary: The piece screens Canadian copper miners for takeover likelihood, noting that copper demand is forecast to exceed supply in the coming years due to the energy transition. It highlights potential M&A interest in companies like First Quantum and Imperial Metals, but offers no near-term operational or market-shock data for copper prices.

title: Erick Thohir: Copper Smelter in Gresik Increases Export Value
summary: Indonesia’s SOE minister inaugurated production at PT Freeport Indonesia’s Gresik smelter, saying nickel export value could rise to $40bn from $1–2bn, reflecting expanded refining and downstream migration. He also mentioned the government pushing further downstream of copper and gold, signaling broader copper processing intent.

title: Aluminum Dynamics provides jobs for the community
summary: Aluminum Dynamics’ $2.5 billion aluminium rolling mill in Mississippi is more than halfway complete, with construction employing hundreds of contractors and nearly 400 staff. The project aims to have the facility shipping aluminium by next year and expects up to 750 employees by summer 2025, indicating rising aluminium demand.

title: The Overnight Report: RBA In Focus
summary: Overnight markets: investors awaited the RBA, but commodity news drove metal focus. Gold hit a record. Copper rose on renewed expectations China may pursue stronger stimulus to bolster growth. Separately, Nickel Industries acquired 51% of Indonesia’s Siduarsi nickel-cobalt project, supporting a constructive nickel narrative.

title: Process and Control Today | Schneider Electric and Glencore collaborate to drive copper circularity
summary: Schneider Electric and Glencore will collaborate to digitize and decarbonize Glencore’s copper supply chain, improve energy reporting and process electrification, and explore higher recycled-content copper plus end-of-life take-back recycling. The piece frames this as closing the material loop and reducing emissions, but with limited immediate market impact detail.

title: Judge makes ruling in Copper World Mine right-of-way case
summary: A Maricopa County judge ruled in favor of an environmental group in a lawsuit over right-of-way permitting for Hudbay’s Copper World Mine. The judge found a noticing/disclosure error at a state board meeting and said related approvals are null and void, potentially delaying permits and requiring new environmental review.

title: Houghton tech startup to assemble workforce for nickel project
summary: The U.S. Department of Energy awarded Revex Technologies up to $145 million to expand manufacturing for EV battery supply chains, partnering with Eagle Mine to extract nickel in new ways. The company will focus on workforce readiness and community benefits, with construction of new facilities targeted for next year.

title: Indonesia Launches $941 Million Smelter-Grade Alumina Refinery
summary: Indonesia launched a $941 million smelter-grade alumina refinery in West Kalimantan, supplying 1 million tons per year and planned expansion, using bauxite feedstock. The project is run by Antam and Inalum, with plans to add an aluminium plant and reduce imports, potentially supporting aluminium supply expectations.

title: Indonesia launches $941 million smelter-grade alumina refinery
