summary: Indonesia launched a $941 million smelter-grade alumina refinery in West Kalimantan, with 1 million mt/year capacity and plans to expand by another 1 million mt plus build an aluminium plant. The project follows Indonesia’s bauxite export ban and aims to reduce aluminium imports by scaling domestic processing.

title: Freeport, Amman mark milestones on copper smelters - Companies
summary: Indonesia’s Freeport Indonesia began operating a $3.7bn copper smelter in Gresik. The facility can process 1.7m tonnes of concentrate annually to produce about 900,000 tonnes of copper cathode, alongside byproducts. The inauguration suggests additional copper supply from refining is coming online.

title: Analysis of Nickel Ore Import Data for August 2024 [SMM Data] | Shanghai Non ferrous Metals
summary: China’s nickel ore imports in August 2024 fell 10.79% YoY to 4.93mn mt, including laterite down 11.24% YoY, though shipments from the Philippines rose MoM on smelter restocking. Overall supply growth stayed limited as Indonesia bought nearly 2mn wmt of Philippine laterite, keeping nickel ore tight.

title: Kabanga Nickel Project: A boon for Tanzania's economy
summary: Tanzania’s Kabanga Nickel project, backed by US support and BHP, is discussed alongside investment and development of a planned Kahama refinery. The project targets first production in 2025 and includes projected annual outputs of 40,000 tonnes nickel and 6,000 tonnes copper, supporting constructive sentiment for nickel markets despite the later start.

title: Indonesia boosts mining sector with launch of two copper smelters
summary: Indonesia’s President launched two large copper smelters to expand downstream processing. The projects—one by PT Amman Mineral (900,000 tpa concentrate) and another by PT Freeport (1.7 million tonnes concentrate)—are designed to produce substantial copper cathode volumes. The move aims to strengthen Indonesia’s role in global copper refining.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Intersects 1.12% Copper over 117.83 Metres within 259.98 Metres at 0.68% Copper at the Recently Discovered Banjo Breccia in the American Eagle Area
summary: Faraday Copper reported additional drill intercepts from Phase III drilling at its Copper Creek project in Arizona, including 117.83 m at 1.12% copper and 259.98 m at 0.68% copper within a newly delineated Banjo breccia. The company says follow-up drilling is ongoing to expand resource potential.

title: Mercedes-Benz Group AG: Mercedes-Benz and Hydro Join Forces in the Brazilian Amazon to Foster Long-Term Development Along Their Aluminum Supply Chain
summary: Mercedes-Benz and Hydro expand their aluminum supply-chain partnership in Brazil’s Pará, focusing on community development along Hydro’s bauxite slurry pipeline to the Alunorte alumina refinery and on low-carbon aluminium initiatives. The MoU with NGOs targets decarbonization and responsible sourcing, without any stated near-term production or tariff changes.

title: Indonesia launches alumina refinery smelter to boost industrial independence
summary: Indonesia inaugurated phase 1 construction of an alumina refinery smelter in West Kalimantan, backed by PT Borneo Alumina Indonesia, Inalum and Antam. The project aims to cut reliance on imported alumina and reduce raw material exports. More domestic alumina supply supports aluminium refining and may underpin aluminium prices.

title: Vital Battery Metals Commences Drilling at the Company's Sting Copper Project
summary: Vital Battery Metals commenced drilling at its Sting Copper Project in Newfoundland, targeting chargeability anomalies and anomalous soil/rock results. The release notes permitted drilling plans and expected exploration funding support. It is a copper exploration development update, but it does not provide production or supply data to strongly affect near-term copper prices.

title: Faraday Copper Intersects 1.12% Copper over 117.83 Metres within 259.98 Metres at 0.68% Copper at the Recently Discovered Banjo Breccia in the American Eagle Area
summary: Faraday Copper reported drill results from two holes at its Copper Creek Project in Arizona, including 117.83 m at 1.12% copper (with higher-grade continuity) and additional Banjo breccia intercepts. The company says mineralization remains open and follow-up drilling is in progress, supporting potential near-surface copper resource expansion.

title: FTTH Council welcomes proposal for copper switch off
summary: FTTH Council Europe welcomed a Draghi Report proposal to set a date for shutting down legacy copper networks to accelerate Europe’s fibre (FTTH) deployment. The group argues copper switch-off supports investment and demand for fibre. The piece contains no quantified copper or aluminium supply/demand figures, limiting near-term price impact.

title: GT Resources Inc.: GT Resources Intersects 2.12% Nickel Over 20 meters at the Canalask Nickel-Copper Project
summary: GT Resources reported initial 2024 drill assays from its Canalask nickel-copper project in Yukon, including 2.12% nickel over 19.9m (and a higher-grade interval within). Copper and cobalt were also detected, while drilling outcomes are aimed at expanding mineralization. The results are broadly supportive for nickel sentiment.

title: Aussie Stays Firm With Copper's Rally Giving Extra Support
summary: Copper is surging sharply higher as China rolls out a broad stimulus package aimed at boosting economic activity. The move is accompanied by technical upside signals—breaks above near-term resistance and projections implying further gains—supporting expectations for continued upward pressure in copper prices over coming days.

title: BHP and Cobre Invest in Copper in Botswana
summary: Cobre announced it signed a letter of intent with BHP to negotiate an exclusive joint venture for the Kitlanya West and East copper projects in Botswana, which would fully fund exploration. Botswana’s copper output is already growing via newer mines, but the deal’s size and timing are unknown.

title: ITC holds hearing on aluminum printing plate tariffs
summary: The U.S. ITC held a hearing on proposed AD/CVD tariffs on aluminum lithographic printing plates from China and Japan. Industry stakeholders argued the duties would raise costs, limit supply, and harm printers and publishers, noting no U.S. supply for the aluminum sheet used to make the plates. No testimony supported new tariffs.

title: Aluminum Pigment Market size is set to grow by USD 168.6 million from 2024-2028, growing demand for aluminum pigment from automotive sector boost the market- Technavio
summary: Technavio projects the aluminum pigment market to grow by about USD 168.6 million (2024-2028), driven by automotive demand and tightening VOC regulations leading to low-VOC aluminum pigments. It also notes aluminum price volatility historically affects pigment costs, implying supportive demand expectations for aluminium.

title: Freeport-McMoRan Stock Soars as Copper and Gold Prices Rise
summary: Investopedia reports Freeport-McMoRan shares jumped as copper and gold prices rose. Copper futures climbed about 4% after China unveiled stimulus aimed at supporting sluggish housing and financial markets, boosting expected demand. The piece also notes Fed rate cuts weaken the dollar, further supporting copper and gold prices.

title: London mining company with Canadian connections is planning copper mine acquisitions after sealing Turkish deal
summary: A London-listed ACG Metals executive says he is buying the Gediktepe mine in Turkey as a first step to build a copper-focused portfolio. The mine is set to become largely copper, supported by a $145m expansion. The move reinforces EV-driven copper demand optimism, boosting copper sentiment.

title: Western Metallica to Start Drilling at Its Luz Maria Copper Porphyry Prospect in Peru
summary: Western Metallica announced the start of a first drilling program in October at its Luz Maria copper (Cu-Mo) porphyry prospect within the Caña Brava project in Peru, following permits. The news is an exploration sentiment driver with no immediate supply or demand change; nickel and aluminium are not addressed.

title: Indonesia inaugurates two copper smelters
summary: Indonesia inaugurated two major copper smelters: PT Amman Mineral’s West Sumbawa refinery (900,000 tonnes of copper concentrate capacity per year) and a PT Freeport smelter in Gresik (processing 1.7 million tonnes from Papua). The move supports Indonesia’s downstreaming push and strengthens near-term copper processing capacity expectations.

title: GGL Resources Corp.: Major Mining Company Options the Le Champ Copper-Molybdenum-Gold Porphyry Target from GGL at its Gold Point Project, Nevada
summary: GGL Resources announced Teck’s option agreement for GGL’s Le Champ copper-molybdenum-gold porphyry target in Nevada, including cash option payments and a production-decision milestone. The release supports potential future copper/molybdenum development but provides no near-term output, so any immediate copper price impact is likely limited.

title: Copper Fox Metals Inc.: Copper Fox Announces 2024 Third Quarter Operating and Financial Results
summary: Copper Fox reported its Q3 2024 operating and financial results, including continued geotechnical and exploration progress at several copper projects (Van Dyke, Mineral Mountain, Sombrero Butte, Eaglehead) and geotechnical drilling at Schaft Creek. The company highlighted ongoing metallurgical testwork and permitting timelines; no production-impact events were noted.

title: Russia Increases Aluminum Supplies to China to Record $2.3Bln
summary: Sputnik reports Russia boosted aluminium shipments to China 1.4x to a record $2.3B in Jan-August, far above 2019’s $60.6M. Total metal supplies to China rose 9%. The increased aluminium supply is likely to pressure near-term aluminium prices, while copper and nickel were more stable.

title: Koryx Copper Announces $10 Million Non-Brokered Private Placement
summary: Koryx Copper announced a CAD$10 million non-brokered private placement to fund advancement of its Haib copper project in Namibia and Luanshya West/Mpongwe projects in Zambia, plus working capital. Shares are subject to a four-month hold and TSX-V approval. It is not an immediate supply shock.

title: Bayhorse Silver Inc.: Bayhorse Silver Announces Drill Program on Bayhorse Mine VTEM Anomaly for Potential Porphyry Copper Target
summary: Bayhorse Silver Inc. announced an underground diamond drilling program targeting a low-resistivity anomaly under its Oregon Bayhorse Silver Mine for a potential porphyry copper deposit. The company links the anomaly to a low-resistivity porphyry model and plans downhole geophysics after drilling to refine mineralization profiles.

title: Copper in high demand in South Africa
summary: South Africa is facing an epidemic of armed copper theft, stripping copper from power stations, cables and rail infrastructure and damaging public assets. Authorities have struggled to contain the problem. At the same time, expanding green technologies such as electric vehicles, wind and solar is cited as boosting overseas copper demand.

title: Vietnam extends anti-dumping duties on some Chinese aluminum products to 2029
summary: Vietnam’s trade ministry extended anti-dumping duties on some Chinese-origin aluminum products until October 2029, with rates from 2.85% to 35.58%. The ministry said imports could harm Vietnam’s domestic industry if dumping measures lapsed, implying continued restriction of cheap aluminum inflows.

title: Export of copper ore and concentrates to China by Kyrgyzstan down 37%
summary: Kyrgyzstan’s exports of copper ore and concentrates to China fell 37% in the January–August 2024 period, according to Tazabek. The reduced shipment flow suggests less copper concentrate supply into the Chinese market, which can support expectations of tighter copper availability.

title: Cobre and BHP in Talks for Copper-Silver Exploration in Botswana
summary: Cobre and a BHP subsidiary have agreed to exclusively negotiate an earn-in joint venture to explore Cobre’s Kitlanya West and East copper-silver projects in Botswana. The deal follows BHP’s Xplor-funded seismic survey, with results expected end of the quarter. It targets potential Tier 1 discoveries but remains subject to approvals and paperwork.

title: Revised Development Plan for Kinusi Copper Mine | Company Announcement
summary: Marula Mining updated its Kinusi Copper Mine plan to use a two-phase processing route, aiming for LME-grade copper cathode. Open-pit activity starts in Q4 2024, with high-grade concentrate production planned for Q1 2025 and Phase 2 test work continuing into commissioning. The Board approved the plan.

title: Vietnam issues final review of anti-dumping measures on Chinese aluminum
summary: Vietnam’s Ministry of Industry and Trade has issued final results extending anti-dumping measures on Chinese-origin aluminum products for an additional five years. Duty rates range from 2.85% to 35.58%, following findings of dumping and harm to Vietnam’s domestic aluminum industry, likely reducing import competition and supporting prices.

title: PIVOT project aims for lighter cast aluminium
summary: The PIVOT project, backed by UK government funding, uses AI and casting simulation to create up to 30% lighter cast aluminium vehicle components, including designs based on 100% recycled aluminium. The stated goal is major reductions in embedded carbon. This may support aluminium demand expectations, though it is R&D-focused.

title: Breaking news: Aurubis keeps European copper premium offer at $228/t, unchanged for third year despite record low TCs
summary: Aurubis said its European refined copper premium stays unchanged at $228/t for 2025, despite record low concentrate treatment charges and expectations of a larger premium increase. Sources cited tight European supply but also weak local demand. The article also notes falling Grade A cathode premiums and sharply lower concentrate TCs.

title: Pacific Ridge Exploration Ltd.: Pacific Ridge Completes Inaugural Drill Program at the Chuchi Copper-Gold Project in B.C.; Intersects Copper Mineralization in Every Drill Hole
summary: Pacific Ridge Exploration completed its first drill program at the Chuchi copper-gold project in British Columbia, reporting copper mineralization (chalcopyrite-pyrite) in every diamond drill hole across a 750 m strike length at the BP Zone. Assays are pending, with potential for expansion at depth.

title: EV Parts and Copper Foil Maker Londian Wason to Launch New Facility in Malaysia
summary: Londian Wason, an electrolytic copper foil maker, signed an MOU to develop a high-end copper foil project in Malaysia’s Kuantan Industrial Park. The facility will produce copper foil for EV battery applications and copper clad laminates, supporting growing demand tied to EV and energy storage.

title: Vedanta becomes only aluminium producer to comply with government's quality control order
summary: India’s DPIIT has made BIS certification mandatory for aluminium wire rods, sheets, plates, and strips sold in the country, effective Thursday. Vedanta Aluminium says it is the first and only producer to receive BIS certification for products from BALCO and Jharsuguda facilities, implying tighter supply compliance for aluminium rolled goods.

title: Copper rallies above $10,000 | Regina Leader Post
summary: Copper rallied above US$10,000 on the LME, driven by China’s Politburo pledging real-estate stabilization and “forceful” rate cuts, plus a potential large capital injection into state banks. U.S. growth data also improved risk appetite. Aluminium rose about 2% alongside copper strength.

title: Comex Copper Settles 3.46% Higher at $4.5810 — Data Talk
summary: The only available information is the headline reporting that Comex copper futures settled up 3.46% at $4.5810. This points to bullish near-term price pressure in copper. However, the page content containing the underlying causes is missing, limiting confidence about specific drivers.

title: Materials Up as Copper Jumps on Chinese Stimulus Hopes -- Materials Roundup
summary: Producers of raw materials rallied as markets priced in potential further Chinese stimulus. Copper futures jumped 3.5% on Comex, the biggest gain since 2022, with strategists expecting follow-up fiscal measures in 2–4 weeks. A weaker U.S. dollar also supported broad risk appetite and commodity prices.

title: Vedanta Becomes The Only Aluminium Producer To Comply With Government's Quality Control Order For Wire Rods And Rolled Products
summary: India’s DPIIT mandate requires all aluminium wire rods and rolled products sold domestically to carry BIS certification starting September 26, 2024. Vedanta Aluminium says it is the first and only producer to receive BIS certification for these items. The regulation could limit near-term supply from non-compliant producers.

title: Geophysics unleashed for Pan Asia copper hunt in Chile
summary: Pan Asia Metals launched an induced-polarisation (IP) geophysical survey at its Rosario copper-silver project in Chile to map “manto-style” copper mineralisation ahead of maiden drilling. It also starts geochemical exploration, with about 27 line kilometres of DCIP planned before RC drilling later in the year.

title: Survey jags new copper-gold targets for Carnaby, Latitude 66
summary: Carnaby Resources reported results from a VTEM magnetic survey at the Greater Duchess copper-gold JV, identifying multiple new undrilled conductive targets and highlighting the Mohawk corridor with prior 21m at 2% copper. Management expects immediate drilling focus and possible resource expansion, but no near-term output change is provided.

title: Next Week At A Glance - 30 Sep-4 Oct 2024
summary: Next Week At A Glance highlights broad material-sector support from PBOC stimulus, but the only direct industrial-metals link is Nickel Industries buying a 51% stake in Indonesia’s Siduarsi nickel-cobalt project. This can marginally lift near-term nickel supply expectations, supporting prices modestly.

title: Copper foil maker Londian Wason to launch new Malaysia facility
summary: Londian Wason plans to launch a new Malaysia facility in the Malaysia-China Kuantan Industrial Park to produce high-end electrolytic copper foils for EV batteries and copper clad laminates. The move supports Southeast Asian EV supply expansion and suggests increased copper-related production and demand activity.

title: Mining industry struggles with valuation gap amid shift to copper
summary: Reuters reports mining companies are struggling to pay premiums for pure-play copper assets as copper demand expectations keep valuations elevated. It cites robust outlook tied to EV and data-center/AI demand, while noting benchmark copper has recently pulled back from record highs. The sentiment remains supportive for copper.

title: In Indonesia's Sulawesi, the promise of a nickel boom comes at a cost for local farmers
summary: Villagers in Indonesia’s Sulawesi protest nickel exploration and HPAL smelting operations, citing land loss, environmental and safety concerns, and potential livelihood disruption. The story links Indonesia’s expanding nickel supply—including HPAL smelters—to persistent oversupply and weak price outlooks, implying bearish near-term sentiment for nickel.

title: Business Brief: The true price of Indonesia's nickel boom
summary: The article investigates Indonesia’s nickel industry in Sulawesi, visiting nickel mines, smelters and local communities. It describes environmental pollution from mining and coal-powered smelting, unsafe working conditions, and alleged illegal land seizures. The narrative links the nickel boom’s social and environmental risks to potential challenges for nickel production and costs.

title: Novelis sets carbon reduction and 75% recycled aluminium targets
summary: Novelis’ “3x30” initiative targets 75% recycled content and lower CO2 intensity for flat-rolled aluminium by 2030, alongside investments in circularity. It also cites record recycled-content levels, 2.3 million tons recycled in 2023, and plant upgrades to handle contaminated scrap, supporting aluminium demand for low-carbon metal.

title: Schneider Electric, Glencore partner to decarbonise copper supply chain
summary: Schneider Electric partnered with Glencore to decarbonise the copper supply chain, improve procurement standards for low-emission capital equipment, and explore greater recycled copper content and closed-loop solutions. The firms also plan enhanced energy monitoring and electrification services for Glencore’s raw material supply, aiming to lower emissions rather than change near-term output.

title: FireFly secures A$65m to fund Canada copper project
summary: FireFly Metals raised A$65m via a share placement to fund an expanded drilling and exploration program at its Green Bay copper-gold project in Canada. The company plans additional 100,000m of drilling, supported by underground access upgrades and new geophysical targets. The deal supports future copper supply expectations but not immediate production changes.

title: Panama Eyes Export of First Quantum's Stockpiled Copper
summary: Panama is reportedly considering exporting the first batch of First Quantum’s copper that is already stockpiled. If exports restart or increase soon, it can improve near-term supply flow visibility and support market sentiment for copper prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Gov. Ivey announces $100M investment in Aluminum Forging Operation in Auburn
summary: Governor Ivey announced ILJIN’s nearly $100 million expansion in Auburn to begin producing forged aluminum control arms. The shift from steel to aluminum components is expected to strengthen and lighten vehicles, with raw forgings sent to ILJIN’s South Carolina plant for final processing.

title: Interpretation of Aluminum Industry-Related Content in the "Guidelines for Equipment Renewal and Technological Transformation in Key Industrial Sectors"
summary: China’s MIIT issued guidelines for equipment renewal in key sectors, including aluminum. The plan targets major energy/carbon efficiency improvements by 2027 and calls for phasing out prebaked anode electrolytic cells below 200 kA, subject to capacity replacement rules. The affected capacity share is small, implying limited short-term supply shock.

title: Koryx attracts N$128m for Namibian and Zambian copper projects
summary: Canadian firm Koryx Copper secured C$10 million for its Haib copper project in Namibia and additional funds for Zambia’s Luanshya West and Mpongwe projects. The raise supports PEA-stage development and exploration, but it doesn’t indicate immediate production or supply disruptions that would likely affect copper prices in the near term.

title: The high-nickel pig iron market is sluggish; the supply-demand imbalance continues to affect price trends
summary: High-nickel pig iron prices fell week-on-week to 975.2 yuan per nickel point amid smelter profit inversions that discourage higher output and weak stainless steel restocking ahead of the National Day holiday. Demand remains soft and inventories do not rebound. The piece expects nickel-related raw material prices to stay under pressure.

title: Canada GDP's slight growth, Vancouver's grain terminal strike and Indonesia's nickel boom: Business and investing news for Sept. 29
summary: The news digest highlights “Indonesia’s nickel boom,” noting the country’s large share of global nickel output and ongoing exploration by mining companies on Sulawesi, alongside smelter and community impacts. These developments support market expectations around nickel supply and battery-related demand. Other stories focus on Canada macro and a grain-terminal strike.

title: Strong copper visuals for Pan Asia at Chilean play
summary: Pan Asia Metals reports promising early “visual” copper indications at its Rosario project in Chile, including malachite mineralisation from soil and rock-chip sampling and new induced-polarisation surveys. Results are pending lab confirmation, with follow-on drilling planned later, keeping the near-term impact on copper prices limited.

title: BT Get £105m for First Sale of Old UK Copper Telecoms Cables
summary: BT said it received £105m as the first upfront prepayment under a forward agreement to sell copper granules made from leftover UK copper telecom cables. The copper comes from exchange clearance as BT/Openreach replace copper with fibre, with a multi-year target of recovering up to 200,000 tonnes through the 2030s.

title: Explainer: China's carbon market to cover steel, aluminium and cement in 2024 | News | Eco-Business
summary: China’s ETS is set to expand in 2024 to cover aluminium (plus steel and cement), raising covered emissions to 60%. New sectors will initially receive free allowances with no overall cap, while analysts warn the system’s intensity focus and allowance oversupply may limit carbon-price strength, so aluminium price impact appears muted.

title: BHP expects copper demand to grow by 1 million metric tons a year until 2035
summary: BHP forecasts global copper demand to increase by an additional 1 million metric tons per year on average until 2035, supported by copper-intensive technologies in energy transition and digital sectors. It also flags constrained supply due to declining ore grades and higher costs, implying tighter fundamentals.

title: Kincora Copper Announces Mongolian Earn-In Finalised with Drilling to Commence
summary: Kincora Copper finalized an earn-in and joint venture with Woomera for its Bronze Fox copper-gold project in Mongolia, enabling up to $4m spend for an 80% interest. Drilling is set to begin with a 2,250–3,250m program and a second mining license application, targeting resource expansion.

title: Exclusive-Copper output at Freeport's Manyar smelter delayed until November
summary: Freeport’s Manyar copper smelter in Indonesia will not deliver initial output until November after water and steam leakage issues during startup tests. The delay may reduce near-term refined copper supply expectations. Manyar was expected to begin in September, with samples for client testing in October.

title: Study Group has a sobering message for copper bulls: Andy Home
summary: Copper surged on hopes of China stimulus and tightening Shanghai stocks, but Reuters warns the fundamentals point to ample supply. The ICSG projects large global surpluses for 2024-2025 and forecasts rising mine and refined output. Exchange stocks are high and contango persists, indicating no immediate copper shortage.

title: Kamoto Copper reportedly owes €800m in royalties
summary: The DRC government reportedly says Kamoto Copper owes about €800m in unpaid royalties/taxes and is investigating the company’s accounts. Authorities previously froze local bank accounts and sealed Kamoto’s warehouse tied to metal storage/export, though production was reportedly uninterrupted. The dispute raises near-term copper shipment and supply risk.

title: Bonnell Aluminum Commenting on Final Determinations in Trade Cases on Aluminum Extrusions from 14 Countries
summary: Bonnell Aluminum said it is pleased with the U.S. Department of Commerce’s final determinations that impose anti-dumping and countervailing duties on aluminum extrusion imports from 14 countries. The decision is expected to reduce unfairly traded imports and support pricing for aluminum extrusion products.

title: Metso inks equipment deal with major copper mine
summary: Metso secured a large equipment order from Barrick Gold for expansion work at the Lumwana copper mine in Zambia, supplying equipment for grinding, flotation, thickening, feeding and filtration for a concentrator plant. Lumwana is projected to reach about 240,000 tonnes of copper per year, supporting bullish copper sentiment.

title: Noronex unleashes drill rig for Namibian copper hunt
summary: Noronex started a 5,000m reverse-circulation drilling program at its Fiesta copper project in Namibia to test several mineralised shear zones. The company cites strong historical copper intercepts and will later move the rig to its Damara project, funded via a South32-linked JV/earn-in.

title: Power Nickel Announces New Assay Results from its Polymetallic Lion Zone Discovery
summary: Power Nickel announced assay results from the first five holes of its summer 2024 drilling at the polymetallic Lion Zone discovery. Reported intervals range from about 5–12 metres with copper-equivalent grades between 2.36% and 5.93%, which may strengthen expectations for future nickel and copper resource development.

title: Power Nickel Announces New Assay Results From Its Polymetallic Lion Zone Discovery
summary: Power Nickel reported assay results from the Lion Zone discovery, including multiple copper- and nickel-bearing intercepts (e.g., several meters of %Cu and sub-% Ni, plus CuEq). While positive drill results can support sentiment for future nickel and copper supply, the impact is likely small given the exploration stage.

title: Tsingshan cuts Indonesian nickel output due to tight ore supplies - Companies
summary: Tsingshan cut Indonesia ferronickel (nickel pig iron) output due to persistent nickel ore shortages linked to delays in mining quota approvals. Nickel production costs rose and some furnaces reportedly switched to other output. Philippine ore prices jumped sharply, while Chinese NPI prices rose only modestly, implying bearish near-term nickel sentiment.

title: Australia's copper production set for decline in 2024, recovery expected by 2025
summary: Australia’s copper production is expected to fall 4.7% in 2024 to 765.7 kt, driven by closures of Sandfire’s DeGrussa and Monty and lower output from several Glencore and Newmont mines. Some restarts and modest increases won’t prevent the aggregate decline. Recovery is expected in 2025 from new projects.

title: Global copper production to grow by 3.2% in 2024, supported by key expansions
summary: Global copper production is forecast to rise 3.2% in 2024 to a record 22.9 million tonnes, supported by expansions and ramp-ups across major producers including Chile (Quebrada Blanca), the DRC (Tenke Fungurume, Kamoa-Kakula), and Russia (Ak-Sug, Udokan), along with growth in China and Zambia.

title: QC Copper and Gold Inc: QC Copper Announces Strategic Acquisition of Cuprum Corp.
summary: QC Copper announced an all-share acquisition of Cuprum, adding the Thierry Copper Project and increasing its copper resource base. The Thierry asset historically produced copper and contains minor nickel, with references to past concentrate shipments. The deal is positioned for future development, not immediate production or supply changes.

title: Orecap Invest Corp.: Orecap's Ownership of Cuprum to be Acquired by QC Copper & Gold
summary: Orecap announced QC Copper’s offer to acquire Cuprum in an all-share deal, adding the Thierry copper project and increasing QC Copper’s copper resource base. The transaction, expected to close by end-December 2024, strengthens Canada’s copper developer footprint. Thierry also historically produced concentrate with minor nickel content.

title: Copper Fox Metals Inc.: Copper Fox Retains Stantec to Complete Strategic Review and Hydrology Characterization of Van Dyke Project
summary: Copper Fox announced it retained Stantec to complete a hydrogeology characterization and conceptual site model for its Van Dyke ISCR oxide copper project in Arizona. The work reviews historical data, updates groundwater requirements, and supports advancement toward a preliminary feasibility study, but no immediate production or supply change is stated.

title: Metso to supply equipment for Barrick's Zambia copper project expansion
summary: Metso was awarded an ~€70m contract to supply process equipment for Barrick Gold’s Lumwana copper project expansion in Zambia. The scope covers grinding, flotation, thickening, feeding and filtration. The expansion is positioned to boost Lumwana’s copper output, supporting sentiment for copper supply growth, despite longer construction timelines.

title: Copper demand to increase by 1mt a year until 2035, says BHP
summary: BHP said the energy transition should lift copper demand by about 1 million tonnes per year until 2035, with demand growth expectations rising over time. It also flags supply challenges from falling ore grades and rising production costs, implying a future supply deficit that could support copper prices.

title: Buy US-Listed Casino and Copper Stocks After China Stimulus: Trivariate
summary: Trivariate Research says China’s aggressive stimulus announced in late September has been incrementally bullish for US equities, citing stronger moves in US-listed copper stocks such as Freeport-McMoRan and Southern Copper. The stimulus is intended to support weak Chinese demand and property activity, potentially lifting copper expectations.

title: Canada could offer relief from tariffs on imported China steel, aluminum
summary: Canada’s Finance Minister said Ottawa could implement a framework to consider requests for tariff relief from a 25% surtax on imported Chinese steel and aluminum due Oct 22. The government is responding to stakeholder concerns about adjustment time, with details to be released later.

title: Canada to impose surtax on Chinese-made steel, aluminum products
summary: Canada will impose a 25% surtax on selected Chinese-made steel and aluminum products. The aluminum component can increase the cost competitiveness of Chinese imports versus domestic supply, tightening near-term availability and supporting aluminium price expectations over coming weeks.

title: Canada to Consider Tariff Relief on 25% Surtax Targeting China-Made Steel, Aluminum
summary: Canada plans to implement a 25% surtax on certain steel and aluminum products from China on Oct. 22, while considering tariff relief where alternative supply is in short demand. The move follows a same-day 100% surtax on Chinese-made electric vehicles. Trade barriers may tighten aluminum availability and support prices.

title: Canada to Hit Chinese Steel and Aluminum With Tariffs on Oct. 22
summary: The report headlines that Canada plans to impose tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum starting Oct. 22. By restricting Chinese aluminum imports, the measure could reduce near-term availability and shift demand toward alternative suppliers, potentially lifting aluminum price expectations in the coming days.

title: PA Resources gets 0% dumping rate from US for aluminium extrusion exports
summary: PA Resources said the US Commerce Department granted it a 0% dumping rate for aluminium extrusion exports after anti-dumping proceedings. The ruling means the products are considered fairly priced and face no extra tariffs in the US, improving competitiveness and potentially supporting aluminium extrusion demand and pricing expectations.

title: Canada to hit Chinese steel and aluminum with 25% tariffs
summary: Canada will impose 25% tariffs on a wide range of Chinese steel and aluminum items starting Oct. 22, citing China’s overcapacity and protecting domestic producers. Goods already in transit on the start date are exempt. The policy is framed as aligning with allied trade actions against Chinese industrial supply.

title: Capstone Copper Corp.: Capstone Copper Announces Achievement of Commercial Production at MVDP and Outlines Leadership Succession Plan
summary: Capstone Copper says its Mantoverde Development Project achieved commercial production, defined by 30 consecutive days at 75% of nameplate throughput, with in-line concentrate grade and recoveries. It expects Q4 to be the strongest quarter and shows 2024 production near the low end while C1 costs run slightly above guidance.

title: Capstone Copper Corp.: Capstone Announces Mantoverde Optimized Feasibility Study
summary: Capstone Copper reported results of an optimized feasibility study for its Mantoverde brownfield expansion in Chile, including debottlenecking to raise sulphide concentrator throughput and add ~20,000 tonnes per annum of incremental copper for $146 million. The plan targets low C1 cash costs and follows recent commercial production startup.

title: Capstone Copper Announces Achievement of Commercial Production at MVDP and Outlines Leadership Succession Plan
summary: Capstone Copper said its Mantoverde Development Project reached commercial production after achieving 30 consecutive days of mill operation at 75% of nameplate throughput. The firm expects Q4 to be the strongest quarter, while 2024 output trends toward the low end of guidance and C1 costs are slightly higher.

title: Nearctic Nickel Mines Inc. Divests All Interest in Ungava Mines Inc.
summary: Nearctic Nickel Mines Inc. announced it has divested all remaining interest in Ungava Mines Inc., ending its indirect interest in UMEI. UMEI is a plaintiff in an ongoing action against the Quebec government alleging disguised expropriation. The update mainly changes company exposure, not disclosed nickel output or timing.

title: Panamanian Government Seeks to Export Copper Stored at First Quantum – Newsroom Panama
summary: Panama’s government is seeking an environmental assessment to determine the amount and extraction timing of copper concentrate stored at First Quantum’s dormant mine. Officials said copper can’t remain indefinitely and they may pursue export after due diligence. The mine was idle after a court ruling, affecting revenues and growth, and the company is in arbitration.

title: BHP's nickel drop: Could Nico Resources rise to the occasion?
summary: BHP said it will temporarily suspend Nickel West operations due to global nickel oversupply and high costs, which has pressured nickel prices. The piece argues the event could benefit Nico Resources’ Wingellina project via lower competitive pressure and investor attention, but impact on near-term nickel tightness is unclear.

title: Norris McDonald | Bauxite, health, the Cockpit Country and the Maroons' justice fight | Commentary
summary: The commentary says Jamaica’s Cockpit Country contains Jamaica’s last proven bauxite reserves and describes a new protected-area designation after long Maroon opposition. It argues bauxite/alumina mining harmed health and the environment and questions whether mining areas are included, implying potential supply disruption and downside risk for aluminium.

title: Danske predicts improved copper grades at Boliden's Aitik after six years of declining grades
summary: Danske Bank says Boliden’s 2025 guidance for copper grades at the Aitik open pit mine will be key at the Oct. 22 Q3 report. After grades fell from 0.29% (2018) to 0.17% recently, Danske expects a 0.18% grade in 2025, signaling an improved multi-year cycle. Bullish outlook.

title: Exuberant iron ore, subdued copper show different sides of China stimulus
summary: China’s stimulus (lower rates, easier home purchases) sparked a strong sentiment-driven rally in iron ore, but copper reacted more modestly. Shanghai copper rose 1.8% and London copper stayed near pre-stimulus levels and below a recent four-month high, reflecting cautious expectations for global demand.

title: LME monitors tightness in aluminium market after spike in spread
summary: LME is monitoring tightness after the aluminium October contract premium vs November surged to about $18/ton. One trader holds a large long position in October while most nearby inventory is concentrated in Port Klang. Higher ISTIM re-warrant/cancellation fees could deter delivery, raising prospects of short-covering and sharp price moves near expiry.

title: UKEF guarantees €12.6m loan for Uzbekistan's largest copper producer
summary: UK Export Finance guaranteed a €12.6m loan to Uzbekistan’s Almalyk to refinance automated machinery purchases from Weir, supporting ongoing operations and exports tied to Almalyk’s copper facility. The deal is the first UKEF transaction in Uzbekistan and complements Almalyk’s planned expansion to raise copper cathode output.

title: Canada Nickel Begins Submission of Federal Impact Statement for Crawford Nickel Sulphide Project
summary: Canada Nickel says it has started submitting the federal Impact Statement for its Crawford nickel sulphide project and expects to complete it within six weeks, targeting permits in 2025. The company frames the process as advancing permitting progress. This can modestly support near-term nickel market sentiment via improved supply outlook.

title: Ero Copper Announces Initial NI 43-101 Mineral Resource
summary: Ero Copper reported an initial NI 43-101 mineral resource for its Furnas copper-gold project in Brazil, including indicated and inferred copper grades and planned 28,000 meters of Phase 1 drilling after receiving permits. The news is about resource definition rather than near-term output changes.

title: Prairie Operating Gets Output, Acreage Boost from Nickel Road M&A
summary: Prairie Operating reportedly gained additional production and increased acreage via a Nickel Road M&A transaction. The update points to improved nickel resource access and/or output potential. In the near term, incremental supply expectations can weigh on nickel pricing, with no clear information here affecting copper or aluminium.

title: International Copper Association Appoints New Chairman, Glencore's Stephen Rowland
summary: The International Copper Association (ICA) appointed Glencore executive Stephen Rowland as its board chair and outlined a new strategic plan emphasizing sustainability, circularity, carbon footprint and market intelligence to defend copper demand. Glencore described net-zero plans by 2050. No near-term copper production, trade, or pricing actions were announced.

title: Strategic Sale of Cangai Copper Mine  | Company Announcement
summary: Castillo Copper Limited announced a conditional agreement to sell its Cangai Copper Mine tenements in northern New South Wales to Infinity Mining, receiving IMI shares and options. The deal is subject to due diligence, approvals, and royalty arrangements, mainly reallocating development ownership rather than changing copper supply quickly.

title: Power Nickel Announces Biggest Intersection Yet - Major Advancements At The Lion Zone!
summary: Power Nickel released new drill assay results from the Lion Zone at its Nisk property, highlighting longer and higher-grade intersections with notable nickel and copper grades. The company says the discovery appears substantially bigger than previously envisioned, improving confidence in mineral continuity and supporting expectations for future Ni-Cu supply.

title: Power Nickel Announces Biggest Intersection Yet - Major Advancements at the Lion Zone!
summary: Power Nickel reported assay results from three additional drill holes at its Lion Zone polymetallic discovery. Hole 70 returned 32m of 0.18% Ni plus 3.62% Cu and other metals, alongside additional Au and Ag. The update strengthens the perceived resource potential and is mildly supportive for nickel and copper sentiment.

title: Grid Metals Corp.: Grid Outlines 4 km Copper 'Corridor' at the MM Copper/Nickel Project; Prepares to Commence Drilling
summary: Grid Metals outlines 4 km of copper-dominant mineralization with associated nickel at its MM copper/nickel project’s Eagle gabbro target in Manitoba. The company plans inaugural drilling and additional geophysical surveys. It provides grab-sample grades but no new resource estimate or production impacts.

title: Grid Metals Corp.: Grid Outlines 4 km Copper 'Corridor' at the MM Copper/Nickel Project; Prepares to Commence Drilling
summary: Grid Metals reported surface copper/nickel mineralization along a ~4 km Eagle gabbro corridor at its MM project in Manitoba, with grades up to 1.3% Cu and associated nickel/cobalt/PGM values. The company plans geophysical work and inaugural drilling this fall after permits, but no production or supply changes were announced.

title: Granite Creek Copper Ltd.: Granite Creek Copper Discovers New Zone in 2024 Drilling at Carmacks Copper-Gold-Silver Project in Yukon, Canada
summary: Granite Creek Copper reports discovery of a new “Gap Zone” at its Carmacks copper-gold-silver project in Yukon, with copper mineralization in 3 of 4 holes and results pending from sampled sections. The company suggests potential to expand resources and mine life, but this is exploration news without immediate supply impact.

title: Granite Creek Copper Discovers New Zone in 2024 Drilling at Carmacks ...
summary: Granite Creek Copper reports discovering a new zone during 2024 drilling at its Carmacks property. The update can be read as improving prospects for potential future copper resources. Because the release provides no detail on deposit size, grades, or timing to production, any immediate copper price impact is likely limited.

title: Battery Mineral Resources Corp.: Battery Mineral Resources Announces Encouraging Drill Results from Its Punitaqui Copper Mine in Chile
summary: Battery Mineral Resources announced encouraging 2024 underground drill intercepts at its Punitaqui/Cinabrio copper mine in Chile, including multiple intervals grading between roughly 0.65% and 2.6% Cu (with silver). Management says results confirm copper grade and better delineate mineralization within planned production areas.

title: Alro Slatina Commissions New Aluminium Cutting Facility In Wake Of RON13.7M
summary: ALRO opened a new aluminium processing (cutting) facility, CUTSMART SYSTEMS, following a RON13.7M investment. The move is aimed at diversifying processing capabilities and expanding production support. While it may modestly affect aluminium supply/demand expectations, the article lacks volume or market-wide implications.

title: Copper concentrates dislocation likely to mean smelter cuts, Codelco chair says: LME Week
summary: Codelco chair Maximo Pacheco says a dislocation in the copper concentrates market—lower concentrate availability and smelter capacity excess—could lead to smelter closures tied to spot market exposure. He notes spot copper concentrate treatment charges rose to very low levels/volatility and benchmark talks are ongoing for 2025.

title: Codelco's copper premium contract talks ongoing, chairman says: LME Week
summary: Codelco’s chairman said no copper premium number will be issued this week as contract talks with customers continue. The story references prior Codelco premium levels and notes stable European and US cathode premium assessments. It also points to firmer physical demand signals (Chinese stimulus, falling inventories), but premiums remain largely unchanged.

title: Copper Falls on Geopolitical Tensions, Firmer Dollar, China Stimulus Doubts
summary: Copper prices fell on geopolitical tensions, a stronger US dollar, and doubts about when China’s stimulus would translate into physical demand. LME three-month copper dropped 1.8% to about $9,906/ton, after rising the prior session, indicating near-term risk to demand sentiment.

title: Comex Copper Settles 2.05% Lower at $4.5020 — Data Talk
summary: Comex copper reportedly settled 2.05% lower at $4.5020. The move suggests immediate bearish sentiment toward copper futures, reflecting weaker price action into the settlement rather than a neutral or bullish development.

title: Romanian aluminium producer Alro invests EUR 2.7 mn in new facility
summary: Romanian aluminium producer Alro has begun operations of a new aluminium processing facility after a EUR 2.7mn investment, aimed at high-precision cutting and broader product offerings via Cutsmart Systems. The company says it improves efficiency and can reduce CO2 via optimized transportation and exact metal quantities, but the scale suggests limited near-term price impact.

title: Castillo Copper to divest Cangai Copper Mine in NSW to Infinity Mining
summary: Castillo Copper announced a conditional sale of Cangai Copper Mine tenement licences in New South Wales to Infinity Mining. The transaction requires sale agreements, capital raising, and shareholder/regulatory approvals, with royalty interests transferred and Castillo receiving equity in Infinity. It supports Castillo’s shift toward its NWQ copper project.

title: Metal Energy Corp.: Metal Energy Announces Acquisition of Highland Valley Copper Project
summary: Metal Energy Corp. announced an arm’s-length deal to acquire 100% of the Highland Valley Copper Project in British Columbia from Happy Creek. The property is copper-silver-molybdenum mineralized and permitted for drilling, with a planned exploration spend ahead of year-end, but no immediate production impact is stated.

title: Lifezone Metals and JOGMEC sign MOU for nickel supply in Japan
summary: Lifezone Metals signed an MOU with JOGMEC to supply nickel from the Kabanga Nickel Project in Tanzania to Japanese battery demand. The arrangement supports JOGMEC’s acquisition of cleaner metals and references hydromet refining at Kahama. It signals incremental nickel supply visibility, with a likely supportive tone for nickel prices.

title: ALRO opens new aluminium cutting facility
summary: ALRO opened a new precision aluminium cutting facility (Cutsmart Systems) after a RON 13.7 million investment. The company says the plant improves efficiency and reduces CO2 emissions via optimized transportation and ordering exact quantities. The move expands ALRO’s processing capabilities and product tailoring for customer needs.

title: Secular demand trends may help reduce copper's cyclicality, Freeport CEO says: LME Week
summary: Freeport CEO Andrea Quirk says the medium/long-term copper outlook is positive and short-term price action is sentiment-driven. She cites China stimulus and US rate cuts for improving sentiment and supporting LME copper prices. Demand drivers remain strong, mine supply growth is limited, and copper-to-aluminium substitution is expected to be small (1–2%).

title: Freeport shifts away from marketing copper concentrates as new smelter ramps up, CEO says: LME Week
summary: Freeport says it will shift from marketing copper concentrates to marketing cathodes as its new Gresik smelter ramps up. The timing coincides with tight copper concentrate supplies, worsened by Cobre Panama’s closure. Copper concentrate treatment charges rose to about $2/tonne, signaling feed constraints that can support copper.

title: Northstar and Novamera to 'surgically mine' Cam Copper site in Ontario
summary: Northstar Gold and Novamera signed an MOU to test and develop potential copper at the Cam Copper site in Ontario using “surgical mining.” Work includes 3D modeling, calibration, permitting, and environmental assessment, with later extraction dependent on external funding. The initiative is copper-focused but exploratory, not immediate supply.

title: Solis Minerals Ltd.: Solis Expands Peruvian Copper Exploration Portfolio with Canyon Project
summary: Solis Minerals applied for 27 exploration concessions (25,600Ha) for the Canyon Project in Peru’s Coastal Batholith, targeting porphyry copper mineralisation with planned reconnaissance and drilling near year end. The release focuses on early-stage exploration and potential near-surface heap-leachable copper oxides, not production or supply disruption.

title: Kavango says Karakubis Copper Project test results promising
summary: Kavango Resources said Phase 1 drilling at its Karakubis Copper Project in Botswana produced promising stratigraphic results, including evidence of structural trap sites and significant hydrothermal alteration. Copper-bearing mineralisation was confirmed across five holes, prompting additional geophysical surveying and future drill targeting, but no production timelines were given.

title: Residents of Marbel Stage Protest Rally and Filed a Special Civil Action against Tampakan Copper-Gold Project
summary: Residents of Marbel protested and filed a petition to block the 12-year FTAA extension for the Tampakan copper-gold project, arguing constitutional and consultation violations and environmental risks. However, sources say the mine is still expected to become fully operational next year, limiting immediate copper supply disruption expectations.

title: Power interruption planned for Copper Cliff on Oct. 11
summary: Greater Sudbury Hydro announced a scheduled power outage in Copper Cliff on Oct. 11 from 12:30 a.m. to 4:30 a.m., affecting 1,245 customers. The utility said the interruption is for essential maintenance and offered safety guidance. No direct copper production impact is stated.

title: BHP's decision to shutter Nickel West will reverberate through Kalgoorlie-Boulder
summary: BHP plans to shutter its Nickel West division and put the Kalgoorlie Nickel Smelter on care and maintenance, standing down most workers as the flash furnace nears extinguishing. The article attributes past weakness to cheaper Indonesian nickel flooding the market, reinforcing near-term nickel supply concerns.

title: Copper Mine Bidding War: A Race to Control Jharkhand's Copper Resources
summary: Hindalco and JSW Steel plan to bid for two copper mines in Jharkhand owned by Hindustan Copper Ltd, with the auction scheduled for this month. The mines could support higher domestic output, while Hindustan Copper pursues lease extensions, forestry clearances, and underground development to expand production capacity.

title: Hindustan Copper Limited Announces Resumption of Surda Mine Operations
summary: Hindustan Copper Limited said it has resumed Surda mine operations and highlighted plans to raise Surda’s capacity from 0.4 mtpa to 0.9 mtpa over seven years. Jharkhand cabinet approvals also support reopening Kendadih and Rakha mines, increasing domestic copper production and supply expectations.

title: Ero Copper Reports Temporary Power Disruption at the Tucumã
summary: Ero Copper reported a temporary power outage at its Tucumã copper operation in Brazil after a windstorm damaged the regional grid. Processing circuits were affected while mining/crushing continued, with industrial power expected to be fully restored within two weeks. The company expects main impact on processing ramp-up and full-year results.

title: Kavango, ENRG jag 32 per cent Kalahari copper in Botswana
summary: Kavango Resources and ENRG report very strong early drilling results at the Karakubis copper project in Botswana’s Kalahari Copper Belt, including bornite and chalcopyrite hits with high copper readings. The JV is continuing with geophysical and electromagnetic surveys alongside further diamond drilling, indicating promising potential for a large discovery.

title: Hedge fund Elliott loses appeal against dismissal of LME nickel lawsuit
summary: Elliott Associates lost its appeal against dismissal of its lawsuit against the LME over billions of dollars of cancelled nickel trades. The LME annulled $12 billion in nickel trades in March 2022 after a record price spike. The Court of Appeal upheld that the LME acted lawfully in cancelling to prevent a “death spiral.”

title: Copper demand for electric vehicles is intact, trader IXM says
summary: Trader IXM said copper demand tied to electric vehicles is intact. The message implies ongoing consumption support for copper, reducing downside fears about EV-related demand weakening in the near term. That view is typically supportive for copper sentiment as markets look for evidence of steady end-user demand.

title: London Market Today - Elliott Loses UK Appeal Over LME's Nickel Market Shutdown
summary: Elliott Investment Management’s UK appeal was rejected after the LME halted a runaway short squeeze in the nickel market. The decision follows the exchange’s controversial move to stop squeeze-driven volatility. Such regulatory intervention can cool speculative pressure and weigh on nickel prices near term.

title: Russia's Rusal plans to double Siberian plant output by 2030
summary: Rusal plans to double capacity at the Boguchansky aluminium smelter in Krasnoyarsk to 600,000 tonnes by the end of the decade, with construction on additional work scheduled to begin in 2025. The move could add to long-term supply expectations, though near-term output changes are limited.

title: Elliott Loses UK Appeal Over LME's Nickel Market Shutdown – BNN Bloomberg
summary: BNN Bloomberg reports that Elliott has lost a UK appeal over the LME’s nickel market shutdown. The decision highlights ongoing issues around trading or settlement of nickel on the exchange, which can worsen near-term supply/availability expectations and pressure nickel prices over coming sessions.

title: Camino Minerals Corp: Camino, Nittetsu and Denham Capital Sign Definitive Agreement for Acquisition of the Puquios Copper Project in Chile
summary: Camino Minerals, with Nittetsu, signed a definitive agreement to acquire the Puquios copper project in Chile, a construction-ready SXEW copper heap leach asset with permits and infrastructure. The deal includes cash and share consideration plus financing for working capital, potentially supporting near-term copper development and future supply expectations.

title: Low-Carbon Aluminium Premium Launch: Green Metal Market
summary: Argus will launch a European monthly upcharge for low-carbon aluminium to reflect payment structures for lower-emission metal as manufacturers seek greener inputs. The move formalizes trading of sustainability-linked premiums, suggesting increased willingness to pay for low-carbon supply and supporting higher aluminium premium expectations in the coming weeks.

title: Production of copper concentrate in Armenia grew by 11.4% in 8 months
summary: Armenia’s copper concentrate production increased 11.4% year-on-year to 202,087.6 tonnes in January–August 2024, according to the national statistical committee. The same report notes zinc and molybdenum concentrate changes, but the copper output rise suggests improved near-term supply conditions for copper.

title: Aurwest Resources Corporation: Aurwest Enters Purchase & Sale Agreement for Sale of Stars Porphyry Copper-Moly Project
summary: Aurwest Resources will sell its 100% interest in the Stars porphyry copper-molybdenum project in British Columbia to Interra Copper for C$250,000 plus Interra shares and warrants. The acquisition is subject to approvals and includes a 2% NSR. It mainly reflects ongoing exploration financing, not near-term copper supply changes.

title: Court of Appeal dismisses challenge against London Metal Exchange nickel ruling
summary: A Court of Appeal upheld the LME’s decision to suspend and cancel nickel trades in March 2022 after a dramatic price spike. The court said the LME acted lawfully to prevent a potential “death spiral.” The article notes nickel’s importance to stainless and batteries, but the judgment is retrospective.

title: Ero Copper : to Release Third Quarter 2024 Operating and Financial Results on November 5, 2024 Form 6 K
summary: Ero Copper Corp. announced it will release its third-quarter 2024 operating and financial results on Nov. 5, 2024 and hold a conference call on Nov. 6. The statement is a routine investor-relations update and includes company background, but no new production, guidance, or market-moving data for copper.

title: Recycling old cables could help provide copper needed for green tech – study
summary: A study for the Recycle Your Electricals campaign estimates UK households hold hundreds of millions of unused/binned cables containing tens of thousands of tonnes of copper. Researchers and the Royal Society of Chemistry warn of potential supply constraints for copper in wind and solar, urging more recycling to boost secondary supply.

title: Britons urged to dig out unwanted electricals to tackle copper shortage
summary: Britons are urged to recycle unwanted electricals to unlock “urban mining” copper contained in unused cables and chargers. The study estimates large hidden copper volumes in UK e-waste and argues recycling could help offset rising demand from renewables and EVs. Copper shortages are projected, but near-term effects look limited.

title: Copper wire thieves hit streetlights, impacting Las Vegas residents on busy road
summary: Las Vegas residents report prolonged streetlight outages after thieves stole copper wire from light poles. The county confirms copper-wire theft caused the failures and says nearly 1 million feet of wiring were stolen since 2022, replacing over $1.5 million of copper wiring, with about 200 repair sites still pending.

title: Chakana Copper Corp.: Chakana Relinquishes Condor Concessions, Soledad Project, Peru
summary: Chakana Copper Corp. relinquishes its option to acquire the Condor concessions that make up about 25% of its expanded Soledad copper-gold-silver project in Peru. The decision follows inability to agree on a buyout price amid outstanding property payments. Permits will be cancelled and Condor would need new permitting if proceeding.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel Intersects 3 New Zones of Mineralization on the Carlang Trend Including Highest Nickel Grades to Date & Significantly Extends Strike Length by 7km
summary: EV Nickel reported maiden drilling results at the CarLang trend, intersecting near-surface nickel mineralization in new zones (B, C and E) over more than 7 km of strike. CarLang C delivered the highest grades to date, including up to 0.96% Ni over short intervals, extending the potential resource footprint.

title: Copper Fox Retains Quantec to Complete Geophysical Survey on Sombrero Butte Porphyry Copper Project
summary: Copper Fox Metals said it retained Quantec to run a deep penetrating DCIP and MT geophysical survey on its Sombrero Butte porphyry copper project in Arizona, aiming to advance toward drill-ready targets. Work is budgeted at about US$300,000 and planned to start mid-October, contingent on Phase I results.

title: E waste could help close net zero copper gap
summary: A study estimates UK households hold about 38,449 tonnes of copper in discarded electricals, while UK copper use is ~250,000 tonnes per year and expected to rise with electrification. Bloomberg Intelligence projects a global copper shortfall by 2033 and warns new supply is slow, boosting recycling relevance for future tightness.

title: First Atlantic Nickel Commences Drilling at Atlantic Nickel
summary: First Atlantic Nickel Corp. began core drilling at its Atlantic Nickel Project in Newfoundland after summer sampling expanded visible awaruite (a naturally occurring nickel-iron alloy) targets along a 30 km trend. The company aims to test new, widely spaced nickel targets, with results pending, implying limited immediate market impact.

title: Grid Battery Metals highlights new copper acquisition and 2024 exploration plans
summary: Grid Battery Metals announced it acquired a large copper land position in north-central British Columbia and outlined exploration plans for 2024/2025, including drilling activity in its Nevada projects. The news relates to potential future copper supply from exploration activity but provides no immediate production volumes or supply disruptions.

title: EV Nickel Intersects 3 New Zones of Mineralization on the Carlang Trend Including Highest Nickel Grades to Date & Significantly Extends Strike Length by 7km
summary: EV Nickel Inc. announced maiden diamond drilling at the CarLang trend intersected three new zones of near-surface nickel mineralization, including the highest grades to date. Results included intervals up to 0.96% Ni and a 7km strike extension, with mineralization appearing magmatic. The discovery remains open for expansion.

title: JLR production hit by aluminium supply disruption
summary: Jaguar Land Rover said production was restricted due to supply disruptions from a key high-grade aluminium supplier affecting multiple OEMs. The disruption follows Novelis force majeure after Switzerland floods shut a plant. JLR also held some vehicles pending quality checks. The company expects supply to normalise in H2.

title: Great cable challenge aims to tackle copper crunch
summary: The RSC warns the UK may face a substantial copper supply shortfall as wind and solar targets approach, citing already-struggling production to meet demand. Ahead of International E-Waste Day, it launches a cable-recycling campaign to increase secondary copper supply, seeking government investment in recycling infrastructure.

title: Western Metallica Advances Drill Targeting and Permitting on Its Caña Brava 1 Copper Prospect in Peru
summary: Western Metallica Resources said it is finalizing logistics and access for a drill program in late October 2024 at its Caña Brava copper project in Peru, including targeting at the Caña Brava 1 porphyry prospect. Rock chip results indicate shallow copper mineralization and anomalies open in all directions.

title: Japan Q4 aluminium premium rises on supply fears amid firmer Europe prices
summary: Japan’s Q4 aluminium premium for October–December was set at $175/t, up 1.7% QoQ, with producers citing tighter regional supplies and firmer European premiums. The premium follows higher offers and is tied to benchmark LME cash pricing. Weak Japanese demand and higher inventories likely limit upside.

title: Nickel 28 Capital Corp: Nickel 28 Announces Confirmation of Cash Distribution from Ramu Joint Venture
summary: Nickel 28 Capital Corp. announced confirmed cash distributions from its 8.56% interest in the Ramu nickel-cobalt project, including about US$4.0 million for H1 2024 and repayment of part of its construction debt. Management attributes distributions to efficient operations despite low nickel and cobalt prices, with timing pending confirmation.

title: Moxico Resources to acquire stakes in two Argentina copper projects
summary: Moxico Resources, via Atlantic Metals, signed an agreement to earn 75% in two copper exploration projects in Argentina, including drilling and milestone payments. Planned work includes 65,000m of drilling and feasibility studies, with an option to reach 100% later. No near-term supply disruption is indicated.

title: Freeport Resources Inc.: Freeport Resources Appoints Key Advisors to Lead Yandera Copper Project Optimization Study
summary: Freeport Resources appointed Practara to run a Phase 1 desktop optimisation study for the Yandera copper project in Papua New Guinea, aiming to update the 2017 pre-feasibility assumptions and improve CAPEX/OPEX, metallurgy, and logistics before a definitive feasibility study. No production change is announced.

title: The Future Is Nickel In Indonesia
summary: The interview says Indonesia’s nickel industry is scaling into an EV battery-material ecosystem, citing commissioned precursor and lithium refining capacity and existing copper-foil operations near Freeport. It also notes forced-labor/environmental allegations and IRA rules limiting subsidized EV inputs from highly foreign-controlled entities, plus LFP’s nickel-free shift.

title: £266m worth of copper in UK's unused or binned electrical items – new research | Engineering and Technology Magazine
summary: The UK campaign Recycle Your Electricals urges “urban mining” to recycle unused cables and electronics, claiming UK homes hold up to ~38,449 tonnes of copper worth about £266m. It cites a global supply-demand shortfall and argues better recycling could help meet additional copper demand.

title: Novelis and TSR: Strategic Partnership to Advance Circularity in the Aluminum Industry
summary: Novelis and TSR signed a 3-year contract for about 75,000 tonnes of presorted end-of-life aluminum scrap to be processed at Novelis’ Nachterstedt recycling center and converted into low-carbon automotive sheet. The deal boosts recycled-content aluminum availability and supports demand for high-recycling feedstock in Europe.

title: Lara Exploration Ltd.: Lara Reports Maiden Copper-Gold Resource for the Planalto Project, Brazil
summary: Lara Exploration reported its maiden mineral resource for the Planalto copper-gold project in Brazil, with indicated and inferred resources graded around 0.5% copper. The pit-shell and economic parameters use assumed copper prices, but there is no production or supply timeline, implying limited short-term impact on copper markets.

title: Beehive Archive: Copper mine swallows company towns | News, Sports, Jobs
summary: A Utah history feature explains how Bingham Canyon/Kennecott Copper Mine grew with U.S. copper demand, supported company towns, and later expanded further. It notes Kennecott supplies about 13% of U.S. copper and links growing renewables and EV adoption to continued copper use, supporting demand expectations.

title: Canada Nickel Announces $4.38 million Contribution from the Government of Canada
summary: Canada Nickel received a C$4.38 million conditional contribution from Canada’s Critical Minerals Infrastructure Fund to fund electrical infrastructure pre-implementation studies for its Crawford nickel sulphide project. The studies run April 2024 to June 2025, supporting project development and eventual nickel production, but it’s early-stage financing.

title: Patriot Lithium signs option agreement for Katwaro Copper Project
summary: Patriot Lithium signed a binding option agreement to acquire an 80% stake in Zambia’s Katwaro Copper Project from Array Metals. The deal covers a 12-month option period with exploration funding and potential extra payments tied to JORC-indicated copper resources. Planned work is mainly review and surveys in Q4 2024.

title: Aluminum Extrusions From 13 Countries – Commerce Makes Affirmative Final AD And CVD Determinations - International Trade & Investment - International Law
summary: Commerce issued affirmative final AD/CVD determinations in a U.S. aluminum extrusions investigation, deferring most scope-related comments. Importers face rules around suspension of liquidation and depositing duties (CVD/AD mechanics pending an ITC injury decision within 45 days). The outcome could support domestic aluminum-extrusion supply expectations.

title: TSR and Novelis sign supply deal for 'sustainable P1020 substitute' high-grade aluminium scrap
summary: TSR and Novelis agreed a three-year supply deal for 75,000 tonnes of high-quality, pre-sorted end-of-life aluminium scrap for automotive sheet production. The scrap grades TSR130/136 target specific alloys and decarbonization goals. Novelis cites limited scrap availability and the need for long-term supply resilience.

title: NorthWest Copper Discovers New Mineralized Zone at the Lorraine-Top Cat Project
summary: NorthWest Copper announced new mineralized zone results from first-ever drilling at its Lorraine-Top Cat Road IP target, including 104.7 metres at 0.13% copper and 7.4 metres at 1.10% Cu. Assays also show anomalous copper at the Nova target. No production or supply impacts were stated.

title: Direct Wire Unveils New State-of-the-Art Copper Rod Mill Using Innovative Copper Upcasting Technology
summary: Direct Wire opened a new oxygen-free copper rod mill using an oxygen-free copper upcasting process to improve purity and conductivity. The company says the facility will expand production of oxygen-free copper rods and stems for energy and high-tech manufacturing. The release signals additional copper output, but without volumes, near-term pricing impact is unclear.

title: Core Nickel Corp.: Core Nickel Announces up to $252,000 Non-Brokered Private Placement Financing
summary: Core Nickel Corp. announced a non-brokered private placement of up to $252,000 to fund general working capital, including potential flow-through unit proceeds. As a nickel explorer, the financing may support future exploration, but it provides no immediate production or supply impact, suggesting limited near-term effect on nickel prices.

title: Nickel - Topic - ABC News
summary: BHP is placing its WA Nickel West division on care and maintenance for at least three years, cutting jobs and effectively closing parts of Australia’s nickel supply chain. The report links the decision to global nickel oversupply and falling prices, alongside other mine closures including First Quantum’s Ravensthorpe.

title: Moore brothers reflect on nickel boom and now bust as BHP's Kalgoorlie smelter shuts down
summary: BHP has shut down production at its Kalgoorlie Nickel Smelter, placing it on care and maintenance after decades of continuous operation. The closure follows broader shutdowns in Western Australia’s nickel mines, with nickel export values forecast to fall sharply. Job losses underscore tightening local supply prospects for nickel.

title: Patriot Lithium expands into copper with 80% earn-in agreement at Katwaro project in Zambia
summary: Patriot Lithium secured a deal with Array Metals to earn an 80% interest via a 12-month due diligence/option for the Katwaro copper project in Zambia. Patriot will fund exploration and feasibility after transfer, with payments tied to resource delineation. The plan targets future copper development, not immediate supply.

title: Canada's aluminium and steel tariff surcharge on China to be effective from Oct 22
summary: Canada will implement tariff surcharges on Chinese enterprises for aluminium (and steel) effective Oct 22, 2024, as part of measures against China’s perceived overcapacity and unfair trade policies. The action is likely to increase costs for Chinese aluminium imports into Canada and support nearby aluminium price expectations.

title: Alumina Jumps to Record in China on Supply Woes, Strong Demand
summary: The article headline says alumina in China has risen to a record high on supply woes while demand remains strong. As alumina is the key feedstock for aluminium smelting, tighter supply and higher input costs tend to lift expectations for aluminium prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Suvo Strategic Minerals turns nickel slag into high-strength, low-carbon cement
summary: Suvo Strategic Minerals reports lab trials showing nickel slag can be converted into high-strength, low-carbon cement. The nickel slag is supplied by Indonesia producer PT Huadi Nickel-Alloy Indonesia, which has large stockpiles. Further trials aim to qualify additional cement properties, supporting potential offtake arrangements.

title: Copper prices in 2024 and 2025: a global overview and analysis
summary: Fastmarkets’ outlook expects copper prices to face upward pressure in Q4 2024. Drivers cited include Fed rate cuts and China’s large stimulus, a recovery in Chinese physical demand and Shanghai cathode premiums, potential smelter production cuts tightening supply, and positive seasonality/speculative long rebuilding. Risks include macro and geopolitical shocks.

title: Clark County considers stiffer laws to crack down on copper wire thefts
summary: Clark County is considering stiffer laws targeting copper wire and other scrap purchased from suspected stolen sources. Proposed rules would restrict scrap transactions (e.g., seller transport requirements, payment methods, and proof for burned copper). Violations carry fines and the city of Las Vegas already adopted a similar ordinance.

title: Correction to aluminium 6063 extrusion billet premium, in-whs dp Rotterdam, on October 11
summary: Fastmarkets issued a correction to its previously published premium for aluminium 6063 extrusion billet (in-warehouse Rotterdam) for Oct 11. The premium range was adjusted from $530-560/tonne to $525-560/tonne and the pricing database was updated accordingly within its North Europe aluminium billet package.

title: High-Nickel Pig Iron Prices Surge After National Day Holiday, Strong Supply and Demand Drive Market Upward
summary: High-nickel pig iron prices rose sharply after the National Day holiday: SMM 8–12% NPI averaged 988.13 yuan per nickel point, up 12.9. Indonesian NPI FOB also increased. Better smelter profitability, easing ore supply, and stronger stainless-steel demand supported nickel price strength, with macro factors boosting pure nickel.

title: Bandits steal copper wire
summary: Bandits stole copper wire worth Rs600 million from a Chinese camp’s supposedly secure storage area at Wapda’s Tarbela Dam/Tarbela Power Station. The theft occurred without visible forced entry, and police are investigating. Earlier thefts of valuable materials were also reported, suggesting possible insider involvement and localized disruption to copper usage.

title: 'We believe Canada needs more nickel,' Wyloo boss says
summary: Wyloo’s CEO says Canada needs more nickel and highlights the Eagle’s Nest project in Ontario’s Ring of Fire, targeting nickel output for EV battery supply and potential nickel-sulphate processing. It notes the mine also yields copper as a by-product, reinforcing near-term expectations for additional supply.

title: SMM Analysis On Overseas September Metallurgical Grade Alumina Production And October Forecast
summary: SMM reports overseas metallurgical-grade alumina output fell 2.7% YoY in September, with refinery operating rates down year-on-year. Multiple disruptions and guidance cuts (Alcoa shutdown, Rio Tinto reductions, South32 maintenance/environment delays) contribute. October is forecast to decline further 2.7% YoY, with weaker operating rates.

title: Pan Asia eyeballs more strong Chilean copper shows
summary: Pan Asia Metals reported encouraging early fieldwork at its Chile Rosario copper project, finding secondary copper minerals like malachite and chrysocolla and some primary copper sulphides. Results from soil/stream sediment and an IP geophysical survey are expected soon, followed by planned RC drilling.

title: Column-China copper, iron ore stay stimulus believers, but others sceptical: Russell
summary: Reuters columnist Clyde Russell says investors reacted differently to Beijing’s latest stimulus rhetoric. Shanghai copper futures opened higher while London copper fell, reflecting sentiment on possible refinancing of local government debt and renewed construction/property demand, though the author argues demand effects may be limited and later.

title: Woomera Mining commences dual-focused drilling of high-grade copper-gold zone at Bronze Fox
summary: Woomera Mining started a dual-rig diamond core drilling program at its Bronze Fox copper-gold project in Mongolia’s Southern Gobi copper belt, targeting an extension of a previously reported high-grade zone. The work includes infill and resource expansion toward a mining license, with results expected in January.

title: Xanadu tables US$1.4 billion gold-copper PFS in Mongolia
summary: Xanadu released a large prefeasibility study for its Kharmagtai copper-gold project in Mongolia, projecting ~60,000 tonnes of copper annually initially, low cash costs, and a long 29-year mine life. The company expects a bankable feasibility study in 2026, supporting sentiment for future copper supply.

title: China Sept copper imports climbs from prior month on seasonal demand, brighter outlook
summary: China’s unwrought copper imports rose 15.4% in September to 479,000 tonnes versus August, driven by improving seasonal demand, restocking before Golden Week, lower inventories, and an open arbitrage window from relatively high global prices. U.S. rate cuts and China stimulus further brighten copper demand outlook.

title: Alma Metals gains 51% Briggs Copper stake in Queensland
summary: Alma Metals acquired a 51% JV stake in Queensland’s Briggs Copper Project after meeting earn-in conditions and expanded an ongoing drilling program. Results include long intercepts with grades around 0.40–0.45% copper, prompting increased drilling metres and aiming for tighter resource estimates and potential scoping work.

title: Copper Futures (HG_F) Elliott Wave Forecasting the Path
