summary: The technical piece analyzes Elliott Wave patterns in copper futures (HG_F). After an impulsive move from the 3.9230 low, copper experienced a 3-wave pullback. It now argues the price has reached the buyers’ zone (4.3758-4.3069), found support near 4.3729, and could rally toward new highs or a three-wave bounce.

title: Copper's Not-So-Hidden Signal for Gold
summary: The piece argues that gold/mining stocks are correcting, and uses copper as a confirmation signal. It says copper’s short rally after Friday was erased, labeling the late-September attempt above key Fibonacci/July highs as invalidated. The author expects the decline to continue, citing a broader bearish technical pattern.

title: Freeport Indonesia Halts Copper Cathode Output at Manyar After Fire, CEO Says
summary: Freeport Indonesia stopped copper cathode production at its Manyar smelter after a Monday fire in a sulphuric acid unit. Production was halted because the gas must be captured by that plant. The firm is investigating the cause and will determine the restart timeline, with ramp-up plans to be reviewed.

title: Freeport halts production at new copper smelter after fire - Companies
summary: Freeport Indonesia temporarily halted operations at its new copper smelter in Gresik, East Java, after a fire at the gas cleaning plant on Monday. The blaze was extinguished the same evening, with no casualties reported. An assessment will determine damage, cause, and any impact on plans to raise smelter capacity.

title: Los Andes Copper Ltd.: LME Week 2024: Copper Highlighted as 'Top Prospect'
summary: Los Andes highlights LME Week 2024 discussions where copper was voted the “top prospect” for base metals. It notes copper’s strong 2024 performance and analyst views that demand weakness from China has not materialized, while insufficient capex implies an impending copper supply gap, supportive of bullish prices.

title: Firetail Resources Commences Drilling at Skyline Copper Project Under Option Agreement with York Harbour Metals
summary: York Harbour Metals says Firetail Resources has started drilling at the Skyline copper project in Newfoundland under an option agreement. A 5,000-metre maiden program and EM surveys aim to extend high-grade copper mineralization along a 16 km strike length. It signals progress, but no near-term supply impact is stated.

title: Pre-Feasibility Study – Kharmagtai Copper-Gold Project
summary: Xanadu Mines released a pre-feasibility study for the Kharmagtai copper-gold project in Mongolia, estimating 60–80 ktpa copper over early expansion stages and low cash costs. The study supports potential development and a future supply outlook for copper, but it does not signal imminent production, limiting near-term price pressure.

title: Alcoa To Supply Up To 16.5 Mln Tonnes Of Smelter Grade Alumina To Aluminium Bahrain Over 10 Years
summary: Alcoa said it will supply up to 16.5 million tonnes of smelter-grade alumina to Aluminium Bahrain (Alba) from 2026–2035, mainly sourced from Western Australia. The deal extends a long relationship and is intended to provide Alba reliable alumina supply, though it is not a near-term shock to prices.

title: Great Western gears up to drill Oval Copper-Gold Target in WA
summary: Great Western Exploration mobilised a drill rig to begin imminent diamond drilling at its Oval copper-gold target in Western Australia. The program aims to test EM and gravity anomalies to refine the model before further holes. Assays are expected weeks after drilling; funding support was also received from WA.

title: Strix lauds "milestone"; Quartix to meet expectations
summary: The article is a London-listed companies roundup. The main commodity-relevant item is Great Southern Copper PLC, which reports new copper-gold-silver alteration and mineralisation at its Viuda prospect in Chile and plans further mapping and sampling to reach drill-ready status. No direct aluminium or nickel developments are mentioned.

title: Bahrain Business: Alba renews alumina supply deal with Alcoa
summary: Aluminium Bahrain (Alba) has renewed a long-term alumina supply agreement with Alcoa for up to 16.5 million tonnes of smelter-grade alumina over 10 years, beginning in 2026. Both firms said the deal secures stable feedstock for Alba’s operations and reinforces Alcoa’s alumina-supply position.

title: Clark County targets copper theft with stricter penalties
summary: Clark County commissioners in Nevada proposed an ordinance to curb persistent copper wire theft by imposing harsher penalties, including minimum fines of $500 for first offenses and $1,000 for repeat violations. A public hearing is scheduled for Nov. 19. The measure targets purchase of stolen copper or scrap metals.

title: Rio Tinto Says Amrun Bauxite Mine Operating Above Nameplate Capacity -- Commodity Comment
summary: Rio Tinto said its Amrun bauxite mine is operating above nameplate capacity, lifting bauxite output, but primary aluminum production fell due to an electricity reduction request at its New Zealand smelter that has ended and ramp-up is underway. The firm also reported lower mined copper output. Overall effects may offset near term.

title: AAC renews call for bauxite, alumina, and aluminium to be listed as Critical Minerals
summary: Australia’s Aluminium Council renewed its call for bauxite, alumina and aluminium to be listed as Critical Minerals, arguing risks from geopolitics, higher costs, and lengthy environmental approvals have impaired and curtailed alumina refining. The group urges faster approvals to secure bauxite feed for refineries and avoid supply disruption.

title: ASX miners: Metro Mining cleans up as bauxite price rally likened to iron ore boom
summary: Supply disruption in Guinea suspended bauxite exports from Guinea Alumina Corporation over customs issues. With Guinea accounting for about 4% of global bauxite supply, alumina prices have surged, creating potential gains for bauxite producers like Metro Mining. The tighter feedstock outlook points to near-term bullish aluminium price pressure.

title: Wyden, Merkley announce $37 million in federal funds to replace lead, copper water pipes across Oregon
summary: Wyden and Merkley announced $37 million in EPA Drinking Water State Revolving Fund support for Oregon to replace lead and copper water pipes. The program targets replacing lead pipes over time and improves aging water infrastructure, which should modestly boost short-term demand for copper plumbing materials in the region.

title: Eramet: 2024 targets lowered for manganese and nickel
summary: Eramet cut its 2024 targets for Comilog and PT Weda Bay Nickel amid weaker carbon steel demand in China and fewer nickel ore sales permits from Indonesia than expected. Nickel ore external volume for PT WBN was revised down to 29 million wet tons, indicating reduced supply expectations.

title: Third quarter production results | Company Announcement
summary: Rio Tinto reported Q3 copper and aluminium production updates. Copper ramp-up continues at Oyu Tolgoi, while Kennecott faced lower mined output from highwall movement and Escondida improved on higher grades. Aluminium output was slightly lower due to an NZAS electricity-reduction request, now ended and ramp-up underway.

title: Antofagasta 9-month Gold, Copper Production Drops; Backs Annual Output Outlook
summary: Antofagasta reported lower gold and copper output over the first nine months, with copper slipping to 463.7kt from 469.1kt amid weaker output at Centinela concentrates, partially offset by higher production elsewhere. The miner expects full-year copper at the low end of guidance, implying softer near-term supply.

title: Antofagasta backs outlook as copper production picks up
summary: Antofagasta said Q3 copper production rose 15% to 179,000 tonnes and copper sales increased 9.3% quarter-on-quarter. Cash costs before by-product credits fell in the quarter, though guidance stays unchanged with full-year output at the lower end. The firm expects little change in 2025.

title: Freeport to delay Indonesian copper sales to second quarter of 2025 after fire, sources say
summary: Freeport McMoRan will postpone refined copper sales from Indonesia until Q2 2025 after a fire caused additional delays at its Manyar smelter. The disruption may slow ramp-up, tighten refined supply versus expectations, and narrow an anticipated 2025 surplus, supporting copper prices in the near term.

title: Copper Bounces From Key Technical Level on China Hopes
summary: Copper rebounded on Wednesday after stabilising at a key support level, with three-month LME copper up about 1% to $9,624/ton. The move follows a three-week low, driven by hopes China will announce further support for its ailing property sector, improving near-term demand sentiment.

title: Barrick Holds to Production Target as Quarterly Gold Output Slips, Copper Rises
summary: Barrick said gold output slipped in the latest quarter but held its full-year guidance while copper output increased. Preliminary copper production rose to about 48,000 metric tons versus 43,000 tons the prior quarter, driven by higher grades and recoveries at Lumwana. Results are due Nov. 7.

title: Alumina Prices Surge: Will Aluminium Smelters Face a Squeeze or Relief in 2025?
summary: Alumina prices surged to multi-month/all-time highs on SHFE and in spot markets as global supply disruptions and tighter bauxite availability tightened the alumina balance. Rising alumina costs raise input expenses for aluminium smelters (30–40% of costs), potentially squeezing margins and leading to production cuts if aluminium prices lag.

title: Vale Achieves Six-Year High in Iron Ore Output, Copper and Nickel Production Also Climb
summary: Vale reports a six-year high in iron ore output, and the article states that its copper and nickel production also increased. Stronger production trends can improve near-term supply expectations, which generally supports prices for copper and nickel over the following days to weeks.

title: Vale Achieves Six-Year High in Iron Ore Output, Copper and Nickel Production Also Climb
summary: Vale reported six-year-high iron ore output, and the title also notes that copper and nickel production climbed. If investors expect improved near-term supply from Vale, it can pressure copper and nickel prices over the following days as market balances adjust.

title: Alcoa, Ignis close to signing joint funding deal for Spain aluminium plant
summary: Alcoa says it is nearing a joint funding deal with Spain’s Ignis to support operation of its San Ciprian aluminium plant in Galicia. Alcoa would invest €75m, Ignis €25m for 25% ownership, with potential further funding up to €100m. The plan aims to offset high energy costs and comes amid efforts to sell the plant.

title: SolGold makes progress at Cascabel copper-gold project
summary: SolGold says it has optimized an infrastructure investigation for its Cascabel copper-gold project in Ecuador, adding ground geophysics to reduce drilling requirements. Drill sites for plant and portal testing are being prepared, and core samples will be assayed to support mine design and declines. Near-term production impact is not indicated.

title: EV Minerals Corporation: EV Minerals Announces Acquisition of High Grade Copper Asset in Chile
summary: EV Minerals announced it will acquire the Santa Monica copper project in northern Chile, including past-producing copper oxide and sulphide mines and permits for a 5,000 tpm sulphide flotation plant plus tailings storage. Management highlights low exploration coverage and potential for near-term development and restart.

title: Ero Copper : Confirms Full Power Restoration at the Tucumã Operation Form 6 K
summary: Ero Copper says full power has been restored at its Tucumã copper operation in Brazil after a temporary outage from a localized windstorm on Oct. 5. With power back, the firm resumes ramp-up of processing circuits (milling, flotation, filtration), supporting near-term copper production.

title: Kutcho Copper Announces Financing
summary: Kutcho Copper Corp. announced a non-brokered private placement raising up to $750,000 to advance the Kutcho Project and for working capital. Units priced at $0.10 include common shares and warrants exercisable at $0.16. Completion is subject to TSX Venture approval; no immediate production or supply impact is described.

title: Ero Copper Confirms Full Power Restoration at the Tucumã
summary: Ero Copper said full power has been restored at its Tucumã copper operation in Brazil after a temporary outage from a localized windstorm on Oct. 5. With power back, the company resumed ramp-up of milling, flotation, and filtration circuits, supporting resumed copper processing rates.

title: Alcoa Shares Jump as Surging Alumina Prices Boost Profit
summary: Alcoa shares rose as surging alumina prices boosted profitability. Alumina is a key feedstock for primary aluminium production, so the article signals momentum and tighter conditions within the aluminium cost/value chain that can influence expectations for near-term aluminium pricing.

title: US issues final determination on Vietnamese aluminum anti-dumping probe
summary: The US Department of Commerce issued a final determination on its anti-dumping probe into Vietnamese aluminium extrusions/products, raising dumping margins versus the preliminary conclusion. Duties would follow an ITC injury decision and could reduce Vietnamese import volumes into the US. This creates near-term downside pressure on aluminium prices.

title: Increasing Oman's copper output
summary: Minerals Development Oman signed a mining concession and is progressing copper projects. It broke ground on the Lasil and Al Baydha copper mines redevelopment in Sohar, targeting 800,000 tonnes of copper ore annually, and is set to begin construction on the Yanqul Copper Project, expected later in 2024.

title: EV Minerals plans to acquire copper asset in Chile's Antofagasta region
summary: EV Minerals signed a binding LOI to acquire a Target company holding the Santa Monica Copper Project in Chile’s Antofagasta region. The project includes past-producing copper mines and is permitted for a 5,000 t/month flotation plant. Management frames it as a near-term development and exploration opportunity, supporting copper sentiment.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Intersects 1.31% Copper over 22.65 Metres within 50.20 Metres at 0.74% Copper Near Surface at the Banjo Breccia
summary: Faraday Copper reported assay results from drill hole FCD-24-074 at its Copper Creek Project in Arizona, intersecting 22.65 m at 1.31% Cu within 50.20 m at 0.74% Cu near the Banjo breccia. The company says mineralization extends to depth and continues near-surface drilling.

title: Grid Metals Corp. Initiates Maiden Eagle Drill Program at the MM Copper/Nickel Project
summary: Grid Metals reports receiving permits and commencing a maiden drill program at the Eagle gabbro within its MM copper/nickel project in Manitoba, with geophysical surveys running in tandem. Assays are expected by mid-November/early next month. The update is exploratory and does not change near-term supply.

title: Grid Metals Corp. Initiates Maiden Eagle Drill Program at the MM Copper/Nickel Project
summary: Grid Metals reports the initiation of its maiden drill program at the Eagle gabbro within its MM copper/nickel project in Manitoba, supported by permits and geophysical surveys. Management expects initial assays by mid-November and cites potential copper-dominant mineralization. The update is exploratory and not directly tied to near-term production changes.

title: Copper concentrate TCs to remain low; benchmark expected to fall sharply
summary: Fastmarkets sources expect next year’s copper concentrate benchmark treatment charges to fall to about $20s–low $30s per tonne versus $80 last year. Tight concentrate availability after mine shutdowns and subdued output, combined with expanded smelting capacity, should keep the market super tight and potentially support copper prices.

title: Aston Bay Holdings Ltd.: Aston Bay and American West Metals Report 42.7m @ 3.1% copper from the surface at the Storm Project, Nunavut, Canada
summary: Aston Bay and American West reported thick, high-grade near-surface copper drill results at the Storm Project’s Chinook and Cyclone deposits on Somerset Island, Nunavut, including multiple multi-percent Cu intercepts from surface and shallow depths. Assays for additional holes are pending, supporting advancement toward a maiden resource.

title: Pacific Empire Minerals Corp.: Pacific Empire Assays to 2.95 g/t Gold & 0.65% Copper from Outcrop at Trident
summary: Pacific Empire Minerals reported rock chip and historical drill-core sampling results at its Trident copper-gold exploration project, including up to ~1.53% copper in drill core and 0.65% copper from outcrop. The company interprets the findings as supporting a porphyry copper-gold system, but no production changes are announced.

title: Michigan DNR acquires mineral rights at Porcupine Mountains Wilderness State Park, trade does not impact Copperwood Project
summary: Michigan DNR acquired 8,392 acres of mineral rights in Porcupine Mountains Wilderness State Park in a mineral-for-mineral land exchange, citing prospective copper and nickel resources. The article stresses the transaction does not impact Highland Copper’s Copperwood project, which would access minerals outside the park with no surface disturbance.

title: Aston Bay and American West Metals Report 42.7m @ 3.1% copper from the surface at the Storm Project, Nunavut, Canada
summary: Aston Bay and American West report thick, high-grade near-surface copper intersections from the Chinook and Cyclone deposits at the Storm Project in Nunavut, including 42.7m at 3.1% Cu and 29m at 2.6% Cu. Assays for remaining holes are due in 2–4 weeks, supporting a maiden resource estimate.

title: Aston Bay Holdings Ltd. Provides an Update on Drilling Activities At the Storm Copper Project on Somerset Island, Nunavut
summary: Aston Bay Holdings reported drilling results from the Storm copper project in Nunavut, including multiple intersections of chalcocite/bornite and grades up to 7.1% Cu in the Chinook deposit and copper sulfide zones in Cyclone. The company says deposit continuity suggests potential extension at depth and along strike.

title: Acquisition of Producing Copper Mine in Morocco | Company Announcement
summary: MetalNRG signed a binding agreement to acquire 100% of the producing Oumejrane copper mine in Morocco for $30m plus contingent payments linked to the average copper price after completion. Financing via a $25m convertible loan note is proposed, subject to regulatory approvals. Copper price linkage is indirect and likely limited near term.

title: MetalNRG strikes USD30 million deal to acquire Morocco copper mine
summary: MetalNRG agreed to acquire Managem SA’s Oumejrane copper mine in Morocco for about $30 million upfront plus $2 million on the first anniversary, with a final contingent payment linked to the average copper price. The mine is producing and profitable, and the deal expands MetalNRG’s copper exposure.

title: Rail News - RTD-Denver: Copper wire thefts disrupt light-rail service. For Railroad Career Professionals
summary: Regional Transportation District–Denver says copper wire thefts near track signals, switches and crossings have disrupted its light-rail service since April, with 21 incidents and about $110,000 in replacement costs. RTD links theft activity to high copper demand and says prior mitigation reduced thefts.

title: Lakeshore's Can Art Aluminum receives $5M from Ottawa
summary: Ottawa awarded Can Art Aluminum Extrusion Canada a $5 million grant to scale up aluminium parts manufacturing for electric vehicles, expanding capacity to produce new components for the EV market. The funding supports six EV manufacturers, and signals rising near-term aluminium demand tied to EV battery and component supply.

title: FNI eyes partnership for nickel processing plant - BusinessWorld Online
summary: Global Ferronickel Holdings (FNI) is in talks with Asian and European firms to build a nickel processing facility, adding to existing plants in Palawan and Surigao run by Nickel Asia. The government is also seeking incentives and clearer rules for critical-mineral processing, which supports nickel supply outlook sentiment.

title: BHP ASX: SA Olympic Dam copper mine forced to halt after electricity transmission towers damaged in storms
summary: BHP’s Olympic Dam copper mine in northern South Australia was halted for around a week after wild storms damaged electricity transmission towers supplying power. Operations were switched to care-and-maintenance, using backup generators. The outage reduces near-term copper output, likely adding downside pressure to copper prices.

title: Genius Metals options Tifernine Copper Project in Morocco
summary: Genius Metals signed an option deal to acquire 100% of the Tifernine copper project in Morocco, including cash payments and exploration commitments over three years. The company cites observed copper mineralisation and plans follow-up work in 2025. The announcement is an exploration step with no near-term supply impact.

title: Bahlil discusses reliance on foreign labor in nickel downstreaming - Economy
summary: Indonesia’s Energy and Mineral Resources Minister Bahlil Lahadalia said the nickel downstream industry relies on foreign workers to speed progress. He cited faster smelter construction by Chinese workers and described efforts to repatriate foreign labor when local skills are available, though transitions cannot happen instantly.

title: Shanghai frenzy fuels alumina's record-breaking rally: Andy Home
summary: Alumina prices surged to records on tight supply and Guinea bauxite export problems, driving speculative inflows in Shanghai. The higher alumina-aluminium cost ratio is compressing smelter margins and widening cash premiums versus forwards. With reduced ShFE stocks, aluminium prices face potential upside as costs become unpredictable.

title: Indonesia aims to manage nickel ore supply to support prices
summary: Indonesia’s mining minister said the government will manage nickel ore supply and demand to support prices, using smelter prices and demand as parameters for market balance. He cited quota-approval delays that forced some smelters to import ores from the Philippines, highlighting near-term supply-control efforts.

title: [SMM Analysis] New Developments in Indonesia's RKAB Nickel Ore Quota Realized: How Will Nickel Ore Prices Respond?
summary: SMM reports Indonesia’s Ministry of Mines adjusted PT WBN’s laterite nickel ore sales quota (2024-2026), raising annual sales volume to 32 mln wmt. Markets reacted with bearish expectations for Indonesian nickel ore premiums, though current prices stay stable due to already-signed orders. Indonesia may soften premiums later this month; Philippines remains firmer.

title: Vedanta announces to invest Rs 1 lakh crore in Odisha to set up alumina refinery, aluminium plant
summary: Vedanta announced a Rs 1 lakh crore investment in Odisha to build a 6 MTPA alumina refinery and a 3 MTPA green aluminium plant. The project is expected to expand downstream industrial activity, but it signals future capacity rather than near-term production changes. Immediate aluminium price impact appears limited.

title: Is the LME to blame for the 251-day aluminium queue at Port Klang?
summary: Fastmarkets reports a 251-day aluminium withdrawal queue at Port Klang’s Istim warehouse, tied to LME warehouse rules (QBRC) and traders’ metal cancellations to capture free rent. Debate centers on whether QBRC worsens queues or traders exploit rent incentives, amid inflows of 652,525 tonnes in May 2024.

title: Vedanta's Rs. 1 Lakh Crore Boost: Odisha's Green Aluminium Leap
summary: Vedanta plans to invest Rs. 1 lakh crore in Odisha to build an alumina refinery and an aluminium plant with major annual capacities, aimed at producing “eco-friendly” aluminium using renewable energy. The project is expected to create jobs and support MSMEs, strengthening aluminium production outlook in the region.

title: High-nickel pig iron prices have reached a record high, driven by improved supply and strong demand
summary: High-nickel pig iron prices in China and Indonesia hit record highs, with weekly increases attributed to better smelter profitability, eased nickel ore shortages in Indonesia, and stronger stainless-steel mill restocking after National Day. The NPI-to-electrolytic nickel discount narrowed, supporting a stable-to-strong outlook for nickel-linked prices next week.

title: Crackdown on copper, catalytic converter theft in New York
summary: New York officials announce legislation to curb rising copper and catalytic converter theft. The bill would require serial-number marking of catalytic converters and impose stricter standards and penalties on scrap metal recycling facilities, aiming to deter illegal resale. Officials cite large U.S. losses from copper theft and seek better enforcement.

title: BHP's Olympic Dam Copper Mine Paused Due to Power Outage
summary: BHP paused most underground mining and surface processing at its Olympic Dam copper mine after electric storms damaged transmission lines feeding the operation and Roxby Downs. Backup generators run critical infrastructure, but restoration time is unclear. With 215,000+ tons of copper cathode produced in FY through June, supply is likely disrupted.

title: Carnaby, Latitude 66 jag multiple Qld copper hits
summary: Carnaby Resources and JV partner Latitude 66 report positive VTEM/magnetic survey results at the San Quentin and other Greater Duchess prospects in Queensland, including exposed copper mineralisation up to 6.7% and recent drilling intercepts (e.g., 13m at 2.7% Cu; zones up to 3.7% Cu). Further EM and drilling are planned soon.

title: South32 Q1 Alumina Production Down, But Aluminium Production Up
summary: South32 said Q1 alumina production (share) fell to 1.184 million tonnes from 1.290 million, but its quarterly aluminium production rose to 298 thousand tonnes from 288 thousand. The company kept its fiscal 2025 production guidance. The report implies near-term aluminium supply support despite weaker alumina output.

title: Analysis of Nickel Ore Import Data for September 2024 [SMM Analysis]
summary: SMM data show China’s September nickel ore imports fell 7.4% MoM and 23.5% YoY, with declines across both sulfide and oxide. Philippine ore remains the main source, but Indonesia’s RKAB quota progress expected in October may reduce Philippine demand and shift exports toward China, with possible typhoon-driven shipping delays.

title: Latin Metals Secures Key Permit to Advance Exploration at Esperanza Copper-Gold Project, San Juan Province, Argentina
summary: Latin Metals said it received a key exploration permit for the Esperanza copper-gold project in Argentina, enabling mapping, sampling and geophysical work and requiring at least 5,000m of drilling in the first option year. The update supports longer-dated copper potential, but offers no near-term production or price shock.

title: Taseko Mines Provides Construction Update for Florence Copper
summary: Taseko provided a construction progress update for its Florence Copper project, noting ~40% completion as of Sept. 30, 2024 and ongoing work on earthworks, concrete, structural steel, process equipment, powerline installation, and wellfield drilling (34 production wells). First copper remains targeted for Q4 2025.

title: American Eagle Extends High-Grade Near-Surface Mineralization with Multiple +1% Copper Equivalent Intercepts; Confirms Continuity of Mineralization >1km Along Trend
summary: American Eagle Gold reports new drill results at its NAK copper-gold porphyry project, including multiple >1% CuEq near-surface intercepts and continuity of mineralization over more than 1 km. The findings expand the copper-bearing system, but remain exploration-focused, with no immediate supply or trade impact.

title: Construction Update for Florence Copper | Company Announcement
summary: Taseko reported construction progress at its Florence Copper project, with about 40% complete as of Sept. 30, 2024, and ongoing installation of key infrastructure and process equipment. The company reiterated first copper production is still expected in late 2025 and filed for a US DOE 48C tax credit.

title: Taseko Mines Limited Provides Construction Update for Florence Copper
summary: Taseko Mines reported progress on its Florence Copper project: ~300,000 hours worked, no injuries or environmental incidents, and ~40% completion as of Sept. 30, 2024. Construction activities—earthworks, concrete, wellfield drilling, and process equipment/steel installation—continue on schedule, with first copper production still targeted for Q4 2025.

title: Excelsior gets final permit for Arizona copper mine operations
summary: Excelsior Mining secured the final Arizona permit to restart operations at the Johnson Camp copper mine, completing amended Mined Land Reclamation Plan approvals alongside air quality and aquifer permits. The site has SX-EW capacity for cathode copper and uses Nuton’s heap-leaching technology, improving expectations for renewed domestic copper supply.

title: Kincora Copper Limited: Kincora Announces Cutting-Edge Geophysics Confirms High Priority Drill Target At The Nyngan Project
summary: Kincora Copper reports integrated ambient noise tomography and gravity surveys that confirm and refine a copper-gold porphyry drill target at its Nyngan “Ace of Spades” region, with a 6–8 hole program starting imminently. The release focuses on exploration progress, not production or supply changes, limiting near-term price impact.

title: Freeport-McMoRan's third-quarter profit beats on higher copper prices
summary: Freeport-McMoRan reported a third-quarter profit beat driven by higher copper prices. Reuters attributes the copper price rise to improving demand signals from top consumer China, falling inventories, and stimulus measures aimed at strengthening the slowing economy. Freeport’s realized copper price rose to $4.30/lb from $3.80 a year earlier.

title: Southern Copper Corporation Announces Production Results for the Third Quarter and Nine Months Ended September 30, 2024
summary: Southern Copper reported Q3 and nine-month production results ending Sept. 30, 2024, with copper output rising to 253,441 tons in Q3 and 737,743 tons for nine months versus last year. Other metals also increased, but the report’s direct market linkage is primarily copper supply expectations.

title: Southern Copper : 3Q24 Conference Call details
summary: Southern Copper Corporation announced its 3Q 2024 conference call and provides call access details. The company is described as a large integrated copper producer operating in Mexico and Peru. No quarter-specific production, cost, supply disruption, or demand guidance is included in this notice.

title: QC Copper to acquire remaining 50% of Roger Gold-Copper Project
summary: QC Copper agreed to acquire the remaining 50% interest in the Roger gold-copper project in Quebec from SOQUEM, with approvals pending and closure expected by October 2025. The deal provides QC Copper full control of the asset and is framed as strategic after favourable metallurgical results, but no near-term output change is cited.

title: Aston Bay Holdings Ltd.: Aston Bay Receives C$1.38 Million Initial Royalty Payment for the Storm Copper Project, Canada
summary: Aston Bay announced it received an initial royalty payment (C$1.38 million) under a funding arrangement for the Storm Copper Project in Canada. The financing advances exploration and milestones toward PFS and a resource expansion, with payments tied to prefeasibility and JORC resource growth. No immediate copper supply impacts are stated.

title: Zambia plans to boost copper production
summary: Zambia plans to boost copper production by moving mining permits to a new state-owned enterprise that will negotiate partnerships with investors, while keeping minority stakes. Subsidiaries of major miners already supply about two-thirds of output. The government also plans surveys and license support to accelerate new projects.

title: First Gold, Then… - The Daily Reckoning
summary: The piece centers on gold’s rally but also discusses industrial metals momentum. It says copper has been repairing losses since an August “false start” breakout, with China stimulus uncertainty causing volatility. It argues copper futures could resume strength on a breakout above $4.75, implying a bullish near-term tone for copper.

title: Mining giant Grupo Mexico's profit jump on copper prices, production
summary: Grupo Mexico reported a 17.6% jump in Q3 net profit, attributing gains to roughly 8% higher copper prices during the year and higher production. The firm slightly lifted its 2024 copper output forecast to 1.09 million tonnes and said Q3 copper production rose 10.6% y/y. Reuters notes transport results lagged.

title: New task force aims at stopping copper wire thefts in Louisville
summary: Louisville formed a Critical Infrastructure Task Force to curb copper wire thefts. Police audits target non-compliant recyclers and the city reports costs from stolen street lighting cable. The KY Transportation Cabinet is piloting solar lighting to reduce copper wire use. A $15,000 reward supports prosecutions.

title: Supply Changes and Macro Uncertainty Suppress Nickel Prices; High-Grade NPI Prices Remain Firm but Risk Falling [SMM Analysis]
summary: SMM reports nickel prices have fallen sharply, with SHFE dropping below 126,000 yuan/mt and LME trading around $16,300–$16,500. The main drivers are improved Indonesian nickel-ore supply expectations via RKAB approvals and broader macro risk aversion ahead of the US election. High-grade NPI remains firmer but may retreat on weakening stainless fundamentals.

title: Forte Minerals Corp: Forte Minerals to Acquire the Miscanthus Epithermal Gold and Porphyry Copper Prospects in Central Perú with Environmental Drilling Permit
summary: Forte Minerals announced acquisition of the Miscanthus Cu-Mo-Au and Au-Ag prospects in Peru, including an approved DIA drilling permit for up to 40 platforms. While the copper component may affect medium-term expectations for copper exploration and potential supply, the article provides no near-term physical market data, implying limited price impact.

title: EMX Royalty Corp.: EMX Royalty Partner, Zijin Mining, Provides an Update on Expanded Copper and Gold Production in Serbia
summary: EMX Royalty says its Serbia Timok partner, Zijin, produced 90,008 tonnes of copper in H1 2024 from the Cukaru Peki Mine and is expanding plant throughput from 12,000 to 15,000 tonnes per day, lifting annual copper capacity. Timok royalties are uncapped and generate quarterly payments.

title: Aluminum trailer plant in Hartford to close in January, laying off 113 workers
summary: ALCOM LLC will close its Triton Trailers aluminum trailer plant in Hartford on Jan. 12, laying off 113 workers, citing operation centralization and competitiveness. The shutdown reduces output from an aluminum trailer manufacturer, but the article provides no volume data, making broader aluminum price impact unclear.

title: Man charged in heist of industrial spools of copper wire from Ameren substation
summary: A man was charged after authorities said he and others stole a trailer of copper wire spools worth over $285,000 from an Ameren substation in Missouri. Investigators reportedly found stripped spools at another property. The theft is localized and unlikely to meaningfully move copper prices beyond local scrap concerns.

title: Aluminium producer Norsk Hydro's core profit rises slightly more than expected
summary: Norsk Hydro reported slightly better-than-expected third-quarter core profit, citing higher aluminium and alumina prices, lower raw material costs and favourable currency effects. The company highlighted a challenging downstream market but ongoing strength from upstream drivers. Platts Alumina Index rose to $562/tonne as global alumina supply tightened.

title: Teck Resources reports Q3 profit beat on higher copper production
summary: Teck Resources reported a Q3 profit beat, helped by higher copper production at its Quebrada Blanca (QB) mine. Adjusted profit was C$0.60 per share versus analysts’ C$0.37 estimate. The Reuters report links improved results directly to increased copper output, a near-term supply positive for copper.

title: Anglo American copper, diamond output down in Q3, 2024 guidance unchanged
summary: The article states Anglo American’s copper output declined in Q3, but it keeps its 2024 guidance unchanged. Reduced quarterly production can weigh on near-term copper supply expectations and prompt bearish sentiment, though unchanged full-year guidance suggests investors may not expect a major deterioration beyond Q3.

title: Anglo American's Copper, Diamond Output Drop; Keeps Guidance
summary: Anglo American said Q3 copper output fell 13% year on year because of a planned closure of a processing plant at its Los Bronces mine in Chile. It also flagged a potential coal-division sale. Nickel and platinum guidance was raised, but the reported copper production decline is the main near-term pressure.

title: Anglo American's Diamond, Copper Output Slumps -- Commodity Comment
summary: Anglo American said copper production fell 13% quarter-on-quarter due to the planned closure of Chile’s Los Bronces plant, partially offset by higher grades at El Soldado and improvements at Quellaveco expected later. Nickel output rose 6%, though Codemin refinery issues partially offset gains.

title: Anglo American Q3 Copper, PGMs, Diamond Production Slip; Ups Annual Nickel Output Guidance
summary: Anglo American said Q3 copper production fell to 181Kt versus 209Kt, citing planned closure of Los Bronces, partially offset by higher grades at El Soldado. Nickel production rose and full-year nickel guidance was raised to 38-39Kt. Annual copper outlook remains within 730-790Kt, tempering market impact.

title: Anglo American Q3 Copper, PGMs, Diamond Production Slip; Ups Annual Nickel Output Guidance
summary: Anglo American said Q3 copper output fell to 181Kt from 209Kt due to the planned closure of the smaller, costlier Los Bronces plant, partially offset by higher grades at El Soldado. Nickel output rose to 9.9kt and full-year nickel guidance was raised, while copper guidance stayed broadly within 730–790Kt.

title: Core Nickel Corp.: Core Nickel Announces Board Changes
summary: Core Nickel Corp. announced changes to its board, welcoming Paul Reid and Marc Pais, and noting upcoming early-2025 drilling/testing plans on its Thompson Nickel Belt nickel projects near existing mills. The article is primarily corporate governance with no immediate production, supply, or inventory impact for nickel prices.

title: Koryx Copper Inc.: Koryx Copper Files Technical Report with Updated Mineral Resource Estimate
summary: Koryx Copper Inc. filed an updated NI 43-101 technical report for its Haib copper project in Namibia, with an updated mineral resource estimate effective Aug. 31, 2024. The release provides project background and confirms review under Canadian reporting standards, but does not indicate imminent production changes.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: Talon Metals Makes New Copper-Nickel Discovery in Michigan
summary: Talon Metals announces its maiden drill hole at the Boulderdash target in Michigan intersected 99.92 meters of copper-nickel mineralization, including intervals with stated copper and nickel equivalents. The company plans additional drilling and EM surveys. The discovery is early-stage, near existing nickel operations, but not production.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: Talon Metals Makes New Copper-Nickel Discovery in Michigan
summary: Talon Metals announced its first drill hole at the Boulderdash target in Michigan intersected 99.92 meters of copper-nickel mineralization, including high-grade CuEq/NiEq intervals, and plans additional drilling and EM surveys. The release frames it as a potential domestic critical minerals resource near an existing U.S. nickel mine, but provides no production.

title: Surge Copper Intersects 412 metres grading 0.40% CuEq including ?54 metres grading 0.53% CuEq at the Berg Deposit
summary: Surge Copper reported new drill results from its Berg project in British Columbia, including 412m grading 0.40% CuEq and 288m grading 0.30% CuEq, with higher-grade intervals in supergene and hypogene zones. Management expects these holes to upgrade Inferred resources, but no immediate supply change is indicated.

title: [SMM Analysis] Policy Adjustments by Indonesia's New Government: Challenges and Opportunities for the Nickel Industry
summary: Indonesia’s new government targets higher economic growth and plans downstream nickel capacity expansion via hydrometallurgy, which could support nickel demand and output. At the same time, the government aims to raise fiscal revenue and may adjust taxes (higher VAT, potential CIT reduction), creating mixed effects on mining and processing costs, so near-term price impact is uncertain.

title: Hillgrove secures standby facility for Kanmantoo copper mine scale-up
summary: Hillgrove secured a A$10m standby debt facility with Freepoint Metals and Concentrates to provide financial backup for scaling up its Kanmantoo underground copper mine in South Australia. The funding is not currently planned for drawdown, but supports the ramp-up of copper concentrate output and balance sheet flexibility.

title: Royal Road Minerals secures drilling permits for Alouana copper-gold project
summary: Royal Road Minerals secured drilling permits for its Alouana copper-gold project in Morocco and plans ~2,000m of scout drilling targeting multiple zones. No prior drilling has occurred, and the campaign aims to test copper mineralisation thickness and extent. The news may modestly support near-term copper supply expectations.

title: McEwen Copper Announces an Additional US$35 Million Investment by Nuton, a Rio Tinto Venture
summary: McEwen Copper announced the closing of a second $35 million investment by Nuton LLC, a Rio Tinto venture, as part of a larger equity offering. Proceeds will fund feasibility study work for the Los Azules copper project in Argentina. The news is financing-related with no near-term output impact.

title: Teck Resources tops third-quarter profit estimates, cuts full-year copper production forecast
summary: Teck Resources reported third-quarter results and again cut its copper production outlook for 2024 and QB2-related 2025 guidance. Setbacks include haul-truck/autonomous system issues at Highland Valley and grade, dewatering, throughput, and recovery problems at Chile’s QB2 mine. The repeated downgrades raise near-term supply concerns.

title: Anglo American Signals Progress on Pivot to Copper; Keeps Guidance for Key Metals -- Commodities Roundup
summary: Anglo American said it is making progress on a restructuring that will pivot its portfolio toward copper and kept production targets for key metals. It reported digging 13% less copper in Q3, citing a planned closure of a processing plant at the Los Bronces mine in Chile, but maintained overall guidance.

title: Can Anglo's copper pivot help thwart renewed takeover bid?
summary: Reuters reports Anglo American’s move toward a copper-focused strategy and how its restructuring pace may affect a renewed takeover bid by BHP. The company cited a 13% third-quarter copper output decline, though it reaffirmed guidance. Market coverage is mainly deal-related, with only indirect copper price implications.

title: NewRange Copper Nickel hosts open house
summary: NewRange Copper Nickel held an open house to build momentum for plans to develop two copper-nickel deposits near Hoyt Lakes. The project follows Glencore/Teck’s earlier PolyMet efforts that faced permit reversals and lawsuits. NewRange seeks to reapply for key permits in 2025, with mining not expected before 2030.

title: NewRange Copper Nickel hosts open house
summary: NewRange Copper Nickel held an open house to build momentum for two copper-nickel deposits near Hoyt Lakes, with plans to salvage and refurbish an old concentrator. The project faces permitting and legal setbacks, including a revoked Clean Water Act permit, and operations are not expected before 2030, making near-term price effects limited.

title: Chinese nickel pig iron prices push up to 11-month high
summary: Fastmarkets says Chinese nickel pig iron (NPI) prices climbed 20-30 yuan to 1,030-1,050 yuan per nickel unit, the highest since Nov 10, 2023. A major stainless steel tender lifted NPI offers on rumors of joint feedstock price hikes, citing Indonesia ore supply shortages and higher production costs.

title: Teck Resources' share prices falls as miner lowers copper production forecast again
summary: Teck Resources’ share price fell as the miner lowered its copper production forecast again. A reduced output outlook can signal weaker near-term copper supply expectations, which often pressures copper prices in the following days as markets adjust output and supply expectations.

title: Teck Resources' QB2 copper mine 'continues to have challenges,' analyst says  – BNN Bloomberg
summary: Teck’s analyst said the Quebrada Blanca 2 copper mine in northern Chile continues to face ramp-up challenges, operating at roughly 75% of design capacity and hitting a plateau. Teck also cut copper guidance for 2024-2025 after reporting results, adding downside to near-term copper supply expectations.

title: China's Copper Cathode & Secondary Copper Rods Both Weak: What's Happening in the Market?
summary: China’s copper rod market is weak in the September-October peak season, with downstream buyers waiting because absolute copper prices remain high. New orders and production operating rates have not recovered, and secondary rod demand is sluggish due to an eroding/insufficient primary-versus-scrap price incentive and tighter scrap availability.

title: Global nickel premiums stagnant amid falling LME nickel price
summary: Nickel premiums were flat globally for full-plate cathodes, 4×4 cathodes, and briquettes, even as the LME three-month nickel contract hit its lowest 5pm close since mid-September. LME warehouse stocks in Rotterdam are ample and import arbitrage losses narrowed slightly.

title: Reliance Steel & Aluminum Co. (NYSE:RS) Q3 2024 Earnings Call Transcript
summary: Reliance Steel & Aluminum’s earnings call said metals pricing declined more than expected in Q3. Management highlighted aluminum price weakness tied to global market correction and an abundance of low-priced U.S. imports, after effects of Russian sanctions. The company reported lower average selling prices per ton and expects continued choppy demand/pricing near term.

title: Flying Nickel Mining Corp.: Flying Nickel Announces Receipt of Final Order for Arrangement with Norway House
summary: Flying Nickel announced a final court order for an arrangement with Norway House Cree Nation to acquire the company’s Minago nickel project in Manitoba for $8 million cash and related share surrender and royalties. Closing is expected by end of October, subject to customary approvals. No operational or supply changes are detailed.

title: Supply changes and macro uncertainties suppress nickel prices. High-grade NPI prices remain relatively firm but face the risk of decline.
summary: Nickel prices have fallen sharply, with SHFE and LME dropping after intraday declines. The move is linked to Indonesia’s additional RKAB approvals for nickel ore, suggesting rising mining supply, and to US election-driven macro uncertainty that boosts risk-averse sentiment. High-grade NPI remains steadier, though procurement may soften.

title: ITC Determines That Aluminum Printing Plates Are Subsidized By China
summary: The U.S. International Trade Commission determined that imported aluminum printing plates are sold at less than fair value and subsidized by China, prompting potential countervailing and antidumping duties. Preliminary duties were very high (200% China, 87% Japan), and new tariffs could disrupt plate imports tied to aluminum use.

title: FLSmidth A/S: FLSmidth signs strategic cooperation agreement with Enter Engineering for the delivery of core mineral processing equipment for a new copper concentrator production line at Almalyk MMC in Uzbekistan
summary: FLSmidth and Enter Engineering signed an agreement to deliver core mineral processing equipment for the MOF-4 copper-gold-molybdenum concentrator in Almalyk, Uzbekistan. The project is expected to be among the largest copper concentrators globally, with orders potentially totaling around DKK 1.5 billion over several years.

title: Bitcoin (BTC) Bulls Have Several Reasons to Rejoice, Except the Persistent Slide in Copper-Gold Ratio
summary: The article argues that bitcoin’s outlook is clouded by a persistent slide in the copper-to-gold ratio, which dropped to fresh lows after China’s late-September stimulus and despite a Fed rate cut. The falling ratio is framed as a risk-off cue and historically tied to weaker copper demand expectations.

title: US Treasury's finalized Section 45X a big win for secure supply chains, aluminium manufacturing: sources
summary: The US Treasury and IRS finalized Section 45X tax credit rules, expanding eligible definitions and confirming credit amounts for components tied to clean-energy supply chains, including critical minerals. Sources say the guidance is a “game-changer” for primary aluminium producers by reducing cost pressures and supporting modernization and stabilization in a low-price market.

title: Stillwater Critical Minerals Enters Letter of Intent to Sell the Duke Island Cu-Ni-PGE Project in Alaska to Granite Creek Copper
summary: Stillwater Critical Minerals signed a letter of intent for Granite Creek Copper to acquire a 90% interest in the Duke Island Cu-Ni-PGE project in Alaska. The announcement is mainly a project ownership and advancement plan, with no near-term production impact specified, limiting immediate effects on copper and nickel prices.

title: Camino Minerals Corp: Camino Provides Exploration Summary for the Maria Cecilia Copper Porphyry Project in Peru
summary: Camino Minerals reported results from a 2024 summer drilling campaign at its Maria Cecilia copper porphyry project in Peru, including a 234m continuous low-grade copper intercept (0.08% Cu) and anomalous surface chip samples. The company highlighted zonation and ongoing exploration follow-up, with no immediate production changes.

title: White Cliff Minerals Unveils Copper Potential at Rae
summary: White Cliff Minerals reports promising airborne geophysical survey results at its Rae Copper Project in Nunavut, Canada, identifying multiple conductive anomalies that support potential sediment-hosted copper mineralization. The firm plans to refine drilling targets and expand drilling in 2025, with no immediate production or supply impact stated.

title: Balancing Indonesia's ambition in nickel downstreaming with a dose of realism - Academia
summary: The piece argues that Indonesia’s nickel downstreaming push—despite rapid smelter growth and cheap feedstock—may not translate into significant battery capacity or higher nickel value. It notes most nickel output still goes to stainless steel and that foreign competitors are bypassing steps. Beijing’s advice to keep EV components in China raises stakes.

title: World Pumps - FLSmidth to supply core mineral processing equipment for new copper concentrator in Uzbekistan
summary: FLSmidth will supply core mineral processing equipment, including HPGRs, flotation systems, thickeners, filters, and related pumps/cyclones, for a new copper concentrator in Uzbekistan. The plant is expected to become one of the world’s largest. Equipment orders are linked to collaboration with local mining firms.

title: Perseverance Metals Inc.: Perseverance Metals Announces New Critical Mineral Discoveries from the Lac Gayot Nickel-Copper-PGE Project, Quebec
summary: Perseverance Metals reported new high-grade nickel discoveries at its Lac Gayot project (up to ~1.54% Ni in surface samples) and highlighted an airborne HeliTEM2 survey over the property. The company continues nickel-copper-PGE exploration, but provides no production or confirmed near-term supply changes.

title: Perseverance Metals Inc.: Perseverance Metals Announces New Critical Mineral Discoveries from the Lac Gayot Nickel-Copper-PGE Project, Quebec
summary: Perseverance Metals reported new high-grade nickel discoveries at its Lac Gayot nickel-copper-PGE project in Québec, including up to 1.54% nickel in surface samples, plus an airborne HeliTEM survey. The company also identified spodumene-bearing pegmatites, but the direct market impact is mainly nickel-copper exploration sentiment.

title: Sterling Metals Corp.: Sterling Metals Provides Exploration Update for Copper Road, Including up to 15.9% Copper and 4.84% Molybdenum in Surface Grab Samples
summary: Sterling Metals reported high-grade copper and molybdenum values from surface grab samples at its Copper Road porphyry target in Ontario, with an ongoing 3D IP survey to guide drilling. The article is copper-related but contains no production or reserve/timing updates, limiting any near-term price impact.

title: Canadian Copper to acquire Caribou processing plant in New Brunswick
summary: Canadian Copper has signed a term sheet to acquire the Caribou processing plant complex in New Brunswick, aiming to restart processing for the nearby Murray Brook polymetallic deposit using the plant’s permitted milling capacity. The move is designed to speed timeline, reduce costs, and enable earlier copper concentrate production.

title: Sterling Metals Corp. Provides Exploration Update for Copper Road, Including Up to 15.9% Copper and 4.84% Molybdenum in Surface Grab Samples
summary: Sterling Metals reported initial Phase 1 exploration results at its Copper Road project in Ontario, with surface grab samples returning up to 15.9% Cu and 4.84% Mo, plus evidence of a ~2 km footprint of porphyry mineralization. The news is development-focused and unlikely to materially move near-term copper prices, especially beyond sentiment.

title: Anglo American unlocking "sterilised" copper resources
summary: Anglo American says it has developed technologies and stakeholder approaches to “unlock” undeveloped copper resources that were sterilised by environmental and community constraints. It highlights water-security projects at Los Bronces and hydraulic dewatered stacking at El Soldado, supporting a more sustainable path to future copper production.

title: Australian miners partner to develop copper-gold resources in Tennant Creek
summary: Emmerson Resources, CuFe, and Tennant Minerals formed a strategic alliance to advance copper-gold and critical metals projects in Australia’s Tennant Creek region. The plan includes a shared hub-and-spoke processing facility to shorten the path to production, supported by high-grade copper results at projects like Bluebird.

title: Southern Copper : 3Q24 Conference Call transcript
summary: Southern Copper’s Q3 2024 conference call updates the copper market view, citing LME copper strength and expecting a slight 2024 surplus (~100,000 tons). The company reports higher Q3 copper output (up 11% q/q), production growth plans for 2024, and discusses costs and byproducts; no comparable near-term catalysts for nickel or aluminium are stated.

title: MAWARID MINING EXPORTS FIRST SHIPMENT OF OMANI COPPER CONCENTRATES, MARKING A NEW MILESTONE IN THE SULTANATE's MINING INDUSTRY
summary: Mawarid Mining announced the successful export of its first shipment of Omani copper concentrates from the Al Ghuzayn underground project. The mine and Lasail concentrator are designed to process large ore volumes and produce about 20,000 tons of copper concentrate annually for export, adding incremental copper supply.

title: Chilean Economy Under Pressure Despite Positive Performance as Copper Demand Weakens
summary: The piece says the Chilean peso is under pressure as China’s $1.4 trillion stimulus is not translating into stronger industrial profits, which fell 27.1%, indicating weaker copper demand. With China Chile’s main partner, the weaker outlook for copper demand could pressure copper prices in the near term.

title: Bougainville Copper settles dispute with Bougainville Government
summary: Bougainville Copper has agreed with the Autonomous Bougainville Government to extend its exploration licence for the Panguna copper-gold project by five years. The settlement resolves disputes over exploration rights and should reduce uncertainty, helping the company evaluate future development pathways after decades of inactivity.

title: Shares of Chinese Aluminum Giant Chalco Fall After Disappointing Earnings
summary: Shares of China Aluminum Corp. of China (Chalco) fell sharply after weaker-than-expected Q3 profits. Analysts attributed the miss to smelting depreciation adjustments and changes related to power surcharge and bauxite reserves. While production and sales improved sequentially, the earnings disappointment spurred short-term profit taking, pressuring aluminium-related sentiment.

title: Selby men charged with copper wire theft at Fiddler's Ferry | Runcorn and Widnes World
summary: Four men were charged with burglarizing the derelict Fiddler’s Ferry power station near Warrington, allegedly stealing about £7,000 worth of copper cables. Authorities say they used tools such as an angle grinder and saw and had batteries and spanners. No broader supply disruption is described.

title: Saudi Arabia in advanced talks over Zambia copper mine stake, Ma'aden CEO says
summary: Saudi Arabia’s Ma’aden/Manara says it is in advanced talks over acquiring a minority stake in a Zambian copper mine, expecting a deal by year-end. Prior Reuters sources linked the stake purchase to First Quantum Minerals’ Zambian copper and nickel assets, but no immediate operational changes are mentioned.

title: State is taking comments on Copperwood Mine planned for U.P.
summary: Michigan state officials are accepting public comments and holding a virtual hearing on an air permit for Highland Copper’s proposed Copperwood underground mine in Gogebic County. The permit will set limits on mining-related emissions to meet air-quality standards. The outcome is uncertain, with no decision timeline provided.

title: Commodities Prices - Copper prices subdued ahead of US election, key China meeting
summary: Copper prices were subdued ahead of the US election and a key China meeting. Three-month LME copper edged up 0.1% to around $9,542/ton, while SHFE December copper was also discussed, suggesting near-term hesitation and no strong directional impulse. Other commodities mentioned do not change copper fundamentals here.

title: PAN GLOBAL COMMENCES GROUND GEOPHYSICS AT BRAVO COPPER TARGET, ESCACENA PROJECT, IN PREPARATION FOR MAIDEN DRILL PROGRAM
summary: Pan Global initiated an IP geophysical survey at the Bravo copper target within Spain’s Escacena Project to refine drilling locations. Gravity, soil geochemistry, and helicopter EM anomalies suggest concealed VMS sulphide mineralization possibly hosting copper. Financing is on track, but no drilling results or output changes are announced.

title: BeMetals Corp.: BeMetals 2024 Shallow Aircore Results Extend Footprint of Nkala Copper Zone by 1.3 km and Identifies Additional Satellite Targets at Pangeni Project, Zambia
summary: BeMetals announced 2024 shallow aircore drilling at Zambia’s Pangeni Copper Project, extending the Nkala Zone footprint and identifying several new copper anomalies, with further core results expected in coming weeks. The news is exploration-focused and does not indicate immediate production or market supply changes for copper.

title: Glencore production results reveal falling zinc, nickel production
summary: Glencore reported lower nickel production in the first three quarters of 2024, driven by Koniambo’s move to care and maintenance. Higher output from Australia’s Murrin Murrin partly offset the decline, and with IRA-compliant briquettes becoming more constrained, the nickel briquette premium in the US rose sharply.

title: Abandoned copper mines embraced as fast track to boost output
summary: Reuters reports companies are restarting shuttered copper mines and other abandoned assets to fast-track additional supply for the clean-energy and AI demand outlook. Examples include Canada, Quebec and Spain reopenings, with output targets over the next years. The revival is largely driven by recent high copper (and nickel) prices.

title: BHP leaves a new offer for British copper miner Anglo on the table
summary: BHP said comments from its chairman at Anglo American’s AGM were not intended to rule out a renewed takeover offer. The firm had previously dropped a $49 billion bid after multiple refusals, with a late-November freeze expiry prompting speculation. The U.K. Takeover Panel confirmed no intention-to-offer signal was implied.

title: Foran Mining: Construction of a Copper Mine in Canada with Great Economics and Upscaling Potential
summary: Swiss Resource Capital reports that Foran Mining plans/construction is underway for a new copper mine in Canada, highlighting strong economics and potential upscaling. The news is tied specifically to future copper supply and mining investment, which can improve short-term market sentiment toward copper, though no immediate output is quantified.

title: New copper, nickel discovery made in Upper Peninsula
summary: Talon Metals announced discovery of 99.92 meters of copper and nickel mineralization at the Boulderdash target in Michigan’s Upper Peninsula. Using surface prospecting, geophysics, and maiden drilling, the company says results confirm the source of mineralized boulders. It highlights potential domestic critical mineral supply.

title: Flying Nickel Mining Corp.: Flying Nickel Announces Closing of $8 Million Minago Sale with Norway House
summary: Flying Nickel Mining Corp. announced the closing of an $8 million sale of its Minago Nickel Project to Norway House Cree Nation via a purchaser entity. The transaction transfers the project and related obligations and cancels NHCN’s shareholding. It signals asset repositioning but provides no immediate production or supply figures affecting nickel prices.

title: Eight dead after copper mine pit collapses in Zambia
summary: Eight miners died after an open-pit copper mine pit collapsed in Chingola, Zambia, with one missing and two survivors. Victims were informal prospectors searching for copper without permission. The incident follows other fatal collapses in Zambia, with authorities citing the deaths as unacceptable, but no quantified production impact is provided.

title: BeMetals Expands Copper Targets in Zambian Project
summary: BeMetals updated progress on its Pangeni Copper Project in Zambia, adding four new key copper targets and extending the Nkala Zone. An aircore drilling program yielded results supportive of expanding the mineralized footprint, boosting expectations for a potential major copper discovery. The news is primarily copper-focused.

title: Big hit extends Strickland Serbia copper-gold strike to 150m
summary: Strickland Metals says drilling at its Medenovac prospect in Serbia has extended thick, high-grade copper-gold mineralisation, with new intersections reported and a maiden resource potentially in Q1 next year. The update strengthens the project’s future copper outlook, but no near-term production or supply impact is indicated.

title: Kinusi Copper Mine Operations Update | Company Announcement
summary: Marula Mining reported continued open-pit drilling/blasting, stockpiling, and sample testing at its Kinusi copper mine in Tanzania. Trial shipments of stockpiled copper oxide ores are planned for the quarter while metallurgical work and contracts progress toward Phase 1 processing capacity of 24,000 tpa, supporting near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Tomago Aluminium needs energy certainty to achieve green metals potential. | Newcastle Herald
summary: Tomago Aluminium says it wants to shift toward renewables by 2035, but requires certainty of renewable power supply and transmission at internationally competitive prices. It produces about 600,000 tonnes of aluminium and argues for incentives, streamlined approvals, and investment support to sustain primary aluminium and enable “green aluminium” growth.

title: Copper Fox Metals Inc.: Copper Fox Provides Update on Drill Permitting at Mineral Mountain
summary: Copper Fox provided an update on U.S. permitting for a maiden drilling program at its Mineral Mountain porphyry copper project in Arizona. After BLM approval of a Plan of Operations, the company is completing an Environmental Assessment following a biological evaluation under ESA. No permit decision or drilling start date is provided.

title: District Copper Corp: District Copper Reports Highly Encouraging Results at Copper Keg Project in British Columbia
summary: District Copper reports highly encouraging 2024 field results from its Copper Keg project in British Columbia, including soil sampling with elevated copper anomalies (average 45.8 ppm Cu; 8 samples above 100 ppm Cu) and favorable porphyry-style geology. The news supports exploration prospects but implies no near-term production impact.

title: American Pacific Mining Corp.: American Pacific Drills 10.4 Metres of 1.17% Copper, 12.17% Zinc, 1.01 g/t Gold and 101.49 g/t Silver (7.3% Copper Equivalent) from Zone 1 at the Palmer Copper-Zinc VMS Project
summary: American Pacific Mining reported early assay results from its Palmer copper-zinc VMS project in Alaska, including strong copper grades such as 10.4 metres of 1.17% Cu. The company frames the drilling as successful in extending and infilling the mineralized zone, which could modestly bolster copper sentiment despite no current output changes.

title: Steppe Copper and Cuprum Energy to cooperate in hydrometallurgy sector
summary: Mongolia and Kazakhstan held a joint business council session, including a memorandum between Steppe Copper and Cuprum Energy to cooperate in hydrometallurgy. The deal aims to apply Mongolian engineering experience in cathode copper production to Kazakhstan, but provides no immediate output or trade volume changes.

title: Power Nickel Announces Major Copper Discovery as Gold Hits Historic High more stocks inside….
summary: Power Nickel Inc. says it made its most significant copper-equivalent discovery to date at the Lion Zone, drilling a 39.6-meter intersection grading 4.19% CuEq. The CEO highlights the richness of the contained metal. The update may modestly bolster copper sentiment by improving future supply prospects.

title: Power Nickel Announces Major Copper Discovery as Gold Hits Historic High more stocks inside….
summary: Power Nickel Inc. announced its largest copper-equivalent discovery to date, reporting a 39.6-meter drill intersection grading 4.19% CuEq at the Lion Zone. The company characterized the result as exceptionally rich in contained metal, which could bolster market confidence in future copper supply prospects.

title: US not impose anti-dumping duties on aluminum extrusions from Vietnam
summary: Vietnam’s trade authority said the US Department of Commerce will not impose anti-dumping duties on aluminium extrusions imported from 14 countries/territories, including Vietnam. The ITC found the US industry was not significantly injured, despite prior DOC dumping/subsidy findings, reducing tariff-driven support for aluminum extrusion prices.

title: Capstone Copper Corp.: Capstone Copper Reports Third Quarter 2024 Results
summary: Capstone Copper reported Q3 2024 results, highlighting 47,460 tonnes of copper production and lower C1 cash costs, plus Mantoverde achieving commercial production in September and delivering first concentrate shipments. The company also cited a higher realized copper price and expects Q4 to be its strongest quarter, though 2024 guidance remains at the low end.

title: EGLE presents draft permit for Copperwood Mine project
summary: EGLE has released a draft air pollution permit for Highland Copper’s Copperwood Mine, outlining annual pollutant and explosives-emulsion limits and requiring inspections and a malfunction abatement plan. Public comment focused on vent placement, noise, and environmental impacts. The permit is still under review, so near-term output is uncertain.

title: West Africa's Capesize growth hits new heights: Bauxite, iron ore, and manganese propel the region forward
summary: West Africa’s Capesize bulk exports are accelerating, led by Guinea’s expanding bauxite shipments to China. Analysts cite rising total volumes and a sharp shift in cargo mix toward Guinean bauxite. Jefferies data shows bauxite’s global Capesize share has increased, implying stronger aluminium feedstock supply expectations.

title: 3 Questions: Can we secure a sustainable supply of nickel?
summary: MIT researchers assess nickel’s growing role in EVs and renewables and the risks in its supply chain, emphasizing Indonesia’s dominance and coal-based processing’s high emissions, plus land, pollution, and social impacts. Policymakers are urged to enforce sustainability standards, but no immediate market action is announced.

title: High-Nickel Pig Iron Prices Face Downward Pressure Amid Supply and Demand Shifts
summary: High-nickel pig iron prices are falling this week: SMM 8–12% Ni pig iron averaged 1,022.1 yuan per nickel point, down week-on-week, and Indonesia’s NPI FOB index also declined. Weaker stainless steel spot prices worsen steel mill margins and dampen purchases, despite some cost support and improved supply/profitability signals.

title: Tasmanian farmers urge action on escalating copper thefts | Stock & Land
summary: Tasmanian farmers report escalating thefts of copper cabling from irrigation equipment after storms. One farmer estimates losses of $16,000–$18,000 for replacement and repair, delaying crop watering. Farmers urge tougher penalties, but the reported incidents appear localized rather than system-wide supply disruption for copper.

title: Silver lining? Why an Australian startup is betting on a copper solar boom
summary: An Australian startup, SunDrive Solar, backed by major investors, plans to scale copper-based solar cell technology via a joint venture with Trina and seeks funding under Australia’s Solar Sunshot program. If commercialized, the copper cells could replace silver-focused PV approaches, supporting future copper demand.

title: ASX RIO: Rio Tinto wants aluminium subsidies under Future Made In Australia policy
summary: Rio Tinto urged the Albanese government to introduce production credits for Australian aluminium smelters under the Future Made In Australia policy. It warned smelter operations in Queensland and NSW may not continue past 2030 without a shift from coal-heavy power to clean energy, highlighting supply risk.

title: ASX RIO: Rio Tinto racing to seal Mongolian copper deal over giant Oyu Tolgoi mine
summary: Rio Tinto is in talks with Entree Resources and the Mongolian government to secure additional copper-rich tenements for the Oyu Tolgoi project. Management is racing to avoid a slump in copper grades and output at the mine, which is expected to be among the world’s top copper producers by 2030.

title: Alba and Daiki Aluminium Reiterate Commitment to Sustainable Aluminium Production at Gateway Gulf 2024
summary: Alba and Daiki Aluminium plan to form a joint venture (ADSS) to build a sustainable aluminium dross processing facility in Bahrain. Alba holds a 70% stake and Daiki 30%. The partners target operations to begin by September 2026, highlighting recycling and sustainability goals rather than immediate production changes.

title: Pan Asia grabs 17 per cent rock chip in Chilean copper zone
summary: Pan Asia Metals says rock-chip and soil sampling at its Rosario copper project in Chile outlined a large mineralised zone and returned spot XRF grades up to 17% copper. Assays and IP survey results are pending, with plans for RC drilling. The update is copper-positive for sentiment.

title: Ball : Acquires Alucan to Expand Sustainable Impact Extruded Aluminum Packaging Solutions in Europe
summary: Ball Corporation acquired Alucan to expand its European extruded aluminum aerosol and bottle packaging business, adding manufacturing facilities in Spain and Belgium. The plants aim to meet growing demand and will lightweight cans with higher recycled content, increasing aluminum packaging output and potentially supporting near-term aluminum input demand.

title: Solgold plc Announces Commencement of Geotechnical Investigations At the Cascabel Copper-Gold Porphyry Project
summary: SolGold began geotechnical investigations at its Cascabel copper-gold porphyry project in Ecuador, including drilling and seismic assessments to refine ground conditions for mine infrastructure. The pre-feasibility plan targets 3.2Mt copper (0.60%) and schedules further feasibility work. The step is incremental and not a near-term copper supply shock.

title: Copper and Other Metals Gain on Weak Dollar, China Stimulus Hope
summary: Copper and other metals reportedly gained as the U.S. dollar weakened and markets built hopes for China stimulus. The combination tends to improve risk sentiment and expected industrial demand, generally supporting prices for industrial metals like copper, aluminium, and nickel over the coming days.

title: North Bay Resources Announces Assays up to 9.5% Copper at Murex Copper Project, British Columbia
summary: North Bay Resources reported assay results of up to 9.5% copper from its Murex Copper Project in British Columbia, describing high-grade rock chip samples in the D Zone and other mapped copper-bearing areas. The release is based on Summer 2024 exploration sampling and filed assessment work, not commercial production.

title: Japan's Sumitomo Plans to Sell Madagascar's Largest Nickel Mine
summary: Sumitomo is resuming operations at its Ambatovy nickel project in Madagascar after production was paused by a pipeline rupture. The mine has missed prior output targets and faced write-downs, and a nickel export revenue decline is noted. With the market already weak, restored supply expectations may support nickel prices.

title: Kutcho Copper Corp.: Kutcho Copper Closes Financing
summary: Kutcho Copper Corp. closed a non-brokered private placement raising $1.29 million to advance the Kutcho copper project and for working capital. Units were sold at $0.10 with warrants exercisable at $0.16. The company paid finder fees and awaits final TSX Venture approval.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Reports Third Quarter 2024 Financial Results
summary: Faraday Copper reported Q3 2024 financial results and highlighted ongoing exploration drilling at its Copper Creek Project in Arizona, including multiple copper intercepts and positive metallurgical outcomes. The release also notes equity funding and future technical reporting milestones. It is largely company-specific with no clear immediate impact on overall copper supply or demand.

title: Teck Outlines Detailed Strategy for Leading Copper Growth
summary: Teck Resources presented its strategy to grow copper production to ~800 ktpa before decade end, backed by $3.2–$3.9B investment over four years and a strong balance sheet. Projects such as Quebrada Blanca optimization and mine life extensions are expected to lift copper output in 2024-2025.

title: Teck Resources To Outline Growth Strategy And Copper Production Goals At 2024 Strategy Day
summary: Teck Resources said it will present its strategy and plans to boost copper production to about 800,000 tonnes per year by the end of the decade. The company plans US$3.2–3.9bn of investment in four near-term copper projects and forecasts output rising to 420–455 kt in 2024 and 510–590 kt in 2025.

title: L&F to supply nickel-95 cathode materials
summary: L&F says it will start producing NCM cathodes with 95% nickel content for BEV lithium-ion batteries by end-2024, with shipments to cell manufacturers beginning in December. The company cites technology progress from N90 to N95 and expects more volume, supporting incremental nickel demand sentiment.

title: Inomin, Sumitomo partner on British Columbia nickel project
summary: Inomin and Sumitomo have signed a non-binding term sheet to jointly develop the Beaver-Lynx nickel project in British Columbia. Sumitomo could earn up to 80% via C$8m in exploration spend in two phases. Early results suggest significant nickel volumes, though the JV remains subject to due diligence.

title: TRU Precious Metals Corp.: TRU Copper Exploration Program Returns Samples Assaying 3.7% and 3.2% Cu at Golden Rose
summary: TRU Precious Metals reported assay results from its Golden Rose copper exploration program in Newfoundland, including rock/float samples up to 3.7% Cu at multiple prospects. The company says the findings expand copper target zones and will be incorporated with earn-in partner Eldorado’s model, with soils pending.

title: L&F to mass produce cathodes with 95% nickel content
summary: South Korean materials maker L&F plans to mass produce NCM battery cathodes with 95% nickel content starting in December and supply Korean battery makers and US EV manufacturers. The move suggests higher near-term consumption of nickel-rich cathode materials, which can lift short-term nickel demand expectations and support nickel prices.

title: Public hearing draws on big questions about U.P. copper mining
summary: Michigan’s EGLE is holding a public comment process for an air-use permit for the proposed Copperwood underground copper mine near Lake Superior. Opponents cite environmental justice and emissions concerns, while officials say the permit focuses on air standards. No decision timeline is set, leaving near-term copper supply uncertainty.

title: Canada Nickel Intersects Massive Sulphide at Bannockburn Project
summary: Canada Nickel announced it intersected 3.9 metres of massive sulphide within 12.7 metres of mineralization at its Bannockburn Property near Timmins, Ontario. The company said this is the first massive sulphide drilled in the Timmins Nickel District, suggesting improved prospects for nickel mineralization at the site.

title: Megado Minerals enters agreement to acquire 80% stake in Iberian Copper
summary: Megado Minerals agreed to acquire an 80% stake in Iberian Copper’s Spanish copper project and plans to fund development through a rights issue and share placements. Sampling at the former St. Emilia mine returned high copper grades. The transaction awaits approvals and proceeds depend on future mine construction decisions.

title: Doré Copper Provides Update on Arrangement Agreement With Cygnus Metals
summary: Doré Copper announced progress on its definitive arrangement agreement with Cygnus Metals, including Cygnus raising commitments and a first tranche to fund the acquisition. The update supports company-level financing for Doré Copper’s Québec copper project, but provides no new production, cost, or demand information for copper markets.

title: Rio Tinto Partners With SPIC To Trial Battery Swap Technology At Oyu Tolgoi Copper Mine
summary: Rio Tinto partnered with China’s SPIC to trial battery-swap electric haul trucks at its Oyu Tolgoi copper mine in Mongolia.
