A two-year project will test eight 91-tonne trucks and a robotic battery swapping/charging system for non-production use. No direct changes to copper output or inventories are indicated.

title: US Imports Russian Aluminum for 1st Time Since 2023 in September
summary: Sputnik analysis of US customs data says the US imported 798 tonnes of unprocessed Russian aluminium in September—the first time since 2023—totaling $1.9 million. It follows a prior US ban on Russian aluminium imports and related trading services imposed in April 2024, suggesting changed supply flows.

title: Copper Drops as Dollar Strengthens on Early US Election Results
summary: Copper is reported to be dropping as the US dollar strengthens after early US election results. The move suggests tighter USD conditions reduced demand expectations for dollar-priced industrial metals, pressuring copper prices in the near term despite election-related uncertainty.

title: Copper Drops as Dollar Strengthens on Trump Lead in US Election
summary: Copper prices reportedly declined as the US dollar strengthened on expectations tied to a Trump lead in the US election. The move implies near-term bearish pressure for copper given the currency effect on dollar-denominated commodity pricing and trading sentiment.

title: Rentails project expands tin and copper resources | The Advocate
summary: Metals X reported an expanded mineral resource estimate for the Rentails tailings retreatment project at Tasmania’s Renison mine. Tin and copper contained in the D Dam tailings increased, with copper measured up 15% to 62,000 tonnes. The project will require further feasibility, approvals, and construction.

title: Copper smelters to face tough time in 2025
summary: Fastmarkets reports copper concentrate TCs have been below $10/t in 2024, with expectations for 2025 benchmarks to fall sharply into the $20s or below. Sources warn of potential smelter financial stress and a large concentrate deficit, limiting full-rate output despite some disruptions and project delays.

title: Armenia's copper concentrate production up 11.4 per cent in 9 months
summary: Armenia’s copper concentrate output rose 11.3% to 232,372 tons in January–September 2024 versus the same period a year earlier, according to the National Statistical Committee. Zinc and molybdenum concentrate production changed in opposite directions. The copper production increase may signal higher supply for downstream refining.

title: PROFILE - Donald Trump: From real estate kingdom to US presidency for 2nd time
summary: The profile notes Trump’s return to office and his stated plans for new protectionist tariffs, including a 60% customs tax on goods from China and additional duties on imports from other countries. It also recalls his earlier tariffs on steel and aluminum, suggesting a tariff backdrop supportive for aluminium prices.

title: Rio Tinto to trial battery swap trucks at Mongolia's Oyu Tolgoi copper mine
summary: Rio Tinto will trial battery-swap technology for electric haul trucks at Mongolia’s Oyu Tolgoi copper mine via SPIC. Eight 91t trucks and a robotic swap/charging setup will be commissioned progressively, initially for above-ground non-production tasks. The project targets less downtime and faster electrification assessment.

title: Windarra gold and nickel tailings project agreement now unconditional
summary: Poseidon Nickel said its Windarra tailings agreement with Encore Minerals is now unconditional after meeting conditions. The project—about 720 km from Perth—includes processing gold tailings using glycine leaching technology and could begin production, receiving upfront payments and royalties. Better development prospects likely support nickel sentiment near term.

title: Guinea's Next Move: Will It Follow Indonesia's Bauxite Export Ban?
summary: Guinea halted bauxite exports from EGA’s GAC subsidiary, prompting a sharp alumina price jump to record levels in Shanghai. The government/EGA talks could prolong the suspension or affect refinery operations and bauxite availability. Given Guinea’s large bauxite share, the news is likely to support aluminium prices near term.

title: Trump win prompts uncertainty, fears of trade war for Canada's steel and aluminum producers
summary: Canada’s steel and aluminum producers face uncertainty after Trump’s election and his campaign talk of broad U.S. tariffs. History includes 2018–2020 tariff back-and-forth between the U.S. and Canada, plus existing USMCA monitoring. Aluminum industry leaders warn another flareup and tariff-based concessions are possible, weighing on prices.

title: Material Matters: Copper, Aluminium & Lithium
summary: The piece notes Trump’s US election win could bring tariff hikes on China, pressuring base metals in the short term. Offsetting that, brokers see an accelerating copper deficit from electrification demand and expect aluminium supply deficits. Nickel is expected to remain weak with rising LME inventories and softer demand.

title: Material Matters: Copper, Aluminium & Lithium
summary: The piece links Donald Trump’s US election win to potential tariff hikes on China, a short-term headwind for base metals. It also highlights RBC’s view of accelerating copper deficits from electrification and Wilsons’ forecast of an aluminium swing to deficit as China’s supply growth is constrained. Nickel remains pressured by inventories and soft demand.

title: Saudi Arabia Eyes Strategic Copper Investment to Bolster Mining Ambitions – The Middle East Observer
summary: Saudi Arabia’s Ma’aden/Manara Minerals is in advanced talks to acquire a 15%–20% stake in Zambian copper assets held by First Quantum Minerals, potentially valuing $1.5–$2 billion. The deal is expected to close by year-end. Aluminium is mentioned as a strategic priority but without any specific transaction.

title: Metal Energy Corp.: Metal Energy Completes Highland Valley Copper Acquisition
summary: Metal Energy completed acquisition of a 100% interest in the Highland Valley Copper project adjacent to Teck’s Highland Valley Copper mine. The property hosts copper-rich mineralization in Zones 1 and 2 and will begin new geophysical work ahead of permitted drilling, but no immediate production impact is stated.

title: Barrick Quarterly Earnings Buoyed by Higher Gold, Copper Prices
summary: Barrick’s quarterly earnings improved as both gold and realized copper prices rose. Realized copper was up 13% year-on-year, and copper output increased to 48,000 tons from 43,000 tons in the prior quarter. The company expects production growth into Q4 from capacity ramps at several sites.

title: Jubilee Metals quarterly copper output slumps after limited run time
summary: Jubilee Metals said its copper production fell to 744 tonnes in the first quarter from 1,048 tonnes previously, citing limited run time during linkage to the Roan concentrator ramp-up and power outages in Zambia. The company raised some other output but maintained copper guidance for the half-year ahead.

title: Market remains skeptical about China's easing restrictions on recycled copper and aluminium imports from mid-November
summary: China will implement from Nov 15 clarified rules that widen categories for importing recycled copper and aluminium scrap, but market participants doubt near-term volumes due to unchanged copper quality requirements. Copper inflow gains are expected limited, while aluminium scrap demand is stronger; however high import prices and LME volatility curb buying.

title: Market remains skeptical about China's easing restrictions on recycled copper and aluminium imports from mid-November
summary: China’s MEE scheduled new categories for recycled copper and aluminium scrap imports to take effect Nov 15, but copper quality thresholds remain strict, limiting incremental scrap inflows and keeping copper scrap discount pressure modest. Aluminium scrap demand is stronger, though high import prices and LME futures restrain near-term buying.

title: Trump's re-election sparks aluminium market optimism in US; Europe, Latin America watchful of trade impacts
summary: Trump’s re-election is seen as bullish for US aluminium, with expectations of continued tariffs and possible tighter rules of origin that could affect imports from China-linked supply chains and Latin America. Despite election volatility, aluminium remains supported by upstream supply disruptions and tight supply, lifting US and European premiums.

title: Jaguar Land Rover says aluminium shortages dragging on profits
summary: Jaguar Land Rover said aluminium shortages and supply disruptions have temporarily curtailed production, including a hold on 6,000+ vehicles and a 10% fall in quarterly profits. It linked issues to its unnamed aluminium supplier and notes Europe flooding halted aluminium plant output, expecting improvement later.

title: Metro Mining secures new bauxite cargo offtake contracts in Australia
summary: Metro Mining secured additional multi-cargo bauxite offtake contracts for its Bauxite Hills Mine in Queensland, raising contracted volumes for 2025–2026 and extending dealings with Xinfa Aluminium Group. It also uses contracts of affreightment with fixed charter and bunker rates, and increased loading capacity via its Ikamba terminal.

title: Metal Energy acquires 100% interest in Highland Valley Copper project
summary: Metal Energy completed the acquisition of the Highland Valley Copper Project in British Columbia, securing 100% ownership from Happy Creek Minerals. Terms include cash and share issuance plus a 2.5% net smelter royalty, with exploration and $2.5m financing requirements. The news supports future copper development but is not supply-shifting immediately.

title: Huayou Cobalt seeks $2.7bn for Ford-backed nickel plant in Indonesia
summary: Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt is seeking about $2.7bn financing for a Ford-backed HPAL nickel processing facility in Indonesia, using ore from Vale’s Pomalaa Block mine to produce battery-grade nickel. The fundraising comes while nickel prices are subdued near a four-year low due to weaker stainless and slower EV demand growth.

title: ESCOM Transformer Ransacked for Copper Wires in Mitundu, Police Search for Suspects
summary: Police in Lilongwe are investigating theft of copper wires from an ESCOM transformer at Mlale farm in Mitundu, shortly after lightning damaged the original unit. ESCOM had planned repairs and replacement, but unknown suspects removed the transformer and cut all wires. Investigations are ongoing.

title: China opens up copper blending business to private firms, sources say
summary: China has licensed more private firms to blend and process more polluting complex copper concentrates domestically, widening import flexibility and easing concentrate grade constraints. With China a major copper smelter/importer facing concentrate shortages, the change could improve smelter feed supply and influence near-term refined copper availability and prices.

title: Koryx Copper Closes Second Tranche of Oversubscribed
summary: Koryx Copper closed the second tranche of an oversubscribed private placement, raising about $5.2M (at $1.10/share) and bringing total gross proceeds to about $14.9M. Net proceeds will support the Haib copper project in Namibia, Zambia projects, and working capital, which can modestly improve copper development sentiment.

title: GoldHaven Completes Acquisition of Copper Peak Metals Inc.
summary: GoldHaven Resources reports it has completed the acquisition of Copper Peak Metals Inc., including its 100% mineral interests in properties in British Columbia. The announcement covers share consideration and a small option payment but does not indicate immediate production changes or disruptions that would materially move copper prices soon.

title: Foundation stone for Mazoon Copper Project to be laid on Sunday
summary: Oman’s Mazoon Mining Company plans to lay the foundation stone for the Mazoon Copper Project in Yanqul Wilayat. The integrated project includes five mines and a processing plant aimed at producing 2.5 million tonnes of copper ore annually for copper concentrate. It supports copper value-chain expansion in Oman.

title: Iran's aluminum output falls by 4% y/y in 7 months to October
summary: IMIDRO said Iran’s aluminum ingot output in four major smelters fell to 352,423 mt in the seven months to Oct. 21 versus 367,091 mt a year earlier. The largest smelter SALCO contributed nearly 41% of total output, while alumina and bauxite output rose.

title: Steel, Copper, Nickel, Cobalt: How Policy Changes Could Impact Metal Demand
summary: The article says the renewables sector could face policy changes under a new Trump administration, potentially redirecting IRA-linked funding away from renewable and EV projects. Because copper is used in solar and electrification and nickel in energy storage and EVs, weaker renewable demand expectations could pressure their prices.

title: Steel, Copper, Nickel, Cobalt: How Policy Changes Could Impact Metal Demand
summary: The article says the Renewables sector could face demand headwinds if the Trump administration shifts funding away from Biden-era renewable initiatives, including possible changes to Inflation Reduction Act support. Since copper is used in solar/grid wiring and nickel in EVs and energy storage, weaker policy-driven demand could pressure their prices.

title: PT Vale Indonesia and GEM sign net-zero nickel production site collaboration  - Quick Dispatch
summary: Indonesia’s PT Vale Indonesia and GEM signed a collaboration for a US$1.4bn HPAL project in Central Sulawesi aimed at a net-zero processing site for nickel. The project targets at least 60,000 tonnes of contained nickel in MHP annually, alongside R&D, ESG initiatives, and community development.

title: Great Southern Copper raises nearly GBP800,000 via placing
summary: Great Southern Copper PLC raised about GBP780,000 via a placing of 62.4 million shares at 1.25 pence, with warrants exercisable later. Proceeds will fund expanded drilling and exploration at its Chile Especularita copper-gold project over the next 6–12 months. No near-term production effects are indicated.

title: Koryx raises N$93m more for Namibian copper mine
summary: Koryx Copper raised about US$5.2 million in a second equity tranche to fund development work at Namibia’s Haib copper project, plus Zambia’s Luanshya West Project and working capital. The company reports strong investor demand and plans increased drilling ahead of a 2025 PEA update.

title: Lindian to monetise Guinean bauxite
summary: Lindian Resources signed a 10-year lease and royalty agreement for its Woula bauxite project in Guinea, with production targeted to start within 12 months. Guinea-based lessees will mine about 2 mtpa and use preferential port rights, supporting future bauxite supply and aluminium-alumina feedstock expectations.

title: Canada Nickel Announces Assay Results from Massive Sulphide Intersection at Bannockburn Project
summary: Canada Nickel announced assay results from drillhole BAN24-18 at its Bannockburn project, including 3.95% nickel over 4 metres and up to 4.65% nickel over 1 metre. The interval also reports minor copper (0.40% over 12 metres). The update supports bullish near-term sentiment for nickel.

title: G11 sees 75km-long massive copper sulphide potential in NSW
summary: G11 Resources reported significant copper-rich VMS drill intercepts at its Wilandra copper corridor in NSW, while Firetail Resources released high-grade massive copper-zinc-silver intercepts from its Skyline copper project in Newfoundland. Both pieces are exploration updates with no stated near-term mine output changes.

title: Hindustan Copper's Profit Soars by 67% in Q2 2024
summary: Hindustan Copper reported a 67.4% rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 101.67 crore, driven by higher operating revenue (Rs 518.19 crore vs Rs 381.40 crore). As India’s only integrated copper producer, improved business performance can bolster near-term expectations for copper market fundamentals.

title: Chile's Codelco offers copper to Chinese clients at a premium of $89/t, sources say
summary: Codelco, Chile’s state copper producer, has offered its 2025 refined copper output to Chinese clients at a premium of $89 per tonne over LME, largely unchanged from last year. Premiums are a demand/tightness indicator. The offer comes as Codelco tries to lift production after historic lows.

title: Copper views Trump win through Chinese lens: Andy Home
summary: Reuters notes Trump’s win did not recreate the 2016 copper rally. Copper traded risk-off ahead of the result, then rebounded on hopes of China stimulus tied to tariff threats. China’s $1.4 trillion debt measures disappointed bulls, triggering renewed selling. The piece also cites higher U.S. duties on Chinese aluminium.

title: Floods at Swiss Aluminum Supplier Drag Down JLR Q2 Revenues
summary: Floods forced Novelis to declare force majeure and stop production at its Sierre, Switzerland aluminum mill in June. Jaguar Land Rover links aluminum supply constraints to weaker Q2 revenues and profits and expects recovery later in 2024, highlighting near-term tightness for aluminum supply.

title: Premium Nickel Resources Ltd.: Premium Nickel Extends Selebi Mines Study Phase and Provides Operational Update
summary: Premium Nickel Resources extended the study phase for its Selebi Mines project by one year to complete an economic study and a US$25 million milestone payment. It continues drilling and metallurgical/engineering work, and reports historic drill core data including nickel and copper to support an upcoming resource estimate.

title: Atlantic Copper and Alter Enersun agree to build a 30 MWp photovoltaic plant for self-consumption | REVE News of the wind sector in Spain and in the world
summary: Atlantic Copper, a major Spanish producer of high-purity refined copper, signed a long-term PPA with Alter Enersun to supply green electricity from a 30 MWp solar PV plant for self-consumption at its Huelva metallurgical complex. Electricity pricing risk should be reduced, improving cost stability, though the plant starts in 2026.

title: Nigeria signs $1.2 billion deal to revamp gas plant for aluminium smelter
summary: Nigeria signed a $1.2 billion contract with CNCEC to revamp a gas processing plant feeding a dormant aluminium smelter. The project aims to restart gas operations and support aluminium output of roughly hundreds of thousands of tons annually (potentially up to one million), improving production capacity expectations.

title: Hot Chili secures option to acquire La Verde copper mine in Chile
summary: Hot Chili signed a three-year option to acquire 100% of Chile’s historical La Verde open-pit copper mine, paying $320,000 upfront with additional contingent payments and a $6.89m final exercise fee. The deal consolidates the La Verde copper system, enabling comprehensive drilling and forthcoming assay results.

title: Ground broken on Mazoon Copper Project in Oman
summary: Minerals Development Oman has broken ground on the Mazoon Copper Project in Oman, an integrated copper concentrate development with multiple open-pit mines, a processing plant, and planned annual output of copper concentrate. The company cites rising global demand and secured financing, positioning Oman as a copper hub.

title: Nigeria signs $1.2bn deal to revamp gas plant for aluminium smelter
summary: Nigeria signed a $1.2bn deal with CNCEC to revamp a gas processing plant at a dormant aluminium smelter. The restart of the gas plant could enable the smelter to produce roughly 300,000 tonnes annually initially, with expansion targets and power generation, improving prospects for aluminium output in Africa.

title: Coppernico Drills 19 Meters of 0.50% Copper in First 5
summary: Coppernico Metals reported early drilling results from its Sombrero Project in Peru, including 19.15 m of 0.50% copper and additional lower-grade copper intervals, with skarn/chargeability associations. The company is also applying to expand permits and drill more extensively. No production or market supply data were provided.

title: South32 invests in Canadian copper explorer American Eagle Gold
summary: South32 will invest $29.16m to acquire a 19.9% stake in Canadian copper explorer American Eagle Gold to fund further drilling at the NAK project in British Columbia. The deal strengthens the company’s balance sheet for expanded programs in 2025-26, but it is exploration-stage with no near-term output changes.

title: In La Plata Mountains, possibility of copper mining has neighbors anxious
summary: Metallic Minerals held a community meeting over its exploratory drilling in Colorado’s La Plata Canyon, estimating a sizable low-grade copper resource. Residents worry about environmental and water impacts, including an approved but unused creek-water drilling plan. Company leaders stress mining is not imminent and depends on funding and future permitting.

title: Surge Copper Intersects 320 metres grading 0.46% CuEq from 10 metres depth including 88 metres grading 0.87% CuEq at the Berg Deposit
summary: Surge Copper reported assay results from infill drilling at its 100%-owned Berg project, including 320m at 0.46% CuEq (0.29% Cu) and higher-grade intervals within supergene sulfides. Results are expected to upgrade inferred resources, potentially improving outlook for future copper supply.

title: Coppernico Drills 19 Meters of 0.50% Copper in First 5 Holes and Applies for Additional Permits at Sombrero
summary: Coppernico Metals reports early drill results from its Sombrero (Sombrero Minerales SAC) project in Peru, including 19.15 m of 0.50% copper and other intervals with elevated copper/zinc. The company is also applying to expand permits for more drilling rigs and shares are expected to start trading on OTCQX.

title: GEM, PT Vale Indonesia partner for $1.4bn nickel HPAL project
summary: GEM and PT Vale Indonesia agreed on a $1.4bn nickel HPAL facility in Sulawesi, aimed at producing at least 60,000t/year of contained nickel in MHP for battery use. The project includes R&D and ESG components and may expand into anode/precursor production downstream.

title: Thunderbird Minerals Corp. Expands the Argo Copper-Gold Project
summary: Thunderbird Minerals announced a ~39% expansion of its Argo Copper-Gold Project land package near Quesnel, adding ground prospective for epithermal and porphyry-style copper-gold mineralization. The York target includes historical copper anomalies and chalcopyrite observations, but no production or resource update is provided.

title: Lara Exploration Ltd.: Operational Restart at The Celesta Copper Project in Brazil
summary: Lara Exploration says mining and processing have resumed at its Celesta copper project in Brazil after reinstating permits and taking the plant out of care and maintenance. Tessarema resumed ore processing from stockpiles and the Osmar pit, with a gradual ramp-up expected in coming months alongside additional drilling.

title: Four expected talking points ahead of CESCO's Asia Copper Week
summary: Ahead of CESCO’s Asia Copper Week, Fastmarkets expects the copper concentrates TC/RC benchmark and refined copper cathode supply discussions to dominate. Smelter fires and ongoing concentrate supply constraints keep the market tight, though some disruptions may ease early 2025. Chinese cathode contract appetite appears weak amid losses and demand pessimism.

title: Cumberland Resources Nickel Corp.: Cumberland Resources Announces Non-Brokered Private Placement
summary: Cumberland Resources Nickel Corp. announced a non-brokered private placement of units priced at $0.03, raising up to $750,000. Net proceeds will be used for property development and working capital related to its St. Anthony nickel property in Newfoundland. The financing could support near-term project plans, slightly improving nickel sentiment.

title: Hotel industry raises concern over nickel mine in Raja Ampat  - Companies
summary: Indonesia’s hotel association raised concerns about a nickel project on Gag Island in Raja Ampat, arguing mining could harm the marine ecosystem and tourism. Antam’s unit bought 30% of a nickel smelter for $102 million, potentially accelerating mining. The piece highlights environmental risks more than immediate supply impacts.

title: Swapping aluminium for copper will maintain China's resources, group says
summary: China’s base metals smelting group says using more aluminium instead of copper could help secure copper resources, given China’s higher reliance on overseas copper imports versus aluminium. The chairman cites economic advantages and calls for copper refining capacity reorganisation, but no immediate supply disruption is stated.

title: Swapping aluminium for copper will maintain China's resources, group says
summary: Ge Honglin of China’s nonferrous smelting industry group said promoting aluminium use instead of copper would help conserve China’s copper resources, where imports are more dependent. He noted copper is priced far higher than aluminium and urged mergers/reorganisation of copper refining capacity, but no immediate policy or supply shock was cited.

title: Copper market surplus could be short-lived
summary: The piece says copper’s growing use in renewables and EVs will increasingly strain supply because mine development takes time, while demand is supported by solar, wind and electric vehicles. Despite a likely 2024 surplus from weaker Chinese/global demand, it expects a more expensive, tighter copper market ahead.

title: QC Copper and Gold Inc: QC Copper: Thierry Drill Core Resampling Program on Bulk Tonnage K1 Deposit Now Completed
summary: QC Copper completed a cost-effective resampling program on historical drill core at the Thierry Copper Project (K1 Zone) to better delineate disseminated chalcopyrite/pyrite mineralization and potentially expand resources. Cuprum owns the project; a related business combination is expected to close in December. No immediate production or supply impacts are described.

title: Sonoran Desert Copper Corporation Announces New Brazilian Subsidiary and Application for New Copper Concessions in Pernambuco Brazil
summary: Sonoran Desert Copper Corporation announced the creation of a Brazilian subsidiary and filed an application with Brazil’s Agência Nacional de Mineração for seven new copper exploration concessions in Pernambuco and Bahia. The company said technical work is underway for a preliminary prospecting program. No production or output impact was mentioned.

title: Genius Metals Enters Option Agreement to Acquire 100% Interest in Timarighine Copper Project, Kingdom of Morocco
summary: Genius Metals signed an option agreement to acquire 100% of the Timarighine copper project in Morocco. The property targets high-grade copper with potential sulfide mineralization at depth. However, the announcement is exploratory and does not imply immediate production or supply changes, limiting near-term copper price impact.

title: Securing IRA-compliant nickel units to get tougher | Hotter Commodities
summary: Markets are watching for the incoming US administration to tighten IRA Foreign Entity of Concern (FEOC) rules, likely limiting Chinese-linked nickel from qualifying for EV tax credits. Allegations of nickel misreported as IRA-compliant are also driving scrutiny. Analysts expect automakers and battery makers to rush to secure non-FEOC nickel units, tightening supply expectations.

title: Copper Hits Two-Month Low on China Demand Angst
summary: Copper prices fell to a two-month low as the dollar rose and traders weighed cautious U.S. rate-cut expectations. Sentiment was further hit by weak demand prospects in China, the leading copper consumer. LME benchmark copper was down about 1.3% near $9,026/ton, following a sharp post-election decline.

title: Nickel prices slide on EV and China construction slowdowns
summary: Nickel prices have slid toward a four-year low as weaker-than-expected electric vehicle demand and China’s real estate downturn weigh on expectations for battery-metal demand. The move highlights how softer end-demand in EVs and construction can quickly pressure nickel pricing, erasing prior gains tied to the EV boom.

title: BHP ASX: Citi slashes copper price forecasts amid Trump tariffs and China stimulus
summary: Citi cut its short-term copper price target to $8,500/t from $9,500/t, citing concerns that Trump’s sweeping tariffs and disappointing China stimulus could hurt global manufacturing demand. LME copper fell below $9,000/t for the first time in two months, reinforcing bearish short-term sentiment.

title: Hunter man charged after substation explosion, copper theft | Newcastle Herald
summary: A man was charged after allegedly attempting to steal copper cabling from an Ausgrid substation in Heddon Greta, triggering an explosion and injuries. Police said the theft and damage require repairs and replacement costing over $165,000. Ausgrid warned copper theft endangers public safety and power infrastructure.

title: Hunter man charged after substation explosion, copper theft | Manning River Times
summary: Police charged a man over an attempted theft of copper cabling from an Ausgrid substation in Heddon Greta. The stripped cabling allegedly caused an explosion, injuring him. Repairs to replace stolen copper cables are expected to exceed $165,000, and authorities warn copper theft endangers public safety.

title: Hunter man charged after substation explosion, copper theft | Camden Haven Courier
summary: Police charged a man after he allegedly stripped copper cabling from an Ausgrid substation, triggering an explosion that injured him and causing major power-infrastructure damage. Authorities expect repairs and replacement of stolen cables to cost over $165,000, highlighting ongoing copper-theft risks and disruption.

The utility urged reporting of copper theft to protect public safety.

title: Dollar Gains Momentum on Fed Outlook, Copper Decline Weighs on Aussie
summary: The dollar firmed on hotter-for-longer Fed expectations, while markets weighed renewed concerns about China’s growth outlook. The piece notes continued pressure on Hong Kong equities and copper, arguing US-China trade tensions may jeopardize manufacturing recovery. It also highlights copper’s bearish technical acceleration and downside targets.

title: BHP set to detail copper growth plans on Chile roadshow, analysts say
summary: BHP is expected to detail plans on a Chile roadshow to spend at least $7bn to recover more copper from Escondida and maintain output as ore grades decline. Analysts discuss large capex needs for concentrator and process upgrades and note expectations that copper prices could trend higher.

title: BKM Copper Project Optimisation Works Update | Company Announcement
summary: Asiamet reports completed process plant optimisation engineering for its BKM copper project and incorporates updated capex estimates, targeting US$50–80 million upfront capex reduction with US$26 million already delivered. The company also advances project planning and biomass power cost estimates ahead of debt financing re-engagement and later-stage milestones.

title: Troilus gets $500m loan guarantee for Quebec copper-gold project
summary: Troilus Gold secured a up-to-$500m loan guarantee backing for its Quebec copper-gold project, contingent on a long-term offtake agreement with Germany’s Aurubis. The move improves financing prospects for future concentrate supply, but as it is a development milestone, the immediate effect on copper prices is likely limited.

title: Barksdale Resources Corp.: Barksdale Receives Assays Results That Reveal High-Grade Copper-Silver, Lead-Zinc-Silver Veins
summary: Barksdale Resources said drill assays from its Sunnyside project in Arizona returned high-grade copper-silver and zinc-silver mineralization, including up to 4.33% copper and 99.7 g/t silver, plus broader anomalous zones. Management highlighted consistency of the near-surface chalcocite copper zone and ongoing drilling toward deeper targets.

title: York Harbour Metals Strengthens Position with 100 Million Firetail Shares and Milestone Progress at High-Grade Copper-Zinc-Silver Project in Newfoundland
summary: York Harbour Metals announced progress under an option agreement for the Skyline high-grade copper-zinc-silver project in Newfoundland. It received AUD 200,000 plus 100 million Firetail shares and outlined further milestone payments. Firetail reported initial drill intersections with strong copper grades, supporting bullish sentiment for copper.

title: Highland Copper Announces Successful Completion of
summary: Highland Copper reported substantial completion of early wetlands and streams site work at its Copperwood project, progress on detailed engineering and permitting, and a pending state infrastructure grant decision. At White Pine, it updated on completed drilling, environmental baseline studies, and ongoing metallurgical test work, supporting future copper development.

title: Growth Forecast - Commodity Roundup: Oil steady, aluminum price forecast raised to $2,450/tonne at BMI
summary: A commodity roundup reports BMI (Fitch Solutions) lifted its 2024 aluminium price forecast to $2,450/tonne from $2,400/tonne, expecting prices to rise from the current average. Other items discuss oil demand forecasts and macro conditions, but the only direct tracked-metal change is aluminium.

title: Helix Resources expands in Australia's Bryah Basin with copper project acquisitions
summary: Helix Resources, via Leichhardt Resources, agreed to acquire a 51% interest in seven new copper project tenements in Western Australia’s Bryah Basin, with earn-in terms to potentially reach 90% ownership. Drilling is planned with government funding, building on prospects near the DeGrussa copper mine.

title: How green aluminium is transforming the metal industry
summary: The piece explains how “green aluminium” using renewable-powered, low-carbon smelting and more recycling is gaining traction. It highlights increased offtake commitments (e.g., Mitsui/Albras) and notes slight upward movements in European low-carbon value-added differentials, while demand remains cautious and premiums face some hesitation.

title: Class 1 Nickel Announces Filing of Updated Dundonald South
summary: Class 1 Nickel filed an NI 43-101 Technical Report supporting an updated Mineral Resource Estimate for the Dundonald South nickel sulphide deposit, including higher indicated nickel tonnage and continued drilling plans. While it does not change production, the update is supportive for near-term nickel sentiment and expectations.

title: Osisko Metals Incorporated Announces Significant Increase in Mineral Resources At Gaspe Copper
summary: Osisko Metals announced an updated mineral resource estimate for the Gaspé Copper project near Murdochville, showing a 53% rise in indicated copper-equivalent and a major increase in inferred copper-equivalent. The pit-constrained estimate contains about 4.91 billion pounds of contained copper, alongside molybdenum and silver, with further drilling planned in 2025.

title: Capstone Copper Corp.: Capstone Copper Files Technical Report for Mantoverde Optimized Project
summary: Capstone Copper filed an NI 43-101 technical report and feasibility study for its Mantoverde Optimized brownfield expansion project in Chile. The report covers the Mantoverde Mine development outlook and related studies. The update is regulatory and does not signal immediate production changes or market-moving disruptions.

title: China October aluminium output rises on firm demand, higher prices
summary: China’s October primary aluminium output rose 1.6% year-on-year as smelters ran at higher rates, supported by stimulus-linked demand in construction and packaging. Aluminium prices reached a five-month high on the Shanghai Futures Exchange, offsetting higher alumina and power-related costs despite tighter bauxite supply from Guinea.

title: New alumina supplies in 2025 poised to rupture record price rally
summary: Reuters reports that new alumina refineries starting up next year should ease tight alumina supplies and potentially end the record alumina price rally. Disruptions this year (Guinea/Brazil bauxite issues, Alcoa and Rio Tinto output suspensions) drove sharp alumina gains. Analysts expect a surplus in 2025 and lower prices.

title: Brunton Pass Copper-Gold Project - Drill Start   | Company Announcement
summary: Tertiary Minerals announced the start of reverse circulation drilling at its Brunton Pass copper-gold project in Nevada. Two holes target skarn/porphyry copper and two target an epithermal gold-silver/geophysical/geochemical anomaly. Results are expected in early 2025, implying no immediate near-term copper supply impact.

title: Eqtec sells entire stake as MetalNRG shifts to be Morocco copper miner
summary: Eqtec sold its entire stake in MetalNRG as MetalNRG pivots to copper mining. In a reverse takeover, MetalNRG will acquire Morocco’s Oumejrane producing copper mine from Managem for USD32 million. The shift is tied to refocusing on mining rather than new energy infrastructure, potentially affecting near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Premier Energies to enter aluminum frame manufacturing
summary: Premier Energies, an Indian solar cell and module maker, plans to build an aluminum frame factory with 36,000 metric tons annual capacity for captive use in its solar products. The move increases on-site aluminum demand, but the impact on broader aluminum prices within weeks is likely modest and localized.

title: New Caledonia's Prony to restart nickel operations after six-month halt
summary: New Caledonian nickel producer Prony Resources will restart operations from Monday after a six-month shutdown linked to riots. The restart follows restored power, water and road access, though no production timeline is provided. Wider unrest has disrupted other local producers, so supply recovery could support nickel prices.

title: China to cut or cancel export tax rebates for products including aluminium, copper
summary: China’s finance ministry plans to reduce or cancel export tax rebates effective Dec. 1, including scrapping rebates for aluminium and copper products. Traders expect lower Chinese exports, tightening supply abroad. Reuters reported a jump in LME aluminium prices and broader commodity moves as rebate changes affect cross-border flows.

title: China to cut or cancel export tax rebates for products including aluminium, copper
summary: China will reduce or cancel export tax rebates for various commodities effective Dec. 1, including scrapping rebates for aluminum and copper products. Traders expect higher export costs and lower Chinese outbound supply, which has already triggered an LME aluminium price jump and supports copper.

title: High-Nickel Pig Iron Prices Continue to Plunge Amidst Weak Market Fundamentals
summary: High-nickel pig iron prices are plunging further, with SMM 8-12% NPI averaging 1,005.2 yuan per nickel point and the Indonesian NPI FOB index also falling. Weak stainless demand/off-season and sluggish procurement coincide with macro pressure (Fed/LEM), pushing both NPI and pure nickel downward and widening the NPI/electrolytic nickel discount.

title: Indonesia's January-October Nickel Ore Imports Surge to 9.3 Million Metric Tons
summary: Indonesia’s nickel ore imports climbed to 9.3 million tons in January–October 2024, versus 161,917 tons a year earlier. Reuters links the surge to record purchases from the Philippines since April as smelter demand increased, while Indonesia delayed mining quotas amid heavy rains disrupting mining activity.

title: BHP faces balance sheet pressure due to copper investment
summary: BHP is expected by Berenberg to face balance sheet pressure from higher capital outlay for copper projects in Chile, Argentina and Australia, with total growth capex estimated at USD21–26 billion over 10 years. The bank expects net debt to rise above targets and limits capital returns, though no near-term supply change is cited.

title: China to cut or cancel export tax rebates for products including aluminium
summary: China’s finance ministry plans to reduce or cancel export tax rebates effective Dec. 1, including scrapping rebates for aluminium and copper products. The policy is expected to raise exporters’ costs and reduce China’s outbound metal flows, boosting near-term aluminium prices on the LME and supporting copper sentiment.

title: [SMM Analysis] After the premium of Indonesian domestic trade laterite nickel ore declined, it temporarily stabilized，and strong price support for Philippine nickel ore is coming
summary: SMM reports Indonesian laterite nickel ore premiums are flat and prices stable amid uncertainty over RKAB quota consumption by year-end. In the Philippines, limited northern shipments and firmer FOB/CIF mid-grade nickel ore pricing are gradually strengthening prices, though weakening domestic high-grade NPI tempers restocking. Overall nickel ore sentiment is supportive short term.

title: Is Copper's Bull Run Over? | OilPrice.com
summary: Copper Monthly Metals Index and Comex copper prices declined in October-November, with a downside bias after the U.S. election. China’s $1.4 trillion plan disappointed markets and failed to lift the Yangshan copper premium. LME funds reduced long exposure and added shorts in early October, reinforcing short-term bearish sentiment.

title: Bauxite mining corruption case: Pahang govt to fully cooperate with MACC, says Wan Rosdy
summary: Malaysia’s Pahang state government pledged full cooperation with MACC over investigations into illegal bauxite excavation that bypassed procedures. Authorities arrested three suspects, including a state agency officer accused of taking bribes to protect operations. The action aims to reduce revenue leakage, potentially curbing illicit bauxite supply.

title: SC dismisses review plea by Vedanta against closure of copper smelting plant in Thoothukudi
summary: India’s Supreme Court dismissed Vedanta’s review plea against the closure of its copper smelting plant in Thoothukudi. The plant has been shut since May 2018 over pollution concerns and related unrest. The ruling keeps copper smelting capacity offline, potentially tightening refined copper supply expectations near term.

title: Miner Marimaca Copper preps ASX listing
summary: Marimaca Copper, valued at C$457 million, is preparing an Australian (ASX) listing and has a flagship copper discovery near Antofagasta, Chile. The company aims to file paperwork for the listing and advance a feasibility study by year-end. The news is about financing/listing rather than near-term supply.

title: Breaking News! Export Tax Rebate for Aluminum Extrusion to Be Cancelled! [SMM Analysis]
summary: China’s Ministry of Finance announced cancellation of export tax rebates for aluminum extrusion HS codes (76042100, 76042910, 76042990). With most aluminum semi export products previously receiving a 13% rebate, the policy raises export costs, may dampen export enthusiasm, and could pressure domestic aluminium semis prices despite limited deadline-driven shipments.

title: Malaysia's Aluminum Stocks Rise After China Ends Export-Tax Rebate
summary: Malaysia-listed aluminum stocks rose after China said it will end export-tax rebates for aluminum starting Dec. 1. Analysts expect the removal to increase Chinese aluminum export costs, potentially reducing near-term exports and tightening supply. ING also flags trade shifts toward alternative sources. The rebate change includes copper.

title: [SMM Analysis] New tax rebate policy in China shocked the global copper and aluminium market
summary: China’s Ministry of Finance will end 13% export tax rebates for copper and aluminium semi-finished products from 1 Dec 2024. With weak domestic demand and tight replacement options globally, exporters’ margins fall and overseas buyers may face higher prices or limited availability. LME/SHFE initially moved differently, but shortages could support prices.

title: [SMM Analysis] New tax rebate policy in China shocked the global copper and aluminium market
summary: China will end a 13% export tax rebate for copper and aluminium semi products effective 1 December 2024, cutting exporter margins as domestic demand is weak. SMM expects limited ability to replace Chinese supply quickly, with potential support for LME prices, despite near-term pricing negotiations and shipping/bonded-warehouse acceleration.

title: U.S. GoldMining Intersects 120 meters at 1.00 g/t Gold Equivalent - Confirms Western High-Grade Zone Within Whistler Gold-Copper Deposit, Alaska
summary: U.S. GoldMining reported confirmatory drilling results at its Whistler gold-copper project in Alaska, including 120 m at 0.16% copper and 1.00 g/t gold equivalent. The update signals potential improvement in deposit grades, but no production, permitting, or shipment changes are provided, so near-term copper price impact is likely limited.

title: 10 Best Nickel Stocks to Invest in According to Analysts
summary: The article discusses nickel price momentum and volatility, citing oversupply from Indonesia and mine curtailments elsewhere, alongside weaker Chinese economic/demand conditions. It notes Chinese stimulus briefly lifted nickel prices in September, but prices retreated after the initial surge, implying near-term bearish pressure.

title: Is Carpenter Technology (CRS) the Best Nickel Stock to Invest in?
summary: The piece highlights nickel’s volatile first half and a Q3 oversupply situation driven by increased laterite supply from Indonesia, prompting curtailments in other regions. It cites weak Chinese demand despite stimulus-induced price support in September, noting prices retreated again. It frames Carpenter Technology as a nickel alloys producer.

title: Is Sibanye Stillwater Limited (SBSW) the Best Nickel Stock to Invest in?
summary: The piece reviews nickel market conditions, citing oversupply of nickel from Asian/Indonesian sources and weak Chinese demand due to a strained real estate sector and deflation. It notes brief price support from Chinese stimulus in September, but prices later retreated, keeping nickel pressure negative.

title: Is Ryerson Holding Corporation (RYI) the Best Nickel Stock to Invest in?
summary: The article reviews nickel market conditions affecting “best nickel stocks,” noting strong H1 momentum but Q3 2024 volatility. It cites laterite nickel supply growth from Indonesia/Asia driving oversupply, while weak Chinese demand from deflation and real estate pressures offset battery demand growth, and September stimulus only temporarily supported prices before retreating.

title: Is ArcelorMittal S.A. (MT) the Best Nickel Stock to Invest in?
summary: The piece highlights strong but volatile nickel momentum in H1 and Q3 2024, attributing weakness to oversupply of laterite nickel from Indonesia and mine curtailments in other regions, while Chinese demand remains constrained by a difficult real-estate backdrop. A September stimulus briefly supported prices, but they retreated again.

title: Is Leggett & Platt, Incorporated (LEG) the Best Nickel Stock to Invest in?
summary: The article reviews nickel price momentum and volatility, citing oversupply of laterite nickel from Indonesia and weaker Chinese demand from stainless-steel and broader economic deflation. It notes short-lived support from Chinese stimulus in September. It also mentions LEG uses nickel-based alloys but provides no direct nickel supply/demand catalyst.

title: Is ATI Inc. (ATI) the Best Nickel Stock to Invest in?
summary: The piece reviews nickel market conditions and ATI’s positioning. It highlights H1 strength but Q3 volatility tied to oversupply from Indonesia, mine curtailments elsewhere, and weak Chinese demand. Even after Chinese stimulus briefly supported nickel prices in September, prices retreated, implying ongoing downside risk for nickel.

title: Egypt Aluminum's Profits Soar as Global Demand Drives Growth
summary: Egypt Aluminum reported a sharp Q1 profit jump, attributing the surge to strong global demand and rising aluminum prices, alongside operational efficiency and production modernization. Analysts expect growth to continue as infrastructure projects boost consumption of lightweight materials, supporting near-term positive sentiment for aluminium demand.

title: Mazoon Mining breaks ground on Oman's largest copper project
summary: Mazoon Mining (MDO) has begun work on Oman’s Mazoon Copper Project, described as the country’s largest integrated copper concentrate venture. It includes multiple open-pit mines and a processing plant targeting 115,000 tons of copper concentrate annually. The project aims to meet rising copper demand, though it is a longer-run supply build.

title: TSX Venture Copper Miner Osisko Metals (TSX-V: OM) Making Moves
summary: Osisko Metals announced an updated mineral resource estimate for its Gaspé Copper Project in Quebec, boosting contained copper-equivalent resources substantially and planning a 70,000-metre drill program in 2025. The news improves perceived future copper project potential, supporting copper sentiment though it won’t affect near-term supply immediately.

title: Is Rio Tinto Group (RIO) the Best Nickel Stock to Invest in?
summary: The article discusses nickel’s H1 momentum but highlights Q3 2024 volatility driven by Indonesian supply growth, mine curtailments elsewhere, and persistent oversupply. It notes China demand softness from macro issues despite stimulus measures that briefly lifted nickel prices before prices retreated again.

title: Is Vale S.A. (VALE) the Best Nickel Stock to Invest in?
summary: The article reviews nickel price momentum and volatility in 2024, citing Indonesian laterite supply, nickel oversupply, and China stimulus-induced swings in demand. It also highlights Vale’s involvement in nickel and copper and an agreement for a $1.42B Indonesian nickel plant, but provides no clear short-term market disruption.

title: FTA with US 'unlikely' under Trump but nickel deal may be doable - Regulations
summary: The piece says a Trump-era, more protectionist trade environment could make an Indonesia–US free-trade agreement unlikely. It also notes the IRA favors EV supply chains in US/FTA countries, affecting Indonesian nickel shipments that are widely sent to China, while Tesla may gradually reduce nickel dependence.

title: Reward offered for copper wire thefts in AT&T's Indiana regions - Indianapolis News | Indiana Weather | Indiana Traffic | WISH-TV
summary: AT&T is offering rewards for information leading to arrests of people stealing copper wires in Indiana, citing outages caused by wire theft. AT&T says thefts increased over the past year as copper prices rose. Copper wiring is still used in some services, businesses, hospitals, and emergency systems.

title: Australian Gold and Copper jags 1.6kg per tonne silver in NSW
summary: Australian Gold and Copper and PolarX report new drill intercepts with meaningful copper grades. AGC’s South Cobar Achilles discovery includes copper-bearing intervals, while PolarX’s Caribou Dome delivers additional high-grade copper zones below 300m depth. The results may slightly support copper sentiment, though they don’t affect current supply immediately.

title: Ministry defends nickel imports to preserve domestic reserves - Markets
summary: Indonesia’s Energy and Mineral Resources Ministry defended local smelters’ imports of nickel ore despite abundant domestic resources. It said the imports follow individual company strategy and help extend domestic nickel supply as reserves deplete. Indonesia also remains a major producer but imported much nickel ore from the Philippines in 2023 and 2024.

title: Kodiak Copper Corp.: Kodiak Drills New Shallow High-Grade Copper Mineralization at 200m Step-Out from Adit Zone
summary: Kodiak Copper Corp. reported 2024 drill results at its MPD copper-gold porphyry project in southern British Columbia, including shallow high-grade copper mineralization from new Adit Zone step-out holes (up to ~0.64% Cu over 4m, 0.73% CuEq). The company says the Adit zone remains open and warrants further drilling in 2025.

title: Prony Resources gears up for nickel production restart at Goro mine
summary: Prony Resources plans to restart operations at the Goro mine and battery-grade nickel plant in New Caledonia after a six-month suspension from local riots. The workforce return revives a major regional nickel source (with battery-grade nickel and cobalt output), potentially lifting short-term supply expectations and weighing on nickel prices.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Intersects 23.25 Metres at 1.58% Copper Within 57.73 Metres at 0.85% Copper in the Rum Area
summary: Faraday Copper Corp. reported new drill intercepts at its Copper Creek Project in Arizona, including 57.73 m at 0.85% copper with an enrichment zone. The company plans continued near-surface drilling in Rum and American Eagle. The news supports exploration success but does not imply immediate production impacts.

title: Talon Metals Corp.: Talon Metals Michigan Update: Drilling Hits 110.3 Meters of Copper & Nickel Mineralization at 9.59 Meters
summary: Talon Metals’ drilling at the Boulderdash target in Michigan intersected substantial copper-nickel sulphide intervals across several drill holes, including up to 110.3 meters of mineralization with up to 40% sulphides, and indicators of possible massive sulphides. Assays are pending; results could modestly support copper and nickel sentiment.

title: Sterling Metals Corp.: Sterling Metals Completes 3D IP Survey at Copper Road, Discovers New Outcrop Areas and Extends Mineralized Footprint
summary: Sterling Metals reported completion of a 3D IP survey over its Copper Road project in Ontario, identifying new copper sulphide outcrops and extending the porphyry footprint. The company collected additional surface samples and is starting a drone magnetic survey, with final IP inversion expected in December.

title: Germany: Hydro starts battery and solar rooftop operations at Offenburg aluminium plant in Germany
summary: Hydro began interim operations of onsite solar rooftop systems and battery storage at its Offenburg aluminium plant, with similar installations planned for Rackwitz and Uphusen in Germany. The projects aim to boost locally generated renewable power, smooth demand, and cut energy costs while lowering carbon footprints. Completion is targeted for early 2025.

title: Vital Battery Metals Inc: Vital Battery Metals Announces Assay Results on its Sting Copper Project including 9.3% Cu, 15.8 g/t Ag and 6.7% Zn
summary: Vital Battery Metals reported assay results from its Sting Copper Project, including a grab sample with 9.3% Cu and soil sampling showing a 300+ meter Cu–Zn–As anomaly. The update supports exploration potential but does not indicate near-term supply changes, limiting likely immediate effects on copper prices and none on nickel or aluminium.

title: Kinusi Copper Mine Operations Update  | Company Announcement
summary: Marula Mining provided an update on the Kinusi copper mine in Tanzania. Export permits were received and three ore samples were shipped to South Africa for metallurgical testing and assays, with more trial shipments planned by 31 December 2024. Continued mining and stockpiling are expected to support early copper concentrate sales.

title: AT&T offers $5,000 reward for information on copper wire thefts in Brown, Marion and Shelby Counties
summary: AT&T is offering up to $5,000 rewards for tips leading to arrests over copper wire thefts in several Indiana counties. The firm links rising theft activity to higher copper prices and says stolen lines caused recent phone outages and safety hazards, urging reporting to police and AT&T security.

title: Glencore Strikes Deal to Test Copper Leaching at Chile Mine
summary: Glencore will begin scaled on-site testing of a copper leaching process at its Lomas Bayas mine in northern Chile. The trial follows lab results and aims to improve recovery from 0.25% grade sulfide ore, potentially extending mine life. First results are expected in April/May.

title: Is a Global Aluminum Shortage on the Horizon?
summary: Aluminum is reported to have steadied in October but turned slightly bearish mid-November as copper and other base metals weakened. The key near-term support is China ending export rebates for aluminum and copper from Dec 1 and elevated alumina prices amid Guinea export stoppage fears, tightening aluminum supply expectations globally.

title: Clark County prohibits sale of copper wire without proper documentation
summary: Clark County in Nevada adopted an ordinance banning scrap and junk dealers from buying “7 strand” copper without documentation and increasing scrutiny of copper sellers. The rule adds a 10-day review hold and limits sales methods to deter copper wire thefts from streetlights and utilities, potentially tightening near-term scrap copper inflows.

title: New law targets illegal copper sales; bans cash payments and walk-up sellers
summary: Clark County approved an ordinance to curb illegal copper wire sales, requiring documentation for seven-strand copper wire, banning walk-up sellers, and prohibiting cash payments at scrap yards. Officials link the move to ongoing streetlight copper theft, which may tighten illicit copper flows. The article also cites continued aluminum substitution and replacement costs.

title: Updates on possible royalty change on nickel ore and RKAB approval progress
summary: SMM reports Indonesia is considering changes to the non-tax state revenue (PNBP) interpretation and resource fee structure for laterite nickel ore. A proposed 2% royalty for ore below 1.5% grade is aimed at supporting battery materials. It also updates RKAB approvals and quota volumes for 2024-2026.

title: Tomago Aluminium: Rio Tinto-backed smelter says renewable energy is too expensive and in short supply
summary: Tomago Aluminium’s CEO says switching to low-carbon electricity later this decade is not achievable due to renewable power being too expensive and in short supply. Without government assistance, the smelter near Newcastle faces ongoing operating risk as its current electricity contract with AGL Energy expires at end-2028, derailing emissions plans.

title: BHP to invest up to $14bn to boost copper production in Chile
summary: BHP plans to invest $10bn–$14bn to expand copper production at Chile’s Escondida mine, targeting output growth of 430,000–540,000 tonnes per annum. It aims to counter ore-grade declines and stabilize long-term output while projecting continued demand growth from renewables and EVs.

title: Xanadu reveals four new high-grade Mongolian copper targets
summary: Xanadu Mines announced four new high-grade copper targets at its Sant Tolgoi project in Mongolia, with surface rock-chip assays up to 2.1% Cu and geophysical anomalies pointing to mineralised intrusions. The planned reconnaissance drilling will test for massive sulphide copper and possibly nickel, but no production is yet confirmed.

title: Arras Minerals Corp.: Arras Minerals Identifies Multiple New Copper-Gold Targets for Drill Testing in 2025 In Kazakhstan
summary: Arras Minerals reports extensive 2024 exploration in Kazakhstan’s Bozshakol-Chingis magmatic arc, identifying new undrilled copper and copper-gold targets and planning to commence drill-testing in the first half of 2025. The release focuses on exploration activities and does not indicate immediate copper supply changes, so near-term price effects appear limited.

title: Electra secures exploration permit for copper and cobalt projects in US
summary: Electra Battery Materials received a ten-year exploration permit from the US Forest Service covering 91 drill pad locations for its Idaho Cobalt Belt projects, including the Iron Creek copper-cobalt deposit. The permit adds regulatory certainty to resume exploration, but the news is more developmental than an immediate supply change.

title: CoTec Holdings Corp.: Cotec Investment Ceibo Partners with Glencore's Lomas Bayas to Support Revolutionary Copper Leaching Technology
summary: CoTec announced Ceibo is partnering with Glencore’s Lomas Bayas to deploy leaching technology aimed at improving copper recovery from low-grade sulphides and possibly extending mine life. After two years of tests, scaling begins via an on-site lab. Results could improve operational efficiency, but current impact is uncertain.

title: Vedanta Aluminium Powers Ahead with Natural Gas Pact
summary: Vedanta Aluminium agreed with GAIL Gas to supply natural gas to its Jharsuguda, Odisha smelter via a short pipeline. The switch is intended to cut annual emissions by about 47,292 tonnes CO2e and reduce carbon footprint, supporting operations and India’s aluminium demand. Gas supply begins soon with defined volumes.

title: Usha Resources Ltd.: Usha Resources Announces Induced Polarization Survey Ahead of Maiden Drill Program at the Southern Arm Copper-Gold VMS Property
summary: Quartz Mountain Resources announced completion of an induced polarization survey at its Maestro property ahead of planned 2026 drilling. Technical results relate to identifying sulphide systems tied to epithermal Au-Ag and porphyry Mo-Cu/Cu-Mo mineralization, including notes of increasing Cu grades. No immediate production or supply impacts are stated.

title: Western Metallica Commences Drilling at Luz Maria Copper Porphyry Prospect
summary: Western Metallica began drilling at the Luz Maria copper porphyry prospect, progressing 200 metres of a planned 350 metres for the first phase of 6 drill holes and targeting Cu and Mo anomalies. The company cites encouraging prior rock/regolith results and expects early assay and drill updates in early December.

title: High Priority Copper Drill Targets Defined at Sant Tolgoi
summary: Xanadu Mines announced high-grade surface copper assay results from its Sant Tolgoi project in Mongolia, identifying four drill targets based on geochemistry and geophysics, with planned reconnaissance drilling in Q2 2025. Assays show copper up to 2.1% and very low nickel (<0.06%) at surface, implying exploration potential only.

title: The Post-Election Stock Surge Is Boosting These 2 Sectors
summary: The piece argues that Fed rate cuts and global stimulus after the election are reviving risk appetite and boosting commodities-linked stocks. It cites strong moves in metals/mining equities and mentions copper resilience. Overall, it frames an environment likely to support near-term expectations for copper prices and, indirectly, aluminium sentiment.

title: Copper thieves making up to $1,000 an hour in spate of Alice Springs Telstra thefts
summary: Northern Territory Police are investigating ongoing copper wire thefts in Alice Springs, targeting telecommunications pits since April. Officers say thieves have taken hundreds of metres of wire, with losses in the tens of thousands of dollars. Police are appealing for witnesses as the investigation continues.

title: Pan Asia trebles size of Chilean copper project
summary: Pan Asia Metals (to be renamed Flagship Minerals) expanded its Rosario copper project in Chile by filing for additional exploration concessions, increasing acreage from 25 to 86 sq km. Recent geochemical results reportedly show strong copper grades and discovery of a sizable copper zone, supporting further exploration drilling.

title: Copper Standard acquires Pucara Gold, brings Peru copper assets into portfolio
summary: Copper Standard Resources completed the court-approved acquisition of Pucara Gold, adding three prospective copper exploration assets in Peru (including a 3,768ha porphyry copper target with 3% copper zones). Share issuance and delisting occurred, but no near-term production or supply impact was indicated.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Ltd.: Ivanhoe Mines Announces DRC President, His Excellency Félix Tshisekedi, Officially Reopens the Kipushi Zinc-Copper-Lead-Germanium Mine
summary: Ivanhoe Mines announced the official reopening of the Kipushi zinc-copper-germanium mine in the DRC. The restart is expected to bring additional copper supply from the existing Kamoa-Kakula/Kipushi complex over time. Ceremonial confirmation supports near-term optimism on copper output and project ramp-up.

title: Alaska Energy Metals Discovers Broad Zones Of Nickel With
summary: Alaska Energy Metals reported assay results from three drill holes at the Canwell claim block, intersecting wide zones of nickel-bearing polymetallic mineralization and providing evidence of sulfide/metallic-hosted nickel. The company plans further drilling, but the update is not production-related, limiting immediate supply impact.

title: Pan Asia Metals secures new concessions near Rosario copper project in Chile
summary: Pan Asia Metals applied for additional exploration concessions adjacent to its Rosario copper project in Chile’s Atacama region, expanding holdings from about 25km² to 86km². The move targets prospective copper mineral trends and infrastructure/energy corridors. It signals future potential but no near-term production change.

title: Mitsui places highest bid for stake in First Quantum's Zambian copper mines
summary: Mitsui has submitted the highest bid (~$2bn) for about a 20% stake in First Quantum’s Zambian Kansanshi and Sentinel copper mines, beating a competing offer from Manara Minerals. The deal follows First Quantum’s financial stress after a Panamanian mine closure and comes amid rising copper demand expectations.

title: Ivanhoe Mines Announces DRC President, His Excellency Félix Tshisekedi, Officially Reopens the Kipushi Zinc-Copper-Lead-Germanium Mine
summary: Ivanhoe Mines says the DRC president officially reopened the Kipushi mine, restarting operations at the ultra-high-grade zinc-copper-lead-germanium site. The ceremony follows a resumption of production after prior shutdowns, signaling improved near-term mining supply prospects, particularly for copper from Kipushi’s portfolio.

title: Copper: Japan and Saudi Arabia Compete for Two Mines in Zambia
summary: Saudi Arabia and Japan are competing for minority stakes in First Quantum’s Sentinel and Kansanshi copper mines in Zambia, with bids reported around $1.5–$2 billion for 15–20% stakes. Talks remain ongoing and no deal is finalized, so the supply impact is uncertain in the near term despite the mines’ projected 375,000 t output.

title: Japan Allocates Budget for Securing Copper Mine Interests
summary: Japan plans to include securing copper mine interests in its economic measures, allocating several hundred billion yen to acquire stakes in African copper deposits. Officials cite rising global demand from EVs, semiconductors, and data centers and fears of shortages, aiming to ensure supply stability and support copper availability.

title: Dore Copper Announces Filing and Mailing of Management Information Circular in Connection with Special Meeting and Encourages Shareholders to Access Meeting Materials Electronically
summary: Doré Copper Mining Corp. filed and mailed a management information circular for a special shareholder meeting on Dec. 16, 2024 to vote on a statutory plan of arrangement with Cygnus. The board and special committee recommend voting for the resolution, subject to interim court and shareholder approval conditions.

title: Large copper deposit discovered in Zavkhan province
summary: Xanadu Mines announced strong surface copper assay results from its Sant Tolgoi Project in Mongolia and identified four drill targets. The company plans 3,000m of reconnaissance drilling to test for high-grade massive sulphide copper and nickel, with follow-up drilling expected in early 2025.

title: Electric Royalties Ltd.: Electric Royalties Enters Into Definitive Agreement to Acquire 0.75% Gross Revenue Royalty on Producing Punitaqui Copper Mine in Chile
summary: Electric Royalties signed an agreement to acquire a 0.75% gross revenue royalty on the producing Punitaqui copper mine in Chile, providing cash to the operator to support continued production and processing. It also notes a prior copper stream will not proceed. The news is copper-focused but largely financial and not a near-term supply shock.

title: Prices Of High-Nickel Pig Iron Continue To Fall As Weak Market Demand Persists
summary: High-nickel pig iron prices are continuing to fall, with weak stainless steel demand and subdued mill transactions keeping sentiment negative. Indonesian NPI FOB prices declined and discounts to electrolytic nickel widened. Nickel also faced renewed downward pressure from less supportive Fed rate-cut expectations, suggesting near-term weakness likely to persist.

title: Finnish aluminium exports to Russia double
summary: Finnish Customs data show aluminium exports from Finland to Russia have doubled, reaching about €22.3m by end-September versus €11.3m the prior period. Growth is mainly from aluminium studs not on sanctions lists, shipped via sea or the Baltics, raising concerns these goods could support Russia’s war efforts.

title: Rusal to cut aluminium output by 250,000 tons
summary: Rusal says it will curtail aluminium production by 250,000 tons, citing record-high alumina prices and weaker macro conditions that keep aluminium prices from rising proportionally. Rusal also faces higher costs from buying over a third of required alumina overseas. Demand is shrinking in domestic construction and automotive sectors.

title: Aldebaran Reports a Very Significant Increase in Mineral Resources at the Altar Copper-Gold Project in San Juan, Argentina
summary: Aldebaran announced an updated mineral resource estimate for its Altar copper-gold project in Argentina, showing a substantial increase versus 2021, including 22.01 billion pounds of copper. The company also plans the next study work (PEA in Q2 2025), adding near-term development optimism for copper.

title: Capstone Copper At Inflection Point
summary: Capstone Copper’s analysts argue the company is at an “inflection point,” citing ramp-up progress at Chile’s Mantoverde and expected operational improvements in coming quarters. The piece notes September issues from mill downtime and higher costs, but anticipates better recoveries and cashflow as payback from capex nears, reinforcing positive copper sentiment.

title: Minnesota DNR delays decision on key proposed copper-nickel mine permit
summary: Minnesota’s Department of Natural Resources has delayed its decision on a key permit for a proposed copper-nickel mine. The delay may push back timelines for potential future production, improving near-term supply expectations. This is supportive for both copper and nickel prices, though magnitude is uncertain while the project remains pending.

title: Minnesota DNR delays decision on key proposed copper-nickel mine permit
summary: Minnesota DNR delayed its decision on a key permit for a proposed copper-nickel mine. The delay likely postpones potential production timelines, increasing near-term uncertainty around future supply. That typically supports bearish sentiment for copper and nickel as markets recalibrate expectations for when the project could contribute output.

title: Copper Slips as Dollar Surges After Trump Threatens More Tariffs
summary: Copper is reported to be slipping after the U.S. dollar surges, following Trump’s threat of more tariffs. The headline links the currency move and trade-policy uncertainty to weaker near-term market sentiment for copper, implying downward price pressure in the coming days.

title: First Atlantic Nickel Submits Additional Drill Permits and
summary: First Atlantic Nickel applied for additional drill permits and plans a direct access route to accelerate winter drilling at the RPM Zone. The discovery hole intersected visible awaruite (nickel-iron alloy) mineralization from surface to depth. Phase 2 drilling is planned pending permits and assay results.

title: How to catch a copper thief
summary: A Las Vegas-area recycling firm, SA Recycling, works with Metro Police on a copper theft task force to detect and prosecute stolen-copper sales, including streetlights and construction-site wire. The company supports a Valley-wide ordinance and a proposed 2025 state law making possession of stolen copper illegal to deter theft and improve traceability.

title: Metals Creek Resources Corp.: Metals Creeks Commences Diamond Drilling at the Tillex Copper Project
summary: Metals Creek Resources began diamond drilling at the Tillex Copper Project in Ontario to further define the structurally complex copper mineralization. The release reiterates recent high-grade drilling intercepts and states results will be provided after compilation. The updates relate to potential future copper supply but likely won’t affect near-term pricing.

title: How global copper, nickel markets will drive cobalt outlook 2025
summary: The article is focused on cobalt but repeatedly ties it to copper and nickel. It forecasts copper prices to remain strong, supporting further mined supply growth in the DRC, while noting nickel’s short-term price weakness despite Indonesia’s expanding HPAL-linked output. Net signals for copper vs nickel are mixed.

title: Fresh Tariffs Could Raise Aluminum and Steel Prices in U.S. -- Commodities Roundup
summary: The article says new U.S. tariffs on Canada and Mexico could raise aluminum prices because Canada is a key, low-cost aluminum supplier to the U.S. Other market notes mention copper falling amid stronger USD and tariff pledges, implying mixed near-term pressure across aluminum (upward) versus copper (downward).

title: Latest News | Vedanta to Invest USD 2 Billion in Copper Projects in Saudi Arabia
summary: Vedanta said it will invest USD 2 billion in Saudi Arabia copper projects, including a 400 KTPA greenfield smelter/refinery and a 300 KTPA copper rod project, plus an existing 125 KTPA rod mill. Production is planned for full swing in Q4 FY26 as Saudi copper demand rises and is met via imports.

title: True North Copper raises $32.7m to advance copper projects in Queensland
summary: True North Copper secured about A$50.3m ($32.7m) in a heavily discounted underwritten equity placement to recapitalize its Queensland copper projects. Funds will support renewed exploration and drilling, repay/convert debts, and redefine offtake/tolling agreements with Glencore. The news is company-specific and unlikely to shift broader copper prices in the next weeks.

title: Trump's 25% Tariff Will Drive Up US Prices of Aluminum and Steel
summary: The piece reports that Trump’s proposed 25% tariff would raise US prices for aluminium (and steel). By increasing the cost of imported metal and tightening supply availability in the short term, the policy is expected to push aluminium prices higher in the near-term market outlook.

title: Vedanta plans $2bn investment in big Saudi copper projects
summary: Vedanta is reported to plan about $2bn in investments in major copper projects in Saudi Arabia. The announcement is likely to support market sentiment for copper by reinforcing expectations around future supply development and associated construction and procurement activity, even though near-term production timing remains uncertain.

title: Norsk Hydro: Hydro Capital Markets Day 2024: Accelerating the green aluminium transition
summary: Norsk Hydro’s Capital Markets Day emphasizes accelerating its low-carbon aluminium strategy—growing recycling and extrusions, investing in renewable power, and outlining cost-improvement programs. It highlights historically high alumina prices supporting higher aluminium prices and provides guidance on working capital and margin resilience amid weaker downstream demand.

title: Hydro Capital Markets Day 2024: Accelerating the green aluminium transition
summary: Hydro Capital Markets Day outlines an accelerated 2030 strategy focused on aluminium recycling, extrusions, and renewable power. The company launches a NOK 6.5 billion improvement program, reports growing sales of its low-carbon aluminium products, and phases out battery and green hydrogen activities amid weak market conditions.

title: Nickel trading case: Prosecution says 947 invested S$1.46bil into scheme that was 'fiction'
summary: Prosecutors allege nickel trading businessman Ng Yu Zhi ran a fraud in which investors were promised discounted nickel purchases from Poseidon Nickel Limited and profitable resale. The Envy entities allegedly never bought or sold nickel, instead using new investor funds to pay earlier ones, via forged contracts and documents.

title: MEED | Vedanta seeks to invest $2bn in Saudi copper projects
summary: MEED reports Vedanta is seeking to invest $2bn in copper projects in Saudi Arabia. If confirmed, the move would signal continued development of copper capacity and related spend in the near term. With details unavailable due to paywall, the immediate effect on spot prices is uncertain but cautiously supportive for copper.

title: Vedanta to set up $2 billion copper project in Saudi Arabia
summary: Vedanta will invest $2 billion in Saudi Arabia to build a 400,000 t copper smelter/refinery and 300,000 t copper rod facilities, after closing an Indian smelter following an accident. Initial rod mill work starts first, with full production planned for 2026, boosting copper processing capacity visibility.

title: GT Resources Inc.: GT Resources Announces BHEM Survey at the North Rock Copper-Nickel-PGE Project, Ontario, Canada
summary: GT Resources announced a Phase I BHEM geophysical survey and reconnaissance work at its North Rock copper-nickel-PGE project in Ontario. The program targets historic holes to find net-textured to massive sulphides beneath shallow drilling, with a historic copper grade noted, but no near-term production impact.

title: GT Resources Inc.: GT Resources Announces BHEM Survey at the North Rock Copper-Nickel-PGE Project, Ontario, Canada
summary: GT Resources announced a BHEM survey and reconnaissance at its North Rock copper–nickel–PGE project in Ontario, targeting historic holes around the Beaver Pond zone. The work aims to identify new sulphide conductors beneath shallow drilling. It is exploration activity with no immediate production or market flow impact.

title: World Copper Ltd.: World Copper Arranges $1.5 Million Financing
summary: World Copper Ltd. announced a non-brokered private placement raising up to $1.5 million to fund an expansion drill program and working capital. The company is focused on copper porphyry projects in Chile and Arizona. The release does not describe any change to production, logistics, or copper market fundamentals.

title: Odisha govt says no plans for bauxite mining in Gandhamardan hills
summary: Odisha’s government says it has no plans to allow Adani or any other company to conduct bauxite mining in Gandhamardan hills. Ministers deny allegations of permission for mining, citing land acquired for compensatory afforestation related to earlier coal project impacts. Opposition questions bauxite mining; the government reiterates the hills won’t be destroyed.

title: Trump tariffs on Canada, Mexico impact US aluminium market
summary: Trump’s proposed 25% tariffs on all goods from Canada and Mexico, alongside a separate 10% tariff on China goods, are expected to disrupt the US aluminium supply chain. The US is highly reliant on Canadian unwrought aluminium, so tariffs could raise input costs for manufacturers and exporters, with analysts warning of adverse impacts on consumers and demand.

title: Australia's Arrow to Join the circle of bauxite producers in Guinea
