summary: Arrow Minerals reported positive initial drilling results at its Niagara bauxite project in Guinea, confirming bauxite mineralization. Guinea is a major global bauxite supplier to China and is pushing local processing. The discovery may strengthen future supply expectations, but it is still pre-resource estimation.

title: Horizon Copper Provides Portfolio Development Updates
summary: Horizon Copper highlights portfolio progress, including high-grade drill results from the Oyu Tolgoi Hugo North Extension. Underground development commenced at Lift 1 Panel 1 and additional diamond drilling intersected substantial copper grades, extending mineralization at depth. The firm also notes pre-construction work at Hod Maden. Overall, the update supports copper-focused sentiment.

title: Luxury cars, high-end jewellery: Lavish purchases made by man in S$1.46bil nickel trading case
summary: A Singapore businessman, accused of running a S$1.46 billion nickel investment scam, allegedly promised profits from buying and selling physical nickel but prosecutors say no nickel trades occurred. Instead, earlier investors were paid with new funds. The case centers on fraud, money laundering, and lavish personal spending.

title: Rusal to cut 6% annual aluminium production due to alumina price surge and decreased domestic demand
summary: Rusal will reduce annual primary aluminium production by about 6% (250,000 tonnes) as alumina prices have doubled to above $700/ton, lifting cash costs above normal levels, while domestic demand weakens. The decision follows alumina supply disruptions and should tighten aluminium supply expectations near term.

title: China's scrap copper imports set to slump over US trade worries, analysts say
summary: China’s scrap copper imports are expected to drop as some traders stop buying from the US amid rising US–China trade tensions and promised tariff hikes. Analysts at SMM and BMI say reduced US scrap supply will tighten scrap availability, potentially boosting demand for refined copper and increasing short-term copper price volatility.

title: Canada's McEwen Copper seeks US$2.5-billion for construction of Los Azules copper mine in Argentina
summary: McEwen Copper is raising US$2.5 billion to build Argentina’s Los Azules copper mine. The project is awaiting an environmental permit in four to six weeks and targets large-investment incentives for tax and customs relief. Renewables energy and stakeholder support are highlighted, pointing to improved future supply prospects for copper.

title: McEwen Copper seeks $2.5 billion for Argentina copper mine Los Azules
summary: McEwen Copper is raising $2.5 billion to advance the Los Azules copper mine in Argentina. The project awaits a key environmental permit in 4–6 weeks and seeks to qualify for President Milei’s RIGI incentives. Progress and improved investment prospects for new supply are supportive for copper sentiment.

title: Gleason & Sons LLC: Gleason & Sons Funds Electric Royalties' Acquisition of 0.75% Gross Revenue Royalty on the Producing Punitaqui Copper Project
summary: Gleason & Sons advanced C$3.05m to Electric Royalties to acquire a 0.75% gross revenue royalty on the producing Punitaqui copper project in Chile, pending TSX-Venture approval. The company expects closing in days and cites potential upcoming catalysts across its royalty portfolio, including further copper-related projects.

title: 'We are not stupid people': Private banker victim breaks down during $1.5b nickel trading scam trial
summary: A Singapore trial describes a $1.5 billion “nickel trading” scam in which 947 investors were duped after claims that nickel could be bought at a discount from an Australian mine and resold at profits. Prosecutors say no nickel was bought or sold; payments to earlier investors came from new money.

title: DNR delays decision on northeast Minnesota copper nickel mine
summary: Minnesota’s DNR is postponing a decision on permits for NewRange Copper Nickel’s proposed copper and nickel mine on the Iron Range. The state has paused consideration until August next year due to regulatory and legal challenges, leaving output uncertain and potentially constraining future supply expectations.

title: DNR delays decision on northeast Minnesota copper nickel mine
summary: Minnesota’s DNR is postponing its permit decision on the proposed NewRange Copper Nickel project in northeastern Minnesota, pausing further consideration until August next year. The delay stems from regulatory and legal challenges, potentially pushing back future copper and nickel supply.

title: McEwen Copper seeks $2.5bn funding for Los Azules mine in Argentina
summary: McEwen Copper is seeking $2.5bn to fund development of the Los Azules advanced copper project in Argentina. The company expects an environmental permit within 4–6 weeks and highlights government incentives, tax credits, and renewable energy supply plans. Progress toward construction is likely supportive for copper sentiment.

title: Indonesia seeks investors to speed up bauxite downstreaming-Xinhua
summary: Indonesia is seeking investors to fund delayed bauxite downstreaming and smelter development, after earlier plans were hindered by financing and several smelter projects were postponed. With a June 2023 ban on raw bauxite ore exports and only four of 12 smelters ready, the push to accelerate processing may support aluminium supply expectations.

title: Indonesia seeks investors to speed up bauxite downstreaming
summary: Indonesia is seeking new investors to accelerate bauxite downstreaming after funding constraints delayed several smelter projects. Indonesia has banned raw bauxite exports since June 2023, but only four of 12 planned bauxite smelters are ready. The slower progress could influence near-term aluminium production expectations.

title: Exclusive-Chile's Codelco boosts copper output in final dash to meet 2024 target, sources say
summary: Codelco, Chile’s state copper miner, is ramping production after a weak first half to meet its 2024 copper target. An internal memo and sources suggest October output beat target by 2.9%, implying near-120,000 tons, while leadership is confident. Final results depend on remaining Q4 ramp-up.

title: S$1.5bil nickel-trading scam: Defence accuses investor of caring only about revenue
summary: A Singapore trial described an alleged S$1.46 billion nickel-trading scheme where prosecutors say no nickel was bought or sold and earlier investor payouts came from new funds. The focus is on due diligence and investor deception, with little direct information on nickel market fundamentals that would move prices.

title: Aluminum manufacturers eagerly await Trump's tariffs
summary: U.S. aluminum extruders are seeking reversal or expansion of tariff protection after the International Trade Commission declined higher duties on aluminum parts from multiple countries. The article cites Trump’s campaign proposals and pledges for broad import tariffs, which manufacturers expect to raise the cost of cheap aluminum imports and support domestic prices.

title: Continued Downward Trend in High-Nickel Pig Iron Prices Amid Weak Demand
summary: High-nickel pig iron prices fell for a second consecutive week (SMM: 962.2 yuan per nickel point, down 21.4). Indonesian FOB also declined. Weaker stainless-steel spot prices, seasonal demand lull, and shrinking NPI smelter profits reduce output and keep NPI discounts to electrolytic nickel widening, bearish for nickel sentiment.

title: Global alumina production hits record 12.6m tonnes in October
summary: Global alumina production is reported to have reached a record 12.6 million tonnes in October. Alumina is the key feedstock for aluminium smelting, so higher output can reduce perceived supply tightness for refiners and support expectations for aluminium production and pricing.

title: Global copper shortage looms but Australia could help to fill the gap
summary: The piece warns that rising demand for renewable energy and electrification could lead to a global copper deficit, though not immediately. It argues Australia could help by expanding production, citing major output from Queensland and South Australia and potential new supply after a mine closure.

title: Copper - Topic - ABC News
summary: The articles highlight rising copper theft in Australia and ongoing uncertainty around copper refining/smelter and mine continuity in outback Queensland. With disruptions to supply and limited new mines coming online, analysts warn of future shortages. Together, these factors point to near-term tightening and higher copper prices.

title: WA's nickel industry has collapsed but multi-billion-dollar projects still in development with eye on future
summary: Western Australia’s nickel industry has “collapsed” this year with multiple mine closures and job losses, attributed to cheaper Indonesian nickel flooding global markets. Analysts expect nickel to remain oversupplied until at least 2029. While green/nickel-cobalt projects continue, the current market dynamics point to weak pricing near term.

title: Copper theft costing WA millions as criminals steal estimated 15,000m of cabling in Perth
summary: Main Roads WA says thieves stole about 15,000 metres of copper cabling from light poles in Perth, with overall losses of roughly 800,000 metres over five to six years. Replacement costs are estimated at $2–$3 million annually and theft is increasing, prompting remediation efforts and trials of new security measures.

title: Title V/Clean Air Act: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency Order Denying Objection to Warrick County, Indiana Aluminum Production Facility Permit | Mitchell, Williams, Selig, Gates & Woodyard, P.L.L.C.
summary: The EPA denied a Sierra Club petition objecting to the Clean Air Act Title V permit renewal for Warrick Newco LLC, an Alcoa-linked aluminum production plant in Indiana. The petition raised restart/permit compliance concerns for potlines #2 and #6, but EPA said it was a forward-looking compliance issue rather than a current permit-writing problem.

title: Mogotes Metals: Drill Program Starting Soon Next to Filo Mining's Copper Deposit
summary: Mogotes Metals announced that a drill program is set to start soon next to Filo Mining’s copper deposit. The update is exploration-related and may raise expectations of additional copper resource potential, which can support short-term sentiment for copper prices, though the immediate production impact is likely limited.

title: Patriot Lithium Acquires Major Copper License in Zambia
summary: Patriot Lithium says it has secured an option to acquire a 90% stake in Zambia’s Kitumba copper exploration license next to the Kitumba copper deposit. The move is linked to Sinomine’s stated $600 million investment to increase regional copper production. Near-term supply effects appear limited.

title: Nam Định approves $90 million aluminium project
summary: Nam Định Province approved a US$90 million aluminium alloy factory in Mỹ Thuận Industrial Park, to produce green aluminium alloy bars, electronic materials and automotive components. Capacity is 183,000 tonnes/year, with construction expected to finish in Q3 2027 and trial/official operations in late 2027.

title: VR Resources Ltd. Announces Drilling Underway at VR Resources Empire Copper - Gold Project in Ontario, Targeting New IP Chargeability Anomalies
summary: VR Resources says drilling has begun at its Empire copper–gold project in Ontario, targeting strong IP (chargeability) anomalies identified by a recent DCIP survey and related EM conductivity features. Results are preliminary and no resource or production changes are disclosed, limiting near-term implications mainly to copper sentiment.

title: Rio Tinto to Sell Stake in Copper-Gold Project to Sumitomo Metal
summary: Rio Tinto will sell a 30% stake in its Winu copper-gold project in Western Australia to Sumitomo Metal Mining for $399 million, with $195 million upfront and deferred milestone-linked payments. The joint venture is expected to be finalized in 1H 2025, supporting copper project development prospects.

title: Uncertainty Looms Over Aluminum Prices as Chinese Exports Face New Tariff
summary: China’s Ministry of Finance canceled a 13% VAT refund for exported aluminum and copper semi-finished products effective Dec 1. Buyers rushed shipments ahead of the deadline and the LME aluminum price reportedly surged about $200/ton, while SHFE fell, reflecting immediate supply-chain cost pressure and uncertainty.

title: Butte's Copper Mountain Complex safe for recreating despite seeps
summary: Butte’s Copper Mountain Complex, built atop a Superfund wastes repository, was found to have contaminated groundwater seepage. An initial investigation of hundreds of soil samples found no health risk in recreation areas, with only slight lead elevations near the parking lot. Further testing and possible cap remediation are planned, alongside tighter local lead standards.

title: Rio Tinto and Sumitomo Metal Mining to partner on Winu copper-gold project
summary: Rio Tinto and Sumitomo Metal Mining signed a term sheet for a joint venture to develop the Winu copper-gold project in Western Australia, with SMM paying Rio Tinto $399 million for a 30% share. The companies will finalize definitive agreements in 1H 2025 and continue pre-feasibility and permitting work.

title: Rio Tinto And Sumitomo Metal Mining Partner On Winu Copper-gold Project
summary: Rio Tinto and Sumitomo Metal Mining signed a term sheet for a joint venture to develop the Winu copper-gold project in Western Australia. Sumitomo will pay Rio Tinto $399 million for a 30% stake, while definitive agreements and a pre-feasibility study are planned for 2025.

title: Hopewell continues search for suspect in attempted copper theft
summary: Hopewell police are searching for a suspect who attempted to steal three large copper spools at a WestRock papermill. The thief walked away empty-handed after 30 minutes. Police say copper scrap thefts are becoming more common and can target HVAC and other copper-bearing components for cash.

title: Lincoln unearths big copper-lead hit in old data
summary: Lincoln Minerals says it re-analysed historical drill cores at its Minbrie project and found a previously unassayed high-grade sulphide intercept, including 12m at 1.4% copper (plus significant lead and zinc). Management is reworking the 2011 campaign and plans follow-up drilling, which is copper-positive for sentiment.

title: Rio Tinto signs new partnership agreement to study low carbon aluminium project in Finland
summary: Rio Tinto partnered to study a low-carbon greenfield aluminium project in Kokkola, Finland, using its AP60 smelting technology and sourcing low-fossil electricity with partners including Fortum. If successful, it could be the first continental Europe primary aluminium project in 30 years, boosting low-carbon aluminium expectations.

title: Rio Tinto Partners With Vargas, Mitsubishi And Others For Low Carbon Aluminium Project In Finland
summary: Rio Tinto partnered with Vargas, Mitsubishi and others to study a low-carbon aluminium greenfield project in Kokkola, Finland. Rio Tinto will support with its AP60 smelting technology, aiming for the first AP60 deployment in a smelter outside Quebec. Arctial will run feasibility and environmental assessments.

title: Rio Tinto raises 2025 copper production view on Mongolia's Oyu Tolgoi ops boost
summary: Rio Tinto lifted its fiscal 2025 outlook for consolidated mined copper production, citing a planned 50% rise from Mongolia’s Oyu Tolgoi next year. Copper output is expected at 780,000-850,000 tons in FY2025 versus 660,000-720,000 in FY2024, alongside broader copper growth ambitions.

title: Sumitomo to partner on Winu copper-gold project | Company Announcement
summary: Rio Tinto and Sumitomo Metal Mining signed a term sheet for a joint venture on the Winu copper-gold project in Western Australia, with SMM paying $399 million for a 30% stake. Definitive agreements and studies are targeted for 1H 2025, signaling continued copper project progress.

title: Rio Tinto eyes copper output hike; Zigup profit falls
summary: Rio Tinto said it expects 2025 copper output of 780,000–850,000 tonnes, up from its 2024 range, and also projected higher aluminium production. It outlined growth plans and signed a joint-venture deal for the Winu copper-gold project. The update supports near-term supply expectations.

title: Rio Tinto: aluminium partnership in Finland
summary: Rio Tinto is partnering with Vargas, Mitsubishi and others to study a low-carbon aluminium project in Kokkola, Finland, using its AP60 technology and low-carbon energy supplied with Fortum. Feasibility and environmental assessments are planned. If developed, it would be continental Europe’s first primary aluminium project in 30+ years.

title: RIO ASX: Rio Tinto outlines 40pc surge in copper as it pivots from iron ore
summary: Rio Tinto told investors it plans to increase copper volumes by 18% next year and 40% by 2030 as it reduces reliance on Australian iron ore. The company also expects similar iron ore export volumes next year. The copper expansion is the key development for copper market sentiment.

title: Rio Tinto, Sumitomo partner on Winu copper-gold project development in Australia
summary: Rio Tinto and Sumitomo Metal Mining agreed on Sumitomo acquiring a 30% stake in the Winu copper-gold project in Western Australia for $399m. The managing partner remains Rio Tinto, with JV terms targeted for mid-2025 and pre-feasibility and environmental approvals ongoing.

title: Resourcing Tomorrow: copper deficit a focus of discussion
summary: Barrick CEO Mark Bristow says clean-energy demand will outpace existing and planned copper production, widening a potential supply gap after 2026, with future supply likely in challenging jurisdictions. The piece highlights Argentina’s improved mining policy, a secured permit for Los Azules, and the role of recycling.

title: CaNickel Mining Limited: CaNickel Announces Extension of Option Agreement for Proposed Sale of the Bucko Lake Mine
summary: CaNickel extended an option agreement with Cobalt One and Blackstone to purchase the Bucko Lake nickel sulfide mine, shifting the option deadline to January 3, 2025. If exercised and approvals are obtained, the buyers would advance permitting and development toward commercial production, improving nickel project outlook despite current market challenges.

title: Rio Tinto signs new deal for low carbon aluminium project in Finland
summary: Rio Tinto, together with Vargas, Mitsubishi and other partners, is exploring a low-carbon greenfield aluminium project in Kokkola, Finland, using its AP60 efficient smelting technology. The Arctial partnership will run feasibility and environmental impact assessments. The news may support expectations around aluminium supply and demand for low-carbon metal.

title: USA News Group: Renewables and EVs Are Driving Copper Shortages Faster Than Expected
summary: pv magazine reports that renewables and EVs are driving copper shortages faster than expected. It notes solar module prices rose in February by about €0.01–€0.015/W, moving 15%–18% above December 2024 lows, suggesting increased input pressure in copper-intensive supply chains.

title: Renewables and EVs Are Driving Copper Shortages Faster Than Expected
summary: The piece argues copper shortages are emerging faster than expected as renewables and EVs boost demand, with UBS forecasting a supply deficit exceeding 200,000 tons by 2025. It stresses the long lead time for new mines and reports ongoing copper-focused exploration and operational updates from major producers.

title: [SMM Analysis] Prospects of the Indonesian Nickel Ore Market: The Interplay of Potential Policy Adjustments and Changes in Supply and Demand
summary: SMM highlights Indonesia’s potential RKAB quota policy refinements and tighter supervision of environmental/compliance rules, alongside SIMBARA-driven application/approval delays that could affect Q1 supply. It also notes execution risks from weather and uncertainty over sustained nickel ore inflows from the Philippines, affecting supply tightness for next year.

title: Why Reliance, Inc. (RS) is the Best Aluminum and Aluminum Mining Stock To Buy?
summary: The piece highlights China’s planned cancellation of export tax rebates for several products, including aluminum and copper, effective Dec. 1. It states the announcement already triggered an immediate LME aluminum price surge, with traders expecting reduced Chinese export flows, less global supply, and higher prices.

title: Why Ball Corporation (BALL) is the Best Aluminum and Aluminum Mining Stock To Buy?
summary: Insider Monkey highlights Ball Corporation, but the key market driver described is China’s Nov. 29 decision to cancel export tax rebates starting Dec. 1 for aluminum and copper products. The change already lifted LME aluminum prices as traders expect reduced Chinese export flows and tighter global supply.

title: Why Crown Holdings (CCK) is the Best Aluminum and Aluminum Mining Stock To Buy?
summary: The piece highlights China’s decision to cancel export tax rebates for products including aluminum and copper starting Dec. 1. It says the announcement already boosted aluminum prices on the LME, with traders expecting curtailed Chinese exports and reduced global supply. It also cites supportive near-term demand in packaging and autos.

title: Why Mueller Industries (MLI) is the Best Aluminum and Aluminum Mining Stock To Buy?
summary: The article discusses China’s decision to cancel export tax rebates for several products, including aluminum and copper, effective December 1. It states the announcement had an immediate market impact, with LME aluminum prices surging as traders expect reduced Chinese export flows and lower global supply.

title: Why Century Aluminum Company (CENX) is the Best Aluminum and Aluminum Mining Stock To Buy?
summary: The piece highlights China’s decision to cancel export tax rebates for several products, including aluminium and copper, effective December 1. It states the announcement had an immediate impact, with aluminium prices surging on the London Metal Exchange. Traders expect reduced Chinese exports, tightening supply and supporting higher prices.

title: Why Constellium (CSTM) is the Best Aluminum and Aluminum Mining Stock To Buy?
summary: Insider Monkey highlights China’s decision to cancel export tax rebates for several products, including aluminium and copper products, effective Dec 1. It notes the announcement already pushed aluminium higher on the LME and traders expect fewer Chinese exports and tighter global supply, supporting higher prices. The piece also discusses recycling demand trends.

title: Why Kaiser Aluminum (KALU) is the Best Aluminum and Aluminum Mining Stock To Buy?
summary: The article discusses China’s move to cancel export tax rebates for several products, including aluminum and copper, effective December 1. It says the announcement already boosted LME aluminum prices and traders expect reduced Chinese export supply, tightening global availability and supporting higher prices near term.

title: Why Rio Tinto (RIO) is the Best Aluminum and Aluminum Mining Stock To Buy?
summary: The piece notes China’s impending cancellation of export tax rebates for aluminum (and copper products), effective Dec 1, and says the announcement immediately lifted LME aluminum prices as traders expect fewer Chinese exports and tighter global supply. It also discusses Rio Tinto’s aluminum smelter acquisitions and demand outlook for aluminum.

title: Why Alcoa Corporation (AA) is the Best Aluminum and Aluminum Mining Stock To Buy?
summary: Insider Monkey discusses Alcoa but highlights a key China policy change: cancellation of export tax rebates (including for aluminum and copper products) effective Dec 1. The announcement immediately pushed LME aluminum prices higher as traders expect reduced Chinese exports and tighter global supply, supporting near-term price strength for aluminum.

title: Why Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMBP) is the Best Aluminum and Aluminum Mining Stock To Buy?
summary: The piece discusses China’s November 29 cancellation of export tax rebates starting Dec 1, explicitly including aluminum and copper products. It notes the change immediately boosted LME aluminum prices, with expectations for reduced Chinese exports and tighter global supply. It also cites ongoing demand strength for aluminum in packaging and transportation.

title: McEwen Copper obtains environmental permit for Los Azules project in Argentina
summary: McEwen Copper said Argentina’s San Juan province issued the environmental impact approval needed to proceed with the Los Azules project, a large high-grade open-pit copper development. The permit advances feasibility and construction planning, though construction is expected from 2026 and full output is further out.

title: Electric Royalties Ltd.: Electric Royalties Closes Acquisition of 0.75% Gross Revenue Royalty on Producing Punitaqui Copper Mine in Chile
summary: Electric Royalties said it closed its acquisition of a 0.75% gross revenue royalty on the producing Punitaqui copper mine in Chile, with royalty coverage extending to third-party materials processed at the site through 2027. The company used a convertible credit facility drawdown to fund the cash payment at closing and expects Punitaqui to ramp up production.

title: Key Takeaway from SMM Motor Annual Conference: Copper Prices More Likely to Rise than Fall, While Aluminum Price Volatility May Be Lower than Copper
summary: SMM’s conference takeaway highlights copper: weak macro but improving liquidity signals, and notably tightening copper concentrate conditions (negative spot concentrate TCs, worse smelting economics) with expectations of supply constraints. It reports copper inventory buildup yet argues copper prices are more likely to rise than fall; aluminum shows higher costs, export policy changes, and lower volatility.

title: Key Takeaway from SMM Motor Annual Conference: Copper Prices More Likely to Rise than Fall, While Aluminum Price Volatility May Be Lower than Copper
summary: SMM’s conference takeaway highlights that copper prices are more likely to rise than fall, citing weakening spot concentrate terms, deteriorating smelting profits, and a tightening concentrate outlook alongside demand support from power/new energy. Aluminum is described as facing higher costs and export/trade shifts, but with volatility expected lower than copper.

title: Lifezone Metals : Upgrades High Grade Nickel Copper and Cobalt Mineral Resources at its Kabanga Nickel Project Form 6 K
summary: Lifezone Metals reported a December 2024 mineral resource update at its Kabanga nickel project in Tanzania, upgrading high-confidence Measured and Indicated resources and adding contained nickel and copper. The release improves resource confidence and discusses potential partner/offtake, but it is not a production or reserve change.

title: Lifezone Metals Upgrades High-Grade Nickel Copper and Cobalt Mineral Resources at its Kabanga Nickel Project
summary: Lifezone Metals announced an upgrade of measured and indicated mineral resources at its Kabanga nickel project in Tanzania, adding contained nickel and reporting higher-confidence resources. The resource update also includes associated copper grades. Because it does not change near-term mine supply or production, any effect on copper and nickel prices should be modest.

title: Lifezone Metals : Upgrades High Grade Nickel Copper and Cobalt Mineral Resources at its Kabanga Nickel Project Form 6 K
summary: Lifezone Metals announced a December 2024 Mineral Resource Update for its Kabanga project in Tanzania, upgrading Measured and Indicated resources with higher contained nickel and copper grades, plus a revised nickel-equivalent cut-off. The release supports longer-term project value but provides no near-term production or supply impact.

title: Canada Nickel Announces Assay Results from Second High Grade Sulphide Intersection at Bannockburn Project
summary: Canada Nickel reported assay results from drill BAN24-20 at its Bannockburn nickel sulphide project, including 1.11% nickel over 10.1 metres (and up to 1.32% Ni over 4.4 metres). The company is continuing follow-up drilling and BHEM surveys, but no production or supply changes are announced.

title: TNR Gold Corp.: TNR Gold NSR Royalty Update - Los Azules Copper, Gold and Silver Project: McEwen Copper Secures Environmental Permit for Construction and Operation of Los Azules
summary: TNR Gold reported that McEwen Copper received San Juan Province approval of the Environmental Impact Assessment for the Los Azules copper project. The permit is a key step toward feasibility and potential construction. TNR holds an NSR royalty on Los Azules, so the milestone advances project development prospects for copper supply.

title: Rio Tinto and partners to study low-carbon aluminium project in Finland
summary: Rio Tinto and partners launched the Arctial project to study a low-carbon greenfield aluminium smelter in Finland’s Kokkola. The work includes feasibility and environmental assessments and plans to use AP60 aluminium smelting technology with carbon-free electricity. If successful, it could add primary aluminium capacity in Europe after decades.

title: Nornickel's largest investor Interros objects to Rusal lawsuit over dividends
summary: Interros, Nornickel’s largest shareholder, objected to Rusal’s London lawsuit aimed at influencing Nornickel’s dividend policy. The dispute could force sensitive disclosures under geopolitical conditions. Nornickel is a major nickel producer, while Rusal uses dividends to service debt; however, no immediate production or trade changes are cited.

title: Tariffs on Chinese EVs, aluminum and steel to raise federal revenues by $473M: PBO
summary: Canada’s parliamentary budget officer estimates tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles plus steel and aluminum imports will raise $473M in federal revenue over five years. Since October, Ottawa has imposed a 100% tariff on Chinese-made EVs and a 25% tariff on Chinese steel and aluminum imports, affecting aluminum supply and pricing expectations.

title: Ford Eyes Indonesia for EV Expansion: Strategic Move into the Heart of Nickel Production?
summary: Ford is positioning for EV growth by investing in Indonesia, the world’s largest nickel producer. The move is linked to a $4.5 billion nickel processing project with Vale and Huayou, targeting battery cathode supply. Indonesia also pushes higher local-content rules for EVs, reinforcing nickel demand expectations.

title: Tariffs on Chinese EVs, aluminum and steel to raise federal revenues by $473M: PBO | iNFOnews
summary: Canada’s Parliamentary Budget Officer estimates tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles plus 25% tariffs on steel and aluminum will raise federal revenues by $473M over five years. The report says aluminum imports from China should fall about 50% after the tariffs began, potentially tightening supply and supporting aluminum pricing.

title: Tariffs on Chinese EVs, aluminum and steel to raise federal revenues by $473-million, PBO estimates
summary: Canada’s Parliamentary Budget Officer estimates tariffs on Chinese EVs, aluminum and steel will raise revenue by $473 million over five years and cut aluminum and steel imports from China by about 50%. The 25% aluminum tariff reduces Chinese inflows, likely tightening local supply conditions for aluminum.

title: Federal revenues to rise due to tariffs on Chinese EVs, aluminum and steel: PBO - Canadian Manufacturing
summary: Canada’s Parliamentary Budget Officer projects federal revenue gains from tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles, and 25% tariffs on Chinese steel and aluminum imports. The PBO estimates aluminum imports from China fall about 50%. By reducing Chinese supply flows into Canada, the policy is likely to support aluminium pricing in the near term.

title: Tariffs on Chinese EVs, aluminum, steel to raise revenues by $473M: PBO
summary: Canada’s parliamentary budget officer estimates tariffs on Chinese EVs plus 25% duties on steel and aluminum will raise federal revenue by $473M over five years. The report says the measures cut Chinese aluminum imports by about 50%, potentially tightening near-term aluminum availability and supporting prices.

title: Former Rio Tinto Copper Mine Poses Continuing Risks, Independent Report Says
summary: An independent assessment says the abandoned Panguna copper mine in Bougainville still poses risks from unstable structures, landslides, and soil and water contamination. Rio Tinto, which offloaded its stake and supports discussions, says it will review findings, while communities urge faster remediation funding.

title: Ero Copper Corp. (ERO): A Bull Case Theory
summary: The article summarizes a bullish thesis on Ero Copper (ERO), highlighting an expected ramp at the Tucuma Project from 10,000 tons of copper production in 2024 to over 50,000 tons in 2025. It links potential earnings growth to copper prices around $4/lb and notes ongoing investment and Brazil political risk.

title: Rio's Abandoned Panguna Copper Mine Still a Threat, Report Says – BNN Bloomberg
summary: A BNN Bloomberg report says Rio’s abandoned Panguna copper mine in Papua New Guinea remains a threat. While the mine is shuttered, the story raises concerns that could complicate future supply outlooks or potential restart plans, which may add support to copper expectations in the near term.

title: "Power Nickel (TSX.V: PNPN) (OTCQB - MarketScreener
summary: Power Nickel says shareholders and courts approved the spin-out of its Golden Ivan and certain Chilean exploration assets into Chilean Metals Inc., with dividends payable in the new shares. It also reports drilling success at the Nisk Project, extending the Lion Zone 550 meters along strike, and adds a strategic advisor.

title: Canadian Copper Inc.: Canadian Copper Closes Oversubscribed Private Placement: PEA Progressing for Combined Strategy
summary: Canadian Copper Inc. closed an oversubscribed private placement to fund completion of a Preliminary Economic Assessment for processing its Murray Brook copper deposit at the Caribou processing complex. The company says it is focused on completing the PEA for timing in 1H 2025 and advancing corporate activities for the restart strategy.

title: High-Grade NPI and Refined Nickel Prices Remain Under Pressure Amid Weak Stainless Steel Market
summary: High-grade NPI prices (8–12%) fell to 952.2 yuan/mtu and Indonesian NPI FOB declined. Weak stainless steel spot and seasonal surplus weigh on NPI demand, keeping refined nickel rangebound amid limited supportive signals. The NPI vs refined nickel discount narrowed slightly, but overall nickel sentiment remains pressured.

title: Adani smelter expansion will cut India's refined copper imports, government says
summary: India’s Ministry of Mines said Adani’s new Mundra refined copper smelter will eventually make the country self-sufficient, reducing reliance on refined copper imports. India imported 363,000 tons in FY to March 2024 amid a domestic production shortfall. Start-up is underway, with full capacity targeted for early next year.

title: Marvel Discovery Corporation: Marvel Discovery Corp. to Return to Blackfly Gold Project and Duhamel Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Projects; Evaluates Joint Venture Opportunities for Elliott Lake Uranium & Critical Element Assets
summary: Marvel Discovery Corp. says it is returning to Ontario’s Blackfly gold project and Quebec’s Duhamel nickel-copper-cobalt project, discontinuing uranium options. The release cites historical Ni/Cu/Co mineralization and corridor potential but provides no production or definitive near-term supply changes, implying limited immediate impact on copper/nickel prices.

title: Osisko Metals Acquires Additional Claims Near Gaspé Copper
summary: Osisko Metals announced it acquired 199 additional claims adjacent to its Gaspé Copper Project in Québec, paying with common shares and a 2% net smelter return royalty. The claims extend ground and potential tailings areas for exploration north and south of the current property. The news is exploratory and not tied to near-term production changes.

title: Osisko Metals Incorporated Acquires Additional Claims Near Gaspe Copper
summary: Osisko Metals said it acquired 199 claims adjacent to its Gaspé Copper Project. The deal adds a 100% interest in the claims for 5 million common shares plus a 2% net smelter return royalty. The update can strengthen perceived copper project value and sentiment for near-term development outlook.

title: Chris Temple Talks about Nickel, Lithium, $200 Uranium, US Policies and 2025 Potential Energy Shift
summary: A podcast interview discusses current commodity trends, with Chris Temple predicting a rebound in nickel prices. He attributes the outlook to tight nickel supply and depleted warehouse stocks. The conversation also notes inflation/demand differences across the US and China, but focuses on nickel’s near-term support.

title: Norsk Hydro to supply Mercedes-Benz with low-carbon aluminum - Telegraph
summary: Norsk Hydro will supply Mercedes-Benz with low-carbon aluminum for various models, including electric EQ cars. Mercedes aims for near-zero carbon aluminum by 2030 and intends to cut and eventually offset CO2 emissions. The partnership also targets further R&D on low-carbon and recycled aluminum use in vehicles.

title: Copper demand sees 13% yoy growth in FY2024, reaches 1700 kilotonnes: ICA India
summary: International Copper Association India (ICA India) said India’s copper demand grew 13% year-on-year in FY2024 to 1,700 kilotonnes. The upbeat demand data can improve near-term expectations for market tightness and support copper prices as buyers anticipate higher consumption.

title: Customs and Border Protection to seize aluminum products of Chinese-owned company
summary: U.S. Customs and Border Protection says it will seize and restrict aluminum products from Kingtom Aluminio, a Chinese-owned firm in the Dominican Republic, after finding forced-labor and related labor-rights violations. The action applies at all U.S. ports of entry, potentially tightening aluminum supply entering the market.

title: Adani copper smelter expansion to reduce India's refined copper imports
summary: India’s Ministry of Mines says expansion of Adani’s Kutch Copper smelter will add refined copper capacity, potentially reducing reliance on imports. The Mundra plant has started operations, with initial 500,000 t capacity and plans to double later. India currently imports hundreds of thousands of tonnes annually due to a supply gap.

title: XXIX Metal Corp. Closes Strategic Acquisition of Cuprum Corp.
summary: XXIX Metal Corp. completed its all-share acquisition of Cuprum Corp. and the 100% owned Thierry Copper Project, expanding its copper resource portfolio in Quebec and Ontario alongside its Opemiska project. The company was renamed and shares begin trading under a new TSXV ticker on December 11, 2024.

title: Lundin sells European mines for up to US$1.52-billion to fund South American copper ambitions
summary: Lundin Mining will sell two European mines for up to $1.52 billion to raise cash and strengthen its balance sheet. Proceeds fund its South American copper growth strategy, including the Vicuna operations and joint projects with BHP. The deal also includes copper-linked pricing thresholds for part of the payment.

title: Copper concentrate production in Armenia up 8.9% in 10 months
summary: Armenian copper concentrate production rose 8.9% in January–October 2024 to 258,497.5 tons year-on-year, according to the national statistics committee. The report also notes changes in zinc and molybdenum concentrates, but the primary copper signal is higher concentrate supply, likely not enough for an immediate price move.

title: Chilean Peso Rises Following Copper and other Commodity Increases
summary: The piece says the Chilean peso strengthens against the US dollar because commodities rise, with copper up more than 2%—its best performance since November. It attributes the move to China’s 2025 policy shift toward easier monetary conditions, while noting near-term uncertainty from upcoming US inflation data.

title: The Overnight Report: China Stimulus
summary: China’s Politburo promised more proactive fiscal policy and moderately loose monetary policy, aimed at stabilizing property and markets. The report says industrial metal prices rebounded and notes copper trading above USD9,200/t as demand prospects improved, supported by expectations of stronger growth.

title: Tucson sees increase in copper wire thefts from street lights
summary: Tucson says copper wire thefts from street lights have surged, with more than 445,000 feet stolen in six months and over $1.3 million spent on repairs. Maintenance is delayed and sometimes wire is stolen again. The city is seeking countermeasures but still needs ongoing copper replacements.

title: China Nov copper imports hit one-year high
summary: China’s November copper imports hit a one-year high at 528,000 tons, driven by solid end-demand, declining inventories, and more shipments from Africa. Copper stocks at the Shanghai Futures Exchange fell to a nine-month low, and higher imports occurred despite recent price drops, indicating stronger physical buying.

title: India's copper demand surges as infra projects expand at rapid pace
summary: India’s copper demand rose 13% year-on-year to 1,700 kilotonnes in 2023-24, supported by rapid infrastructure and construction growth. The article also cites higher copper production and 13% higher net imports, plus duty exemptions and a new smelter coming online. It expects continued demand growth.

title: South32 Pulls Output Guidance for Mozambique Aluminum Smelter
summary: South32 has pulled output guidance for its Mozambique aluminium smelter, signaling uncertainty around near-term aluminium supply. In the coming days to weeks, traders may price a potential reduction or disruption to smelting output, which can weigh on aluminium prices as expectations for market balance shift.

title: Capstone Copper Corp.: Capstone Copper Publishes 2023 Sustainability Report
summary: Capstone Copper published its 2023 sustainability report, highlighting progress on “The Copper Mark,” renewable electricity coverage, and sustainability/performance metrics across its copper assets in Arizona, Mexico, and Chile. It provides energy and emissions trends but no new guidance, mine disruption, or supply-demand change. Immediate impact on copper prices appears limited.

title: South32 Pulls Output Guidance at Mozambique Aluminum Smelter
summary: South32 reportedly pulled output guidance for its Mozambique aluminum smelter. The update suggests weaker near-term production prospects, which can reduce anticipated aluminum supply and tighten market expectations. Such guidance changes often influence short-term pricing by shifting balance estimates for the next days to several weeks.

title: Copper Forecast Today 10/12: Looks Like Value Trade (Video)
summary: Copper rallied about 1.76% early Monday, with price attempting to break above the 50-day EMA and viewed as near “fair value.” The piece links potential upside to inflation dynamics and hopes for China stimulus that could increase housing demand. The strategy favors buying dips above key support.

title: Norilsk Nickel expects copper market surplus in 2024
summary: Norilsk Nickel forecasts a copper market surplus of about 200,000 metric tons in 2024, expecting rebalancing only in 2025 as demand grows. The firm also cites new smelter supply coming online (mainly in China) and mixed demand risks from slowing industrial activity, supporting a bearish near-term copper outlook.

title: Norilsk Nickel expects copper market surplus in 2024
summary: Norilsk Nickel expects the global copper market to show a surplus of about 200,000 metric tons in 2024, with balance returning in 2025 as demand growth catches up. It notes copper prices have already fallen since May amid mixed industrial outlooks, pointing to near-term bearish sentiment.

title: GT Resources Inc.: GT Resources Drilling Intersects 2.4% Copper and 3.1 g/t Gold Near Surface at the Canalask Nickel-Copper Project
summary: GT Resources reported 2024 drill results from the Canalask Nickel-Copper Project in Yukon, including copper-rich skarn-like mineralization and nickel intersections (e.g., up to ~2.4% Ni and ~1.84% Cu in sections). The company frames results as expanding exploration targets, with no immediate production impact.

title: GT Resources Inc.: GT Resources Drilling Intersects 2.4% Copper and 3.1 g/t Gold Near Surface at the Canalask Nickel-Copper Project
summary: GT Resources reported final 2024 drill results at its Yukon Canalask nickel-copper project, including copper-rich and nickel-rich intercepts (skarn-like Cu-Au and peridotite-hosted Ni with PGE anomalism). The findings expand geological upside but do not imply near-term production changes, limiting impact on short-term copper and nickel prices.

title: Benton Resources Inc.: Benton Recommences Drilling at Great Burnt Copper Deposit, Extends South Pond Gold-Copper Zone to 2.3 km, and Discovers New Sulphide Zone 1 km South of South Pond
summary: Benton Resources reports recommenced drilling at its Great Burnt copper deposit and expands the South Pond gold-copper zone to over 2.3 km, including sulphide intersections with assays partly pending. It also describes a nickel target from an ultramafic anomaly with limited rock sampling. Overall, this is exploratory and small scale.

title: Granite Creek Copper Ltd.: Granite Creek Copper Confirms New Mineralized Zone in 2024 Drilling at Carmacks Copper-Gold-Silver Project in Yukon, Canada
summary: Granite Creek Copper reported drilling results from its Carmacks copper-gold-silver project in Yukon, confirming a new mineralized “Gap Zone” with copper mineralization in all four holes. The company says the discovery could support resource expansion and longer mine life, boosting sentiment around future copper supply potential.

title: Norilsk Nickel expects a surplus of 150,000 tons on nickel market in 2024-2025
summary: Norilsk Nickel expects a ~150,000 tonne nickel market surplus in 2024-2025, mainly in high-grade nickel, driven by new Indonesia capacity and China cathode nickel inflows, alongside growing exchange stocks. The company also notes many producers are unprofitable at current prices, implying further selling pressure unless demand tightens quickly.

title: Norden Crown Identifies New Copper Porphyry, Epithermal
summary: Norden Crown Metals reports completing a field evaluation at the Smart Creek Gold-Copper Project and identifies multiple porphyry/CRD/epithermal-style targets, including high-priority copper oxide zones and porphyry copper opportunities. The company cites historic drill intercepts and outlines planned geophysics and sampling before drilling in 2025.

title: Manx Telecom to begin phased copper network switch-off in 2025
summary: Manx Telecom will begin phasing out the Isle of Man’s copper telecom network in 2025, completing the transition to fibre broadband by 2029. The company says fibre rollout is already advanced. The change affects copper usage in telecoms, but it appears small and gradual versus global markets, limiting price impact.

title: MT to phase out copper telecom network from next year
summary: Manx Telecom plans to begin phasing out the Isle of Man’s copper telecom network next year, replacing it with fibre optic broadband under a £50 million investment. The shift will be region-by-region through 2029, with homes classified by fibre availability and customers encouraged to act to avoid disruption.

title: Panamanians Divided Over Reopening First Quantum's Copper Mine – Newsroom Panama
summary: Panama’s public is divided over reopening First Quantum’s suspended Cobre Panamá copper mine. The shutdown follows a court ruling and has led to $11–13m monthly preservation costs and about 121,000 tonnes of copper concentrate stockpiled for potential export. Support for reopening rises when job losses are highlighted.

title: Copper wire theft on the rise but difficult to prevent and investigate, senators told
summary: Canadian telecom executives told a Senate committee that copper wire theft is rising, disrupting services and harming emergency operations. They urged tougher criminal penalties and rules targeting resale of stolen telecom copper, including tighter scrap/recycling controls and traceability. Officials note copper can be melted down, complicating enforcement.

title: Copper wire theft rising, hard to prevent, senators told
summary: Canadian officials told a Senate committee that copper wire theft is rising and hard to prevent, with telecom carriers reporting over 1,300 incidents since January 2022 and copper theft responsible for most cases. Theft often causes network outages and collateral damage to fibre lines, prompting calls for stronger enforcement and laws.

title: Southern Hemisphere nails thick copper in Chile
summary: Southern Hemisphere Mining announced thick, higher-grade copper-equivalent drilling intercepts at its Chilean Llahuin copper-gold-molybdenum project, extending strike length and indicating deeper, still-untested expansion targets. The company plans further diamond/RC drilling and an MT survey, potentially boosting resource upgrade expectations in the first half of next year.

title: Ministry to curb nickel output to push up global prices - Markets
summary: Indonesia’s Energy and Mineral Resources Ministry said it plans further limits on nickel product output to avoid oversupply and keep prices higher, while protecting domestic miners. It did not specify timing or the exact restriction terms, but the measure could tighten global nickel supply given Indonesia’s market dominance.

title: Trump and China add to copper headwinds in 2025
summary: ING flags worsening 2025 copper headwinds after Trump’s election, citing potential US tariffs and a stronger dollar that could depress industrial demand. It points to weak China property consumption, high exchange stocks, and a refined surplus. Aluminium is mentioned as relatively advantaged, but macro pressure remains bearish for both.

title: Canada Nickel Announces Positive Exploration Results and Confirms New Discovery at Mann Township Properties
summary: Canada Nickel reported positive exploration drill results from Mann West and Mann South, including nickel intercepts above 0.3% over multiple intervals and a new discovery. The company also noted anomalous PGM horizons and overall drilling progress on 14 properties, targeting additional resources in 2025.

title: Downside risks persist for nickel amid supply glut
summary: ING flags persistent downside risks for nickel, citing Indonesia-driven supply growth after the 2020 ore export ban, a continuing global surplus, and rising LME Class 1 stocks with more Chinese/Indonesian deliveries. Demand headwinds include weaker stainless steel activity and slower EV/battery growth, keeping prices under pressure.

title: Canada Nickel Company Inc. Announces Positive Exploration Results and Confirms New Discovery at Mann Township Properties
summary: Canada Nickel Company reports positive exploration and assay updates from drilling at the Mann West/Central/South properties in Ontario’s Timmins Nickel District. The program intersected nickel sulphide mineralization (pentlandite/heazlewoodite) and is expected to support a first resource estimate in Q1 2025, boosting nickel supply expectations.

title: Cyclic Materials Secures Multi-Year Agreement to Supply Recycled Copper to Global Natural Resources Company Glencore
summary: Cyclic Materials signed a multi-year offtake agreement with Glencore to supply recycled copper from its Spoke operations in Quebec. The copper, processed from electric motors and scrap, will be refined into copper cathode at Glencore’s Horne Smelter and CCR. The deal aims to expand recycled copper supply for electrification.

title: Inverted Duty Structure Shake-Up: Boosting Domestic Aluminium Manufacturing
summary: India’s government is considering an overhaul of an “inverted duty structure” for aluminium ahead of next year’s Union Budget. The industry proposes lowering import duties on calcined and raw petroleum coke, while increasing duties on finished aluminium products to shield local manufacturers and improve margins.

title: Great Southern Copper gets approval for drilling in Chile
summary: Great Southern Copper says it has received permitting and authorization for diamond drilling at the Cerro Negro prospect in Chile, targeting high-grade copper-silver mineralisation at the Mostaza mine. The company has appointed a contractor and plans to start drilling in about two weeks, which is largely company-specific.

title: Lion Copper and Gold Corp.: Lion Copper Receives US$5 Million Additional Nuton Funding, Proposes Early Repayment of Convertible Debentures, Adopts Rolling Stock Option Plan and Grants Stock Options
summary: Lion Copper and Gold Corp. said it received an additional US$5 million from Nuton LLC to advance studies and complete a pre-feasibility study for its Yerington copper project. The firm also plans early repayment of convertible debentures. The funding supports copper project progress and modestly bullish sentiment.

title: Rio Tinto signs new partnership agreement to study low-carbon aluminum project in Finland - Chemical Engineering
summary: Rio Tinto and partners signed an agreement to study a low-carbon greenfield aluminum project in Kokkola, Finland, using Rio’s AP60 smelting technology and carbon-free electricity sources. A feasibility study and environmental assessment will follow. If successful, it could restart primary aluminum production in continental Europe after 30 years.

title: Copperwood Mine funding approved by MI House, heads to Senate for consideration
summary: Michigan’s House committee approved $50 million in re-allocated funds to advance the Copperwood Mine project, intended to develop a new copper mine in Michigan’s Western UP. The funding would support site infrastructure and utilities. The project now moves to the Senate committee for consideration amid local environmental and jobs debate.

title: $50M state grant for Copperwood Mine clears another hurdle
summary: Michigan’s House Appropriations Committee backed a $50 million state grant for Highland Copper’s Copperwood underground copper mine in Michigan’s Upper Peninsula. The money still needs Senate approval and the firm must raise additional funds. The project would improve site infrastructure and is justified by copper demand and jobs.

title: No approval given to bauxite mining proposal in Kuantan, Dewan Rakyat told
summary: Malaysia’s Dewan Rakyat was told that the environmental impact assessment for a proposed bauxite mining project in Bukit Goh, Kuantan has not been approved, and a similar prior EIA was rejected. The ministry said it is reviewing and strengthening the EIA process, affecting potential bauxite supply.

title: Grid Metals Corp. Signs Agreement with a Major Mining Company to Fund the Makwa Nickel Project
summary: Grid Metals and Teck signed an option/JV agreement to explore the Makwa Ni-Cu-PGM-cobalt project in Manitoba. Teck can earn up to 70% by funding exploration expenditures and cash payments, with an initial drilling campaign anticipated. The update may influence sentiment for nickel and copper, but not near-term supply.

title: Barksdale Resources Corp.: Barksdale Intercepts Copper-Rich CRD Sulfide Mineralization
summary: Barksdale Resources said its Sunnyside drilling in Arizona intercepted copper-dominant semi-massive sulfides in a CRD-style target, including chalcopyrite-rich intervals, with drilling continuing deeper. Assays are pending, but the copper-rich discovery and proximity to known mineralized districts could support near-term copper sentiment.

title: 8 Best Copper Stocks To Buy According to Hedge Funds
summary: The piece reviews copper supply-demand dynamics: high demand from energy transition but softer China real estate demand, while supply exceeded demand (ICSG surplus cited) with rising mine/refined output. It then lists copper mining stocks favored by hedge funds, including Ero Copper and BHP, with production-focused company updates.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel Announces Positive Mineralogical Results For New Large-Scale Zone
summary: EV Nickel reports QEMSCAN/EPMA results for a new zone confirming nickel sulphides (millerite and heazlewoodite) that could improve recovery rates and produce higher-grade nickel concentrate, with chalcopyrite also present as a dominant copper mineral. The company plans follow-up metallurgical flotation tests and 2025 drilling to define a resource.

title: Aughinish Alumina on course to return to profit in 2025
summary: Aughinish Alumina (Limerick Alumina Refining), the largest European alumina refinery, reported $113.6m pre-tax losses in 2023 due to higher costs, expensive natural gas, and bauxite supply issues. Sanctions and “self-sanctioning” risks around UC Rusal threaten financing and volumes, though profitability is forecast to return in 2024-25.

title: Rio Tinto's Fair Value Estimate Increased by 4% on Higher Iron Ore and Aluminum Prices
summary: Rio Tinto said its fair value estimate rose about 4%, attributing the increase to higher iron ore and aluminum prices. While iron ore is not tracked here, the mention of stronger aluminum pricing suggests supportive conditions for aluminium markets in the near term.

title: Teck Shares Overvalued on Enthusiasm Over Copper Demand From Decarbonization and Electrification
summary: The piece argues that while decarbonization and electrification support copper demand, China’s economic rebalancing from investment toward household consumption should reduce growth for investment-linked commodities. It therefore expects weaker demand momentum and lower copper prices than the favorable 2023 period, weighing on optimism reflected in Teck shares.

title: State House committee approves $50 million in funding for Copperwood mine
summary: A Michigan House committee advanced $50 million in state funding for Highland Copper’s proposed Copperwood underground mine. The project faces local environmental opposition and a petition, but supporters argue it supports mineral supply for renewable technologies and local jobs. Funding still requires approval from a state Senate committee.

title: Idaho Copper Corporation Reports Earnings Results for the Third Quarter and Nine Months Ended October 31, 2024
summary: Idaho Copper Corporation reported a net loss of USD 2.35 million for the third quarter and USD 4.43 million for the nine months ended October 31, 2024, compared with higher losses in the prior year. The release includes loss-per-share figures but no production or guidance details affecting copper fundamentals.

title: Policy Shifts and Supply Chain Disruptions Drive Copper Bull Run
summary: China is increasing copper scrap imports to offset limited ore availability, but U.S. copper scrap purchases have paused, likely tightening China’s scrap supply in January. Proposed U.S.-China tariffs and China’s revised scrap import regulations add volatility. Overall, the flow squeeze and smelter constraints suggest bullish near-term copper pricing.

title: Proposed bauxite mining in Kuantan rejected, says Nik Nazmi
summary: Malaysia’s Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability Minister said no EIA approval has been given for a proposed bauxite mining operation in Bukit Goh, Kuantan, and a previous similar EIA was also rejected. The decision delays/blocks bauxite output, potentially tightening near-term aluminium supply expectations.

title: South32 claims win at Worsley Alumina project site, as WA environment minister Reece Whitby trumps green concerns
summary: South32 says Western Australia’s environment minister has tentatively backed extending the Worsley Alumina project, overruling objections from the state’s Environmental Protection Agency. The dispute involves approval to extend bauxite mining in jarrah forests to supply feedstock for the refinery, after tighter environmental rules.

title: Is Teck Resources Limited (TECK) the Best Copper Stock to Buy According to Hedge Funds?
summary: The article discusses copper supply-demand dynamics, noting demand strength tied to energy transition while citing a near-term global surplus. It also spotlights Teck’s record copper output and guidance for higher Quebrada Blanca production after coal divestment, framing TECK as a preferred copper play.

title: Is Southern Copper Corporation (SCCO) the Best Copper Stock to Buy According to Hedge Funds?
summary: The article profiles Southern Copper (SCCO) and reviews copper market conditions: elevated but fluctuating prices in 2024, China’s weaker real-estate-driven demand, and a reported copper surplus of 535,000 MT through the first eight months. It notes SCCO’s copper sales share and production growth, but offers no new catalyst.

title: Is Hudbay Minerals Inc. (HBM) the Best Copper Stock to Buy According to Hedge Funds?
summary: The article discusses copper market dynamics—high demand from the energy transition, a Chinese real-estate slowdown, and an ICSG-reported supply surplus in early 2024. It then highlights Hudbay Minerals’ copper-focused production and lower cash costs, arguing the stock benefits from rising copper and gold prices.

title: Is BHP Group Limited (BHP) the Best Copper Stock to Buy According to Hedge Funds?
summary: The piece discusses copper market fundamentals and focuses on BHP as a top copper stock for hedge funds. It cites copper surplus/supply and China demand headwinds, but highlights BHP’s rising copper output and a new Argentina copper joint venture, which supports near-term copper sentiment.

title: Is Rio Tinto Group (RIO) the Best Copper Stock to Buy According to Hedge Funds?
summary: The piece reviews copper fundamentals and Rio Tinto’s copper exposure. It cites an early-2024 copper surplus (ICSG 535,000 MT) and softer Chinese real-estate demand, offset by still-elevated global demand from energy transition themes and ongoing mine/processing output growth. Overall, signals are mixed for near-term prices.

title: Is Barrick Gold Corporation (GOLD) the Best Copper Stock to Buy According to Hedge Funds?
summary: The piece lists copper stocks favored by hedge funds and highlights Barrick (GOLD), noting it produced about 420 million pounds of copper in 2023 and reported a 12% quarterly copper production rise in Q3 2024, supported by efficiencies and cost reductions. It reviews broader copper supply/demand but gives no new price catalyst beyond company-level updates.

title: Is Ero Copper Corp (ERO) the Best Copper Stock to Buy According to Hedge Funds?
summary: The article reviews copper supply-demand, citing an ICSG surplus of 535,000 tonnes through the first eight months of 2024 and softer Chinese real-estate demand, partly offset by energy-transition demand. It also profiles Ero Copper’s Brazil operations and recent production/earn-in progress, but offers no major immediate market shock.

title: Push to list copper as critical mineral would mean green energy tax breaks
summary: Arizona lawmakers’ Critical Mineral Consistency Act would add copper to the USGS critical minerals list, enabling tax incentives and accelerated permitting under FAST-41 and other regulatory benefits. Opponents warn of reduced environmental and tribal oversight. The Senate hasn’t acted yet, but House approval may lift expected copper supply support.

title: Global Aluminium Industry Greenhouse Gas Emissions Intensity Reduction Continues, With Total Emissions Below 2020 Peak
summary: The International Aluminium Institute reports that global aluminium output rose to 111.2 Mt in 2023 while total industry GHG emissions were essentially stable versus prior year. Emissions intensity fell 2.33% to 10.04 tCO2e per tonne. The industry claims decoupling of growth from emissions with third consecutive production growth year.

title: South32 expects decision on Worsley Alumina expansion early next year
summary: South32 said Australia’s federal government will decide early next year on the proposed expansion of its Worsley alumina refining operation in Western Australia. The company appealed prior conditions recommended by regulators, citing operating challenges, and amendments have now been recommended by an appeals committee. Decision timing could affect alumina and thus aluminium sentiment.

title: LVMPD: Crackdown to curb copper wire theft in Arts District is working
summary: Las Vegas Metro and the City of Las Vegas say a crackdown—covert officers, video surveillance, and a scrap-metal sales ordinance requiring documentation—has reduced copper wire theft in the Arts District. Authorities cite ten related arrests since summer and plan expanded patrol and enforcement in 2025.

title: WA government overturns environmental conditions on South32's Worsley Alumina expansion
summary: WA’s Environment Minister approved changes to conditions for South32’s Worsley Alumina expansion, overturning parts of the EPA’s recommended requirements after appeals. Opponents cite weaker greenhouse-gas oversight and environmental offsets, while South32 views it as a positive step toward expected further approvals, supporting supply expectations for alumina-linked aluminium.

title: Grid Metals signs agreement with Teck Resources to develop Canadian nickel project
summary: Grid Metals signed an option/JV agreement with Teck Resources to develop the Makwa nickel project in Manitoba. Teck may earn up to 70% by funding C$15.7m in expenditures with staged cash payments and further exploration commitments. The deal may support future nickel supply, but near-term price impact is likely limited.

title: Column-Bleak times for copper smelters as conversion fees slump: Andy Home
summary: Reuters reports an unprecedented drop in copper smelter treatment charges, with benchmark terms for next year far below current levels. It attributes the slump to fast expansion of smelting capacity versus limited concentrates, plus potential tightening of feed as scrap imports from the U.S. may fall amid renewed tariff fears.

title: Canada Nickel lands $20M investment from Ontario Indigenous group in groundbreaking financing in critical minerals sector: sources
summary: Canada Nickel says Taykwa Tagamou Nation will invest $20 million via convertible notes, potentially taking an 8.3% equity stake, and gaining a board seat for its Crawford nickel-cobalt project. The funding reduces uncertainty amid junior mining capital crunches and supports expectations for future nickel supply, modestly bullish for nickel.

title: Got Copper or Miners? Watch Out.
summary: The piece argues copper is turning bearish, citing an invalidated breakout on both daily closes and intraday trading, plus a further breakdown below rising support and the head-and-shoulders neckline. It also notes USD strength as a headwind for commodities, implying copper (and related mining stocks) may slide further in coming weeks.

title: Canada Nickel lands $20-million from Ontario First Nation in groundbreaking critical minerals investment
summary: Canada Nickel says it received a $20-million investment from an Ontario First Nation (Tagamou Nation) for a critical minerals initiative. The funding is tied to the vehicle/battery supply chain, and the First Nation will receive governance participation. The announcement supports nickel project progress and sentiment.

title: Trends and Developments in the High-Nickel Pig Iron Market
summary: High-nickel pig iron prices in China were slightly weaker and Indonesian NPI FOB edged down, with sluggish stainless demand and higher output expectations. However, Indonesia reiterated plans to restrict nickel production, raising concerns about future ore tightness. The article expects pure nickel to rise, widening the pig iron discount.

title: First-ever copper production from tailings in Oman
summary: A project in Oman begins extracting copper from legacy tailings near Suhar. Green Tech Mining will first commission a calibration plant to produce saleable copper cathodes by mid-Q1 2025, with larger tailings remediation lines later. The company expects to recycle copper cathodes for sale on global markets.

title: Humble rock eclipses iron ore price as aluminium smelters shop around
summary: Bauxite prices used to produce aluminium have overtaken iron ore for the first time, climbing to a record $112 a tonne. The surge reflects an Africa supply crunch and increased Chinese demand. The rise follows a 59% jump since January, highlighting tighter aluminium feedstock availability.

title: Some Japan buyers agree Q1 aluminium premium 30% higher than Q4 -sources
summary: Some Japanese aluminium buyers agreed to pay a premium of $228/mt over the benchmark price for January–March shipments, up 30% from Q4. This fourth consecutive quarterly premium increase is above $175/mt in Oct–Dec, and Japan’s import premiums are a key regional pricing yardstick tied to LME cash.

title: Bleak times for copper smelters as conversion fees slump: Andy Home
summary: Reuters reports an unprecedented drop in copper smelter treatment charges, with 2025 benchmark rates falling far below 2024 levels. It attributes the slump to fast capacity growth outpacing available feed, squeezing margins, and warns China’s smelters face tighter concentrate and scrap availability, with tariff risks to U.S. scrap flows.

title: Some Japan buyers agree to 30% higher aluminium premiums for Q1, sources say
summary: Japan buyers reportedly agreed to 30% higher aluminium premiums for Q1, according to sources. Higher agreed premiums usually reflect improved demand/availability balance and can translate into stronger near-term aluminium pricing expectations as premiums are closely linked to physical market tightness.

title: Assays pending from Javelin Coogee copper-gold drilling in WA
summary: Javelin Minerals completed phase one of a 2921m RC drilling program at its Coogee copper-gold project in Western Australia and is awaiting assays, expected over coming weeks. Results so far highlight gold indicators along a 950m strike and suggest copper-gold potential, but no confirmed copper supply impact yet.

title: [SMM Analysis] Will Stable Nickel Ore Prices See New Fluctuations Later This Month?
summary: SMM reports stable nickel ore pricing this week: Philippine FOB prices around $29/wmt for 1.3% ore, and Indonesia premiums $15–17/wmt. However, declining high-grade NPI prices in China and high restocking costs add downward pressure. Indonesian policy rumors on restricting output may offer limited support.

title: Taykwa Tagamou Nation And Canada Nickel Announce $20 Million Investment Partnership
summary: Taykwa Tagamou Nation will invest $20 million via a convertible note in Canada Nickel, taking an 8.4% interest in the company. Proceeds support the Crawford Nickel Sulphide Project, with conversion expected in January 2025. The deal reinforces development momentum for a major Canadian nickel mine.

title: CopperCorp Resources Inc.: CopperCorp Granted New Exploration Licence EL11/2024 Adjacent to Razorback Property
summary: CopperCorp announced it received a new exploration licence EL11/2024 adjacent to its Razorback property in western Tasmania, targeting Cu-Au mineralization near the Mt Lyell Cu-Au camp. The company is planning geophysical work and future drilling, but provides no production or supply impact, implying limited near-term price effect.

title: Industry Calling for Stiffer Penalties for Copper Wire Theft
summary: Energy and communications companies are urging stiffer penalties for copper wire theft after incidents reportedly rose sharply. Bell Canada says copper theft drives most network security disruptions, including a Miramichi cut that required 24 hours of repairs and cost $30,000. The push is regulatory/penalty-focused with no clear direct supply change.

title: Usha Resources Ltd.: Usha Resources Announces Receipt of Intervention Permit for Upcoming Drill Program at the Southern Arm Copper-Gold VMS Property
summary: Usha Resources reports it has received an intervention permit to start access and drill-pad preparations for a maiden drill program at its Southern Arm copper-gold VMS property in Quebec, targeting priority zones after ongoing IP and black spruce bark sampling. The update is mainly permitting/exploration and not a near-term supply change for copper.

title: Mink Ventures Commences Diamond Drill Program at Warren Nickel Copper Cobalt Project, Timmins, Ontario
summary: Mink Ventures announced the start of a diamond drill program at its Warren Ni-Cu-Co project in Ontario, targeting geophysical anomalies at the Shaft, North and SW zones. The zones show prior copper and nickel mineralization associated with IP/EM responses. The work is intended to maintain momentum toward earning full ownership; no production changes are reported.

title: Mink Ventures Commences Diamond Drill Program at Warren Nickel Copper Cobalt Project, Timmins, Ontario
summary: Mink Ventures began diamond drilling at its Warren project in Timmins, Ontario, targeting geophysical anomalies associated with nickel, copper, and cobalt mineralization. The company highlights prior massive sulphide and disseminated sulphide assays at the North, Shaft, and SW zones, aiming to test untested IP/EM targets.

title: Global Copper Supply Faces Crunch as AI Investments Reshape the Energy Landscape
summary: The piece argues AI-driven data center and power-grid buildouts are lifting copper demand while mine development constraints tighten supply. It cites UBS expectations for a >200,000-ton deficit by 2025 and notes copper surged over 2% after China’s shift in monetary policy. It also highlights company exploration updates for copper projects.

title: Taykwa Tagamou Nation and Canada Nickel Announce $20 million Investment Partnership
summary: Taykwa Tagamou Nation (TTN) will invest $20 million via a convertible note into Canada Nickel’s Crawford nickel sulphide project, taking an 8.4% equity interest and a board nomination right. The financing is expected to close in January 2025, supporting continued development toward construction decisions.

title: Viewpoint: Al market hopes for alumina supply recovery
summary: Alumina prices hit record highs in 2024 after production stoppages and disrupted supply routes, with force majeure affecting Australian alumina output and bauxite shipments from Brazil and Guinea. Tight alumina supplies are already causing aluminium curtailments, such as Rusal’s production cut, implying downward pressure on aluminium prices until supply improves.

title: Rio Tinto agrees deal to build Western Australia copper mine with Japanese partner
summary: Rio Tinto and Sumitomo agreed that Sumitomo will take a 30% stake in Rio Tinto’s Winu copper-gold mine in northern Western Australia. The project is planned at 10m tonnes/year mining capacity and could expand, supporting copper supply-investment sentiment despite longer development timelines and emissions scrutiny.

title: Canada Nickel raises $20-millon from Ontario First Nation in groundbreaking financing
summary: Canada Nickel announced it has secured $20 million in financing from Ontario’s Tagamou Nation as part of a new partnership tied to the company’s advancing mine construction. By strengthening funding for development progress, the news can reduce perceived near-term project risk and be mildly supportive for nickel markets.

title: Ball : and Dabur Team Up for Eco-Conscious Launch of Réal Bites Juice in Aluminum Cans
summary: Ball and Dabur launched Réal Bites juice in fully recyclable aluminium cans in India, highlighting longer shelf life and sustainability versus other packaging. The announcement points to continued growth in India’s juice category and expected can substrate growth, implying incremental aluminum packaging demand, but without large, measurable supply-demand effects for near-term prices.

title: Indonesia's Growing Nickel Production Disrupts Global Market
summary: The piece argues Indonesia is ramping nickel output, expanding LME and SHFE exchange inventories substantially (with limited price support). Coupled with soft stainless demand, buyer reluctance to forward purchase, and ongoing downside bias in the NAS 304 surcharge, it points to bearish near-term nickel price pressure.

title: Police arrest four, seize 16 tonnes stolen copper wire from Tanesco, TRC
summary: Police in Tanzania arrested four suspects and seized about 16.9 tonnes of stolen copper wire and blocks taken from TANESCO and TRC. The copper was being processed to conceal its origin and was linked to planned illegal trafficking. The crackdown targets theft from critical infrastructure.

title: RCMP Investigate Copper Wire Theft Amid Industry Calls for Stiffer Sentences
summary: RCMP is investigating copper wire theft from an NL Hydro communications site near Long Harbour. Industry officials say copper wire theft has surged and urge Ottawa to impose stiffer sentences. The reported incident is localized, offering limited near-term evidence of a broader copper supply disruption.

title: Copperwood Mine Project funding awaits Michigan Senate Appropriations Committee approval
summary: Michigan state funding for Highland Copper’s Copperwood Mine awaits Senate Appropriations Committee approval after House approval. Supporters cite jobs and development, while opponents warn about environmental risks, waste storage near Lake Superior, and regional pollution. The project’s progress could modestly improve sentiment for future copper supply.

title: 'It is a public safety issue:' Kinetic copper thefts continue
summary: Kinetic in Eastern Kentucky reports continuing “copper theft corridor” incidents, with 73 thefts this year. Thieves strip copper cables, sometimes cutting down utility poles, causing longer outages and risks to customers such as hospitals and 911 service. The utility has formed a dedicated enforcement-focused team.

title: Chevron Inks Gas Supply Deal With Aluminum Giant
summary: Chevron has signed a 10-year natural gas supply deal with Alcoa to provide 130 petajoules from the Gorgon and Wheatstone LNG projects starting in 2028. Alcoa will use the gas for alumina refineries in Western Australia, supporting reliable energy costs and expectations for aluminium supply and demand momentum.

title: MAC Copper Limited and Sprott Amend Loan Agreement to Permit Early Repayment
summary: MAC Copper Limited amended its mezzanine debt facility with Sprott to add an option for early repayment between 1 Jan 2025 and 16 Jun 2025. The decision depends on cash balances and forecasts. It cites ongoing deleveraging tied to the CSA Copper Mine, but production is unchanged.

title: First Atlantic Nickel to Acquire Strategic Land Claim Adjacent to RPM Zone, Advancing Atlantic Nickel Project
summary: First Atlantic Nickel said it will acquire 100% of the RPM-South claims adjacent to its RPM nickel discovery in Newfoundland, enabling further exploration for depth and extensions. It resumes Phase 1 core processing and has submitted Phase 2 drilling permits. The release also promotes awaruite’s processing advantages for nickel supply security.

title: Amarc Resources Ltd.: Boliden Continues Earn-In at Amarc's Duke Copper-Gold District
