summary: Amarc said Boliden will continue its earn-in at the DUKE copper-gold district in central British Columbia through 2025 with a $10 million budget. The operator role remains with Amarc, with drilling and surveys targeting additional Cu-Mo mineralization areas. Results from 2024 are pending, supporting copper project sentiment.

title: Saudi Arabia Aluminum Windows and Doors Market Outlook
summary: A ResearchAndMarkets report on Saudi Arabia’s aluminum windows and doors market forecasts growth, citing Vision 2030, Sakani affordable housing, and rising demand for energy-efficient thermally broken aluminum. It also notes smart/automated and customized product trends, implying increased aluminum demand from residential and commercial construction.

title: Potential Trump Tariffs Could Reshape Copper Market Dynamics in 2025
summary: The article says a potential Trump administration could impose 25% tariffs on US copper imports from Canada and Mexico. Experts warn the move could disrupt trade routes, reduce cost competitiveness of those supplies, and shift buyers to other origins. It also notes uncertainty affecting copper scrap flows, adding downside risk.

title: Taykwa Tagamou Nation to fund Crawford Nickel Sulphide Project in Canada
summary: Taykwa Tagamou Nation will invest C$28.6m via a convertible note to advance Canada Nickel’s Crawford nickel sulphide project in Ontario. The partners plan to support development in the Timmins Nickel District as the project moves toward a construction decision, potentially improving near-term nickel supply expectations.

title: Westwin Elements make strides in Nickel powder production
summary: Westwin Elements announced first successful production of nickel powder at its Lawton, Oklahoma demonstration plant, designed to make about 20 tons per year via a carbonyl process. The company plans to produce Class 1 samples for customer qualifications to support a more domestic nickel supply chain, reducing foreign dependence.

title: Copper wire thefts knocks out internet & phone service in part of Metro East
summary: The report says thieves stole copper wire from utility poles in Belleville, causing AT&T to lose internet and phone service and prompting crews to restore communications. It notes copper thieves often sell scrap to recycling businesses and mentions Illinois rules for scrap buyers and police investigation.

title: NorthX Nickel Corp.: NorthX Nickel Announces Agreement to Sell Sudbury Portfolio
summary: NorthX Nickel announced an agreement with Magna Mining to sell its Sudbury portfolio of nickel and base metal assets. The transaction streamlines NorthX toward its Grasset nickel project, while Magna assumes related liabilities and operator/royalty obligations. Closure is expected by end of Q1 2025, subject to approvals.

title: Nickel 28 Capital Corp: Nickel 28 Files Fiscal Q3 2025 Financial Statements
summary: Nickel 28 reported results for the quarter ended Oct. 31, 2024. Its Ramu nickel-cobalt JV produced and sold contained nickel, but a mechanical failure shut one acid plant, cutting production capacity roughly in half until end-February 2025, lowering 2025 nickel-in-MHP guidance to ~29,000 tonnes.

title: Hot Chili Intersects Significant Copper-Gold Porphyry-style Mineralisation at La Verde
summary: Hot Chili announced strong initial drilling at its La Verde copper-gold porphyry target, including long intercepts such as 308m grading 0.5% copper from 46m and 202m at 0.6% copper. The company expanded the drill program and is advancing Costa Fuego PFS work, supporting copper sentiment.

title: New Orleans streetcar goes dark after copper cable theft | News
summary: New Orleans transit and city infrastructure faces service interruptions after thieves stole copper cables, forcing emergency substation repairs and suspending a streetcar line. Officials link the theft wave to higher copper demand at salvage yards, increasing maintenance costs and outages across the city’s copper-dependent systems.

title: Win the Future for U.S. Aluminum: Aluminum Association
summary: The Aluminum Association released a U.S. policy brief urging stronger targeted trade enforcement against subsidized Chinese aluminum imports, improved recycling/EPR programs to boost scrap availability, and a national strategy supported by clean energy and tax incentives. The measures are intended to secure supply and competitiveness as demand grows.

title: Copper Prices End 2024 Higher Despite Bearish Outlook
summary: Copper ended 2024 higher, but the piece stresses a bearish trend overall, with Q4 losses attributed to disappointing Chinese stimulus, a firm U.S. dollar, and uncertainty about U.S. policy support for EV and wind. It frames near-term demand sentiment as mixed and downside risk as dominant.

title: Senate Committee stalls on decision for Copperwood Mine Project
summary: Michigan’s Senate Appropriations Committee canceled a scheduled meeting that would have approved a $50 million state spending transfer to Highland Copper for the Copperwood Mine Project. Supporters argue the funding enables mine and infrastructure development, while opponents raise environmental concerns. Lawmakers have until month-end to act.

title: Mozal Aluminium Update | Company Announcement
summary: South32 says safety at Mozal Aluminium is intact and road blockages are largely cleared, allowing alumina trucking to resume. However, civil unrest could disrupt trucking, prompting further amperage reductions or potline curtailment. Continued exports are noted, but supply risk remains near term for aluminium.

title: Minnesota to require license for buying, selling scrap metal copper
summary: Minnesota will require a $250 license to buy or sell scrap metal copper starting Jan. 1, 2025. The policy aims to curb illegal sourcing amid copper wire theft from streetlights and signals in Minneapolis and St. Paul. A judge upheld the law, limiting a scrap market disruption in the near term.

title: Sumitomo Chemical to exit resale business of imported aluminium ingots
summary: Sumitomo Chemical will sell its stake in Brazilian smelter Nippon Amazon Aluminium and stop reselling imported aluminium ingots, citing volatile margins from international conditions. The move contributes to a supplier–buyer power shift, keeping Japanese premiums elevated; January–March premiums reportedly rise to $228/ton over LME cash.

title: South32 to rebuild Mozal alumina stocks if trucking conditions remain favourable
summary: South32 said road blockages in Mozambique have largely cleared, enabling it to safely truck alumina from port to the Mozal Aluminium smelter and rebuild alumina stocks over the coming days if conditions stay favourable. Previously, unrest disrupted transport, prompting reduced amperage and potential potline curtailment.

title: Indonesia weighs deep cuts to nickel mining to boost prices, Bloomberg reports
summary: Indonesia is reportedly weighing deep cuts to nickel mining quotas, potentially reducing ore mined next year to about 150 million tons from 227 million this year. The move aims to support nickel prices amid smelter complaints of ore shortages and higher reliance on imports.

title: Hannan Metals Ltd.: Hannan Defines Large-Scale IP Geophysical Anomaly at The Ricardo Herrera Copper-Gold Porphyry, Valiente Peru
summary: Hannan Metals announced discovery of a large IP (induced polarization) chargeability anomaly at its Ricardo Herrera copper-gold porphyry target within the Valiente project in Peru. The 3DIP survey supports drilling plans with 14 platforms for Q2 2025, aiming to test copper mineralization at depth.

title: Indonesia Weighs Deep Cuts to Nickel Mining to Boost Prices
summary: The report’s headline says Indonesia is considering deep cuts to nickel mining to support higher prices. By signaling reduced near-term nickel supply, the move would likely tighten market expectations and provide upward pressure on nickel prices over the coming days to weeks.

title: Energy Minister Bahlil Rejects Freeport's Copper Concentrate Export Request
summary: Indonesia’s energy minister Bahlil rejected Freeport Indonesia’s request to export copper concentrates, citing national interests and reaffirming the long-standing ban on raw mineral exports to push downstream processing. The decision follows a smelter fire in Gresik and urges repairs, potentially limiting near-term copper concentrate export supply.

title: Sun Peak Metals Corp.: Sun Peak Metals to Continue Next Phase of Work on the Shire Copper-Gold VMS Project
summary: Sun Peak Metals announced continued work and planned Q1 2025 drilling at its Shire VMS project in Ethiopia, including DTEM surveys and targeting the Meli trend and Anguda North. The release highlights prior copper-gold intercepts from multiple drill targets, but no near-term production changes or physical supply effects.

title: Hannan Metals Limited Defines Large-Scale IP Geophysical Anomaly at The Ricardo Herrera Copper-Gold Porphyry, Valiente Peru
summary: Hannan Metals reports large-scale induced polarization (IP) chargeability anomalies at its 100% owned Ricardo Herrera copper-gold porphyry project in Peru. Results include a main anomaly linked to surface mineralization and a blind parallel target, de-risking an upcoming drill program.

title: Trump victory boosts copper-nickel prospects
summary: A Trump victory is expected to loosen U.S. and state constraints on Minnesota mining. The piece highlights efforts to restart Twin Metals’ copper-nickel project and advance NewRange’s long-stalled PolyMet-era mine via renewed permitting. Environmental groups warn of renewed legal challenges, but policy winds could aid timelines.

title: Trump victory boosts copper-nickel prospects
summary: Minnesota mining firms are expecting a Trump administration to reverse the Biden-era Superior National Forest mining moratorium and reduce permitting friction. Twin Metals hopes to restart copper-nickel mining, while NewRange Copper Nickel may reapply for required federal and state permits. Environmental opponents warn of renewed court battles.

title: $50M grant for copper mine project in Upper Peninsula in limbo after lawmaker no-vote
summary: A Senate committee declined to approve a $50M grant that would support the proposed Copperwood copper mine in Michigan’s Upper Peninsula. While other grants were approved, the missing funding could delay the project’s development amid environmental opposition. The delay may weaken near-term expectations for copper supply growth.

title: Cross-border transporter arrested over copper cables
summary: A South Africa-based transporter was arrested in Zimbabwe near the Gwanda Lithium Mine with copper cables, allegedly stolen and burned to process copper for sale on the black market. Authorities recovered the vehicle, cables, and tools. The case is prompting concern about growing illegal copper trade in Zimbabwe.

title: Exclusive-Nornickel in talks with Xiamen C&D to shift copper smelting to China

summary: Xinhua says China’s Qinghai–Xizang Plateau has seen major copper exploration breakthroughs, with over 20 million tonnes of newly discovered copper resources reported over four years. The story points to future supply potential, but does not indicate current mine output or near-term market flow changes.

title: Nickel Prices Slump as EV Boom Fails to Materialize
summary: Nickel prices are slumping as EV demand expectations weaken and oversupply persists, with Chinese firms promoting nickel-free LFP batteries instead of nickel-based chemistries. At the same time, Harum Energy’s Indonesian projects expand nickel refining capacity, which could further weigh on near-term nickel balances.

title: Nobel Resources Signs Option Agreements to Acquire 100% Interest in Chilean Copper Portfolio in Antofagasta Region, Chile
summary: Nobel Resources announced it can acquire a 100% interest in four copper projects in Chile’s Antofagasta region via option agreements. The assets include the Cuprita project and three others within the IOCG belt, with reported copper grades based on sampling. The news is exploratory and not linked to near-term output changes.

title: NMU pulls support for Copperwood Mine | News, Sports, Jobs
summary: Northern Michigan University withdrew support for the proposed Copperwood copper sulfide mine, citing concerns about long-term economic benefits and risks to Indigenous rights and Lake Superior natural resources. Opposition highlights environmental and tailings-dam collapse fears, and the company had listed NMU as a supporter as recently as Nov. 21.

title: EMX Royalty Corp.: EMX Announces Acquisition of a Royalty on the Chapi Copper Mine Property in Peru
summary: EMX Royalty Corp. says it acquired up to a 2% NSR royalty on the Chapi copper mine property in Peru and related processing/AOI royalties. MPC/Quilla plan to restart SX-EW production, targeting initial output in H1 2026. The deal is copper-focused but timing limits near-term price impact.

title: NMU withdraws support of Copperwood Mine project, legislators react
summary: Northern Michigan University withdrew its support for the proposed Copperwood copper mine, citing job and environmental risks, including potential impacts to Indigenous rights and Lake Superior. Legislators opposed the move, arguing the ore body is large and permitted. The state also failed to approve $50 million for the project.

title: Plateau poised for world-class copper hub tag
summary: Chinese researchers report a major copper exploration breakthrough on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, adding over 20 million tonnes of copper ore and positioning the region as a world-class copper resource base. Authorities say this improves China’s copper supply security amid tighter refined supply conditions, but near-term production is not specified.

title: New filter captures and recycles aluminum from manufacturing waste
summary: MIT engineers developed a nanofiltration membrane that selectively captures over 99% of aluminum ions from cryolite waste streams and could allow recovered aluminium to be returned to production. The work is demonstrated in lab experiments and suggests future scale-up, aiming to reduce hazardous waste and mining needs for growing aluminium demand.

title: NMU withdraws support for proposed Copperwood Mine as opposition grows | News, Sports, Jobs
summary: Northern Michigan University withdrew support for the proposed Copperwood copper sulfide mine amid growing opposition over environmental harm, tailings-dam risk, and impacts to Indigenous rights and Lake Superior fisheries. The rescinding of support could delay or undermine the project, reducing near-term confidence in copper supply prospects.

title: SMM to wholly own Philippine Coral Bay nickel smelter
summary: Sumitomo Metal Mining will buy the remaining 15.625% stake in the Philippines’ Coral Bay Nickel HPAL smelter from Nickel Asia, raising its ownership to 100%. The plant has 24,000 t/y nickel capacity. The move strengthens SMM’s nickel processing footprint, likely supporting nickel supply expectations in the near term.

title: US Copper Corp announces positive PEA results for Moonlight-Superior Copper Project
summary: US Copper Corp announced positive PEA results for its Moonlight-Superior open-pit copper project in California, citing $1.08bn NPV and production of about 903,000 tonnes of copper over a 14-year mine life. The company says economics are attractive at current copper prices as it seeks a JV partner.

title: VR Resources Outlines Targets for Upcoming Drilling at Silverback Copper-Gold Project in Ontario
summary: VR Resources outlined plans for an upcoming drill program at its Silverback copper-gold project in Ontario, targeting IP anomalies and shear-zone structures. The company aims to test for remobilized copper-gold mineralization, but no production, discovery size, or resource update is provided.

title: Canada Nickel to establish ExploreCo, secure surface rights for Crawford project
summary: Canada Nickel announced agreements to create ExploreCo and secure surface rights for its Crawford nickel sulphide project near Timmins, Ontario. It consolidates mining and access rights to streamline development and permitting toward a 2025 construction decision. The transactions are subject to TSX Venture Exchange approvals.

title: EVs, green tech seen driving nickel, copper demand in 2025
summary: Philippine mining officials expect stronger 2025 demand for copper and nickel as EVs and renewable-energy technologies scale. Copper output and production value rose sharply in the first nine months of 2024, while nickel output fell year on year, suggesting potential supply tightness. Net-zero policy supports demand outlook despite governance uncertainty.

title: EVs, green tech seen driving nickel, copper demand in 2025
summary: Philippine mining officials expect EV and renewable-energy growth to raise 2025 demand for nickel and copper. They cite falling nickel ore output earlier but improved metallic production overall, with copper output up sharply in 2024’s first nine months. Net-zero policy support is framed as a continuing catalyst.

title: Nickel Asia out to exit Coral Bay - Worldnews.com
summary: Nickel Asia Corp., the Philippines’ largest nickel producer, said it is negotiating with Sumitomo Metal Mining to sell its entire stake in Coral Bay Nickel Corp., which operates an HPAL plant. The company will reclassify the investment and stop recognizing equity gains or losses, but the deal’s impact on near-term supply is unclear.

title: Copper concentrates market outlook 2025: Bumpy road ahead
summary: Fastmarkets expects 2025 copper concentrate TC/RCs to fall further into negative territory, with prices sometimes below smelter costs. Market participants warn low TC/RCs could trigger smelter disruptions or shutdowns, supported only partly by sulfuric acid and by-product revenues. This raises short-term downside risk for refined copper supply.

title: U.P. legislators oppose NMU's change of support for Copperwood mine project | News, Sports, Jobs
summary: Upper Peninsula legislators criticize Northern Michigan University for changing its stance on the Copperwood project from support to neutral. Supporters argue the U.P. should mine copper, citing government recognition of “critical minerals” and claims about environmentally verified tailings safety and permitted dam design.

title: C3 Metals Inc.: C3 Metals Further Expands Khaleesi Copper-Gold Mineralization in Peru Latest Rock Samples Return up to 1.80% Copper, 4.4 g/t Gold, and 403 ppm Molybdenum
summary: C3 Metals reported recent rock chip assays from its Khaleesi copper-gold project in Peru, with samples returning up to 1.80% copper. The company is advancing mapping, soil geochemistry, and planned geophysics ahead of a maiden drill program. No production or supply disruption information is provided.

title: Nickel Asia to sell stake in Coral Bay Nickel to Sumitomo
summary: Nickel Asia plans to sell its entire 15.63% stake in Coral Bay Nickel to Sumitomo, retaining a 10% interest in Taganito. Coral Bay is the Philippines’ sole HPAL processing plant. The move follows equity losses linked to higher costs and lower LME nickel prices, amid a nickel glut.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Intersects 40.06 Metres at 0.78% Copper Within 109.42 Metres at 0.41% Copper at the Boomerang Breccia and Expands Near-Surface Mineralization at the Prada Breccia
summary: Faraday Copper reported drill results from five holes at its Copper Creek project in Arizona, intersecting near-surface mineralization with reported copper grades including high-grade chalcopyrite zones. The release is primarily exploration-focused, offering limited immediate linkage to copper supply, inventories, or trade flows.

title: UP legislators oppose NMU's change in support for Copperwood mine | News, Sports, Jobs
summary: Upper Peninsula legislators criticize Northern Michigan University for shifting its support for the proposed Copperwood project to neutral. They argue copper mining is necessary for jobs and national security, citing permitting and infrastructure investment. Overall, the piece reflects political support for restarting a U.P. copper mine after 20 years.

title: Hudbay to invest $210m in Constancia copper mine expansion in Peru
summary: Hudbay is seeking permits for a $210m expansion of Peru’s Constancia copper mine, upgrading pits, processing equipment and tailings capacity to improve efficiency and increase throughput. The company expects 2024 production of 98,000–120,000t of copper concentrates, with construction planned to start in Q4.

title: Exclusive-Copper output at Chile's Codelco rose to 1.328 million tons in 2024, document shows
summary: Reuters reports that Codelco’s internal document shows 2024 copper output rose to 1.328 million tonnes, slightly above 2023’s 1.325 million tonnes, and hit its 2024 target after efforts to overcome declining ore grades and project issues. The incremental supply improvement may support short-term copper sentiment.

title: Cuts to nickel mine output in Indonesia could remove 35% of global supply
summary: Indonesia is weighing cuts to nickel mine quotas for 2025, potentially reducing output from 272 mln to 150 mln tons. Macquarie said such cuts are unlikely, but if implemented they could remove up to 35% of global nickel supply, creating upside risk for prices amid prior Fitch downgrades.

title: Brimstone to produce smelter-grade alumina, enhancing US aluminium supply chain
summary: Brimstone says it will build a first-of-a-kind US plant to produce smelter-grade alumina from domestically sourced rocks, supported by nearly $8.7m in DOE funding. The project targets reducing reliance on imported bauxite and strengthening the US aluminium supply chain, potentially improving aluminium market sentiment.

title: Vizsla to acquire Rand copper-gold claims at Woodjam Project in Canada
summary: Vizsla Copper agreed to acquire a 49% JV interest tied to the former Rand copper-gold claims within Canada’s Woodjam Project, moving to full ownership of the claims. The company plans exploration based on copper-gold porphyry geology and recent drilling results, potentially supporting future copper production outlook.

title: Investors keen on bauxite mining projects in Đắk Nông
summary: Vietnam’s Đắk Nông province is attracting about US$8 billion for bauxite mining and processing, with plans for four new factories under government mineral planning. The province cites significant bauxite reserves and coordination to remove planning barriers, potentially improving near-term aluminium supply expectations.

title: Michigan's $50 million copper mine deal looks hard to justify – Mackinac Center
summary: Michigan’s economic development agency proposed a $50 million subsidy to Highland Copper for the Copperwood copper mine, but the deal has lost momentum. The project stalled amid environmental and citizen pushback and ultimately failed to pass the Michigan Senate. The article argues the investment case is weak versus prior copper-price declines.

title: NPA drafting bill as metal thefts surge alongside price of copper | The Asahi Shimbun: Breaking News, Japan News and Analysis
summary: Japan’s National Police Agency is drafting new laws targeting scrap dealers to curb rising copper thefts, citing higher scrap copper prices as the main driver. The proposed rules include dealer identity checks, transaction records, and reporting red flags. Copper accounts for over half of stolen materials by type.

title: Taseko Mines produces 106 million pounds of copper at mine
summary: Taseko Mines says its Gibraltar open-pit copper mine produced 106 million pounds of copper in 2024 and is ramping up after July maintenance. Milling throughput averaged above design in Q4, and 2025 copper output is guided to 120–130 million pounds, weighted later in the year.

title: Exclusive-Vitol plans to cut costs by taking aluminium from LME warehouses in Malaysia, sources say
summary: Vitol plans to cut LME storage costs by withdrawing significant aluminium from Port Klang warehouses, leading to a sharp rise in cancelled warrants. Cancellations were concentrated in Vitol-linked stocks and follow long warehouse withdrawal waits. LME inventory data coincided with higher benchmark aluminium prices, reflecting tighter near-term expectations.

title: Market must learn to pay premium for green alumina
summary: Fastmarkets reports growing likelihood of premiums for low-carbon alumina as producers switch to renewable electricity. It cites Hydro/Alunorte’s boiler conversions under long-term solar and wind power contracts and shows low-carbon aluminium differentials (e.g., P1020A) assessed near small positive levels, suggesting continued price support for low-carbon aluminium.

title: Public can comment on environmental impact of nickel mine till Feb. 7
summary: The public can comment until Feb. 7 on Canada Nickel’s Crawford Nickel Project environmental impact statement, covering a long-running open-pit nickel-and-cobalt mine. The assessment flags habitat and water impacts and mitigation measures. It’s in phase 2 of a 5-phase process, with decisions still far off.

title: Copperwood Mine funding awaits committee vote
summary: Michigan’s Senate Appropriations Committee has not yet taken up a request to transfer $50 million to Highland Copper for the Copperwood Mine project. Approval would support infrastructure for the permitted mine. Opposition groups say senators would vote no, making timing uncertain and limiting immediate copper price impact.

title: Indonesia Sets 2025 Nickel Ore Mining Quota at Around 200 Million Metric Tons
summary: Indonesia’s mining ministry set a nickel ore mining quota of around 200 million metric tons for 2025. The quota may be reduced if miners fail performance checks, especially regarding reclamation and environmental management. A higher quota generally supports nickel supply expectations, weighing on prices near term.

title: Arizona Sonoran Copper announces C$19.9m private placement with Hudbay
summary: Arizona Sonoran Copper announced a C$19.9m private placement with Hudbay, with proceeds earmarked for drilling, exploration, technical studies and development of its Cactus copper project in Arizona. Hudbay’s stake rises to ~9.99%. The deal is financing-focused, with no near-term production shift, so copper price impact is limited.

title: Indonesia nickel output cuts may impact global supply by 35% warns Macquarie
summary: Macquarie warns that proposed Indonesian nickel mine quota cuts could slash output from 272mt in 2024 to about 150mt, removing more than one-third of global supply. Even if a major cut is unlikely, lower-than-expected production is seen as an upside risk for nickel prices.

title: Intertwined Dynamics and Downturns: Challenges in the High-Nickel Pig Iron Market
summary: High-nickel pig iron prices in China and Indonesia weakened, with SMM NPI falling weekly and the Indonesian FOB index declining. Stainless steel maintenance reduced procurement, while Indonesia’s new capacity and supply variability increased. The NPI discount to electrolytic nickel widened, and macro/FX pressure plus possible oversupply sustain bearish nickel sentiment.

title: [SMM Analysis] Weekly Review of the Indonesian Nickel Market for the First Week of 2025
summary: SMM reviews Indonesia’s nickel market: nickel ore domestic trade improved amid policy uncertainty, with supply stabilizing and ore premiums potentially rising. However, Indonesian high-grade NPI FOB fell $0.7/mtu WoW, with seasonal stainless demand weakness. Refined nickel production is ramping up, with more output expected in 2025.

title: Daycare disrupted by copper theft at Merewether Uniting Church | The Maitland Mercury
summary: A daycare church in Merewether/ Newcastle lost running water and gas after thieves stole about 16 metres of copper water and gas piping, causing more than $4,000 in damage. Repairs used plastic piping. The event follows warnings about copper theft in the Hunter area, but appears localized.

title: First Nation and Canada Nickel announce $20M partnership
summary: Taykwa Tagamou Nation (TTN) will invest $20M via a convertible note that can be converted into an 8.4% stake in Canada Nickel, linked to the company’s Crawford Nickel Sulphide Project. The partnership is framed as community empowerment and long-term collaboration around developing Canada’s largest nickel mine.

title: Tougher penalties for copper thieves, Rogers tells Senate
summary: Canadian telecom operators (Rogers and Bell Canada) urged Senate committees to impose tougher penalties on scrap copper thieves after vandalism increased, causing outages and repair costs. The request focuses on using Canada’s “essential infrastructure” and sabotage provisions to prosecute copper theft more severely, citing threats to connectivity and public safety.

title: Chile's Year-End Copper Windfall Signals Mining Recovery
summary: Chile’s central bank data show December copper export revenues rose 10% versus November and 13% versus a year earlier, tied to a recovery in mining output after years of low production. Output improvements from Codelco modernization and increased operations by Teck are highlighted, despite the average copper price remaining lower month-over-month.

title: New Caledonia nickel firm appoints new chair
summary: New Caledonia’s Koniambo nickel (KNS) has appointed a new chair as the company continues seeking buyers after Glencore plans to exit and the plant was mothballed in late August 2024. KNS is in talks with international firms, while Prony resumes production after unrest.

title: India nears agreement with Mongolia for copper and coking coal supply
summary: India is close to signing an MOU with Mongolia to secure copper and coking coal supplies. With Mongolia a key copper resource and India dependent on imports, the agreement should improve near-term copper sourcing visibility and reduce supply-risk concerns, which can support copper price sentiment over coming weeks.

title: Aluminium is "the elephant in the room" for global emissions, according to Trek, but the latest gen Marlin cuts CO2 by 53%
summary: Trek’s 2024 sustainability report says most of its emissions come from suppliers’ material processing, with aluminium singled out as a top contributor. Trek plans to shift aluminium frame sourcing so suppliers use renewable electricity, claiming the Gen 3 Marlin 5 cuts CO2e by 53.7%, and broadens recycled material use.

title: Jubilee Metals blames power woes in Zambia for copper production slump
summary: Jubilee Metals said power outages in Zambia disrupted its copper output, with production down 14% to 1,454 tonnes for the first half versus prior year and below a revised target. Shutdowns at the Roan concentrator due to electricity supply limits prompted guidance review until power stabilizes.

title: Abaxx plans lithium carbonate contract within weeks after nickel launch
summary: Abaxx plans to launch a physically deliverable lithium carbonate contract within weeks after starting trading of its nickel sulphate futures. The exchange’s physically deliverable nickel contract begins in Singapore, with settlement linked to the LME nickel price and possible new delivery points. The story focuses on contract mechanics rather than nickel fundamentals.

title: Global Nickel Market Faces Uncertain Future as Indonesia Cuts Output
summary: MetalMiner reports bearish nickel market conditions, with Indonesia blamed for a supply glut. Nickel prices fell below $15k/mt to a multi-year low and exchange inventories rose sharply (LME and SHFE at highs). Indonesia is considering cutting mining quotas, but tighter supply may not be immediate, keeping prices under pressure.

title: Column-LME puts 2022 nickel crisis behind it as trading booms: Andy Home
summary: Reuters notes the LME has fully recovered from its 2022 nickel crisis, with nickel inventories rising sharply and trading volumes rebounding. The exchange expanded approved nickel brands and broader stock/liquidity trends supported higher activity across base metals, while copper and aluminium are referenced largely as part of the overall inventory cycle.

title: LME puts 2022 nickel crisis behind it as trading booms: Andy Home
summary: Reuters says the LME has fully recovered from the 2022 nickel crisis, with 2024 trading volumes surging and LME nickel inventory rising to around 230,000 mt by end-November 2024 from under 40,000 in May 2023. Higher stocks and improved delivery options point to easing tightness.

title: Copper Market to Grow by USD 70 Billion from 2024-2028, Driven by High Demand in APAC and AI-Driven Market Transformation
summary: Technavio estimates the global copper market will grow by about USD 70 billion from 2024-2028, citing strong APAC demand and technology-driven uses such as electronics, 5G/IoT, EVs, and renewables. It also warns copper prices remain volatile due to shifting supply-demand and macro factors, including mining disruptions and policies.

title: Kinusi Copper Mine Update on Initial Copper Sales  | Company Announcement
summary: Marula Mining updated that it is advancing initial copper ore sales from the Kinusi Copper Mine in Tanzania, with up to 1,000t being sold to trading groups by 31 January 2025. Assay/testwork delays were due to lab turnaround, and preliminary hydrometallurgy feedback is very positive for copper performance.

title: Ball : enters into an alliance with Meadow to take fully recyclable aluminum can to new categories worldwide
summary: Ball Corporation announced a minority investment in Meadow to scale circular “reusable dispenser” pre-filled cartridges using fully recyclable aluminum cans and ends. The partnership targets broader product categories and launches expected in 2025. It supports sustainability goals but provides no near-term volume or supply-impact details that would strongly move aluminum prices.

title: Mitsubishi halts metal trading in China after suspected copper fraud
summary: Mitsubishi says it will stop new domestic metal trading activity in China after suspected copper-trader fraud led to a client payment default and losses of about 13.8 billion yen. A Shanghai trader was dismissed and charged. The firm will keep serving Chinese clients via other entities, with limited additional restructuring costs.

title: American Eagle Gold Corp.: American Eagle Intersects 407 Metres of 0.78% Copper Equivalent from Surface, Including 248 Metres at 1.1%
summary: American Eagle Gold Corp. reported new drill intercepts at its NAK copper-gold porphyry project, including 248m of 1.1% copper equivalent within a broader 407m interval. The company describes mineralization as open to depth and expands known zones. The findings may influence copper supply expectations but do not imply production now.

title: US aluminium premium shows market sanguine over threat of Trump tariffs on Canada
summary: U.S. primary aluminium premiums have risen only modestly since Trump’s election, suggesting markets doubt he will impose threatened 25% tariffs on Canadian (and Mexican) imports. Analysts say a tariff would imply a much larger premium spike, but the current premium move remains subdued versus 2018’s tariff reality.

title: Quartz Mountain Resources Ltd.: Quartz Discovers a New Copper-Gold-Silver Porphyry at Jake Project in British Columbia
summary: Quartz Mountain Resources announced a new copper-gold-silver porphyry discovery at its Jake Project in British Columbia after maiden scout drilling. Results include significant copper intercepts and acquisition of claims around the system. The news is exploration-focused with no production schedule or inventory changes, limiting immediate market impact on copper prices.

title: Taseko Provides Construction Update on Florence Copper Project | Company Announcement
summary: Taseko announced progress on its Florence copper project in Arizona, stating overall completion of 56% as of Dec. 31, 2024 and that construction remains on schedule with first copper production targeted before end-2025. It reports costs in line with guidance but notes the DOE 48C(e) tax credit application was declined.

title: Taseko Provides Construction Update on Florence Copper Project
summary: Taseko reported that its 100%-owned Florence Copper project in Arizona is 56% complete as of Dec. 31, 2024, with construction progressing on schedule. Key SX/EW and wellfield activities advanced in Q4, and first copper production remains targeted before end-2025, suggesting limited immediate near-term supply impact.

title: U.S. aluminum premium shows market sanguine over threat of Trump tariffs on Canada
summary: U.S. aluminum premiums have risen only modestly since Trump’s election, reflecting skepticism about threatened 25% tariffs on Canadian and Mexican shipments. Because Canada supplies most U.S. primary aluminum imports, tariffs would likely be priced into the Midwest premium, implying potential near-term upward pressure on U.S. aluminum prices.

title: Column-Copper's early-year rally leaves investors unimpressed: Andy Home
summary: Copper has rallied early in 2025 on falling exchange stocks and stronger China refined imports, boosting bullish near-term optics. title: EU to propose ban on Russian aluminium imports in new sanctions package, EU diplomats say
summary: The European Commission plans to propose a phased ban on imports of Russian primary aluminium as part of its 16th sanctions package against Russia. EU diplomats discuss details ahead of a February vote. The EU already bans some aluminium products, and the move would further restrict supply into Europe.

title: Copper's early-year rally leaves investors unimpressed
summary: Copper has rallied early in 2025 on falling LME/ShFE inventories and stronger Chinese refined imports, but fund managers remain cautious. The main drag is tariff and trade-war risk after Trump takes office, which could reduce metal-intensive manufacturing demand. A widening CME-LME premium signals markets are pricing import-duty sensitivity.

title: EU Plans New Sanctions: Target Russian Aluminium
summary: The European Commission is preparing a 16th sanctions package aimed at banning Russian primary aluminium imports into the EU, to be discussed with member states and potentially finalized by February. This aligns with US and UK import bans and would phase restrictions in gradually, tightening supply for EU buyers.

title: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia in talks over copper, gold mines investment
summary: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia are in advanced talks over investment in the Reko Diq mine in Balochistan, described as a major underdeveloped copper project. A Saudi mining firm, Manara Minerals, is expected to invest within the next two quarters, and officials suggest further announcements soon, supporting copper supply expectations.

title: PAN GLOBAL ACCELERATES 2025 EXPLORATION PROGRAMS TO TEST MULTIPLE COPPER-GOLD-TIN TARGETS IN SPAIN
summary: Pan Global plans to accelerate 2025 exploration in Spain, including imminent drilling at the Escacena and CaÌrmenes projects. The program targets copper-tin-silver extensions at La Romana and copper-cobalt-nickel mineralization at CaÌrmenes. No immediate mine output or trade disruption is cited.

title: EU Moves to Ban Russian Aluminium Imports Amid Ongoing Sanctions
summary: The European Commission is preparing its 16th sanctions package to propose a phased ban on Russian primary aluminium imports, targeting implementation in February. The measure follows earlier US and UK restrictions and reflects continued EU efforts to curb Russian metals trade. Substitutes may come from Middle Eastern suppliers like the UAE and Bahrain.

title: EU's Tough Stance: Aluminium Sanctions in the Making
summary: The European Commission is preparing its 16th sanctions package, including a gradual ban on Russian primary aluminium imports. The goal is to reduce EU reliance on Russian metal supply amid the Ukraine war. Russian aluminium’s EU share has fallen sharply, and market prices have spiked following the news.

title: The LME puts 2022 nickel crisis behind it as trading booms
summary: Reuters reports the LME has fully recovered from the 2022 nickel crisis, with nickel inventories rising to nearly 230,000 tonnes and new nickel brands approved, boosting confidence. It also cites higher exchange stocks across base metals (including aluminium) and fluctuating copper volumes tied to fund flows, implying mixed near-term price signals.

title: Copper's early-year rally leaves investors unimpressed: Andy Home
summary: Copper’s January rally has left investors cautious. LME stocks have fallen and China refined imports and premiums improved, but funds remain only marginally net long. The main overhang is an expected tariff and trade-war escalation after Trump takes office, which could curb metal-intensive manufacturing and imports.

title: EU to adopt 16th package of anti-Russia sanctions in February, to ban aluminium imports
summary: The EU European Commission plans to propose its 16th anti-Russia sanctions package in February, including a phased ban on imports of Russian primary aluminium. EU sources say the move aims to mark the third anniversary of the war. The measure would restrict a key aluminium supply source into Europe.

title: EU prepares ban on trade of Russian aluminium, Reuters reports
summary: Reuters reports the EU is preparing a ban on trade of Russian aluminium. If implemented, the measure would limit Russian metal flows into European markets, tightening available supply in the short term and affecting pricing expectations for aluminium within days to weeks.

title: Kremlin says EU sanctions on Russian aluminium would risk destabilising a 'fragile' global market
summary: The Kremlin warned that EU sanctions targeting Russian primary aluminium imports could destabilize a fragile global aluminium market. Reuters reported the European Commission is considering an import ban as part of a new sanctions package over Russia’s war in Ukraine. The move would directly constrain Russian supply to Europe.

title: Hannan Metals Ltd.: Hannan Metals Discovers 1.2 km Chargeability Anomaly at Sortilegio Copper-Gold Porphyry, Valiente Peru
summary: Hannan Metals reports a 1.2 km induced-polarization chargeability anomaly at its Sortilegio copper-gold porphyry prospect in Peru and states the target is drill-ready with permits for Q2 2025. This is positive for long-term copper optionality, but it does not affect current supply or inventories.

title: XMT to deploy hybrid drilling rig at Ivanhoe Arizona copper project
summary: XtremeX Mining Technology will field-test a hybrid AC-electric automated coiled tubing and electric top-drive diamond core rig at Ivanhoe Electric’s Santa Cruz copper project in Arizona. The trial targets depths up to 2,000m and is intended to improve drilling speed and core recovery, supported by $11m Series-A funding.

title: Could Southeast Asia become aluminium scrap hub 2025?
summary: Fastmarkets reports Southeast Asia may grow as an aluminium scrap processing hub as China eases import restrictions for recycled materials. Scrap supply is constrained by congestion, stricter checks, and potential European shortages, while EV/auto-related investment supports demand. Traders expect busier conditions and higher scrap-linked costs for aluminium.

title: Europe steel, aluminium bodies urge EU action on scrap exports
summary: Eurofer and European Aluminium urge the EU to limit steel and aluminium scrap exports, arguing CBAM has already disrupted foreign markets and that scrap “leakage” is draining supply and weakening Europe’s circular economy. They cite higher scrap prices and expanding non-EU recycling capacity, recommending reciprocal trade barriers to boost EU scrap availability.

title: First Atlantic Nickel Granted Permits for Phase 2 Drill Program Following RPM Discover at the Atlantic Nickel Project
summary: First Atlantic Nickel says Newfoundland’s Mineral Lands Division has granted permits for Phase 2 drilling and a southern access trail at its Atlantic Nickel Project. The program will expand the RPM discovery area and target extensions toward Chrome Pond and Pipestone. The firm is preparing for drilling and expects Phase 1 assay updates soon.

title: Aluminum Market Wavers Amidst Tariff Uncertainty
summary: LME aluminum prices have been mostly sideways in early January, while the Midwest premium remains up, suggesting markets price in potential tariffs. North American demand rose in 2024, supporting aluminum. The Guinea bauxite export halt and SPIC plans for new alumina capacity also influence alumina costs and processor margins.

title: Brussels Aims at Russian LNG and Aluminum
summary: The EU is reportedly preparing a new sanctions package aimed at reducing reliance on Russian LNG and includes discussion of sanctions on Russian aluminum imports. Brussels is considering a phased LNG cut, while aluminum restrictions could limit Russian supply into Europe, tightening trade availability and weighing on near-term aluminium prices.

title: Rio Tinto Produced Slightly Less Iron Ore, More Copper Last Year
summary: Rio Tinto said 2024 output was slightly lower for iron ore but higher for copper and bauxite, with bauxite production up 7% year over year and above guidance. The company also produced more aluminum-linked materials, implying improved supply expectations for copper and aluminium despite reduced iron ore shipments.

title: Rio Tinto Produced Slightly Less Iron Ore, More Copper Last Year -- Update
summary: Rio Tinto said 2024 iron ore output and shipments fell ~1% y/y, while it produced more copper (+13% to 697,100 tons) and slightly more primary aluminum (nearly 3.3 million tons). Copper gains came from Oyu Tolgoi and higher-grade Escondida, and aluminum from higher plant availability.

title: Rio Tinto Continues to Review Options for Kennecott Copper Mine -- Commodity Comment
summary: Rio Tinto reported weaker iron-ore production but raised mined copper: yet Kennecott copper output fell 35% in Q4 2023 due to pit-wall geotechnical instabilities lowering head grade and forcing more low-grade stockpiled ore. Company says 2025 and 2026 output will be impacted, despite bauxite and aluminium-related improvements.

title: Rio Tinto rides copper wave - Australian Mining
summary: Rio Tinto said Q4 2024 copper production rose 26% year-on-year to 202,000 tonnes, citing ramp-up progress at Mongolia’s Oyu Tolgoi and improved grades at Escondida. It also reported slightly higher bauxite output in Australia, a more indirect support for aluminium feedstock supply.

title: Weighing the green cost: How nickel mining in Indonesia impacts forests and local communities
summary: The article argues that Indonesia’s rising nickel output is driving higher deforestation, pollution, and mining-related disasters in Sulawesi.
