title: White House defends new copper tariffs as critical national security measure
summary: The White House defended a new 50% tariff on copper imports, effective August 1, citing national security and domestic supply adequacy. The measure is intended to rebuild industrial supply chains and increase sourcing from the U.S. Copper prices on COMEX jumped to record levels following the announcement.

title: Trump announces 50% tariff on copper
summary: Trump announced a 50% tariff on copper. Such a tariff increases the landed cost of imported copper into the U.S., likely reducing import volumes and tightening near-term availability. That typically lifts short-term copper price expectations as buyers seek alternatives and inventories.

title: Trump's tariff war threatens Australia's Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme and copper exports
summary: The article claims the Trump administration is escalating tariffs, including a 50% copper import tariff to be imposed within weeks and a 50% tariff on aluminium, alongside a 10% general tariff. It argues these moves will hit Australia’s copper exporters via weaker China refining demand and disrupt metal-linked supply chains.

title: Manufacturers seek clarity on Trump tariffs before copper stockpiles dwindle
summary: Manufacturing executives are seeking clarity on Donald Trump’s tariff policy ahead of a planned 50% levy on copper imports from August 1. With copper stockpiles running down and contract timing uncertain, companies fear higher costs and possible tariff application to all copper products. Aluminium tariffs are referenced as already in place.

title: Proposed North Thompson copper mine aims for 2028 approval | iNFOnews | Thompson-Okanagan's News Source
summary: Yellowhead Copper, a planned Taseko Mines open-pit project north of Kamloops, could become one of Canada’s largest copper operations if approved. The company is restarting environmental assessment work, targeting permit decisions by 2028, with several years of construction before production. Near-term copper impacts appear limited.

title: The Global Impact Of Trump's Copper Tariff
summary: Trump’s administration is reported to move toward a 50% US import tariff on copper under Section 232. With the US a major copper importer, the market expects front-loaded US buying now and a sharp closure of further shipments, tightening ex-US supplies but lowering ex-US prices and compressing premiums/spreads.

title: Trump's Copper Tariffs Threaten India's Semiconductor and Electronics Push
summary: The article reports Trump’s proposed 30% tariff on imported copper products could disrupt global copper flows and raise refined copper prices. India’s semiconductor and electronics sector relies on imported high-purity copper for chip wiring and PCBs, while local output is insufficient, likely increasing costs and supporting higher copper prices.

title: India's new copper cathode rule risks supply shortages, trade body says
summary: India’s quality-control order on imported copper cathodes, requiring costly BIS licensing and checks, is expected to cut domestic refined-copper availability, the Bombay Metal Exchange says. It claims fewer imports and potential foreign supplier withdrawals, notably from Japan, could cause immediate downstream shortages despite the government’s defense in court.

title: The off-season, coupled with cost pressure, will lead to a decline in the operating rate of secondary aluminum producers in July [SMM analysis]
summary: SMM data show secondary aluminium alloy producers’ operating rate rose to 41.9% in June, aided by stronger orders and fewer holiday disruptions. As July nears, off-season demand pressures, slower automaker production, tighter raw material circulation, and cost losses prompt furnace shutdowns, so operating rates are expected to decline slightly.

title: Bauxite: 2,000 Jobs Threatened by Dispute Between Guinea and Emirates Global Aluminium
summary: Guinea Alumina Corporation (GAC), linked to Emirates Global Aluminium, announced layoffs after an intensifying dispute with Guinea over building an alumina refinery. Guinea blocked GAC bauxite exports and halted mining, threatening alumina/bauxite availability. The standoff raises near-term supply risk for aluminium-linked inputs.

title: Regulator makes decision on Limerick bauxite refinery's dredging plans
summary: Ireland’s environmental regulator approved Rusal’s expanded dredging around Foynes Port and permission to dump dredged materials at a new site near Foynes Island. The decision removes a final licensing hurdle for the alumina refinery’s continued operations, supporting confidence in local input and logistics flow.

title: The Race Is on to Build U.S. Copper Mines After Trump Pledges Higher Tariffs -- Commodities Roundup
summary: The article highlights Trump’s pledge of higher tariffs and a proposed 50% levy on U.S. copper imports from Aug. 1, with analysts noting a temporary demand gap could weigh on prices; LME copper is down. It also reports South32 reviewing Mozal’s aluminum smelter due to electricity-supply uncertainty, adding risk to aluminum output.

title: Copper prices rise ahead of U.S. import tariff
summary: A 50% U.S. import tariff on copper begins Aug. 1, prompting traders to front-load purchases and divert shipments to other markets like China and Canada. With deliveries still en route and global smelting capacity limited, supply backlogs and U.S. buyers’ higher costs are expected to support rising copper prices.

title: The fluctuation in the operating rate of secondary copper rod plants has intensified, with a shortage of raw materials and pressure from industry transformation coexisting
summary: SMM data show secondary copper rod plants’ operating rate rose to 33.61% but sales losses deepened due to ongoing shortages of secondary copper raw materials. Inventories in China’s distribution centers are only 20–30% of normal. Tight supply and firmer scrap-to-copper spreads lifted input prices and constrained downstream consumption during the off-season.

title: Tyranna Resources Limited entered into agreement to acquire 70% stake in Maongo Copper-Gold Project in Namibe, Angola from O.C.J.A.F. - Exploração Mineira, Limitada for approximately AOA 380 million.
summary: Tyranna Resources agreed to acquire a 70% stake in Angola’s Maongo copper-gold project for about AOA 380 million, with payments tied to due diligence and licensing milestones. The announcement signals future copper resource development, but it lacks near-term production changes, limiting immediate price impact.

title: Great Southern Copper to prioritise Especularita
summary: Great Southern Copper (Chile-focused) reports completion of geophysical surveys at the Cerro Negro prospect within its Especularita project, defining copper/gold targets ahead of Phase III drilling. To fund this prioritisation, it will pause option agreements at other Cu-Au and lithium projects. No immediate output changes are reported.

title: Green Bridge Metals Corporation: Green Bridge Metals Enters into Definitive Agreement to Option Large Bulk Tonnage Copper-Nickel-PGE Serpentine Project, Duluth Complex, Minnesota, USA
summary: Green Bridge Metals announced a definitive agreement to option up to a 70% interest in the Serpentine Cu-Ni project in Minnesota. The company cites historical copper and nickel resources, strong flotation recoveries, and new exploration permitting progress, positioning domestic policy tailwinds as supportive. The deal signals potential future supply, not immediate market balance.

title: Green Bridge Metals Corporation: Green Bridge Metals Enters into Definitive Agreement to Option Large Bulk Tonnage Copper-Nickel-PGE Serpentine Project, Duluth Complex, Minnesota, USA
summary: Green Bridge Metals signed a definitive agreement to option up to 70% of the Serpentine bulk-tonnage copper-nickel project in Minnesota. The release cites historical resource grades, strong flotation recoveries, ongoing exploration permitting, and U.S. federal support for domestic copper supply, but provides no production timeline.

title: Copper Tariffs: A Risky Gamble for U.S. Industry
summary: The piece argues the Trump administration’s proposed 50% tariffs on imported copper would sharply raise copper prices in the U.S., where the country is a net importer for a large share of needs. It notes mining and refining capacity takes years and requires credible long-term price support to invest.

title: New US Copper Mine Is on the Fast Track
summary: Ivanhoe Electric is fast-tracking the Santa Cruz project in Arizona, aiming for copper production starting in late 2028 after construction next year. The push comes as the US plans a 50% tariff on copper imports from Aug. 1, alongside strong demand from EVs, renewables, and data centers.

title: Copper theft may increase as price of copper jumped 13% after Trump tariffs
summary: Copper prices jumped about 13% after Trump announced a 50% tariff on copper imports to the US. The article says US import dependence is high, and recycling firms see increased and unstable pricing. Authorities warn copper theft may rise due to the higher profitability, indicating strong near-term copper demand and tightness.

title: Renewed Trade Offensive Continues: White House Announces 50% Tariffs on Copper, Previews Duties on Pharma and Chips | Alston & Bird
summary: The White House announced that a Section 232 probe on U.S. copper imports has ended, with 50% duties scheduled to take effect August 1. The rate may also cover semi-finished copper products. Officials cite boosting domestic production, with potential supplier redirection (Chile, Mexico) still uncertain.

title: Copper Forecast Today 15/07: Buyers on Dips (Video)
summary: Copper prices dipped slightly on Monday but the market reportedly turned around, suggesting buyers on dips. The commentary links recent volatility to Trump’s proposed tariffs on certain copper products, which previously spurred a sharp move. Traders are watching $5.45 and $5 levels for support, with $6 as a key upside trigger.

title: US to Construct Its First Copper Mine in Over a Decade
summary: The Wall Street Journal, citing sources, says Ivanhoe Electric’s Santa Cruz project in Arizona will begin construction in early 2025, with copper cathode sales targeted for end-2028. The report also notes a planned 50% US tariff on copper starting August 1, aimed at boosting national security.

title: Process and Control Today | ABB joins Arctial's low-carbon aluminium smelter project for Europe
summary: ABB has joined Arctial’s feasibility partnership for a Greentop low-carbon primary aluminium smelter in Finland, with early work on electrification and automation. The plant is projected to be the first new continental Europe primary smelter in 30+ years, but final investment decision is in 2026–2027.

title: US launches anti-circumvention probe into Việt Nam's aluminum containers
summary: The US Department of Commerce opened an anti-circumvention probe into disposable aluminum containers and related items imported from Vietnam and Thailand. Authorities suspect the products use Chinese aluminum foil processed in third countries to evade US duties on Chinese exports. Preliminary and final determinations are due within 150 and 300 days.

title: Commodities: Tariffs shake up copper | MarketScreener
summary: Donald Trump’s announcement of a 50% tariff on copper imports triggered a sharp market reaction: US copper futures jumped about 17% on the news, while London spot copper was down slightly. The headline implies tariffs are quickly re-pricing supply and trade flows, supporting near-term bullish copper momentum in the US.

title: South32's Mozambique aluminium smelter faces uncertainty
summary: South32 says its Mozal aluminium smelter in Mozambique faces uncertainty as negotiations to renew power tariffs with Hidroeléctrica de Cahora Bassa run to March 2026, while drought could reduce hydro output and raise supply risk. Production guidance for FY2026 is under review, pointing to potential aluminium supply constraints.

title: Industry bodies warn that India's copper cathode quality control order poses a risk of supply deficit
summary: India’s industry body warns that quality-control licensing for imported copper cathode could impose costly compliance burdens on foreign suppliers, reducing supply. It argues downstream buyers face an imminent shortage as domestic licensed firms consume all cathode and some foreign license holders do not supply cathode.

title: South32's Mozambique aluminium smelter faces uncertainty amid power supply issues
summary: South32’s Mozambique aluminium smelter is reportedly facing uncertainty related to power supply problems. Any disruption or slowdown in smelting output can reduce near-term aluminium availability and improve supply tightness expectations. That mechanism can lead to upward price pressure over the following days to weeks.

title: US starts anti-circumvention probe into aluminum containers imported from Vietnam
summary: The US Department of Commerce initiated anti-circumvention investigations into disposable aluminum containers and related items imported from Vietnam and Thailand. The probe alleges these goods use aluminum foil from China processed in third countries to evade US antidumping/countervailing duties. A preliminary conclusion is expected by December 4.

title: Copper thefts surge in Ontario and Canada
summary: Copper wire thefts are surging in Eastern Canada, with Ontario most affected. Police and Bell attribute the rise to high scrap copper prices and an increase in copper theft from hydro poles and telecom infrastructure. The report also cites forecasts of record copper prices in 2025, supporting bullish copper sentiment.

title: WESTERN COPPER AND GOLD PROVIDES UPDATE ON ESE SUBMISSION
summary: Western Copper and Gold said it is progressing toward submission of its Environmental and Socio-economic Effects (ESE) Statement for the Casino Project in Yukon, expected before end-October. The company highlights extensive studies, consultation progress, and final compilation for assessment, supporting expectations for future copper supply.

title: US Copper Scrap Market Insights on Price Volatility
summary: US copper scrap participants are shifting pricing benchmarks from COMEX to LME after Trump’s announcement of a proposed 50% copper import tariff. COMEX prices surged on July 8, triggering wider scrap discounts and margin stress. Traders cite arbitrage moves and influx/outflow dynamics capping momentum near $10,000/t.

title: Tyranna to acquire 70% stake in Angola's Maongo copper-gold project
summary: Tyranna plans to acquire a 70% stake in Angola’s Maongo copper-gold project. The deal suggests renewed investment and potential development progress for a copper resource. In the near term, such expansion signals can be modestly supportive for copper prices, though timing to production is unclear.

title: Tyranna Resources to acquire stake in Maongo copper-gold project
summary: Tyranna Resources plans to buy a 70% interest in the Maongo copper-gold project near Namibe, Angola, after negotiations with ANRM. It will run mapping, soil geochemistry and geophysical surveys, with a prospecting licence expected in the Sept 2025 quarter and no near-term production impact mentioned.

title: ABB helps assess feasibility of low-carbon aluminium smelter in Finland
summary: ABB will support Arctial’s feasibility studies for the Greentop low-carbon primary aluminium smelter project in Finland, including electrification and automation design. The project targets Europe’s first primary aluminium development in 30+ years, using low-carbon power. Final investment decision is expected in 2026–2027.

title: US Copper Corp.: US Copper Releases Study on Economic Benefits for Plumas County of the Moonlight-Superior Copper Project
summary: US Copper Corp. published a study estimating local economic gains from building and operating the Moonlight-Superior copper project in California, including $568m annual mining revenues and ~60m lb/year copper production. While it signals future copper supply potential, it is primarily a planning/economic-study update without immediate production start, so near-term price effects appear limited.

title: Oklahoma incentives land a $4 billion aluminum smelter
summary: Oklahoma approved up to about $1 billion in incentives for Emirates Global Aluminium to build a $4 billion primary aluminium smelter at Tulsa Port of Inola, targeting 600,000 tpy. The plan is framed as tariff-driven U.S. onshoring and depends on power supply agreements and energy availability, supporting aluminium demand for the region.

title: Rick Rule's Big, Beautiful Gold-Silver-Copper (and More) Conference
summary: The piece reports that President Trump imposed a 50% tariff on imported copper, which immediately boosted the share prices of copper-related companies at the conference. It links the policy to expected supply-demand tightness for copper in the short run, while most other content focuses on gold and silver.

title: How will Trump's new copper tariff impact Utah?
summary: The article says Trump’s new 50% tariff on copper imports starts Aug. 1, framed as a move to boost U.S. copper production for national security. It highlights Utah’s major operations, including Rio Tinto’s Kennecott mine and smelter, and suggests demand and investment incentives that could support higher copper prices.

title: US copper scrap industry needs export controls, PMR CEO says | Hotter Commodities
summary: PMR CEO says US should impose “smart” export controls on high-value copper scrap flowing to China, arguing it prevents domestic refining investment. The CDA has responded to a US Section 232 process, while Trump signals a 50% tariff on copper imports from Aug. 1, potentially tightening supply and supporting copper prices.

title: Wealth managers wondering how long copper spike will last
summary: Copper prices spiked more than 10% last week to near $6/lb following a 50% Trump tariff announcement. The piece attributes the rally to speculative buying, end-user stockpiling/front-running, and a weaker US dollar, while noting investors will test sustainability as demand and supply assessments evolve.

title: Update on inclusion requests pertaining to Section 232 tariffs on steel and aluminum | Clark Hill PLC
summary: The update explains that Section 232 tariffs on steel and aluminum have been expanded and that BIS has implemented an inclusion process to add new aluminum derivative products to the tariff schedule. After Trump doubled tariff rates, BIS is expected to issue first inclusion decisions around July 14, potentially increasing future aluminum duties.

title: Potential New Tariff Rates for Canada, Mexico, the EU and Copper Products | Warner Norcross + Judd
summary: The article discusses letters threatening new reciprocal tariffs by Aug. 1 and notes unresolved legal challenges. Separately, Trump announced a 50% tariff on copper imports to the U.S. It also highlights unclear interactions with existing sectoral tariffs that already cover areas like aluminum.

title: Miners lift blockades along Peru's key copper route, protest leader says
summary: Peruvian miners allowed to operate temporarily paused protests that had blocked a key copper transit corridor for more than two weeks. They plan to suspend activity through Friday while seeking permit extensions, warning they may resume blockades if negotiations fail. Companies including MMG, Glencore and Hudbay flagged potential production impacts.

title: Trump's 50% Copper Tariffs Jolt US Market as Buyers Slash Imports and Delay Orders
summary: Trump’s proposed 50% copper tariffs are reportedly prompting US buyers to reduce copper imports and delay orders. The shift in purchasing behavior suggests weaker near-term demand and tighter short-term demand expectations, which typically weighs on copper prices even as tariffs could eventually influence pricing power.

title: Russell Kenneth Dubberlin sentenced to 7 months prison after being caught with $6000 worth of copper wire
summary: A man was sentenced for stealing about $6,000 worth of copper wire/cabling, which previously caused street lighting outages after thefts on Paganoni Road and elsewhere. Main Roads says copper cable theft is rising and millions of dollars are lost annually, with utilities working on restoration and enforcement.

title: Latin America Isn't Signing Blind Mining Deals Anymore
summary: The piece notes that President Trump recently pushed copper prices to record highs after threatening 50% tariffs on the metal. It discusses Latin America’s exposure to US trade policy and highlights local value capture and sustainability efforts by miners, but the only direct price catalyst described is the copper tariff threat.

title: CEO.CA Technologies Ltd.: CEO.CA's Inside the Boardroom: Super Copper Announces Strategic $1.3M Acquisition of High-Potential Chile Project
summary: CEO.CA interviewed Super Copper CEO Zachary Dolesky about the company’s $1.3 million acquisition of the Castilla Copper Project in Chile’s Atacama region. The deal is positioned as non-dilutive and part of a copper exploration platform strategy, potentially boosting sentiment toward copper exploration prospects.

title: Trump's 50% Copper Tariff Impact on Global Markets in 2025
summary: Trump’s announced 50% tariff on U.S. copper imports (raw and some semi-finished copper) effective Aug. 1 has driven pre-implementation stockpiling, widened U.S. copper premiums, and increased volatility as buyers cut or delay imports. The policy also encourages limited copper-to-aluminum substitution in some uses, affecting demand expectations.

title: Second quarter production results | Company Announcement
summary: Rio Tinto’s Q2 results show copper equivalent output up 13% YoY, with copper production expected at the higher end of 2025 guidance due to ramp-up at Oyu Tolgoi and strong Escondida performance. It also notes aluminium tariff impacts and premium dynamics versus 50% duties.

title: Antofagasta's copper output up 11% in first half
summary: Antofagasta said first-half copper production rose 11% to 314,900 tonnes due to higher output from its concentrators. Net cash costs fell 32% to $1.32/lb, while full-year copper output guidance remained unchanged at 660,000–700,000 tonnes. The company also continues expansion work at Centinela.

title: Rio Tinto's copper output rises 15pc on year in Apr-Jun
summary: Rio Tinto said April-June 2025 copper production rose 15% to 229,000 tonnes, helped by record output from Mongolia’s Oyu Tolgoi mine. It kept 2025 guidance at 780,000-850,000 tonnes and expects upper-end output. Copper concentrate gains at Escondida were partly offset by slower refining at Kennetcott.

title: CEO.CA's Inside the Boardroom: Super Copper Announces Strategic $1.3M Acquisition of High-Potential Chile Project – IT Business Net
summary: Super Copper’s CEO discusses the company’s $1.3 million acquisition of the Castilla Copper Project in Chile’s Atacama region. The deal is positioned as a non-dilutive step to build a copper exploration platform. The announcement is copper-focused but does not indicate imminent production or material supply changes.

title: China Starts Copper Rush in Africa; US Moves Forward With Its Own Ambitions
summary: The article says China is spending billions to buy copper and secure mining and processing rights in Africa. It frames this as preparation for stronger competition with the United States for African critical mineral supply. The move could affect future copper supply expectations, but near-term price impact is uncertain.

title: Rio Tinto ramps up copper production as Trump preps fresh tariffs
summary: Rio Tinto said 2025 copper output should be at the top end of forecasts as it ramps production at Oyu Tolgoi and expects good performance at Escondida. However, it flags the threat of fresh US tariffs from 1 August on copper imports, contributing to price dislocations and tariff pressure across metals, including aluminium.

title: Indonesia to export only refined copper to U.S.-Xinhua
summary: Indonesia says it will export only processed copper to the United States and will not ship raw copper. The government also banned exports of copper concentrates and is pushing domestic refining. The move follows Trump’s positive comments on Indonesian copper quality and is expected to affect near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Peru copper mining protests temporarily halt amid discussions
summary: Peruvian copper miners with temporary permits paused protests after blocking a critical Cusco road for about two weeks in July 2025. The truce lasts until mid-July while miners and government representatives negotiate in Lima. Companies warned of production impacts if disruptions continued, suggesting near-term copper supply risk easing.

title: Green Bridge Metals Corporation: Green Bridge Metals Reports Significant Disseminated and High-Grade Copper - Nickel Mineralization from Previously Unsampled Core at the Skibo Prospect
summary: Green Bridge Metals reports newly received drill core assays from the Skibo prospect, including long intercepts and higher-grade zones with copper and nickel mineralization (plus PGE, cobalt, and titanium). The release is an exploration update and does not announce production, supply disruptions, or policy changes affecting near-term copper or nickel markets.

title: China Cost Us 10,000 Nickel Jobs, Now It's Coming for Copper and Lithium: Australian Senator
summary: Australian Senator Matt Canavan says Chinese state-backed supply expansion has already hurt Australia’s nickel industry, costing thousands of jobs, citing the resources minister. He calls for a Senate inquiry and warns China may now target copper (and mentions lithium), implying extra supply could pressure prices.

title: China Cost Us 10,000 Nickel Jobs, Now It's Coming for Copper and Lithium: Australian Senator
summary: Australian Nationals Senator Matt Canavan says China’s state-backed financing is expanding nickel supply and has already undermined Australia’s nickel industry, costing about 10,000 jobs. He calls for a Senate inquiry and warns China may now pressure copper and lithium markets as well, implying downside price risk for nickel and potentially copper.

title: Century Aluminum (CENX) Plans New US Smelter After Higher Aluminum Tariffs
summary: Century Aluminum (CENX) plans a new US smelter after higher US aluminum tariffs. The policy change likely increases the attractiveness of domestic production versus imports, supporting near-term sentiment for aluminum prices as market participants adjust to altered trade flows and supply expectations.

title: Market upheaval ahead as Trump threatens 50% copper tariff
summary: Trump has proposed a 50% tariff on all US copper imports starting Aug 1, after a Commerce national-security review. Traders frontloaded purchases, raising Comex prices versus other venues. Analysts expect a short uptick in near-term seaborne imports but inventory drawdowns and contract/logistics disputes as deliveries shift away from the US.

title: Spot Market Tightness Boosts Aluminum Prices
summary: The piece says Midwest aluminum premiums resumed rising after a mid-June dip tied to Section 232 tariff changes and cautious trade expectations. It links the move to tighter spot conditions, with LME inventories down sharply and primary cash prices still at a modest premium. Trade talks with Canada are unresolved, keeping volatility risk high.

title: How Canada is responding to the U.S. steel and aluminum tariffs
summary: Canada is responding to U.S. steel and aluminum tariffs by imposing retaliatory levies and introducing procurement rules and steel/aluminum tariff rate quotas. It also adjusts counter-tariffs and sets surtaxes if imports exceed 2024 levels or involve higher-risk origins, alongside business relief and loans.

title: Rio says Trump tariffs added US$300 million in aluminum costs
summary: Rio Tinto said U.S. tariffs on its Canada-made aluminum added over US$300 million in gross costs in the first half. The company noted only partial clawback via higher U.S. premiums as tariff rates rose. Aluminum premiums and contract values in the Midwest surged, signaling higher costs for buyers.

title: Reports: Indonesia Trade Deal Unlocks Massive Copper Access for U.S.
summary: Reports say a Trump–Prabowo trade deal would grant the U.S. tariff-free access to Indonesia’s copper resources. It also notes Indonesia’s nickel raw-ore export ban may be lifted for the U.S. improving critical-minerals trade flows, which could support near-term expectations for copper and nickel prices.

title: How Canada is responding to the U.S. steel and aluminum tariffs | iNFOnews | Thompson-Okanagan's News Source
summary: Canada responded to U.S. steel and aluminum tariffs with retaliatory levies, procurement rules limiting sourcing, and tariff rate quotas with potential 50% surtaxes if imports exceed 2024 levels. It also added measures targeting steel intended for redirection to Canada, plus business relief and lending support.

title: Kodiak Copper Corp.: Kodiak Expands Team with Proven Talent to Drive Next Phase of Growth
summary: Kodiak Copper Corp. appointed a metallurgical advisor and a senior exploration manager to strengthen work on its 100%-owned MPD copper-gold porphyry project in southern British Columbia. The release emphasizes progress toward metallurgical work and a 2025 initial resource estimate, but does not indicate immediate supply changes.

title: US tariffs on Canadian aluminium impact mining giants Rio Tinto, Alcoa
summary: US tariffs on Canadian aluminium exports (raised from 25% to 50%) have increased costs for Rio Tinto and Alcoa and disrupted supply chains. Bloomberg cited rising costs for US buyers, with Alcoa redirecting shipments abroad and forecasting further negative impact in Q3 2025 as tariff effects feed through to inflation and sentiment.

title: Vedanta plans Zambian smelter refurbishment to boost copper output
summary: Vedanta’s Konkola Copper Mines plans a comprehensive smelter refurbishment in Zambia, implying a shutdown/overhaul that will temporarily reduce smelting capacity. The piece notes Zambia waived an export tax on copper concentrates due to the smelter’s inability to process them, pointing to near-term constraints on refined copper supply.

title: Gold Hart Copper Corp.: Gold Hart Copper Acquires Three Additional Gold-Copper-Silver Properties in Chile
summary: Gold Hart Copper Corp. announced the acquisition of three new gold-copper-silver properties in Chile’s Domeyko Belt, increasing its land position by ~30%. The company highlights surface copper grades and intends near-term drilling results from its flagship Tolita asset, which may be a mild copper sentiment support.

title: Alcoa's global Al output up, bauxite and alumina fall
summary: Alcoa said aluminium smelted in April–June rose 5.3% to 572,000t, supported by ramp-up at the Alumar smelter in Brazil that offset declines from the San Ciprián shutdown. Shipments also softened. Tariffs are expected to cost $90mn in July–September, potentially tightening US availability.

title: President Trump Announces 50% Tariff on Copper: Mining and Upstream Users Experience Record Price Surge | ArentFox Schiff
summary: President Trump said a 50% tariff on all copper imports will take effect Aug. 1, 2025 under a Section 232 national-security investigation framework. The news cites record highs in US copper futures after the announcement and warns mining and upstream users to prepare for higher copper prices.

title: Copper wire theft caused "significant disruption" to cell service
summary: Ontario Provincial Police said vandalism to two communication towers in East Ferris caused a major mobile service outage. Preliminary findings suggest copper wire theft, with cables cut and removed from the tower enclosure. The OPP is investigating, but the report doesn’t indicate any market-significant copper supply disruption.

title: Update On Inclusion Requests Pertaining To Section 232 Tariffs On Steel And Aluminum
summary: The article updates on U.S. Section 232 steel and aluminum tariffs, noting rates doubled from 25% to 50% and that BIS shifted from an exclusion process to an inclusion process for additional derivative products. BIS will decide inclusion requests within 60 days, with duties expected shortly after Federal Register notice.

title: China did not take Indonesia's nickel
summary: The piece argues the US failed to secure a nickel supply arrangement with Indonesia under the IRA, while China-led investment expanded Indonesian nickel refining. With over 80% of processing tied to Chinese investors and IRA benefits limited for Indonesia, market expectations may shift toward Indonesia-China nickel flows.

title: Africa Becomes Global Copper Battleground for Asian Powers
summary: China and India are competing for copper assets in Africa, including India’s Zambia exploration block and a policy push to expand smelters/refineries and overseas copper holdings. Vedanta plans a major $1 billion expansion of Zambian KCM to raise output, signaling tighter future supply expectations for copper.

title: Q&A: American Pacific sees copper growth ahead
summary: The Q&A says Trump’s planned 50% tariffs on copper imports could materially affect US miners and downstream users. It notes copper prices “drastically increased” after the tariff announcement, prompting demand for US copper sources and renewed investment in projects and smelting capacity, while highlighting US supply shortfalls.

title: US copper tariff poses a double-edged sword for Indonesian miners - Markets
summary: The US plans a 50% tariff on imported copper from Aug. 1. Analysts warn it could disrupt trade, but the announcement triggered short-term stockpiling by buyers ahead of the deadline. The article says copper jumped 13% in one day to a record high, reflecting immediate bullish pressure.

title: BHP delays Jansen potash project as costs surge; logs record copper output
summary: BHP flagged a delay and cost overrun at its Jansen potash project, but also reported record copper output in fiscal 2025. It expects copper output to fall in fiscal 2026 because Escondida will mine lower grades, potentially tightening supply expectations. It is reviewing Western Australia nickel assets for potential divestment.

title: BHP Flags Higher Costs, Delays on Potash Project; May Sell Nickel Arm -- Update
summary: BHP flagged higher costs and delays for its Canadian Jansen potash project. Separately, it is reviewing whether to divest its Australian Nickel West operations after earlier suspension. BHP also reported record annual copper production and provided a near-term copper output range, shaping short-term supply expectations for both nickel and copper.

title: BHP Copper Output Rises for Third Straight Year -- Commodity Comment
summary: BHP reported record annual copper production, including a 17-year high at Escondida, driven by higher throughput and recoveries, and noted improved copper performance after an outage at its South Australia operations. It also said its Western Australia Nickel unit is in temporary suspension with a divestment/restart review into early 2027.

title: BHP Flags Higher Costs, Delays on Potash Project; May Sell Nickel Arm — Update
summary: BHP said its Jansen potash project faces higher costs and delays, but the update also included record annual iron ore and copper production and new copper output guidance. Separately, BHP is assessing selling its Nickel West business after shutting operations amid a global nickel supply glut, creating offsetting copper and nickel signals.

title: LA County RV homeless encampments leads to illegal dumping, copper theft
summary: Neighbors and business owners in Los Angeles County report illegal dumping and rising copper theft tied to RV homeless encampments. A business owner says $100,000 of copper piping and electrical wiring was stripped. Officials cite enforcement and a safe parking pilot, but emphasize housing shortages and ongoing cleanup.

title: SMM Analysis: After Surge in H1 2025, Copper Prices to Face Considerable Uncertainties in H2
summary: US Section 232 copper import investigation and expectations of up to 25% tariffs disrupted global copper supply chains, shifting inventory toward COMEX and boosting prices. Tight ore availability and falling concentrate TCs also supported rallies. However, demand weakened into Q2/Q3 seasonality and tariff implementation uncertainty keeps H2 volatile.

title: Lifezone Metals Consolidates Control of the World-Class Kabanga Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Sulfide Project

The announcement triggered a sharp selloff: US Comex copper futures fell about 20% and prices were already rerating for fuller tariff application.

title: Trump excludes raw copper from 50 percent tariff - Markets
summary: Trump excluded raw/primary copper inputs (ores, concentrates, cathodes/anodes) from a new 50% tariff, limiting it to copper pipes, tubes and semi-finished products and products copper is heavily used to make. Markets reacted by cutting Comex refined copper sharply and expecting further downside as US inventories build.

title: Australian shares slide as tariff shockwaves hit copper
summary: Australian shares fell as copper prices plunged after a surprise US tariff decision. A 50% tariff on copper semi-finished products starting Friday triggered selling and fears that around 250,000 tonnes of cathode in US warehouses could be re-exported, pressuring global copper supply and prices.

title: North QLD pleads for federal aid to save copper jobs | The North West Star
summary: North Queensland leaders urged the federal government to fund Glencore’s Mount Isa copper smelter and Townsville copper refinery, warning Glencore may place assets into care and maintenance by September if a financial gap isn’t covered. They cited large job losses and broader industrial impacts, framing potential refined copper supply risk.

title: Trump issues blitz of tariff announcements on copper, Brazil, South Korea, small-value imports
summary: Trump announced a 50% tariff on US imports of copper pipes, tubes and other semi-finished copper products, with the levy set to start Friday. The clarification narrowed coverage versus earlier expectations and led to a sharp repricing: US Comex copper prices fell over 17% as markets unwound premiums tied to higher US costs.

title: Italy's Prysmian sees stronger U.S. pricing, margins after new copper tariff scheme
summary: Prysmian said a new U.S. copper tariff scheme will raise costs for importers of copper-intensive cables and support pricing, with management upgrading its outlook. The tariff includes 50% levies on semi-finished copper products from August 1. Analysts expect benefits for U.S. low-voltage margins; aluminium may face similar logic.

title: Trump's watered-down copper tariffs crush Comex premium
summary: Markets reversed after President Trump reduced expected copper tariffs. The levy cut by excluding ores, concentrates and cathodes and applying only to certain copper products. Comex copper plunged over 20%, erasing the prior premium versus the LME benchmark as traders unwind rushed inventory inflows into the U.S.

title: Trump's 50% tariffs on copper could end up hurting US industry: GTRI
summary: A think tank argues Trump’s planned 50% tariff on imports of semi-finished copper and copper-based products from Aug. 1 could harm US industry. The tariff is intended to reduce import dependence but is expected to disrupt copper supply and raise costs, pressuring copper price expectations.

title: Chile dodges US's 50% tariffs on copper
summary: The White House 50% tariff on US copper imports excludes Chile’s main export—refined copper cathodes—and also exempts copper inputs (concentrates, cathodes, anodes) and scrap. After the proclamation, COMEX copper prices dropped nearly 20% as traders sold previously stockpiled metal, reflecting bearish near-term pressure.

title: US Imposes 50% Tariffs On Imports Of Semi-finished Copper Products
summary: The US signed a proclamation imposing a universal 50% tariff on imports of semi-finished copper products (pipes, wires, rods, sheets, tubes) and copper-intensive derivative components, effective August 1. The measure is aimed at countering copper import impacts on national security and is expected to tighten US supply.

title: US delays interest rate cut & copper prices crash
summary: The SBS podcast says the US Fed held rates as tariffs remain a concern and discusses fresh US tariff announcements that triggered a sharp copper drop (reported as the biggest since 1988). It links the volatility to ad hoc tariff changes and uncertainty about inflation and growth impacts.

title: Philippines' 'last ecological frontier' battles demand for nickel
summary: Palawan in the Philippines faces local opposition to new nickel mining, including a 50-year moratorium on mining permits. With the Philippines a key nickel exporter, delays to expansions and potential constraints on new projects could reduce near-term supply growth expectations. Environmental concerns and legal disputes add uncertainty.

title: Trump Ends Tariffs on All Low-Cost Shipments, Sets Levies on Copper and Brazil Imports
summary: The White House said Trump signed orders ending tariff exemptions for low-cost shipments (effectively ending the U.S. de minimis treatment) and imposing a 50% tariff on copper imports, along with higher levies on imports from Brazil. The copper-specific tariff is likely to pressure prices lower in the near term.

title: Copper Turns Lower in London Following U.S. Tariff Exemptions
summary: London copper fell after Trump said 50% tariffs would apply to copper products but not raw copper, enabling about 250,000 tons in U.S. warehouses to be re-exported. Comex saw its biggest one-day drop since 1988 (around -21%), and LME three-month futures fell to about $9,600/t amid easing supply tightness.

title: Glencore copper equivalent production grows 5% in H1 2025
summary: Glencore said H1 2025 copper equivalent production rose 5% YoY, but own-sourced copper fell 26% due to lower grades and recoveries impacting several mines. The company narrowed its 2025 copper forecast range. Nickel output also declined 7% on maintenance at Murrin Murrin. Overall, net price impact is unclear.

title: US announces 50% tariff on copper imports
summary: The US signed a proclamation imposing a universal 50% tariff on imports of semi-finished copper products (pipes, wires, rods, sheets, tubes) and copper-intensive derivative products, effective August 1. Copper ores/concentrates/cathodes and scrap are exempt, while rules increase domestic scrap sales and licensing to support local refiners.

title: Business Brief: Trade, copper, tariffs and fowl-play allegations
summary: The business brief highlights tariff talk ahead of Canada–U.S. trade negotiations and notes Trump’s 50% tariff on imported copper is sparing key products for Canadian producers. It frames this as relief for exporters, suggesting the tariff could tighten supply and support copper pricing in the near term.

title: After Guinea's Licence Crackdown, a Suspended Bauxite Operator Eyes a Comeback
summary: Guinea revoked mining licences for under-performance, forcing Axis Minerals’ bauxite sites in the Boffa–Fria corridor into care-and-maintenance and furloughing workers. SD Mining is seeking to restart while GIC appeals. The article suggests global bauxite remains surplus, limiting immediate aluminium price pressure.

title: The proportion of liquid aluminum pulled back significantly in July, and whether it can recover in August remains to be verified [SMM data]
summary: SMM reports China’s July primary aluminium output rose slightly, but the proportion of liquid aluminium at smelters fell by 2.06 percentage points to 73.77%, reflecting strong off-season cuts in downstream alloying. Despite high operating capacity into August and some replacement commissioning, end-use demand weakness keeps liquid share expected low.

title: Trump's scrap copper quotas too small to shift the market
summary: The article headline says Trump’s planned scrap copper quotas are too small to shift the overall market. This suggests the policy would not materially change near-term expectations for scrap availability and copper supply tightness, limiting any immediate impact on copper prices.

title: Koryx Copper Announces Closing of $25 Million Financing
summary: Koryx Copper closed a C$25 million financing (bought deal offering and private placement) to fund technical work and exploration at its Haib copper project in Namibia. Management says the capital will help advance toward PEA/PFS milestones and optimize development plans. The release contains no operational output or supply change details.

title: Indonesia cuts export benchmark price for copper concentrate for 1st half of August-Xinhua
summary: Indonesia’s Ministry of Trade cut the export benchmark price for copper concentrate for Aug. 1–14 by 0.64% to $4,653.74/wet metric ton, citing effects from U.S. import tariff policies, improved LME trading activity, and higher global supply, including from Chile. Benchmark declines can pressure nearby copper prices.

title: Freeport-McMoran (FCX) Tumbles 9.46% as Copper Gets Slapped With 50% Tariff
summary: Freeport-McMoran (FCX) shares reportedly tumble about 9.5% as copper faces a proposed or announced 50% tariff. The headline suggests the tariff raises costs and dampens trade flows or demand expectations for copper, creating near-term bearish pressure on copper prices.

title: Zeb Nickel Corp.: Zeb Nickel Project Successfully Completes SpectremPlus AEM Survey
summary: Zeb Nickel Corp. reports completion of a SpectremPlus airborne electromagnetic survey over its Zeb Nickel Project in South Africa, with final processed datasets and 3D inversion models expected by end of August. The company will integrate EM with gravity and magnetic data to refine drill targets for high-grade nickel sulphide mineralisation.

title: Why U.S. copper tariff exemption won't fully ease price rises
summary: The U.S. copper tariff exemption was narrowed to semi-finished copper (pipes, rods, sheets, wires) while excluding cathode, ores, concentrates and scraps. Traders reacted sharply, sending COMEX copper down ~19% intraday and reducing the U.S. premium versus LME. Analysts expect follow-through pressure as inventories build.

title: Unifor Members At Dajcor Aluminum On Strike - Canadian Manufacturing
summary: Unifor says workers at Dajcor Aluminum in Chatham started a strike after rejecting a tentative agreement and accusing the company of preparing to remove equipment and bring in scab labor. The dispute follows past public funding for capacity expansion, and aims to protect jobs at the aluminium facility.

title: Copper's Long-Term Fundamentals Remain Strong, Anglo American CEO Says on Bloomberg TV
summary: Anglo American CEO Duncan Wanblad said copper’s long-term fundamentals remain “absolutely fantastic” amid energy-transition demand and supply constraints. He also discussed the impact of new Trump-era tariffs: 50% duties on imported copper products, but not on raw copper. Market focus is on how the tariff could affect near-term copper sentiment.

title: Explainer-What impact will US plans to restrict copper scrap exports have?
summary: Reuters discusses planned US rules restricting copper scrap exports from 2027, requiring at least 25% of “high-quality” scrap to stay in the US. Analysts say near-term effects may be small since the US consumes over 40% of its generated scrap. Definitions and enforcement could matter for future supply balances.

title: Copper Turns Lower in London Following U.S. Tariff Exemptions -- Commodities Roundup
summary: Copper prices in London fell after the U.S. announced a 50% tariff on copper products but exempted raw copper, allowing about 250,000 tons in U.S. warehouses to be re-exported. Comex saw its biggest daily drop since 1988, and LME three-month futures dropped around 1.2%.

title: Copper Turns Lower in London Following U.S. -2-
summary: Copper prices fell sharply after the U.S. granted a surprise exemption for refined metal from parts of its copper-products tariff. LME three-month copper dropped ~1.1%, while Comex prices fell over 20% as traders unwind pre-tariff long positions, collapsing the Comex–LME premium.

title: Canada spared from 50% copper tariff as U.S. targets China, expert says
summary: The U.S. plans a 50% tariff on semi-finished copper items like pipes, tubes, and wiring, targeting China. Canada is largely exempt because it exports mostly raw/refined copper (concentrate, anodes, cathodes). The tariff move initially hit U.S. Comex copper, falling over 17% and reversing recent premiums.

title: Canada will be spared from 50% copper tariff as U.S. targets China, expert says
summary: The headline says Canada will be spared from a proposed 50% U.S. copper tariff, with the measure aimed at China instead. By reducing the risk of a direct tariff-driven supply shock for Canadian copper, expectations should be supportive for near-term copper prices.

title: "Three Consecutive Increases" in Aluminum Wheel Exports; Operating Rate of Primary Aluminum Alloy Rebounds Against the Cycle in July [Analysis by SMM]
summary: SMM reports July’s primary aluminium alloy PMI and operating rate improved, supported by billet production cuts and conversion to alloys, with new export orders rebounding. However, it warns demand remains weak in the off-season, high aluminium prices reduce demand, and US-China tariffs keep export expectations uncertain. Aluminium wheel exports held up but may need deeper adjustment.

title: Semi-annual Review of Recycled Copper Raw Materials: Domestic Production Falls Short, Overseas Supply Severely Mismatched
summary: China’s implementation of “reverse invoicing” and renewed China-US tariff conflict is disrupting recycled copper raw material procurement and limiting market circulation. After tariffs resumed, domestic copper prices fell and trading inventories were hit, with cargoes held back. Scrap spreads narrowed, and outlook remains uncertain with weak rebounds in coming weeks.

title: Trek Bicycle Announces Industry-First Shift to Low-Emission Aluminum
summary: Trek will make nearly all its aluminum bicycle frames from October 2025 using aluminum sourced from renewable-powered facilities, recycled content, or both, limiting emissions to 11 kg CO2e/kg or less. Trek frames this as a major shift in its aluminum supply chain and supports broader adoption.

title: Tariff Chaos As Massive Copper Trade Suffers Record Implosion
summary: The US imposed 50% tariffs on copper imports but exempted refined metals, disrupting the main international copper trade and collapsing the CME-LME basis market. US copper prices suffered a record plunge as traders had rushed shipments before the levies. The New York premium versus London evaporated and turned negative.

title: Trump Nukes Copper Spec-Longs, Points to China
summary: Copper futures plunged more than 19% in minutes after a White House tariff announcement. A 50% duty starts Aug. 1 on semi-finished copper imports and copper-intensive derivatives, while refined copper cathodes are exempt for now. The surprise exemption and delayed schedule led to aggressive unwinding of long positions.

title: U.S.-Canada Trade Talks Dealing With Aluminum-Tariff Levels, Bessent Says
summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said trade talks with Canada focus on aluminum tariff levels as firms such as Ford report large tariff costs. Canada faces a 50% aluminum tariff into the U.S., and talks aim to resolve the tariff row before a deadline. Possible relief would support aluminum sentiment.

title: Copper market forgot Trump's tendency to chicken out on his most extreme tariff threats
summary: Trump’s copper tariff proclamation takes effect Friday but targets semi-manufactured imports (wire/tube) while excluding refined copper until at least 2027. Traders reacted sharply: CME U.S. copper futures fell over 20%, the prior LME premium collapsed, and physical supply is now heavy in the U.S., pressuring prices.

title: President Trump Issues Executive Order Imposing a 50% Tariff on Semi-Finished Copper Products and Intensive Copper Derivatives | Husch Blackwell LLP
summary: President Trump issued an executive order imposing a 50% tariff on imports of semi-finished copper products and “intensive copper derivatives,” effective for goods entered or withdrawn for consumption on or after Aug. 1, 2025. The tariff is additive to other duties and limits duty drawback, with potential scope expansion within 90 days.

title: Copper Market Reels From Tariff Surprise
summary: The report says the copper market is reacting to a major tariff surprise, driving violent swings and unprecedented trade dislocation. It notes the S&P GSCI Copper Index is down 0.54% at the time of reporting, pointing to near-term bearish pressure as tariff-related demand and trade flows are disrupted.

title: U.S. Copper Prices Post Biggest Loss Ever as Traders Unwind Stockpiles -- Update
summary: Copper prices plunged as traders reacted to a U.S. proclamation imposing a 50% tariff on copper products while exempting raw copper. The decision allowed re-export of about 250,000 tons in U.S. warehouses, crushing the Comex-LME spread and driving a record one-day Comex drop.

title: Capstone Copper Corp.: Capstone Copper Reports Second Quarter 2025 Results
summary: Capstone Copper reported Q2 2025 results with record consolidated copper production (57,416 tonnes) and higher EBITDA, driven largely by Mantoverde sulphide ramp-up. It also received the Mantoverde Optimized environmental permit, removing throughput permit constraints. C1 cash costs fell year-on-year, with reiterated 2025 guidance.

title: Trump Strikes 90-Day Tariff Deal with Mexico on Fentanyl, Steel, Copper
summary: Trump announced a 90-day extension of the U.S.-Mexico trade deal that keeps steep tariffs on industrial metals. Mexico will pay 50% tariffs on aluminum and copper (along with steel) and 25% on fentanyl, alongside requirements to eliminate non-tariff trade barriers. Cartel-finance sanctions add pressure on Mexico.

title: Ero Copper Reports Second Quarter 2025 Operating and
summary: Ero Copper reported record Q2 2025 consolidated copper production of 15,513 tonnes, driven by ramp-up at Tucumã (commercial production effective July 1) and higher output at Caraíba. The firm updated 2025 copper production guidance based on these improvements and cost performance, indicating stronger near-term supply potential.

title: Why Southern Copper Corporation (SCCO) is a Top Pick for Materials Dividends in 2025
summary: The piece highlights Southern Copper’s status as a major integrated copper producer and notes approved projects to expand output (156,000 tons by 2027 and additional growth by 2032). It also discusses its long dividend record and current dividend yield. The content is copper-focused but largely long-term.

title: US to Impose 50% Tariffs on Copper Imports Starting Friday
summary: The US plans to impose a 50% tariff on copper imports starting Friday, according to the headline. The measure is expected to increase the cost of imported copper, potentially reducing near-term import demand/flows and weighing on copper market expectations over the coming days.

title: Transcript : Capstone Copper Corp., Q2 2025 Earnings Call, Jul 31, 2025
summary: Capstone Copper’s Q2 2025 earnings call transcript can influence short-term copper market sentiment through updates on production, cost trends, and guidance. The excerpt provided includes only the operator introduction, with no disclosed operational or financial metrics, so the net near-term price impact cannot be determined from the text shown.

title: Tim Ayres says federal government not ruling out support for copper smelter
summary: Glencore says forecast losses of about $2.2 billion over seven years could force closure of its Mount Isa smelter, threatening thousands of jobs. Queensland is on board with assistance, while the federal government is not ruling out further support, potentially reducing copper supply-risk expectations.

title: Copper Extends Steep Fall, Sparked by Modification of Trump's Tariff Plan for Metal's Imports
summary: Copper prices extended a steep decline, falling to the lowest in nearly four months. The article links the shock to President Trump modifying his metal import tariff plan, excluding some copper products (pipes and wiring) from a 50% tariff list. The move triggered strong bearish technical signals and record weekly losses.

title: Safety at risk after copper wire stolen in Alberta
summary: Copper wire theft in Alberta is disrupting telecom and critical services, with police reporting large-scale damage and increasing theft frequency. The article also details provincial and federal legislative efforts to improve scrap traceability and deter theft. By tightening illicit copper supply, it may support near-term copper price expectations.

title: Mexican Aluminium Market Diversifies Beyond US Dependence
summary: Fastmarkets reports Mexico’s primary aluminium market has thin spot liquidity, with producers reducing capacity and imports/exports constrained by tariff uncertainty. Participants expect imported premium pressure to stay downward as inventories linger. The market is also “in limbo” pending US-Mexico talks, suggesting additional downside risk for aluminium prices and premiums.

title: Gov't Holds Emergency Meeting to Discuss Impact of U.S. Tariff on Copper Imports
summary: The government held an emergency meeting to discuss how a U.S. tariff would affect copper imports. The policy change is expected to reduce incoming copper supply or raise delivered costs, supporting near-term expectations for firmer copper prices over the next days to weeks.

title: Simpang Pulai factory raided, over RM8.5mil in copper, equipment seized
summary: Authorities raided a factory in Simpang Pulai, seizing more than RM8.5 million worth of copper materials and machinery and arresting a suspect. Officials say the site processed materials potentially intended for export and operated without Environment Department approval. The case is under environmental enforcement, with monitoring continuing in nearby states.

title: Collapse at Chile's major copper mine kills 1 worker and leaves 5 missing
summary: A collapse at Chile’s major copper mine reportedly killed one worker and left five missing. The accident raises the likelihood of production disruption and near-term supply uncertainty. While the full impact on output is unclear, such events commonly weigh on copper price expectations over coming days.

title: 【SMM Analysis】Weekly Review of Indonesian Nickel Market - 8.1
summary: SMM’s weekly Indonesia review finds nickel ore benchmarks slightly higher, while pyrometallurgical ore demand remains cautious amid smelter negative margins. In contrast, high-nickel pig iron (NPI) prices rose, activity improved, and discounts versus electrolytic nickel narrowed, supported by stainless steel sentiment, implying mildly bullish nickel near-term.

title: Glencore accused of discharging copper concentrate dust at Horne smelter | iNFOnews
summary: Quebec has charged Glencore under environmental laws for allegedly releasing copper concentrate dust at its Horne smelter in March 2023. Residents reported “black snow,” and Glencore attributed it to wind gusts and dry stockpile conditions. The company faced cleanup costs and could face fines, with no stated production impact.

title: New Tariff Actions Announced Back-to-Back from the White House: Copper 232, Brazil Tariffs, and De Minimis | Kelley Drye & Warren LLP
summary: The White House issued executive orders imposing a 50% Section 232 tariff on imports of semi-finished copper products and copper-intensive derivative goods (tariff based on copper content), effective Aug. 1, 2025. It also suspends de minimis entry for shipments under $800, increasing duty exposure for low-value imports.

title: Unionized Dajcor Aluminum plant workers on strike in Chatham | The Stratford Beacon Herald
summary: Unionized workers at Dajcor Aluminum’s Chatham facility began a strike after rejecting a tentative wage agreement. Unifor alleged the company planned to remove equipment and use scab labour, risking job losses and production integrity. Dajcor said it will still meet customer requirements but strikes may disrupt aluminium extrusion, fabrication and anodizing output.

title: Unionized Dajcor Aluminum plant workers on strike in Chatham
summary: Unionized workers at the Dajcor aluminum plant in Chatham are on strike, according to the report. The work stoppage is expected to interrupt aluminum production, potentially tightening near-term supply and supporting aluminum prices over the next days to weeks, depending on outage duration.

title: Which Side Are You On, Girl?
summary: Union workers at Dajcor Aluminum’s Chatham plant are on strike after rejecting a tentative contract, alleging the company plans to remove equipment and use scab labour. The stoppage risks disrupting aluminum extrusions, fabrication, and anodizing deliveries. The dispute is ongoing while both sides negotiate wages and terms.

title: Night Vision
summary: Police are investigating an attempted theft at a construction site near Wiltshire Drive in Chippenham after two men were seen acting suspiciously around 4am, including pushing a wheelbarrow. Officers say the target was copper pipes and request public information via 101 or Crimestoppers.

title: Search Intensifies For Five Trapped In Giant Chile Copper Mine
summary: Rescue efforts are underway after a seismic event caused a partial collapse and killed a worker, halting operations at Chile’s El Teniente mine. The world’s largest underground copper site contributes a large share of Chilean output, so the outage raises short-term supply concerns for copper.

title: 1 Dead, 5 Trapped After Copper Mine Collapses Following 4.2 Magnitude Earthquake
summary: A 4.2 magnitude earthquake caused a collapse at a copper mine, leaving one dead and five trapped. The incident is expected to disrupt operations and near-term copper supply, which can improve short-term price expectations for copper as markets anticipate reduced output and recovery time.

title: 'Bigger than it's ever been': Safety at risk after copper wire stolen in Alberta
summary: Copper theft in Alberta is intensifying, with telecommunications (TELUS) reporting many incidents and crews sometimes taking days to repair damaged lines and towers. The piece links theft to the scrap copper market and rising copper prices, prompting calls for tougher regulation and improved traceability to curb stolen supply.

title: Materials Down After Weak Jobs Data, Copper Rout -- Materials Roundup
summary: Copper and other materials fell after weak U.S. jobs data and tariff developments. Copper futures dropped 23% this week, the biggest weekly decline since 1968. The tariff on copper imports was narrower than feared, but trade and spread dynamics (U.S. premium vs London) still pushed prices sharply lower.

title: Glencore accused of discharging copper concentrate dust at Horne smelter in Quebec
summary: Quebec charged Glencore’s Horne smelter with an alleged breach of environmental laws after residents reported “black snow” in March 2023. The charge follows an investigation linked to copper concentrate dust. Glencore cites dry stockpile conditions and past cleanup, and faces fines, but no production disruption is mentioned.

title: Teams race to rescue trapped workers at world's largest underground copper mine
summary: Rescue teams in Chile are working to reach five trapped miners after a tremor caused tunnel collapses at the world’s largest underground copper mine. Codelco has halted copper extraction and said the next 48 hours are critical, implying near-term production disruption and possible supply tightness risk for copper.

title: Quebec's aluminum processors press Ottawa for support as trade talks continue
summary: AluQuébec is pressing Ottawa for subsidies as U.S.-imposed aluminum tariffs on Canadian goods remain high and trade talks appear stalled. The U.S. threatened further tariff increases after a missed deadline. The Aluminum Association reports demand in the U.S. and Canada fell in Q1, adding near-term downside pressure.

title: One dead, five trapped in Chile copper mine collapse
summary: A seismic event triggered a partial collapse at Codelco’s El Teniente copper mine in Chile, killing one worker and trapping five underground. Codelco suspended operations in affected areas and evacuated workers, with the “next 48 hours crucial.” Operations disruption at the world’s largest underground copper deposit supports tight near-term supply expectations.

title: Donors offer $5 billion to Pakistan for Reko Diq copper, gold mining project in Balochistan: Report
summary: Pakistan’s government says multinational donors including ADB, IDB, IFC and US Exim Bank offered $5 billion to fund the Reko Diq copper and gold project in Balochistan. The project is nearing financial close and aims to start copper and gold production by 2028, with financing and investor efforts accelerating.

title: Chile continues rescue operations of workers trapped in world's largest copper mine
summary: Chile is continuing rescue operations after an earthquake partially collapsed the world’s largest copper mine. One worker has died and production has been halted, with teams working to rescue five trapped employees. The production stoppage creates short-term copper supply uncertainty, likely pressuring prices downward until output resumes.

title: One dead, five trapped after giant Chile copper mine collapses
summary: A giant copper mine in Chile reportedly collapsed, leaving one person dead and five trapped. Such incidents can halt operations, disrupt near-term copper supply, and increase short-term risk premiums, which is generally bearish for copper prices over the coming days as market participants price potential production losses.

title: Rescue workers race to save five men trapped in Chilean copper mine
summary: Rescue workers are racing to save five men trapped in a copper mine in Chile. The incident could disrupt near-term mine operations and create a short-lived supply risk for copper, but the report provides no information on how long production might be affected, making any price impact unclear.

title: Disruptions to China's Copper Concentrate Imports This Year [SMM Analysis]
summary: SMM lowers its 2025 forecast for China copper concentrate imports amid U.S.-China tariff disputes (imports from the U.S. drop to zero in June) and risks of earlier tightening of Indonesia’s export quota. Higher spot TC offers and potential quota cuts imply less smelter feed for China, supporting copper prices.

title: Two dead, four trapped in Chile copper mine collapse
summary: A collapse at Chile’s Codelco El Teniente copper mine has killed two workers and trapped others. Codelco is still reaching the blocked tunnels and investigating whether the trigger was mining activity or a 4.2 quake. Rescue and added caution could slow production recovery, pressuring near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Rescuers recover body of trapped worker at Chile copper mine
summary: Rescuers recovered the body of a worker trapped at a copper mine in Chile. The incident highlights a disruption to operations at a producing site, which can influence expectations for near-term copper supply and tightness. Specific impacts on output duration were not provided in the excerpt.

title: Rescue workers find body amid race to save people trapped in Chile copper mine
summary: Rescue workers in Chile found a body inside the El Teniente copper mine after an earthquake triggered a collapse. Five miners remain trapped as rescuers drill through about 295 feet of rock. Codelco described the incident as a seismic event and reported injuries, suggesting short-term copper output disruption.

title: Two dead, five missing after Chile copper mine collapse
summary: Chile’s El Teniente copper mine collapse has reportedly killed two workers, while five others remain missing and trapped. Codelco said human remains were found during ongoing search operations. The accident raises short-term production and supply disruption concerns for Chilean copper output.

title: Rescue efforts continue to reach group trapped in Chile copper mine
summary: Rescue efforts continue after an earthquake collapsed Chile’s El Teniente copper mine, one of the country’s largest operated by Codelco. One body was found and authorities are identifying others while teams drill through 295 feet of rock. The incident is attributed to a seismic event, risking short-term copper output disruption.

title: Rescuers recover body of one of five workers trapped at Chile copper mine
summary: Rescuers recover the body of one of five workers trapped at a Chile copper mine. The incident highlights ongoing disruptions and potential operational constraints at the site. In the near term, traders may adjust expectations for copper output and supply availability.

title: Collapsed Chile mine: Race against time to rescue miners trapped under collapse at the world's largest underground copper mine after two are found dead
summary: A partial collapse at Codelco’s El Teniente underground copper mine in Chile, triggered by a seismic event, has killed two workers and left five trapped. Codelco has halted production at the site while rescue drilling continues. The incident is expected to disrupt near-term copper supply as reporting guidance is delayed.

title: Overview of Q2 2025 Copper Production from the World's Top 13 Mining Companies [SMM Analysis]
summary: SMM summarizes Q2 2025 copper output from 13 top mining groups: 2.642 million tonnes, slightly lower YoY but higher QoQ. Individual miners cite grade/recovery issues, equipment and power constraints, and some ramp-ups (e.g., Oyu Tolgoi, Las Bambas). Panama’s project clears safety steps, enabling shipments.

title: Rescue efforts under way to reach group trapped in Chile copper mine
summary: Rescue efforts continue at Codelco’s El Teniente copper mine in Chile after a strong tremor triggered a collapse, trapping five workers. Three were later found dead, bringing fatalities to four. Teams are clearing blocked passages and Codelco is investigating whether mining activity or tectonic shifts caused the incident.

title: Collapse at Chile's major copper mine kills 1 worker, leaves 5 missing
summary: A collapse at a major underground copper mine in Chile killed one worker and left five missing underground. Authorities reported injuries to other workers and forced Chile’s state mining company to suspend operations in affected areas of the world’s largest underground copper deposit, signaling a near-term supply disruption.

title: All five missing miners confirmed dead after Chile copper mine collapse
summary: Five miners were found dead after a shaft collapse at Codelco’s El Teniente copper mine in Chile. The collapse followed a 4.2 earthquake, and Codelco halted operations in the affected section and evacuated workers. Prosecutors are investigating whether the quake was natural or mining-related, raising near-term supply concerns for copper.

title: Trapped miners in Chile's copper mine found dead after three-day rescue mission
summary: Five miners died after a shaft collapse at Chile’s El Teniente copper mine following a 4.2 earthquake. Codelco halted operations in the affected section and evacuated workers, while prosecutors investigate whether mining activity contributed. The disruption at the world’s largest underground copper mine can tighten near-term copper supply expectations.

title: All five miners trapped after copper mine collapse in Chile found dead
summary: All five miners trapped after a copper mine collapse in Chile have been found dead. The incident suggests production at the mine has been disrupted, raising near-term supply concerns for copper, which can weigh on expectations and sentiment for copper prices over the following days.

title: The bodies of all 5 miners are found and identified in copper mine after collapse
summary: All five miners trapped in a shaft collapse at Chile’s El Teniente copper mine were found and identified after three days. The mine operator Codelco halted output in the affected section and evacuated thousands, with investigations into whether mining activity contributed to the quake.

title: Bodies of Trapped Miners Recovered After Collapse at World's Largest Underground Copper Mine – The Yeshiva World
summary: Bodies of five trapped miners were recovered after a shaft collapse at Chile’s El Teniente, the world’s largest underground copper mine, following a 4.2 earthquake. Operations were halted in the affected section and workers evacuated, with authorities investigating causes and possible safety violations.

title: Goldman Sachs under fire after faulty advice to invest in copper
summary: Goldman Sachs advised clients to buy copper based on an expected 50% US import tariff. When the announced duties proved limited and exempted the most traded copper type, Comex copper prices fell about 22% within hours. Goldman later apologized, underscoring how tariff signals rapidly move copper markets.

title: Japan's Mitsubishi Materials may scale back copper smelting due to worsening margins
summary: Mitsubishi Materials is considering cutting copper concentrate processing at its Onahama smelter as falling TC/RC charges squeeze smelting margins. The firm warned further margin erosion from miners’ terms. With peers also weighing production cuts, investors may expect tighter refined copper supply in coming weeks.

title: Trek Bicycle Announces Industry-First Shift To Low-Emission Aluminum
summary: Trek will source nearly all aluminum bicycle frames from facilities powered by renewable energy and/or using recycled content, making low-emission aluminium the default across its alloy lineup from October 2025. The change covers over one million bikes annually and aims to cut aluminium’s lifecycle emissions, potentially boosting demand for lower-carbon supply.

title: 50% tariff imposed on copper semi-finished products! Who is at the center of the storm?
summary: Trump signed a proclamation imposing a 50% tariff on US imports of semi-finished copper products and copper-rich derivatives from Aug. 1. The article cites large US import volumes for copper semis and wire/cable, implying higher landed costs, reduced flows into the US, and firmer copper price expectations.

title: From Arizona to Indiana, copper tariffs will spark a U.S. industrial comeback
summary: The article says President Trump will impose Section 232 tariffs on imported copper, including a 50% duty on semi-finished and derivative copper products and phased higher tariffs on refined copper. It argues tariffs will boost domestic refining, reduce import dependence, and thus support U.S. copper supply chains and prices.

title: Indonesia's state-owned firm prioritizes domestic copper supply while expanding in Asia-Xinhua
summary: Indonesia’s state-controlled copper producer PT Freeport Indonesia said it will keep prioritizing domestic market demand while continuing exports to Asian markets. The emphasis on supplying local industry could imply relatively less copper available to international buyers, which may weigh on near-term copper price expectations despite ongoing exports.

title: Tribe, environmentalists seek ruling against Oak Flat copper mine as deadline nears
summary: The headline reports that Indigenous groups and environmentalists are seeking a court ruling to stop the Oak Flat copper mine as a deadline approaches. If the challenge prevents or delays mining approvals, it would tighten expected near-term copper supply and likely weigh on copper prices.

title: Vedanta sees Aluminium costs falling below $1,700/t in H2FY26 as Sijimali bauxite mine nears approval
summary: Vedanta expects primary aluminium cash (hot-metal) costs to fall below $1,700/t in H2FY26 as Train II at Lanjigarh ramps captive alumina and the Sijimali bauxite mine nears approval. Alumina cash costs are targeted to drop with higher captive mix, alongside debottlenecking and smelter capacity upgrades.

title: Trump's Copper TACO Move To Trigger Huge Market Revamp
summary: The White House exempted raw copper from a planned 50% tariff on July 30, reversing tariff-driven supply fears. COMEX copper futures fell over 20% in a day, the COMEX-LME spread collapsed, and inventories reportedly shifted toward the US, leaving expectations for copper to move into discount versus LME.

title: "Tariff Tsunami": New Copper Tariffs and Changes to De Minimis Duty Exemption | Troutman Pepper Locke
summary: The article says President Trump imposed a 50% Section 232 tariff on a range of copper products effective Aug. 1, 2025, citing national security concerns and the U.S.’s reliance on foreign copper. It also ends the de minimis duty exemption for low-value non-postal imports effective Aug. 29, potentially shifting trade flows.

title: Bodies of All 5 Missing Miners Found as Death Toll in Copper Mine Collapse Reaches 6
summary: The report states that all five missing miners were found dead and that the copper mine collapse death toll has reached six. The incident suggests the affected mine is likely suspended or operating with constraints, raising short-term concerns about copper supply disruption.

title: SC partly rejects VAT claim in Coral Bay Nickel ecozone case
summary: The Philippine Supreme Court partly rejected a VAT exemption argument by Coral Bay Nickel Corp., a PEZA-registered exporter. It ruled the cross-border VAT doctrine doesn’t apply to inputs consumed outside the ecozone and confirmed VAT applies within customs territory, while limiting refunds for unutilized input VAT.

title: The "Illusion of Slight Increase" in China's Blister Copper RCs: A Brief Analysis of Supply-Demand Imbalance in the August Market [SMM Analysis]
summary: SMM reports stable-to-higher July blister copper RCs and a slight rebound early August, but warns August supply is “not optimistic.” It expects copper concentrate shortages, limited anode imports, falling scrap supply, and secondary-to-rod capacity shifts to keep blister/anode supply tight. Demand for anode remains high for cathode production.

title: Unearthing US Vulnerabilities: President Trump Outlines Steps to Strengthen the US Copper Industry | Mayer Brown
summary: The Trump administration says it investigated copper imports under Section 232 on national-security grounds and then imposed new tariffs on copper and copper-intensive derivative products. The policy targets greater domestic copper mining, smelting and refining, aiming to reduce reliance on imports and support US copper businesses.

title: Star Copper Corp.: Star Copper Announces Plans for Fully Funded Fall 2025 Phase 2 Drill Campaign in Golden Triangle of BC
summary: Star Copper reports newly processed geophysical data and plans for a fully funded Phase 2 drill campaign in fall 2025 at its Star copper-gold project in British Columbia’s Golden Triangle. The company is building on Phase 1 results with deeper step-out drilling across Star Main, Star North, Star East, and Copper Creek targets.

title: Southern Hemisphere, FMR lock-in Chilean copper-gold JV
