title: Infrastructure and power push in Union Budget likely to ramp up aluminium demand: NALCO CMD
summary: NALCO’s CMD said India’s aluminium demand should stay strong as the government is expected to keep prioritising infrastructure development and power sector expansion in the upcoming Union Budget. The statement implies improved demand outlook for aluminium, which could support short-term aluminium price expectations.

title: THE ECONOMIST: The race for copper has brought a wave of mining mega-mergers
summary: The Economist says mining mega-mergers are accelerating in response to a copper race. It highlights strong copper price gains, rising long-term demand expectations, and constrained/declining mine head grades plus slower new supply. It argues acquisitions may secure assets but won’t quickly solve processing/refining bottlenecks.

title: Chinese crack down on high-frequency traders hits copper, zinc, tin, nickel, and lead prices on the London Metal Exchange
summary: Chinese regulators’ crackdown on high-frequency trading aimed at reducing volatility and leveling access for retail investors led to a weekend speed bump in base-metal prices on the LME. The article says copper and nickel’s early-year rally hit a pause, indicating near-term sentiment/liquidity effects rather than fundamentals.

title: Chinese crack down on high-frequency traders hits copper, zinc, tin, nickel, and lead prices on the London Metal Exchange
summary: Chinese regulators have cracked down on high-frequency traders in base metals on the London Metal Exchange, aiming to reduce market imbalance and volatility. After a strong early-year run, the policy shift caused a weekend speed bump, weighing on copper and nickel prices and potentially altering short-term trading conditions.

title: 18, 22 or 25 Million Tons? Indonesia's Bauxite 2026 Plot Twist
summary: The article weighs scenarios for Indonesia’s 2026 bauxite RKAB quotas (18, 22, or 25 Mt) against 23–25 Mt projected demand tied to alumina refinery expansions. A most-likely 18–22 Mt outcome implies tighter supply discipline and potential bauxite price normalization, supporting higher near-term expectations for aluminium-related feedstock costs.

title: Litchfield goes deep on NT copper-gold hunt
summary: Litchfield Minerals has started a maiden diamond drilling campaign at its Oonagalabi copper-gold project in Australia’s Northern Territory after RC drilling returned broad copper-zinc assays and gold-bismuth intercepts. The program targets intrusive zones and geophysical conductors tied to potential IOCG/IOG mineralization.

title: Panama's Mulino to Announce Decision on Future of Copper Mine
summary: Panama’s President Mulino expects to announce by mid-year a decision on the future of First Quantum’s Cobre Panama copper mine. The government’s steps include approval for removal and processing of stockpiled ore. First Quantum welcomes the progress and remains open to negotiations, keeping supply prospects positive for copper.

title: Barrick selected Metso's flotation technology for the Lumwana expansion copper project
summary: Barrick selected Metso’s Concorde Cell flotation technology for its Lumwana copper project expansion in Zambia, integrating it with the previously chosen TankCell system. Metso’s high-intensity forced-air technology is aimed at improving flotation kinetics and recovery. The equipment order was booked in Metso’s 2025 Q3 intake.

title: ONGold Resources Ltd.: ONGold Intercepts High-Grade Copper, Silver with Gold in Newly Identified Massive Sulphide Zone at Gold Ridge: 11.10% Cu, 218 g/t Ag and 4.45 g/t Au over 0.4 Metres in Hole GR-25-012
summary: ONGold Resources reported new, high-grade copper results from drilling at its TPK Gold Ridge project, including up to 11.1% Cu over 0.40 m within a near-surface massive sulphide zone. The news supports exploration progress but provides no production or operational details that would affect copper supply in the near term.

title: Antofagasta Copper Output Set to Increase Significantly
summary: Antofagasta’s CEO says the company is on track to increase copper output by nearly 30% before the end of the decade, supported by permitting reform and faster project execution in Chile and other jurisdictions. The piece also notes industry cost pressures and higher throughput needs, but supply growth expectations weigh on copper sentiment.

title: Copper miner 29Metals launches $150m equity raising
summary: 29Metals, an Australian copper miner, launched a $150m entitlement offer to support its capital position as it seeks to rebuild confidence during a period of stronger commodity prices. The funding is company-specific and does not provide explicit changes to near-term copper supply or demand, so market impact on copper pricing appears limited.

title: BHP Upgrades Copper Output Guidance; Raises Potash Project Cost Estimate Further
summary: BHP raised its fiscal-year copper output guidance to 1.9–2.0 million metric tons, citing stronger delivery across assets. Copper production in Q2 was 490,500 tons. The company simultaneously increased its cost estimate for Canada’s Jansen potash project, but the copper upgrade is the near-term supportive signal.

title: BHP Upgrades Copper Output Guidance; Raises Cost of Potash Project Again -- Update
summary: BHP upgraded its fiscal-year copper production guidance to 1.9–2.0 million tonnes, citing strong output at Chile’s Escondida mine. The move reinforces market expectations of tight near-term supply, with U.S. copper futures at record highs amid demand strength and supply disruptions. A separate potash cost overrun was also reported.

title: Hot Chili nails further wide, shallow copper-gold hits in Chile
summary: Hot Chili released further drill results from its La Verde copper-gold discovery in Chile, reporting long, near-surface copper intercepts (e.g., 495m at 0.38% Cu) and additional high-grade zones. Management says this could add open-pit feed to its Costa Fuego hub, potentially extending mine life.

title: Vale Indonesia appeals nickel quota, says granted volume is too low - Companies
summary: PT Vale Indonesia is appealing Indonesia’s approval of its annual production plan (RKAB) after receiving only about 30% of the nickel ore quota it requested. The shortfall may jeopardize supply commitments for three HPAL plants, including a major Pomalaa project, creating potential near-term nickel supply uncertainty.

title: Alara Resources Dispatches 33rd Copper Concentrate Shipment
summary: Alara Resources said it dispatched its 33rd copper-concentrate shipment from the Al Wash-hi Majaza copper-gold mine in Oman. The January 18 departure from Sohar Port included 1,395 WMT of concentrate, containing about 243 MT of copper. The release tracks ongoing mine production across parcels.

title: BHP Lifts Copper Guidance on Record Output as Iron Ore and Coal Deliver
summary: BHP reported strong first-half FY26 results and lifted group copper production guidance after record output at several copper assets, including Escondida and Antamina. The company cited a favorable pricing environment and improved operational delivery, while iron ore and coal also performed well.

title: After a dip in 2025, First Quantum bets on copper rebound in Zambia
summary: First Quantum reported 2025 copper production in Zambia fell 8% to 370,000 tons but set out a steady rebound. Kansanshi volumes are guided higher into 2026–2028, driven by ramp-up of the S3 processing circuit and improved ore grades. Sentinel remains weaker on lower-grade ore and maintenance.

title: Dow Jones Top Company Headlines at 1 AM ET: BHP Upgrades Copper Output Guidance | Zurich ...
summary: The Dow Jones update highlights that BHP has upgraded its copper output guidance, now expecting 1.9–2.0 million metric tons of copper production for its fiscal year through June. The revision raises near-term production expectations and supports copper market sentiment over the coming weeks.

title: Litchfield hunts for hidden copper in NT with geophysics push
summary: Litchfield Minerals has begun an induced polarization (IP) geophysical survey at its Oonagalabi project in Australia’s Northern Territory to detect blind extensions of a copper-rich system under shallow cover. The survey aims to connect strike continuity toward Silver Valley and a VT1 conductor to refine drill targets, but no immediate production changes are described.

title: Sarytogan lights up Kazakh copper play in shallow drilling
summary: Sarytogan Graphite reports shallow drilling at Kazakhstan’s Baynazar project found a 600m-wide copper bedrock anomaly up to 0.5% Cu, with copper mineralisation confirmed by malachite and sulphide veinlets. Alteration patterns fit a copper porphyry system, supporting expectations for potential future copper resources.

title: Nanshan Aluminum Jumps After Unveiling Plan to Expand Electrolytic Aluminum Capacity in Indonesia
summary: Nanshan Aluminum shares rose after announcing a USD437 million plan to build a 250,000-ton electrolytic aluminum plant in Indonesia’s Bintan Industrial Estate. Construction is expected to take two years and is meant to leverage local bauxite resources and meet downstream demand. It follows a similar facility announced in April 2023.

title: Strong Finish! Enamelled Copper Wire Exports Maintained Momentum in December, with Full-Year Growth at 21%
summary: China’s exports of copper enamelled (winding) wire under HS 85441100 totaled 12,538 mt in December, and were up 21% YoY for full-year 2025. Demand stayed strong in Vietnam and several emerging markets like India and Turkey, supporting a generally bullish near-term copper-demand outlook.

title: Gunnison Copper Corp.: Gunnison Copper Eliminates Nebari Debt and Achieves Major Balance Sheet Milestone
summary: Gunnison Copper Corp. said it eliminated US$15.0 million of Nebari-related principal debt after receiving additional conversion notices, issuing 22.65 million shares. The company frames this as improved financial flexibility while advancing its Gunnison Project and supporting domestic copper supply; no operational or production change is stated.

title: Robust Demand for Secondary Copper with Full-Year 2025 Imports Exceeding 2.34 Million mt
summary: China imported 239,000 mt of secondary copper scrap in December 2025, and full-year 2025 imports totaled 2.3427 million mt, up 4.12% YoY. Growth was driven by Japan and especially Thailand’s surge, suggesting sustained demand for recycled copper feedstock.

title: FinancialContent - The Great Metal Migration: Aluminum Substitution Accelerates as Copper-Aluminum Price Ratio Pierces 4.2 Threshold
summary: The piece reports copper prices surging while the copper-to-aluminum ratio exceeds 4.2, prompting manufacturers to accelerate substitution toward aluminum across HVAC and electrical uses. It attributes copper strength to supply disruptions and geopolitics, while highlighting tight aluminum supply/cap constraints in China. Net effect: lower near-term copper demand prospects and price pressure.

title: What's happening with gold, silver and copper? A chief investment officer on why prices have soared and what could happen next
summary: The piece says gold and silver are rising on safe-haven flows, central bank buying, and Chinese demand, but it also points to copper climbing on a mix of cyclical optimism for 2026 and structural demand from technology, electric cars, and green energy. It implies continued support for copper prices near term.

title: FinancialContent - The Great Metal Migration: Aluminum Substitution Accelerates as Copper-Aluminum Price Ratio Pierces 4.2 Threshold
summary: The piece says the copper-to-aluminium price ratio has exceeded 4.2 after copper supply shocks and aluminium supply constraints in China, accelerating copper-to-aluminium substitution in HVAC/EV-related uses. It describes near-term aluminium demand tailwinds and highlights looming aluminium capacity/surplus risk, creating mixed price pressures.

title: FinancialContent - LME Copper Hits Record $13,000: Geopolitical Tensions and Supply Scarcity Drive New Super-Cycle
summary: LME copper surged past $13,000/tonne, driven by decade-low inventories, widening refined deficits, and geopolitical shock following US action in Venezuela raising South America supply-risk premiums. Analysts cite record scarcity and AI/energy-transition demand growth. The outlook suggests further volatility and potential substitution to aluminium only if copper remains very high.

title: Barrick selected Metso's Concorde Cell flotation technology for the Lumwana copper project in Zambia
summary: Barrick chose Metso’s Concorde Cell flotation technology for the Lumwana copper project in Zambia, to be used alongside TankCell® technology. The equipment is intended to improve flotation kinetics and recovery of fine particles. Metso said the Concorde Cell order was booked in its 3Q25 Minerals intake for 2024.

title: Investing: Congo offers manganese, copper‑cobalt, and lithium
summary: The DRC sent U.S. officials a shortlist of state assets for a minerals partnership, including Gecamines’ Mutoshi copper-cobalt project. It also cites U.S. backing for the Lobito Corridor upgrade to improve regional mining logistics. These steps could strengthen perceived copper supply flow from Congo.

title: Southern Copper Corporation (SCCO): A Bull Case Theory
summary: The article presents a bullish investment case for Southern Copper (SCCO), emphasizing it as a large, vertically integrated copper producer with low cash costs and a pipeline of Peru and Mexico projects. It argues resilience despite production dips and highlights byproduct leverage, but provides no concrete near-term market-moving copper shock.

title: BHP Jansen potash project: Cost blowout overshadows copper guidance upgrade
summary: BHP reported its December-quarter production and upgraded guidance for copper, described as the “hottest commodity.” The note is set against a separate issue: a cost blowout on BHP’s Jansen potash project. While potash details don’t directly affect traded metals here, the copper upgrade is supportive.

title: Thieves Allegedly Stole Copper Wire From Streetlights, Left Entire Blocks In Darkness
summary: Copper wire theft from Los Angeles streetlights has reportedly left multiple blocks in darkness, with authorities citing over half of repair requests tied to wire theft. Rewiring costs exceed $2.5 million and legislation targets metal theft, implying higher replacement copper demand, which can support copper prices over the coming weeks.

title: FinancialContent - The Great Metal Rally of 2026: Gold, Silver, and Copper Surge Amidst Global Scarcity and Geopolitical Unrest
summary: The piece describes a 2026 industrial metals rally, highlighting copper at $5.84/lb and attributing strength to mine disruption at Freeport’s Grasberg, permit delays in North America and Chile, and rising demand from AI data centers and electrification. It anticipates continued volatility but overall bullish price pressure into early 2026.

title: Rio Tinto Posts Higher 2025 Production On Strong Copper And Iron Ore Performance
summary: Rio Tinto reported higher 2025 output, with copper production rising 11% to 883 thousand tonnes and exceeding guidance, helped by the Oyu Tolgoi underground ramp-up. Aluminium production increased 3% to 3.38 million tonnes. Q4 shipments also improved, suggesting steadier supply outlook.

title: Rio Tinto and Glencore merger: Impact on coal and copper | The Singleton Argus
summary: The article speculates on a possible Rio Tinto–Glencore merger. It says Rio wants Glencore for its copper mine assets and notes copper is in higher demand. Much of the discussion instead covers thermal-coal mine prospects in Australia, but the merger narrative has potential implications for copper supply expectations.

title: [SMM Analysis] China's Copper Scrap Import Landscape Shifts in 2025 – Japan Replaces US as Top Supplier
summary: China’s customs data show December 2025 copper scrap (HS 74040000) imports rose 14.81% MoM and 9.88% YoY to 239,000 mt, with full-year imports up 4.12% YoY to 2.34 million mt. Japan, Thailand and others increased supply as the US share collapsed, indicating steadier recycled feedstock inflows.

title: Structural Transformation in Aluminum Semis Exports, Processing Trade Charts a New Course
summary: China’s export tax rebate adjustment (ending the 13% rebate for aluminum semis and copper semis as of Dec 1, 2024) is linked to a fall in 2025 aluminum semi exports and a shift toward processing trade with imported materials. SMM expects higher processing trade share in 2026, supporting export competitiveness.

title: Seven Arrested for Copper Theft in Ontinyent, Montaverner, and L'Ollería - News, Sport, Information, Property, Business, Travel, Tourism
summary: Spanish Guardia Civil arrested seven people for copper wiring theft from public lighting in industrial parks in Montaverner and L’Ollería and from a company in Ontinyent. Damages total about €231,000. Authorities linked multiple thefts and describe a method of cutting and removing copper cables for resale.

title: Koryx Raises $33 Million to Advance Haib Copper Project in Namibia
summary: Koryx Copper raised about $33 million to advance its Haib copper project in Namibia, funding technical studies and exploration. A preliminary assessment suggests potential output of 88,000 tonnes per year, but Koryx plans a definitive feasibility update by late 2026, pointing to longer-term development rather than immediate supply changes.

title: Rio Tinto reports 8% increase in 2025 copper production
summary: Rio Tinto said 2025 copper equivalent output rose 8% and copper production climbed 11% YoY, with shipments up 5%, helped by Oyu Tolgoi ramp-up. The company also reported increased aluminium output (up 3% for the year) alongside bauxite growth, implying improved supply momentum.

title: Analysis of Import and Export Data for Unwrought Aluminum Alloy in 2025 [SMM Analysis]
summary: China’s customs data show unwrought aluminum alloy imports fell in 2025 but December imports rose MoM, while exports increased YoY. The weak import trend was tied to inverted domestic/overseas price spreads and higher overseas alloy ingot prices. Late-Dec/early-Jan ADC12 prices rose, reopening the import window and supporting aluminium demand expectations.

title: NITI Aayog unveils roadmap for cutting emissions in cement, aluminium, MSME sectors
summary: NITI Aayog released a decarbonisation roadmap for aluminium (and cement/MSMEs), projecting a major rise in aluminium output and highlighting high electricity-driven emissions. It recommends renewable power, dedicated RE grids, and transmission utility reforms for near-term action, aiming to reduce emissions and manage potential future export restrictions.

title: Sheriff: Copper theft causes widespread Whitley County outages Tuesday morning
summary: Whitley County, Kentucky officials said thieves cut and stole copper wire from utility lines near the Tennessee border, damaging cables and triggering power and cable outages lasting for hours. Deputies are investigating multiple similar thefts in recent months, but the incident appears localized with limited market impact.

title: Copper climbs with tight stocks, demand in focus
summary: Copper prices rose after a prior sharp drop as investors focused on tight inventories outside the U.S. The cash LME copper premium jumped above $100/ton, pointing to strong near-term demand, before flipping into a small discount. Traders raised doubts about whether demand will hold, especially with weaker Chinese premiums.

title: MacroAsia unit cleared to develop Palawan nickel project
summary: MacroAsia’s subsidiary received Mines and Geosciences Bureau clearance to develop and operate the Infanta Nickel Project in Palawan. The approval authorizes extraction and commercial disposition of nickel (and associated minerals) under MPSA terms, subject to environmental and regulatory conditions, after an ECC was issued in December 2023.

title: Potential nickel refinery in Richmond Hill draws support, criticism
summary: Westwin Elements is seeking a site in Richmond Hill, Georgia, to build a large nickel refinery producing Class 1 nickel for defense and energy security. The plan faces environmental, legal, and community opposition, and a previous similar effort stalled amid weaker nickel prices. Still, U.S. supply support is bullish for nickel sentiment.

title: 2026 Global Outlook for New Alumina Supply
summary: SMM expects China’s alumina capacity to rise to 118.92 million mt in 2026, with 8.6 million mt of new projects starting and 7.6 million mt in Guangxi. The added supply shifts Guangxi toward surplus, likely driving regional and national alumina price declines and increasing global competition, bearish for aluminium.

title: China's Copper Foil Customs Details for December 2025: Trade Deficit Narrowed [SMM Analysis]
summary: China’s copper foil imports rose in December 2025 (up 7.96% MoM) and copper clad laminate imports also increased (up 27.34% MoM). Copper foil exports surged YoY, narrowing the trade deficit. SMM links improved domestic capabilities and stronger Southeast Asia demand, suggesting firmer copper-based demand.

title: Copper Plate/Sheet and Strip Exports: Surged 25.4% YoY in December, Steady Growth for the Full Year, Inbound Processing Dominates Trade Structure [SMM Analysis]
summary: China’s exports of copper plate/sheet and strip totaled 10,133 mt in December 2025, down 6.9% MoM but up 25.4% YoY, and were steady for the full year (+0.88% YoY). Despite cancellation of copper export tax rebates from Dec 1, 2024, firms shifted to processing/bonded trade, lifting copper strip exports (+6.6% YoY).

title: South32 Posts Strong December Half-Year Gains Across Alumina, Aluminium, Copper, Zinc And Manganese
summary: South32 reported 3% higher December half-year alumina output and a 2% rise in aluminium production, citing record Brazil Alumina performance and increased Hillside capacity testing. Mozal ceased pot relining ahead of a planned March 2026 care-and-maintenance shift. Copper production met expectations with strong overall first-half volumes.

title: South32 Posts Strong December Half-Year Gains Across Alumina, Aluminium, Copper, Zinc And Manganese
summary: South32 reported a 3% rise in alumina production and 2% higher aluminium output in the December 2025 half-year, citing record Brazil Alumina performance and Hillside capacity testing, plus Mozal pot relining ahead of planned care and maintenance. Copper production was in line with expectations, so near-term effects are likely small.

title: Rising Copper Demand and India's Strategic Opportunity
summary: The piece argues copper demand is rising globally and in India, with copper prices having surged after a major Chilean mine strike triggered supply concerns. It notes India’s growing import dependence and suggests reopening Sterlite Copper under a green framework to expand domestic refining, potentially tightening near-term availability.

title: Noronex stretches copper-silver horizon in Namibia
summary: Noronex expanded its Namibia Powerline/Humpback–Damara exploration and reported new copper-silver drill intercepts, including 0.58% copper over 4m. Results extend mineralisation along the D’Kar–NPF contact and follow partner South32’s funding. The update is supportive for copper sentiment, but no near-term supply disruption is cited.

title: Capstone Copper Mines Deep Pockets (and Volumes)
summary: Capstone Copper reported record output in 2025 but is now disrupted by a labor strike at its Mantoverde mine, running at 50%–75% capacity since early January 2026. The company’s revenue and earnings remain sensitive to copper prices, implying near-term supply constraints that can weigh on copper demand/supply expectations.

title: Kingfisher Confirms Blind Copper-Gold Porphyry Discovery at Hank, HWY ...
summary: Kingfisher Metals reports final assays from drillhole HW-25-011 at its HWY 37 Project in BC, confirming a blind copper-gold porphyry discovery. Results include 425.0 m of 0.15% copper (0.40% CuEq). The company highlights open mineralization and targets for follow-up drilling in 2026.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Intersects Near-Surface Copper Mineralization from Five Drill Holes in the American Eagle Area
summary: Faraday Copper reports drill intercepts of near-surface mineralization at its Copper Creek Project in Arizona, including multiple copper grades above open-pit cutoff expectations. The company says Phase IV drilling continues to expand potential open-pit resources. The update is exploration-related and does not indicate immediate supply changes.

title: The copper boom in Zambia comes with a toxic price
summary: A burst dam at Sino-Metals’ Zambia copper mine released large quantities of acidic waste and toxic pollutants into waterways, harming farming and prompting foreign travel health warnings. The article links Zambia’s export reliance on copper to rising international prices, but highlights growing regulatory and disruption risk from repeated spills.

title: Fathom Nickel Inc.: Fathom Nickel Announces $3 Million Private Placement Including Strategic Participation by Crescat Capital LLC
summary: Fathom Nickel announced a C$3 million private placement to fund resumed drilling at its Gochager Lake Ni-Cu-Co project, with Crescat taking a strategic stake. The company cites a strengthening nickel market and plans a 3,000–4,000 meter program, but provides no immediate supply or inventory impact.

title: Abitibi Metals Continues to Expand High-Grade Copper-Gold Mineralization in the Western Down-Plunge, Highlighted by 12.83% CuEq over 5m | Company Announcement
summary: Abitibi Metals announced additional high-grade copper-gold intercepts from Phase 3 drilling at the B26 polymetallic deposit in Québec, including 12.83% CuEq over 5.0 metres. The company is expanding drilling into Phase 4 and highlights resource growth potential, implying incremental bullish sentiment for copper, but no confirmed near-term supply change.

title: FinancialContent - Freeport-McMoRan (FCX): The Red Metal Titan Navigating the Copper Supercycle
summary: Freeport-McMoRan’s Q4 2025 earnings and Indonesia milestones are framed around a copper-led upcycle. The article highlights copper trading above $6/lb, record realizations boosting results, full-capacity smelting enabling refined exports, and an Indonesian license extension supporting long-run supply rights. Risks remain from Grasberg recovery delays.

title: FinancialContent - Freeport-McMoRan Slumps Despite Earnings Beat as Investors Exit the "Copper Fever" Rally
summary: Freeport-McMoRan shares fell after an earnings beat as investors focused on operational setbacks in Indonesia, including a mud-rush that cut Grasberg copper output 39% and lifted cash costs. The company’s cautious 2026 copper outlook and Indonesia policy transition add near-term supply uncertainty for copper.

title: MMG Copper: Key Performance of Las Bambas Mine
summary: MMG said its Las Bambas copper output rose 27% in 2025 to 410,834 tonnes of concentrates, alongside higher output at other mines. The company expects 2026 production to be lower, citing cautious guidance, but highlights improved, disruption-free operations and stockpiled supplies.

title: Rio Tinto Copper Output Surges Amid Demand
summary: Rio Tinto said copper production rose 11% to 883,000 tonnes in 2024, helped by Oyu Tolgoi’s ramp-up. The piece links resilient output to expectations that supply deficits will widen despite mine-disruption risks, alongside tightening in copper concentrates markets and rising producer forecasts, supporting copper prices.

title: [SMM Analysis] Benchmark Loosening and Capacity Restructuring: The Global Copper Smelting Industry Faces Dual Transformation in "Pricing and Capacity."
summary: SMM describes rising copper concentrate demand from new smelting projects, driving a supply-demand imbalance and sharp declines in copper TC/RCs and benchmark pricing representativeness. It also cites delays in several China smelting projects, while overseas smelting capacity ramps up. Net near-term outlook implies tighter concentrate conditions supporting copper.

title: SMM Analysis: Aluminum Wire and Cable Exports Ended 2025 on a Strong Note, with Full-Year Exports Up 42.9% YoY
summary: SMM cites China’s aluminum wire and cable exports rising 42.9% YoY in 2025, with December also higher YoY. Growth is linked to renewed overseas spending on renewable energy and power grid modernization, supported by specific national policies in Australia and Tanzania. Export momentum is expected to persist into 2026.

title: The Proportion of EQ Imported Copper Cathode in China Continued to Rise in 2025!
summary: Full-year 2025 data show EQ copper cathode made up 67.54% of China’s total imports, rising year on year. Despite US siphoning some global cathode supply and diverting African material, China is expected to keep receiving high EQ cathode volumes in 2026 from Russia, Kazakhstan and others, implying supportive copper availability expectations.

title: Review of China's Copper Scrap Market in 2025: Reshaping Import Structure, Strengthening Domestic Circulation, and Rising Smelting Demand
summary: SMM reports China’s copper scrap imports rose in 2025, while Malaysia tightened rules and EU proposals may limit “critical” recycled material exports. Meanwhile low/negative concentrate TCs push smelters toward scrap-based anode plates, and tax/policy costs pause some processors. Net effect is stronger scrap availability pressure for copper refining.

title: [SMM Analysis] Nickel Prices Extended Gains This Week, Domestic Refined Nickel Inventory Continued to Build
summary: Nickel prices extended gains, with SHFE 2602 up 2.52% WoW and LME 3M up 4.07%, supported by positive macro news and Indonesian developments. Spot trading was sluggish and average spot prices edged down, while domestic social inventory rose, yet the outlook says nickel should hold up next week.

title: SLAM Exploration Ltd.: SLAM Launches Airborne VTEM Survey - Geotech Flying Over Goodwin Copper Nickel Cobalt Project
summary: SLAM Exploration began an 852 km VTEM-Plus airborne survey over its Goodwin copper-nickel-cobalt project in New Brunswick. The company aims to map potential copper-nickel targets based on prior drill intercepts. Assays are pending for a separate gold program; no production or inventory changes are announced.

title: SLAM Exploration Ltd.: SLAM Launches Airborne VTEM Survey - Geotech Flying Over Goodwin Copper Nickel Cobalt Project
summary: SLAM Exploration started an 852 km VTEM-Plus survey over its Goodwin copper-nickel-cobalt project in New Brunswick to refine targets for potential ovoid-type Cu-Ni deposits. The release cites strong historical copper-nickel-equivalent drilling but provides no new assay results or production/inventory impacts.

title: Prospect Ridge Resources Corp: Excalibur IP Survey Results Confirm High Priority Copper Gold Drill Targets
summary: Prospect Ridge reports final IP survey results identifying a large chargeability/resistivity/magnetic target at its Excalibur copper-gold porphyry project and expects to finalize drill targets and begin a maiden diamond program in June 2026, subject to permits. The update is sentiment-supportive for copper but no near-term supply effect is stated.

title: Copper smelter investment as Metso books equipment order
summary: Metso booked large orders and equipment for new primary copper smelters and concentrator-related equipment, while Kamoa-Kakula’s world-scale flash furnace in the DRC started up and began casting anodes. Additional smelter/refinery investment plans in Mongolia, Canada, and Chile continue, even as low TC/RCs and potential output cuts pose uncertainties.

title: [SMM Analysis]In 2025, China's total copper concentrate imports exceeded 30 million tons, yet geopolitical risks intensified supply chain shifts.
summary: China imported a record 30.365 million dmt of copper ore and concentrate in 2025, with strong YoY growth. However, supply-chain stability is challenged by policy and geopolitics: Panama’s mine suspension, Indonesia’s copper concentrate export quotas, and reduced U.S. exports tied to tariff friction. Risks could tighten near-term copper availability.

title: Eco-activists block entrance to Europe's northernmost copper mine project
summary: Eco-activists blocked access to the Nussir project, Europe’s northernmost copper mine, demanding withdrawal of the permit to dump tailings into Repparfjord. Authorities granted the company approval for large-scale dumping, but activists cite new environmental studies and potential damage to spawning grounds. The disruption and permit risk could delay copper supply.

title: Decarbonise Aluminium Production to Promote Trade: Niti Aayog
summary: Niti Aayog says EU’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism makes aluminium decarbonisation crucial, given India’s higher emissions intensity and coal-heavy power supplying the sector. It argues for shifting to cleaner electricity/fuels and expanding scrap recycling, with potential policies like EPR and low-emission quotas boosting demand for recycled aluminium.

title: Copper RRS 2025 - Top Miners Pursue Resilience With Partnerships, Asset Growth
summary: S&P Global Energy highlights that the leading 10 copper producers added 130.9 Mt of reserves from 2015-2024, covering about 134% of production. Exploration budgets totaled $6.97 billion, with more brownfield focus and limited new discoveries (7 Mt from major finds).

title: Copper supply to fall short as AI, renewables and EVs fuel demand surge
summary: S&P Global warns the copper market could face a supply shortfall as AI, renewables, and EVs drive demand growth. It projects demand rising from 28Mt in 2025 to 42Mt by 2040 and highlights limited new mining investment, declining output, and constrained recycling, implying tighter conditions for copper prices.

title: Europe's Aluminum Production Collapse Sparks Crisis for Key Industries
summary: Europe’s primary aluminum output has collapsed to 950,000 tons versus 13.5 million tons consumption, driven by shuttered smelters and high power costs. With downstream demand from aerospace backlogs and CBAM taxing carbon-intensive imports, the market faces acute near-term aluminum scarcity and upward price pressure.

title: Copper rallies on tariff moves and AI hype despite China slowdown
summary: Copper prices surged to an all-time high as investors anticipate AI-driven demand will tighten the market. At the same time, buyers reportedly rushed to build inventories as a hedge against potential Trump tariffs, boosting near-term physical demand and reinforcing bullish sentiment.

title: High Copper Prices Put Brass Billet Market Under Pressure, Sluggish Pattern Before the Holiday Hard to Change
summary: The article reports copper cathode spot prices staying at record highs in early January and driving higher brass billet costs. Despite price gains, weak downstream demand and squeezed margins keep volumes low (“price up, volume down”). It expects copper to hover at highs into February, limiting big copper declines.

title: 2025 Refined Copper Imports and Exports Review: A Turning Point in China's Offshore Trade Structure
summary: China’s refined copper trade shifted in 2025: imports fell 10.3% to 3.35 Mt while exports jumped 73.7% to 790 kt, supported by new domestic smelting capacity and strong LME-COMEX arbitrage and VAT rebate incentives. Offshore activity diluted inbound volumes, suggesting near-term bearish pressure on copper.

title: Freeport-McMoRan Boosts 2026, 2027 Capex, Advancing Copper Projec...
summary: Freeport-McMoRan plans $4.3–$4.5B of capex for 2026-2027 to advance copper expansions and projects, including Bagdad in Arizona and Kucing Liar in Indonesia, plus recycling investment. Management also cites strong U.S. copper demand from data centers, power grid and renewables, supporting higher expectations for copper supply and demand.

title: Aluminum Plate/Sheet and Strip Exports Declined by 12% Overall in 2025, Facing Dual Challenges of Anti-Dumping and CBAM in 2026
summary: China’s aluminum plate/sheet and strip exports totaled 270,900 mt in Dec 2025 and fell 12% in 2025. The downturn is attributed to ongoing anti-dumping/countervailing tariffs against Chinese products and the impending EU CBAM implementation in 2026, raising export costs and compliance burdens, pressuring demand outlook.

title: Century takes 40% stake in EGA's US aluminium smelter
summary: Century Aluminum will take a 40% stake in Emirates Global Aluminium’s planned U.S. aluminium smelter in Oklahoma, raising capacity to 750,000 tpa from 600,000 tpa. The project supports the U.S. tariff-driven push for domestic supply, but output is set for the late decade, tempering near-term price pressure.

title: Century to take 40% of project to build first US aluminum smelter in 46 years
summary: Century Aluminum will take a 40% stake in Emirates Global Aluminium’s planned Inola, Oklahoma, primary aluminum smelter, boosting capacity to 750,000 mt/year. The project starts construction by year-end, supporting domestic output amid U.S. import tariffs that have lifted the Midwest aluminum premium to records.

title: EGA signs deal to build first US aluminium plant in almost five decades
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) signed a joint development agreement with Century Aluminium to build a new primary aluminium plant in Inola, Oklahoma, aiming for ~750,000 tonnes/year. The project follows plans for a $4 billion investment and seeks to cut US import dependence, supporting aluminium supply expectations.

title: EU Secondary Aluminium Prices Firm Amid Shortages
summary: EU secondary aluminium prices are firm as tight scrap availability reduces domestic feed supply across the region. Yards report limited inflows as traders position ahead of expected Spring 2026 EU scrap export restrictions. CBAM is also expected to raise import landed costs, supporting EU remelted material despite cautious downstream demand.

title: Camrail and Camalco Seal Rail Deal to Enable Bauxite Exports from Minim Martap
summary: Camrail and Camalco agreed to prepare Cameroon’s rail network to transport bauxite from the Minim Martap deposit to the port of Douala. The plan includes CFA5 billion rail rehabilitation and further CFA47 billion investments to ramp output toward 10 million tons per year, enabling exports from 2026.

title: Lion Copper and Gold Corp.: Lion Copper and Gold Corp. Receives US$30.5 Million from Nuton to Advance Yerington Copper Project
summary: Lion Copper and Gold says Nuton LLC (Rio Tinto subsidiary) has provided US$30.5m under a Stage 3 earn-in to advance the Yerington Copper Project’s DFS and permitting in Nevada. The funding supports engineering, environmental studies, and possible use of copper leaching technology aimed at future cathode production.

title: Capstone Copper (TSE:CS) Reaches New 1-Year High  – Still a Buy?
summary: Capstone Copper shares reached a 52-week high amid multiple analyst upgrades and higher price targets. The article reviews recent earnings and company operations (primarily copper mining across the Americas). However, it does not cite new copper supply, demand, or policy developments, making any commodity-price impact likely limited.

title: Copper price: Chinese buyers clamour for the commodity amid frenzied demand for the precious metal
summary: Copper prices have climbed above $13,000/tonne, driven by sluggish mine output and strong electrification-linked demand, including EVs and renewable energy. The article also describes frenzied Chinese bar purchases, suggesting active spot buying and reinforcing bullish near-term expectations for copper.

title: Court hearing over Benson aluminum plant lawsuit
summary: A judge postponed a decision on a motion to dismiss a lawsuit challenging Benson’s approval of a proposed 200-acre aluminum recycling plant. Community groups cite alleged permitting violations and air-emissions concerns near homes and schools. The project awaits EPA review of an air-quality permit before construction can proceed.

title: Nickel refinery in SE Georgia? - Statesboro Herald
summary: Westwin Elements is seeking to build what it says would be the only major U.S. nickel refinery in coastal Georgia, scaling from 18,000 to 68,000 tons annually and producing Class 1 nickel for defense and energy security. The project faces local environmental and legal opposition, but could boost expectations for domestic nickel supply.

title: Stocks to Watch Today: Axis Bank, Waaree Renewable, PVR Inox, Hindustan Copper, Torrent Pharma, Zydus Life, UltraTech & Urban Company in Focus on 27 January
summary: Indian markets are recovering after a sell-off and traders await Fed cues, with tariff threats also in focus. In stock highlights, Hindustan Copper is named preferred bidder for a Madhya Pradesh mining lease and composite licence, which supports expectations for future copper supply and may lift copper sentiment.

title: Rising copper demand triggers supply concerns
summary: The piece argues that copper demand is rising rapidly with electrification, renewables, EVs, AI and data centers—especially in China and Asia-Pacific—while supply growth lags due to ore quality deterioration, long mine lead times, permitting delays and investment uncertainty. It cites setbacks in South America and Australia and expects prices to keep rising.

title: Bryan County leaders and residents respond to possibility of Nickel refinery
summary: Bryan County, Georgia residents are split over Westwin Elements’ proposal to build a nickel refinery at an abandoned industrial site. Opponents cite environmental and safety risks; the company argues strong containment and compliance, using nickel carbonyl in a sealed process. A town hall is scheduled to review project data.

title: Major Aluminum Project in Oklahoma Promises Thousands of Jobs
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium and Century Aluminum plan a joint venture to build the first new U.S. primary aluminum smelter in nearly five decades in Inola, Oklahoma. The project targets about 750,000 tons annually, strengthens domestic supply versus imports, and involves site preparation and power/engineering discussions ahead of construction.

title: India's Hindalco unveils $2.3 billion aluminium smelter expansion plan
summary: Hindalco announced a 210 billion-rupee ($2.3 billion) expansion of its aluminium smelter in Odisha, plus a 45 billion-rupee FRP and battery-grade aluminium foil facility. The plan aims to reduce India’s aluminium import dependence amid local manufacturing push, potentially boosting supply and battery-grade output.

title: First Atlantic Nickel Corp.: First Atlantic Nickel Increases RPM Zone Strike Length 50% to Over 1.2 km and Width to Over 800 m from Phase 2x Drilling at Pipestone XL Magnetic Nickel-Cobalt Alloy Project
summary: First Atlantic Nickel reports expanded RPM Zone drilling at its Pipestone XL project, with all holes returning positive magnetically recoverable nickel (awaruite) results and continued growth of the nickel-bearing footprint. It also references a White House proclamation on US imports of processed critical minerals, naming nickel and cobalt amid limited domestic processing capacity.

title: Hindalco announces $2.3 billion aluminium smelter expansion in India
summary: Hindalco will invest about $2.3 billion to expand its aluminium smelter capacity in Odisha and commission a ₹45 billion plant for flat rolled products and battery-grade aluminium foil. The company aims to cut India’s reliance on imported aluminium, supported by rising EV and renewables demand.

title: Quimbaya Gold Inc.: Quimbaya Gold Announces that Dr. Stewart Redwood Provides Independent Confirmation of Porphyry Copper System at Tahami Center
summary: Quimbaya Gold reports independent confirmation of an extensive Tahami porphyry copper-gold-molybdenum system, with visible copper and anomalous Cu/Mo in preliminary sampling. The company plans maiden drilling in Q2 2026, but there is no near-term production or supply change, limiting immediate price pressure.

title: Benton Resources Inc.: Benton Confirms New VMS Copper Discovery at End Zone and Delineates Gold and Copper Horizon at South Pond Gold-Copper Deposit
summary: Benton Resources announced new VMS-style copper intersections at its South Pond project in Newfoundland, including up to 1.6% Cu over 0.70 m, and additional gold results. One drill hole also found highly anomalous nickel, chromium, and cobalt intervals, with follow-up drilling planned. This is exploration news with limited near-term price impact.

title: Guinea's bauxite exports rise in 2025 despite disputes and sector reforms
summary: Guinea exported 182.8 million tons of bauxite in 2025, up 25% from 2024, despite permit withdrawals, disputes, and ongoing sector reforms. The country remains the top global bauxite exporter. Export volumes are expected to be further influenced by new state-linked operations and refinery plans.

title: Zambia's copper output rises 8 pct in 2025-Xinhua
summary: Zambia produced about 890,346 tonnes of copper in 2025, up 8% from 825,513 tonnes in 2024, according to official figures. The mines minister linked the rise to improved performance at Mopani, Konkola and Kansanshi and government policies supporting struggling operators, with a goal of 3 million tonnes by 2031.

title: Century Aluminum to Construct 1st US Aluminum Plant in More Than 40 Years
summary: Century Aluminum and Emirates Global Aluminium agreed to develop and build the first new primary aluminum production plant in the US since 1980. The project targets smelting alumina into new aluminum metal, expanding primary supply potential and likely pressuring aluminum price expectations in the near term.

title: [SMM Analysis] China's Copper Concentrate Imports Hit Record High in 2025, Yet Geopolitical Risks Threaten Supply Chain
summary: China’s 2025 copper ore and concentrate imports hit records, with imports from Chile and Peru rising year-on-year. However, policy and geopolitical risks—such as Panama’s mine suspension, Indonesia’s export quota, and US tariff frictions—show supply disruptions can quickly affect China’s concentrate inflows, supporting near-term copper price expectations.

title: FinancialContent - Squeeze in the Secondary: Europe Braces for Aluminum Scrap Crunch as Export Ban Looms
summary: Europe is facing a tight supply of aluminum scrap and secondary ingots as domestic scrap generation falls and EU export restrictions on aluminum scrap are due to start in spring 2026. Scrap and secondary ingot prices have surged to multi-year highs, compressing smelter margins and signaling further upward pressure.

title: FinancialContent - The Bacterial Gold Rush: How Microscopic 'Bugs' Are Unlocking Copper's $6 Pound
summary: The piece argues copper prices are supported by a tight 2026 supply outlook after major mine disruption (Grasberg) and by accelerating biomining/bioleaching efforts (Rio Tinto, BHP, Freeport-McMoRan). It frames copper as still in deficit despite newer recovery gains, warning of further upside toward $6.50/lb.

title: Proposed Fundraise to Accelerate Copper Project  | Company Announcement
summary: Atalaya Mining announced a proposed £130m equity fundraise to accelerate development of its Spanish copper projects (Riotinto District growth and Touro early works). Proceeds aim to strengthen the balance sheet and optimize project funding. The news is copper-focused, but mainly relates to financing and longer build timelines.

title: Century Aluminum CEO discusses industry comeback amid security concerns
summary: Century Aluminum’s CEO warns the U.S. aluminum supply chain is “so thin” that a single plant fire could trigger nationwide shortages, highlighting aluminum’s critical role in defense and infrastructure. He also cites resurgence from security concerns and prior tariffs that reduced smelter decline, implying firmer near-term aluminum fundamentals.

title: Copper exports to China cross $1.14b
summary: Pakistan’s mineral exports to China rose in 2025, with copper and copper articles reaching about $1.14bn and aluminium ores/concentrates jumping over 4,700% to $14.16m. The report links demand to China’s manufacturing and energy transition, but it doesn’t signal an immediate supply disruption or market-wide inventory shock.

title: True North beefs up Queensland copper-gold stash
summary: True North Copper increased its Wallace North copper-gold mineral resource in Queensland by adding results from two RC drillholes, taking contained copper to about 25,000 tonnes and gold to about 50,000 ounces. The update supports ongoing studies and extension drilling, reinforcing bullish sentiment around near-term copper supply expectations.

title: [SMM Analysis] Social Inventory of Copper Cathode Records First Decline Recently, Initial Signs of Downstream Stockpiling Willingness?
summary: SMM reports social copper cathode inventories peaking around 330,200 mt and only seeing a small MoM decline, while spot markets remain structurally discounted versus futures and downstream buying is price-sensitive. High inventories, wide spreads and ample smelter output are expected to keep liquidity weak and suppress copper prices into and around Chinese New Year.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel Reports Positive Metallurgical Results From Gemini North Project
summary: EV Nickel announced positive interim flotation test results from its Gemini North nickel sulphide zone. Tests show nickel recoveries of ~81–85% and final concentrate grades meeting project targets (up to ~5.83% Ni, with variability to 9.70% noted), using repeatable conditions suitable for bioleaching.

title: Fathom Nickel Inc.: Fathom Announces Upsizing of Previously Announced Placement to $3.75 Million and Planned 3,000-4,000 Meter Drill Program at the Gochager Lake Project
summary: Fathom Nickel upsized a private placement to fund a planned 3,000–4,000 m drill program at its Gochager Lake Ni-Cu-Co project, targeting sulphide mineralization and using BHEM and soil geochemistry. The company provides nickel and copper tenors but no near-term production or supply changes.

title: Northstar Gold Corp.: Northstar Gold Corp. Announces $4 Million Digital Co-Investment to Advance Cam Copper and Novamera's Surgical Mining
summary: Northstar Gold announced approval for up to $4 million in DIGITAL (Canada) co-investment to advance the Cam Copper Surgical Mining project led by Novamera. Funding supports permitting and pilot activities, with first reimbursements expected mid-April 2026. The announcement is copper-focused but lacks immediate production-scale changes.

title: FinancialContent - Metals Market Shaken as Aluminum Hits Fresh Peak Amid Four-Year Low for U.S. Dollar
summary: Aluminum prices surged to a new multi-year peak on the LME, driven by tightening global supply, structural production caps in China, and extremely low warehouse inventories. A four-year low in the U.S. dollar boosted dollar-priced commodities, increasing buying interest and physical premiums, sustaining strong bullish momentum.

title: Hindalco announces Rs 21,000 crore aluminium smelter expansion in Odisha
summary: Hindalco said it will invest Rs 21,000 crore to expand its aluminium smelter in Odisha, including commissioning a new flat rolled products and battery-grade aluminium foil facility. The company also expects reduced import dependence and positions the project as part of broader aluminium growth in India.

title: Barrick Gold taps Metso technology for copper project
summary: Barrick Gold selected Metso’s Concorde Cell flotation technology for its Lumwana copper expansion in Zambia, to operate alongside TankCell solutions. Metso equipment is intended to improve flotation performance and concentrate quality. The Concorde Cell order was recorded in 2025 Minerals segment order intake, alongside earlier concentrator equipment.

title: Century Aluminum To Construct First US Aluminum Plant In More Than 40 Years
summary: Century Aluminum and Emirates Global Aluminium plan to build a new primary aluminum smelter in Oklahoma, targeting 750,000 tonnes/year and more than doubling current US output. The article links the project to recent US aluminum import tariffs, implying stronger domestic supply expectations and supportive pricing bias for aluminum.

title: Copper sets record amid geopolitical risks, weak dollar
summary: Copper jumped to record highs on speculative buying, supported by a weaker dollar and geopolitical risk, though physical demand signals in China remain soft and inventories are high. LME and Shanghai moves were volatile, with aluminium rising then retreating and nickel slightly higher, suggesting broader risk-driven trading rather than stable fundamentals.

title: Stir over Utkal Alumina's unmet promises continues
summary: Residents affected by Utkal Alumina’s bauxite mining operations in Rayagada began a dharna near the firm’s RMP gate, citing unfulfilled development promises, lack of permanent jobs, discontinued allowances, and health risks from red mud/ash pollution. They demand jobs, compensation, and pollution controls, potentially disrupting near-term supply.

title: Australian gov't announces investment in high purity alumina producer-Xinhua
summary: Australia’s federal National Reconstruction Fund Corporation will invest A$75 million in Alpha HPA to complete a planned expansion to 10,000 tons/year of high-purity alumina, a critical input for semiconductors. The support boosts alumina supply expectations and could be mildly supportive for the aluminium chain.

title: Glencore reports 11% drop in 2025 copper output
summary: Glencore said 2025 copper output fell 11% to 851,600 tonnes and its 2026 guidance is 810,000–870,000 tonnes due to lower grades and water constraints at Chile’s Collahuasi. With traders already expecting supply tightening, the news is likely to support copper prices near term.

title: Glencore 2025 Own Sourced Copper Production Down 11%
summary: Glencore said 2025 own-sourced copper production fell to 851,600 tonnes, down 11% from the prior year, mainly from lower head grades and recoveries tied to mine sequencing and ore feedstock changes at Collahuasi, Antamina and Antapaccay. The report is relevant to near-term copper supply expectations.

title: Glencore's 2025 Copper Production Falls Despite Second-Half Recovery
summary: Glencore said 2025 copper production dropped 11% to 851,600 mt, citing lower ore grades and recoveries tied to mine sequencing, despite a stronger second-half output. The company is also in talks with Rio Tinto on a potential combination, with copper central to the deal.

title: Antofagasta 2025 Copper Production Down 2%
summary: Antofagasta reported 2025 copper production of 653,700 tonnes, down 2% year-on-year. It also set 2026 copper guidance at 650,000–700,000 tonnes, indicating output near current levels with some incremental gain at Los Pelambres. The production slowdown can weigh on copper sentiment in the near term.

title: Mass Signature Campaign Seeking Reopening of Sterlite Copper Plant Gains Momentum – Chennaionline
summary: A mass signature campaign in Thoothukudi is gathering support to reopen the Sterlite copper plant under a proposed “green copper” framework addressing environmental concerns. Local workers and fishing communities argue the closure harmed incomes and livelihoods since 2018. The petition will be submitted to state and central authorities in coming weeks.

title: Glencore's 2025 Copper Production Falls While Steelmaking Coal Jumps -- Commodity Comment
summary: Glencore says 2025 own-sourced copper production fell to 851,600 tonnes, down 100,000 tonnes (11%) versus 2024, mainly from lower ore grades and recoveries at several mines (notably Collahuasi, Antamina and Antapaccay). Despite a stronger second half, the year-on-year decline is modestly bearish for copper sentiment.

title: [SMM Analysis] High Nickel Prices Stimulate Sentiment to Hold Prices Firm, Nickel Salt Prices Slightly Increase
summary: SMM reports battery-grade nickel sulphate prices at 32,857 yuan/mt, slightly higher than the prior day, alongside rising nickel prices. The cost impact stems from nickel price fluctuations tied to Indonesian policy disruptions, while producers show more willingness to hold prices firm. Demand is mixed as Chinese New Year stocking is cautious.

title: Antofagasta touts "compelling" copper outlook amid production increase
summary: Antofagasta said copper output rose 9.4% quarter-on-quarter to 177,000 tonnes in Q4 2025, with copper sales up 42% and full-year net cash costs reduced 27% to $1.19/lb. Management reiterated its growth program is on track, citing constrained supply and rising demand.

title: Copper Soars Above $13,900 as Metals Rally Gains Steam
summary: Copper jumped above $13,900/ton on the LME, with futures up about 6% in early European trade and miners also gaining. The rally is linked to a weaker U.S. dollar and strong investor demand for physical assets, alongside speculative positioning despite softer China fundamentals and contango.

title: South American upgrades boost Glencore's copper turnaround
summary: Glencore’s CEO says South American reserve upgrades and “notable increases” from exploration at mines in Peru, Chile and Argentina (plus the US) provide a tailwind for its copper turnaround. The firm seeks to lift output after multi-year declines and production setbacks, supporting expectations for copper supply.

title: PEA Report Confirms World Leading Alumina Resource in Saskatchewan
summary: Canadian Energy Metals’ PEA for the Thor Project outlines a large Saskatchewan alumina resource and proposed long-term production, positioning it as an alternative to imported bauxite. Because it remains a preliminary study with no near-term output, the news is unlikely to create immediate aluminium price pressure within days to weeks.

title: World faces copper shortage as AI data centres drive power demand: Survey
summary: India’s Economic Survey warns the world faces an upcoming copper shortage as AI data centres boost power demand. It links higher copper price volatility to mine outages in Indonesia, Congo and Chile, raising concerns about supply deficits. It also highlights growing material needs for renewable power generation.

title: Copper posts biggest one-day gain in years, surpasses US$14,000 a tonne, as speculators pile in
summary: Copper surged to record highs above $14,000/t on heavy speculative buying in China, aided by a weak dollar and geopolitical concerns and expectations of stronger U.S. growth and infrastructure demand. The move lifted other LME base metals too, with aluminium rising and nickel up modestly, though physical demand in China remained weak.

title: Lumentum CEO senses 'industry pivot' from copper to optics
summary: Lumentum’s CEO says an industry pivot is replacing copper links used for ultra-short data-center scale-up connectivity with optical scale-up and CPO. He expects early scale-up CPO shipments replacing longer copper connections by late 2027, while OCS/CPO ramps accelerate. That outlook can reduce copper demand expectations.

title: Expert expects environmental, economic benefits from potential alumina mine in Sask.
summary: A University of Regina expert says a potential alumina mine near Tisdale could bring environmental benefits by reducing shipment of imported alumina/bauxite for aluminum production. Canadian Energy Metals’ Thor Project is described as having longer-term development potential, with possible jobs and improved access to local feedstock for smelters.

title: Copper Thieves Target Mountain Shrine in Japan
summary: Japan has seen increasing thefts of copper roofing panels, plates, cables and wiring across remote shrines, bridges, tourist sites and greenhouses. Police arrested suspects tied to large theft volumes. Copper demand-linked price rises are mentioned, but thefts highlight short-term disruption and reduced copper availability at local levels.

title: Glencore to suspend plan to upgrade Quebec copper smelter after emissions talks break down
summary: Glencore will suspend a $1-billion upgrade of its Horne copper smelter in Quebec after failed talks with the province over toxic arsenic emissions targets and permitting certainty. The company warns Canada’s only copper smelter could close without changes, potentially tightening refined copper supply.

title: Ardea lands $1B Aussie, US govt backing for monster WA nickel hub
summary: Ardea Resources received up to about A$1 billion equivalent in letters of support from EFA and US EXIM under a critical minerals program for its Goongarrie nickel hub in Western Australia. The funding underpins progress toward a DFS and potential FID, strengthening bullish sentiment for nickel supply development.

title: Western Kentucky aluminum plant sold for redevelopment into data center
summary: Century Aluminum sold its Hawesville, Kentucky aluminium plant, which will be redeveloped into a digital infrastructure campus for AI and high-performance computing. With the site no longer functioning as an aluminium facility, the change implies reduced aluminium supply, potentially weighing on aluminium prices.

title: Bougainville Rejects China and Turns to India to Reopen Massive Copper Mine
summary: Bougainville’s autonomous government rejects a plan to dilute its stake in Bougainville Copper Limited and instead seeks an Indian firm to reopen the Panguna mine. Panguna is described as containing about 1 billion tonnes of copper. The decision raises prospects for renewed copper production and future supply.

title: Anglo American Q4 Copper Production Down, Cuts Copper Production Outlook For FY26-FY27
summary: Anglo American said Q4 copper production fell 14% to 169,500 tonnes versus 198,000 tonnes a year earlier. While output at Los Bronces rose, lower grades at Quellaveco and Collahuasi weighed on totals. The company also lowered its FY26 and FY27 copper production outlook ranges.

title: International Business: Precious metals, oil slide as global tensions ease; copper down
summary: Copper prices fell about 2% as tensions eased following US-China contact and US-Iran talks progress, removing some geopolitical premium. A steadier-to-stronger US dollar weighed on dollar-priced commodities. Copper also faced pressure from weaker demand expectations and rising LME-registered warehouse stocks.

title: Anglo American reports drop in copper output and warns of further losses in De Beers diamond business
summary: Anglo American said copper production fell 10% last year to 695,000 tonnes and cut 2026 copper guidance to 700,000–760,000 tonnes, while maintaining later-year expectations. It also warned of further losses at De Beers and is restructuring, including planning to sell some nickel assets.

title: Anglo lowers copper forecast after production hiccup in Chile
summary: Anglo American lowered its 2026 copper production forecast by 60,000 tonnes after problems at Chile’s Collahuasi mine reduced output, with guidance now 700,000–760,000 tonnes. It also cites lower-grade ore impacts through end-2026. Despite longer-term hopes, the near-term supply outlook worsened.

title: Aspocomp installs new copper plating line at Finnish PCB factory
summary: Aspocomp says it has installed a new, higher-capacity copper plating line at its Finnish PCB plant, combining electroless and electrolytic copper to improve through-hole and microvia quality. The expansion (~EUR 10m) boosts copper plating capacity 1.5x and production throughput, but it is unlikely to move global copper prices materially.

title: Copper Fox Metals Inc.: Copper Fox Announces $3,000,000 Non-Brokered Private Placement
summary: Copper Fox Metals announced a C$3 million non-brokered private placement of up to 4.62 million common shares at $0.65. Net proceeds will support exploration and development on its copper projects (Van Dyke, Mineral Mountain, Eaglehead, Sombrero Butte) plus working capital. The deal is subject to exchange approval.

title: Algo Grande Copper Corp.: Algo Grande Discovers Three New Skarn Horizons, Reports 36.00 Metres Above 1.0% Copper, Including 14.79 Metres of 1.4% Copper and Identifies Evidence for Porphyry Potential at Depth
summary: Algo Grande Copper Corp. reports inaugural drilling at the Adelita Project, including discovery of three new skarn horizons with multiple copper-rich intervals (up to 4.1% Cu over 1.85 m) and evidence of a potential deeper porphyry system. Mineralization remains open; follow-up drilling is ongoing.

title: FinancialContent - Copper Cracks Under Pressure: Industrial Metal Slides Below $13,000 as Trade Tensions Chill Global Markets
summary: Copper prices slid below $13,000/ton on the LME to around $12,650, reversing recent highs. The fall is attributed to potential U.S. tariffs on refined copper imports, hawkish Fed-driven dollar strength, and soft Chinese demand causing inventory build at Shanghai warehouses, shifting markets away from shortage fears.

title: Kalgoorlie Nickel secures $701m in backing for Goongarrie project
summary: Kalgoorlie Nickel’s Goongarrie Hub Project secured non-binding interest letters for roughly A$1bn total backing from Australia’s EFA and the US EXIM, tied to eligibility and approvals. The funding would support development of a key nickel-cobalt resource for stainless steel and battery cathodes, a positive signal for nickel demand/supply outlook.

title: Letter to the editor: Observations about the proposed nickel refinery
summary: A letter discusses Westwin Elements’ proposed nickel refinery in Richmond Hill, citing community concerns and past feasibility issues. It notes an earlier expansion was dropped partly due to “decreasing nickel values,” implying nickel price levels affected project economics. The rest focuses on lawsuits and local governance without clear near-term market impact.

title: Editor's Corner: Nickel for my thoughts - Bryan County News
summary: The editor discusses Westwin Elements’ plan to build a nickel refinery in Richmond Hill, Georgia, and notes that an emergency County Commission meeting blocked the project’s advances while an investigation examines contamination concerns under public nuisance laws. The local controversy could delay refining capacity, supporting nickel supply expectations.

title: Metals are turning bearish – Silver (XAG/USD), Gold (XAU/USD) and Copper (XCU/USD) Outlook
summary: The article is a technical market outlook for metals, including copper. It says copper is testing the lower bound of its September upward channel and pivotal support around $5.70. Breaching below could prompt further retracement to $5.40-$5.50 and possibly the $4.90-$5.00 major monthly support.

title: Capstone Copper to resume full production at Chile's Mantoverde mine as strike ends
summary: Capstone Copper said unions at Chile’s Mantoverde mine approved a new three-year labor contract, ending a strike that began Jan. 2 and cut output to about 55% of normal. With agreements with all unions, Capstone expects production to return to full operations, boosting near-term copper supply outlook.

title: Japan's Aisin to make aluminum EV parts in Canada via tie-up
summary: Aisin plans to establish a Canadian joint venture with Toyota Tsusho and Minth Group to manufacture aluminum components for electric vehicles. While the partners expect future growth in demand for lightweight EV parts, the article notes a recent EV sales slowdown, limiting certainty about how quickly aluminium demand will rise.

title: Vietnam's Lam Dong approves $2.3bn expansion of alumina projects
summary: Lam Dong province approved two major alumina project expansions operated by Vinacomin, including a new 1.2 mt/year alumina line and an expanded bauxite-aluminium complex, totaling about $2.3bn. Start dates are late 2030, implying limited immediate impact on aluminium prices over the next weeks.

title: Capstone Copper Corp. Announces Labour Agreement at Mantoverde Operation
summary: Capstone Copper said the Union #2 at its Mantoverde Mine in Chile ratified a new three-year collective bargaining agreement, ending a strike that began January 2. During the dispute, the mine ran at about 55% of normal output. Mantoverde expects to return to full operations and has agreements with all unions.

title: Hindustan Copper says well-positioned to make  strategic entry into critical minerals sector
summary: Hindustan Copper said it is expanding into critical minerals, supported by its hard-rock mining and beneficiation capabilities. It signed agreements to explore and develop critical minerals including copper and nickel, and plans to triple ore production capacity from 4 MTPA to 12.2 MTPA by 2030-31, boosting future supply expectations.

title: American Pacific Mining Corp.: American Pacific Announces New Geological Discoveries and Target Vectoring in Preparation for Drill Program at Madison Copper-Gold Project in Montana
summary: American Pacific Mining reports new underground geological observations at its Madison copper-gold project in Montana, including additional exposed altered zones and identification of phreatic breccia with chalcocite veins and native copper. The findings improve drill targeting ahead of a planned program, but no production or supply change is announced.

title: Copper up 40 pc globally in FY26; H1 FY27 forecast at $11,000-$12,000 per tonne
summary: ICRA says global copper prices have risen nearly 40% in FY26 to about $13,000/t by January 2026, driven by mine-side supply disruptions, lower ore grades, and inventory dislocations between COMEX and LME amid tariff uncertainty. It expects copper supported at $11,000–$12,000/t in H1 FY27, despite some demand risks.

title: Copper up 40 pc globally in FY26; H1 FY27 forecast at $11,000–$12,000 per tonne
summary: ICRA reports global copper prices up nearly 40% in FY26 to about $13,000/tonne by Jan 2026, driven by mine-side supply disruptions, lower ore grades, and inventory dislocations between COMEX and LME. It expects a tight market deficit into CY25/CY26 and forecasts $11,000–$12,000/tonne in H1 FY27.

title: Sandfire, Havilah to advance Kalkaroo copper project
summary: Sandfire and Havilah executed agreements to progress the Kalkaroo copper-gold project in South Australia, allowing Sandfire to earn an 80% stake after a shareholder vote. The A$117.6m transaction includes further drilling and a new pre-feasibility study, alongside A$30m regional exploration over two years.

title: Armenia continues to work with partners on copper smelter construction project – Papoyan
summary: Armenia’s Economy Minister said work continues with local and international partners on constructing a copper smelter, with Zangezur Copper and Molybdenum Combine tying the project to development of a new mine to raise output. The article reiterates negotiations and technology talks but no near-term commissioning timeline.

title: Copper breaks 20-year-old record, leaves investors in dilemma; Can it replace gold as next precious metal?
summary: The piece argues copper has turned into a “growth haven,” citing a COMEX breakout above a nearly 20-year rising channel and bullish technical signals in metal stocks. It links copper demand to renewables, smart grids, and EV investment by governments, suggesting improving supply-demand expectations versus other precious metals.

title: Abitibi Metals Delivers 124% Resource Growth at B26, Defining a High-Grade Copper-Gold System of Meaningful Scale | Company Announcement
summary: Abitibi Metals announced a 124% increase in B26 mineral resources, expanding Indicated and Inferred categories and raising contained copper by about 40% on a contained basis. The company also commenced a fully funded 40,000-metre Phase 4 drilling program, supporting continued exploration of the copper-gold VMS system.

title: Miners Win as China's Export Ban Triggers 54-Nation Pact Reshaping Critical Minerals
summary: China’s tungsten export restrictions are discussed, but the tracked near-term price link is mainly Rio Tinto/Chalco’s deal to buy a controlling interest in Brazil aluminium producer CBA. This expands/strengthens an integrated, low-carbon aluminium supply chain, potentially tightening sentiment on aluminium supply expectations.

title: New Tritton copper mine approved for Nyngan in Western NSW | Daily Liberal
summary: NSW approved Aeris Resources’ Constellation Project near the Tritton copper operations, projecting ~500,000 tonnes of copper ore per year from an open-cut and underground mine. Officials cite rising global electrification demand for copper and say mining could start before year-end, supporting copper supply expectations.

title: Abitibi Metals Delivers 124% Resource Growth at B26, Defining a High-Grade Copper-Gold System of Meaningful Scale
summary: Abitibi Metals announced a 124% increase in mineral resources at its B26 copper-gold project in Quebec, including higher contained copper and the start of a fully funded 40,000-metre Phase 4 drill program. The update is exploration-focused and does not signal near-term production or inventory changes.

title: Ero Copper (NYSE:ERO)  Shares Down 4.1%   – Time to Sell?
summary: The piece reports Ero Copper Corp. shares fell 4.1% and details mixed analyst rating changes after the company’s last earnings release. It describes Ero Copper’s Brazilian mining and copper concentrate sales but does not cite operational, policy, or market factors that would materially shift copper supply/demand expectations in the near term.

title: Proposed nickel refinery plan raises questions over experience, transparency and safety
summary: A proposed Westwin Elements nickel refinery in coastal Georgia faces strong opposition and scrutiny over alleged contamination and safety concerns. Bryan County may investigate whether the site is a nuisance and could block the sale until remediation. Lawsuits and disputes with a technology partner add uncertainty, potentially delaying nickel supply plans.

title: Alphacool and be quiet! Announce Price Increases Due to Rising Copper Costs
summary: Alphacool says it will raise prices 5%–10% by late February because higher copper costs for liquid-cooling components are no longer absorbable in margins. The article also notes be quiet! is monitoring raw-material inflation but not changing prices. Aluminium is mentioned as also rising.

title: SC aluminum smelter poised to lose a long-held distinction
summary: Century Aluminum said it will invest with Emirates Global Aluminum to build a new 750,000 mt/year primary aluminum smelter in Oklahoma, boosting U.S. output materially. The company also cites tariff-driven support for domestic production after U.S. plans to raise aluminum import tariffs by 50% in June.

title: Piyush Goyal clarifies US steel, aluminium tariffs not India-specific
summary: Piyush Goyal said US Section 232 tariffs of 50% on steel, aluminium and certain semi-finished copper apply globally and are not India-specific. The interim India–US trade deal keeps about $12bn of metal-related exports unchanged and grants exemptions on finished/high-value components, limiting direct near-term price impact.

title: "No, there's no confusion...we are on same footing as any other country": Piyush Goyal on India-US steel, copper and aluminium tariffs
summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said India is treated on the same footing as other countries regarding US tariffs on steel, aluminium and copper. The clarification implies no special relief for Indian exporters, supporting the view that tariff costs and demand impacts could pressure near-term copper and aluminium prices.

title: DMCI Mining says nickel output up 33% in 2025; Long Point mine set to start operations
summary: DMCI Mining said nickel ore production rose 33% in 2025 to 2 million WMT, with shipments up 31% to 1.9 million WMT. The firm expects Long Point in Palawan to start mining in 2–4 weeks pending permits. It also notes higher 1.5% laterite FOB nickel ore prices in 2025.

title: Shrines being preyed upon as easy target for copper thieves | The Asahi Shimbun: Breaking News, Japan News and Analysis
summary: Japanese shrines have increasingly been targeted for theft of copper roof plates as copper prices rise. Jinja Honcho urges vigilance, noting plates are easy to process and durable. Multiple shrines report repeated thefts, with repairs often switching to less stealable galvalume.

title: BHP's Vicuña could double investment in Argentina copper project to $800 million in 2026, executive says
summary: Vicuña Corp., formed by BHP and Lundin Mining, said it may nearly double 2025 investment to about $800 million in its Filo del Sol and Josemaría copper projects in Argentina. The mines are expected to start production in 2030, but incentives and project momentum support copper sentiment amid projected shortages.

title: Are my 1 and 2p coins now worth more than face value thanks to soaring copper prices?
summary: The piece links soaring copper prices to rising demand from electric vehicles, renewable energy (wind/solar), and AI data-centre buildouts. It cites copper reaching an all-time high above $13,000/tonne in January 2026, which underpins the claim that pre-1992 1p/2p coins’ scrap value exceeds face value.

title: Copper Price in Pakistan - Copper Rates Today
summary: Pakistan’s copper market is reported to be “buzzing” as copper rates keep climbing, with high-quality copper scrap and newly refined copper trading higher in major cities. The surge is linked to record international copper prices, sometimes above $13,000/ton, and movements in the LME and the Pakistani rupee.

title: Mozambique pushing to keep South32 aluminium smelter open, minister says
summary: Mozambique’s government says it is taking steps to ensure South32’s Mozal aluminium smelter remains open. South32 had planned to place the plant under care and maintenance by March after failing to secure an energy deal. Ongoing negotiations focus on power supply for the energy-intensive smelter.

title: Mozambique pushing to keep South32 aluminium smelter open: Minister – Channel Africa
summary: Mozambique’s mineral resources and energy minister said the government is taking required steps to keep South32’s Mozal aluminium smelter operating. South32 had planned care-and-maintenance by March after failing to secure a power deal, following years of negotiations for energy supply.

title: Oscillate agrees to buy Kalahari Copper ahead of move to AIM market
summary: Oscillate agreed to buy Kalahari Copper, including copper exploration licences in Namibia and Botswana, with consideration of cash and AIM share issuance plus milestone payments. A 1.9% net smelter royalty applies to copper produced from the licences. The deal supports copper exposure but likely has no near-term supply impact.

title: Harmony Gold says newly acquired Australian copper mine requires two-year revamp
summary: Harmony Gold said its newly acquired CSA Copper Mine in Australia requires significant recapitalisation and a de-bottleneck revamp, potentially taking up to two years. Key constraints include insufficient ventilation and limited mining flexibility, and the company does not expect the mine to “shoot the lights out,” pending an outlook in March.

title: GIADEC CEO clarifies land dispute, outlines aluminium industrial park plans
