summary: GIADEC CEO Reindorf Twumasi Ankrah clarified government legal ownership of land for a planned Ghana aluminium industrial park and said preparatory work is underway after site inspections. The initiative aims to partner with companies to develop part of the land for aluminium-related activities, supporting industrial expansion and jobs.

title: Boundary Waters Wilderness Threatened by Legislation That Would Allow Copper Mining
summary: The U.S. Senate is considering legislation (H.J. Res. 140) to overturn a 20-year mining moratorium and allow copper-nickel mining near Minnesota’s Boundary Waters Wilderness. The proposal could raise expectations of additional metal supply, likely weighing on short-term copper and nickel sentiment, despite environmental concerns.

title: Zambia's Mumbezhi Copper Project Resources Grow 63%, Add Gold and Cobalt
summary: Prospect Resources said its Mumbezhi copper project in Zambia saw a 63% rise in mineral resources to 174 million tonnes at 0.44% copper, lifting contained copper to about 771,900 tonnes. The update adds gold and cobalt by-products and supports plans for further exploration and potential mine development.

title: Aluminum feels the heat of EU carbon tariff
summary: EU CBAM began on Jan 1, adding carbon costs at the EU border for non-EU aluminum producers. The piece highlights uncertainty over indirect emissions and likely limited scope expansion. Offsets via China’s carbon market appear small due to far lower carbon prices and no trading yet for electrolytic aluminum, pressuring costs and trade competitiveness.

title: 【AICC Original Article】Anhui Huaibei: Grounded in Aluminum, Moving Toward Innovation
summary: Huaibei, Anhui is expanding its aluminum-based industry, including battery foil production and high-end aluminum materials for EV and energy-storage supply chains. Projects and output value growth are cited, along with the launch of an aluminum materials research institute and copper-aluminum composite development, suggesting supportive demand signals for aluminum.

title: Inola residents voice concerns over proposed aluminum plant at city council meeting
summary: Residents oppose a proposed Emirates Global Aluminum primary aluminum smelter at the Port of Inola, citing lack of environmental information and potential contamination risks. The company claims major new U.S. primary aluminum capacity and jobs. Opposition could delay construction, tightening near-term aluminum supply expectations.

title: True North builds scale at Queensland copper-gold hub
summary: True North Copper increased the resource at its Cloncurry copper-gold hub in Queensland, lifting contained copper and raising confidence via drilling and updated geological models. It also continues prefeasibility work and metallurgy studies, including potential SX-EW processing. The update is positive for development prospects but implies no immediate production impact.

title: Canada Nickel Announces Closing of US$32 Million Bridge Loan Facility with Auramet International, Inc.
summary: Canada Nickel closed a US$32 million bridge loan with Auramet. Proceeds will fund additional work on the Crawford nickel sulphide project and repay an existing loan. The financing lowers near-term funding risk for the nickel project, supporting nickel-related sentiment while the loan is due May 9, 2026.

title: Cooler Prices Could Increases Due to Rising Copper Costs
summary: Liquid cooling vendor Alphacool says it will raise product prices 5%-10% by end-Feb, citing rising copper costs and unsustainable margin absorption. It highlights copper’s use in radiators, blocks and heatsinks. It also mentions aluminum prices have increased, though be quiet! ultimately plans no price hikes while monitoring raw-material pressures.

title: Oreterra Metals Corp.: Oreterra Announces $6,000,000 Private Placement to Support First-Ever Drilling of the Trek South Porphyry Copper-Gold Prospect, Golden Triangle, BC
summary: Oreterra Metals announces a C$6.0m private placement to fund its first-ever drilling of the Trek South copper-gold porphyry prospect in British Columbia. The financing includes hard-dollar and flow-through units, with proceeds earmarked primarily for exploration, implying future potential but no immediate copper supply shift.

title: Russia, Ethiopia to explore construction of aluminum plant — ambassador
summary: Russia and Ethiopia will explore constructing an aluminium plant in Ethiopia, with cooperation documents signed between Rusal and Ethiopian Investment Holdings. The ambassador said the aim is to sustain rising bilateral trade and improve mechanisms like interbank settlements and logistics, signaling potential future aluminium capacity development.

title: Thor Project pilot plant positions Tisdale for future alumina role
summary: Canadian Energy Metals’ Thor Project plans to repurpose a facility in Tisdale for pilot/demonstration work to scale high-purity alumina production. The company is advancing exploration with drilling and lab testing, supported by Saskatchewan’s exploration incentive program. The project is early-stage, so it’s unlikely to move aluminium prices immediately.

title: Energy Department Awardee to Build First American Aluminum Smelter Since 1980
summary: The U.S. Department of Energy awarded $500 million to support construction of a new Century Aluminum primary smelter in Inola, Oklahoma. The project aims to produce over 500,000 tons of primary aluminum annually, reducing reliance on imports. Backing and expansion plans are broadly supportive for aluminum sentiment.

title: APAA Applauds U.S. Secretary of Energy Chris Wright for Celebrating Emirates Global Aluminum and Century Aluminum's New Partnership
summary: APAA praised U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright for celebrating a new partnership between Emirates Global Aluminum (EGA) and Century Aluminum. The investment is described as multi-billion-dollar, intended to more than double U.S. aluminum production and create 5,000 jobs. The news points to expanding aluminum supply capacity in the U.S.

title: Minth Group Shares Jump on Aluminum Parts JV With Aisin Corp., Toyota Tsusho
summary: Minth Group announced a Canada-based joint venture to produce aluminum body frame parts, with Aisin Corp. and Toyota Tsusho. The project aims to strengthen North American supply chains and relies on expected growth in aluminum lightweight technologies for electrification. Analysts see improved order intake in the region.

title: Indonesia to cut nickel mining quota in 2026 | Latest Market News
summary: Indonesia’s ESDM will reduce the 2026 nickel RKAB work plan quota to 260–270mn t, compared with 379mn t approved for 2025 and below estimated 2026 ore consumption (~330mn t). Some expect imports or lower smelter production, with changes taking full effect from April.

title: Fitch Downgrades Eramet's Rating as Company Seeks Higher Nickel Quotas in Indonesia
summary: Fitch downgraded Eramet’s rating and highlighted weak earnings and high leverage, but the key market item is Indonesia’s nickel quota framework. Eramet’s Weda Bay Nickel received an initial annual production/sales cap of 12 Mt (down from 32 Mt in 2025). The firm plans to request higher quotas.

title: TNPCB Denies Vedanta Green Copper Plant Clearance – Chennaionline
summary: Tamil Nadu’s Pollution Control Board rejected Vedanta’s application to obtain “Consent to Operate” for its proposed green copper plant at the Sterlite premises in Thoothukudi. The company plans legal recourse, with an expert committee and further court review. The decision may delay copper-related output, but timing/magnitude are unclear.

title: Aluminum feels the heat of EU carbon tariff - People's Daily Online
summary: EU CBAM began on Jan 1 and is expected to increase the cost and uncertainty for Chinese aluminum exports priced at the EU border. Indirect emissions tied to electricity are mostly excluded for now, but the ability to offset EU charges via China’s carbon market is limited by much lower carbon prices and delayed trading.

title: Eramet says Indonesia nickel permit volume slashed for 2026
summary: Eramet said its Indonesia nickel venture received a 2026 initial production allowance of 12 million wet metric tons, far below the 32 million initial allowance for 2025 (later raised to 42 million). Indonesia’s 2026 RKAB quotas are still being discussed, implying tighter nickel supply expectations.

title: Oil-rich Angola makes first major copper exports
summary: Angola shipped its first major copper concentrates from the $250 million Tetelo mine, marking the start of exports to offtakers including Glencore. Output is targeted at about 19,000 tons this year and rising to steady-state and higher levels next year, expanding copper supply prospects for the market.

title: Novelis expected to resume production of aluminum sheet between May and September, according to Ford
summary: Ford said Novelis’ Oswego aluminum sheet plant should restart between May and September 2026 after two fires. While Ford previously absorbed higher costs from aluminum imports and tax increases, the planned recovery should ease aluminum supply tightness and improve expectations for aluminum sheet availability.

title: Kincora Copper (CVE:KCC) Trading Up 26.3%  – Time to Buy?
summary: Kincora Copper shares jumped after drilling recommenced and the Nevertire program was expanded/upgraded with partner AngloGold Ashanti Exploration. The release is a procedural catalyst with no assay/intercept results yet, so near-term upside depends on future findings and timing rather than confirmed supply changes.

title: Nickel Futs Jump As Indonesia Instructs World's Largest Mine To Slash Output
summary: Nickel futures jumped after Indonesia instructed the world’s largest nickel mine, Eramet and Tsingshan’s Weda Bay Nickel, to slash output. Authorities capped 2026 nickel-ore production at 12 million tons versus 42 million tons in 2025, tightening supply. LME nickel rose about 2.8% on the move.

title: FinancialContent - Aluminum's Sudden Surge: How Supply Cracks and China's Recovery Are Fueling a 2026 Bull Run
summary: Aluminum prices jumped 5.7% in early February 2026, pushing LME above $3,000/ton, as inventories hit multi-year lows and China’s “Two New” stimulus and EV growth boosted demand. Sanctions restrict Russian supply, while capacity caps and environmental mandates limit new smelting, tightening supply.

title: FinancialContent - The Red Metal's Tug-of-War: Record Highs Meet Inventory Buffers as Copper Rally Cools
summary: Copper prices surged to record highs in late January before cooling in February as China entered Lunar New Year holiday shutdowns and speculative momentum faded. U.S. COMEX inventories rose to a 21-year high, buffering supply risks even after the Mantoverde mine strike ended, keeping near-term price direction mixed.

title: Vedanta Ltd Moves Madras High Court Against TNPCB's Refusal To Permit Green Copper Manufacturing Unit At Thoothukudi
summary: Vedanta has filed a plea with the Madras High Court after Tamil Nadu’s Pollution Control Board declined permission for its proposed “Green Copper” unit at its Sterlite Copper facility in Thoothukudi. The court asked the state to respond. The dispute could delay copper production in the near term.

title: Vedanta Moves Madras HC Against TNPCB's Rejection of 'Green Copper' Project
summary: Vedanta has filed a petition in Madras High Court to quash TNPCB’s refusal to grant consent for its proposed “Green Copper” operation at the Thoothukudi smelter (closed since 2019). Vedanta argues procedural violations and seeks a court-monitored expert review, potentially improving outlook for copper supply.

title: Study: Bacterium enriches mine drainage copper to ore level | The Asahi Shimbun: Breaking News, Japan News and Analysis
summary: Researchers say an iron-oxidizing bacterium in old mine drainage can concentrate copper up to ore-like levels, potentially enabling more efficient copper recovery from scrap electronics. Given demand growth amid limited large new mines, the finding could modestly improve near-term supply expectations, supporting copper prices.

title: US embargo on Cuba: Island under siege in nickel wars
summary: The article argues the U.S. embargo on Cuba—especially cutting energy and financial channels—has caused widespread blackouts and has “crippled” Cuba’s mining sector, with nickel production falling sharply. It highlights Cuba’s major nickel reserves and claims the disruption weakens battery-material supply chains tied to China and Russia.

title: NIC ASX: ASX nickel stocks get a sugar hit from Indonesia's output curb
summary: Indonesia’s regulators ordered PT Weda Bay Nickel to cut ore production quotas sharply, from 42 million tonnes last year to 12 million tonnes for 2026. The move is intended to correct a nickel supply glut, and nickel reportedly rallied in London following the announcement.

title: Vedanta moves HC over proposed green copper project
summary: Vedanta moved the Madras High Court to push Tamil Nadu to form an expert panel to assess feasibility of its proposed “green copper” project at the defunct Sterlite site after TNPCB rejected its operating application. The court seeks a state response by Feb 26; approval is not yet decided.

title: CopperTech partnership to boost geoscience tech at Konkola mines
summary: CopperTech Metals partnered with Axiom, VBKOM and Fleet Space to apply AI-driven mining and Fleet’s ExoSphere platform for detailed 3D seismic surveys at Zambia’s Konkola Copper Mines. The goal is higher-resolution orebody models, better drill targeting, and faster exploration decision-making, which could support copper production outlooks.

title: Metalero Mining Corp.: Metalero Reports Extended Copper and Gold Soil Results at the Cantin Target on the Benson Project, Quesnel Trough, British Columbia.
summary: Metalero Mining reported expanded copper (and gold) soil anomalies at its Benson Project after an additional Ionic Leach survey. The anomalies cover large areas and remain open in multiple directions, supporting future drilling plans. Funds from a private placement will support exploration, with no near-term production impacts mentioned.

title: CME to list Taiwan, Hong Kong warehouses in Asia aluminium push, sources say
summary: CME Group is set to approve Taiwan’s Kaohsiung and Hong Kong as delivery warehouse locations for Comex aluminium futures, expanding its Asia footprint beyond Malaysia, Singapore and South Korea. The change could improve access to bonded storage and attract more non-U.S. supply flows, with aluminium stocks low globally.

title: DRiV Expands Ferodo Premier Copper-Free Brake Pads for Commercial Vehicles
summary: DRiV/ Ferodo is expanding OE-quality copper-free brake pads for commercial vehicles, using alternative friction materials to eliminate copper due to environmental hazard concerns. The company claims improved durability and bedding-in performance via a high-performance coating. The copper substitution could marginally reduce copper demand, but volumes are not provided.

title: Vale posts $3.8 billion Q4 loss on nickel assets impairment
summary: Vale reported a widened Q4 net loss, including a $3.5 billion impairment on its Canadian nickel assets. The impairment was triggered by downward revisions to long-term nickel price assumptions based on market estimates. While core EBITDA beat expectations, the nickel outlook deterioration is likely negative for nickel sentiment near term.

title: Trump plans to roll back tariffs on metal and aluminium goods, FT reports
summary: The FT reports that Trump plans to roll back tariffs on metal and aluminium goods. Easing trade barriers would likely lower import costs and improve near-term demand expectations for aluminium products, offering support to aluminium prices over the following days to weeks.

title: Trump plans to roll back some tariffs on metal and aluminium goods, FT reports
summary: Trump plans to scale back some U.S. tariffs on steel and aluminum goods, reviewing product lists and shifting to more targeted probes. The FT/Reuters report says tariffs are raising consumer prices. Aluminum prices on the LME fell to a one-week low and U.S. aluminum buyers face record premiums despite the news.

title: Motheo copper mine on-site power project
summary: Tshukudu Metals Botswana, a Sandfire Resources subsidiary, signed a deal for a 21 MW solar plant at the Motheo copper mine near Ghanzi. The project, financed via a lease-to-own arrangement, is expected online by end-2026 and should cover ~30% of electricity demand. Impact on near-term copper prices appears limited.

title: Trump plans to roll back some tariffs on metal and aluminium goods
summary: Trump plans to scale back some US tariffs on steel and aluminium goods, reviewing affected product lists and potentially exempting some items while using targeted national security probes instead of broader tariff coverage. The report cites sources and Reuters could not immediately verify, implying potential near-term shifts in aluminium import expectations.

title: Trump plans to roll back steel and aluminium tariffs
summary: Trump plans to scale back certain US tariffs on imported steel and aluminium products, with reviews to exempt some items and halt tariff list expansions. Officials say tariffs raised consumer prices. The change should ease aluminium import costs and reduce near-term price pressure, likely weighing on aluminium markets.

title: Trump plans to roll back some tariffs on steel and aluminium goods, FT reports
summary: The FT/Reuters report says the Trump administration plans to scale back some steel and aluminium tariffs by exempting certain products and halting expansion of levy lists. Officials argue tariffs are raising consumer prices. Easing aluminium trade barriers should support near-term aluminium price sentiment; copper impact is more indirect via industrial demand.

title: Trump Plans to Scale Back Some Steel, Aluminum Tariffs, FT Says, Citing Sources
summary: Financial Times reports that Trump plans to roll back some steel and aluminum tariffs, with exemptions for certain items and additional targeted trade probes. While officials declined comment, the proposed tariff easing on aluminum would likely reduce import restrictions and weaken price support in the near term.

title: SMM Aluminium P1020A premium, ddp Midwest US Launch [SMM Price Announcement] — Shanghai Metals Market (SMM)
summary: SMM reports declining US primary aluminum operating capacity and rising reliance on imports, alongside a prior increase in US aluminum import tariffs from 25% to 50%. It will start publishing a new US Midwest DDP premium (P1020A) daily from Feb 27, 2026 to improve price transparency based on delivered transactions.

title: Tender No. 936- Misr Aluminum Company | The Middle East Observer
summary: The Middle East Observer lists a tender (No. 27/2025/2026) by Misr Aluminum Company for the supply of electric cables, with a specified bid bond and a deadline of 26 February 2026. While it may signal some demand for cable materials, no quantities or contract size are provided.

title: Aluminum Futs Slide As Trump Weighs Metal Tariff Rollback In Affordability Push
summary: London aluminum futures fell 1.3% as a Financial Times report said the Trump administration is considering a partial rollback, exemption carve-outs, and narrower investigations for up to 50% steel and aluminum tariffs. Officials see tariffs denting consumer sentiment and prices for goods like drink cans, pressuring aluminum markets.

title: US steel and aluminium tariffs: White House reviewing exemptions after price increases
summary: The White House is reviewing exemptions for US steel and aluminium tariffs after the levies to metal-made goods contributed to higher prices. After raising steel and aluminium import tariffs to 50% last June and expanding coverage to products like cans and cutlery, officials may exempt some items, per reports.

title: Copper is pricing scarcity at a time of plenty
summary: Copper prices are rallying on prior scarcity fears, but the article argues tightness is easing. Exchange inventories have surged across CME, LME, and SHFE; premiums like the CME/LME spread and Yangshan premium have narrowed to lows. Forward curves shifted to contango, signaling ample availability and curbing demand expectations.

title: Weak nickel prices drag down Vale's fourth quarter results
summary: Vale reported a US$3.8 billion fourth-quarter net loss, citing weak nickel prices as a key driver. The company also booked a $3.5 billion impairment on Canadian nickel assets after downward revisions to long-term nickel price assumptions linked to a nickel surplus and softer EV-linked demand.

title: A.I.S. Resources' Saint John Copper/Gold/Antimony Project Gets TSXV Acceptance
summary: AIS announced TSXV Exchange acceptance for an earn-in agreement to acquire up to a 75% interest in the Saint John IOCG/porphyry project in New Brunswick. The project targets copper alongside gold, silver, and antimony, with surface samples reporting copper up to 10.55% and planned surveys/drilling. No near-term production impacts are stated.

title: Trump TACOs on Steel, Aluminum Tariffs
summary: The post claims Trump is preparing to roll back promised steel and aluminium tariffs. It cites a Bloomberg comment that aluminium in America has surged to a record high above $5,000/metric ton, suggesting tariffs were propping prices. Rolling them back would likely reduce immediate cost pressure on aluminium.

title: Inside the $400 billion copper battle that could reshape America's future
summary: The article recounts ongoing legal and political disputes over Alaska’s Pebble copper project, including an EPA veto and court litigation. Backers cite a massive copper resource and argue US permitting changes could unlock strategic supply amid electrification, AI demand, and China-led processing dominance. Full production would take years, but near-term sentiment supports copper.

title: Al Taiseer Group Talco wins approval for key Saudi aluminum plant acquisition
summary: Al Taiseer Group Talco received board approval to acquire a 60% stake in Saudi-based Eastern Aluminum Extrusion Factory in Dammam. The deal follows preliminary agreement for due diligence and depends on feasibility studies and fair-value determination. The transaction supports expansion in aluminium extrusion and finishing, potentially boosting near-term aluminium demand.

title: Al Taiseer Group Talco wins approval for key Saudi aluminium plant acquisition
summary: Al Taiseer Group Talco says its board has approved a 60% stake acquisition in Saudi-based Eastern Aluminum Extrusion Factory in Dammam. The deal follows a preliminary agreement to conduct due diligence and studies, subject to feasibility confirmation and fair-value determination before a share purchase agreement is signed.

title: Apple's Budget MacBook to Feature iPhone Processor, Fun Colors, and Aluminum Body [Report]
summary: Apple is reportedly finalizing a budget entry-level MacBook aimed at education and enterprise customers. The laptop would use an aluminum body with a new forging process to reduce manufacturing costs. While it may modestly increase aluminum demand, the article lacks volume details, limiting expected near-term price impact.

title: Acid, not copper, is paying China's smelters but will it last?
summary: After Russia halted sulphur exports, sulphuric acid prices surged and boosted profits for China’s copper smelters, even as TC/RC fees fell to record lows. Analysts expect acid prices to decline 10–30% amid demand destruction and export caps, increasing the risk of lower smelter utilization and weaker copper sentiment.

title: Hot Chili stacks shallow high-grade copper hits in Chile
summary: Hot Chili says new diamond drilling at its La Verde copper-gold discovery in Chile returned multiple long, high-grade intercepts near surface and indicates a thickening copper porphyry core at depth. Results could improve early pit economics for the Costa Fuego development, boosting copper sentiment despite no immediate production impact.

title: Fleet Space partners with CopperTech Metals & Axiom Group to deploy agile geoscience in Zambia
summary: Fleet Space is partnering with CopperTech Metals and Axiom Group to deploy its ExoSphere “Agile Geoscience” platform in Zambia, integrating AI-assisted targeting and multi-physics subsurface surveys into near-mine exploration at Konkola. The effort aims to accelerate resource-to-reserve conversion and support copper production growth, but without near-term volume impacts.

title: Avalon nickel bond default leaves State's Mining Rehab Fund bracing for record $300m clean-up bill
summary: Avalon’s nickel bond default has the Western Australia Mining Rehab Fund preparing for a record $300m clean-up bill. The news highlights financial distress tied to nickel assets, increasing perceived short-term risk of operational disruption and potential supply constraints, which can support nickel price expectations over coming weeks.

title: FinancialContent - Copper Values Retreat to $5.9 Per Pound as Chinese Industrial Engine Idles for Lunar New Year
summary: Copper futures eased to about $5.90/lb as China enters Lunar New Year, pausing industrial activity and allowing refined copper stocks to build in Shanghai and LME warehouses. The seasonal demand dip plus expectations of slower 2026 refined output growth outweigh support from AI/data-center demand in the near term.

title: This new aluminum-based EV battery could solve cold-weather range and charging issues
summary: Researchers in China report a new aluminum-anode, wide-temperature lithium-ion battery for EVs that maintains high efficiency in sub-zero conditions and enables faster charging in extreme cold. If commercialized, the aluminum-based design could support incremental demand expectations for aluminium used in batteries, though current evidence is still early.

title: Big Aussie miner marks record earnings boost on copper
summary: BHP reported record earnings and production, with its copper division contributing 51% of underlying earnings. The company attributed results to a surge to record copper prices tied to supply disruptions and demand from renewables and data centers. BHP also lifted 2025/26 copper output guidance to 1.9–2.0 million tonnes and reiterated growth plans.

title: Copper powers profit surge at Australia's BHP
summary: BHP reported a sharp rise in half-year profits, attributing it partly to demand for copper used to expand electrical networks for renewables. The company cited its increased copper output (including from Chile’s Escondida) and said copper is now the biggest earnings contributor, reinforcing expectations for higher copper prices.

title: Mega miner BHP posts record copper, iron ore production
summary: BHP reported record interim production and earnings, with copper driving more than half of underlying profits. The company lifted its 2025/26 copper output guidance to 1.9–2.0 million tonnes and cited strong demand and supply disruptions behind recent price strength. It also plans major copper project spending in Argentina.

title: BHP profit beats forecasts as copper tops iron ore earnings on AI-driven demand
summary: BHP reported stronger-than-forecast profits, with copper overtaking iron ore in earnings as red-metal prices surge. The rise is attributed to AI-driven growth in electricity demand for data centres and the shift to cleaner energy. BHP cited higher realised copper prices and expects continued focus on copper expansion.

title: BHP earnings show copper growing in importance alongside iron ore
summary: BHP’s December half profits highlight an upsized US73¢ interim dividend, exceeding market expectations. The coverage notes copper is gaining importance alongside iron ore, focusing investor attention on BHP’s copper outlook and helping reinforce near-term sentiment toward copper demand/supply expectations.

title: Suspended jail time for man who damaged UC RUSAL copper cables
summary: A man in Jamaica received suspended jail time for maliciously cutting copper cables belonging to UC RUSAL. Security staff reported he removed copper wire from the company’s facilities, with copper wire and a hacksaw found in his possession. The incident is localized and unlikely to affect broader copper supply or pricing.

title: How might end to steel and aluminum tariffs impact consumers?
summary: The Financial Times reports President Trump may roll back aluminum and steel tariffs. The change could lower prices of goods that use these metals, such as appliances and cans, though effects on housing and groceries would be limited. White House officials say no final decision is made yet.

title: True North steps up Qld copper push with development drilling
summary: True North Copper has ramped up extension drilling at its Cloncurry Queensland copper project, including metallurgical and infill/extension holes aimed at boosting resource confidence ahead of a pre-feasibility study. It reports larger copper resources at Great Australia, Taipan and Orphan Shear, with additional target testing at nearby prospects.

title: Hindustan Copper, NALCO, other stocks fall up to 4% as metals decline; index down 2%
summary: Shares of Hindustan Copper and NALCO fell up to 4% as metal prices weakened. Copper futures with Feb expiry dropped around 2% on MCX, and the Nifty Metal index declined 2%. The report links the equity slump to falling metals and mentions easing geopolitical tensions.

title: Antofagasta's 2025 core profit climbs 52% on soaring copper prices
summary: Antofagasta reported a 52% jump in 2025 core profit as benchmark copper prices surged more than 40% last year. The miner said higher capital spending at its Centinela concentrator supports production and noted potential progress on its Twin Metals copper-nickel project in Minnesota. Shares fell despite the earnings beat.

title: Antofagasta: Copper's red-hot year | MarketScreener
summary: Antofagasta reported a 52% jump in annual core profit largely due to an 18% rise in its realized copper price, despite slightly lower copper output. It plans higher capital spending, including Centinela expansion, to lift production over the medium term, while maintaining 2026 guidance.

title: Talisman Metals to acquire Tirzzit Copper Project in Morocco
summary: Talisman Metals agreed to acquire the Tirzzit copper-silver project in Morocco from Aya Silver & Gold, via its subsidiary Horizons Mines. The licences cover 16.5km² near Agadir, with expiry in 2028. The deposit is described as a copper-silver system and is expected to be assessed for development over coming months.

title: Australia's BHP to invest in copper projects | Latest Market News
summary: BHP outlined a pipeline of copper projects that could add 1.8-2.0mn t of capacity over the next decade, while keeping FY25/26 copper production guidance unchanged. It cited ongoing output changes at South Australia and forecasts increasing long-run demand and potential supply shortfalls, with project start-ups from 2028 onward.

title: Canadian Copper Inc.: Canadian Copper Announces a Non-Brokered Flow-Through Offering
summary: Canadian Copper Inc. announced a non-brokered flow-through share offering to raise up to $2.2 million, earmarked for 2026–2027 exploration expenses in New Brunswick. The program includes drilling and geophysics at copper deposits, but the release does not affect near-term production or physical copper supply.

title: Camino Minerals Corp: Camino Intercepts High-Grade Copper with 83.5m at 0.94% Cu including 7.1m at 2.13% Cu at Los Chapitos, Peru
summary: Camino Minerals reported Phase 1 drilling results from its Los Chapitos copper project in Peru, including broad intervals such as 83.5m at 0.94% Cu and 7.1m at 2.13% Cu, plus other mineralized hits. The company says results validate geology and extend prospects for deeper continuity, planning further drilling.

title: BHP profit beats forecasts as copper tops iron ore
summary: BHP reported stronger-than-expected profits, with results driven by copper as realised copper prices rose 32%. The company links copper demand growth to AI-fuelled data centre power demand and cleaner energy expansion, and reiterated copper output growth plans and large development investment. Iron ore weakened, but copper outperformed.

title: BHP profit beats forecasts as copper tops iron ore earnings on AI demand
summary: BHP reported a stronger-than-expected half-year profit, with copper outperforming iron ore in operating earnings as copper prices surged 32%. Management links demand to AI-driven power growth for data centers and the clean-energy transition, reinforcing bullish near-term expectations for copper, alongside higher dividends.

title: Miners BHP and Antofagasta cash in on soaring copper demand as investors pile into metals
summary: BHP and Antofagasta reported stronger results as copper demand remains robust. BHP said copper contributed the largest share of earnings and raised production guidance, while Antofagasta saw higher profit on increased demand and prices. Copper is cited near record levels, reinforcing bullish near-term sentiment.

title: American Steel and Aluminum Introduces New Domestic Ground Screw Offering to Accelerate US Solar Projects with Shorter Lead Times
summary: American Steel and Aluminum introduced a new domestically produced steel ground screw to speed US solar project foundations via shorter lead times and domestic supply-chain control. The news is primarily about steel/racking equipment rather than tracked copper or aluminium pricing, so any impact on those markets is likely indirect and limited.

title: BHP Targets $10 Billion in Asset Sales to Help Fund Copper Expansion -- Commodities Roundup
summary: BHP plans to raise up to $10 billion through asset sales, including a $4.3 billion silver-streaming deal tied to its Antamina copper mine, to fund copper expansion. The piece also highlights Antofagasta’s record earnings supported by higher copper prices, reinforcing positive sentiment for copper.

title: World Pumps - Weir installs China's largest mill circuit slurry pumps at high-altitude copper mine
summary: Weir installed China’s largest mill circuit slurry pumps at a high-altitude copper mine (5,300m), deploying six MCR 650 and two MCR 750 pumps. Crews completed the work on schedule despite freezing temperatures and thin air. Weir said the pumps help miners boost throughput as ore grades decline.

title: BHP shares rally as supply squeeze, AI demand fuel copper-mania
summary: BHP’s results are framed as copper “mania,” with realized copper prices up 32% and copper driving over half of profit. The firm cites tight supply from disruptions at major mines and tariff threats, while raising FY copper guidance. Analysts link AI data centres and EV/renewables to sustained demand.

title: Arizona Sonoran Copper, Nuton Terminate Option to Joint Venture on Cactus Project
summary: Arizona Sonoran Copper said it has mutually agreed with Nuton to terminate an option for a joint venture on its Cactus Project in Arizona. The company will pay $15 million immediately and $5 million within a year, plus up to about $15 million more if a change of control occurs. No production timing changes were stated.

title: FinancialContent - Aluminum Prices Defy Tariff Rollback Rumors as 'Project Vault' and Carbon Levies Reshape Global Supply
summary: Aluminum prices are holding above $3,100/tonne despite tariff rollback rumors because physical scarcity persists. The U.S. “Project Vault” launches a large federal buying program, while EU CBAM (from Jan. 1) tightens supply of traditional primary aluminum. Low inventories and a record Midwest Premium point to further upside.

title: BHP's Copper Pivot Pays Off With Surprise Dividend Bump, Record-High Stock Price
summary: BHP’s earnings beat and a dividend increase helped shares hit a record high, with copper contributing over half of profit for the first time. Management highlighted its copper pivot and improvements at Escondida, as copper prices rallied. Iron ore was softer, but copper-led results support bullish sentiment for copper within weeks.

title: Erdene Resource Development Corporation: Erdene Expands Mineralization at Zuun Mod Molybedenum-Copper Project
summary: Erdene reported new drilling intersections at its Zuun Mod molybdenum-copper project in Mongolia, extending near-continuous Mo and Cu mineralization and planning a resource update and PEA in 2026. The update may modestly affect sentiment on future copper supply, but no immediate production changes were announced.

title: Erdene Resource Development Corporation Expands Mineralization At Zuun Mod Molybedenum-Copper Project
summary: Erdene reported drill results and plans to update resources and complete a PEA for its Zuun Mod molybdenum-copper project in Mongolia. Near-surface drilling intersected high-grade Mo and copper, including further testing of copper porphyry targets. The news is pre-development, limiting short-term metal price effects.

title: US Open to Changing Steel and Aluminum Tariffs, Greer Says
summary: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said the administration is open to adjusting how steel and aluminum tariffs are applied, though the core metals tariffs will remain. Companies face compliance complexity and trading partners seek reductions. Aluminum stocks fell sharply on the news, and steel also declined, indicating bearish sentiment for aluminum prices.

title: Trade representative hints there might be changes to steel and aluminum tariffs
summary: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said the administration may ease or adjust how proposed steel and aluminum tariffs are applied, citing company compliance difficulties and political headwinds. While he indicated the underlying metals tariff proposals remain, any rollback/relief would likely support near-term expectations for aluminum prices.

title: Marimaca Copper Corp.: Marimaca Copper Announces Global Offering of C$409 Million (~ A$423 Million)
summary: Marimaca Copper Corp. announced a C$409 million global offering (treasury and secondary components) to fund pre-construction engineering, early site works, and a drilling campaign at its Marimaca copper project in Chile. Net proceeds support development and working capital; secondary proceeds go to selling shareholders. No immediate production change is described.

title: The Overnight Report: Gold, Silver, Copper Fall
summary: The overnight report flags commodity risk-off as gold and silver dip on improved US-Iran prospects and a stronger USD. Crucially, it says copper fell to around US$12,700/t as exchange stockpiles rose to multi-year highs and China demand/spot premiums weakened. Aluminium stabilised near US$3,000/t as LME inventories declined.

title: Capstone Copper Corp.: Capstone Copper Announces 2026 Guidance
summary: Capstone Copper released 2026 annual production and cost guidance, forecasting 200,000–230,000 tonnes of copper and C1 cash costs of $2.45–$2.75/lb. It outlined mine-specific grade/maintenance impacts and planned capital for the Mantoverde Optimized Project and Santo Domingo, influencing expectations for future copper supply and costs.

title: Copper Drives BHP Earnings Beyond Wall Street Expectations
summary: BHP’s shares jumped after earnings beat expectations, with copper contributing more than half of profit for the first time. The company’s pivot into copper and improvements at Escondida were aided by a surge in LME copper prices, while iron ore remained weaker. Coverage underscores strong near-term copper momentum.

title: Golden Sky Minerals Corp.: Golden Sky Minerals Reports Results of 2025 Exploration at Rayfield-Gjoll Copper-Gold Project
summary: Golden Sky Minerals announced results from a 2025 airborne magnetic survey at its Rayfield-Gjoll copper-gold project in British Columbia, highlighting structural trends and copper-in-soil values up to 0.96% Cu. The company increased target confidence and plans induced polarization and diamond drilling, but no production or supply changes are reported.

title: USTR hints at possible adjustments in steel, aluminum tariff implementation
summary: USTR official Jamieson Greer suggested the U.S. may adjust how steel and aluminum tariffs are applied for compliance, citing difficulties calculating duties on derivative products. He said the steel and aluminum tariffs have been successful and will remain, while Supreme Court consideration of emergency-law tariffs continues.

title: Indonesia tightens control on nickel as the US and China scramble for critical minerals
summary: Indonesia is tightening state control over its nickel sector through crackdowns on illegal exploitation, with large seizures and fines across mines and processing sites. With EV makers increasingly shifting toward LFP batteries that use less nickel, the move raises near-term supply uncertainty and lowers nickel demand expectations.

title: Indonesia tightens control on nickel as the U.S. and China scramble for critical minerals | The Asahi Shimbun: Breaking News, Japan News and Analysis
summary: Indonesia is tightening state control over the nickel industry after crackdowns on illegal mining and large seizures/fines. The move raises uncertainty for supply and downstream processing at a time EV demand is shifting toward lower-nickel battery chemistries (LFP). China-U.S. competition for critical minerals adds market focus.

title: Can Australia benefit from Indonesia's nickel cuts?
summary: Indonesia ordered major reductions in nickel ore production for 2026, including a 71% cut at the PT Weda Bay Mine, to address global oversupply and stabilize prices. The announcement is cited with LME benchmark nickel jumping more than 2% and analysts upgrading nickel forecasts, indicating near-term bullish pressure.

title: Glencore sets 1-million-tonne copper target after annual profit swing
summary: Glencore reported swung to annual profit and reiterated momentum for a copper-led growth strategy. It targets annualised copper production of over 1 million tonnes by end-2028 and reached a DRC land-access agreement for Kamoto Copper Co. The operational performance and production plans are supportive for near-term copper market sentiment.

title: Glencore Finalises Land Access Agreement With Gécamines For Kamoto Copper Co.
summary: Glencore said it has finalised a land access agreement with Gécamines for Kamoto Copper Co. in the DRC, unlocking long-term mining titles and leases. The deal supports expansion of tailings storage and waste rock dump capacity, enabling an extension of KCC’s life of mine and higher recovery in existing areas.

title: Zambia's ZCCM Considers Direct Copper Exports as Demand Outlook Tightens
summary: Zambia’s ZCCM is discussing with Mercuria and others to directly market its share of copper output, shifting from dividend income to active trading and export control. The move parallels DRC’s Gécamines, amid rising demand and IEA warnings of a widening copper supply gap ahead.

title: Zambia Was Africa's Top Copper Producer. Now It's Investing Billions to Close the Gap With the DRC
summary: Zambia says it is investing billions and securing funding for copper projects, with 2025 output up 8% year-on-year. Prospect Resources raised A$45 million for the Mumbezhi project as Zambia targets 3 million tons of annual copper by 2031, aiming to narrow the gap with the DRC.

title: Canada One Mining Corp.: Canada One Assays up to 9.96 g/t High-Grade Au with Cu and Ag at the Reco Target, Copper Dome Project
summary: Canada One Mining reported high-grade rock grab assay results from the Reco target at its Copper Dome Project, including elevated copper (up to ~1.75% Cu). The company says results strengthen its copper-gold exploration thesis next to Hudbay’s Copper Mountain Mine. The news is exploration-stage and preliminary.

title: Glencore profits take a hit as coal price slump offsets copper boom
summary: Glencore reported lower adjusted earnings because coal and energy prices slumped, partially offset by stronger metals pricing during a copper boom. The piece notes copper trading near fresh highs, supported by safe-haven demand and a weaker dollar, and highlights Glencore’s new DRC copper lease deal.

title: Glencore deepens DRC ties to expand Kamoto Copper Company
summary: Glencore said it reached a land access deal with DRC state firm Gecamines to unlock expanded leased areas for Kamoto Copper Company. The agreement extends KCC’s mine lifespan and allows increased efficiencies, targeting higher copper output to around 300,000 tonnes annually and longer operations into the mid-2040s.

title: Indonesia Tightens Control on Nickel as the US and China Scramble for Critical Minerals
summary: Indonesia is tightening state control over its nickel industry, seizing large areas and imposing significant fines over illegal or improper operations. The crackdown comes as EV makers increasingly adopt LFP battery chemistries that use less nickel. Together, supply and demand uncertainties in the largest nickel supplier weigh on nickel expectations.

title: Enduro Metals Corporation: Enduro Metals Identifies New Gold Skarn in Bedrock, Expands 5.5 km Gold-Copper Target at October Dome Project, BC
summary: Enduro Metals reports 2025 sampling that identified strongly mineralized gold skarn in bedrock at its October Dome project and expanded a gold-copper target corridor to 5.5 km, with soil copper anomalies up to 0.13%. The release is exploration-focused with no production impact, so near-term copper price effects are likely limited.

title: Indonesia tightens control on nickel as US and China scramble for critical minerals
summary: Indonesia is tightening state control over nickel, seizing large areas of mines and processing sites, imposing fines, and targeting illegal exploitation. As EV makers increasingly shift to lithium iron phosphate batteries that use less nickel, the market faces both higher supply uncertainty and weaker near-term demand outlook for nickel.

title: Cyclone Gezani Forces Halt at Madagascar's Ambatovy Nickel Mine
summary: Cyclone Gezani has halted operations at Sumitomo’s Ambatovy nickel and cobalt mine in Madagascar. The company suspended production ahead of the storm and says the mine cannot restart immediately due to damage assessment and rebuilding needs. With Ambatovy already below capacity, the stop increases near-term nickel supply uncertainty.

title: FinancialContent - Red Gold Rises: Copper Hits Record Highs as AI Boom and Trade Tensions Reshape Global Markets
summary: Copper surged over 8% to record levels, with LME copper futures peaking around $14,500/ton, driven by AI infrastructure demand and U.S. tariff-related stockpiling that tightened physical availability. The article projects a refined copper deficit into 2026, keeping prices elevated. Aluminium is mentioned mainly as a constrained substitute.

title: Anglo Asian eyes shift to copper as main product, tripling output
summary: Anglo Asian Mining said it aims to triple copper production in 2026 to 20,000–25,000 tonnes, making copper its primary product, helped by Azerbaijani mines starting production last year. The firm also forecasts higher gold and silver output and provides copper cost guidance of $6,800–$7,800/t.

title: Glencore Goes Shopping Again, Copper in Hand
summary: Glencore’s failed $260 billion Rio Tinto merger is off, but CEO Gary Nagle reiterates willingness to pursue large deals in a copper-hungry market. The firm also reports strong metals performance and progress on expanding output at Kamoto in the DRC, supporting a bullish copper narrative.

title: Role of Gupta-linked shipping agent in Trafigura nickel scandal highlights long-standing problem
summary: A UK logistics intermediary is linked to a London court finding of fraudulent duplicate bills of lading tied to Trafigura’s nickel claims. The court found Gupta-controlled entities used the agent to duplicate documents and that some cargoes weren’t nickel at all. The disputes disrupt delivery and raise counterparty and trade-finance risk for nickel.

title: Viridian Confirms Basin-Scale Plumbing Systems and Copper-Bearing Chemical Traps at the Sedna Project
summary: Viridian Metals reports MT and mapping results at its Sedna Project in Labrador, showing basin-scale plumbing systems and widespread copper-bearing reduced horizons hosting disseminated chalcopyrite. The company says the model de-risks an emerging sediment-hosted copper district and moves forward with permitting and follow-up exploration at targets.

title: Trump DOJ Blocks Largest Copper, Gold, And Silver Extraction Site In The US Over Salmon, Sending Stock Tumbling
summary: The Trump DOJ defended the Biden EPA’s 2023 veto blocking the Pebble Mine in Alaska. The project was projected to be the US’s largest copper source, alongside other metals. Blocking it raises near-term copper supply uncertainty, contributing to a sharp drop in Northern Dynasty Minerals’ shares.

title: Norway's Scatec Signs 21 MW Solar Lease for Botswana Copper Mine
summary: Release, a Scatec subsidiary, signed a seven-year lease for a 21 MW solar plant to power Botswana’s Motheo copper mine, supplying about 30% of the site’s electricity needs. Service is expected by end-2026. The move reflects mining’s shift to cleaner power, potentially easing production constraints over time.

title: Congo state firm strikes deal to sell copper from Glencore mine, Bloomberg News reports
summary: DR Congo’s state miner Gecamines has reportedly secured rights to tender and market about half of output from Glencore’s Kamoto Copper Company for at least two years, and 30% thereafter. Reuters could not verify; Glencore didn’t comment. The arrangement affects copper supply flows from the DRC.

title: Molson Coors forecasts sharp drop in 2026 profit as aluminum costs bite
summary: Molson Coors forecast lower 2026 profit due to higher aluminum tariffs and a spike in the U.S. Midwest aluminum premium, which increased its cost of goods sold for aluminum-can packaging. The company expects aluminum costs to weigh on profit by about $125 million, reinforcing near-term aluminum price pressure.

title: Taseko Announces Strong Fourth Quarter Financial Results and Commencement of Copper Production at Florence Copper | Company Announcement
summary: Taseko announced strong 2025 results and that Florence Copper’s SX/EW plant has started and is now plating copper cathode, with wellfield injection operating and cathode harvest expected in coming days. The company also guided higher 2026 Gibraltar copper output, supporting improved near-term copper supply expectations.

title: BHP Crowns Itself The Asset Savvy Copper King
summary: The piece says BHP’s first-half copper earnings surpassed its iron ore earnings for the first time, aided by a highlighted silver streaming deal and an unexpectedly strong dividend. While details are limited, better-than-expected results tied to copper are likely to support short-term copper sentiment.

title: Taseko starts Florence copper cathode output as it returns to profit
summary: Taseko says production of copper cathode has begun at its Florence Copper project in Arizona, with commissioning now complete and first cathode harvest expected soon. The firm also swung to profit on higher fourth-quarter revenue, alongside improved Gibraltar copper output and sales.

title: Western Australia voices disappointment in U.S. aluminum giant after record environmental fine-Xinhua
summary: Western Australia’s premier criticized Alcoa after the U.S. miner was fined 55 million Australian dollars for unlawfully clearing native forest to mine bauxite in WA. The federal government said Alcoa will continue operations under an agreement requiring stronger invasive species management, conservation programs, and ecological offsets, likely increasing near-term costs and uncertainty for aluminium supply.

title: Lundin Mining Increases M&I Copper Mineral Resources by 37% and Updates Mineral Reserves
summary: Lundin Mining reported updated mineral resource and reserve estimates effective Dec. 31, 2025, with contained copper resources and reserves detailed across its Chile/Brazil assets and the Vicuña project. Changes are driven by resource updates, reserve declassifications, and asset sales. This is a copper supply-sentiment update without immediate production disruption.

title: Rio Tinto's annual profit flat as copper strength offsets weaker iron ore
summary: Rio Tinto reported flat full-year profit, with stronger copper prices and higher output offsetting weaker iron ore markets. The company’s underlying earnings matched expectations. The report signals copper price strength for Rio’s flagship operations, which can support near-term copper sentiment.

title: Landslide in Indonesia's Morowali nickel hub kills one, halts operations
summary: A landslide hit a tailings area at PT Indonesia Morowali Industrial Park (IMIP) in Sulawesi, killing one contractor and halting operations at the affected zone. The incident damaged equipment and is under investigation, potentially disrupting Indonesia’s nickel processing supply in the near term.

title: Copper prices help boost Teck Resources' Q4 profit forecast
summary: Teck Resources reported profit gains and works to close its Anglo deal. The headline notes that copper prices contributed to lifting its Q4 profit forecast, indicating better near-term copper price expectations that could support copper sentiment in the coming days.

title: Cherry bacterial canker: Chilean researchers reveal pathogen adaptation and warn about copper resistance- FreshFruitPortal.com
summary: Chile researchers found strains of the cherry bacterial canker pathogen have adapted locally and some populations show greater resistance to copper-based products. The findings suggest current copper controls may be less effective, supporting a shift toward integrated management and alternative measures, potentially softening expectations for copper-treated inputs.

title: Teck Resources tops profit estimates on higher copper prices, output
summary: Teck says QB2’s tailings-dam issues in Chile should stop constraining production by year-end, after mitigation work to improve drainage and dam height. The earnings call also reviews ongoing antitrust approvals for Anglo’s acquisition. The piece links the copper price backdrop to broader supply disruptions, implying near-term but mixed copper sentiment.

title: Selkirk Copper Mines Inc.: Selkirk Copper Intersects High-Grade Copper-Gold-Silver at the Minto East Zone, and Continues to Expand the Minto North West Zone
summary: Selkirk Copper Mines reported new assay results from drilling at its Minto Mine in Yukon, including high-grade copper intervals (up to 3–4% Cu in broader zones and higher grades in short intercepts). The company also updated its Phase 1 drilling progress and restart planning, targeting a longer mine life.

title: Kaiser Aluminum (NASDAQ:KALU) Announces Quarterly Earnings Results, Misses Expectations By $0.03 EPS
summary: Kaiser Aluminum reported Q4 EPS of $1.53, slightly below the $1.56 consensus, while revenue rose about 21% year over year to $929 million. Despite some strength in sales and dividend declaration, modest margins and a small EPS miss suggest limited net impact on near-term aluminium price expectations.

title: Amarc Resources Ltd.: Amarc Confirms Discovery of Third New Porphyry Copper-Gold System at JOY
summary: Amarc Resources reported final assay results from 10 holes at the JOY District, including the TWINS discovery, described as a third porphyry copper-gold system with extensive IP-defined lithocap and anomalous Cu-Au intercepts. The company plans further 2026 drilling; no near-term production changes are announced.

title: Vale Base Metals secures future of Manitoba mine with new consortium to invest up to US$200 million into Thompson Nickel Belt
summary: Vale Base Metals and partners formed a consortium to invest up to US$200 million to secure the Thompson Mine Complex in Manitoba, including the Thompson Nickel Belt. The deal includes an offtake agreement for nickel concentrate and aims to maintain long-term nickel production, supporting employment and operational continuity into the future.

title: Rio Tinto annual earnings flat as iron ore weakens, copper cushions blow
summary: Rio Tinto reported flat annual earnings as weak iron ore offset stronger copper results. The copper division doubled earnings, helped by higher realized 2025 copper prices and 11% higher output, including Oyu Tolgoi ramp-up. Aluminium is mentioned only as a smaller earnings contributor without specific drivers.

title: Glencore unveils DRC copper access deal - African Review
summary: Glencore said it reached an agreement with Gécamines in the DRC granting land access and long-term mining titles for Kamoto Copper Company (KCC). The deal enables capacity expansions for tailings and waste rock, improves efficiencies, supports a ~300,000 tpa copper output target, and extends mine life into the mid-2040s, subject to cadastre registration.

title: Copper drilling program starts north of Sault
summary: Sterling Metals has begun a drilling program at the Soo Copper Project north of Sault Ste Marie, targeting at least 20,000 metres this year and aiming to expand on last year’s results. The company frames the project as potentially significant copper discovery, but there’s no immediate production or supply impact.

title: Rio Tinto profits flat as weaker iron ore prices take shine off copper
summary: Rio Tinto reported flat profits as weaker iron ore prices were offset by higher copper prices and increased production. The company said copper realised prices rose 17% with output up 11%, supported by ramping Oyu Tolgoi. Analysts noted China demand concerns but copper-led growth remains in focus.

title: FinancialContent - The Carbon Wall: EU's CBAM Redefines Global Aluminum Markets as 2026 Levy Commences
summary: EU CBAM shifts into its 2026 levy phase, making importers of primary aluminium into the EU purchase and surrender EUA-linked certificates. Carbon costs penalize high-carbon coal-based smelters while low-carbon and scrap-based producers gain a “green premium.” The piece indicates immediate ripple effects on LME/Europe aluminium pricing via higher Rotterdam-linked premiums.

title: FinancialContent - Nickel Defies Gravity: Why Prices Are Soaring Amidst a Global Glut
summary: Nickel surged 5.2% in one session despite an oversupplied backdrop as Indonesia cut RKAB mining quotas, cracked down on illegal operations, and delayed compliance systems—limiting high-grade ore flows to smelters. The move was reinforced by U.S. strategic stockpiling targeting nickel, boosting speculative and institutional demand.

title: Vale Base Metals sells majority stake in Thompson Nickel Belt to Canadian-led consortium
summary: Vale Base Metals agreed to sell a majority stake in Manitoba’s Thompson Nickel Belt mine to a Canadian-led consortium, creating Exiro Nickel. The buyers plan $200 million to revive the operation, with Vale retaining 18.9% and signing a five-year offtake. Nickel prices have been pressured by higher supply and weak demand.

title: After UAE tour, Commerce CEO touts Inola aluminum plant amid anti-Muslim tensions
summary: Oklahoma leaders toured Emirates Global Aluminum and highlighted plans for a multi-billion-dollar primary aluminum smelter in Inola, described as the largest in the U.S. in 50 years. With EGA holding majority ownership and partnering with Century Aluminum, the project signals expanding aluminum production capacity, supporting sentiment despite being planned.

title: Exiro Nickel Company: Exiro Nickel Company to Acquire Thompson Operations from Vale Base Metals
summary: Exiro Nickel agreed to acquire Vale Base Metals’ Thompson nickel mine and concentrator in Manitoba, planning to restore production rates toward prior peaks and process ore at the on-site mill. The deal is expected to close by end-2026, with Vale retaining off-take rights, supporting a constructive nickel outlook.

title: Newmont Reports 2025 Mineral Reserves of 118.2 Million Gold Ounces and 12.5 Million Tonnes of Copper - Iberonews
summary: Newmont reported end-2025 mineral reserves of 118.2M ounces of gold and 12.5M tonnes of copper, with copper reserves slightly down from 2024 mainly due to reclassification of Yanacocha Sulfides from reserves to resources. The update does not mention operational changes that would materially affect near-term copper flows or prices.

title: Century Aluminum Company Reports Fourth Quarter 2025 Results
summary: Century Aluminum reported Q4/FY2025 results and discussed near-term operational changes: Iceland idled due to equipment failure, Mt. Holly planned restart over 50,000MT by end of Q2 2026, and Hawesville sale/redevelopment. It cited higher realized aluminum prices/premiums and expects Q1 2026 EBITDA to improve despite higher U.S. energy costs.

title: Beyond Capstone Copper's Guidance Shock
summary: Capstone Copper met 2025 targets but delivered weaker 2026 guidance: lower output (200–230kt vs consensus), higher cash costs, and higher capex, driven by grade shortfalls and a Mantoverde strike/shutdown. Brokers may adjust earnings down, even as copper price forecasts were upgraded to cushion the impact.

title: DMRC to Replace Copper Cables with Aluminium Across 175 km to Curb Theft
summary: Delhi Metro Rail Corporation plans to replace 175 km of 33 kV copper wiring with aluminium cables to deter repeated thefts that have disrupted signalling and auxiliary power. The Rs 32.59 crore project replaces existing copper cables with aluminium over 18 months, targeting vulnerable lines and improving reliability.

title: DMRC to Replace Copper Cables with Aluminium Across 175 km to Curb Theft
summary: Delhi Metro Rail Corporation plans to replace about 175 km of 33 kV copper signaling/power cables with aluminium over 18 months to reduce theft-driven outages. The project targets troublesome lines and follows repeated incidents causing signalling failures, speed restrictions, and delays. It reallocates cable demand from copper to aluminium.

title: Copper splits the majors: Rio vs BHP - Investor Daily
summary: Rio Tinto reported weaker overall results, but copper drove performance, with higher realised copper prices and sharply higher volumes after the Oyu Tolgoi ramp-up. BHP also confirmed copper is now its largest earnings driver and lifted copper guidance, reinforcing expectations of tight supply and firmer copper prices.

title: How Will Tight Copper Market Affect Data Center Growth?
summary: The piece argues that fast-growing AI data center demand is colliding with a tightening refined copper market, including a predicted 150,000 mt 2026 deficit. It notes rising copper quantities per GW, potential delays in copper-based electrical equipment, and measures like reserves and smelter relief—yet says shortages remain a risk.

title: Hudbay Minerals Inc.: Hudbay Delivers Record Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results; Achieves 2025 Consolidated Copper and Gold Production and Cost Guidance
summary: Hudbay reported record 2025 revenue and EBITDA and said it met its consolidated copper production guidance, with copper output of 118,188 tonnes. It also outlined 2026 copper guidance and cited temporary operational interruptions. The update may slightly affect near-term copper supply expectations, but likely not move the wider market meaningfully.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Signs Letter of Intent to Acquire BHP's San Manuel Property in Arizona, Creating a Multi-Asset Copper District in the USA
summary: Faraday Copper signed a non-binding LOI to acquire BHP’s San Manuel copper property in Arizona, adjacent to its Copper Creek project. The deal would consolidate the assets into a district-scale copper initiative and potentially support expedited cathode production, subject to definitive agreements and approvals.

title: Faraday Copper Signs Letter of Intent to Acquire BHP's San Manuel Property ...
summary: Faraday Copper signed a non-binding LOI to acquire BHP’s San Manuel copper property in Arizona, including mine deposits and processing sites. The company aims to consolidate adjacent assets to potentially accelerate copper cathode production and strengthen U.S. copper supply. Deal timing is toward Q3 2026, but sentiment is supportive.

title: Copper the new Gold?: Record Copper Prices - Why a Massive Shortage Is Coming
summary: Copper has hit record highs, and the interview argues the move may not be temporary. It attributes strength to electrification, EV adoption, renewable expansion, AI data centers, and grid upgrades, suggesting growing expectations of a substantial structural copper shortage ahead, which could keep prices firm.

title: FinancialContent - Copper's Cooling Period: Prices Retreat from Record Highs as Market Stabilizes After January Surge
summary: Copper prices are pulling back from late-January record highs, with the LME three-month contract retreating about 12% to the $12,600–$12,800/t range. The decline is linked to a stronger U.S. dollar, post-tariff profit booking, and China’s Lunar New Year trading slowdown, easing near-term demand.

title: Hudbay Minerals Inc.: Hudbay Receives New Ingerbelle Expansion Permits for Copper Mountain
summary: Hudbay says it has received amended Mines Act and Environmental Management Act permits for the New Ingerbelle expansion at its Copper Mountain mine in British Columbia. The approvals enable advancement of the project, extend mine life, and support higher copper output, improving near-term copper supply expectations and reducing permitting risk.

title: BHP Group plans Arizona land sale to Faraday Copper for stake in firm
summary: BHP signed a letter of intent with Faraday Copper to explore selling its San Manuel property in Arizona in exchange for a 30% interest and rights in Faraday. The parties will explore restarting the mine and building a copper hub. Restart expectations are supportive, but the agreement is non-binding.

title: Lundin Mining rides copper rally to record quarter
summary: Lundin Mining reported a record quarter and year, attributing results to realized copper prices near record highs. It is advancing the Vicuña joint venture with BHP, whose staged development could eventually produce large volumes of copper, with a potential sanction decision before year-end. The company says it can fund its share.

title: Rio Tinto Likely To Increase Iron Ore and Copper Volumes
summary: Rio Tinto, a major supplier to China, is expected to increase its copper volumes. The piece also discusses weakening demand after the China boom, especially for iron ore, but the explicit near-term operational change is directed at copper, which can influence expectations for copper supply and price.

title: Anquiro Ventures Ltd.: Anquiro Ventures Ltd and Black Pine Resources Corp Initiate Drill Program at Sugarloaf Copper Property
summary: Anquiro Ventures and Black Pine Resources begin a winter drill program at the Sugarloaf copper property near Tyrone, New Mexico. Permits are secured and up to 11 holes will test shallow oxide secondary copper, with planned Cu/Mo/Ag assays. The release is exploratory and does not affect current supply immediately.

title: What's up with the U.P.'s proposed 'Copperwood Mine' project? | Interlochen Public Radio
summary: The article discusses Michigan’s proposed Copperwood mine in Gogebic County, intended to produce mostly copper, with permits already secured and potential $250 million Exim financing under consideration. It also notes opposition concerns and failed prior state grants, but emphasizes copper prices are at record highs due to strong demand from renewables and data centers.

title: Western Copper and Gold Corporation: Western Copper and Gold Announces Filing of Final Short Form Prospectus
summary: Western Copper and Gold filed a final short-form prospectus for a bought deal equity offering to fund its business, including the Casino copper-gold project in Yukon. The note mainly covers financing mechanics, approvals, and prospectus availability, with only general mention that company results depend on copper prices.

title: Trump threatens 'global' tariff on aluminum scrap
summary: Trump threatened a new 10% tariff on US imports of aluminum scrap after the Supreme Court struck down his earlier reciprocal tariffs. The proposal could raise costs for scrap-fed smelters unless legal pathways supersede USMCA benefits. A higher tariff backdrop is likely supportive for nearby aluminum pricing.

title: Great Southern Copper (LON:GSCU) Stock Price Down 10.9%  – Here's What Happened
summary: The article reports Great Southern Copper PLC shares fell 10.9% after trading Tuesday/Wednesday and summarizes its financial metrics and focus on copper-gold exploration projects in Chile. It provides no new operational or market fundamentals for copper; the move appears primarily stock-specific sentiment.

title: Trio charged, 4th suspect sought in Milton, Halton Hills copper thefts
summary: Police in Milton and Halton Hills charged multiple suspects in a string of copper wire thefts from telecom cable lines. Over 40 incidents were reported in 2025, with arrests and search warrants in January 2026 and a fourth suspect sought. The crackdown may reduce near-term copper scrap availability.

title: Following Supreme Court decision, PeopleForBikes focuses on averting an aluminum tariff
summary: After a Supreme Court ruling weakened the Trump administration’s ability to use IEEPA for tariffs, industry group PeopleForBikes urged members to prevent additional Section 232 tariffs. The prior proposal would add imported bikes/e-bikes and frames to 50% aluminum tariff lists, and Commerce is deciding inclusions.

title: To Get the Copper We Need, Prices Have to Double
summary: A University of Michigan-led study says copper prices may need to double from around $13,000/ton to stimulate new mine development, given typical project costs over $22,000/ton of annual output. It argues approvals must speed up and that recycling alone won’t close the gap as demand rises.

title: Copper Unlikely to Follow Near-Term Gold Rally
summary: Copper retreated from a record above $13,000/ton to about $12,700 as expectations of long-term electrification demand met heavy stockpiling at U.S. and China exchange hubs, softer pre-holiday demand, and oversupply signals (including contango). Analysts attribute the slide to liquidation and persistent inventory builds until post-holiday demand returns.

title: Copper, a coveted metal boosting miners
summary: The piece links miners’ improved profits at BHP, Glencore and Teck to soaring copper prices, citing output increases and a potential supply deficit. It attributes earlier price gains to mine disruptions in Chile, Indonesia and DR Congo, plus tariff threats and US-China tensions boosting stockpiling, with demand from energy transition uses.

title: Copper slides towards third weekly fall
summary: Copper edged up on Friday but was still set for a third straight weekly fall. Sentiment remained pressured by a firmer US dollar and persistent concerns over global demand, weighing on industrial metals. Three-month LME copper rose early in trade, but the weekly trend stayed negative.

title: Indonesia tightens control on nickel as US, China scramble for minerals | The Arkansas Democrat-Gazette
summary: Indonesia is tightening state control over its nickel industry, seizing land and issuing large fines for alleged illegal exploitation. The crackdown comes as EV makers increasingly shift to lithium iron phosphate batteries that use less nickel, reducing demand outlook. Investor uncertainty and possible disruptions could pressure nickel prices near term.

title: Copper wire theft disrupts light rail service in south King County for 2nd time in 9 days
summary: Sound Transit reports copper wire thefts disrupting Link light rail service twice in nine days, prompting repair efforts and increased security. Local lawmakers propose HB 2213 to require recyclers to document and hold copper for ten days before selling. The article frames theft as a broader market demand issue, but with no market-wide copper pricing implications.

title: Podcast: Zambia's Copperbelt in focus, ft Midnight Sun's Adrian O'Brien
summary: The episode discusses Zambia’s Copperbelt mining landscape, including regulatory and security comparisons versus the DRC, and highlights key companies and projects. It also mentions Midnight Sun Mining and prior interest by Barrick. The content is informational rather than reporting concrete near-term production or policy shifts impacting copper pricing.

title: Updated JORC Exploration Targets at Copper Project | Company Announcement
summary: New Frontier Minerals reported updated JORC exploration targets across 14 prospects at its NWQ copper project in Queensland. The targets are conceptual (no defined JORC resource), but include a mining lease review for the Big One deposit and plans to process copper ore via Austral Resources’ Mt Kelly facility. Overall impact on near-term copper prices is limited.

title: TMIC signs SMS contract for aluminium cold rolling mill in KSA - Technical Review Middle East
summary: TMIC has signed an SMS contract to supply a six-high aluminium cold rolling mill for an integrated aluminium foil complex in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. The plant will roll aluminium strips into thin foil for food, pharmaceutical and industrial packaging. The announcement supports future capacity expansion but does not imply immediate supply constraints.

title: NKT signs €6 billion copper supply deal with KGHM
summary: NKT, the power cable maker, has renewed a €6 billion copper supply agreement with KGHM Polska Miedź to secure European-produced copper for 2028–2036. KGHM covers mining and refining/smelting, while NKT expands capacity for cable demand. The long-dated deal supports supply security more than immediate price pressure.

title: Zambians pay price amid Copperbelt mining boom
summary: Communities in Zambia’s Copperbelt say renewed mining has brought pollution and social harm, after a February 2025 acid spill at a Chinese-owned leaching operation contaminated the Kafue River watershed. While copper demand from renewables is rising, activists and unions warn environmental risks could disrupt supply and raise regulatory pressure.

title: Faraday Copper targets acquisition of BHP's San Manuel site in US
summary: Faraday Copper is negotiating a non-binding deal to acquire BHP’s San Manuel property in Arizona, with plans to study restarting the copper mine and creating an integrated Arizona copper hub using existing infrastructure. If approvals and due diligence progress, it could boost expectations for US copper supply, supporting prices.

title: BC Government accepts Surge Copper's Berg Project
summary: British Columbia accepted Surge Copper’s Berg Project into its Critical Minerals Office, providing coordinated provincial support to streamline regulation. The Berg Project contains a copper-molybdenum-silver deposit and is expected to primarily produce copper with byproducts. This improves sentiment around future copper supply and regulatory progress, supporting copper prices modestly.

title: Queensland invests in Austral's Rocklands copper facility refurbishment
summary: Queensland has allocated A$15m via QIC to refurbish Austral Resources’ Rocklands copper sulphide processing facility near Cloncurry. The project targets restoring production capabilities after the 2024 care-and-maintenance period, with output resuming later as part of a broader Queensland resources reinvigoration strategy.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Announces up to C$100 Million Private Placement with Participation by the Lundin Family Trust and BHP
summary: Faraday Copper announced a non-brokered private placement raising up to C$100m, with participation by the Lundin Family Trusts and BHP. Proceeds will be used to advance its Arizona copper projects, including integration of the San Manuel property from BHP, subject to regulatory approvals.

title: Egypt Aluminium Ranks Sixth Among Global Corporate Renewable Power Buyers in 2025
summary: Egypt Aluminium, Egypt’s largest aluminium producer, signed more than 1 GW of renewable power PPAs, including a March 2025 1.1 GW solar deal with Scatec plus battery storage. The move supports EU CBAM compliance and aims to cut product carbon footprints as corporate clean-power deals slow.

title: Koryx Copper Announces Further Significant Drill Results at the Haib Copper Project, Southern Namibia
summary: Koryx Copper reported assay results from 13 infill/expansion drill holes at the Haib copper project in Namibia, highlighting generally stronger-than-expected copper intercepts and continued advancement toward an updated MRE and a PFS in late 2026. The news is supportive for project fundamentals but unlikely to shift near-term copper markets materially.

title: Indonesia considering revoking environmental permit of nickel company after fatal landslide, minister says
summary: Indonesia is assessing revoking the environmental permit of PT QMB New Energy Materials after a landslide struck mine waste at its nickel processing hub in Sulawesi. The minister cited repeated fatal incidents; QMB already suspended most production after a 2025 landslide. Indonesia’s action could further disrupt nickel supply.

title: FinancialContent - Doctor Copper's Fever Breaks: Record Highs Meet the 'Goldman Chill' as Markets Brace for 2026 Correction
summary: Copper surged to a record $14,268/t on Jan 29, then reversed to about $12,850/t by late February. Drivers cited include U.S. tariff front-loading and speculative long positioning unwind, plus stronger dollar and profit-taking after mining disruptions. Goldman warns of a deeper mid-2026 correction toward $11,000–$11,200/t.

title: Nickel Industries H2 Earnings Call Highlights
summary: Nickel Industries’ H2 earnings call highlighted record NPI and mine production but “challenging” nickel pricing, citing LME nickel down 9.8% and NPI down 2.8% versus 2024. Indonesia RKAB quota timing caused standby costs and lost volumes. Management also flagged ENC commissioning and higher early-2026 margins.

title: B.C. approves expansion of open-pit Copper Mountain mine in southern Interior
summary: British Columbia approved permits for the New Ingerbelle expansion at the Copper Mountain copper-gold mine near Princeton, extending operations by 12 years. The province projects about 750,000 tonnes of copper over the extended lifespan, supporting jobs and local activity, which adds expected supply pressure to copper markets.

title: B.C. approves Copper Mountain mine expansion, securing operations to 2040
summary: British Columbia has approved Hudbay Minerals’ Copper Mountain (New Ingerbelle) expansion, extending mine operations to at least 2040 and potentially increasing annual copper production by up to 90% over a three-stage project. Environmental groups opposed the plan, but permits were issued after the proposal met assessment thresholds.

title: B.C. approves Copper Mountain mine expansion, the latest in string of minerals projects
summary: B.C. approved Hudbay Minerals’ Copper Mountain “New Ingerbelle” expansion in southern Interior, extending mine operations to at least 2040 and potentially increasing annual copper production by up to 90% over a three-stage plan.
