The decision follows regulatory reviews and environmental concerns about tailings.

title: [SMM Analysis] Global Macro Mildly Positive, Aluminum Market Sees Short-Term Volatility Awaiting Demand Recovery
summary: SMM reports LME aluminum rose modestly after the Chinese New Year holiday, supported by a Mozal (South32) shutdown tightening supply and limited expectations of US tariff narrowing. Macro PMIs are mildly positive and inventories are forecast to build near record highs, keeping short-term volatility likely.

title: [SMM Analysis] China Accelerates the Construction of a Peripheral Copper Resource Supply Belt
summary: SMM notes China’s copper concentrate import mix is shifting toward land-transported supplies from nearby Central/Southeast Asian countries, with land share rising from ~11.5% (2019) to 15% (2025). The diversification and shorter logistics are expected to improve concentrate access for Chinese smelters, supporting copper supply outlook.

title: True North wins state support to probe old Qld copper mine waste
summary: True North Copper secured a $400,000 Queensland grant to sample and metallurgically test legacy waste at its Mt Oxide copper project. The program aims to see if stockpiles/leach heaps contain recoverable copper and other payable metals, potentially adding future supply upside. Results are uncertain, but sentiment is supportive for copper.

title: Indonesia mulls revoking license for nickel company after fatal landslide - Companies
summary: Indonesia’s environmental minister is considering revoking PT QMB New Energy Materials’ environmental approval after a fatal landslide in a tailings area at the Morowali Industrial Park. The incident occurred at an HPAL unit processing low-grade nickel ore to produce MHP for EV batteries. Tailings operations were halted and investigations continue.

title: Singapore bank faces complaint to SGX over Indonesian coal-powered nickel financing
summary: A watchdog complaint filed with SGX alleges OCBC may have misled investors about its financing exposure to Harita Nickel Group, whose Obi Island nickel operations rely almost entirely on captive coal power. The challenge raises climate-transition and disclosure risks, potentially increasing near-term risk premia for nickel.

title: Fathom Nickel Inc.: Fathom Announces Completion of Gochager Lake Winter Trail and Expected Start of Winter Drill Program
summary: Fathom Nickel reported completion of a winter access trail and mobilization for a 3,000–4,000 m drilling program at the Gochager Lake Ni-Cu project, expected to start in early March. The release outlines multiple high-priority targets and geochemical results, but provides no production or finalized resource changes.

title: FinancialContent - The Great Gold Divide: Barrick's High-Stakes Bet on a Copper-Rich Future and a North American Spinoff
summary: Barrick Gold approved preparations for an IPO/spinoff of its North American assets while increasing focus on copper. The article says copper is ~30% of Barrick profits and points to expansions/financing for projects like Lumwana and Reko Diq. Such updates can support near-term copper demand and sentiment.

title: FinancialContent - Copper Shatters Records at $14,000 as 'AI Metals Frenzy' Collides with Global Supply Shocks
summary: Copper prices surged to record levels near $14,500 as AI data-center demand collided with supply shocks: a 35-day Chile mine strike and force majeure/output cuts from Indonesia’s Grasberg. Prices remain highly volatile after trade-related tariff developments, with potential aluminum substitution easing some downstream demand.

title: EU expects US to scale back steel, aluminum goods tariffs within weeks, Bloomberg News reports
summary: EU officials expect the U.S. to scale back tariffs on goods containing steel and aluminum within weeks, easing transatlantic trade friction. Tariffs on commodity-grade metal forms are expected to remain. The development could improve near-term aluminum demand and trade expectations, though copper is not directly referenced.

title: It may be a long wait for the next big rally in nickel prices
summary: The piece attributes nickel’s mid-December rise to supply-tightening signals from Indonesia and outlines large Indonesian growth and lower production costs. It separates Class 1 vs Class 2 nickel and notes EV demand headwinds from LFP. Despite some tightening in niches, it projects surpluses through 2026, keeping nickel range-bound.

title: EU expects US to lower steel, aluminum tariffs within weeks, Bloomberg News says
summary: EU officials expect the US to lower tariffs on goods containing steel and aluminum within weeks, according to Bloomberg. The change is anticipated to ease transatlantic trade friction and likely supports aluminium demand and import/export expectations in the near term, offering mild upward pressure on aluminium prices.

title: Ero Copper Shares Rally With Initial Assessment for Brazil Copper Project
summary: Ero Copper shares rose after a preliminary economic assessment for Vale-owned Furnas in Brazil, outlining a large-scale mine with estimated early-life copper production and multi-year development milestones. While supportive for future copper supply expectations, it does not indicate imminent output changes, limiting near-term price pressure.

title: Aluminium maker Alcoa seeks to sell 10 sites to data centres
summary: Alcoa said it plans to sell 10 closed or curtailed aluminium sites to the data-centre industry, with the first transaction expected by end-June. The move reflects intense competition for electricity for smelting, but also the opportunity of AI-driven data-centre demand. It also notes cash-negative alumina refiners may cut output.

title: Tartisan Nickel Corp.: Tartisan Nickel Corp. Intersects 3.0 Metres of 2.17% Ni, 1.45% Cu at The Kenbridge Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project, Northwestern Ontario
summary: Tartisan Nickel Corp. reported assay results from its Kenbridge nickel-copper-cobalt project, including 3.0m grading 2.17% nickel and 1.45% copper. The company is continuing an infill/drill program to expand and improve deposit continuity, with additional assays pending. No production or supply changes were announced.

title: Copperwood Mine Project a bad idea | News, Sports, Jobs
summary: The letter urges Michigan regulators not to grant permits for the proposed Copperwood Mine by Highland Copper, citing risks of clear-cutting forests, damaging wetlands, rerouting streams, and drawing water from Lake Superior. It frames the project as environmentally harmful and implies potential permitting delays or denial, which could tighten copper supply expectations.

title: Copper's new fundamental: How fear is shaping the market
summary: The piece frames copper’s outlook as increasingly driven by fear, geopolitics, and policy-driven trade barriers. It cites tariffs and deglobalization prompting sourcing uncertainty and strategic stockpiling, alongside AI/electrification demand growth. It also points to e-waste recycling as a future supply source but emphasizes immediate anxiety shaping prices.

title: Copper, chaos and contrarian thinking | Fast Forward podcast season 3 episode 1 transcript
summary: The podcast transcript discusses what’s driving copper, emphasizing that global uncertainty can translate into investor flows and stockpiling. It also notes US policy ambiguity around copper tariffs and potential stockpile actions (Project Vault) that can tighten available metal and keep premiums elevated, supporting firmer copper price expectations despite near-term supply comfort.

title: Comex Copper Settles 2.60% Higher at $5.9230 — Data Talk
summary: Comex Copper front-month February contract settled 2.60% higher at $5.9230, gaining 15 cents per pound. The move is the largest one-day dollar and percentage gain since Feb. 18 and follows mixed recent sessions. It remains below key recent highs but above prior settlements and lows.

title: Jack Lundin on the five forces pushing copper demand higher
summary: Jack Lundin discusses conditions he says are lifting copper demand, despite heightened market volatility. He argues the drivers supporting copper prices remain intact and highlights Lundin Mining’s Vicuña project in South America as potentially making it a top producer. Overall, the interview is framed as copper-positive.

title: Global Demand Reshapes Kazakhstan's Copper Exports
summary: Kazakhstan produced 471,000 tons of refined copper in 2025 (+1.5% y/y) but exports fell 8.3% in Jan–Nov, driven by sharply lower shipments to China. Türkiye and other markets gained share. The Eurasian Commission approved a temporary duty exemption on copper intermediates, lowering input costs for domestic producers.

title: How to Maximize the Value of Your Aluminium Scrap
summary: The piece explains how to increase the value of aluminium scrap by isolating aluminium during waste handling, avoiding contamination (oils, paints, adhesives), sorting by alloy series, storing cleanly to prevent oxidation, and tracking volumes and weights. It focuses on better resale/grading outcomes rather than broader aluminium market drivers.

title: Can India secure enough copper to power 30 million EVs?
summary: The article argues India’s copper demand from EVs and chargers could surge while supply lags, as India imports most of its copper and domestic output is stagnant. It also cites US Section 232 tariffs and inventory build-ups, lifting copper prices, and warns shortages could raise battery costs and slow EV targets.

title: FTTH Council Europe Updates on Copper Switch Off Progress by Country
summary: FTTH Council Europe’s 2026 update tracks progress across 27 European countries in switching off copper broadband networks in favor of full-fibre FTTP/H/B. Results vary widely, with some countries far ahead and others lacking data. The copper phase-out is gradual, so near-term copper price effects are likely limited.

title: Capacity additions to lift Indonesia's nickel supply in 2026
summary: Indonesia, the dominant nickel producer, is expected to boost nickel supply in 2026, with production projected to rise about 11.9% to 2.9mt. Capacity increases are supported by higher RKAB-permitted volumes and ongoing NPI/HPAL plant commissioning despite policy efforts that may tighten quotas.

title: FinancialContent - Aluminum Midwest Premium Hits Record $2,182: Inside the 2026 Price Surge and the 'Bessent Pivot'
summary: US Midwest aluminum premium surged to a record $2,182/tonne, driven by 50% Section 232 aluminum tariffs that cut imports sharply and deplete inventories. Treasury comments hint any tariff rollback may apply mainly to derivative products, not primary metal, keeping US aluminum “all-in” prices elevated and volatile.

title: FinancialContent - The Inventory Paradox: Why Copper Prices are Cooling Despite a Global Stockpile Surge
summary: Copper prices have fallen from January records as visible exchange inventories surge to a 23-year high (~1.1m tonnes across LME/SHFE/COMEX). The buildup is attributed to U.S. tariff-driven front-loading and early-2026 inflows to LME warehouses, reducing the tightness premium and cooling the physical bid.

title: FinancialContent - Heavy Metal: Base Metals Surge as China Reopens to a Favorable U.S. Trade Ruling
summary: Base metals rallied after Chinese markets reopened and a U.S. Supreme Court decision limited emergency powers for broad tariffs. Morgan Stanley projected U.S. levies on Chinese goods falling from 32% to ~24%. Copper surged 2.8% with a 60% rise in Yangshan premium; aluminum rose ~1% as trade uncertainty eased.

title: smǝlqmíx leaders emphasize 'no consent' as B.C. approves Copper Mountain Mine expansion
summary: B.C. issued Mines Act and Environmental Management Act permits for the New Ingerbelle expansion of the Copper Mountain Mine near Princeton in smǝlqmíx territory. The project revives the century-old Ingerbelle open pit gold and copper site and extends operations until 2047, pending Indigenous concerns.

title: Copper Mining Projects Continue to Gain Traction in Argentina
summary: First Quantum plans to invest about $5.25 billion to develop the Taca Taca copper mine in Argentina under the RIGI incentive regime, targeting 291,000 tonnes of copper annually in the first decade. The project is progressing through environmental assessment and incentives, but near-term production changes are not immediate.

title: FinancialContent - Copper Breaks Records: Why the 'Dr. Copper' Rally Signals a New Industrial Era
summary: Copper surged to all-time highs above $13,000/t on the LME, driven by a “perfect storm” of AI-driven demand and tightened supply. The article cites mine outages (e.g., Grasberg mudrush), labor strikes at Escondida, tariff-driven inventory pull-forward, and a deficit near 400,000 tons.

title: Prospect Ridge Resources Corp: Prospect Ridge Confirms Discovery Of Copper-Gold Porphyry with Final Drill Results from 100% Owned Camelot Copper-Gold Project in B.C.'s Cariboo Mining District
summary: Prospect Ridge reports assay results from its 100% owned Camelot copper-gold project in B.C., highlighting intersections such as CAM25-009 averaging ~0.08% Cu over 156.6 m, plus other holes with weaker Cu-Au mineralization. The release discusses geology and targeting criteria, with CuEq estimates based on assumed copper prices.

title: World Copper Ltd.: World Copper Signs Definitive Agreement to Acquire Brassie Creek Project in British Columbia
summary: World Copper Ltd. signed a definitive property option to acquire a 100% interest in the Brassie Creek porphyry-skarn copper-gold project in British Columbia, subject to payments, exploration expenditures, and a 2% net smelter returns royalty. The company plans steps toward project evaluation, supporting copper-linked sentiment.

title: Industry warns against disrupting nickel ecosystem under US trade pact - Regulations
summary: Indonesia’s Nickel Industry Forum warns that implementing a US-Indonesia Agreement on Reciprocal Trade (ART) should not disrupt the “nickel ecosystem” of existing smelter and refining contracts. The US has a small processing footprint but seeks influence in critical mineral supply chains, while China dominates current refining investment.

title: Gunnison Copper Corp.: Gunnison Copper Announces Updated Preliminary Economic Assessment of Its Flagship Gunnison Copper Project Reporting Post-Tax NPV8 of US$2.0 Billion
summary: Gunnison Copper Corp. released an updated NI 43-101 PEA for its Gunnison oxide copper heap-leach/SX-EW project in Arizona. The study highlights 174 mln lbs/year of 99.999% copper cathode for 15 years, lower costs, and higher NPV8% at a $4.60/lb copper deck, with project optimizations driving the increase.

title: Kincora Copper Limited: Request for Trading Halt
summary: Kincora Copper Limited requests a trading halt on ASX while it prepares an announcement about a planned capital raising. The halt is to help manage continuous disclosure obligations. The release provides no details on production impacts or supply changes, indicating limited direct linkage to copper price fundamentals.

title: Bougainville government takes control of copper assets
summary: The Autonomous Bougainville Government increased its control of Bougainville Copper Limited to 72.9% and says it will ensure redevelopment of the Panguna copper project proceeds lawfully and transparently. The government lacks technical and financial capacity to advance mining independently, but greater control may improve supply outlook.

title: Press Metal 4Q profit jumps 32%, sees steady FY26 on firmer aluminium prices
summary: Press Metal Aluminium reported a 32% jump in FY25 4Q profit and expects steady FY26 performance, citing strengthening aluminium prices and easing alumina input costs. Management attributes resilience to stable demand, low inventories, supply constraints, and a favourable copper-to-aluminium ratio amid evolving trade policies.

title: Why this ASX copper stock could be a better buy than Rio Tinto
summary: The article discusses Bell Potter’s bullish view on Aeris Resources, an ASX copper-dominant producer. It cites a financial update showing earnings leverage to rising copper (and gold) prices and expects production growth. While it’s stock-focused, the stated outlook is tied directly to near-term copper-price expectations.

title: Chalco Capitalizes on Aluminum Demand Surge
summary: Global aluminum demand is described as accelerating, especially from Asia-Pacific construction and EV-related packaging, supporting a bullish tone for aluminum. Chalco reports higher alumina and primary aluminum output and rising net income, while a deal to buy CBA expands its Brazilian aluminum/alumina footprint amid energy and price volatility.

title: Canada Nickel Announces Significant Awaruite at Midlothian Property
summary: Canada Nickel announced mineralogical and metallurgical results from its Midlothian Project in Ontario, highlighting widespread awaruite (about 79% of nickel) with initial grades around 0.28% nickel and Davis Tube Recoverable nickel roughly 0.07–0.15%. Higher-quality recoverable nickel expectations are incremental positive for nickel sentiment.

title: Eskay Mining Corp.: Eskay Mining to Drill for Copper-Gold Porphyry and Stacked Gold Vein Deposits in 2026 on its Consolidated Eskay Project, Golden Triangle, BC
summary: Eskay Mining announced its 2026 exploration plans at the Consolidated Eskay Project in British Columbia, including drilling to test targets with porphyry copper/gold potential near the Kyba Line. The company secured camp and drilling capacity and is refining borehole locations and interpreting historical datasets to guide fieldwork, with drilling expected in 2026.

title: Tinka Resources Limited: Tinka Provides Initial Drill Results at Silvia Copper-Gold Project and Updates Exploration Progress at Ayawilca
summary: Tinka reported initial diamond drilling results from its Silvia copper-gold project, highlighting copper-bearing intervals and planning follow-up geophysics over a wider target area. The company also updated progress at its Ayawilca zinc-silver-tin project. The copper exploration news may sway sentiment, but no immediate supply impact is indicated.

title: Questcorp Mining Inc.: Questcorp Mining Commences 2026 IP Survey at the North Island Copper Project
summary: Questcorp Mining begins a 2026 induced polarization (IP) survey at its North Island Copper Project to confirm and refine historical targets in the Marisa Zone porphyry copper system. The program aims to improve subsurface modeling ahead of a potential future drill program; no production or sales changes are cited.

title: Businessman Gupta refused permission to appeal in Trafigura nickel fraud lawsuit
summary: London’s High Court refused an Indian businessman permission to appeal a ruling that he defrauded Trafigura over fake nickel cargoes. Trafigura said it is owed about $640 million, while the judge found Trafigura was induced by false representations. The dispute affects credibility and settlement risk more than near-term nickel fundamentals.

title: Search continues for man who stole over $100,000 worth of copper
summary: Police in Coldwater, Michigan are investigating a copper heist at American Copper and Brass. Nearly $100,000 in copper coils and scrap were stolen, using a forklift to load materials onto a stolen U-Haul trailer. Officials noted higher copper prices around $6 per pound make tracking harder after melting.

title: Kutcho Copper Corp.: Kutcho Copper Announces Closing of $3,000,000 Flow-Through Financing
summary: Kutcho Copper announced the closing of a C$3.0 million flow-through financing to fund exploration on its Kutcho copper-zinc property in British Columbia. Proceeds are intended for Canadian exploration and flow-through critical mineral expenditures. The release includes standard financing and regulatory language, with no direct near-term production or supply change.

title: Comex Copper Settles 0.64% Lower at $5.9470 — Data Talk
summary: Comex copper front-month (March delivery) settled 0.64% lower at $5.9470, down 3.85 cents per pound and ending a two-session winning streak. Prices are also slightly below recent highs, with the contract off 3.7% from a 2026 high earlier in the month.

title: Copper Nano clean-up for Birim River raises environmental risk concerns — UEW Lecturer
summary: A UEW lecturer warns Ghana’s EPA copper-nanoliquid pilot for the polluted Birim River could unintentionally introduce or increase copper toxicity, citing unpredictable behavior in sediment-laden waters and risks of exceeding the 2.0 mg/L drinking-water standard. He calls for rigorous real-world monitoring and precautionary evaluation.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: EV Nickel Announces Maiden Mineral Resource Estimate for Gemini North Nickel Zone
summary: EV Nickel announced a maiden mineral resource estimate for the Gemini North nickel zone within its Shaw Dome project, reporting indicated and inferred tonnes/grades and contained nickel using a pit-constrained approach. The company highlights nickel-copper sulphide potential but provides no near-term production timeline, so short-term nickel price impact is limited.

title: Kincora Copper Limited: Kincora Raises $4 Million in Strongly Supported Placement
summary: Kincora Copper Limited raised A$4 million via a placement at A$1.05 per CDI to fund expanded near-term drilling and geophysics at its Condobolin, Fairholme, Trundle, and Jemalong projects. The company’s exploration focus includes copper-containing porphyry and lens targets, but no production or supply change is described.

title: Sound Transit seeks help from prosecutors to hold copper thieves accountable
summary: Sound Transit is asking King County prosecutors to pursue copper wire thieves after repeated thefts disrupted light rail, including incidents affecting the new 1 Line extension. Officials seek tougher scrap-yard controls, including a proposed photo-database requirement that would have enabled police seizures.

title: Emirates Global Aluminium secures $5bn in debt financing
summary: Emirates Global Aluminium secured $5bn of debt financing to refinance obligations and support expansion. It had a bauxite supply disruption after Guinea revoked a licence, but arranged alternative bauxite shipments. The firm also plans a new US primary aluminium plant to materially expand output, alongside reported stronger aluminium prices.

title: CME approves first aluminium warehousing in Taiwan
summary: CME Group approved its first aluminium storage facilities in Taiwan, adding 95,000 tonnes of approved outdoor capacity in Kaohsiung for Comex aluminium deliverables. Warehousing approvals for firms C. Steinweg and Pacorini are intended to broaden aluminium contract usage in Asia, where Taiwan is a major regional market.

title: FinancialContent - Aluminum Prices Hit Four-Year High Amid Global Rearmament and Supply Deficits
summary: LME aluminum is trading near a four-year high around $3,300/ton as structural supply deficits, lower physical inventories and backwardation, and defense/reindustrialization demand tighten availability. China’s production cap, trade disruptions, tariffs, energy constraints, and CBAM risks are cited as sustaining elevated prices despite a late-February technical pullback.

title: King Copper Discovery Reports on Key Technical Team Additions and Participation at Upcoming 2026 PDAC Core Shack
summary: King Copper Discovery Corp. reported appointments to its Peruvian Colquemayo project team and participation at PDAC, alongside plans to reprocess historical core and pursue a fully financed 35,000-metre drill program. The project targets copper-gold-silver mineralization with past high-grade copper intercepts, but no production or supply change is announced.

title: Vista Global Metal Highlights Nickel-Based Alloy Supply Capabilities and Plans Comprehensive Product Display at 2026 Industry Exhibition
summary: Vista Global Metal Co., Ltd. says it will showcase a full range of nickel-based alloys (Inconel, Monel, Hastelloy, Incoloy) at a 2026 industry expo, emphasizing supply capabilities for high-temperature and corrosive applications. The announcement is company promotional and does not quantify new production or trade flows, but it centers on nickel alloy demand.

title: A Huge "Problem" in the Copper Industry - The Daily Reckoning
summary: The piece argues that many of the world’s largest copper mines are aging and producing declining grades, requiring new supply. It cites rising demand expectations versus slower supply growth, suggesting a potential shortfall unless many new mines are developed. The conclusion is that copper prices should stay high or rise further.

title: Sterling Metals Corp.: Sterling Metals Discovers Cu-Mo Porphyry Stock 1.5km from MEPS Discovery Zone Confirming Scale of Porphyry Copper System
summary: Sterling Metals says its first 2026 drill hole intersected a Cu-Mo felsic porphyry stock about 1.5km from the prior MEPS discovery, with potassic alteration and copper sulphides (chalcopyrite/bornite) plus molybdenite in veins. The company frames results as evidence of a large porphyry copper system at the Soo Project.

title: 'Significant explosion' reported at aluminum plant in Greene County
summary: Reports say a significant explosion occurred at an aluminium plant in Greene County. The incident raises concerns about damage and production downtime, potentially reducing near-term aluminium output. Traders may adjust expectations for short-term supply availability, which can weigh on aluminium prices over the coming days.

title: Nigeria, AFC sign $1.3 billion deal to build alumina refinery
summary: Nigeria and Africa Finance Corporation signed a $1.3 billion deal to build a gas-powered alumina refinery, processing 1 million tons of bauxite annually and targeting about 19 million tons of alumina over 20 years. The government links it to boosting mining revenue, reducing oil reliance, and accelerating exploration.

title: FG, African Finance Corporation Sign Landmark $1.3 Billion Alumina Deal – THISDAYLIVE
summary: Nigeria’s federal government and the African Finance Corporation signed a MoU for a $1.3 billion alumina refinery project, including bauxite processing and a Bayer-process flowsheet with power generation. The project is projected to produce significant alumina volumes over a 20-year period, boosting value addition and potential alumina supply.

title: FG, AFC Sign Landmark $1.3bn Deal for Alumina Refinery, Mining Projects - Latest News In Nigeria, Nigeria News Today, Your Online Nigerian Newspaper
summary: Nigeria’s Federal Government, via the Solid Minerals Development Fund, signed a MoU with Africa Finance Corporation for a $1.3bn alumina refinery and related solid-minerals initiatives. The refinery would process bauxite using a Bayer process, improving domestic alumina supply prospects and supporting aluminium value-chain expectations.

title: Hudbay To Acquire Arizona Sonoran Copper In $1.48 Bln All Share Deal
summary: Hudbay Minerals agreed to acquire the remaining shares of Arizona Sonoran Copper in a $1.48 billion all-share deal, closing in Q2 2026. The transaction expands Hudbay’s Arizona copper assets, strengthening its U.S. growth pipeline, but it is unlikely to change copper supply tightness within days.

title: Visionary Copper and Gold Mines Inc.: Visionary Intersects 51.9m of 0.46 g/t Gold, 0.37% Copper and 75.8m of 0.45% Copper at Pt. Leamington, Newfoundland
summary: Visionary Copper and Gold Mines reported Phase I drilling results at the Pt. Leamington VMS project, including discovery of the Kraken copper-rich zone. Highlights include 75.8m grading 0.45% Cu and additional 23.5m grading 0.43% Cu, plus broader higher-grade copper intersections elsewhere. Step-out drilling continues to define the zone.

title: FinancialContent - Copper's "Red Gold" Fever Breaks: Market Braces for a Mid-2026 Correction After Record Peak
summary: Copper prices have reversed sharply after an early-January peak driven by supply constraints and U.S.-tariff-related pre-emptive stockpiling. The article cites collapsing TC/RC, demand destruction, and a Goldman forecast of a deeper mid-2026 correction toward $11,000–$11,200, with some buyers switching toward aluminum.

title: FinancialContent - Indonesia Shakes Global Nickel Market: World's Largest Mine Sees 70% Production Cut in Push to Inflate Prices
summary: Indonesia (ESDM) cut PT Weda Bay Nickel’s 2026 production quota to 12 million Mwmt, a ~71% drop from the prior year, aiming to constrain supply and stabilize prices. LME nickel surged over 2% after the announcement, shifting the market narrative from surplus to imminent shortage.

title: Aluminium market prices - reactive analysis
summary: The note argues that if GCC smelters cannot ship through the Strait of Hormuz, they may keep output running but face alumina supply risks. Traders may scramble for aluminium units, supporting a higher LME aluminium price and pushing Rotterdam premiums higher, though alumina could become oversupplied if disruptions persist.

title: Capstone Copper Corp.: Capstone Copper Reports Record Fourth Quarter 2025 Results
summary: Capstone Copper reported record Q4 2025 results, with higher copper output and record-low C1 cash costs, plus 2026 guidance of 200,000–230,000 tonnes. It also said a Mantoverde union strike that began January 2, 2026 ended after a new three-year agreement was signed February 5.

title: Bahrain Business: Alba signs exclusive agreement to acquire Aluminium Dunkerque
summary: ALBA signed an exclusive agreement to acquire 100% of Aluminium Dunkerque, the EU’s largest primary aluminium smelter producing ~300,000 tonnes/year. The deal emphasizes improved operational reliability, energy efficiency, and long-term electricity supply agreements. It is expected to close in 2026 and remains subject to approvals, including EU antitrust.

title: Aluminium dips as dollar strengthens on widening Middle East war
summary: Aluminium ended lower as a stronger dollar and a widening Middle East conflict against Iran pressured commodity prices. The closure of Hormuz earlier had boosted aluminium, but risk persisted and producers paused premiums. Copper and nickel also weakened, reflecting broad base-metal pressure from higher oil/gas inflation fears.

title: Taruga set to unlock copper-gold targets in PNG
summary: Taruga Minerals is reprocessing old aeromagnetic data to build a refined 3D geologic framework for its Kol Mountain porphyry copper-gold project in Papua New Guinea, aiming to rank drill targets and constrain drilling. Historic results showed copper grades and supergene enrichment, supporting mildly bullish copper sentiment.

title: [SMM Analysis] US-Iran War: What It Means for Global Copper Concentrate Market?
summary: A US-Israel strike on Iran raises geopolitical disruption risk and may increase freight and insurance costs affecting global copper concentrate sentiment. But Iran is a minor supplier (about 1.8–2.0% share globally) and provides only ~0.1% of China’s imports. With diversified sourcing and limited mine disruption, copper impact is expected limited.

title: Norsk Hydro says QatarEnergy announces halt to aluminium production
summary: Norsk Hydro said QatarEnergy announced a halt to some downstream output in Qatar, including aluminium-related operations. QatarEnergy supplies gas to Qatalum, a 50/50 Hydro joint venture with primary aluminium capacity of 648,000 tonnes. The effect on Qatalum’s aluminium production is not yet clear, but supply risk is immediate.

title: Capstone Copper's Record Output Fuels Guidance Confidence And Project Growth Prospects
summary: Capstone Copper’s announcement (as indicated by the title) points to record production and firmer guidance, improving confidence in its operating outlook and growth prospects. Stronger-than-expected output can lift expectations for near-term copper supply and generally supports copper price sentiment over coming days.

title: Taseko's Florence mine delivers first new US copper in 17 years
summary: Taseko Mines reports the first copper cathodes from its Florence operation in Arizona, describing it as the first new U.S. copper output from a greenfield project since 2008. The milestone adds supply expectations for the near term, generally supportive for copper market sentiment.

title: 'Hotter than the sun': alleged copper thief in hospital
summary: An alleged thief cut an 11,000-volt cable at an Ergon Energy substation near Brisbane and suffered serious burns. The report says Ergon had replaced copper with aluminium at the site due to copper theft, and around 800 customers lost power briefly. The event is localized and mainly operational.

title: Qatalum Starts Controlled Shutdown Of Aluminum Production Amid Natural Gas Shortage
summary: Norsk Hydro said it has started a controlled shutdown of its Qatalum aluminum smelter on March 3, expected to run through March end, after its gas supplier warned of a suspension of gas deliveries. Restart could take months and timing is uncertain, implying near-term aluminum supply constraints.

title: Aluminium Supply Concerns From the Strait of Hormuz
summary: Escalating Iran–US/Israel tensions are disrupting logistics across the Arabian Gulf, with shipping suspensions and delayed aluminium deliveries. European import dependency on Middle East supply is cited, while Rotterdam aluminium premiums and aluminium duty-paid premium futures rise on supply fear. Conflict duration may further tighten supplies and push premiums higher.

title: FinancialContent - The Copper Cliff: 'Red Gold' Reverses as Geopolitical Shockwaves Hit the Strait of Hormuz
summary: Copper’s historic rally abruptly reversed on March 4, with LME prices falling nearly 10% as investors de-risk amid Strait of Hormuz disruptions. The blockade boosts energy costs and interrupts sulfur supply for SX-EW, raising costs while geopolitics lifts war-risk premiums. Demand-growth fears and de-grossing deepen the bearish move.

title: Bahraini aluminum producer goes to force majeure — Reuters
summary: Aluminium Bahrain (Alba) declared force majeure on its contracts, citing inability to ship due to disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. The company says it is still producing, with metal stored onsite. As Alba is a major aluminum producer, export constraints may reduce near-term supply and support aluminium prices.

title: Debswana Seeks New Opportunities in Copper, Platinum, Solar
summary: Debswana approved plans to diversify beyond diamonds amid a demand slump, including expanding copper and platinum projects via Naledi Mining Services and developing a solar farm near the Jwaneng mine. The article suggests strategic redirection of investment and potential long-run supply signals, but no immediate production changes are specified.

title: Two Palmdale residents arrested in KCSO undercover copper wire theft operation
summary: Kern County Sheriff’s Office arrested two Palmdale residents after an undercover operation targeting copper wire theft. Investigators said suspects bought stolen copper wire in Kern County and took it to Los Angeles to recycle. Theft reportedly caused replacement and repair costs, and recyclers face documentation and reporting requirements.

title: Japan's next US investments likely to cover nuclear plant, copper refinery
summary: Japan and the U.S. are considering including a nuclear plant and a copper refining facility in a second phase of Japan’s $550 billion investment and loan pledge in the U.S., according to Nikkei. The prospect of added copper refining capacity could improve expectations for processing supply and support copper prices.

title: Risks to Western aluminium supply rise as US-Israeli war with Iran escalates - Academia
summary: Escalation in the US–Israeli war with Iran threatens shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, where Gulf states ship millions of tonnes of aluminium and inputs. Qatar Aluminium faces possible suspension tied to disrupted power from halted LNG production. With Russian imports limited, the risk of supply loss supports rising LME aluminium prices.

title: MainPower Issues Reward To Stop Copper Thefts
summary: MainPower in North Canterbury says copper thefts from power poles have exceeded 200 incidents this year, prompting a $5,000 reward for information. The company estimates over $1 million in repair and operational time, citing copper’s per-kg value, while emphasizing safety risks rather than market-wide copper supply effects.

title: Business.Scoop » MainPower Issues Reward To Stop Copper Thefts
summary: MainPower says copper earthing wires on its North Canterbury power poles have been cut and stolen more than 200 times this year, prompting a $5,000 reward for information. The company cites costly repairs and safety risks from compromised earth connections, but theft volumes appear small globally.

title: Noronex pockets first $1.25M from non-core Namibian copper sale
summary: Noronex received a first $1.25M tranche payment from the sale of its non-core Witvlei copper project in Namibia after due diligence by Joint Era Mining. Noronex expects to receive $1M initially, with further milestones tied to mining licence approval and future production via a net smelter return royalty.

title: NALCO stock rallies nearly 8% amid aluminium supply fears from US-Iran conflict | Indiablooms - First Portal on Digital News Management
summary: NALCO shares rose about 8% as escalating US–Iran tensions raised aluminium supply fears. The article says Aluminium Bahrain invoked force majeure and halted deliveries to some customers. Disruptions tied to safety concerns around the Strait of Hormuz have pushed global aluminium prices to their highest since 2022.

title: Australian Miner Prospect Resources Seeks Larger Stake in Zambia's Mumbezhi Copper Project
summary: Prospect Resources agreed to raise its stake in Zambia’s Mumbezhi copper project to 90% from 85%, buying an additional 5% for $4.25 million, subject to regulatory approvals. The firm plans expanded exploration and drilling after the rainy season, but project ownership changes are unlikely to affect near-term copper supply materially.

title: Canada Nickel Achieves Significant Permitting Milestone for Crawford Nickel Project
summary: Canada Nickel says the federal Impact Assessment Agency of Canada has ended the Impact Statement phase and formally started the Impact Assessment for the Crawford nickel sulphide project in Ontario. The company expects a federal permitting decision by summer 2026 after draft report and public comment.

title: EU receives anti-dumping complaint on Vietnamese copper pipes
summary: Vietnam’s trade authority says the European Commission has accepted a complaint seeking an anti-dumping investigation into copper pipes imported from Vietnam. If initiated, questionnaires will be sent and Vietnamese exporters must provide shipment data for 2023-2025 to respond. The process may weigh on demand for copper pipes in the near term.

title: Aluminium Production Halted by QatarEnergy Concerns
summary: QatarEnergy, majority owner of Qatalum, has halted aluminium production amid escalating Iran-Israel-US tensions. QatarEnergy also paused other downstream outputs, while Hydro said implications are unclear but is seeking details. With regional port closures and Strait of Hormuz disruptions, traders expect tighter aluminium supply and higher regional premiums.

title: Aluminium prices hit high after Alba suspends metal deliveries
summary: Aluminium prices surged to the highest since 2022 after Alba suspended deliveries to customers, citing force majeure linked to halted shipments through the Strait of Hormuz amid Iran-related conflict. Traders fear continued transit interruptions, and London aluminium rose as much as 5.1% on supply concerns and delays.

title: Strait of Hormuz closure threatens copper cathode flows
summary: Closure of the Strait of Hormuz is suspending bookings and transits, drying up GCC cathode supply and threatening Iranian refined-copper exports through Bandar Abbas. The disruption may also affect Middle Eastern sulfur shipments used for African SX-EW cathode production. Market participants caution that near-term LME copper price moves may be limited.

title: 60 streetlights out in NE Portland after thieves strip copper wire
summary: Thieves stripped copper wire from 60 streetlights near I-84 in northeast Portland, costing ODOT about $200,000. ODOT expects repairs by next week and plans to replace the copper with cheaper aluminum while hardening access points. The story highlights copper theft dynamics and ongoing demand signals.

title: MEED | Alba to acquire EU's largest primary aluminium producer
summary: MEED reports that Alba will acquire the EU’s largest primary aluminium producer. The planned acquisition may influence near-term expectations for European primary aluminium supply, refining capacity, and market structure. However, the article content is paywalled and does not provide deal size, timing, or capacity changes.

title: Bell Copper Corporation: Bell Copper Announces Non-Brokered Convertible Debenture Financing with Crescat Capital LLC
summary: Bell Copper secured C$2.05m convertible debenture financing from Crescat to fund drilling and exploration at its Big Sandy porphyry copper project. The release says Crescat believes Bell is on the verge of a significant copper discovery. Funds are for exploration and working capital; no production impacts are stated.

title: China's MMG Plans $400 Million Investment to Expand Botswana Copper Mine
summary: MMG plans to invest $400 million in 2026 to expand its Khoemacau copper mine in Botswana, targeting higher production and new processing capacity to reach 130,000 tons of copper concentrate by 2028. The expansion follows earlier multi-year spend and is positioned amid rising copper prices and demand growth expectations.

title: FinancialContent - Copper Slumps as Energy-Driven Inflation Squeezes Industrial Demand: A $13,000 Test for the 'Red Metal'
summary: Copper slumped 1.6% on the LME to around $13,131/t after a surprise build-up of LME-registered inventories and speculative profit-taking. The move reflects macro pressure from higher rates and energy-driven inflation, while aluminium and nickel also dipped modestly as traders shifted toward tighter conditions.

title: FinancialContent - The Red Metal Giant: A Deep Dive into Freeport-McMoRan (FCX) and the Global Copper Deficit
summary: The piece highlights Freeport-McMoRan as a key driver of copper supply amid a stated global copper deficit. It emphasizes near-term catalysts like the Grasberg restart and scaling of the Americas leach/“hidden mine” program, alongside sensitivity to the spot copper price near $6/lb.

title: FinancialContent - The Disciplined Giant: BHP Group's Post-Anglo Strategy and the Future of Copper
summary: BHP’s unsuccessful bid for Anglo American in 2024 is framed as a pivot to organic growth, with continued emphasis on copper via assets like Escondida and Olympic Dam. The piece also cites a broader global copper supply crunch, but it offers no concrete immediate change in copper supply, demand, or trading terms.

title: Gulf disruption squeezes Indonesia nickel makers' sulphur supply
summary: Reuters reports Gulf shipping disruptions from the Iran conflict are squeezing Middle East sulphur supplies used for sulphuric acid in HPAL nickel refining and copper processing. Indonesia imports most sulphur and has limited stockpiles, with analysts warning HPAL output cuts by next month. African copper miners may face similar shortages and higher acid costs.

title: Boliden halts expansion of Lapland copper and nickel mine
summary: Boliden said its Kevitsa mine expansion in Finland is on hold after Finland quadrupled mining taxes on metal ores from 0.6% to 2.5%. Boliden Kevitsa, producing copper and nickel, has initiated change negotiations and is reviewing operations, potentially affecting future supply expectations.

title: Boliden halts expansion of Lapland copper and nickel mine
summary: Boliden halted a €1 billion expansion at its Kevitsa open-pit mine in Finland after the government quadrupled mining taxes on metal ores from 0.6% to 2.5%. The changes could affect operations at the Kevitsa copper and nickel producer, raising supply-growth risk.

title: Aluminum, nickel supplies from Russia to China up substantially in 2025 — research
summary: Research cited by TASS says Russian shipments to China surged in 2025: aluminium up 94% to 2.1 mln tons, nickel up 51% to 88,000 tons, and refined copper up 58% with copper concentrate up 2.1-fold. Increased inflows raise supply expectations and can weigh on aluminium, nickel, and copper prices.

title: Aluminum, nickel supplies from Russia to China up substantially in 2025 — research
summary: Research cited by TASS says Russia’s shipments to China surged in 2025: aluminium exports rose 94% to 2.1 mln tons, nickel to 88,000 tons (+51%). It also notes higher refined copper (+58%) and copper concentrate (+2.1x) supplies. Greater availability likely pressures prices.

title: U.S. aluminum buyers hunt for alternatives amid disruption
summary: U.S. buyers are scrambling for alternative aluminium supplies as the Iran war disrupts Middle East shipping via the Strait of Hormuz, with Gulf producers suspending deliveries and shipments stuck in Dubai. LME aluminium prices and U.S. Midwest premiums are at multi-year highs, while regional alumina shortfalls could force smelter curtailments.

title: Ero Copper Q4 Earnings Call Highlights
summary: Ero Copper’s earnings call highlighted record Q4 revenue and improved operational performance across its Brazilian mines, with higher quarterly copper output at Caraíba and Tucumã and revised 2026 guidance for 67,500–77,500 tons of copper. Management also cited strong copper pricing and ongoing throughput investments.

title: Ero Copper Corp. (NYSE:ERO) Q4 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
summary: Ero Copper’s earnings call highlights record Q4 copper concentrate sales, higher copper production at Caraiba and Tucuma, and stronger margins amid improved copper pricing. Management also reiterated 2026 consolidated copper production guidance (weighted to the second half) based on sustained throughput and mine sequencing, supporting positive near-term sentiment.

title: Alba acquires Europe's largest primary aluminium smelter
summary: Alba announced it will acquire 100% of Aluminium Dunkerque, the EU’s largest primary aluminium smelter, producing 300,000 tonnes annually. The deal is framed around long-term operational continuity, investment, energy-efficiency gains, and secure electricity supply. Closing is expected in 2026, supporting aluminium supply competitiveness in Europe.

title: AC prices to rise 5-15 per cent as expensive copper, weak rupee and new energy norms push costs
summary: Indian room air-conditioner makers (Daikin, Voltas, Blue Star, LG, Haier, Mitsubishi) raised prices 5–15% citing higher raw-material costs, especially expensive copper, plus aluminium costs, a weaker rupee, higher freight, and new energy-efficiency norms. Firms expect demand to strengthen with hotter summer conditions.

title: AC prices to rise 5-15 pc as expensive copper, weak rupee and new energy norms push costs
summary: Indian room airconditioner makers plan price hikes of 5–15% citing rising input costs, explicitly including higher copper prices, a weaker rupee making imports costlier, increased freight, and new energy-efficiency norms. Some firms also reference aluminium-related costs, reinforcing near-term upward pressure on metal demand expectations.

title: Apple is eyeing a new kind of aluminum material for its smartwatches
summary: Apple is reportedly exploring 3D-printing aluminum components for future Apple Watch models, potentially reducing waste versus conventional machining and increasing the use of recycled metal powder. If scaled, the manufacturing shift could improve efficiency and sustainability, but the article lacks any near-term volume details that would likely move aluminum prices.

title: Queensland's Phosphate Hill sold to Mayfair, ensuring continued operations at copper smelter
summary: Queensland’s Phosphate Hill fertiliser asset was sold to Mayfair, allowing Dyno Nobel’s acid plant to continue. That acid supports Glencore’s Mount Isa copper smelter, helping it operate until a proposed 2028 end date and avoiding a likely shutdown scenario. The reduced disruption risk is supportive for copper sentiment.

title: Smart transformation powers growth of China's major copper smelter-Xinhua
summary: Xinhua reports Guixi Smelter, affiliated with Jiangxi Copper (about 10% of China’s electrolytic copper output), is undergoing smart automation, fully automating 12 smelting steps and using AI inspection and monitoring. The article emphasizes scale and production capacity, but gives no specific near-term supply change.

title: Lance Neita | Bauxite industry poised for new opportunities
summary: The column says Jamaica’s alumina output rose in 2024 and notes bauxite exports and Discovery Bauxite/Gramercy and Jamalco capacity restoration efforts. It warns that geopolitics and energy/rules uncertainty could squeeze market access, but overall the investment and supply upgrade tone supports aluminium demand-supply expectations.

title: Is copper back? | News, Sports, Jobs - The Mining Gazette
summary: Highland Copper says it completed the sale of its 34% interest in the White Pine North copper project, transferring full control to Kinterra. The news also references Project Vault, a U.S. strategic critical-minerals stockpile intended to reduce supply disruption risk and price volatility, with copper listed by USGS.

title: Supply fears lift LME aluminium to nearly four-year high
summary: LME three-month aluminium rose to nearly a four-year high as Middle East escalation disrupted shipping via the Strait of Hormuz and worsened supply tightness. Additional constraints came from Qatalum shutting down and Aluminium Bahrain declaring force majeure on shipments, raising fears of tighter alumina inflows and exports.

title: 10 Copper Cathodes Stolen from Moving Truck in Mazabuka
summary: Police in Zambia are investigating the alleged theft of 10 copper cathodes worth about $7,000 from a moving truck on the Great North Road near Mazabuka. The cargo originated in Ndola and was headed to Johannesburg, carried by Sunshine Industry Limited. No arrests or recoveries reported.

title: Indonesian nickel plants halt output after deadly landslide
summary: Four GEM-linked Chinese-run HPAL nickel plants at Indonesia’s Morowali park have shut temporarily after a deadly landslide at a waste site. The biggest QMB unit may stay offline up to three months. The disruptions hit roughly 30% of local HPAL capacity as Indonesia increases environmental enforcement.

title: Copper's Record Rally and Structural Supply Risks: What the Mining Industry Must Do to Avoid a Critical Minerals Crisis in 2026
summary: The piece argues copper enters 2026 with a likely refined deficit driven by electrification, grid buildouts, and AI data-center demand. It highlights constrained mine project pipelines, longer permitting, operating and refining bottlenecks, and recycling limits. Ecuador’s evolving mining policy is discussed as a potential supply addition.

title: FinancialContent - Red Gold Rush: AI Infrastructure Surge Drives Copper to Historic Highs as Global Supply Gap Widens
summary: Copper is surging to historic LME levels as AI-driven data-center buildouts sharply increase demand for copper-intensive power delivery and cooling. The article links the rally to a widening supply gap (ICSG deficit projection) and long lead times for copper-based grid transformers and electrical equipment, implying continued upward pressure.

title: Middle East Escalation: Copper Prices Under Pressure Amid Rising Supply Risks in Africa
summary: Rising Israel-Iran tensions are raising concerns about shipping security via the Strait of Hormuz and higher oil prices. The article argues elevated energy costs and tighter monetary expectations curb risk appetite and weigh on copper in the short term. It also flags potential sulfuric-acid supply-chain disruptions affecting DRC hydromet production and regional premiums.

title: Mongolia urges Rio Tinto to rewrite terms of Oyu Tolgoi copper mine, FT reports
summary: Mongolia is urging Rio Tinto to renegotiate “unfair” commercial terms for the Oyu Tolgoi copper project, including lowering a floating-rate loan currently above 11% to below 6% and reducing management fees. Officials warn of potential export-tax increases if talks fail, raising near-term copper supply-investment expectations.

title: Mongolia urges Rio Tinto to rewrite copper mine terms
summary: Mongolia is urging Rio Tinto to renegotiate “unfair” commercial terms for the Oyu Tolgoi copper project, including lowering a high floating loan interest rate and cutting management fees. Officials warned of possible higher export taxes if talks fail. Rio says discussions aim to maximize Oyu Tolgoi’s potential.

title: Indonesia's nickel at a crossroads in the EV battery race - Regulations
summary: Indonesia is expanding nickel ore processing, including saprolite and limonite chains, to move toward higher-purity nickel and battery intermediates. However, EV demand is shifting from nickel-based chemistries to LFP, which has much lower pricing and rising market share. This combination suggests weaker near-term nickel battery demand versus expanding supply capacity.

title: copper shortage looms as tariff fears, mine disruptions fuel tightness
summary: ING forecasts a continued refined copper deficit, including a 600 kt shortfall for 2026, alongside ongoing supply constraints. The report also highlights major mining disruptions and tariff fears as drivers of tighter copper availability, implying supportive near-term market conditions despite the longer time horizon mentioned.

title: Aluminum, helium supply shortage weighs on Korean electronics industry
summary: Middle East conflict and concerns about possible Strait of Hormuz closures are disrupting shipping and tightening aluminum supply. LME cash aluminum rose about 8% to $3,406.5/ton. Analysts warn Gulf producers are exposed and escalating conflict could push aluminum above $4,000/ton, raising Korean manufacturers’ costs.

title: Greenridge Exploration Inc.: Greenridge Exploration Completes 100% Earn-in for the Electra Nickel Project
summary: Greenridge Exploration says it has earned a 100% interest in the Electra Nickel Project in Ontario, which is prospective for nickel-copper-cobalt (and PGEs). The article details project geology, past-producing grades, and exploration results, but provides no operational output or near-term supply changes affecting nickel or copper prices.

title: PTX Metals Inc. Step-Out Drill Hole Intercepts 213 Combined Meters of Mineralization and Ends in Higher Grade Zone at Depth at Its W2 Copper-Nickel-PGE and Gold Project
summary: PTX Metals reports assay results from W2 step-out drilling, extending the CA1 zone with long intercepts of copper-nickel-PGE mineralization. Grades are highlighted using copper and nickel inputs into CuEq calculations. While supportive for future copper/nickel resource potential, it is mainly an exploration update with limited immediate market impact.

title: PTX Metals Inc. Step-Out Drill Hole Intercepts 213 Combined Meters of Mineralization and Ends in Higher Grade Zone at Depth at Its W2 Copper-Nickel-PGE and Gold Project
summary: PTX Metals reports step-out drill results from its W2 Cu-Ni-PGE project, including 213.85m of mineralization and high-grade intervals with 0.90% Cu over 7.0m and 0.41% Ni over 0.5m. The findings expand the CA1 zone footprint, but do not imply near-term production changes.

title: FinancialContent - The Carbon Wall: EU CBAM Implementation Sends Shockwaves Through Global Aluminum Trade
summary: EU CBAM’s definitive phase (from Jan 1, 2026) forces importers of carbon-intensive goods, including aluminum, to buy certificates linked to EU ETS auction prices. The change is driving higher Rotterdam/EU premiums for low-carbon (“green”) aluminum and penalizing high-carbon (“grey”) metal, increasing volatility and supply realignment.

title: FinancialContent - Copper Market in Crisis: Strait of Hormuz Closure and Infrastructure Failures Threaten Global Supply
summary: A military closure of the Strait of Hormuz is halting ~40,000 tonnes/month of copper cathode shipments and triggers a sulphur shortage needed for copper leaching in the DRC/Zambia Copperbelt. Flooding collapses the Kasumbalesa Bridge, cutting refined exports. LME copper prices surge above $13,000/tonne, raising the risk of $15,000 bids.

title: Armenia's production of copper, zinc, and molybdenum concentrates increased in January 2026
summary: Armenia’s statistical committee data show January 2026 copper concentrate production rose 35% year-on-year to 28,690 tons. Molybdenum and zinc concentrate output also increased slightly, while ferromolybdenum fell. The higher copper concentrate supply suggests improved short-term availability for copper markets.

title: Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (FCX) Upgraded to Buy as Copper Outlook Improves
summary: Freeport-McMoRan (FCX) is upgraded to a Buy rating as the article argues that the copper outlook is improving. Such analyst-driven optimism tied to improved copper demand/supply expectations can support short-term buying interest and sentiment for copper futures, though specific data are not shown in the excerpt.

title: Zambia seeking global investors to help triple copper output by 2031
summary: Zambia is seeking global investors to fund a major expansion of copper production, aiming to more than triple output to 3 million tonnes by 2031. The US is mentioned as a potential partner amid efforts to diversify supply chains. Zambia’s copper performance missed last year’s target.

title: Aluminium prices expected to rise with prolonged war set to hit Gulf producers
summary: Aluminium prices are expected to stay elevated after nearing a four-year high as war-related disruption effectively halts shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, threatening both exports of primary aluminium and imports of alumina for Gulf smelters. Force majeure and production shutdowns were cited, with analysts projecting possible gains toward $3,700–$4,000.

title: Aluminium's surge propels Chinese tycoon to $61 billion fortune
summary: Zhang Bo’s China Hongqiao produces large volumes of aluminium. The article links aluminium’s 25%+ one-year rise to demand from EVs, solar and wind, and to supply volatility from Middle East conflict disrupting smelters and shipments via the Strait of Hormuz. It also stresses China’s production poised to fill gaps.

title: Alba, Qatalum halt aluminium production - Technical Review Middle East
summary: Alba declared force majeure on some contracts after Strait of Hormuz shipping disruptions prevented exports through the corridor. Separately, Qatar’s Qatalum started a controlled aluminium production shutdown after QatarEnergy suspended natural-gas supplies. Together, the measures curtail regional aluminium flows and signal tighter short-term supply.

title: Bauxite Production Seen As Potential Employment Catalyst In South-Western Odisha
summary: Odisha’s Budget 2026–27 launches a livelihoods initiative and discusses fast-tracking local bauxite mining in Kalahandi, Koraput and Rayagada to create jobs and feed existing alumina refineries. It argues this could strengthen a Western Odisha aluminium hub. The plan is supply-oriented for bauxite-derived inputs, supporting aluminium sentiment.

title: BHP's Vicuña project targets 395,000 tpy of copper concentrate
summary: BHP and Lundin’s Vicuña project (Josemaria and Filo del Sol) targets about 395,000 tpy of copper over 25 years, with significant capex and PEA pricing assumptions far below current precious metals. The piece also highlights very weak copper concentrate TC/RCs and process needs for arsenic-bearing concentrate, suggesting limited immediate impact on spot copper.

title: China Hongqiao Group (CHHQF) Expected to Announce Earnings on Friday
summary: China Hongqiao Group is expected to report quarterly earnings before market open on Friday, with analysts forecasting $0.2316 EPS and $11.4141B revenue. Hongqiao produces primary aluminum via an integrated bauxite-to-smelting chain, so earnings news can affect aluminum sentiment, though no actionable results or guidance are provided.

title: As Global Demand for Copper Rises, Zambia Courts U.S. and Other Investors to Boost Output
summary: Zambia is courting U.S. and other investors to expand copper production toward 3 million tonnes by 2031, up from about 890,300 tonnes in 2025. The government expects new capital to bolster projects at major mines and processing capacity, signaling additional future supply.

title: Harmony Gold boosts dividend as CSA copper comes online
summary: Harmony Gold reported steady earnings growth driven by higher gold prices and maiden copper production from its CSA mine in Australia. CSA output guidance for the next eight months was updated, with a planned one-month halt for essential shaft steel replacement. The update supports copper supply expectations but is likely company-specific.

title: Indonesia's coal, nickel output cuts spark outcry from industry
summary: Indonesia’s government has cut coal and nickel production quotas to bolster prices, but miners and related industries complain about possible shortages, including power plant operators. The piece links the policy to a broader price jump after the Iran war, suggesting tighter nickel supply could raise near-term nickel prices.

title: Chinese billionaire Zhang Bo sees wealth surpassing $48B as aluminum prices jump
summary: The article says aluminium prices have jumped over the past year, citing supply constraints from conflict-related stalling through the Strait of Hormuz and timing risks such as Mozal going offline. It also notes region-wide shipment limits and potential production disruptions, supporting bullish near-term aluminium price expectations.

title: Fortescue's Nascent Exploration acquires Alta Copper
summary: Fortescue’s subsidiary Nascent Exploration completed the acquisition of Alta Copper, gaining full ownership of Peru’s Cañariaco copper project. The deal pays shareholders C$1.40 per share and expands Fortescue’s copper exploration portfolio. The near-term focus is technical reviews and community engagement, not immediate output.

title: Fund managers are betting on copper amid exploding AI demand
summary: Fund managers stay bullish on copper as record LME prices reflect surging AI/data-center and EV demand, while supply remains constrained by mine disruptions (including flooding at major operations). Investors also point to M&A and stockpiling ahead of potential tariffs, supporting expectations for tighter markets, even with macro and dollar-related risks.

title: SLAM Exploration Ltd.: SLAM Acquires New Copper Nickel Cobalt Showing Adjacent to Goodwin
summary: SLAM Exploration said it acquired the Mount Raymond claim adjoining its Goodwin copper-nickel-cobalt project, expanding coverage within a 25 km belt in New Brunswick. Historical drilling reported chalcopyrite/pyrrhotite mineralization with grades up to 0.43% copper and 0.12% nickel, plus cobalt. It also reports completion of VTEM surveying.

title: Zambia's Growth Seen Accelerating to 6.1% in 2026 on Copper Output, Lower Inflation
summary: Fitch Solutions expects Zambia’s growth to accelerate, driven mainly by rising copper production and easing inflation. It forecasts Zambia’s copper output to increase 10% in 2026, boosting exports and investment interest. Risks include potential Middle East-related supply disruptions to copper inputs like sulfur.

title: Algo Grande Copper Corp.: Algo Grande Identifies Additional Skarn Mineralization 3km South of Cerro Grande, With Samples Above 3% Copper and Confirms Copper in Multiple Targets on the Property
summary: Algo Grande provides an exploration update from its Adelita project in Sonora, including surface samples with grades above 1% Cu, discovery of a new skarn zone at Potrero South with samples over 3% Cu, and progress from Phase I drilling at Cerro Grande with assays pending. The release is copper-focused.

title: Faraday Copper Corp.: Faraday Copper Announces Closing of C$100 Million Offering with Participation by a Lundin Family Trust and BHP
summary: Faraday Copper Corp. closed a C$100 million non-brokered private placement, with participation from a Lundin Family Trust and BHP. The net proceeds will fund advancement of its Arizona copper projects, including integrating the San Manuel property from BHP. The financing can improve near-term development outlook for added U.S. copper supply.

title: FinancialContent - Dr. Copper's New Diagnosis: Why the 'Wiring of the Energy Transition' is Defying Traditional Economics
summary: Copper prices are surging on a structural deficit narrative: late-2025 disruptions at Indonesia’s Grasberg mine and DRC logistics bottlenecks tightened supply while AI data centers and electrification demand surged. Inventories are described as at historic lows, pushing copper near $13,500/t and potentially toward $15,000 with additional risks.

title: Questcorp Mining completes IP survey at BC's North Island Copper Project
summary: Questcorp Mining says it has completed an IP survey at its North Island copper project on Canada’s BC North Island. This is an exploration step aimed at improving understanding of the subsurface for potential copper resources. It is supportive for the project timeline but not a direct near-term supply driver.

title: Questcorp Mining completes IP survey North Island Copper Project
summary: Questcorp Mining completed a 12.8-line km IP survey over the Marisa Zone of its North Island copper project in British Columbia, confirming a historical chargeability anomaly tied to copper mineralisation. The company will build a 3D inversion model and seek permits for drilling in late H1 or early H2 2026.

title: Star Copper Corp.: Star Copper Announces Closing of Oversubscribed Flow-Through Share Private Placement
summary: Star Copper Corp. closed an oversubscribed flow-through private placement raising about C$7.3 million, upsized for additional gross proceeds. Funds will be used for exploration spending on its Star Project in British Columbia, including an expanded 2026 drill program. The release supports copper development but signals no immediate supply impact.

title: 9 Best Aluminum and Aluminum Mining Stocks to Invest In
summary: Citing Reuters and analyst commentary, the article links Iran/hostilities to disruption in aluminum supply, including a smelter declaring force majeure and another winding down operations. It notes Middle East contributions to global and US supply and suggests announced idling could take months to normalize, supporting higher aluminum prices.

title: World's top bauxite producer considers export curbs after
summary: Fastmarkets reports Guinea is considering export curbs or reduced export quotas after bauxite prices plunged ~50% in 2025 amid oversupply to China. The measures aim to limit shipments and possibly encourage local refining/smelting. Analysts say curbs may need actual production cuts to lift prices.

title: Canada Nickel Company aims to break ground by year's end
summary: Canada Nickel Company says the Crawford Project has received major federal and Ontario permitting boosts, enabling faster financing, engineering, and the aim to break ground before year-end. The CEO reiterates it will become the western world’s largest nickel sulphide operation and outlines additional deposits and electric arc furnace processing.

title: Century Aluminum (NASDAQ:CENX) Sets New 52-Week High  – Still a Buy?
summary: Century Aluminum shares hit a new 52-week high as analysts reiterated or upgraded ratings and raised price targets. The company recently reported in-line quarterly results and investors highlighted strong institutional buying. As a primary aluminum smelter, the upbeat sentiment is likely to support near-term aluminium price expectations.

title: Canyon Resources Shareholders Block Afriland Stake in Minim Martap Bauxite Project
summary: Canyon Resources’ shareholders rejected part of a capital-raising plan to fund the Minim Martap bauxite project in Cameroon, blocking a second tranche involving Afriland and Eagle Eye. The company says the initial phase is still funded and maintains its timeline to begin mining in late March 2026 and ship first cargo in 3Q 2026.

title: Nickel market could turn to deficit amid Indonesia quota
summary: Macquarie says nickel prices could rise further this year as Indonesia, the top producer, limits production starts. The resulting supply shortage may deepen into a market deficit, tightening near-term availability and supporting higher nickel prices as the production limits feed through to output and supply.

title: 'The last frontier': how red globules of nickel ore are suffocating an island's precious wilderness | Mining
summary: A Guardian report describes nickel laterite mining on Palawan, Philippines, with communities alleging silt runoff harms fisheries, rice fields and coral. The mine (Ipilan) has faced protests, license challenges and cease-and-desist orders that were later overturned, keeping output uncertain and potentially constraining nickel supply.

title: Abitibi Metals Corp.: Abitibi Metals Achieves Early Exercise of B26 Option, Securing 80% Ownership of the High-Grade Copper-Gold Project in Quebec
summary: Abitibi Metals secured 80% ownership of the B26 high-grade copper-gold polymetallic project in Quebec through early option exercise with SOQUEM. The company reports a 124% growth in its mineral resource estimate and plans a fully funded 40,000-metre drill program in 2026, with Abitibi as operator.

title: White Gold Corp. Makes New High-Grade Copper Discovery with Bedrock ...
summary: White Gold Corp. announced discovery of high-grade copper mineralization at the Lost Pup target on its Hen property in Yukon, with rock samples assaying up to 0.96% Cu and chalcopyrite-bearing quartz veins plus malachite/azurite. The company plans further exploration and catalysts, but the find’s market impact on near-term supply is uncertain.

title: Northstar Gold Corp.: Northstar Intersects High-Grade VMS Depth Extension at Cam Copper 3.05% Cu, 5.9 g/t Au, 22.9 g/t Ag, 0.45% Mo over 3.07 Metres; 13.95% Cu Bornite Intercept at Depth
summary: Northstar Gold reports strong high-grade copper-bearing VMS intercepts at its Cam Copper Mine (Zone 2), including multiple high-grade Cu domains and indications of increasing grade with depth. The company plans to update models and step-out drilling, supporting potential resource expansion and improved copper supply prospects.

title: Prysmian Partners with Rio Tinto for Innovative Aluminum Solution with ...
summary: Prysmian and Rio Tinto partnered to supply Prysmian’s U.S. aluminum building wire produced with Rio Tinto’s ELYSIS low-carbon technology. The announcement builds on a five-year low-carbon aluminum supply agreement and positions ELYSIS as suitable for wire and cable, though large-scale availability is still limited.

title: FinancialContent - The Red Metal's AI Renaissance: Copper Supercycle Hits Fever Pitch as Futures Hold Above $5.90
summary: Copper futures are holding above $5.90/lb amid multi-year tightness in refined supply, including prior mine and Asia smelter/refinery disruptions and multi-year low inventories. The piece links demand acceleration to AI data-center buildout and electrification, projecting ongoing deficit risk and persistent bullish momentum.

title: FinancialContent - Aluminum's Tightrope Walk: Global Market Braces for Structural Deficits Amid Energy and AI Power Struggles
summary: The article forecasts continued aluminum tightness as a global deficit widens (citing Reuters and Rusal), LME inventories face drawdowns, and energy/power bidding by AI data centers squeezes smelter margins. It also notes rising premiums in Japan and sanctions/force majeure risks, supporting further price strength.

title: FinancialContent - BHP's $14 Billion Chile Strategy: Fighting the Global Copper Crunch
summary: BHP is accelerating a $10–14 billion Chile investment plan focused on copper supply expansion and efficiency, including a new Escondida concentrator and restarting Cerro Colorado. Chile’s new pro-mining administration aims to speed permitting. The piece frames these moves as closing a looming global copper shortfall driven by AI and green energy demand.

title: Rio Tinto, Prysmian Partner To Produce Low-carbon Aluminum Cables For Data Centers
summary: Rio Tinto and Prysmian are running an industrial trial to produce low-carbon aluminum cables for data centers. The aluminum rod uses low-carbon supply from Rio Tinto’s hydro-powered Alma smelter and ELYSIS technology to eliminate direct smelting emissions. The companies also have a five-year supply agreement.

title: Indonesian nickel company scrubbed coal power disclosures after complaint to SGX
summary: Market Forces says Indonesia’s Harita Group removed specific figures on coal power capacity tied to electricity supply for its nickel smelting operations after an SGX-linked complaint involving OCBC. The scrutiny raises transparency and potential sustainability-breach concerns, increasing perceived compliance/financing risk for nickel producers.

title: Tens of thousands worth of copper wire stolen, police asking for information
summary: Sioux Falls police are seeking information about thieves who stole roughly 750 feet of copper wire from a business, valued at about $30,000. The report is a local theft case with a possible reward but provides no broader supply, production, or market-level impacts for copper prices.

title: Tartisan Nickel Corp.: Tartisan Nickel Corp. Proposes $1,000,000 Flow-Through Financing at $0.38 per Share
summary: Tartisan Nickel Corp. announced a non-brokered flow-through financing of up to $1,000,000 at $0.38/share to fund eligible Canadian exploration expenses. Proceeds will support further work at its Kenbridge Nickel-Copper-Cobalt project in Northwestern Ontario. The release is financing-focused, implying limited immediate impact on nickel/copper prices.

title: Middle East conflict might create supply constraints, raise in aluminium premiums in Mexico
summary: Tensions around the Strait of Hormuz are disrupting logistics for GCC primary aluminium exports, with port delays, suspended shipping, and force majeure notices from producers. Supply concerns have pushed LME aluminium higher and increased Mexico premiums for billet and extrusion billet, reflecting imminent tighter availability and higher costs.

title: Small Business Pauses Expansion as Aluminum Tariffs Persist
summary: A small U.S. manufacturer of aluminium aircraft parts says Section 232 aluminium tariffs remain in force despite a court halt on other tariff authority. Aluminum input costs are up sharply, prompting hiring freezes, postponed expansion, and a tariff surcharge to customers, signaling weaker near-term aluminium demand.

title: Tennessee bill would let cash purchases round to nickels as pennies vanish nationwide
summary: Tennessee has passed a bill allowing cash purchases to round to the nearest nickel as pennies fade after the U.S. Treasury suspended penny production due to cost. The state aims to reduce liability for lawful rounding, while noting Treasury expects rounding to boost nickel demand.

title: Copper Fox Metals Inc.: Copper Fox Provides Update on Results of 2025 Program at Schaft Creek
summary: Copper Fox reported receipt of geotechnical, environmental, meteorological, glacier, and hydrogeology reports from the 2025 Schaft Creek program managed with Teck. The studies indicate no significant changes from prior work and support scoping-level design, with recommendations for further data collection to advance permitting.

title: FinancialContent - Alcoa Corp. (AA): The Industrial Pivot to AI Infrastructure and the Aluminum Surge
summary: The piece centers on Alcoa’s outlook amid a surge in global aluminum prices, citing geopolitical supply disruptions and the energy/green-transition demand backdrop. It also notes protective U.S. tariffs and CBAM-related low-carbon premiums that support realized aluminum pricing. The JPMorgan upgrade reinforces bullish sentiment toward aluminum-linked earnings.

title: 1950s Yorkshire aluminium bascule bridge set for off-site refurbishment to remedy corrosion
summary: A 73-year-old aluminium bascule bridge in Yorkshire will be removed and refurbished off-site for about three months after inspectors found corrosion and component deterioration. Work includes structural repairs, replacement of mechanical/electrical systems, and repainting, then reinstallation and reopening later this summer, with temporary closures during testing.

title: Asiamet shares jump 10% as Chinese regulator clears KSK copper project sale
summary: Asiamet shares jumped 10% after a Chinese regulator cleared the sale of its KSK copper project. The approval lowers regulatory uncertainty around bringing the asset to its new ownership, improving expectations for copper supply and supporting bullish sentiment toward copper prices.

title: EV Nickel Inc.: CORRECTION FROM SOURCE: EV Nickel Announces Maiden Mineral Resource Estimate for Gemini North Nickel Zone
summary: EV Nickel announced a maiden mineral resource estimate for the Gemini North Nickel Zone at its Shaw Dome project. The release provides nickel grades and contained nickel (including pit-constrained starter resources) and notes metallurgical recovery assumptions for a future open pit. It is a resource update, not an immediate supply disruption.

title: WA Police confirm worker's death at South32's Worsley Alumina refinery
summary: WA Police and Worksafe are investigating a fatal contractor injury at South32’s Worsley Alumina refinery near Collie. South32 paused non-essential work to protect safety and site stability while inquiries proceed. Such disruption to alumina output can affect near-term supply expectations, generally weighing on aluminium prices.

title: Middle East Tensions, Shipping Disruptions Fuel Aluminium Price Rally
summary: Middle East tensions and shipping disruptions are adding to a recent aluminium rally by threatening roughly 5.14 million tonnes of supply via key export routes around the Strait of Hormuz. The piece cites tight LME warehouse inventories and Mozal production cuts, supporting a strong bullish near-term outlook for aluminium prices.

title: Middles East Crisis Ups Aluminium Prices, New Battery Tech To Support Long-Term Demand
summary: The piece links aluminium’s recent surge to Middle East tensions disrupting key export routes, threatening up to 5.14 million tonnes of supply, alongside falling LME inventories and smelter cuts (e.g., Mozal). It expects further upside if disruptions persist, with additional supportive demand narratives from EV/battery tech.

title: EU Commission started investigation on Việt Nam's copper tubes
summary: The European Commission began an anti-dumping investigation into coiled copper tubes and pipes imported from Vietnam and other countries after a complaint from EU copper tube manufacturers.
